jobs.title: Chief Audit Executive
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS).
jobs.summary: Chief Audit Executive position within the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, offering R1 554 696 per annum at SMS Level 14.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a Bachelor’s degree or Advanced Diploma in Internal Auditing / Risk Management / Financial Management / Law (LLB) / Forensic Investigation (NQF Level 7). Membership of the Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIA SA). Successful completion of Pre-entry Certificate for SMS as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). Job related work experience: Minimum of five (5) years’ experience at a senior managerial level (auditing, project management, financial and operational management. Project management. Membership of the Institute of Internal Auditors is recommended. Job related knowledge: Project Management best practice. The Standards of the Institute of Internal Auditors. Risk based Internal Audit methodologies and procedures and software. Job related skills: Written and verbal communication skills. Interviewing skills. Analytical and problem-solving ability. Staff and interpersonal skills. Project management skills. Computer skills. Business process analysis skills. Risk and Control assessment skills. A valid driver’s licence. Ability to travel and work irregular hours.
jobs.duties: Manage the compilation of the Internal Audit and Forensic Investigations strategic and operational plans in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on an annual basis: Manage the development and updating of methodologies, policies and procedures in line with the best practise and the International Standards of the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) and the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) Professional Standards on an annual basis. Manage the compilation of the Chief Directorate’s strategic plan and operational plan by April each year. Manage the compilation of the Chief Directorate’s Internal Audit operational and process risk registers by April each year. Manage the compilation of the Internal Audit Strategic 3-year Rolling and Annual Internal Audit Plans by April each year. Coordinate with other internal and external service assurance providers to ensure proper risk coverage and to minimise duplication of effort. Manage the compilation of the Forensic Investigations Comprehensive and Annual Case Management Registers by April each year. Manage the implementation of the Internal Audit and Forensic Investigations strategic and operational plans in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on a continuous basis: Manage the achievement of the Chief Directorate’s strategic and operational objectives on a continuous basis and report progress to the Director-General on a monthly basis. Manage the achievement of the Chief Directorate Internal Audit risk register action plans on a continuous basis and report progress to the Director-General on a monthly basis. Manage the achievement of the Internal Audit Strategic 3-year Rolling and Annual Internal Audit Plan’s deliverables on a monthly basis and report progress to the Audit Committee and the Director-General on a quarterly basis. Manage the achievement of the Forensic Investigations Comprehensive and Annual Case Management Registers on a monthly basis and report progress to the Audit Committee and the Director-General on a quarterly basis. Manage the performance of Quality Assessment reviews on the annual internal audit plans projects on a continuous basis, the annual Internal Quality Assessment Review and the five yearly External Quality Assessment Review and report the results of the annual and five yearly reviews to the Audit Committee and Director-General. Manage the reliance of the Audit-General of Soth Africa on the work performed and reports issued by the Internal Audit and Forensic Investigations Directorates on a monthly basis and report progress to the Audit Committee and the Director-General on an annual basis. Manage the implementation of the Internal Audit Report’s Action Plans and the Forensic Investigations Report’s Recommendations by line management on a quarterly basis: Manage the requests for progress reports from line management on the implementation of action plans on all internal audit reports and implementation of recommendations on all forensic investigation reports on a quarterly basis. Manage the analysis of the line management’s status of implementation of action plans of Internal Audit Reports and recommendations of Forensic Investigations Reports and clarification of statuses with line managers on a quarterly basis. Manage the preparation of progress reports on the implementation of management action plans and recommendations presentations to the Audit Committee and Director-General on a quarterly basis. Manage the co-ordination of the Audit Committee Meetings and Audit Committee In-committee Meetings on a continuous basis: Manage the contracts and payments of the Audit Committee Members on a continuous basis. Manage the co-ordination and secretariat function of the Audit Committee meetings and Audit Committee In-committee meetings as per the Audit Committee annual work plan. Manage the co-ordination of the Audit Committee meetings with the Minister as per the Audit Committee annual work plan. Manage the Audit Committee In-committee meetings with the departmental management, the AGSA and the Chief Directorate Internal Audit as per the Audit Committee annual work plan. Manage the Chief Directorate Internal Audit’s resources: Manage human, logistical and financial resources allocated to this position on an on-going basis in line with Departmental prescripts.
jobs.enquiries: Ms K Kgang Tel No: (012) 319 7331
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email CAErecruit81@nda.gov.za OTHER POSTS
jobs.notes: To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates, for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoof-oudit-uitvoerende beampte
af.summary: Hoof-oudit-uitvoerende beampte-posisie by die Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, wat R1 554 696 per jaar bied op SMS-vlak 14.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Bachelorsgraad of Gevorderde Diploma in Interne Oudit / Risikobestuur / Finansiële Bestuur / Regte (LLB) / Misdaadondersoek (NQF-vlak 7). Lidmaatskap van die Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIA SA). Voltooiing van die Toetreedsertifikaat vir SMS soos onderskryf deur die National School of Government (NSG). Werksverwante werkervaring: Minimum van vyf (5) jaar ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak (ouditering, projeksbestuur, finansiële en operasionele bestuur). Projekbestuur. Lidmaatskap van die Institute of Internal Auditors word aanbeveel. Werksverwante kennis: Beste praktyk in projekbestuur. Die standaarde van die Institute of Internal Auditors. Risiko-gebaseerde interne ouditmetodologieë en prosedures en sagteware. Werksverwante vaardighede: Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Onderhoudvoeringsvaardighede. Analitiese en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Personeel en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. Besigheidsprosesanalise-vaardighede. Risiko- en beheerassesseringsvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vermoë om te reis en onreëlmatige ure te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur die opstel van die Interne Oudit- en Misdaadondersoeke strategiese en operasionele planne in ooreenstemming met die Hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandaarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n jaarlikse basis. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en opdatering van metodologieë, beleide en prosedures in ooreenstemming met die beste praktyk en die Internasionale Standaarde van die Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) en die Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) se professionele standaarde op 'n jaarlikse basis. Bestuur die opstel van die Hoofdirektoraat se strategiese plan en operasionele plan teen April elke jaar. Bestuur die opstel van die Hoofdirektoraat se Interne Oudit operasionele en prosesrisikoregisters teen April elke jaar. Bestuur die opstel van die Interne Oudit Strategiese 3-jaar Rol- en Jaarlikse Interne Ouditplanne teen April elke jaar. Koördineer met ander interne en eksterne diensversekeringsverskaffers om behoorlike risikodekking te verseker en duplisering van werk te minimaliseer. Bestuur die opstel van die Misdaadondersoeke Omvattende en Jaarlikse Saakbestuurregisters teen April elke jaar. Bestuur die implementering van die Interne Oudit- en Misdaadondersoeke strategiese en operasionele planne in ooreenstemming met die Hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandaarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis. Bestuur die bereiking van die Hoofdirektoraat se strategiese en operasionele doelwitte op 'n deurlopende basis en rapporteer vordering aan die Direkteur-generaal op 'n maandelikse basis. Bestuur die bereiking van die Hoofdirektoraat Interne Oudit risikoregister aksieplanne op 'n deurlopende basis en rapporteer vordering aan die Direkteur-generaal op 'n maandelikse basis. Bestuur die bereiking van die Interne Oudit Strategiese 3-jaar Rol- en Jaarlikse Interne Ouditplan se lewerings op 'n maandelikse basis en rapporteer vordering aan die Ouditkomitee en die Direkteur-generaal op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die bereiking van die Misdaadondersoeke Omvattende en Jaarlikse Saakbestuurregisters op 'n maandelikse basis en rapporteer vordering aan die Ouditkomitee en die Direkteur-generaal op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die uitvoering van Kwaliteitsassesseringshersienings op die jaarlikse interne ouditplan-projekte op 'n deurlopende basis, die jaarlikse Interne Kwaliteitsassesseringshersiening en die vyfjaarlikse Eksterne Kwaliteitsassesseringshersiening en rapporteer die resultate van die jaarlikse en vyfjaarlikse hersienings aan die Ouditkomitee en Direkteur-generaal. Bestuur die staatmaak van die Auditor-General of South Africa op die werk verrig en verslae uitgereik deur die Interne Oudit- en Misdaadondersoeke Direktorate op 'n maandelikse basis en rapporteer vordering aan die Ouditkomitee en die Direkteur-generaal op 'n jaarlikse basis. Bestuur die implementering van die Interne Ouditverslag se Aksieplanne en die Misdaadondersoekeverslag se aanbevelings deur lynbestuur op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die versoeke om vorderingsverslae van lynbestuur oor die implementering van aksieplanne op alle interne ouditverslae en die implementering van aanbevelings op alle misdaadondersoekverslae op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die ontleding van die lynbestuur se status van implementering van aksieplanne van Interne Ouditverslae en aanbevelings van Misdaadondersoekeverslae en die verduideliking van statusse met lynbestuurders op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die voorbereiding van vorderingsverslae oor die implementering van bestuursaksieplanne en voorleggings van aanbevelings aan die Ouditkomitee en Direkteur-generaal op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die koördinering van die Ouditkomiteevergaderings en Ouditkomitee In-komiteevergaderings op 'n deurlopende basis. Bestuur die kontrakte en betalings van die Ouditkomiteelede op 'n deurlopende basis. Bestuur die koördinering en sekretariaatfunksie van die Ouditkomiteevergaderings en Ouditkomitee In-komiteevergaderings volgens die Ouditkomitee se jaarlikse werkplan. Bestuur die koördinering van die Ouditkomiteevergaderings met die Minister volgens die Ouditkomitee se jaarlikse werkplan. Bestuur die Ouditkomitee In-komiteevergaderings met die departementele bestuur, die AGSA en die Hoofdirektoraat Interne Oudit volgens die Ouditkomitee se jaarlikse werkplan. Bestuur die Hoofdirektoraat Interne Oudit se hulpbronne. Bestuur die menslike, logistieke en finansiële hulpbronne wat aan hierdie posisie toegewys is op 'n deurlopende basis in ooreenstemming met departementele voorskrifte.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiyinhloko Sokuhlola Iziphakamiso
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuPhathi Esiyinhloko Sokuhlola Iziphakamiso kumnyango we-Agriculture ePretoria, sinikeza iholo le-R1 554 696 ngonyaka emazingeni e-SMS Level 14.
zu.requirements: Abafakelayo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's degree noma i-Advanced Diploma kwi-Internal Auditing / Risk Management / Financial Management / Law (LLB) / Forensic Investigation (NQF Level 7). Kumele kube ngamalungu e-Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIA SA). Kumele bagqibe ngemuva i-Pre-entry Certificate for SMS njengoba kunconyiwe yi-National School of Government (NSG). Ukunakekelwa kwemisebenzi ehlobene nendima: Amava anomthetho ocashwe kuwona ubuncane eminyakeni eyisihlanu (5) emazingeni aphakeme okubusa (ukuqeqeswa, ukuphatha imiklamo, uphatho lwezimali kanye nokuphatha imisebenzi. Ukuphatha imiklamo. Ukuba yilungu le-Institute of Internal Auditors kunconywa. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izenzo ezinhle zokuqeqesha imiklamo. Izindinganiso ze-Institute of Internal Auditors. Indlela kanye namasiko okuhlola ngokubhekiswa engozini ukwangaphakathi kanye namaphiloshemu. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma. Amakhono okubuzwa imibuzo. Amakhono okuhlaziya futhi axazulule izinkinga. Amakhono wokuphatha izisebenzi kanye nabantu. Amakhono wokuphatha imiklamo. Amakhono wokusebenzisa isikhompyutha. Amakhono wokuhlaziya inqubo yebhizinisi. Amakhono okuhlonza ingozi nolawulo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukukwazi ukuhamba futhi usebenze emahoreni angajwayelekile.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuhunyushwa kwezinhlelo ezinkulu kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuHlola ngaphakathi kanye noPhenyo Izinkohlakalo ngokuya ngeminganana yekhwalithi, izindlela, izinqumo kanye namasiko eChief Directorate minyaka yonke: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekezwa kwezindlela, izinqumo namasiko ngokuya ngokwenza okuhle kanye ngezindinganiso zamazwe ngamazwe ze-Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) kanye nezindinganiso zomsebenzi ze-Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) minyaka yonke. Phatha ukuhunyushwa kwenqubo enkulu eyisinqubo kanye nenqubo yokusebenza yeChief Directorate ngase-Eprili minyaka yonke. Phatha ukuhunyushwa kwezibhalo zengozi zokuHlola ngaphakathi kanye nenqubo yokusebenza yeChief Directorate ngase-Eprili minyaka yonke. Phatha ukuhunyushwa kwe-Internal Audit Strategic 3-year Rolling kanye ne-Annual Internal Audit Plans ngase-Eprili minyaka yonke. Hlanganisa nabanye abanikezeli bethembile banganaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwingozi okufanele kanye nokwehlisa ukuphindaphinda imisebenzi. Phatha ukuhunyushwa kwe-Forensic Investigations Comprehensive kanye ne-Annual Case Management Registers ngase-Eprili minyaka yonke. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ezinkulu nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuHlola ngaphakathi kanye noPhenyo Izinkohlakalo ngokuya ngeminganana yekhwalithi, izindlela, izinqumo namasiko eChief Directorate ngokuqhubeka: Phatha ukufeza imigomo enkulu eyisinqubo kanye nemigomo yokuHlola iChief Directorate ngokuqhubeka futhi umbikele umbhalo ku-Director-General nyanga zonke. Phatha ukufeza izinhlelo zenzo zeChief Directorate Internal Audit zokubhala izibhalo zengozi ngokuqhubeka futhi umbikele umbhalo ku-Director-General nyanga zonke. Phatha ukufeza izinto ezifanele zokuHlolwa e-Internal Audit Strategic 3-year Rolling kanye ne-Annual Internal Audit Plan's zanyanga zonke futhi umbikele umbhalo ku-Audit Committee kanye no-Director-General kwindla yonke. Phatha ukufeza i-Forensic Investigations Comprehensive kanye ne-Annual Case Management Registers nyanga zonke futhi umbikele umbhalo ku-Audit Committee kanye no-Director-General kwindla yonke. Phatha ukwenza izibuyekezo zokuHlolwa ikhwalithi ezinhlelweni ezinkulu zokuHlola minyaka yonke ngokuqhubeka, i-annual Internal Quality Assessment Review kanye ne-five yearly External Quality Assessment Review futhi umbike imiphumela yezibuyekezo zonyaka nazinyanga ezinhlanu ku-Audit Committee kanye no-Director-General. Phatha ukuthembela kuka-Audit-General of South Africa emsebenzi owenziwe nakuhibhade lokhishwe yi-Directorates yokuHlola ngaphakathi kanye noPhenyo Izinkohlakalo nyanga zonke futhi umbike umbhalo ku-Audit Committee kanye no-Director-General minyaka yonke. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zenzo zabhalo zokuHlola ngaphakathi kanye nezincomo zebhodi lokuPhenya Izinkohlakalo ngabaphathi bemiThetho kwindla yonke: Phatha izicelo zezibhalo zokuqhubela phambili kusuka kubaphathi bemithetho ekusetshenzweni kwezinhlelo zenzo zazo zonke izibhalo zokuHlola ngaphakathi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezincomo kuyo yonke imibhalo yokuPhenya Izinkohlakalo kwindla yonke. Phatha ukuhlaziya isimo sokusebenza kwaba phathi bemithetho ekusetshenzweni kwezinhlelo zenzo zabhalo bokuHlola ngaphakathi kanye nezincomo zabhalo bokuPhenya Izinkohlakalo kanye nokucacisa izimo kubaphathi bemithetho kwindla yonke. Phatha ukulungiswa kwemibhalo yokuqhubela phambili ekusetshenzweni kwezinhlelo zenzo zabaphathi kanye nezincomo ezibhalwe phambi kwe-Audit Committee kanye no-Director-General kwindla yonke. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa kwemiThetho ye-Audit Committee Meetings ne-Audit Committee In-committee Meetings ngokuqhubeka: Phatha izivumelwano kanye nokuKhokha kwamalungu e-Audit Committee ngokuqhubeka. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa kanye nomsebenzi wokuba ngumnyali we-Audit Committee meetings kanye ne-Audit Committee In-committee meetings ngokuya ngohlelo lweminyaka yonke lwe-Audit Committee. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Audit Committee meetings kanye neMinista ngokuya ngohlelo lweminyaka yonke lwe-Audit Committee. Phatha i-Audit Committee In-committee meetings nomphathi womnyango, i-AGSA kanye neChief Directorate Internal Audit ngokuya ngohlelo lweminyaka yonke lwe-Audit Committee. Phatha izinsiza ze-Chief Directorate Internal Audit: Phatha izinsiza zomuntu, ezokuthutha nangezimali ezabelwe lesi sikhundla ngokuya ngemithetho yomnyango ngokuqhubeka.

xh.title: Noxulu Ophethe uVavavo Oluphakamileyo
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguNoxulu Ophethe uVavavo Oluphakamileyo kwisebe lezeZolimo ePretoria,elinika R1 554 696 ngonyaka kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 14.
xh.requirements: Abafakiselwa kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 negunya le-Bachelor okanye i-Advanced Diploma kwiVavavo langaphakathi / uLawulo loMngcipheko / uLawulo lweMali / umMiso woMthetho (LLB) / uPonyo lweNtsebenzo yeZophulomthetho (NQF Level 7). Ukuba lilungu le-Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIA SA). Ukuqedela ngempumelelo isatifikethi sangaphakathi kwi-SMS njengokuqatshiwe yi-National School of Government (NSG). Imfundo enxulumene nomsebenzi okungenisa isiphaluka: Amava amabalwa (5) eminyaka ubuncwane kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo (ukuvavava, ulawulo lweenkqubo, ulawulo lweemali nolusebenzayo. Ulawulo lweenkqubo. Ukuba lilungu le-Institute of Internal Auditors kunconywa. Ulwazi oluxulumene nomsebenzi: Iziseko ezilungileyo zoLawulo lweenkqubo. IiStandard ze-Institute of Internal Auditors. Iindlela neziqu zokuvavavo langaphakathi ngenkqubo yomngcipheko. Amakhono axulumene nomsebenzi: Amakhono wobhalo nakwethethura. Amakhono ekubuzeni imibuzo. Isakhono sokuhlalutya nokusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono abasebenzi nokuhamba nabantu. Amakhono olawulo lweenkqubo. Amakhono ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Amakhono ekuhlalutyeni iinkqubo zeshishini. Amakhono okuqamba nokuqinisekisa umngcipheko. Ilayisenisi yokushayela eyasebenzayo. Isakhono sokuhamba nokusebenza iiyure ezingaqhelekanga.
xh.duties: Phatha ukulungiselelwa kweenkqubo zomgama nezomsebenzi zeVavavo langaphakathi nezoPonyo lweZophulomthetho ngokwemilinganiselo yekhwalithi, iindlela, iinkqubo nezicwangciso zeChief Directorate ngonyaka wonyaka: Phatha ukuphuhliswa nokuhlaziya kwezindlela, iinkqubo nezenzo ngokweziseko ezilungileyo ngeeStandard zeNgamazwe ngamazwe ze-Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) nezenzo ezingcwetywe ngamabala yi-Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) Professional Standards ngonyaka wonyaka. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kwenkqubo yomgama nenkqubo yomsebenzi yeChief Directorate ngo-April ngamnye. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kwezicwangciso zomsebenzi nolwazi lokuswela kwezinkqubo zeVavavo langaphakathi zeChief Directorate ngo-April ngamnye. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kweNkqubo Yomgama yeVavavo langaphakathi eqhutywa kwiminyaka emithathu neNkqubo Yonyaka yeVavavo langaphakathi ngo-April ngamnye. Linganisa nabanye abanikezeli bokuqinisekisa inkonzo bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubanzi komngcipheko nokunciphisa ukuphinda kwenziwa imisebenzi. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kweNkqubo eBanzi yePonyo lweZophulomthetho neNkqubo Yonyaka yoLawulo lweMimisela ngo-April ngamnye. Phatha ukuphunywa kwexesha kweenkqubo zomgama nezomsebenzi zeVavavo langaphakathi nezoPonyo lweZophulomthetho ngokwemilinganiselo yekhwalithi, iindlela, iinkqubo nezenzo zeChief Directorate ngokutohloka kwexesha: Phatha ukufezekiswa kwemigama nemiqulu yomsebenzi yeChief Directorate ngokutohloka kwexesha uxelele inkqubela kwi-Director-General ngenyanga. Phatha ukufezekiswa kwezenzo zenkqubo yomngcipheko weVavavo langaphakathi yeChief Directorate ngokutohloka kwexesha uxelele inkqubela kwi-Director-General ngenyanga. Phatha ukufezekiswa kwezinto ezelwe yiNkqubo Yomgama yeVavavo langaphakathi eqhutywa kwiminyaka emithathu neNkqubo Yonyaka yeVavavo langaphakathi ngenyanga uxelele inkqubela kwi-Audit Committee naseku-Director-General kwikatrhetha. Phatha ukufezekiswa kweNkqubo eBazi neyoNyaka yoLawulo lweMimisela yePonyo lweZophulomthetho ngenyanga uxelele inkqubela kwi-Audit Committee naseku-Director-General kwikatrhetha. Phatha ukusebenza kokuVavavo uluhlu lolungiselelo lwekhwalithi kwiinkqubo zenkqubo yonyaka yevavavo langaphakathi ngokutohloka kwexesha, ukuVavava ulungiselelo lweKhwalithi lwaNgaphakathi lwaNyaka nokuVavava ulungiselelo lweKhwalithi lwaNgaphandle kwiminyaka emihlanu uze uxele iziphumo koluhlu lwaNyaka nalwalwa kwiminyaka emihlanu ku-Audit Committee naku-Director-General. Phatha ukuthembela kolawulo jikelele lwaseMzantsi Afrika ekuwenziweni komsebenzi nakumagunya apapashiweyo ziNdawo zeVavavo langaphakathi nezoPonyo lweZophulomthetho ngenyanga uze uxele inkqubela kwi-Audit Committee naseku-Director-General ngonyaka. Phatha ukuphunywa kwexesha kweNkqubo yezenzo zeCedulo lweVavavo langaphakathi neziKumceli zecadulo lePonyo lweZophulomthetho ngabaphathi benkqubo kwikatrhetha: Phatha iimfuno zeedatala zecadulo lwenkqubela kubaphathi benkqubo malunga nokuphunywa kwexesha kweenkqubo ezenziwayo kuyo yonke iindatala zovavavo langaphakathi nokuphunywa kwexesha kwezikumceli kuyo yonke iindatala zoponyo lwezophulomthetho kwikatrhetha. jobs.title: Deputy Director: Human Resource Policy (
jobs.salary_text: R896 436 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive remuneration package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS).
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Human Resource Policy position in Pretoria requiring a National Diploma in HR Management and 3 years' junior management experience in HR policy.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate and a National Diploma (NQF 6) in Human Resource Management/ Public Management/ Public Administration. Minimum of 3 years’ experience at junior management level in HR Policy environment. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Human Resource Policies. Knowledge of Human Resource Prescripts. Job related skills: Communication skills (verbal and written). Strategic planning and leadership. Presentation and facilitation skills. Conceptual skills and human relations. Policy drafting (Report writing). Negotiations and consultation with relevant key stakeholders. Computer literacy skills. Problem solving skills. A valid driver’s licence. Ability to travel and work irregular hours.
jobs.duties: Monitor HR Policies developed, reviewed, aligned, facilitated and implemented in the Department. Identify policies to be developed/ amended and aligned. Undertake gap analysis/ identify problems/ challenges/ research and best practices as and when required. Compile/ draft policies. Request inputs/ comment from stakeholders. Consider and consolidate inputs/ comment. Finalise draft policy. Consult policy at relevant forums (components, task teams, labour, DBC, management meetings). Finalise policy for consideration for approval from management (prepare memorandum/presentation). Assist and manage implementation of policy (communication). Monitor HR Delegations regarding PSA and PSR developed/ reviewed and implemented in Department. Identify HR functions to be delegated in accordance with prescripts/ legislation. Compile/ draft delegations. Request inputs/ comment from relevant stakeholders. Consider and consolidate inputs/ comment. Compile and finalise draft delegations (set of Delegations). Consult draft delegation at relevant forums if necessary. Finalise delegations for consideration for approval from management (prepare memorandum/ presentation). Assist and manage implementation of delegations (communication). HR Policies advocated to ensuring consistent implementation and application in the Department. Issue/ distribute approved policy. Arrange information sessions to advocate relevant policy (via Teams, Zoom or venue). Prepare/compile presentation on matter. Issue/distribute ICM with details of the session. Render/ assist/deal/advise on issues/matters and cases. HR Delegations advocated to ensure consistent implementation and application throughout the Department. Issue/ distribute approved/ amended delegations. Arrange information sessions to advocate relevant delegations (via Teams, Zoom or venue). Prepare/ compile presentation on matter. Issue/ distribute ICM with details of the session. Render/ assist/ deal/ advise on issues/ matters and cases. Manage and deal with HR related administrative functions/ activities/ tasks/ requests/ instructions as requested/ instructed by Management. Render/ assist/ deal/ advise on issues/ matters and cases as and when required. Analyse/ do research and obtain relevant prescripts. Consult relevant role players (Labour, legal, relevant Component). Compile response/ memorandum for consideration/ approval. Communicate approval/ advise/ outcome of decision.
jobs.enquiries: Mr C Mathebula Tel No: (012) 319 7322
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email DDHRPrecruit82@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: African Males and Persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates, for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Umkhulumeli Jele: Inqubomgomo Yezinsizakusebenza Abantu (
zu.summary: Isikhundla somKhulumeli Jele: Inqubomgomo Yezinsizakusebenza Abantu ePretoria esidinga iDiploma Yezwe kuYilwa kwezinsizakusebenza Abantu neminyaka emi-3 yokuqashwa ezingeni lemurongo lokuqasha kwinqubomgomo yezinsizakusebenza Abantu.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neDiploma Yezwe (NQF 6) kuYilwa kwezinsizakusebenza Abantu/ ukuYilwa Komphakathi/ ukuQondiswa Komphakathi. Okungenani iminyaka emi-3 yokuqashwa ezingeni lemurongo lokuqasha kwindawo yenqubomgomo yezinsizakusebenza Abantu. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwezinqubomgomo zezinsizakusebenza Abantu. Ulwazi lwezelayo zezinsizakusebenza Abantu. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okuxoxa (okubhalwayo nokuqoshwayo). Ukuhlela okubukhulu nokuba ngumholi. Amakhono okubhukuda nokuqondisa. Amakhono okucabanga kanye nobudlelwano nabantu. Ukuloba izinqubomgomo (ukubhala imibiko). Ukuxoxisana nokubonisana nabalingane ababalulekile abahlobene. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikono lokuhamba nokusebenza amahora angajwayelekile.
zu.duties: Qapha izinqubomgomo zezinsizakusebenza Abantu ezakhiwe, zibuyekezwe, zihambisane, ziqondiswe futhi zisetshenziswe kuyilowo nalowo umnyango. Hlukanisa izinqubomgomo okufanele zakhiwe/ zilungiswe futhi zihambisane. Yenza ukuhlaziywa kwesikhala/ thola izinkinga/ izinselelo/ ucwaningo kanye nezindlela ezinhle kunesikhathi esidingekayo. Hlanganisa/ bala izinqubomgomo. Cela izinkulumo/ imibono kubalingane. Cabanga futhi uhlanganise izinkulumo/ imibono. Qedela inqubomgomo ebhalwe. Xoxisana ngenqubomgomo eminhlanganweni ehlobene (izingxenye, amaqembu abasebenzi, abasebenzi abahlinzekwa umsebenzi, DBC, iminhlangano yokuqondisa). Qedela inqubomgomo ukuze icatshangelwe ukuze ivunyelwe ukuphuma kubaphathi (lungeza imemorandamu/ sithombe-mlando). Siza futhi uphathe ukusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo (ukuxoxa). Qapha amalungiselelo ezinsizakusebenza Abantu mayelana ne-PSA ne-PSR akhiwe/ abuyekezwe futhi asetshenziswe kuyilowo nalowo umnyango. Hlukanise imisebenzi yezinsizakusebenza Abantu okufanele inikezelwe ngokuvumelana nezelayo/ umthetho. Hlanganisa/ bala izinikezelo. Cela izinkulumo/ imibono kubalingane abahlobene. Cabanga futhi uhlanganise izinkulumo/ imibono. Hlanganisa futhi qedela izinikezelo ezibhalwe (uhlu lwazinikezelo). Xoxisana ngenikezelo ebhaliwe eminhlanganweni ehlobene uma kunesidingo. Qedela izinikezelo ukuze zicatshangelwe ukuze zivunyelwe ukuphuma kubaphathi (lungeza imemorandamu/ sithombe-mlando). Siza futhi uphathe ukusetshenziswa kwezinikezelo (ukuxoxa). Izinqubomgomo zezinsizakusebenza Abantu zikhuthazwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa nokusebenzisa okuhambisanayo kuyilowo nalowo umnyango. Khishisa/ sasaza inqubomgomo evunyiwe. Hlela izikhathi zolwazi ukuze kukhuthazwe inqubomgomo ehlobene (ngokusebenzisa i-Teams, Zoom noma indawo). Lungeza/ hlanganisa sithombe-mlando ngendaba. Khishisa/ sasaza i-ICM enemininingwane yesikhathi sokuhlangana. Nikeza/ siza/ phatha/ tela ngezinkinga/ izindaba kanye namacala. Amalungiselelo ezinsizakusebenza Abantu akhuthazwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa nokusebenzisa okuhambisanayo kuyo yonke indawo kuyilowo nalowo umnyango. Khishisa/ sasaza izinikezelo ezivunyiwe/ ezilungiwe. Hlela izikhathi zolwazi ukuze kukhuthazwe izinikezelo ezihlobene (ngokusebenzisa i-Teams, Zoom noma indawo). Lungeza/ hlanganisa sithombe-mlando ngendaba. Khishisa/ sasaza i-ICM enemininingwane yesikhathi sokuhlangana. Nikeza/ siza/ phatha/ tela ngezinkinga/ izindaba namacala uma kunesikhathi esidingekayo. Phatha futhi ukubambe ngemisebenzi yezinsizakusebenza Abantu ehlobene/ izinkomba/ umsebenzi/ izicelo/ imiyalo njengoba kuceliwe/ kuyalelwe ngokuphuma kubaphathi. Nikeza/ siza/ phatha/ tela ngezinkinga/ izindaba kanye namacala uma kunesikhathi esidingekayo. Hlaziya/ yenza ucwaningo futhi uthole izelayo ezihlobene. Xoxisana nabalinganeli abahlobene (Abasebenzi abahlinzekwa umsebenzi, abomthetho, izingxenye ezihlobene). Hlanganisa impendulo/ imemorandamu ukuze icatshangelwe/ ivunyelwe. Xoxa ukuvunywa/ yala/umphumela wesinqumo.

xh.title: Isekabaphathi: Inqaku leNgcobo yeMisebenzi (
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaSekabaphathi: Inqaku leNgcobo yeMisebenzi ePretoria esifuna iDiploma yeziZwe kokuLawulwa koMsebenzi wokuZinza kunye neminyaka 3 yamava ohlelweni lolawulo lasekhaya kwinqaku leNgcobo yeMisebenzi.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifiketi seGraji ye-12 kunye neDiploma yeZwe (NQF 6) kokuLawulwa koMsebenzi wokuZinza/ ukuLawulwa koLuntu/ uLawulo loLuntu. Amava amabalula eminyaka 3 kwinqanaba lolawulo lasekhaya kwimeko yokuNqamla koMsebenzi. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngeeNqaku zoLawulo loMsebenzi. Ulwazi ngeeMiyalelo yoLawulo loMsebenzi. Ikhono elihlobene nomsebenzi: Ikhono lokunxibelelwana (elishunquliweyo neliqoshiweyo). Uqwalaselo olusabekayo kunye nobukhosi bokulada. Ikhono lokubonisa nokuqhuba iindaba. Ikhono lokucinga ngokubakho kunye nezihlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ukubhala iinqaku (ukubhala iingxelo). Iintsomini kunye nokuquka nabathintekayo abaphambili. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokusombulula iingxaki. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulawulo lokuhamba kunye nokusebenza iiyure ezingajeloqo.
xh.duties: Qwalasela iiNqaku zoLawulo loMsebenzi ezenziwe, zihlolwe, zidibaniswe, ziqhutywe kwaye zisetyenziswe kwiSebe. Chonga iinqaku ezi kufuneka zenziwe/ zilungiswe kwaye zidibaniswe. Yima ukuqwalasela iindleko/ chonga iingxaki/ iingcinga/ uphando kunye neendlela ezilungileyo nangapandleoko xa kufuneka. Hlanganisa/ bhala iinqaku. Cela izimvo/ amagama kubathintekayo. Qwalasela kwaye udibanise izimvo/ amagama. Qedelela ukuhlola inqaku. Qhotsa inqaku kwindawo ezifanelekileyo zokuxoxwa (iinxalenye, amaqela abasebenzi, abasebenzi basekuhlaleni, DBC, iindaba zolawulo). Qedelela inqaku masiphe nokuqwalaselwa ukugunyaziswa kulawulo (lungiselela imemo/ siphiso). Nceda kwaye ulawule ukusetyenziswa kwenqaku (nxibelelana). Qwalasela ukuNikela amagunya kuMsebenzi woLuntu malunga nePSA kunye nePSR azenziwe/ ahlolwe kwaye asetyenziswe kwiSebe. Chonga imisebenzi yoMsebenzi wokuZinza emakawunikwe igunya ngokwemiyalelo/ umthetho. Hlanganisa/ bhala amagunya. Cela izimvo/ amagama kubathintekayo. Qwalasela kwaye udibanise izimvo/ amagama. Hlanganisa kwaye uqedelele ukuhlola amagunya (iseti eZeziGunya). Qhotsa ukuhlola igunya kwindawo ezifanelekileyo zokuxoxwa ukuba kuyimfuneko. Qedelela amagunya masiphe nokuqwalaselwa ukugunyaziswa kulawulo (lungiselela imemo/ siphiso). Nceda kwaye ulawule ukusetyenziswa kwamagunya (nxibelelana). IiNqaku zoLawulo loMsebenzi zikhuthazwa ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokungalinganiyo nokusebenzisa kwiSebe. Nikela/ sasaza inqaku egunyazisiweyo. Lungelela iindaba zolwazi ukukhuthaza inqaku elifanelekileyo (ngeTeams, Zoom okanye kwindawo). Lungiselela/ qulunqa isiphiso ngomxholo. Nikela/ sasaza i-ICM ngeenkcukacha zesiqendu. Yale/ nceda/ phatha/ lela ngemiba/ iingxaki kunye neetyala. Amagunya oMsebenzi wokuZinza akhuthazwa ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokungalinganiyo nokusebenzisa kuwo wonke umsebenzi weSebe. Nikela/ sasaza amagunya agunyazisiweyo/ alungisiweyo. Lungelela iindaba zolwazi ukukhuthaza amagunya afanelekileyo (ngeTeams, Zoom okanye kwindawo). Lungiselela/ qulunqa isiphiso ngomxholo. Nikela/ sasaza i-ICM ngeenkcukacha zesiqendu. Yale/ nceda/ phatha/ lela ngemiba/ iingxaki kunye neetyala. Lawula kwaye uphathe imisebenzi yopelo/ imisebenzi/ amaxwebhu/ izicelo/ imiyalelo ephathelene noMsebenzi wokuZinza njengoko celwa/ lalelwa nguluLawulo. Yale/ nceda/ phatha/ lela ngemiba/ iingxaki kunye neetyala nangapandleoko xa kufuneka. Nqamba/ yenza uphando kwaye ufumane imiyalelo ehlobene. Qhotsa abathintekayo abadlala indawo (Abasebenzi basekuhlaleni, bomthetho, Inxalenye ehlobene). Qamba impendulo/ imemo nokuqwalaselwa/ ukugunyaziswa. Xela ukugunyaziswa/ lela/ isiphumo sigqibele.

jobs.title: Senior Security Officer
jobs.summary: Supervise security officers and manage duty rosters for the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, requiring Grade 12, PSIRA Grade B, and three years of security experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of grade 12 certificate. Grade B Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA) Certificate. Must have a minimum of three (3) years security experience Job related knowledge: Knowledge of access control procedures. Knowledge of measures for the control and movement of equipment. Knowledge of security incident reporting and recording procedures. Knowledge of the powers, duties and responsibilities of security officers in terms of applicable legislation, policies, standards and procedures. Knowledge of prescribed security Legislation (e.g. Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS), Criminal Procedure Act, Minimum Physical Security Standard (MPSS), Protection of Information Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, etc) and the authority of security officers under these documents. Knowledge on the relevant emergency procedures. Willingness to work 12 hours shifts, travel and work irregular hours (afterhours, weekends and public holidays). Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Supervise the security functions performed by the security officers, ensuring adherence to department security policies. Allocate duties to security officers, monitor outcomes and institute the necessary corrective measures to address deviations from norms and standards. Develop and manage duty rosters, shift schedules and overtime arrangements in accordance with operational requirements and applicable prescripts. Monitor access control to prevent unauthorised entry in buildings and other premises. Authorisation of the equipment, documents and stores into or out of the building or premises. Inspect and report all none functioning of security measures (e.g., X-Ray machines, Walk-through metal detectors, security lights and etc.). Report faulty, damaged or non-functional security equipment and systems to the relevant supervisor or responsible unit. Supervise human resources/staff. Allocating work. Check, verify and update documentation/registers (leave forms, EPMDS, overtime). Updating work plans and performance standards. Performance assessment. Staff development. Manage export admin office to ensure effecting Wine Online support services. Ensure that incidents are properly recorded in occurrence books, incident registers and other prescribed records. Review security camera footage upon receipt of an authorised request and in accordance with approved procedures. Identify, respond to and report security breaches, incidents, and other irregularities. Monitor and provide support in case of emergencies. Inspect and verify occurrence books, registers and other prescribed security records to ensure that they are accurately and consistently maintained. Ensure that unauthorised persons and dangerous or prohibited objects do not enter departmental buildings or premises. Conduct security inspections and ensure that all access points and designated areas are properly secured and locked after hours. Ensure that the movement of equipment, assets, documents, and other items into and out of departmental premises is properly authorised and controlled. Administrative and related functions. Determining rosters, shift schedules and overtime. Monitor performance of employees and determine training needs. Control leaves and related personnel matters in line with HR procedures and prescripts. Provide security related services. Administer key control system. Identify risks and threats to the security of the department. Provide information regarding incidents to investigating officers. Report faulty equipment/systems. Ensure systems are functioning optimally through scheduled services. Conduct preliminary incident investigations and submit reports. Administer all control room operations to safeguard the department`s assets. Supervise all control room activities. Ensure that control room personnel perform their duties in accordance with approved procedures and security prescripts. Report all incidents and any identified non-compliance relating to security prescripts. Review of footages upon request through proper procedure. Update all registers for the incidents observed.

af.title: Senior Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Superviseer veiligheidsbeamptes en bestaar diensroosters vir die Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, met vereistes van Graad 12, PSIRA Grade B, en drie jaar se veiligheidsonderervaring.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n graad 12-sertifikaat. Grade B Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA)-sertifikaat. Moet 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar se sekuriteitservaring hê Werkverwante kennis: Kennis van toegangsbeheerprosedures. Kennis van maatreëls vir die beheer en beweging van toerusting. Kennis van prosedures vir die rapportering en rekordhouding van sekuriteitsvoorvalle. Kennis van die bevoegdhede, pligte en verantwoordelikhede van veiligheidsbeamptes ingevolge toepaslike wetgewing, beleide, standaarde en prosedures. Kennis van voorgeskrewe sekuriteitswetgewing (bv. Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS), Criminal Procedure Act, Minimum Physical Security Standard (MPSS), Protection of Information Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, ens.) en die gesag van veiligheidsbeamptes kragtens hierdie dokumente. Kennis van die tersaaklike noodgevalsprosedures. Bereidwilligheid om 12-uur skofte te werk, te reis en onreëlmatige ure te werk (na ure, naweke en openbare vakansiedae). Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Superviseer die sekuriteitsfunksies wat deur die veiligheidsbeamptes uitgevoer word, en verseker nakoming van die departement se sekuriteitsbeleide. Ken pligte toe aan veiligheidsbeamptes, monitor uitkomste en institueer die nodige regstellende maatreëls om afwykings van norme en standaarde aan te spreek. Ontwikkel en bestuur diensroosters, skofskedules en oortydreëlings in ooreenstemming met operasionele vereistes en toepaslike voorskrifte. Monitor toegangsbeheer om ongemagtigde toegang tot geboue en ander persele te voorkom. Magtiging van toerusting, dokumente en voorrade in of uit die gebou of perseel. Inspekteer en rapporteer alle nie-funksionering van sekuriteitsmaatreëls (bv. X-straalmasjiene, deurloop-metaalopsporenbouers, sekuriteitsligte, ens.). Rapporteer foutiewe, beskadigde of nie-funksionerende sekuriteitstoerusting en -stelsels aan die tersaaklike toesighouer of verantwoordelike eenheid. Superviseer menslike hulpbronne/personeel. Toewysing van werk. Kontroleer, verifieer en dateer dokumente/registers op (verlofbriewe, EPMDS, oortyd). Opdatering van werkplanne en prestasiestandaarde. Prestasie-evaluering. Personeelsonwikkeling. Bestuur die uitvoer-administrasiekantoor om effektiewe Wine Online-ondersteuningsdienste te verseker. Verseker dat voorvalle behoorlik in voorvalboeke, voorvalregisters en ander voorgeskrewe rekords aangeteken word. Hersien sekuriteitskamerabeeldmateriaal upon ontvangs van 'n gemagtigde versoek en in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde prosedures. Identifiseer, reageer op en rapporteer sekuriteitskendings, voorvalle en ander onreëlmatighede. Monitor en verskaf ondersteuning in die geval van noodgevalle. Inspekteer en verifieer voorvalboeke, registers en ander voorgeskrewe sekuriteitsrekords om te verseker dat dit akkuraat en konsekwent gehandhaaf word. Verseker dat ongemagtigde persone en gevaarlike of verbode voorwerpe nie departementele geboue of persele binnegaan nie. Voer sekuriteitsinspeksies uit en verseker dat alle toegangspunte en aangewese areas behoorlik beveilig en na ure gesluit is. Verseker dat die beweging van toerusting, bates, dokumente en ander items in en uit departementele persele behoorlik gemagtig en beheer word. Administratiewe en verwante funksies. Bepaling van roosters, skofskedules en oortyd. Monitor prestasie van werknemers en bepaal opleidingsbehoeftes. Beheer verlof en verwante personeelsake in ooreenstemming met HR-prosedures en voorskrifte. Verskaf sekuriteitsverwante dienste. Administreer sleutelbeheerstelsel. Identifiseer risiko's en bedreigings vir die sekuriteit van die departement. Verskaf inligting aangaande voorvalle aan ondersoekbeamptes. Rapporteer foutiewe toerusting/stelsels. Verseker dat stelsels optimaal funksioneer deur geskeduleerde dienste. Voer voorlopige voorvalondersoeke uit en dien verslae in. Administreer alle beheerkamer-bewerings om die departement se bates te beskerm. Superviseer alle beheerkamer-aktiwiteite. Verseker dat beheerkamerpersoneel hul pligte in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde prosedures en sekuriteitsvoorskrifte uitvoer. Rapporteer alle voorvalle en enige geidentifiseerde nie-nakoming met betrekking tot sekuriteitsvoorskrifte. Hersiening van beeldmateriaal op versoek deur die behoorlike prosedure. Dateer alle registers op vir die waargenome voorvalle.

zu.title: Umphathi Ophakeme Wezokuphepha
zu.summary: Qondanisa abaphathi bezokuphepha futhi phephisa izikhathi zomsebenzi eMnyangweni Wezolimo ePretoria, kudingeka ibe khona ibanga lesi-12, i-PSIRA ibanga B, kanye namakhulu amathathu (3) eminyaka yohlu oluqondene nezokuphepha.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babe nokuqinisekiswa kwesitifiketi sesigaba sesi-12. Isitifiketi se-Grade B Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA). Kufanele babe nobungenako bomsebenzi wezokuphepha bonyaka abathathu (3) Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemiyalelo yokulawula ukungena. Ulwazi ngomezekile wokulawula nokunyakaza kwemishini. Ulwazi ngemiyalelo yokubika nokugcina imininingo yezehloko zezokuphepha. Ulwazi ngamandla, imisebenzi nemithwalo yabaphathi bezokuphepha ngokomthetho ohambisanayo, izinqubomgomo, izinga nezinqubo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezokuphepha ophiwe (okthi. Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS), Criminal Procedure Act, Minimum Physical Security Standard (MPSS), Protection of Information Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, njll) kanye namandla abaphathi bezokuphepha ngaphansi kwala mabhulukwe. Ulwazi ngemiyalelo ephathelene nezimo ezibuthakathaka. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ube usuku olunamahora angu-12, ukuhamba futhi usebenze amahora angajwayelekile (emva kwamahora, ekonsathini nangamaholide). Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Qondanisa imisebenzi yezokuphepha yenziwa abaphathi bezokuphepha, uqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlatshiwe izinqubomgomo zezokuphepha zumnyango. Ceda imisebenzi kubaphathi bezokuphepha, hlola imiphumela futhi misuse izinyathelo zokulungisa eziyimfuneko ukubhekana nokushiywa kwemigqomupho kanye namazinga. Besezisa futhi uphephise izikhathi zomsebenzi, izikhathi zokushintshana nokuhlelwa kohamba ngaphakathi kwemiyalelo yokusebenza nezinyathelo eziyimfuneko. Hlola ukulawulwa kokungena ukuze kuvinjelwe ukungena okungemthetho ezakhiwo naseminyezini. Gunya imishini, amadokhumenti izitokfuyi zingenayo noma zikiphoyo kulesakhiwo noma eminyezini. Hlola futhi utoke konke ukungasebenzi kwezinyathelo zezokuphepha (okthi., izintengoma ze-X-Ray, izihlaki ezibamba isinsimbi eziphakathi, izibani zezokuphepha njll.). Toza isisetshenziswa esikrazayo, esonakele noma esingasebenzi nezinhlelo zezokuphepha kumphathi ohlobene noma eqoqo elibekiwe. Qondanisa abantu/imisebenzi yezisebenzi. Ceda umsebenzi. Hlola, qinisekisa futhi ubuyekeze imibhalo/izibuko (amafomu enqasamgodu, i-EPMDS, ukushintshana kwamahora). Ukubuyekeza izindaba zokwenza nenothando yomsebenzi. Ukubuyekeza kwenzo. Inhlokisa yezisebenzi. Phephesa inkantolo yezimbaluli ukuze kuqinisekiswe usekelo lwe-Wine Online. Qinisekisa ukuthi izehloko zibhalwe kahle kubhukwe lezehloko, izibuko zezehloko kanye nobunye obubhaliweyo obuyimfuneko. Buyekeza isibonakaliso sekhamera ngemuva kokuqala kwenceceno esemthethweni ngokuhambisana nezinqubo ezamukelekile. Chaza, bhekana futhi utoze ukuphula komthetho wezokuphepha, izehloko, kanye nezinye okungalungile. Hlola futhi usekele ezimeni eziyisiphephelo. Hlola futhi qinisekisa izibuko lezehloko ukuthi zigcinwe ngokunembile futhi ziqhubekayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi abantu abangemthetho nezinto eziyingozi noma ezivaliwe angangen ezakhiweni naseminyezini zumnyango. Yenza izihloko zezokuphepha futhi uqinisekise ukuthi konke okufakwa kuyo noma okukhonjwayo kuqinisekisiwe futhi kuvaliwe emva kwamahora. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukunyakaziswa kwemishini, izinto, amadokhumenti kanye nezinye izinto ezingena noma ziphuma eminyezini zumnyango kunikezwe igunya futhi kulawulwe kahle. Imisebenzi yolusito kanye nezinye ezihlobene. Cacisa izikhathi zomsebenzi, amasimu kanye nokushintshana kwamahora. Hlola ukwenza kwezisebenzi futhi chaza imfuneko yokolotsha. Lawula ukunqasamgodu nezinye ezihlobene nezisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinqubo nemiqulu yabaqashi. Nikeza imisebenzi ehlobene nezokuphepha. Phatha isimiso sokulawula okhiye. Chaza ingozi nesihe Ezokuphepha zumnyango. Nikeza ulwazi ngezehloko kubaphathi bopiko. Toza isisetshenziswa/izinhlelo esikrazayo noma esingasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza ngokugcwele ngokuhlelelwa kwenkonzo. Yenza upiko olungaphambilini lokuphenya izehloko uthumela imibiko. Phatha yonke imisebenzi yangaphakathi kwelivi lokulawula ukuze ivikele izinto zumnyango. Qondanisa yonke imisebenzi yelivi lokulawula. Qinisekisa ukuthi basebenzi belivi lokulawula benza imisebenzo yabo ngokuhambisana nezinqubo ezamukelekile nemiqulu yezokuphepha. Toza wonke amehloko nanoma yikuphi ukungalawuleki okubonakalayo okuhlobene nomqulu wezokuphepha. Buyekeza izibonakaliso ngocelo ngokuhamba kwendlebo efanele. Ukubuyekeza wonke amabuko ngeze zehloko ezebonakalayo.

xh.title: Umphathi Wamagosa Akhuselekayo
xh.summary: Qonda amagosa akhuselekayo ulawule uluhlu lwemisebenzi kwiSebe leZolimo ePretoria, befuna ibhasethi yebanga lesi-12, i-PSIRA Ibanga B, namashumi amathathu eminyaka yamava okhuseleko.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi sebhasethi lesi-12. Isatifikethi se-Grade B Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA). Kufuneka abe nobuncinane beminyaka emithathu (3) yamava okhuseleko Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokulawula ukungena. Ulwazi ngamanyathelo okulawula nokuhamba kwemishini. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokubika nokurekhoda iziganeko zokhuseleko. Ulwazi ngamagunya, imisebenzi nemi Yalelo yamagosa akhuselekayo ngokwemithetho ebekwayo, iinkqubo, amagunya nemigaqo. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokhuseleko ebolekileyo (umz. Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS), Criminal Procedure Act, Minimum Physical Security Standard (MPSS), Protection of Information Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, nokunye) nelayithente yamagosa akhuselekayo phantsi kwala maxwebhu. Ulwazi ngemigaqo ehambelana namava obungozi. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza iishifti zeeyure ezili-12, ukuhamba nokusebenza iiyure ezingaqhelekanga (emva kweyure yomsebenzi, iiveki nangemihla yiholide). Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Qonda imisebenzi yokhuseleko ezenziwa ngamagosa akhuselekayo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zokhuseleko zesebe. Aba imisebenzi kumagosa akhuselekayo, ujonge iziphumo uze ufake amanyathelo olungiso afunekayo ukubonisana nokuqhwanda kwemigaqo namanqanaba. Yila ulawule uluhlu lwemisebenzi, iinkqubo zeshifti nezicwangciso zesikhathi esongezelelweyo ngokwemfuneko yomsebenzi nangokwemigaqo ebekwayo. Qonda ukulawula ukungena ukuthintela ukungena ngaphandle kwesigunyaziso kwiinkxaso nakwezinye iindawo. Isigunyaziso semishini,amaxwebhu negcinindlela kungekho ngaphandle okanye singene kwinkxaso okanye esindulweni. Khangelo uze ubike konke okungasebenzi kumanyathelo okhuseleko (umz., iinto ezinjenge-X-Ray machines, Walk-through metal detectors, iilithi zokhuseleko nokunye). Bika imishini yokhuseleko engasebenyo, eonakeleyo okanye engasebenziyo ngezinkqubo kumjongi ohambelanayo okanye kwicandelo elinesibophelelo. Qonda abasebenzi/iinkqubo zabantu. Aba umsebenzi. Khangelo, qinisekisa uhlaziye amaxwebhu/iirekhodi (iifomu zeholide, i-EPMDS, isikhathi esongezelelweyo). Ukuhlaziya iinkqubo zomsebenzi namanqanaba apheleleyo. Isilinganiso sepumelelo. Uphuhliso lwabasebenzi. Lawula ofisi yophando phandle ukuze uqinisekise iinkonzo zoxhaso zeWine Online ezingundoqo. Qinisekisa ukuba iziganeko zibhalwe kakuhle kwii-occurrence books, kwirejista yeziganeko nakwezinye iirekhodi ebolekileyo. Phinda ucinge iifothu zekhamera zokhuseleko xa ufumene isicelo esigunyazisiweyo nangokwemigaqo egunyazisiweyo. Chonga, phendula uze ubike ukwaphuka kokhuseleko, iziganeko, nakwezinye iinto ezingaqhelekanga. Qonda uze unike uxhaso kwiimeko zobungozi. Khangelo uze uqinisekise ii-occurrence books, iirejista nakwezinye iirekhodi zokhuseleko ebolekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba ziyagcinwa ngokuchanekileyo nangokuqhubeka. Qinisekisa ukuba abantu abangenayo isigunyaziso nanto eyingozi okanye ezithintelweyo zingangeni kwiinkxaso zesebe okanye ezindulweni. Yenza iinkqubo zokukhangela ukuze uqinisekise ukuba zonke iindawo zokungena nendawo ezichaziweyo ziqinisekiswe ukuze zibethwe izitshixo emva kweeyure. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuhamba kwemishini, iimpahla, amaxwebhu, nezinye iinto ukungena naphandle kwendawo yesebe kusigunyazisiwe kakuhle ulawulwa. Imisebenzi yolawulo nezinye ezihlobene nayona. Ukumisela iirosta, iinkqubo zeshifti nesikhathi esongezelelweyo. Khangelo ukuphumelela kwabasebenki uze umisele iimfuno zolungiselelo. Lawula iholide nendaba zabantu ezingxamiselekayo ngokwemigaqo yabaRhamatya nakwemigaqo ebekwayo. Nikeza iinkonzo ezingxamiselekayo no khuseleko. Lawula inkqubo yolawulo lweqhosha. Chonga iingozi neengozi ezikwingozi yokhuseleko lwesebe. Nikeza ulwazi malunga nezingozi kubaphandi. Bika imishini okanye iinkqubo ezingasebenyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zisebenza ngokupheleleyo ngeenkonzo ezicwangciswe. Yenza uphando olusisiseko olweziganeko uze unike iingxelo. Lawula zonke iinkqubo zekamva lolawulo ukuze kuvikelwe iimpahla zesebe. Qonda yonke imisebenzi yekamva lolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuba abasebenzi bekamva lolawulo benza imisebenzi yabo ngokwemigaqo egunyazisiweyo nemigaqo yokhuseleko. Bika zonke iziganeko nanalo naluphi na ukungalandelwa kwemigaqo okubonakalayo ngokuhlobene nemigaqo yokhuseleko. Ukucengwa kweekamva phantsi kwesicelo ngenkqubo efanelekileyo. Hlaziya zonke iirejista ngezingozi ezibonakalayo.
