Successful candidates will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) months in terms of the prescribed rules. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Mediese Administrasie: Kompensasie
af.summary: Bestuur mediese kompensasie-administrasie vir Verdedigingspersoneel, insluitend beseringsake, personeelverliese, begrafnisse en groepslewensversekering by die Department of Defence.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (NQF 4) of gelykwaardig met Nasionale Diploma NQF 6 in HRM/Public Administration met 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in administratiewe en toesighoudende poste. Spesiale vereistes (vaardighede benodig): COIDA, rekenaarvaardig (MS Word, PowerPoint, hoe om toegang tot die Internet te verkry, MS Excel en mainframe). Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik) en kliëntegerigtheid. Oor toesighoudende ervaring beskik. Oor uitstekende interpersoonlike en probleemoplossingsvaardighede beskik. Besit van 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie word aanbeveel. Die kennis en begrip van Compensation Occupation Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA), Group Life Insurance Scheme (GLIS) Policies en die mediese administrasieproses vir die staande mag. Uitstekende telefoonetiket. Vermoë om binne 12 maande na aanstelling 'n vertroulike veiligheidsklarings te verkry.
af.duties: 'n Suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om die volgende pligte uit te voer: Administrasie van beserings- en siektegevalle wat deur Defence Act Personnel (DAP) en Public Service Act Personnel (PSAP) in diens opgedoen is. Administrasie van personeelverliese en begrafnisse en Group Life Insurance Scheme (GLIS). Administrasie/goedkeuring van insluiting/herinsluiting van afhanklikes van Defence Act Personnel (DAP) vir mediese voorregte. Bywoon van vergaderings soos vereis. Inspeksie van alle registers wat deur die klerke bygehou word. Opstel en bywerk van posprofiele en pligstate vir alle posbekleërs op die struktuur van die Mediese Afdeling. Assessering en toesig oor ondergeskiktes se prestasie met betrekking tot sterktes en swakhede om goeie prestasie te erken en te beloon, en swak prestasie te bestuur deur relevante kursusse te identifiseer. Bystand verleen met loopbaanbestuur deur ondergeskiktes te ondersteun en aan te moedig om geleenthede vir ontwikkeling en bevordering te soek en hulle vir kursusse te benoem. Alle Mediese Afdeling se personeel vir uitstaande kursusse benoem. Persoonlike ondersoek van kritieke navrae en die opstel van konsepantwoorde vir ondertekening deur hoër gesag. Voltooiing van halfjaarlikse prestasie-assesserings vir alle ondergeskiktes tesame met relevante verslae.

zu.title: Umzekeli weNhlangano: Ukuphathwa Kwezokwelapha: Ihlawulo
zu.summary: Ukuphathwa kolawulo lohlawulo lwezokwelapha sabasebenzi beSikhululo sokuZivikwa, okuhlanganisa izimo zezilimali, ukulahlekelwa abantu, izinkomoko namashadi ensimbi yokuphila abahlangene, eMnyangweni weSikhululo sokuZivikwa.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (NQF 4) noma okulinganayo ne-Diploma Yezwe NQF 6 kwi-HRM//uLawulo Lomphakathi enokuncika okungaphezu kweminyaka emithathu (3) yemisebenzi ekuqinisekisweni nasemabhalweni. Izidingo Ezikhethekile (izikhululo eziyimfuneko): i-COIDA, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-PowerPoint, ukuthi ungafika kanjani ku-Inthanethi, i-MS Excel namainfreym). Izikhululo zokuxhumana ezinhle (ezomlomo nangokubhalwayo) kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuba nempilo yokuba ngumqashi. Ukuba nezikhululo zokuqhathanisa kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuba nelisensi yokushayela okusemthethweni kunconywa. Ukwazi nokuzuva uMthetho Wokuhlwaywa Kokulimala Nokugula Emsebenzini (i-COIDA), Izinqubo Zenkqubo Yensimbi Yokuphila Abahlangene (i-GLIS) nenqubo yokuLawula Izokwelapha kwamabutho aqotho. Indlela enhle yokukhuluma efoni. Ikhono lokuthola isivikelo esikhulelekile samafihlo emuva kwezinyanga eziy-12 zokuqashwa.
zu.duties: Umphathi ophumelelayo uzodingeka ukwenza imisebenzi elandelayo: Ukuphathwa kwezimo zezilimali nezifo ezenzeka Kubantu BakaMthetho WeSikhululo (i-DAP) Nabantu BakaMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi (i-PSAP) ngesikhathi bekusebenzeni. Ukuphathwa kokulahlekelwa abantu kanye namashadi nenkqubo Yensimbi Yokuphila Abahlangene (i-GLIS). Ukuphathwa/ukuvunyelwa kokuhlanganisa/phinda ukuhlanganisa abakekelayo Bantu BakaMthetho WeSikhululo (i-DAP) emahlabathini ezokwelapha. Ukuhlanganyela emihlanganweni njengoba kudingeka. Ukuhlola yonke imibhalo egcinwa ngababhali. Ukubhala nokuvuselela izinkomba zesikhundla namakhasi womsebenzi bonke ababheke izikhundla esakhiweni Sasecshini Ezezokwelapha. Ukuhlola futhi aqapse abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakhe ngemisebenzi yabo ngokuqina nangokungakhuthazi ukuze ahloniphe futhi azuze okuhle, aphathe kabi ukusebenza ngokuthola amakilasi afanele. Ukusiza ngokuphathwa kwekhaya ngokuxhasa nokukhuthaza abasebenzi abangaphansi ukuba bafune ithuba lokuthuthuka bese ukhuphuka kanye nokubakhetha kumakilasi. Ukukhetha bonke abasebenzi Basecshini Ezezokwelapha kumakilasi abakhulu. Ukuphenya ngokwakho imibuzo ebalulekile kanye nokubhala imibhalo engavunyiwe yizithunywa zobukhulu. Ukuqedela ukuhlola ukusebenza okwenziwa njalo ngeminyaka emibili kubo bonke abasebenzi abangaphansi kanye nemibiko ehambisanayo.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkundla: Ukulawulwa kweZamelenko: I-Nqweno-mali
xh.summary: Lawula ukulawulwa kwenqweno-mali yamayeza abasebenzi beNkonzo yoKhuselo, kuquka iimeko ezizakwalimaza, ukulahlekelwa ngabasebenzi, izindlu zangaphakathi namakhaso obomi abavela ngokwazo kwisebe leNkonzo yoKhuselo.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12 (NQF 4) okanye efanayo ne-National Diploma NQF 6 kwi-HRM/Public Administration enomgangatho weemfundo ezincinci (3) zeminyaka yamava ekulawulweni nakwindima yokulawula. Iimfuno ezizezelweyo (izakhono efunekayo): COIDA, ukwazi ukusebenza ngamakompyutha (MS Word, PowerPoint, indlela yokungena kwi-Internet, MS Excel kunye ne-mainframe). Amanye amakhono okunxibelelwana (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo) nokujolise kumthengi. Kuba nolwazi lokuba ngumlawuli. Kuba namakhono amakhulu okuzipatha kakuhle nabantu nokusombulula iingxaki. Kukhuthazwa ukuba nelayisensi yokuqhuba egqithisiweyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Compensation Occupation Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA), i-Group Life Insurance Scheme (GLIS) Policies nenkqubo yolawulo lwamayeza kwamajoni aqhelekileyo. Indlela echaseneyo yokuziphatha kwi-telefoni. Ukuba nakho ukufumana isikhululo sokhuseleko esiyimfihlo kuminyaka elishumi elinesibini (12) emva kokuba umiselwe.
xh.duties: Umphathi ophumeleleyo uyakufuneka akwenze oku kulandelayo: Ulawulo lweemekho ezizakwalimaza neyezifo ezifunyenwa kubasebenzi be-Defence Act Personnel (DAP) kubasebenzi be-Public Service Act Personnel (PSAP) beta bekumsebenzi. Ulawulo lokulahlekelwa ngabasebenzi nakwindlu yasekhaya ne-Group Life Insurance Scheme (GLIS). Ulawulo/uvunywa lokuquka/ngokuqinda kwakhona abaxhasi babasebenzi be-Defence Act Personnel (DAP) kumalungiselelo ezamelenko. Ukuza kwiindiba njengoko kufunwa. Ukuhlola izibhalo zonke ezigcinwa ziklearikitshi. Ukuqamba nokuhlaziya iinkcazelo zesithuba namaphepha omsebenzi bonke abazii-sithuba kwindlela ekuqwalaselwa kuyo iNcwadi yamayeza. Ukulinganisa nokulawula imisebenzi yabangaphansi ngokwamandla nabashabileyo ukuze kuzive kwaye kubekho isixeko kwabasebenzi ngamanye amaxesha, nokulawula ukusebenza ngokungalunganga ngokubeka izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Uncede nolawulo lomsebenzi ngokuxhasa nokukhuthaza abangaphansi ukuba bafune ithuba lophuhliso nokuqhubela phambili nokubakhetha kwezifundo. Ukukhetha bonke abasebenzi beNcwadi yamayeza ukuba baye kwezifundo ezibalulekileyo. Uphononongo lweemvuyo eziphakamileyo nokuqamba iimpendulo ezingazange zagqitywa ngamagunya olawulo ophakamileyo. Ukuqedela isiqendu esithi ngamnyaka sokulinganisa imisebenzi yabangaphansi kunye neengxelo ezifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Accounting Clerk: Production
jobs.centre: FASC Durban Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/01 (X3 Posts) FASO Ladysmith Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/02 FASC Mtubatuba Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/03 FASC Lohathla Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/04 FASC Polokwane Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/05 (X3 Posts) FASC Makhado Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/06 FASC Thohoyandou, Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/07 FASC Port Elizabeth Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/08 FASC Umtata Ref No: FMD/31/32/36/09 FASC Garrison Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/10 (X4 Posts) FASC Hoedspruit Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/11 FASC Potchefstroom Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/12 FASC Klipdrift Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/13 FASC Wonderboom Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/14 FASC Kimberley Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/15 FASC Youngsfiled Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/16 FASC MOD Ref No: FMD/31/32/26/17 (X2 Posts)
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 at 16h00 (Applications received after the closing date and faxed copies will not be considered).
jobs.summary: The Department of Defence seeks accounting clerks across multiple centres to perform cashier duties, receipt state monies, and apply financial policies at salary level 5.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) or equivalent with Accounting or Mathematics as subjects. No experience. Valid Driver’s License. Special requirements / Skills needed: Basic knowledge of financial and accounting processes. Computer literate in MS Office software packages (Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Ability in understanding, interpreting and correctly applying financial policies and prescripts. Ability to effectively liaise and communicate with clients. Decisive and persevering in terms of task finalisation. Willing to be detached to Satellite Offices across geographical boundaries. Perform cash administration duties as cashier, in Rand and Foreign currency. Perform general administrative functions and archiving / filing / safekeeping of all accounting documentation. Basic knowledge of contract management and supply chain management process. Sound Knowledge and understanding of PFMA, Treasury Regulations, National Treasury practice notes on supply chain processes (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Knowledge of basic financial operating systems (FMS, PERSOL, PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS etc)
jobs.duties: Strictly apply policies, prescriptions and regulation. Performing of cashier duties by paying out of cash advances. Receipt of State monies into the paymaster General Account (PMG). Receive cash from client and verify or correctness in terms of the purpose of the payment. Issue an official receipt. Accurate allocation of Revenue. Timely preparation and capturing of deposits on FMS and securely dispatching of deposits to the bank. Safekeeping and issuing of Face Value Documents (FVD). Archiving of Accounting documents, Safekeeping of payment and other accounting documentation for audit purposes. Utilise the Financial Management System (FMS) to regularly record all accounting transactions and do enquiries, administering of claims on the central Advance System and capturing of all related accounting transactions on FMS. Confirmation of Telkom accounts and assisting with general administration and accounting functions at the FASC. Scrutinise, verify, register and couple medical and supplier invoices for payment.
jobs.enquiries: Ms C.L. Cele Tel No: (012) 392 2892
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted through the post to: Financial Management Division, DFSS, Career Management Section, Private Bag X137, Pretoria, 0001 or email to Recruit2FMD@dod.mil.za or Recruit3FMD@dod.mil.za In case where applicants are stationed in the Pretoria area, applications may be hand-delivered to: Poynton building, 195 Bosman Street, Pretoria where it must be placed in wooden post box number 5 at Reception. Please use reference number not post number.
jobs.notes: It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through       the    filling  of     this   posts    with     candidates     whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity in line with the numeric targets as contained in our Employment Equity plan. Applications must be submitted on the prescribed form Z83 (obtainable from any Public Service Department office i.e effective 01 January 2021 or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/. Should an application be received using incorrect application employment form Z83, it will be disqualified, which must be originally signed and dated by the applicant and which must be accompanied by a detailed CV only (with full particulars of the applicants’ training, qualifications, competencies, knowledge & experience). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview which should not be older than six months. Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in applications being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one post must submit a separate form Z83 (as well as the documentation mentioned above) in respect of each post being applied for. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. Should an application be received where an applicant applies for more than one post on the same applications form, the application will only be considered for the first post indicated on the application and not for any of the other posts. Under no circumstances will photostat copies or faxed copies of application documents be accepted. The successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks and qualification and employment verification). Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. The level of appointments is dependent upon, qualifications, relevant experience and research output. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The competency assessment will be limited to successful candidates in the interview process only. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability checks (pre-employment screening) which may include social media profiles checks. A successful candidate will have to undergo a full security vetting while in the employ of the department and negative outcome shall nullify employment contract. Failure to submit the required documents will result in your application not being considered. Successful candidates will be required to disclose their financial interests within one (1) month of appointment. Applicants who do not receive confirmation or feedback within 3 (three) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Due to the large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. For more information on the job description(s) please contact the person indicated in the post details. Successful candidates will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) months in terms of the prescribed rules. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Rekenboekkundige Klerk: Produksie
af.summary: Die Department of Defence soek rekenboekkundige klerke oor verskeie sentrums om kassierpligte uit te voer, staatsgelde te ontvang, en finansiële beleide toe te pas op salaris vlak 5.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van Graad 12 (NQF Level 4) of gelykwaardig met Rekenkunde of Wiskunde as vakke. Geen ervaring nie. Geldige Bestuurderslisensie. Spesiale vereistes / Vaardighede benodig: Basiese kennis van finansiële en rekenkundige prosesse. Rekenaarvaardig in MS Office-sagtewarepakkette (Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Vermoë om finansiële beleide en voorskrifte te verstaan, te interpreteer en korrek toe te pas. Vermoë om doeltreffend met kliënte te skakel en te kommunikeer. Besluitvaardig en volhardend ten opsigte van taakvoltooiing. Gewillig om na Satellietkantore oor geografiese grense gestasioneer te word. Voer kontantadministrasiepligte as kassier uit, in Rand en buitelandse valuta. Voer algemene administratiewe funksies en argivering / lêering / veilige bewaring van alle rekenkundige dokumentasie uit. Basiese kennis van kontrakbestuur en voorsieningskettingbestuursproses. Deeglike kennis en begrip van PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, Nasionale Tesourie-oefennotas oor voorsieningskettingprosesse (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PPPFA, Finansiële Handleiding). Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (FMS, PERSOL, PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS ens)
af.duties: Pas beleide, voorskrifte en regulasies streng toe. Uitvoering van kassierpligte deur die uitbetaling van kontantvoorskotte. Ontvangs van Staatsgelde in die rekening van die betaalmester-generaal (PMG). Ontvang kontant van kliënt en verifieer die korrektheid daarvan ten opsigte van die doel van die betaling. Reik 'n amptelike kwitansie uit. Akkurate toewysing van Inkomste. Tydige voorbereiding en vaslegging van deposito's op FMS en veilige versending van deposito's na die bank. Veilige bewaring en uitreiking van Nominale Waarde Dokumente (FVD). Argivering van Rekenkundige dokumente, veilige bewaring van betaling en ander rekenkundige dokumentasie vir ouditdoeleindes. Gebruik die Finansiële Bestuurstelsel (FMS) om gereeld alle rekenkundige transaksies aan te teken en navrae te doen, administrasie van eise op die sentrale Voorskottetelsel en vaslegging van alle verwante rekenkundige transaksies op FMS. Bevestiging van Telkom-rekeninge en bystand met algemene administrasie- en rekenkundige funksies by die FASC. Ondersoek, verifieer, registreer en koppel mediese en verskaffaarfakturas vir betaling.

zu.title: Iklekhi Eshalini: Ukukhiqiza
zu.summary: I-Department of Defence ifuna abakleki beshala emasikhundleni amaningi ukuze benze imisebenzi yethilashi, bathole imali yombuso, futhi basebenzise izinqubomgomo zezimali ezingeni leholo 5.
zu.requirements: Isilinganiso se-Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) noma okulinganayo okune-Accounting noma i-Mathematics njengezifundo. Akukho nohlobo lomsebenzi odingekayo. I-Driver's License evumelekile. Izidingo ezikhethekile / Amakhono adingekayo: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nenqubo yezimali nakubuchwepheshe beshalo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kumaphakheji wohlelo lwe-MS Office (Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ikono lokuzwa, ukuhumusha futhi ukusebenzisa ngendlela efanele izinqubomgomo nezinqubo ezibalulekile mayelana nezimali. Ikono lokuxhumana nokuthintana nabathengi ngempumelelo. Ukuthatha izinqumo nokuphikelela ekuphedweni komsebenzi. Ukuzithoba ekushintshweni kwezikhungo ezingeni elinganayo kuzo zonke izindawo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwemali ethashiyi, ngemali ye-Rand kanye nemali yezwe elingesinye. Ukwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yolawulo nokugcina izixhumanisi zeshalo. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokuphathwa kwezinkontileka kanye nenqubo yokuphathwa kwensindiso. Ulwazi oluhle kanye nokuqonda i-PFMA, izimiso ze-Treasury Regulations, okubhaliwe yi-National Treasury kuzinkambu ze-supply chain processes (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Ulwazi ngamahlelo abhalwe phansi aphathwa ngemali (FMS, PERSOL, PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS etc)
zu.duties: Ukusebenzisa ngokuqinile izinqubomgomo, izinqubo nezimiso. Ukwenza imisebenzi yethilashi ngokukhokha izimali ezibhiselwe ngaphambili. Ukuthola imali yombuso kwi-Akhawunti ye-Paymaster General (PMG). Ukuthola imali ethiwe ngumthengi bese uhlole ukuzwakala ngokusho ngenjongo yokukhokha kwayo. Ukwakhula isitifiketi semali esisemthethweni. Ukwaba ngokunembile imali engenayo. Ukuhlunga ngokushesha nokubhala imali efakiwe kwi-FMS bese uyithumela ngokuphephile ebhange. Ukugcina nokuphiwa amaphephu amadokhumenti (FVD). Ukugcina imibhalo yeshalo, ukulondoloza imibhalo yokukhokha kanye nezinye izixhumanisi zeshalayo ukuze kusetshenziswe ekuhloleni. Ukusebenzisa i-Financial Management System (FMS) ukubhala rhoqo yonke imisebenzi yeshalo futhi uphendhe imibuzo, ukuphatha izimangalo kwesiqongo esibhalwe ukuthola izimali, bese ubhala yonke imisebenzi ehlobene ne-FMS. Ukuqinisekisa ama-akhawunti e-Telkom kanye nokusiza ngezinkinga zolawulo nakushalo ekhonjintha ye-FASC. Ukuhlola, ukuqinisekisa, ukubhalisa bese uhlanganisa izikweletu zokwelashwa nezinkampani ngokuzo ukuthi zikhokhwe.

xh.title: Iclerk yoBhaliso: Ukuveliswa
xh.summary: Isebe lezoKhuselo lifuna iiklerk zobhaliso kumaziko amaninzi ukwenza imisebenzi yecashier, ukwamkela imali karhulumente, nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zemali kwinqanaba lomvuzo 5.
xh.requirements: Isixa esingaphantsi seGrade 12 (NQF Level 4) okanye esilinganayo nge-Accounting okanye iMathematics njengemizekelo. Akukho nqaqambele. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Iimfuno ezizezile / Ikhono elidingekayo: Ulwazi olusisiseko malunga neenkqubo zemali nobhaliso. Ukuba nolwazi ngakwiikhompyutha kwiinkqubo zesoftware zeMS Office (Word, Excel kwaye PowerPoint). Amandlaokuqonda, ukucazulula nokusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo iinkqubo zemali nezikhokelo. Amandla okudibana nokuqhubeleka kolwazi nabathengi. Ukuba ngumntu othatha izigqibo kwaye onesibindi ekupheliseni imisebenzi. Ukulungele ukuthunyelwa kumakhaya eeSatellite kumida woMhlaba. Ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo lwemali njengocashier, kwiRand nalemali yamanye amazwe. Ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo olujikeleziyo kwaye ugcine / ulungelelanise / ugade onke amaxwebhu obhaliso. Ulwazi olusisiseko kolawulo lwezivumelwano nenkqubo yolonikezelo. Ulwazi olusisiseko nokuqonda i-PFMA, Iimizila yeTreasury, iNqununu yeTreasury malunga neenkqubo zolonikezelo (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PPPFA, iNkqubo yeMali). Ulwazi lweenkqubo ezisisiseko zemali ezisebenzayo (FMS, PERSOL, PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS njl).
xh.duties: Sebenzisa ngokungenabungcinga iinkqubo, izikhokelo kwaye imithetho. Ukwenza imisebenzi yecashier ngokuhlawula ngaphambili ngekhadi. Ukamkela imali karhulumente kwi-Akhawunti yePaymaster General (PMG). Ukamkela imali kumthengi kwaye uqiniseke ukuziphatha ngokomgama wentlawulo. Ukupha isitifikedi sokwamkelwa. Ukwahlwa ngokuchanekileyo kweNgeniso. Ukulungisa ngexesha nokubamba iimali ezingenayo kwiFMS kwaye uzithumele ngokhuselekileyo kwindlu yamabenk. Ukugcina nokunika amaxwebhu eFace Value (FVD). Ukugcina amaxwebhu obhaliso, Ukugada iimali zendlela nokunye okubhaliso ngenjongo yokuphononwa. Ukusebenzisa iNkqubo yoLawulo lweMali (FMS) ukubhala rhoqo onke iinkalo zebhaliso kwaye wenze imibuzo, ukulawula iingcali kwinkqubo ye-Accounting System eNdibaniselweni, nokubhala onke iinkalo ezahlobene nobhaliso kwi-FMS. Ukuqinisekisa iakhawunti ze-Telkom kwaye uncede ngolawulo jikeleziyo kwaye nemisebenzi yobhaliso kwi-FASC. Ukuqhola, ukuqinisekisa, ukubhalisa nokuhlanganisa i-inovasi zezempilo nezabathengi endlawulweni.

jobs.title: Director: Human Resource Management
jobs.summary: Director of Human Resource Management at the Compensation Fund in Pretoria, overseeing HR services, performance management, employee relations and HR administration across provinces.

af.summary: Senior Regsadministratiewe Beampte by die Vergoedingsfonds in Pretoria, wat 'n LLB of ekwivalent met 8 jaar se regsonderhoud en toelating as 'n Advokaat of Prokureur vereis.

Ukucinga ngokubalulekileyo nangokutsha. Ukumisela inkqubo. Ukukhuthaza isithembiso. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ukwenza umsebenzi nokuqwalasela. Ulawulo lweNkqubo/Umsebenzi. Qinisekiso lokhwalithi. af.requirements: Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 6) soos deur SAQA erken in Finansies/Beleggingsbestuur/Finansiële Ekonomie/Finansiële Rekenkunde. 4 Jaar funksionele ervaring in 'n Tesourie-/Finansies-/Beleggingsbestuur-/Finansiële Rekenkunde-omgewing waarvan 2 jaar op 'n senior staatsrekenmeestervlak of toesigvlak moet wees. Finansiële risikobestuur en beheer. Finansiële nakoming. Inligtingverwerking. Finansiële markte en instrumente (Finansiële ontleding). Digitale vaardigheid (Finansiële stelsels, gereedskap). Portefeuljerisiko-optimalisering. Beleggingsbestuur. Bestuur van finansiële rekeninge. Afrigting en mentorskap. Konflikbestuur. Kritiese en innoverende denke. Rigtingbepaling. Toewyding inspireer. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwebandla Ukubamba Iqhaza. Ukubuka Phambili Inqubo.

xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaze kufundela kwiNkonzo ezingalawulo / ekuLawuleni iMisebenzi / ekuLawuleni iVeliso / eBugcwele beNjineli / ekuFundeni umsebenzi / ekuLwazi lokuziphatha kwabasebenzi kunye neNkcubeko kwiNqanaba leNQF 6 njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Iminyaka mibini (2) yamava kwindawo ekuQwalaselweni kwenkcubeko (OD). Ulwazi: iMigaqo yeNkonzo yoLuntu. iMigaqo yeMali yoLuntu. iMigaqo yeNkonzo yoLuntu. iMigaqo yeNxaxheba yeBasebenzi. iMigaqo yeNdalo ezisezantsi zeNkonzo. iMigaqo yeNtshukumbo eNtseni ngokoYilo lwenkcubeko. Isixokelelwano sekuqwalaselwa komsebenzi / ukulinganiselwa. Iindlela zokuFunda umsebenzi. Isikhokelo seDPSA seMmesebenzi. Amakhono: ekuLawuleni iMali. ekuThetheni. ekuSebenzeni iKhompyutha. ekuLawuleni iXesha. ekuHlobiseni nabantu. ekuBhaleni iNgxelo. eCwangciseni nokuCwangcisa. ekuQwalaselweni. ekuQambeni. ekuKhuliseni. ekuBoniseni.
xh.duties: Yila uze uphonononge uLwakhiwo lwenkcubeko. Qwalasela inqubo ekuqwalaselwa umsebenzi ngaphakathi kwesixa samali. Zisebenzise iLwakhiwo lwenkcubeko, iMigaqo/ iMiyalelo. Yila uze uxhase ukusayina kwezimemo zomsebenzi. Lawula amaxhoba kwisiNgangixa.

jobs.title: Chief Security Officer
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum, plus 37% in lieu of benefits
jobs.summary: Chief Security Officer at the Mmabatho Provincial Office, responsible for monitoring safety, access control, and resource management within the Department of Employment and Labour.
jobs.requirements: Three (3) year National Diploma 9NQF6) / Undergraduate Bachelor Degree (NQF7) in Security/ security Risk Management. Grade B Security Certificate and PSIRA. One-year functional clerical / administrative experience in Security Training Services or Security Management Services. Knowledge: Departmental Policies and Procedures. Criminal Procedure Act. Tender Procedures. Safety and Security. Damage and Loss control. Supply Chain Management. Accommodation procedures. National Strategic Intelligence Act. National Key points Act. Firearms control Act. OHS Act. Access to Public premises and Vehicle Act. Public Finance Management Act. Labour Relations Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Skills: Management Skills. Computer Literacy. Project Management. Innovative. Conflict Resolution and Negotiation. Diversity facilitation. Communication Skills.
jobs.duties: Monitor the safety of officials and assets in the Department. Administer access control to the building. Manage control room and key control. Provide administration support services for the sub-directorate. Security standby ad after-hours inspection. Manage resources within the division.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Litheko Tel No: (018) 387 8128
jobs.applications: Chief Director: Provincial Operations: Private Bag X2040, Mmabatho, 2735 or hand deliver at Provident House, University Drive, Mmabatho or email: Jobs- ASDHRM-NW@labour.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Sub-directorate: Deputy Director: Human Resources Management
jobs.notes: Online application must include an application form Z83 and CV as one attachment, indicate the correct job title and correct reference number of the post on the email. Use the correct email address associated with the post. Applications quoting the relevant reference number, correct job title and correct name of the Department must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the old Z83 application form will not be considered. Each application for each post (s) must have its own application form. All fields of Section A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83 it is acceptable for applicants to indicate refer to CV or see attached. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered and declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV and a completed, initialled and signed Z83 application form is required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following the communication from Human Resources and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit holders in posession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Applicants who do not comply with the application instructions/requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The requirements for application of Senior Management Services (SMS) include the successful completion of an SMS Pre-entry programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School Government (NSG). Prior to appointment, a candidate should therefore have proof that they have registered for the Pre- Entry Certificate and have completed the course. The cost for Nyukela is at the applicant’s own expense. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the      below      link:     https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Your information will be used soley for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. Successful candidates will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the below advertised post(s). Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within eight (8) weeks after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The Employment Equity targets will be taken into consideration during the selection process. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofsekuriteitsbeampte
af.summary: Hoofsekuriteitsbeampte by die Mmabatho Provinsiale Kantoor, verantwoordelik vir die monitering van veiligheid, toegangsbeheer en hulpbronbestuur binne die Department of Employment and Labour.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) / Voorgraadse Bachelordiploma (NQF7) in Sekuriteits-/ Sekuriteitsrisikobestuur. Graad B Sekuriteitsertifikaat en PSIRA. Een jaar funksionele klerklike / administratiewe ervaring in Sekuriteitsopleidingsdienste of Sekuriteitsbestuursdienste. Kennis: Departementele beleide en prosedures. Criminal Procedure Act. Tenderprosedures. Veiligheid en sekuriteit. Skade- en verliesbeheer. Supply Chain Management. Akkommodasieprosedures. National Strategic Intelligence Act. National Key points Act. Firearms control Act. OHS Act. Access to Public premises and Vehicle Act. Public Finance Management Act. Labour Relations Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Vaardighede: Bestuursvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Projekbestuur. Innovatief. Konflikoplossing en onderhandeling. Diversiteitsfasilitering. Kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Monitor die veiligheid van amptenare en bates in die departement. Administreer toegangsbeheer tot die gebou. Bestuur kontrolekamer en sleutelbeheer. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste vir die subdirektoraat. Sekuriteitsstandby en na-uurs inspeksie. Bestuur hulpbronne binne die afdeling.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esikhulu Sokuphepha
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esikhulu Sokuphepha eMmabatho Provincial Office, esibhekele ukugqamisa ukuphepha, ukulawula ukungena, nokuphathwa kwamaphakheji ngaphakathi kweDepartment of Employment and Labour.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF6) / i-Undergraduate Bachelor Degree (NQF7) kwi-Security / Security Risk Management. Isitifikedi Se-Proviso seSikolo seGrade B kanye ne-PSIRA. Isipiliwo seminyaka eyodwa somsebenzi wasekoloji / wobulungisi ekwenziweni kwezinsizakalo zokuqeqesha ukuphepha noma ezinsizakalo zokuphathwa kokuphepha. Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo nokuqhubeka kweminyango. I-Criminal Procedure Act. I-Tender Procedures. Ukuphepha nokuvikeleka. Ukulawula ukulahlekelwa nokonakala. I-Supply Chain Management. Izenzo zendlalo. I-National Strategic Intelligence Act. I-National Key Points Act. I-Firearms Control Act. I-OHS Act. I-Access to Public Premises and Vehicle Act. I-Public Finance Management Act. I-Labour Relations Act. I-Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Amakhono: Amakhono okuphatha. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukuba nomqondo osha. Ukuxazulula imfucuza kanye nokuxoxisana. Ukulekelela ekuhlukweni. Amakhono okuxhumana.
zu.duties: Qaphela ukuphepha kwezikhulu nakwezimpahla kumnyango. Lawula ukungena esakhiweni. Phatha igumbi lokulawula kanye nokulawula ukhiye. Nikeza insiza yobulungisi kumqondo ophantsi. Ukuma kokuphepha nokuhlola emuva kwamahora. Phatha amaphakheji ngaphakathi kwesigaba.

xh.title: ISikhulu esiPhezulu soKhuseleko
xh.summary: ISikhulu esiPhezulu soKhuseleko kwiNdzuzo yaseMmabatho, exhaswe ukulawula ukhuseleko, ulawulo lokungena, nolawulo lwemithobo-mali ngaphakathi kwiSebe loMsebenzi nokuSebenzela.
xh.requirements: Diploma yaminyaka mithathu (3) (NQF6) / Isidanga seSekondari seBachelor (NQF7) kwiKhuseleko / uLawulo loMngcipheko wokhuseleko. Isatifikethi seKhuseleko seGrade B nese-PSIRA. Isiphalaphala seminyaka eliloda kwinkonzo yomphathiswa / ulawulo kwiinkonzo zoQeqesho loKhuseleko okanye iinkonzo zoLawulo loKhuseleko. ulwazi: iNgqungquthana nemiQathango yesebe. uMthetho wokuQhuba iimBaNgo. iNkqubo yokuThengisa. uKhuseleko nokuKhuselwa. uLawulo lokuShicilelwa nokuLahleka. uLawulo lokuQhagamshelana nemithobo. iNkqubo yokuLungiselela indawo yokuhlala. uMthetho weZizwe nokuQonda iQonga. uMthetho weZizwe weNdawo eziBalulekileyo. uMthetho loLawulo lweZixhobo zokuQhuba. uMthetho woKhuseleko lweNgqondo. uMthetho wonikezelo lwangaphambili kwindawo zikaZwelonke nokuQhuba. uMthetho loLawulo lweMali yoLuntu. uMthetho weMiba yawoMsebenzi. uMthetho woMthetho oNxulumene neMiba yokuQeshwa. Amandla: Amandla oLawulo. ukwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha. uLawulo lweProjekthi. ukuQabambela. ukuLungisa iingxabano nokuNxibelelana. ukuQondisa iNgcambu. Amandla eNkundla.
xh.duties: Qaphela ukhuseleko lwabasebenzi nemiqhathengi kwisebe. lawula ukungena kwabantu kwisakhiwo. lawula igumbi lolawulo nokuqhotsoza. bonezela inkonzo zolawulo kumntlwana. qinisekisa ukhuseleko ngenxoluthi yokuvavanya emva weyure. lawula imithobo ngaphakathi kwecandelo.

af.summary: Inbound-agente hanteer kliëntnavrae en registreer COID-eise by die Compensation Fund in Pretoria, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat benodig met geen vorige ervaring wat nodig is nie.

Kennis: Kennis van toepaslike regulasies, reg en wetgewing (PFMA, COIDA, POPIA, Promotion of access of Information Access, Public Service Act, Labour Relation Act, National Treasury Regulations). Digitele vaardigheid/oplettendheidsentrum-funksionaliteite. Oproepbestuur. Navraagbestuur. Belanghebbende-ontwikkeling en -bestuur. Compensation Fund-beleide, prosedures, prosesse. zu.summary: Abagenti abangenayo baphathela imibuzo yamakhasimende futhi babhalise izikhalazo ze-COID e Compensation Fund e-Pretoria, kudingeka isitifiketi se-Grade 12 lingadinga mhlawumbe ngaphambi kokuba nolwazi oluthile lwemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. (NQF Level 4). Akukho lolunye ukuhlelelwa. Ukuzidumbuza kwe-Digital/Imisebenzi yethimba lezocingo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwesimanga. Ukulawula imibuzo. Ukuthuthukiswa nokulawulwa kwabalalele. I-Compensation Fund, izinhlelo, izinqubo, namaqhinga. Isibono nezinhloso zethimba lezocingo. Izidingo zokusebenza kwethimba lezocingo. Izinsiza kumakhasimende (Izimiso ze-Batho Pele). Izinqubo namaqhinga eNakekelwa amakhasimende. Izidingo zomthetho: Akukho. Amakhono: Ukuthola kanye nokuthumela imininingwane. Ukulawula isimanga. Ukuzwa ngokuphila. Ukucabanga ngokubaluleka nokwakha okusha. Ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi. Ukuba nokuhlakahlaka kokulethwa kwesevisi.
zu.duties: Ukuhamba ngesibaxa ngokuphathelene nemibuzo yamakhasimende ngesevisi engenayo. Ukubhalisa kanye nokuthumela izikhalazo ze-COID kwisimiso esisebenzayo. Ukwenza izinqubo zokuphucula ngokuqhubeka.

jobs.title: Scientist Specialist: Small Pelagic Fish and Fisheries
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 21 September 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: Lead scientific research and regulatory functions for small pelagic fish and fisheries at the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: PhD (NQF Level 10) in Science /Natural or relevant qualification within the related field as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of ten (10) years relevant scientific experience after BSc qualification and Compulsory registration with SACNASP as a Professional Natural Scientist. Theoretical and/or practical knowledge of fisheries and biological research activities. Small pelagic fish and fisheries resources and sustainable management thereof. Scientific methodologies and models. Scientific research and development. Data analysis and statistics with a strong quantitative focus. Marine biology, fish biology, aquatic vertebrate or invertebrate reproductive biology. Research and development. Knowledge of current states and trends in fisheries research and management (globally). Statistical analysis of data and statistical programming languages. Knowledge of legal compliance. Scientific presentation. Recognized level of expertise. Mentoring, Research and development. Programme and project management. Strategic capability and leadership. Planning, organising and execution. Financial management. Conflict management and People management. Ability to identify research gaps and develop an appropriate research programme. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to develop and apply policies. Ability to work under pressure and submit documents to local and international fora within required timeframes. Ability to work long hours voluntarily, under extreme pressure, individually and in a team. Good interpersonal relations skills. Ability to work with difficult persons and to resolve conflict. Ability and willingness to work at sea.
jobs.duties: Perform scientific analysis and regulatory functions: lead, oversee, perform scientific functions and provide strategic research direction that results in knowledge accumulation, progress in scientific applications and technology, relating to small pelagic fish and fisheries. analysis of scientific data (statistical analysis and modelling) fisheries stock assessment on a broad range of fisheries resources; Apply Operational Management Procedures to generate information and scientific advice for sustainable fisheries management. Develop and implement methodologies, policies, systems and procedures: Identify gaps and develop appropriate interventions; Develop working relations with fisheries industry, small scale fisheries, all fisheries right holders. Research and development: Conduct basic and applied research on fisheries stock assessment and management procedures; Perform research/literature studies to improve expertise; Publish and present research findings. Provide scientific support and advice: Provide scientific data, information and advice when required; Develop scientific advice and documentation for sustainable fisheries management. Human capital development: Train, mentor and develop junior personnel on data-analysis related queries; Supervise scientific work and processes. Supervise scientific data archiving and retrieval as appropriate.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Zimasa Jika at 082 332 7943

af.title: Wetenskaplike Spesialis: Klein Pelagiese Vis en Visserye
af.summary: Lei wetenskaplike navorsing en reguleringsfunksies vir klein pelagiese vis en visserye by die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Cape Town.
af.requirements: PhD (NQF Level 10) in Wetenskap/Natuurwetenskap of 'n tersyakklike kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar se tersyaklike wetenskaplike ervaring na BSc-kwalifikasie en verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as 'n Professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Teoretiese en/of praktiese kennis van visserye en biologiese navorsingsaktiwiteite. Klein pelagiese vis- en visseryehulpbronne en volhoubare bestuur daarvan. Wetenskaplike metodes en modelle. Wetenskaplike navorsing en ontwikkeling. Data-analise en statistiek met 'n sterk kwantitatiewe fokus. Mariene biologie, visbiologie, akwatiese werwel- of ongewerwelde voortplantingsbiologie. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Kennis van huidige toestande en tendense in visserynavorsing en -bestuur (wêreldwyd). Statistiese analise van data en statistiese programmeertale. Kennis van wetlike nakoming. Wetenskaplike voorlegging. Erkende vlak van kundigheid. Mentorskapsvermoë, navorsing en ontwikkeling. Program- en projekbestuur. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Beplanning, organisering en uitvoering. Finansiële bestuur. Konflikbestuur en mensebestuur. Vermoë om navorsingsgappe te identifiseer en 'n toepaslike navorsingsprogram te ontwikkel. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te analiseer. Vermoë om beleide te ontwikkel en toe te pas. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en dokumente binne vereiste tydperke aan plaaslike en internasionale forums voor te lê. Vermoë om vrywillig lang ure te werk, onder uiterste druk, individueel en in 'n span. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los. Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om ter see te werk.
af.duties: Voer wetenskaplike analise en reguleringsfunksies uit: lei, hou toesig oor, voer wetenskaplike funksies uit en verskaf strategiese navorsingsrigting wat lei tot Kennisakkumulasie, vordering in wetenskaplike toepassings en tegnologie, met betrekking tot klein pelagiese vis en visserye. analise van wetenskaplike data (statistiese analise en modellering) visseryvoorraadassesserings oor 'n wye reeks visseryhulpbronne; Pas Operasionele Bestuursprosedures toe om inligting en wetenskaplike advies vir volhoubare visserybestuur te genereer. Ontwikkel en implementeer metodes, beleide, stelsels en prosedures: Identifiseer gapings en ontwikkel toepaslike ingrypings; Bou werkverhoudinge met die visserybedryf, kleinskaalse visserye, alle visseryreghebbers. Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Voer basiese en toegepaste navorsing oor visseryvoorraadassessering en bestuursprosedures uit; Voer navorsings/literatuurstudies uit om kundigheid te verbeter; Publiseer en lê navorsingsbevindings voor. Verskaf wetenskaplike ondersteuning en advies: Verskaf wetenskaplike data, inligting en advies wanneer vereis; Ontwikkel wetenskaplike advies en dokumentasie vir volhoubare visserybestuur. Menslike kapitaalontwikkeling: Train, mentor en ontwikkel junior personeel oor data-analieseverwante navrae; Hou toesig oor wetenskaplike werk en prosesse. Hou toesig oor wetenskaplike data-argivering en -terugwinning soos toepaslik.

zu.title: Isikhulu sezibaluli: Izinhlanzi ezincane ezibhukuda kanye nozimboni wokudoba
zu.summary: Beka iqhaza ekubukeni ucwaningo olusemthethweni nemisebenzi yokulawula ngokwezinhlanzi ezincane ezibhukuda kanye nolwangu oluzimele oNyakeni i-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment eCape Town.
zu.requirements: I-PhD (NQF Level 10) eScience /Natural noma izifundo ezihambisana nazo njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Ubude obungu-10) iminyaka yemfundo ngemva kwe-BSc kanye nokubhalisa ngokuyikho ngo-SACNASP njengengcwaba ye-Natural Scientist. Ukuqonda ngokwendlela ngenhloso mayelana nezimboni zokudoba nemisebenzi yokuhlola ubuhlelwane. Izinhlanzi ezincane ezibhukuda nezinsiza zokudoba kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezihlelekile. Izindlela zobuchwepheshe nezibonelo. Ucwaningo nezinto ezingashiswa kakhulu. Ukuhlaziya imininingwane nezibalo ngokuqonda okuhambisana nezibalo ezinamathuba amakhulu. Ucwaningo ngemvelo yolwandle, ubuhlelwane bezinhlanzi, ukuzala kolwandle kwezilwane ezincane noma ezinkulu. Ucwaningo oluzimele nokuqeqesha. Ukuqonda ngemithetho yamanje namagugu ohlelo lwemboni yezokudoba kanye nokuphathwa kwemithetho emhlabeni jikelele. Ukuhlaziya imininingwane ngokwesibalo nezilimi zohlelo lokucwazula. Ukuqonda ngokomthetho kahulumeni. Ukwethula izinto ezingashiswa kakhulu. Izinga elihambisana namandla ezinsuku. Ukufundisa, ukwenza ucwaningo nokuthuthukisa. Ukuhola izinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ubuchwepheshe bokubuka kude nokuhola. Ukuhlela, ukulungisa nokuphumeza imisebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye nokuphathwa kwabantu. Ukuba nolwazi lokusebenza ngokwemvelo nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezifanele. Ukuba nolwazi lokuqoqa ukuhlaziya imininingwane. Ukuba nolwazi lokuqonda nokusebenzisa izinhlelo. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkinga kanye nokuhambisa imibhalo kumhlangano wasekhaya nasezweni jikelele ngemva kwesikhathi. Ukusebenza isikhathi eside ngokuzimela, ngaphansi kwezinkinga ezinkulu, ngabanye nangabanye kanye nakwabanye. Ukusebenza ngokwemvelo ezidingweni zomuntu. Ukusebenza ngabantu abanzima kanye nokuqonda izinkinga. Ukusebenza kolwandle.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuhlaziya ngokwesayensi nemisebenzi yokulawula: bamba iqhaza, hola, yenza imisebenzi yesayensi futhi nikezela ngemfundo eqondile ethuthukisa izinhlelo kanye nobuchwepheshe obuthelekisa izinhlanzi ezincane ezibhukuda nezimboni zokudoba. ukuhlaziya imininingwane (isibalo nokuqondisa imodeli) ukuqoqwa kwezinsiza zezimboni zokudoba eziningi; Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuqondisa imisebenzi ukukhiqiza imininingwane kanye nokuqinisekisa izenzo ezingashiswa kakhulu zokulawula izimboni. Buka izindlela ezincane nokwenza izinhlelo: Qaphula izikhala bese ukhetha izinhlela; Yiza nohwebo lobudlelwano nabahwebi bezinhlanzi, abantu abancane kwezinhlanzi, onke amalungelo abantu abadoba. Ucwaningo kanye nokuqeqesha: Yenza ucwaningo ngezenzo ezincane noma ezinkulu ezihlobene nezinsiza zemfuyo kanye nezinsiza ezisesimeni sendlela; Yenza ucwaningo noma ukuthola imininingwane ukukhulisa izinsiza; Shicilela bese ukhombisa imininingwane. Yiza ngezinsiza ezingashiswa kakhulu kanye nokuqinisekisa izenzo ezifanele: Yiza ngedatha, imininingwane kanye nokuqinisekisa lapho kudingeka khona; Hlela imininingwane kanye nemibhalo yokulawula izinhlanzi ezincane ezibhukuda. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla abantu: Qeqesha, fundisa bese ukhuthaza abantu abancane kumibuzo ehlobene nedatha; Hola imisebenzi yesayensi kanye nendlela. Hola imininingwane yesayensi bese uyigcina bese uyifaka futhi lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: Isikhulu seSayensi Esonqweni: Iintlanzi nezeMpilo zeentlanzi ezincinane nezolimo lwentlanzi
xh.summary: Qonda ucando lokuphandelo lwesayensi nemisebenzi yemithelelo yeentlanzi ezincinane nezolimo lwentlanzi kwisebe leMininzi, iZolimo lwentlanzi nendalo kwisebe leMininzi, iZolimo lwentlanzi nendalo eCape Town.
xh.requirements: I-PhD (NQF Level 10) kwiSayensi/Inzululwazi okanye nesi ngqinisekiso esidibene nendawo njengokuchaziwe yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane kweminyaka elishumi (10) yamava obugcisa obunomdla emva kwe-BSc kwaye kuqatshanwe ukubhalisa kwi-SACNASP njengakusayensi yendalo eBalulekileyo. Ulwazi lwengcamango okanye nolwesembenzo ngezolimo lwentlanzi nemisebenzi yophando lebayoloji. Iintlanzi ezincinane namathuba azolimo lwentlanzi nalawo alawulwa ngokuzinza. Iindlela zesayensi nezomzobo. Uphando nokuphuhliswa kwesayensi. Uhlalutyo lwedatha nabalazo ngokusondezela ngamazinga amaninzi ekulinganiseni. I-bayoloji yolwandle, i-bayoloji yentlanzi, i-bayoloji yokuzala kumaxhoba olwadle okanye abangekho kumaxhoba olwandle. Ucandelo lokuphanda nokuphuhliswa. Ulwazi ngemilinganiselo yanjani nangemiqondo ekuphandweni nolawulweni lolimo lwentlanzi (emhlabeni jikelele). Uhlalutyo lwedatha ngeelwimi zebalo zokwenza iinkqubo. Ulwazi ngokumiselwa kwemithetho. Isepsethensi yesayensi. Ukuyala, ukuphanda nokuphuhliswa. Ulawulo lwenkqubo namaprojekhthi. Amandla okulwandlela kwaye abe ngumlawuli. Ulungelelwaniso, ukuqamba nokwenza izinto. Ulawulo lwemali. Ulawulo lweengxaki nolawulo lwabantu. Amandla okuqaphela izikhewu ekuphandweni nokuqamba inkqubo ekufanelekileyo yophando. Amandla okuqokeleza nokuhlalutya iinkcukacha. Amandla okuqamba nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezilawulayo. Amandla okusebenza ngxamxele nokungenisa amaxwebhu kumazwe ngamanye amazwe ngexesha elichaziweyo. Amandla okusebenza iiyure ezininzi ngokuzithanda, ngokuxinanisa, ngamnye naphakathi kwqembu. Amandla amagama obudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Amandla okusebenza nabantu abanengxaki nokusombulula iingxabano. Amandla nokuzimisela ukusebenza olwandle.
xh.duties: Yenza uhlalutyo lwesayensi nemisebenzi yemithelelo: qhobosha, lawula, yenza imisebenzi yesayensi unike indlela eqondileyo yophando evela kolwazi, inkqubela ekusebenziseni isayensi noluntu, ngokumayelana neentlanzi ezincinane nezolimo lwentlanzi. uhlalutyo lwedatha yophando (izibalo nokuqamba iinkqubo) iyonke lezolimo kwizinto ezahlukeneyo zezolimo lwentlanzi; Sebenzisa iindlela zoLawulo oQhoboshoyo ukuvelisa iinkcukacha nengcebiso yesayensi ngolawulo lolimo lwentlanzi oluzinzelweyo. Qamba usebenzise iindlela, iinkqubo ezithintela imisebenzi, iinkqubo namagunya: Qaphela izikhewu uze uqambe iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokungenelela; Qamba ubudlelwane ngexesha lonke noshishino lolimo lwentlanzi, ezolimo lwentlanzi ezincinane, bonke abanamagunya abalawula izolimo. Ucandelo lokuphanda nokuphuhliswa: Qamba uphando olusetyenziswa yolimo lolimo lwentlanzi nolawulo ngenkqubo; Qamba ucando lokuphanda/ukufunda amagama obugcisa ukuze uphucule i-sepsethensi; Shicilela ubike imixholo yophando. Nike inkxaso negcebiso yesayensi: Nike idatha yesayensi, iinkcukacha negcebiso xa kufuneka; Qamba ingcebiso yesayensi namaxwebhu ngolawulo lolimo oluzinzelweyo. Uphuhliso lwamandla abantu: Qeqisha, yala uze uphuhlise abantu abangabafundi kumabala ahlalutyo lwedatha; Qhobosha imisebenzi nenkqubo yesayensi. Qhobosha ukugcina idatha yesayensi nokuqokelela idatha ngendlela efanelekileyo.

Knowledge of the National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No 84 of 1998) (NFA) and the National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No 101 of 1998) (NVFFA). Knowledge of the function of different departments and levels of government. Government business practices and policies. Project Management and strategic planning. Stakeholder Engagement. Promote partnerships between government, Non-Government Organisations (NGOs) and private individuals and communities to ensure long term commitment to land under forestry programmes. Promote sustainable use of natural resources on indigenous forest areas on both communal and privately owned land through partnerships with interested and affected parties. Coordinate and facilitate forestry greening and livelihood programmes and projects. Facilitate the implementation of greening initiatives (Ten Million Trees) programmes. Provide technical support in the development of business plans and source funding for enterprise and livelihoods projects. Facilitate the integration of Forestry Development into Local, Provincial and National Government Development spheres. Participate in the Comprehensive Rural Development and Urban Renewal Programmes. Render support in the coordination of forestry greening campaigns. Provide support for the Arbor Month and Arbor City Awards Programme.

Kennis van die funksie van verskillende departemente en vlakke van regering. Regeringsakepraktyke en -beleid. Projekbestuur en strategiese beplanning. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en kritiek te hanteer. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om in moeilike situasies te onderhandel en konflik op te los. af.duties: Verskaf tegniese advies en ondersteuning ten opsigte van vergroeningsprogramme of -inisiatiewe. Bevorder vennootskappe tussen regering, nie-regeringsorganisasies (NGO's) en private individue en gemeenskappe om langtermynverbintenis tot grond onder bosbouprogramme te verseker. zu.title: Onozimele: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezihlahla (UKUHLOLWA noku
zu.summary: Onozimele wokuThuthukiswa kwezihlahla ukuze axhase izinhlelo zokuhlolwa kuzo zonke izindawo i-Kimberley, i-Bellville ne-Nelspruit.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQ6) kwezokuQoqwa kwezihlahla noma ukuFunda ngokuThuthukiswa noma izifundo ezihambisana naso njengokuthiwa yi-SAQA. Ukubekezela okungenani kweminyaka emithathu (3) ephezulu yokusebenza kwezokuQoqwa kwezihlahla noma noma yisiphi isikhundla esihlobene nakho. Ukwazi ngokuQunjelwa kwezihlahla Nsuku zonke, 1998 (Act No 84 of 1998) (NFA) kanye noMthetho wokuVuthwa kwamalahle neMlilo weNhlabathi nakwezihlahla, 1998 (Act No 101 of 1998) (NVFFA). Ukuba nesiqu sokusebenza kabanzi ngezinhlelo ezahlukeneyo zabaholi bamaphandle, ukuqonda ukuthi zisebenza kanjani izigaba eziyingxenye yohlelo kolwazi lwawo wonke amaphoyisa. Ukuqonda ngobungcweti beenhlelo zombuso nezinqubomgomo. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nokuhlela. Ukuxhumana nabantu abathintekayo. Ikholofane nokuba bukhali ekubukeni ngakudlule nokuba yinhloko ekubukeni okusetshenziswa khona. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokubakhuthaza. Amakhono okuba nobuhlobo obuhle kabanzi. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle. Isikhwenzi sokusebenza ngaphansi komthwalo kanye nokuqonda izinkinga. Isikhwenzi sokuqoqa kanye nokucazula imininingwane. Isikhwenzi sokuqasha kwezinkinga ezinzima kakhulu nezinto ezingaxazululeki. Amakhono okushayela amaphepha kanye nesithembiso sokuvakasha.
zu.duties: Yanika izeluleko ngeseluleko ngokuhlolwa ngezinhlelo noma iziqinisekiso ngokuhlolwa kwemitapo nezihlahla. Khuthaza amakhono okubuyisela umhlaba ohlwempuzekile kubantu abangakwazi ukuba nabantu abajwayelekile nabangenamkhakha kulezo zinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwemitapo yezihlahla. Khuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezindawo zemvelo ngendlela ehlala isikhathi eside ezindaweni zasendle nakulabo abanomhlaba nabayikho, kubandakanya nabantu abathintekayo. Hlanganisa futhi unike izeluleko ezinhlelweni zokuhlolwa kwemitapo nezihlahla, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ziphilile ngokomthetho. Yize izeluleko nangokuphumeleliswa kwezinhlelo ngokuHlolwa kwemitapo (Izigidi ezilishumi) izinhlelo. Yanika iseluleko ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo bese ithola imali yokusekela izinhlela zokuPhila komphakathi. Hlanganisa izinhlelo zokuThuthukiswa kwemitapo yezihlahla kumaphoyisa omKhakha weNdklu, neSebe leNdlu, neSigungu sobuKhosi. Genza kakhulu ezinhlelweni zokuThuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya nokuvuselelwa kwezindawo ezakhiwa ngaphezulu. Yanika inkokhelo kulezo zinhlelo ezihlola ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlolwa kwemitapo. Sekela inyanga yokuHlolwa kwemitapo kanye noMkhakha wezindawo ezifakelwa izihlahla abazuzile amakhosi wona.

xh.summary: Umcedisi weNdlela ukuYila weNkcubeko ePhuhliweyo kuThungelwano lweZihlahla ukuxhasa iinkqubo zokuhlambela kuzo onke amazanga Kimberley, Bellville kunye Nelspruit.

Ulwazi ngoMthetho weZihlahla zoMthetho waseLizwe, 1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 84 ka-1998) (NFA) nakuMthetho weVeld yaseLizwe kunye noMthetho weMlilo weZihlahla, 1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 101 ka-1998) (NVFFA). Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamasebe ahlukeneyo kunye namanqanaba ahlukeneyo karhulumente. Iinkqubo kunye neenqobo zoshishino karhulumente. uLawulo lweProjekthi kunye neCandelo lokuQamba iNdlela. uNxibelelwano namaQela ahlukeneyo. uKwazi ukuQamba iNdlela kunye noBuntu bokuzoba. uLawulo lweMali. uLawulo lwabantu kunye namandla okuzinikela. Amandla amabaluleyo ekunxibelelaneni nemizwa yoluntu. Amandla amabaluleyo ekuNcedisana kolwimi luthathu. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi komthwalo wamandla kwaye ukiphele amaxhala okugxekiweyo. Ukwazi ukuqokelela kunye nokuqwalasela iNkcukacha. Ukwazi ukuxoxwa izinto ezinzima kwaye uxolise iingxabano. iLayisenisi yokushukuma ethi yawowayo nokuzimisela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Nika izeluleko zobugcisa kunye nencebo ngenkqubo yokuhlambela okanye ngenkuthazo. Khuthaza ubudlelwane phakathi karhulumente, amaQela eNhlangano ezingurhulumente (NGO) nabantu abangeyiyo karhulumente nemiqulu ukuqinisekisa isazuziso eside ngesithuba somhlaba kuyo inkqubo yamahlahlala. Khuthaza ukusetyenziswa okuzinza kwemithombo yendalo kwimimandla yamahlahlala endalo kokubili umhlaba wonke kabanzi nomhlaba obumwashwashu ngokudibana namajoni anomdla kwaye athintekileyo. Lungiselela kwaye uncedise iinkqubo zamahlahlala nokuhlambela okunjalo yonk' imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla nemiqulu. Ncedisa ukuphumezelela iinkqubo zokuqalisa imibutho yokuqala ngokuhamba kwexesha nokwenza amashishini (iTen Million Trees). Nika incedo ngokubakho kobuchule bokuzoba izicwangciso zoshishino kwaye ufune imali ngenkqubo yamashishini namaphuhliso. Ncedisa ukufakwa kwenkcubeko ephuhliweyo kwizihlala seziKhal ezaKhuselwa iNkcubeko ePjuza ngokukhawuleza eNdaweni, ePhondo naseLizwe.

xh.duties:
Phonononga, uhlole ngenkqubo zonke izicelo ze-EIA.
Phonononga, uhlole ngenkqubo zonke izicelo ezimayelana neMigunya yeNdalo Ehlanganiswayo.
Phonononga, uhlole ngenkqubo zonke izicelo ze-S24G.

zu.title: Inkosi Yomphakathi Wesimo sezulu Eqondene NokuKhiqiza: Okuphakamisiwe
zu.summary: Kudingeka Inkosi Yomphakathi Wesimo sezulu ePretoria ukubuyeza izicelo ze-EIA, ukuqamba ukuvakashela izindawo, kanye nokuhlanganisa neminyango yokuqinisa nokunikeza izimvume.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Honours (NQF Level 8) kwi-Environmental Management/Natural Sciences noma iziqu ezihlobene nale ndawo njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Kumele kube nokuhlangene kweminyaka eyisithuphu (3) yokuqashwa komsebenzi ohlobene nale ndawo. Okuhlangenwe nakho ekuphatheni izinqumo ze-EIA bese njalo okubandakanyeka kwisekhthi ye-EIA. Ulwazi nokuhlangenwe nakho okujulile ngoMthetho Wokuqonda Izwe Nesimo sezulu, njengoba ushintshiwe kanye noMthetho Wokuqonda Izwe Nesimo sezulu: UMthetho WeZinkohlakalo. Ulwazi nokuhlangenwe nakho okujulile kwi-GN Regulation 982, 983, 984, 985 kanye ne-994 kanye noshintsho oluphakanyisiwe. Ulwazi olujulile ngo-S24 we-NEMA. Ulwazi olujulile ngokuqondwa kokuqondisa isimo sezulu kanye nokusetshenziswa kwaso. Ulwazi ngemigomo namagugu entsukumbilo yokuthuthuka. Okuhlangenwe nakho ekuphatheni nokuqeqeshwa kwe-EIA kanye namandla e-EIA ekuphathweni kwamasistimu. Amakhono okusebenza ngokujulile ngokwegumbi elikhombisa ulwazi azokuba lusizo. Ukuqashwa kwi-EAPASA, ukubhaqelela izifundo ze-environmental management noma i-EIA, kanye namakhono we-GIS azokuba lusizo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (okubhaliwe, okuthethwayo kanye nemidwebo). Amakhono amahle okuhlela, ukulungiselela kanye nokubika. Umoxaziswa wezinkinga nomcabango ongakamuva. Ikono lokusebenza ngabanye kanye nasenhlanganweni. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela kanye nesifiso sokuhamba ibanga elide. Kumele abe nelayiseni yokushayela elivunyiwe.
zu.duties: Buyeza futhi uhlole izicelo ze-EIA. Buyeza futhi uhlole izicelo zokuqukethweziwezelelwa kwemvume yesimo sezulu ehiywe ngokushintshwa. Buyeza futhi uhlole izicelo ze-S24G. Qamba ukuvakashela izindawo bese uhlanganisa imibiko yokuvinjwa kwendawo. Hlanganisa nezinkqubu zokuqinisa nezokuqinisa ngaphakathi komnyango. Siza ekuphatheni futhi uqaphele ukuziphendula kokumiswa kwemvume yesimo sezulu. Nikeza inzulu ngokuvunyelwa kwesimo sezulu. Hlola imibhalo futhi uphakamise izinqumo ze-EIA. Siza ekuthuthukisweni kwemigomo ehiywe ngokushintshwa yolwazi oluzenzakalelayo lwezinhlelo (SOPs). Zinqume izistimu, izinsiza nezinhlelo ehiyiwe ezihlobene nokugcina nokuqonda isimo sezulu. Xhumana ngaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nezicelo zemvume yesimo sezulu (ukuxhumana nabalawuli namakhasimende). Nikeza inzulu yezobuchwepheshe emibhalweni ebanjiweyo enikwa ngwe-Nkosikazi nge-NEMA nangezinqumo ze-NEMA. Siza ekuphatheni futhi uqaphele ukuziphendula kokumiswa kwemvume yesimo sezulu ehiyweyo. Faka izinsiza kumthetho namagugu ohlobene nesimo sezulu.

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Spesialisproduksie
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte gesoek in Cape Town om akwakultuurplase se nakoming van wetgewing rakende mariene visselveiligheid te monitor, insluitend skulpdiere-biotoksiene en mikrobiologiese kwaliteitstoetsing.
af.requirements: Honours-graad (NQF-vlak 8) in Omgewingsbestuur of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Moet 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in die tersaaklike veld hê. Kennis van die Marine Living Resource Act, 1998, Suid-Afrikaanse wetgewing rakende voedsel- en verbruikersveiligheid verbonde aan akwakultuur. Kennis en ervaring in laboratoriumouditprosedures. Ervaring in laboratoriuminstrumentasie en -tegnieke, monsterversameling en data-analise. Begrip van akwakultuur- en voedselveiligheidskontroles. Ervaring in beleids- en wetgewingsontwikkeling. Ervaring in administratiewe prosedures en databasisontwikkeling en -bestuur. Vaardighede in projek- en kontrakbestuur.
af.duties: Monitor nakoming ten opsigte van akwakultuur-bystandwetgewing verbonde aan voedselveiligheid. Verseker nakoming deur gemagtigde mariene akwakultuurplase van die Aquaculture Marine Fish Food Safety Programme deur voortdurende monitering van skulpdiere-biotoksiene, mikrobiologiese kwaliteit en fitoplanktonvlakke. Monitor en verseker volledige nakoming deur tersaaklike laboratoria van AMFFSP-skulpdieremoniteringsvereistes. Verskaf tegniese advies by die opstel en implementering van akwakultuur-bystandwetgewing, regulasies, beleide, voedselveiligheidsprogramme en vergunningsvoorwaardes. Verskaf tegniese leiding aan bedryfsbelanghebbendes rakende AMFFSP. Dra by tot die opstel van standaarde/ riglyne en AMFFSP-verwante dokumente. Finaliseer en versprei die National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications (NRCS) monsternemingskedule. Dra by tot die opstel van MoU's, ooreenkomste en kontrakte ten opsigte van die AMFFSP soos vereis en bestuur die implementering daarvan, insluitend deelname aan tersaaklike Projekbestuurskomiteevergaderings. Bevorder omgewingsopvoeding en bewustheid rakende die Aquaculture Marine Fish Food Safety Programme. Stel voedselveiligheidsverslae op. Verskaf insette vir die Aquaculture Yearbook. Reël en onderneem werksbesoeke aan operasionele mariene akwakultuurplase en stel verslae op. Verteenwoordig die Departement en die Food Safety Unit in vergaderings rakende die AMFFSP en verwante werkswinkels en konferensies, insluitend SPS-TBT-vergaderings en die Akwakultuurbedryf-liaisonvergaderings. Verseker dat voedselveiligheidsbeamptes op die werk opgelei word en mentorskap ontvang ten opsigte van die AMFFSP-vereistes.

zu.title: Isikhundla soMphathi wemvelo wenkokelomkhiqizo oyilwa
zu.summary: Kuyafunwa wonke umphathi wemvelo ongaphakathi kwedolobha i-Cape Town ukuba aze abuke ukusukuma kokuvunywa emthethweni kwamasimu okulimaza izinhlanzi ngokuhambisana nomthetho wePhepha lokuphepha kokudla kwezinhlanzi zasolwande, okuhlanganise ukuhlolwa kwe-biotoxin ezinhlanzi kwayesizinga lezinzwa ezibukhali.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yeziqu ezenza njengeNQF Level 8 kwabosebenzabahleli weqhaza okwabonke noma iziqu ezifanele njengoba zinkambathiswa yi-SAQA. Kufanele kube nokuhlangenwe ndaba okuncane kweminyaka emithathu (3) umkhakha ohlobene. Ukwazi umthetho we-Marine Living Resource Act, 1998, kanye nomthetho wakuleNingizimu Afrika ngokuphepha kokudla kwabathengi ehlobene nokulimaza izinhlanzi. Ulwazi nokuhlangenwe ndaba kumajaha eklabhulabhushi. Ukuhlakaniphile kwayesikrwele kunamehlo kwayedokhumenti kwayelungiselela ukubuyiswana nokugcina ukuqinisekiswa kwe-DBRisahlelo. Isipiliyoni ngokukhethwa kwamathuluzi kanye namaqhaza okuqoqwa kwesampula nokuhlanganisa. Ukwaziswa ngesimo sokusebenza okungokwemvelo nokulungisa imithethosisekelo. Isipiliyono ekubumbeni imithetho kwayesigqibele ukulungisa isimo. Isipiliyono ngokuqhuba imicimbi yokuphatha ukusebenza kanye nokuqashwa kokuvulwa kwemikhakha. Isipiliyono ekule imikholezima kwayesisekelo nangokulawula iholo eliphelele.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuthobela emthethweni ngokusho komthetho onikela amandla okulimazwa kolwandle ohlobene nephepha lokuphepha kokudla. Qinisekisa ukuthobela emthethweni kwamasimu okulimaza izinhlanzi zasolwandle anegunya ngenqubo yokuphepha kokudla kwezinhlanzi zasolwandle ngokuqhubekayoukuqapha ama-biotoxin ezinhlanzi, izinga lokuthamba kwezinzwa kanye namazinga e-phytoplankton. Qapha futhi uqinisekise ukuthobela okuphelele kwamalabhulabhushi ehlobene nezidingo zokuqapha izinhlanzi ze-AMFFSP. Nikeza ikelula ubuchwepheshe ekubhalweni nasekuqhubeni umthetho onikela amandla okulimazwa kolwandle, imithetho, izinqubomgomo, izinhlela zokuphepha kokudla kanye nezimo zezimvume. Nikeza izinhlanga ezibandakanyayo ebezzomkhakwa ikelula ubuchwepheshe ngokuqhathaniswa ne-AMFFSP. Siege ekubhalweni kwezizinga/ iziqondiso namadokhumenti ahlobene ne-AMFFSP. Qedelela futhi sabelaisehejuli yokuthatha amasampula e-National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications (NRCS). Siege ekubhalweni kwe-MoUs, izivumelano namakontrathi ngokusho kwe-AMFFSP, njengoba kudingeka futhi uphathe ukusetshenziswa kwazo, okuhlanganisa ukubambe iqhaza emihlanganweni yaphansi komkhakha wezinhlelo zokuphatha. Khuthaza imfundo nesazi ngomkhakwa wemvelo ebyhlobene nenhlelo yokuphepha kokudla kwezinhlanzi zasolwandle. Bhala imibiko yokuphepha kokudla. Nikeza imibiko kumakhaphisi wezulu le-Aquaculture. Hlela futhi wenzi izivakashi kumasimu okusebenza okulimiza izinhlanzi zasolwandle ubhale imibiko. Mela i-Department nenyuvesi yokuphepha kokudla emihlanganweni ehlotshaniswa ne-AMFFSP kanye nemicimbi yokusebenza kanye nezinkulumo ezingahlonitshwa okuhlanganise imihlangano ye-SPS-TBT kanye nemihlangano yokuxhumana nomkhakwa wokulimaza izinhlanzi. Yenza imisebenzi yentengahlangano nehlobene nenhlelo yokuphepha kokudla kwezinhlanzi zasolwandle. Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bezokuphepha kokudla bahlolwe emsebenzini futhi baholwa ngokwezidingo ze-AMFFSP.

xh.title: IOfisa yeNdalo ekukhiweni kwezinto ngesishwankathelo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa iOfisa yeNdalo eCape Town ukuba ilawule ukuzithobela kolwangeniso kwamafama enkundla zaselwandle ngomthetho wokhuseleko lokutya kweentlanzi zasolwandle, kuquka ukuhlola iibayotoxini zezilwanyana ezithwalwa ngaphakathi kweeqhina nokuqinisekisa imigaqo yomgangatho wezinto ezingabonakalanga ngeso lonke ixesha.
xh.requirements: Izifundo zeHonours (NQF Level 8) ekulawulweni kweNdalo okanye izifundo ezifaneleyi njengoko zivunywa nguSAQA. Kufuneka abe nakho amava amabalo angaphantsi kwamathathu (3) emnyangweni ochanekileyo. Ulwazi ngomthetho weMarine Living Resource Act, 1998, nomthetho wokukhusela ukutya nabadityanwa baseMzantsi Afrika ongqinelana nolwangeniso oluhlukeneyo. Ulwazi namava ekuqinisekiseni iziphimo zemisebenzi yegumbi lokuhlola. Amava kwiimpahla zokuhlola iigumbi namacebo okuziphatha, ukuqokelela iisampulu nokuqonda iimpawu zeempawu. Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kolwangeniso loluhlu lwezilwanyana kwaye kukhuseleke ukutya okutyiwayo. Amava ekuyileni iindlela zokusebenza nomthetho. Amava kwiindlela zokuphatha izinto ezidityaniswe nokuyila nokulawula idatabase yeenkcukacha. Amakhono ekulawuleni amaprojekthi nesezivumelwano.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuthobela kolwangeniso ngokomthetho onika ilungelo ngokuthintela ukungenwa kokutya okungalunganga. Qinisekisa ukuzithobela kolwangeniso lwamafama aserekileyo ezaselwandle kunye noMthetho woKukhusela iindida zeentlanzi zaselwandle ngokuhlola ngokubi nexesha iibayotoxini zezilwanyana ezithwalwa ngaphakathi kweeqhina, ukungcoliswa okubangelwa zizinto ezingabonakalanga nomthamo wezityalo zaselwandle. Qwalasela ukuqinisekisa ukuzithobela okupheleleyo kumagumbi okuhlola ahambelana neemfuno zokuqwalasela iindida zeentlanzi ezibambe kwindlela efanayo neMthetho woKukhusela iindida zeentlanzi zaselwandle. Nikela ngeliso lezobuchwepheshe ekuyileni nokusebenzisa umthetho one gunya lokuqhuba imisebenzi yolwangeniso loluhlu lwezilwanyana, iingqinisekiso zobugcisa, iindlela zokwenza izinto, iinkqubo zokhuseleko lokutya nemiqathango yamava efunwa kwindlela enikwa ilungelo. Bonezela abanjineli bamasiko ngendlela ekhokeleyo ekujoliswe kuyo iNkqubo yoKukhusela iindida zeentlanzi zaselwandle. Sikhulule iimfuno zokuyila imigaqo eqqonywa kwindlela ekugqithiswa kuyo oovimba bakowonke-wonke okanye iNkqubo yokukhusela iindida zeentlanzi zasolwandle. Qwalasela nokusetyenziswa kolwangeniso loluhlu lwezilwanyana ngokwemigaqo yecandelo. Qeda kwaye wabelane ngenkqubo yokuqokelela iisampulu zeNATIONAL Regulator for Compulsory Specifications (NRCS) kumazwe ngamazwe. Sika ixesha elifanelekileyo sokuzimisela okumangalisayo ekulawulweni okuzinze kubomi beempazamo zangaphakathi. Nikela ngesandla ekuyileni iMfuno yokuqwalasela nokwabelana ngolwazi, iinkqubo zokusebenza kunye namathuba abakho kwindawo ethile. Bhala iingxelo zokhuseleko lokutya. Nikela ngolwazi kwesiXhosa kwakhona ekuyileni iNdlela yokusetyenziswa kolwangeniso loluhlu lwezilwanyana kwindawo ethile. Lungiselela kwaye wenze ukhangelo lwasekhaya kwindawo esetyenziswa ukulungiselela izinto ezingafunekiyo. Sika ixesha elifanelekileyo kubasebenzi bokuqwalasela ukubakho komsebenzi weNkqubo yokukhusela iindida zeentlanzi zasolwandle kwizindlu ezingahlawulelwayo kwaye abancedwe ngokwemigaqo yokusebenza. Qwalasela imisebenzi yolwangeniso kwaye wenze izinto ezingazange zenziwe kwangaphambili ngokomthetho. Zibandakanye ekuzameni ukuphucula ulwazi lweendalo nendalo yolwangeniso loluhlu lwezilwanyana. Qwalasela ukubakho kwezicelo ezifunwa ngumthetho ekusebenzeni kolwangeniso. Yenza iingxelo zobuchwepheshe ekuyileni iMthetho othile. Sika ixesha elifanelekileyo ekulawulweni kolwangeniso loluhlu lwezilwanyana kwaye uhlole ukuba ukhuseleko lokutya lugqithiswe njani.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Forest Management Planning
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 21 September 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Forest Management Planning in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma in Forestry and three years' experience, paying R487197 per annum.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Forestry or relevant qualification within the related field as recognized by SAQA. A Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in Forestry or related field. Knowledge of the National Forests Act, 1998 (Act 84 of 1998) (NFA) and the National Veld and Forest Fires Act, 1998 (Act 101 of 1998) (NVFFA) including other relevant Environmental legislations such as NEMBA and NEMA. Knowledge of Principle, Criteria, Indicators and Standards (PCIS). Knowledge of silviculture and harvesting operation. Knowledge in collection of enumeration data, Forestry planning system, forestry management in the forestry finance/economics. knowledge of Modified Cash Standard. Good Knowledge of governmental administrative procedures (Public Service regulation, Public Service Act, PFMA and National Treasury Regulations, Labour Relations). Sound knowledge of policy development. Intergovernmental and stakeholder relations. Project and programme management. Financial Management. Ability to plan, organize and execute under pressure. Good Communication skill and interpersonal skill. Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams. facilitation and negotiation skills. Computer literacy. A valid Driving license and willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Maintain forest central master growing stock database using Microforest system. Create, modify and disable user account on the Microforest system. Monitor user account activities and report unusual activities to management. Perform a quarterly review of user account for validity. Compile and review Audit Trail Reports. Compile tactical harvesting plans for all plantations in the region by using Microforest tactical planning system. Conduct site visits and coordinate re-mapping of plantations through Geographic Information System (GIS) support services. Supply geographic information to management for annual production planning. Compile forest growing stock management plan. Coordinate and updating of plantation maps and alpha numeric data. Collect and analyse data from regions. Conduct valuation of biological assets. Compile valuation working document and disclose note to submit to Directorate: Financial Management. Calculate cost value and standing value of biological assets (age class and volume summaries). Prepare and provide all documentation (biological assets valuation pack) used for compiling Asset Valuation report to the office of the Auditor General (AG). Analyse and follow up on AG’s finding during field verification audits. Develop action plan with regions to address AG recommendations or outcome. Procure the Forestry Detailed Analysis and Cost Benchmark Report document from Forest Economic Services. Conduct technical forest audits. Conduct stock enumerations. Schedule enumeration training and train the enumeration teams. Manage processing and auditing of enumerations according to the policy. Analyse and correct processed enumeration data.
