af.title: Grondwerker: Groenmaak en Bestaansmiddele-implementering
af.summary: Onderhou gronde, besproei plante, beheer onkruid en maai grasperke by Rusplaas Nursery in Lebowakgomo, waarvoor Graad 9 sonder vorige ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 09 (NQF vlak 1) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Geen ervaring vereis. Kennis van National Forestry Act 84 of 1998, National Veld, Fire Forestry Act 101 of 1998 (NVFFA) en Occupational Health and Safety Act. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om lang ure vrywillig te werk, individueel en in 'n span te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede, kreatiwiteit en vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los.
af.duties: Voer roetine-aktiwiteite ten opsigte van gronde uit, besproei en water plante en grasperke. Voer onkruidverwydering en onkruidbeheer uit. Snoei en knip plante, voer snoeiwerk uit, saai en verskuif plante. Maai grasperke, raak organiese afval ontslae, grawe kompos, grawe, spuit en onderhou saailingbeddens en rande. Voer algemene roetine-aktiwiteite ten opsigte van infrastruktuurondersteuning uit. Saadversameling. Skoonmaak van saad. Saadbehandeling voor saai. Voorbereiding van saailingbakkies. Saai van saad. Voorbereiding en saai van steggies. Verseker plant en verskuif van saailinge en bome. Vul plant­sakke met grond. Berei ruimte in beddens voor vir verskuif. Verskuif saailinge uit bakkies na sakke. Verskuif bome van klein na groter sakke. Verpak verskuifde bome. Verskaf algemene arbeid in die kwekery. Meng sand en kompos. Handmatige en chemiese onkruidbeheer. Besproeiing van saailinge en bome. Bystand met voorraadopname. Merk plante korrek. Kontroleer saailinge en plante vir plae en siektes. Bystand aan klante wat bome kom koop. Verantwoordelik vir toegekende gereedskap. Rapporteer enige skade in die kwekery aan die voorman. Verseker die gebruik, skoonmaak en basiese instandhouding van trekker en dumpwa. Verskuif sand en kompos na die tafels of beddens. Verskuif saailinge, kratte en bome. Hou toerusting en masjinerie skoon na gebruik.

zu.title: Isikhundla sokugcina indawo: Ukuphela kokuQamba Izinto Ezintsha kanye Nosebenzo Wokuziphilisa
zu.summary: Gcina indawo, nephulisela izitshalo, lawula izikhohlamlilo umela ucima/ulungise emahlathini eRusplaas Nursery eLebowakgomo, kudingeka ibe ne-Grade 9 ngaphandle kokutholakala kwamandla wokuqasha.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 09 (NQF level 1) noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Akukho ndlela eceleni edingekile. Ukwaziswa kukaMthetho Wezihlahla Kazwelonke 84 ka-1998, uMthetho Wezihlahla kazwelonke, nomlilo 101 ka-1998 (NVFFA) kanye noMthetho WokuPhepha NokuziPhilisa Emsebenzini. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Isu sokusebenza amahora amude ngokuzithandela, ukusebenza uwedwa nakwindawo eqenjini. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nozwe, ukwakhiwa kwento entsha, kanye nesu sokusebenza ngaphansi kwesisindiso esinamandla. Isu sokusebenza nabantu ababucayile kanye nokuqeda izinkhundla ezikhona.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi evamile ohlotsheni lwendawo okhiqizayo, ukunephulisela nokunisela izitshalo kanye namahlatshi. Yenza ukususa izikhohlamlilo kanye nokuzithi izikhohlamlilo. Songa futhi usike izitshalo, ukusika okukhulu njengesebenzi, ukubhobola izitshalo ukuzitshala nokuzikhombisa emakhaya awo. Cima amahlathi amahle, ukulahla impiliso yezinhlayiya zomhlabathingqondo, ukumba umquba, ukumba okunye okumele kubhalwe, ukufutha nokugcina izigaxa ezincwaba kanye nezinkalo ezingangeni emngcwameni. Yenza imisebenzi evamile ehlotshaneni lokusekela izakhiwo. Iqoqo lezitshalo. Ukuhlanzwa kwemitshwelakho. Ukuxhuma kwemitshwelakho ngaphambi kokuyitshala. Ulungiselelo lokuqasha kwemitshwelakho ematshini. Ukutshala kwemitshwelakho. Ukulungiselela nokutshala izinqola ezinqamlezile. Qinisekisa ukutshala nokudlulisela izinsimbi kanye nezihlahla. Amafutha emisakhizo yamphakethe ngemvula. Lungiselela isikhundla emadwaleni ukuze kudluliselwe. Ukudlulisela izinsimbi ematshini ukuya emaphaketheni. Ukudlulisela izihlahla emaphakethe amancane ukuya kumakhulu. Ukubeka izihlahla ezidluliselwe. Nikeza isandla sebenzi iquphela kwemisebenzi yohlelo. Ukuhlanganisa isihlabathi nomquba. Ukuhlanzwa kwemitsho ngokusuka kanzima kanye nokwamakhemukhali. Ukunephulisela izinsimbi kanye nezihlahla. Siza ekubaleni izinto. Ukunika amaphasi izitshalo ngendlela efanele. Hlola izinsimbi nezitshalo kwezifo nezilwane ezikhiqiza izifo. Siza abakhethi abafika ukuthenga izihlahla. Umamelela izinkuliso ezinikiwe. Nika isiko nganoma yisiphi isifo ohlelweni lohlelo kumQondiswana. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa, ukuhlanzwa, ukugcinwa ngokusuka ohlelweni lokukhulu nengxenye yohlelo lokukhetha. Hamba nesihlabathi kanye nomquba uya ematafuleni noma emadwaleni. Hamba nezinsimbi, amabhokhosi kanye neziqhwago. Gcina izinguxa kanye nohlelo lwamaphasi ezingaluntuli emva kokuthi isebenze.

xh.title: Isithuba somntu ogcina indalo: Inkonzo ezalathwayo
xh.summary: Ukugcina imigca, kuncelise izityalo, kulawulwe iindlebe kwaye kusikwe amagadi e Rusplaas Nursery e Lebowakgomo, kufuneka Grade 9 ngaphandle kwenkqubo yangaphambili.
xh.requirements: Grade 09 (NQF level 1) okanye izidanga ezingoko. Akukho nako lfunekayo. Ulwazi nge National Forestry Act 84 of 1998, National Veld, Fire Forestry Act 101 of 1998 (NVFFA) kunye ne Occupational Health and Safety Act. Iimpawu zokusombulula iingxaki. Iimpawu zobuhlobo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza iiyure ezide ngokuzithanda, ukusebenza udwa nakwiqela. Iimpawu ezilungele ezobuhlobo, ukucinga, nakukwazi ukusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo olubukhali. Ukukwazi ukusebenza nabantu abanzima nakusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Zenza imisebenzi yonqamlezelo ngokwemigca yamagadi, kuncelise kwaye kunyathelwe amanzi izityalo namagadi. Kwenziwe ukususa nengcamla iindlebe. Kusikwe kwaye kucutshungulwe izityalo, kusikwa izityalo, kutyhwe imbewu kwaye kutshintshelwe izityalo. Kusikwa amagadi, kugqithwa izinto ezingcolisayo eziphuma emthini, kutywilwa kompost, kutyhwa iinthuli, kutyhwa amachiza kwaye kugcinwa iinthuli zembewu namagadi. Kwenziwa imisebenzi yonqamlezelo ngokubakho kweziseko ezingundoqo. Iqokelelwa imbewu. Kucocwa imbewu. Kusikelwa imbewu isiqalelelo esangaphambili. Kulungiselwa izixhobo zemithi. Kutyhwa imbewu. Kwenziwa nokutyha imithi. Kuqinisekiswa ukutyhwa nokutshintshelwa kweenthuli nemithi. Kuzaliswa izikhongozeli zokutyha ngenxweme. Kulungiselwa indawo kwigadi ngenjongo yokutshintshela. Kutshintshelwa iinthuli ezikwizixhobo zibe kwiinthuli. Kutshintshelwa imithi kwizikhwama ezincinci kuzo ezinkulu. Kubekwa imithi etshintshelweyo. Kunikezelwa umsebenzi wokuqamba ngokwendalo kwindalo. Kudityaniswa umhlaba nomnqamlezo. Kususwa iindlebe ngesandla nakwezamachiza. Kunceliswa amanzi iinthuli nemithi. Kuncedwa ngokubala izinto. Kubhalwa ipepa kumthi. Kujongwa iinthuli nezityalo ukuba zizikroba. Kuncedwa abathengi abeza kutyla imithi. Kuthathwa unxibelelwano nezixhobo ezinikiweyo. Kuxelwa nakuphi na ukonakala kwindalo kumlawuli osengangathi. Kuqinisekiswa ukusetyenziswa, ukucoca nolonwabo lwezonqamlezelo lomgca kwaye. Kuhambiswa umhlaba nomnqamlezo kwiindawo. Kuhambiswa iinthuli, izityalo nengcamla iinthuli. Kusetyenziswa izixhobo nakuphi na kwaye zicocwe emva kokusetyenziswa.

jobs.title: Project Manager: Jobs Fund PMU
jobs.summary: Lead project planning, management, and monitoring within the Jobs Fund PMU at GTAC, requiring a relevant bachelor's degree and minimum five years' project management experience.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor Degree / Advanced Diploma / BTech Degree (NQF 7) in Development Finance, Economics, Business Management, Project Management, Project Finance, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification (NQF 8) in Development Finance, Economics, Business Management, Project Management, or Project Finance would be advantageous. Minimum 5 years' experience in a project management or programme management position, at least 2 of which at a management level.
jobs.duties: The purpose of this role is to lead the planning, management, organisation and monitoring of project implementation within the Jobs Fund (JF). The role also contributes to the Jobs Fund's knowledge and learning agenda by supporting evidence-based insights, continuous improvement and shared learning across projects. Project Management: Manage project plans, deliverables, financials, dependencies and outcomes of assigned projects, to ensure that the project goals and objectives are achieved within the project timeframe and guidelines by the relevant stakeholders and management committees. Manage overall project risk through identified mitigation processes proactively with project stakeholders to avoid project delivery, problems and delays. Manage the successful implementation of projects for the full cycle of each project, including quality maintenance of project records and documentation; guidance and direction in terms of Fund objectives and operations; analysis and reporting on project products (e.g. business plans and project plans); support data population and manage information; monitoring and evaluation of projects; project cash flows and expenditure reporting; and conduct commercial analysis, financial modelling and analysis, risk analysis and institutional analysis. Ensure Project documentation conforms to agreed standards and procedures, and review progress against milestones and targets. Do a qualitative analysis of documents. Compile and present project status reports to provide project updates on activities and deliverables. Assist with ensuring that governance requirements of professional project management and those applicable to the National Treasury are adhered to. Make recommendations aligned with the project specifications, ensuring that the specifics of the project are being adhered to. Strategic Management and Planning: Manage projects and portfolio activities in line with strategies and policies. Design and implement strategic management and planning activities as directed. Financial Management: Contribute to the efficient financial and technical management of Jobs Fund projects. Ensure project deliverables stay on time, on-target and in-budget. Coordinate with other members of the JF to review financial information and forecasts. Compare and analyse actual results with plans and forecasts to identify financial status and monitor variances. Analyse current and past financial data and performance, identify trends in financial performance and provide recommendations for improvement. Assist with the compilation of data, financial reports and interpretation of legislated financial reporting requirements and regulations. Stakeholder Engagement: Establish and maintain an effective relationship with the National Treasury and other government departments, the private investor community, official development agencies and other stakeholders. Identify and liaise with relevant project stakeholders. Competencies required: Administrative Operations: Knowledge, capabilities and practices associated with the support of administrative and management activities to facilitate organisational and mission goals and objectives. This competency requires knowledge of the appropriate rules, regulations, processes and associated systems within various enabling functions, which may include human resources management, resource management, employee support services, documentation, procurement and financial management. Client Service Orientation: The ability to interact with and respond to internal and external client needs and expectations in a manner that puts into practice the Batho Pele spirit and meets and exceeds service delivery standards, with priority given to client satisfaction. Commitment to Learning: Actively pursue learning and development in order to achieve results and contribute to continuous improvement. Supports and encourages the learning and development of others. Computer Literacy: Knowledge and ability to use computers and technology efficiently. Refers to the comfort level someone has with using computer programs and other applications associated with computers (MS Office, Internet, email). Includes the ability to learn new applications associated with the business. Concern for Quality and Order: The desire to see things done logically, clearly and well. It takes various forms: monitoring and checking work and information, insisting on the clarity of roles and duties, and setting up and maintaining an information system. Development Financing: Knowledge of development financing approaches and methods, including the financing of long-term projects and public services based upon a non-recourse or limited recourse financial structure, in which project debt and equity used to finance the project are paid back from the cash flow generated by the project. Effective Communication: The ability to transmit and receive information clearly and communicate effectively to others by considering their points of view to respond appropriately. This may involve listening, interpreting, formulating and delivering verbal, non- verbal, written, and/or electronic messages. It includes the ability to convey ideas and information in a way that brings understanding to the target audience. Emotional Intelligence: The capacity for recognising their own feelings and those of others, for motivating themselves and others as a result of this awareness, and for managing emotions within themselves and in others. Financial Analysis: Knowledge of financial data analysis, including the ability to collect and monitor data, analyse results, monitor variances, identify trends, recommend actions and assist with annual and quarterly forecasting. Grant Management: Knowledge of grant funding (non-repayable funds) approaches and methods and the regulatory environment governing the management of public funds. This includes knowledge of the South African grant funding reforms initiative and grant management systems. Information Sharing: Both the motivation to expand and use one's knowledge and the willingness to share this knowledge with others. Integrity/Honesty: Contributes to maintaining the integrity of the organisation; displays high standards of ethical conduct and understands the impact of violating these standards on an organisation, self, and others; is trustworthy. Labour Markets: Knowledge of how labour markets work and the current active labour market policy interventions, with an emphasis on youth employment. Legislative Knowledge: Knowledge of the regulatory environment and processes regarding the implementation of policies, legislation and service delivery programmes, and knowledge of the NT and/or DPSA and/or other regulatory prescripts regarding procurement, contract management and services payment; Jobs Fund and grants management; and labour management and employment in South Africa. Problem Solving and Analysis: The ability to understand a situation, issue, problem, etc., by breaking it into smaller pieces, or tracing the implications of a situation in a step-by-step way. It includes organising the parts of a problem, situation, etc., systematically; making systematic comparisons of different features or aspects; setting priorities on a rational basis; and identifying time sequences, causal relationships, or if-then relationships. Create timely and well-developed solutions by examining alternatives, risks and consequences. Project Budget Management: Knowledge of regulations regarding the management of public finances, and the methodologies, processes and tools for managing project budgets, including the forecasting, implementing, monitoring, evaluating and reporting on expenditure activities and schedules. Project Governance: Knowledge of project risk management analysis and risk controls design, and conducting of due diligence exercises and project audits. Project Management: Knowledge of project management principles, methods, or tools for appraising, conceptualising, structuring, scheduling, coordinating, and managing projects and resources, including monitoring, evaluating and reporting on project impact, costs, work, and contractor performance. Resources Planning: Organises work, sets priorities and determines resource requirements; determines short- or long-term goals and strategies to achieve them; coordinates with other organisations or parts of the organisation to accomplish goals; monitors progress and evaluates outcomes. Results Orientation: Concern for holding yourself and others accountable for achieving results or for surpassing a standard of excellence. It includes the process of setting measurable objectives, implementing change and then checking back to determine the effect of your efforts. The standard may be one's own past performance (striving for improvement); an objective measure (results orientation); outperforming others (competitiveness); or challenging goals one has set, or even what anyone has ever done (innovation). Systems Thinking: Orientation to think in system-wide terms with regard to functions or divisions within the organisation. This includes spotting opportunities to connect the initiatives underway in other areas or proactively sharing information or resources that can be seen to have relevance and impact on others. Team Participation: The ability to work cooperatively with others, to work together as opposed to working separately or competitively. Valuing Diversity: The ability to understand and respect the practices, customs, values and norms of other individuals, groups and cultures. It goes beyond what is required by governmental employment equity regulations to include the ability to respect and value different points of view and to be open to others of different backgrounds or perspectives. It includes seeing others' differences as a positive part of the work environment. It also means being able to work well with a wide variety of people representing different backgrounds, cultures and socio-economic levels. Vision and Purpose: Modelling and promoting high personal and professional standards that support the organisation's vision, mandate and values. Sharing goals, objectives and ideas to encourage others to commit to and be enthusiastic about realising the vision.
jobs.enquiries: HR Kaizer Malakoane at 066 250 7072 Technical Job Enquiries: jobsfund@treasury.gov.za
jobs.applications: Please register, or if you are already registered, sign in and apply for this position on the GTAC eRecruitment website https://erecruitment.gtac.gov.za/erecruitment/
jobs.notes: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications not accompanied by a comprehensive CV and a fully completed Z83 form will not be considered. Only South African Citizens, and Permanent Residents need apply as per PSR 2016. Applications should be accompanied by a duly completed and signed Z83 form (obtainable from any Public Service department). The post title and reference number must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. A recent comprehensive CV should be submitted. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be required to be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview from shortlisted candidates. All short-listed candidates must make themselves available for a panel interview on the date determined by the GTAC. All short-listed candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks, and the successful candidate will undergo security vetting in order to confirm employment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Late applications, and those not meeting the requirements, will not be considered. If you have not received feedback from the GTAC within 2 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Note: The GTAC reserves the right to fill or not fill the advertised posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Projekbestuurder: Jobs Fund PMU
af.summary: Lei projektebeplanning, -bestuur en -monitering binne die Jobs Fund PMU by GTAC, wat 'n tersaaklike baccalausgraad en minimum vyf jaar se projekbestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Baccalausgraad / Gevorderde Diploma / BTech-graad (NQF 7) in Ontwikkelingsfinansiering, Ekonomie, Besigheidsbestuur, Projekbestuur, Projekfinansiering, of 'n verwante veld. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF 8) in Ontwikkelingsfinansiering, Ekonomie, Besigheidsbestuur, Projekbestuur, of Projekfinansiering sal voordelig wees. Minimum 5 jaar se ervaring in 'n projekbestuurs- of programbestuursposisie, waarvan ten minste 2 jaar op bestuursvlak.
af.duties: Die doel van hierdie rol is om die beplanning, bestuur, organisering en monitering van projekimplementering binne die Jobs Fund (JF) te lei. Die rol dra ook by tot die Jobs Fund se kennis- en leeragenda deur bewysgebaseerde insigte, deurlopende verbetering en gedeelde leer oor projekte heen te ondersteun. Projekbestuur: Bestuur projekplanne, leweransies, finansies, afhanklikhede en uitkomste van toegewysde projekte om te verseker dat die projekte se doelwitte en oogmerke binne die projektydperk en riglyne deur die tersaaklike belanghebbendes en bestuurskomitees bereik word. Bestuur algehele projekrisiko deur geïdentifiseerde mitigasieprosesse proaktief met projekbelanghebbendes te hanteer om probleme en vertragings met projeklewering te voorkom. Bestuur die suksesvolle implementering van projekte vir die volle siklus van elke projek, insluitend kwaliteithandhawing van projekrekords en -dokumentasie; leiding en rigting ten opsigte van Fondsdoelwitte en -bedrywighede; ontleding en verslagdoening oor projekprodukte (bv. besigheidsplanne en projekplanne); ondersteuning van datavul en bestuur van inligting; monitering en evaluering van projekte; projekkontantvloei en bestedingsverslagdoening; en voer kommersiële ontleding, finansiële modellering en ontleding, risiko-ontleding en institusionele ontleding uit. Verseker dat projekdokumentasie aan ooreengekome standaarde en prosedures voldoen, en hersien vordering teenoor mylpale en teikens. Doen 'n kwalitatiewe ontleding van dokumente. Stel projekstatusverslae op en bied dit aan om projekopdaterings oor aktiwiteite en leweransies te verskaf. Help om te verseker dat bestuursvereistes van professionele projekbestuur en dié van toepassing op die National Treasury nagekom word. Maak aanbevelings in ooreenstemming met die projekspesifikasies om te verseker dat die besonderhede van die projek nagekom word. Strategiese bestuur en beplanning: Bestuur projekte en portefeulje-aktiwiteite in ooreenstemming met strategieë en beleide. Ontwerp en implementeer strategiese bestuurs- en beplanningsaktiwiteite soos aangewys. Finansiële bestuur: Dra by tot die doeltreffende finansiële en tegniese bestuur van Jobs Fund-projekte. Verseker dat projekleweransies betyds, op teiken en binne begroting bly. Koördineer met ander lede van die JF om finansiële inligting en vooruitskattings te hersien. Vergelyk en ontleed werklike resultate met planne en vooruitskattings om finansiële status te identifiseer en afwykings te monitor. Ontleed huidige en vroeëre finansiële data en prestasie, identifiseer tendense in finansiële prestasie en verskaf aanbevelings vir verbetering. Help met die samestelling van data, finansiële verslae en die interpretasie van wetlike finansiële verslagdoeningsvereistes en -regulasies. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid: Vestig en handhaaf 'n doeltreffende verhouding met die National Treasury en ander regeringsdepartemente, die private beleggersgemeenskap, amptelike ontwikkelingsagentskappe en ander belanghebbendes. Identifiseer en skakel met tersaaklike projekbelanghebbendes. Vereiste bevoegdhede: Administratiewe bedrywighede: Kennis, vermoëns en praktyke wat verband hou met die ondersteuning van administratiewe en bestuursaktiwiteite om organisasie- en missie-doelwitte en -oogmerke te fasiliteer. Hierdie bevoegdheid vereis kennis van die toepaslike reëls, regulasies, prosesse en geassosieerde stelsels binne verskeie bemagtigingsfunksies, wat menslike hulpbronbestuur, hulpbronbestuur, werknemerondersteuningsdienste, dokumentasie, verkryging en finansiële bestuur kan insluit. Kliëntediensgerigtheid: Die vermoë om met interne en eksterne kliënte se behoeftes en verwagtinge in te skakel en daarop te reageer op 'n manier wat die Batho Pele-gees in die praktyk bring en diensleweringsstandaarde ontmoet en oortref, met prioriteit gegee aan kliëntetevredenheid. Toewyding aan leer: Streef aktief leer en ontwikkeling na om resultate te bereik en by te dra tot deurlopende verbetering. Ondersteun en moedig die leer en ontwikkeling van ander aan. Rekenaargeletterdheid: Kennis en vermoë om rekenaars en tegnologie doeltreffend te gebruik. Verwys na die gemaklikheidsvlak wat iemand het met die gebruik van rekenaarprogramme en ander toepassings wat met rekenaars verband hou (MS Office, Internet, e-pos). Sluit die vermoë in om nuwe toepassings wat met die besigheid verband hou, te leer. Bekommernis oor gehalte en orde: Die begeerte om te sien dat dinge logies, duidelik en goed gedoen word. Dit neem verskeie vorme aan: monitering en nagaan van werk en inligting, aandring op duidelikheid van rolle en pligte, en opstel en handhaaf van 'n inligtingstelsel. Ontwikkelingsfinansiering: Kennis van ontwikkelingsfinansieringsbenaderings en -metodes, insluitend die finansiering van langtermynprojekte en openbare dienste gebaseer op 'n nie-terugvorderbare of beperk-terugvorderbare finansiële struktuur, waarin projekskuld en -eigenaarskap wat gebruik word om die projek te finansier, terugbetaal word uit die kontantvloei wat deur die projek gegenereer word. Effektiewe kommunikasie: Die vermoë om inligting duidelik te versend en te ontvang en doeltreffend met ander te kommunikeer deur hul standpunte in ag te neem om gepas te reageer. Dit kan luister, interpreteer, formuleer en aflewer van verbale, nie-verbale, geskrewe en/of elektroniese boodskappe behels. Dit sluit die vermoë in om idees en inligting oor te dra op 'n manier wat begrip by die teikengehoor bring. Emosionele intelligensie: Die vermoë om eie gevoelens en dié van ander te herken, om hulself en ander as gevolg van hierdie bewustheid te motiveer, en om emosies binne hulself en by ander te bestuur. Finansiële ontleding: Kennis van finansiële data-ontleding, insluitend die vermoë om data in te samel en te monitor, resultate te ontleed, afwykings te monitor, tendense te identifiseer, aksies aan te beveel en te help met jaarlikse en kwartaalvooruitskattings. Toelagbestuur: Kennis van toelagfinansierings- (nie-terugbetaalbare fondse) benaderings en -metodes en die regulerende omgewing wat die bestuur van openbare fondse goedgekeur. Dit sluit kennis in van die Suid-Afrikaanse toelagfinansieringshervormingsinisiatief en toelagbestuurstelsels. Inligtingdeling: Beide die motivering om eie kennis uit te brei en te gebruik, en die bereidwilligheid om hierdie kennis met ander te deel. Integriteit/eerlikheid: Dra by tot die handhawing van die integriteit van die organisasie; toon hoë standaarde van etiese gedrag en verstaan die impak van die skending van hierdie standaarde op 'n organisasie, self en ander; is betroubaar. Arbeidsmarkte: Kennis van hoe arbeidsmarkte werk en die huidige aktiewe arbeidsmarkbeleid-ingrypende maatreëls, met die klem op jeugswerkverskaffing. Wetgewende kennis: Kennis van die regulerende omgewing en prosesse rakende die implementering van beleide, wetgewing en diensleweringsprogramme, en kennis van die NT en/of DPSA en/of ander regulatoriese voorskrifte rakende verkryging, kontrakbestuur en diensbetaling; Jobs Fund en toelagbestuur; en arbeidsbestuur en indiensneming in Suid-Afrika. Probleemoplossing en ontleding: Die vermoë om 'n situasie, kwessie, probleem, ens., te verstaan deur dit in kleiner stukke op te breek, of die implikasies van 'n situasie stap-vir-stap na te speur. Dit sluit in om die dele van 'n probleem, situasie, ens., stelselmatig te organiseer; stelselmatige vergelykings van verskillende kenmerke of aspekte te maak; prioriteite op 'n rasionele basis te stel; en tydvolgordes, oorsaaklike verhoudings, of as-dan-verhoudings te identifiseer. Skep tydige en goed ontwikkelde oplossings deur alternatiewe, risiko's en gevolge te ondersoek. Projekbegrotingsbestuur: Kennis van regulasies rakende die bestuur van openbare fondse, en die metodes, prosesse en gereedskap vir die bestuur van projekbegrotings, insluitend die vooruitskatting, implementering, monitering, evaluering en verslagdoening oor bestedingsaktiwiteite en skedules. Projekbestuur: Kennis van projekbestuursbeginsels, -metodes of -gereedskap vir die beoordeel, konseptualiseer, struktureer, skeduleer, koördineer en bestuur van projekte en hulpbronne, insluitend monitering, evaluering en verslagdoening oor projekimpak, koste, werk en kontrakteursprestasie. Hulpbronbeplanning: Organiseer werk, stel prioriteite en bepaal hulpbronvereistes; bepaal kort- of langtermyn-doelwitte en strategieë om dit te bereik; koördineer met ander organisasies of dele van die organisasie om doelwitte te bereik; monitor vordering en evalueer uitkomste. Resultaatgerigtheid: Bekommernis om uself en ander verantwoordelik te hou vir die bereiking van resultate of om 'n standaard van uitnemendheid te oortref. Dit sluit die proses in om meetbare doelwitte te stel, verandering te implementeer en dan terug te kyk om die effek van u pogings te bepaal. Die standaard kan eie vroeëre prestasie wees (streef na verbetering); 'n objektiewe maatstaf (resultaatgerigtheid); ander oortref (mededingendheid); of uitdagende doelwitte wat 'n mens gestel het, of selfs wat iemand al ooit gedoen het (innovering). Stelseldenke: Oriëntasie om in stelselwye terme te dink ten opsigte van funksies of afdelings binne die organisasie. Dit sluit in om geleenthede raak te sien om inisiatiewe wat in ander areas aan die gang is, te verbind, of proaktief inligting of hulpbronne te deel wat gesien kan word om relevansie en impak op ander te hê. Spandeelname: Die vermoë om saam met ander saamwerkend te werk, om saam te werk in plaas van afsonderlik of mededingend te werk. Waardering van diversiteit: Die vermoë om die praktyke, gebruike, waardes en norme van ander individue, groepe en kulture te verstaan en te respekteer. Dit gaan verder as wat deur regerings se indiensnemingsgelykheidsregulasies vereis word om die vermoë in te sluit om verskillende standpunte te respekteer en te waardeer en oop te wees vir ander van verskillende agtergronde of perspektiewe. Dit sluit in om ander se verskille as 'n positiewe deel van die werksomgewing te sien. Dit betook ook om goed met 'n wye verskeidenheid mense wat verskillende agtergronde, kulture en sosio-ekonomiese vlakke verteenwoordig, te kan saamwerk. Visie en doel: Modelleer en bevorder hoë persoonlike en professionele standaarde wat die organisasie se visie, mandaat en waardes ondersteun. Deel doelwitte, oogmerke en idees om ander aan te moedig om hulle te verbind tot en entoesiasties te wees oor die verwesenliking van die visie.

zu.title: Umlingisi Wamaphrojekthi: i-Jobs Fund PMU
zu.summary: Holela ekubhekeni, ekuphatheni, nasekuhloleni iphrojekthi ngaphakathi kwe-Jobs Fund PMU e-GTAC, kudinga ibachelor's degree ehlobene kanye namava okuphatha amaphrojekthi okungenani iminyaka emihlanu.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor / i-Advanced Diploma / i-BTech Degree (NQF 7) kwi-Development Finance, i-Economics, i-Business Management, i-Project Management, i-Project Finance, noma indawo ehlobene nayo. Isibuyekezo esingaba muva (NQF 8) kwi-Development Finance, i-Economics, i-Business Management, i-Project Management, noma i-Project Finance singaba lusizo. Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yamava endaweni yokuphathwa kwephrojekthi noma indawo yokuphathwa kwenhlekelele, lapho okungenani iminyaka engu-2 kuyo kube ngazinga eliphezulu.
zu.duties: Inhloso yalesi sikhundla ukukhokhela ukucwangqiswa, ukuphathwa, ukuhlelwa nokubhekelwa phambili kokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ngaphakathi kwe-Jobs Fund (JF). Leli sikhundla futhi sisinikeza isandla ekwazisweni nasekufundeni kwethemba le-Jobs Fund ngokusekela izibono ezingokwesizinda, ukuphucuka okuphethukiwe nokufunda okuhlanganyeni kubona phakathi kwamaphrojekthi. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi: Phatha izinhlela zamaphrojekthi, okuzodlulelwa kuyo, izimali, ukwehliseka nemibuzo yezinhlelo ezithunywe kuwe, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo nemigomo yamaphrojekthi iyashkiwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi nemiqobo yephrojekthi ngabaxhasi ababalulekile nabaphathi. Phatha engozini yephrojekthi ngokuphelele ngamachibiyela omlando abalulekile, waziwe nomphathi wephrojekthi ngokwenzela ukuze kugwemwe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo ngokushaywa isikhathi nokuwohloka. Phatha ngempumelelo ukusetshenziswa kwephrojekthi ngesikhathi esiphelele nesibambe isikhathi eside, kuhlanganise nokuqinisekisa kumkhando wemibhalo namaphrojekthi ezidingo; ukweluleka nokukhombisa inkomba nangokomgomo weFund kwezinhloso; ukubhuka nemibiko yemphakeli yamaphrojekthi (isb. izinhlela zebhizinisi nezinhlela zamaphrojekthi); ukuxhasa ukuhlanganiswa kwamanani nokuphatha ulwazi; ukubheka nokubuyekeza amaphrojekthi; imithombo yemali yamaphrojekthi nemibiko yokuchitha; kanye nokwenza isibhekezo sezohwebo, ukulinganisa nokuhihliyela imali, isibhekezo sezengozi nesibhekezo sezinhlangano. Qinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo yamaphrojekthi ihambisana nezindlela eziyisimilo ezingavunyelwanga, futhi ubuyekeze inqubomgomo ngokwezinhloso nezinhlelo. Yenza isibhekezo esingokwemibhalo esingokwezinkomba. Lengisele futhi unikeze imibiko yemimo yamaphrojekthi ukuze unikeze izibibulo ngemicimbi nezinto ezizodlulela kuyo. Siza ekuvimbeleni ukuthi kuhlonitshwe izidingo zokulawula zokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi abanemvume kanye nalezho ezihambene ne-National Treasury. Nikela izincomo ezingokwesibonakaliso samaphrojekthi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yephrojekthi iyahlonitshwa. Ukuphathwa Nokubheka Phambili Okusobala: Phatha amaphrojekthi nemisebenzi yemigudu ngesikhundla sobuchule namasheya. Hlela futhi usebenzise imisebenzi yokubheka phambili nokuphathwa kohlelo njengakwesinyathelo. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Siza ekuphathweni okusebenzayo kwezimali nobuchule bamaphrojekthi e-Jobs Fund. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezingeniswayo ziyasebenza isikhathi esifanele, zihlose futhi zikwezinalini. Hlanganyela namalungu amanye e-JF ukubuyekeza imininingwane yezimali namaphrojech. Buka futhi uhihliye imiphumela yokwenza ngokomgomo wakho namaphrojele ukuze ubone imeko yezimali, kanye nokubheka imikhuba yezinye ezinye izimali. Hla kwamanje namaphulo amaphrojele ukuqonda imikhuba ekukhonza ekubeni kusukela namaphulo amaphrojele, futhi ahluke kwezinye izincomo zokuphucula isibikezelo. Siza ukuba mibiko yemininingwane, imibhikisa yokuhlonitsha imikhuba yemithetho. Ukuxhumana Nabantu: Sakaza futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwane obusebenzayo i-National Treasury kwezinye izigaba zombuso, ilunga labantu abatshala imali, izinkampani ezisiza ngokuthuthukiswa kwezizinda, kubakhwe abanye. Khomba futhi uxhumane nabanikela nangamaphrojele abahlobene nendaba. Izindidi eziphansi ezincane ezifuneka: Izinhlelo Ezingokwenzakalo: Ulwazi, amakhono nezindlela ezingokwenzakalo eziyisibonakaliso, kwamaphrojele ebuso esebenza ngezinhlelo eziphoqwe izigidi zeNational Treasury ezingahlakaza mthetho.

xh.title: Umphathi Weprojekthi: Jobs Fund PMU
xh.summary: Qhubeza icebo lokucwangcisa, ulawulo, nokuqwalasela ngaphakathi kwe-Jobs Fund PMU e-GTAC, kufuneka nededigri ye-bachelor efanelekileyo nokuba nobugcisa bokuphatha iiprojekthi iminyaka emincinane esihlanu.
xh.requirements: I-Bachelor Degree / i-Advanced Diploma / i-BTech Degree (NQF 7) kwi-Development Finance, i-Economics, i-Business Management, i-Project Management, i-Project Finance, okanye indawo ehlobene nayo. I-postgraduate qualification (NQF 8) kwi-Development Finance, i-Economics, i-Business Management, i-Project Management, okanye i-Project Finance ibingabantu abathembekileyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-5 yamava kwisithuba sokuphatha iiprojekthi okanye iinkqubo, ubuncinane amnyaka mabini kwaye ngaphezulu kwinqanaba lolawulo.
xh.duties: Injongo yalo nkundlu kukuhamba phambili ekucwangcisweni, ekulawulweni, ekuqwalaselweni nasekulungiseleleni ukusetyenziswa kweeprojekthi ngaphakathi kwe-Jobs Fund (JF). Iculo lakho lenzima likwadonela kwiegenda yolwazi noku.funda ye-Jobs Fund ngokuxhasa iingqiqo ezisekelwe kubungqina, ukuphucuka ngokwesiqhelo nokwabelana ngoku.funda kwiiprojekthi. Ukulawula Iiprojekthi: Lawula amacebo eeprojekthi, iziphakamiso, ezemali, izithembiso nemiphumela yeeprojekthi ezabelwe, ukuze aqiniseke ukuba iinjongo nemi.nqwenqwe yeprojekthi zifinyelelwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangokwezikhokelo ngamalungu abalulekileyo namakomiti olawulo. Lawula ingozi yeprojekthi jikelele ngenkqubo yokujika ezifunyenwe, ngokuzakhelayo namalungu abalulekileyo beprojekthi ukugwema iingxaki zokuletsa iiprojekthi noku.qwalasela. Lawula ukusetyenziswa ngempumelelo kweeprojekthi kwicala loku.qonda leprojekthi nganye, kuquka ukugcina ikhwalithi yamaxwebhu nemiqulu yeprojekthi; inkokhelo nolwandiso ngokwemigqaliselo ye-Fund nentsebenzo; uhlalutyo nokuxela ngemveliso yeprojekthi (umz. amacebo ebhizinisi namacebo eeprojekthi); ukuxhasa ukuzaliswa kwedata noku lawula ulwazi; ukuqwalasela noku VIU iiprojekthi; ukulawula imali exhulayo kwaye ukuxela ngokuchithwa; kwaye ukwenza uhlalutyo lotyala, ukumodela ngokutsha negalelo kumakhela, uhlalutyo lweingozi nolwazo lendalo. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu eprojekthi alandela iiprotokhile nemigaqo ekuqiqiweyo, yaye ukwenza iiprojekthi zihlaziye ngokwemigangatho yomgcu nemigangatho. Yenza uhlalutyo lwekhwalithi lamaxwebhu. Hlela yaye ukuxela ngelixa lemeko yeprojekthi ukunika izihloko eziphindaphindiweyo kumashishini nemi.qulu yeprojekthi. Nceda ukwenza ukuba imfuno yolawulo yomphathi webhofesi wesigqeba namaphelo abalulekileyo aye kwi-National Treasury alandelwe. Yiza neengcebiso ezingumthetho weprojekthi ngokweenkcukacha, qinisekisa ukuba iinkcukacha zeprojekthi zilandelwa ngokuchanekileyo. Ukulawula noku.cwangcisa ngokwenjongo: Lawula iiprojekthi nemisebenzi yehemphi ngokweemba noku.mthetho. Hlela yaye ukusetyenzisa imisebenzi yonika noku.cwangcisa njengoko ulaywe. Ukulawula iindleko: Nceda ekuphatheni iindleko yaye iindleko ngokusetyenziswa kwamandla e-Jobs Fund iiprojekthi. Qinisekisa ukuba imi.qulu yeprojekthi ihamba ngesikhathi, ikumganga ochanekileyo kwaye ikumda webhajeti. Ngokusemzileni namalungu amanye e-JF ukuze ahlalutye iindleko zolwazi noku.qikelela. Ngokuthe ngqo yaye uhlalutye iziphumo ezinqamlezileyo namacebo aqikelelwe ukuze aqonde imeko yemali aze aqwalasele iinguqu. Hlalutya idatha yemali yangoku yaye yexesheshi, qonda iindlela zeemeko yemali kwaye unike iingcebiso ngokuphucula. Nceda ekunqamlezeni idatha, ukuxela ngemali nokutolika iimfuno zokuxela ngemali ngokomthetho naku.mthetho. Ukuqhagamshelana namalungu abalulekileyo: Misela yaye ugcine ukuxhumana okusebenzayo ne-National Treasury namanye amasebe huru, ingingqi yabatyali-mali abangaphandle, amasebe abathunywa ngamanyelelawo nanjalo namanye amalungu abalulekileyo. Qonda yaye uqhagamshele namalungu abalulekileyo beprojekthi abafanelekileyo. Iinkqutshwa ezifunekayo: Iindleko zokulawula iindleko: Ulwazi, amandla noku.sebenzisa oonxibelelwano olusekelwe kwinkxaso yokulawula nokuqhubeza imisebenzi yoku.nika inkqubo noku.qaliswa kwemigqaliselo yehlelo. Le nkqutshwa idinga ulwazi ngemigaqo, imithetho yonke, iinkqubo yaye iisixhobo ezahlukeneyo ngaphakathi kwabasebenzi abangenela, ezingaquka ulawulo lwabantu abasebenzayo, ukulawula iindleko, iinkonzo ezinceda abasebenzi, amaxwebhu, ukuthengwa kwezinto noku lawula iindleko. Isikhokelo seNkonzo yabathengi: Ikhono lokunxibelela noku phendula iimfuno nolindwe ngaphakathi nangaphandle ngendlela evelisa ngokutsha isipili sabathengi ngokomoya kaBatho Pele, ukwanela noku.gqitha iinkqutshwa zoku.nika inkonzo, ngokubekisisa ukwaneliseka kwabathengi. Ugqitho lokufunda: Ngokuzimisela ukufunda noku phucuka ukuze ufumene imiphumela yaye uncedise ekuphuculeni ngokwesiqhelo. Nxiba noku khuthaza ukufunda noku.phucuka kwabanye. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha: Ulwazi noku sebenzisa ikhompyutha nengqondo ngokusebenza nayo. Iqhagamshela ngenqanaba lokuzifedelela omunye umntu analo ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zekhompyutha nezinye iinkqubo ezingena ngaphakathi (i-MS Office, i-Intanethi, i-email). Iquka ukusebenzisa noku.funda iinkqubo ezintsha ezisekelwe kubhizinisi. Ukukhathalela ubuchwepheshe noku.hlela: Inkqutshwa yokubona izinto zenziwa ngokweenkcukacha, ngokucacileyo naku.qondile. Ithatha iindlela ezininzi: ukuqwalasela noku khangela umsebenzi nolwazi, ukubanga ukucaca kwamagunya nemi.sebenzi, noku misa yaye ukugcina inkqubo yolwazi. Ukuxhaswa kwelizo lophuhliso: Ulwazi ngeendlela noku hla ngeendlela zokuxhasa uphuhliso, kuquka uxhaso Iweprojekthi nkonzo zoluntu zexesheshi elide ezisekelwe kusakhiwo semali esingenasona isixhobo sokutyalela okanye esinamakhonkco ambalwa, apho imali yangapha nethutyana elisetshenziselwa ukuxhaswa yeprojekthi ihlawulwa kumntla ovela kwithutyana leprojekthi. Unxibelelwano olusebenzayo: Ikhono lokudlulisela nokuamkela ulwazi noku ncoma ngokucacileyo kwabanye ngokuqwalasela iindawo zoku bona babo ukuze baphendule ngokufanelekileyo. Oku kunokuquka ukulalela, uku.nika ingqiqo, uku.qamba noku fedelela imiyalezana esetyenziswa ngomlomo, ezingomlomo, ebhaliweyo, yaye/okanye yekhompyutha. Iquka noku nika iingqaqambili zonika ulwazi ngenqanaba loku qonda abo bakuqondiseleyo. Isazwi sokuziva: Ikhono loku nika isazwi sezihlabelo zabo nangakunye, lokuzikhusela ngokwabo naku khuthaza abanye ukuba benze ngokwabo ngokusekelwe kwesi sazwi, noku lawula iimvakalelo ngaphakathi kwakhe nakunabanye. Uhlalutyo lwemali: Ulwazi loku hla i data yemali, kuquka ukwazi ukuthuthuba ngokwe siseko, ukuqwalasela i data, uhlalutya iziphumo, qwalasela iinguqu, qonda iindlela ze meko, inike iingcebiso ezithintela ekubeni ngumsebenzi wamanye, noku nceda kwi ngqikelelo yonyaka nakuqhubekeko kwamaxesha. Ukuphathwa kwamakhulu: Ulwazi ngoku xhaswa ngamakhetha (iindleko ezingenambuyekezo) noku hla ngamadoda nokuqonda noku lawula imali yomphakathi. Oku kubandakanya ulwazi ngesaziso sovavanyo loku phuculwa koluntu eMzantsi Afrika kumakhetha noku lawula inkqubo yoku phatha amakhetha. Ukwabelana ngolwazi: Kokubili inkqubela yokwandisa noku sebenzisa ulwazi ngokwakho noku dlulela koku yabelana nayo nabanye. Ukuzithembeka noku qotho: Nceda ukuba ugcine izikhokelo kunqonqo loluntu; ukhombise iinkqutshwa ezihamba ngobuzithembisa; uqonde ukubakho kokubakho koku wisa koku zala ngale migaqo, kwizikhokelo ngokwakho nakubanye; ngumntu othembekeyo. Iimarike zabasebenzi: Ulwazi ngokusebenzwa kwemarike yabasebenzi kwaye iinkqubo ezinyanzelekileyo ezisebenzayo kwilizwe ngokuchasene nemarike yabasebenzi, ngokugxila ekubeni abasebenzi ngabasha. Ulwazi ngomthetho: Ulwazi ngokuqhubekeko komgaqo-nkqubo nakuqwalasela iinkqubo zokuqaliswa kwemigaqo, nomthetho, noku nika inkonzo, yaye ulwazi nge-NT yaye/okanye i-DPSA yaye/okanye ezinye iinkqubo ngokuthengwa kwezinto, ukulawula iinkqubo ezibini noku nika inkonzo yindleko; i-Jobs Fund nokulawula iinzuzo; noku lawula abasebenzi noku baqashe eMzantsi Afrika. Ukulawula noku hla ingxaki: Ikhono loku qonda inxaxheba, ukuba khona kwengxaki, noku zenzakalayo, ngokuyahlula ngezityhulu, okanye ngoku landela iindlela zengxaki ngesinyatha ngekhonkco elinye ngesinye. Iquka ukuhlela ngezityhulu zengxaki, oku zenzekileyo, ngokuhamba ngokwenqanaba; ukwenza uqhathaniso ngokwemigaqo noku hla iindlela okanye izinto ngesiqhelo; uku misa iinkqutshwa ngenkqubo ezingatshatyalaliswa; noku qonda ukulandelana kwamaxesha, amaqhingqana ngokwemvelaphi, okanye amaqhingqana anje ngokuba-ke. Dala izisombululo ezisebenzayo noku.pezulu ngokuhamba kwexesha ngokuhlola ezinye iindlela, iingozi noku veliswa kwezakhono. Ukulawula ibhajethi yeprojekthi: Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokulawula iimali zoluntu, naku hla nokuqhuba noku.qhuba noku hla ngokomntla, nokuqikelela, ukuyala, ukuqwalasela, uku VIU nokuxela ngamashishini angamaqotsa. Ukulawula iiprojekthi ngenkqubela: Ulwazi loku hla ingozi yeprojekthi noku wulula iingozi, yaye ukwenza uhlalutyo lokuqwalasela yaye ukwenza i-audit yeprojekthi. Ulawulo Iiprojekthi: Ulwazi ngemigaqo, iindlela, okanye izixhobo zokuqwalasela, ukuqamba, ukuqamba, uku hlela, uku hlela, ukuqwalasela, noku lawula iiprojekthi nokuqhuba imithombo, kuquka ukuqwalasela, uku VIU noku xela nge ngqweno yeprojekthi, amakhetha, umsebenzi, noku lawula imiphumela yengxenye. Uku hlela iindleko: Hlela umsebenzi, uku misa iinkqutshwa zoku qonda noku qinisekisa iindleko ezifunekayo; uku misa iinjongo zexesheshi elifutshane okanye elide nokuqumbela iindlela ezizeza kuzo; ukuqwalasela ngoku landelana nakuqwalasela noku hamba phambili kwamanye amahlelo okanye iindawo zehlelo ukuze kufezwe iinjongo; ukuqwalasela inkqubela yaye uk VIU imiphumela. Uku lungelelanisa imiphumela: Ukukhathalela ukuzibophezela nokubophezela abanye ekufezekiseni imiphumela okanye ekugqitheni umganga ogqithisileyo. Iquka inkqubo yoku misa iinjongo ezikabakho, ukwenza inguqu yaye ukuya emva ukumisela ukubakho kolwazi lwezakhono ezihlukeneyo. Umganga unoku ba ngowakho ngokuhlala ngokwakhe (ukuzimisela ekuphuculeni); inkqubela yokulinganisela (ukulungelelanisa imiphumela); ukugqitha abanye (ukukhuphisana); okanye iinjongo ezinzima ozi misileyo, okanye nokuba iyiphi na into enye umntu owayenze (ukudala okutsha). Ukucabanga ngenkqubo: Ukuba ngumlinganisela woku caba ngokweenkqubo jikelele malunga namagunya okanye iindawo ngaphakathi kohlelo. Oku kuquka uku bona ithuba lokuqhagamshela izigaba eziqhubekayo kwezinye iindawo okanye ngokuzakhelayo ukwabelana ngolwazi okanye amathuba abonakala ukuba neloqhawa nakuqhagamshele abanye. Ukubamba iqela elinye: Ikhono lokusebenza ngokubakho kwabanye, ukusebenza kunye esikhundleni soku hamba ngokuhlukileyo okanye ngokukhuphisana. Ukubeka ixabiso kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo: Ikhono loku qonda noku hlonela iindlela, iinkqubo, amaxabiso noku hamba koluntu kwamanye amakho, amaqela namanyanqo. Idlula nangaphezu koko oku funekayo ngumthetho woqoqosho lokulingana kwabasebenzi kurhulumente kuquka ukuba nako uku qonda noku hlonela ukulungelelana koluntu ngokwenza iindlela ezahlukeneyo noku phelelwa ngengqondo kwabanye abanemvelaphi okanye ababuka into ngendlela eyahlukeneyo. Iquka uku bona oku ahlukeneyo kwabanye njengesikhashana esilungileyo kwindlu yokusebenza. Itekisa noku qonda ukuba ukwazi ukusebenza kakuhle nabantu abanamvelaphi,amasiko nakuqoqosho abahlukene kakhulu. Ukubona nokuqonda nokuwela injongo: Ukubakhetha noku khuthaza iinkqubo zobuntu ezibe ngaphezulu nakwabasebenzi abayiyo ezixhasa injongo, igunya namaxabiso ehlelo. Ukwabelana ngeenjongo nokuqonda iingqaqambili noku qamba ukuba khuthaze abanye ukuba bazibophezele baze banxhaxhe ekugcineni injongo.

jobs.title: Director
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Director role at INDLELA in Olifantsfontein overseeing recapitalisation, policy development and accreditation for artisan training within the skills development sector.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree/ Advanced National Diploma (NQF level 7) in Management or Engineering related qualification. An artisan trade qualification and experience as an artisan assessor, trainer and moderator would be an advantage. Five to ten years’ work experience in the skills development sector. A minimum of five years at middle/senior management experience with artisan development. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Excellent computer skills and the ability to develop basic online applications for general use. A valid driver’s license and willingness to travel. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed as endorsed by NSG. Knowledge: Knowledge of the Skills Development Act, 1998. Knowledge of Skills Development Levies Act (SDLA), Treasury Regulation, National Skills Development Strategy (NSDS), Skills Accord and Artisan Training and Development Regulation. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (PFMA). Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS). Skills: Leadership inclusive of Management skills. Communication inclusive of Presentation skills. ICT Management inclusive of Systems Development Planning. Human Resource Development inclusive of Supervisory Management. Policy development inclusive of relevant Legislation.
jobs.duties: will include: Develop, implement, and maintain a recapitalization and modernization project for INDLELA through a User Asset Management Plan (UAMP) in collaboration with Department: Public Works.· Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures and guidelines that ensures that INDLELA is accredited by Quality Council for Trades and Occupations for a range of relevant occupational qualifications and part qualifications.· Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures and guidelines that ensures that INDLELA achieves and maintains ISO Standards for Quality (ISO 9001), Occupational Health and Safety (ISO 9018) and Environmental Control (ISO 9014).· Develop and implement processes to ensure that there is continuous development of relevant INDLELA staff to maintain quality standards of training and assessment.· Collaborate with public TVET College system and processes to ensure that INDLELA is aligned and supports the TVET System nationally.· Manage at a senior management level the efficient, effective, and economic collaboration between INDLELA and the centralized services located at DHET in Pretoria. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements.

af.title: Direkteur
af.summary: Direkteurspos by INDLELA in Olifantsfontein wat toesig hou oor herkapitalisering, beleidsontwikkeling en akkreditasie vir ambagsmanopleiding binne die vaardigheidsontwikkelingssektor.
af.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree/ Advanced National Diploma (NQF level 7) in Management or Engineering related qualification. An artisan trade qualification and experience as an artisan assessor, trainer and moderator would be an advantage. Five to ten years’ work experience in the skills development sector. A minimum of five years at middle/senior management experience with artisan development. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Excellent computer skills and the ability to develop basic online applications for general use. A valid driver’s license and willingness to travel. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed as endorsed by NSG. Knowledge: Knowledge of the Skills Development Act, 1998. Knowledge of Skills Development Levies Act (SDLA), Treasury Regulation, National Skills Development Strategy (NSDS), Skills Accord and Artisan Training and Development Regulation. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (PFMA). Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS). Skills: Leadership inclusive of Management skills. Communication inclusive of Presentation skills. ICT Management inclusive of Systems Development Planning. Human Resource Development inclusive of Supervisory Management. Policy development inclusive of relevant Legislation.
af.duties: sal die volgende insluit: Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou 'n herkapitaliserings- en moderniseringsprojek vir INDLELA deur middel van 'n User Asset Management Plan (UAMP) in samewerking met Department: Public Works.· Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou beleide, prosedures en riglyne wat verseker dat INDLELA deur die Quality Council for Trades and Occupations geakkrediteer word vir 'n reeks relevante beroepskwalifikasies en gedeeltelike kwalifikasies.· Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou beleide, prosedures en riglyne wat verseker dat INDLELA ISO-standaarde vir gehalte (ISO 9001), beroepsgesondheid en veiligheid (ISO 9018) en omgewingsbeheer (ISO 9014) bereik en handhaaf.· Ontwikkel en implementeer prosesse om te verseker dat daar voortdurende ontwikkeling van tersaaklike INDLELA-personeel plaasvind om gehaltestandaarde van opleiding en assessering te handhaaf.· Werk saam met die openbare TVET-kollegestelsel en prosesse om te verseker dat INDLELA in lyn gebring is en die TVET-stelsel nasionaal ondersteun.· Bestuur op seniorbestuursvlak die doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese samewerking tussen INDLELA en die gesentraliseerde dienste wat by DHET in Pretoria geleë is. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

zu.title: Umlawuli
zu.summary: Isikhundla somlawuli ku-INDLELA e-Olifantsfontein sokuhlola ukuvuselelwa kwemali, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo kanye nokwemukelwa kokusebenza kwabakhiqizi ngaphakathi kwesigaba sokuqhakambiswa kwamakhono.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor eziyanele/Advadiploma ePhakeme ye-National (izinga le-NQF 7) ku-Management noma iziqu ezihlotshaniswa ne-Engineering. Isiqu sokusebenza njengomakhiqizi kanye nolwazi lokuba umhloli, ongumfundisi nomphathi wabakhiqizi kuzoba yinzuza. Ukuba nolwazi lomsebenzi ongaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu kuye kwemishangu emihlanu kulesigaba sokuqhakambiswa kwamakhono. Ukuba nolwazi lokuqondiswa okungenani eminyakeni emihlanu njengomphathi ophakathi/ophakeme ekuthuthukisweni kwabakhiqizi. Bonke abagqoke aba khethiwe, okuhlanganisa i-SMS, bazothatha izivivinyo ezimbili zangaphambi kokungena. Esinye kumele sibe sisivivinyo esisebenzayo, futhi esinye kumele sibe sokuHlolwa koQiniso (Ukuziphatha okuhloniphekile). Iphaneli yokukhetha izokuhlola womabili amasevisi obuchule njengesithakazelo esengeziwe enkombolweni yesivivinyo. Ukuba namakhono amahle kakhulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha kanye nokukwazi ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusetyenziswa ezinzima zokusetshenziswa okujwayelekile. Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni kanye nokuzimisela ukuhamba. Ukuphothula ngempumelelo iNyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengoba kugunyazwe yi-NSG. Ulwazi: Ulwazi lokuQashwa kwamakhono, 1998. Ulwazi lokuQashwa kwamakhono kanye noMthetho weLevy (SDLA), uMthetho weTreasury, uMkhandlu weNyunyana weSizwe woKuthuthukiswa kwamakhono (NSDS), iSkills Accord kanye noMthetho wokuQeqshwa kokuThuthukiswa kwabaKhiqizi. Ulwazi loMthetho woLawulo lweMali kahulumeni, 1999 (PFMA). Ulwazi lokuQashwa koMsebenzi kokuZinza kweMpilo (OHS). Amakhono: Ubuholi okuhlanganisa namakhono okuLawula. Ukuxhumana okuhlanganisa namakhono eSethulo. IkuLawula i-ICT okuhlanganisa noCwaningo loKuthuthukiswa kweMimoya. uKuthuthukiswa kweZinsizakalo zabaBantu okuhlanganisa noLawulo lokuQondisa. uKuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo okuhlanganisa noMthetho ohlobene nayo.
zu.duties: kuzohlanganisa: Ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa, futhi kugcinwe iphrojekthi yokuvuselelwa kwemali nasekwenqabini i-INDLELA ngeNdlela yoLawulo lwamaKhasi oMsebenzisi (UAMP) ngokubambisana ne-Department: Public Works.· Ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa, futhi kugcinwe izinqubomgomo, inqubo kanye nezindlela ezikuqinisekisa ukuthi i-INDLELA iyamukelwa yi-Quality Council for Trades and Occupations kwinkambu yeziqu zokusebenza ezihlobene kanye neziqu eziyingxenye.· Ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa, futhi kugcinwe izinqubomgomo, inqubo kanye nezindlela ezikuqinisekisa ukuthi i-INDLELA ifinyelela futhi igcine amazinga e-ISO weQuality (ISO 9001), i-Occupational Health and Safety (ISO 9018) kanye noLawulo loMphilo (ISO 9014).· Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukusebenzise inqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kwabasebenzi abahlobene ne-INDLELA ukuze kugcinwe amazinga okuhle eqeqshweni nasekuhLOlweni.· Ukubambisana nenqubo kanye namandla ezikole ze-TVET zomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-INDLELA ihambisana futhi ixhasa iNqubo ye-TVET ezweni lonke.· Ukuphatha ezingeni eliphezulu lobaphathi ukusebenzisana okusebenzayo, okunamandla, kanye nokuqinisekisa ekubambisweni phakathi kwe-INDLELA kanye namasevisi asendaweni eyodwa atholakala ku-DHET e-Pretoria. N.B. Bonke abagqoke aba khethiwe bazocelwa ukuba baphedule isivivinyo soqhakambo oluhlobene.

xh.title: Umongameli
xh.summary: Isithuba somongameli kwi-INDLELA e-Olifantsfontein esibukele ukuzibuyela emva kwemali, ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo ezisemthethweni nokuqinisekiswa ukwaziswa kwabasebenzi ngezandla ngaphakathi kwesebe lophuhliso lwamakhono.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo zebachelor noma i-Diploma ePhakamileyo yezizwe (NQF level 7) kwakuPhatho okanye nakwimisebenzi yeNjineli. Iziqu zomsebenzi wesandla nolwazi lokusebenza njengomlinganisi wabasebenzi ngasezandleni, kathala nomsameli kubakho nzuzo. Iimvelo zokusebenza ezisukela kwiminyaka emihlanu ukuya kweyishumi kwisebe lophuhliso lwamakhono. Kufuneka kube nolwazi oluncedo lweminyaka emihlanu kumanqanaba aphakathi n/aphezulu oluphathweni ngophuhliso lwabasebenzi ngasezandleni. Bonke abathunyelwe kwoludwe, kuquka ne-SMS, kuya kwenza izihloko zokuqinisekisa ezimbini ngaphambi kokungena. Enye kufuneka ibe yimisebenzi yobugcisa bokwenza izinto, yaye le yenye kufuneka ibe luluvo lokuziphatha (Ukuziphatha okuLungileyo). Iindumba ezikhetha abantu ziya kugcina amanqanaba amabini omsebenzi wobugcisa njengendlela eyongeziweyo ekwenzeni iintevyu. Ulwazi oluhle ngakwikhompyutha nokuqonda ukudala izicelo ezisisiseko ezikwi-intanethi ukuze zisetyenziswe ngabantu abaninzi. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba egqityiweyo nolonwabo lokuhamba. Ukugqiba ngempumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengoko ixhaswa yi-NSG. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngomthetho weSkills Development Act, 1998. Ulwazi ngomthetho weSkills Development Levies Act (SDLA), iTreasury Regulation, iNational Skills Development Strategy (NSDS), iSkills Accord nakuMthetho woKulolongwa nokuPhuhliswa kwaBasebenzi ngasezandleni. Ulwazi ngomthetho wePublic Finance Management Act, 1999 (PFMA). Ulwazi nge-Occupational Health and Safety (OHS). Amaxa: Ukulawula kuquka namaxa okuPhatha. Unxibelelwano kuquka namaxa okuBonakalisa. uPhatha i-ICT kuqukaokuCwangcisa uPhuhliso lweeNkqubo. uPhuhliso lwaBasebenzi kuquka nokuLawula ngokuQaphela. uPhuhliso lweenkqubo ezisemthethweni kuquka neMithetho ehlobene nayo.
xh.duties: kuya kuquka: Ukuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa nokuqinisekisa inkqubo yokuzibuyela kwemali nokuYilwa kabusha ngokwenyaniswa kwi-INDLELA ngeNkqubo yoKulawula iziAsethi zoMsebenzisi (UAMP) ngokusebenzisana nesebe: i-Public Works.· Ukuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa nokuqinisekisa iinkqubo ezisemthethweni, iinkqubo nolweliso olwenza isicelo sokuba i-INDLELA iqinisekiswe yi-Quality Council for Trades and Occupations ngeziqu ezahlukeneyo zomsebenzi nangamacala amancinci eziqu.· Ukuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa nokuqinisekisa iinkqubo ezisemthethweni, iinkqubo nolweliso olwenza isicelo sokuba i-INDLELA ifikelele kwaye igcine amanqanaba e-ISO ngokuGcina umgangatho (ISO 9001), ukuQinisekisa ukuPhila nokuKhuseleka emsebenzini (ISO 9018) nokuLawula iNdalo (ISO 9014).· Ukuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho ukuqhubeka phambili kolwazi koqoqosho lwabasebenzi be-INDLELA ukuze kugcinwe umgangatho wololongwa nokuqinisekiswa.· Ukusebenzisana nolawulo noluntu lwe-TVET College nenkqubo yayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba i-INDLELA ihambisana nayo kwaye ixhase inkqubo ye-TVET kwizinwe.· Ukulawula kwinqanaba eliphezulu ulwabiwo olusebenzayo oluchanekileyo nokwenzeka ngokweemfuno phakathi kwe-INDLELA neenkonzo eziqulunqwe ndawonye ezikwi-DHET ePretoria. N.B. Bonke abathunyelwe kwoludwe kuya kufunwa bagqibe umsebenzi wamakhono ahambelanayo.

jobs.title: Director: Teacher Education
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Director of Teacher Education in Pretoria, leading policy development for initial teacher education and professional development within the Department of Higher Education and Training.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree/Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) in Education and Training Development / Teaching / or a related qualification. A minimum of five (5) years relevant experience at middle / senior management level in Education Management/ Higher Education environment; Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed as endorsed by NSG. Knowledge and understanding of policies and regulatory frameworks governing the basic and higher education sector; Advanced experience in interpretation, development, and implementation of teacher education and development policies; An extensive knowledge of, and insight into initial teacher education (ITE) and continuing professional development (CPD) of early childhood and schooling teachers, community education and technical and vocational lecturer education practices, policies, qualifications, and programmes; Extensive knowledge of quality assurance processes and mechanisms in higher education; The ability to develop, support and monitor the implementation of policies and programmes; The ability to work in collaboration with other government departments, with quality councils, universities, and other relevant role-players; Good computer skills. This position requires a dynamic individual with proven management, leadership, change management and people management capabilities. Experience in budgeting, financial management, and project management is essential. High level of accuracy and analytical capability, including presentation and report writing skills. Good problem-solving skills; client orientation and customer focus. Excellent communication both in writing and verbal and good computer skills. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Lead and manage the Department of Higher Education and Training’s responsibilities with respect to developing, maintaining, supporting, and monitoring the implementation of policies for initial teacher education and continuing professional development of education professionals. Conceptualise and implement programmes and projects to strengthen early childhood, schooling, community education and training (CET) and technical and vocational training (TVET) college lecturers’ teacher education programmes and qualifications at universities. Contribute to the implementation of the Integrated Strategic Planning Framework for Teacher Education and Development (ISPFTED) and the National Policy Framework for Teacher Education and Development (NPFTED). Provide strategic support to the sector through the Provincial Teacher Education Development Committee (PTEDC). Monitor teacher supply and demand patterns, teacher education enrolments, graduation and graduate employment patterns and using information to inform teacher production planning. Have constant engagements with the Department of Basic Education (DBE) and universities on various matters of interest in the sector. Draft speeches, briefing notes and replies to parliamentary and media questions. Collate inputs for Medium Term Development Plan (MTDP). Prepare and make presentations to different stakeholders. Travel extensively and attend meetings with universities, stakeholders, and partners for various purposes. Manage and monitor the Directorate, the Teaching and Learning Development Capacity Improvement Programme (TLDCIP) and partner- and donor-funded projects’ budget and expenditure. Prepare quarterly reports as per annual performance plan (APP) and ensure the compilation of annual report and strategic plan of the Directorate. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements.

zu.title: Umphathi: Imfundo Yabafundisi
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezemfundo Yabafundisi ePretoria, ohola ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo yemfundo yokuqala yabafundisi nentuthuko yobungcweti ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yesizukulwane esifanele / i-Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) ku-Education and Training Development / Teaching / noma izifundo ezihlobene. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yesiphephelo sokuhamba phambili / ezingeni eliphezulu lokubusa ku-Education Management / kwindawo ye-Higher Education; Ukuphumelela ngokuphelele i-Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengoba kunqanyuliwe yi-NSG. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezinqubomgomo nezakhiwo ezilawula izikhathi zemfundo ekuqala nengaphezulu; Isiphephelo esivezayo sokuhumusha, ukuthuthukisa, nokuqashwa kwezinqubomgomo yemfundo nentuthuko yabafundisi; Ulwazi olubanzi, nokugqamayo kwemfundo yokuqala yabafundisi (ITE) nokuqhubeka kolwazi obungcweti (CPD) kwabafundisi bemfundo yasebuntwaneni nasemzikayikolishi, imfundo yomphakathi nendlela yokufundisa kwabalawuli bemfundo yobuchwepheshe nobusebenza, izinqubomgomo, izifundo, kanye namaprogramu; Ulwazi olubanzi lwenqubo nomezibozo wokuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi kwemfundo ezingeni eliphezulu; Ikhono lokuthuthukisa, ukusekela kubukeka ukuphunyuzwa kwezinqubomgomo namaprogramu; Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela nomnyango wezinye izinhlanga zikahulumeni, nomagunyazi wekhwalithi, namanyuvesi, nabanomthelela abafanele; Amakhono amahle ekusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Lesi sikhundla sifuna umuntu onamandla onesiphephelo esibonakalayo sobuqhawe, ukubusa, ukuphatha izinguquko nobuqhawe bokuphatha abantu. Isiphephelo kumabhalo mali, ukuphatha izimali, nokuphatha amaprojeku kuyadingeka. Izinga eliphezulu lokunikela ngokunembile nokuqonda izinto, okuhlanganisa namakhono okwethula nokubhala imibiko. Amakhono amahle okuxazulula izinkinga; ukumiswa kombono omusha wokuxhumana nabathengi nokuqwalasela ukunikelwa kwabanikabelo. Ukuthumela imiyalezo ngokubhaliwe nangomlomo ngokuhle kanye namakhono amahle ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Hola uphathe izibopho ze-Department of Higher Education and Training ngokuqondene nokuthuthukiswa, ukugcinwa, ukusekelwa, nokubukwa ukuphunyuzwa kwezinqubomgomo zemfundo yokuqala yabafundisi kanye nokuqhubeka kolwazi obungcweti babafundisi bamalunga. Cabanga uphunyulwe amaprogramu namaprojeku ukuze kuqiniswe imfundo yasebuntwaneni, esikoleni, imfundo yomphakathi kanye noqeqesho (CET) kanye noqeqesho lobuchwepheshe nobusebenza (TVET) kwamakholishi amaprogramu nemfundo yabafundisi kumanyuvesi. Sega ekuphunyuzweni kwe-Integrated Strategic Planning Framework for Teacher Education and Development (ISPFTED) kanye ne-National Policy Framework for Teacher Education and Development (NPFTED). Nikeza isisekelo esihle emkhakheni ngqo i-Provincial Teacher Education Development Committee (PTEDC). Buka ukubakwa kwabafundisi nokuqakuliswa kwemfuno, ukubhaliswa kwemfundo yabafundisi, ukuthweswa iziqu nendlela yokusebenza kwabaphume iziqu kubukeke ukusetshenziswa kolwazi lokubika ukukhiqizwa kwabafundisi. Ukuba noxhumo olungaphekanywa ne-Department of Basic Education (DBE) namanyuvesi ngemibhalo ehlose emikhakheni. Bhala izinkulumo, okuqashelwa okufushanisiwe kanye nezimpendulo zemibuzo ephathelene nophalamende nezindaba. Qoqa okufakwayo ku-Medium Term Development Plan (MTDP). Lungelela ube nezethulo kubambiswe namalunga ahlukene. Hambha kakhulu ubambe ihambe namanyuvesi, abathintekayo, nabanomziswa njengezinhloso ezahlukene. Phatha kubuke ukuba sebakheni, i-Teaching and Learning Development Capacity Improvement Programme (TLDCIP) abahlobene kanye noshere namaphrojeku abhalwe ngaphezu kwesabelo kubuke imali ekhishiwe. Lungelela imibiko yenyanga ngemva kwezinyanga ezingamunye ngendlela yokuhamba ngonyaka (APP) futhi qinisekisa ukuqoqwa kwemibiko yonyaka nendlela yokubala eqhutshwa isikhungo. N.B. Bonke abafakwa ohlwini bazodingeka kuphothe isiphephelo esifanele.

jobs.title: Director: CET Curriculum and Institutional Support
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Northern and Western Cape Regional Office
jobs.summary: Director position to lead curriculum development, institutional support, and lecturer development for Community Education and Training in the Northern and Western Cape region.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree/Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) in Education or a related qualification. A relevant postgraduate degree in Education or related qualification (NQF level 8) will be an added advantage. A minimum of five (5) to ten (10 years of experience in the Post-School Education and Training sector and five (5) years’ experience at middle/senior managerial level. In PSET consideration will be given to candidates with proven management experience working in PSET. Understanding and knowledge of prescripts and legal frameworks applicable to the PSET sector will be an added advantage. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre- entry Programmed as endorsed by NSG. Further requirements are excellent and proven project management capabilities, problem-solving and financial management skills, proposal, and report writing and computer skills. Ability to work under pressure and willingness to work extended hours. Skills required: Ability to work in a team, good interpersonal and communication skills, computer literacy, financial management, strategic planning, and leadership. Willingness to work irregular hours and travel extensively. A valid driver’s license is essential.
jobs.duties: Ensure effective leadership and management of the strategic planning process, institutional governance, and management support in the Region. Provide proper and effective curriculum development and support in the region. Manage lecturer development and support, including the effective support of the governance (council, SRC, Academic Board) in the Region. Manage and support teaching and learning in the colleges. Oversee the management of examinations and assessments. Coordinate monitoring and evaluation functions of the programmes in the Colleges. Provide overall monitoring and evaluation, including reporting in line with the departmental frameworks. Liaise with industry, SETAs, and other government institutions to create a conducive environment for partnerships and stakeholder relations. Manage the delegated administrative and financial responsibilities. Manage the compensation of employees’ budget in the unit including the recruitment processes and provide support to the public CET College on matters relating to labour relations, change management, and implementation of IQMS and PMDS. Ensure compliance with public Service Regulations and all administrative matters. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

af.title: Direkteur: CET Kurrikulum en Instellingsondersteuning

'n Relevante nagraadse graad in Onderwys of 'n verwante kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 8) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) tot tien (10) jaar se ervaring in die Naskoolse Onderwys- en Opleidingssektor en vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. In PSET sal oorweging gegee word aan kandidate met bewese bestuurservaring in PSET. Begrip en kennis van voorskrifte en regsraamwerke van toepassing op die PSET-sektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Volledige voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Program soos deur die NSG goedgekeur. Verdere vereistes is uitstekende en bewese projekbestuursvermoëns, probleemoplossings- en finansiële bestuursvaardighede, voorstel- en verslagskryf en rekenaarvaardighede. Bestuur dosentontwikkeling en -ondersteuning, insluitend die effektiewe ondersteuning van die bestuur (raad, SRC, Akademiese Raad) in die Streek.
