zu.title: Director: CET Curriculum and Institutional Support
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Director sokuhola ukuthuthukiswa kwe-curriculum, ukwesekwa kwezikhungo, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabalufundisi kwi-Community Education and Training esifundeni sase-Northern nase-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor ehambisanayo noma i-Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) eMfundweni noma iziqu ezihlobene nayo. I-postgraduate degree eMfundweni noma iziqu ezihlobene nayo (NQF level 8) izoba yinzuzo. Ubuncane besikhathi esihleziwe eminyakeni engu- five (5) kuye kwayi- ten (10 years of experience emkhakheni we-Post-School Education and Training futhi eminyakeni engu- five (5) years’ experience kwesigaba sokuphatha phakathi/phezulu. Ekuqasheni kwe-PSET kuzonakaliswa abantu abanolwazi olubonakaliswe ngokuphatha abasebenze kwi-PSET. Ukuqonda nokwazi imithetho kanye namakhandlela okomthetho asetshenziswa kumkhakha we-PSET kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukuqedwa ngemvama kwe-Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre- entry Programmed njengoba kuqinisekiswe yi-NSG. Ezinye izidingo yikho ukuphathwa kohlelo okubonakalayo kakhulu nokuqinisekisiwe, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono okuphatha imali, ukubhala izindatshana kanye namapheshana, kanye namakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Isipho sokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezelwa nokuzithoba ukusebenza amahora amude. Amakhono adingekayo: Isipho sokusebenza eqenjini, amakhono amahle okuhlobana nomuntu ngamunye nokuqhumunyisa, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphatha imali, ukuhlela ngokwesimo sokuqonda izinhloso, nokuhola. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza amahora angajwayelekile ukuze ahambe ivela kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile iyadingeka.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle nokuhola inqubo yokuhlela kabusha ngokwesimo sokuqonda izinhloso, ukuphathwa kwezikhungo, kanye nokwesekwa kokuphatha kule ndawo. Nikeza ukuthuthukiswa nokesekwa okufanele nokuqinisekile kohlelo lokufundisa kule ndawo. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokesekwa kwabalufundisi, okuhlanganisa nokwesekwa okuqinisekile kokuphathwa (ibandla, SRC, i-Academic Board) kule ndawo. Phatha futhi useke ukufundisa nokufunda emakholiji. Qapha ukuphathwa kwezivivinyo kanye nokuhlola. Hlanganisa imisebenzi yokubuka nokuhlolwa kohlema lwezinhlelo ezikwimakholiji. Nikeza ukubuka nokuhlolwa kohlema lwayo wonke, okuhlanganisa ukubika ngokuhambisana namakhandlela oMnyango. Xhumana nomkhakha wezimbono, ne-SETA, kanye nezinye izikhungo zahulumeni ukuze kudalwe isimo esifanele sokubambisana namabalana abathintekayo. Phatha izinkingo ezinikelwe zokuphatha kwezomdabu namasheya. Phatha imali yesabelo yabasebenzi kuleyunithi okuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuqasha futhi useke ikolishi lika-CET likawonke mayelana nezindaba zokuhlobana nomsebenzi, ukuphathwa koshintsho, kanye nokusebenzisa i-IQMS ne-PMDS. Qinisekisa ukuzilandela ngemithetho yaseZweni Yokwenza Komphakathi kanye nazo zonke izindaba zokuphathwa kwemisebenzi. N.B. Bonke abagqwayizi abakwi-listi encane bazodinga ukuqedza umzamo ofanele wamakhono.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ulwazi lokuYilwa kwesiCwangciso neNkxaso yeMigaqo yeCET
xh.summary: Isithuba somongameli sokukhokula ukuyilwa kwesicwangciso, inkxaso yemigaqo, nophuhliso lwabalufundi kuMfundo noziqendu zeKhomphu waseMantla naseNtshona Kapa.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelors/ iDiploma ePhakamileyo (NQF level 7) ekuQondene neMfundo okanye izidanga ezinxulumene nako. Isidanga seQela leFundo ephezulu (postgraduate) ekuQondene neMfundo okanye izidanga ezinxulumene nako (NQF level 8) kuya kuba lumnandi ongawongezelelo. Kufuneka abe nobugcisa bokusebenza obungalula phantsi komthetho wePSET bobugcisa kubaphathi abaphakathi kweminyaka emihlanu (5) ukuya k Kwishumi (10) nabamanye abaphathi abangaphezulu kwaye abe nobugcisa bokusebenza iminyaka emihlanu (5) kwinqanaba eliphakathi/lamadoda amakhulu. KwiPSET kuza kubakho isigqibo esinikwa abagqatswa abangenisa isicelo kubaphathi abadumileyo ngobugcisa babo abangenisa isicelo kwiPSET. Ukuqonda nolwazi ngeendlela zokubhala imigaqo nakumthetho osebenza kwicandelo lePSET, kuya kuba lumnandi kubongezelelo ekuphumeleleni. Ukugqiba ngemveliso inkqubo yeNyukela Public Service SMS Pre- entry Programmed njengokuvunywa yiNSG. Iimfuno ezongezelelekileo kukuba nobugcisa obubonakaliseyo obugqwesileyo bokulawula izicwangciso, ukusombulula iingxaki noko kukwazi ukulawula imali, iimfono zokuqamba nokuclulula iingxelo, kukwanoko ukwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha. Ukuba namandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwenkxwaleko nokulungele ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelekileyo. Ubuchule obudingekayo: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokwethu, ubuchule obuhle bokuziphatha nokunxibelelana nabantu, ukwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha, ukulawula imali, ukucwangcisa ngokwendlela ekuqonda kuyo, nokuba nguRhanyo. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngeeyure ezingazenzisiyo nokuhamba kakhulu. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni lundoqo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba kukho ukulawula nokulawula ngokuchanekileyo inkqubo yocwangciso, ulawulo lwemigaqo, nenkxaso ekulawulweni ngaseKhapayi. Zenza ulwazi oluchanekileyo nephumelelayo ngokuyilwa kwesicwangciso ngenkxaso eKhapayi. Lawula uphuhliso ngenkxaso yabalufundi, kuquka nokuxhasa ngokufanelekileyo ulawulo (urhulumente, iSRC, iBoard yezeMfundo) eKhapayi. Lawula uze uxhase ukufundiswa nokufunda kumaziko emfundo. Qwalasela ulawulo lokubhaliswa nokuhluzwa kweekhosi. Xhumana nokulawula nokuhla kweenkqubo zokuqwalasela eZikolweni. Xhosa.

af.title: Hoof: False Bay TVET College
af.summary: Hoofpos by False Bay TVET College wat 'n bachelorsgraad en agt jaar se ondervinding in die na-skoolse onderwys- en opleidingssektor vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Bachelorsgraad/Gevorderde Diploma (NQF Vlak 7) in Onderwys/Openbare/Besigheidsadministrasie of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Relevante nagraadse kwalifikasie in die Na-skoolse Onderwys- en Opleidingssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se ondervinding binne die Na-skoolse Onderwys- en Opleidingssektor en vyf (5) jaar se ondervinding op middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed soos deur die NSG goedgekeur. Uitgebreide ondervinding in enige of al die volgende algemene bestuursfeites: kollege-/onderwysinstellingbestuur, strategiebestuur, onderwysbestuur, menslike hulpbronbestuur en -ontwikkeling. Bewese bestuursvaardighede en 'n loopbaanrekord in die voorbereiding, implementering en bestuur van strategiese, operasionele en finansiële bestuursplanne en -projekte. Moet tersaaklike werkondervinding in opleiding en ontwikkeling of 'n verwante omgewing hê. Vermoë om interne stelsels en kontroles te ontwerp om goeie organisatoriese beheer, finansiële bestuur en beheer te verseker. Bewese rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend gevorderde MS Word, MS Excel en MS PowerPoint. Bewese verslagskryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Deeglike kennis van die openbare TVET-kollegesektor en sy regulatoriese en wetgewende raamwerk. Kennis van onderwys- en instellingsbestuursbeginsels, -metodologieë en -prosedures. Kennis van beheer- en openbare sektor bestuursverslagdoeningsvereistes. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, kliëntoriëntasie en klantfokus, finansiële bestuur, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, kommunikasie en belanghebbendebestuur. Kennis van en/of ondervinding in die privaatsektor/bedryf sal ook as 'n bykomende voordeel beskou word. Bereidwilligheid om onreëlmatige ure te werk en wyd te reis. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Om die doeltreffende en effektiewe implementering van kollegebeheerraamwerke en -stelsels aan te dryf; en die funksionering van beheerstrukture, insluitend die kollegeraad en die akademiese raad. Om 'n effektiewe bestuurspan te bou en te bevorder wat die kollegemandaat op 'n geïntegreerde, nakomende en prestasiegerigte wyse beplan en uitvoer. Om die rol van rekenpligtige beampte van die kollege te vervul deur kollege-finansiële en voorsieningskettingbestuurstelsels in te stel en te monitor ter bereiking van strategiese doelwitte en nakoming van alle tersaaklike wetgewing en regulasies. Om effektiewe menslike hulpbronbestuurs- en belanghebbende-betrokkenheidstelsels in te stel en te monitor wat bemarking en kommunikasie inkorporeer. Om 'n platform vir effektiewe bestuursbesluitneming te skep deur die instelling van 'n akkurate en toeganklike inligtingsbestuursplatform. Om die ontwikkeling en levering van responsiewe beroeps- en beroepsmatige kurrikula en programme te lei en die geassosieerde gehalteversekeringsprogram en impak op studenteprestasie en -plasing te monitor. Om besigheidspartnerskappe en -skakelings te opereonaliseer wat vertaal in studenteplasing, werkplekgebaseerde leer en artikulasie. Om 'n studentebestuursraamwerk en -stelsel in te stel en te bestuur wat studentesteun en -beheer fasiliteer en alle ingeskrewe studente van holistiese akademiese en sosiale steun voorsien. Om 'n kollege-infrastruktuur- en landgoedbestuurstelsel in te stel en te lei wat die verkryging, onderhoud, bestuur en verwydering van fisiese hulpbronne verseker wat die bereiking van strategiese en operasionele doelwitte fasiliteer. zu.title: UMongameli: False Bay TVET College
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMongameli e-False Bay TVET College esifuna isiqu se-bachelor's degree kanye nesipiliyoni seminyaka eyisishiyagalombili emkhakheni wemfundo kokuqeqeshwa kwezenhlalo zikahulumeni.
zu.requirements: Isiqu se-Bachelor's Degree/Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) esifanele eMfundeni/Yolawulo Lomphakathi noma Yezabhizinisi noma isiqu ehlobene nalo. Isiqu semfundo esimva kwedigri esimweni sezenhlalo zikahulumeni sokufunda kokuqeqeshwa kuzobe nodlalo omkhulu ongemumele. Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili (8) ngaphakathi kumkhakha wezemfundo kokuqeqeshwa kwezenhlalo zikahulumeni kanye nesipiliyoni seminyaka emihlanu (5) ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi noma ophezulu. Ukugcwalisa ngempumelelo iNyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengoba kunconywa yi-NSG. Isipiliyoni esibanzi kunoma yisiphi esinye noma yonke le mingcele yokuqeqeshwa okuvamile: ukuphathwa kwekolishi noma yenhlanganisela yemfundo, ukuphathwa kobuchwepheshe, ukuphathwa kwemfundo, ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza zabantu, nokuthuthukiswa. Amakhono obuholi abucayile kanye nerekhodi ekuthuthukiseni, ekuqashweni, nasekuphathweni kohlelo obhezu kakhulu, obusebenzayo, nabalingisi bomphakathi nemali. Kumele kube nesipiliyoni somsebenzi ofanele ekuqeqeshweni nasekuthuthukisweni noma endaweni ehlobene nayo. Ikhono lokuhlela amasistimu angaphakathi nokuqaphela ukuthi kuhle ukuphathwa kwenhlanganisela, ukuphathwa kwemali, nokuqaphela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha okubucayile okuhlanganisa i-MS Word ephambili, i-MS Excel, kanye ne-MS PowerPoint. Amakhono okubhala umbiko kanye nokuqhakambisa okuqinisekisiwe. Ukwazi kahle umkhakha wekolishi le-TVET kahulumeni nakunomsimamo kanye nokuqondiswa kobugqila. Ulwazi lwemigqo yokuphathwa kwezemfundo kwezinhlanganisela, izindlela, kanye nendlela zokwenza. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezokuqasha izindaba kwezinsiza zikahulumeni ezibalulekile. Ikhono lobuholi nezindlela, ukumisela umthwalo kugxile ekuthumeleni kwemisebenzi kubathengi, ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokusungula amandla, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuphathwa abahlanganyeli. Ulwazi kanye/noma isipiliyoni emkhakheni wangasese wezimboni nazo zizobe zithathwa njengenye. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza amasikhathi angajwayelekile nokuhamba kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela ehlola ukuthi iyasebenza
zu.duties: Ukuqhuba ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kanye nekakhulu kwezohlulelo nobuholi bokuphathwa kwekolishi kanye namasistimu; nokuqhuba ukusebenza kwezakhiwo zobuholi, okuhlanganisa ibhodi lekolishi kanye nebhodi yezemfundo. Ukwakha futhi kwuthuthukise iqembu labaphathi abasebenzayo elicubungula futhi eliphephisa umyalezo wekolishi ngendlela ehlangene, evumelana nomthetho, futhi egxile ekuqashweni. Ukufeza indima kanomzuli wekolishi ngokusungula futhi kwahlulela amasistimu okuphathwa kwezimali kanye nezohwebo zezinsizakusebenza eziya ekufezeni amaphuzu aphambili obuchwepheshe kanye nokuvumelana nawo wonke umthetho kanye nemithesho. Ukusungula futhi kwahlulela ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza zabantu olusebenzayo kanye namasistimu ohlelo lokuzibandakanya nabahlanganyeli okuhlanganisa kokubili ukuthengisa nokuxhumana. Ukudala insiza yokuqasha izinqumo zabaphathi abasebenzayo ngokusungula insiza yolwazi olunembile futhi olufinyeleleka kalula. Ukuhola ekuthuthukiseni nasekuhanisweni kwemigqo yezifundo yemisebenzi kanye namaphrogremu futhi ukuhlola iphrogremu yokutholakala kwekhwalithi ehambisana nayo kanye nomthelela wayo ekwenziweni kwabafundi nasekubekweni kwabo. Ukwenza amabhizinisi nabahlanganyeli bokuhambisana okuhumusha kube ukubekwa kwabafundi, ukufunda ngendlela yomsebenzi, kanye nokujwayelana. Ukusungula futhi ukuphatha uhlelo nokuphathwa kwabafundi okwenza ukuxhaswa kwabafundi kanye nobuholi futhi okunika bonke abafundi ababhalisile ukuxhaswa okuyisisekelo kwezemfundo nabezimali. Ukusungula futhi ukuhola isistimu yezakhiwo kanye nokuphathwa kwefayuni lekolishi eqinisekisa ukutholwa, ukugcinwa, ukuphathwa, nokulahlwa kwezinsiza ezingokomzimba ezikuncedeni ekufezeni amaphuzu aphambili obuchwepheshe kanye namaphuzu abalulekile. Ukwenza amaphrogremu ahambisana nokuqhuba phambili. Qaphela: Bonke abagijimiswayo abayishumi nambalwa bazodinga ukugcwalisa isenzo esibucayi kohlelo.

xh.title: Iprinziphali: False Bay TVET College
xh.summary: Isithuba sePrinziphali kwi-False Bay TVET College esifuna isidanga se-bachelor kunye neminyaka yamava eyi-eight kwingingqi yemfundo yokwangemva kwesikolo nokuqeqesha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor’s Degree/Advanced Diploma esifanelekileyo (NQF Level 7) kwi-Education/Public/Business Administration okanye nesiqinisekiso esinxulumene nako. Isidanga se-postgraduate esifanelekileyo kwingingqi ye-Post Schooling Education and Training siza kuba yincedo ephawulekayo. Ukolunye umva weminyaka eyi-eight (8) ngaphakathi kwingingqi ye-Post School Education and Training kunye namava eminyaka eyi-five (5) kwinqanaba eliphakamileyo/ eliphezulu lokulawula. Ukuqeshwa ngempumelelo kwi-Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengokuqinisekisiwe yi-NSG. Amava amaninzi nakuzo naziphi na okanye zonke ezi ndawo zilandulo zolawulo jikelele: ulawulo lwekolishi/iinstithu zemfundo, ulawulo lwenqumba, ulawulo lwemfundo, ulawulo lweemveliso zabantu, nokuqeqesha. Amakhono obuqeqeshi obuqinisekisiweyo kunye nenqanaba lokwenza iindlela ezicwangcisiweyo, ezisebenzayo, nezilawulayo zolawulo ngokwendlela, ngokusebenza, nangemali kunye neeprojekthi. Kufuneka ube namava okusebenza axhumene nokuqeqesha nokuqhuba okanye kwindawo enxulumene nayo. Ikhono lokuyila iinkqubo zangaphakathi nezilawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo oluhle lwequmrhu, ulawulo lweemali, lolawulo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwekhompyutha oluqinisekisiweyo, oluquka i-MS Word, i-MS Excel, kunye ne-MS PowerPoint ezisezantsi. Amakhono okubhala iiriphoti nokubonisa aqinisekisiweyo. Ulwazi oluhle lwebhlorho yamakolishi e-TVET sommango kunye nendlela yawo yolawulo nemithetho. Ulwazi ngamagama, iindlela, neendlela zolawulo lwemfundo kwaye ngeentsebenzo. Ulwazi ngokuxela ngeemfuno zolawulo lolawulo lommango kwaye kolawulo lwemfundo. Ikhono eliyimeko lokulawula nokuba ngumkhokeli, ukujolisa kumthengi kwaye kuqondele umthengi, ulawulo lweemali, ulawulo labantu nokuqxaxha, ukuthetha, kunye nolawulo lwabaqhubiyo. Ulwazi kwaye/okanye amava kwikampani yommango/shishini nayo iya kuthathwa njengencedo ephawulekayo. Ukuqina ekusebenzeni ngeyure ezingamiselwanga kwaye uhambe kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela eyigunyazisiweyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba ngempumelelo nangokusebenzayo ukuqediswa kweekhaphu zolawulo kwaye iinkqubo ze-False Bay TVET College zolawulo; kunye nokusebenza kweziqu zolawulo, kuquka ibhunga lekolishi kunye nebhodi yemfundo. Ukwakha kwaye ukhulise iqela elisebenzayo lokulawula elicwangcisa kwaye aliphureze iNkuliso ye-False Bay TVET College ngendlela ehlanganisiweyo, ehambelana nemithetho, kwaye ejolise kwimigaqo. Ukuze ugcwalise indima yenkunzi yee-akhawunti ze-False Bay TVET College ngokusungula kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zemali kunye noyilo lwe-False Bay TVET College ngokujolisa ekufezweni kwemigqongo yolawulo kwaye ngokuhambelana nayo yonke imithetho nayimigaqo ephathwayo. Ukusungula kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zolawulo lweemveliso zabantu zisebenzayo kwaye uxhumanise nabathathi-nxaxheba eziqukammathwa eziquka kokubakha-namme ukuthetha-nxaxheba. Ukuyila indawo yokwenza iigqibo ezisebenzayo ngokusungula inkqubo esemgangathweni wolwazi egqithisweyo ngokuchanekileyo nangaphantsi kolawulo. Ukulawula ukuphuhliswa nokunikwa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokufundisa iziqu zobugcisa bokusebenza nangemisebenzi kwaye ukujonge inkqubo eqinisekisayo umgangatho ongxulumene nayo kwaye impembelelo emveni yomfundi nokubekwa kwakhe. Ukuze usebenze ngokobuhlobo nabashishino kunye noqhagamshelwano oluquka ukubekwa kwabafundi kwimisebenzi, ukufunda ngasebenzini, nokudibanisa. Ukusungula kwaye ulawule iNkqubo nokulawula inkqubo yokulawula abafundi ezenza ukulondolozwa kolwazi abafundi nokulawula kwaye labonelela bonke abafundi ababhalisileyo ngokuxhaswa ngokupheleleyo kwemfundo nakwilentlalo. Ukusungula kwaye ukhokole inkqubo yolawulo lwekolishi nokulawulwa kwezindlu ezibonelela ngokufumanisa, ukulondoloza, ukulawula, ukuphoswa kwamacebo amlinganeyo akuqinisekisa ukufezwa kwemigqongo yolawulo nokuqhuba. Ukunceda ngokubeka ngokudibanisa iinkqubo nokuphuhliswa. N.B. Onke amagqabantshi alandululwe aya kufunwa aqale umzobo wamakhono abakulawulo.

jobs.title: Deputy Principal: Corporate Services
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: This post is based in Community Education and Training (CET) Colleges

jobs.summary: Deputy Principal for Corporate Services at a CET College, providing strategic leadership in HR, IT, marketing, facilities and governance at salary level 12.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate bachelor’s degree (NQF Level 7) in Human Resource Management/ Development or related qualification. A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years’ relevant work experience of which three (3) years’ experience at a junior management level in corporate services environment. An understanding of the Department of Higher Education and Training’s strategic vision and priorities. Knowledge of Public Service Act, Employment of Educators Act, Labour Relations Act and Public Financial Management Act. Knowledge of policies and legislative frameworks governing education and training as well as the Public Service and Employment Service in South Africa. Experience in managing people and projects with the ability to plan strategically. An ability to develop, support and monitor the implementation of policies and the ability to work in a team environment, good project management and computer skills. Willingness to work irregular hours and travel extensively. Computer literacy (Ms Word, Ms PowerPoint, Ms Excel, Ms Excess and Ms Outlook). A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership in the areas of Human Resource, IT, Marketing, Facilities Management, Records Management, Labour Relations and Governance. Oversee the entire day to day operational requirement of the HR, Marketing and IT functions including those activities in the campus. Render communication and information technology services to meet the specific needs of the college. Accountable for the effective delivery of service in each of these areas. Facilitate and drive the timely and accurate preparation of the college’s annual budget in line with Strategic priorities. Coordinate and driver the preparation for the annual review of the college’s strategic plan. Prepare quarterly reports as per annual performance plan and ensure the compilation f the annual report and strategic plan of the college. Encourage and builds an organisational climate conductive to optimal performance through implementing change management. Develop and implement best practice policies, procedure, and internal control systems to ensure effective corporate governance. Ensure the provision of appropriate and cost-effective service. Oversee the proper and effective management of the college’s assets and facilities. Ensure the provision of appropriate and cost-effective services. Manage human resources and corporate management service affairs in the college. Provide guidance and adequate support and development of the staff. Ensure compliance with all administrative requirements, regulations, rules and regulations pertaining to Corporate Services. Responsible for IT and information management solutions to meet the specific needs of the Region. Responsible for communication and marketing for the Regional Office. Ensure development of PMDS of staff. Monitor quality control of work and develop annual performance plan. Monitor the planning, organisation, and delegation of work. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

af.title: Adjunk-prinsipaal: Korporatiewe Dienste
af.summary: Adjunk-prinsipaal vir Korporatiewe Dienste by 'n CET-kollege, wat strategiese leierskap bied in HR, IT, bemarking, fasiliteite en bestuur op salarisvlak 12.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike bachelorsgraad (NQF-vlak 7) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuurl/ontwikkeling of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se relevante werkservaring waarvan drie (3) jaar se ervaring op 'n juniorbestuursvlak in 'n korporatiewe dienste-omgewing. 'n Begrip van die Departement of Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding se strategiese visie en prioriteite. Kennis van die Openbare Dienswet, die Wet op die Diens van Onderwysers, die Arbeidsverhoudingswet en die Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur. Kennis van beleidsraamwerke en wetgewing wat onderwys en opleiding sowel as die Openbare Diens en Arbeidsdiens in Suid-Afrika regeer. Ekkervaring in die bestuur van mense en projekte met die vermoë om strategies te beplan. 'n Vermoë om belede te ontwikkel, te ondersteun en die implementering daarvan te monitor, en die vermoë om in 'n spanomgewing te werk, goeie projektbestuursvaardighede en rekenaarvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om onreëlmatige ure te werk en wyd te reis. Rekenaarvaardighede (Ms Word, Ms PowerPoint, Ms Excel, Ms Excess en Ms Outlook). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die areas van Menslike Hulpbronne, IT, Bemarking, Fasiliteitebestuur, Rekordbestuur, Arbeidsverhoudings en Bestuur. Hou tosig oor die algehele daaglikse operasionele vereistes van die HR-, Bemarkings- en IT-funksies, insluitend daardie aktiwiteite op die kampus. Lewer kommunikasie en inligtingstegnologie-dienste om in die spesifieke behoeftes van die kollege te voorsien. Verantwoordelik vir die effektiewe levering van diens in elk van hierdie areas. Fassiliteer en dryf die tydige en akkurate voorbereiding van die kollege se jaarlikse begroting in ooreenstemming met strategiese prioriteite. Koördineer en dryf die voorbereiding vir die jaarlikse hersiening van die kollege se strategiese plan. Berei kwartaalverslae voor ooreenkomstig die jaarlikse prestasieplan en verseker die samestelling van die jaarlikse verslag en strategiese plan van die kollege. Moedig 'n organisatoriese klimaat wat tot optimale prestasie lei aan deur veranderingsbestuur te implementeer. Ontwikkel en implementeer bestepraktykbeleid, prosedures en interne beheerstelsels om effektiewe korporatiewe bestuur te verseker. Verseker die verskaffing van toepaslike en kostedoeltreffende dienste. Hou tosig oor die behoorlike en effektiewe bestuur van die kollege se bates en fasiliteite. Verseker die verskaffing van toepaslike en kostedoeltreffende dienste. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne en korporatiewe bestuursdienssake by die kollege. Verskaf leiding en voldoende ondersteuning en ontwikkeling van die personeel. Verseker nakoming van alle administratiewe vereistes, regulasies, reels en regulasies wat op Korporatiewe Dienste van toepassing is. Verantwoordelik vir IT- en inligtingsbestuursoplossings om in die spesifieke behoeftes van die Streek te voorsien. Verantwoordelik vir kommunikasie en bemarking vir die Streekkantoor. Verseker die ontwikkeling van PMDS van personeel. Monitor kwaliteitsbeheer van werk en ontwikkel jaarlikse prestasieplan. Monitor die beplanning, organisering en afbakening van werk. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal verlang word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidsopdrag te voltooi.

zu.title: Isiphathinduna: Izinsizakalo Zezinkampani
zu.summary: Isiphathinduna sezinsizakalo zezinkampani eKholejhi le-CET, sinikezela ngobuholi obuhle mayelana ne-HR, i-IT, okuthengiswa, izindawo kanye nobulungiswa beholo izinga 12.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-bachelor's degree ezifanele (NQF Level 7) kokuqashwa/kwethuthwa kwemisebenzi yabantu noma iziqu ezihlobene. Umkhulo ophakeme kwezintathu (3) kuye kwezinhlanu (5) iminyaka yomqondo ohlobene lapho kusebenza khona, lapho kulawulwa khona iminyaka emithathu (3) ekubhenyeni kokuqashwa kwabanzi kwindawo yezinsizakalo zezinkampani. Ukuqonda ngabhekisiso bokuqamba izinhloso nomgomo we-Department of Higher Education and Training. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Public Service Act, Employment of Educators Act, Labour Relations Act kanye ne-Public Financial Management Act. Ulwazi mayelana nomthetho omusha futhi ulawule izindinganiso zomthetho ezibhekene nemfundo kanye nokuqashwa, kanye ne-Public Service ne-Employment Service e-South Africa. Uhambe kahle ekubeni nabantu nasekubhekaneni imibhalo ngehlelo ukuze ukwazi ukuqamba izindinganiso zokuqhuba. Ukuthanda kwakho ukwazi ukuqamba, ukusekela kanye nokuqapha ukusetshenziswa komthetho, futhi ukwazi ukusebenza ndawonye, ukuphatha imibhalo nesekhompuyutha. Ukuthanda kwezikhathi ezingajwayelekile nokuhamba kakhulu. Ulwazi lwekhompuyutha (Ms Word, Ms PowerPoint, Ms Excel, Ms Excess kanye ne-Ms Outlook). Ilayisense yokushayela elifanele.
zu.duties: Nika ubuholi obuhle mayelana nezindawo ze-Human Resource, IT, Marketing, Facilities Management, Records Management, Labour Relations and Governance. Qapha zonke izidingo zansuku zonke ezenzakalayo ze-HR, Marketing and IT kuhlanganise nemisebenzi ekhamphasini. Nikezela ngemininingwane yezinsizakalo zomakhelwane ekuqasheni ukuzuzisa izidinganiso ezithile zekholeji. Phendula ngokuphumelelayo kokuhlinzekwa kwemininingwane emkhakheni ngamunye. Buchule futhi uqonde ukulungiswa kwekholeji nyanga zonke emahhala ngokuhambisana nezinhloso. Hlela futhi ukhokhe ukulungiswa kokubuyekezwa kohlelo lwekholeji nyanga zonke. Lungise imibiko yenyanga ngokuhambisana nohlelo lokusebenza lwamashumi, futhi qinisekisa ukuhlanganiselwa kwemibhalo yamashumi kanye nohlelo lwekholeji. Khuthaza futhi wakhe isimo esihle sokuhleleka okuthi sibe nokusebenza kahle ngokushintsha uhlelo. Qamba futhi usebenzise izinqumela ezinhle, izindlela, futhi ulawule imithetho yangaphakathi ukuze uvumele ukulawulwa kahle kwezinkampani. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunikezelwa okufanele okungabi namthengi. Qapha ukuphathwa okuhle nokuqondile kwezimpahla kanye nezindawo zekholeji. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunikezelwa okufanele okungalungi. Lawula abantu kanye nezindaba ezingokuphathwa kwezinsizakamo zekholeji. Nikeza ngokuqondisa okuphelele kanye nokuxhasa ukuthuthuka kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nezinkinga ezihlukene zomthetho, izinkomba, nemithetho ekhuluma ngemisebenzi yezinkampani. Phendula mayelana ne-IT kanye nokuphathwa kwemibhalo ekwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile ze-Region. Phendula mayelana nokuxhumana nokuthengisa ku-Regional Office. Qinisekisa ukuthuthuka kwe-PMDS yabasebenzi. Qapha ukulawulwa kwekhwalithi yomsebenzi futhi wakhe uhlelo lokusebenza lamashumi. Qapha ukuhleleka, ukuhlelwa, nokunikezwa komsebenzi. N.B. Bonke abantu abakhethiwe bazodinga ukugcwalisa imisebenzi yokulingana.

xh.title: Isekabaphathi: Iinkonzo zeNkampani
xh.summary: Isekabaphathi eeNkonzo zeNkampani eKholeji yeCET, inika inkokhelo ngokubonelela kwi-HR, i-IT, ukumaketha, iziseko ezihlala ngaso sonke isixeko nakulawulo kwinqanaba lomvuzo 12.
xh.requirements: Idegree elifanelekileyo le-bachelor’s (NQF Level 7) kwiHuman Resource Management/ Development okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nalo. Ubuncinane iyertha zethatu (3) ukuya kwezintlanu (5) zeminyaka yamava emsebenzini ofanelekileyo apho kuneyertha zethatu (3) zeminyaka yamava kwinqanaba lolawulo lwabancinane kwimeko yeenkonzo zenkampani. Ukuqonda kubonelelo kwiNjongo ephambili nezinto ezibalulekileyo zeSebe leHigher Education and Training. Ulwazi ngePublic Service Act, Employment of Educators Act, Labour Relations Act nakwiPublic Financial Management Act. Ulwazi ngeendido ezilawula imigaqo-nkqubo yemfundo nokuqeqesha nakwinkonzo kaWakethu nakuSebenziso lweenkonzo eSouth Africa. Amava ekulawuleni abantu neeprojekthi anamandla okucocwa ngokubonelela. Amandla okuphuhliswa, axhaswe nikugqatshwa kokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zemigaqo-nkqubo nendlela yokusebenza ngokubambisana, ukulawulwa kweprojekthi oluhle ngezakhono zekhompyutha. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza iiyure ezingaqondanga kakhulu nohambo olude. Ulwazi lokusebenza nggekhompyutha (Ms Word, Ms PowerPoint, Ms Excel, Ms Excess kunye neMs Outlook). Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkokhelo ngokubonelela kwizikhundla zeHuman Resource, IT, Marketing, Facilities Management, Records Management, Labour Relations nakulawulo. Qwalasela zonke iimfuno zemisebenzi yamhlanje ye-HR, Marketing nakwi-IT kubandakanywa nemisebenzi ekampusi. Zela iinkonzo zokunyanzelelana nobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha ukuze kugqitywe iimfuno ezithile zekholeji. Zinyanzele kokuzelelwa okusebenzayo kwezinkonzo kwelinye naliphi na le nacha. Yenza nikuyale ukulungiselelwa ngexesha elichanekileyo nokuchanekileyo kwesaphulelo sonyaka sekholeji ngokwemigqa enkulu ephambili. Lawula nikuyale ukulungiselelwa ukujongwa ngokutsha kweshishini lokubonelela leminyaka yekholeji. Lungiselela iingxelo zenyanga ezintathu njengakulinganiselo lokusebenza kwanyaka nokuqinisekisa ukuhlanganishwa kwengxelo yenyaka neshishini lokubonelela leminyaka yekholeji. Khuthaza nokuwakha isimo esenza ukuba abantu basebenze ngokugqithisileyo ngokuphumeza ulawulo lokutshintsha. Phuhlisa nokuzeza iindlela ezilungileyo zemigaqo-nkqubo, iindlela zokwenza, neenkqubo zolawulo lwangaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo olusebenzayo lwenkampani. Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngeenkonzo ezifanelekileyo nangexabiso eliphantsi. Qwalasela ulawulo oluchanekileyo nolusebenzayo lweempahla neendawo zekholeji. Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngeenkonzo ezifanelekileyo nangexabiso eliphantsi. Lawula izinto ezimalunga nabantu nokulawulwa kweenkonzo zenkampani ekholeji. Nika inkokhelo naxhaso ngokwaneleyo nakuphuhlisa abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iimfuno zonke ezolawulweni, imigaqo, izinto ezichwetheziweyo nangemigaqo ngeenkonzo zeNkampani. Nxibelela nge-IT nezisombululo zolawulwa lolwazi ukuze kugqitywe iimfuno ezithile zeNdawo. Nxibelele ngenkundla yaseburhulumente nakumaketha koMnyamazwe weNdawo. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kwe-PMDS yabasebenzi. Qwalasela ukulawulwa ngomgangatho wemisebenzi nokuphuhlisa isicwangciso sokusebenza ngokweminyaka. Qwalasela uqeqesho, ukuqamba, nokuthumela kolunye umsebenzi. Qaphela. Onke amagqabi abakhethiweyo kuya kufuneka aqale isikhundla sokuzivavanya ngesikhundla esifanelekileyo.

jobs.summary: Deputy Director for CET Curriculum and Institutional Support based in Johannesburg, requiring a Bachelor's degree in Education and five years' TVET or PSET sector experience at junior management level.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree/Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) in Education or a related qualification. A minimum of five (5) years of working experience in Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) or PSET Sector environment with at least three (3) to five (5) years ‘of relevant experience at the junior management level is required. Sound Knowledge of Curriculum Development and Institutional Support in line with the strategic objectives of the Department of Higher Education and Training. Understanding and knowledge of prescripts and legal frameworks applicable to the TVET sector. Advanced experience in the interpretation, development, and implementation of policies. Skills requirements are good and proven project management capabilities, problem-solving and financial management skills, proposal, and report writing and computer skills. Good project management and communication skills, including proposal and report writing and understanding of basic financial management systems. The ability to work with a team; the ability to develop, support and monitor the implementation of policies. The ability to work in collaboration with lecturers at TVET Colleges and with other government departments and relevant role-players, and good computer skills. willingness to travel and a valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be reporting to the Director: Curriculum and Institutional Support: will be responsible for implementing curriculum and institutional support in the Region; Ensuring the TVET curriculum development and support for the TVET Colleges; Providing TVET institutional Planning; Providing advice and guidance on formal non-and formal programmes; Monitor and evaluate the implementation of developed frameworks for TVET Colleges; Support monitor and verify college systems and sub-systems in relations to student admission and enrolment management, as well as data reporting; Ensure Supporting and monitoring the implementation of the National Improvement Plan for teaching and learning in TVET Colleges. Ensure monitoring and evaluation of appropriate data collection and management; Provide oversight functions on governance and management areas in TVET Colleges Conducting monitoring visits to pilot centres, give advice to the department on matters related to programmes; curriculum and assessment in TVET Colleges. Be a member of the National Coordinating Curriculum Committee. Provide support to the public CET College on matters relating to labour relations, change management, and implementation of IQMS and PMDS. Ensure compliance with Public Service Regulations and all administrative matters. Support the Director in managing the Directorate including assisting with planning, budgeting, and management of staff within the line function. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: CET Kurrikulum en Institusionele Ondersteuning
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir CET Kurrikulum en Institusionele Ondersteuning, gevestig in Johannesburg, wat 'n Bachelorsgraad in Onderwys en vyf jaar se TVET- of PSET-sektorerfaring op juniorbestuursvlak vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Bachelorsgraad/Gevorderde Diploma (NQF vlak 7) in Onderwys of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se werkservaring in 'n Tegniese en Beroepsonderwys en -opleiding (TVET)- of PSET-sektorklient met ten minste drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se tersaaklike ervaring op juniorbestuursvlak word vereis. Deeglike kennis van Kurrikulumontwikkeling en Institusionele Ondersteuning in ooreenstemming met die strategiese doelwitte van die Department of Higher Education and Training. Begrip en kennis van voorskrifte en regsraamwerke wat op die TVET-sektor van toepassing is. Gevorderde ervaring in die interpretasie, ontwikkeling en implementering van beleide. Vaardigheidsvereistes is goeie en bewese projekbestuursvermoëns, probleemoplossing- en finansiële bestuursvaardighede, voorstel- en verslaggeskryf en rekenaarvaardighede. Goeie projekbestuurs- en kommunikasievaardighede, insluitend voorstel- en verslaggeskryf en begrip van basiese finansiële bestuurstelsels. Die vermoë om in 'n span te werk; die vermoë om die implementering van beleide te ontwikkel, ondersteun en monitor. Die vermoë om in samewerking met dosente by TVET-kolleges en met ander regeringsdepartemente en tersaaklike rolspelers te werk, asook goeie rekenaarvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal aan die Direkteur: Kurrikulum en Institusionele Ondersteunings verslag doen; sal verantwoordelik wees vir die implementering van kurrikulum en institusionele ondersteuning in die Streek; Om TVET-kurrikulumontwikkeling en ondersteuning vir die TVET-kolleges te verseker; Om TVET-institusionele beplanning te verskaf; Om advies en leiding te gee oor formele nie-formele en formele programme; Om die implementering van ontwikkelde raamwerke vir TVET-kolleges te monitor en te evalueer; Om kollegestelsels en substelsels met betrekking tot studenttoelating en inskrywingsbestuur, asook datarapportering te ondersteun, monitor en verifieer; Om die ondersteuning en monitering van die implementering van die Nasionale Verbeteringsplan vir onderrig en leer in TVET-kolleges te verseker. Om monitering en evaluering van toepaslike dataversameling en -bestuur te verseker; Om toesigfunksies oor bestuurs- en beheergebiede in TVET-kolleges te verskaf; Om moniteringsbesoeke aan loodsentrums uit te voer en die departement advies te gee oor aangeleenthede wat verband hou met programme; kurrikulum en assessering in TVET-kolleges. Om 'n lid van die Nasionale Koördinerende Kurrikulumkomitee te wees. Om ondersteuning aan die openbare CET-kollege te verskaf oor aangeleenthede wat verband hou met arbeidsverhoudinge, veranderingsbestuur en die implementering van IQMS en PMDS. Om voldoening aan die Public Service Regulations en alle administratiewe aangeleenthede te verseker. Om die Direkteur te ondersteun in die bestuur van die Direktoraat, insluitend hulp met beplanning, begroting en bestuur van personeel binne die lynefunksie. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal 'n tersaaklike bevoegdheidoefening moet voltooi.

zu.title: Menzi Ohambisayo: Isifundo sika-CET kanye Nokwesekwa Kwesikhungo
zu.summary: Menzi ohambisayo we-CET Curriculum and Institutional Support ozosebenza eJohannesburg, ofuna iziqu ze-Bachelor's degree e-Education neminyaka emihlanu yamava asebenze emkhakheni we-TVET noma PSET ezingeni lokuqashwa komphathi wamalandela.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor's Degree/Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) efanelekileyo ku-Education noma iziqu ezihlobene nayo. Kudingeka abe nobuchule bokusebenza iminyaka engu-five (5) nakuggiya kokusebenza emkhakheni we-Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) noma PSET Sector, okungenani uneminyaka ethathu (3) kuya kwengihlanu (5) yamava afanelekile ezingeni lokuphatha abantu abangangeni phansi kwesikhundla sabo. Kudingeka abe nolwazi olululo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwe-Curriculum kanye Nokwesekwa Kwesikhungo ngokuvumelana nezinhloso eziyinhlokoshe zomnyango i-Department of Higher Education and Training. Kudingeka aqonde futhi alwazi ngemithetho namagunya asebenza emkhakheni we-TVET. Kudingeka abe namava aphezulu ekutolikeni, ekuthuthukiseni, nasekuqasweni kwezinqubomgomo. Izidingo zamakhono ukuba namakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi kahle futhi abe namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuphatha izimali, ukubhala izinkulumo ezinikezwa kanye nezindikimaba, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kudingeka abe namakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi nokuxhumana kahle, okuhlanganisa nokubhala izinkulumo ezinikezwa kanye nezindikimaba kanye nokuziqondisa ngokuphatha izinhlelo zezimali. Ikhono lokusebenza nomqondo ohambisana nabanye; ikhono lokuthuthukisa, ukusekela kanye nokuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokubambisana nabadlali bezinkundla ema-TVET Colleges kanye namanye amaphoyintu ahlobene, futhi alwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kahle. Kudingeka abe nesifiso sokuhamba futhi abe nenkeliso yokuqasha evumelekile.
zu.duties: Umqashi ohambisayo uzobika ku-Director: Curriculum and Institutional Support; uzobekwe ngesibopho sokuqaswa kwesifundo nokwesekwa kwesikhungo endaweni; Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-TVET curriculum kanye nokusekela am-TVET Colleges; Ukunikeza i-TVET institutional Planning; Ukunikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa ngohlelo olungokomthetho nolungokomthetho; Ukuqapha futhi ahlole ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezenziwe noma zitholakalela ama-TVET Colleges; Ukusekela ukuqapha futhi aqinisekise izinhlelo zamakolishi nangaphansi kwazo mayelana nokwamukelwa kwezifundo zabafofokazi kanye nokuphatha ukubhaliswa kwabo, kanye nokuqopha idatha; Ukuqinisekisa ukwesekwa kanye nokuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwe-National Improvement Plan yokufundisa nokufunda ema-TVET Colleges. Ukuqinisekisa ukuqapha futhi kuhlole idatha efanelekileko eyiqoqo nasekuphathweni kwayo; Ukunikeza imisebenzi yokugada ngokuphathwa kanye nokwelashwa kwemikhakha ema-TVET Colleges; Ukuhamba ahambele izikhungo zezilingo, futhi anikeze umnyango izeluleko ezihlobene nezinhlelo; isifundo kanye nokulingiswa ema-TVET Colleges. Ukuze abe yilungu le-National Coordinating Curriculum Committee. Ukunikeza ukwesekwa ku-CET College kolawulo mayelana nezinkinga zomsebenzi, ukuphatha izinguquko, nokuqaswa kwe-IQMS kanye ne-PMDS. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambiswa nemicimbi ye-Public Service Regulations kanye nazo zonke ezinye izindaba zokuphatha. Ukusekela u-Director ekuphatheni i-Directorate okuhlanganisa nokusiza ekulungeniseni, ekwabelweni imali, nasekuphathweni abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesigaba somsebenzi. N.B. Bonke abaqashwa abakhaladiwe bazodingeka ukuba bafeze isibhalo esihlobene namakhono abo.

xh.title: Isekondi weNqanaba eliPhakamileyo: Isixhobo soMsebenzi weCET nokuNxuselwa kweZiko
xh.summary: Isekondi weNqanaba eliPhakamileyo woMsebenzi weCET nokuNxuselwa kweZiko ogqithisele kwiJohannesburg, efunayo izidanga zeBachelor kwiMfundo kunye namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yamava kwindawo ye-TVET okanye i-PSET kwinqanaba lolawulo lwamakhulu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelor esifanelekileyo/Isidanga seQonga esiNgumandla (inqanaba le-NQF 7) kwiMfundo okanye isidanga esinxulumene nalo. Kufuneka kube khona ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava omsebenzi kwindawo ye-Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) okanye kwindawo ye-PSET Sector, inomsebenzi ochanekileyo ongaphaya kweminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kwemihlanu (5) kwinqanaba lolawulo lwamakhulu. Kuqondwa kakuhle nokuqonda Ukuphuhliswa kweNkqubo yokufundisa nokuNxuselwa kweZiko ngokwemigqalisela enika inkundla kwisebe le-Department of Higher Education and Training. Ukuqonda ukumiselo kolwazi ngeemithetho ezilawula indawo ye-TVET. Amava amakhulu ekutolikeni, ekuyileni nasekusebenziseni iinkqubo zemigqalisela. Iimfuno zobugcisa obu balulekileyo bubungakanani bemisebenzi obungabonwayo nje ngokusebenzayo, amandla okusombulula iingxaki nolonikezelo lweemali, ukubhala iinkelziso nokuvela kwiingxelo nakhona ukwaziswa komsebenzi wekhompyutha. Ubungakanani bemisebenzi obungalulo nakhona amandla okunxibelelana nabantu, kuquka ukubhala iinkelziso nakuvela kwiingxelo, nokuvakalelwa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokulawula iimali. Amandla okusebenza nomntu wonke; amandla okuyila, ukuxhasa nokujonga ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zemigqalisela. Amandla okusebenza ngokubambisana nabaphengululi kwi-TVET Colleges nakwamanye amasebe karhulumente nabanomdla kumanyano, nakho konke ukwaziswa komsebenzi wekhompyutha. Ukugqitha ukuhamba naye ilayisenisi yokushayela evakalayo.
xh.duties: Umqeshwa onempumelelo uya kuxela kuMlawuli: Isixhobo soMsebenzi nokunxuselwa kweZiko: uya kuba nawo umba wokusebenzisa inkqubo yokufundisa nokunxuselwa kweZiko kwKondzo; Kuqinisekiswa ukuphuhliswa kwenkqubo yokufundisa ye-TVET nokuxhaswa kwe-TVET Colleges; Kufunyaniswa isiCwangciso se-TVET seZiko; Kufunyaniswa ingcebiso nokuqondiswa kwiiNkqubo ezingagqibekanga noko zidanga ngokugqibeleleyo; Kujongwa kwaye kuqwalaselwa ukusetyenziswa kwezicwangciso ezinikezelwe i-TVET Colleges; Kuxhaswa ukujonga nokugqiba iinkqubo ze-TVET Colleges kwindawo yokwamkela iindidi zabafundi kulawulo lokubhalisa, nanjengokubonelela ngolwazi ngokubonakalayo; Kuqinisekiswa ukuxhaswa nokuqwalaselwa koku setyenziswa kwesicwangciso se-Department of Higher Education and Training sokuphucula ulwazi nokufundisa kwi-TVET Colleges. Kuqinisekiswa ukujonga nokuqwalaselwa kolwazi olufunekayo nanjengolawulo; Kubonelelwa ngesikhundla sokulawula nokuqwalaselwa kwindawo yolawulo kwakunye nolawulo kwi-TVET Colleges. Kukho ukujongwa kolwandlalo kwindawo ezikwizinga elingakalingiswa, kunikezelwa ingcebiso kwisebe ngemiba enxulumene neenkqubo; inkqubo yokufundisa nokulinganisa kwi-TVET Colleges. Ukuba lilungu leKomiti yeSizwe eLawulayo yeNkqubo yokufundisa. Kubonelelwa ingxowa kwi-College kaMphakathi kaCET ngemiba enxulumene nokuLawulwa kweMisebenzi, ukuTshintsha uLawulo, nokuSetyenziswa kwi-IQMS naku-PMDS. Kuqinisekiswa ukuzinikela ngokweziMiso zoBuntu kunye namakha amakhulu okulawula karhulumente. Kuxhaswa uMlawuli ekulawuleni uLawulo lokuQwalaselwa kuquka ukuncedisa ekuyileni, ekwabeleni nangokulawula abasebenzi ngokwendlela esetyenziswayo. N.B. Onke amaqhalo aqeqeshwayo aya kufuna ukuba aqedele isihloko esinxulumene nobunyani bokuziphatha.

zu.requirements: I-Bachelor’s Degree/Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) elifaneleko eMfundweni noma iziqu ezihlobene nayo. Kudingeka abe nokuhlolakuye okunguqotho abangaphezulu kweminyaka emithathu (3) kwayikhomunina (5) wokusebenza kwindawo yayo Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) noma kwindawo yoMkhakha we-PSET, anominyaka emithathu (3) kwayikhomunina (5) woluhlolakuye oluhambisana ezingeni lokuphatha okuncane. Ukwaziswa okuhle kokuthuthukiswa kwekharijhulamu nokwesekwa kwezikhungo ngokulandela izinjongo ezibalulekileko zoMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqeshwa. Ukuqonda nokwaziswa ngemithetho nezakhiwo zomthetho ezisetshenziswa emkhakheni we-TVET. Okuhlolakuye okuphakeme ekutolweni, ekuthuthukiseni nasekuqedeni izindlela. Izidingo zamakhono ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi okuhle nokuqinisekisiweko, ukuxazulula izinkinga nakhono okuphathwa kwezimali, ukubhala izinkampani nemibiko kanye nakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okuphathwa kwephrojekthi kanye nokuqhubana ngamandla okuthintana nabantu, okuhlanganisa ukubhala izinkampani nemibiko, kanye nokuqonda izimiso eziyisisekelo zokuphathwa kwezimali. Isandla sokusebenza nabantu; isandla sokuthuthukisa, ukweseka nokulawula ukuqedwa kwezindlela. Isandla sokusebenza ngokubambisana nabadayimani kwii-TVET Colleges nakumanye oomnyango kahulumunde nabathintekako, kanye nakhono okuhle okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Isandla sokuhamba nelayisense lokushayela elisebenzayo. IMISEBENZI: Umuntu ophumeleleko uzokubika kuMphathi: Ikharijhulamu Nokwesekwa Kwezikhungo: uzokunikelwa isandla somsebenzi wokuqedwa kwekharijhulamu nokwesekwa kwezikhungo eNdaweni; Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-TVET ikharijhulamu nokwesekwa kwii-TVET Colleges; Ukunikeza i-TVET iplani yezikhungo; Ukunikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa izinhlelo ezingakavunyelwa nokuvunyelwa; Ukulawula nokuhlola ukuqedwa kwezakhiwo ezithuthukisiweko kwii-TVET Colleges; Ukweseka ukulawula nokugqabaza izimiso nezimiso ezincane zekolishi ngokuhlobene nokwamukelwa kwabafundi nokuphathwa kokubhaliswa, kanye nokubika imininingwane; Ukuqinisekisa ukwesekwa nokulawula ukuqedwa kweNational Improvement Plan yokufundisa nokufunda kwii-TVET Colleges. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawula nokuhlola ukuqoqa nokuphathwa kwemininingwane elifaneleko; Ukunikeza isandla sokulawula ekuphathweni nokubusamngqongongqongweni kwamaphoyinti we-TVET Colleges Ukwenza ukuvakatshela kolawula kumakhaya okuhlola, ukunikeza izeluleko koomnyango ngendaba ezihlobene nezinhlelo; Ikharijhulamu nokuhothwa kwabafundi kwii-TVET Colleges. Ukuba lilungu leKomidi elihlanganisa iKarijhulamu yoMbuso. Ukunikeza ukwesekwa kwi-public CET College ngamaphoyinti ahlobene nezingqungqubana zomsebenzi, ukuphathwa koshintsho, nokuqedwa kwe-IQMS kanye ne-PMDS. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana noMthetho wokuQeqeshwa koMphakathi nendlela zonke ezihlobene nokuphathwa. Ukusekela uMphathi ekuphathweni koMnyango okuhlanganosa ukusiza ngokuqamba, imali yokusebenza, nokuphathwa kwabantu emkhakheni womsebenzi. A.B. Bonke abagqwayizi abalengiweko bazodingeka ukuba bagcwalise isenzo semisebenzi elifaneleko.

xh.title: Maleko Oyintloko: TVET Icolum kunye Neeziko
xh.summary: Maleko oyintloko woXhaso lwe-TVET Icolum kunye neeZiko kwisebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo kunye neNqaliso, lifuna isidanga seBachelor kunye namava obuhlalanuzo kwicandelo le-TVET.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelor esifanelekileyo/Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) kwiMfundo okanye ngesi sidanga esinxulumene nalo. Kufuneka kubekho imimiselo emithathu (3) ukuya kwemihlanu (5) yamava emsebenzini kwimeko yeTechnical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) okanye kummandla wePSET Sector onamava abalulekileyo amathathu (3) ukuya kwamahlanu (5) emva kwexesha elithile kumgangatho wolawulo lomzantsi. Ukuqonda kakuhle ngokuPhuhliswa kweCurriculum noXhaso lweeZiko ngokuvumelana neengoqo ezibalulekileyo zesebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo kunye neNqaliso. Ukuqonda nokwazi ngemigaqo nemiGalelo yomthetho eseSetyenziswa kwicandelo le-TVET. Amava anzulu ekutolikiweni, ekwakhiweni, nakusetyenzisweni kweenkqubo. Iimfuno zamakhono zibalulwa kakhulu kukuba nomiselo olingayo kwaye obonakaliswe ngokulawula iiprojekthi, amandla okuxazulula iingxaki kunye namakhono obuncwadi bemali, ukubhala iintetho-nqakumbhala iingxelo namakhono ekhompyutha. Imiselo elungileyo ekulawulweni iiprojekthi nakunxibelelwano, kuquka ukubhala iintetho-nqaku iingxelo, nokutolikayo nakwinkqubo yeenkcukacha-mali ezisezingeni elingundoqo. Amandla okusebenza nomthambo; amandla apha, axhase alawule usetyenziso lweenkqubo; Amandla okusebenzisana nogqithisa nakwizikola e-TVET nakwezinye iisebe karhulumente kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba, amakhono amabalulekileyo ngokubakho nokumama ukhompyutheni. Ukulungele ukuhamba kunye nelaysensi yokushayela. IMISEBENZI: Umntu ophumeleleyo uya kuxela kuTata: Curriculum and Institutional Support; uya kuba nokuxhomekeka ekusebenziseni nkqubo yecurriculum uxhaso lweziko kulondolozo lwe-TVET; Qinisekisa ukuba kukho inkqubo yokuphuhliswa kweCurriculum nakuxhaso kule zikola e-TVET; Ziba imiba ekuphuhliseni kwecurriculum kwizikola e-TVET; Unika ingcebiso nokuqondisa okukhululekileyo ngokunxulumene nezikola ezingekho mthethweni nangokusemthethweni kwezi nkqubo; Qwalasela ukuvavanywa nokulinganiselwa ngokusetyenziswa kwemigangatho kwizikola e-TVET; Axhasa, aqwalasele aqinisekise ezobuqu nakwishishini esikolasamu kwelinye iqela ngokunxulumene nokuGqithwa kwezifundo nezingqinisiso, kwanokuphathwa kolwazi; Qinisekisa ukuba ngaphezulu ngokuxhasa, eqwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo ezingagqibekanga kwaye ziqwalaselwa uluntu kuGcwaliswa lweeTVET Colleges. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kweenkcukacha-mali kubandakanya ukuba ngaphezulu kwezicwangciso, ukumisela imali, kwaye alawule abasebenzi; Onke amadoda aqwalaselwa kuya kudinga ukuqinisekiswa ngokukhula kwamandla obukhosi.

jobs.title: Deputy Principal: Academic Services
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: These posts are based on Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Colleges West Coast TVET College Ref No: DHET 11/09/2026 South Cape TVET College Ref No: DHET 12/09/2026
jobs.city: These posts are based on Technical and Vocational Education
jobs.summary: Deputy Principal for Academic Services at West Coast and South Cape TVET Colleges, requiring a bachelor's degree and management experience in education.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate bachelor’s degree/advanced diploma (NQF Level 7) in Education and Training. A relevant post-graduate qualification in Education and Training will serve as an added advantage. A minimum of five three (3) to (5) years relevant experience with at least three (3) to five (5) years of relevant experience at the junior management level in an education and training environment. Experience in working at CET/ TVET College in the teaching and learning disciplines will also be treated as an added advantage. A sound and thorough knowledge of all the transformational issues, capacity-building processes, and the National Qualification Framework (NQF) in education and training, especially concerning curriculum management and delivery. Strategic management, conflict management, budgeting, and financial management skills. Verbal and written communication and presentation skills. Computer skills (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Access, and MS Outlook). An understanding of DHET’s strategy Vision and priorities. Thorough knowledge of all policies and legislative Frameworks governing TVET/CET Colleges in South Africa. Thorough knowledge of the student/information management system concerning education and training. A willingness to work irregular hours and travel extensively. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership regarding the proficient delivery of Curriculum Services and programme and qualification offerings. Guide, inform, and develop the Programs and Qualifications Mix (PQM) of the college for executive approval. Ensure that modalities of curriculum delivery, accommodate the students with support and provide advice on the work of the Academic Board. Develop a system of partnership engagement with strategic stakeholders to enhance student learning and employability. Facilitate and manage the policy framework for the institution as per relevant portfolios. Manage student career guidance and placement on entry. Develop a system of Work Integrated Learning (WILL) for students and lecturers. Monitor student performance and develop Academic support interventions. Ensure that the 12 targets for student success as set by DHET and /or college academic Boards are met. Report on all initiatives undertaken by the college to improve student retention, attendance, performance, and certification. Formulate strategies and policies related to performance and ensure its implementation and target achievement as per the TEVT/CET Monitoring and Evaluation Policy. Ensure that all the requirements for quality teaching and learning are in place, namely: Policies to implement teaching and learning, student learning resources, lecturer teaching resources, timetables for students and lecturers, learning training and professional development of the staff; and student continuous assessments. Ensure the provision of appropriate and cost-effective services. Verify the validity and reliability of registration documentation and all EMIS data and reports. Coordinate the preparation of examinations for all programmes involving assessment. Ensure current examination regulations and conventions are adhered to. Building a strong network of contacts with other institutions and industries. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements.

af.title: Adjunk-prinsipaal: Akademiese Dienste
af.summary: Adjunk-prinsipaal vir Akademiese Dienste by West Coast en South Cape TVET Colleges, wat 'n baccalaureusgraad en bestuurservaring in onderwys vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike baccalaureusgraad/gevorderde diploma (NQF Level 7) in Onderwys en Opleiding. 'n Relevante nagraadse kwalifikasie in Onderwys en Opleiding sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Minimum van vyf drie (3) tot (5) jare relevante ervaring met ten minste drie (3) tot vyf (5) jare relevante ervaring op juniorbestuursvlak in 'n onderwys- en opleidingsomgewing. Ervaring in werk by 'n CET/ TVET College in die onderrig- en leerdissiplines sal ook as 'n bykomende voordeel beskou word. 'n Deeglike en grondige kennis van al die transformasiekwessies, kapasiteitsopbouprosesse, en die National Qualification Framework (NQF) in onderwys en opleiding, veral ten opsigte van kurrikulumbestuur en -lewering. Strategiese bestuurs-, konflikbestuurs-, begrotings- en finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie- en voorleggingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Access en MS Outlook). 'n Begrip van DHET se strategiese Visie en prioriteite. Deeglike kennis van alle beleide en wetgewende raamwerke wat TVET/CET Colleges in South Africa regeer. Deeglike kennis van die student/inligtingsbestuurstelsel ten opsigte van onderwys en opleiding. 'n Bereidwilligheid om onreëlmatige ure te werk en wyd te reis. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap ten opsigte van die doeltreffende lewering van Kurrikulumdienste en program- en kwalifikasie-aanbiedings. Lei, inlig en ontwikkel die Programs and Qualifications Mix (PQM) van die college vir uitvoerende goedkeuring. Verseker dat modus van kurrikulumlewering studente met ondersteuning akkommodeer en advies verskaf oor die werk van die Academic Board. Ontwikkel 'n stelsel van vennootskapsbetrokkenheid met strategiese belanghebbendes om studente leer en werksaamheid te verbeter. Fasiliteer en bestuur die beleidsraamwerk vir die instelling volgens relevante portefeuljes. Bestuur studente se loopbaanoliding en plasing by inskrywing. Ontwikkel 'n stelsel van Work Integrated Learning (WILL) vir studente en dosente. Monitor studente se prestasie en ontwikkel akademiese ondersteuningsintervensies. Verseker dat die 12 teikens vir studente sukses soos deur DHET en/of college academic Boards gestel, bereik word. Rapporteer oor alle inisiatiewe wat deur die college onderneem word om studente retensie, bywoning, prestasie en sertifisering te verbeter. Formuleer strategieë en beleide wat verband hou met prestasie en verseker die implementering en teikenbereiking daarvan volgens die TEVT/CET Monitoring and Evaluation Policy. Verseker dat al die vereistes vir kwaliteitsonderrig en -leer in plek is, naamlik: Beleide om onderrig en leer te implementeer, studenteleerbronne, dosentonderrigbronne, roosters vir studente en dosente, leer, opleiding en professionele ontwikkeling van die personeel; en deurlopende assesserings van studente. Verseker die voorsiening van toepaslike en koste-effektiewe dienste. Verifieer die geldigheid en betroubaarheid van registrasiedokumentasie en alle EMIS-data en verslae. Koördineer die voorbereiding van eksamens vir alle programme wat assessering behels. Verseker dat huidige eksamenregulasies en konvensies nagekom word. Bou 'n sterk netwerk van kontakte met ander instellings en bedrywe. N.B. Alle kortlys-kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Isiphathikhulu Esihlangothi: Amasevisi Ezemfundo
zu.summary: Isiphathikhulu Esihlangothi samasevisi ezemfundo e West Coast and South Cape TVET Colleges, sidinga iziqu ze-bachelor's degree namava obuqotho embusweni wemfundo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-bachelor's degree/advanced diploma (NQF Level 7) ezimfundeni nokuqeqesha. Isiqu esihlobene se-post-graduate esimfundeni nokuqeqesha sibe yinzuzo eyongeziwe. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 kuye ku-5 yamava ahlobene kanye neminyaka engu-3 kuye ku-5 yamava ahlobene ezingeni lombuso ophakeme kumjaho wemfundo nokuqeqesha. Amava okusebenza e CET/ TVET College emikhakheni yokufundisa nokufunda nawo ube yinzuzo eyongeziwe. Ulwazi olujulile noluphelele ngazo zonke izindaba zoshintsho, inqubo yokwakha amandla, kanye ne-National Qualification Framework (NQF) emfundeni nokuqeqesha, ikakhulukazi ngokuphathwa kohlelo lokufunda nokuhanjiswa kwalo. Amakhono obuphathi bokuhlela isu ngokusobala, ukuphatha izinkinga, ukwenza izibalo ezimalini, kanye nokuphatha izimali. Amakhono okuxoxa ngomlomo nokubhala kanye nokwethula. Amakhono ekhompyutha (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Access, kanye ne-MS Outlook). Ukuqonda isu, kubono, kanye nezinto ezibalulekile ze-DHET. Ulwazi oluphelele ngazo zonke izinqubomgomo nezakhiwo zomthetho ezibusa ama TVET/CET Colleges e South Africa. Ulwazi oluphelele ngosizo lokulawula abafundi/ulwazi mayelana nemfundo nokuqeqesha. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza amahora angajwayelekile kanye nokuhamba kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Nika ubuholi ngokusobala ngokwezinhlobo zokulawula ukuhanjiswa kwezinhlelo zemfundo kanye namakilasi ahlobene neziqu. Hola, wazise, futhi uthuthukise i Programs and Qualifications Mix (PQM) yasekolishi ukuba ivunywe ngabaphathi. Qiniseka ukuthi izindlela zokuhanjiswa kwezinhlelo zemfundo, zikhombisa ukwesekwa kwabafundi futhi zinikeze izeluleko emsebenzini we-Academic Board. Phuma usungule isimiso sokuzibandakanya nabaphathi abahlobene ukwenza ukuthi abafundi bafunde futhi bathole imisebenzi. Qedela futhi uphathe izinqubomgomo zesikhungo ngokwezindima ezihlobene. Phatha izeluleko ngomsebenzi kanye nokubekwa kwabafundi lapho bengena. Sungula isimiso se-Work Integrated Learning (WILL) sabafudi nabalabeli. Hlola ukusebenza kwabafundi uthuthukise izindlela zokwesekwa ngokwezemfundo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhintza olungu-12 lokupehla kwabafundi njengoba behlonywe ngi DHET kanye/noma ngama-Academic Boards ekolishi afezwa. Bika ngazo zonke izinhlela ezathathwa ngukolishi ukuthuthukisa ukugcinwa kwabafundi, ukubakhona, ukusebenza, kanye namaphepha eziqu. Hlela izinhlelo nezinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokusebenza futhi qinisekisa ukuphumeleliswa kwayo kanye nokuqhwabele phambili ngokwe-TEVT/CET Monitoring and Evaluation Policy. Qiniseka ukuthi zonke izidingo zokufundisa nokufunda ngokwekhwalithi zikhona, okuyilawa: Izinqubomgomo zokuphatha ukufundisa nokufunda, izibonelelo zabafundi zokufunda, izibonelelo zabafundi zokufundisa, izikhathi zabafudi nabalabeli, ukufundwa kanye nokuqeqeshwa ngobungcweti babasebenzi; kanye nokuqhuba nokuhlola abafundi ngokuqhubekayo. Qinisekela ukwethulwa kwezinsiza ezifanele futhi ezingabiza kakhulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi iziqu zokubhalisa kanye yonke imininingwane kanye namarekhodi we-EMIS asemthethweni futhi athembekile. Hlela ukulungiselela izivivinyo kuzo zonke izinhlela ezibandakanya ukuhlolwa. Qiniseka ukuthi kuhlonishwa imithetho nezinqubomgomo zamanje zezivivinyo. Akha uhlelo oluzinzile olwemisebenzi namanye amakolishi kanye nemboni. Qaphela. Bonke abafaki isicelo abayisikhombisa bazocelwa ukuba bagcwalise isivivinyo esihlobene sobuholi.

xh.title: Isekela lePrinsipala: Iinkonzo zeZifundo
xh.summary: Isekela lePrinsipala leZinkonzo zeZifundo kwiWest Coast and South Cape TVET Colleges, elifuna isidanga se-bachelor namava obulungiselelo emfundo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-bachelor esifanelekileyo/diploma ephambili (NQF Level 7) kwiEducation and Training. Isifundo se-post-graduate esifanelekileyo kwiEducation and Training siza kubakho ngcono. Okungenani i-five three (3) to (5) years yamava afanelekileyo anokungenayo amava afanelekileyo okungenayo amava atatu (3) okuya kwantlanu (5) emzinganweni obuncinane obulungiselelayo kwindawo yemfundo nokuhlala. Amava okusebenza kwiCET/ TVET College kumacandelo okufundisa nokufunda nayo ayakubakho ngcono. Ulwazi olululo nolucacileyo ngazo zonke iingxaki zoguqulo, iinkqubo zokwakhiswa amandla, kunye neNational Qualification Framework (NQF) kwimfundo nokuzilolonga, ngakumbi malunga nokulawula nokuhanjiswa kwezifundo. Amakhono obulungiselelo obuziva, ulawulo lweengxaki zamalinge, uluntu loxasazo, kunye nolawulo lwemali. Amakhono okuthetha nokuporta, okubhala, kunye nokupezentatha. Amakhonye ekhompyutha (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Access, neMS Outlook). Ukuqonda i-strategy Vision neziphithiphithi zeDHET. Ulwazi oluqotho nzalo ngazo zonke iingcaphepho kunye namagqabantethi oLilizo alawula iindawo zeTVET/CET Colleges eSouth Africa. Ulwazi oluqotho nzalo ngenkqubo yolawulo lwabafundi/ulwazi ngokumalunga nemfundo nokuzilolonga. Ilungelelaniso lokusebenza iiyure ezingaqhelekanga nokuhamba kakhulu. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkokheli yamagqabantethi ngokuphathwa ngokuchanekileyo kwezinkonzo zeCurriculum nezindlela zokuvelisa amagqabantethi. Qalisa, yazi, ze uphuhlise iPrograms and Qualifications Mix (PQM) yekholeji ukuvunywa nguqonda phambili. Qinisekisa ukuba iindlela zokuphathwa kwezifundo, zikhusele abafundi ngokuxhasa zenike izimvo malunga nomsebenzi webhodi yezifundo. Phuhlisa inkqubo yokuzibandakanya nabalingane ababuzo amagqabantethi ukuphucula ukufunda kwabafundi nokuqeqeshwa kwawo. Khokelela ulawulo lwamagqabantethi amanngunngundi weziko njengoko kulingana namaphondo. Lawula imilolo nomkhakha wokumisela iindawo zokungena kumfundi. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zokufunda (WILL) kubafudi nalutshwal LMkhakha wokom bona isiph se somsalumngqangi kubafudi ngokungena kubakho ukuvimba alawulam khulule abafudi ngokusebenz ubuchwephes Mhla wokuvala ixesha lomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba amaphupha okuba nabalawuli esibini abafakiswe sisiPikisweni ukuze kubunjwe amathuba okubakho ukubakha ngokupela kwindawo yokuba ngokuqinisekiswa ngakumbi wemise. Tyhala ingxelo kwindawo ingcamango ngokuphucula ukuphila kwabafudi kwindawo ingcamango nethuba lokukhula kwesigqoki sobunxwamazela kwindawo ikhaya leyxa khupha iintlongo ezifudumala kwindawo kwindawo iqela elingenise ukubhalisa kwabafundi abafakiweyo abajonge ukusukela kwenzalo ngokusetyenziswa kwe-WILL. Liliza ngokulungiselelwa kokuvavanywa kwezikolo ezintson zihlobo namathuba okubhaliswa. Qinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo imigaqo nendlela yokusetyenziswa kwamavavanyo. Ngokwakha ithungelwano eliqinileyo lobudlelwane namanye amaziko namashishini. Qaphela: bonke abo bakhetiweyo baya kufuneka bagqibe isicatshulwa sokuzilolonga esifanelekileyo.

jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: These posts are based on Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Colleges Boland TVET College Ref No: DHET 13/09/2026 Gert Sibande TVET College Ref No: DHET 14/09/2026 East Cape Midlands TVET College Ref No: DHET 15/09/2026
jobs.city: These posts are based on Technical and Vocational Education
jobs.summary: Deputy Principal for Corporate Services at TVET colleges, providing strategic leadership in HR, IT, marketing, facilities and governance at SMS Level 12.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate bachelor’s degree (NQF Level 7) in Human Resource Management/ Development or related qualification. A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years’ relevant work experience of which three (3) years’ experience at a junior management level in corporate services environment. An understanding of the Department of Higher Education and Training’s strategic vision and priorities. Knowledge of Public Service Act, Employment of Educators Act, Labour Relations Act and Public Financial Management Act. Knowledge of policies and legislative frameworks governing education and training as well as the Public Service and Employment Service in South Africa. Experience in managing people and projects with the ability to plan strategically. An ability to develop, support and monitor the implementation of policies and the ability to work in a team environment, good project management and computer skills. Willingness to work irregular hours and travel extensively. Computer literacy (Ms Word, Ms PowerPoint, Ms Excel, Ms Excess and Ms Outlook). A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership in the areas of Human Resource, IT, Marketing, Facilities Management, Records Management, Labour Relations and Governance. Oversee the entire day to day operational requirement of the HR, Marketing and IT functions including those activities in the campus. Render communication and information technology services to meet the specific needs of the college. Accountable for the effective delivery of service in each of these areas. Facilitate and drive the timely and accurate preparation of the college’s annual budget in line with Strategic priorities. Coordinate and driver the preparation for the annual review of the college’s strategic plan. Prepare quarterly reports as per annual performance plan and ensure the compilation f the annual report and strategic plan of the college. Encourage and builds an organisational climate conductive to optimal performance through implementing change management. Develop and implement best practice policies, procedure, and internal control systems to ensure effective corporate governance. Ensure the provision of appropriate and cost-effective service. Oversee the proper and effective management of the college’s assets and facilities. Ensure the provision of appropriate and cost-effective services. Manage human resources and corporate management service affairs in the college. Provide guidance and adequate support and development of the staff. Ensure compliance with all administrative requirements, regulations, rules and regulations pertaining to Corporate Services. Responsible for IT and information management solutions to meet the specific needs of the Region. Responsible for communication and marketing for the Regional Office. Ensure development of PMDS of staff. Monitor quality control of work and develop annual performance plan. Monitor the planning, organisation and delegation of work. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
