af.title: Adjunkhoof: Korporatiewe Dienste
af.summary: Adjunkhoof vir Korporatiewe Dienste by TVET-colleges wat strategiese leierskap bied in HR, IT, bemarking, fasiliteite en bestuur op Vlak 12.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike baccalaureusgraad (NQF Vlak 7) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/-ontwikkeling of verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se relevante werkservaring waarvan drie (3) jaar se ervaring op 'n juniorbestuurvlak in 'n korporatiewe dienste-omgewing. 'n Begrip van die departement van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding se strategiese visie en prioriteite. Kennis van die Public Service Act, Employment of Educators Act, Labour Relations Act en Public Financial Management Act. Kennis van beleide en wetgewende raamwerke wat onderwys en opleiding sowel as die Publieke Diens en Indiensnemingsdiens in South Africa regeer. Ervaring in die bestuur van mense en projekte met die vermoë om strategies te beplan. 'n Vermoë om beleide te ontwikkel, te ondersteun en die implementering daarvan te monitor, en die vermoë om in 'n spanomgewing te werk, goeie projektbestuur en rekenaarvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om onreëlmatige ure te werk en wyd te reis. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Ms Word, Ms PowerPoint, Ms Excel, Ms Excess en Ms Outlook). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die areas van Menslike Hulpbronne, IT, Bemarking, Fasiliteitebestuur, Rekordbestuur, Arbeidsverhoudinge en Bestuur. Hou toesig oor die totale daaglikse operasionele vereistes van die HR-, Bemarkings- en IT-funksies insluitend daardie aktiwiteite op die kampus. Verskaf kommunikasie- en inligtingstegnologiedienste om aan die spesifieke behoeftes van die kollege te voldoen. Verantwoordelik vir die effektiewe lewer van diens in elk van hierdie areas. Fasiliteer en dryf die tydige en akkurate voorbereiding van die kollege se jaarlikse begroting in ooreenstemming met strategiese prioriteite. Koördineer en dryf die voorbereiding vir die jaarlikse hersiening van die kollege se strategiese plan. Berei kwartaallikse verslae op grond van die jaarlikse prestasieplan voor en verseker die opstel van die jaarlikse verslag en strategiese plan van die kollege. Moedig aan en bou 'n organisatoriese klimaat bevorderlik vir optimale prestasie deur veranderingsbestuur te implementeer. Ontwikkel en implementeer beste-praktykbeleide, prosedures en interne beheerstelsels om effektiewe korporatiewe bestuur te verseker. Verseker die voorsiening van toepaslike en koste-doeltreffende diens. Hou toesig oor die behoorlike en effektiewe bestuur van die kollege se bates en fasiliteite. Verseker die voorsiening van toepaslike en koste-doeltreffende dienste. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne en korporatiewe bestuursdienssake by die kollege. Verskaf leiding en voldoende ondersteuning en ontwikkeling van die personeel. Verseker nakoming van alle administratiewe vereistes, regulasies, reëls en regulasies wat op Korporatiewe Dienste van toepassing is. Verantwoordelik vir IT- en inligtingsbestuursoplossings om aan die spesifieke behoeftes van die streek te voldoen. Verantwoordelik vir kommunikasie en bemarking vir die streekkantoor. Verseker ontwikkeling van PMDS van personeel. Monitor kwaliteitsbeheer van werk en ontwikkel jaarlikse prestasieplan. Monitor die beplanning, organisering en delegering van werk. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Isabelo sikaNgqongqoshe: Isevisi Yomkhakha
zu.summary: Sihlalo wezinsiza zomkhakha kumakholeji e-TVET, onika ubuholi obuhle kakhulu e-HR, i-IT, ekumaketheni, izinsiza nasekubuphatheni ezingeni le-SMS Level 12.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-bachelor ezingekho ezifanelekanayo (NQF Level 7) ekuPhathweni kobuNikazi bezinSiza/baPhathi noma iziqu ezihlobene. Isiphekelelo seminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kuhlanu (5) seminyaka yohlu lwezokusebenza okufanele lapho kuyisiphekelelo seminyaka emithathu (3) yohlu lokusebenza ezingeni elisezansi nobuholi emkhakheni wezinsiza zomkhakha. Ukuqonda inguqulo enkulu nezinhloso zikaBungelezi bokuFunda nokuQeqesha. Ukwazi ngomthetho woMkhakha weZwi Lombuso, umthetho wokuSebenzisa oFundisa, umthetho weziNdinganiso zokuQasha nomthetho woMkhakha weMali woMumbuso. Ukwazi ngomthetho nezinhlaka zemithetho ephatha imfundo nokuqeqesha kanjalo neNkonzo yoMphakathi neNkonzo yokuQasha eNingizimu Afrika. Uholelo lokuphatha abantu namaphrojekthi ngenkhosi yokuhlela ngokuhle. Inkhoso yokwakha, ukusekela nokuhlola ukusebenza kwezinqumo kanye ngenkhoso yokusebenza emkhakheni weqembu, iziskhuni ezinhle zokuphatha amaphrojekthi nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuze nesibopho sokuqasha amahora abeke kanye nokuHamba kakhulu. Ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha (Ms Word, Ms PowerPoint, Ms Excel, Ms Excess kanye ne-Ms Outlook). Ileyisensi yokushayela evunyiwe.
zu.duties: Nika ubuholi obuhle kakhulu ezindaweni ezinjenge-Nhloko yabasebenzi, i-IT, Ukumaketha, Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, Ukuphathwa kwezinkomba, Izindinganiso zokuqasha kanye noBuphathi. Qapha zonke izidingo zokusebenza nsuku zonke kumisebenzi ye-Nhloko yabasebenzi, yokumaketha ne-IT kuhlanganise nemisebenzi ekhempasini. Hlinzeka nggezinsizakalo zokuxhumana nobuchwepheshe bolwazi ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo ezithile zesikole. Uxhomeke ekufonweni okusebenzayo kokuhlinzeka ngesevisi kunoma yisiphi isabelo kuleyo mindeni. Yenza futhi uqhube ukulungiswa ngokushesha nangokuyiqondile kwebajethi yonyaka wesikole ngokuhambisana nezinhloso ezinkulu. Hlela futhi uqhube ukulungiselwa ukubuyekezwa kwonyaka kohlelo lokuhlela lwesikole. Lungisa imibiko yenyanga yezikhathi ezine ngokohlelo lokuqasha lonyaka futhi uqinisekise ukuhlanganiswa kombiko wonyaka nohlelo lokuhlela lwesikole. Khuthaza futhi wakhe isimo sezinhlangano esiza ekufinyeleleni ngemvama ngokuphatha ukushintshwa. Lula futhi usebenzise izinqulumo, izinqubo kanye nezinhlela zolawulo lwangaphakathi ezinhle kakhulu ukuze uqinisekise ubuphathi obuhle bomkhakha. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo ezifanele kanye nabathengi abakhokha kancane kakhulu. Qapha ukuphathwa okuyiqondiso nokusebenza kahle kwempahla nezinsiza zesikole. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo ezifanele kanye nabathengi abakhokha kakhulu. Phatha izindaba zomkhakha wokuphathwa kwe-Nhloko yabasebenzi noBuphathi kolwazi kulesi sikole. Hlinzeka ngokuqondiswa, ukwesekwa okwanele nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuzikwelela ngokuphathwa kwazo zonke izidingo, izimiso nemithetho ngokuphathwa kwemikhakha. Uxhomeke ekubhaleni nasekuphathweni kolwazi ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo ezithile zeNgingi. Uxhomeke ekuxhumaneni nakumaketha ngakwa-Kantilo. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-PMDS yabasebenzi. Qapha ukulawula izinga lemisebenzi futhiuthuthukise uhlelo lokuqasha lonyaka. Qapha ukuhlela, ukuhlelela nokwabelana komsebenzi. N.B. Bonke abantu abakhethiwe bazodinga ukuqedesisasasasakun. Khumbula: Gcina uhlobo lomsebenzi othile.

xh.title: Isekela loMlawuli: Iinkonzo zoBuchule
xh.summary: Isekela loMlawuli weeNkonzo zoBuchule kwiikholeji ze-TVET, sibonelela nokuholwa ngokweziququmbelo kwi-HR, i-IT, ukuthengisa, izinto zolawulo nokulawulwa kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 12.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo ze-bachelor (NQF Level 7) kwintsimi yoLawulo/Phuhliso lweMisebenzi yabantu okanye izidanga ezinxulumene nayo. Ubuncinane beminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kwemihlanu (5) yamava emisebenzi exhuliswayo apho kunesakhulu samava eminyaka emithathu (3) kwinqanaba lolawulo lweejoni kwindawo yenkonzo yobuchule. Ukuqonda umbono weziququmbelo neenkqubela phambili ze-Department of Higher Education and Training. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Act, i-Employment of Educators Act, i-Labour Relations Act ne-Public Financial Management Act. Ulwazi ngeenqobo zoqeqesho kunye nemiqathango yokulawula imfundo noqeqesho ngenkqubo ye-Public Service ne-Employment Service eSouth Africa. Amanqanaba okulawula abantu namaphrojekthi anamandla okuceba ngokweziququmbelo. Amandla okuphuhlisа, ukuxhasa nokujonga ukusebenza kweenqobo zoqeqesho namandla okusebenza kwindawo yeqela, amakhono amnandi oLawulo lweephrojekthi nakwikhompyutha. Ulungelelwaniso lokusebenza iiyure ezingaqhelekanga nahambo elide. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (Ms Word, Ms PowerPoint, Ms Excel, Ms Excess ne-Ms Outlook). Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Bonelela ngokuholwa ngokweziququmbelo kwiiNdawo zoLawulo lweMisebenzi yabantu, i-IT, ukuThengisa, uLawulo lwezeNkcukacha, uLawulo lweRekhodi, uQuqumbelo lweMisebenzi noLawulo. Qwalasela iimfuno zonke zemisebenzi yemihla ngemihla ze-HR, ukuThengisa ne-IT kuquka naloo misebenzi ikwikhamphas. Yeza iinkonzo zoxhumo nolwazi lwekhompyutha ukuyalela iimfuno ezithile zekholeji. Uxanduva lokugqibezela ukubonelelwa ngokusebenza ngempumelelo kuyo yonke le ndawo. Yenza kwaye ukhokele ekulungiseni ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangokuchanekileyo imeko yemali yonyaka wekholeji ngokuvumelana neenkqubela phambili ezingaququmbelo. Lungisa kwaye ukhokele ekulungiseni ukuhlola ngeminyaka yonyaka iplani yesiququmbelo yekholeji. Lungisa iingxelo zenyanga zonyaka ngokweplani yempumelelo yonyaka uze uqiniseke ukuhlanganiswa kwenkqubo yomhlalaphantsi namacebiso eplani yesiququmbelo yekholeji. Khuthaza waze wakha imozambeko yoluntu ehlelekileyo kwimpumelelo elungileyo ngokusebenzisa uguqulo lolawulo. Phuhlisa waze usebenzise iinkqubo ezilungileyo zangaphezulu, iinkqubo, nameendlela zolawulo zangaphakathi ukuze qinisekiswa uLawulo olusebenzayo lweshishini. Qwalasela ukubonelelwa ngenkonzo efanelekileyo nengabizi kakhulu. Qwalasela ulawulo olufanelekileyo nolusebenzayo lweempahla kunye nezinto zolawulo zekholeji. Qwalasela ukubonelelwa ngenkonzo efanelekileyo nengabizi kakhulu. Lawula imisebenzi yabantu nezabakhuselo bolawulo lobuchule kwiKholeji. Sika inkqubo kwaye bonelela ngokuxhasa okupheleleyo nophuhliso basebenzi. Qwalasela ukuze kuhambelane neemfuno zonke zolawulo, imigaqo-nkqubo kunye neemithetho malunga neeNkonzo zoBuchule. Uxanduva bokubonelela iinkonzo ze-IT nolawulo lolwazi ukubonelela imfuno ethile yoMmandla. Uxanduva loxhumo nakuthengisa iKontsi yoMmandla. Qwalasela uphuhliso lwe-PMDS yabasebenzi. Qwalasela ulawulo lweemfuno zomgangatho womsebenzi yaza uphuhlisa iplani yempumelelo yonyaka. Qwalasela ukuqamba, ukuqamba nokuqhuba umsebenzi. Qaphela: Bonke abagqatswa abakhethiweyo baya kufuneka bagqibe isikolo sabakhweli.

jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for National Norms and Standards in higher education, developing funding policies for TVET Colleges in Pretoria. Requires a commerce degree and management experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce/Advanced Diploma or equivalent qualification in Economics/Accounting and/or Financial Management. A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years, preferably in funding frameworks and policies with at least three (3) to five (5) years of work experience at the Junior Management level. Extensive knowledge and insight into the education policies and legislations for public colleges. Experience in financial management in a government environment will be an added advantage. Policy analysis, development, and implementation skills. Knowledge of the policies or legislative framework in Technical and Vocational Education and Training Colleges, Public Finance Management Act. Good financial analysis and research skills. Good communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills. Ability to work in a team and to work under pressure. Meet tight deadlines and be target driven. Computer literacy; with extensive knowledge of MS Word and Excel skills. A postgraduate degree or Diploma in Economics or Finance will be an added advantage. Willingness to travel and a valid driver’s license.

Gather, analyse, and utilise data for the development of national Norms and Standards for Technical and Vocational Educational and Training Colleges. Research and analysis of emerging issues to inform the development and the review of funding norms. Benchmarking against other financing policies globally. Research and analysis of emerging issues to inform development and the review of programme funding norms and standards. Plan the equitable distribution of funding in support of policies for education and training delivery in the Technical and Vocational Educational and Training Colleges. Manage models for planning equitable pro-poor funding. Determining required education inputs. Analyse and interpret emerging and evolving conditions for review of the funding policies where circumstances demand and/or at certain intervals. Manage the development, review, and implementation of an equitable funding framework for Training and Vocational Educational and Colleges. Manage and monitor implementation to ensure compliance with the funding norms. Facilitate reporting on the implementation of the funding policy to identify areas for improvement as well as maintain and sustain best practices. Analyse, interpret and apply both financial and non- financial data for financial policy development. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Nasionale Norme en Standaarde
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Nasionale Norme en Standaarde in hoër onderwys, wat befondsingsbeleide vir TVET-kolleges in Pretoria ontwikkel. Vereis 'n handelsgraad en bestuurservaring.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte Baccalaureusgraad in Handelswetenskappe/Gevorderde Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Ekonomie/Rekenkunde en/of Finansiële Bestuur. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar, verkieslik in befondsingsraamwerke en beleide met ten minste drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se werkservaring op Juniorbestuursvlak. Uitgebreide kennis en insig in die onderwysbeleide en -wetgewing vir openbare kolleges.ervaring in finansiële bestuur in 'n regeringsomgewing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vaardighede in beleidsontleding, -ontwikkeling en -implementering. Kennis van die beleide of wetgewende raamwerk in Tegniese en Beroepsopleidingskolleges, Openbare Finansiële Bestuurswet. Goed finansiële analise- en navorsingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik) en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk en onder druk te werk. Haak styf aan sperdatums en wees doelgerig. Rekenaarvaardigheid; met uitgebreide kennis van MS Word en Excel-vaardighede. 'n Nagraadse graad of Diploma in Ekonomie of Finansies sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel die programbefondsingsbeleid ter ondersteuning van onderwys- en opleidingslewering in TVET-kolleges en monitor die implementering daarvan. Analiseer, interpreteer en pas beide finansiële en nie-finansiële data toe vir die ontwikkeling van infrastruktuurbevondsingsbeleid. Versamel, analiseer en gebruik data vir die ontwikkeling van nasionale Norme en Standaarde vir Tegniese en Beroepsopleidingskolleges. Navorsing en analise van ontluikende kwessies om die ontwikkeling en hersiening van befondsingsnorme in te lig. Vergelyking met ander befondsingsbeleide wêreldwyd. Navorsing en analise van ontluikende kwessies om die ontwikkeling en hersiening van programbefondsingsnorme en -standaarde in te lig. Beplan die billike verspreiding van befondsing ter ondersteuning van beleide vir onderwys- en opleidingslewering in die Tegniese en Beroepsopleidingskolleges. Bestuur modelle vir die beplanning van billike pro-arm befondsing. Bepaling van vereiste onderwystoelogange. Analiseer en interpreteer ontluikende en ontwikkelende toestande vir hersiening van die befondsingsbeleide waar omstandighede dit vereis en/of op sekere tussenpose. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van 'n billike befondsingsraamwerk vir Beroepsopleidings- en Opleidingskolleges. Bestuur en monitor implementering om nakoming van die befondsingsnorme te verseker. Fasiliteer verslagdoening oor die implementering van die befondsingsbeleid om areas vir verbetering te identifiseer asook om beste praktyke te handhaaf en vol te hou. Analiseer, interpreteer en pas beide finansiële en nie-finansiële data toe vir finansiële beleidsontwikkeling. N.B. Alle kortge lysde kandidate sal veros word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.summary: Sibonke sokusebenzela izigaba namazinga wezwe kwezemfundo ephakeme, ukwakha imigomo yokuxhaswa kwamakholeji e-TVET ePretoria. Idinga iziqu zobuhle wobungcweti kanye nokuqonda ukuphatha abantu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeBachelor ezingenzelwe icando ezezimali/I-Diploma ephakeme noma isibambekelo esilinganayo ku-Economics/Accounting futhi noma ku-Financial Management. Uuncwathi mathathu (3) kuya kweshlanu (5) ubuncwathi, ngaphezu kwako konke kumagugu namapholisi okuxhaswa nobuncwathi obungaseenze bonke bebhange (3) kuya kweshlanu (5) emsebenzini ohlukene ngomnuzo (management level). Ukwaziswa okubanzi nokuqonda kakhulu imigodo yezincwadi ezingezwa imfundo namthetho wawo wonke amakholeji. Uholo lwezezimali ekuqondeni kwesikhashana kuzodingeka kubhalwe ngomzamo wokwenza imigomo ekusebenziseni izimali. Amabungu okusebenzisa imigodo nezinqubo ezisetshenziswa ekuphathweni kwezimali. Ulwazi ngemigomo noma amagugu ezincwadi ezimayelana nabakholeji bemfundo nobungcebezelo bokwenzela umsebenzi, umthetho wezimali zachaze. Ukuhlola, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imininingwane yezezimali nengewona yezezimali ukwakha imigomo yezimali. Amandla okuxoxa ngomlomo nangokuscriba kanye namandla okusebenza nabantu. Amandla okusebenza eqenjini futhi usebenze ngaphantsi kwesisindo. Ukuba nendlela yokuphela kwesikhathi kanye nokuqonda ukuthi kufanele uphele esikhathini. Amabungu okusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokwaziswa okubanzi kwamakhono e-MS Word ne-Excel. Isiqu soziphumo se-postgraduate noma i-Diploma ku-Economics noma i-Finance kuzodingeka kubhalwe ngomzamo wokwenza. Ukulungele ukuhamba kanye nelayisense yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Buthula imigomo yokuxhaswa kohlelo ukuze usekele ukulethwa kwemfundo nokololule eKholejini ze-TVET futhi ulawule ukuphunyuka kwalo. Hlola, chaza futhi usebenzise imininingwana yezezimali kanye naleyo engewona yezezimali ekwakheni imigomo yokuxhaswa kwesakhiwo. Qoqa, hlola, futhi usebenzise imininingwane ekwakheni amanani namazinga wezwe amaKholeji azeMfundo nobuNgcebezelo bokufundela umsebenzi. Cwaninga futhi uhlole izinkinga ezivelayo ukuze unikeze ulwazi ekwakheni nasekuhloleni amanani okuxhaswa. Qathanisa namanye amagugu okuxhaswa emhlabeni jikelele. Cwaninga futhi uhlola izinkinga ezivelayo ukuze unikeze ulwazi ekwakheni nasekuhloleni amanani namazinga okuxhaswa kohlelo. Cwangcisa ukusabalalisa okulinganisayo kokuxhaswa ukuze usekele imigomo yemfundo nokololule eKholejini azeMfundo nobuNgcebezelo bokufundela umsebenzi. Phatha amamodeli okucwangcisa ukuxhaswa okulinganisayo okubhekise kubantu abampofu. Qinisekisa okufunekayo ekuletheni imfundo. Hlola futhi uchaze izimo ezivelayo nezishintshayo ukuze kuhlolwe imigomo yokuxhaswa lapho kudingeka khona futhi noma ngezikhathi ezithile. Phatha ukwakhiwa, ukuhlolwa, nokuphunyuka kokuhleleka okulinganisayo kokuxhaswa kumaKholeji azeMfundo nabuNgcebezelo bokufundela umsebenzi. Lawula futhi ulandele ukuphunyuku ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhambisana namazinga okuxhaswa. Khokha imibiko ngokuphunyuka kwemigomo yokuxhaswa ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokugcina futhi ugcine izinkambiso ezinhle. Hlola, chaza futhi usebenzise imininingwana yezezimali kanye naleyo engewona yezezimali ekwakheni imigomo yezezimali. Qaphela: Bonke abagcotshiwe abakuluhlu lwa manje bazodinga ukuba qedele umzamo olawulwayo ohlobene nokusebenza.

xh.title: Isekela nguMlawuli: IiMigaqo nemiQathango yoMbazwe
xh.summary: Isekela nguMlawuli weeMigaqo nemiQathango yoMbazwe kumfundo ephakamileyo, uphuhlisa iinkqubo zolawulo lweemali zesiKolo samaTVET ePretoria. Kufuneka ube nemvuzo wezolimo kwaye unamava olawulo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelor esifanelekileyo kuRhwebo/I-Diploma ePhakamileyo okanye isiguqulo esilinganayo kuQoqosho/uKwabiwo-mali nanga beenkcukacha kunye/okanye uLawulo lweMali. Ukuzincedisa kweminyaka elishumi elinambini (3) ukuya kwelishumi elinesihlanu (5), ngokukhethwa kwindlela zolawulo lwemali nemiqathango ngenani leminyaka elishumi elinambini (3) ukuya kwelishumi elinesihlanu (5) yamava asebenzayo kwingqanaba loLawulo lwaBafundi. Ulwazi olubanzi nokuqonda ngemigaqo nemiqathango yolawulo lweziko lendalo. Amava kwezolimo lolawulo kwindawo kahulumeni zibe ngenye yezibonelelo eziphumelelayo. Iimpawu zokuqwalasela, ukwakhiwa nokuqatywa kolawulo nemiqathango. Ulwazi ngemigaqo okanye inkqubo yomthetho kwiZiko lemfundo yeBuchule nabaSebenzi bayo, uMthetho woLawulo lweMfuziswe yoLuntu. Iimpawu ezilungileyo zesophuhliso nentswenso yemali. Iimpawu ezilungileyo zoxhumo (lwemiwa nolubhalwayo) nokuqhathaniswa nabaninyanga. Inkonzo yokusebenza eqela nangxweme. Ukuba nako ukugqiba umsebenzi ngexesha elifutshane nokuqokelela ngaphandle kwemigangatho. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; nolwazi olubanzi lweMS Word ne-Excel. Isidanga okanye i-Diploma ephakamileyo kuQoqosho okanye Imali ngamanye amava aphezulu. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba nelayisensi yokushayela.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa inkqubo yomthetho wokwabiwa kwemali ngokuxhasa ukunika imfundo nokuqeqesha kwiZiko leTVET kwaye ulawule ukusetyenziswa kwayo. Qwalasela, camagcisa kwaye usebenzise idatha yemali nengemali ukuphuhlisa inkqubo yomthetho wokwabiwa kwemali yezakhiwo. Qokelela, qwalasela, kwaye usebenzise idatha ukuphuhlisa iMigaqo nemiQathango yoMbazwe yeeKholeji zokuQeqesha nokuRhatywa. Uphononongo nokuqwalasela iingxaki ezisanda kuvakalayo ukumisela ukuphuhliswa nokuhlolwa kwemigaqo yokwabiwa kwemali. Ukuthelekisa nezinye iinkqubo zokwabiwa kwemfi naphesheya. Uphononongo nokuqwalasela iingxaki ezisanda kuvakalayo ukumisela ukuphuhliswa nokuhlolwa kwemigaqo nemiQathango yemali yokunika inkxaso. Cwangcisa ukwabiwa kwemali ngokulinganayo ngokuxhasa imigaqo yokunika imfundo nokuqeqesha kwiKholeji zokuQeqesha nokuRhatywa ezizeObunye nabaSebenzi. Lawula iimodeli zokucwangcisa ukwabiwa kwemali ngokulingana ngokuxhasa iintsapho ezisisweli. Ukumisela izinto ezingeniso zolwazi. Qwalasela kwaye ucacise iimeko ezintsha neziguqukayo ukuvavanywa kolawulo lwemali kwimeko ezidinga kwaye/okanye ngexesha ethile. Lawula ukuphuhliswa, ukuhlolwa, nokusetyenziswa kolawulo lweMali equlunqwe kwiKholeji zokuQeqesha. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukusetyenziswa kuqinisekise ukwabiwa kokuhambelana nomthetho wemigaqo yokwabiwa kwemali. Qedela ukunika iinkcazelo ngokusetyenziswa kolawulo lokwabiwa kwemali ukumisela iindawo ezifuna ukuphucula njengoko kwaye ugcine ngokomelela izabelo ezilungileyo. Qwalasela, camagcisa, kwaye usebenzise idatha yemali nengemali ukuphuhisa umthetho weMali. N.B. Onke amagosa alinganiswe ukwakhiwa korsari koqhagamshelwano ebandakanya ukuqwalasela amandla.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Assessment Administration
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Assessment Administration at INDLELA, Olifantsfontein, requiring a degree and management experience to oversee trade testing assessment systems.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Business Management, Public Management, Business Administration or equivalent. A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years’ appropriate experience in a Junior Management/ Assistant Director in administration environment. At least three (3) to five (5) years work experience in office administration in a supervisory capacity, Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of stakeholder management. Verbal and written communication and presentation skills. Advanced computer skills (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Access, and MS Outlook) Knowledge and understanding of Public Service Act and Regulation. Knowledge and understanding of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of Logistics and Supply Chain Management, National Skills Development Strategy (NSDS), Skills Accord and Artisan Training and Development Regulation. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (PFMA). Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS). Skills: Leadership inclusive of Management and Financial skills. Communication inclusive of Presentation skills. Strategic Management skills. Logistics management skills. Change management skills. Risk management skills. Basic supply chain processes and understanding. Computer literacy.

This includes: Implement and maintain a candidate trade testing administration system inclusive of fee mechanism and trade test scheduling in line with the trade test regulations ;Ensure that all trade test applicants are given feedback on trade test results and certification inclusive of responses to enquiries: Submit all necessary documentation to NAMB for recommendation of certification: Submit reports on registration and completions to NADSC and Management as required: Investigate and report on any irregularities and/or fraud within administration process and represent DHET at relevant legal processes in collaboration with DHET Legal Unit: Coordination of centralized functions of HR, ICT, supply chain, assets, security as well as support functions: facilities management, maintenance, auxiliary services and transport related to INDLELA day to day operations.: Apply good governance and HR management principles. Maintain effective risk management within the unit. Implement corrective measures as per reports from internal audit and the office of the Auditor General. Preparation and submission of Medium-Term Expenditure Framework in puts (MTEF), Estimated National Expenditure (ENE) and Adjusted Estimated National Expenditure (AENE) annual. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

zu.title: oSekela-Mqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kokuqashwa
zu.summary: oSekela-Mqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kokuqashwa e-INDLELA, e-Olifantsfontein, ofuna idigri nesipiliyoni sokuphatha ukuze aqaphele izinhlelo zokuqashwa kwemikhono yokuhalaliswa.
zu.requirements: Idigri yeziqu ehambelana nenhlokodada noma izifundo ezingezinye ezifanayo kokuqondisa Ibhizinisi, ukuqondisa Izinkonzo Zomphakathi, ukuqondisa Ibhizinisi noma okufanayo. Isipiliyoni esifaneleko seminyaka engu-three (3) kuyakuqala kwaye kufike emuvalweni weminyaka engu-five (5) kwindiza yokuqondisa ezingeni eliphansi / Onjomene Omncane kumhlabatho wonke wezomphakathi. Isipiliyoni sokusebenza emhlabeni wezinhlelo zokuphatha ofinyelela emuvalweni weminyaka engu-three (3) kuyakuqala kwaye kufike emuvalweni weminyaka engu-five (5) ngomsebenzi wezinhlelo zokuphatha, ulwazi: Isiko nokugonda kwabahlanganyele bezomthelela. Amakhono okukhuluma okubhaliwe kanye nokuyibeka phambi koluntu. Amakhono ekhaya oshibhili okuthuthukile (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Access, kanye ne-MS Outlook) kanye nokugonda komsumo wezinhlelo zomphakathi nemiyalelo yawo. Isiko nokugonda kwawo msumo wezimali zomphakathi (PFMA) kanye nemiqango yesigaba sezimali. Isiko ngemiba ezomlele zokuqondisa nokuqashwa kwempahla yomphakathi, umgomo wamakhono ezwe i-National Skills Development Strategy (NSDS), i-Accord yamakhono nomthethonqubo wokubuyelela kwamakhono nabasebenzi bemikhono eminingi. Isiko ngawo msumo wezimali zomphakathi, 1999 (PFMA). Isiko ngokuphathwa kwezokuphila nokuzivikela emsebenzini (OHS). Amakhono: Abakhono bokuphatha kuhlangothi lwekhono lokuqondisa nezimali. Amakhono okunxulumana nabantu kuhlangothi lwebhalo kanye nokugxila ekubukeni imigangatho yokuphathwa kwenhlangano. Amakhono obuchwepheshe bokulawula izinsizakusebenza kanye nokuqondisa impahla. Amakhono okulawula inkinga yokushintsha izinhlelo zokuphatha. Amakhono okuphatha ubungozi. Amakhono abothisha ukulandela imiqango yesigaba sezimali nokuqondisa impahla yomphakathi. Amakhono wokuqonda nokuqamba imibhalo ngesikhathi somakhalekhukhwini.
zu.duties: Yakha uphuhlise imigangatho yokuphathwa kokubhaliswa kwemikhono e-INDLELA, ukuze kube nokulawula kwamaphepha okubhaliswa nokugcina amarekhodi, ukwakheka kwawo nokukhuluma ngamaphuzu abalulekile okusuka kokuhlolwa kwemikhono. Lokhu kufaka: Ukulawula imigangatho yokuqondisa yokubhalisa abantu abayofunda imikhono yokuhlolwa kwaye kubandakanye nendlela yokuhlawula nendlela yohlelo lokuhlolwa kwemikhono ngokuhambisana nomthethonqobo wokuqondisa imikhono nokuhlolwa kwemikhono; Qiniseka ukuthi bonke abantu abafaka isicelo sokuhlolwa kumkhono bathola imibiko yokuqondisa imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwemikhono kanye nokuqediwa kokubhaliswa okunamaphasiyoni ekubukeni imibuzo: Thumela wonke amaphepha abalulekile kuNAMB ukuze akwazi ukuthi undulule ukuba umuntu afakwe esigabeni samakhono: Thumela imibiko ekubhalisweni nasekuqedweni kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi eNADSC kubaphathi ngokuthanda kwabo: Phenya uthule imibiko yezinto ezingahambisana nomthethonqobo kanye/noma ukuqopha izinto ezingeyiyo oqobo zohlelo lwokuqondisa uphinde umele i-DHET ezintweni ezibalulekile zomthethonqabo ngokusebenzisana neqembu lomthethonqubo le-DHET: Qondanisa izinhlelo eziphakathi kwesikhungo okuyi-HR, ICT, ukuletha nezinkonzo ezihlukaniswe ngenhloso yokutholakala komsebenzi wansuku zonke e-INDLELA ezingezinye izindlela: ukuphatha izindlu, ukulungisa izinto, ukuletha izinkonzo zokweseka kanye nokuqondisa izimoto ezibheke e-INDLELA nsuku zonke: Sebenzisa izinhlelo ezinhle zokuqondisa nezokuphatha abantu. Qiniseka ukuthi kubekho imigangatho yokuphatha ubungozi okuhambisana nesigaba somthethonqobo olungeleleni, ukuze kugqamise imigangatho yokuqondisa izinhlelo zokulawula ubungozi ngokusho kwemibiko evela eqoqongweni ngaphakathi kweqembu lokuqondisa imali yomphakathi; Isibonakaliso sokuzenzakalelayo sokungenisa izimali eqoqweni lomthethonqubo we-2024-25 MTEF nokuphinda kuhlelwe ngokokuqediwe i-Estimated National Expenditure (ENE) nakwindlela yokuqondiswa kokugqitshwa kwemali eshiwo ku-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) qoqa yonke imininingo ye-ENE ejwayelekile mayelana nokubhaliswa kwemikhono emikhulu emikhulu ekuleTHU; Kwenze wonke amaphepha abalulekile afakwe eqoqongweni leqembu lokulinga imikhono; Qaphela kwaye uqinisekise ukuthi imithethonqubo yezinkonzo ezithile e-INDLELA ilandwa ngokufanelekile ngokwendlela oqondise ngayo ukuze uhlele nangendlela oqondise ngayo izinto ezibalulekile ekwenzeni imisebenzi okufanele igqitshwe ngayo e-INDLELA.

xh.title: Ulawulo Lwezinto Ezingangeniswa Ezifunekisayo
xh.summary: Iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezikwindawo yokulinganisa ulwazi ngeziqu ezingangqamana nomntu ongumlawuli we-INDLELA, e-Olifantsfontein, ebonisa iimfuno zobudlelwane nabantu bokuhamba-hamba nokuba nolwazi ngokulawula imisebenzi yamandla amakhulu kwi-theaster.
xh.requirements:
Iziqinisekiso ezifanelekileyo zesidanga se-bachelor okanye izifundo ezingabarhangqa kwi-Business Management, Public Management, Business Administration okanye ezinjalo. Amaxesha amabalwa alishumi elinesithathu (3) ukuya kwelishumi elinesihlanu (5) amava aphananga kwindawo esemva kwesigaba sabantu abangekaqeqeshwa kakhulu.

Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwezinto ezithintela ukusetyenziswa kolwimi lwakho nokubonakala kolwimi kwindawo abantu bakulawula.
xh.duties:
Phuhlisa nzigcine iindlela zolawulo loqeqesho lokulinganisa ze-INDLELA, ulawulo olusebenzayo lweefom ezingengeniso ukuba zilinganisiwe ezikwisiphelo esiwangakumbi nokungena kwamaxesha anjalo, ukuqamba kwaye kwenziwe iintango ezithetha ukuba zibe nolwazi ngendlela yokulungiselela ukusebenzisa ulwazi.

Misebenzi equka: Qamba iindlela ezahlukeneyo ekusebenziseni izibonelelo, ngokubeka izinto ongazenzileyo kukhoyo ukuziphendulela kwakhona, nokuzama ukukwenza okanye ukuzibandakanya kwakho kwezinto ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Electrical
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Electrical at the Department of Higher Education and Training in Olifantsfontein, managing trade testing accreditation and ARPL in an electrical environment.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree/Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) in Electrical engineering or related qualification, Recognized South African Trade Qualification in an Electrical -related trades (Electrician, Millwright, Instrumentation, Electronics) Assessor as well as a Moderator Certificate and a valid Driver’s license. Registration with the National Artisan Moderation Body as an assessor/moderator will be an advantage. A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years of industry-related workplace experience after qualifying as an artisan and three (3) years’ management experience in Artisan Development (Training, ARPL and Trade Testing). Willingness to travel Knowledge of assessment and quality assurance methods and principles. Knowledge of policies and processes related to artisan training, ARPL and trade testing in the Electrical environment. Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Knowledge of staff management. Knowledge of the Skills Development Act, Public Finance Management Act and the Occupational Health and Safety Act. A good understanding of the trade test regulations, ARPL Criteria and Guidelines as well as processes and guidelines of the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations and the National Artisan Moderation Body. zu.title: Onozaneji: KwezokuKagesi
zu.summary: Onozaneji: KwezokuKagesi eKwindla lezeMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha eOlifantsfontein, ephatha ukuma ngokusemthethweni kokuqeqeshwa kobungcweti kanye ne-ARPL endaweni yamandla kagesi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeBachelor's Degree/Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) ekuQeqeshweni kwezokuKagesi noma iziqu ezihambisana nayo, Iziqu eZaziwayo zaseNingizimu Afrika zokuQeqesha Ubungcweti emisebenzini ehlobene namandla kagesi (Electrician, Millwright, Instrumentation, Electronics) Isitifikedi sikaHlolisisi kanye nosokaHlolisisi kanye neLesayisensi yokuQhuba egunyaziwe. Ukuqunjelwa kwi-National Artisan Moderation Body njengenhlolisisi/ososkahlolisisi kuzoba yinhleso. Amanani amancane amathathu (3) kuya kwayisihlanu (5) iminyaka yemvelo yokusebenza endaweni yokusebenza ngemva kokuba ngumqeqeshi kanye neminyaka emithathu (3) yemvelo yokuqonda ekuPhuhliseni koMqeqeshi (ukuQeqeshwa, i-ARPL nokuHlolwa kokuQeqesha Ubungcweti). Ukuzethandaza ukuhamba Ulwazi lwezindlela nezimiso zokuhololwa kwezinga eliphezulu kanye ne-Nqubo yokubika. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zamazwe nezinqubo eziphathelene nokuqeqeshwa kabenzi bomsebenzi, i-ARPL nokuHlolwa kokuQeqesha Ubungcweti endaweni yamandla kagesi. Ulwazi lwezimiso i-Batho Pele Principles. Ulwazi lokuphatha abasebenzi. Ulwazi lwe-Skills Development Act, i-Public Finance Management Act kanye ne-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Ukuqonda okuhle ngemithethonqubo yokuHlolwa kokuQeqesha Ubungcweti, izindinganiso kanye nezixwayisi ze-ARPL kanye neNqubo kanye nezixwayisi ze-Quality Council for Trades and Occupations kanye ne-National Artisan Moderation Body. Ukukwazi ukucela, ukuhlela, ukuphatha, kanye nokubheka izinkalo kanye neNqubo ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Ukukwazi ukufaka futhi kuhambisane nezinhlela zamazwe eziphathelene nomqeqeshi kanye neNqubo bese ukuphatha kwezinga eliphezulu kwezinsizakalo zokuHlolwa kokuQeqesha Ubungcweti. Amakhono okuqondisa kanye nokweseka iqembu. Amakhono okuhumusha bese kuqonda iNqubo. Ikhono lokuqamba, ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinqubo eziyisisekelo kanye neNqubo. UkuHlolwa kwezinkinga, ukuHlonza ingozi kanye nokuBika. Ukuphatha izingxabano kanye namakhono abantu ngokuvamile kanye neNqubo yezimali. Ukubuka ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint). Ilesayisensi yokuQhuba egunyaziwe.
zu.duties: Gcina futhi uphathe isimo sokuqashelwa okusemthethweni sokuHlolwa kokuQeqesha Ubungcweti, i-ARPL ekuQeqeshweni kwaKagesi futhi uxhumane nabanikazi bengxenye bangaphakathi nangaphandle be-INDLELA. Phatha ukubonelela okwethembekayo kwe-ARPL nokuHlolwa kokuQeqesha Ubungcweti endaweni yamandla kagesi, futhi ukuyifaka igcinwe kahle ukuqinisekiswa kwezinga lokhaya. Bheka futhi ubeke ukuHlolwa ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuphatha ngempumelelo kanye nokusebenzisa okungesikhathi kanye nokuhlola kanye nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. UkuHlela okuphumelelayo, ukulawula imali, ukubhaqa kanye nokuThenga okungesikhathi ngezinhlobo zakuHlolwa kwaKagesi. Qinisekisa indawo yokusebenza iphephile futhi iholele ukuHlolwa kokuQeqesha Ubungcweti kwezinga eliphezulu kanye nezinsizakalo ze-ARPL kubungcweti beKagesi. Hlola kanye nokuphatha ingozi ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Qaphela. Bonke abafakelo abakhiqityiwe bazocela ukugcwaliseka kwenqubo ehambisana namandla.

xh.title: Isebe elingangeneleli iNqanaba eliPhakamileyo: Amandla
xh.summary: Isebe leSikhundla esingeneleleyo kwindawo yamandla sisebe leMfundo ePhezulu nezoQeqesho eOlifantsfontein, silawula ukuzinze kokuqinisekiswa kolwazi kwaye kwi-ARPL kwindawo yamandla.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo ezingunaphakade (NQF Level 7) kwikqondo lezobunjineli yamandla okanye isidanga esinxulumeneyo. Isidanga sakwaMzantsi Afrika sokugqithiswa kolwazi kwindawo ecaleni kwamandla (Umbhedi wesixhobo, Umbhedi wamandla nokuqhakamshelana, isixhobo sokulinganisa, i-Electronics) Isatifikethi sobaniqinisekisi kwaye nomqondisi kunye nelayisensi yokuqhuba. Ukubhalisa kwi-National Artisan Moderation Body njengomqinisekisi/umqondisi kuya kuba ngumda ongancedo. Ubuncinane beminyaka elithathu (3) ukuya kwaye kwehlanu (5) yamava wendawo yokusebenza enxulumene nenqanaba lemidlalo emva kokugqithiswa njengomuntu olumileyo kwaye uneminyaka elithathu (3) yamava wolawulo ekuPhuhliseni abalumleyo (Uqeqesho, ARPL noQinisekiso loLwazi). Ukuzimisela okokuhamba Ulwazi ngokulinganisa iindlela kunye neengcamango zokuqinisekisa. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo namagunya ahambelana noqeqesho lwabalumleyo, i-ARPL noqinisekiso lolwazi kwindawo yamandla. Ulwazi ngeenqobo zoBatho Pele. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngeMthetho woPhuhliso lweZakhono, uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zeSigqiki noMthetho woKhuseleko nempilo yabaSebenzi. Ukuqonda okuhle ngemithetho ephathelene nokuqinisekiswa kolwazi, iinkqubo nemiqathango ye-ARPL kunye neenqubo neengcamango ze-Quality Council for Trades and Occupations kunye ne-National Artisan Moderation Body. Ikhono lokucwangcisa, ukuqamba, ukulawula, nokuphendula ukwenzakala kwaye ulawule iinkqubo ezikwicala yesebe. Ikhono lokuzisa iinkqubo ezinxulumene nabalumleyo kwaye uzithobele kwaye ulawule kwaye uqinisekise ukunikela ngenkonzo yokulinganisa ulwazi. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa kwaye luncedo ekuthungelweni iqela. Ikhono lokutolika nokuyiqonda inqubo. Ikhono lokuphuhlisa, ukuphucula nokuzisa iinkqubo ezisezantsi zokusebenza neendlela zokwenza. Uhlalutyo lweziganeko, ukuqhawula ngokusingatha kwaye ibe sisiqendu sobuhlalutyo. Ukulawula iingxabano ezinkulu kwaye kubekho imali engathathi ncali ekulawulweni kwemali. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Gcina ulawulo olusemthethweni lokuqinisekiswa kolwazi kwindawo yemisebenzi yamandla kwaye unxibelelane nabanikeli bengqalelo bangaphakathi nangaphandle kwi-INDLELA. Lawula ukunikela ngokuqinisekileyo kwi-ARPL nakuqinisekiswa kolwazi lwendawo yamandla, uze ufake kwaye ugcine ulawulo olungaphakathi lolungelo. Qapha kwaye wenze ulawulo olungaphakathi nangaphandle. Ulawulo olusemthethweni nokusebenzisa izixhobo ngokufanelekileyo kunye nokuqondisa nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesebe. Uplani olusemthethweni, ulawulo lweemali, uqoqosho kwaye uthenge izixhobo zokuqinisekiswa kolwazi kwindawo zokusebenza zamandla. Qinisekisa ukuba indawo yokusebenza iphephile kwaye ifanele ukunika inkonzo eqinisekileyo yokuqinisekiswa kolwazi kwaye kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olubhekisa kwindawo yamandla. Chonga kwaye ulawule imiba engengozi ngaphakathi kwesebe. Qaphela: Bonke abagqithiswa kolu ludwe kuya kufuneka bagqibe umzobo wamandla ahambelanayo.

Bonke abo bakhethiweyo kuya kudingeka benze umzobo wamakhono ahambelana nalom msebenzi.

zu.title: Iphini Lomqondisi: Izimoto
zu.summary: Iphini Lomqondisi: Izimoto eDepartment of Higher Education and Training e-Olifantsfontein, elibhekele ukuhlola okuyinh technical kwe-ARPL kanye nezinhlolovo zamakhono ezinkundleni zemimoto.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yesiqu elifanelekile/I-Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) ku-Automotive Engineering noma isitifikedi esilinganayo. Kumele abe ngumazenzi othunyelwe kwishadi lezimoto. Kumele abe ne-Certificate yokuba ngu-Assessor kanye no-Moderator. Ubuncwane beminyaka eyihlanu (5) yokuhlola, ukuqeqesha noma isipiliyoni sezinhlevo zamakhono emva kokuba ngumazenzi. Ilayisense yokushayela esesimweni. ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho ye-Public Financial Management Act (PFMA), kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho ye-Skills Development Act, i-National Qualification Framework, i-Occupational Qualifications Sub Framework, kanye no-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho yezinhlevo zamakhono, inqubo yokwamukela ulwazi ngaphambili kwabazenzi (ARPL), kanye nokuqinisekisa izinga kanye nenqubo yokwamukelwa ngaphakathi kwezinhlevo zamakhono. Amakhono: Ikhono lokucubungula, ukuhlela, ukuphatha, kanye nokulawula imisebenzi kanye nezinqubo ngaphakathi kwelenhlangano. Ikhono, lokusebenzisa kanye nokuhambisana nemithetho kanye nezinqubo eziyingxenye yomzenzi, nokuphatha kanye nokuqinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zezinhlevo zamakhono. Amakhono okubambisana kanye nokukhangaba amaqembu. Amakhono okutolika kanye nokuqonda umthetho. Ikhono lokwakha, ukuthuthuka kanye nokusebenzisa izinqubo nezingachazi zokusebenza. Ukuhlazwa kwezinkinga, ukuqaphela ubungozi kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ukuphatha izingxabano kanye namakhono jikelele okuphatha abantu kanye nezimali. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukuhlola okuyinh technical kwe-ARPL kanye nezinhlolovo zamakhono zabafakwa emisebenzini ehambisanayo (izinkundla zemimoto). Ukuphatha ukulinganiswa kwezinhlolovo zamakhono emisebenzini ehambisana nemimoto ukuze kuqinisekiswe imiphumela ehlanzekile. Ukuphatha kanye nokubheka ukwakhiwa kwamaphepha okulawula inhlolovo yamakhono, amaphepha okumaka kanye nezithako zenhlolovo yamakhono. Ukwakha kanye nokusebenzisa izincwadi zokusetshenziswa kwisigaba. Ukuphatha ukuqeqesha ukusebenza kanye nokuqeqesha izisebenzi. Ukuphatha umtholampilo wemali kanye nensimbo yokuthenga yesigaba semimoto. Ukuphatha ukulondolozwa kanye nosevisi lwempahla kanye nezibhobelo kulesigaba. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amawokishopho ahambisana no-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Ukuba nguMhlanganisi phakathi kwe-INDLELA kanye nabaphathi abaningilizi. Kanye nokugcina ukwamukelwa kwe-Automotive Unit. Qaphela: Bonke abaphakanyiswa imigwaqo kuzofuneka bafeze isipiliyoni esihambisanayo.

Kufuneka ube nobunjalo beminye emi-5 (5) yemimiselo yokuqeqesha ngobuchwepheshe okanye amava eovulo zobugcirha emva kokugunyaziswa njengoBugcirha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi olulungileyo ngemigaqo yeovulo zobugcirha, iinkqubo zokuqaphela ulwazi lwangaphambili kwabagcirha (ARPL), iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa umgangatho kunye nokuvunywa kweovulo zobugcirha. Aakhonza: Ikholo yokucwangcisa, ukuqamba, ukulawula, nokuhlola imisebenzi kunye neenkqubo ngaphakathi kwicandelo. Ikholo yokusebenza kunye nokuthobela iinkqubo nobugcirha abavelene nayo, ukulawula nokubonelela iinkonzo zeovulo zobugcirha. Aakhonza aqhelanise uluntu nakukhokela iinqanaba. Aakhonza okokumela ayiqonde ngokupheleleyo iinkqubo. Aakhonza aqamba, aze acwangcise iinkqubo zokusebenza ngolu hlobo, axhaswe ziinkqubo ezizele. Isiphithiphithi sokuhlolwa, ukuchonga iingozi kunye nokubhala iingxelo. Ukulawula ukungavani kweembono, nokulawula ngokubanzi imithombo yemali nabantu.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuvavwa kobuchwepheshe kwi-ARPL kunye neovulo zobugcirha zabafaki isicelo kumagatya ahambelanayo (amagatya e-Automotive). Lawula ukwenziwa kolawulo kweovulo zobugcirha kumagatya ahambelana ne-Automotive ukuqinisekisa iziphumo ezikumgangatho. Lawula ke, ulawule nokuphuhlisa iiphepha zemiyalelo yeovulo zobugcirha, iiphepha phawuli kunye nezixhobo zeovulo zobugcirha. Qamba, cwangcisa iincwadi zemigaqo kule candelo. Lawula ukuqeqesha nokuphuhlisa imisebenzi yabasebenzi. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kwebhajethi nendlela yokuthenga ibangathelo lef candelo le-Automotive. Lawula ukugcinwa nokwenziwa inkonzo kweempahla nezixhobo kule candelo. Qinisekisa ukuba iindawo zokusebenza ziyahambelana noMthetho woKhuseleko loBumi kunye neMpilo yabaSebenzi. Yiba nguMmeli wokuqhubela phambili iINDLELA kunye nabathile abasenzo. Ze ulondoloze ukuvunywe kwe candelo le-Automotive. QAPH. Abathunywa bonke abakhetiweyo kuya kufuneka bagqibe isenzo esahambelana nobuchwepheshe nendlela yokuphumeza.

zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa koku setshenziswa kwenqubo Yempilo Nempiro Yabasebenzi kanye nezinhlelo, Hola ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokubuyekezwa kwenqubo Yempilo Nempiro Yabasebenzi (EHW) ehambisana namagqabho ezinhloso eziyisinqamba komnyango, Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ze-EHW (impiro, HIV & AIDS, TB, impilo engokomqondo, njl.),Qinisekisa ukuhambisana ne-DPSA EHW Strategic Framework kanye neminye imiyalo ehambisanayo, Thuthukisa izinhlelo zoku setshenziswa zeminyaka yonke futhi ulandelele ukulethwa kwezinhlelo, Hlanganisa izinhlobonhlobo ze-EHW nezinye izinhlelo ze-HR kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zenhlangano, Hlola amaphuzu engcupheko yempiro ezivelayo uphinde uthole izisombululo ezifanele, Phatha izinhlelo Zempilo Nempiro Yabasebenzi, Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zempiro yabasebenzi (isb. ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, amakhasimodi okwazisa), Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinsizakamo Zenhlelo Yosizo Labasebenzi (EAP), Khuthaza impilo engokomqondo kanye nezinhlobonhlobo zokwesekwa ngokomqondo, Landela ukusetshenziswa kanye nokusebenza kwezinsizakamo zempiro, Hlanganisa imikhakha yemikhosi yempiro (isb. World AIDS Day, Mental Health Awareness), Qinisekisa ukubhema ilunga lezinsimbi ezifanele kanye namazinga emithetho ezinsizakamo zokusekela abasebenzi. Ukuqapha, Ukuhlola Nokubika ngohlelo lwempilo nempiro yabasebenzi, Thuthukisa izakhiwo zokuqapha noku hlola izinhlelo ze-EHW, Landela ukusebenza ngokomgomo namagqabho abalulekile, Hlanganisa imibiko yenyanga zonke, yamakota naminye yonke, Hlola ukuba yisinqamba futhi unike izeluleko zokuthuthukiswa, Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zokubika (ngaphakathi nangaphandle), Nikeza izinsizakamo zeseluleko kanye Nokuphathwa Kwabathintekayo, Nikeza izeluleko ezibaluleke kakhulu abaphathi ngemikhakha ye-EHW, Xhumana nabathintekayo abangaphakathi (HR, Labour Relations, OHS committees),Xhumana nabathintekayo abangaphandle (abahlinzeki, iminyango kahulumeni, ama-NGO),Mela umnyango emikhosini ye-EHW kanye namakomidi, Khuthaza ukuqonda nokwakha amandla abaphathi nabasebenzi, Uphatha wonke amathuba eyunithi, Phatha iyunithi uphinde uqapse abasekeli kanye Noku thuthukisa Uphatha ibhajethi ye-EH&, ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo, okugunundwa kakhulu, futhi okusebenza kahle kwezimali.N.B. Bonke abafakazi abakhethiwe bazodinga ukuqeda isivivinyo sokufaneleka esihambisanayo.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli Izele loMntu oSebenzayo nokuPhila
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli Izele loMntu oSebenzayo nokuPhila kwiSabe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha ePretoria, lifuna isidanga esifanelekileyo se-bachelor noku)bhaliswa kwisigaba esizinzileyo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Undergraduate Bachelor / Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) kuLawulo loBuntu obuSebenzayo / iNkqubo yoBuntlola / ukuSebenza kobomi / ukuPhila koMsebenzi / ukuPhila koLuntu njengokoqatyiwe yiSAQA. UkuBhaliswa kumagatya achileyo afana neSouth African Council for Social Services Council Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wentlola; iHealth Professions Council of South Africa njengengxolvelwano ebhalisiweyo / othandabuzi basekliniki. Unyaka wokuSebenza ongemizi-3–5 kwinqanaba leJunior Managerial (ASD) kwindawo yoMntu oSebenzayo nokuPhila. ulwazi: iPublic Service Act, iPublic Service Regulations, iMigaqo yeBatho Pele, iDPSA Employee Health and Wellness Strategic Framework, iOccupational Health and Safety Act, namagqabantshintshi bolawulo bo-HIV & AIDS nesifo soMshuba. Amapondo: uLawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi, uLawulo lweemali, amabali loNxibelelwano nolwalamano, amabali oBizo loQeqesho loBuntlola, ukuQeqesha, uPhuhliso lweMigaqo, uCwangciso olucwangcisiweyo nokuSombulula iingxaki. ukuZimisela ukusebenza iiyure ezingachangelanga nokuHamba kakhulu. ilayisenisi yokushuka echanekileyo iyimfuneko.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso nokusebenza kweNkqubo neMigaqo yoMntu oSebenzayo nokuPhila, Qhoboshela uphuhliso nocwangciso lweNkqubo yokuPhila noMntu oSebenzayo (EHW) ehambelana neenjongo ezicwangcisiweyo zesebe, Qaphela ukusebenza kweenkqubo zeEHW (ukuphila, i-HIV & AIDS, isifo soMshuba, ukuphila kwengqondo, njl.njl.),Qinisekisa ukuhambelana neDPSA EHW Strategic Framework namanye magatya amfunekayo, Phuhlisa iinkqubo zomsebenzi zonyaka uliwedwa uze ulawule ukuhanjiswa kweenkqubo, Fakela iinkqubo ze-EHW kwiinkqubo ezibandakanyiyo ze-HR nolwakhiwo lwesebe, Qaphela iingozi ezisavelayo zokuphila uze udadle amanyathelo afanelekileyo, Lawula iinkqubo zoMntu oSebenzayo nokukhuthaza ukuPhila, Qaphela ukusebenza kweenkqubo zokuphila komntu osebenzayo (umz. ukuKhangwa koMso, iinkqubo zokuQaphela), Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo zeEmployee Assistance Programme (EAP), Khuthaza ukuphila kwengqondo nokuNxibelelana ngokwengqondo namanyathelo okuxhasa ngokomntu wonke, Qaphela ukusetyenziswa nokusebenza kweenkonzo zokuphila, Xubenisa iiganeko neenkqubo zokuphila (umz. iWorld AIDS Day, ukuQaphela ukuPhila kwengqondo), Qinisekisa ubumfihlo namagqabantshintshi abugcwele kwiinkonzo zoxhaso lomntu osebenzayo. ukuQaphela, ukuLinganisa nokubika ngamagqabantshintshi ngokuphila komntu osebenzayo, Phuhlisa iinkqubo zokuQaphela nokuLinganisa ze-EHW, Landela isiphumelele ngokuchasene namagunya nemilinganiselo ebalulekileyo, Qekeenza amabiki nyanga zonke, kwikota nakunyaka wonke, Xola utshintsho lulwaza uze unike iingcebiso ngokuphucula, Qinisekisa ukuvumelana neemfuno zokubika (ngaphakathi nangaphandle), Bonelela ngeenkonzo zoBulumko nokuLawulwa kweNxibelelwano, Bonelela ngengcebiso eziNzima kulawulo ngamagatya e-EHW, Qinisekisa uNxibelelwano nabantu abangaphakathi (i-HR, uNxibelelwano loBasebenzi, amakomiti we-OHS),Dibanisa nabantu abangaphandle (abanikazi beenkonzo, amasebe karhulumente, ama-NGO),Mela iSabe kumajelo namakomiti e-EHW, Qhuba iinkqubo zokuQaphela nokuQeqesha ukwakhula amandla abaphathi nabobasebenzi, uLawulo lwazo zonke iindlela zeYuniti, Lawula iYuniti uze uQonge abasebenzi abaxhasayo nokuPhuhlisa nokuLawula ibhajethi ye-EH&, ukuqinisekisa ukusebenzisa imali ngokusebenza, ngokugcina, nangokusebenza kakuhle.Hoy. Onke amagqabantshintshi abuzweyo aza kufuneka aqwalaselwe inkqubo ekhetheka kuyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: European, American Partneships
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Deputy Director position managing European and American partnerships in higher education international relations, requiring a relevant degree and three to five years' experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree / Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) in International Relations, Developmental Studies or Public Management. A post graduate qualification will be an added advantage. At least three (3) to five (5) years relevant work experience as an assistant director, of which at least two (3) years must have been in the conduct of international relations. The appointee should have a good understanding of South Africa’s higher education and training policies as well as its foreign policy. Excellent communication skills (written and verbal); demonstrated client orientation and interpersonal skills; a team player with good management and administrative skills having the ability to multitask; the appointee will be expected to travel both locally and internationally; work under pressure and odd hours at times and must have a driver’s license. Applicants may be required to undergo competency assessment tests.
jobs.duties: The appointee will be involved in the promotion of international relations concerning higher education and training matters at both bilateral and multilateral levels; develop and monitor agreements and implementation plans on bilateral cooperation; provide strategic analysis of higher education and training in countries in order to assist in the formulation of cooperation strategies and policy development processes; provide comprehensive status reports and synthesized political and education briefings on international collaboration programmes and projects; liaise with the Department of International Relations and Cooperation and diplomatic missions both internally and externally on bilateral and multilateral matters in higher education and training; maintain relations with education and training institutions, specialised agencies and educational non-governmental organisations working in the field of promoting South Africa’s educational objectives abroad; contribute towards the maintenance of a database on international linkages and programmes of all higher education and training institutions through regular updates; to manage the logistical and programmatic arrangements for the hosting of incoming international delegations, conference workshops, seminars and outgoing study visits and delegations. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.“DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Europese, Amerikaanse Vennootskappe
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteurposisie wat Europese en Amerikaanse vennootskappe in internasionale betrekkinge vir hoër onderwys bestuur, met 'n relevante graad en drie tot vyf jaar se ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte Bachelorsgraad / Gevorderde Diploma (NQF vlak 7) in Internasionale Betrekkinge, Ontwikkelingsstudies of Openbare Bestuur. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ten minste drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se relevante werkervaring as 'n assistentdirekteur, waarvan ten minste twee (3) jaar in die uitoefening van internasionale betrekkinge moes wees. Die aangestelde moet 'n goeie begrip hê van Suid-Afrika se hoër onderwys- en opleidingsbeleid sowel as sy buitelandse beleid. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling); getoonde kliëntoriëntasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede; 'n spanspeler met goeie bestuurs- en administratiewe vaardighede wat die vermoë het om veelvuldige take gelyktydig te hanteer; die aangestelde sal verwag word om beide plaaslik en internasionaal te reis; onder druk en soms ongewone ure te werk en moet 'n bestuurslisensie hê. Aansoekers kan vereis word om bevoegdheidsassesserings toetse af te lê.
af.duties: Die aangestelde sal betrokke wees by die bevordering van internasionale betrekkinge rakende hoër onderwys- en opleidingsake op beide bilaterale en multilaterale vlakke; ooreenkomste en implementeringsplanne oor bilaterale samewerking ontwikkel en monitor; strategiese ontleding van hoër onderwys en opleiding in lande verskaf om te help met die formulering van samewerkingsstrategieë en beleidsontwikkelingsprosesse; omvattende statusverslae en gesintetiseerde politieke en opvoedkundige voorligting oor internasionale samewerkingsprogramme en -projekte verskaf; skakel met die Department of International Relations and Cooperation en diplomatieke sendings beide intern en extern oor bilaterale en multilaterale aangeleenthede in hoër onderwys en opleiding; betrekkinge met onderwys- en opleidingsinstellings, gespesialiseerde agentskappe en opvoedkundige nie-regeringsorganisasies wat werk op die gebied van die bevordering van Suid-Afrika se opvoedkundige doelwitte in die buiteland, handhaaf; bydrae tot die handhawing van 'n databasis oor internasionale skakelings en programme van alle hoër onderwys- en opleidingsinstellings deur middel van gereelde opdaterings; die logistiese en programmatiese reëlings bestuur vir die aanbieding van inkomende internasionale afvaardigings, konferensiewerkswinkels, seminare en uitgaande studiebesoeke en afvaardigings. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Deputy Director: European, American Partneships
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Deputy Director sokuphatha izinhlangano zokusebenzisana zase-Yurophu naseMelika ebubini bezindinganiso zamazwe ngamazwe kwemfundo ephakeme, sidinga isiqu esifanelekile kanye namalyela amathathu kuya kwesihlanu iminyaka yezokuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: Isiqu samabhalo esifanelekile se-Bachelor's Degree / i-Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) ku-International Relations, i-Developmental Studies noma i-Public Management. Isiqu sendlela yamaphuzu e-post graduate sizoba yinzuzo ekhonjiswa. Okungenani amalyela amathathu (3) kuya kwesihlanu (5) iminyaka yezokuhlangenwe nakho emsebenzini ofanelekile njengomphathi oncedisayo, okuyilapho okungenani iminyaka emibili (3) kumele ibe ngaphansi kokukhokhiswa kwemisebenzi yezinto zomhlaba wonke. Kufanele ukuthi umfolamhlanga kube nokubukeka okuhle kwezinqubo zemfundo ephakeme kanye namakhono e-South Africa, kanye nayo inqubomgomo yayo yangaphandle. Amafunde kahle abalandelayo (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa); ukubonakala kwezimfanelo zomthengi kanye nemibono engqondweni; umuntu okhuluma kakhulu ngokusebenza ngokuhlangenwe nabo, onesipho esihle sokuphatha izinsizakusebenza kanye naleso sokuba yindodla ezinkonzo eziningi ezingahleliwe; umfolamhlanga uzofunwa ukuze ahambe emkhakheni wangaphakathi nasemkhakheni wamazwe ngamazwe; kufanele akwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkathi zoxinzelelo nezinye izinkathi ezingajwayelekile, futhi kufanele abe nelayisensi yokushayela. Abantu abafaka izinto zabo kulelo bhalo kungadingeka ukuba bagenze izivivinyo zokuhlola amandla abo.
zu.duties: Umfolamhlanga uzobe ebandakanyeka ekukhuthazeni izinto zomhlaba wonke ezithinta imicabango yezemfundo ephakeme nemfundo yamakhono emazingeni obuhlula nobubini; ukuthuthukisa futhi alawule izivumelwano neziyalezelo zokuphatha ngokubambisana ezithinta inhlangano yobelu; ukunikeza ukuhlaziya okusemigangathweni yemfundo ephakeme nemfundo yamakhono kwezwe ngesinye isikhathi ukuze kusize ekwenziweni kwezindlela zokusebenzisana nasekuqameni inqubomgomo; ukunikeza imibiko egcwele nokuqoqa imininingwane yezepolitiki nemfundo mayelana nezinhlelo zamaphrojekthi zokusebenzisana kwamazwe ngamazwe; ukuxhumana ne-Department of International Relations and Cooperation kanye namamishwa wobudiplomatic ngaphakathi nangaphandle ngemibanduca yobelu nobubini mayelana nemfundo ephakeme nemfundo yamakhono; ukugcina ubudlelwano nezikhungo zemfundo namakhono, izinhlelo ezikhethekile kanye nenhlangano zangaphandle ezingeyohulumayente ezigxile ekukhuthazeni inhloso zemfundo zase-South Africa kwezinye izwe; ukufaka isandla ekugcineni isiqu semininingwane ezibalulekile ngamakhono ohlelo lwemfundo ephakeme kanye nenhlelo yazo zonke izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme namakhono; ukulawula izinhlelo zokulandelana kwezemisakazo ohlelweni abangenayo, amakhasimende amhlophe, iinhlelo zokulandelana kwesikhathi eside neziphithizela, ukudweba nokuvezwa kwesikhathi esifushane. N.B. Abantu abakhethwayo kufanele bazogqamisa ngokuphelele noma ingabe kudingeka ukuba kwenziwe ngokuthi 'mera lemininingwane kanye nokuthi bakhombise iziqu ezithile'.

xh.title: Isekela Mlawuli: Ubuyisanano lwaseYurophu naseMelika
xh.summary: Isithuba seSekela Mlawuli esilawulayo ubuyisanano lwaseYurophu naseMelika kumabakani phakathi kwelizwe lonke jikelele kwimfundo ephakamileyo, kufuneka kubekho degree ekufaneleyo neminyaka yamava emithathu ukuya kuhlanu.
xh.requirements: I-Bachelor’s Degree / Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) ekufaneleyo kwi-International Relations, Developmental Studies okanye i-Public Management. Iziqu ze-post graduate ziya kuba ngumzuzu olongezelelekileyo. Ubuncinane iminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kuhlanu (5) yamava omsebenzi ongundoqo njengakwisikhulu ncedisayo, apho ubuncinane kwiminyaka mibini (3) kufuneka ibibikho ekwenzeni umabakani phakathi kwelizwe lonke jikelele. Umthunywa kufuneka abe nokuqonda okuhle ngezinundo zemfundo ephakamileyo nokuqeqesha zelaseNingizimu Afrika nakwelinye izicwangciso zakhe zasematshatshatsheni. Amaphepha ebali achulumeyo (abhalwe netheni nangomlomo); abonise ukumisela kumthengi namakhono abantu; umdlali wesiqhembu onolawulo oluhle nolulawulo lweenkonzo onakho ukwenza imisebenzi emininzi ngaxa nye; umthunywa uya kulindeleke ukuba ahambe ngaphakathi nakaphandle kwelizwe; aze asebenze ngoxinezele nangemiyalezo yamaxa engajwayelekanga ngamaxesha athile kwaye kufuneka abe nelayisenisi yokushayela. Abafaka isicelo banokufuneka benza uviwo lokuqikelela amakhono.
xh.duties: Umthunywa uya kubandakanyeka ekugquthizeni umabakani phakathi kwelizwe lonke jikelele malunga nemibhalo yemfundo ephakamileyo nokuqeqesha kwinqanaba lababini nabalintathu; aze ahlome ayilandele izivumelwano neecwangciso zokuqaliswa kwesivumelwano sababini; anike isahluko esilula nembono yolwazi lwemfundo ephakamileyo nokuqeqesha kumazwe ukuze ancede ekwakheni iindlela zokusasanya izivumelwano nokuqaliswa kweecwangciso; anike iingxelo ezizezinye zeemo nezincukutha ezidityanisiweyo ezimalunga nolwezopolitiko nemfundo kumacwangciso namaprojekthi ohamatsho phakathi kwelizwe lonke jikelele; achazele nesebe le-Department of International Relations and Cooperation nabaqhubi basemizimba yangaphakathi nangaphandle ngeemiba zababini nabalintathu kumfundo ephakamileyo nokuqeqesha; aze agcine ubudlelwane nezikolo zemfundo nokuqeqesha, iincwadada ezizodwa namagebenga angahulumeni okumfundo asebenza kwimfundo yonqakuliswa iziphangelo zemfundo yaseNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle; axube ekugcineni idatha ngeendlela ezidityanisayo nakumacwangciso aphakathi kwelizwe lonke jikelele kwoona maskele onke wemfundo ephakamileyo nokuqeqesha ngokuhlaziya rhoqo; alawule iindawo zomthwalo wezinto neecwangciso sokubamkela iindumba ezivela ngaphandle zangamazwe, amanqwengqweng, iindlwana namaxa abo bayo kwindlela yokufunda namadumba abaya phandle. N.B. Bonke abagqibele abakhethiweyo baya kufuneka bagqibe isiqendu esikufaneleyo sokulinganisa amakhono.

jobs.reference_number: DHET 23/09/2026 Branch: Technical And Vocational Education And Training Directorate: TVET Colleges Budget Planning
jobs.title: Assistant Director: Financial Planning / TVET Colleges
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for financial planning at TVET Colleges, managing infrastructure funding allocation and budget modelling. Requires a relevant diploma or degree and three to five years of experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree/National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Financial Management / Economics / Built Environment / Accounting /or an equivalent qualification. A Built Environment together with bachelor’s in commerce with Economics / Financial Management qualifications as well as advanced qualification will be an added advantage. At least three (3) to five (5) years relevant work experience, preferably in funding frameworks and policies. Extensive knowledge and insight into the education policies and legislations for public colleges. Policy analysis, development, and implementation skills. Financial Management skills. Knowledge of the policies and legislative framework in Technical and Vocational and Educational Training (TVET) colleges, and Public Finance Management Act. Financial analytical and research skills. Develop models for implementation for infrastructure funding policy. Conduct readiness assessment for implementation of the infrastructure funding norms. Responsible for implementation of the infrastructure funding norms. Manage payments of infrastructure funds to the TVET Colleges. N.B. af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir finansiële beplanning by TVET-kolleges, wat infrastruktuurtoekenningsfinansiering en begrotingsmodellering bestuur. Vereis 'n relevante diploma of graad en drie tot vyf jaar ervaring.
af.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor's Degree/National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Financial Management / Economics / Built Environment / Accounting /or an equivalent qualification. A Built Environment together with bachelor's in commerce with Economics / Financial Management qualifications as well as advanced qualification will be an added advantage. At least three (3) to five (5) years relevant work experience, preferably in funding frameworks and policies. Extensive knowledge and insight into the education policies and legislations for public colleges. Policy analysis, development, and implementation skills. Financial Management skills. Knowledge of the policies and legislative framework in Technical and Vocational and Educational Training (TVET) colleges, and Public Finance Management Act. Financial analytical and research skills. Basic knowledge of the built environment. Good communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills. Ability to work in a team and to work under pressure. Meet tight deadlines and be target driven. Computer literate with basic knowledge of MS Word and Excel skills. Valid Driver's License and willingness to travel extensively and as and when required.

Allocate funding to TVET Colleges based on the priority and criticality of the infrastructure conditions and make transfers. Keep date of the infrastructure needs at various institutions which will be at college and campus level. Gather, analyse, and utilise data for the development of National Norms and Standards for funding infrastructure of Technical and Vocational Education and Training colleges. Draft and review of the infrastructure funding norms for Technical and Vocational Education and Training colleges. Develop and manage advocacy strategy of the infrastructure funding norms. Develop models for implementation for infrastructure funding policy. Conduct readiness assessment for implementation of the infrastructure funding norms. zu.title: UmSizi weNhloko: Ukuhlela izeZimali / Amakolishi e-TVET
zu.summary: Ongunxumalkazi ongumSizi weZinhlelo ezeZimali / Amakolishi we-TVET, ophatha ukwabiwa kwemali nokuqagela amabhalansi. Kudinga idiploma noma iziqu ezifanele kanye namathathu kuya kashanu iminyaka yamava.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree/National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ezifanele eMphathweni Wezimali / Ezezoqoqosho / Ezakhiwo / Ezezimali / noma isiqephu esilinganayo. I-Built Environment ekanye ne-Bachelor's ezezomayelana noqoqosho / Iziqu zobuMphathi Bezimali kanye neziqu ezithuthukisiwe kuzoba ngumsa ongaphezulu. Okungenani amathathu (3) kuya kwashanu (5) iminyaka yamava okusebenza ahlobene, ngokuncamelayo kumaphiko nokuminqango yoxhaso. Ukwazi kakhulu futhi kuqonde kahle izinqubomgomo zezemfundo kanye nomthetho wamakolishi omphakathi. Amakhono okuhlola isinqubomgomo, okuqamba, kanye nokuqalisa. Amakhono oBunjiniyela bezezimali. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo nobume bomthetho kumakolishi oBuchwepheshe namakhono eMfundo (TVET), kanye noMthetho WobuPhathi bezeZimali zomPhakathi. Amakhono okuhlola nokuphenya izimali. Ulwazi olusukuma ngendawo eyakhiwe. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle (awomlomo nawesibhali) nabantu. Isikhathi sokusebenza eqenjini nokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkulu. Hlangabezana namadethedi amancane bese ukhokhelwa ukufinyelela okuthile. Ukubhala ngomthombo oqinisekisiwe ngolwazi olusukuma kwi-MS Word ne-Excel skills. Ilayisense Esemthethweni sokushayela nokuzikhethela ezindaweni eziningi njengoba kudingeka
zu.duties: Sebenzisa izinhlelo ezahlukene kuhlanganise izinhlelo zokuqagela izindleko ukunquma izabelomali zokuxhaswa kwezinsiza. Qaba imali kumakolishi e-TVET ngokusekelwe kumandla okubaluleka kanye nesimo esiphephile sezinsiza bese wenza izidluliselo. Gcina ulwazi ngemidingo yezinsiza ezikhungweni ezahlukene okuzoba ngazinga lekolishi nengane yekhasimodi. Qoqa, hlaziya, bese usebenzisa idatha ekuthuthukisweni kwezimo Nosezinhlelo Zavelonketho zokuxhaswa kwezinsiza zamakolishi aMfundo namakhono obuchwepheshe. Bhala bese uhlolisisa izimiso zokuxhaswa kwezinsiza zamakolishi aMfundo namakhonyo obuchwepheshe. Thuthukisa bese uphatha inqubo yokukhuthazwa kwezimiso zokuxasa kwezinsiza. Thuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwenqubo yesimiso sokuxhaswa kwezinsiza. Yenza ukulinganisa ukulungele ukusetshenziswa kwezimiso zokuxhaswa kwezinsiza. Uxhome ekuphathweni kwezimiso zokuxhaswa kwezinsiza. Phatha izinkokhelo zemali yokuxhaswa kwezinsiza kumakolishi e-TVET. QAPHELA. Bonke abangeneleli ababekwe ohlwini bazodingeka ukuba bagcwalise isenzo esifanele sokulinganisa amakhono obuqeqeshi.

xh.title: Umphathi ongenamandla: Uqeqesho lokuhlola iimali / TVET Colleges
xh.summary: Umphathi ongenamandla wokuqeqesha iimali kwi-TVET Colleges, uphatha ulwabişo lweemali zokwakhiwo kunye nemodeli yesabelo semali. Kufuneka kube nediploma okanye isidanga ngokufanelekileyo kunye neminyaka elithathu ukuya kwehlanu yamava.
xh.requirements: I-Bachelor’s Degree/National Diploma (NQF Level 6) efanelekileyo kwi-Financial Management / Economics / Built Environment / Accounting / okanye isifanekiso-sifundo esilinganayo. I-Built Environment kunye ne-bachelor’s in commerce nge-Economics / Financial Management izifundo kwakunye nesifundo esiphezulu kuya kuba lusazo olongeziweyo. Akhade iminyaka elithathu (3) ukuya kwelihlanu (5) yamava omsebenzi ofanelekileyo, ngokukhethekileyo kumakhowudi namapolići eemali. Ulwazi olubanzi nolunolwazi ngamapolići nezithetho zemfundo zamakholeji angowomma. Amapolići okuhlola, okuphuhliswa, nokusetyenziswa. Amakhono e-Financial Management. Ulwazi ngamapolići nakhowudi yomthetho kwi-Technical and Vocational and Educational Training (TVET) colleges, nakwi-Public Finance Management Act. Amakhono oluvo lweemali nophando. Ulwazi olusisiseko se-Built Environment. Amakhono obunzima bokunxibelelwana (olwentywilikyo nolubhalwayo) nolonxibelelwano nabantu. Amandla okusebenza eqela nokuqhubeka ngantsingiselo. Ukuphumeza iindlela ezixhwebileyo zexesha nokuba nomgca wokuqhagamshelwa. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nolwazi olusisiseko lwe-MS Word ne-Excel. I-Driver’s License egqithisiweyo nolwazisele ukuhamba kakhulu naxa kufuneka.
xh.duties: Sebenzisa iimodeli ezahlukeneyo kuqukiwa neemodeli zexabiso ukumisela amasabelo eemali zokwakhiwo. Ulwabişo lweemali kwi-TVET Colleges ngokusekelwe kumngangatho wokuqinisekiswa nobungako bezimo zokwakhiyo ukwenza iindlela ezithileyo. Gcina idatha yemfuneko yamagumbi okulalela ngamayunivesithi ahlukileyo ngaloo ndlela kwenziwa amacandelo ejikeleze ipolisi. Qokelela, hlalutywa, isetyenziswa idatha ngokuphuhliswa kwemiMigqo nezemiGangatho yeZizwe ekunikezela ngemali kwamagumbi okulalela ezi Technical and Vocational Education and Training colleges. Bala kwaye uqwalasele imigaqo yokunikela ngemali yamagumbi okulalela kwi-Technical and Vocational Education and Training colleges. Bala iqela elingenamagunya legunya ukufuna imigaqo yokunikela ngemali yamagumbi okulalela. Bala imodeli yokusetyenziselwa ukwenza imigaqo yokunikela ngemali. Panga intlalo ekungeniseneni imigaqo yokunikela ngemali. Ngenisa imigaqo yokunikela ngemali ngokufakela. Yenza imali yamaphulo ngokunikela ngemali kwi-TVET Colleges. N.B. Onke amagosa okhethiweyo aya kufuna ukwenza isixhobo esifanelekileyo sokulinganisa amakhono.

af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Tegniese Sertifikaat N3 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in die handelsgebied. 'n Handelsvlaktoetssertifikaat in die toepaslike handel. 'n Assessor-sertifikaat. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Drie jaar se handelverwante ervaring na kwalifisering as 'n vakman. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se vakman-opleidings- of assesseringservaring. Kennis: Skills Development Act van 1998. Moet in staat wees om handelsvlaktoetse in die elektriese en verwante handele uit te voer en te modereer. Moet in staat wees om prosesse ten opsigte van ARPL in die handel uit te voer. Moet in staat wees om die ARPL Toolkit te interpreteer en te implementeer. Moet in staat wees om Regulasies betreffende handelsvlaktoetsing te interpreteer en daaraan te voldoen. Moet in staat wees om die Occupational Health and Safety Act in alle werkswinkels te interpreteer en te implementeer. Vaardighede: Goed beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Goed verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Goed mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees (MS Word, Excel, Power Point). Toesighoudende en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om hulpbronne te bestuur wat menslike, assesseringstoerusting en -materiaal insluit. Effektiewe rekordhouding.

Voer handelsvlaktoetse in die Elektriese handel uit en modereer dit, asook implementeer en onderhou ARPL. Voer moderasie van handelsvlaktoetse intern en ekstern uit. Onderhou en verseker veilige bewaring van assesseringsrekords. Bestuur Handelsvlakassistent. Verkry assesseringstoerusting en -materiaal. Evalueer werksprestasie van personeel in die eenheid. N.B. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: I-Artisan Ephambili Izinga A: Kagesi
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Artisan Ephambili Izinga A: Kagesi e-Olifantsfontein esifuna isitifiketi se-N3, isifundo sethathu kanye nesipiliyoni sokukholisa abenzi bobuciko, sinikeza iholo le-R499,470 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Sezobuchwepheshe Sezwe i-N3 esifanele noma isifundo esilinganayo endaweni yokuhweba. Isitifiketi Sethathu Sokuhweba kukhando olufanele. Isitifiketi sokuhlola. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Isipiliyoni seminyaka emithathu esihlobene nokuhweba ngemva kokugunyazwa njengenkosikazi yobuciko. Isipiliyoni eminyakeni emithathu (3) kuyaye kuyiwe emihlanu (5) yokukholisa nokuqeqesha abenzi bobuciko. Ulwazi: Umthetho Wokuphuculwa Kwezakhono ka-1998. Kumele ukwazi ukwenza futhi ahlole Ithathu Lokuhweba kukhando olukagesi noluhlobene nalo. Kumele ukwazi ukwenza izinqubo ezihlobene ne-ARPL kukhando. Kumele ukwazi ukuhumusha futhi asebenzise Ithuluzi Le-ARPL. Kumele ukwazi ukuhumusha futhi alandele Izimiso ezibusayo Ukuhlolwa Kwethathu Lokuhweba. Kumele ukwazi ukuhumusha futhi asebenzise Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuvikeleka Kwezokusebenza kuzo zonke izindlu zokusebenza. Izakhono: Izakhono ezinhle zokuqamba izinhlelo futhi zokuhlela. Izakhono ezinhle zokubhala imibiko. Izakhono ezinhle zokuxoxa ngesikhulumi nakubhalwe. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Power Point). Izakhono zokuphatha kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikakhulu lokuphatha izinsiza okuhlanganisa abantu, izisetshenziswa zokuhlola kanye nezinto. Ukugcina amarekhodi ngempumelelo.
zu.duties: Yenza futhi uhlolo ukuhlolwa kwethathu lokuhweba kukhando olukagesi kanye nokusebenzisa futhi ulondoloze i-ARPL, Yenza futhi uhlolo ukuhlolwa kwethathu lokuhweba kukhando olukagesi kanye nokusebenzisa futhi ulondoloze i-ARPL, Yenza ukuhlolwa Kwethathu Lokuhweba ngaphakathi nangaphandle, Ulondoloze futhi uqinisekise ukugcinwa kwamarekhodi okuHLola, Qondisa Abasizi BokuHweba, Thenga izisetshenziswa zokuHLola nezinto, futhi Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kuleyo yuniti.Ama.N.B. Bonke abantu abakhethe kuzofuneka bagcwalise isenzo sokukholiswa esifanele.

Ikakhulu ukulawula izixhobo eziquka abantu, izixhobo zohlolo kunye nezinto. Ukugcina iirekhodi ngokusebenzayo.
