Qaphela. Bonke abagqabi abakhethiweyo baya kufuneka bagqibe isibhengezo sedlelileyo lokuzilolonga.

jobs.title: Chief Artisan Grade A: Rigger
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R499 470 per annum, (OSD Sale Salary Scale)
jobs.summary: Chief Artisan Grade A Rigger position at Olifantsfontein requiring N3 certificate, trade test in rigging, and 3 to 5 years supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: A National Technical Certificate N3 or equivalent qualification coupled with three (3) to five (5) years supervisory and technical training experience after qualifying as an artisan. Trade Test Certificate in Rigging. Moderator and Assessor Experience. Any additional trade qualification in the Mechanical engineering field as well as a Moderator Certificate will be an advantage Knowledge: Knowledge of Skills Development Act, 1998 and Trade Test Regulations. Must be able to assess candidates in Rigging. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, Power Point). Good report writing. Good planning and organizing skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Good problem- solving skill. Good supervisory skills.
jobs.duties: Conduct assessment in the Rigging trade and implement ARPL. Conduct Moderation of Trade Test internally and externally. Conduct audits of external Trade Test centres. Maintain and ensure safekeeping of assessment records. Supervise Trade Assistants Assess performance of staff reporting to him/her. Procurement and control of assessment stock. Maintain safety in the workshop. Adhere to health and safety policies and procedures. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.“DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en Administrasie
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en Administrasie by Northern Cape CET College, wat menslike kapitaal, werwing en HR-strategie-implementering bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad / Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/-ontwikkeling of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. PERSAL-sertifikate sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se relevante toesigervaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing. Kennis van die Continuing Education Act, (CET Act), Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act en kennis van Menslike Hulpbron-wetgewing en -beleid. Uitgebreide kennis en ervaring van diensvoorwaardes, werknemervoordelige, werwing en keuringsprosesse, en personeelestablishment. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling, Prestasiebestuurs- en ontwikkelingsprosedures, Public Service Employee Wellness Programs. 'n Goeie begrip van Arbeidswetgewing, beleid en prosedures van toepassing op die Publieke Diens. Uitgebreide kennis van PERSAL-stelsels. Beplanning, organisering, verslagskrywing, fasilitering en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.

Bestuur en koördineer die implementering van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur-funksies binne die Kollege, insluitend werwing en keuring, diensvoorwaardes, prestasiebestuur, verlofadministrasie en personeelestablishment. Bestuur Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsprogramme en personeelopleidingsintervensies. Verseker nakoming van HR-wetgewingsraamwerke en departementele riglyne. Verskaf strategiese HR-advies en steun aan bestuur en personeel. Hou toesig oor en ontwikkel HR-personeel om hoë prestasie en effektiewe dienslewering te verseker. Berei HR-verslae voor en handhaaf akkurate HR-rekords. Bevorder goeie Arbeidspraktyke en bevorder 'n positiewe organisatoriese kultuur binne die Kollege. Stel programme in ter ondersteuning van werknemergezondheid en -welstandsdienste binne die Kollege. Opstel en bestuur die Menslike Hulpbronbestemming-budget. N.B. zu.title: Umncedisi Wezinqondiso: Abasebenzi Abantu Nomphathi Wezomphakathi
zu.summary: Umncedisi Wezinqondiso oNgqongqoshe we-Asebenzi Abantu kwiKolishi iNtshona Koloni i-CET College, uphatha imali yamandla abantu, abantu abasha, kwaye yempumelelo yokusebenza kwe-Abasebenzi Abantu.
zu.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor / Isidanga seSizwe (i-NQF Level 6) kwiHuman Resource Management/ Development okanye isidanga esihlobene nayo. I-PERSAL certificates ziya kuba ngomvuzo ongezelekileyo. Ubuncinane bamashumi amathathu (3) kuya kwamahlanu (5) eminyaka yamava wobaphathi abahlobene ne-Human Resource Management. Ulwazi nge-Continuing Education Act, (i-CET Act), i-Public Service Regulations, i-Public Service Act nolwazi ngeempawu ze-Human Resource nemigaqo. Ulwazi olunamava amaninzi ngeemeko zomsebenzi, iindlela zolawulo lwabasebenzi, amava abantu abasha nemigaqo yokuqamba. Ulwazi nge-Human Resources Development, i-Procedures ze-Performance Management and Development, i-Public Service Employee Wellness Programs. Ukuqonda okuhle kwe-Labour Legislation, imigaqo neendlela ezisebenzayo kwinkonzo yaWonke-wonke. Ulwazi olunamava amaninni nge-PERSAL systems. Amava okulungiselela, ukuhlanganisa, ukubhala iingxelo, ukunceda kwaye yemiboniso yamava. Amava amaninini okuziphatha nabantu ekuthetheni nokuBhala. Amava ekhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela echanekileyo.
zu.duties: Phatha imali yamandla abantu ngaphakathi kweKolishi. Ukuphucula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kwe-Human Resource Strategy nemigaqo. Phatha ukuhlanganisa nokusebenza kwe-Human Resource Management ngaphakathi kweKolishi, kuquka ukubumba abantu abasha nokuqamba, iimeko zomsebenzi, ukulawula amava, ukulawula iNcwadana yokuhamba kunye nokuqamba abantu. Phatha iinkqubo ze-Human Resources Development nokuqesha abantu abasebenzayo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo ye-HR kwaye ulawule imigaqo yendawo. Nikeza ngcebano le-HR oluqondayo kwaye uxhase abaphathi nabasebenzi. Lawula kwaye uphucule abantu abasebenza ngo-HR ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuphezulu nolonke olusebenzayo. Lungiselela iingxelo ze-HR kwaye zigcine ngokuchanekileyo iirekhodi ze-HR. Khuthaza iindlela ze-Labour ezilungileyo kwaye wakhe inkqubo eya kuhle kwindalo yeKolishi. Faka iinkqubo ezixhasa impilo yabasebenzi nolonke lwezempilo ngaphakathi kweKolishi. Bala kwaye ulawule ibhajethi ye-Human Resources. Qaphela. xh.title: Umsekeli weNkundla: Uluntu nokuLunga kombutho
xh.summary: Umsekeli weNkundla wokuLunga kombutho noluntu kwikholeji yaseNorthern Cape CET College, ephatha abantu abanemvuzo, ukuzunca, nokuqwalaselwa kwenkqubo yokulunga komsebenzi wabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelor esifanelekileyo / iDiploma yesiQanga (NQF Level 6) kokuLawula / ukuPhepha kwabasebenzi okanye isifundo esinxulumeneyo. Ithifikethe zePERSAL ziya kuba yolonwabo olongezelelweyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kwemihlanu (5) yamava okulawula ahambelana nendawo yokuLawula kwabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngomthetho weContinuing Education Act, (CET Act), iPublic Service Regulations, iPublic Service Act nolwazi ngemithetho nolugqibo ngokulunga komsebenzi wabasebenzi. Ulwazi oluqinileyo namava ngemigaqo yomsebenzi, izibonelelo zabasebenzi, iinkqubo zokuzunca nokhetho, nesiseko sabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngokuPhepha koluntu, iinkqubo zokuLawula nokuPhepha kobuchule, namaqonga abasebenzi abakhathalelekileyo. Ukuqonda okulungileyo ngomthetho weLabour, ipeleka nemigaqo esetyenziswayo kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngeenkqubo zePERSAL. Amandla okucwangcisa, ukuhamba, ukubhala ingxelo, ukulawula iinkqubo nokuyila. Amandla mahle okuthetha nabantu ngomlomo nangokubhala. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo.

Lawula wenze ngokubambisana ukusetyenziswa kweinkqubo zokulunga komsebenzi wabasebenzi ngaphakathi kweKholeji, kuquka ukuzunca nokhetho, imigaqo yomsebenzi, ukulawula ukusebenza, ukulawula i-leave noluntu olusebenzayo. Lawula iinkqubo zokuPhepha koluntu kwaye ulungiselele abasebenzi iinkqubo zokuqeqesha. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba ngemithetho ye-HR nemigaqo yesabe. Nikeza ingcebiso ngenkqubo yokulunga komsebenzi wabasebenzi usize abalawuli nabasebenzi. Lawula uphuhlise abasebenzi be-HR ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngamandla nokuzelelwa ngokufanelekileyo. Lungiselela iingxelo ze-HR zigcine umnga onyani we-HR. Khuthaza iinkqubo ze-Labour ezilungileyo uzame ukwakha isiko elingathandi kwindawo yokusebenza ngaphakathi kweKholeji. Misa iinkqubo ezixhasa impilo nabasebenzi abakhathalelekileyo ngaphakathi kweKholeji. Bhala ulawule imali yesablho yokuLawula uluntu olusebenzayo. jobs.title: Assistant Director: Donor Grant Support
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed in Pretoria to coordinate, manage and evaluate donor-funded grants and projects within the Department of Higher Education and Training.
jobs.requirements: Prospective candidates should be in possession of a three-year Bachelor’s Degree/Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) in Public / Business Administration /Financial Management or equivalent qualification. A relevant post-graduate qualification will be an added advantage and be proactive, effective with ability to work in a diverse team. Experience of three (3) to five (5) years in education and training and skills to provide support to a relevant project will be strongly recommended. Apart from project management, the candidate should have financial management backed by at least three (3) to five (5) years’ experience in project grants local and international donor funds management at junior management level. A qualification in Financial Management is an added advantage. In addition, the successful candidate must have proficiency in MS Office Packages as well as communication and report writing skills.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will primarily be required to: Assist in the coordination, management, monitoring and evaluation of the grants and donor funded projects. Assist in compiling quarterly semester performance reports on projects funded by grants and donors. Assist in ensuring strict adherence to reporting procedures of projects and deadlines. Assist in the coordination, management, monitoring and evaluation of the grants and donor funded projects. Provide administrative support to grants and other donor funded project committees for the post school sector. Develop and maintain the database on various projects. Evaluate projects proposals and appraise Business Plans for the effective and efficient utilization of project funds. Manage the interface with different stakeholders of the DHET at the required level. Perform other duties delegated from time to time in the Directorate. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Ondersteuning vir Skenkings en Toelaes
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig in Pretoria om skenker-gefundeerde toelaes en projekte binne die Department of Higher Education and Training te koördineer, bestuur en evaluateer.
af.requirements: Voornemende kandidate moet 'n driejaar Baccalaureusgraad/Gevorderde Diploma (NQF level 7) in Publieke / Besigheidsadministrasie / Finansiële Bestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. 'n Relevante nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees en die kandidaat moet proaktief en doeltreffend wees met die vermoë om in 'n diverse span te werk. Ervaring van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar in onderwys en opleiding en vaardighede om ondersteuning aan 'n relevante projek te verleen, sal sterk aanbeveel word. Afgesien van projekbestuur, moet die kandidaat oor finansiële bestuur beskik, ondersteun deur ten minste drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in projekte-toelaes en plaaslike en internasionale skenkerfondsbestuur op juniorbestuursvlak. 'n Kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur is 'n bykomende voordeel. Daarbenewens moet die suksesvolle kandidaat vaardigheid in MS Office-pakette sowel as kommunikasie- en verslagskryfvaardighede hê.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidate sal hoofsaaklik vereis word om: Te help met die koördinering, bestuur, monitering en evaluering van die toelaes en skenker-gefundeerde projekte. Te help met die opstel van kwartaal- en semesterprestasieverslae oor projekte wat deur toelaes en skenkers gefinansier word. Te help om streng nakoming van verslagdoeningsprosedures van projekte en sperdatums te verseker. Te help met die koördinering, bestuur, monitering en evaluering van die toelaes en skenker-gefundeerde projekte. Administratiewe ondersteuning aan toelaes en ander skenker-gefundeerde projekkomitees vir die na-skoolse sektor te verleen. 'n Databasis oor verskeie projekte te ontwikkel en te onderhou. Projekvoorstelle te evalueer en besigheidsplanne te beoordeel vir die effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van projekfondse. Die skakeling met verskillende belanghebbendes van die DHET op die vereiste vlak te bestuur. Ander pligte uit te voer wat van tyd tot tyd deur die Direktoraat gedelegeer word. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Omkhindi Oholiswayo: Ukusekela Imibhalo Yezimali Ezinikezwa Abanikeli
zu.summary: Kudingeka Omkhindi Oholiswayo ePretoria ukuba ahlole, aphathe futhi alinganise imibhalo yezimali nezinhlelo ezixhaswa ngabanikeli ngaphakathi kweNyuve yoMfundo ePhakeme nokuqeqesha.

Isiqu esifanele sokuthuthukiswa kwezifundo ngeke sibe lusizo kuphela kodwa futhi sibe nomoya wokuzinaka, usebenze ngokusebenza kahle ongakhoni ukusebenza eqenjini elihlukahlukene. Asize ekubhaleni imibiko yokusebenza kwesikhashana yenyanga ezintathu ngeminye yonke mayelana nezinhlelo ezixhaswa ngemibhalo yezimali nabanikeli. Asize ekuqinisekiseni ukubambelela okuqinileyo kumadelu amabhalo wezinhlelo nasezinsukwini zokuvala. Asize ekuphathweni, ekulawulweni, ekugadweni nasekuhloleni imibhalo yezimali nezinhlelo ezixhaswa ngabanikeli. Anike isixhaso esibhalweni semibhalo yezimali namakomidi ezinye izinhlelo ezixhaswa ngabanikeli mayelana nendawo yokufunda okuhamba esikhathini. Athuthukise futhi agcine isizathu sedatha ngezinhlelo ezahlukene. Ahlole izindlu ezinikezelwayo ezinhlelo futhi athathelele eNkundleni Yezimabhizinisi ekuqinisekiseni ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwezimali zezinhlelo. Aphathe ukuxhumana namabalabala ahlukene be-DHET kulinganiso elidingekayo. Azenze eminye imisebenzi enikelwe kuye ngesikhathi esibhalweni ngaphakathi kweDirectorate. Qaphela. Bonke abafakiwe ohlwini abafushane bazodinga ukuqedza isivivinyo sobuchule esihlobene.

zu.title: Umsizi Weqonga: Ukuqondiswa kwamababe bushelelezi nokuqashwa kwabantu
zu.summary: Umsizi Weqonga wokuqondiswa kwamababe bushelelezi eCape Town, ongqondiswa kokuqondiswa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi, izimo zokusebenza, kanye noqeqesho phakathi kwesigaba semfundo ephakeme.
zu.requirements: I-degree / Isidiploma sikaZwelonke kokuqondiswa kwamababe bushelelezi noma isibuyekezo esifana naleso ku-NQF Level 6. Amashumi amathathu (3) kuya kwamahlanu (5) unyaka wonyaka olusemthethweni weqonga lokuqondiswa kwamababe bushelelezi. Ukuqonda okuhle nokukuqonda isistimu ye-PERSAL. Ukuqonda okuhle nokukuqonda imithetho elawula isigaba se-TVET kufaka phakathi njengoko kunjalo i-CET Act njll. Ukuqonda okuhle nokutolika imithetho ye Public Service: public Service Act, Public service Regulations, Labour Relation Act, Basic Condition of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act, Skills Development Act, Skills Development Levies Act kanye nemithetho ephathelene ne-HR. Ulwazi nokuqonda okuqondene nokuqondiswa kwamababe bushelelezi, ukulawula nokuqeqesha izinqubo. Amakhono alawulayo amahle, amakhono okubhala umbiko amahle, amakhono okucwaninga angqondo amahle, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu amahle, amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela kahle, amakhono obuqhawe, amakhono okubonisa, kanye namakhono okuqeqesha. Ukuqonda ngokweqile izicomputha. Kudingeka ukuthi ube nelayisense yokushayela osemthethweni.
zu.duties: Qondisa izinkonzo zokuqondiswa kwamababe bushelelezi nokuqondiswa - Nikeza izimo zokusebenza (Ukhalazo, Izindlu, Izokwelapha, Ilima emsebenzini, Ukumanywa kokusebenza isikhathi eside, ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi, ukushintsha indawo, izimpenshi, ukudluliselwa, izimali ezongeziwe njll); Qondisa izinqubo zokwazisa nokukhetha njengoko kuhambisana nezigaba zomnyango (ukwazisa, ukukhetha abafakiwe, imibuzo yokuxoxisana, ukuhlolwa kwezokuvikela, ukuhlolwa kwamakhono, ukuhlola inkomba, ukuqinisekisa iziqu) zihlelhwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esihleliwe; Ukuqondiswa kwamarekhodi abasebenzi be-HR. Qondisa izinkonzo zokuqondiswa kwamababe bushelelezi - Nikeza ukulawula izibhasidi; Nikeza isikhathi sokusebenza njengomfundi kanye nokufunda okuhlotshanisiwe nomsebenzi (WIL); Qeqesha abasebenzi abasha; Hlanganisa futhi uqeqeshe izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa. Qamba futhi usebenzise i-Workplace Skills Plan (WSP); Ukulawula i-Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) kanye ne-Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS). Hlanganisa futhi uqeqeshe izinkonzo zokuqondiswa kwezinhlangano - Hlanganisa futhi uqeqeshe izinkonzo zezinhlangano ngokuqamba, ukubuyekeza nokusebenzisa isakhiwo sesifunda; Qeqesha ukwakhiwa kwezinkomba zemisebenzi; Hlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yamaphosti/umsebenzi futhi uthumele eNhlokweni YoMnyango; Yenza ucwaningo lwemisebenzi nokwakhiwa kabusha kwenqubo yomsebenzi; Qeqesha ukuphathwa koshintsho nokuqondiswa koshintsho kwezinhlangano. Hlanganisa futhi uqeqeshe izinkonzo zokuqondiswa kwamababe bushelelezi (HRP) kanye nokulingana kokusetshenziswa (EE) - Hlanganisa, qamba, buyekeza, sebenzisa futhi ulawule ipleni ye-HR ye-Regional Office, yakha; Nikeza umbiko ngeplenii ye-HR ne-EE ukuze ulawule izakhiwo ezifanele. Siza ekwakheni nokusebenziseni izinqubo kanye nemiyalo ye-HR. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi. Yenza omunye umsebenzi onikelwe nguMphathi. QAPHELA. Bonke abafakiwe abakhethiwe bazodingeka ukuba bagcwalise isipeshiyela esifanele sokuhlola amakhono.

xh.title: Umphathi ongancedwa: Ukuqonda nokulawula Abasebenzi
xh.summary: Umphathi ongancedwa woLawulo loBasebenzi abantu eCape Town, ongenisa ulawulo lwe-HR, iimeko zenkonzo, kunye nokubhalisa kwabasebenzi kwicala lemfundo ephakamileyo.
xh.requirements: I-Degree / Isidanga sesizwe kwi-Human Resources Management okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF Level 6. Iyahoba iminyaka elithoba (3) ukuya kuthi kngamashumi amahlanu (5) yamava okulawula kwiliso le-Human Resource Management. Ulwazi oluhle nokuyiqonda inkonzo ye-PERSAL system. Ulwazi oluhle nokuyiqonda ngeemithetho elawula isithuba se-TVET kubandakanya phakathi kwezinye i-CET Act njl. Ukuqonda okuhle nokutolika iimithetho ye-PERSAL system: public Service Act, Public service Regulations, Labour Relation Act, Basic Condition of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act, Skills Development Act, Skills Development Levies Act kunye ne-HR Related Prescripts. Ulwazi nokuQonda iinkqubo zenkonzo zokuqondisa nokulawula basebenzi. Ikhono elihle lokulawula, ikhono elihle lokubhala iingxelo, ikhono elihle lokuphandangqondo, ikhono elihle lonxibelelwano nakubantu, ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuqamba, ikhono lokuba ngumlawuli, ikhono lokubonisa, nokuyalela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngaphezulu kweqondo. Kufuneka kube khona ilayisenisi yokushukuma.
xh.duties: Qondisa iinkonzo zoLawulo nabasebenzi - Yenza iinkonzo ngeendlela zenkonzo (I-Leave, Housing, Medical, Injury on duty, Long service recognition, overtime, relocation, pensions, transfers, allowances njl); Qondisa iinkqubo zokubhalisa nokukhetha njengoko kugqitywe ngaphakathi kwisebe (advert), shortlisting, interviews, security vetting, competency test, reference check, verification of qualifications) ngokwexesha elichaziweyo); Ukuqonda nokuqonda iirekhodi zabasebenzi be-HR. Qondisa iinkonzo zophuhliso lwabasebenzi - Yenza ulawulo lwe-Bursaries; Yenza u-Internship Work Integrated Learning (WIL); Qonda abasebenzi basebenza; Qondisa nokuyalela iinkqubo zolwazi. Phuhlisa kwakhona inkqubo yamakhono asebenzayo (WSP); Ulawulo lweenkqubo zokwenza nokuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi (PMDS) nentsimo ephakathi yemfuno (IQMS). Qondisa nokuyalela ukwakha kabusha kwarsebe, iinkonzo - Qondisa nokuyalela iinkonzo zohlengahlengiso lwebhunga ngokwakha, ukujonga kwakhona nokusebenzisa isakhiwo seNgingqi; Yenza okwenze ukubhaliswa kweekomwe kobume bobusebenzi; Qondisa ukuqondiswa kobume bobusebenzi kumagatya/omsebenzi kwaye usinike iNtloko; Yenza ukufunda nomsebenzi oqhuba kabusha iinkqubo; Yenza ulawulo lwangoku nokuqamba kabusha kolwazi. Qondisa nokuyalela iinkonzo zoLawulo lwabasebenzi kwaye (HRP) Employment Equity (EE) - Qondisa, phuhlisa, jonga, usebenzise kwaye ulawule iNjingqi yamaphandle i-HR plan, phuhlisa; Yaza ingxelo nge-HR EE iindlela ezahlukeneyo.uncedo usile ekuqondeni ukulawula abasebenzi kwakunye nokuqonda abasebenzi - Nceda ekuyileni nasekusebenziseni iinkqubo zokulawula abasebenzi. Ulawulo lwabasebenzi. Yenza naye eminye imisebenzi enikiweyo lulawuli. N.B. Onke amagatya okhethiweyo aya kufuneka aqedele isikhathi sokuzama ikhono.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Performance Management
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to coordinate performance management systems for CET and TVET lecturers within the Department of Higher Education and Training.
jobs.requirements: NQF Level 6 qualification in Human Resources Management / Public or Management/Human Resource Development as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) to Five (5) years relevant experience in PMDS environment of which 3 years should be at the supervisory level. A post degree qualification on the above will be an added advantage. PERSAL Certificate and knowledge will be an advantage. Proven Computer Literacy. In-depth understanding of the legislative framework that governs the Public Service Understanding and application of the following prescripts: PSR, PSA, EEA, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Treasury & DPSA Circulars, Educators and DPSA Legislation Frameworks, Chapter 4, SMS Handbook. Understanding of HRM best practices. Good communication skills (written and verbal skills) and a good command of English language. Strong analytical skills. Must be computer literate in MS Office. Ability to operate under pressure and willingness to work extended hours as and when required. Willingness to travel. Planning and organizing skills. Adaptive to situations Knowledge of the Education Sector will be an added advantage. Presentation and report writing skills. Ability to function without supervision and work under pressure. Team Leadership and people management skills. A valid driver’s license required.
jobs.duties: Coordinate performance contracting and compliance. Coordinate and implement performance assessment, performance monitoring, and Moderations. Coordinate the development and implementation of performance management for CET and TVET Lecturers. Provide support on the implementation of the online performance management system. Coordinate the implementation of performance management outcomes. Develop Annual Operational Plans (AOP). Analyze the performance management trends and reports. Provide technical support on Performance management and moderations. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from the manager. Write and quality assurance submissions. Manage the PMDS online system. Handle grievances, disagreements, and disputes related to performance management. Ensure timeously development and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all subordinates. Conduct and facilitate the validation process. Conduct moderations of all employees across the Department. Coordinate the implementation of performance incentives. Conduct and coordinate PMDS workshops and Training. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential, provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure management, maintenance, and safekeeping of assets. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity.One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.“DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Prestasiebestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur benodig om prestasiebestuurstelsels vir CET- en TVET-dosente binne die Department of Higher Education and Training te koördineer.
af.requirements: NQF Level 6-kwalifikasie in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Publieke of Bestuursontwikkeling/Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) tot Vyf (5) jaar relevante ervaring in 'n PMDS-omgewing waarvan 3 jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in bogenoemde sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. PERSAL-sertifikaat en kennis sal 'n voordeel wees. Bewysrekenaargeletterdheid. Diepgaande begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Begrip en toepassing van die volgende voorskrifte: PSR, PSA, EEA, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Treasury & DPSA Circulars, Educators and DPSA Legislation Frameworks, Chapter 4, SMS Handbook. Begrip van HRM-bestuurspraktyke. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (geskrewe en mondelinge vaardighede) en 'n goeie beheer van die Engelse taal. Sterke analitiese vaardighede. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees in MS Office. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk soos en wanneer benodig. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Aanpasbaar by situasies. Kennis van die Onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Voorlegging- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Vermoë om sonder toesig te funksioneer en onder druk te werk. Spanleierskap en mensebestuursvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Koördineer prestasiekontraktering en nakoming. Koördineer en implementeer prestasieassessering, prestasiemonitoring en moderasies. Koördineer die ontwikkeling en implementering van prestasiebestuur vir CET- en TVET-dosente. Verskaf ondersteuning met die implementering van die aanlyn prestasiebestuurstelsel. Koördineer die implementering van prestasiebestuursuitkomste. Ontwikkel Jaarlikse Operasionele Planne (AOP). Analiseer die prestasiebestuurstendense en verslae. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning oor prestasiebestuur en moderasies. Los probleme van motivering en beheer met minimale leiding van die bestuurder op. Skryf en verseker gehalte van voorleggings. Bestuur die PMDS-aanlynstelsel. Hanteer griewe, meningsverskille en geskille wat verband hou met prestasiebestuur. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling en implementering van Werksplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle ondergeskiktes. Voer uit en fasiliteer die validasieproses. Voer moderasies van alle werknemers oor die departement uit. Koördineer die implementering van prestasie-aansporings. Voer uit en koördineer PMDS-werkswinkels en opleiding. Bestuur daaglikse werknemerprestasie en verseker tydige prestasieassesserings van alle ondergeskiktes. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Verseker bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van bates. N.B. Alle gekortelysde kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Umphathi Osekela: Ukuphatha Ukusebenza
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi ongesikhundla ukuthi ahlanganise izinhlelo zokuphatha ukusebenza kubafundisi be-CET ne-TVET ngaphakathi komnyango we-Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezilingana nezinga le-NQF 6 kwi-Human Resources Management / Public or Management / Human Resource Development njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA. Ukuba namava eminyaka eyi-Three (3) kuya kwey-Five (5) ekuphatheni izinto ezihlobene nendawo ye-PMDS, okuyona iminyaka eyi-3 kufanele ibe ngazinga lokuba ngumphathi. Ukuba neziqu zesikhundla kuleyo ehambisana naleyo ngenhla kuyoba yinzuzo. Isitifikedi nenolwazi nge-PERSAL kuyoba yinzuzo. Ubuchwepheshe bekhompyutha obubonwayo. Ukuqonda ngokujulile umthetho obeka i-Public Service, nokufunda nokusebenzisa imithetho elandelayo: i-PSR, i-PSA, i-EEA, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Treasury & DPSA Circulars, i-Educators and DPSA Legislation Frameworks, isahluko 4, i-SMS Handbook. Ukuqonda okungcono ngendlela yokwenza izinto kwe-HRM. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunywa), nenkululeko enhle kolimi lwesiNgisi. Amakhono okuhlaziya amancane. Kumelwe ukuze akwazi ukusebenzisa i-MS Office. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphezulu kobungqingili nelunga lokusebenza amasikhathi anwetshiwe lapho kudingeka khona. Ubulunge bokuhamba. Amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlole. Ukubumbene kwezimo. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuqeqesha kuzoba yinzuzo. Amakhono okwethula nokubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphandle komphathi nokusebenza phansi kobunzima. Ukuba ngumholi wethimba nokuphatha abantu. Isivumelwano sokushayela esisemthethweni sidingekayo.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa amasivumelwano okusebenza nokuhambisana nomthetho. Hlanganisa futhi usebenzise ukuhlola ukusebenza, ukugcina isikhathi esifanele sokusebenza, kanye nokulinganiswa. Hlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusebenziswa kwenkqubo yokuphatha ukusebenza kubafundisi be-CET kanye nabesimenyu se-TVET. Nikeza inkxaso ekusebenziseni inkqubo yokuphatha ukusebenza ku-inthanethi. Hlanganisa ukusebenziswa kwezomphumela wokuphatha ukusebenza. Thuthukisa Izinhlelo Zokusebenza Zonyaka (AOP). Hlaziya ukuthi kuphatha ukusebenza kuhamba kanjani kanye nemibiko. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekuphatheni ukusebenza nasekulinganisweni. Nxiba izinkinga zokweseka nokulawula ngokusondela okuncane kumphathi. Bhala futhi wenze isiqiniseko sokhuni kwemibiko ethunyelwe. Phatha inkqabo ye-PMDS ku-inthanethi. Phatha izikhalazo, ukungavumelani, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nokuphatha ukusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi esifanele nokusebenziswa kwezinhlela zokusebenza kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa komuntu siqu (PDP's) kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Yenza futhi uhlole inqubo yokuqinisekisa. Yenza ukulinganiswa kubo bonke abasebenzi kulo lonke umnyango. Hlanganisa ukusebenziswa kwezibuyiso eziyisibonezela ekusebenzeni kahle. Yenza futhi uhlanganise amaseminari a-PMDS kanye noQeqesho. Phatha ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwabasebenzi bese uqinisekisa ukuhlola ukusebenza kwesikhathi esifanele kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Inqabela imisebenzi abasebenzini ngokwamandla komuntu ngamunye, unikeze isiqondiso nesinxaso esidingekayo bese unikeza abasebenzi amathuba okuqeqeshwa nokuthuthuka. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa, nokuphephwa kwezimpahla. Qaphela: Bonke abantu abakwiqhaza abakaqinisekiswa kulindeleke ukuthi bagcwalise isivivinyo sekhono esimayelana nalokho.

xh.title: uMlawuli oncedayo: uLawulo lokuSebenza
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMlawuli oncedayo ahlanganise inkqubo yolawulo lokusebenza kubafundisi be-CET nabe-TVET ngaphakathi kwesebe leHigher Education and Training.
xh.requirements: Isifanekiso senqanaba le-6 se-NQF kwizifundo zoLawulo lweZemisebenzi nabantu / Kurhulumente okanye uPhuhliso/Intshukubo yemisebenzi njengoko ivunywe ngummandla we-SAQA. Iiminyaka elithoba (3) ukuya kwelishlanu (5) yamava ahambelanayo kwindawo ye-PMDS apho iminyaka elithoba kufuneka iliyifunde kwindawo yolawulo. Isifanekiso sokuqhuma kwelona xesha lokuqhuma ingowona mexenxa. I satifikethi ye-PERSAL kunye nolwazi nge-PERSAL kuyobe kungummandla ophumelelayo. Ukuba ulwazi lwekhompyutha olubonakalayo. Ukuqonda ngokucacileyo ngokobuMthetho ongumthetho ophatha iNkonzo yaRulumende. Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa ezi mithetho ilandelayo: i-PSR, i-PSA, i-EEA, iMithetho yoLawulo loMali kaRulumende, iMithetho yeQelashe, iZaziso zeQelashe ne-DPSA, iNkqubo yoMthetho yeZemfundo kunye noGciselwa lwe-DPSA, iNqaku lesi-4, iNcwadi yesandulela se-SMS. Ukuqonda iindlela ezilungileyo ze-HRM. Amaphupha amnandi (umbhalo nolwimi) kunye nokuchaneka kolwimi lwesiNgesi. Ikhono elikhulu lokuqwalasela. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-MS Office. Ik ... elokuqhuba phantsi kwexinzelelo kwaye ufuna ukusebenza iiyure ezinde xa kufuneka. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba. Ikhono locwangciso loluhlelo. Ukuziphumeza kumemo. Ulwazi ngeQela leZemfundo kuyobe kungumnikezelo ophumelelayo. Ikhono lokubonakalisa kunye nokuqwalasela iimveliso. Ikhono elikhulu lokusebenza ngaphandle kolawulo nangaphantsi kweenkxwalo. Ikhono lokulawula iqela labasebenzi. Ifayithekhesi esebenzayo yomqhubi iyafuneka.
xh.duties: Qhellanisa iiynkcazelo ezimali nento nengqwalasela. Qhellanisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuqwalasela ukusebenza, ukwengqwalasela ukusebenza, kunye noQwalaselo. Linganisela iinkqubo zophuhliso nokusebenzisa inkqubo yolawulo lokusebenza kubafundisi be-CET nabe-TVET. Zisa inkxaso ekusebenziseni inkqubo yolawulo lokusebenza online. Qhellanisa ukusebenzisa iziphumo zolawulo lokusebenza. Phuhlisa iCwangciso loNyaka loMsebenzi (AOP). Hlola iintshukumo neemveliso zelawulo lokusebenza. Zisa inkxaso yobugcisa kuLawulo lokusebenza nokuQwalasela. Solula iingxaki zokukhuthaza nolawulo ngolawulo oluncinci ovela kumlawuli. Bhala kwakhona ucwangcise ngomgangatho iinkqubo ezithunyelwayo. Lawula inkqubo ye-PMDS kwi-intanethi. Phatha iingxaki, iingxabano, neentabano ezidityaniswa nolawulo lokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho phuhliso nokuSetyenziswa kwesiXa seMisebenzi neeNkqubo zoPhuhliso loBuqu (PDPs) zoWonke wonke abasebenzi abangaphantsi. Qhube futhi usebenzise inkqubo yoqinisekiso. Qhelanisa ukuqwalaselwa kwawo onke amasebenzi kulo lonke iSebe. Qhellanisa ukusebenzisa izibonelelo zokusebenza. Qhube uphinde uqhellanise amasebe e-PMDS nakwiNqaku. Lawula ukusebenza kwangemini kbasebenzi uqinisekise ukuba kuqwalaselwa ngexesha ukusebenza kwawo onke amacebo abasebenzi abangaphantsi. Yabelise imisebenzi kubasebenzi ngokwamandla abanawo, nikezela inkxaso efunekayo uze unike abantu abasebenzayo ithuba lokuzilolonga nokuziphuhlisa. Qinisekisa ukulawula, ukugcina, nokukhusela okwenzelwe ukusetyenziswa koluntu. Qaphela. Bonke abafakiswe kwindlela yokhetho lokuqala baya kufuneka bagqibeze imiddavo yokulinganisa amandla.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Arbeidsverhoudinge
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur Arbeidsverhoudinge by Buffalo City TVET College, wat 'n graad of diploma in Arbeidsverhoudinge vereis en vyf jaar se tersaaklike ondervinding, waarvan drie jaar toesighoudend is.
af.requirements: Matriek of NCV Level 4 met 'n erkende M+3 jaar graad of Nasionale Diploma in Arbeidsverhoudinge, Arbeidsbetrekkinge of Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie ;5 jaar in 'n Arbeidsverhoudinge- of Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing of verwante veld , waarvan 3 jaar toesighoudende ondervinding in die tersaaklike veld in 'n Arbeidsverhoudinge- of Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing of verwante veld moet wees; Kennis van beleide en die bestuursomgewing van TVET Colleges, insluitend kennis van die jaarlikse verslagdoeningsvereistes; Kennis van die Labour Relations Act, Openbare Dienswetgewing en beleide verwant aan Menslike Hulpbronbestuur; Deeglike kennis van Arbeidsverhoudingewetgewing; Deeglike kennis van die International Labour Organisation (ILO); Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie; Kennis van PERSAL.
af.duties: Onderhou goeie Arbeidsverhoudinge: Verskaf advies oor arbeidsverwante aangeleenthede, ontwikkel en implementeer Menslike Hulpbronbeleid en -handleidings; Verseker behoorlike implementering van dissiplinêre prosedures, klagteprosedures en gedragskode; Voer ondersoeke en dissiplinêre verhore uit; Bestuur van staksiwering; Minimeer Arbeidsgeskille; Fasiliteer en voer arbeidsverhouding-opleiding en -werkswinkels uit; Verseker behoorlike implementering van die resolusie van die kollektiewe bedingingsraad; Bestuur van alle Menslike, Finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid.

zu.title: Onqumanqamu: Izinselele Zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Onqumanqamu Wezinselele Zabasebenzi e-Buffalo City TVET College, ofuna ibhitshe noma idiploma kwezinselele zabasebenzi nahlelo oluneminyaka emihlanu yohluvo oluhambisana nalokhu okubandakanya iminyaka emithathu lokubukeka.
zu.requirements: Ibhidishi yamabanga aphakeme noma i-NCV Level 4 nge-Degree evela kusimiso esiqinisekisiweko samaminyaka mithathu noma i-National Diploma kwezinselele zabasebenzi, izinselele zomsebenzi noma izintloko zabantu noma isitifiketi esihlobene nalokhu ;iminyaka emihlanu kwesigaba sezokusebenza noma kwesigaba sezintloko zabantu noma esikweni esihlobene nalokhu , okubandakanya iminyaka emithathu kumele ibe yohluvo lokubukeka esikweni esihlobene nalokhu kwesigaba sezokusebenza noma kwesigaba sezintloko zabantu noma esikweni esihlobene nalokhu; ulwazi lwezinqungwana namandla weziko lezi-TVET Colleges okubandakanya ulwazi lwezidingo ezivela kwindabe yokubika ngomnyaka; ulwazi lwe-Labour Relations Act, amagazethi namapholisi we-Public Services ahlobene nokupathwa kwezintloko zabantu; ulwazi olujulileko ngesifanekiso sezokusebenza kwezinselele zabasebenzi; ulwazi olujulileko nge-International Labour Organisation (ILO); ulwazi nokuqonda i-TVET/CET Administration; ulwazi lwe-PERSAL.
zu.duties: Gcina izinselele zabasebenzi ezinzile: Nikeza iseluleko ngemithwalo ehlobene nabasebenzi, tota nokwenza amapholisi namakhonkco ezintloko zabantu; qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufaneleko kwamasu okuhlukunywa, kwamasu okuzwelana kanye newadi yokuziphatha; yenza uphenyo nezinkululeko zokuhlukunywa; kuphathwa kwezinyunyana zokushibha; nciphisa iimfayisano zabasebenzi; sitsha futhi ubeke izifundo nezikolo zezinselele zabasebenzi; qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufaneleko kwesinqumo sekhansili yokuxoxisana ngamaholo; kuphathwa kwezontlu zabantu, ezeimali namanye amaphuzu leyo yuniti.

xh.title: I-Assistant Director: Labour Relations

xh.requirements: I-Matric okanye i-NCV Level 4 kunye ne-Degree evunyiweyo ye-M+3 years okanye i-National Diploma kwi-Labour Relations, i-Employment Relations okanye i-Human Resource Management okanye ngesiqhinga esinxulumene nalo; Iminyaka emi-5 kwindawo ye-Labour Relations okanye ye-Human Resource Management okanye kwicala elinxulumene nalo, apho iminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe ngumgoqo wobugcisa bokulawula kwicala elinxulumene nalo kwindawo ye-Labour Relations okanye ye-Human Resource Management okanye kwicala elinxulumene nalo; Ukwazi ngeenkqubo nommelwane wolawulo we-TVET Colleges kuquka nokwazi ngeemfuno zexesha lemiko yomyalezo wonyaka; Ukwazi ngoMthetho we-Labour Relations Act, umthetho weenkonzo zikawonke wonke kunye neenkqubo ezinxulumene noLawulo lwabantu; Ukuqonda okuqinileyo kwemithetho ye-Labour Relation; Ukuqonda okuqinileyo nge-International Labour Organisation (ILO); Ukwazi ukuqonda i-TVET/CET Administration; Ukwazi nge-PERSAL.
xh.duties: Ukugcina iziqinisekileyo ezilungileyo kwiQondo loBuse baseBesebenzi: Nika inkcazelo ngemiba ehlobene nobuse basebsebenzi, Yakha uze usebenzise iinqobo zomsebenzi namagqabantshintshi kuLawulo lwabantu; Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngendlela efaneleyo kweenqubo zolwahlanyezo, iinqubo zeengxabano kunye nekhowudi yokuziphatha; Yenza iingxoxo ezijoliswe kuqondiso neenguqu ezingundoqwane kulwahlanyezo; Ulawulo lwenzo yokubambelela ekuhoyeni umsebenzi; Nciphisa iingxaki zobuse basebsebenzi; Qhuba ize wenze iimfundo kunye neendibano zobuse basebsebenzi; Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kwezigqibo zeengcungcuthelo zamalungiselelo; ULawulo lonke lwabantu, lemali kunye namanye amacebo aloo candelo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Facilities & Record Management
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Oversee facilities, maintenance, SHERQ compliance, fleet and records management at Buffalo City TVET College.
jobs.requirements: Matric or NCV Level 4 with a recognized M+3 years Degree or National Diploma in Building Management/Safety Management or Construction Management or relevant equivalent qualification; 5 years’ experience in a Facilities Management, SHERQ and OHS Environment; in which 3 years must be supervisory experience in a Facilities Management, SHERQ, Construction Management and OHS Environment; Knowledge of Public Service Act and Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, immovable Assest Management Act, Telephone Management System, fire control system and facilities management system; Knowledge of Occupational Health & Safety Act 85 of 1993 and related Regulations.
jobs.duties: Oversee maintenance of buildings and premises; Ensure compliance to SHERQ and OHS Act; Oversee fleet management; Maintain the physical security functions including key control, personnel, document and surveillance security; Records management; Management of all Human, Financial and other resources of the unit.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Lulama Jongidiza Tel No: (043) 880 0177, Ext 2250
jobs.applications: Buffalo City TVET College, HR Division, Private Bag 9016, East London, 5200 or deliver it to the Administration Centre, corner of Lukin Road and King Street, Selborne, East London, email: hr2026@bccollege.co.za
jobs.notes: All applications must be submitted on the new approved Z83 Application form (dated January 2021) obtainable from the DPSA website. The new Z83 Application form must be accompanied by a detailed recently updated comprehensive CV with three (3) contactable references (provide their contact number and email addresses), Driver’s license, ID copies and Qualifications copies, such copies need not to be certified when applying for a post. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted to submit the required certified documents. Incomplete applications or applications received after the closing date will not be considered. A complete set of application documents should be submitted separately for every post you wish to apply for. Applicants with foreign qualifications would be required to submit an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification (SAQA) on or before the day of the interview. The College reserves the right to withdraw the post at any time. Communication will only be entered into with the shortlisted and successfully candidates. All shortlisted candidates may be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship and qualification verification). The suitable candidates will be required to annually disclose their financial interests and declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. People living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. All applicants must consider their applications to be unsuccessful if not contacted within 60 days after the closing date.

Khuthaza imeko yomsebenzi ephilayo nakhuselekileyo kuzo zonke iindawo. Lawula ukucinga ngokulinganisela iingozi zeempilo nakhuselo olusebenzayo ngokutyelela zonke iindawo ukuze kujongwe rhoqo. Nikela ingcebiso ngokwempilo nakhuselo olusebenzayo. Thobela iinkqubo namagunya e-DHET nakwisiKholeji.

jobs.title: Senior Practitioner: Performance Management
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Senior practitioner role in performance management requiring an NQF Level 6 qualification and 3-5 years' HR experience, including supervisory experience, for the Department of Higher Education and Training in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: NQF Level 6 qualification in Human Resources Management / Public or Management/Human Resource Development as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) to five (5) years’ experience working in the relevant area of which 3 years must be at the supervisory level. A post degree qualification on the above will be an added advantage. Valid driver’s license Code 8. PERSAL Certificate and knowledge will be an advantage. Proven Computer Literacy. In-depth understanding of the legislative framework that governs the Public Service Understanding and application of the following prescripts: PSR, PSA, EEA, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury regulations, Treasury & DPSA Circulars, Educators and DPSA Legislation Frameworks, Chapter 4, SMS Handbook. Understanding of HRM best practices. Good communication skills (written and verbal skills) and a good command of English language. Strong analytical skills. Must be computer literate in MS Office. Ability to operate under pressure and willingness to work extended hours as and when required. Willingness to travel. Planning and organizing skills. Adaptive to situations Knowledge of the Education Sector will be an added advantage. Presentation and report writing skills. Ability to function without supervision, and work under pressure. Team Leadership and people management skills.
jobs.duties: Provide administration and the implementation of Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS) and Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) processes; Monitor the implementation of IQMS and the PMDS policy frameworks. Coordinate the implementation and monitoring of performance management, Coordinate the submission of performance agreements. Coordinate the submission of mid-term and annual reviews. Quality assurance Performance Management and Development System (PMDS) documents before authorising on PERSAL. Ensure that PMDS status is updated. Arrange assessment committee meetings and provide secretariat support. Compile minutes and draft letter for signatures of moderating committee chairperson. Inform employees (in writings) about outcomes of assessment committees. Arrange meetings to discuss dissatisfaction cases. Implement performances incentives on PERSAL. Ensure correctness of service records of employees after payment of pay progressions. Compile database of Personal Development Plan (PDPs). Check and advise on submissions of employees requiring training. Coordinate provincial training and development activities. Handle grievances, disagreements, and disputes related to performance management. Ensure timeously development and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all subordinates. Facilitate the validation process. Facilitate moderations of all employees across the Department. Facilitate the implementation of performance incentives. Facilitate and coordinate PMDS workshops and Training. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389

jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. af.title: Senior Praktisyn: Prestasiebestuur
af.summary: Senior praktisynrol in prestasiebestuur wat 'n NQF Vlak 6-kwalifikasie en 3-5 jaar se HR-ervaring, insluitend toesigervaring, vereis, vir die Department of Higher Education and Training in Pretoria.
af.requirements: NQF Level 6-kwalifikasie in Human Resources Management / Public or Management/Human Resource Development soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die betrokke gebied waarvan 3 jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in bogenoemde sal 'n voordeel wees. Geldige bestuurslisensie Code 8. PERSAL-sertifikaat en -kennis sal 'n voordeel wees. Bewese rekenaarvaardigheid. Diepgaande begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Begrip en toepassing van die volgende voorskrifte: PSR, PSA, EEA, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury regulations, Treasury & DPSA Circulars, Educators and DPSA Legislation Frameworks, Chapter 4, SMS Handbook. Begrip van HRM-bestuurpraktyke. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelike en mondelinge vaardighede) en 'n goeie beheer van die Engelse taal. Sterke analitiese vaardighede. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees in MS Office. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en bereidwilligheid om lang ure te werk soos en wanneer nodig. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Aanpasbaar by situasies. Kennis van die onderwyssektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Voorleggings- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Vermoë om sonder toesig te funksioneer en onder druk te werk. Spanleierskap en mensebestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf administrasie en die implementering van Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS) en Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) prosesse; Monitor die implementering van IQMS en die PMDS-beleidsraamwerke. Koördineer die implementering en monitering van prestasiebestuur. Koördineer die indiening van prestasieooreenkomste. Koördineer die indiening van midtermyn- en jaarlikse hersienings. Kwaliteitsverseker Performance Management and Development System (PMDS) dokumente voor magtiging op PERSAL. Verseker dat PMDS-status opgedateer word. Reël assesseringskomiteevergaderings en verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning. Stel notules op en skryf briewe vir handtekeninge van die voorsitter van die modereringskomitee. Stel werknemers (skriftelik) in kennis oor die uitslae van assesseringskomitees. Reël vergaderings om ontevredenheidsake te bespreek. Implementeer prestasie-aansporings op PERSAL. Verseker die korrektheid van diensrekords van werknemers na betaling van salarisvordering. Stel 'n databasis van Personal Development Plan (PDP's) op. Kontroleer en adviseer oor indienings van werknemers wat opleiding benodig. Koördineer provinsiale opleidings- en ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite. Hanteer griewe, meningsverskille en geskille wat verband hou met prestasiebestuur. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling en implementering van Work Plans en Personal Development Plans (PDP's) vir alle ondergeskiktes. Fassiliteer die geldigheidsproses. Fassiliteer moderasies van alle werknemers regdeur die departement. Fassiliteer die implementering van prestasie-aansporings. Fassiliteer en koördineer PMDS-workshops en opleiding. Bestuur daaglikse werknemerprestasie en verseer tydige Prestasie-assesserings van alle ondergeskiktes. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede.

zu.title: Umlawuli ophathe kakhulu ekuphathweni kokuqashwa
zu.summary: Indima yomsebenzi ophathe kakhulu ekuphatweni kokuqashwa, okudinga isiqu se-NQF Level 6 kanye namawonke eminyaka engu-3 kuya kengu-5 ekuqashweni kwabantu, okuhlanganisa nolwazi lokuphatha abanye, owayezoba ngumsebenzisi we-Department of Higher Education and Training ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo eziyisisekelo nokuqashwa: Isidingo seziqu kwe-Masters Degree. Uqeqesho ekuqashweni kwabantu, ekuqashweni kwenzele ezikoleni, ekuqashweni kwamaphoyisa, ekuqashweni kwamasosha, ekuqashweni kwabasebenzi bomphakathi, noma ekuqashweni kwenhlangano ekhethekile. Ukuqonda okuzayo kweziyalo zohlelo lwemfundo eziphakeme kuzohola ekuthuthukisweni okuhle. Ukuze ube ngumuntu ongakwazi ukuqashwa, kudingeka uqeqeshe ekuphatweni kohlelo lokusebenza nasekudayetheni izinto eziyikhono. Ukuqonda okuzayo kweziyalo zohlelo lwezempilo eziphakeme kuzodingeka. Ukuze ube ngumuntu ongakwazi ukuqashwa, kudingeka uqeqeshe ekuphatweni kwezinto ezithile. Iziqu eziphezulu kulezi ezithunywe ngenhla kuzokwengeza inzuzo. Iphasiyense yokushayela ivunyelwe ngekhodi eyi-8. Isitifiketi nesikhathi se-PERSAL kanye nolwazi ngaleyo ndlela kuzokwengeza inzuzo. Ukuqonda okuzayo kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi nokuzinza. Ukucabanga okubanzi, ukuhweba kalula, isibindi nokuzuza okuthile. Ukuze ube ngumuntu ongakwazi ukuqashwa, kuzodingeka ukwazi ukulawula izinto ezehla kanye nokuvuselela izindaba ezinobudala. Ukucabanga ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuze uqonde ukuthi kuzokwenzenjani. Ukuze ube ngumuntu ongakwazi ukuqashwa, uzodingeka ukwazi ukuhamba. Ukwazi ukuhlanganisa izinto ukwenze zisebenze.
zu.duties: Nikela ngengqalaselo yokuqashwa kanye nokuphumeza izinqubo zesistimu yokuphathwa kwekhwalithi ehlanganiswe (IQMS) kanye nesistimu yokuphathwa nentuthuko kokusebenza (PMDS). Qapha ukuphathwa kwezinqambe ezibalulekile ze-IQMS ne-PMDS. Hlanganisa ukuphumeza nokuphatha ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokuhlanganisa ukuhumusha izinkulumo ezimayelana nokusebenza. Hlanganisa ukuhumusha okokubukwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi nenyanga zonke. Qinisekisa izinga lezinkulumo ze-PMDS ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa kwi-PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuthi isimo se-PMDS sibuyekezwe. Lunga amamehlolo abavikeli bese unikeza inkomelo eqinisekisa imibhalo. Hlanganisa izingqinamba ezenziwa ngabaholi bemihlangano eqondiswayo. Yazise abasebenzi (ngokubhaliwe) ngemiphumela yomhlangano wokuhlola. Lunga imihlangano esingxoxweni ngabahole ngezimo ezingathandiwe. Qinisekisa inzuzo yokusebenza kahle ku-PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yesevisi yonke ihloliwe ngemuva kokukhokhelwa. Hlanganisa idatha eyisisekelo yokuqasha abantu abafuna ukuqeqeshwa. Hlola futhi unikeze ngamacebo okuhumusha ngabasebenzi abadinga ukuqeqeshwa. Hlanganisa imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa nokuphathwa kwezemfundo esifundazweni. Phatha izikhalazo, izinkinga nemiphumela engemihle emayelana nokuphathwa kokusebenza kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zomsebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu siqu (PDP's) ngokushesha ukuthi zithuthukiswe futhi zisetshenziswe kulo lonke ihhovisi elikhulu.

xh.title: Omlili Obonakalileyo: Ukulawula Ukusebenza
xh.summary: Indima yomlili obonakalileyo ekulawuleniu ukusebenza efuna ifundo ye-NQF Level 6 namava emisebenzi ye-HR eminyaka 3-5, kuquka namava okulawula, kwisebe le-Department of Higher Education and Training e-Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Ifundo ye-NQF Level 6 kumanKqubo woLawulo lwabantu / Orhole lokuLawula okanye iNkqubo yoLawulo / uPhuhliso lweZisebenzi njengokujululiswa yi-SAQA. Amava eminyaka y Three (3) ukuya kuyi five (5) yokusebenza kwel candelo elinxulumeneyo apho kweminyaka 3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lolawulo. Ifundo yesitegede ngaphezulu koku kuya kuba lumsa ongezelewayo. Ilayisensi yokushaya ibhasi esemthethweni ye-Code 8. Isatifikethi nenkqubo ye-PERSAL kuya kuba lumsa ongezelewayo. Ukuqonda ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha okugqithiswe ngaphaya. Ukuqonda ngokujulileyo isiseko esithetha umthetho esilawula inkonzo kaRhamenthe. Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa e zilandelayo imigaqo: i-PSR, i-PSA, i-EEA, i-Public Finance Management Act, imigaqo ye-Treasury, nama-Circulars e-Treasury & DPSA, uLwazi lwe-Educators noBume bemigaqo ka-DPSA, Isahluko 4, Incwadi yesandule se-SMS. Ukuqonda izenzo ezilungileyo ze-HRM. Amakhono abalulekileyo ekunxibelelaneni (okuqamba kunye nokuthetha) nalawo okusebenzisa ulwimi lwesiNgesi. Amakhono aqondo nzimbulu. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngxama nokuzimisela ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweko xa kufuneka. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba. Amakhono okulungiselela nokuqamba. Ukuvela koluhlu ngeemeko. ulwazi nge candelo lemfundo kuya kuba lumsa ongezelewayo. Amakhono okubetha iinkcukacha nokubhala iingxelo. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphandle kolawulo, nokusebenza ngxama. Amakhono okukhokela iqela nolawulo abantu.
xh.duties: Nikeza ulawulo lenkqubo kwaye iphumeze iinkqubo ze-Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS) kwaye iinkqubo zokuLawula nokuPhuhlisa ukuSebenza (PMDS); Qwalasela ukuphunyezwa kwe-IQMS kunye neenkqubo zomthetho ze-PMDS. Linganisela ukuphunyezwa nokuqwalaselwa kokulawula ukusebenza. Linganisela ukungenisa iisivumelwano zokusebenza. Linganisela ukungenisa iingxelo zangaphakathi kwesiqu nesenyanga. Qinisekisa ubumnond into be Performance Management and Development System (PMDS) e zibe zifunyenwe ngaphambi kokuzemvumela kwi-PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuba isimo se-PMDS sithi hlaziya. Lungiselela iindibano zamaqela okuqwalaselwa kwaye unikeze inkxaso yesikrini. Qamba amaminithi kwaye ulungiselele iileta zokuqinisekisa usayini komlawuli weqela. Yazise abasebenzi (ngokubhalayo) ngeziphumo zamaqela okuqwalaselwa. Lungiselela iindibano zoxoxo lwezimeko ezingavumelani. Phumeza iinkhuthazo zokusebenza kwi-PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwegazati lesixhese sabasebenzi emva koku-hlawuliswa kophuhliso lokuhlawula. Qagqela idatabase yamacebo oPhuhliso oBuntanga (i-PDPs). Khangela kwaye unikeze ingcebiso kungeniso zabantu abafuna uqeqesho. Qhobosela imisebenzi yokuqeqeshelwa nophuhliso kwiphondo. Yenza izikhalazo, iingxaki, neengxabano ezinxulumene nokulawula ukusebenza. Qinisekisa ngexesha elifanelekileyo uphuhliso nokuphunyezwa kweZa milo zezaBantu kwaye amacebo oPhuhliso oBuntanga (PDPs) onke abangaphansi kwawo. Qinisekisa inkqubo yokuqinisekiswa. Qhobosela uqwalaselwa bonke abasebenzi kulo lonke i-Department. Qhobosela ukuphunyezwa kweenkhuthazo zokusebenza. Qhobosela kwaye ulawule iindibano zoqeqesho neze-PMDS. Lawula ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kwaye qinisekisa ukuphunyezwa ngexesha iQwalaselwa lokusebenza lonke ulawulo. Yabelan imisebenzi kubasebenzi ngokusekelwe kwimigononmgama yokuqonda kwabanye bantu, nikeza iinkcukacha ezingcali zokukhokela kwaye uxhase abantu nolawulo ngenkonzo efanileyo yokubanceda.

Ukuqhamba iqoqosho lezabalaseva zobomi nyanga zonke. Ukunceda ekujolweni nokuqwalaselweni kwemigaqo nendlela zezabalaseva zobomi. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthembeka nokuqinisekiswa kolwazi lwesazabalaseva. Nikela inkxaso yamava kukuhamba kwendawo engingqi phantse kubakho imibuzo yezindaba. Unxibelelane nolitha lokusasaza ulwazi aze inzondele iNgingqi, ngokwemiba ethinta iRhulumente. Luka inzondele iNdingqi ngemiba ephantse kweendaba. Lungisa nulolise ukoyila iBali ekhoyo olukhutshwa ngokwemvelo ngakumbi iNgingqi. Nceda uHlaziye uphonononge iimiso. Zonke izabelo ezinika nentshona ngokwemigaqo yengingqi yindawo. Qaphela. Bonke abaKhethwayo baya kufuneka bagqibe isipaqo semisebenzi ekuhambelanayo esingekho kwindawo esemthethweni yokuzama ukukhula ngokomthethweni.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Expenditure Administration
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Senior State Accountant needed in Pretoria to manage expenditure administration, including authorising payments on BAS and LOGIS, requiring a diploma in accounting and government finance experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of an appropriate National Diploma in Accounting / Financial Management or related qualification with accounting as a subject. Two (2) to three (3) years appropriate experience in Government Financial Accounting; the BAS system, knowledge and understanding of the PFMA and Treasury Regulations; knowledge and understanding of the Basic Accounting System (BAS) and the LOGIS online system; good communication (verbal and written) skills; computer literacy; problem-solving skills; planning and organizing skills; analytical skills; liaison skills; client orientation skills; financial management skills; presentation skills; customer care skills. Other Attributes/Skills: Friendly and trustworthy; Accuracy; Confidence; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to work in a team and independently; Assertiveness; and Self-starter. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Checking and authorizing sundry and creditor payments on BAS, which includes the Travel Accounts, Communication Accounts and Courier Accounts. Checking and authorizing order payments on LOGIS online. Capturing payments on BAS. Assist on Audit Queries. Responsible for the managing and clearing of general ledger accounts. Assist with the provision of information for the compilation of the quarterly and annual financial statements with specific reference to general ledger accounts. Authorizing of General Journals applicable to expenditure. Issuing and reconciling interdepartmental claims and claims in respect of the National Skills Fund. Clearing of suspense accounts related to expenditure. Manage and respond to enquiries related to this function. Supervise the work performance of subordinates by inter alia, allocating and controlling work and maintaining office discipline, Requesting of BAS reports when required. Filing of claim related documents. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

af.title: Senior Staatrekenmeester: Uitgawe-administrasie
af.summary: Senior Staatrekenmeester word in Pretoria benodig om uitgawe-administrasie te bestuur, insluitend die magtiging van betalings op BAS en LOGIS, waarvoor 'n diploma in rekenkunde en regeringsfinansies-ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n toepaslike Nasionale Diploma in Rekenkunde / Finansiële Bestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie met rekenkunde as 'n vak. Twee (2) tot drie (3) jaar toepaslike ervaring in Regeringsfinansiële Rekenkunde; die BAS-stelsel, kennis en begrip van die PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies; kennis en begrip van die Basic Accounting System (BAS) en die LOGIS-aanlynstelsel; goeie kommunikasie (mondelinge en skriftelike) vaardighede; rekenaargeletterdheid; probleemoplossingsvaardighede; beplannings- en organisingvaardighede; analitiese vaardighede; skakelvaardighede; kliëntgerigtheidvaardighede; finansiële bestuursvaardighede; aanbiedingsvaardighede; klintesorgvaardighede. Ander eienskappe/vaardighede: Vriendelik en betroubaar; Akkuraatheid; Selfvertroue; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk; Selfstandigheid; en inisiatief. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Kontrole en magtiging van diverse en skuldeiser-betalings op BAS, wat die Reisrekeninge, Kommunikasierekeninge en Koerierrekeninge insluit. Kontrole en magtiging van bestellingsbetalings op LOGIS aanlyn. Vaslegging van betalings op BAS. Bystand met Ouditnavrae. Verantwoordelik vir die bestuur en skoonmaak van algemene grootboekrekeninge. Bystand met die voorsiening van inligting vir die samestelling van die kwartaallikse en jaarlikse finansiële state met spesifieke verwysing na algemene grootboekrekeninge. Magtiging van Algemene Joernale van toepassing op uitgawes. Uitreiking en rekonsiliasie van interdepartementale eise en eise ten opsigte van die National Skills Fund. Skoonmaak van wagrekeninge wat verband hou met uitgawes. Bestuur en reageer op navrae wat verband hou met hierdie funksie. Toesig hou oor die werkprestasie van ondergeskiktes deur onder andere werk toe te ken en te beheer en kantoordissipline te handhaaf. Versoeke van BAS-verslae wanneer benodig. Liasseer van eisverwante dokumente. N.B. Alle kortelys-kandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidsuitoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Senior State Accountant: Expenditure Administration
zu.summary: Kudingwa i-Senior State Accountant ePretoria ukuphatha ukuphathwa kokuchithwa kwemali, okuhlanganisa ukuvuma izinkokhelo kwi-BAS kanye ne-LOGIS, okudinga idiploma kwi-accounting kanye namava ezimali kahulumeni.
zu.requirements: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe ne-National Diploma ehambisana ne-Accounting / Financial Management noma izifundo ezihlobene nalokho ukuthi i-accounting kuyisihloko. Amawaka amabili (2) kuya kwamathathu (3) iminyaka yamava ahambisana ne-Government Financial Accounting; Isistimu ye-BAS, ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA kanye ne-Treasury Regulations; ulwazi nokuqonda i-Basic Accounting System (BAS) kanye ne-LOGIS online system; amakhono okuxhumana okukhulumayo nakokubhaliwe; ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; amakhono okuhlela nokuhlanganisa; amakhono okuhlaziya; amakhono okuxhumana nabantu; amakhono okukhomba iklayenti; amakhono okuphatha izimali; amakhono okubukeka; amakhono okunakekelwa iklayenti. Ezinye izici/Amakhono: Kubemnene futhi ethembekile; Ukuqiniseka; Ukuzethemba; Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokucindezelekile; Ukukwazi ukusebenza eqenjini nokwedwa; Ukuzimisela; kanye Nomsingi weqhaza. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola futhi kuvume izinkokhelo ezingezansi nezinkokhelo zabanikazi bamatemu kwi-BAS, okuhlanganisa ama-akhawunti okuhamba, ama-akhawunti yokuxhumana nama-akhawunti yabathumeli bendawo. Ukuhlola futhi kuvume izinkokhelo zama-oda ku-LOGIS online. Ukungena kwezinkokhelo kwi-BAS. Ukusiza ekupheni imibuzo ye-Audit. Ukwaba ukuphatha nokusula ama-akhawunti ajwayelekile enkosini. Ukusiza ngemininingwane edingekayo ekwakheni izitatimende zezimali ezinyanga ezintathu nezinyanga zonke ngokubheka ngokukhethekile ama-akhawunti ajwayelekile enkosini. Ukuvuma ama-journals ajwayelekile ahambisana nokuchithwa kwemali. Ukukhipha nokuhambisanisa izimango phakathi kweminyango kanye nezimango mayelana ne-National Skills Fund. Ukusula ama-akhawunti okulindile ahambisana nokuchithwa kwemali. Ukuphatha futhi uphendule imibuzo ehlobene nale misebenzi. Ukuqapha ukusebenza kwabaphansi phakathi kokunye, ngokwaba futhi ukulawula umsebenzi kanye nokugcina inqubo yehhovisi, Ukucela imibiko ye-BAS uma kudingeka. Ukugccina izixhumanisi ezihlobene nezimango. Qaphela. Bonke abagqwayizi abakhethiwe bazocelwa ukuba bagcwalise isenzo sokuhlakanipha esifanele.

xh.title: Mphathi weakhawunti zeBhasa: Ulawulo lweendleko
xh.summary: Kufuneka abantu abangagcina iakhawunti zeBhasa ePretoria ukulawula ulawulo lweendleko, kuqala ngokugunyazisa im rheliso yemali kwi-BAS nakwi-LOGIS, kufuna isidanga se-accounting namava kwimali karhulumente.
xh.requirements: Okufuneka kumgangathi wamava ngokuthi abantu abangeneleyo baphathe iNational Diploma kwi-accounting ne-Financial Management okanye izidanga ezinxulumene nayo, ebonisa i-accounting njengento ethile. Amava eminyaka yamashumi amabini (2) ukuya kwamathandathu (3) kwi-accounting yemali yoMbuso; inkqubo ye-BAS, ulwazi nokuqonda ngePFMA kunye noLawulo lweNgcenye ye-National Yemali; ulwazi nokuqonda ngeBAS (Basic Accounting System) nendlela e-online ye-LOGIS; amakhono amaninzi okuvelisa ulwazi, okubhala nokuthetha; amakhono ekhompyutha; amakhono okusombulula iingxaki; amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlanganisa; amakhono othotho; amakhono olwazi; amakhono okuzinika ngomsebenzisi; amakhono ekulawuleni iimali; amakhono okubonisa ulwazi; amakhono enkonzo yabathengi. Amanye amakhono: Ukuba mhle nethembile; Ukuchaneka; Ukuzithemba; Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngx运动会e nkxwelo; Ukukwazi ukusebenza eqabini nangalwendodla; Ukuzimisela nokuziqhoboshela; Ukuziqala ngokwakho. Idrayiva yeliseni esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukuhlola nokugunyazisa im rheliso yemali yezinto ezingafanelekanga nezabatyali-mali kwi-BAS, equka i-Akhawunti Zokuhamba, i-Akhawunti Zoxhumo, kunye ne-Akhawunti Zomthunywa. Ukuhlola nokugunyazisa im rheliso yemali yoku-oda kwi-LOGIS online. Ukufaka im rheliso yemali kwi-BAS. Ukuncedisa kwiMibuzo yeVavanyo. Uxanduva lokulawula nokuqhotshiswa kweekhawunti zeqela eliphambili. Ukuncedisa ngokuvelisa ulwazi oluchazwe ngokudityaniswa kweStatements zemali zenyanga ngezinyanga kunye nezomnyaka ngesalathiso esithile kweekhawunti zeqela eliphambili. Ukugunyazisa amaJournals ajikelezayo echaphazelekayo ekuchithweni kwemali. Ukupapashwa nokulinganisa amangalelo phakathi kweesebe nokulinganisa amangalelo ngokuphathelele iNgeniso leezakhono eZikummandla. Ukuqhotshiswa kweekhawunti ezibambe zeDlu ngokuphathelele ekuchithweni kwemali. Ukulawula uphendulo kumibuzo edibanayo nale nsibayoxabisa. Ukuqonda ngokusebenza okuvela kumagosa asezantsi phantsi ekuthumela nokuqamba isebenza kolungelelwaniso, kwindalo imisebenzi nokulawula iofisi yexesha, ukucela amapepha e-BAS xa kufuneka. Ifayile yolwazi lwamagunya. Qaphela: Wonke amagosa aqukiwe kwalityalwa liya kufuneka aqhubeke nesebenziso lesiphotho.

af.title: Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Pos vir Veiligheidsbeampte by die Limpopo Streekkantoor wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Veiligheidsbestuur en twee tot drie jaar se administratiewe ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Erkende Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Veiligheidsbestuur of verwante kwalifikasie. Minimum van twee (2) tot drie (3) jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n Administrasie-omgewing. Kennis van Openbare Dienst-wetgewing en beleide. Kennis van PSET. Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie. Begrip van die Hoër Onderwys-sektor. Begrip van korporatiewe bestuur. Begrip van Kostesentrum-, begrotings-, bestedings- en kontantvloei-bestuur. Employment Equity Act, Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act, en enige ander verwante wetgewing.
af.duties: Identifiseer potensiële gevare en potensiële groot voorvalle (voer omvattende Gevaaridentifikasie en Risikobevaling by die Streekkantoor op 'n jaarlikse basis uit, reël Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheids- (BGV)-nakomingsoudits deur toepaslike owerhede). Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor die BGV-bestuurstelsel (voer gesondheids- en veiligheidsrisikobevaling in die Streekkantoor se gebou uit, ontwikkel 'n BGV-bestuurstelsel, en verseker doeltreffende instandhouding en diens van alle brandblustoerusting). Ondersteun CET- en TVET-kolleges deur BGV-verwante opleiding en deurlopende opvoedkundige programme te koördineer (reël en verskaf BGV-oriëntering aan nuwe werknemers en deurlopende bewustheids- en opvoedkundige programme aan alle personeellede). Ondersteun die Streekdirektorate met die monitering van BGV-nakoming in die Kolleges. Ontwikkel intervensiestrategieë wanneer nodig. Bestuur menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne in die eenheid (bestuur Menslike hulpbronne in die eenheid, evalueer die prestasie van personeel). N.B. zu.title: Safety Officer
zu.summary: Isikhundla seSafety Officer eLimpopo Regional Office esidinga iNational Diploma kuSafety Management kanye namava eminyaka emibili kuya kweyisithathu wobuphathi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeNational Diploma (NQF 6) ezingunobumba ohlonzwe eSafety Management noma esinye isiqu esihlobene nalokho. Okungenani okuphambili kweminyaka emibili (2) kuye kweyisithathu (3) yamava ohlukene endaweni yokuphatha iAdministration. Ukwazi ngemithetho kanye namapholisi asePublic Service. Ukwazi ngePSET. Ukwazi kukuqonda i-TVET/CET Administration. Ukuqonda isigaba seHigher Education. Ukuqonda intshwelabolide yebhomu. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kweCost centre, kwesabelomali, kwezimali ezishiwayo, nakwesilimi semali. Employment Equity Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act, kanti kulesinye isikhathi nakwezinye imithetho ehlobene nalokho.
zu.duties: Hlola izingozi ezizothi nakwezinye izinhlekelele ezinkulu ezizothi (wenze ukuhlolwa okuphelele kokuHlola Izingozi kanye nokuQagela Amingo eNgozi eLimpopo Regional Office njalo ngonyaka, lulungele futhi ulawule ukuhlolwa kolandelelwano lwe-Occupation Health and Safety (OHS) iziguqugi zezimoto eziqondile). Lungelelanisa, phumelelisa futhi ulawule isistimu yokuphatha i-OHS (wenze isilinganiso sengozi yezempilo nokuphephela kwezakhiwo zeLimpopo Regional Office, lungelelanise isistimu yokuphatha i-OHS, futhi qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokusebenza kahle kwayo yonke imishini yokushisa). Sekela amakolishi e-CET kwa-TVET ngokulawula ukuqeqeshwa okuhlobene ne-OHS kanye nezinhlelo zemfundo eziphindhwa njalo (lungiselele futhi unikeze isikhokho se-OHS kubasebenzi abasha kanye nezinhlelo zokwazisa njalo kanye nezinhlelo zemfundo kubo bonke abasebenzi). Sekela iRegional Directoriates ekubukeni ukulandelwa kolandelwano kwe-OHS kumakolishi. Lungelelanise izindlela zokungena lapho kudingeka khona. Phatha abantu, izimali, kanye nezinye izinsiza egatsheni (phatha izinsiza zabantu egatsheni, hlolisisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi). N.B. Bonke abagqanywa kumkhankaso bazocelwa ukuba bagcwalise isivivinyo sokuzivivinywa esihlobene nesikhundla.
