xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) ekuqatshelwa kwi-Safety Management okanye ngesiifikelelo ezinxulumene nayo. Amava angaphantsi kweminyaka mibini (2) kuya kwithathu (3) emagunjini olawulo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo kunye namalungiselelo abantu baseburhulumenteni. Ulwazi nge-PSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-TVET/CET Administration. Ukuqonda ingxwabu le-Higher Education. Ukuqonda urhulumente wobuchwepheshhe bolungranishini. Ukuqonda i-Cost centre, ulawulo lwebhajeti, ukuchithwa kwemali, kunye nolawulo lwemali ebambeleyo. I-Employment Equity Act, i-Public Service Regulations kunye ne-Public Service Act, i-Labour Relations Act, nakunye nayo yonke eminye imigaqo enxulumene naleyokunye.
xh.duties: Qaphela iingozi ezinokubakho nemitshato emikhulu enokubakho (qhuba ukuqaphelwa kweengozi nokulinganiswa kwengxwabu ngokubanzi kwi-Regional Office nyaka zonke, hlela ukuvavanywa kolandelelwano lwe-occupation Health and Safety (OHS) ziigunya ezifanelekileyo). Phuhlisa, seta kunye nokujonga indlela elawulwa ngayo i-OHS (qhuba ukulinganiswa kweengozi ezeempilo nokhuseleko kwakhiwo lwe-Regional Office, phuhlisa indlela elawulwa ngayo i-OHS, uze uqinisekise ukwakhiwa nokukhonza koluhlelo lonke lwemililo elungileyo). Nceda i-CET ne-TVET Colleges ngokulungelelanisa imfundo enxulumene ne-OHS kunye namaphrogramu emfundo ephilayo (hlela uze unikeze isaziso se-OHS kubasebenzi abasha kunye namaphrogramu abantu bakuqonda ngokuqhubekayo nexesha lonke abasebenzi bonke). Nceda i-Regional Directorates ekujongeni ulandelelwano lwe-OHS kwi-Colleges. Phuhlisa iindlela zokungena xa kufuneka. Lawula abantu, iimali, nakunye namathuba kwicandelo (lawula abantu kwicandelo, hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi). N.B. Onke amagosa achongiweyo kuya kufuneka agcibe isivivinyo sefikelelo esifanelekileyo.

This must be supported by a minimum of (2) two to three (3) years of work experience in administering and coordinating the development of statistical publications. The candidate must demonstrate the capacity to plan and coordinate data collection activities from various stakeholders, ensuring alignment with project plans, deliverables and reporting requirements. Experience within the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector or its entities and understanding of the PSET-related data will be advantageous. Intermediate proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Access, Ms Outlook and PowerPoint is required. Strong written and verbal communication skills, project management, report writing, and ability to arrange and systematise information. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be reporting to the Deputy Director: Data Analyst, under the Sub-Directorate: Information Management and Reporting. The responsibilities include assisting with the development, processing, approval and dissemination of the Statistics on PSET, assist with preparation of submissions, memorandums, development of factsheets and regional reports for the PSET sector, assist with the development and implementation of standards, assist with submission of data logbooks and processing of data requests and provide logistical and administrative support when required. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

af.title: Senior Administrative Officer
af.summary: Senior Administrative Officer word in Pretoria benodig om statistiese publikasies en data-insameling vir die Department of Higher Education and Training te koördineer.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma in openbare administrasie/sosiale wetenskappe. Dit moet gesteun word deur 'n minimum van (2) twee tot drie (3) jaar se werkservaring in die administrering en koördinering van die ontwikkeling van statistiese publikasies. Die kandidaat moet die vermoë toon om data-insamelingsaktiwiteite vanaf verskeie belanghebbendes te beplan en te koördineer, om sodoende belyning met projekplanne, lewerbare items en verslagdoeningsvereistes te verseker. Ervaring binne die Post-School Education and Training (PSET)-sektor of sy entiteite en 'n begrip van PSET-verwante data sal voordelig wees. Tussenvlakbevoegdheid in MS Word, Excel, Access, Ms Outlook en PowerPoint word vereis. Sterk skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, projekbestuur, verslagskrywing, en die vermoë om inligting te reël en te sistematiseer. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal rapporteer aan die Adjunkdirekteur: Data-ontleding, onder die Subdirektoraat: Inligtingsbestuur en Verslagdoening. Die verantwoordelikhede sluit in om hulp te verleen met die ontwikkeling, verwerking, goedkeuring en verspreiding van statistiek oor PSET; help met die voorbereiding van voorleggings, memorandums, die ontwikkeling van bladsye met feite en streeksverslae vir die PSET-sektor; help met die ontwikkeling en implementering van standaarde; help met die indiening van datalogboeke en die verwerking van dataversoeke; en logistieke en administratiewe ondersteuning verskaf wanneer vereis. N.B. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate sal vereis word om 'n tersaaklike bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Umlawuli Omkhulu Wezokuphathwa
zu.summary: Kudingeka umkhulumi olawula izikhundla eziphakeme zamaphoyisa ePretoria, ukuze ahlele kwezokushicilelwa kanye nokuqoqa imininingwane ye-Department of Higher Education and Training.

Lokhu kumele kusekelwe isikhathi esingaphansi kokuqashelwa kweminyaka engu-(2) kubheke kumithetho yolawulo nokuhlela kocwaningo lwezibalo zomphakathi. Kumele kubonise isimemo sokucabanga nokuhlela imisebenzi yokuqoqa imininingwane kubantu abahlukene, ukuze kuhambisane nezigaba zemibhuzo, izinhloso ezifunekayo namaphuzu wobuqotho. Isipiliyoni ngaphakathi kwe-Post-School Education and Training (PSET) noma ngaphakathi kwezinhlangano ezikanye nayo, kanye nokuqonda imininingwane ehlobene ne-PSET kuzuba lusizo. Ukugqwesa ngokuphathelene ne-MS Word, MS Excel, MS Access, MS Outlook kanye no-MS PowerPoint kudingwa. Ukugqwesa kwakho ngokusuka ezandleni nangokusuka emlonyeni, ukuphatha imibhuzo, ukubhala umbiko, kanye nokuqashwa kwezibalo ezahlukene kuyadingeka. Isibaphi sikahulumu.
zu.duties: Umkhandeli ophumelelayo uzobe emcabangini kumongameli ongumsekeli: Onzululwazi lwemininingwane, ngaphansi kweSikhundla esincane: Kolawulo Lolwazi nokubika. Izibopho zihlanganisa ukusiza ekuthuthukisweni, ekucubunguleni, ekuqashelweni nokusabalaliseni izibalo ngo-PSET, ukusiza ekulungiseleleni okufakwayo, okhodi, ekuthuthukiseni amakhasi oqiniso nakumabhaphu wendawo bese ikhomba umkhakha we-PSET, ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni nakokuqashwa kwemigomo, ukusiza ekuthunyelweni kwabhalo-bhuku lwemininingwane nakokucubungula izicelo zemininingwane nokuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sezokuthutha kolawulo lapho kudingeka. Qaphela. Bonke abagqitshiswa abakhethiwe bazodingeka ukuqedelela isipiliyoni esihambisana nokuqeqeshwa.

xh.summary: Kufuneka igosa eliphezulu lezoburhalwe ePretoria ukuqhagamshela izinto ezibaliweyo ezingamanani nokuthwala idatha kwisebe le-Department of Higher Education and Training.

Igosa kufuneka libonise amandla okuqamba iindlela nokuqhagamshela imisebenzi yokuthwala idatha evela kubahlali bahlukeneyo, kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana neendlela zeprojekthi, izinto eziziweyo neemfuno zokubika. Ikhono eliphakathi kwi-MS Word, Excel, Access, Ms Outlook ne-PowerPoint kufuneka lifunekwe. Ikhono eliqinileyo lokubhala nokuthetha, ulawulo lweeprojekthi, ukubhala iingxelo, nendlela yokulungisa nokuqamba indlela yolwazi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.

af.title: Kommunikasiebeampte: Korporatiewe Dienste
af.summary: Bestuur interne en eksterne kommunikasie, opstel van toesprake en mediaverklarings, en doen navorsing by die Limpopo Streekskantoor.
af.requirements: ’n Toepaslike baccalaureusgraad/nasionale diploma (NQF vlak 6) in Kommunikasie in Kommunikasie/ Bemarking/ Publieke Verhoudinge of relevante kwalifikasie. ’n Minimum van 1-2 jaar se ervaring in ’n Bemarking- en Kommunikasie-omgewing. Kennis van sosiale media-praktyk en -kanale. Begrip van die belangrikheid van handelsriglyne, grafiese ontwerp en toepassing daarvan oor ’n verskeidenheid kanale. Kennis en begrip van belanghebbende-bestuur. Kennis van geleentheidbestuur. Kennis en begrip van digitale bemarking. Kennis en begrip van webwerfonderhoud. Kennis en begrip van die toepassing van die Wetgewende Raamwerk van die Openbare Diens. En moet ’n bestuurslisensie hê. Program- en projekbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analitiese vaardighede. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en kundefokus. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, nasionaal te reis en sperdatums na te kom. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag, Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom.
af.duties: Hanteer verskeie aangeleenthede wat verband hou met interne en eksterne kommunikasie in die Streekskantoor. Doen elementêre navorsing oor aangeleenthede wat verband hou met kommunikasie. Versamel inligting om te help met die opstel van toesprake, mediaverklarings/persverklarings, ens. Vir verskillende geleenthede of sake van die Departement. Berei voor en/of fasiliteer die druk van departementele publikasies om effektiewe kommunikasie aan alle belanghebbendes van die departement te verseker, bv. jaarverslae, departementele nuusbriewe/brosjures, jaarlikse kalender, geleentheidsprogramme, groetkaarte, naamplate vir amptenare binne die departemente, ontwerp en uitleg van publikasies vir druk, ontwerpkonsepte vir drukmaatskappye. Bied hulp by die ontwikkeling van en verseker die suksesvolle implementering van die departementele kommunikasiebeleid om kommunikasie binne en buite die departement te bevorder en te verbeter. Werk inligting op die Departementele webwerf by en skakel met die webwerfontwerper oor aangeleenthede wat daarmee verband hou. Hanteer verskeie aangeleenthede wat verband hou met die opstel van response op media- en persverklarings, nuusbriewe en artikels. Lewer fotodiens aan die departement. Monitor mediadekking en stel ’n sinoptiese verslag op van aangeleenthede wat die Departement beïnvloed en/of impakteer ten einde toepaslike response deur die relevante gesag in te lig. Reël en/of help met die reëling en/of koördinering van departementele geleenthede ten einde die beeld van die departement in die Streek te bevorder. Verteenwoordig die eenheid in verskeie vergaderings. Voer enige ander verwante funksies uit soos versoek deur die Streeksbestuurder. N.B. Alle gekandidateerde kandidate sal vereis word om ’n relevante bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Inkhenkethi Yokuxhumana: Amasevisi Ebhokhwe
zu.summary: Phatha unxibelelwano langaphakathi nangaphandle, hlumba amakhulu amagama amagazethi, futhiwenze ucwaningo eLimpopo Regional Office.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-bachelor's degree/national diploma (NQF Level 6) ezifanelekile eziku-Communication/ Marketing/ Public Relations noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokho. Uhumathe weminyaka engu-1-2 wokuhlangenwe nakho esimweni se-Marketing and Communication. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamajinja woxhumano nomiya. Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuqondiswa komkhiqizo, ukwakhiwa kwezithombe kanye nokusebenzisa kwemikhakha ehlukene. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwabahlobo. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezinkundla. Ulwazi nokuqonda okumakethe yedijithali. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukugcinwa kwenkonzo yomshini ongakhona. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusetshenziswa kohlaka lomthetho lomPhakha Wamasevisi. Futhi kufanele abe nelayisensi yokuqhuba. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nobunye. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuqondisa kubo. Isikhono sokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo, ukuhamba kuzwe lonke kanye nokuhlangabezana namasikhathi. Ukubekezela kanye nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba, isikhono sokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo nokuqedela imisebenzi ngesikhathi.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izindaba ezihlukene ezingokunxibelelwano ngaphakathi nangaphandle eRegional Office. Ukwenza ucwaningo olulula ezindabeni ezingokunxibelelwano. Ukuqoqa ulwazi ukusize ekubhaleni amakhulu amagazethi, izitatimende zabezindaba/ izitatimende zabezindaba, njll. Ezinkundleni ezahlukene noma izesikhathi somnyango. Ukulungiselela futhi/noma ukwenza kubhukwe ukushicilelwa kwemibhalo yomnyango ukugcina ukuxhumana okusebenza kahle kubo bonke abahlobo bomnyango isb. imibiko yonyaka, amapheshana/amabhulashi omnyango, ikhalenda yonyaka, izinhlelo zezinkundla, amakhadi okubingelela, amapuleti amagama abasebenzi ngaphakathi komnyango, ukuklama nokubeka ngendlela okushicilelwa ngayo imibhalokanye nokulungiselela ukushicilelwa kwemibalo emakompanini zokushicilelwa. Ukusize ekwakheni futhi kuqinisekise ukuphumelela kokusetshenziswa kolimi lomnyango ngokusiza nokuqinisa ukunxibelelwano ngaphakathi nangaphandle komnyango. Ukubuyekeza ulwazi kuwebsite yomnyango kanye nokuxhumana nomklami wakho website ezindabeni ezihlobene nalokho. Ukuphatha izindaba ezihlukene ezingokubhalwa kwemibiko yabezindaba futhi ishicilelo lezindaba, amapheshana namapheshana. Ukubhukwa izinkonzo zokuthathwa kwezithombe kumnyango. Ukulandela ukuthunyelwa kwezindaba kanye nokuqoqa umbiko omfushane wezindaba ezithinta futhi/noma zinomthelela kumnyango ngosuku lolwazi olufanele ukuphendulwa ngabaphathi abafanelekile. Ukulungiselela futhi/noma usize ekulungiseleleni futhi/noma ukumataniseni izinkundla zomnyango ukuze kuthuthukiswe isithombe somnyango kwesifunda. Ukumela iyunithi emihlanganweni ehlukene. Ukwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi othintekile njengoba celwa ngu-Regional Manager. N.B. Bonke abafaki isicelo abayisihluthulelo bazocelwa ukuba bagcwalise isivivinyo sokuzwana esifanele.

xh.title: Iofisa woNxibelelwano: Iinkonzo zeShishini
xh.summary: Phatha unxibelelwano langaphakathi nangaphandle, bhala iinketho nezitatimendeabezindaba, uze wenze uphononongo kwiOfisi yoMmandla yeLimpopo.
xh.requirements: Idegree esemthethweni/ idiploma yezwe (NQF Level 6) kuNxibelelwano kuNxibelelwano/ uMarkeṭing/ uManyano lwaNzala ngokomphakathi okanye izimangalo ezifanelekileyo. Amava amabaluleke apho kwiminyaka engu-1-2 kumxholo weMarkeṭino noNxibelelwano. Ulwazi ngokuzilolonga kwendalo yamajoni oNxibelelwano nemiqondiso yayo. Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwemigaqo yophawu, uyilo lwezithombe nokusebenzisa kumajoni ahlukeneyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula abanikabelo. Ulwazi lokulawula iziganeko. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-digital marketing. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukugcinwa kwenkundla yonke iwebhsayithi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusebenzisa inguqulelo yomthetho yoBuntu bonke. Kwaye kufuneka anelayisensi yokushayela. Ukulawula iinkqubo namaprojekhthi. Amandla okuxazulula iingxaki nokuqonda ngokuhlaziya. Ukulawula abantu namahlahluvabaluleyo. Ukujolise kumthengi nagqondo kumthengi. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, okuhamba kwilizwe lonke nokuqwalasela iimveliso kwexesha elichaziweyo. Ukuziphendula nokuziphatha ngokungakwenzi bubi, Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo neokuqwalasela iimveliso kwixesha elichaziweyo.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha iindaba ezahlukeneyo ezinxulumene noNxibelelwano langaphakathi nangaphandle kwiOfisi yoMmandla. Wenza uphononongo olusisiseko kwiindaba ezinxulumene noNxibelelwano. Qokelela ulwazi ukuncedisa ekubhaleni iinketho, izitatimendeabezindaba/izaziso bezindaba, njl. Kwiziganeko okanye iimeko ezahlukeneyo zeSebe. Lukhungele nokuba/Nceda ekushicilelweni kweepapasho zesebe ukuze kuqiniseke unxibelelwano olusebenzayo kubo bonke abanikabelo basebe njengalokuxabNjingalwe emva konyaka, iindaba zangaphakathi zesebe/ibhrosho, ikhalenda yonyaka, iinkqubo zeziganeko, amakhadi eNdlela-ntle, amaphedi-ebhodi eefishaali basebe, uyilo neendawo zokubekwa iindatsh zokushicilela, uyilo lwetyala lokushicilela kwiinkampani zokushicilela. Nceda ekuphuhliseni ukuze kuqinisekelwe ukusebenza ngempumelelo kweguqulo yesebe yopolisi yoNxibelelwano ukukhuthaza nokuphucula unxibelelwano ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesebe. Hlaziya ulwazi kwiwebhsayithi yeSebe uthethe nomgqozi wewebhsayithi kwiindaba ezingxulumene naloo nto. Phatha iindaba ezahlukeneyo ezinxulumene nokubhala iimpendulo kwabezindaba kwaye ukhuphe izazisoabezindaba, iindaba zangaphakathi neendatsh. Kuza ngkonzo zokuthatha izithombe kwisebe. Qwalasela ukusasazwaabezindaba uze udibanise ingxelo emfutshane yendaba ezichaphazela nokuba/ zinomthelela kwiSebe ukuze uqikelele iimpendulo ezifanelekileyo ngumlawuli ongundlayo. Hlela/Nceda ngokuHlela/Nceda ngokuqwalasela iiganeko zesebe ukuze kukhuthazwe umfanekiso wesebe kummandla. Mela iqili kwindibano ezahlukeneyo. Wenze nayiphi na eminye imisebenzi engxulumene nalo njengoko celwa nguMlawuli woMmandla. Qaphela. Bonke abagqithiswe kuludwe lokugqibela baya kufuneka bagqibe isenzo esifanelekileko sokuzilolonga.

jobs.title: IT Technician
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: An IT Technician is sought to provide LAN and desktop support services at the Limpopo Regional Office, requiring a National Diploma in IT and one to two years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A recognised National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Information Technology or equivalent qualification. At least one (1) to (2) two years’ work experience in the IT Field as an IT Technician. The industry recognised certifications such as MCSE/ MCITP, A+, N+ Security +, ITIL as well as other IT governance framework will be an added advantage. Good communication, problem solving, ICT infrastructure support and Customer relationship skills. Network Administration, IT Service Management. Sound knowledge COBIT 5 Foundation, ITIL and other IT Governance frameworks.
jobs.duties: To provide Local Area Network and Desktop support services: Creating user account on desktop and laptop (mailbox and windows). Unlocking of password using Admin Pack. Setting up desktop, printers and data projectors. Configuring mainframe applications. Provide support of data migration during computer setup. Provide telephonic support. Troubleshooting of all issues reported. Gather and analyses users’ issues in ICT and provide solutions. Provide support for identified Level 8 and Level 9/10 issues where configuration solutions have already been documented on the ITIL. IT helpdesk services: Provide first level contact and convey resolutions to customer issues as requested by level 8/9. Perform any other related function as requested by Supervisor. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.“ DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements

af.title: IT-Tegnikus
af.summary: 'n IT-Tegnikus word gesoek om LAN- en lessenaarondersteuningsdienste by die Limpopo-streekkantoor te lewer, met 'n vereiste van 'n Nasionale Diploma in IT en een tot twee jaar se relevante ervaring.
af.requirements: 'n Erkende Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Inligtingstegnologie of ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Ten minste een (1) tot (2) twee jaar se werkservaring in die IT-terrein as 'n IT-Tegnikus. Bedryfserkende sertifiserings soos MCSE/ MCITP, A+, N+ Security +, ITIL asook ander IT-bestuursraamwerke sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goeie kommunikasie-, probleemoplossings-, IT-infrastruktuurondersteunings- en klantverhoudingsvaardighede. Netwerkadministrasie, IT-diensbestuur. Deeglike kennis van COBIT 5 Foundation, ITIL en ander IT-bestuursraamwerke.
af.duties: Om Local Area Network- en lessenaarondersteuningsdienste te verskaf: Skep gebruikersrekeninge op lessenaar en skootrekenaar (posbus en windows). Ontsluit van wagwoord met behulp van Admin Pack. Opstel van lessenaar, drukkers en dataprojektors. Konfigureer hoofraamtoepassings. Verskaf ondersteuning van datamigrasie tydens rekenaaropstel. Verskaf telefoniese ondersteuning. Ontleed alle aangemelde probleme. Versamel en ontleed gebruikers se probleme in IT en verskaf oplossings. Verskaf ondersteuning vir geïdentifiseerde Level 8 en Level 9/10 probleme waar konfigurasie-oplossings reeds op die ITIL gedokumenteer is. IT-helpdeskdienste: Verskaf eerste vlak kontak en gee oplossings deur aan kliëntprobleme soos aangevra deur level 8/9. Voer enige ander verwante funksie uit soos aangevra deur die toesighouer. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: IT Technician
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-IT Technician ukuletha izinkonzo zokwesekwa kwe-LAN kanye ngedeskithophu eLimpopo Regional Office, kudinga i-National Diploma ku-IT kanye nomyaka owodwa kuya kwababili abohluvo loluvo oluhlobene.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ebalulekayo ku-Information Technology noma isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Okungenani unyaka owodwa (1) kuya kwababili (2) iminyaka yohluvo lomsebenzi enkundleni ye-IT njengoba IT Technician. Izitifiketi eziyaziwe emkhakheni njenge-MCSE/ MCITP, A+, N+ Security +, ITIL kanye namanye amashekhele wobuholi be-IT kuzoba yinzuzo eyedwa. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukusekelwa kwezinsiza ze-ICT kanye nobudlelwano nomthengi. Ukuphatha inethiwekhi, Ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo ze-IT. Ulwazi olujulile nge-COBIT 5 Foundation, ITIL namanye amashekhele wobuholi be-IT.
zu.duties: Ukuletha izinkonzo zokwesekwa kwe-Local Area Network kanye neDesktop: Ukudala ama-akhawunti womsebenzisi kwideskithophu nkelaphu (ibhokisi le-imeyili kanye newindows). Ukukhiya kabusha igama lokungena ngemvula usebenzisa i-Admin Pack. Ukulungiselela ideskithophu, abaphathi beshicilelo kanye nabaqondisi bemininingwane. Ukulungiselela izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-mainframe. Ukunikeza isekelo lokufuduka kwemininingwane ngesikhathi kusethwa ikhompyutha. Ukunikeza isekelo ngocingo. Ukuxazulula zonke izinkinga ezibikhiwe. Ukuthola kanye nokuhlaziya izinkinga zomsebenzisi ku-ICT bese kunikeza izixazululo. Ukunikeza isekelo ezinkingeni eziqashelwe ezingeni le-Level 8 kanye ne-Level 9/10 lapho izixazululo zokulungiselela sesivezwe kakade ku-ITIL. Izinkonzo ze-IT helpdesk: Ukuba yinto yokuxhumana yokuqala futhi udlulise izixazululo ezinkathazweni zomthengi njengoba kuceliwe yizinga le-8/9. Ukwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi ohlobene njengoba kuceliwe umphathi. N.B. Bonke abagcotshiwe baza kudingeka ukuba baqedele ukuzivivinya lokuzenza okuhlobene.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wasekhaya we-IT (IT Technician)
xh.summary: Kufunekwe omlonji we-IT (IT Technician) ukubonelela ngekonzo zoxhaso ze-LAN nazo-desktop kwiOfisi yoMmandla we-Limpopo, kwaye kufuneka abe neNdiploma yeSizwe kwi-IT kwaye enye ukuya kwezimbini zeminyaka yamava ahlobene nalo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seSizwe esivunyiweyo (NQF Level 6) kwiNkulumbuso yolwazi lekhompyutha (Information Technology) okanye isidanga esilinganayo nesiko. Okona ingxaki emnye (1) ukuya kwi-(2) zimbini zeminyaka yamava wokusebenza kwinkalo ye-IT njengotitshala we-IT (IT Technician). Iifikithelesi ezizivunyiweyo kwishishini ezinjenge-MCSE/ MCITP, A+, N+ Security +, ITIL nakwezinye iinkqubo zolawulo lwe-IT ziya kuba lulondolozo olongezelelweyo. Amakhono amaninzi okunxibelelana, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuxhasa kumaziko e-ICT, namakhono ohlolwe ngawo abakho kumakhaya abakhi bomnatha isikhathi eside. Ulawulo lweNethiwekhi, ulawulo lweenkonzo ze-IT. Ukuqonda ukuba mikho kakhulu iziseko eziyimfuneko ze-COBIT 5, ITIL, nezinye iinkqubo zolawulo lwe-IT.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngekonzo zoxhaso loMmandla weNethiwekhi yaBantu basesikweni (Local Area Network) nezeDesktop: Ukudala ama-akhawunti womsebenzisi kudesktop nasekompuyutha ethi laptop (mailbox ne-windows). Ukukhulula iphaswedi ngokusebenzisa i-Admin Pack. Ukuhlela idesktop, iiprinta nedatha projector. Ukumisa iaplikheyishini zamainframe. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwendalo yedatha ngexesha lesetyenziso lwekompuyutha. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso ngefowuni. Ukuhlolwa kwaye kusonjululwe yonke imiba echaziweyo. Ukuqokelela nanokuhlola iingxaki zabasebenzisi kwi-ICT kwaye kubonelelwe ngezisombululo. Ukubonelela ngoxhaso kumanqanaba achaziweyo e-Level 8 naku-Level 9/10 apho izisombululo zomiselo sezisiqulunqwe kwelona ITIL. Iinkonzo ze-IT helpdesk: Ukubonelela nongathwala noqhagamshelo lokuqala kwaye udlulise izisombululo kwingxaki yamakhasimwe njengoko kucelwa kwinqanaba lesi-8/9. Ukwenza nawuphi na omnye umsebenzi ohlobene nje njengoko kucelwa nguMphathi. Qaphela. Bonke abagqithiswa kumgca o mfutshane baya kufuneka bagqibe isoqulatho sokuzipha esihlobene nalo.

af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Bestedingsadministrasie
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeester in Pretoria vir die Department of Higher Education and Training, wat 'n diploma in Rekenkunde of Finansiële Bestuur met een tot twee jaar se regeringsfinansiële rekenkundige ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale diploma in Rekenkunde/Finansiële Bestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie met rekenkunde as 'n vak beskik. Een (1) tot twee (2) jaar toepaslike ervaring in Regeringsfinansiële Rekenkunde; die BAS-stelsel, kennis en begrip van die PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies; kennis en begrip van die Basic Accounting System (BAS); goeie kommunikasie (mondelingse en skriftelike) vaardighede; rekenaargeletterdheid; probleemoplossingsvaardighede; beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede; analitiese vaardighede; skakelvaardighede; kliëntgerigte vaardighede; finansiële bestuursvaardighede; aanbiedingsvaardighede; klieënsorgvaardighede. Ander eienskappe/vaardighede Vriendelik en betroubaar; Akkuraatheid; Selfvertroue; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk; Daadkrag; en Selfaanvang.
af.duties: Kontrole en magtiging van diverse en skuldeiserbetalings op BAS, wat die Reisrekening, Telkom en Nashua-rekeninge insluit; Kontrole en magtiging van bestelbetalings op LOGIS aanlyn. Vaslegging van betalings op BAS. Bystand met ouditnavrae; Verantwoordelik vir die bestuur en skrap van algemene grootboekrekeninge. Bystand verleen met die verskaffing van inligting vir die opstel van die kwartaal- en jaarlikse finansiële state met spesifieke verwysing na algemene grootboekrekeninge. Magtiging van algemene joernale van toepassing op besteding. Bestuur en reageer op navrae wat verband hou met hierdie funksie. Toesig hou oor die werkprestasies van ondergeskiktes deur onder andere werk toe te ken en te beheer en kantoor dissipline te handhaaf; Opvra van BAS-verslae wanneer nodig. Inviling van eisverwante dokumente. N.B. Alle gekortlysde kandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: State Accountant: Expenditure Administration
zu.summary: Um-Accountant wezwe ePretoria kwi-Department of Higher Education and Training, edinga i-diploma ku-Accounting noma i-Financial Management elunyaka oyedwa kuye kubabili iminyaka yamava kuma-akhawunti wezimali kahulumeni.
zu.requirements: Abafaki badinga ukuba bephethe i-diploma yezwe iminyaka yamathathu (3) ku-Accounting/Financial Management noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokhu lapho i-accounting ingenye yezifundo. Umnyaka (1) kuya kumabili (2) iminyaka yamava afanele kwi-Government Financial Accounting; isistimu ye-BAS, ulwazi kanye nokuqonda i-PFMA namalawu e-Treasury; ulwazi kanye nokuqonda i-Basic Accounting System (BAS); amakhono okuxhumana okuhle (athintekile nobhalwe) ukusebenza ikhompyutha; amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlele; amakhono okuhlaziya; amakhono obudlelwano; amakhono okumiswa kumakhasimende; amakhono ephetha imali; amakhono okubonisa; amakhono enakekelwa kumakhasimende. Izinyanga ezinye/Izakhono Zesibopho futhi azikhohlisi; Ukuqobo; Ithembu; Ikhono lokusebenza ngomfutho; Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini ngokuzimela; Ukuqina; kanye nokuziqalisa.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola futhi uvume izinkokhelo ezingahleliwe nezabakhipheli kwi-BAS, okuhlanganisa i-Akhawunti Yokuhamba, ama-Akhawunti e-Telkom ne-Nashua, Ukuhlola futhi uvume izinkokhelo zodolo kwi-LOGIS online. Ukufaka izinkokhelo kwi-BAS. Ukusiza eMibuzweni Yokuhlola, Ubumbele ekuqpheneni futhi ukusulela ama-akhawunti ejenerali leja. Ukusiza ngokunikezwa kolwazi oluhambisana nokulungiselelwa kwemingcwango yemali yesikhashana kanye nonyaka ngokubhega ama-akhawunti ejenerali leja. Ukuvuma amajenali ejenerali ahambisana nokuhenulwa. Ukuqondisa futhi uphendule imibuzo ehlobene nalomsebenzi. Ukuphatwa kwenza umsebenzi abangaphansi ngokubandakanya, ukwabelwa nokulawula umsebenzi kanye nogcingo lwezofisi, Ukucelwa kwemibiko ye-BAS noma sikhatsi sidingekile. Ukucla uthuli lwamafayela ahlobene nezinsizakusebenza. N.B. Bonke abantu abame esihlwini kuzofuneka benze isivivinyo samakhono esihambisana nalokhu.

xh.title: Umsebenzi weSizwe we-Akhawunti: uLawulo lweendleko
xh.summary: iNdlela yokwenza izinto ngokuchanekileyo ePretoria ngeSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, kufuneka abe nediploma kwi-Akhawunti okanye uLawulo lweMali, enye ukuya kubabini kwiminyaka yokwenza izinto ngokuchanekileyo kwi-Akhawunti yeSizwe.
xh.requirements: Abafake izicelo kufuneka babe ne-diploma yaseZantsikwelizwe eyiminyaka elithathu (3) kwi-akhawunti/ ukulawula iIMali okanye nangomsebenzi ongqamana nalo kwingcwecwe le-akhawunti njengesiqalelo. Umva onye (1) ukuya kwababini (2) abangamashumi amabini phantsi komsebenzi kwi-Akhawunti yeSizwe; inkqubo yeBAS, ulwazi nokuqonda iPFMA kunye noMgaqo-nkqubo weNdlu-ntsebenzo yezimali; ulwazi nokuqonda iNkqubo yeAkhawunti eYintsika (iBAS); amakhono abalulekileyo ancedisayo (olubini olubhalwayo noluthethwayo) aluncedo kumsebenzi ohamba phambili kwinkqubo yekhompyutha eya kubakho kwaye ibambe iqhaza ngokusombulula iingxaki nasekuyilweni nokuhlelwa ngokuchanekileyo kwemisebenzi; amakhono obuntu bakho obubonakalayo ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi olutsha njengoko isithuba simfunile. omnye wabantu abaninzi abanomtsalane ochasene nongathembekiyo kwaye enomtsalane ochasene nongathembekiyo obeka iziqalelo ngokuchanekileyo nokuthembeka; ukuqina ngakumbi ngokuchanekileyo; ukuqonda ngokupela; Ukuzinza; ukuzimela; ukuphatha; amakhono okuqonda ngqo indlela yokwenza izinto; amakhono okubeka ngokwendlela yokwenza izinto; amakhono okusombulula iingxaki ngokuchanekileyo; ukuzimisela okukhulu ekubeni nengqondo ekwazi ukwenza izinto ngokwenene; amakhono okuqonda kakhulu ukuba nabathengi abaninzi kumsebenzi ohamba phambili; nangamakhono anegalelo ngokwenza izinto ezininzi ngokuchanekileyo; amakhono okubonelela ngolwazi kubantu abaninzi.
xh.duties: ukuhlola kunye nokugunyazisa iindleko ezahlukeneyo kunye neentlawulo zabanikazi-bhalo kwiBAS, eziquka i-Akhawunti yoHamba, ii-Akhawunti zeTelkom kunye neNashua. Ukuhlola kunye nokugunyazisa iintlawulo z-odolo kwiLOGIS online; Ukubhala iintlawulo kwiBAS. Uncedisa kwimibuzo yeVokhthi. Uxanduva lokulawula nokucoxula ii-akhawunti zenhloko-jikelele. Uncedisa ngokuvelisa ulwazi oluya kwakhiwo lwemibiko yemali yehlabathi nengamnyaka ngokuthe ngqo kwi-akhawunti zenhloko-jikelele. Ukugunyazisa amaJenalisi Jikelele ohlobo lweendleko. Ukulawula kuphendula imibuzo enxulumene nalomsebenzi. Ukulawula umsebenzi wabasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho, phakathi kwabo, ngokwabelwa nokulawula umsebenzi nokugcina isithintelo esebenza kwindlu-ntsebenzo; ukucela iimbowulo zeBAS xa kufuneka. Ukugcwalisa iifayile zamaxwebhu ahlobene neesimiki. N.B. Onke amagqabantshintshi abekiweyo kwi-akhawunti aya kufuneka abambe iqhaza kwicandelo lokulingesisa lokumiselweyo.

jobs.title: State Accountant: Cash Flow Management
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: State Accountant role in cash flow management at the Department of Higher Education and Training in Pretoria, requiring a diploma in accounting and government finance experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of an appropriate 3-year National diploma in Accounting/Financial Management or related qualification with accounting as a subject. One (1) to two (2) years appropriate experience in Government Financial Accounting; the BAS system, knowledge and understanding of the PFMA and Treasury Regulations; knowledge and understanding of the Basic Accounting System (BAS); good communication (verbal and written) skills; computer literacy; problem-solving skills; planning and organizing skills; analytical skills; liaison skills; client orientation skills; financial management skills; presentation skills; customer care skills, Other Attributes/Skills: Friendly, trustworthy and accuracy.
jobs.duties: Preparation of cash flow reports to the Minister and Management and ensure that the expenditure is within the approved budget of various functions and to report any envisaged over-expenditure, Compile IYM expenditure report and submit to National Treasury monthly. The compilation and submission of the Conditional Grant report in accordance with the format prescribed by National Treasury not later than 20 days after the end of each month Updating, recordkeeping and monthly cash flow statement of official entertainment and report to Management Request reports, check and rectify any incorrect allocations on a daily basis, Request commitment reports and check the commitments. Authorize General Journals on BAS. Manage and respond to enquiries related to this function Supervise the work performance of subordinates by inter alia, allocating and controlling work and maintaining office discipline, Requesting BAS reports when required and Filing of claim related documents. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.“DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. af.title: Staatrekenaar: Kontantvloeibestuur
af.summary: Staatrekenaar-pos in kontantvloeibestuur by die Department of Higher Education and Training in Pretoria, wat 'n diploma in rekenkunde en regeringsfinansie-ondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n toepaslike 3-jarige Nasionale diploma in Rekenkunde/Finansiële Bestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie met rekenkunde as 'n vak. Een (1) tot twee (2) jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Regeringsfinansiële Rekenkunde; die BAS-stelsel, kennis en begrip van die PFMA en Tesourie Regulasies; kennis en begrip van die Basiese Rekenkundige Stelsel (BAS); goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik) vaardighede; rekenaargeletterdheid; probleemoplossingsvaardighede; beplannings- en organisasievaardighede; analitiese vaardighede; skakelvaardighede; kliëntgerigtheidsvaardighede; finansiële bestuursvaardighede; voorleggingsvaardighede; klieënsorgvaardighede, ander eienskappe/vaardighede: Vriendelik, betroubaar en akkuraat.
af.duties: Voorbereiding van kontantvloeiverslae aan die Minister en Bestuur en verseker dat die besteding binne die goedgekeurde begroting van verskeie funksies is en om enige beoogde oorbesteding te rapporteer. Stel IYM-bestedingsverslag op en dien dit maandeliks by Nasionale Tesourie in. Die opstel en voorlegging van die Voorwaardelike Toekenning-verslag ooreenkomstig die formaat wat deur Nasionale Tesourie voorgeskryf is, nie later nie as 20 dae na die einde van elke maand. Opdatering, rekordhouding en maandelikse kontantvloeistaat van amptelike vermaak en verslag doene aan Bestuur. Versoek verslae, kontroleer en regstel enige verkeerde toedelings op 'n daaglikse basis. Versoek toebidingsverslae en kontroleer die toebidings. Magtig Algemene Joernale op BAS. Bestuur en reageer op navrae wat verband hou met hierdie funksie. Hou toesig op die werkprestasie van ondergeskiktes deur onder andere werk toe te ken en te beheer en kantoordissipline te handhaaf. Versoek BAS-verslae wanneer nodig en lê eisverwante dokumente weg. N.B. Alle gekortlysde kandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikabaholi kahulumeni: Ukuphathwa kwezimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikabaholi kahulumeni sokuphathwa kwezimali e Department of Higher Education and Training e Pretoria, esidinga idiploma ebhalweni ngenhlobotshana kanye namava ezimali zahulumeni.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izifundo kumele babe ne-national diploma eyikhulu yeminyaka engu-3 ku-Accounting/Financial Management noma iziqu ezihlobene nalokhu lapho i-accounting itholakala khona njengesifundo. Ukuthola amava afanele angu-One (1) kuya kuthi ngangu-two (2) eminyakeni kwi-Government Financial Accounting; isistimu ye-BAS, ulwazi kanye nokuqonda i-PFMA kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury; ulwazi nokuqonda i-Basic Accounting System (BAS); amakhono okuxhumana ahle (okukhulunywayo nakubhalwayo); ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; amakhono okuhlela futhi ahlele; amakhono okuhlaziya; amakhono okuxhumana nabantu; amakhono okuqondisa abathintekayo; amakhono okuphatha izimali; amakhono okubukhonisa; amakhono okunakekela abathintekayo, Izinyawo/Ezinye Ikhono: Mhlophe, ethembekayo futhi onokuqinisekisa ukulunga.
zu.duties: Ukulungiselela imibiko yezimali ayokhona ayokhokhwa kwi-Minister kanye noMphathi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izimali ezikhokhiwe zingaphakathi kwesabelo esivunyiwe sezinhlelo ezahlukene futhi kube umbiko nganoma yisiphi isidingo sokukhokha ngaphezulu, Ukuqoqa imibiko yokusebenzisa i-IYM futhi uyithumele i-National Treasury nyanga zonke. Ukuqoqa kanye nokuthumela imibiko ye-Conditional Grant ngokwakheka obekiwe i-National Treasury, ingaqedi minyaka yonke ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-20 ekupheleni kwenyanga. Ukubuyekeza, ukugcina izibhalo kanye nombiko wenyanga zonke wemali ehamba ayokhokhwa kumasevisi ahloniphekayo futhi umbiko uye kwoMphathi. Ukucela imibiko, ukuyihlola futhi ulungise noma yimiphi imitholampilo engalungile nsuku zonke. Ukucela imibiko yezibhanongo bese uyihlola izibhanongo. Ukugunyaza i-General Journals ku-BAS. Ukuphatha futhi uphendule imibuzo ephathelene nale nkundla. Ukugada inkqubo yokusebenza kabanzi bomsebenzi ngaphakathi kokunye, ngokwaba ukusebenza futhi ulawule umsebenzi kanye nokugcina isigqibo kwe-ofisi. Ukucela imibiko ye-BAS kuthandwa lapho kudingeka futhi ukubeka uhhafu ofayela wamadokhonda ahlobene nezimali ezikhokhwayo. N.B. Bonke abafaki izifundo ababekiwe bazonikezelwa umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa amakhono ahlobene nalokhu okufanele.

xh.title: Igosa elilawula imali yesiRhulumente nokuQonda imali esiRhulumenteni
xh.summary: Indima yegosa elikulawula iimali ezechacheneyo ekuqhubeni imali kwiSebe leMfundo ePhezulu nokuQeqesha ePretoria, esifuna isatifikethi sokubhala iimali nomvuzo wemali ohamba phambili ekuqhubeni imali esiRhulumenteni.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abathunyelwa babe nelayisensi yeNcwadi yesiZwe ukuba ngamagosa eRhulumente kwiSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha. Kubafunwe abantu abanemfuno yokuba benesatifikethi seNcwadi yeNcwadi yesiZwe kwiBango leSizwe lokulawula imali okanye iziqu ezifanayo nalezo ezisisikebhe. Inyanga elinye ukuya kwezibini zeminyaka yokwaziswa ngemali esiRhulumenteni ekulawulweni kwezoQoqosho; iNkqubo yeBAS, ulwazi nokuqonda ngePJe (PFMA) noMthetho woQoqosho oluphathwa ngumanyano; ulwazi nokuqonda ngeNkqubo yeBAS (iNkqubo yeBhaliso yeBhasa); amakhono amabalise okubaleka ngokusesikweni; ulwazi lokusebenzisa iKhompyutha; amakhono okusombulula iingxaki; amakhono okuqamba iindlela; amakhono okwahlula-hlula; amakhono okuba nabaphathi abamsulula; amakhono okusekela abantu abakho kule nkqubo; amakhono okuphatha imali; amakhono okuyalela; amakhono abakho kumthwalo weSizwe ngokubakho kwabantu abamsulula kule nkqubo, kwaye namanye amakhono: ukuba mhle, wethembeleke, unegazi elinzuzo.
xh.duties: Ukulungiselela iimveliso zemali ezihamba phambili kumna kumanabala weNkulumbuso, abaphathi beNkundla yeLuntu neyoQoqosho, ezifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuchithwa ngaphakathi kwesixa esamkelekileyo kwiindidi ezahlukeneyo zomsebenzi kwaye kwenziwe umbiko ngalo naliphi na igama elithethwa ngokuchithwa ngokugqithisileyo. Ulungiselele iNkqubo yeCandelo lethu ebiza ngokusesikweni ngokomthetho (IYM) ngokuchithwa kwemali kwaye ungenise kwindlu yoGcino leSizwe (National Treasury) minyanya leminyanya. Ulungiselele ungenise umbiko weMyalezo emininzi ngenene yeenkonzo ezingezisezo (Conditional Grant Report) ngokwemigaqo efunwa ngumnyama ngokomthetho kuphela, eya kufuna amagama ayo kube ngapantsi kweyure ngezantsi ngokuchithwa kwemali xa kwanditywa inyanga. Ulwazi ngokuBhaliswa kwemali ethengwa ngalo nayiphi na ihlelo lokuBhalisa kwamaphetha namapha ndla kwaye kwazwe kusithiwe ngemini yonke into ekhoyo kwangale minyaka. Umbiko woQoqosho ongangeemeko ezilawulwayo neendaba zemali kumaphetha namapha ndla naxa ukuba kusetyenziswa ihlelo lokulawula imali (BAS). Umbiko weMeko yoQoqosho lwelinye igatya leNkundla yesiXeko esilawulwa kuphela ngokumiselwa kwexesha, ngesiXeko saseBhasa kwaye sibe ngaphantsi kokuLawulwa kwamaphetha namapha ndla.

af.title: Hoof Finansieklerk: Salarisbeheer
af.summary: Bestuur salaristransaksies op PERSAL en BAS, insluitend oortydaansoeke, onderhoudsbevele en kansellasies van aftrekkings.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma met rekeningkunde as 'n vak of 'n verwante kwalifikasisie hê; Voorkeur sal gegee word aan kandidate met Een (1) tot twee (2) jaar toepaslike ervaring in Regerings Finansiële Rekeningkunde; die PERSAL en BAS-stelsel, kennis en begrip van die PFMA en Tesourie Regulasies; kennis en begrip van die Basiese Rekeningkundige Stelsel (BAS); goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik) vaardighede; rekenaargeletterdheid; probleemoplossingsvaardighede; beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede; analitiese vaardighede; skakelingsvaardighede; kliëntgerigte vaardighede; finansiële bestuursvaardighede; aanbiedingsvaardighede; kliasorgvaardighede. Ander Attribuut/Vaardighede: Vriendelik en betroubaar; Akkuraatheid; Selfvertroue; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk; Selfbeskeidendheid; en Selfsmotivering.
af.duties: Kontroleer en magtig salarisverwante transaksies op PERSAL en BAS vir Departementele amptenare. Beheer die betaling van aanvullende eise soos oortyd, sessiestoelaes en voorskotte. Beheer die instelling van onderhoudsbevele. Beheer die kansellasie van aftrekkings soos versekeringspolisse. Kontroleer en magtig Plaaslike en Buitelandse reis- en subsistensie-eise. Beheer betalings van salariseise. Beheer die korrektheid van die verspreiding van PERSAL-itemanaliseverslae aan Finansiële Instellings en die indiening van hierdie verslae op 'n maandelikse basis. Beheer die skoonmaak, afstemming en verslagdoening oor die stand van salarisverwante rekeningkundige rekenings. Beheer verlof- en bulkbetalings. Beheer die samestelling van die Maandelikse BAS/PERSAL-koppelvlakafstemmings. Volg op en dien PERSAL-uitsonderings op BAS weer in. Debiteurbheer: Kontroleer en keur salarisverwante skuldberekenings en transaksies goed wat op BAS geaffekteer moet word en beheer skulddokumentasie. Bestuur en reageer op navrae wat verband hou met hierdie funksie. Hou toezig op die werkprestasie van ondergeskiktes deur onder andere werk toe te ken en te beheer en kantoordisipline te handhaaf; Aanvra van BAS-verslae wanneer nodig. Indien van eisverwante dokumente. N.B. Alle kortlys-kandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Ofisi eNkulu YezeMali: Ulawulo loMholo
zu.summary: Lawula izinkokhelo ezingaphakathi kwe-PERSAL ne-BAS, kuhlanganisa nokubika isikhathi esongiwe, imiyalelo yokugcina, kanye nokucisha izinkokhelo ezingemuva.
zu.requirements: Kumele abafake izibongo babe namadiploma wezikhathi ezintathu efanelekile okuyona isiqu sezoMnotho, noma esinye isiqu esihlobene nawo. Iziphi angaphandle kwezinye iziqu eziphakeme kakhulu, zizophathelwe ngendlela efanayo nabafake izibongo ezikhethekile; Isipiliwoni samunyaka owodwa (1) kuya kwamawunyaka amabili (2) kwi-State Financial Accounting; izinhlelo ze-PERSAL ne-BAS, ulwazi ngomthetho we-PFMA kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury; ukwazi nokuzwa iBAS; amasu okukhuluma (ebukhomeni nakubhalwe); amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha; amandla okuxazulula izinkinga; amandla okuhlela nokubumba amanye amandla; amandla ekuhlaziya; amandla okuxhumana; amandla okubuka abathengi ngokukhethwa; amandla okulawula imali; amandla okubukela abathengi. Amagama athe qwa: Msamu futhi ethembekile; Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sikahulumende; Amadodakazi aya esikoleni; Amandla okusebenza ngaphansi kokuqiniswa; Amandla okusebenza esitatshini ngokuzimela; Ukuzimisela, kwaye uqale ngokwakhe.
zu.duties: Hlola futhi uvume izinkokhelo ezihlobene nomholo kwi-PERSAL ne-BAS kubasebenzi bomnyango. Lawula ukukhokhelwa kwezimangazo ezingezandle, ezinjengesikhathi esongiwe, izimali mboleko zamaseshini kanye nezikweletu. Lawula ukumiswa kwezimiso zokuhlala. Lawula ukukhansulwa kwezinkokhelo ezinjengezindlela zomshwalense. Hlola futhi uvume izimangazo zokuHamba zaseduzi nasaphandle nezinkokhelo zokuphila. Lawula izinkokheloezihlobene nemimangazo yomholo. Lawula ukuthi kusafakwa kahle kanjani ukwahlukanisa kwezibalo zokuHlola izinto ze-PERSAL kumagebhu neminye emikhakha, futhi kwafakwa kumafayela lezi zibalo njalo ngenyanga. Lawula ukucisha, ukulinganisa kanye nokubika ngemumo emaphazini ehhohlewe ngemali ehlobene nomholo. Lawula ukukhishwa kwezinkokhelo zokuhlala ezivezwa ngosuku kanye nazo ezikhishwa esikhundleni sawo. Lawula ukwenziwa kohlelo lwenyanga i-BAS-PERSAL yezinkokhelo ze-BAS-PERSAL. Landa futhi uphinde wethule izinto ezingezile ze-PERSAL kwi-BAS. Ukulawula abanikazi: Hlola futhi uvume izibalo eziphathelene nezikweletu kanye nokuvela kwezinkokhelo kwi-BAS, futhi lawula ukwenziwa kwamaphayiphu ezikweletu. Lawula futhi uphendule imibuzo ehlobene noma ngabe yimiphi yemisebenzi yokulawula. Lawula umsebenzi ngokugcwalisa nokwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwemisebenzi, nokuthuthukiswa kwayo njengesinyathelo sokuthuthukisa imigqopho elawulwa ubuhlakani bekhaya. . Phetha imibuzo ehlobene nalolu hlelo. Qaphela futhi ulawule ngokuphelele imigwaqo yemisebenzi yabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho ngokubalwa nabanye, ngokuphepha imisebenzi, nokulawula izinhlelo zomsebenzi, njengasekunqumeni izinhlelo noma isikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi. Ukucela imibiko ye-BAS lapho kudingeka khona. Ukugcina emafayeleni imibhalo ephathelene nezimangazo. Qaphela: Bonke abaqeqeshiwe ukuthi bazodinga ukuqeqeshwa ngohlelo ababekiwe kulo ukuba bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ehlobene nalesi sikhundla.

xh.title: Omandla we-Akhawunti Wosapho: Lawulo Lomvuzo
xh.summary: Lawula iinkcitha zomvuzo kwi-PERSAL nase-BAS, kuquuka izigqibo zolwazi I-akhawunti, imirhalo yemali kwiintsapho nokuqwalaselwa kokurhoxiswa kwemali.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Diploma yaseZantsi yeminyaka emi-3 esifanelekileyo nge-akhawunti njengomxholo okanye isiqinisekiso esinxulumene naye, Ingqinelo iza kunikwa kubafaki isicelo abanamava afanelekileyo emnyakeni omnye (1) ukuya kweminyaka emibini (2) ekuKhomishani ye-Akhawunti yamava ekuRhulumeni; i-PERSAL nendlela yokusebenza ye-BAS, ulwazi nokuqonda kwe-PFMA nemiGaqo yeSizulu ye-National Treasury; ulwazi nokuqonda kweekhadi zeSiseko se-Akhawunti (BAS); amakhono amnandi wolwazi olubhalwayo noluthethwayo; ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha; amakhono okusombulula iingxaki; amakhono okucwangcisa nokuqamba; amakhono okuhlalutya; amakhono okuxhumanisa nabanxibelelanayo; amakhono okukhathalela abathengi; amakhono okulawula imali; amakhono okubonisa; amakhono okukhathalela abathengi. Ezinye Iimpawu/Amakhono: Mhlophe kwaye ethembekileyo; Ukuqinisekiswa; Qinisekile; Ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo; Ukwazi ukusebenza kwindima kwaye njengomntu oyedwa; Ukuzimisela; kwaye Uqale ngokwakhe.
xh.duties: Hlola futhi ugunyaze iinkcitha ezinxulumene nomvuzo kwi-PERSAL nase-BAS kumsebenzi wabasebenzi baseKhomishani. Lawula inkokhelo yezicelo ezongezelelweyo njengamaxesha okusebenza ngaphezu kwesigqibo, intlawulo yamaholide kwaye uxhase ngaphambili. Lawula ukumiswa kokuvala izigqibo sokwenzela intsapho. Lawula ukurhoxiswa kwemfuneko yokuthatha imali emseleni njengamaxabiso egumbi lokhuseleko. Hlola futhi ugunyaze izicelo zentswela-bindi kunye nezicelo zokutya eNgaphakathi naseKunye namanye amazwe. Lawula intlawulo yezicelo zomvuzo. Lawula ukuchaneka kokusaswa kwemibiko yokuhlalutya kwezinto ze-PERSAL kumaziko ezeMali kwaye ugcine le mibixo inyanga nganye. Lawula ukucofa, ukuqamba intengiselwano nokubika malunga nemo yee-akhawunti zemali ezinxulumene nomvuzo. Lawula ukushiywa kwentswela-bindi nentlawulo yemali. Lawula ulungelelwaniso lwenyanga yexesha lokudibanisa kwe-BAS/PERSAL. Landela uphinde ungenise iingxaki ze-PERSAL kwi-BAS. Lawula abatyala: Hlola futhi ugunyaze izibalo zetyala elinxulumene nomvuzo kwaye ugunyaze iinkcitha eziza kusebenza kwi-BAS kwaye ulawule uxwebhu lwetyala. Lawula futhi uphendule imibuzo enxulumene nalomsebenzi. Qeqesha umsebenzi wabaphansi ngokuthi phakathi kwabanye, wabelwe futhi ulawule umsebenzi kwaye ugcine inyameko le-ofisi. Celwa imibiko ye-BAS xa kufuneka. Kugcinwa kwamaxwebhu anxulumene nezicelo. Qaphela: Bonke abagqibi kumalinge abafutshane kuya kufuneka bagqibe isicwaliselo esibalulekileyo.

jobs.title: Occupational Health and Safety Practitioner
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: The Department of Higher Education and Training seeks an Occupational Health and Safety Practitioner in Pretoria to coordinate OHS compliance, conduct risk assessments, and perform health and safety inspections and audits.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate recognized National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Occupational Health and Safety/ Degree in Environmental Health or Safety Management.1- 2 years’ experience in the Occupational Health and Safety field. Extensive knowledge of Occupational Health & Safety Act 85 of 1993, Public Finance Management Act 1 of 1999, Compensation of Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act 130 of 1993, Disaster Management Act 57 of 2002, and the EHW strategic Framework. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. A valid driver’s license and SAMTRAC will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Coordinate, monitor, advice and render health and safety administration. Monitor OHS compliance. Conducting risk assessments, identifying hazards, and implementing appropriate control measures. Conduct OHS inspections and audits. Facilitate prompt response and resolution of all faults identified. Monitor and support regions compliance with OHS requirements. Coordinate OHS trainings and awareness programme within the department. Monitor the functionality of the OHS Committee at the regions. Provide administrative and secretariat support to OHS committees, coordinating meetings, and ensuring the implementation of resolutions. Facilitate health and safety training, awareness campaigns, and emergency preparedness initiatives, while promoting a culture of safety across all levels of the organisation. Ensure compliance of emergency equipment. Prepare and implement the emergency/evacuation drills in the Department. Liaise with facilities management to conduct building inspections and address hygiene related matters. Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses, compile reports, and recommend preventative and corrective actions to mitigate risks. Report all injuries on duty and Occupational disease to the Compensation Fund office. Facilitate and coordinate the development of occupational health and safety policies, procedures and guidelines. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.

Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. af.title: Beroeps Gesondheids- en Veiligheidspraktisyn
af.summary: Die Department of Higher Education and Training soek 'n Beroeps Gesondheids- en Veiligheidspraktisyn in Pretoria om OHS-nakoming te koördineer, risikobevalings uit te voer, en gesondheids- en veiligheidsinspeksies en oudite te doen.
af.requirements: N toepaslike erkende Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Occupational Health and Safety/ Graad in Environmental Health of Safety Management. 1- 2 years' ervaring in die Occupational Health and Safety veld. Uitgebreide kennis van Occupational Health & Safety Act 85 of 1993, Public Finance Management Act 1 of 1999, Compensation of Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act 130 of 1993, Disaster Management Act 57 of 2002, en die EHW strategic Framework. Uitstekende kommunikasie- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie en SAMTRAC sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Koördineer, monitor, adviseer en lewer gesondheids- en veiligheidsadministrasie. Monitor OHS-nakoming. Voer risikobevalings uit, identifiseer gevare, en implementeer toepaslike beheermaatreëls. Voer OHS-inspeksies en oudite uit. Fasiliteer vinnige reaksie en oplossing van alle foute wat geïdentifiseer is. Monitor en ondersteun streke se nakoming van OHS-vereistes. Koördineer OHS-opleidings en bewustheidsprogramme binne die departement. Monitor die funksionering van die OHS-komitee in die streke. Verskaf administratiewe en sekretariaatsteun aan OHS-komitees, koördineer vergaderings, en verseker die implementering van besluite. Fasiliteer gesondheids- en veiligheidsopleiding, bewustheidsveldtogte, en noodgereedheidsinisiatiewe, terwyl 'n kultuur van veiligheid oor alle vlakke van die organisasie bevorder word. Verseker nakoming van noodtoerusting. Berei voor en implementeer nood/evakuasie-oefeninge in die departement. Skakel met fasiliteitsbestuur om gebou-inspeksies uit te voer en higiëne-verwante aangeleenthede aan te spreek. Ondersoek voorvalle, ongelukke, en byna-ongelukke, stel verslae op, en beveel voorkomende en korrigerende maatreëls aan om risiko's te verminder. Rapporteer alle beserings op diens en beroepsiektes aan die Compensation Fund kantoor. Fasiliteer en koördineer die ontwikkeling van beroeps gesondheids- en veiligheidsbeleide, prosedures en riglyne. N.B. Alle kortlyskandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Umuntu osebenza ngokuqinisekiswa kwezempilo nokuphephileko emsebenzini
zu.summary: I-Department of Higher Education and Training ifuna umuntu osebenza ngokuqinisekiswa kwezempilo nokuphephileko emsebenzini ePretoria ukuba ahlole agcinise ukuziphendulela kwe-OHS, enze ukulinganiswa kwezingozi, futhi enze ukuphenya nokuhlolwa kwezempilo nokuphepha.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ehambelana nezimo eziyindida eziyamukelwe ekuqinisekisweni kwezempilo nokuphephileko/ I-Degree ekuQondweni kwendalo nasekuPhathweni kokuphepha.1- 2 iminyaka yokuhlangenwe nakho emkhakheni wezempilo nokuphephileko emsebenzini. Ukuqonda okujulile ngawe-Occupational Health & Safety Act 85 of 1993, i-Public Finance Management Act 1 of 1999, i-Compensation of Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act 130 of 1993, i-Disaster Management Act 57 of 2002, kanye ne-EHW strategic Framework. Amakhono aphezulu okuxoxa nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye ne-SAMTRAC kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa, hlola, nikeza izeluleko futhi unikele inqubo yokuphathwa kwezempilo nokuphepha. Hlola ukuziphendulela kwe-OHS. Ukwenza ukulinganiswa kwezingozi, ukuhlola izingozi, nokusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ezifanele. Yenza ukuphenya nokuhlolwa kwe-OHS. Siza ekuphenduleni ngokushesha nasekuxazululeni zonke iziphazamiso ezitholakele. Hlola futhi uxhase izifunda ekuziphenduleleni ngemithetho ye-OHS. Hlanganisa izifundo ze-OHS kanye nenqubo yokwazisa ngaphakathi komnyango. Hlola ukusebenza kweqembu le-OHS ezifundeni. Nikeza inkxaso yokuphatha kanye nokubhalisa kumakomidi we-OHS, ukuhlanganisa izingqungquthela, futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumo. Siza ezifundweni zezempilo nokuphepha, imikhankaso yokwazisa, kanye nezinyathelo zokulungiselela izimo eziphuthumayo, ngenkhiyo kukhuthazwe isiko lokuphepha kuzo zonke izinga kohlelo. Qinisekisa ukuziphendulela kwemishini yesimo esiphuthumayo. Lungisa futhi usebenzise imiyalo yesimo esiphuthumayo/esokuphumula endaweni egqamile kumnyango. Xhumana nabaphathi bezakhiwo ukuze wenze ukuhlolwa kwezakhiwo uxazule izindaba ezihlobene nokuhlanzwa. Phenya izehlakalo, izingozi, kanye nezehlakalo ezaseduze kakhulu nokuvela kwezingozi, hlela imibiko, futhi uwakhuthaze izinyathelo zokuvimbela nokulungisa ukuze kuncishwe izingozi. Tshela ngesikhungo se-Compensation Fund ngawo wonke amalimba asebenzayo kanye nesifo somsebenzi. Siza futhi uhlanganise ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, izinqubo kanye nemilawu yezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini. N.B. Bonke abagqwayizi ababhaliwe kuzofuneka baqedele isenzo esifanele sokulingiswa.

xh.title: Umntu osebenzela iMfundo yezoBumphefumlo nokuQinisekiswa kumSebenzi
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha lifuna uMsebenzi weMfundo ngokweZempilo nokuQinisekiswa komSebenzi ePretoria ukuze alungiselele ukuvumelana ne-OHS, wenze ukulinganiswa kweengozi, aze axhase iingxoxo nokuqinisekiswa ngokwemigaqo ekhoyo ngokuhamba kwemisebenzi yezempilo nangokukhuseleka kwindawo.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) exeshekileyo kwindawo yokugqibela iindlela zokuhamba nezigqibo ngokwesiko lwezempilo nokukhuseleka kumsebenzi / inqanaba kwizicwangciso ezahlukeneyo zokuhlonza ezinokubakho kwindalo okanye ukulawula ubukhuseleko kwindawo.1- 2 yeminyaka yokuhamba nokukhuseleka kwindawo yokugqibela iindlela ezahlukeneyo ngokwesiko lwezempilo nokukhuseleka kwindawo. Ulwazi olubanzi lomthetho weOccupational Health & Safety Act 85 of 1993, i-Public Finance Management Act 1 of 1999, i-Compensation of Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act 130 of 1993, uMthetho weDisaster Management Act 57 of 2002, nangaphezu koko iEHW strategic Framework. Amap esi amaNqwthi amakhulu okudibana kwendlela ekhulumanayo kunye nalokungakumbi ukuhlola iingxaki kwindawo. Ukuqinisekiswa kolawulo lwe-National Driver’s License iya kuba ngumngeni ongenelela kuluntu kunye nokuxhaswa kwendlela ezakuthi ngoko igqitywe ngayo inkqubo yokubhalwa kokuhamba.
xh.duties: Lungisa, qaphela, nikela ngolulekoweni kwaye unikeze izicelo zolawulo lwezempilo nokoluseko. Qaphela ukuvumelana ne-OHS. Ukwenza ukulinganiswa kwengozi, ukuqaphela iingozi, nokuseka izigqibo ezifanelekile zolawulo. Yenza ukutlolwa kwe-OHS nokuqinisekiswa. Khankanya impendulo yakutsha nokuqwalaselwa kwazo zonke iziphoso ezifunyeniweyo. Qaphela kwaye uxhase ukuvumelana kwezithili ngeemfuno ze-OHS. Lungisa iindlela zokuzinza noluvo lwe-OHS ngaphakathi kwesebe. Qaphela ukusebenza kweKomiti ye-OHS kummandla. Nikela ngolawulo nengxowa yomabhalo kwiikomiti ze-OHS, ulungelelanise iindibano, uze uqinisekise ukusebenza kwezigqibo. Khankanya kwizikolo ezahlukeneyo zokutya ukulungiselela iingosi, ukusasaza ulwazi, nokuqinisekisa ukulungiselela iimeko ezingozini, ngelixa uxhasa inkqubo yokhuseleko kuzo zonke iinqanaba zenkundla. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana kwegalelo lezoxhobo zomlilo. Lungisa kwaye usebenzise imiyalelo yoxhobo lomlilo mayela nokuvela ngaphandle kwesebe. Phathisana nabaphathi bezakhiwo ukuze uhlole izakhiwo axhase iingxaki ezithinteahluuke kwindalo. Phando iiganeko, iingozi, nasekuhambeni kweziganeko ezingezanga ngozi, qamba iingxelo, yaye ucele ukuba kusetyenziswe ezinye iindlela zokuthintela nokulungisa ekuhambeni kobomi ukunciphisa ubungozi. Xela zonke iingozi kwimisebenzi nangokugula kobumphefumlo kwindawo yeNdlu yoMvuzo. Khankanya ukuba lulungelelana nabakwiKomiti ngokwenza iingxoxo ngendlela ezakuthi ngoko zikwazi ukusebenzela iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo kwindawo yomsebenzi ngokwemigaqo yeempucuko neyamasheyaqo, iindlela ezahlukeneyo nemigaqo ekhokelayo. Qaphela kwaye uphuhlise ngokubhaliswa kwemigaqo yomsebenzi mayela nokulungelelanisa ulwazi kwinkqubo yoxhobo loluhlu kunye nolunye uhlu lokugqithisa kukhuseleko ngokwemigaqo yokuhamba phambili ekukhethwa kwenkqubo ezakuthi igqibe kuyo imisebenzi efunekayo yokulinganisa iimfuno.

af.title: Werknemersgesondheids- en Welstandspraktisyn
af.summary: Werknemersgesondheids- en Welstandspraktisyn benodig in Pretoria om welstandsprogramme te bevorder, verwysings te bestuur en gesondheidsveldtogte vir Department of Higher Education and Training-personeel te implementeer.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike bachelorsgraad/ gevorderde diploma (NQF Vlak 6) in Sielkunde/ Gedragswetenskap/ Maatskaplike Werk met Sielkunde as hoofvak. 'n Minimum van een (1) tot twee (2) jaar praktiese ervaring in die Werknemersgesondheids- en Welstandsomgewing. Kennis van MIV, SOI's en TB-wetgewing en verwante beleide. Kennis van die Strategiese Raamwerk vir Werknemersgesondheid en Welstand in die Openbare Diens met 'n fokus op MIV, SOI's en TB, Gesondheid en Produktiwiteit, en Welstandsbestuurspilare. Analitiese denke, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede, innoverend en kreatief, projekbestuursvaardighede, voorleggingsvaardighede, beplannings- en organiseervaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, goeie koördinasievaardighede, beradingsvaardighede, kliëntgerigtheid, eties en handhawing van vertroulikheid. af.duties: Bevordering van die Werknemersgesondheids- en Welstandsprogramme, verwys werknemers met middelmisbruikversteurings na eksterne organisasies en produseer verslae van formele verwysings, bevordering van fisieke welstand van werknemers deur sportprogramme, implementering van welstandveldtogte insluitend geestesgesondheidsbewustheid, verminder stigmatisering van geestesiektes en andere volgens die gepasmaakte gesondheidskalender, verskaf werk-lewensbalansdienste, implementering van stres- en finansiële bestuurswerkswinkels insluitend voor-aftrede beplanningsprogramwerkswinkels om finansiële welstand te verseker, implementering van MIV, SOI's en TB, gesondheids- en produktiwiteitsbewustheidsveldtogte, bevordering van redelike akkommodasie vir werknemers met gesondheidstoestande, en bevordering van siekte- en chroniese siektebestuur. zu.title: Umuntu osebenza kwezempilo nakwezokuphila kahle kubasebenzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu osebenza kwezempilo nakwezokuphila kahle kubasebenzi ePretoria ukuthi khuthaze izinhlela zokuphila kahle, aphathe ukuthumela abantu kwezinye izikhungo, futhi asebenzise amakhamphani ezempilo abasebenzini baka Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-bachelor's degree/ advanced diploma (NQF Level 6) ku Psychology/ Behavioural Science/ Social Work ethatha i Psychology njengenkomba. Ukube ngaphezu kokuthola amava emisebenzi yonye (1) kuya konyaka (2) oguqukayo kwindawo ezempilo nakwezokuphila kahle kubasebenzi. Ulwazi ngemithetho ye HIV, STIs kanye ne TB kanye nezinqubomgomo ezihlobene nayo. Ulwazi lwe Employee Health and Wellness Strategic Framework kwi Public Service egqamisa i HIV, STIs ne TB, kanye nezempilo nokukhiqiza, nezinhlela zokuphila kahle. Ukwazi ukwenza ukweluleka kwesikhathi esifushane, ukufundisa ngokwengqondo, kanye nokunqamula nokuxoxa ngokusindwa kwengqondo. Ulwazi lwe Mental Health Care Act, imithetho ehambisana ne EHWP kanye nekuqonda zonke izinqubo ze PILIR kanye ne COID Act. Ukubhaliswa kubalimi abalandelayo kuyaye kwenzeke: South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wenzalo, Health Professions Council of South Africa njengomhlengikhi wesikhathi esifushane/ngengqondo noma umhlengikhi obhaliwe. Ukubhaliswa kubalimi abahlobene njengengeyabo Employee Assistance Professionals Association of South Africa (EAPA-SA), South African Occupational Social Work Association (SAOSWA) kanye ne Association for Supportive Counsellors and Holistic Practitioners (ASCHP) okunye kuzoba yinzuzo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuthula (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Amakhono okucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo, kuba yingqayizivele nokudala okusha, amakhono okuphatha izinhlelo, amakhono okuyisa imibhalo, amakhono okuhlela futhi uhle, amakhono okubhala imibhalo, amakhono amahle okuhlanganisa, amakhono okweluleka, ukujwayela abathengi, ukhokho futhi ugcine imfihlo. Ukuqonda imithetho, izimiso, kanye nezinqubomgomo ze Public Service. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ku MS Word, excel, PowerPoint kanye ne Outlook. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Ukukhuthaza izinhlela ze Employee Health and Wellness Programmes, ukuthumela abasebenzi abanesifo sokudakwa yizidakamizwa kwezinye izikhungo bese ukhiqiza imibhalo yokuthumela abantu ngokuhlelekile, ukukhuthaza ukuphila kahle ngokomzimba kubasebenzi ngezinhlela zemidlalo, ukusebenzisa amakhamphani okuphila kahle okuhlanganisa ukwazisa ngokuphila kwengqondo, ukunciphisa isithiyo sokuhlonzwa abantu abagula engqondweni nakwezinye izinhlela njengoba kushiwo ukhalenda wezempilo oguquguqukiwe, ukuletha izinsiza zokulinganisa impilo kanye nomsebenzi, ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokulwa nengcindezzi kanye nokuphatha imali okuhlanganisa izinkundla zokuqeqesha abantu abasathatha umhlalaphansi ukuze baqinisekiswe ukuphila kahle ngokwezimali, ukusebenzisa amakhamphani wokwazisa ngale HIV, STIs ne TB, ezempilo nokukhiqiza, ukukhuthaza izindawo ezifanele abasebenzi abanemikhawulo yesimo sempilo, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa kwezifo nezifo ezingapheli. Ukwenza ukweluleka, ukufundisa ngengqondo, kanye nokuxoxa ngokusindwa kwengqondo. Ukukhokela izinqubo zokuzilela kanye nokweseka imindeni ekhulunwe abantu abadluleyo, ukuqamba imibhalo yalolu hlobo njalo masonto nanyanga okuhlanganisa ukuletha izinto, izaziso, nakunye okubhalwe okudingeka, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amafayela abathengi abuye ashintshwe futhi agcinwe iphephile. N.B. Bonke abantu abezwe izikhundla bazodingeka ukubaqedele isivivinyo esihlobene namakhono abo.

xh.title: Umpractitioner Weempilo Nempilo Yabasebenzi
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe khona uMpractitioner Weempilo Nempilo Yabasebenzi ePretoria ukukhuthaza iinkqubo ezimalunga nempilo, ukulawula iindlela ezithunyelwa kuzo abantu, nokuphumeza iinkqubo ezimalunga nezempilo zabasebenzi beDepartment of Higher Education and Training.
xh.requirements: Idegree yeziqu efanelekileyo okanye idiploma ephakamileyo (NQF Level 6) kwisiXhosa sayensi yokuziphatha okanye kuSocial Work edibana nesiXhaba sayensi yokuziphatha. Amava okusebenza omnye (1) ukuya kwamnye (2) eminyaka yokoqobo kwindawo yeempilo nempilo yabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngomthetho ngeHIV, i-STIs neTB nemigaqo exhunyelewe kulo. Ulwazi ngeSakhiwo Sokuqamba Iindlela i-Employee Health and Wellness Strategic Framework kwiNkonzo Zikarhulumante ngokugqithisa kwiHIV, i-STIs neTB, iMpilo nokuSebenza, kwaye nemigaqo yokuLawula iMpilo. Ukuzipatha kakuhle ekwenzeni iseluleko esifutshane, ukufundisa ngokwengqondo, nasekukhululekeni iindaba ezibuhlungu nokuzivakalisa. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weMental Health Care Act, wemithetho exhunyelewe kwi-EHWP nokuqonda iinkqubo zonke ze-PILIR naye woMthetho we-COID. Ukubhalisa kumagunya alandelayo ngokomthetho kuyinyaniso: South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi weentlalo, Health Professions Council of South Africa njengengcali yeseluleko/ye Ngcali yokuziphatha okanye ngumceluleki obhalisiweyo. Ukubhalisa kumagunya abasebenzi abahambelanayo afana ne-Employee Assistance Professionals Association of South Africa (EAPA-SA), South African Occupational Social Work Association (SAOSWA) ne-Association for Supportive Counsellors and Holistic Practitioners (ASCHP) nakunye kuya kuba luncedo. Amakhono amabalwe ahlelyo abantu, amakhono okunxibelelanakunye nokubhala. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutyo, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuThatha iigqibo, amakhono obuchule bokudala izinto ezintsha, amakhono okulawula iiprojekthi, amakhono okubhala iinkcukacha, amakhono okulungiselela nokuqamba iindlela, amakhono okubhala iingxelo, amakhono olungelo lonxibelelwano, amakhono okunika iseluleko, ukuzinikela kumthengi, ukuziphatha ngokwenene kwaye ugcine iimfihlo. Ukuqonda umthetho wabaRhulumante, imigaqo, namacebo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha kwii-MS Word, excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evakalayo.
xh.duties: Ukukhuthaza iinkqubo zeempilo nempilo yabasebenzi, ukuthumela abasebenzi abanako ukuzibamba ngokusinga izixhobo kwizinkqubo ezingaphandle nokubhala iingxelo zezinto ezithunyelweyo, ukukhuthaza ukuba nempilo yomzimba ngokusebenza ngezinkqubo zemidlalo, ukuphumeza iinkqubo ezimalunga nempilo kuquka nemfihleko engqondweni, ukunciphisa ukubhitywa kwengondo eqondene nesoqhwithi nangeminye imiba njengokuba kwenziwa kwikhalenda yempilo esecwangciswe ngokodidi, ukunika iinkonzo ezimalunga nobudlelane phakathi komsebenzi nempilo, ukuphumeza iindlwang zokuqonda ngezinxwambo ezimalunga nemfihleko engqondweni nezempilo ngokwendalo, ukuphumeza iinkqubo zokuqonda ngeHIV, i-STIs neTB, iinkqubo ezimalunga nempilo emsebenzini, ukukhuthaza ukuba abasebenzi abanengozi empilweni bafumane indawo yokuhlala, kwaye ukukhuthaza ukukhanya kwezifo ezihlala ixesha elide. Ukwenza iseluleko, ukufundisa ngokwengqondo, neenkqubo zokulunga iindaba ezibuhlungu ngengqondo. Ukulawula iinkqubo zokuxhelwa kobomi besikhukhula nekusekela usapho oluxhelwe, ukuqamba iingxelo zeesebe ngo ngeveki nanye ngenyanga ngokudibana neminye imizekelo, iimemo, nakunye imiyalezo efunekayo, kuqinisekiswe ukuba amafayile abathengi ahlaziwayo kwaye agcinwe kakuhle. Amaxesha amakhawulzayo. Onke amagqabi amakhulu akhethwe kuya kufuneka awenze umbhalo wokuqinisekisa ukuziphatha okufanelekileyo.
