'n Minimum van 1-2 jaar se werkervaring in Vraag en Verkrygingsbestuur. Kennis van die PFMA, PPPFA, SCM-riglyne, Tesourie-regulasies, Supply Chain Framework Act, en B-BBEE Act. Diepgaande kennis van verkrygingsprosedures. Goeie interpersoonlike, mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Kliëntverhoudings- en veranderingsbestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om oplossings vir 'n verskeidenheid probleme in ooreenstemming met SCM-riglyne en departementele beleid te ontwikkel (besluitneming) en effektief met belanghebbendes op alle vlakke binne die departement te kommunikeer. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom. Analitiese, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ontvang rekwisisies vir goedere en dienste. Kontroleer of alle relevante dokumente aangeheg is. Registreer alle ontvangde rekwisisies in 'n register. Versprei volgens Voorsieningsketting-delegerings van gesag. Verwerk rekwisisies vir goedere en dienste. Vang en registreer alle rekwisisies op Request for Quotations (RFQ)-register. Help eindgebruikers met tydige ontwikkeling van die spesifikasies/ terme van verwysing vir die bekom van kwotasies. Help eindgebruikers met die behoorlike invul van rekwisisies. Bekom verskaffers uit die CSD op 'n rotasiebasis en verseker nakoming van beginsels van vraag- en verkrygingsbestuur. Koördineer voorligtingsessies. Monitor publikasie van terme van verwysing/spesifikasies vir RFQ's. Voer evaluering uit vir RFQ's met tegniese funksionaliteitskriteria. Berei bestuursinligting, verslae, statistieke en verslagdoening oor verkryging aan bestuur voor. Toesig oor personeel. N.B. Alle kortlys-kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sommeli Ohlela Izezimpahla: Isidingo Nokutholwa
zu.summary: Isikhundla Sommeli Ohlela Izezimpahla kwiSidingo Nokutholwa eDepartment of Higher Education and Training ePretoria, sidinga idigri noma idiploma kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele kweminyaka eyodwa kuya kwayikhombisa.
zu.requirements: Idigri yebachelors eminyaka emithathu evunyiwe/Idiploma lezwe kuSupply Chain Management/ Purchasing Management/ Public Management/ Public Administration/ Business Management/ Logistics Management (noma izifundo ezilinganayo). Okungenani eminyakeni yoku-1-2 yohlu lokuhlangenwe nakho emsebenzini koIsidingo Nokutholwa. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, i-PPPFA, iziqondiso ze-SCM, izimiso ze-Treasury, i-Supply Chain Framework Act, kanye ne-B-BBEE Act. Ulwazi olunjalo ngezinqubo zokuthenga. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, okukhuluma, nokubhala. Amakhono ohlelwanalimi abathengi kanye nokuphatha izinguquko. Ikono lokuthumba izixazululo kwezinkinga ezihlukahlukene ngokuhambisana neziqondiso ze-SCM kanye nezinqubomgomo zomnyango (ukuthatha izinqumo) kanye nokuxhumana kakuhle nabahlanganyeli emazingeni onke ngaphakathi koMnyango. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkuthazelelo kanye nokuhlangabezana namaphasi. Amakhono okuhlaziya, ukuhlela, kanye nokuhlela izinto. Ilayisense yomshayeli esebenzayo.
zu.duties: Thola izicelo zezimpahla kanye nosebenza. Hlola ukuthi yonke imibhalo ehambisanayo ifakwe yini. Bhala wonke amaselo atholwe kusibhalo. Yahl ngokuka-Supply Chain Delegations of authority. Bulunga amaselo ezimpahla kanye nosebenza. Faka futhi ubhale wonke amaselo ku-Request for Quotations (RFQ) Register. Siza abasebenzisi ngokuhlela ngokushesha izinkomba/ izinkombomba ngomlomo zokuthola izincasiselo. Siza abasebenzisi ukuthi bagcwalise ngokufanele amaselo. Thola abahlinzeka ku-CSD ngokujikeleza futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana nezigaba zokuqondisa isidingo & nokutholwa. Hlela izinqubo zokwazisa. Qaphela ukushicilelwa kwezinkomba/izinkombomba zomlomo ze-RFQ's. Yenza ukuhlola i-RFQ's ngemigomo yobuchwepheshe. Lungiselela ulwazi lolawula, imibhalo, izibalo, kanye nokubika ngokuthenga kulawulo. Buka abasebenzi. N.B. Bonke abafaki izicelo abakhethiwe bazocelwa ukuthi bagcwalise inqubo efanele yokuqinisekisa ikhono.

xh.title: MLawuli oPhambili we-Supply Chain: Isidingo noQoqo lwezinto
xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli ophambili we-Supply Chain kwisidingo nokuqoqa kwiSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqeshwa ePretoria, lifuna isidanga noma i-diploma nexesha lokusebenza elingawaka ukuya kweminyaka emibini.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelors's venda kulwazi olunyani kwisebe leNjinjiya ngamakhoswe aphakathi (umchazi) nokukhuluma nokubeka iimeko ukuze kuhlolelwe abo bethu abanjengabakho eKhaiyeshawudwini nakwindawo yesiyingozi kwilungelo leNjinjiya. Isidanga noma iDiploma yelizwe kwimigaqo ye-Supply Chain Management / Purchasing Management / Public Management / Public Administration / Business Management / Logistics Management (okulingana nalolunye lwazi).
xh.duties: Wamkela iindinganiso zezinto nesebenza. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iixatshato ezithintekileyo zidityanisiwe. Qulathe zonke iindinganiso ezamkelweyo kwisiqulathi. Zihambise ngokweNikelo lamandla le-Supply Chain. Ceboza iindinganiso zezinto nesebenza. Thatha ngaphakathi nokuqulatha kwesiqulathi se-Request for Quotations (RFQ) zonke iindinganiso. Siza abasebenzisi ekwakheni ngexesha elincinci iinkcazelo/iimeko zokuqonda ekuzuzeni iisenti. Siza abasebenzisi ekugqibeleleni iindinganiso. Zuzezela ababoneleli kwi-CSD ngokutshintshana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela nemigaqo yolawulo lwesidingo nokuqoqa. Lawula iindibano zokwazisa. Qwalasela ukushicilelwa kwezo nkcazelo/nemiba yokuqonda malunga ne-RFQ. Zenza isilinganisilo se-RFQ ngeenkcazelo zobugcisa. Lungiselela ulwazi lolawulo, iiripothi, izibalo, nokuripota ngokuqeshwa kulawulo. Ulawulo lwabasebenzi. Qaphela: Bonke abakhethiweyo kwi-logical list kuya kufuneka bagqibezele umzamso obalulekileyo wobuchule.

af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Klerk benodig in Pretoria om vergaderings te koördineer, korrespondensie te bestuur en sekretariële ondersteuning binne die Direktoraat van Nasionale Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling te bied.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12/NCV Sertifikaat vlak 4. 'n Verwante graad/Nasionale diploma sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van een tot twee jaar se relevante ervaring sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet aanpasbaar, gedissiplineerd, selfversekerd wees en in staat wees om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk en saam met 'n diverse span te werk. Goeie skryf-, Kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede is noodsaaklik tesame met ervaring in administrasie. Vermoë om notules te skryf, agenda's op te stel, plekke en versnaperinge te organiseer, vergaderings te koördineer, beleide, wette en regulasies, Rekenaarvaardigheid d.w.s. MS Word, Excel, Outlook en PowerPoint, Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en Kennis en begrip van sosiale media.
af.duties: Om te help met die werk wat in die Direktoraat: Nasionale Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling verrig word, insluitend die koördinering van vergaderings vir die Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsraad van Suid-Afrika en sy strukture. Om alle inkomende en uitgaande pos te hanteer en na die korrete rolspelers te verwys. Om sekretariele funksies in raadsvergaderings te vervul en waarookal die Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsraad van Suid-Afrika sitting het. Om seminare, vergaderings en sosiale funksies te reël en te skeduleer en plekke te identifiseer, rolspelers uit te nooi en verfrisings te organiseer. Om alle notules/besluite aan te teken en aan alle relevante rolspelers te kommunikeer en opvolg te doen oor vordering. Om alle relevante dokumente vir vergaderings bymekaar te maak. Dokumente deur te gaan om vas te stel watter aksies/inligting/ander dokumente vir vergaderings benodig word. Om 'n lêerstelsel te hou. Om dokumente, memorandums, briewe en verslae op te stel. Om agenda's en notules vir vergaderings en werkswinkels op te stel. Om met reisagente te skakel om reis- en akkommodasie-reëlings te tref vir lede en sosiale vennote van die HRDCSA. Om die reis- en onderhoudsakte te verwerk. Om die Adjunkdirekteur te help met die bestuur van die kantoor en ondersteuning te bied wanneer vereis. zu.title: Ofisi Omncane Womphatho: Ukolwa, Ukuhlanganiswa
zu.summary: Ofisi Omncane Womphatho udingwa e Pretoria ukuze ahlanganise izinkomfa, aphathe ukuxhumana, futhi anikeze inkxaso yobunobhala ngaphakathi kwoMnyango Wezendlalelo zabantu eNingizimu Afrika.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samatikulu/Isigaba 12/Isitifikedi se-NCV izinga 4. I-degree/diploma yezwe efanayo izobe ngaphezulu. Amava afanele okungenani unyaka 1 kuya konyaka 2 azobe ngaphezulu. Umuntu ophumelelayo kumele ukwazi ukuzivikela, abe nenkolo, azibe nokuzethemba, akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa naphansi kwengcindezi, futhi akwazi ukusebenza nomquluso ohlukahlukene. Amakhono amahle okubhala, okuxhumana nobudlelwano nabantu abadingekile kanye namava kolwa. Ukukwazi ukubhala iminithi, ukulungisa izinhlela zokuhlangana, ukulungiselela izindawo kanye nokudla, ukuhlanganisa izinkomfa, izinqubomgomo, kanye nemithetho. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha njengokusebenzisa i-MS Word, Excel, Outlook kanye ne-PowerPoint, ukuxhumana namanye abantu abahilelekile nokukhanya kwamasosyalamedia.
zu.duties: Ukusiza emsebenzini owenziwa oMnyangweni: Wezendlalelo zabantu eNingizimu Afrika, okubandakanya ukuhlanganisa izinkomfa ze-Human Resource Development Council of South Africa kanye nezakhiwo zayo. Ukuphatha yonke imeyili engenayo naphumayo futhi idluliselwe kubantu abafanele. Ukunikeza imisebenzi yobonini ekuhlanganweni kwebhodi nini naphi lapho i-Human Resource Development Council of South Africa ihlangana khona. Ukulungiselela futhi uhlele izinkomfa, izinkomfa, nemikhosi futhi uchaze izindawo, umeme abantu abahilelekile, futhi ulungiselela ukuphakelwa. Ukubhala yonke iminithi/izinqumo futhi uziduliselle kubantu bonke abahilelekile futhi ulandele inqubomgomo. Ukuqoqa yonke imibhalo edingekayo yezinkomfa. Ukugcina imibhalwa ngaphandle kwezinye ukuthola ukuthi yimipho imisebenzi/imininingwane/eminye imibhalo edingekayo ezinkomfweni. Ukugcina isistimu yokulondoloza imibhalo. Ukulungisa imibhalo, imemorandamu, wocingo nemibhalo. Ukulungisa izinhlela kanye neminithi yezinkomfa futhi uhlele izinkomfa. Ukuxhumana nezinndlu zezohambo ukwenza izinhlela zokuhamba nokuhlala kubangamela nabalingani bemiphakathi ye-HRDCSA. Ukucubungula izimali zokuhamba nokuhlala. Ukusiza uMqondisi oyinhloko ngaphezulu ekubuseni kwehofisi futhi unikeze inkxaso lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuhanjiswa nokubuyiswa kweyimeyili, ukuthayipha imemorandamu nezinkulumo. Amava amabalule kakhulu okusuka kwinyakaxa ukuya kwesibini kule ndawo iza kuba lusongo. Umphatheleli ophumeleleyo kufuneka akwazi ukuzinza, abe nesithintelo, akholelwe kuye, akwazi ukusebenzela yedwa nangxinki, akwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi komgxuma, kwaye akwazi ukusebenza nediarrayana yabantu abangekho ngophawu. Amakhono amaninzi okubhala, uncwadiwesithintela, nobudlelwane bomqondiso kufuneka abekho kubukhali kakhulu kubandakanya amava kolawulo. Ukubhala imibhalo yeentsuku, ukulungisa izithuba, ukulungela iziko nekelo, ukulungelelanisa iindibano, iintetho ngamagunya nemigaqo, ulwazi ngokusebenzela ngokubanzi kwiNkqubo ye Khompyutha ezinje ngokuba yi-MS Word, i-Excel, i-Outlook ne-PowerPoint, unxibelelwano neBhunga nolwazi ngokusebenzela kwiindidi ezintson kakhulu.
xh.duties: Ukunceda kumsebenzi ozenziwa kwiSebe leNqanaba: uPhuhliso lweZemntu, ngokubandakanya ulungelelaniso lweendibano zeKhonsele yoPhuhliso lweeMisebenzi zeMntu eMzantsi Afrika nemimisela yayo. Ukuphatha onke amaxhesha awayo nawo aphumayo, awagqithise kubapayiweki abachanekileyo. Ukunika imisebenzi yomceli ngeendibano zeBhunga kwaye nakanjani apho iKhonsele yoPhuhliso lweeMisebenzi eMntu eMzantsi Afrika ihlala. Ukulungisa kwaye ulungenze isikhathi izeminzaro, iindibano, nemikhankaso yerhwebo, uchaze iindawo, mamemse abapayiweki, kwaye ulungise ukutya. Ukubhala onke amabhala/iigqibo kwaye uzixelele bonke abapayiweki abalulekileyo kwaye ulandele inkqubela. Ukuthumba onke amaxwebhu amabalule kakhulu amafutshane. Ukuphonononga amaxwebhu ukuchaza iintshukumo/olwazi/amanye amaxwebhu afunekayo kwiindibano. Ukugcina inkqubo yokulondoloza. Ukubhala amaxwebhu, iindulumteno, iileta neengxelo. Ukubhala iagenda nemibalo yeesikhathi kwiindibano neziqendu. Unxibelelwano neenkampani zokuhamba ukwenza amalungiselelo okuhamba nokuhlala kumalungu neenkampani ezikhusela iNkqubo ye-HRDCSA. Ukusebenza iindleko zokuhamba nokuhlala. Ukunceda uSekela weNkulumbuso ekusebenzeni kwe-ofisi kwaye unike inkxabo xa kufuneka. Ukuthumela nokubuyisa i-imeyile, ukubhala iindulumteno neziphakamiso. N.B. Bonke abakhethiweyo kuya kufuneka bagqibe isixhobo sokuqinisekisa inkqubela.

af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat (Grade 12) of Nasionale Sertifikaat (Vocational) Level 4. 'n Diploma (NQF Level 6) of baccalaureusgraad (NQF Level 7) in Management Assistant sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bewese ervaring in dagboekbestuur, vergaderingkoördinasie, dokumentkontrole en algemene kantooradministrasie. Kennis van rekordbestuur, kantooradministrasieprosedures en basiese finansiële administrasie (insluitend kleingeld en faktuurverwerking). Vaardigheid in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, uitstekende telefoonetiket, sterk organisatoriese vaardighede, aandag vir detail, en die vermoë om vertroulikheid en professionaliteit te handhaaf.

zu.title: Umtshali wesikhwama kagesi kanye nosomlilo
zu.summary: Isikweletu somqondisi esinikeza usekelo lokuphathwa kwezokusikwa kwezibhalo nangokuphathwa kwadayari eJohannesburg, sidinga i-Grade 12 kanye namava eminyaka eyi-1 kuya kweyi-2 kumisebenzi ehambisanayo.
zu.requirements: Uthungelwano lweSebenzi senior leSikolo (Iziqu ze-Grade 12) noma ithungelwano leSikolo (Umsebenzi oqeqeshwa ngaphansi kwesikhathi esincane) izinga 4. Idiploma (izinga 6 le-NQF) noma idigri yebhasheli (izinga 7 le-NQF) kwimizamo yokuphathwa kwezinto izoba yinhle. Amava eminyaka eyi-1 kuya kweyi-2 emisebenzi ehambisanayo izoba yinhle. Izifundo ze khompyutha, izifundo zobungunyiswa bomsebenzi, ukuphathwa kwehhovisi izoba yinhle. Amava abonakalayo ekuphathweni kwadayari, ukuhlelwa kwemihlangano, ukulawulwa kwamadokhumenti nangokuphathwa jikelele kwehhovisi. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwamarekhodi, izinqubo zokuphathwa kwehhovisi kanye nokuphathwa kwezezimali okuyisisekelo (okuhlanganisa imali yesikhwama saselokhu ukwenza izinto ezincane kanye nokuqhuba amainvoisi). Ukusebenzisana kahle kokuqonda amagama okusebenzisana nabo, amakhono aphezulu okukhuluma nokubhala, amakhono amahle okuziphatha esifonini, amakhono amahle okuhlela izinto ngendlela efanele, ukuqaphela izinto ezingangingeni, ikhono lokugcina imfihlo nokuba nomoya wokuziphatha kahle emsebenzini.
zu.duties: Nika umqondisi usekelo olugcwele lwezokusikwa kwezibhalo nemisebenzi yezokuphathwa. Phatha idayari yomqondisi, hlela imihlangano, amawokishophu nama-aphoyintimenti, ulungiselele futhi uhlele izinhlela zokuhamba. Lungiselela, wakhe uhlole ukuthi yahambelana namaphuzu abhalwe ngendlela efanele, amabali, izithakweselo, amajenda namaminithi. Phatha amarekhodi, amasistimu okulondolaza amafayela (asezandleni nakwalawa obuchwepheshe) nokuphepha kwamadokhumenti. Phathisa okubhaliwe, imibuzo nokuxhumana nabantu abangaphakathi nabangaphandle. Nikeza usekelo olwamukela abantu futhi olusemazweni, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kabashakeli. Siza ekuqoqweni kwamabali, ukungenisa idatha nokugcina amalogi namarejista. Nikeza usekelo oluyisisekelo lwezimali nezokuphathwa zabantu, okuhlanganisa ukuthenga izinto ezisabelayo, ukuphathwa kwamainvoisi, ukuphathwa kweholo kanye nemisebenzi ehambisana naleso yezokusekelwa kohlelo. N.B. Bonke abantu abakethiwe bazodingwa ukuba bagcwalise isenzo esibonisa amakhono abo.

xh.title: Unobhala kaMlawuli
xh.summary: Unobhala kaMlawuli onikezela ngenkxaso yolawulo nolawulo lwedayari eJohannesburg, efuna iGrayidi 12 eneminyaka engu-1 ukuya kwengama-2 yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate (Grade 12) okanye i-National Certificate (Vocational) Level 4. I-diploma (NQF Level 6) okanye iziqu ze-bachelor's degree (NQF Level 7) kwi-Management Assistant ziya kuba lusizo. Ubuncinane beminyaka engu-1 ukuya kwengama-2 yamava ahambelanayo buya kuba lusizo. I-Computer Studies, i-Secretarial Studies, i-Office Management ziya kuba lusizo. Amava abonwayo ekulawulweni wedayari, uco-ordinatham amaqela, ulawulo lwamaxwebhu nolawulo jikelele le-ofisi. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwerekhod, iinkqubo zolawulo le-ofisi nolawulo lwezemali esisezantsi (kuquka nolawulo lwemali encinci nokusebenza iinvoice). Ubulungiselelo kwi-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint ne-Outlook. Amakhono amabalwa abhalwe nethethwa, indlela elungileyo yokuphendula ifowuni, amakhono amaninzi okuhlelwa, ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha, nokuba nakho ukugcina iyimfihlo nokuziphatha ngokuchanekileyo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso epheleleyo yobhala nolawulo kuMlawuli. Lawula idayari kaMlawuli, cwangcisa amaqela, i-workshops namaxesha okubonisana, uze uco-ordinate ukuhamba. Lungiselela, fumana isimo sazo nokuhlola ngokulinganayo iinkomfa, iireport, i-submissions, i-agenda namaminethi. Lawula iirekhod, iinkqubo zokulungelelanisa iifayili (zentsundo nezabakhompyutha) nokugcina axabisekile amaxwebhu. Phatha iinkomfa, imibuzo nokunxibelelwana nabahlali bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nika inkxaso yamagumbi okwamkeela ngefowuni, kuquka nolawulo ababindakuli. Siza ekwakheni iireport, ekubambeni idatha ekugcineni ii-log namarejista. Nika inkxaso ezisezantsi yemali nabantu bolawulo, kuquka ukuthenga izinto eziqhelekileyo, ukusebenza iinvoice, ulawulo loluhlu namanye omisebenzi ohambelanayo wenkxaso le-ofisi. N.B. Onke abagqithiswa abakhethiweyo baya kufuneka bagqibe isikhokelo sobuchule esihambelanayo.

Aansoekers moet ook oor die volgende vaardighede beskik: Goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede – skakeling met kollegeamptenare; Algemene korrespondensie – onttrekking, samestelling, opname van data en reaksie op navrae. Rekenaarvaardigheid, veral die gebruik van MS Word en Excel; Uitstekende rekordhouding, elektroniese en handmatige lêervaardighede, veeltalligheid en probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Algemene staatsdiens-aanbevellingsraamwerke en -beleide sal vereis word. Moet in staat wees om onafhanklik sowel as in 'n span te werk; asook bereid wees om oortyd te werk.
af.duties: Ontvang en pak eksaminstasiekwasioneeringsaflewerings; Stuur eksaminstasie na alle geregistreerde eksamensentrums. Verwerking van eksaminkonsessies vir kolleges in provinsies; Registrasie van eksamensentrums, monitering van die uitvoering van eksamens in kolleges; Onttek tekortkominge uit die instrumente vir samestelling van die nasionale verslag en statistieke oor die eksamens wat uitgevoer is. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan kolleges rakende eksaminkonsessies, registrasie en monitering van eksamens. Registrasie van alle onreëlmatighede ontvang vir die huidige eksaminsiklus; Voorbereiding van lêers vir die NEAIC-vergadering. N.B. Alle gekose kandidate sal 'n relevante bevoegdheidsoefening moet voltooi.

zu.title: Ungleleli Wezolawulo Jikelele
zu.summary: Kudingeka ongumlekeleli wezolawulo jikelele ePretoria ukuphatha isithunywa sezitshudeni zokuhlola, ukubhalisa izikhungo nokubheka ukusebenza ngeholo elingu-R237,453 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi samabanga aphezulu noma itholakalo lesiNgaba 12, benomuzwa kuloLawulo jikelele. Ukuba namava eminyaka eyisikhombisa (1) kuya kubili (2) ekuholweni kwezitshudeni kuzoba yinzuzo. Abafaka izicelo kumele futhi babe nalezikhakheli ezilandelayo: Izikhakheli ezinhle zokuhlobana nokuxhumana – ukuxhumana nosobala bakamakolishi, Ukubhala imibhalo jikelele – ukukhipha, ukuhlela, ukugcina ukwaziso kanye nokuphendula imibuzo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha, ikakhulukazi ukusetshenziswa kwe-MS Word ne-Excel Ukugcina amarekhodi kahle, amakhono okugcina amafayela ngekhompyutha nangokubhalwayo, amakhono okwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga, Izinhloso nezinqubomgomo zokuthenga zesevisi yomphakathe jikelele zizodingeka. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza uzimele kanye nalapho usebenza njengosuku; kanye nokuba nomzimba wokusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi.
zu.duties: Thola upake isithunywa sezitshudeni zokuhlola, Thumela isithunywa sezitshudeni zokuhlola kuzo zonke izikhungo ezibhalisiwe zokuhlola. Ukucubungula imikhawulo yesitshudeni sezitshudeni zokuhlola kumakolishi emifundazweni, Ukubhalisa izikhungo zokuhlola, ukubheka ukuthi kuhlolwa kanjani izitshudeni emakolishi, Khicitha izinsimbi ezincane ohlwini lokuhlanganisa umbiko weZwelonke ngezibalo ngokuholwa kwesitshudeni. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo emakolishi ngokuphathelene nemikhawulo yesitshudeni, ukubhalisa nokubheka ukuholwa kwezitshudeni. Ukubhalisa yonke imikhawulo etholakalayo yesikhashana samanje sesitshudeni. Uklulungeza amafayela ohlelweni lwe-NEAIC. N.B. Bonke abagqoqwe kuhlu abazocelwa ukuba bagcwalise isivivinyo esifanele sokukwazi.

xh.title: Umshicileli woManyano lweNgcali
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMshicileli woManyano lweNgcali ePretoria ukubamba ipepa lokubhala lokuvavanya, ukubhalisa kweziko nokugqola ngenkulungwane ye-R237,453 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka benze iSatiyefikheji ePhezulu okanye isigaba se-12, benobe namava kwilinye leNgcali. Umva owunga-1 ukuya kowesi-2 kumalungiselelo okuvavanya kuya kuba luncedo. Abafaki isicelo kufunzeko babe namakhono alandelayo: Amakhono amabalenguko athile wokuchazana nabantu ekunxibelelaneni – ekunxibelelaneni nabasebenzi bekholeji, ukubhalelana ngokubanzi – ekukhupheni, ekudibaniseni, ekubhaliseni iinkcukacha nasekubaleleni imibuzo. Ukuzazi kwekhompyutha, ngakumbi ukusebenzisa i-MS Word ne-Excel. Ukugcina amarekhodi amahle, amakhono okulayisha ngesandla nangemoyili, ukwenza izinto ezininzi ngexesha elinye nokuqonda iingxaki, iimvisiswano nezixhobo zentengo yalo manyano lweNgcali ziza kufuneka. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenza eyedwa nangokwakho nakwicala nenyani; nokuba ulungele ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwamaxesha abekiweyo.
xh.duties: Amkela alungise ilwelisiyepepa lokuvavanya, Athumele ilwelisiyepe lokuvavanya kuzo zonke iindawo ezibhalisiweyo zokuvavanya. Ukuphatha iinkhawulezomvuzo zokuvavanya kwikholeji kwiphondo, Ukubhaliswa kweendawo zokuvavanya, ukugqola indlela okwenziwa ngayo imivavanyo kwikholeji, Ukukhupha iimpazamo kule zoqobo ezibhalwe ngomxholo weSizwe nangokubalwa kwemivavanyo esezinziweyo. Zonke iindawo ezibhalisiweyo zokuvavanya kufuneka zithunyelwe kwezo zibhalisiweyo ngokwexesha. Nikela ngokuluncedo kolunye lweNgcali kwikholeji malunga nokuqesha iinkhawulezomvuzo, ukubhalisa nokugqola imivavanyo. Ukubhalisa zonke iingxaki ezifunyenwe kweso sixesha salo mva wokuvavanya. Ulungiselela iifayili zokuhlangana kwi-NEAIC. N.B. Onke amagosa abekiweyo aya kufuneka aqedele isiqendu sokuziqhelanisa.

jobs.title: Human Resource Clerk: Corporate Services
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Human Resource Clerk providing recruitment, conditions of service and performance administration support at the Polokwane Regional Office.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate national senior certificate/grade 12 (Vocational) (NCV) certificate (Level 4) certificate. An appropriate bachelor’s degree/national diploma in Human Resource Management/ Public Management will be an added advantage. A minimum of one (1) to two (2) years of working experience in a Human Resource Management environment will be an added advantage. Knowledge of Human resources or Public Administration processes. Computer Literacy. Knowledge of Human Resource functions as well as the ability to capture data, operate computers and collate administration statistics. Basic knowledge and insight into human resource prescripts. Knowledge and understanding of PERSAL. Knowledge of registry duties and importance. Flexibility and teamwork. To have good interpersonal and communication skills, listening skills, and analytical skills. Be customer-orientated and client-focused. Be able to conduct him/herself ethically and accountably. Able to work under pressure and be able to deal with confidential information and apply good judgement. To work independently and to meet deadlines.
jobs.duties: Implementation of Human Resource practices i.e., Recruitment and Selection, Conditions of service- attend employee benefits. Serve as secretariat during selection and interview periods. Administration of Performance and Development system, Probationary periods adhered to and to assist on Pillar processes. Render registry services. Adhere to Government Prescripts. Assist in leave management. Coordinate and facilitate training and induction programmes. Liaise with external training providers. Conduct training needs analysis. Advise employees regarding career development. Assist with skills development audits. Administer Internships/Learnerships programmes. Facilitate needs-directed courses, seminars, and workshops. Serve as a secretary during training committee meetings. Perform other related functions as requested by the supervisor. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:   https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. af.title: Menslike Hulpbronklerk: Korporatiewe Dienste
af.summary: Menslike Hulpbronklerk wat werwing, diensvoorwaardes en prestasieadministrasieondersteuning by die Polokwane Streekkantoor verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike nasionale senior sertifikaat/graad 12 (Beroepsgeoriënteerde) (NCV) sertifikaat (Vlak 4) sertifikaat. 'n Toepaslike bachelorsgraad/nasionale diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/ Openbare Bestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van een (1) tot twee (2) jaar se werkservaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbronne of Openbare Administrasieprosesse. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronfunkies asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaars te bedryf en administrasiestatistieke saam te stel. Basiese kennis en insig in Menslike Hulpbronvoorskifte. Kennis en begrip van PERSAL. Kennis van registerpligte en die belang daarvan. Buigsaamheid en spanwerk. Oor goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede, luistervaardighede en analitiese vaardighede beskik. Kliëntgerig en kliënsgefokus wees. In staat wees om hom/haar eties en verantwoordelik te gedra. In staat wees om onder druk te werk en vertroulike inligting te hanteer en goeie oordeel toe te pas. Om onafhanklik te werk en sperdatums na te kom.
af.duties: Implementering van Menslike Hulpbronbronne-praktyke, d.w.s. Werwing en Keuring, Diensvoorwaardes - bywoon van werknemervoordele. Tree op as sekretariaat gedurende keurings- en onderhoudperiodes. Administrasie van Prestasie- en Ontwikkelingstelsel, proeftydperke word nagekom en om te help met Pilaarprosesse. Lewer registerdienste. Hou by Regeringsvoorskifte. Help met verlofbestuur. Koördineer en fasiliteer opleidings- en inlywingsprogramme. Skakel met eksterne opleidingsverskaffers. Voer opleidingsbehoeftesontleding uit. Adviseer werknemers aangaande loopbaanontwikkeling. Help met vaardigheidsontwikkelingsoudits. Administreer Internskappe/Leerderskapsprogramme. Fasiliteer behoeftegerigte kursusse, seminare en werkswinkels. Tree op as sekretaris gedurende opleidingskomiteevergaderings. Voer ander verwante funksies uit soos deur die toesighouer versoek. N.B. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Human Resource Clerk: Corporate Services
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikhozikamabonakude ngabakhwazi kwezangaphakathi ngamagunya, izimo zokusebenza kanye nokuxhaswa komsebenzi ngenkomba ye-Polokwane Regional Office.
zu.requirements: Kufanele ube nesitifikedi sesikole samabanga aphezulu/i-Grade 12 (Vocational) (NCV) Level 4. I-degree yebachelors noma i-diploma yezwe ku-Human Resource Management/Public Management izoba yinenzuzo. Ukuba nomzamo weminyaka eyi-1 kuye kwayi-2 kusebenzeni kwe-Human Resource Management izoba yinenzuzo. Ulwazi nge-Human resources noma izinqubo ze-Public Administration. Ulwazi ngokus
zu.duties: Ukuqashwa kwezindlela ezithintwe abantu okuyinkomba, okuyinkomba kokubetha ngqo, izimo zokusebenza, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukulawula nokuqapha ukusetshenziswa komthetho kwezulu lomsebenzi, ukuphathwa kwezindleko zomsebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza.

xh.title: Human Resource Clerk: Corporate Services
xh.summary: Usihlalo weHuman Resource onceda ngokuthatha abasebenzi, iimeko zokusebenza nokusebenza kakuhle kukhsebe iPolokwane Regional Office.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo senior certificate/grade 12 (Vocational) (NCV) (Level 4). Idegree yebhasela/iploma yelizwe kwiHuman Resource Management/ Public Management iya kuba ngumngeniso ongaphezulu. Amava okusebenza angaphantsi kweyure (1) ukuya kwezimbini (2) kwindawo yeHuman Resource Management iya kuba ngumngeniso ongaphezulu. Ulwazi ngezenkokeli zoluntu okanye iinkqubo zolawulo loluntu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezentsapho zoluntu nokukwazi ukugcina ulwazi, ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zolawulo. Ulwazi olusentlanganini nokuqonda ngeemiyalelo yezentsapho zoluntu. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PERSAL. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeregistry nokuqonda ukubaluleka kwayo. Ukuzinika nokuqonda ngokusebenza njengesiqhagamshelwano. Ukuba nakhono eziquka ezikwazikwazana nabantu ezindwendweni, nakuqonda nokulalela, nakwikritisism. Ukuziphatha ngokuzinikela kuqoqosho loluntu. Ukuziphatha ngokuzigqaja ngokusesikweni kwaye ube neliqesha elihle. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo kwaye ukwazi ukuba nabantu abagqithisayo ngolwazi oluyimfihlo nokubonelela ngokuqonda okuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuphumeza iindlela zezenkokeli zoluntu, oko kukuthi, Ukuthatha abantu abasebenzayo nokuKhethwa, iimeko zokusebenza - ukuzisa izibonelelo zohambo labasebenzi. Ukukhonza njengesikolo-phethuli ngelaxesha lokukhethwa nethumba. Ulawulo loluhlelo lokuZenza kakuhle nokuPhuhlisa, ukuqinisekiswa kwamaxesha okuzama noku nkxaso kwiinkqubo zePillar. Ukunika iinkonzo zeregistry. Ukuzithoba kumagazini kaRhulumente. Ukuncedisa kulawulo loluxesha lokuphumla. Ukuqamba nokuququzelela iinkqubo zolungiso nokuqaliswa kwindlela. Uxhumano nababoneleli bolungiso bangaphandle. Ukuqumba isicwangciso sezidingo zolungiso. Ukwelisa abasebenzi ngophuhliso lomsebenzi. Ukuncedisa kwizikhalazo zophuhliso lwamakhono. Ulawulo lwenkqubo zokungenisa iziko kubafundi nokuqeqeshwa. Ukuququzelela iinkosi ezisuka kumfuno, iiseminari, nokuqoqwa. Ukukhonza njengosekretarhi kwiintlanganiso zekomiti yolungiso. Ukwenza eminye imisebenzi enxulumeneyo njengoko celwa ngumlawuli. Qaphela. Onke amagqabantshathi akhethiweyo aya kufuneka agqibe isixhobo esifaneleyo sokulinganisa ikhono.

af.title: Finansiesklerk: Salarisbeheer
af.summary: Finansiesklerk benodig in Pretoria om salarisverwante transaksies op PERSAL en BAS vas te lê, wat Grade 12 met rekeningkunde en een tot twee jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat (Grade 12) of 'n NCV-sertifikaat met rekeningkunde as 'n geslaagde vak. 'n Minimum van een tot twee jaar se relevante ervaring sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ander eienskappe/vaardighede: Vriendelik, betroubaar en akkuraatheid.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verwag word om dokumente en inligting met streng vertroulikheid te hanteer. Die verantwoordelikhede van die aangestelde sal behels die vaslegging van salarisverwante transaksies op PERSAL en BAS vir departementele amptenare, die vaslegging van betalings van bykomende eise soos oortyd, sessietoelaes en voorskotte, die instel van beslagbeveilingsbevele, die nietigverklaring van aftrekkings soos versekeringspolisse, die vaslegging van plaaslike en buitelandse reis- en verblyftoelae, die nagaan en vaslegging van salariseise, die verspreiding van PERSAL-itemanaliseverslae aan finansiële instellings en die indien van hierdie verslae op 'n maandelikse basis, die berekening en vaslegging van verlof- en paaiementtobetaling en die reageer op navrae wat verband hou met hierdie funksie, indien van salarisverwante dokumente. Bystand met die byhou van 'n register vir salarismbetalings en aftrekkings. Bystand met ouditnavrae aangaande salarismbetalings en aftrekkings. N.B. Alle gekose kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidsopdrag te voltooi.

zu.title: Iclerk Yezimali: Ukulawula Iholo
zu.summary: Kudingeka iclerk yezimali ePretoria ukuze ifake emshinini izinkalo ezihlotshaniswe neholo kwi-PERSAL ne-BAS, kudingeka ibone i-Grade 12 enezibalo kanye namaphuzu eminyakeni eyi-1 kuya kwayi-2 yohluvo oluhlobene nalesi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikadi Esiphakeme (i-Grade 12) noma isitifikadi se-NCV okuyisona isibalo esidlule. Ukuze kube mnandi kuzodingeka ibe nolwazi oluncane lwamaphuzu amunyaka eyi-1 kuya kwayi-2. Izimpawu/Ekhono: Kufanele ukuba musa kwaye thembekile kwaye akhondo kakuhle.
zu.duties: Umama ofunyenweyo kulindeleke ukuba aphathe amaxwebhu nenkcazelo ngobugcisa obukwisagulo. Iinkalo zomthunywa ziya kubandakanya ukubhala iinkalo ezihlotshaniswe neholo kwisiQungathi sePERSAL neBAS ngabasebenzi boMnyango, ukubhala iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ezinjengemali yokwenza umsebenzi ongaphaya kwesikhathi, izibonelelo ezinje ngemali yokuhlanganyela nezimali ezinyanzelekileyo, ukumisela iinkalo ezikwicala lezomthetho, ukumisa iinkalo ezinje ngemali efunwa zii-insurance, ukubhala iinkalo ezihlotshaniswe nokuhamba nokutya kwindawo engaphandle nakwindawo enganeno, ukukhangela nokubhala iinkalo ezihlotshaniswe neholo, ukuhambisa iinkcazelo ezivela kwiPERSAL ezibonelela ngolwazi malunga neentsapho zamanyano, ukuzigcina iindaba ezinjalo ekuhlaleni rhoqo, ukubala nokubhala iinkalo ezihlotshaniswe nokuwa kwaye nokuza ngesixa, nokuphendula imibuzo ephathwe ngale nkalo. Ukubhala iindaba ezihlotshaniswe neholo. Ukuncedisa ukugcina inani elibhala ngemali yokuhola nasekukhupheni. Ukuncedisa ngemibuzo engundwendwe malunga nemali yokuhola.

xh.title: I-Clerk yezeMali: Ulawulo loVuzo

Iimviswano zomntu oqeshwe ziya kuqulathe ukubhala iintshukumo ezinxulumene nentlawulo kwi-PERSAL nase-BAS kubasebenzi beDepartment, ukubhala iintlawulo zezicelo ezongezelelweyo njengemisebenzi yehoure, imiddabo yeseshoni kunye nentswela-buhlungu, ukuseka iiodolo zomthwalo wemali wesigqeba, ukurhoxisa ukukhuswa njengamapoli omtshato wolonwabo, ukubhala iindlela zokuHamba zaseKhaya naseLuzwini kunye nezi zimangalo zokuphila, ukukhangela nokubhala iimviswano zentlawulo yemivuzo, ukusasaza iindaba ze-PERSAL zohlalutyo lwezinto kubasekelisi beMali njalo ngenyanga, nokuFayila la mandaveyili, ukubala nokubhala iindlela zokuphumla nentlawulo yexabiso elithe ngqo kwaye uphendule imibuzo enxulumene nalomsebenzi, uFayila lwamaxwebhu axhunyiwe kwntlawulo yemivuzo. Ukuncedisa ukugcina irejista yentlawulo nokukhuswa kumvuzo. Ukuncedisa ngemibuzo ye-Audit malunga nentlawulo nokukhuswa kumvuzo. jobs.title: Receptionist: Office of the Regional Manager
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Provide reception and administrative support services at the Polokwane Regional Office, managing calls, visitors and related secretarial duties.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate national senior certificate/grade 12 certificate (Vocational) (NCV) Level 4 certificate. An appropriate bachelor’s degree/national diploma (NQF Level 6) in Administration/Management or related qualification will serve as an added advantage. A minimum of one (1) to two (2) years’ working experience in rendering receptionist, administrative and secretarial support services will be an added advantage. The ideal candidate should be proficient in MS Office, typing, and written and verbal communication skills. Organisational and prioritisation skills. Customer care and Client orientation skills. Telephone etiquette and document management are some of the skills required for this job. Ability to work in a team and independently.
jobs.duties: Render reception services to the Office of the Regional Manager. Receive and direct telephonic and electronic calls and messages. Liaise with clients, managers and related stakeholders as directed. Receive and engage visitors. Keep a logbook of each day’s visitors. Ensure a clean reception area. Exercise control of access to the Office of the Regional Manager. Arrange and provide refreshments for visitors /clients as directed. Provide general administrative support services to the office of the Regional Manager. Receive and administer the flow of information and documents in the Office. Prepare and distribute documents as directed. Assist with enquiries related to the Office. Administer the procurement process of office equipment and stationery. File/store trace and electronically and manually retrieve documents and files. Assist with processing of claims for travel and accommodation. Assist with administration of leave for staff in the office of the Regional Manager. Provide general secretarial services to the office of the Regional Manager. Assist with the arrangement of meetings. Organise logistics for the meeting. Assist with the preparation of documentation for the meetings. Execute all claims for travel, accommodation, and rental cars. Assist with an effective flow of information and documents: Direct received a submission to relevant managers within the office of the Minister. Ensure the safekeeping of documentation. Responds to enquiries received from internal and external stakeholders as directed. Draft documents as required. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

af.title: Receptionis: Kantoor van die Streekbestuurder
af.summary: Verskaf ontvangs en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste by die Polokwane Streekskantoor, bestuur oproepe, besoekers en verwante sekretariële pligte.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike nasionale senior sertifikaat/grade 12 sertifikaat (Vocational) (NCV) Level 4 sertifikaat. 'n Toepaslike baccalaureusgraad/nasionale diploma (NQF Level 6) in Administrasie/Bestuur of verwante kwalifikasie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Minimum van een (1) tot twee (2) jaar se werkservaring in die lewer van receptionis-, administratiewe en sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Die ideale kandidaat moet vaardig wees in MS Office, tik, en skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Organisasie- en prioriteitsvaardighede. Kliëntesorg en kliëntgerigte vaardighede. Telefoonetiket en dokumentbestuur is van die vaardighede wat vir hierdie werk vereis word. Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Lewer ontvangsdienste aan die Kantoor van die Streekbestuurder. Ontvang en stuur telefoon- en elektroniese oproepe en boodskappe. Skakel met kliënte, bestuurders en verwante belanghebbendes soos aangewys. Ontvang en hanteer besoekers. Hou 'n logboek van elke dag se besoekers. Verseker 'n skoon ontvangsarea. Oefen beheer oor toegang tot die Kantoor van die Streekbestuurder uit. Reël en verskaf verfrissings vir besoekers/kliënte soos aangewys. Verskaf algemene administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die kantoor van die Streekbestuurder. Ontvang en administreer die vloei van inligting en dokumente in die Kantoor. Berei dokumente voor en versprei dit soos aangewys. Bystand verleen met navrae wat verband hou met die Kantoor. Administreer die verkrygingsproses van kantoortoerusting en stasie. Berg, traceren en haal dokumente en lêers elektronies en handmatig op. Bystand verleen met die verwerking van eise vir reis en akkommodasie. Bystand verleen met administrasie van verlof vir personeel in die kantoor van die Streekbestuurder. Verskaf algemene sekretariële dienste aan die kantoor van die Streekbestuurder. Bystand verleen met die reëling van vergaderings. Reël logistiek vir die vergadering. Bystand verleen met die voorbereiding van dokumentasie vir die vergaderings. Voer alle eise vir reis, akkommodasie en huurmotors uit. Bystand verleen met 'n effektiewe vloei van inligting en dokumente: Stuur ontvang voorleggings na relevante bestuurders binne die kantoor van die Minister. Verseker die veilige bewaring van dokumentasie. Reageer op navrae ontvang van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes soos aangewys. Opstel van dokumente soos vereis. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Ibhange lemlando ngomsindo: Ehhovisi lika Mphathi Webhange
zu.summary: Nikeza ngemisebenzi ekwamukeleni ibango kanye nokuphathwa kwezintlu eNkantweni Yesifunda iPolokwane, ukuphatha amakholi, abavakashi eminye imisebenzi ephathelene nayo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esifanele sikaqeqeshwe esikoleni samabanga aphezulu/isitifikedi segreyidi 12 (seBhange Lemisebenzi) (NCV) isitifikedi sezinga 4. Ibhachelo esifanele/idiploma yezwe (izinga le-NQF 6) ezini yokubhalisa/nakukulinganisa izinto noma iziqu eziphathelene nazo kuzosiza kakhulu. Okuncane isiponso esisodwa (1) kuya kokubili (2) seminyaka yohlezi iqinisekiswe ekubhaliseni iholo eqinisekiswe ekuqoqweni kwamaphephandaba kuncane isikhathi esisukuma ekwakhiweni kwezibalo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemisebenzi yokwamukela ibango eNkantjeni Yomphathi wesifunda. Wamukela futhi uhola amakholi wocingo namaseshini kanye nemiyalezo. Xhumana nabathengi, abaphathi kanye nalabo abehile kuleyo ndaba njengoba kumelayo. Wamukela futhi uxhume nabavakashi. Gcina incwadi yokungena ngosuku ngamunye lwabavakashi. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokwamukela ibango ihlale ihlanzekile. Lawula ukungena eNkantjeni Yomphathi wesifunda. Hlela futhi unikeze iziphuzo abavakashi/abathengi njengoba kumelayo. Nikeza ngemisebenzi yonke yokuphathwa kwezintlu eNkantjeni Yomphathi wesifunda. Wamukela futhi uphathe ukugeleza kwemininingwane namadokhumenti eNkantweni. Lungiselela futhi usabalalise amadokhumenti njengoba kumelayo. Siza ngemibuzo ehambisana nenhKantolo. Phatha inqubo yokuthenga izinsiza zenkantolo nezinto zokubhala. Faka/gcina futhi uphinde ulande ngokubhalisiwe nangokubhandayo amadokhumenti namafayela. Siza ekuqoqweni kwezimali zohambo nendawo yokuhlola. Siza ekuphathweni kwamalunga ehhovisi lomphathi wesifunda. Nikeza ngemisebenzi yonke yobuhlakani ehhovisi lomphathi wesifunda. Siza ekuhlelweni kwezinkomfa. Hlela izinsiza zethuluzi zezi nkomfa. Siza ekulungiseleleni kwamadokhumenti wezi nkomfa. Qedela zonke izimali zohambo, indawo yokuhlola, nezimoto eziqashiwe. Siza ukugeleza okusebenzayo kwemininingwane namadokhumenti: Qondisa okuthunyelwe kwabaphathi abahile ngaphakathi kwehhovisi loNgqongqoshe ebandakanya lezo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okuphephile kwamadokhumenti. Phendula imibuzo etholakale kubaphathi abangaphakathi nabangaphandle njengoba kumelayo. Bhala amadokhumenti njengoko kudingeka. N.B. Bonke abafakelwe ohlwini bazodinga ukugcwalisa isevisi ejwayelekile enobuchopho.

xh.title: Iziko: Isebe le-Office of the Regional Manager
xh.summary: Kukho isithuba sokuba ngumamkeli wabantu kwindawo ethile yokusebenza ePolokwane, apho kuya kubakho umntu oza kugcina uluhlu lwabantu abaya kuyo, ajonge abantu abaya kwindawo yokusebenza, ancede abanye abantu abafuna ukwenza imisebenzi ye-Office of the Regional Manager.
xh.requirements: Isebe lidinga umntu oneminye yonke imfuneko yokuba nesidanga sekholeji nakwizidanga ezisisiseko zomsebenzi okanye isidanga se-Grade 12. Kuya kubakho mnikezelo ojongiweyo wokuba ngumamkeliweyo kweli sithuba, ngokutsho kwezonyango ezahlukeneyo. Isebe liza kunika into yokuba kubekho isiphithiphiti kwindawo esebenza ngokomoya woluntu, apho baya kuba nolwazi olupheleleyo lokusebenza kwakhona ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zolawulo. Kwaye i Office of the Regional Manager iza kuvavanya ukuba ngaba abantu abasemva koko banomdla wokusebenza ngakumbi naba bancedise ngokuphatha amaxwebhu abo.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zokwamkela kwi-Office of the Regional Manager. Yamkela wayele emagunyazini amanani kunye nabasebenzi base-ofisini, kwaye ubagqithise kubasebenzi abafanelekileyo nge-email xa kuyimfuneko. Qhagamshelana nakho konke oko kusetyenziswa kwikhompyutha egcwaliswayo nokubhaliweyo nokunyatheliswayo, kwaye uqiniseke ukuba amanqaku abhalwe ngokuchanekileyo ayalandelwa. Bika ngokubakho kwezinto ezingekho siqweni kwikhompyutha ekusebenzela kuyo. Yongeza amanqaba namaxwebhu afunekayo kwiakhawunti yokubhalisa ixesha elidibana nexesha elifikelela kwelinye ilizwe, ukuze abantu bazi. Gcina iziko elifanelekileyo lokugcina amaxwebhu namanqaku axwebhu asebenzayo, aguqule, ahlaziye kwaye aphinde abuyisele. Qinisekisa ulungelelwaniso kwindawo yokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo lwe-Office of the Regional Manager.

zu.title: Msiza Wobuchwepheshe (Izikhundla Elishiyi)
zu.summary: Izikhundla elishiyi zokubayizinda zobuchwepheshe e-Olifantsfontein ezisekela imisebenzi yokuhlola ngokuhloma izikhali, izinto zokwakha kanye nokugcina ukuhlanzeka kwesikhungo somsebenzi.
zu.requirements: Kumele uphe luhlelo lokulinganiselwa le-Grade 10/ Standard 8/ (ABET Level 4). Okungenani ukutholwa kokuhlolwa okuthile iminyaka eyi-1 kuya kweyi-2 ngephumelela. Ukwazi ukuphathwa komthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Ukwazi kokuqinisekileyo ukuvuma izinto zokwakha. Ukwazi okuphansi lula koku-hamba ukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yokucwatywa kwemisebenzi. Ukuze akwazi ukubhala nokufunda. Ukwazi okuqinisekileyo lobuchwepheshe bokungenisa kanye nokuhlwahlwaza ezinye izinsiza ezingase zisize ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuhlolwa. Ukuze akwazi ukusebenzisa izinto zokwakha. Ukwazi okuhle ngokwenziwa kokulungiswa okuncinci emisebenzini yokuhlola ezinsiza zokusebenza nokuhlolwa. Ukwazi ukuvakatshela ukuhlanzeka kwesikhungo somsebenzi. Ukwazi ukubona izinsiza namathuluzi okuhlolwa nokugcina izinsiza zesitolo. Ukwazi okuphansi lula kokuqinisekisa impilo yokuphila. Ukuze akwazi ukukhetha izinsiza namathuluzi okuhlolwa. Ukuze akwazi ukubona izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukuze akwazi ukubhala nokufunda. Ukuze alungise izinsiza namathuluzi okuhlolwa, ukubhala nokubhala. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa izinto zokuhlanzeka. Ukwazi okuhle lokwenza ukulungiswa okuncinci kwamathuluzi okuhlolwa namashini.
zu.duties: Nika abantu abafuna umsebenzi izinsiza ezidingekayo, izinto zokwakha kanye / noma ezinye izinsiza lapho zidingeka khona. Lungisa izinto zokwakha namathuluzi okuhlolwa ngosuku olungaphambi kokuhlolwa. Gcina isikhungo somsebenzi / indawo yokuhlolwa, amashini, izinsiza namaphakethe ezinto ezibhalwayo. Gcina ukuhlanzeka nokuhlelwa okuhle esikhungweni somsebenzi / endaweni yokuhlolwa. Yenza ukulungiswa okuncinci kwezinsiza zokuhlolwa namashini. Yenza imisebenzi yokuzinza kulesikhungo somsebenzi / endaweni yokuhlolwa futhi hambisa izinto ezabelwe abantu kulesikhungo somsebenzi lapho zidingwa khona kanye nokuhambisa izinto ezingadingeki esikhungweni somsebenzi kuye kubaphathi bezinto lapho zidingwa khona. N.B. Bonke abantu abakhethiwe bazodinga ukwenza isibhaxo sokulinganiselwa okuhlobene.

xh.title: Trade Assistant (TEN Posts)
xh.summary: Izithuba ezili-10 zabafundi bokwakha e-Olifantsfontein ezixhasa imisebenzi yokulinganisa ngokulungisa izixhobo, izinto zokwakha kunye nokugcina indawo yomsebenzi ihlanzekile.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka aphyelele iGrade 10/ Standard 8/ (ABET Level 4). Urhobo oluncinci lomnye ukuya kweminyaka emibini yamava ahambelanayo kuya kuba lusongo. Ulwazi nge Occupational Health and Safety Act. Ulwazi olusesikweni lokucoca. Ulwazi lolungiselelo lwezinto kunye nezixhobo kwimisebenzi yokuqathanisa. Amap skill okuthetha, ukufunda nokubhala. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe kolwazi lobugcisa bokwakha. Amap skill okusetyenziswa kolwazi lokucoca. Ulwazi oluhle lokwenza ukulungisa okuncinci nokubhekisa izixhobo zokuqathanisa kunye neemashini. Ulwazi lokucoca indawo yomsebenzi kunye nezixhobo. Ulwazi lwemizekelo yokucoca kunye nezixhobo kwaye igcinwe kakuhle. Ulwazi olusesikweni lokhuseleko. Ulwazi lokukhetha imizekelo yokubeka umlinganiso esifanelekileyo nezixhobo ngokobugcisa. Ulwazi lokubona izinto ezifunekayo ezibekwe ngaphambili. Ulwazi lokufunda nokubhala. Ukulungiselela imizekelo kunye nezixhobo kwimisebenzi yokuqathanisa, amap skill okuthetha, ukufunda kunye nokubhala. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe ngokobugcisa bokwakha. Ukusetyenziswa kolwazi lokucoca. Ulwazi oluhle lokwenza ukulungisa okuncinci nokubhekisa izixhobo zokuqathanisa kunye neemashini.
xh.duties: Hlaba abafaki ngesixhobo esifunekayo, izinto zokwakha kunye/nokunye iinkonzo xa kudingeka. Lungisa ngokuchanekileyo izinto zokwakha kunye nezixhobo kwimisebenzi yokuqathanisa ngosuku ngaphambi kokwenza ukuqathanisa. Gcina ukhuseleko kwindawo yomsebenzi/endlwini yokulinga, iimashini, izixhobo kunye nezinto ezisetyenziswa. Gcina ukucocekile nokulungela endaweni yomsebenzi/endaweni yokulinga. Yenza izonongelo ezincinci kunye nokulungisa izixhobo zokuqathanisa kunye neemashini. Phetha imisebenzi yokhuseleko endaweni yomsebenzi/endaweni yokulinga kwaye uthwale izinto ezabelwe ngazo njl.njl. kulawulo lwezinto zekhaya aye kwindawo yomsebenzi xa kudingeka, kunye nokuthwala izinto ezingasafuneki njl.njl. endaweni yomsebenzi ziye kulawulo lwazo xa kufuneka. Qaphela. Onke amagosa akhethiwe aya kudingeka ukuba aqedise isenzo sokulingana esifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Security Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Security Officer sought at Olifantsfontein to perform access control, visitor management and premises security functions, requiring Grade 12 and PSIRA Grade C certification.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate national senior certificate /grade 12 and or NCV certificate (level 4) or a related qualification. Be in possession of PSIRA Certificate Grade C and valid driver's license. Knowledge of MISS and MPSS. Report writing, communication and Administration skills.
jobs.duties: Perform access control functions, which will include control of visitors and confirm the appointments with the host, ensuring that the visitors register is correctly completed and issue the visitor’s tags/cards. Ensuring that unauthorized people and dangerous objects do not enter the premises. Report and record the incidents inside the occurrence book. Ensure that Departmental assets do not leave the premises unauthorized. Undertake premises/building patrols to identify water leaks, any signs of break-ins, check unlocked doors, check fire equipment and be able to apply emergency procedures during emergencies situations. Report and record all security breaches. Be able to complete all security registers. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Kgare/Ms XE Rikhotso/Ms P Morota Tel No: (012) 312 5165/5513/6389
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlist ted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.“DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. af.title: Sekuriteitsbeampte
af.summary: Sekuriteitsbeampte gesoek by Olifantsfontein vir die uitvoer van toegangsbeheer, besoekersbestuur en perseelsekuriteitsfunksies, wat Grade 12 en PSIRA Graad C-sertifisering vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike nasionale senior sertifikaat /grade 12 en of NCV-sertifikaat (vlak 4) of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. Wees in besit van PSIRA-sertifikaat Graad C en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis van MISS en MPSS. Verslagdoening, kommunikasie en administratiewe vaardighede.
af.duties: Voer toegangsbeheerfunksies uit, wat die beheer van besoekers en die bevestiging van afsprake met die gasheer sal insluit, om te verseker dat die besoekersregister korrek ingevul word en om besoekers se kentekens/kaarte uit te reik. Verseker dat ongemagtigde persone en gevaarlike voorwerpe nie die perseel betree nie. Rapporteer en teken voorvalle in die voorvalboek aan. Verseker dat departementele bates nie sonder magtiging die perseel verlaat nie. Onderneem perseel/geboupatrollies om waterlekkasies te identifiseer, enige tekens van inbrauke op te spoor, oop deure na te gaan, brandblustoerusting na te gaan en in staat te wees om noodprosedures tydens noodtoestande toe te pas. Rapporteer en teken alle sekuriteitskragtinge aan. Wees in staat om alle sekuriteitsregisters te voltooi. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal verlang word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.summary: Kufunwa isiphathi sezokuphepha e-Olifantsfontein ukusebenza imisebenzi yokulawula ukungena, ukuphathwa kwabavakashi kanye nokuphepha indawo, okudinga izinga le-12 nesitifikedi se-PSIRA izinga C.

xh.title: Isiphathihlazi
xh.summary: Kufunekwa isiphathihlazi e-Olifantsfontein ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo lokungena, ulawulo labanjindwendwa nokhuseleko lwendawo, kufuneka ibe ne-Grade 12 kunye nesatifikethi se-PSIRA Grade C.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo se-national senior certificate / grade 12 kwaye okanye isatifikethi se-NCV (level 4) okanye nesiqinisekiso esinxulumeneyo. Kufuneka ube nesatifikethi se-PSIRA Grade C kunye nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi nge-MISS nge-MPSS. Amakhono ebhala iirepoliti, ekunxibelelaneni nolawulo.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo lokungena, equka ulawulo labanjindwendwa kuqinisekise iinhlobo nomnxeba nomamkeli, kuqinisekiswe ukuba irejista yabanjindwendwa igqibiwe kakuhle kunye nokunikwa iitag/cards zabanjindwendwa. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba abantu abangenelayisensi nabantu abathweleyo izinto ezisengozini bangangeni kwindawo. Chadanisa kwaye urekode iziganeko kwincwadi yeziganeko. Qinisekisa ukuba izinto zesebe azishiya kwindawo ngaphandle kwelayisensi. Yenza amajoni kwii-premises / izakhiwo ukuze ukhangele ukuphuma kolwelo, iziphetho zokungena ngamandla, ukukhangela iingcango ezingavalelwanga, ukukhangela izixhobo zomlilo ukwazi ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zezenzo eziphuthumayo ngexa la meeko zibalulekileyo. Chadanisa kwaye urekode zonke iziphula-khuseleko. Makakwazi ukugqibela zonke iirejista zokhuseleko. N.B. Onke amagqatswa akhethiweyo kuya kufuneka bagqibe isikhtiwe sekhompthensiya esifanelekileyo.

af.title: Grondwerker: Onderhoud
af.summary: 'n Grondwerker word by Olifantsfontein benodig om gebou-inspeksies, klein herstelwerk en grasonderhoud uit te voer met behulp van verskeie tuoinstrumente en toerusting.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12 of ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Goeie kennis van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Goeie kennis van die gebruik van grasmaaiers. Basiese kennis om klein grasmaaierherstelwerk en sweisprobleme aan te spreek. Kommunikasie en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Goeie luistervaardighede.
af.duties: Voer gereelde gebou-inspeksies uit en help met klein elektriese, loodgieters- en sweiswerkherstelwerk. Maai van grasse en gras om geboue en omgewing volgens tuinboustandaarde. Vermoeë om alle tipes grasmaaiers, tuoinstrumente en toerusting te bedryf, vir die maai van alle grasse en omliggende gebiede. Verwydering van ou blomme en plante, insluitend verwydering van onkruid en skoonmaak van paaie. Snoei van bome. Plant van nuwe blomme en plante. Veiligheidsbewaring van onderhoudsinstrumente en voorrade en Rapporteer gebreke. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Isikhundla somsebenzi wasekhaya: Ukugcinwa kwakho konke
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu ozosebenza emhlabathini e-Olifantsfontein ukwenza ukuhlola izakhiwo, ukulungisa okuncane, kanye nokugcina ihlathi ngokusebenzisa izithombe zesivo nemishini yehlathi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikilidi ephakeme kazwelonke/Isigaba 12 noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Ulwazi oluhle ngoMthetho we-Khalendera lweNhlelo Yokuphathwa kweMisebenzi. Ulwazi oluhle lokuphatha imishini yokuhlabela ihlathi. Ulwazi olulula lokulungisa imishini yokuhlabela ihlathi kanye nezinkinga zokuhlanganisa amalungu. Amakhono okuxoxa nokubhala umbiko. Amakhono okulalela kahle.
zu.duties: Ukwenza ukuhlola kwemikhondo yezakhiwo kanye nokubamba iqhaza ekulungeni izinkinga ezincane zamandla okulwandle kanye namalungu amancane ezinhlelo. Ukukhulu kwamahlathi nemifula ecelo kwakhe nokuhambisana nemithetho yokulima. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa zonke izinhlobo zemishini yokuhlabela, izinkomba zokulima nezimiso zokulima ngokugcwele. Ukususa amabhulorho namafutha akudala okubalulekile kanye nezinsizakusebenza zokuhlabela emigwaqeni eminingi. Ukulungisa imithi. Ukulisha imifula emitsha nezithombo ezingezansi. Ukulondoloza amathuluzi okusebenza nokuhlolwa kwemikhondo yesiphithiphithi. Qaphelani: Bonke abantu abakhethiwe bazodingeka ukwenze umsebenzi wokuhlolwa.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wokuLungiselela: Emandulo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umntu oza kusebenza ngokuhlola izakhiwo, ukulungisa okuncinci, nokugcina iintsana zengca esikhundleni seOlifantsfontein, esebenzisa izixhobo zegadi ezahlukeneyo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Seziko Sibanqangi/EliGatya 12 okanye izidanga ezilinganayo. Ulwazi olulungelelwane ngoMthetho wezaMafa nokuKhuseleko kwisebe loMsebenzi. Ulwazi olulungelelwane lokuqhuba imishini yokuqhwesa ingca. Ulwazi olusiseko lokumela kumanndlo amancini okulungisa imishini yokuqhwesa ingca neengxaki zoliboqho. Amandla okunxibelelana nokubhala iingxelo. Amandla amalungileyo okulalela.
xh.duties: Qhuba ukuhlolwa kwakho kwexhuqa ezindlini ngamaxesha angamanye kwaye nceda kumanndlo amancinci okulungisa kumbane, nobhedu neloqwa. Ukuqhweswa kwamablankethi nengca ejikelezile ezindlini nakwindawo ejikelezile ngokwemigqaliselo yezolimo. Ulwazi lokuqhuba zonke iintlobo zemishini yokuqhwesa ingca, izixhobo zegadi nezixhobo, ukuba kwingca yonke nakuwo wonke amacala amajikelezile. Ukushenxisa iintyatyambo ezimdala neezityalo, kuquka ukushenxisa iintseba nokucoca iindela. Ukwaphula amathunzi. Utyala iintyatyambo ezintsha neezityalo. Ukugcina ngokhuseleko izixhobo zolungiselelo nezinto ezifunekayo kwaye uchaze iziphaphu. N.B. Bonke abagquliweyo kulu luhlu bazakuba nefuneka ukuba bagqibe isikhathi esifanelekileyo sokuzihlola.

af.summary: Voedselbedieningshulp wat ondersteunende ondersteuning bied, insluitend algemene skoonmaak, die voorbereiding van vergaderruimtes en vermaak by Olifantsfontein.

Kennis van voedsel- en akkommodasiedienste sal 'n voordeel wees. Moet in 'n span onder druk kan werk. Moet goeie kommunikasievaardighede hê. Vermoë om te lees en te skryf. Ten minste een -jarige relevante werkservaring in 'n skoonmaakomgewing.
af.duties: Algemene skoonmaak van kantoorruimtes, rusruimtes en gange. Voorberei en skoonmaak van vergaderruimtes. Bedryf en sorg vir toerusting en is verantwoordelik vir die rapportering van foutiewe toerusting. Berei vermaak vir vergaderings voor en verfris die vergaderruimtes tydens die middagpouse. Was en ruim eetgerei voor en na vergadering op. Verseker dat skoonmaaktoerusting versorg en na gebruik skoongemaak word. Bedryf en sorg vir toerusting en is verantwoordelik vir die rapportering van foutiewe toerusting. Verantwoordelik vir algemene netheid en higiëne. Bystaan in die ontvangs, berging en verpakking van voorraad en voorraadopname. Werk volgens werkskedules wat deur toesighouer uitgereik word. Bystaan toesighouer met ander take wat verband hou met skoonmaakdienste. N.B. Alle kortlyskandidate sal verlang word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Isekela Ukuphathwa Kwemisebenzi Yokudla
zu.summary: Ukwenza konke okuseduzane nokudla, okusekela ukunakekelwa okuhlanganisa ukuhlanzwa kakhulu, ukuqhweba izigqoki zokuhlanganiswa nezinto zokudla zingamathumbu.
zu.requirements: Ukwaziswa kwe-Batho Pele okuncane kwesikole samabanga aphansi, okuncane kwezemfundo yeziqu. Kukhona okuncane okuwaziyo ngokwelapha imisebenzi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kusemthethweni. Izindikimba zomnyango. Okuhle kokuba nalolu lwazi kuzokwenza kube lula. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza abanye abantu noma kunzima. Kufanele ukwazi ukukhuluma kahle nabanye. Kufanele ukwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Kufanele ube nalosikhathi esingaphezu konye weminyaka ekusebenzeni ukuhlanza amagumbi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanzwa okuvamile kwezikhala zebhuloho, izigqoki zokuphumula, kanye namadala. Ukuqhweba nokuhlanza izigqoki zokuhlanganiswa. Ukusebenzisa futhi ukunakekelwa kwemishini ukubika imishini ephukile. Ukuqhweba iziphuzo zokuhlanganiswa nokubuyisela izigqoki zokuhlanganiswa ngesikhathi sokuphumula. Ukugeza nokuhlanza imisinda yangaphambi futhi emva kokuhlangana. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokuhlanza inakekelwa futhi ihlanziwe ngemva koku-setshenziswa. Ukusebenzisa futhi ukunakekelwa kwemishini nokubika imishini ephukile. Ukunakekelwa ngokuvamile koku-hlanzwa nokuhlanzwa. Ukusiza ekwamukeleni, ekugcineni, kanye nasekubhaleni insiza. Ukusebenzisa imishini ngesikhathi esihle ngemiyalo yomphathi wakho. Ukusiza umphathi ngezinye izifundo ezihlobene nokuhlanza imisebenzi. A. Bonke abaqeqeshwa abancane bazodinga ukuphothulelwa uku-qeqesha okuhlobene nenhlangano.

xh.title: Ukukhululwa kokutya: Inkxaso yoncedo
xh.summary: Ukukhululwa kokutya okuvelisa inkxaso yoncedo kubandakanya ukucoba ngokubanzi, ukulungiselela iindlwana zokuhlangela nemiphefumlo e Olifantsfontein.
xh.requirements: ABET/Standard 8/Grade 10 Ulwazi ngamagama aseBatho Pele, Ulwazi olusisiseko ngempilo yolunye nomkhuseleko wabasebenzi. Iinkqubo zolawulo zesebe. Ulwazi ngonkonzo yokutya nolonke lokuhlala kuya kuba lusizo. Makabe nakho ukusebenza eqeleni ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Kufuneka abe nobuchule obuhle bokunxibelelwana. Ukuba nakho ukufunda nokubhala. Ubuncinane unyaka omnye wamava wobomi bokusebenza kwindawo yokucoba.
xh.duties: Ukucoba ngokubanzi kwendawo yeeofisi, iindlwana zokuphumla, neendonga. Ukulungiselela nokucoba iindlwana zokuhlangela. Ukusebenzisa nokunakelela izixhobo kwaye ungenele ekubikela izixhobo ezonakeleyo. Ukulungiselela imiphefumlo yokuhlangela nokuvuza iindlwana ngexesha lenyanga yemini. Ukuhlamba nokucoca izitya phambi nangemva kokuhlangela. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba izixhobo zokucoba zinakekelwa kwaye zicothe emva kokuzisebenzisa. Ukusebenzisa nokunakelela izixhobo kwaye ungenele ekubikela izixhobo ezonakeleyo. Uyayinekela ngokucoba ngokubanzi nokhuseleko lwezempilo. Uncede ekwamkeni, ekugcinini nasekupakeni kwesitokhwe nokubala kwesitokhwe. Ukusebenza ngokwendlela yokusebenza eziyisiwe ngumphathi. Uncede umphathi kwezinye imisebenzi evela kunkonzo yokucoba. N.B. Bonke abagqithiswayo abakwiqela elitsha baya kufunwa kwagqiba umzobo wokuzenzelelo ohambelanayo.

jobs.centre: Cape Town – Western Cape Management Region
jobs.summary: Coordinate Independent Correctional Centre Visitors and oversee regional activities for the Judicial Inspectorate in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Senior Certificate/Grade 12, Degree/National Diploma in Public Administration/Public Management at NQF 6 as recognised by SAQA. Three-year Degree/National Diploma in Office Management or Administration or relevant qualification on NQF 6 or equivalent qualification. A minimum of 5 years’ experience in the Justice Cluster or a minimum of 2 years’ supervisory experience. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Act and Regulations and National Treasury Regulations. A valid driver’s licence. Skills and competencies: computer literacy (MS Office, Excel and PowerPoint), sound interpersonal relations, communication skills (verbal and written), planning and organisational skills, ability to work under pressure and independently and as part of a team, willingness to work extra hours, problem solving and leadership skills, attention to detail and good conflict resolution skills.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for providing management, supervision and control of Independent Correctional Centre Visitors within the region. Coordinate and monitor ICCV activities, allocate work, review reports, monitor attendance and performance and facilitate induction and training arrangements. Manage complaints, including general, urgent and mandatory complaints, ensure proper recording and escalation of matters and follow up on outstanding responses. Coordinate Visitors’ Committee and stakeholder engagement meetings, prepare agendas, compile minutes and track implementation of resolutions. Conduct performance evaluations, compile statistical and management reports, maintain records and registers, provide administrative support to regional oversight activities and liaise with correctional centres, ICCVs, Visitors’ Committees and internal stakeholders to support effective oversight.

af.summary: Koördineer Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrumbesoekers en hou toesig oor streekaktiwiteite vir die Geregtelike Inspektoraat in Cape Town.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Senior Sertifikaat/Grade 12, Degree/National Diploma in Public Administration/Public Management op NQF 6 soos deur SAQA erken. Three-year Degree/National Diploma in Office Management or Administration of relevante kwalifikasie op NQF 6 of ekwivalente kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring in die Justisieskluster of 'n minimum van 2 jaar se toesigervaring. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Act and Regulations en National Treasury Regulations. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office, Excel en PowerPoint), goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik), beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede, vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk, bereidwilligheid om ekstra ure te werk, probleemoplossings- en leierskapsvaardighede, aandag aan besonderhede en goeie konflikoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die voorsiening van bestuur, toesig en beheer van Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrumbesoekers binne die streek. Koördineer en monitor ICCV-aktiwiteite, wijs werk toe, hersien verslae, monitor bywoning en prestasie en fasiliteer inductie- en opleidingsreëlings. Bestuur klagtes, insluitend algemene, dringende en verpligte klagtes, verseker behoorlike registrasie en eskalasie van sake en volg uitstaande response na. Koördineer Besoekerskomitee- en belanghebbende betrokkenheidsvergaderings, berei agenda's voor, stel notules op en hou die implementering van besluite dop. Voer prestasie-evaluerings uit, stel statistiese en bestuursverslae op, hou rekords en registers by, verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan streektoezigaktiwiteete en skakel met korrektiewe sentrums, ICCV's, Besoekerskomitees en interne belanghebbendes om doeltreffende toesig te ondersteun.

I-Degree yeminyaka emithathu/National Diploma ku-Office Management noma ku-Administration noma izifundo ezihambisana nalesi ezingeni le-NQF 6 noma izifundo ezalinganayo nalokhu. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 yokuhlolwa ku-Justice Cluster noma okungenenzi eminyakeni eyi-2 yokuhlola abantu. Amakhono nendlela yokuziphatha: ukwazi ukusebenza ngemishini (i-MS Office, i-Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint), ukuba nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu, amakhono okuxoxa (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ukwazi ukuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo, ukwazi ukusebenza ngocindezelo nokuzimele kanye njengengxenye yeqembu, ukuzimisela ukusebenza amahora amaningi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nendlela yokuqamba izinhlelo, ukunaka iminikelo kanye namakhono amahle okuxazulula izingxabano.

af.title: Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrum Besoeker
af.summary: Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrum Besoeker benodig by Somerset East Correctional Centre om terreinbesoeke uit te voer, gedetineerdes te onderhou en klagtes te bestuur.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12/Senior Sertifikaat. Rekenaargeletterd en akkuraat. 'n Aanbeveling van nominasie as 'n ICCV deur 'n gemeenskapsorganisasie (nie ouer as ses (6) maande nie). Vermoë om onafhanklik en as 'n span te werk. Gemeenskapsgerig en deeglike kennis van die Batho Pele-beginsels. Selfversekerdheid en vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). 'n Bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan kwalifiserende aansoeke wat ontvang is van persone wat woonagtig is in gemeenskappe wat in die nabyheid van die korrektiewe sentrum is waar die pos gevul moet word.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die uitvoer van terreinbesoeke en verslagdoening oor dringende aangeleenthede. Om gereelde onderhoude en konsultasies met gedetineerdes en DCS-amptenare rakende klagtes en verpligte aangeleenthede te voer. Ontvang en vaslegging van alle klagtes/versoeke op die databasis. Oopmaak en instandhouding van saaklêers. Opvolg doen op uitstaande klagtes. Indiening van maandelikse verslae. Verskaf statistiese ontleding van alle klagtes ontvang. Beroep op navrae. Uitvoer van alle redelike opdragte deur die toesighouer/ Streekbestuurder.

Ukuba nomoya wokuzithoba kanye nolwazi oluhle ngemigomo ye-Batho Pele. Amandla okuzethemba kanye nenkomo yokusebenza ngaphansi kokuvuthwa. Inkinga yokukhuluma (ngomlomo nangesibhalo). Izokutholwa izicelo ezingamiswa kubantu abahlala emakhaya esifundeni kuleyo ngqikithi esifunda esikhumulo esitholwa kweyona ndawo elingukhaya kweli khasi lezindaba.

Ukuvula nokugcina amafayela ezicelo. Ukulandela izikhalazo ezingakapheli. Ukuthumela izibika zanyanga zonke. Ukwenza isilinganiso sezibalo samawonke amasikhalazo atholakalayo. Ukuphendula imibuzo. xh.requirements: Abafaki-isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12/isatifikethi esiphakamileyo. Bakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha baze bachenze. jobs.title: Senior Inspector: Mine Health and Safety
jobs.department: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources
jobs.summary: Senior Inspector for Mine Health and Safety in Witbank, requiring a Mining Engineering diploma and Mine Manager's Certificate, at R1,101,468 per annum.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma in Mining Engineering (NQF6), Mine Manager’s Certificate of Competency, plus a drivers license with minimum 3 years’ experience at a junior managerial level in mining, Knowledge of: Mine Health and Safety Act and Regulations and Legal Proceedings, Mining Engineering – Mine Equipment .e.g. winder, boilers, plants etc, Hazard identification and risk management, Public Service Staff Code, DMPR Policies, Skills: Ability to interpret and apply Mine Health and Safety Act, DMPR Policy and Staff Code, Management skills- Planning, Leading, Organising and Controlling, Report Writing Formulation, Good interpersonal relations, Analyses and interpretation of accident statistics, Be able to recommend mining engineering solutions, negotiation skill, Language proficiency, computer skills Thinking demand: Innovative thinker, Analyse situations carefully, make fair and reasonable decisions, Receptive to suggestions and ideas, Be able to stay calm and collective during difficult situations.
jobs.duties: Coordinate, conduct and report on underground, shaft and surface audits and inspections on matters relating to ground stability, support, explosives, blasting operations and other matters relating to the Mine Safety. Coordinate, conduct report on investigations into mine related accidents contraventions and complaints as well as the analysis of mine accidents and trends to determine high risk mining operations and take appropriate action. Coordinate and serve on any necessary board of examiners. Coordinate the Investigation, consultation and provision of input on mine closure, prospecting rights, mining rights and permits, EMP’s, and township development. Provide managerial activities.

zu.title: I-Senior Inspector: I-Mine Health and Safety

zu.duties: Hlela,enza uphenyo futhi ube umbiko ngokuqinisekiswa kanye nokubukeka okwenziwa ngaphansi komhlabathi,emgodini nasephezulu mayelana nokuqina komhlaba,ukwesekwa,izinsimbi eziphazimisayo,imisebenzi yokuphazima kanye nezinye izindaba ezingahlobene nephephandle lomgodi. Hlela, enza uphenyo futhi ube umbiko ngokuphenya ngemuva kwezehlakalo ezingahlobene nabezomgodi,ukwephula umthetho kanye nabezinkhalo kanye nokuhlaziya izehlakalo kanye netrend yokubuka ukuba yiziphi izindlela eziphithizela kakhulu futhi uthathe izinyathelo ezifanele. Hlela futhi usebenze nakuzo yonke iwindi labaphenyi uma kudingeka. Hlela uphenyo,ingxoxo kanye nokunikeza umbono wokunqamula ukusebenza kwabezomgodi, amalungelo okusesha, amalungelo abezomgodi namavithule, ama-EMP, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamadolobha. Nikeza imisebenzi yabaphathi.

Iimfuno zoKucinga: iNgcangcazelo ekucingeni, ukuHlola iimeko ngokucokela, ukwenza iigqibo ezize neezinjongo, ukwamkela iingcebiso neengcamango, nokuba nakho ukuzinza ngexesha lezimeko ezinzima.
xh.duties: Hlela, yenze nize uxelele ngokutya kuhluziwe, ukuHlolwa phantsi komhlaba phakathi kweendonga, nakuwo onke amagumbi ngokuthe ngqo ngokuzinza, ukuxhasa, ukuqhakamsha iibiloko, ekuqhakamshweni nasezinye iindaba ezinezakuzo uKhuseleko lweMigodla. Hlela, yenza nize uxellele ngeengxaki ezihlotyisiwe ngokuba yingxaki, iingozi ezingezanga ezivela emigodleni izienguvo noxutsho nokuchaswa, nakuChazwa iingozi nakwezi ndawo ukuze kwaziwe iindawo zemigodla eziyingozi kakhulu zenziwe iintshukumo ezifanelekileyo. Hlela iNgxaki ePhandiweyo, ukuNcokola nokunika iingcali ngokuValwa, ukuChukumiseka kwamagunya, namagunya okumba nemvume yokuBakwa, i-EMP, nakuPhuhliso lwamaphetha. Yize imisebenzi yokuLawula.

af.title: Inspekteur: Myntoerusting
af.summary: Inspekteer myntoerusting, voer oudits en ondersoeke uit, en handhaaf nakoming van mynbou-gesondheids- en veiligheidsregulasies in Braamfontein.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Elektriese/ Meganiese Ingenieurswese (NQF 6) PLUS 'n Sertifikaat van Bevoegdheid vir Meganiese / Elektriese Ingenieurswese (Myne) met 'n minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in mynbou en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis van: Myngesondheids- en Veiligheidswet en Regulasies en Regsverrigtinge. Mynbou-ingenieurswese - Myntoerusting bv. Winder, Boilers, Aanlegte. Gevaar- en Risikobestuur. Staatsdiens Personeelkode. DMPR Beleide. Vaardighede: Vermoë om die Myngesondheids- en Veiligheidswet te interpreteer en toe te pas. DMPR Beleide en personeelkodes. Bestuurs-, beplannings-, leidings-, organisatoriese en beheervaardighede. Verslagskrywing en formulering. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Wees in staat om mynbou-ingenieurswese oplossings voor te stel. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Taalvaardigheid. Rekenaarvaardighede. Denkeis: innoverende denker.
