zu.title: Isikhulumi: Isethunjini Sezimayini
zu.summary: Hlola izethunjini sezimayini, qamba imibiko futhi wenze uphenyo, futhi uqinise ukuziphathisa kwezomthetho wezempilo nokuphepha kwezimayini e-Braamfontein.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe ku-Engineering yeKagesi/Qundeqondo (NQF 6) KANYE nesitifiketi sokulingana se-Engineering yezobuchwepheshe (Kagesi/Qundeqondo) (ezimayini) nokuhlangenwe nakho okungu-3 eminyakeni kwezimayini nelayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi ngo: uMthetho wezempilo nokuphepha kwezimayini kanye Nemithetho kanye Nenqubo yezomthetho. I-Engineering yezimayini - izethunjini zemayini isb. I-Winder, ama-boiler, izitolo. Ukuphathwa kwezingozi nobungezela. Ikhodi yabasebenzi asebenzela umbuso. Inqubo ze-DMPR. Amakhono: Ikhono lokuhlaziya futhi usebenzise uMthetho wezempilo nokuphepha kwezimayini. Inqubo ze-DMPR namakhodi abasebenzi. Amakhono okuphatha, ukweluleka, ukubusa, inhlangano nokulawula. Ukuhlaziya nokubhala imibiko. Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Ukukwazi ukunikela ngemibono ye-engineering yezimayini. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Ukusebenzisa ulimi kahle. Amakhono ekhompyutha, Isidingo sokucabanga: ukuba umuntu oveza imibono entsha. Hlaziya izimo ngokucophelela, uthathe izinqumo ezibusulo nezifanelekile. Wamukele iziphakamiso nemibono. Ukukwazi ukuhlala uzola futhi udideke kabi esikhathini sezimo ezinzima. Umdidiyeli wezimo ezahlukene.
zu.duties: Qamba imibiko ngokuphenya nokubuka ezimayini emsanweni, emgodini nangaphezulu kwezitolo, izakhiwo, izethunjini zokuhamba emgodini ezinamasondo nangawo ongawaso kanye namasistimu wekagesi futhi uthathe isinyathelo esidingekayo sokugunyaza lapho kudingeka. Phenya ubungenze futhi wenze imibiko ngemikhuba eyiphutha ephathelene nezimayini, ukwephula umthetho nezikhalazo kanye nokuhlaziya iziputha zemayini kanye nezinkomba ukuze ukqabe ukusebenza kwezimayini okunengozi ephezulu futhi uthathe isinyathelo esifanele. Hlola futhi unikeze layisensi futhi wenze imibiko ngakho, kuzo izethunjini ezimayini njll, i-winder, ama-lift, ama-chairlift, ama-boiler futhi uqhube ococayo olawulwa umthetho. Phuma kubhodi yabahloli noma iyiphi enye edingekayo. Phenya, uxoxe futhi unikeze izimvo ngokuvalwa kwezimayini, amalungelo okukhangela, amalungelo okumbhula namalayisensi, ama-EMP, kanye nenxushunxulu kwamaphandle. Nikeza izimvo kwimibiko yendawo, ukubuyekezwa kwemithetho yezinsimbi, inqubo nezilinganiso; futhi izicelo zokukhululeka, imvume nezivumelwano.

xh.title: Isilumkisi: Izixhobo zemigodi
xh.summary: Qinisekisa izixhobo zemigodi, qhuba ukuhlolwa nokuPhanda, kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kuhlonitshwa imithetho yeMPilo neKhuseleko kwimigodi kwi-Braamfontein.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma ye-Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (NQF 6) PLUS Isatifikethi Sobuchule be-Mechanical/Electrical Engineering (Mines) enokulinganiselwa kwiminyaka eli-3 yamava kumigodi nayilesenti evakalisiweyo, Ukuqonda: uMthetho noMthetho wokuQonda ukuGcina iMpilo noKhuseleko kumigodi, neNkqubo yoMthetho. I-Mining Engineering- Izixhobo zemigodi ezinje ngamaza, iindlu zokushisa, iindawo zokwenza izinto. Ulawulo lweengozi. I-Public Service Staff Code. I-DMPR Policies. Amakhono: Ulawulo, uQesho, ukuKhusela, ukuCwangcisa, ulawulo nokuLawula. UkuBala imibhalo nokuyila. Iziqu ezomfutshane kunye nabantu. Ukuba nakho ukupakamisa izisombululo zamandla kwimigodi. Amakhono okuRhuqela. Ulwimi. Isakhono sokusebenzisa i-computer, kuyafuneka: Ukuba nalwazi. Hlola imiba ngononophelo, zenze isigqibo esikho okusesikweni. Yamkela iingcamango nemvo. Ukuba nakho ukuzola kwaye udibane ngokuzola. Sabelo.
xh.duties: Qhuba uba ube ngumbhalo ngokwenziwa kwezinto ngaphantsi komhlaba, kwezindonga zemigodi nakumagumbi aphandle kuwo onke amaza, izakhiwo, izixhobo zemigodi ezihamba kwicala elinguzibethelo naphandle koluhlu ezikwimigodi, iindlela zamandla kwaye uthathe izigqibo ezifunekayo zokwenza isinyezo apho kufunekayo. Phanda uvakele ube ngumbhalo ngengxaki zemigodi, ecaliweyo nengxaki yokungahoywa kwemithetho, nayimibuzo yabantu, nakulo naluphi na uhlalutyo lweengozi zemigodi nakwezi zhengasco nokuqonda iindawo ezingozayo kumigodi uze uthathe isigqibo esifanelekileyo. Xelela izixhobo zemigodi ize zibe negunya, kwaye wenze umbhalo ngayo na, ezinje ngamaza, iindawo zokuhamba, izixhobo zokuhamba, iindlu zokushisa kwaye wenze oovavado olubekiweyo ngokomthetho. Zibandakanye kwalo naluphi na udidi lwebhunga labavavayo. Phanda, ucace ize unike izimvo ngokuvalwa kwemigodi, amalungelo okukhangelwa iintsiba namalungelo okuhlumba, namamayeleza, i-EMP, nentshukumo yamaphakade. Nikeza izimvo kwimibhalo yemimandla, ulungiselele ulwahluko kolwabiwo-mali lwezixhobo, isikhokelo nengqikitho; nayimfuneko yoxolo, imvume nokugqitywa.

Applications must be submitted on the recent Z83 application form which came into effect from 01 January 2021 as issued by the Minister of Public Service Administration in line with regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 as amended, which is obtainable online from www.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za. All sections of the Z83 must be completed (In full, accurately, legibly, honestly, initialled, signed and dated), and accompanied by a comprehensive/ detailed Curriculum Vitae only. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Applicants must note that personnel suitability checks (PSC) will be conducted on the short-listed applicants, therefore will be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct this exercise. PSC includes security screening and vetting, qualification verification, criminal records, financial records checks. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as application received after the closing date will not be considered. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, He/ She must do so in writing. It is also important to note that the Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Sekuriteitsrisiko-offisier
af.summary: Sekuriteitsrisiko-offisier benodig in Springbok om toegangsbeheer te bestuur, inspeksies uit te voer en op sekuriteitsvoorvalle te reageer. Vereis Grade 12, PSIRA Grade C en 'n bestuurslisensie.
af.requirements: A Grade 12 (NQF4) met 'n Grade C PSIRA-sertifikaat, 1 jaar ervaring as 'n Sekuriteitswag en 'n bestuurslisensie, Kennis van: Sekuriteitswetgewing, beleide en, Prosedures, Toegangsbeheerprosedures, Veiligheidsvoorsorgmaatreëls, Sekuriteitsregisters, Vaardighede: Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik), Denkwyse: Innoverende en proaktiewe denke, Analitiese verstand.
af.duties: Voer toegangsbeheer uit en monitor bewegings binne en tussen geboue. Voer roetine-inspeksies en sekuriteitsrondtes uit. Voorkoming van ongemagtigde verwydering van departementele bates. Reageer op alarmaktiverings en sekuriteitsvoorvalle. Bedryf beheerkamer-sekuriteitstoerusting. Ondersteun ministeriële en departementele geleenthede.

zu.title: Umphathi Wobungozi Bokuvikeleka
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu ophatha ubungozi bokuvikeleka eSpringbok ukuze alawule ukungena,enze ukuphenya,bese ephendula emicimbini yokuvikeleka. Kudinga iGrade 12, iPSIRA Grade C, kanye nelayisensi yokushayela.
zu.requirements: Ithi Grade 12 (NQF4) ihlotshaniswa nokuqinisekiswa kwabakwaGrade C PSIRA Certificate, uSuku loku-1 lomsebenzi njengomuntu oqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kanye neLayisensi yokushayela, ULwazi: Ngomthetho wokuvikeleka, izinqubomgomo futhi, Izinqubo, Izinqubo zokulawula ukungena, Izintela zokuphepha, Izibhalo zokuvikeleka, Amakhono: Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga, Ikhono lokuthungatha (elisho ngomlomo neliqoshiwe), Ukucabanga okudingekayo: Ukucabanga okusha futhi okuhamba phambili, Ingqondo ehlehlisisayo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukulawula ukungena bese uphenya ukunyakaza ngaphakathi naphakathi kwakho konke okwakhwayo. Qamba ukuphenya okujwayelekile futhi uenze amajaha okuvikela. Ukuvikela ukuthathwa ngaphandle kwemvume kwempahla yomnyango. Phendula ekubeni kwamaphoyisa alesiya njalo emicimbini yokuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka. Sebenzisa izinto zomshini wokulawula iNcamashi yokuvikeleka. Nikela inkaso emicimbini kaNgqongqoshe nomnyango.

xh.title: Ngumbani na uMlawuli woPhango lweMikhosistarhu?
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMlawuli woPhango lweMikhosistarhu kwindawo yaseBoland ukuba alawule ukungena, aze alawule iimeko ezahlukeneyo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-12 (NQF4) esinesatifikethi se-PSIRA seBanga C, iNgcaka yeminyaka el-1 njengomkhuseleki ikwayiLayisenisi yokushova, ulwazi nge:okoMisela lulwaLucingo loKhuseleko, iinkqubo kunye nezaNqinisekiso, iinkqubo zoLawulo lokuNgena, iNgqibelelo zoKhuseleko, oovuko bhali abalulekileyo bokwamkela iimfuno ezahlukeneyo, iindlela ezinomgama wokuthintela iingozi, oovuko bhali abalulekileyo bokulawula iindawo ezahlukeneyo zokhuseleko, amakhaka aphawulayo: Isiphithiphithi, isakhono: iindlela ezinomgama wokwenza iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ngokuchanekileyo, isakhono sokuziva ocinezela ngokwasemlonyeni nakubhalwe ngokusesikweni.
xh.duties: Phatha ulawulo lokungena uze ulindele iintshukumo ngaphakathi nakwilula emiFixeni. Yenza iingxelo ezizelelweyo nokujikeleza ngekhaya lokhuseleko. Thintela ukususwa ngaphandle kolungelelwaniso lwempahla yesebe. Phendula kwiinkonzo ezivayo kwakhona kwiiseko zokhuseleko. Sebenzisa izixhobo zoKhuseleko zoKulawula iKamaba. Xhasa imisebenzi yoMlawuli nesebe.

jobs.title: Chief Registrar
jobs.centre: Western Cape Division of The High Court: Cape Town
jobs.salary_text: R610 434 – R1 442 451 per annum (MR6). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement. Salary will be in accordance with Occupation Specific Dispensation (Resolution 1 of 2008). Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit a service certificate/s for determination of their experience.
jobs.summary: Chief Registrar sought for the Western Cape High Court in Cape Town, requiring an LLB degree and eight years' post-qualification registrar experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an LLB Degree or a four (4) year legal qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of eight (8) years’ post qualification experience obtained as a Registrar. A valid driver’s license/LLM Degree will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of registry duties, knowledge of legislative framework governing the public service, knowledge of The Superior Court Act and the Uniform Rules of the High Courts, knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, knowledge of Quasi-Judicial, knowledge of Case flow management, knowledge of leadership and supervisory/ managerial experience within court environment/legal environment. knowledge of court documentation management and Human Resource Management, Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in Numeracy, problem solving, decision-making, interviewing, computer literacy (MS Office), excellent communication (written and verbal), interpersonal relations, planning and organising and report writing. Along with the following attributes: Resilience, honesty, integrity, flexibility, personal motivation, creative thinking, work ethic, motivated, professional appearance and conduct, self-management, ability to work under pressure and solve problems and confidentiality.
jobs.duties: Manage the Information and case/court documentation Management System: Implement information desk in the court, develop and maintain a complaints management system, interface with external court stakeholders on a regular basis, ensure that the checking of relevant registers is done in terms of the codes. Provide support to court and case flow management / Quasi-Judicial functions: Develop & implement case management strategies, review and implement projects to improve court efficiency regularly, implement a case/ court documentation and information management system. Implement Service Level Agreements and Strategic Court projects: Ensure that all J33 requests to Service Providers are timeously returned, liaise with the service provider on a regular basis to ensure smooth service delivery, peruse proposed amendments received from the rules board and provide comments, if any to them. Provide leadership of the High Court: Develop annual institutional performance reports & other statutory reports, give direction and guidance to the court based on best court management practices and lead transformation in the High court. Supervise and develop staff: Ensure general supervision of employees, allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work, perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage 90 leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work.

jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. af.title: Hoofregistrateur
af.summary: Hoofregistrateur gesoek vir die Western Cape High Court in Cape Town, wat 'n LLB-graad en agt jaar se post-kwalifikasie registrateur-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n LLB-graad of 'n vier (4) jaar regskwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring verkry as 'n Registrateur. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie/LLM-graad sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van registrateurpligte, kennis van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die staatsdiens regeer, kennis van The Superior Court Act en die Uniform Rules of the High Courts, kennis van bergings- en onttrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing, kennis van Kwasi-Geregtelike, kennis van saakvloei-bestuur, kennis van leierskap en toesigtelike/ bestuurservaring binne 'n hofomgewing/regsomgewing. Kennis van hofdokumentbestuur en Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in Geletterdheid met syfers, probleemoplossing, besluitneming, onderhoude, rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office), uitstekende kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), interpersoonlike verhoudings, beplanning en organisering en verslagskryf. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: Weerbaarheid, eerlikheid, integriteit, buigsaamheid, persoonlike motivering, kreatiewe denke, werketiek, gemotiveerd, professionele voorkoms en gedrag, selfbestuur, vermoë om onder druk te werk en probleme op te los en vertroulikheid.
af.duties: Bestuur die Inligting- en saak/hofdokumentbestuurstelsel: Implementeer inligtingskantoor in die hof, ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n klagtebestuurstelsel, skakel gereeld met externe hofbelanghebbendes, verseker dat die nagaan van relevante registers gedoen word in terme van die kodes. Verskaf ondersteuning aan hof- en saakvloeibestuur / Kwasi-Geregtelike funksies: Ontwikkel en implementeer saakbestuurstrategieë, hersien en implementeer projekte om hofdoeltreffendheid gereeld te verbeter, implementeer 'n saak-/ hofdokument- en inligtingbestuurstelsel. Implementeer Diensvlakooreenkomste en Strategiese Hofprojekte: Verseker dat alle J33-versoeke aan Diensverskaffers betyds terugbesorg word, skakel gereeld met die diensverskaffer om gladde dienslewering te verseker, lees voorgestelde wysigings wat van die reëlsraad ontvang is en verskaf kommentaar, indien enige aan hulle. Verskaf leierskap van die Hooggeregshof: Ontwikkel jaarlikse institutionele prestasieverslae en ander statutêre verslae, gee rigting en leiding aan die hof gebaseer op beste hofbestuurspraktyke en lei transformasie in die Hooggeregshof. Outoesig en ontwikkel personeel: Verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers, wys pligte toe en voer kwaliteitsbeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesigtelikes met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk, voer kwaliteitsbeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word, bestuur 90 verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesigtelikes met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk.

zu.title: Umrelu Omkhulu
zu.summary: Kufunwa umrelu omkhulu we Western Cape High Court e Cape Town, ofuna iziqu ze-LLB neminyaka yamayisikhombisa wemfundo yabantu abathatha iziqu njengenkonzo yomrelu.
zu.requirements: Abafakelayo kufanele babe neziqu ze-LLB noma iziqu zomthetho zeminyaka yamane (4) ezamukelekwa yi-SAQA. Ukuze ube nokuhlala okungenani kweminyaka yamayisikhombisa (8) wemfundo yabantu abathathe iziqu njengenkonzo yomrelu. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela/iziqu ze-LLM izoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yebhange lwegama, ulwazi ngohlelo lomthetho lolawula inkonzo yomphakathi, ulwazi ngomthetho we The Superior Court Act nezimiso ezihambisana ne High Courts, ulwazi ngemigudu yokugcina nokulanda ulwazi ngokwezindawo zokusebenza, ulwazi lwe-Quasi-Judicial, ulwazi lokuphatha ukuphthumelela kwamacala, ulwazi ngokuholo nolawula / okuhola isikhundla sokuba ngumqashi esibhedlela sezinkantolo noma emkhakheni womthetho. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezincwadi zinkantolo nokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza kanye namagugu aphakeme kakhulu e-Batho Pele. Ukuba nokuhlakanipha ekuqoqweni kwezibalo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukubuziswa imibuzo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office), ukuthetha nokubhala kahle, ubudlelwano nobantu, ukuletha isu nokuqamba ukubika. Nokuba le mininingwane elandelayo: Ukumelana nokucindezela, ukuqotho, inkolo, ukuzivumela ukushintsha, ukuzigqugquzela, ukucabanga ngendlela entsha, isimo sokusebenza, ukuzigqugquzela, ukubukeka nokuziphatha ngendlela efanayo nokuzilawula, ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegxulu nokuxazulula izinkinga kwaye ulondoloze imfihlo.
zu.duties: Lawula ulwazi kanye nokuphathwa kwebhange lezincwadi zamacala nankantolo: Qamba kabusha uhlelo lokuqoqwa kolwazi kwinkantolo, bukhuphe futhi adlulise isiso sokuphathwa kwesikhashana, zame ukubonisa ukuthi izinkomba ezihlobene ziyacishwa njengenqubomgomo. Nikeza ukwesekwa kwinkantolo nokuphathwa kwamagama noma ukuphathwa kwamacala / izinkambiso ze-Quasi-Judicial: Qamba futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamacala, bukhuphe futhi usebenzise imiklamo yokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwemikhakha yezinkantolo njalo, sebenzisa uhlelo lokuqoqwa kokuphathwa kwamacala nezincwadi nolwazi. Ukuphathwa kokubhalisana kwemikhakha kanye nemiklamo yobuchule ezinkantolo: Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibuzo eyi-J33 eya kubanikazi besevisi ibuyiswa ngokushesha, thintana ngokuvamile nabanikazi besevisiukuqinisekisa ukuthi inkonzo ihamba kahle, uhlolisise izinguquko eziphakanyiswa ibhodi lemigomo futhi unikeze imibono yao, uma kunezinhlelo. Nikeza isikhokelo enkantolo: Bukhuphe imibiko yonyaka yokwenza komkhakha nezinye izibika zomthetho, nikeza inqubomgomo nesikhokela kunkantolo ngokusekelwe kumkhakha okuhle wokuphathwa kwankantolo futhi uholelele inguquko enkantolo enkulu. Lawule futhi uqashe abantu: Qinisekisa ukuqashwa komphelo abantu abaqashiwe, wenze kabusha i-cv yomsebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zomsebenzi, lawule ukuphumula kwabashaya, lwela isikhokela kubantu abaqashwayo ngakho konke okuhlobene nomsebenzi, lawule ukuphuma kwabasebenzi abayi-90, futhi nikeza isikhokela kubantu abaqashwayo ngakho konke okuhlobene nomsebenzi.

xh.title: IsiNkathunjalo esingunobangela
xh.summary: Kufunwa oyiNjingalwazi yoBukhosi weNkundla ePhakamileyo yaseWestern Cape e-Cape Town, abanabo isidanga se-LLB kwaye beze neminyaka yamava esi-8 ngemva kokuqulunqwa kwemfundo njengomgcinimajola.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Degree ye-LLB okanye iziqu zomthetho zeminyaka emine (4) ezibhalwe ngokuchazwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka yamava eyiyo ubuncinane yeyi-8 efunyenwe njengomgcini webhodi. Ilayiseni yokuqamba elisebenzayo/ Degree ye-LLM iya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yebhodi, ulwazi ngomthetho obala yinkonzo yolutsha, ulwazi ngomthetho we-Superior Court nangamagosa afanayo e-High Courts, ulwazi ngamangqongo nokuhlola kwengxelo ngokomthetho wemveliso, ulwazi lwe-Quasi-Judicial, ulwazi ngolawulo lokuhamba kweetyala, ulwazi ngokukhokela nokulawula uluvo kwindawo yehlabathi legumba / yomthetho, Ulwazi ngomthetho wobunikazi bamasheke nokulawula iinkcukacha ngezeenkalo ezenzwa ngabasebenzi kwiziko lagumbi lenkundla leenkundla nangolawulo iinkcukacha, Ulwazi ngolawulo lwenkundla kwindawo elawula ityala kwindawo lasekhaya. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweenkundla nemisebenzi yoluntu nokulawula abantu, imigaqo yeBatho Pele. Unolwazi kumanani, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuthatha izigqibo, ukubuziswa, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office), ukunxibelelana kakuhle (okubhaliweyo nokuface-to-face), imiba yoluntu, ukuyila nokuhlela nokubhala iingxelo. Kwaye unobomi obutsha nobulungisa, nokungazenzisi, nobungathathi nkqo, nobunyaniseki nokuzinza, nokugqamisa, nokuzimisela ngokwakho, nobungqondo obuzako, nobusebenza ngokwemigaqo, nobambe nkqo, nokuzenzela ngokwakho nokuba nakho ukusebenza ngocinezelo nokusombulula iingxaki nokulondoloza imfihlo.
xh.duties: Phatha iNkqubo yoLawulo lolwazi noloxwebhu lwezityalo/zenkundla: Zise inkqubo yedesk yolwazi enkundla, yakhe ugcino lwenkqubo yolawulo lezigwegwe, Nxibelelane nabalawuli bangaphandle benkundla njalo, qinisekisa ukuba ukupheqululwa kwemibhalo ehambelanayo kwenziwa ngokwemigaqo. Nikez inkxaso enkundleni nasekulawulweni kuhamba kolwazi/Imisebenzi ye-Quasi-Judicial: Yakhe uze usebenzise iindlela zolawulo lwezityalo, phinda uhlolisise uze usebenzise iiprojekthi ukuphucula isebenzisa inkundla, phucula inkqubo yolawulo lolwazi/noloxwebhu lwenkundla. Phumeza iivumelelwanam ngamazinga eNkonzo namaphulo eNkundla: Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iimfuno ze-J33 kubanikeli benkonzo zibuyiswa ngexesha elifanelekileyo, thatha inxaxheba kubanikeli benkonzo rhoqo ukuqinisekisa ukuhanjiswa okukolulekileyo kwenkonzo, hlola utshintsho olucebiwayo oluthunyelwa kubalo iirhululu uze unikeze izimvo, ukuba zikho. Nikezela ubuquphi eNkundleni ePhakamileyo: Yakhe iingxelo zemisebenzi yonyaka ezikolo kunye nezinye iingxelo zequkumbelo, nikezela isalathiso nokuqondisa inkundla ngokwezona ngokoqobo zinjengobugcisa bolawulo benkundla uze ulule uluguqulo eNkundleni ePhakamileyo. Qeqesha uze uphuhlize abasebenzi: Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngokubanzi kwabasebenzi, wabel imisebenzi uze wenze ulawulo lwekhwalithi ngomsebenzi owenziwe ngamagosa, lawule i hunyu yabasebenzi, yale uze ulule abalawuli ngakuzo zonke iindawo zomsebenzi, yenze ulawulo lwekhwalithi ngomsebenzi owenziwe ngamagosa, lawule 90 i hunyu yabasebenzi, yale uze ulule abalawuli ngakuzo zonke iindawo zomsebenzi.

jobs.title: Senior Vetting Investigator
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 – R713 535 per annum (Level 10). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Senior Vetting Investigator at the Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand, conducting confidential vetting investigations and compiling reports at salary level 10.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Social Science, Security Management, Criminology, Police Science or related qualifications at NQF level six (6) as recognised by SAQA. Three (3) years’ experience in the relevant field of which one year should be at supervisory level. Vetting Course from SSA, DI and SAPS will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS) and other departmental policies / guidelines and procedural, knowledge of the National Vetting Strategy, Public Service Act, 103 of 1994, general administrative function including vetting, National Strategic Intelligence Act, 39 of 1994, as amended, Protection of Information Act, 85 of 1985, Protection of Personal Information Act, 04 of 2013 and investigation and procedures applicable to the public service. Skilled in communication (verbal & written), financial management, project management, planning, organising, analytical, decision-making, problem solving and strategic skills.
jobs.duties: Gather all relevant documents and information, conduct proper analysis and quality checks on information, conduct vetting investigations in respect of confidential and secret level, contact subject and references in order to schedule interviews, compile and submit reports to management and National Intelligence Agency (NLA) on all vetting files and report completed on daily basis, ensure that all interviews with subjects and references are conducted, ensure that all nine vetting factors are adequately addressed where relevant during interviews, follow up with the subject or references on any unclarified or inadequately addressed vetting factor or issue, ensure that all interviews conducted are incorporated fully into the report, compile vetting investigation reports outlining the findings and recommendations gathered and collected during interviews and administer vetting investigation files, ensure sound and evidence-based recommendations, monitor Vetting Investigators progress and quality on reports, incorporate and use all sources and documents used into the reports, submit completed Vetting Investigations to the Vetting Manager/ Supervisor for quality control, conduct company screenings as requested by the Vetting Manager on Ad-hoc basis, prepare ad-hoc investigations reports and recommendation on negative pre-employment findings on candidates, conduct verification of company information as provided for using various sources such as MIE checks, SARS etc, ensure quality and sound company screening and ad-hoc investigation reports are submitted to end users for further handling, conduct ongoing assessment of developments in vetting in order assist in policy development, analyse, research and evaluate all vetting related information, provide advice and guidance on the interpretation and application of legislation, policies and procedures, establish and promote relationships with external stakeholders, including credit information providers to access information, ensure general supervision of employees, allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work, manage performance, conduct and discipline of employees. Ensure that all employees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively, develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning and address enquiries and provide advice and guidance on asset allocation and control.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr S Dlamini Tel No: (010) 493 2604 HR Related Enquiries: Mr K Mphela Tel No: (010) 493 2527

Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. af.title: Senior Vettingondersoeker
af.summary: Senior Vettingondersoeker by die Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand, wat vertroulike vettingondersoeke uitvoer en verslae opstel teen salarisvlak 10.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Sosiale Wetenskappe, Sekuriteitsbestuur, Kriminologie, Polisiewetenskap of verwante kwalifikasies op NQF-vlak ses (6) soos deur SAQA erken, hê. Drie (3) jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld waarvan een jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Vetting-kursus by SSA, DI en SAPS sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS) en ander departementele beleide / riglyne en prosedures, kennis van die Nasionale Vetting-strategie, Public Service Act, 103 of 1994, algemene administratiewe funksies insluitend vetting, National Strategic Intelligence Act, 39 of 1994, soos gewysig, Protection of Information Act, 85 of 1985, Protection of Personal Information Act, 04 of 2013 en ondersoek en prosedures van toepassing op die openbare diens. Vaardig in kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), finansiële bestuur, projekbestuur, beplanning, organisering, analitiese, besluitneming, probleemoplossing en strategiese vaardighede.
af.duties: Versamel alle relevante dokumente en inligting, voer behoorlike analise en gehaltekontroles op inligting uit, voer vettingondersoeke ten opsigte van vertroulike en geheime vlak uit, kontak proefpersone en verwysings om onderhoude te skeduleer, stel verslae op en dien dit aan bestuur en die National Intelligence Agency (NLA) in oor alle vettinglêers en verslag daagliks voltooi, verseker dat alle onderhoude met proefpersone en verwysings uitgevoer word, verseker dat alle nege vettingsfaktore waar relevant voldoende tydens onderhoude aangespreek word, volg op by die proefpersoon of verwysings oor enige onduidelike of onvoldoende aangespreekte vettingsfaktor of kwessie, verseker dat alle onderhoude wat uitgevoer is ten volle in die verslag ingesluit word, stel vettingondersoekverslae op wat die bevindings en aanbevelings wat tydens onderhoude versamel en ingesamel is, uiteensit en administreer vettingondersoeklêers, verseker deeglike en op bewyse gebaseerde aanbevelings, monitor die vordering en gehalte van Vettingondersoekers se verslae, inkorporeer en gebruik alle bronne en dokumente wat gebruik is in die verslae, dien voltooide Vettingondersoeke by die Vettingbestuurder/ Toesighouer in vir gehaltebeheer, voer maatskappyondersoeke soos deur die Vettingbestuurder op 'n ad hoc-basis versoek uit, berei ad hoc-ondersoekverslae en aanbevelings oor negatiewe voor-indiensneming-bevindings van kandidate voor, voer verifikasie van maatskappyinliging soos verskaf uit verskeie bronne soos MIE-kontrole, SARS ens. uit, verseker dat gehalte- en deeglike maatskappy-ondersoek- en ad hoc-verslae aan eindgebruikers vir verdere hantering voorgelê word, voer voortdurende assessering van ontwikkelings in vetting uit om met beleidsontwikkeling te help, analiseer, ondersoek en evalueer alle vettingverwante inligting, verskaf advies en leiding oor die interpretasie en toepassing van wetgewing, beleide en prosedures, vestig en bevorder verhoudings met eksterne belanghebbendes, insluitend kredietinligtingverskaffers om toegang tot inligting te verkry, verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers, wys pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit oor die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesigtendes ten opsigte van alle aspekte van die werk, bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van werknemers. Verseker dat alle werknemers opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te kan lewer, ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker en hanteer navrae en verskaf advies en leiding oor batestoewysing en -beheer.

zu.title: Umhloli Omkhulu Wokuhlola
zu.summary: Umhloli Omkhulu Wokuhlola e-Office of the Chief Justice e-Midrand, ophenya ngasese futhi uhlele imibiko emazingeni okuhola ayi-10.
zu.requirements: Abafakelayo kufanele babe ne-National Diploma kwezokusayensi ezenhlalo, eziphathelene nokuphatha ukuvikela, i-Criminology, i-Police Science noma izifundo ezihambisana nazo emazingeni e-NQF ayisithupha (6) njengoba kusho i-SAQA. Banamathuba amathathu (3) unyaka wokuhlangenwe nakho enkundleni ephathelene nokuhlola, kuleyo minyaka eyodwa kufanele ibe ngazinga okubhekelayo. I-Vetting Course evela ku-SSA, ku-DI nakwa-SAPS izoba usizo olwengeziwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngoMthethosisekelo weRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, i-Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS) neminye imithethonqondo / iziqondiso zomnyango nendlela yokwenza izinto, ulwazi ngoMthetho Wokuhlola Kazwelonke, uMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi, 103 ka-1994, imisebenzi yonke yokuphatha okuhlanganisa ukuhlola, uMthetho Wezobuqondisisbe Kazwelonke, 39 ka-1994, njengoba wenziwa ukulungiswa, uMthetho Wokuvikela Ulwazi, 85 ka-1985, uMthetho Wokuvikela Ulwazi Ngomuntu Ngamunye, 04 ka-2013 nokuphenya kanye nezinqubo ezibhekiswe kwisevisi yomphakathi. Unelwazi lokuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ekuphatweni kwezimali, ekuphathweni kwamaphrojekthi, ekuhlelweni, ekuhlelweni kolwazi, ekwenzeni izinqumo, ekuxazululweni izinkinga nasemakhonweni obuchule.
zu.duties: Qoqa yonke imibhalo yolwazi edingekayo, uhlolo ngokuzinzisayo futhi uhlole ikhwalithi yolwazi, wenze ukuphenya kokuhlola ngokuphathelene nazinga elingasese nelifihlakele, uthintane nabahwebelayo nabanikela ulwazi ukuze uhlele izinkampani ezingenwa yilolu cwaningo, hlela futhi uhlothule imibiko kubaphathi nakwi-National Intelligence Agency (NLA) kuyo yonke amafayela okuhlola futhi uwabhale nsuku zonke, qinisekisa ukuthi yonke izinkingamfundo nababanikela ulwazi kwenziwe, qinisekisa ukuthi yonke emaphuzu ayisishiyagalolunye okuhlola aphathwa kahle lapho kudingeka khona ngesikhathi kwenziwa izinkampani zokungenwa ocwaningweni, landela noma ubani ongacacile noma ongaphathwa kahle ngomkhakha noma ngodaba lokuhlola, qinisekisa ukuthi konke okwenziwa ngesikhathi kuhlanganiswe ngokuphelele embikweni, hlela imibiko yokuphenya kokuhlola echaza okutholakele nezindlela eziphethwe ngesikhathi nokutholwa ngesikhathi kwenziwa izinkampani futhi uphathe amafayela okuhlola, qinisisa izincomo eziphathelene nokuqinisekisa kwezibonakaliso, hlola ukuthi kuyaqhubeka kanjani nomomoko wokwenza imibiko futhi uhlole ikhwalithi yayo, futhi uhlanganise futhi usebenzise yonke imithombo namafayela okusebenziswa embikweni, hlela izincomo eziphoqelelekile ezingezinhle ezingakaqashiwa kubafakela bese kuthunyelwa kwi-Vetting Manager/Supervisor ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikhwalithi, wenze izinkampani ezingenwa ngokuhlolwa njengoba selibingelelwa yi-Vetting Manager ngokwesimo esijwayelekile, hlela imibiko yezimo ehlukene futhi unikeze izincomo ngemiphumela engemihle engakaqashiwa ngabafakela abangenwe ocwaningweni, qinisekisa ulwazi ngesikhathi futhi uhlole ukuthi kuyaqhubeka kanjani nokuthi konke okutholwe kuqinisekiswe ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukene okuhlanganisa ukuhlola kwa-MIE, i-SARS njll, qinisekisa ukuthi imibiko ekhwalithi kahle etholwa kubantu abahamba ibhadi isetshenziswa ngokwesimo esijwayelekile ihlelelwe abayisebenzisayo ukuthi bagqibe ukuyiphatha, qhuba ukuhlola ngokwesisindo izimo ezenzeka ekuhloleni ukuze usize ekuthuthukisweni komthethonqondo, hlola, cwaninga futhi uhlole lonke ulwazi oluhambisana nokuhlola, unikeze izeluleko nezindlela ngokuqonda nokusetshenziswa kwemithetho, imithethonqondo nezinqubo, simame izinkampani nomama kanjalo kwaye ugcine ubudlelwano nabantu abavela kwamanye amaphiko abaqondisana nabo okuhlanganisa nabathengisi bezinkampani ngokusebenzisa ezinye izinto, qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaphuzu okuhlola ayisishiyagalombili ahanjiswa kahle lapho kudingeka khona, hlela umkhakha wokuhlola, uhlele imibiko, ugcine ubudlelwano nabasebenzisana nabo, uhlele futhi uphathe konke okudingekayo ekuphatweni komsebenzi, qinisekisa ukuthi wonke abasebenzi bafundiswa futhi bathuthukiswa ukuze bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi odingekayo ngokwemigomo nangokwesikhathi, futhi bathuthukise, bafeze futhi balale imikhakha yomsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuyasebenza ngokulingana kahle nangokusesikhathini baphendule imibuzo futhi banike izeluleko nokuqondisa ngokwabelwa nokulawulwa kwempahla.

xh.title: Umphandi Ophakamileyo Wokuvavwa
xh.summary: Umphandi Ophakamileyo Wokuvavwa kwi-Office of the Chief Justice eMidrand, oqhuba uphando oluyimfihlo kwintsimbi yokuqinisekiswa alungise nawachaze iingxelo kwinqanaba elingu-10.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abafaki-zicelo babe nawoncedo lwe-National Diploma kwi-Social Science, Security Management, Criminology, Police Science okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nayo kwinqanaba le-NQF lesithandathu (6) njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Iimvelo ezintathu (3) zesipho sabasebenzi kwinkimbinkimbi ekunxulumene nayo, apho kubekho unyaka oyedwa ebesengowolawulo. Isifundo se-Vetting esisuka kwi-SSA, DI ne-SAPS siza kubakho lusizo olongezelelekileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, i-Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS) nezinye iindlela zokulawula neengqiqo zolwazi oluncinci zikalaphandle/ iziqondiso nezendlela zokwenza izinto, ulwazi nge-National Vetting Strategy, i-Public Service Act, 103 ye-1994, imisebenzi yobaluleko jikelele ehlanganisela uvavayo, i-National Strategic Intelligence Act, 39 ye-1994, njengoko iguquliwe, i-Protection of Information Act, 85 ye-1985, i-Protection of Personal Information Act, 04 ye-2013 nendlela yokuphanda nemithetho yayo kwiinkonzo zikawonke-wonke. Ukwazi ukunxibelelana (ngolwimi nangokubhalwayo), ukulawula imali, ukulawula iiprojekthi, iplani, ukulungelelanisa, ukuhlalutya, ukuthatha izigqibo, ukuxazula iingxaki namakhono amaqaba.
xh.duties: Qokelela zonke iifayile nolwazi oluxhomekeke kuyo, yenza uhlalutyo oluchanekileyo nokuqinisekisa ngokwemigaqo ulwazi, qhuba uphando lokuvavwa kwinqanaba lemfihlo neliyimfihlo engcolileyo, thintana nomntu onguxhaswa nabagqibelayo ukuze ulungelelanise iidyebhu, cwangcisa ngenza iingxelo ezisundulwa kubalawuli nase-National Intelligence Agency (NLA) ngazo zonke iifayile zokuvavwa ungenise iingxelo ezigqitywe kwisiseko sangemini, qinisekisa ukuba zonke iidyebhu nabantu abanguxhaswa nabagqibelayo kwenziwa, qinisekisa ukuba zonke iintlobo ezisithoba zokuvavwa zibhekwa ngokunyanzeleka apho kufuneka khona ngesikhathi seedyebhu, landela umntu onguxhaswa okanye abagqibelayo nangaliphi na icala elingenacacanga okanye elingaxelwanga ngokwaneleyo ekuvavweni, qinisekisa ukuba zonke iidyebhu ezenziwayo zifakwe ngokupheleleyo kwingxelo, cwangcisa iingxelo zophando lokuvavwa ezichaza iziphumo neengcebiso ezikho ngezenziwe nangeziqokelelwe ngexesha leedyebhu uze ulawule iifayile zophando lokuvavwa, qinisekisa iingcebiso ezilungileyo ezisekelwa ziba bungqina, phatha intshukela yabaPhandi Bokuvavwa nangangoxelo ngokwemigaqo, faka ngokupheleleyo kwaye usebenzise yonke imithombo nelifayile esebenziswayo kungengxelo, ngenisa iziphondo zokuvavwa ezigqitywe kwiVetting Manager/ Supervisor ukuze kusetyenziswe ulawulo lomgangatho, yenza ukuhlolwa kweenkampani njengoko celwa yiVetting Manager ngesiseko se-Ad-hoc, lwangcisa iingxelo ezenziwa ngesiseko se-ad-hoc kunye neengcebiso ezimalanga neziphumo ezingezilunganga ngabafaki-zicelo abangaphambili, qinisekisa iinkcukacha zenkampani ngokusetyenziswa kweemithobo eyahlukahlukeneko efana nokuqinisekiswa kwe-MIE, i-SARS njl, qinisekisa ukuba iingxelo ezilungileyo zokuqinisekisa iinkampani nezididadayo ze-ad-hoc zithunyelwa kubasebenzisi abagqibelayo ukwenza iziphelo ezingakumbi, yenza isilinganiso esiya phambili sezinto ezisetyenziswayo ekuvavweni ukuze kuncediswe kunciphisa kwenziwa iindlela zokusebenza, qondisa, yophando uze uhlalutye zonke iinkcukacha ezingxulumene nokuvavwa, yinkcukacha ebalulekileyo nayo yonke imithetho yombuso weenkqubo, iindlela namagqibo, yongame nezinye iindlela zokuvakalisa ulwazi, ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi oluqinisekiswa yi-NIA, qinisekisa ukuba kubekho ulawulo jikelele lwabasebenzi, ulungelelanise imisebenzi wenze ulawulo lomgangatho kwinkonzo eyenziwe ngamaphandle, lawula iholo labasebenzi, yala uze uhube abo abalawulwa ngawe ngakwalo onke amacandelo omsebenzi, lawula inkonzo, ukuziphatha nobuganga babasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba wonke umsebenzi ufundise uphuhlise abasebenzi ukuba bawukwazi ukufaka inkonzo emgangathweni ofunekayo ngokusebenza kakuhle nangempumelelo, phuhlisa, usebenzise ulandele iinkqubo zemisebenzi nezendlela zokuqinisekisa ukusebenza okusebenzayo nangempumelelo uphendule imibuzo unike icebiso nokuqonda ngokwabiwo lokulawula izixhobo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 - R573 370 per annum (Level 09). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement. CENTRE             Mpumalanga Provincial Service Centre: Mbombela
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Human Resource Management at the Office of the Chief Justice in Mbombela, requiring a National Diploma and three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a three-year National Diploma in Human Resources Management / Public Administration / Public Management / Personnel Management or equivalent qualification at NQF Level 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years’ relevant experience in Human Resources Management environment of which one (1) should be at supervisory level. Introduction to PERSAL certificate. Experience in Labour Relations and a valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge and understanding of Public Service Act. 1994, Knowledge of Public Service Regulation 2016, Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, knowledge of HRM policies, knowledge of HR related standards, practices, processes and procedure, knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in Computer literacy, communication and report writing, Analytical thinking, problem solving, planning and organising skills, decision making, motivational, presentation and time management. Along with the following attributes: Innovative, Meticulous, creative, people orientated, time bound, trustworthy, assertive and self-motivated.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Menslike Hulpbronbestuur by die Kantoor van die Hoofregter in Mbombela, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma en drie jaar se tersaaklike ondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n driejaar Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Publieke Administrasie / Publieke Bestuur / Personeelbestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF Vlak 6 met 360 krediete soos erken deur SAQA beskik. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se tersaaklike ondervinding in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing waarvan een (1) op toesigvlak moet wees. Inleiding tot PERSAL-sertifikaat. Ondervinding in Arbeidsverhoudinge en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van Public Service Act. 1994, kennis van Public Service Regulation 2016, Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, kennis van HRM-beleide, kennis van HR-verwante standaarde, praktyke, prosesse en prosedures, kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid, kommunikasie en verslagskrywing, analitiese denke, probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisasievaardighede, besluitneming, motivering, aanbieding en tydbestuur. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: Innovatief, noukeurig, kreatief, mense-georiënteerd, tydgebonde, betroubaar, selfversekerd en selfgemotiveerd.
af.duties: Implementeer doeltreffende en effektiewe werwing en seleksieprosesse: Identifiseer gefinansierde vakante poste, verseker voorlegging van versoek om adverteringspaneel memo vir goedkeuring, monitor die samestelling en implementering van die werwingsplan, monitor die instandhouding van die personeelbestelling, verskaf advies oor werwing en seleksie-aangeleenthede. Verseker die administrasie van diensvoorwaardes en voordele: Vang kantoorverlofplan in, gehoudsverseker al die nodige dokumente en vorms voltooi en keur goed / keur af verlof op PERSAL, verseker die voorlegging en voltooiing van PILLIR-aansoeke, verseker die administrasie van langdiens-erkenningstoekennings, behuisingsfooraansoeke, waarnemingsfooris en oortyd, monitor die voorlegging van pensioendokumente binne 6 weke na beëindiging, monitor die voltooiing en voorlegging van aanstellings- en beëindigingsdokumente, voer verlof-oudit uit. Implementeer prestasiebestuur en ontwikkelingstelsel en opleidingsinisiatiewe: verseker die voorlegging van prestasie-ooreenkomste, middeljaar-hersienings, jaarlikse assesserings en die vaslegging op PERSAL in ooreenstemming met die PMDS-beleid en voorskrifte, gehoudsverseker data vir uitstaande PMDS-dokumente en neem regstellende maatreëls, fasiliteer voor-moderasievergaderings en neem notule, fasiliteer appèlle wat voortspruit uit die moderasieproses van die provinsie, monitor die betaling van prestasiebelonings, implementeer opleidingsplan in die provinsie, hanteer interne en eksterne ouditnavrae. Implementeer arbeidsverhoudinge-aangeleenthede en EHW-programme: Implementeer die aanbevelings oor klagtes, verskaf ondersteuning aan ondersoeke en disiplinêre verhore waar nodig in oorleg met arbeidsverhoudinge, implementeer die uitslae van disiplinêre verhore, dispute en appèlsake, verskaf ondersteuning by konsiliasies en arbitrasies, fasiliteer die implementering van EHW-programme in die provinsie, verseker die voorsiening van doeltreffende en effektiewe verskaffing van HR-rekordbestuursdienste, verseker die instandhouding van die registrasieboek vir HR-dokumente en versoeke, verseker voldoende lêerstelsel, handhaaf veilige bewaring en beskerming van lêers en rekords, verseker die instandhouding van HR-rekordbestuurdatabasis, hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel, verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers, wys pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesigtiges ten opsigte van alle aspekte van die werk, bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van werknemers, verseker dat alle werknemers opgelei en ontwikkel word om in staat te wees om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lewer, ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werksisteme en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker, hanteer navrae en verskaf advies en leiding oor bate-toewysing en -beheer.

zu.title: Umsekuliwo: uMphathi ohlola imisebenzi yokuqashwa kwezinsiza zabantu
zu.summary: Isikhundla somqondisi othathayo ohlola imisebenzi ephathelene nokuqashwa kwezinsiza zabantu kuso isikhungo soMnyango weNkantolo Ephambili eMbombela, sifuna idiploma kazwelonke kanye neminyaka emithathu yesipheqelo esihambisana naleso sikhundla.
zu.requirements: Abafakelayo kumele babe nediploma yezwe ihle ngonyaka we-3 in Human Resources Management / Public Administration / Public Management / Personnel Management noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 nangamakhredithi angu-360 njengoba kuvunywe yi-SAQA. Isipheqelo seminyaka eyithathu (3) yesipheqelo esihambisana nokuphatheka kwezemikhaya yamansiza kumnyango wokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu, okuyinye yale minyaka kumele ibe ezingeni lokuphatha. Isitifiketi sokungenwa ku-PERSAL. Isipheqelo kumabango abasebenzi nelayisensi yokushayela evikile kuzoba yinklomelo. Ulwazi nemakhono: Ukugonda kanye nokuqonda i-Public Service Act. 1994, Ukugonda i-Public Service Regulation 2016, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Employment Equity Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, ukwaziswa kwemithesho yokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu, ukwaziswa kwezinga le-HRM, amasiko, amaphrosese kanye nemithetho, ukwaziswa ngesimiso se-Batho Pele. Amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuxhumana kanye nokubhala imibiko, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela nokuqamba amasu, ukwenza izinqumo, ukukhuthaza, ukunikeza izinkulumo kanye nokuphatha isikhathi. Kanye nezici ezilandelayo: Ukutsha, ukuqinisile, ukudala, ukukhetha izihlabakhosi, ukubophezela ngesikhathi, ukwethemba, ukuqiniseka kanye nokuzikhuthaza.
zu.duties: Qalisa izinqubo zokubumba abasebenzi nokukhetha ezisebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Thola izikhundla ezingenamali ezizehlule, qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kocingo lokuthumela umbhalo weqembu ukuze uvunywe, hlola ukuhlelwa kanye nokuphunywa kwesuqondo sokubumba abasebenzi, hlola ukugcinwa kwesisekelo sabasebenzi, nikeza izeluleko ezindabeni zokubumba abasebenzi nokukhetha. Qinisekisa ukuphatheka kwezimo zokusebenza nezinzuzo. Faka ihlelo lokuhamba komsebenzi kohofisi, hlolisisa ngokulinganisela yonke imibhalo namafomu ayadingekayo, uqede futhi uvume noma wenqale ukulahlwa kukahamba komsebenzi ku-PERSAL, qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kanye nokuphunywa kwezicelo ze-PILLIR, qinisekisa ukuphatheka kwemiklomelo yokubonga isikhathi eside sokusebenza, izicelo zesibonezelo sezindlu, isibonezelo sokubamba isikhundla kanye nokusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi, hlola ukuthunyelwa kwemibhalo yezimali zokuphumula kwangaphakathi kwamasonto angu-6 emva kokuqeda ukusebenza, hlola ukuqedwa kanye nokuthunyelwa kwemibhalo yokubamba isikhundla nokuqeda ukusebenza, yenze ukuhlolwa kokuhamba komsebenzi. Qalisa inkqubo yokuphathwa nokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza kanye nokuqaliswa kokuqeqesha. Qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwezivumelano zokusebenza, ukuhlolwa okuhalfu unyaka, ukuhlola kwaminyaka yonke kanye nokufaka ku-PERSAL ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo we-PMDS nezinyathelo, hlolisisa idatha yemibhalo ye-PMDS ehlulekile bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa, khokhela izinkumbe zangaphambilini zokuqondanisa futhi ubambe imininingwane, khokhela iziphakamiso ezivela eqenjini lokuqondanisa lesifundazwe, hlola ukukhokhwa kwezinklomelo zokusebenza kahle, qalise ihlelo lokuqeqesha esifundazweni, zibandakanye ekuphenyweni kwezibalo zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Phatha izindaba zomuso kanye namaphrogramu we-EHW. Qalisa izincoma ezindabeni zezikhalazo, nikeza inkxaso ekuphenyweni nasezinkantolo ezenza uthuli lokuqasha lapho kudingeka khona ngokubonisana nomnyango wamasiko womsebenzi, qalisa izinqumo zezinkantolo ezenza uthuli lokuqasha, iziphikiswano nezicelo zesibuyekiso, nikeza inkxaso ekubambisweni nasezinkantolo zokuqondanisa imigqa futhi应对izingxabano, qalisa amaphrogramu we-EHW esifundazweni, qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwenkxaso kahle nangempumelelo yamaphrosese okugcina izikhulu zabasebenzi, qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwebhuku lerekhodi lezobhumane ngemibhalo kwe-HR kanye nezicelo, qinisekisa ukuba khona kohlelo oluyiyo lokuza kabusha, gcina ngokuphepha kanye nokuvikelwa kwamafayela namarekhodi, qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwesisekelo seenjini zamarekhodi zabasebenzi be-HR, phatha futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi, qinisekisa ukuphatheka ngokuvamile kwabasebenzi, abela imisebenzi bese wenza ulawulo olulinganisela emsebenzini owenziwe zizikhulu, phatha ukuhamba komsebenzi kwabasebenzi, lacelela futhi uhola abaphathi ngemayelana nazo zonke izindaba zomsebenzi, phatha ukusebenza, ukuziphatha kanye noso lokuqasha abasebenzi, qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi beqeqeshiwe futhi bathuthukiswe ukuthi bakwazi ukunikeza umsebenzi olinganayo ngempumelelo nakwesikhathi, dala, qalise bese uhlole amasistimu womsebenzi kanye namaphrosese ukuze kusheshe kubonakale ukuthi asebenza kahle futhi nangempumelelo, xoxa ngemibuzo futhi unikeze izeluleko nokuqondisa ukwabiwa kanye nolawulo lwezimpahla.

xh.title: Umncedi woMlawuli: Ulawulo Lwabasebenzi
xh.summary: Umsebenzi woncedo lomlawuli wabasebenzi kwindawo kaMongameli weNkundla eMbombela, ofuna i-National Diploma namava eminyaka emithathu.
xh.requirements:
Abafakeli kufuneka bathathe i-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu kwindawo yabasebenzi / ulawulo lolu hlelo / ulawulo lolu hlelo / ulawulo lwabantu okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF Level 6 ngokubakho kwe-credits ezingama-360 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. 
Ukuqatshwa okungaphantsi kweminyaka emithathu (3) yamava afanelekileyo kwindawo yolawulo lwabantu apho enye (1) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lolawulo. 
Isatifikethi sokungena kwi-PERSAL. 
A mava kwindawo yamaxwebhu nokuba nalayisensi yokuqhuba kuya kuba yinxaxhelo. 
Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nakuqonda koMthetho woLawulo Loluntu. 
1994, Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo Loluntu 2016, UMthetho woLawulo Loluntu, UMthetho weNgqungqutha yoLuntu, UMthetho weMigaqo yoMsebenzi, ulwazi lweendawo zomsebenzi, ulwazi lweendawo ezinxulumene nendawo, ukwenza okulandelayo kuye kubekho amagunya: Ukwenza okuqhelisayo, ukulungisa izigqibo, ukucinga ngeendlela ezahlukileyo, ukwenza ngokobomi, ukuzinza kwixesha, ukuzinikela, ukuzimisela nokuzenzela.
xh.duties:
Zisebenzise iinkqubo ezisebenzayo nangempumelelo zokubasebenzisa noku khetha: Zichonge izithuba ezizeleyo ezixhaswa ngemali, qinisekisa ukuba kuthunyelwa isicelo sokuziphakamisa kumemo yepaneli ukuba kuvunywe, lilandlele ukwenziwa nokusebenza kohlelo lokubasebenzisa, lilandlele ukugcinwa kwesakhiwo sabasebenzi, nike iseluleko kumabango okubasebenzisa nangokukhetha.
Qinisekisa ulawulo lweemeko zesebenza nezibonelelo: Zifake iplani yokuqhashambele komsebenzi kwindawo, zinike izinga lemigqa emitsha yayo yonke imibhalo namafomu apheleleyo qinisekisa ukuze avunywe / angavunywa ikuqhashambele kwi-PERSAL, qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa nokuqedwa kwabezicelo ze-PILLIR, qinisekisa ulawulo lwamafa om koko bakhule, ezokuqasha nasezokusebenza ngaphezulu koxesha, lilandlele ukuthunyelwa kwezibhalo zobungekho iintsuku ezingu-6 emva kokuphuma, lilandlele ukuqedwa nokuthunyelwa kwezibhalo zokuqasha nokuphuma, yenze ukuphononongwa kweempilo zomsebenzi.
Zisebenzise inkqubo yokulawula nokuqhutywa ngokusebenza kahle kweplani yokuqeqeshwa: qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwezivumelwano zokusebenza, ukuqwalaselwa phakathi konyaka, iintatho zemihla ngemihla nokuzifaka kwi-PERSAL ngokwemigaqo nengesi ye-PMDS, qinisekisa izinga lemigqa yonke imibhalo evelayo ye-PMDS wenze izinyathelo zokulungisa, khokela iindibano zokuqwalaselwa phambi kwaye zibe noshicilelo, khokela iziphakamiso evela kwindlela yokuqwalaselwa kule candelo, lilandlele inkokhela yezibonelelo zokusebenza, zisebenzise iplani yokuqeqeshwa kwesi samabenzi, ziphendule imibuzo yokuphonononga yangaphakathi nangaphandle.
Zisebenzise amabango ohlelo lokusebenza namaphula e-EHW: Zisebenzise izindululo kumngeni nike inkxaso eziphando naseendibano zezigwebo apho kufuneka ngokubonisana nesebe lohlobo lomsebenzi, zisebenzise iziphumo zendibano yezigwebo, yengxabano naba phakathi kwamaxwebhu, nike inkxaso ekubeni nokuguquguquzelwa kohlangothi lwentsika yomntu ekuqalwa kwakhona kule candelo, qinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngenkonzo esebenzayo nangempumelelo yemibhalo yolawulo yemisebenzi yase khaya, qinisekisa ukugcinwa kofaku lemibhalo yobuqu, qinisekisa indlela efanelekileyo yokubeka iifayili, gcina ukhuseleko nokhuseleko iifayili noshicilelo, qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwegcini ngokubakho kwabasebenzi basekhaya, qeqesha kwaye uphuhlise abantu, qinisekisa ukuyilawulela ngokubanzi ngokubakho kwakho, wabelwe imisebenzi kwaye ulawule izinga lemigqa kumsebenzi onikezwa ngamaphakathi, ulawule iqhashambele lo basebenzi, uphuhlise kwaye ulenze abalandeli nkqondo kwalo onke amanqanaba omsebenzi, ulawule inkqubo yokusebenza nokuqhutywa ngokumanyenziwa nabantu abangenamahlazo, qinisekisa ukuba abantu besebenza baphuhliswa kwaye bengakanampilo ngenkqubo ukuba bakwazi ukusebenza, uphuhlise, ulawule kwaye ulandelie amasimi ohlelo lokusebenza ukuze kuqhutywe ngokusebenza kakuhle, aphendule imibuzo anike iseluleko ngokwabiwo nokulawulwa kweempahla.

jobs.summary: Vetting Investigator needed at the Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand to conduct vetting investigations and compile reports for confidential and secret level security clearances.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of National Diploma in Social Science, Security Management, Criminology, Police Science or related qualifications at NQF level six (6) as recognised by SAQA. Two (2) years’ experience in the relevant field. Vetting Course from SSA, DI and SAPS will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS) and other departmental policies/guidelines and procedural, National Vetting Strategy, Public Service Act, 103 of 1994, general administrative function including vetting, National Strategic Intelligence Act, 39 of 1994, as amended, Protection of Information Act, 85 of 1985, Protection of Personal Information Act, 04 of 2013 and investigation and procedures applicable to the public service. Skilled in computer literacy, report writing, research, planning, communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

af.title: Vettingondersoeker
af.summary: Vettingondersoeker benodig by die Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand om vettingondersoeke uit te voer en verslae op te stel vir vertroulike en geheime vlak veiligheidsklarings.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n National Diploma in Sosiale Wetenskappe, Sekuriteitsbestuur, Kriminologie, Polisiewetenskap of verwante kwalifikasies op NQF vlak six (6) soos deur SAQA erken besit. Two (2) jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld. 'n Vetting Course van SSA, DI en SAPS sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van die Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS) en ander departementele beleide/ riglyne en prosedures, National Vetting Strategy, Public Service Act, 103 of 1994, algemene administratiewe funksies insluitend vetting, National Strategic Intelligence Act, 39 of 1994, soos gewysig, Protection of Information Act, 85 of 1985, Protection of Personal Information Act, 04 of 2013 en ondersoek en prosedures van toepassing op die openbare diens. Vaardig in rekenaarvaardigheid, verslagskrywing, navorsing, beplanning, kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings) en interpersoonlike vaardighede.
af.duties: Versamel alle relevante dokumente en inligting, voer behoorlike ontleding en gehaltekontrole op inligting uit, voer vettingondersoeke uit ten opsigte van vertroulike en geheime vlak, stel verslae op en dien dit by bestuur en die National Intelligence Agency in oor alle vettinglêers en verslae wat daagliks voltooi word, kontak proefpersone en verwysings om onderhoude te skeduleer, verseker dat alle onderhoude met proefpersone en verwysings gevoer word, verseker dat al nege vettingfaktore waar relevant voldoende tydens onderhoude hanteer word, volg op met die proefpersoon of verwysings oor enige onduidelike of onvoldoende behandelde vettingfaktor of kwessie, verseker dat alle onderhoude wat gevoer is ten volle in die verslag ingesluit word, stel vettingondersoekverslae op wat die bevindings en aanbevelings wat tydens onderhoude ingewin en versamel is uiteensit en administreer vettingondersoeklêers, verseker deeglike en bewysgebaseerde aanbevelings, inkorporeer en gebruik alle bronne en dokumente wat gebruik is in die verslae, dien voltooide Vetting Investigations by die Vetting Manager/ Supervisor in vir gehaltebeheer, voer maatskappyondersoeke soos deur die Vetting Manager op 'n Ad-hoc basis versoek uit, berei ad-hoc ondersoekverslae en aanbevelings voor oor negatiewe vooraf-diensbevindings oor kandidate, voer verifikasie van maatskappyinligting soos verskaf uit deur gebruik te maak van verskeie bronne soos MIE checks, SARS ens, verseker dat gehalte- en deeglike maatskappyondersoek- en ad-hoc ondersoekverslae aan eindgebruikers voorsien word vir verdere hantering, voer deurlopende assessering van ontwikkelinge in vetting uit om te help met beleidsontwikkeling, ontleed, doen navorsing en evalueer alle vettingverwante inligting, verskaf advies en leiding oor die interpretasie en toepassing van wetgewing, beleide en prosedures, vestig en bevorder verhoudings met eksterne belanghebbendes en kredietinligtingverskaffers om toegang tot inligting te verkry.

zu.title: Umphenyi we-Vetting
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphenyi wezokuhlola e-Office of the Chief Justice e-Midrand ukuze aenze ukuphenya ngokuhlola futhi ahlanganise imibiko mayelana nezimvume zokuphepha zezinga lobumfihlo nesesimfihlo.
zu.requirements: Abafakwayo kufanele babe ne-Diploma yezwe wezwe eMnyangweni wezenhlalo, eMnyangweni wezokuphepha, e-Criminology, e-Police Science noma izidingo ezihlobene ezingeni le-NQF lesithupha (6) njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Uluvo lokusebenza eminyakeni emibili (2) enkundeni yamabhodi. Isifundo sokuhlola kwa-SSA, DI kanye ne-SAPS sizoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthethosisekelo weRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, amaphuzu abamba phansi okuphepha kwolwazi (MISS) kanye nanomnyango ongakwazi ukubeka izindlela ezithile, izimiso ezimbalwa zokuhlola izwe, umthetho wePublic Service, 103 of 1994, imisebenzi yohulumeni obejwayelekile ehlanganisa ukuhlola, umthetho we-National Strategic Intelligence Act, 39 of 1994, njengokulungiswa kwawo, umthetho we-Protection of Information Act, 85 of 1985, umthetho we-Protection of Personal Information Act, 04 of 2013 kanye nokuphenya kanye nezinqumo ezisebenza kulezinkampani zikahulumeni. Ukhulelwe ekwazini ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukubhala imibiko, ukucwaninga, ukuhlela, ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuqanjwayo) namakhono okuxhumana nabantu.
zu.duties: Qoqa wonke amadokhumenti nolwazi oluhlobene,enza ukuhlaziya okufanele futhi uhlolo ikhwalithi kulwazi,enze ukuphenya ngokuhlola mayelana nazinga lobumfihlo nesimfihlo,hlanganise futhi unikeze imibiko kubaphathi kanye ne-National Intelligence Agency yonke amafayela okuhlola namabiko aphethwe nsuku zonke,xhumana nabaligugu kanye nabalingisi ukuze uhlelele izingxoxo,qiniseka ukuthi zonke izingxoxo nabaligugu kanye nabalingisi zenziwe,qiniseka ukuthi wonke amaphuzu ayisishiyagalolunye okuhlola aphathwe ngokwanele lapho kufanelekile ngesikhathi kwenziwa izingxoxo,landela kabaligugu noma abalingisi nganoma yiliphi iphuzu lesimo sokuhlola okungacacile noma okungaphathwanga kahle,qiniseka ukuthi zonke izingxoxo ezenziwe zifakwe ngokugcwele embikweni,hlanganisa imibiko yokuphenya ngokuhlola evezwe iziphumelo kanye nezincoma ezitholwe futhi ziqoqwe ngesikhathi kwenziwa izingxoxo futhi ulawule amafayela okuphenya ngokuhlola,qiniseka izincoma ezinomsoco futhi ezeqiniso,faka futhi use wonke emithombo namadokhumenti asetshenziswa kumibiko,nikeze ukuphenya ngokuhlola okuqediwe ku-Vetting Manager/Supervisor ukuze kwenziwe ukulawula ikhwalithi,hlola izinkampani njengoba kucelwa ngu-Vetting Manager ngesikhathi esingahleliwe,lungiselela imibiko yokuphenya okungahleliwe kanye nezincoma mayelana neziphumelo ezingemihle zangaphambi kokusebenza zabafakwayo,qiniseka ulwazi lenkampani njengokuqinisekiswa ngokusetyenziswa kwemithombo ehlukene njengokuqinisekiswa kwe-MIE,SARS njll,qiniseka ukuthi imibiko yokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yezinkampani nokuuphenya okungahleliwe inikwe abasebenzisi bokugcina ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezilandelayo,enze ukuhlola kuqhubeka kwezinto ezintsha ezikhona kokuhlola ukuze kusize ekuthuthukisweni kwemigomo,hlaziya,cwaninge futhi uhlale konke ulwazi oluhlobene nokuhlola,nikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa ngokuchazwa nokusetshenziswa kwemithetho,imigomo kanye namasu,setha,ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano nabashibamnqa bangaphandle kanye nabanikezolwazi bemali ukuze kufinyelelwe kulwazi.

xh.title: Umphandi Wokuhlola
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe khona umPhandi Wokuqinisekisa eKantolo loMlawuli weNqanaba eliphezulu kwiMidrand ukuze enze iimviwo zokuqinisekisa adze anyuse iingxelo ngezona ngcango zokhuseleko ezifihlakeleyo neyimfihlo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zokuba abantu abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neDiploma yezizwe kwiMfundo yezeNdalo, iNkululeko yolawulo, isiCriminology, isiKoloji samaPolisa okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nazo kumqondo we-NQF kwingqingqa yamathandathu (6) njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA. Iimfuno zokuba abantu abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neMisebenzi yamnyaka wama-2 (2) kwinkundla ephilayo. Ukwenza isikhulumi seKholeji yolwazi oluzoqinisekiswa kwi-SSA, i-DI ne-SAPS kuya kuba yinkxaso ezenza isicelo sibe namandla. Ulwazi amandla nokusebenza: Ulwazi lweNqanaba eliphezulu loMthetho wesiZwe iRiphabhuliki yaseMzantsi Afrika, iMilinganiselo yamanye amalungelo obuntu kunye nezinye iinkqubo kunye nemigaqo yolawulo yamasebe, iNqanaba eliphezulu iNqanaba leMigqa yokuqinisekiswa kweLizwe, iMithetho yamanyathelo eNyango yoLuntu ka-1994, iMisebenzi yoLuntu ngokubanzi ebandakanya ukuvavanywa nokugqiba, iNqanaba leZigqibo zeZizwe eziyi-39 ka-1994, njengoko kulungisiwe, iMithetho yokuQinisekisa iNqanaba lemiFihlo i-85 ka-1985, iMithetho yoKhuselo lweNqaba ngokubanzi i-04 ka-2013 kwaye kuphando kwakunye neenkqubo ezisebenza kumanyathelo oLuntu. Ukusebenza ngokwaneleyo kwiikhompyutha, ukubhala iingxelo, ukuphanda, ukuyila, ukunxibelelwana (elibhaliweyo noluthethwayo) nokuqonda ukusebenza nomntu.
xh.duties: Qokelela onke amaxwebhu nolwazi olunxulumene nendlu, yenza isahluko sokungenisa isikolo sabo bonke ulwazi nendlela yokwenza umsebenzi, yenza iimviwo zokuqinisekisa nangaphezulu kwezinto ezingamfihlo nangaphezulu kwezinto ezifihliweyo, bhala uze unikeze iingxelo kuLuntu olukhululekileyo nakuBathi bemida weNqanaba ngaphezulu ngayo yonke imifanekiso yokwenza umsebenzi kwaye unikeze iingxelo ngemini ngemini, thinta abantu abanxulumene nendlu kunye nabanikwe isikhulumi ukuze uqhelanise namava okubonisana, qinisekisa ukuba yonke imibuzo nabanikwe isikhulumi kunye nethimba labo ixoxwe ngokufanelekileyo, qinisekisa ukuba yonke iindaba ezilithoba ezinxulumene nokuqinisekiswa zisetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo apho kufuneka ngexesha lokubonisa, landela umntu okanye abanikwe isikhulumi nantoni na ongayazi okanye into engachazwanga kakuhle nangaphezulu kwindlela yokwenza umsebenzi, qinisekisa ukuba yonke imibuzo exoxiweyo idityanisiwe ngokupela kwingxelo, qamba iingxelo zophando zokuqinisekisa ezibonisa iziphumo nengcebiso eziliqokelelweyo ngexesha lokubonisa kwaye ulawule iifayile zophando zokuqinisekiswa, qinisekisa ukuba kukho ingcebiso ezakhiwo ngokugqibeleleyo nangaphezulu kokuqinisekiswa, dibanisa kwaye usebenzise onke amaphandla naxwebhu kwingxelo, ngenisa iindaba ezigqitywe ngokuphandwa kuMlawuli oqinisekisa imibuzo ngenjongo yokugqiba nokuqinisekisa, yenza ukuvavanya ngokwemini yonke imicimbi enxulumene nempilo yoluntu ukuba kuye kubekho ingcebiso njengoko kucelwe nguMlawuli oqinisekisa kwintsomi engaxokiwayo, lungelelanisa iingxelo zophando olungaqinisekwanga njengoko kubonakaliswe ngokungalunganga kwezinto ezifunyanwe ngaphambi kokusebenza kwabantu, qinisekisa ukuvavanywa kolwazi ngomntu njengoko kubonelelwa ngokusebenzisa onke amaphandla njengakuMIE, i-SARS njl.njl, qinisekisa ukugqitywa kolawulo ngokugqibeleleyo nangaphezulu kwezindaba ezingabangelwa ngokungalunganga iingxelo ezinikezelwe kubasebenzisi bakuqala ukuqhuba phambili, yenza isigqibo ngokusondezela iingqinisekiso ngokuphindaphindiweyo zophando ukuze uncedise ukuyila iinkqubo, hlola, phanda kwaye uqwalasele lonke ulwazi olunxulumene nophando, nika ingcebiso nokuqondisa ngokuqonda nokusebenzisa imithetho, iinkqubo namanyathelo, seka, khuthaza izimiso ezinxulumene nabanikwe iingxelo nabanikezela ngolwazi bengasemva ukuze ukwazi ukufikelela kulwazi.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Asset
jobs.centre: Gauteng Division of The High Court: Johannesburg
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 - R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Administration clerk for asset management at the Gauteng High Court in Johannesburg, requiring a Grade 12 certificate with no prior experience necessary.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade twelve 12 certificate. No experience required. Experience in Asset Management and a valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of relevant legislations, knowledge of PFMA, knowledge of Financial policies and procedures, knowledge of Treasury Regulations; BAS; PMDS; DFI and SCOA; Skilled in Computer literacy (MS office), analytical, communication, interpersonal relations, administration, time management, numeracy, customer services orientation and self-management. Along with the following attributes: Self-motivated, creative thinking, teamwork, ambitious and time bound.
jobs.duties: Provide support with the co-ordination of compliance of Asset Management, ensure accurate specifications and quantities, ensure that Annexure B3 is completed and filed, ensure that all new assets are tagged, registered on the Asset Register, recorded on the signed Inventory List behind the relevant room/location door, prepare and process payments on the JYP System. Ensure Asset Movement form is completed when an asset is being moved or being taken for repairs, quality assure physical assets against the inventory list and the JYP Asset Register, perform a physical asset verification process to ensure the existence and completeness of the lease register, ensure that assets are barcoded and marked with permanent marker, ensure that Leased Assets Register is up to date, request for the uploading of assets on the register must be supported by the relevant payment batches and correct documentation to ensure correct valuation of assets, ensure that unverified assets are investigated to ensure that they were not disposed or transferred, ensure that deadlines for submitting reports at the Provincial Service Centre are adhered to at all times, facilitate disposal of unserviceable, redundant, obsolete and lost assets, facilitate the disposal of assets through the relevant disposal committees, identify and report surplus, redundant, obsolete, unserviceable or under-performing assets to the national office, ensure that assets are disposed of on the JYP system in the same financial year they were physically disposed, ensure a list of assets disposed on the JYP system is forwarded to the Provincial Service Centre for confirmation against approved disposal memorandums, maintain a file for approval disposal certificates (D12), provide administrative support service, provide logistical arrangements to meetings, provide secretariat support services to the meetings, compile minutes and memos, handle incoming and outgoing office correspondence, ensure a proper filling system for all the records and provide support with stationery supplies within the sub-directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Ms R Bramdaw Tel No: (010) 494 8486 HR Related Enquiries: Ms T Mbalekwa Tel No: (010) 494 8515
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/127/OCJ@judiciaryorg.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. ERRATUM: Kindly take note that the post of Usher Messenger at the Western Cape Division of the High Court: Cape Town, Ref No: 2026/69/OCJ advertised on Public Service Vacancy Circular 25, dated 17 August has been withdrawn.
