af.title: Administrasieklerk: Bate
af.summary: Administrasieklerk vir batebestuur by die Gauteng Hooggeregshof in Johannesburg, waar 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat vereis word met geen voorafgaande ervaring wat nodig is nie.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad twaalf 12-sertifikaat beskik. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. Ervaring in Batebestuur en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kennis van relevante wetgewing, kennis van PFMA, kennis van Finansiële beleide en prosedures, kennis van Tesourie Regulasies; BAS; PMDS; DFI en SCOA; Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid (MS office), analities, kommunikasie, interpersoonlike betrekkinge, administrasie, tydbestuur, syferkundigheid, kliëntediens-oriëntasie en selfbestuur. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: Selfgemotiveerd, kreatiewe denke, spanwerk, ambisieus en tydgebonde.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning met die koördinering van nakoming van Batebestuur, verseker akkurate spesifikasies en hoeveelhede, verseker dat Anneksure B3 ingevul en gevlie word, verseker dat alle nuwe bate getar, op die Bateregister geregistreer, op die getekende Voorraadlys agter die betrokke kamer/lokasie se deur aangeteken word, voorberei en verwerk betalings op die JYP-stelsel. Verseker dat die Bataverplasingsvorm ingevul word wanneer 'n bate verskuif of vir herstel geneem word, kvaliteitverseker fisiese bate teen die voorraadlys en die JYP-bateregister, voer 'n fisiese bateverifikasi proses uit om die bestaan en volledigheid van die huurregister te verseker, verseker dat bate van strepieskodes en met 'n permanente merker gemerk word, verseker dat die Huurbateregister op datum is, versoeke vir die oplaai van bate op die register moet ondersteun word deur die betrokke betalingsgroepies en korrekte dokumentasie om korrekte waardasie van bate te verseker, verseker dat onverifieerde bate ondersoek word om te verseker dat dit nie beskik gestel of oorgeplaas is nie, verseker dat sperdatums vir die indiening van verslae by die Provinsiale Dienssentrum te alle tye nagekom word, fasiliteer die beskikking van onbruikbare, oortollige, verouderde en verlore bate, fasiliteer die beskikking van bate deur die betrokke beskikkingskomitees, identifiseer en rapporteer oortollige, verouderde, onbruikbare of onderpresterende bate aan die nasionale kantoor, verseker dat bate op die JYP-stelsel in dieselfde finansiële jaar beskik word as waartydens dit fisies beskik is, verseker dat 'n lys van bate wat op die JYP-stelsel beskik is na die Provinsiale Dienssentrum gestuur word vir bevestiging teen goedgekeurde beskikkingsmemorandums, handhaaf 'n lêer vir goedgekeurde beskikkingsertifikate (D12), verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdiens, verskaf reëlings vir vergaderings, verskaf sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan vergaderings, stel notule en memorandums op, hanteer inkomende en uitgaande kantoor-korrespondensie, verseker 'n behoorlike stelsel van lêer vir alle rekords en verskaf ondersteuning met stasievoorrade binne die subdirektoraat.

zu.title: Clerk Wezaba: Isephuli
zu.summary: Clerk wezabalowoMphathi Wohlelo ohlolenwe eGauteng High Court eJohannesburg, ofuna isitifiketi se-Grade 12 okungekho mkhulu wamava odingekayo.
zu.requirements: Abafakelwayo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade twelve 12. Abekho mava abadingekayo. Ukuqeqeshwa koMphathi Wohlelo kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kuzoba yinzuzo ethile. Amakhono nobukhono balwazi: Ukwazi ngemithetho ehlobene, ukwazi ngePFMA, ukwazi ngezinqubomgomo nezinqubo zezezimali, ukwazi ngeTreasury Regulations; BAS; PMDS; DFI kanye ne-SCOA; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS office), ukuhlaziya, ukuxhumana, ubudlelwano bantu, ukuphathwa kwezindaba, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukubala, ukumathisela kubathengi, kanye nokuziphatha. Kanye nalezi zici: Ukuzimotela, ukucabanga ngokuvusa umbono, ukusebenza isiqhingi, ukuba nezifiso kanye nokuhambisana nesikhathi.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso kokuhlelwa kokuhambisana nokulandela imithetho yoMphathi Wohlelo, qinisekisa izinhloso ezilinganisiwe kanye nezibalo ezifanele, qinisekisa ukuthi i-Annexure B3 igcwalisiwe kanye neyayinamathiselwe, qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amafa amasha athathwe iphosi, abhalwe kwi-Asset Register, abhalwe ohlwini olusayiniwe olungenemuva komnyango wekamelu/indawo, lukhiqize futhi uluhlele izinkokhelo kusistimu ye-JYP. Qinisekisa ukuthi i-Asset Movement form igcwaliswe uma ifa lihamba noma liyiswa ukulungiswa, hlola ngokomgangatho amafa bomzimba ngokohlu lokubhaliswa kanye ne-JYP Asset Register, yenza inqubo yokuhlolwa kwamafa bomzimba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba khona kanye nokuphela kwalease register, qinisekisa ukuthi amafa anamakhodi ekhodi kanye nomaka ongashabalali, qinisekisa ukuthi Leased Assets Register isikhathi esibusuka ibhalwe, ukucela ukufakwa kwamafa ohlwini kufanele kuxhaswe ngamaphakheji ezinkokhelo ahlobene kanye namadokhumenti afanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubeka inani amafa, qinisekisa ukuthi amafa angahloshiwa aphenywa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akuzange akhishwe noma adluliselwe, qinisekisa ukuthi masikhathi wokuhambisa imibiko eProvincial Service Centre alandelwa njalo, yenza inqubo yokukhishwa kwamafa angasebenzi, amaningi, adlule isikhathi nawalahlekelwe, yenza inqubo yokukhishwa kwamafa ngocwaningo lweminyuzane yokuqinisekisa ukukhishwa, tshunga futhi ulochunge izimpinda, amaqembu amakhulu namathambo, amafa angasebenzi noma adlule isikhathi ohlwini lwesikhungo samazwe ngamazwe, qinisekisa ukuthi amafa akhishwa esistimeni ye-JYP kunyaka wezimali ofanayo akhishwe ngokomzimba, qinisekisa ukuthi uhlu lwamafa akhishiwe esistimeni ye-JYP luthunyelwa eProvincial Service Centre ukuze kusinqatshelwe nememorandamu yokukhishwa okugunyaziwe, gcina ifayela lemifanekiso yokuqinisekiswa yokukhishwa (D12), nikezela inkxaso yokuphatha izindaba, hlela izinhlela zokuhanjiswa kwezidingo emihlanganweni, nikezela inkxaso yababhalisi emihlanganweni, qamba amaminithi namamemo, phatha ukufika nokuhamba koxhumano lohhofisi, qinisekisa isistimu efanele yokugcina yamafayela yonke imibhalo futhi nikeze inkxaso ngesabelo samapensela kule ndawo ebuswa ngaphansi komnyango.

xh.title: Umlawuli weNqaba: IzeAselte
xh.summary: Mmangalelo wokulawulwa kwabasebenzi be-asserti ngokulawula impahla eRhuluwe Linguqu ka-Gowkeng eRhodali ngomzini ka-12 12, oodinga isatifiketi seGraji 12 nangaphandle kokuba ndingadli ngaphambili.
xh.requirements: Abafundi kufuneka babe neNqaba seBhascule yama-12. Akukho mfundo edingekayo. Iimfuno ngokumalunga neNkqubo yezeAselte nelisensile lesiQithi malunga nokuhamba ziya kuba yinkxaso ebanzi. Amakhono namakhono apha: ukuqonda kwengqiqo ezahlukeneyo; ukuqonda kwengqiqo iNkqubo yezeMali kaRhuluwe; ukuqonda iingqina ngeenkqubo zemali; ukuqonda iNqamba zeNqaba zeZwelonke; iNkqubo yeBAS; iNkqubo yePMDS; iNkqubo yeDFI; iNkqubo yeSCOA; Uphawu lokusebenza ngeKhompyutha iNkqubo yeMisebenzi yeKhompwtha (MS Office), ukuhlola, ukuthetha, iziganeko zabantu, ukulawula, ukulawula isikhathi, ukubala, ukukhathalela iinkonzo zabathengi, nokuzilawula. Kananjalo kufuneka babe namagunya: ukuzikhusela, ukucinga ngokuhlola, ukusebenza ngokusemthethweni, ukufuna ukuphumelela, kunye nokuba nexesha eliqinisekisiweyo.
xh.duties: inika inkxaso ngokuququzelelwa kokuzalathisa kwelawulo lezeAsethe; qinisekisa ukuchanekileyo kweemfuno nobungakanani; qinisekisa ukuba iNqxmlu B3  igqityiwe kwaye igcinwe lifayile; qinisekisa ukuba onke amaqebombele asetyenziswa okuqala abhalwe ithegi, abhalwe kwisiXhobo sokubhala iiAselte, abhalwe kuluhlu lwempahla eqinisekisiweyo ngemiva kwezicwangciso ezahlukeneyo/indawo yangaphakathi; lungiselela kwaye uqhwalezele iintlawulo kwinkqubo yeJYP. Qinisekisa ukuba ifomu lokushukuma kweAselte igqityiwe xa iqebombele lisshukuma okanye lithunyelwa ukulungiswa; qinisekisa ngokulinganayo iiAselte ezibonwayo zithe ngqo nokulingana noluhlu lweempahla nesiXhobo sokubhala iiAselte seJYP; yenza inkqubo yokuqinisekisa iiAselte ngokubonwa ngesandla ukuze qinisekiswe ukuba zikhona nokuba zigqityiwe kwesINGINGCINI ukubhalwa kwesizukulwana esahlala ixesha elide; qinisekisa ukuba iiAselte zinamakhowudi anesundi kwaye zipawule ngesidwelwa esimileyo; qinisekisa ukuba esiXhobo sokubhala iiAselte ezingenwa ngaphandle sikhona ixesha lonke; iimpahla ezifuneka ukuba zifakwe kwisiXhobo sokubhala iiAselte zizakunikela iinqubo ezahlukeneyo zentlawulo negama elingundoqo ukuba zinikwe iinkcukacha ezifanelekileyo zokuqinisekisa ukubalwa ngokuchanekileyo kwexabiso lempahla; qinisekisa ukuba iiAselte ezingaqinisekiswanga ziphendulwa ngokuphononongwa ukuze qinisekiswe ukuba azikhuliswanga okanye azifuduliswanga; qinisekisa ukuba amaxesha okupela okuthunyelwa kwengxelo eSikhundla seSebe seNgangingo sesiProvincial Service Centre salandwa ngalo lonke ixesha; ququzelela ukubuyiswa kwempahla engasebenziyo, engadingekiyo, edlulelwe lilizwe nakwabeselele abalahle; ququzelela ukubuyiswa kwempahla ngekomiti yokubuyisa edibene nayo; qonda kwaye ungene ingxelo ngenkqubo yeempahla ezininzi, ezingadingekiyo, edlulelwe lilizwe, engasebenziyo okanye ezingasebenzi kakuhle kwikhomityana yezizwe; qinisekisa ukuba iiAselte zibuyiswa kwinkqubo yeJYP ngomnya womhla weemali apho zibuyiswa ngokubonwayo zithe ngqo; qinisekisa ukuba uluhlu lwempahla ebuyiswayo kwiNkqubo yeJYP luthunyelwe kwikhomityana seSebe seNgangingo sesiProvincial Service Centre ukuze qinisekiswe ngokuchanekileyo ngakumbi ngezigqibo ezamkelekileyo zokubuyiswa; zigcine ifayile yeemvume zokuqinisekisa ukubuyiswa kweziNqxmlu (D12); nika inkxaso yolawulo; yenza izicwangciso zokuhamba kwangaphambili kumanyano lwemiboniso; yenza inkxaso yomahlulelwane kumanqanaba okubonisa; qulunqa iinqaku kunye neendaba; phatha ubhalo-ntshukumo oluvela noluphuma kwindlu kaRhuluwe; qinisekisa inkqubo yokulungiselelwa koluhlu iigalelo kwaye unike inkxaso ngesixhobo sokubhala iingxelo kwizigaba ezisezantsi.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Management Clerk
jobs.centre: Mpumalanga Division of The High Court: Mbombela
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Supply Chain Management Clerk needed at the Mpumalanga High Court in Mbombela to handle invoices, asset management, procurement and purchase orders.

A three (3) year National Diploma in Supply Chain Management / Economics / Finance / Financial Management/ Procurement/ Logistics and Public Administration at NQF level 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA and a valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Basic knowledge of financial functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, collate financial statistics, insight of the Public Service financial, legislation, procedures and Treasury regulations (PFMA, PSA, DFI), basic financial operating systems (BAS), basic knowledge of work procedures in terms of work environment, legislative framework governing the public sector and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in communication (verbal and written), problem solving, computer literacy and report writing.
jobs.duties: Capture invoices and creation of creditor payment advises, render asset management clerical support, render demand and acquisition clerical support, process purchase orders and render and record all procurement transactions.
jobs.enquiries: Technical enquiries Ms. RS Ledwaba Tel No: (013) 758 0000 HR enquiries: Mr. SJ Zwane / Mr. MV Maeko Tel No: (013) 758 0000
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/128/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. af.title: Voorsieningskettingbestuursklerk
af.summary: Voorsieningskettingbestuursklerk benodig by die Mpumalanga Hooggeregshof in Mbombela om fakture, batebestuur, verkryging en aankooporders te hanteer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat beskik soos deur SAQA erken. Geen ervaring vereis nie. 'n Drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Ekonomie / Finansies / Finansiële Bestuur / Verkryging / Logistiek en Publieke Administrasie op NQF-vlak 6 met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Basiese kennis van finansiële funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, finansiële statistiek bymekaar te maak, insig van die Publieke Diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en Tesourie-regulasies (PFMA, PSA, DFI), basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (BAS), basiese kennis van werksprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing, die wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare sektor regeer en die Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), probleemoplossing, rekenaargeletterdheid en verslagskrywing.
af.duties: Vaslegging van fakture en skepping van skuldeiserbetalingsadvise, verskaf van klerklike ondersteuning vir batebestuur, verskaf van klerklike ondersteuning vir vraag en verkryging, verwerking van aankooporders en verskaf en rekord van alle verkrygingstransaksies.

zu.title: Umlobi we-Supply Chain Management
zu.summary: Kudingeka umgcinamafa we-Supply Chain Management inkantolo ephakeme i-Mpumalanga High Court e-Mbombela ukuphatha izikweletu, ukuphathwa kwempahla, ukuthenga nokuthenga izinto.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 esamukelwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mkhondo ofunekayo. I-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) e- Supply Chain Management / Economics / Finance / Financial Management/ Procurement/ Logistics and Public Administration ezingeni le-NQF level 6 ngamakhredithi angu-360 njengoba kubonakalwa yi-SAQA kanye nelayisense yokuqasha efanele kuzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Ulwazi nezindlela: Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemisebenzi yezimali, izinqubo kanye nenhlokweni ukuqoqa izibalo zezimali, ukuqonda ngemithetho yezimali yesevisi yomphakathi, izinqubo kanye nemithetho ye-National Treasury (PFMA, PSA, DFI), izinhlelo zokuqasha izimali eziyisiseko (BAS), ulwazi olusisiseko ngolwenziwemisebenzi ngokwesimo sokusebenza, ohlelweni lomthetho lolawula ingxenye yomphakathi kanye nemithelela ye-Batho Pele Principles. Ukugijima emthethweni ekuxhumeni (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ekuxazululweni izinkinga, ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha nakubhalweni kwezibika.
zu.duties: Bhala izikweletu kanye nokudala izaziso zokukhokhelwa abanikazi, nikeza inkxaso yabasebenzi behhovisi ekuphatweni kwempahla, nikeza inkxaso yabasebenzi behhovisi ekuqondiseni nokutholeni impahla, kucubunge izikhiye zokuqasha nokurekhoda zonke izenzakalo zokuthenga impahla.

xh.title: I-clerk yoLawulo lwe-Supply Chain
xh.summary: Kufunekwe i-clerk yoLawulo lwe-Supply Chain kwi-Mpumalanga High Court eMbombela ukuphatha i-invoice, ulawulo lweempahla, ukuze kuthengwe kunye namagunya okuthenga.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikhethe yesiGrede 12 njengokuchazwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mpazamo efunekayo. I-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) kwi-Supply Chain Management / Economics / Finance / Financial Management/ Procurement/ Logistics kunye ne-Public Administration kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 ngee-credits ezingama-360 njengokuchazwa yi-SAQA kunye nelayisensi evumelekileyo yokushumba izimoto ziya kuba yinxaxheba egezayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olusesikweni ngemisebenzi yemali, iinkqubo kunye nokuba nakho ukuqamba i-data, ukuqokelela izibalo zemali, ukuqonda imali yoLuntu LwaseRhulumente, umthetho, iinkqubo kunye neemigaqo zeTreasury (PFMA, PSA, DFI), iinkqubomoya ezisesikweni zemali (BAS), ulwazi olusesikweni lwenkqubo yomsebenzi malunga nokusingqongileyo komsebenzi, inkqubo yomthetho elawula ingingqi koluntu kunye neBatho Pele Principles. Ukuba nokhondo kwinkqubo (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo), ukuxazulula iingxaki, ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha nokubhala iiripothi.
xh.duties: Qamba ii-invoice nendalo yezaziso zentlawulo yobambeleli, nikeza inkxaso yabasebenzi ngabancedo kwilawulo lempahla, nikeza inkxaso ngabancedo kufuna nokuthenga, qhuba amagunya okuthenga unikeze uthathe zebe zibhalwe zonke iintengiselwano zokuthenga.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (DEPUTY Director-general Level)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services (70% of package), the State's contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of Package) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules)
jobs.summary: Chief Financial Officer at Deputy Director-General level providing strategic financial leadership at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF level 8 as recognised by the SAQA in Financial Management or related field of study. 8 years of experience at a senior managerial level in Finance Management. Registration as a chartered accountant will be an added advantage. Knowledge: Strategic Planning, Strategic Knowledge Management, Business analyses and risk management, Change management and organisational development, Extensive knowledge of department strategic objective, In-depth knowledge of government protocol processes, Development and implementation of strategies, Public Finance Management Act, Supply Chain Management, Financial and budget administration processes and systems, Public Service Regulations, Treasury Regulations and directives (MTEF, ENE and Adjustment Estimates), Government Budget Systems and procedures, Government Financial Systems (PERSAL, PMIS, WCS, LOGIS and BAS). Skills: Executive management skills, Sound analytical and problem identification and solving skills, Advanced report writing, Organising and planning, Computer utilisation, Policy formulation, Negotiation skills, Advanced communication (verbal and written), Advanced interpersonal and diplomacy skills, Time management, Decision making skills, Conflict management, Motivational skills, Programme and management skills. Personal Attributes: Innovative, Resourceful, Ability to work effectively and efficiently under sustained pressure, Ability to meet tight deadlines whilst delivering excellent results, People orientated, Assertive, Ability to work independently, Team player. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with professional requirements.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership in the development, implementation and maintenance of Finance policies, directives, guidelines and strategic plans: Undertake research on latest finance trends. Collate all relevant information and infuse them in Finance strategic policy. Source financial policies, guidelines and directives from the National Treasury. Advise and monitor the implementation of National Treasury policies and guidelines in the Department’s Strategic Plan. Evaluate and monitor compliance to Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Ensure that the department’s strategic objectives are aligned to regulations (particular on finance). Undertake the effective monitoring and evaluation of department’s financial policies. Oversee all financial operations, including accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting: Oversee the collation of components budgets. Ensure that the department’s expenditure is in accordance with budget vote. Ensure that effective and appropriate steps are put in place to prevent unauthorised, irregular and fruitless expenditure. Prepare and present reports to the Executing Authority on budget irregularities. Prepare Departments’ budget vote statements. Ensure that budget management complies at all times to the PFMA and MTEF. Ensure that financial reports/statements adhere to applicable financial standards. Manage the implementation of the department trading entity’s financial strategies: Develop guidelines and strategies to manage the effective implementation of budget devolution initiatives and strategies. Oversee and monitor the implementation of the developed guidelines and strategies. Support the Director-General and management in the execution of their functions in terms of PFMA and Treasury Regulations: Establish and maintain effective and efficient financial, risk and internal control systems. Ensure the effective, efficient, economical and transparent use of Department’s financial resources. Manage Department’s working capital efficiently and economically; monitor the preparation and keep full and proper records on Department’s financial affairs. Monitor the settling of all contractual obligations and collection of monies owing to the Department. Advise the Minister, Director General and Heads of Departments on financial management related policies. Monitor the implementation of policies on the management and writing off of damaged and lost assets; act as a link between the Department, National Treasury, Financial Institutions and relevant stakeholders. Represent the department in financial related matters. Manage the Branch: Plan, organise and control activities pertaining to the functions of the branch; Develop and manage the operational plan of the Branch and report on progress as required. Manage performance and development of employees. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Manage and monitor the budget and expenditures for the Branch.

jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a compulsory technical or competency-based exercise that intends to test the relevant technical elements of the job as part of the interview process. Following the technical exercise and the interview, the selection committee will identify up to a maximum of three (3) top scoring candidates to undergo psychometric assessments. It will be expected of the successful candidate to sign a Performance Agreement, be subjected to Top Secret Security Clearance and annually disclose his/her financial interests Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position.
