af.title: Hoof Finansiële Beampte (Vise-Direkteur-generaal Vlak)
af.summary: Hoof Finansiële Beampte op Vise-Direkteur-generaal vlak wat strategiese finansiële leierskap by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Hoofkantoor in Pretoria verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 8 soos deur die SAQA erken in Finansiële Bestuur of 'n verwante studieveld. 8 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak in Finansiële Bestuur. Registrasie as 'n gevolmagtige rekenmeester sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis: Strategiese beplanning, Strategiese kennisbestuur, Besigheidsanalise en risikobestuur, Veranderingsbestuur en organisatoriese ontwikkeling, Omvattende kennis van die departement se strategiese doelwitte, Diepgaande kennis van regeringsprotokolprosesse, Ontwikkeling en implementering van strategieë, Public Finance Management Act, Voorsieningskettingbestuur, Finansiële en begrotingsadministrasieprosesse en -stelsels, Public Service Regulations, Tesourie-regulasies en -direktiewe (MTEF, ENE en Aanpassingsramings), Regeringsbegrotingstelsels en -prosedures, Regeringsfinansiestelsels (PERSAL, PMIS, WCS, LOGIS en BAS). Vaardighede: Uitvoerende bestuursvaardighede, Deeglike analitiese en probleemidentifiserings- en oplossingsvaardighede, Gevorderde verslagskrywing, Organisering en beplanning, Rekenaargebruik, Beleidformulering, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Gevorderde kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), Gevorderde interpersoonlike en diplomatieke vaardighede, Tydbestuur, Besluitnemingsvaardighede, Konflikbestuur, Motiveringsvaardighede, Program- en bestuursvaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Innoverend, Hulpbrønryk, Vermoë om doeltreffend en doeltreffend onder volgehoue druk te werk, Vermoë om stywe sperdatums te haal terwyl uitstekende resultate gelewer word, Mense-georiënteerd, Selfversekerd, Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, Spanspeler. Gewillig om werkskedule ooreenkomstig professionele vereistes aan te pas.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die ontwikkeling, implementering en onderhoud van Finansies-beleide, direktiewe, riglyne en strategiese planne: Ondersoek die nuutste finansieë-neigings. Stel alle relevante inligting saam en voeg dit in Finansies se strategiese beleid in. Bekomm finansiële beleide, riglyne en direktiewe by die National Treasury. Adviseer en monitor die implementering van National Treasury-beleide en -riglyne in die departement se Strategiese Plan. Evalueer en monitor nakoming van die Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Verseker dat die departement se strategiese doelwitte op regulasies belyn is (veral rakende finansies). Onderneem die doeltreffende monitering en evaluering van die departement se finansiële beleide. Hou toesig oor alle finansiële bedrywighede, insluitend rekeningkunde, begroting, vooruitskatting en finansiële verslagdoening: Hou toesig oor die samestelling van komponentbegrotings. Verseker dat die departement se besteding ooreenkomstig die begrotingsstem is. Verseker dat doeltreffende en toepaslike stappe in plek gestel word om ongeoorloofde, onreëlmatige en vrugtelose besteding te voorkom. Berei verslae voor en bied dit aan die Uitvoerende Gesag voor rakende begrotingsonreëlmatighede. Berei die departemente se begrotingsstemverklarings voor. Verseker dat begrotingsbestuur te alle tye aan die PFMA en MTEF voldoen. Verseker dat finansiële verslae/verklarings aan toepaslike finansiële standaarde voldoen. Bestuur die implementering van die departement se handelsentiteit se finansiële strategieë: Ontwikkel riglyne en strategieë om die doeltreffende implementering van begrotingsdevolusie-inisiatiewe en -strategieë te bestuur. Hou toesig oor en monitor die implementering van die ontwikkelde riglyne en strategieë. Ondersteun die Direkteur-generaal en bestuur in die uitvoering van hul funksies ingevolge die PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies: Vestig en onderhou doeltreffende en doeltreffende finansiële, risiko- en interne beheerstelsels. Verseker die doeltreffende, doeltreffende, ekonomiese en deursigtige gebruik van die departement se finansiële bronne. Bestuur die departement se werkskapitaal doeltreffend en ekonomies; monitor die voorbereiding en hou volledige en behoorlike rekords van die departement se finansiële aangeleenthede. Monitor die vereffening van alle kontraktuele verpligtinge en die invordering van gelde wat aan die departement verskuldig is. Adviseer die Minister, Direkteur-generaal en Hoofde van Departemente rakende finansiële bestuursverwante beleide. Monitor die implementering van beleide oor die bestuur en afskrywing van beskadigde en verlore bates; tree op as 'n skakel tussen die departement, National Treasury, Finansiële Instellings en relevante belanghebbendes. Verteenwoordig die departement in finansiële verwante aangeleenthede. Bestuur die Tak: Beplan, organiseer en beheer aktiwiteite met betrekking tot die funksies van die tak; Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Tak en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis. Bestuur werknemers se prestasie en ontwikkeling. Vestig, implementeer en onderhou doeltreffende en doeltreffende kommunikasie-reëlings. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer is. Bestuur en monitor die begroting en besteding vir die Tak.

zu.title: I-Chief Financial Officer (Izinga le-DEPUTY Director-general)
zu.summary: I-Chief Financial Officer ezingeni le-Deputy Director-General enikeza ubuholi bezemali obubalulekile eDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezilinganisela njenge-NQF level 8 njengoba kuzwiwa i-SAQA kwi-Financial Management noma enkundleni efana naleyo. 8 iminyaka yemfundo ezingeni eliphezulu labaphathi kwi-Finance Management. Ukubhalisa njenge-chartered accountant kuzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Ulwazi: Strategic Planning, Strategic Knowledge Management, Business analyses and risk management, Change management and organisational development, Ulwazi olubanzi ngezinhloso eziyisiquqamba zomnyango, Ulwazi olujulile ngezinqubo zomthethosisekelo kahulumeni, Ukuthuthukisa nokuphatha amasu, Public Finance Management Act, Supply Chain Management, Izinqubo nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezimali nabhalali, Public Service Regulations, Treasury Regulations and directives (MTEF, ENE and Adjustment Estimates), Government Budget Systems and procedures, Government Financial Systems (PERSAL, PMIS, WCS, LOGIS and BAS). Amakhono: Amakhono okuphatha abaphathi abaphezulu, Amakhono okuhlola ngokujulile nokubona izinkinga nokuzezisa, Ukubhala amabhali athuthukisiwe, Ukuhlela nokuhlela, Ukusebenzisa ikhakhompyutha, Ukwenza izinqubomgomo, Amakhono okuxoxisana, Unxibelelwano oluthuthukisiwe (olunxibelelwano ngomlomo nolubhaliwe), Amakhono aphakeme okusebenza nabantu nokuqhuba izindaba ngobuhlakani, Ukuphatha isikhathi, Amakhono okwenza izinqumo, Ukuphatha izingxabano, Amakhono okukhuthaza, Amakhono okuphatha amaphrogramu nokuqonda. Izici zabantu: Unobumba, Ongakwazi ukuthola izinsizakusebenza, Ikono lokusebenza ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle ngaphansi kokucindezela okuhlala njalo, Ikono lokuqedza emigqeni yesikhathi ebanzi ngenkathi kuhlinzekwa iziphumelo ezingcono kakhulu, Okuqondiswa kwabantu, Oqinile, Ikono lokusebenza eyedwa, Odlala njengelungu leqembu. Ukuzithobe ukulungisa isikhathi sokusebenza ngokwesidingo sezindlela zomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngobuholi obubalulekile ekuthuthukisweni, ekusetshenzisweni nasekugcinweni kwezinqubomgomo zemali, imiyalo, iziqondiso namasu abalulekile: Yenza ucwaningo ngetrend ephakeme yezimali. Qoqa yonke imininingwane ethintekayo futhi uyifake kwinqubomgomo yesikhombakude yezimali. Thola izinqubomgomo zemali, iziqondiso nemiyalo kwi-National Treasury. Luleka futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo nesisqondiso se-National Treasury kwiStrategic Plan yomnyango. Hlola futhi ulawule ukuziphatha ngokwezinyathelo ze-Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhloso eziyisiquqamba zomnyango zihambisana nemithetho (ikakhulu ezimalini). Yenza ukulawula nokuhlola ngokusebenza kahle kwezinqubomgomo zezimali zomnyango. Lawula yonke imisebenzi yezimali, okuhlanganisa ukubhalwa kwama-akhawunti, ukwenza amabhajeti, ukubikezela, nokubika ngemali: Lawula ukuqoqwa kwezabi zamakomponi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuchithwa kwemali komnyango kuhambisana nevouthu yamabhajeti. Qinisekisa ukuthi kubekwe izinyathelo ezisebenza kahle nangafanele ukuthintela ukuchithwa kwemali okungagunyaziwe, okungalawulekiwe nokungalusizo. Lungisa futhi wethule amabhiki ku-Executing Authority ngezingavamile zebhajeti. Lunga izinkomba zevouthu yamabhajeti zomnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwamabhajeti kuhambisana njalo nge-PFMA ne-MTEF. Qinisekisa ukuthi amabhiki ezimali/izinkomba alandela izinga lemali elisebenzayo. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakusebenza zemali zomnyango: Thuthukisa iziqondiso namasu okuphatha ukusetshenziswa ngokusebenza kahle kwenqubomgomo yokulandwa kwebhajeti nokuqondiswa kwenqubomgomo. Lawula futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo ezenziwe nezinqubomgomo. Sekela u-Director-General nabaphathi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo ngokwe-PFMA ne-Treasury Regulations: Sika futhi ugcine izinhlelo zezimali, engengozi nangolawulo kwangaphakathi ezisebenza kahle. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenza kahle, okusebenza ngemali encane, okuvuna inzuzo nangokwedlulele kwemali yomnyango. Phatha inkathi yokusebenza yemali yomnyango ngokusebenza kahle nangokugcina imali; lawula ukulungiswa futhi ugcose izibhalo ezingeni ephelele nangafanele ngemali yomnyango. Lawula ukuqedwa kwezibopho zamakhonthulakhi kanye nokuqoqwa kwemali ethweswe umnyango. Luleka uNgqongqoshe, uDirector-General noHeads of Departments ngezinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwemali. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo ngokuphathwa nokususwa kwempahla eonakaliwe nalahlekelwe; ube isixhumanisi phakathi komnyango, i-National Treasury, izikhungo zezimali kanye nabathintekayo ababalulekile. Umela umnyango kwezindaba ezihlobene nemali. Lawula i-Branch: Hlela, lungisisa futhi ulawule imisebenzi ehlobene nemisebenzi ye-branch; Thuthukisa futhi ulawule iplenolusebenzo ye-Branch futhi ubike ngokuqhubeka njengoba kudingeka. Lawula ukusebenza kahle nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Sika, yenza futhi ugcine izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenza kahle nangesikhathi. Qamba futhi unikele yonke imibiko ye-administrative edingekwayo. Lawula ngemigomo emibili imisebenzi ethunyelwe ngabasebenzi. Lawula futhi ulawule ibhajeti nokuchithwa kwemali kwi-Branch.

xh.title: I-DEPUTY Director-general (Chief Financial Officer)
xh.summary: I-Chief Financial Officer kwinqanaba le-Deputy Director-General enike ulwazi ngendawo yezimali ngasemhlotyeni i-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office e-Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwamaqabantshi e-NQF level 8 esamkelwe i-SAQA kw Financial Management okanye kwindawo efana nalo. 8 iminyaka yokulinganiselwa kwinqanaba eliphezulu lalawulo kwi Finance Management. Ukubhaliswa njengomntu ofaka i-chartered accountant kuya kuba ngaphezulu kwesidenge esongezelelweyo. Ulwazi: Strategic Planning, Strategic Knowledge Management, Business analyses and risk management, Change management and organisational development, Ulwazi olwandisiweyo ngeendulumiso ezingundoqo zesebe, Ulwazi olubanzi ngenkqubo yaqondo kaRhulumeni, Ukuthuthwa nokuqaliswa kwezitratheji, Public Finance Management Act, Supply Chain Management, Iinkqubo zolawulo lwebhajeti nezimali nokuqwalasela kweziseko, Public Service Regulations, Treasury Regulations and directives (MTEF, ENE and Adjustment Estimates), Government Budget Systems and procedures, Government Financial Systems (PERSAL, PMIS, WCS, LOGIS and BAS). Amakhono: Amakhono obulawulo bekhosi, Amakhono obugcisa nobunzima bokuchonga nokusombulula iingxaki, Ukubhala iingxelo ezingundoqo, Ukuhlela nokuqwalasela, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukubumba iinkqubo ezibambe, Amakhono ombeko, Unxibelelwano lwangengondoqo (ngoluvo nangokubhala), Amakhono obuntu bobugcisa nobungathandi banto, Ukulawula isikhathi, Ukwenza iigqibo, Ukulawula iingxabano, Amakhono okukhuthaza, Ikhono le-programme nolawulo. Iimpawu zomntu: Ukuba nobugcisa bokwenza izinto, Ukuba namathuba, Ukuba ngamandla ukusebenza kakuhle nangenkqubo ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo, Ukuba ngamandla okufeza i-deadlines ezinqamlezileyo unike iziphumo ezilungele, Ukuba nengqondo kwelakhiwa labantu, Ukuzimisela, Ukuba ngamandla ukusebenza ngokulodwa, Umdlali wetrim. Ukuzenzela ukuvumelana nexesha ngokwezidingo
xh.duties: Zela ulwazi olubhekisa phambili ekuthuthuzeni, ukuqaliswa nasekugcineni kwezinqamla zezimali, imiyalelo, iinkqobo zokuqonda iindulumiso noplaani ezingundoqo: Yenza uphononongo lwamathrendi amasha ezimali. Qokelela yonwaba lwazi oluhambelana nendawo nilise kwinqamla yezimali egqamileyo isimo sengqondo. Thatha iinqamla ezimali, iinkqobo zokuqonda iindulumiso nemiyalelo kwiziko leNational Treasury. Lenga uze ulawule ukuyilo kweenqamla zeNational Treasury kwiplaani egqamileyo yesebe. Linganisa ukuze ulawule ulwaneliseko kwiMedium Term Expenditure Framework. Qinisekisa ukuba iindulumiso zesebe ezingundoqo zihambelana neenduluxho (ngokukodwa ngendawo yezimali). Thatha isithuba sokulawula nokuqwalasela ngokuchanekileyo iinqamla zesebe ngendawo yezimali. Lawula ngaphezulu yonke imisebenzi yezimali, kuquka ukubhala izimali, ukwenza ibhajeti, ukuchunguza ngelixa kusalela, nokuvela ngesimo sengxelo ngemali: Lawula ngaphezulu ukuqokelelwa kweebhajeti zamacandelo. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuchithwa kusebe kulandela ibhajeti evunyelweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kuthathwa amanyathelo afanelekileyo nasechanekileyo ukuthintela ukuchithwa ngaphandle kwesaziso nokungenasiphelo. Hlela unike iingxelo kulawulo kuqaliswa ngaphakathi. Hlela izikhulu ze Departments' bhajeti evunyelweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba ulawulo kwesimo sebhajeti luhambelana nge-PFMA nge-MTEF ngelo xesha lonke. Qinisekisa ukuba iingxelo/izikhulu zemali zilandelana nemigangatho efanelekileyo yezimali. Lawula ukuyilo kwezitratheji zezimali kwikamva lesebe lentshukumo khululekileyo: Thaula iinkqobo zokuqonda izitratheji ukulawula ukuyilo okusebenzayo kolwabiwo lwentshukumo yebhajeti nezitratheji. Lawula uze ulinganise ukuyilo kwezi nkqobo nezitratheji ezithawiweyo. Nceda i-Director-General nolawulo ekuphumezeni imisebenzi yawo ngokwe-PFMA nakuqwalaselo kwe-Treasury Regulations: Misela uze ulamle inkqubo yezimali, ingozi nolawulo lwangaphakathi. Qinisekisa uluhlu olufanelekileyo, olulungele ukusebenza olumfutho iindleko ezityhila ngokusebenziswa kwemali yesebe. Lawula oluvalo lwemali yolawulo olusebenza oluqinisekileyo olungatyhaliswa iyure. Ulawula ukulungiselela izikhulu ezizezazo nokuqamba iirekhodi. Ulawula ukuqhela kolwazi I Department, National Treasury, Financial Institutions kwabezinye izigqizo. Mela ibizo ngemisebenzi yezimali. Lawula i-Branch: Rhaqa ulwazi nokulawula imisebenzi ngokweqondo ngokuya ngemisebenzi eqondene nasekhondwini; Hlela unike i-operaal pltan yekhondo nika ingxelo ngonqanqamatho njengoko kufuneka. Lawula ukusebenza ngokulinganiselwa koluntu. Misela uze usebenze ngokuchanekileyo. Hlela ungenise wonke amaxwebhu ohlelo alindelekileyo. Hlela ingxelo yomsebenzi onikwa ngabasebenzi. Lawula uze ulinganise ibhajeti nokuchithwa kwekhondo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Real Estate Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services (70% of package), the State's contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of Package) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director-general for Real Estate Management at Public Works and Infrastructure, requiring an NQF 8 qualification and 8 years senior management experience in property.
jobs.requirements: A minimum NQF 08 qualification as recognised by SAQA, in or directly relevant to immovable asset management, real estate management, property or lease management or the built environment, 8 years of experience at a senior managerial level in real estate management, property investment, or related property functions. An NQF 09 qualification or higher and more than 08 years direct senior management experience as specified will be an added advantage. Leadership & Delivery: a proven and demonstrated track record of orchestrating multidisciplinary professional teams within complex infrastructure delivery and immovable asset management environments; possesses a deep- seated mastery of the entire asset lifecycle, from strategic inception and acquisition to maintenance, optimisation, and disposal, with a proven ability to translate high-level departmental mandates into tangible business outcomes and long-term strategic objectives. Other added advantage: relevant professional registration in built sector or property related field, and private sector property management or immovable asset management experience. Licensing: possession of a valid, unencumbered driver's licence. Vetting & Compliance: the successful candidate will be required to undergo and maintain a formal security clearance. Professional Agility: the ability and willingness to adjust work hours and schedules to meet critical professional requirements and urgent organisational imperatives. Knowledge: professional understanding of real estate and property management, including acquisition, disposal, leasing, contract management, maintenance, servitudes and property investment; legislative frameworks including PFMA, Treasury Regulations, OHS Act, Public Service Act and Regulations, MISS, and relevant built-environment norms and standards; government structures and intergovernmental linkages across national, provincial and local spheres; applied commercial law principles relevant to property transactions; corporate governance, risk management and financial oversight; human resource management, labour relations and organisational change management; service delivery innovation, transformation frameworks and empowerment policies (B-BBEE, SMME, women and disability inclusion). SKILLS: strategic capability and leadership at executive level; programme and project management of large property portfolios; people management, empowerment and talent development; financial management and resource optimisation; advanced problem-solving, business transformation and change management; high-level communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills; policy development, analysis and implementation; contract management, quality assurance and operational coordination. Personal Attributes: innovative, forward-thinking and solutions- driven; high resilience, able to manage complexity under pressure; strong professional judgement and integrity; confident, influential and able to establish high-trust relationships; highly motivated, decisive and able to work independently where required; excellent leadership presence with the ability to inspire and direct large teams.
jobs.duties: Strategic Leadership of Real Estate Management Services: translate the departmental vision into a coherent branch strategy, structure and operational plan; provide executive leadership to ensure the branch delivers on its mandate for real estate, portfolio, asset lifecycle and property investment management; lead the development and implementation of strategies, policies and systems that ensure effective, efficient and compliant management of immovable assets. Real Estate Portfolio Management and Asset Performance: oversee the full property lifecycle, including acquisition, disposal, leasing, estates, servitudes and maintenance of immovable assets; ensure optimal utilisation, economic efficiency and sustainability of the national property portfolio; direct the development and maintenance of the Immovable Asset Register and property information systems; lead the creation of a master plan for managing both freehold and leasehold government property portfolios. Oversight of Leasing, Contracts and Property Transactions: ensure timely and compliant management of lease contracts, including renewals, terminations, rent reviews and cost optimisation; oversee acquisition and disposal processes, ensuring legal compliance, transparency and alignment with national priorities; provide executive governance over creditor management, debtor recovery and contract performance within the portfolio. Governance, Compliance and Organisational Performance: ensure adherence to PFMA requirements, Treasury Instructions, governance frameworks and built-environment standards; establish and maintain internal controls, risk management systems and monitoring mechanisms to ensure integrity of operations; evaluate branch performance against strategic objectives and implement corrective measures to drive continuous improvement; champion organisational transformation, change initiatives and service delivery improvement programmes. Branch Leadership, People Management and Resource Stewardship: provide visionary leadership to the Branch, ensuring a motivated, skilled, high- performing workforce; manage the performance, development, labour relations and wellbeing of staff in accordance with HR frameworks and SMS requirements; manage the branch budget, ensuring financial prudence, accountability and alignment with strategic priorities; oversee administrative reporting, communication systems, audit responses and quality assurance processes. Research, Policy Development and Industry Intelligence: lead research into property market trends, built-environment innovations and emerging risks; identify policy gaps and drive the development or review of legislation, policy frameworks and norms and standards; ensure that branch practices remain future-focused, efficient, integrated and responsive to the needs of government.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Sifiso Mdakane at 082 929 9885
jobs.applications: Email applications for this position must be email to: Recruitment26- 73@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a compulsory technical or competency-based exercise that intends to test the relevant technical elements of the job as part of the interview process. Following the technical exercise and the interview, the selection committee will identify up to a maximum of three (3) top scoring candidates to undergo psychometric assessments. It will be expected of the successful candidate to sign a Performance Agreement, be subjected to Top Secret Security Clearance and annually disclose his/her financial interests Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur-generaal: Vastgoedbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-generaal vir Vastgoedbestuur by Public Works and Infrastructure, wat 'n NQF 8-kwalifikasie en 8 jaar se bestuurservaring op senior vlak in eiendom vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum NQF 08-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, in of direk relevant tot onroerende-batebestuur, vastgoedbestuur, eiendom- of huurbestuur of die geboude omgewing, 8 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak in vastgoedbestuur, eiendomsbelegging, of verwante eiendomsfunksies. 'n NQF 09-kwalifikasie of hoër en meer as 08 jaar direkte senior bestuurservaring soos gespesifiseer, sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Leierskap & Lewering: 'n bewese en aangetoonde rekord van die orkesstrasie van multidissiplinêre professionele spanne binne komplekse infrastruktuurlewering- en onroerende-batebestuuromgewings; besit 'n diepgewortelde bemeestering van die hele bate-lewensiklus, van strategiese ontstaan en verkryging tot onderhoud, optimalisering en beskikking, met 'n bewese vermoë om hoëvlak-departementale mandate in tasbare besigheidsuitkomste en langtermyn strategiese doelwitte te vertaal. Ander bykomende voordeel: tersaaklike professionele registrasie in die gebousektor of eiendomverwante veld, en privaatsektor-eiendomsbestuur of onroerende-batebestuurservaring. Lisensiesering: besit van 'n geldige, onbelemmerde bestuurderslisensie. Veiligheidsklarering en Nakoming: die suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om 'n formele veiligheidsklarering te ondergaan en te handhaaf. Professionele Beweeglikheid: die vermoë en bereidwilligheid om werksure en skedules aan te pas om kritieke professionele vereistes en dringende organisatoriese imperatiewe te noop. Kennis: professionele begrip van vastgoed- en eiendomsbestuur, insluitend verkryging, beskikking, huur, kontrakbestuur, onderhoud, servitute en eiendomsbelegging; wetgewende raamwerke insluitend PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, OHS Act, Public Service Act en Regulasies, MISS, en tersaaklike geboude-omgewingsnorme en -standaarde; regeringsstrukture en interregeringskakelings oor nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike sfere; toegepaste kommersiële regbeginsels relevant tot eiendomstransaksies; korporatiewe goewerance, risikobestuur en finansiële toesig; menslikehulpbronbestuur, arbeidsverhoudinge en organisatoriese veranderingsbestuur; diensleweringsinnovasie, transformasieraamwerke en bemagtigingsbeleid (B-BBEE, SMME, vroue- en gestremdheidsinsluiting). VAARDIGHEDE: strategiese vermoë en leierskap op uitvoerende vlak; program- en projektebestuur van groot eiendomsportefeuljes; mensebestuur, bemagtiging en talentontwikkeling; finansiële bestuur en hulpbronoptimalisering; gevorderde probleemoplossing, besigheidstransformasie en veranderingsbestuur; hoëvlak-kommunikasie, onderhandeling en belanghebbende-bestuursvaardighede; beleidsontwikkeling, analise en implementering; kontrakbestuur, gehalteversekering en operasionele koördinasie. Persoonlike Eienskappe: innoverend, vooruitskouend en oplossingsgedrewe; hoë veerkragtigheid, in staat om kompleksiteit onder druk te bestuur; sterk professionele oordeel en integriteit; selfversekerd, invloedryk en in staat om hoë-vertrouensverhoudings te vestig; hoogs gemotiveerd, beslis en in staat om waar nodig onafhanklik te werk; uitstekende leierskapspresensie met die vermoë om groot spanne te inspireer en te lei.
af.duties: Strategiese Leierskap van Vastgoedbestuursdienste: vertaal die departementele visie in 'n samehangende takstrategie, struktuur en operasionele plan; voorsien uitvoerende leierskap om te verseker dat die tak sy mandaat vir vastgoed-, portefeulje-, bate-lewensiklus- en eiendomsbeleggingsbestuur lewer; lei die ontwikkeling en implementering van strategieë, beleide en stelsels wat doeltreffende, doeltreffende en korrekte bestuur van onroerende bates verseker. Vastgoedportefeuljebestuur en Bateprestasie: hou toesig oor die volle eiendom-lewensiklus, insluitend verkryging, beskikking, huur, boerderye, servitute en onderhoud van onroerende bates; verseker optimale benutting, ekonomiese doeltreffendheid en volhoubaarheid van die nasionale eiendomsportefeulje; bestuur die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van die Onroerende Bateregister en eiendomsinligtingstelsels; lei die skepping van 'n meesterplan vir die bestuur van beide vrye-eiendom- en huur-eiendomsregeringsportefeuljes. Toesig oor Huur, Kontrakte en Eiendomstransaksies: verseker tydige en korrekte bestuur van huurkontrakte, insluitend hernuwings, beëindigings, huurherbesienings en koste-optimalisering; hou toesig oor verkrygings- en beskikkingsprosesse en verseker regs nakoming, deursigtigheid en belyning met nasionale prioriteite; voorsien uitvoerende goewerance oor skuldeiserbestuur, debiteurtherwinning en kontrakprestasie binne die portefeulje. Goewerance, Nakoming en Organisatoriese Prestasie: verseker nakoming van PFMA-vereistes, Tesourie-instruksies, goewerance-raamwerke en geboude-omgewingsstandaarde; vestig en handhaaf interne kontroles, risikobestuurstelsels en moniteringsmeganismes om die integriteit van bedrywighede te verseker; evalueer takprestasie teen strategiese doelwitte en implementeer regstellende maatreëls om deurlopende verbetering te dryf; bevorder organisatoriese transformasie, veranderingsinisiatiewe en diensleweringverbeteringsprogramme. Takleierskap, Mensebestuur en Hulpbronbestuur: voorsien visioenêre leierskap aan die Tak en verseker 'n gemotiveerde, vaardige, hoëpresterende arbeidsmag; bestuur die prestasie, ontwikkeling, arbeidsverhoudinge en welstand van personeel ooreenkomstig HR-raamwerke en SMS-vereistes; bestuur die takbegroting en verseker finansiële omsigtigheid, verantwoording en belyning met strategiese prioriteite; hou toesig oor administratiewe verslagdoening, kommunikasiestelsels, ouditantwoorde en gehalteversekeringsprosesse. Navorsing, Beleidsontwikkeling en Bedryfsintelligensie: lei navorsing oor eiendomsmarkneigings, geboude-omgewingsinnovasies en ontluikende risiko's; identifiseer beleidsgapings en dryf die ontwikkeling of hersiening van wetgewing, beleidsraamwerke en norme en standaarde; verseker dat takpraktyke toekomsgefokus, doeltreffend, geïntegreerd en reaksief op die behoeftes van die regering bly.

zu.title: Usomlilo-Jikelele: Ukuphathwa Kwezindlu Ezingahambeki
zu.summary: Usomlilo-Jikelele wezokuPhathwa Kwezindlu Ezingahambeki ePublic Works and Infrastructure, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF 8 namava eminyaka yama-8 ekuqondweni kwabaphathi abaphezulu endaweni yezindlu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezincane ezingu-NQF 08 njengoba ziyasatshelwa yi-SAQA, ezindaweni noma ezihlobene eduze nokuphathwa kwempahla engahambeki, ukuphathwa kwezindlu ezingahambeki, izindlu noma ukuphathwa kwamakontraka wokuhambisa, noma endaweni ezakhiwe, namava eminyaka yama-8 ezingeni lokuphathwa kwaphezulu ekuphathweni kwezindlu ezingahambeki, ukutshalwa kwemali ezindlini, noma emisebenzini ehlobene nezindlu. Iziqu ze-NQF 09 noma ezaphezulu kanye namava aphezulu kweminyaka yama-8 ekuqondeni kwabaphathi abaphezulu njengoba kuchaziwe kuzoba ngconcoshe ezele. Ukuhola Nokuhlinzeka: irekhodi elivezwe nokuqinisekiswa lokuqamba amaqembu abasebenzi abanamakhono ahlukene endaweni ezindiza ezinzima zokuhlinzeka ngokwakhiwa nokuphathwa kwezimpahla ezingahambeki; linolwazi olujulile ngomjikelezo wempahla wonke, kusukela ekuqaleni nasekutholeni okuhlelekile kuye ekugcineni, ekusebenziseni okuhle, nasekushiyeni, nenkozo eqinisekisiwe yekhono lokuguqula imigomo yomnyango ephakeme ibe yimizamo yebhizinisi ebonakalayo nemithekhi ehlelekile esikhundleni eside. Eminye ingconcoshe ezele: ukuqashelwa ngobungcweti endaweni yesakhiwo noma endaweni ehlobene nezindlu, namava ekuphathweni kwezindlu ezingahambeki emkhakheni wangasese. Ilayisensi: ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, engazibambe. Ukuhlolwa Nokuhambelana Nomthetho: umphakamedi opumelelo uzodinga ukuhola agweme ukuvunywa ngokusemthethweni kokuphepha. Ukukhetha Ngobuchwepheshe: ikhono nomtshingo wokulungisa amahora nokuhlela umsebenzi ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo zobuchwepheshe ezibalulekile nezimiso zomphakathi eziphuthumayo. Ulwazi: ukuqonda ngobuchwepheshe izindlu ezingahambeki nokuphathwa kwendawo, okuhlanganisa ukuthola, ukushiywa, ukuhambisa ngokunqunywa, ukuphathwa kwamakontraka, ukulondolozwa, izinsimbo, kanye nokutshalwa kwemali ezindlini; izakhiwo zomthetho ezihlanganisa i-PFMA, Imitsetho yeTreasury, uMthetho we-OHS, uMthetho Nomthethonqubo Womphakathi, i-MISS, kanye nemiqatho kanye namazinga endaweni ezakhiwe; izakhiwo zikahulumeni kanye nezinhloni phakathi kahulumeni kazwelonke, wesifundazwe, nedolobha; imigomo yomthetho wokuhweba esebenzayo ehlobene nokuhweba ezindlini; ukuphathwa koshuhao, ukuphathwa kweengozi nezimpilo zezimali; ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo, ubudlelwano bemisebenzi, kanye nokuphathwa koshintsho lwemphakathi; intuthuko yezinsizakalo, izakhiwo zoshintsho, namapholisi amandla (i-B-BBEE, i-SMME, okuhlanganisa abesifazane kanye nabakhubazekile). AMAKHONO: ikhono lehlelekile nokuhola ezingeni labaphathi; ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi amaphothofoliyo ezindlu amakhulu; ukuphathwa kwabantu, amandla, nentuthuko yamakhono; ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokusebenzisa imithombo ngokuhlakanipha; ukuxazulula izinkinga ezingeni eliphezulu, ushintsho lwebhizinisi nokuphathwa koshintsho; amakhono okuxhumana, okuxoxa, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlonzi ezingeni eliphezulu; intuthuko yamapholisi, ukuhlola, nokusebenzisa; ukuphathwa kwamakontraka, ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi, nokuhlelanisa imisebenzi. Izici Zomuntu: onesipho esisha, esibuka phambili nesixazulula izinkinga; ukumelana okuphezulu, okwazi ukuphatha izindiza ezinzima ngaphansi koxinzelelo; isikhali esihle sokuhlulela ngobuchwepheshe nokuzithiba; ethembeke, enamandla futhi ekwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obususelwa kusethembe lokuzisebenzela; ehambisela kakhulu, ongabeki eceleni, kwaye ekwazi ukuzisebenzela eyedwa lapho kudingeka; khona nokuhola ngokuzenzakalela okuhle, okukhuthaza, okuhola amaqembu amakhulu.
zu.duties: Ukuhola Okuhlelekile Kwesevisi Yokuphathwa Kwezindlu Ezingahambeki: guqula ibono lomnyango ube yindlela yokuhlelekile ehleliwe yokusebenza, aze ahole abapathi abaphezulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inkomishane ihlinzeka ngesiqu sayo sesibopho sezindlu ezingahambeki, amaphothofoliyo, umjikelezo wempahla, kanye nokuphathwa kokutshalwa kwemali ezindlini; ahole ekwakheni nokusebenziseni izindlela, amapholisi, kanye nezimiso ezinikela ukuphathwa okusebenzayo, okunomsoco, okuhambelana nomthetho kwezimpahla ezingahambeki. Ukuphathwa Kwamaphothofoliyo Wezindlu Ezingahambeki Nokusebenza Kwempahla: qapha umjikelezo wonke wezindlu, okuhlanganisa ukuthola, ukushiywa, ukuhambisa ngokunqunywa, amabizo, izinsimbo, kanye nolondolozo kwezimpahla ezingahambeki; qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle, ukusebenza ngokwezomnotho, nokuzinza kwamaphothofoliyo ezindlu kazwelonke; qondisa ukwakhiwa nolondolozo kweRekhodi Yempahla Eningahambeki kanye nezimiso zolwazi ngezindlu; yehla ukwakha isu eliyisikhombi sokuphathwa kokubili amaphothofoliyo ezindlu kahulumeni ezibambe ngokwayo nokuqashiswa. Ukuqapha Ukuqashiswa, Amakontraka, Nokuhweba Izindlu: qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusheshayo nokuhambelana nomthetho kwamakontraka wokuqashiswa, okuhlanganisa ukuvuselelwa, ukupheliswa, ukuhlola inyanga yentela, kanye nokuqeda izindleko; qapha izinqubo zokuthola nokushiywa, ukuqinisekisa ukulandela umthetho, ukubonakala, kanye nokuqondana nemithekhi kazwelonke; nikeza ngokuqondisa okuphezulu ekuphathweni kwabanikwe imali, ekuweni abatshaliwe, kanye nokusebenza kwamakontraka ngaphakathi kwamaphothofoliyo. Ukuphathwa, Ukuhambelana Nomthetho, Nokusebenza Komphakathi: qinisekisa ukulandela izidingo ze-PFMA, imiyalo yeTreasury, izakhiwo zokuphathwa, kanye namazinga ezakhiwa ezindaweni ezakhiwe; misa kaze ulondoloze izilawuli ezingaphakathi, izimiso zokuphathwa kwezinsongo, kanye nendlela yokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza kwezinsiza; hlolisisa ukusebenza kwenkomishane ngokomithetho yokuhlelela uze usebenzise izinyatholo zokulungisa ukuze kushushulwa ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo; shukumisa ushintsho lomphakathi, izinhloso zoshintsho, kanye namaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa izinsizakalo. Ukuhola Inkomishane, Ukuphathwa Kwabantu, Nokubuka Imithombo: nikeza ngokuholwa okubonwayo Inkomishaneni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe isisebenzi esihle, esinamakhono, esisebenza kahle; phatha ukusebenza, intuthuko, ubudlelwano bensiza, kanye nesimo somzimba sabasebenzi ngokuhambisana nezakhiwo ze-HR nezigaba ze-SMS; phatha ibhajethi yenkomishane, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuziphendula ngemali, ukubeka inani, nokuhambisana nemigomo ephakeme; qapha ukubika ngokwemibhalo, izimiso zokuxhumana, izimpendulo zokuqapha, kanye nezenzo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Ucwaningo, Ukuthuthukiswa Kwamapholisi, Nolwazi Lendawo: yehla ucwaningo ngemigqamiso yemakethi wezindlu, izinto ezingavamile ezindaweni ezakhiwe, kanye nezingozi eziphuma; khomba izikhala kumapholisi uze uphendule ngokuthuthukisa noma ukuhlola umthetho, izakhiwo zamapholisi, imigqo, naleza amazinga; qinisekisa ukuthi izenzo zenkomishane zihlala zibuka ikusasa, zisebenza kahle, ezinhlanganisweni, kwaye ziphendula izidingo kahulumeni.

xh.title: Undi-Njenge eyeMvela: Ulawulo Lwez Mpahla Zeakhiwo
xh.summary: Undi-Njenge eyoLawuleni iMpahla Zeakhiwo kwi Public Works and Infrastructure, efunayo isifundo seNQF 8 kunye neminyaka yamava emi-8 kulawulo lwabanzi kwindawo yempahla.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kweNQF 08 njengokuqatyiweyo yiSAQA, kwindawo ethile okanye esondeleyo nolawulo lweempahla ezingahambekiyo, ulawulo lwezindlu, impahla okanye ulawulo lwe lease okanye indawo yeakhiwo, iminyaka eyi-8 yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lokulawula kulawulo lwezindlu, utyalo-mali kwimpahla, okanye imisebenzi ehambelana nempahla. Isifundo seNQF 09 okanye esiphezulu nokugqithisa iminyaka eyi-08 yamava abaphatha abaphezulu njengokuqatyiweyo kuya kuba lusuzu olongezelelweyo. Urhwebo & ukuZiswa: irekhodi eqinisekisiweyo nobubonakalisiweyo bokuhlanganisa amaqela abantu abanobuchwepheshe abahlukahlukayo kwindawo ezinobungakanani ezinzima zokuza kwakhiwo kunye nolawulo lweempahla ezingahambekiyo; unolwazi olujulile lokuyazi ibhayiseklo yonke yempahla, ukusuka ekuqaleni okulungelelanisiweyo nakuthengweni ukuya kolunjini, ukuphucula, nakuxhaphaze, nobungqina bokuguqula imiyalelo yesebe eliphezulu kumzipho ophangayo ovele waye njengoko kulindelekile nesiphelo. Ezinye iingenelo: ukuqatyiwa kwabachwepheshe kwicala leakhiwo okanye indawo ehambelana nempahla, namava kolawulo lwe mpahla kwingxoxo yabantu okanye ulawulo lwe mpahla ezingahambekiyo. Ilayisense: ukuba nelayisense yokuqhuba eseyilungileyo. Ulungiso lokuziphatha: umntu ophumeleleyo kuya kufuneka aze alungiselele agcine isikhundla sokhuseleko. Ukuqina ngobuchwepheshe: isakhono nokulunga ukulungelelanisa amawaka asebenza namaxesha ukuyalela iimfuno ezibalulekileyo zobuchwepheshe kunye neenkqubo ezibalekileyo zoluntu. Ulwazi: ukuqonda ngobuchwepheshe ukulawula kwempahla nezindlu, kuquka ukuthengwa, ukuxhaphaza, ukuqeshwa, ulawulo lweenkonzo, ukulungisa, iindlela ezisezantsi zomhlaba kunye netyalo-mali kwimpahla; iinkqubo zomthetho kuquka iPFMA, i Treasury Regulations, i OHS Act, i Public Service Act ne Regulations, iMISS, kunye nemigaqo eyiyo nemiqathango yendawo yeakhiwo; iinkqubo zorhwebo loluntu nokudibanisa koluntu phakathi koluntu lulwimi kwi regional, i provincial nakwi local; iinkqubo zomthetho woshishino ezisebenzayo kwintengiselwano yempahla; ulawulo lwebhodi, ulawulo ingozi kunye nokuqwalasela iimali; ulawulo lwabantu, uqhagamshelo lwezabasebenzi nakuguqulwa kwe nkqubo; ukutsha kokuhanjiswa kwenkonzo, iinkqubo zotshintsho namaqabaniso (B-BBEE, SMME, kuqatyiwa kwabafazi abakhubazekileyo). ISIKHONO: isakhono sokulawula nokuqhatha kwinqanaba eliphezulu; ulawulo lwenkqubo kunye neenkqubo zolawulo lothotho lweempahla ezinkulu; ulawulo lwabantu, ukuhlakulela nophuhliso lwamathalenta; ulawulo lweimali nokusebenzisa izibaso; ukuxazulula iingxaki ezibalulekileyo, ukuguqula ibhodi nakutsha kwenkqubo; isikhono sokuthetha nokuhambelana nabantu abathile-nthetha nokuqhagamshelana; uphuhliso lomgaqo, ukuhlalutya nokusebenzisa; ulawulo lweenkonzo, uqinisekiso lomgangatho kunye nolawulo oluhlangenwe. Iimpawu zobuntu: kutsha, kucinga phambili kwaye sifumene izisombulu; ukumelana ngobuqu, bakwazi ukulawula ubungakanani phantsi komcimbi oxinileyo; isigqibo esinamandla sobuchwepheshe nokuzinza; uqinisekile, unamandla kwaye usakhona ukwakha uqhagamshelwano lokwathembana; unothuli, othatha isigqibo kwaye asakhona ukusebenza ngokodwa apho kufuneka khona; isakhono sokulawula abantu abaninzi kwaye sikhona ukuba khona kakhulu.
xh.duties: Ulawulo olulinganiselweyo Lweenkonzo zoLawulo Lwe Mpahla: ukuguqula isiphithiphithi sesabe sibe lusangqa nolungelelanisiweyo noluqhelisayo; ukunika ulawulo oluphezulu ukuqinisekisa ukuba isebe liza nalokhu alibekelwe kona ngelawulo lempahla, i portfolio, ibhayiseklo yempahla kunye nolawulo lotyalo-mali kwimpahla; ukulatha uphuhliso nokusebenzisa iindlela, iinkqubo neendlela ezinika isiqinisekiso sokulawula ngokusebenzayo nangokulinganiselweyo iimpahla ezingahambekiyo. Ulawulo Lweeportfolio zeMpahla nokuPhumeza i Mpahla: ukuyala ibhayiseklo yonke yempahla, kuquka ukuthengwa, ukuxhaphaza, ukuqeshwa, ulawulo, iindlela ezisezantsi nomothamo wee mpahla ezingahambekiyo; ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okulungelelanisiweyo, ukusebenza ngokwezoqoqosho nokugcina i portfolio yempahla yelizwe; ukulatha uphuhliso nokulungisa i Immovable Asset Register neenkqubo zolwazi nge mpahla; ukulatha ukudalwa komgaqo-nkqubo osebenzayo ojikeleze ulawulo lukarhulumbe we mpahla eqashwe nawayethengwa ngokuzodwa. Ulawulo lweLease, ii-Contracts nokuThengiselana nge Mpahla: ukuqinisekisa ukulawulwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangokulungelelanise ngekontrakti ye lease, kuquka ukubuyisela, ukuvala, ukuqwalasela irenti nokunciphisa iindleko; ukulawula iinkqubo zokuthenga nokuxhaphaza, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho, ukucaca nokuqwalasela nezinto eziphambili zelizwe; ukunika ulawulo oluphezulu kolawulo lweentlengence, ukubuyisa ngemali abanikazi bentsengo nokuphumeza iikontrakti kwingxoxo yempahla. Ulawulo, ukuLunga nokusebenza ngokulinganiselweyo koluntu: ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iimfuno zePFMA, i Treasury Instructions, iinkqubo zolawulo nemigaqo yendawo yeakhiwo; ukuseka kwaye ulondoloze ulawulo lwangaphakathi, iinkqubo zolawulo lweengozi nezinto ezikwazwa ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza kweenkqubo; ukuqwalasela ukusebenza kwisebe ngokuchasene neengcali ezibalulekileyo nokusebenzisa iindlela zolungo lokuyisa ekuphuculweni okuza kuqhubeka; ukukhokela utshintsho lwento, iinkqubo zoshintsho nokuphucula iinkonzo eziziwa. Ulawulo oluphezulu lwesebe, ulawulo lwabantu nokuPhatha i Zibaso: ukunika ulawulo olubonakalisa iNgcamango kwisebe, ukuqinisekisa ukuba nomdla, odlulileyo, abasebenzi abasebenzayo abakwaziyo; ukulawula ukusebenza, uphuhliso, uqhagamshelo lwabasebenzi nentsilo yabasebenzi ngokuchasene neenkqubo ze HR nokuqinisekisa iinkqubo ze SMS; ukulawula i bhajethi yesebe, ukuqinisekisa ulawulo oluzolileyo lwe mal, ukwenza iimali ngobulumko nokulingana nezinto ezibalulekileyo ezisebenzayo; ukulawula ukubika ngokwendlela ezisezantsi, iinkqubo zoqhagamshelwano, iimpendulo ze audit neenkqubo zokuqinisekisa umgangatho. Ulwazi lweNdalo, uphuhliso lomGaqo nokuQwalasela isiQhagamshelwano: ukukhokela uphando ngeendaba zentengiselwano yempahla, izinto ezintsha zendawo yeakhiwo nengozi evelayo; ukuqwalasela iindawo ezingazibuthe kumgaqo nokukhuthaza uphuhliso okanye ukuhlaziywa komthetho, iinkqubo zemigaqo nemigaqo yemigaqo; ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zesebe zikumgama oqwalaselwe ixesha elizayo, ezisebenzayo, ezidityanisiweyo kwaye zipendule iimfuno zorhwebo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Policy Research & Regulation
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services (70% of package), the State's contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of Package) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules)
jobs.summary: Lead policy research and regulation at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure, developing legislation and strategies as Deputy Director-general based in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum NQF level 08 qualification as recognised by SAQA in or directly related to the Built Environment, Property Management, Law, Policy Research and Development or Development Studies as recognised by SAQA; 8 years of experience at a senior managerial level in the relevant field; extensive experience in research and policy development. Knowledge: Functioning of national, provincial and local government; fundamental economics; financial management; EPWP goals and objectives; employment creation strategies; appropriate labour-intensive technologies and skills development strategies. Skills: Strategic management; executive management skills; tender processes; effective communication (verbal and written); marketing and liaison; programme and project management; relationship management; influencing skills; negotiation. Personal Attributes: Solution orientated; ability to design ideas without direction; ability to work under stressful situations; ability to communicate at all levels, including with political office bearers.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership in the development and implementation of legislation, strategies, and policies for the Branch: commission researches on latest trends, ensure the development and implementation of effective and efficient acts, strategies and policies, ensure that all branch policies are in line with the department's strategic objectives, determine and develop strategic intervention mechanisms where there are problems/challenges to implement efficient, effective and uniform procedures and policies, and ensure that the budget framework is in line with the Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Develop and implement regulatory framework aimed at addressing the transformation, growth and development of the construction industry: provide strategic leadership in the development of building regulations, norms and standards, research, develop, monitor and review construction sector policies, establish best practice partnerships with various stakeholders in the construction industry (local and international), facilitate policy integration with DPW Public Entities, oversee the development of policies within the Department, and regulate the property industry to promote transformation, growth and development. Promote uniformity and best practice in immovable asset management in the public sector: research, develop, monitor and review policies and regulations, establish best practice partnerships with various stakeholders in the property industry (local and international), provide support to Immovable Asset Management, and oversee the development of policies within the Department. Develop and manage the implementation of international relation framework: manage, integrate and coordinate international relations, identify and articulate issues of strategic significance to the department, and develop international relations framework. Manage the Policy Research and Regulation Branch: establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations, develop and manage the operational plan of the Branch and report on progress as required, manage performance and development of employees, establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements, compile and submit all required administrative reports, quality control of work delivered by employees, and manage and monitor the budget and expenditures for the Branch.
jobs.enquiries: Mr S Mdakane at 082 929 9885.
jobs.applications: People with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Email applications for this position must be email to: Recruitment26-74@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a compulsory technical or competency-based exercise that intends to test the relevant technical elements of the job as part of the interview process. Following the technical exercise and the interview, the selection committee will identify up to a maximum of three (3) top scoring candidates to undergo psychometric assessments. It will be expected of the successful candidate to sign a Performance Agreement, be subjected to Top Secret Security Clearance and annually disclose his/her financial interests OTHER POSTS Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkt-direkteur-generaal: Beleidsnavorsing en Regulering
af.summary: Verskaf leierskap in beleidsnavorsing en regulering by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure, en ontwikkel wetgewing en strategieë as Adjunkt-direkteur-generaal gebaseer in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Minimale NQF level 08-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken in of direk verwant aan die Built Environment, Property Management, Law, Policy Research and Development of Development Studies soos deur SAQA erken; 8 jaar ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak in die relevante veld; uitgebreide ervaring in navorsing en beleidsontwikkeling. Kennis: Funksionering van nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regering; fundamentele ekonomie; finansiële bestuur; EPWP-doelwitte en - doelstellings; indiensskeppingskeppingsstrategieë; toepaslike arbeidsintensiewe tegnologieë en vaardigheidsontwikkelingstrategieë. Vaardighede: Strategiese bestuur; uitvoerende bestuursvaardighede; tenderprosesse; effektiewe kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik); bemarking en skakeling; programme- en projekbestuur; verhoudingsbestuur; beïnvloedingsvaardighede; onderhandeling. Persoonlike eienskappe: Oplossingsgerig; vermoë om idees sonder rigting te ontwerp; vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk; vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer, insluitend met politieke ampsdraers.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die ontwikkeling en implementering van wetgewing, strategieë en beleid vir die Tak: gee opdrag tot navorsing oor die nuutste tendense, verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van doeltreffende en effektiewe wette, strategieë en beleid, verseker dat alle takbeleid in lyn is met die departement se strategiese doelwitte, bepaal en ontwikkel strategiese ingrypingmeganismes waar daar probleme/uitdagings is om doeltreffende, effektiewe en eenvormige prosedures en beleid te implementeer, en verseker dat die begrotingsraamwerk in lyn is met die Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n reguleringsraamwerk wat gemik is daarop om die transformasie, groei en ontwikkeling van die konstruksiebedryf aan te spreek: verskaf strategiese leierskap in die ontwikkeling van bouregulasies, norme en standaarde, doen navorsing, ontwikkel, monitor en hersien konstruksiesektorbeleid, vestig beste-praktykvennootskappe met verskeie belanghebbendes in die konstruksiebedryf (plaaslik en internasionaal), fasiliteer beleidsintegrasie met DPW Public Entities, hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling van beleid binne die Department, en reguleer die eiendomsbedryf om transformasie, groei en ontwikkeling te bevorder. Bevorder eenvormigheid en beste praktyk in onroerende batebestuur in die openbare sektor: doen navorsing, ontwikkel, monitor en hersien beleid en regulasies, vestig beste-praktykvennootskappe met verskeie belanghebbendes in die eiendomsbedryf (plaaslik en internasionaal), verskaf ondersteuning aan Immovable Asset Management, en hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling van beleid binne die Department. Ontwikkel en bestuur die implementering van 'n internasionale betrekkingeraamwerk: bestuur, integreer en koördineer internasionale betrekkinge, identifiseer en formuleer sake van strategiese belang vir die departement, en ontwikkel 'n internasionale betrekkingeraamwerk. Bestuur die Policy Research and Regulation Branch: vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne kontroles en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te bereik, ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Tak en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis, bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling van werknemers, vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasiereëlings, stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in, hou kwaliteitskontrol toe op werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word, en bestuur en monitor die begroting en uitgawes vir die Tak.

zu.title: Umphathi-jikelele ongumhola othe xaxa: Ucwaningo lwezinqubomgomo noMthetho
zu.summary: Hola ucwaningo lwezinqubomgomo nokuqondisa eMnyangweni wePublic Works and Infrastructure, ukuthuthukisa umthetho kanye naMehlolwe njengoba Njengoba Mphathi-jikelele ongumhola othe xaxa obekwe ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezincane i-NQF level 08 njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA kule noma ezihambelana ngokuqondile nokwakhiwa kwesimo, ukuphathwa kwezimpahla, umthetho, ucwaningo lwezinqubomgomo nokuqwashisa noma izifundo zokuqwashisa njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA; 8 iminyaka yamava ezingeni lomphathi ophakeme enkabeni efanayo; amava athuthukile ocwaningweni nasekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi: Ukusebenza kahulumathi kazwelonke, wesifundazwe nedora; izomnotho eziyisiseko; ukuphathwa kwezimali; amaphuzu kanye nemiqondo ye-EPWP; izuva zokwakha amathuba omsebenzi; ubuchwepheshe obuhle bokwakha izisebenzi nokuqwashisa; izisu zokuqwashisa ngokomthetho. Izikhashana: Ukuphatha obuholi obuzayo; izikhashana zobuholi obuphezulu; izinqubo zemiklamo; ukuxhumana okupumelelo (ngomlomo nangobhalwe); ukuthengisa kanye noxhumaniso; ukuphathwa kohlelo namaprojekthi; ukuphathwa kobudlelwane; izikhashana zokwenga; ingxoxo. Izimpawu zobuntu: Ukujwayele izisombulu; ikhono lokwakha imibono ngaphandle kokuqondiswa; ikhono lokusebenza ezimeni ezinengcinezelo; ikhono lokuxhumana emazingeni wonke, okuhlanganisa nababanjwa isikhundla sokupolitiki.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso sobuholi obuzayo ekwakheni nasokuqashelweni kwezomthetho, izuva, kanye nezinqubomgomo zeHlangothi; yenza ucwaningo lwethrendi zakamuva, qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwemithetho, izuva nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo nangempumelelo, qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinqubomgomo zehlangothi zihambisana namaphuzu abuholi obuzayo omnyango, qamba futhiuthuthukise izindlela zokungenelela obuholi obuzayo lapho kunezinkinga/izithiyo ukuze kusetshenziswe izinqubo nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo, ngempumelelo ezibuye zibe zifanayo, futhi qinisekise ukuthi ohlelo lwebhajethi luhambisana ne-Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Yakha futhi usebenzise ohlelo lokuqondisa olujwayele ukulawula ukuguqula, ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa kwembono yezokwakha: nikeza isiqondiso sobuholi obuzayo ekuthuthukisweni komthetho wokwakha, amagugu izinga lokumisa, ucwaningo, thuthukisa, hlola futhi ubuke izinqubomgomo zesigaba sezokwakha, sake ubudlelwane obuhle bokusebenza nabahlali behlukahlukene embonweni yezokwakha (endaweni nasenhlabathi), kukhanyise ukuhlanganiswa kwezinqubomgomo nezikhungo zobuzwe ze-DPW, lawula ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo ngaphakathi kuMnyango, futhi ulawule imbono yezimpahla ukuze ukhuthaze ukuguqula, ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Khuthaza ukufana nokuzipha okuhle ekuphathweni kwezimpahla ezingahambeki kumkhakha kahulumathi: cwaninga, thuthukisa, hlola futhi ubuke izinqubomgomo nomthetho, sake ubudlelwane obuhle bokusebenza nabahlali abahlukene embonweni yezimpahla (endaweni nasenhlabathi), nikeza inkxaso ekuphathweni kwezimpahla ezingahambeki, futhi ulawule ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo ngaphakathi kuMnyango. Yakha futhi ulawule ukusebenziswa kohlaka lwezomphakathi bamazwe ngamazwe: lawula, hlanganisa futhi uqhasisise izibalo namazwe ngamazwe, hhaya futhi iveze izinto ezibalulekile ngobuholi obuzayo emnyangweni, futhi yakhe uhlaka lwezomphakathi namazwe ngamazwe. Lawula iHlangothi loCwaningo lwezinqubomgomo nokuQondisa: misa futhi ulondoloze izilawulo ezingaphakathi ezifanele kanye nezinhlelo zokubika ukuze uhlangabezane nemithelela yokusebenza, thuthukisa futhi ulawule ohlelo lokusebenza lweHlangothi futhi ubike ngokuqhubeka njengoba kudingekile, lawula ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, misa, usebenzise futhi ulondoloze izinqubo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo nangempumelelo, hlunga futhi unikele wonke amabhikhi wokuphatha abadingekayo, lawula ikhwalithi yomsebenzi ohlinzekwe abasebenzi, futhi ulawule futhi uhlale ibhajethi nezinkokhelo zeHlangothi.

xh.title: Isekela eliNinzi leNgangam: Uphononongo lweNkqubo yesebe kunye noLawulo
xh.summary: Qhagamshela uphononongo lwenkqubo yesebe kunye nolawulo kwiSebe lezoMsebenzi kaWonke nokuPhakamilisa, ukwakha umthetho kunye neengcinga njengoSekela eliNinzi eliNgangam ogqitha kulo Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezikhona kumanqanaba aNQF level 08 njengokuqatwa yi-SAQA kummandla ongaphakathi okanye obuqhakambilelio kuko kwimeko yoMilo oZakhriweyo, uLawulo lweMpahla, umThetho, uPhononongo lweNkqubo nokuPhuhlisa, okanye uPhuhliso lweZifundo njengokuqatwa yi-SAQA; 8 iminyaka yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo kwinkqubo ekhoyo; amava amaninzi kuphononongo nokuqwasiswa inkqubo. Ulwazi: Ukusebenza karhulumente welizwe, kwiphondo nakumasipala; imali-mali ebalulekileyo; ulawulo lwezemali; iinjongo nezidingo ze-EPWP; iindlela zokudala iindawo zomsebenzi; iindlela ezifanelekileyo zotshintshiselo-lwazi nokuqhakamshela kakhulu; ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphrojekthi; ulawulo lolwahlulelwaniso; amakhono okuchukumisa; ukudibana-nasemthethweni. IimPawu zobuNhlobo: Ukwondelela kwindlela zokuzisombulula; isakhono sokuyila iingcinga ngaphandle kokulungiselelwa; isakhono sokusebenza kwiimeko ezinzima; isakhono sokunxibelela nakumanqanaba onke, kuquka nabantu abathwe iimbumba zepolitiki.
xh.duties: Yibonelele ngokuba ngumkhokeli oqhuba phambili ekuphuhliseni nokuqwalaselwa komthetho, iindlela, iinkqubo nemiqathango le-Branch: yenza uphononongo ngeendaba ezintsha, qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa nokusebenza komthetho olusebenzayo, iindlela, iinkqubo namagqabantshi elisebe liphakathi kwemigqabamba yoluntu, qinisekisa ukuba zikho iindlela ezibekwa ngokomgama wokungenelela apho kusini nalapho kunokubakho iingxaki ezingenakuphumezelwa iinkqubo ezilungileyo, ze ziphumelele kwaye zibe nentlalo iindlela nezinyathelo ezimiselweyo, yaye uqinisekise ukuba inkqubo yemali ihambelana noMthetho wokuSebenzisele iMali kwaphakathi kweNxenyana. Yila uze usebenzise inkqubo yolawulo eyenzelwa ukusombulula ukutshintsha, ukukhula nokuphuhlisa kwishishini lokuVaka: yibonelele ngokuba ngumkhokeli ekuphuhlisweni kolawulo lokuVaka, imigangatho yendalo, uphononongo, uphuhliso, ukulawula nokuhlola iinkqubo kwishishini lokuVaka, seka uqhagamshelwano oluqhuba ngendlela elungileyo nabasebenzisana nabo kulo ngokwemimandla (engaphakathi nayaphesheya), khokela ekuphuhlisweni kweenkqubo kunye neenkcukacha ze-DPW Public Entities, lawula ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo ngaphakathi kwiSebe, yaye ulawule ukulawula iinkampani zempahla ukukhuthaza ukutshintsha, ukukhula nokuphuhlisa. Khuthaza ulinganiselo nokuzonceda ngendlela echanekileyo ekulawulweni kwempahla engatshukiyo kwinkqubo karhulumente: uphononongo, uphuhliso, ulawulo nokuhlola iinkqubo nemithetho yesebe, seka uqhagamshelwano oluqhuba ngendlela elungileyo nabasebenzisana nabo kulawulo lwempahla (engaphakathi nayaphesheya), yibonelele ngenkxaso ekulawulweni kwempahla engatshukiyo, kwaye ulawule ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Yila uze ulawule ukusebenza kwenkqubo yolwaze ngamazwe ngamazwe: lawula, uhlanganise uthotho lweenkqubo zolwaze ngamazwe ngamazwe, chonga kwaye ulungise iingxaki ezibalulekileyo kwinkqubo yesebe, uphuhlise inkqubo yasekunye lwe-Community yaseqongeni lobuchwepheshe bokudibana-nasemthethweni ngamazwe ngamazwe. Lawula i-Branch yePhononongo lweNkqubo noLawulo: zise inkqubo yolawulo lwangaphakathi ekufanelekileyo kwaye ulonde iindlela zokubika ukwaziswa kwakho ukwazi ukulinganisa iimfuno zokusebenza, phuhlisa ulawule iNdlela yoBomi beNkqubo ye-Branch yaye uchaze inkqubo njengoko kufuneka, lawula ukusebenza nokuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi, seka, usebenzise ulondoloze iindlela ezilungeleleneyo neziphilileyo zokwazisa, qamba uze ungenise zonke iingxelo ezibalulekileyo zolawulo, ulawule isimo somsebenzi ozenziweyo ngabasebenzi, yaye ulawule ulondoloze imali neentswalo ze-Branch.

jobs.title: Chief Construction Project Manager (GARDE A)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 108. per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the OSD)
jobs.summary: Chief Construction Project Manager to oversee large-scale capital and maintenance projects, mentor project managers, and ensure performance at the Cape Town Regional Office.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of relevant engineering degree or equivalent. Six (06) years post qualification experience and registration with the relevant council SACPCMP as a Professional Construction Project Manager. Compulsory registration with the SACPCMP as a Professional Construction Project Manager. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge of programme and project management, project design and analysis, legal and operational compliance, as well as the creation of high- performance culture. Communication, problem solving, analytical, decision making and conflict management skills also are critical.
jobs.duties: Monitor the performance of project managers under his/her supervision. Mentor, develop and offer technical support to improve performance. Manage construction projects on his/her own, ranging from large scale capital projects to maintenance projects and service contracts. Ensure that the needs of the clients are well interpreted into manageable scopes of work. Procure the services of built environment professionals through stipulated supply chain management process. Coordinate the work of various professionals to ensure the required design and documentation quality as well as delivery is in accordance with the project execution plans. Coordinate all internal resources required to ensure the bidding process for appointment of contractors. Ensure that appointed consultants manage the quality of work within their professional scope and responsibility. Ensure that contractors timeously receive relevant specifications and details to contracts. Adjudicate all applications of variation orders and extensions of time and make recommendations to the approving authority within the Department. Process all monthly interim payments as per conditions of contract and in line with the Government’s commitment to pay invoices timeously. Prepare and submit project information to be filled to the Head of Directorate. Secure all required funding for the projects through internal set processes. Ensure that project information is filled appropriately for easy access during audit. Cultivate a culture for good working relationships with fellow colleagues within the Department.

af.title: Hoofkonstruksieprojekbestuurder (GRAAD A)
af.summary: Hoofkonstruksieprojekbestuurder om grootskaalse kapitale en instandhoudingsprojekte te bestuur, projekbestuurders te mentoreer, en te verseker dat prestasie by die Cape Town Regional Office gehandhaaf word.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n tersaaklike ingenieursgraad of gelykwaardig. Ses (06) jaar na-kwalifikasie-ervaring en registrasie by die tersaaklike raad SACPCMP as 'n Professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurder. Verpligte registrasie by die SACPCMP as 'n Professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurder. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van program- en projekbestuur, projektegniese ontwerp en ontleding, wetlike en operasionele nakoming, asook die skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Kommunikasie-, probleemoplossing-, analitiese, besluitnemings- en konflikbestuursvaardighede is ook krities.
af.duties: Monitor die prestasie van projekbestuurders onder sy/haar toesig. Mentoreer, ontwikkel en bied tegniese ondersteuning om prestasie te verbeter. Bestuur konstruksieprojekte op eie houtje, wisselende van grootskaalse kapitale projekte tot instandhoudingsprojekte en dienskontrakte. Verseker dat die behoeftes van die kliënte goed geïnterpreteer word in bestuurbare werksomvang. Beskik oor die dienste van bouomgewingprofessionele deur gestipuleerde voorsieningskettingbestuursproses. Koördineer die werk van verskeie professionele om die vereiste ontwerp- en dokumentasiekwaliteit asook lewering te verseker in ooreenstemming met die projekuitvoeringsplanne. Koördineer alle interne hulpbronne wat vereis word om die biedproses vir die aanstelling van kontrakteurs te verseker. Verseker dat aangestelde konsultante die kwaliteit van werk binne hul professionele werksomvang en verantwoordelikheid bestuur. Verseker dat kontrakteurs betyds die tersaaklike spesifikasies en besonderhede tot kontrakte ontvang. Beoordeel alle aansoeke om wysigingsorders en tydverlengings en doen aanbevelings aan die goedkeuringsgesag binne die Departement. Verwerk alle maandelikse tussentydse betalings volgens kontrakvoorwaardes en in ooreenstemming met die Regering se toewyding om fakture betyds te betaal. Berei voor en dien projekinligting in om by die Hoof van Direktoraat ingevul te word. Verseker alle vereiste befondsing vir die projekte deur interne vasgestelde prosesse. Verseker dat projekinligting toepaslik ingevul word vir maklike toegang tydens oudit. Kweek 'n kultuur van goeie werksverhoudinge met medekollegas binne die Departement.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wezinhlela Zokwakha (GARDE A)
zu.summary: Umphathi Omkhulu Wezinhlela Zokwakha ongibuke izinhlela ezinkulu zethimba nemisebenzi yokulungisa, anikele nesiqondiso kubaphathi bezinhlela, futhi aqinise imisebenzi ohlakeni lasingasingeni iCape Town Regional Office.
zu.requirements: Idegree yokunjulalwezokwakha ehambisana noma okulingana nayo. Amashumi ayisithupha (06) eminyaka yeminyuzo yokuhlehlisa wokuthola isikhundla kanye nokubhalisa kwikhonsili ehambisanayo iSACPCMP njengomphathi ochwepheshe bezinhlela zokwakha. Ukubhalisa ngeSACPCMP njengomphathi ochwepheshe bezinhlela zokwakha kuyisidingo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi mayelana nolawulwezinhlela kanye nolawulwezinhlela okwakhiwe, ukwenza kanye nokuqapha izinhlela, ukuhambisana nemithetho kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokusebenza, kanye nokwakha isiko lokusebenza ngempumelelo ebalulekile. Amandla okuxhumana, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokuphatha izingxabano nayo ayibaluleke kakhulu.
zu.duties: Qapha imisebenzi yabaphathi bezinhlela abangaphansi kokulawula kwakhe. Nikeza isiqondiso, phucusa futhi unikeze inkxaso yezobuchwepheshe ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Lawula izinhlela zokwakha ngokwakho, kusukela kuzinhlela ezinkulu zethimba kuya kwezinhlela zokulungisa kanye namakhontrathi asebenzayo. Qiniseka ukuthi izidingo zabathengi zihumuselwe ngokucacile ezigabeni ezingalawuleki zomsebenzi. Thole izinsiza zochwepheshe bendawo esakhiwe ngokwenza inqubo ehambisana nokuqashwa kwezinsiza ezinkethwe. Hlanganisa imisebenzi yochwepheshe abahlukene ukuze kuqiniseke izinga elidingekile lolwazi lokwakha kanye nokuhumusha nokuthi ukulethwa kwenziwe ngokuhambisana namapulani okuqhuba izinhlela. Hlanganisa zonke izinsiza zangaphakathi ezidingekayo ukuze kuqiniseke inqubo yokubiza ukuqashwa kwabakhiwo. Qiniseka ukuthi ochwepheshe abaqashiwe baphatha izinga lomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwebanga labo lobuchwepheshe kanye nomthwalo wabo. Qiniseka ukuthi abakhiwo bathola ngesikhathi esifanele izinkomba kanye nezincazelo ezihambisanayo namakhontrathi. Cacisa zonke izicelo eziguqulwayo kanye nokwethula isikhathi bese unikeza izinkomba kubantu abagunyazwe ohlakeni lomnyango. Lungisa konke ukukhokhelwa kwanyanga zonke ngokuhambisana nezimo zamakhontrathi nangokuhambisana nesithembiso sikahulumeni sokukhokha izikweletu ngesikhathi esifanele. Lungisa futhi uhlose ulwazi oluzogcwaliswa kwisikhundla esibuswa solwazi kuMphathi Wezinhlela. Qinisekela zonke izimali ezidingekayo izinhlela ngaphakathi kwezinqubo ezibekiwe. Qiniseka ukuthi ulwazi mayelana nezinhleza lwenziwe ngendlela efanelekile ukulondeka kalula ngesikhathi kuhlolwa. Phakamisa isiko lobudlelwane obuhle bokusebenza nabalingane ohlakeni lomnyango.

xh.title: Inkokheli yabaPhathi beProjekthi yoKwakhiwa (GARDE A)
xh.summary: Umphathi ophethe iiprojekthi zokwakhiwa ukulawula iiprojekthi ezinkulu ezinkulu ezifakiweyo kwiiprojekthi ezinkulu ezinkulu, ukubhalisa abantu abahlala kwiiprojekthi ezinkulu ezinkulu, kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba bakwazi ukwenza iinkqubo eziphumelelayo kwindawo abakuyo kwindawo yokulawula iCape Town Regional Office.
xh.requirements: Iqondo elibambi mdla kwimfundo yobugcisa bokwakhiwa okulinganayo. Iiminyaka esixhenxe (06) yamava emva kokufumana isidanga kwaye ubhaliswe kwibhunga elibalulekileyo elithi SACPCMP njengengcali yolawulo lwakho. Iqondo elibambi mdla kwibhunga elithi SACPCMP njengengcali yolawulo lwakho. Iqondo elibambi mdla kwelayisensi yokushayela. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweenkqubo nemiqulu, ulwazi ngolawulo lweekomiti ezilawulayo, ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo nokusebenza ngokweenkqubo, ukwazi ukulawula iinkqubo zomthetho nokuzithintela kwiingozi ezinokubakwa. ulwazi ngokuqonda nokuqamba iindawo zokulunga, ukunika izisombululo iingxaki ezahlukeneyo, ukwazi ukwenza iingqinqiba ezilungele.
xh.duties: Qapha imisebenzi yabaphathi beprojekthi abasekunqanweni lakhe. Qonda, phucula kwaye uze unikeze inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ukuphucula imisebenzi. Lawula iiprojekthi zokwakhiwa ngokwakho, evela kwiiprojekthi ezinkulu zetzindlu ukuya kwimisebenzi yokulungisa nase kwiinkonzo ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iimfuno zabathengi zichazwe kakuhle zibe ngemilinganiselo ebhalwayo yomsebenzi. Thenga iinkonzo zeengcali zendalo yokwakhiwa ngokwemigaqo echaziweyo yokuLawula iNqanaba lezeMveliso. Linganisa umsebenzi weengcali ezahlukeneyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe iyadingo yokuqumba nembalo ekunokufuneka, kwanokuhanjiswa ngokwemigaqo yokuqhuba iiprojekthi. Linganisa zonke izixhobo ezifunekayo ngaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkqubo yokubiza abathengi ngomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba iingcali ezikhethiweyo zilawula kakuhle umsebenzi ngokwemilinganiselo nobunyulu babo. Qinisekisa ukuba abathengi bafumana ngexesha elifanelekileyo iinkcukacha nemiqathango yomsebenzi.ahlulela zonke izicelo ezimalunga nokutshintshwa kwemigaqo kwanokwandiswa kwexesha uze wenze izindululo kwigunya elamlayo ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Cima konke ukuhlawulwa kwinyanga ngokwemiqathano yomsebenzi nakulungelelano noLuntu ukwahlawula iinvoice ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Lungiselela uze ungenise ulwazi lweprojekthi ukuze lugcwaliswe kumntu ophethe iNqidishi. Qinisekisa zonke imali ezifunekayo kwiiprojekthi ngokwenkqubo ezenziweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi lweprojekthi lugcwaliswe ngokufanelekileyo ukwenzela ukuluncedo ekuphenyweni. Baze bathande isiko elilungileyo lokusebenzisana namakholeqa abo eSebe.
