Vaardighede: Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede, Gevorderde verslagdoeningvaardighede, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Beplanning en organisering, Diplomaatvaardighede, Interpersoonlike vaardighede, Beleidsanalise en -ontwikkeling, Probleemoplossing, Voorleggingsvaardighede, Begroting en Fasiliteringsvaardighede Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer; Gewillig om aan werkskedule aan te pas in ooreenstemming met professionele vereistes.
af.duties: Bestuur die toewysing van amptelike akkommodasie vir die President, Adjunkpresident, Ministers, Adjunkministers en Presiderende Beamptes, in ooreenstemming met voorskrifte. Bestuur van kliëntversoeke en klagtes: Verifieer kliëntversoeke en verseker akkurate dokumentasie. Hou tredy met nuwe ontwikkelings rakende Prestige (Gids vir Lede van die Uitvoerende Gesag en verwante regulasies). Uitreik van ontvangsbekragtigingsbriewe aan kliënte om hulle in te lig oor die toegewysde Projekbestuurder (bv. Binnehuise, Tegnies). Verseker behoorlike bestuur en onderhoud van residensiële akkommodasie en huishoudelike meubels vir Prestige-kliënte. Reël en woon kliëntkonsultasies by om hul behoeftes en vereistes te bepaal, en gee leiding in ooreenstemming met toepaslike beleide. Onderhou gereelde kommunikasie met kliënte om opdaterings oor projekvoortgang te verskaf en enige bekommernisse aan te spreek. Bestuur van Bouprogramme vir Kapitale Werke en Beplande Onderhoudsprojekte: Analiseer kapitale, beplande en ongeplande onderhoudsbouprogramme om prioriteite en risiko's te identifiseer. Hersien en analiseer maandelikse uitgawerapporte om finansiële nakoming en uitgawevlakke te monitor. Interakteer met Projekbestuurders om tydige vordering op projekte te verseker en operasionele vertragings op te los. Koördineer met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes om gladse projekuitvoering te ondersteun. Operasionele Bestuur van die Komponent: Skakel met Binnehuise, Direkteur, Adjunkdirekteur (AD), Tegniese Onderhoud en Inspekteurs om kliëntafsprake te skeduleer. Onderhou deurlopende kommunikasie met Projekbestuurders rakende projekstatus en vordering. Woon vergaderings by met interne rolspelers, kliënte, konsultante en Projekbestuurders om voorligtings en opdaterings te verskaf. Koördineer vergaderings met uitvoerende eenhede en diensverskaffers binne die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure (DPWI) om belyning en operasionele doeltreffendheid te verseker. Bestuur van Presidentsiële Gebeurtenisse en Prestige-eiendomme: Reël bilaterale vergaderings met Prestige-kliënte soos vereis. Bystand verleen met beplanning en koördinering van staatsfunksies, Staatsbesoeke en staatsbegrafnisse. Verseker dat alle gebeurtenisse en verwante eiendomsvereistes bestuur word in ooreenstemming met regeringsprotokolle, beleide en tydraamwerke. Bestuur effektiewe kommunikasie met alle kliënte en belanghebbendes.

zu.title: Onozimele: Ukuphathwa Kwebhifolo (IPHARLAMENTHI &
zu.summary: Onozimele wokuphathwa kwebhifolo eCape Town Regional Office, obuka ukwabiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni izikhulu ezinkulu zombuso.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-tertiary zeminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma ku-Public Management, Property Management, Real Estate/ Built Environment noma enkundleni ehubile. Eminyaka emifanele yohluvo lwenkingA Asset Management noma ukuphathwa kwezimpahla noma Facilities Management ezingeni lika-Assistant Director. Ilayiseni yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Asset Management, Property Management, Government Immovable Asset Management Act, 2007. Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Ukuhlola isimiso senani elithengiswayo, Izimali zenhlabathi yezimpahla, Imithetho ye-Treasury, Izinqumo nezexeyimu zombuso / izikhathi; (MTEF), Ukuphathwa kwezimali nokwaziswa, Ukuphathwa amaphrojekthi, Imithetho yokuqhakambisa izakhiwo, indawo ezakhiwe, Works Control System (WCS), Basic Accounting System (BAS), Inqubo nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezimali, Izinkomba noma izinqumo zokuthenga, Izinqumo ze-tender. Amakhono: Amakhono okuxhumana okusebenzayo, Amakhono okubhala emibiko engcono, Ulwazi lwekhompyutha, Ukuhlela nokuhlela kabusha, Amakhono wobudiplomathikhi, Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, Ukuhlaziya nokuqhakambisa izinqubo, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Amakhono okubonisa, Ukwenza ihholo nobuchule bokulekela. IkONO Lokusebenza phansi kokucindezelwa; IkONO Lokuxhumana kumakhono onke; Ukuathanda ukuzivumelanisa nesikhathi sokusebenza ngokwezidingo zomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukwabiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni zoMongameli, oNobhala-jikelele, oNgqongqoshe, oBambiswana beNgqongqoshe nabeNyunywa bePhalamende, ngokomthetho. Ukuphathwa Kwezicelo Zabathengi Nezinkhalazo: Qinisekisa izicelo zabathengi ukuze uqinisekise ukushicilelwa kwezinkomba. Zigcine usazi ngokuqhubeka kwezinto ezintsha ezibhekene lePrestige (Isiqondiso soBahlali beBhodi yoMkhandlu nezinye izinkomba ezihlobene). Nikela ngamagwazi okwamukela abathengi, ubatshengise ngesiNgqongqoshe sePhrojekthi esinikiwe (isb., Interior, Technical). Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele nolondolozo lwezindawo zokuhlala nolwelwani lwasekhaya labathengi bePrestige. Hlela ubambe izinkomba zabathengi ukuze ukhethe izidingo nezidingo zabo, ubanikeze isiqondiso ngokomthetho ohlobene. Gcina ukuxhumana ngokuvamile nabathengi ukubakwazisa ngokuqhubeka kumphrojekthi ukuze bathole ulwazi ngemibuzo ephakanyisiwe. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Zokwakha Amaphrojekthi We-Capital Works Nezokulondoloza Ezihihleliwe: Hlaziya amaphrojekthi okwakha e-Capital, okuhleliwe kanye nokuqeqeshwa okungehleliwe ukuze ukhethe izinto ebalulekile futhi uthole imisindo. Buka uhlaziye imibiko yokuchitha imali yanyanga zonke ukuze ulondoloze ukuzinhla ngokomthetho kwezimali namanani ochithwayo. Xhumana noBaphathi bePhrojekthi ukuze uqinisekise inqubo yophrojekthi esikhathini futhi uxazulule izinkinga zokuqhubeka. Hlelanganisela nabathintekayo bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze uxhase inqubo yephrojekthi egesa. Ukuphathwa Kokusebenza Kwe-Component: Xhumana ne-Interiors, oNgqondankulu, oNobhala-jikelele (DD), Technical Maintenance, kanye noBaqondisi ukuze uhlele izinkomba zabathengi. Gcina ukuxhumana ngokuqhubeka noBaphathi bePhrojekthi ngohlelo nokuqhubeka kwebhifolo. Bambe izinkomba noBamba-igumba bangaphakathi, abathengi, oBaqondisi naboBaphathi bePhrojekthi ukuze ubanikeze izinkomba nokwazisa. Hlelanganisela izinkomba namayunithi aqhuba kanye nabahlinzeli besebenza kule Department of Public Works and Infrastructure (DPWI) ukuze kuhambisane nokusebenza okusebenzayo. Ukuphathwa Kwezinkomba Zezikhulu Zezwe Nezimpahla Ze-Prestige: Hlela izinkomba ze-bilateral nabathengi be-Prestige njengoba kudingekile. Siza ukuhlela nokuhlelanganisela imisebenzi yombuso, izivakashi zombuso, kanye namaphunga ombuso. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkomba nezidingo ezihlobene nezimpahla ziphathwe ngokomthetho, izinqumo kanye nokuqina kwemithetho yombuso. Phatha ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabaqembu bonke abathengi nabathintekayo.

xh.title: Umfundi oQhuba iNgqungquthe (iNgqungquthe &
xh.summary: Umntu ongumphathi ngenqanaba elifanayo, othunyelwa ukuziphatha kweziSikokobo ezisekwa Kapa phantsi kobuRhulumede bobuGcisa beNqanaba leNkundla, alawula nokuba yena wazi ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi lwemisebenzi ngeendawo abakuyo abantu abanamagunya abakhethiweyo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seNyanga ezintsatshu iNdima ephantsi (NQF Level 06) / uQaqambele wesiZwe kwi Lawulo kaBantu, uLawulo lwamafa, urThengiso wamafa / iNdawo eakhiweyo oqeqeshelwe kuyo. Okumbi kweminyaka yokuxhamla kukuLawulwa kweAmafa (okungalunganga) / uLawulo lwamafa oLawulo lwamandla angenamva kweSazwe seNyuvesi. IFlayili yoQaqambele yokusebenzela iNqanaba. Ulwazi: uLawulo lwaMafa (alingoHogo), uLawulo lwamafa, iMigaqo yoLawulo Amanafa aGqitha kwiFama kaRhulumade, 2007. uMthetho woLawulo beeMali kaRhulumade, 1999. Uphando lweSimahla, iziQoqobana zamafa, imilaqo yoNgcweti leMali, iinkqubo / isikhathi soQeqesho lweNgxowa-mali karhulumade (MTEF), uLawulo lolawulo nolawulo lweMali, uLawulo lweProjekthi, imilaqo yoZakhiwo, indawo eakhiweyo, iNkqubo yoLawulo lweNkqubo (WCS), iNkqubo yeAkhowunti eyiNtsimbi (BAS), iinkqubo noluHlelo loLawulo lwamali, imilaqo yokuNanaba neluHlelo, iinkqubo ezithengwayo. Amakhono: Amakhono oXhumo olusebenzayo, amakhono obhalo obuzileyo, ukuFunda nokuBhala ngeKhompyutha, uCwangciso nokuHlela, amakhono eSivumelwano, amakhono oThethwano nabanye, uHlaziyo nokulungiselelwa kweNkqubela, ukuSombulula iNgxaki, amakhono abakhoPhethe, uQeqesho lokwenza iNgxowa-mali nokuba ngumKhombisi wethamsanqa; Ukuguquguquka ekwenzeni imisebenzi ngokuhamba kwemfuneko; Ukuzethemba ekuboniseni ukwazi ukuba nxulumene nabantu abanobungako nobutsha, ukuzihlanganisa nokuHlohloka.
xh.duties: Phatha kwabiwo poko ababhulu abakhoyo aMongameli, uMongameli oNcinci, oNgqungquthe, abaswazi iNgqungquthe kunye namaGosa aPhezulu endlela abhalelwe ngayo phantsi kwemigaqo. Ulawulo lokuSicela koMthengi kunye neSikhalazo: Qinisekisa izicelo zabathengi uze uqinisekise ukuba umxholo obhalwe nguchanekileyo. Hlala uvuselela ulwazi ngamashishini amatsha ahlobene nePrestige (iNkqubo yokuzalisa iLungu leNgqungquthe kunye nemigaqo ezalathwa ngayo). Zihlabelela iileta zokuqaphela kumathengi, ukuze bazi ukuba babelwe uMphathi weProjekthi (umzekelo, iNgaphakathi, iNzululwazi). Qinisekisa ulawulo olululo nolondolozo lwezindlu zokuhlala nobuhlathi bexhotela kubathengi bePrestige.hlela uze ubakhonce kwizikhulwano zabathengi ukuze ukuqonde iimfuno nezidingo zabo, unike imikhelo ngokwemigaqo esebenzayo. Gcina unxibelelwano oluqhelefuzileyo nabathengi ukuze ubanike izihloko ngenkulungwane yeprojekthi uze ubaphathe iinkathazo. Ulawulo lweNkqubo zoZakhiwo zovulo Iprojekthi zoLondolozo eCwangciswe ngoluHlobo: Hlaziya ovulo, olucwangcisiweyo, kunye nalungalanga cwangciswa iinkqubo zolondolozo lwezakhiwo ukuze uqonde izinto ezibalulekileyo nengozi. Phawula uze uhlaziye iingxelo zenyanga zokuchitha imali ukuze ulandele ukuzaliseka kwemigaqo yemali kunye namanqanaba okuchitha. Nxibelelanisa ooPhathi beProjekthi ukuze uqinisekise inkulungwane yeprojekthi uze usombulule iinkxwabo ezingenamthetho. Yiba nentsebenziswano namachaphaze angaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze uxhase uluhlelo olubonakalayo lweprojekthi. ULawulo olubonakalayo loQhagamshelwano: Nxibelelana nabeNgceni, uMphathi, uMphathi oNcinci (DD), uLondolozo olubhekisa kwiNzululwazi, kunye noBaqaqambi-bagqithi ukuze ucwangcise izikhulwano zabathengi. Gcina iinkomfa nooPhathi beProjekthi ngenkulungwane yendalo yeprojekthi. Zukela iindibano namalunga aphakathi kwentshukumo, nabathengi, oCelele, nakooPhathi beProjekthi ukuze unike iinkcazelo ezicwangcisiweyo. Lawula iindibano namacandelo aquka iinkqubo kunye namacebo ngaphakathi kweSebe leZoBuMfundi neziNkqubo (DPWI) ukuze qinisekise ulungelelwaniso nokusebenza kakuhle. ULawulo lweNkqubo kaMongameli kunye nezindlu zoQowo: Hlela iindibano zentshueka ngamathengi ePrestige njengoko kuyimfuneko. Nceda ngokuCwangcisa nokulawula iinkqubo zelizwe, iindwendwa zelizwe, namazihlobo kelizwe. Qinisekisa ukuzo zonke iinkqubo nendlela ezakhiwe ngayo zilawulwa ngokwemigaqo yelizwe, iinkqubo zayo, naxesha elinqatshiweyo. Lawula ukuxhumana okusebenzayo onke amathengi nabalatha indawo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Portfolio Management (PRESTIGE Estate
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 101 468 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the middle management service)
jobs.summary: Manage provision and allocation of official accommodation for Directors-General and Members of Parliament at the Cape Town Regional Office.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Public Management, Property Management, Real Estate/ Built Environment or related field. Appropriate years of experience in Asset (immovable) Management/ Property Management or Facilities Management at an Assistant Director level. A valid Driver’s license. Knowledge: Asset (immovable) Management, Property Management, Government Immovable Asset Management Act, 2007. Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Market research, Property economics, Treasury regulations, Government budget procedures / timeframes; (MTEF), Financial management and administration, Project management, Construction regulations, built environment, Works Control System (WCS), Financial administration processes and systems, Procurement directives and procedures, Tender procedures. Skills: Effective communication skills, Advanced report writing skills, Computer literacy, Planning and organizing, Diplomacy skills, Interpersonal skills, Policy analysis and development, Problem solving, Presentation skills, Budgeting and Facilitation skills Ability to work under pressure; Ability to communicate at all levels; Willing to adapt to work schedule in accordance with professional requirements.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of official accommodation for Directors-General, Members of Parliament (MPs) and sessional officials. Manage allocation of official accommodation for Directors-General, Members of Parliament (MP) and sessional officials in line with prescripts. Ensure provision of safety and security with the residences. Coordinate prestige projects. Ensure that requests received comply with the rules governing the Parliamentary Villages and within the budget allocation. Compile report to the client on progress regarding project in execution and provide timeframes. Coordinate state events and functions. Ensure effective rental debt management. Manage access control and screening of visitors within prestige facilities. Conduct regular property occupation verifications. Coordinate maintenance of assets with Facilities Management unit. Provide inputs towards compilation of annual conditions assessment programme for capital works and planned maintenance. Provide inputs on the analyses and monitoring of capital, planned and unplanned maintenance budget and expenditure for Prestige. Manage the procurement process of new assets. Manage bi-annual verification process of movable assets. Ensure proper handling and preservation of antique furniture. Ensure optimal procurement practices for all assets. Manage effective Prestige client relations: Develop client relations management strategies and standards and ensure adherence thereof. Develop open and effective channels of communication. Manage reporting and communication to clients. Manage prestige clients’ requests and complaints. Compile reports, memos, letters, responses to parliamentary questions, media reports etc. Keep up to date with new developments related to Prestige (Parliamentary Villages Management Act and related regulations). Control and monitor the expenditure of the Parliamentary Villages Management Board budget. Manage contracts of transport service providers for MPs as per PVMB guidelines. Improve the quality of support delivered to users through the ongoing review of services provided. Coordinate Parliamentary Villages Management Board meetings
jobs.enquiries: Mr. T Tshotyana Tel No: (021) 402 2286
jobs.applications: Email applications for this position must be email to: RecruitCPT26- 62@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.summary: Bestuur die voorsiening en toekenning van amptelike akkommodasie vir Direkteurs-generaal en Lede van die Parlement by die Kaapstad Streekskantoor.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Openbare Bestuur, Eiendomsbestuur, Vastegoedereiendom / Bou-omgewing of verwante veld. Toepaslike jare ervaring in Bate (roerlose) Bestuur / Eiendomsbestuur of Fasiliteitebestuur op 'n Assistentdirekteur-vlak. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Bate (roerlose) Bestuur, Eiendomsbestuur, Government Immovable Asset Management Act, 2007. Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Marknavorsing, Eiendomsekonomie, Tesourie-regulasies, Regeringbegrotingsprosedures en tydraamwerke; (MTEF), Finansiële bestuur en administrasie, Projektbestuur, Konstruksie-regulasies, bou-omgewing, Works Control System (WCS), Finansiële administrasieprosesse en stelsels, Voorsieningsriglyne en -prosedures, Tenderprosedures. Vaardighede: Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede, Gevorderde verslagskryfvaardighede, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Beplanning en organisering, Diplomatieke vaardighede, Interpersoonlike vaardighede, Beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling, Probleemoplossing, Aanbiedingsvaardighede, Begroting en fasiliteringsvaardighede Vermoe om onder druk te werk; Vermoe om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer; Bereid om werkskedule aan te pas in ooreenstemming met professionele vereistes.
af.duties: Bestuur die voorsiening van amptelike akkommodasie vir Direkteurs-generaal, Lede van die Parlement (LP's) en sessie-amptenare. Bestuur toekenning van amptelike akkommodasie vir Direkteurs-generaal, Lede van die Parlement (LP) en sessie-amptenare in ooreenstemming met voorskrifte. Verseker voorsiening van veiligheid en sekuriteit binne die wonings. Koördineer prestige-projekte. Verseker dat ontvangste versoeke voldoen aan die reëls wat die Parlementêre Dorpe regeer en binne die begrotingstoekenning. Stel verslag aan die kliënt op oor vordering aangaande projek in uitvoering en verskaf tydraamwerke. Koördineer staatsgeleenthede en -funksies. Verseker effektiewe huurskuldbestuur. Bestuur toegangskontrolering en sifting van besoekers binne prestige-fasiliteite. Voer gereelde eiendomsbesettingsverifikasies uit. Koördineer instandhouding van bates met die Fasiliteitebestuur-eenheid. Verskaf insette tot samestelling van jaarlikse toestandassesseringsprogram vir kapitale werke en beplande instandhouding. Verskaf insette oor die ontleding en monitering van kapitale, beplande en ongeplande instandhoudingsbegroting en -besteding vir Prestige. Bestuur die voorsieningsproses van nuwe bates. Bestuur halfjaarlikse verifikasi proses van roerbare bates. Verseker behoorlike hantering en bewaring van antieke meubels. Verseker optimale voorsieningspraktyke vir alle bates. Bestuur effektiewe Prestige-kliëntverhoudinge: Ontwikkel kliëntverhoudingsbestuurstrategieë en -standaarde en verseker nakoming daarvan. Ontwikkel oop en effektiewe kommunikasiekanale. Bestuur verslagdoening en kommunikasie aan kliënte. Bestuur prestige-kliënte se versoeke en klagtes. Stel verslae, memo's, briewe, antwoorde op parlementêre vrae, mediaverslae ens. op. Hou tredy met nuwe ontwikkelings wat verband hou met Prestige (Parliamentary Villages Management Act en verwante regulasies). Kontroleer en monitor die besteding van die Parliamentary Villages Management Board-begroting. Bestuur kontrakte van vervoerdienverskaffers vir LP's volgens PVMB-riglyne. Verbeter die gehalte van ondersteuning aan gebruikers deur voortdurende hersiening van verskafde dienste. Koördineer Parliamentary Villages Management Board-vergaderings

zu.summary: Phatha ukubonezela nokwabiwa kwendlu eziyisikhungo sabaholi abanjengo-Directors-General nebalungu be-Parliament e-Cape Town Regional Office.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole samatimu eminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Public Management, Property Management, Real Estate/ Built Environment noma elikhundla elihlobene nakho. Iminyaka esebenze ngayo kwa-Asset (immovable) Management/ Property Management noma Facilities Management esigabeni sika-Assistant Director. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Asset (immovable) Management, Property Management, Government Immovable Asset Management Act, 2007. Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Market research, Property economics, Treasury regulations, Government budget procedures / timeframes; (MTEF), Financial management and administration, Project management, Construction regulations, built environment, Works Control System (WCS), Financial administration processes and systems, Procurement directives and procedures, Tender procedures. Amakhono: Amakhono okuxhumana okusebenzayo, amakhono okubhala emibiko ethuthukile, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuqamba, amakhono obudlelwano, amakhono abantu, ukuhlaziya nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okwelula, ukweza ukusebenza nokuthula izinkulumo. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi; Ikono lokuxhumana kwazinga zonke; Ukuqonda ukuzivumelanisa nesikhathi sokusebenza ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukubonezela kwendlu eziyisikhungo kubaholi abanjengo-Directors-General, abalungu be-Parliament (MPs) nebe-official abahlala isikhathi. Phatha ukwabiwa kwendlu eziyisikhungo kubaholi abanjengo-Directors-General, abalungu be-Parliament (MP) nebe-official abahlala isikhathi ngokuhambisana nemigomo. Qinisekisa ukubonezela kokuphepha nokuvikelwa endlini. Hlanganisa imiklamo ye-prestige. Qinisekisa ukuthi izicelo ezitholwe zihambisana nemithetho elawula i-Parliamentary Villages futhi zingaphakathi kwesabelo sempahla. Qamba umbiko umthengi ngokuqhubeka komklamo osebenzakalo futhi unikeze izikhathi. Hlanganisa imicimbi nomcimbi wombuso. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zentela ngokusebenzayo. Phatha ukulawula ukungena nokuqamba izivakashi ezindaweni ze-prestige. Yenza njalo ukuqinisekiswa kokuba ngabantu abahlala ezindlini. Hlanganisa ukugcinwa kwezimpahla neyuni ye-Facilities Management. Nikeza okokufakela ekwenzeni uhlelo lwonyaka lokuhlolwa kwezimo lwemiklamo yezimali nokuqashiwa okuhleliwe. Nikeza okufakwayo kohlaziyweni nokulawulweni kwesabelo nokuqashwa kwemali yamaklamo amakhulu, okuhleliwe nangahleliwe kwa-Prestige. Phatha inqubo yokuthenga izimpahla ezintsha. Phatha inqubo yonyaka yokuvivinywa kabili kwezimpahla ezihambahambayo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle nokugcinwa kwefanitshala endala. Qinisekisa izindlela ezinhle zokuthenga zonke izimpahla. Phatha ubudlelwano obusebenzayo nabathengi be-Prestige: Thuthukisa izinhlelo nobujamo bokuphathwa kobudlelwano nabathengi futhi uqinisekise ukuzigcina kwawo. Thuthukisa izindlela ezivulekile nezisebenzayo zokuxhumana. Phatha ukubika nokuxhumana nabathengi. Phatha izicelo nezikhalazo zabathengi be-prestige. Qamba imibiko, amamemo, amagungu, impendulo ezibuzweni ze-Parliament, imibiko yabezindaba njll. Gcina usekugcineni ngezinto ezintsha eziphathelene ne-Prestige (Parliamentary Villages Management Act nemithetho ephathelene nayo). Lawula futhi ulolule ukusetshenziswa kwesabelo se-Parliamentary Villages Management Board. Phatha izinkontileka zobanikezeli bezinkonzo zokuthutha aba-MP ngokuhambisana nemihlahlandlela ye-PVMB. Thuthukisa izinga lenkonzonikezo kubasebenzisi ngokuqhubeka nokuhlolwa kwezinkonzo eznikiwe. Hlanganisa izingxoxo ze-Parliamentary Villages Management Board

xh.title: Isekela Mlawuli: Ulawulo lweNkqubo (iNtshatsheli ebalulekileyo
xh.summary: Lawula ukubonelelwa nokuwabiwa koluhlalo olusemthethweni kwiBaphathi-Jikelele nakwamalungu ePalamente eKapa Regional Office.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwamashumi amathathu semfundo ephakamileyo (NQF Level 06) / iDiploma yezwe kuloLawulo lukaRhulumente, ulawulo lwepropathi, olwezindlu okanye indawo ekhatshwe kuyo okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Iminyaka efanelekileyo yamava kulawulo lwamafa (angedwa kuyo) / ulawulo lwepropathi okanye ulawulo lwezakhiwo kwinqanaba leSekela woLawuli. Ilayisenisi yokushukuma esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Ulawulo lwamafa (angedwa kuyo), ulawulo lwepropathi, uMthetho woLawulo lukaRhulumente lwaMafa agedwa kuye, 2007. uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, 1999. Upando lwemarike, izithakaziswa zepropathi, imigaqo yeNdlu yamali, iinkqubo / amaxesha okuchaza ishadi likaRhulumente; (MTEF), ulawulo lolawulo lwemali kunye nokulawula imali, ulawulo lwamaprojekthi, imigaqo yezakhiwo, indawo ekhatshwe kuyo, inkqubo yoLawulo lweMisebenzi (WCS), iinkqubo zolawulo lwemali, iindlela zokulinganisa imigaqo yokuthengisa, iinkqubo zokuqasha. Amakhono: amakhono okunxibelelwana asebenzayo, amakhono aphambili okubhala iingxelo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela, amakhono obuzwie, amakhono onxibelelwano, ukuhlalutya nokuphuhlisa iinkqubo, ukusombulula iingxaki, amakhono okubonisa, ukumiselwa kweshadi namakhono okwenza inkqubo. Ulawulo lokusebenza ngaphantsi komfutho; Ulawulo lokunxibelelana naziphi na iinqanaba; Ukulungele ukuqwalasela ishedyuli yomsebenzi ngokwemfuno yemisebenzi.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikwa koluhlalo olusemthethweni kwiBaphathi-Jikelele, amalungu ePalamente (MPs) nabasebenzi basesimeni. Lawula ukwabiwa koluhlalo olusemthethweni kwiBaphathi-Jikelele, amalungu ePalamente (MP) nabasebenzi basesimeni ngokwemigaqo echaziweyo. Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa kokhuseleko nokhuseleko kwindlu. Linganisa amaprojekthi abaluleke kakhulu. Qinisekisa ukuba izicelo ezitholiweyo zihambelana nemigaqo elawula iindawo zokuhlala zePalamente nanakwishadi lokuchitheka kwemali. Hlenga ingxelo kumthengi ngenthuba lenkqubo yeprojekthi ephumeziwayo kwaye unike iinkqubo zexesha. Linganisa imisebenzi yelizwe nemibuthano. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusemphumeni lwezikoloto zokuqeshisa. Lawula ulawulo lokungena nokuhlolwa kwabakhangeli kwindawo ezingagqithiswa kuyo nabakhangele kwindawo. Yenza kuqinisekiso oluchanekileyo rhoqo lokubhaliswa kwepropathi. Linganisa ukonakalisa iimpahla nesebe loLawulo lweZakhiwo. Nikela ngesixhaso ekwenziweni kwenkqubo yonyaka lokuqinisekisa iimeko zeprojekthi zemisebenzi yezemali nokonakaliswa okucwangcisiweyo. Nikela ngesixhaso kumanalisi nokulawula ukuchitheka kwemali emisebenzeni yamaxesha amakhulu, elocwangcisiweyo nangalocwangciswa kuyo nakwiNtshatsheli ebalulekileyo. Lawula inkqubo yokuqasha iimpahla ezintsha. Lawula inkqubo yokucinga iimpahla ezihambayo kabuhlungu ngonyaka. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa nokugcinwa kolungelelwano lwefenitshala yamandulo. Qinisekisa iinkqubo zokuqasha ezilungelelanisiweyo kuzo zonke iimpahla. Lawula ubudlelwane obusempilweni nabathengi bePrestige: Phuhlisa iindlela zamaxabiso nokusingqongileyo kulawulo lobudlelwane nabathengi ukuze kuqhutywe ngokwazo. Phuhlisa iindlela ezivulekileyo nezisebenzayo zokunxibelelwana. Lawula ukunikwa iingxelo kunye nokunxibelelana nabathengi. Lawula izicelo nezingxaki zabathengi bePrestige. Hlenga iingxelo, iimemo, iileta, iimpendulo kwiimbuzo yepalamente, iingxelo ezindwendwendla njl.njl. Gcina ulwazi olutsha malunga nophuhliso olutsha olunxulumene nePrestige (UMthetho woLawulo lweendawo zokuhlala zePalamente namaxwebhu axhobileyo). Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuchitheka kweenkcukacha zeshadi leBhodi yoLawulo lweendawo zokuhlala zePalamente. Lawula iinkqubo zokuqasha iinkonzo zeethrekhupha kumalungu ePalamente njengoko kumiselwe ngemigaqo ye-PVMB. Phucula umgangatho wokuxhasa abasebenzisi ngokuqhuba iingxelo zemisebenzi ebonakalise iinkonzo ezinikiweyo. Linganisa iindibano zeBhodi yoLawulo lweendawo zokuhlala zePalamente.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Property Disposals
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 101 468 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the middle management service)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed to implement property management policies and disposals at the Cape Town Regional Office.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Real Estate Management, Town Planning, Property Development and Management, Law Degree or related field of study. Relevant years of experience at a junior management level (Assistant Director equivalent). On Valid driver’s License. Knowledge: Public Finance Management Act; Financial administration; Procurement directives and procedures; Programme and project planning; Reporting procedures; GIAMA; DISPOSAL ACT; Deeds Registry Act; Financial Assistance Land Act (FALA); BBBEE; Treasury Regulations. Skills: Report writing; Accounts and numeric skills; Analytical thinking; Communication skills; Interpersonal skills; Problem solving skills; Organizing and planning; Personal attributes: Goal and solution orientated; Assertiveness; People and client orientated; Innovative; Ability to work under stressful conditions; Hard working; Ability to communicate at all levels. Ability to adapt in accordance with office requirements.
jobs.duties: Implement and maintain property management policies, procedures and strategies. Implement and maintain property management policies, procedures and frameworks. Ensure compliance with related prescripts, delegations and procedures. Communicate all property management policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders. Establish proper property management, governance processes and internal control measures. Undertake research on the best current practices in relation to property management. Manage the disposal process of redundant and superfluous residential properties. Manage the process of identifying redundant and superfluous residential properties to be disposed of. Ensure the accuracy of information gathered on identified redundant and superfluous residential properties. Conduct inspections to determine status/conditions of redundant and superfluous residential properties. Expedite recommendation for Directorate. Investment Analysis to conduct Investment Option research and advice on best disposal mode. Expedite recommendation for Directorate: Valuation Services to determine the market value of identified properties. Manage the disposal process of redundant and superfluous residential properties. Facilitate and coordinate the submission and presentation of Disposal applications at the Provincial State Land Disposal and Vesting Committee (PSLDVC). Manage the process of identifying redundant and superfluous residential properties to be disposed of. Ensure the accuracy of information gathered on identified redundant and superfluous residential properties. Conduct inspections to determine status/conditions of redundant and superfluous residential properties. Expedite recommendation for Directorate: Investment Analysis to conduct Investment Option research and advice on best disposal mode. Expedite recommendation for Directorate: Valuation Services to determine the market value of identified properties. Contribute towards enhancing effective and efficient state property management: (Conveyancing and disposal from PMIS). Ensure completion of conveyance processes in respect of all properties approved for disposal and released by Ministry of DPW&I. Issue transfer instruction to Office of the State Attorney. Ensure and verify correctness of transfer documents from Office of the State Attorney before signing by Delegated authority in the Region. Ensure completion of conveyance & registration processes in respect of gas, power and water pipeline servitudes over state land. Facilitate and communicate need for disposal/removal/update of the property information PMIS. Manage the Sub-directorate. Ensure maintenance of discipline. Manage performance and development. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Develop and manage the operational plan of the sub-directorate and report on progress as required. Manage procurement and asset management for the sub-directorate. Plan and allocate work. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Manage Financial Resources of the sub-directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. D Gqibela Tel No: (021) 402 2315

Fasiliteer en koördineer die voorlegging en voorlegging van Van die hand sit-aansoeke by die Provinsiale Staatsgrond Van die hand sit en Toewysingskomitee (PSLDVC). Bestuur die proses om oortollige en oorbodige residensiële eiendomme wat van die hand gesit moet word, te identifiseer. Verseker die akkuraatheid van inligting wat ingesamel is oor geïdentifiseerde oortollige en oorbodige residensiële eiendomme. Voer inspeksies uit om die status/toestand van oortollige en oorbodige residensiële eiendomme te bepaal. Bespoedig aanbeveling vir Direktoraat: Beleggingsontleding om Beleggingsopsie-navorsing uit te voer en advies te gee oor die beste metode van van die hand sit. Dra by tot die verbetering van doeltreffende en effektiewe staatseiendomsbestuur: (Aktoorproses en van die hand sit uit PMIS). Gee oordraginstruksie aan die Kantoor van die Staatsprokureur.
