Nikela ekuthuthukiseni ukuphathwa kwamasimu kahulumeni okusebenzayo nokwenziwe kahle: (Ukudluliswa nokulahla kusuka ku-PMIS). Qinisekisa ukugqitywa kwezinqubo zokudluliswa kuzo zonke izindlu ezamukelekile ukulahlelwa futhi ezikhishwe uNgqongqoshe we-DPW&I. Nikezela umyalo wokudlulisa ehhovisi likaMmeli weSizwe. Qinisekisa futhi qinisekisa ukuzwakala kolwazi lokudlulisa olusuka ehhovisi likaMgange wokuDlulisa phambi kokusayinwa igunya elinikiwe esifundeni. Qinisekisa ukugqitywa kwezinqubo zokudlulisa kanye nezokubhalisa ezithinta amayadusi wamaphayiphu egesi, amandla kanye namanzi emasimu kahulumeni. Sula futhi yezisa isidingo sokulahla/ukususa/kubuyekeza ukwaziswa kwamasimu i-PMIS. Phatha isabelo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwesimo. Phatha ukusebenza kahle nokuthuthukiswa. Sula, futhi faka esebenzini futhi sigcime izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo nezokwenziwa kahle. Sungula futhi phathe ipulani yokusebenza yesabelo bese unikeza umbiko ngenqubo njengoko kudingeka. Phatha ukuthenga kanye nokuphatha impahla yesabelo. Hlela futhi wabelwe ngomsebenzi. Ukulawula ukuthula komsebenzi ohanjiwe abasebenzi. Phatha Izinsizakusebenza Zezimali zesabelo.

xh.title: UMsekeli weSikhululi: uLahlwa lweNtengiso
xh.summary: Kufunekana uMsekeli weSikhululi ukuze asetyenzise iinkqubomgama zolawulo lweempahla nolahlwa kwiCandelo eliNgingqi iCape Town.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zesidanga sesithathu (NQF Level 06) / Isidanga saseLizwe kwiQela leZindlu, iQeko leeNyani, uQhagamshelwano nemiQathango yokuSebenzisa, iNqanaba yokuQamba, ukuziphatha kolwazi nemiQathango, iDangwe leMithetho, ukusetyenziswa kolwazi nemiQathango, iDangwe leMithetho yokuSebenzisa, iQeko leQoqo leMisebenzi yolwazi, iNqanaba yeDangwe leMithetho.
xh.duties: Zisebenzise zigcinwe iinkqubomgama, iinkqubo nezicwangciso zolawulo lweempahla. Zisebenzise zigcinwe iinkqubomgama, iinkqubo nendlela yokusebenza zolawulo lweempahla. Qiniseza ukuvumelana neemiyalelo, iindlela zokunikwa amandla nemiqathango. Yazise abantu abathintekayo ngeenkqubomgama nangeenkqubo zonke wolawulo lweempahla. Misela iinkqubo ezilungileyo zolawulo lweempahla, inkqubo yolawulo nezinyathelo zolawulo langaphakathi. Zenze uphando malunga nendlela ezilungileyo zangoku ezihambelana nolawulo lweempahla. Lawula inkqubo yokulahla iindlu ezikhiwe ziyingenelo ezikwisakhono esingenamsebenzi. Lawula inkqubo yokuchonga iindlu ezikhiwe ziyingenalo ezikwisakhono esingenamsebenzi eziza kulahlwa. Qiniseza ulungilelolwazi oluqokelelwe malunga neendlu ezikhiwe ziyingenalo ezichongiwe ezikwisakhono esingenamsebenzi. Zenza ukuhlola ukumisela imeko/izimo zeendlu ezikhiwe ziyingenalo ezikwisakhono esingenamsebenzi. Khawulezisa iimpendulo kwiSikhululi seNdaba. Uhlolojulwazi loMngeni lokwenza uPhando malunga nokukhethwa kolwazi loMngeni kunye nexabiso ngendlela elungileyo yokulahla. Khawulezisa iimpendulo kwiSikhululi: Iinkonzo zoBiso zokumisela ixabiso lemarike yamawonephahla achongiweyo. Lawula inkqubo yokulahla iindlu ezikhiwe ziyingenalo ezikwisakhono esingenamsebenzi. Qiniseza nokubambisana nokugcinwa kweenkqubo nokuvezwa kweenkqubo zokulahla eKomiti yoMmandla wokuLahla uMhlaba weSizwe nokunikwa iNqanaba (PSLDVC). Lawula inkqubo yokuchonga iindlu ezikhiwe ziyingenalo ezikwisakhono esingenamsebenzi eziza kulahlwa. Qiniseza ulungilelolwazi oluqokelelwe malunga neendlu ezikhiwe ziyingenalo ezichongiweyo ezikwisakhono esingenamsebenzi. Zenza ukuhlola ukumisela imeko/izimo zeendlu ezikhiwe ziyingenalo ezikwisakhono esingenamsebenzi. Khawulezisa iimpendulo kwiSikhululi: Uhlolojulwazi loMngeni lokwenza uPhando malunga nokukhethwa kolwazi loMngeni kunye nexabiso ngendlela elungileyo yokulahla. Khawulezisa iimpendulo kwiSikhululi: Iinkonzo zoBiso zokumisela ixabiso lemarike yamawonephahla achongiweyo. Yaluze ekuphuculeni ukusebenza kakuhle nangenelo lolawulo lwempahla karhulumente: ( Ukudlulisa nokulahla kwi-PMIS). Qiniseza ukugqitywa kweenkqubo zokudlulisa malunga nawawonke amawonephahla avunyiweyo ngokolahla anikwa iNkundla ye-DPW&I. Nikezala imiyalelo yokudlulisela kuKhotho kaRhulumente. Qiniseza ukuqinisekisa ukulungileyo kwamaphepha okudlulisa avela kuKhotho kaRhulumente phambi kokutyhunjwa kusayiniwa nguBukhosi obuNikiwe amandla kummandla. Qiniseza ukugqitywa kweenkqubo zokudlulisa nokubhalisa malunga nezinkonzo zendlela yegesi, amandla kunye namaza okutshiza phezu komhlaba karhulumente. Qiniseza kwaza kwazisa ngemfuneko yokulahla/ukususa/hlaziya ulwazi olunesakhono se-PMIS. Lawula isiNqanaba esingaphantsi. Lawula ulungelelwaniso kwaye igcine ukuzithiba. Lawula ukusebenza ngokusetyenziswa kwayo nandipho lweempatho zokusebenza. Misela, usebenzise kwaye ugcine iindlela ezisebenzayo zokubonisana. Yakhe ulawule isicwangciso sokuqalisa esiNqanabeni esingaphantsi kwaye uchaze inqanaba lenkqubo njengoko kufuneka. Lawula inkqubo yokuza nempatho zolawulo esiNqanabeniy esingaphantsi. Cwangcisa kwaye wabelane ngemisebenzi. Lawula umgangatho womsebenzi ohlawulwa ngabasebenzi. Lawula iRhisobho zeemali esiNqanabeniy esingaphantsi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Training Manager (EPWP)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 101 468 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the middle management service)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director Training Manager needed at Gqeberha Regional Office to coordinate EPWP participant training across government spheres.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Human Resources Development/ Human Resource Management/ Public Administration / Public Management / Behavioural Sciences/ Sociology/Psychology / Education. Relevant years of experience in Training and Skills Development Coordination and Management field at a junior management level (Assistant Director equivalent). Valid driver’s license. Prepared to travel extensively. Willing to adapt to work schedule in accordance with the office requirements and long working hours. Knowledge of Disciplinary and Dispute Resolution procedures, Social Facilitation, Project Management, Developmental Studies, Contract Management, Supply Chain Management and Procurement Procedures. Skills; Computer Literacy, Planning and Organising, Problem Solving, Training and Presentation Skills, Communication, Report Writing, Financial Management, Negotiations Performance Management. ETD and Skills Development Environment including SETA knowledge, Post School Training Knowledge, National Skills Development Strategy and Standards, practices, process and procedures related to the management of skills development. National Human Resource Development Strategy. Training facilitation, materials development and standard development. Structure and functioning of the EPWP, EPWP Sectors and EPWP Recruitment Guidelines. Regulatory framework related to HR development including the Skills Development Act, Ministerial Determination, Employment Equity Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, collective agreements. Code of Remuneration and the Public Finance Management Act, Further Education and Training Act, Adult Basic Education and Training Act, Adult Basic Education and Training Act, National Recognition of Prior Learning Policy, Social Facilitation and Interaction. Must have planning and organizing skills. Training and Presentation, Interpersonal, team building, Facilitation decision, report writing and policy interpretation skills. Personal attributes: Resourceful, Team Player, Creative, Ability to work under stressful situations. Ability to communicate at all levels. Punctuality, Assertive, Ability to work independently.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and support the training of EPWP participants. (not limited to DPWI sourced funding): Manage the submission and verification of training applications from sectors and public bodies across all spheres of government. Present the training applications to the EPWP Approval Training Committee for approval. Manage the preparation process of the trainings i.e. logistical meetings, Public Body preparedness, training providers preparedness and venue due diligence. Monitor the training performance to ensure good quality. Profile the EPWP training interventions. Conduct training events. Manage training records as per the set guidelines. Ensure compliance to the Paper Trail System requirements. Coordinate and represent EPWP in training forums. Participate in EPWP training projects as requested e.g. research studies. Support EPWP Sectors in training interventions: - Support Public Bodies with assistance on their Public Body own funded training as requested. Provide support to procurement processes as requested. Provide support to training providers when claiming. Verify training provider claims. Respond to audit requests and implement resolutions of training audits in the province. Intervene and resolve challenges related to training. Develop and maintain sound relationships with stakeholders. Maintain stakeholder relationships. Coordinate EPWP reporting of training performance and monitor data integrity within the province: - Ensure compliance to the reporting guidelines. Submit evidence documents required to confirm training achieved. Analyse EPWP training performance data on an ongoing basis to ensure set targets are met. Prepare performance reports to various stakeholders and forums as required. Intervene and support public bodies in terms of reporting challenges on Training. Support and oversee interventions for ensuring data quality. Facilitate as a trainer on EPWP training interventions: - Facilitate as a trainer on selected training programmes. Manage the sub-directorate: Develop and manage the operational plan and report on progress as required. Manage performance as per the set guidelines. Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls to ensure ethical conduct as per the set requirements i.e. Code of Conduct, PFMA prescripts etc. in order to meet performance expectations. Support the development of subordinate employees. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication protocols in the Unit ensuring maximum utilization and productivity of staff in the Unit. Compile and submit all required administrative reports as per the set prescripts. Quality control the work delivered by subordinate employees. Manage and monitor the allocated budgets. Intervene and address challenges. Manage the training for EPWP participants not limited to NDPW source funding. Consolidate training needs for the province through liaison with sectors and implementing public bodies across the spheres of government. Consolidate, submit and present the provincial training applications and ensure approval thereof. Conduct logistical meetings in preparation of training ensuring all contract prescripts are adhered to and ensure training provided in the province is compliant to the Training Operations Procedures Guidelines of the EPWP Training. Ensure provision of technical assistance to public bodies and programmes in terms of EPWP training interventions not limited to NDPW sourced funding. Ensure training providers are compliant to audit requirements and implement resolutions of audits related to the EPWP training in province. Manage the budget allocated to the region for training of EPWP participants. Consolidate training needs determine the provincial budget allocation. Facilitate as a Project Manager in Supply Chain Management the process of training providers. Compile and present provincial training progress reports on to date progress of expenditure and available budget. Support training providers with processing of claims for approval and payments and ensure reporting of budget and expenditure. Manage the procurement of training providers and manage and support training providers on contractual matters. Compile and present provincial training progress report and ensure training data is reported to the EPWP reporting system. Supervise and manage EPWP training Unit in the Region. Ensure compliance to the Performance Management Development System (PMDS) requirements i.e submission and sign off of work plans and assessments. Provide guidance and direction to Assistant Directors Responsible for training coordination. Manage the coordination and provision of EPWP learning Programmes and any other staff capacity building programmes. Ensure capacity building of staff in the Unit.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. M. Ntese Tel No: (041) 408 2029
jobs.applications: Email applications for this position must be email to: RecruitPE26- 38@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Opleidingsbestuurder (EPWP)
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur Opleidingsbestuurder benodig by Gqeberha Streekkantoor om EPWP-deelnemeropleiding oor regeringsfere te koördineer.
af.requirements: ‘n Minimum driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling/ Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/ Publieke Administrasie / Publieke Bestuur / Gedragswetenskappe/ Sosiologie/Psigologie / Opvoedkunde. Relevante jare ervaring in die Koördinasie en Bestuur van Opleiding en Vaardigheidsonwikkeling op ‘n junior bestuursvlak (Assistent Direkteur ekwivalent). Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereid om uitgebreid te reis. Gewillig om by werkskedule aan te pas in ooreenstemming met die kantoorvereistes en lang werkure. Kennis van Dissiplinêre en Geskilbeslegtingsprosedures, Sosiale Fasilitering, Projekbestuur, Ontwikkelingstudies, Kontrakbestuur, Voorsieningskettingbestuur en Aanbestedingsprosedures. Vaardighede; Rekenaargeletterdheid, Beplanning en Organisering, Probleemoplossing, Opleidings- en Aanbiedingsvaardighede, Kommunikasie, Verslagskrywing, Finansiële Bestuur, Onderhandelings- en Prestasiebestuur. ETD- en Vaardigheidsonwikkelingsomgewing insluitend SETA-kennis, Na-skoolse Opleidingskennis, Nasionale Vaardigheidsonwikkelingstrategie en standaarde, praktyke, prosesse en prosedures verwant aan die bestuur van vaardigheidsonwikkeling. Nasionale Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingstrategie. Opleidingsfasilitering, materiaalontwikkeling en standaardontwikkeling. Struktuur en funksionering van die EPWP, EPWP-sektore en EPWP-Werweringsriglyne. Regulerende raamwerk verwant aan HR-ontwikkeling insluitend die Skills Development Act, Ministeriële Bepaling, Employment Equity Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Kode van Remunerasie en die Public Finance Management Act, Further Education and Training Act, Adult Basic Education and Training Act, Adult Basic Education and Training Act, Nasioniale Erkenning van Voorafgeleerde Beleide, Sosiale Fasilitering en Interaksie. Moet beplannings- en organiseriesvaardighede hê. Opleiding en Aanbieding, Interpersoonlike, spanbou-, Fasiliteringsbesluit-, verslagskryf- en beleidinterpretasievaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Hulpbronderkend, Spanspeler, Skeppend, Vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk. Vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer. Stiptheid, Selfversekerd, Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Koördineer en ondersteun die opleiding van EPWP-deelnemers. (nie beperk tot DPWP-gefinansierde befondsing nie): Bestuur die indiening en verifikasie van opleidingsaansoeke van sektore en openbare liggame oor alle fere van regering. Dien die opleidingsaansoeke voor by die EPWP-goedkeurings- en opleidingskomitee vir goedkeuring. Bestuur die voorbereidingsproses van die opleidings d.w.s. logistieke vergaderings, openbare liggaam-gereedheid, opleidingsverskaffers se gereedheid en lyskontrole van die plek. Monitor die opleidingsprestasie om goeie gehalte te verseker. Profileer die EPWP-opleidingsintervensies. Voer opleidingsgeleenthede uit. Bestuur opleidingsrekords volgens die vasgestelde riglyne. Verseker nakoming aan die Paper Trail System-vereistes. Koördineer en verteenwoordig EPWP in opleidingsforums. Neem deel aan EPWP-opleidingsprojekte soos versoek b.v. navorsingstudies. Ondersteun EPWP-sektore in opleidingsintervensies: - Ondersteun openbare liggame met bystand by hul eie gefinansierde opleiding soos versoek. Verskaf ondersteun aan aanbestedingsprosesse soos versoek. Verskaf ondersteuning aan opleidingsverskaffers by eise. Verifieer opleidingsverskaffers se eise. Reageer op ouditversoeke en implementeer besluite van opleidingsouditte in die provinsie. Interveneer en los uitdagings verwant aan opleiding op. Ontwikkel en behou goeie verhoudings met belanghebbendes. Onderhou belanghebbende verhoudings. Koördineer EPWP-verslagdoening van opleidingsprestasie en monitor data-integriteit binne die provinsie: - Verseker nakoming aan die verslagdoeningsriglyne. Dien bewysdokumente vereis om opleiding bereik te bevestig. Analiseer EPWP-opleidingsprestasie data op ‘n deurlopende basis om te verseker dat gestelde teiken bereik word. Berei prestasieverslae voor vir verskeie belanghebbendes en forums soos vereis. Interveneer en ondersteun openbare liggame ten opsigte van verslagdoeningsuitdagings oor Opleiding. Ondersteun en hou toezig oor intervensies om datakwaliteit te verseker. Fasiliteer as ‘n afrigter by EPWP-opleidingsintervensies: - Fasiliteer as ‘n afrigter by geselekteerde opleidingsprogramme. Bestuur die subdirektoraat: Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis. Bestuur prestasie volgens die vasgestelde riglyne. Vestig en onderhou toepaslike interne beheer om etiese gedrag te verseker volgens die vasgestelde vereistes d.w.s. Gedragskode, PFMA-voorskryfte ens. om aan prestasieverwagtinge te voldoen. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling van ondergeskikte werknemers. Vestig, implementeer en onderhou doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasieprotokolle in die Eenheid wat maksimum benutting en produktiwiteit van personeel in die Eenheid verseker. Stel al die vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit volgens die vasgestelde voorskryfte in. Kwaliteitsbeheer die werk wat deur ondergeskikte werknemers gelewer word. Bestuur en monitor die toegewysde begrotings. Interveneer en spreek uitdagings aan. Bestuur die opleiding van EPWP-deelnemers nie beperk tot NDPW-bronbefondsing nie. Konsolideer opleidingsbehoeftes vir die provinsie deur skakeling met sektore en implementerende openbare liggame oor die fere van regering. Konsolideer, dien in en bied die provinsiale opleidingsaansoeke voor en verseker goedkeuring daarvan. Hou logistieke vergaderings ter voorbereiding van opleiding om te verseker dat alle kontrakvoorskryfte nagekom word en verseker dat opleiding wat in die provinsie verskaf word, voldoen aan die Training Operations Procedures Guidelines van die EPWP-opleiding. Verseker verskaffing van tegniese bystand aan openbare liggame en programme ten opsigte van EPWP-opleidingsintervensies nie beperk tot NDPW-gefinansierde befondsing nie. Verseker dat opleidingsverskaffers aan ouditvereistes voldoen en besluite van ouditte verwant aan EPWP-opleiding in die provinsie implementeer. Bestuur die begroting wat aan die streek toegewys is vir opleiding van EPWP-deelnemers. Konsolideer opleidingsbehoeftes en bepaal die provinsiale begrotingstoekenning. Fasiliteer as ‘n Projekbestuurder in Voorsieningskettingbestuur die proses van opleidingsverskaffers. Stel provinsiale opleidingsvorderingsverslae op en bied dit voor oor die huidige vordering van besteding en beskikbare begroting. Ondersteun opleidingsverskaffers met die verwerking van eise vir goedkeuring en betalings en verseker verslagdoening van begroting en besteding. Bestuur die aanbesteding van opleidingsverskaffers en bestuur en ondersteun opleidingsverskaffers oor kontraktuele aangeleenthede. Stel provinsiale opleidingsvorderingsverslag op en verseker dat opleidingsdata aan die EPWP-verslagdoeningstelsel gerapporteer word. Onderhou en bestuur die EPWP-opleidingseenheid in die Streek. Verseker nakoming aan die vereistes van die Performance Management Development System (PMDS) d.w.s. indiening en ondertekening van werksplanne en assesserings. Verskaf leiding en rigting aan Assistent Direkteurs wat verantwoordelik is vir opleidingskoördinasie. Bestuur die koördinasie en verskaffing van EPWP-leerprogramme en enige ander personeelkapasiteitsbouprogramme. Verseker kapasiteitsbou van personeel in die Eenheid.

zu.title: Isiphathamandla: Abaphathi Bokuqeqesha (EPWP)
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isiphathamandla Somphathi Wokuqeqesha eGqeberha Regional Office ukuqondisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabathathi nxaxheba be-EPWP kuzo zonke izinga zahulumeni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zethatu zeminyaka esikoleni esiphakeme (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma ku-Human Resources Development/ Human Resource Management/ Public Administration / Public Management/ Behavioural Sciences/ Sociology/Psychology / Education. Unyaka obalulekile wemvelo enkampanini yokuqondisa nokuphatha ukuqeqeshwa nokuqhakambisa izikhulezo ezingeni eliphansi lokulawula (okulingana noMsiziwoMqondisi). Ilayisense lokushayela okusemthethweni. Ukwazi ukuzijwayeza kahle ukuba uhambe kakhulu. Ukubekezela ekushintsheni wonkamuke yomsebenzi ngokwezidingo zofisi namahora amade okusebenza. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokulawula izinkantolo zesigaba, ukwenza kuhle izinhlangano zomphakathi, ukuphatha imiklamo, izifundo zokuqhuba imisebenzi, ukuphatha izinkulumo-mlando, ukuphatha izintambo zokulethwa kwezimpahla, nemiqondo yokuthenga imithetho. Amakhono; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuqeqesha nokubhala, ukuvakatshela, ukubhala ngokusemthethweni, ukuphatha imali, ukuphatha imiklamo yokusebenza. I-ETD nezimo zokukhuliswa kakhono okuhlanganisa ulwazi nge-SETA, ulwazi lokuqeqesha emva kwesikole, imikhuba ye-South African national strategy kanye nokwakha izikhundla ezinde, imikhuba nemiqondo edingekayo ekwenziweni kokukhuliswa kwamakhono. Isu leSouth African National Human Resource Development. Ukwenza kuhle izinkulumo zokuqeqeshwa, ukulungiselela izinto nokuqamba izinto ezindalo. Ukuma ukusebenza kwe-EPWP, amapheshana e-EPWP nemiyalo yokubizwa abantu abafuna umsebenzi kuso. Umthetho ohlobene nokuqhuba amaphilo emisebenzi ohlanganisa isimiso se-Skills Development Act, izinkulumo ezenziwe nguNgqongqoshe, Employment Equity Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, izinkulumo-mlando. Isimiso sokukhokha emthethweni, Public Finance Management Act, Further Education and Training Act, Adult Basic Education and Training Act, National Recognition of Prior Learning Policy, ukwenza kuhle izinhlangano zomphakathi. Kufanele ube nakhono okuhle bokuhlela nokuhlanganisa izinto. Ukuqeqesha nokuyisa emhlabeni, ukuxhumana nabantu, ukwakha amaqembu, ukwenza izinqumo, ukubhala ngokusemthethweni nokuhlakanipha imithetho. Izinto zobuuntu: Ukuzuza izinsiza, ukuba yilungu elihle leqembu, ukuba nomqondo onzima, ukwazi ukusebenza ezimeni ezinzima. Ukukwazi ukuzwakalisa imibono noma imicabango kuzo zonke izinga. Ukufika ngesikhathi, ukuba bukhali, ukwazi ukuzisebenzela.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi usekele ukuqeqeshwa kwabathathi nxaxheba be-EPWP. (akukhawulelwe kumali etholakala kwi-DPWI): Phatha ukuthunyelwa nokuqinisekiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphuma emapheshaneni nakumzimba kahulumeni kwazo zonke izinga. Yisa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ekuqeqeshweni kwesigaba se-EPWP Training Committee ukuze zitholwe. Phatha inqubo yokulungiselela ukuqeqesha okuyithi izingxoxo mayelana nezimpahla, ukulungelelana komzimba kahulumeni, ukulungelelana kwabalekeleli bokuqeqesha, nokuqinisekisa izindawo. Qapha inkambu yokuqeqeshwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga elihle. Yenza isibonelo ngenhlobonhlobo ye-EPWP training. Yenza izikhathi zokuqeqesha. Phatha izibhalo zokuqeqesha njengakuko kumyalo othi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho ye-Paper Trail System. Qondisa futhi ube ngumuntu we-EPWP eminhlanganweni yokuqeqesha. Ngenxa kwezinhlelo ze-EPWP training njengoba kucelwe okuyithi ucwaningo lobuchwepheshe. Sekela amapheshana e-EPWP ekule imisebenzi: Sekela umzimba kahulumeni mayelana nesinxibelelo kumali abayikhokhela bhedayo ekule nto njengoba kucelwe. Nikeza isinxibelelo ekule imigudu yokuqeqesha njengoba kucelwe. Sekela abalekeleli bokuqeqesha ekushayweni kwamaphedi. Qinisekisa amaphedi wokuqeqesha abalekeleli bokuqeqesha. Phendula izinto zokuqinisekiswa i-audit futhi usebenzise izinqumo ezenziwe kule ngoxhaso lwe-audit. Sangana futhi uqonde izingqinamba nokuqeqeshwa. Yenza ulwe ukuba nahle kakhulu nalabo abanomthelela. Yiza futhi uphathe ukuba bahle nabantu abanomthelela. Qondisa ukubika ngemisebenzi ezenziwe esifundeni ngomsebenzi ohlelekile: Qinisekisa ukuthobela imitheth yokubika. Thumela izibhalo ezocacisa izinto ezenziwe. Hlaziya njalo imininingwane yokusebenza ukuze kubone ukuthi kufeziwe njengoba kuhleliwe. Hlenga amabhudi emisebenzi ahanjiswa nalabo abanomthelela. Sangana futhi usekele umzimba kahulumeni ekubeni nazo izingqinamba zokubika. Sekela futhi uqaphele ukwenziwa kuhle imininingwane egqitshisiwe. Yenza isikhulumi esikhulu sokuthi kube yisikhulumi ohlelweni: Yenza isikhulumi ohlelweni lwokuqeqesha olukhethiwe. Phatha ukulandelwa kwemisebenzi: Phathe isu lokusebenza futhi ulandele ukuba sekuphi futhi kube nokuhamba kwento. Phatha imisebenzi njengoba kushiwo. Sika futhi uphathe izinhlelo zokuqondisa ngaphakathi ezizokwenza ukuba abantu basebenze kahle ngokomthetho njengoba kushiwo i-Code of Conduct, PFMA prescripts njnj. ukuze kuzuze lokho okulindele ukuba kwenzeke. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Sika futhi uphatle izindlela ezikala ngokusetshenziswa namandla okuqinisekisa abantu basebenza kulesi simo sethu singenele ngakho konke okumele kwenzeke. Hlela bhedayo yazo zonke izibhalo eziyimfuneko futhi uzenze njengakumthetho wokulawula. Qinisekisa izinga lemininingwane ebhalwe ngabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Phathe futhi uphathe imali abayinikezayo bhedayo. Qondisa futhi ulungise izingqinamba. Phatha ukuqeqeshwa kwabathathi nxaxheba be-EPWP nangale koqeqesho oluxhaswa yi-NDPW. Sondela izidingo zokuqeqesha esifundeni ngokuxhumana namapheshana futhi umzimba kahulumeni oqeqeshwa ohole kulo wonke umzimba kahulumeni. Sondela ukuhlanganisa nokubika futhi uziphathe kulesi sifunda ukuthi bathole amandla okuqeqesha abo. Yenza imihlangano yokulunga izinto ngaphambi kokuqeqesha qinisekisa ukuthi konke okwenziwe njengakumthetho nokukwenza kuhle ukuthi lokhu okusebenza njengakumthetho kuhambisana nokuqeqeswa kwe-EPWP. Qinisekisa ukuba nabantu abalekele abalekeleli bokuqeqesha emigudwini ye-EPWP. Qinisekisa ukuthi abalekeleli bathobela imithetho ye-audit basebenzise izinqumo ze-audit ohlelweni lokuqeqesha esifundeni. Hlela imali eznikezwa lesi sifunda ukuze kusetshenziswe ukuqeqesha abathathi nxaxheba be-EPWP. Sondela izidingo zokuqeqesha futhi usize ngokusabela kokuphathwa kwemali. Yenza njengomphathi wakulesi simo mayelana nezinkontileka neze-SCM. Sondela bhedayo yemibiko yokuhamba kokuqeqesha esifundeni nokuthi kufinyelelwa ema-audi. Sekela abalekeleli bokuqeqesha ekubhalweni futhi babambe iqhaza kwemali etholwa bhedayo. Phatha ukuthathwa kwabalekeleli bokuqeqesha futhi uphathe futhi usekele abalekeleli bokuqeqesha emisebenzini yabo. Yenza uphathe imibiko yokuhamba kokusebenza esifundeni futhi ube ngumuntu obhale le mimininingwane emshinini we-EPWP. Buka ngokuqaphela futhi uphathe inqaba yokuqeqesha e-EPWP esifundeni. Qinisekisa ukuba mzele imithetho yesi-Performance Management Development System (PMDS). Nikeza isiqondiso phakathi futhi ubakhulule oMsiziwoMqondisi ekulawuleni ukuqeqeshwa. Qondisa ukuhlelwa nokunikezwa kwezinhlelo zokufunda i-EPWP nezinye izinhlela zokwakha abantu. Qinisekisa ukwakha amandla abantu basebenza kulesi.

xh.title: Isekela leenkosi: Umphathi weZiquko (EPWP)
xh.summary: Kufuneka isekela leenkosi somphathi weziquko kwiOfisi yeSithili sase Gqeberha ukulungiselela eziquko zabathathi nxaxheba kwi-EPWP kuzo naziphi na iindawo karhulumente.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-tertiary seminyaka emithathu ubuncinane (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwi-Human Resources Development/ Human Resource Management/ Public Administration / Public Management / Behavioural Sciences/ Sociology/Psychology / Education. Iimvelo zolwazi ezisebenzayo kwindawo yoLungiselelwa kuqeqesho nasekuPhuhliseni amakhono kunye noLawulo kwinqanaba lolawulo lwasemandulo (elingana ne-Assistant Director). Ilayisenesi yokushayela esemthethweni. Kulungele ukuhamba kakhulu. Avulekile ekuguquguqukelwa kwishejuli yomsebenzi ngokwemfuneko yeofisi nakuwo wonke amaxesha amade osebenzayo. Ulwazi ngeenqobo zamasila e-Disciplinary and Dispute Resolution procedures, i-Social Facilitation, i-Project Management, i-Developmental Studies, i-Contract Management, i-Supply Chain Management neenqobo zokuthenga. Amakhono; i-Computer Literacy, uLungiselelwa nokuHlela, ukuSombulula iingxaki, ukuQeqesha nakho okuBonakalisa, ukuThetha, ukuBala iingxelo, uLawulo lweMali, ukuXoxwa ngokwenzo i-Performance Management. Indawo ye-ETD nokuPhuhlisa amakhono kuquka ulwazi nge-SETA, ulwazi loQeqesho lwangemva kweSikolo, i-National Skills Development Strategy neenqobo, iziquko, iinkqubo ngeenqobo ezimalana nolawulo lokuphuhlisa amakhono. I-National Human Resource Development Strategy. Ukuqeqesha, ukuphuhlisa izinto zokufunda nakho okuPhuhlisa iinkqubo. Ubuwo nokusebenza kwe-EPWP, iisektheyithi ze-EPWP nokuQeqeswa okuchanekileyo kwabasebenzi nge-EPWP. Iframework elawulayo enxulumene nophuhliso lwe-HR kuquka i-Skills Development Act, i-Ministerial Determination, i-Employment Equity Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, i-Labour Relations Act, nezivumelwano zobunye. I-Code of Remuneration naye-Public Finance Management Act, i-Further Education and Training Act, i-Adult Basic Education and Training Act, i-Adult Basic Education and Training Act, i-National Recognition of Prior Learning Policy, ukuqhuba izinto ngokwendalo nokusebenzisana. Kufuneka abe nophawu lokulungiselela nokuHlela amakhono. UkuQeqesha nokubonisa, ukuThetha nabantu, ukuSunga iqela, ukuThatha isigqibo, ukubala iingxelo nakho okuPhicoza iinkqubo zamakhono. Iimpawu zabantu: Unobumba, Ukudlala njengeseti, ukuQamba, ukuKwazi ukusebenza iingxaki ezinxulumene nokugqitha. UkuKwazi ukuthetha nawo onke amanqanaba. Ukufika ngexesha, ukuQinisekisa, ukuKwazi ukusebenza kodwa.
xh.duties: Lungiselela nokuNxiba ekubeni nika inkxaso ekuqeqeshweni kwabathathi nxaxheba kwi-EPWP. (akukho mda kumtyholo wemali evela kwi-DPWI): Lawula ungeniso nokuqinisekisa iindlela zokuqeqesha evela kumacandlo nakubakarhulumente kuwo onke amanqanaba karhulumente. Bonisa izicelo zokuqeqesha ekuQeqesweni kwesigqibo se-EPWP ngenjongo zokuqinisekisa. Lawula iinkqubo zokuLungiselela ukuqeqesha, umzekelo: iindibano ezingokwemigaqo, ulungiselelo lukaKarhulumente, ulungiselelo lababoneleliokuqeqesha nokukhangela iindawo. Qwalasela isimbozo esihle sokuqeqesha ukuze kuqiniseke ixabiso elimhle. Dlala indima ekuqeqeshweni kwamanyathelo athintela i-EPWP. Qhuba iinkqubo zokuqeqesha. Lawula iirekhodi zokuqeqesha ngokwemigaqo equluniweyo. Qinisekisa ukuzalathiswa kweenkqubo ze-Paper Trail System. Lungiselela nokuMela i-EPWP kumagumbi eendibano zokuqeqesha. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphulo okuqeqesha i-EPWP njengokoceliweyo, umz. izifundo zophando. Nikela inkxaso kumacandlo e-EPWP kumanyathelo okuqeqesha: - Nikela abakarhulumente ngenkxaso kwimizabo yabo yokuqeqesha ngezimali ezibonelelayo njengoko cela. Nikela inkxaso kweinkqubo zokuthenga njengoko cela. Nikela inkxaso kwaboneleli bokuqeqesha xa becelela. Qinisekisa iimbeko zaboneleli bokuqeqesha. Phendisa izicelo zokuqinisekisa ukuze uske kwisebe apho igqithiswa kulo igumbi. Thatha inxaxheba kwaye ulungise izicuku ezenziwa ngabasebenzi bokulawula ukuba kungabikho nto yonke into ebe ikho kwindawo yokugqibela ukulawula okanye nangexesha lokuze kusetyenziswe. Phuhlisa ngononophelo ulunjiselwano nabalawuli bomphakathi. Gcina ulunjiselwano nalabo bakarhulumente. Lungiselela iingxelo ze-EPWP ngenkathazo yokuqinisekisa iindaba ezichanekileyo kwiphondo: - Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemigaqo yokubika. Ngenisa amaxwebhu obungqina afunekayo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba kugqityiwe okuqeqeshwa. Hlaziya iingxelo ze-EPWP ngokokuqhubekayo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba iinjongo ezibekekileyo zifinyelelwe. Lungiselela iingxelo ngenkathazo kubamlinyi kunye nokuze kusetyenziswe kwamagumbi. Thatha inxaxheba kwaye unike inkxako kubakarhulumente malunga nesibuxuku sokubikwa kokulungiselelwa ukusebenza kwe-EPWP. Gcina ulunjiselwano nabaninigqi. Lawula iinkqubo ezikhokelwa ngumphathi ongqongqoshe ngokomthetho wokuqeqesha abasebenzi kwiphondo: - Qinisekisa ukuba balinganiselwa imigaqo yokubika. Nikela inkxaso ngexesha lokubakho isibuxuku kwabantu abalawulayo kwimigaqo ebuzwa kwindawo yokulawula abasebenzi ngokwemigaqo ephezulu. Lawula iindawo ezithunyelwa kwithuba elifanelekileyo lokubakho iingxaki kwiziko kwindawo ekufuneka kuhlengwe kuyo. Lungisa iingxaki ezikwindawo. Hlola ukuba kukho ulwazi kubasebenzi abangeneleyo kwinkqubo yokubakho ubulumko nobugcisa bokuza kubakho ingxaki.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Property Disposal (REMS)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Property Disposal position at the Cape Town Regional Office requiring a diploma or law degree, offering R605 742 per annum.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Real Estate Management, Law Degree or related field of study. Relevant years of experience in the field. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge: Public Finance Management Act. Financial administration. Procurement directives and procedures. Programme and project planning. Reporting procedures. Giamadisposal Act. Deeds. Registry Act. Financial Assistance Land Act (FALA) BBBEE. Treasury Regulations. Computer literacy. Skills: Report writing. Accounts and numeric skills. Analytical thinking. Communication skills. Interpersonal skills. Problem solving skills. Organising and planning. Goal and solution orientated. Assertiveness. People and client orientated. Innovative. Ability to work under stressful conditions. Hard working. Ability to communicate at all levels. Must be prepared to travel. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with office requirements.
jobs.duties: Implement and maintain property management policies, procedures and strategies: Implement and maintain property management policies, procedures and frameworks. Provide guidance on compliance with related prescripts, delegations and procedures. Communicate all property management policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders. Co-ordinate the disposal process of redundant and superfluous residential properties: Provide guidance on the process of identifying redundant and superfluous residential properties to be disposed of. Co-ordinate and facilitate the identification process of redundant and superfluous residential properties. Conduct inspections to determine status/conditions of redundant and superfluous residential properties. Co- ordinate the release process of vacant surplus land parcels to achieve Government Land Reform objectives: (Restitution, Distribution, Human Settlements development) Co-ordinate and facilitate the process of identifying vacant surplus land parcels to be released. Verify ownership status of identified vacant surplus land parcels to be released. Co-ordinate the release process of vacant surplus land parcels to achieve Government Land Reform objectives: - (Restitution, Distribution, Human Settlements development) Co-ordinate and facilitate the process of identifying vacant surplus land parcels to be released. Verify ownership status of identified vacant surplus land parcels to be released. Contribute towards enhancing effective and efficient state property management: (Conveyancing and disposal from PMIS) Co-ordinate and facilitate gathering of original conveyance and transfer documentation. Ensure delivery of instructions to the Office of the State Attorney. Accept draft Power of Attorney and transfer documents from Office of the State Attorney in preparation for Delegated Authority to sign. Supervise employees to ensure an effective service delivery.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. D Gqibela Tel No: (021) 402 2315
jobs.applications: Email applications for this position must be email to: RecruitCPT26- 64@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

Relevante jare ervaring in die veld. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet. Finansiële administrasie. Aankoopriglyne en prosedures. Program- en projekbeplanning. Ukuhlela amaphrogramu namaphrojekthi. Izinqubo zokubika. Giamadisposal Act. Izibhalo. Registry Act. Financial Assistance Land Act (FALA) BBBEE. Treasury Regulations. jobs.title: Administration Officer: Prestige Parliamentary Precinct
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Administrative officer providing support to the Prestige Directorate at the Parliamentary Precinct, coordinating meetings, maintaining records and preparing documentation.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Public Administration/Public Management or related qualification. Relevant years of work experience in administrative or operational support. Valid driver license. Computer literacy (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook). Administrative and organising skills, Good written and verbal communication, Record-keeping and document management, Stakeholder liaison, Problem-solving abilities. Knowledge of Government regulatory framework, Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act, Departmental strategic goals and objectives and service delivery programmes, Public Finance Management, Public Service Regulation, Public Service Act, National Minimum Information Requirement, Regulations of the National Archives and records Service of South Africa Act and related records management processes, Archive standards and procedures.
jobs.duties: Provide administrative support to the Prestige Directorate With regard to the Parliamentary Precinct in terms of co-ordinating meetings: Prepare meeting notices, agendas, and documentation packs. Record and distribute minutes and action items. Maintain a register of resolutions and decisions. Coordinate logistical arrangements for bi-lateral meetings. Maintain proper filing systems (electronic and manual). Support communication and liaison processes between the client department, the South African Police Service, and relevant stakeholders: Draft routine correspondence and stakeholder communication. Maintain updated contact databases of the clients and stakeholders. Coordinate submission and tracking of queries and service requests. Assist with the parking administration and record keeping of the parking areas pertinent to the Parliamentary Precinct. Assist with preparation of reports and briefing documents. Supports financial record-keeping and compliance processes in line with Treasury and audit requirements: Track implementation of resolutions pertinent to specific meeting. Liaise with client regarding day-to- day maintenance calls logged. Liaise with Service Providers on work in progress as well as completed calls logged. Do routine site inspections of the Precinct daily. Send out communication alerts as and when required.
jobs.enquiries: Ms B Manuel Tel No: (021) 402 2139

af.title: Administrasiebeampte: Prestige Parlementêre Precint
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte wat ondersteuning bied aan die Prestige-direktoraat by die Parlementêre Precint, vergaderings koördineer, rekorde onderhou en dokumentasie voorberei.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Publieke Administrasie/Publieke Bestuur of verwante kwalifikasie. Relevante jare se werkervaring in administratiewe of operasionele ondersteuning. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, en Outlook). Administratiewe en organisasievaardighede, goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie, rekordhouding en dokumentbestuur, belanghebbende-skakeling, probleemoplossingsvermoëns. Kennis van die reguleringsraamwerk van die Regering, Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act, departementale strategiese doelwitte en doelstellings en diensleweringprogramme, Public Finance Management, Public Service Regulation, Public Service Act, National Minimum Information Requirement, Regulations of the National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act en verwante rekordbestuurprosesse, argiefstandaarde en prosedures.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Prestige-direktoraat met betrekking tot die Parlementêre Precint in terme van die koördinering van vergaderings: Berei vergaderingskennisgewings, agenda's, en dokumentasiepakkie voor. Neem en versprei notules en aksiepunte. Onderhou 'n register van besluite en beslissings. Koördineer logistiese reëlings vir bilaterale vergaderings. Onderhou behoorlike lêerstelsels (elektronies en handmatig). Ondersteun kommunikasie- en skakelingsprosesse tussen die kliëntdepartement, die South African Police Service, en relevante belanghebbendes: Opstel van roetine-korrespondensie en belanghebbende-kommunikasie. Onderhou bygewerkte kontakdatabasisse van die kliënte en belanghebbendes. Koördineer die indiening en naspeuring van navrae en diensversoeke. Bied bystand met die parkeeradministrasie en rekordhouding van die parkeerplekke wat verband hou met die Parlementêre Precint. Bied bystand met die voorbereiding van verslae en briefingsdokumente. Ondersteun finansiële rekordhouding en nakomingsprosesse in ooreenstemming met Tesourie- en ouditvereistes: Hou die implementering van besluite rakende spesifieke vergaderings dop. Skakel met kliënt rakende daaglikse instandhoudingsoproepe wat aangeteken is. Skakel met diensverskaffers oor werk in uitvoering asook voltooide oproepe wat aangeteken is. Doen daagliks roetine-terreinsiens van die Precint. Stuur kommunikasiewaarskuwings uit soos en wanneer benodig.

zu.title: Onogwazi Bobuphathi: Prestige Parliamentary Precinct
zu.summary: Onogwazi bobuphathi abalekelela i-Prestige Directorate e-Parliamentary Precinct, oqukethe imihlangano, egcina amarekhodi futhi alungise imibhalo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokuba ngaphakathi kweminyaka emithathu sesikoleni samabanga aphezulu (NQF Level 06) / i-National Diploma ku-Public Administration/Public Management noma izifundo ezihambisana nalo. Eminyakeni ethile yokuqashelwa ukusebenza ekulekeni izindaba zentengiso noma ezenzakalo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, kanye ne-Outlook). Amakhono obuphathi kanye nalokho ukuhlela ukuthi kuhamba kanjani, ukubhala nokuthetha kahle, ukugcina amarekhodi nokuqamba imibhalo, ukuxhumana nabantu abathintekayo, kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi ngohlelo lomthetho kahulumeni, i-Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act, amagcapheka nokuqonda imigomo yesikhungo kanye nezinhloso zalo kanye namaphrogramu wokulekelela abantu, i-Public Finance Management, i-Public Service Regulation, i-Public Service Act, i-National Minimum Information Requirement, kanye nohlelo lwemithetho ye-National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act neminye imikhakha yokugcina imibhalo, kanye namazinga okugcina imibhalo kahle.
zu.duties: Nikeza usizo kubaphathi be-Prestige Directorate ngokuphathelene ne-Parliamentary Precinct ngokuqamba imihlangano; Lungelela izaziso zomhlangano, izinhlelo zomhlangano, kanye namaphakethe emibhalo. Qamba futhi wabelane ngeziminithi kanye nezinhloso ezenziwayo. Gcina ukubhalisela izinqumo kanye nezibopho ezitholakala emhlanganweni. Hlela yonke imisebenzi ehilelekile imihlangano emibili. Gcina uhlelo lokubhalisa (ngesesekhadi nangokushaya ngokuthi kubhalwe). Londe imisebenzi yokuxhumana kanti futhi kubaluleke ukuba uyisekele ekuxhumene nomnyango ohlanganyelwa, i-South African Police Service, naba bantu abathintekayo; Bala imibhalo edingekayo kanti futhi uthumele abantu abathintekayo. Gcina namathuna olwazi atholakalo ngemithetho kahulumeni ohlinzeka ngemitshina yokugcina amafayela. Hlela nokuthi kwenzeke ukulandwa kokuphendulwa kwemibuzo kanti futhi nesithakazelo sezinsizakalo ezifunekayo. Siza ukulawula amaphaki namaphaki atholakala endaweni ye-Parliamentary Precinct. Siza ekuhleleni imibhalo yokubika kanti futhi nesidumbu sokubika. Siza ekugcineni izinkomba zokusenukela imali ekugcineni kokuhanjiswa kwemithetho yokubeka imali ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ze-Treasury nokuqashwa kwemali; Landela ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumo ngokuphathelene nomhlangano othize. Yiba nentsimi kubantu abayiklayenti ngosuku nosuku ngosuku ngokulungiswa izinto eziye zaphuka. Yiba nentsimi nabahlinzeki ngemisebenzi eqhubekayo futhi nangalawo osekupelile. Yenza okuhlola okujwayelekile i-Precinct nsuku zonke. Thumela izaziso ezibekiwe zokwazisa ngaleyo ndlela okudingekayo.

xh.title: Iofisa Kolulo: iPrestige Parliamentary Precinct
xh.summary: Iofisa kolulo loncedo olunikezela inkxaso kwiPrestige Directorate eParliamentary Precinct, elihlanganisela iindibano, eligcina irekhodi neluqwalasela amaxwebhu.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esingaphantsi kweminyaka emithathu sesikolo sesithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwiPublic Administration/Public Management okanye isiqinisekiso esinxulumene nalo. Iiminyaka efanelekileyo yamava emsebenzini kwinkxaso yolawulo okanye yensebenzo. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, kwaye Outlook). Amandla kolawulo nokuqhubeleka phambili, Incoko ebhalwayo nethethwayo elungileyo, Ukugcina irekhodi nolawulo lwamaxwebhu, Unxibelelwano nabanomdla, Amandla okuxazulula iingxaki. Ulwazi ngolawulo lokusebenza karhulumente, iMinimum Information Security Standards (MISS) Act, iinjongo nemiqondiso yesebe nemiqathango yoluleko, iPublic Finance Management, iPublic Service Regulation, iPublic Service Act, iNational Minimum Information Requirement, iRegulations of the National Archives and records Service of South Africa Act nakuqhubeka ngokulawula iirekhodi, iindalo zoluhlu namanyathelo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwiPrestige Directorate ngokubalene neParliamentary Precinct ngokwokuhlanganisa iindibano: Lungiselela izaziso zendibano, iajenda, namaphakethe amaxwebhu. Qamba aze wabelwe ngamaminethi nangemisebenzi ekufuneka yenziwe. Gcina irekhodi lezigqibo nemigqibo. Hlanganisela izicwangciso zolawulo lweendibano ezibini. Gcina indlela efanelekileyo yoku bhala kwangexesha (ngekhompyutha nangesandla). Yenza inkxaso kumanyathelo onxibelelwano nokuqhagamshelana phakathi kwisebe labathengi, iSouth African Police Service, nabanomdza abathintekayo: Qamba iindaba ezithi zibhale rhoqo nalonxibelelwano nabomdza. Gcina idathabhesi egqithisiweyo yothungelwano labathengi nabanomdza. Hlanganisela ukunikezelwa nokulandela imibuzo nezacelo zenkonzo. Nceda kolawulo lokuqwayiba nokugcina irekhodi kwizitho zokuqwayiba eziphathelene neParliamentary Precinct. Nceda kolungiselelo lweengxelo namaxwebhu okuvisisana. Yenza inkxaso kwigcinwa lifa lezimali namanyathelo obungathembeki ngokuvisisana neTreasury nemiqathelo yokuhlola: Landela ukuphunyezwa kwezigqibo eziphathelene nendibano ethile. Unxibelelane nabathengi ngokumalana nabafundi behlangothi lonke abangabizwa kwangemini. Unxibelelane neenkonzo zabahlinzeki ngokumalana nesebenzi esaqhubeka nalabo obubizwe okuqedywe. Yenza ikuhlolo okwemihla le kwindawo kaqobo kaqobo. Thumela izaziso zokunxibelelana nxa kuyimfuneko.

jobs.summary: Administration officer needed to manage official accommodation allocation for MPs at the Cape Town Regional Office, requiring a public management diploma and relevant experience.

Relevant years of experience in public administration or property management field. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge: Public Finance Management Act; Treasury regulations; Government budget procedures / timeframes; Project management; Financial administration processes and systems; Procurement directives and procedures; Tender procedures. Skills: Professional client relations; Effective communication skills; Advanced report writing skills; Computer literacy; Planning and organizing; Diplomacy skills; Interpersonal skills; Presentation skills. Personal Attributes: Hardworking; Self-motivated; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to communicate at all levels; Analytical thinking. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with office requirements.

Receive and capture accommodation requests and process submissions for allocation. Conduct property inspections prior occupation and eviction by the tenant to determine the condition of the property and report defects / negligence. Follow up on occupant’s allocations or evictions. Verify Sessional Officials per Department and ensure confirmation of eligible status. Conduct regular property occupation verifications and update Parliamentary Villages occupancy lists. Ensure record of occupancy is updated regularly and inform Finance Section of any movements to ensure billing is up to date. Facilitate access control and screening of visitors within prestige facilities. Log and attend to all logged calls by tenants regarding day-to-day maintenance and minor repairs and keep client and relevant colleagues updated on progress until completion of work. Follow-up and liaise with the Facilities Management Contractor on work to be executed. Ensure proactive identification of matters requiring attention within the facility and report for work to be executed. Provide movable and immovable assets administration. Assist with appointments and access for asset verification and the barcoding of new assets. Co-ordinate the movement of furniture. Ensure all administration related matters are kept up to date and accurate filing of documents, etc. General administrative duties. Regular communication with clients on all matters relating to the portfolio. Ensure stop orders are processed through the route for timeous processing. Process requests for approval of the bookings of the hall and other facilities. Liaise with Client Relations Manager in respect of transport requests from clients.

af.title: Administrasiebeampte: Prestige
af.summary: Administrasiebeampte benodig om amptelike akkommodasietoewysing vir LV's by die Kaapstad Streekskantoor te bestuur, wat 'n diploma in openbare bestuur en relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Public Management or related qualification. Relevant years of experience in public administration or property management field. A valid driver's license. Knowledge: Public Finance Management Act; Treasury regulations; Government budget procedures / timeframes; Project management; Financial administration processes and systems; Procurement directives and procedures; Tender procedures. Skills: Professional client relations; Effective communication skills; Advanced report writing skills; Computer literacy; Planning and organizing; Diplomacy skills; Interpersonal skills; Presentation skills. Personal Attributes: Hardworking; Self-motivated; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to communicate at all levels; Analytical thinking. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with office requirements.
af.duties: Facilitate the allocation of official accommodation for Members of Parliament (MPs) and Sessional Officials. Identify and verify vacant accommodation and ensure adequate preparation. Receive and capture accommodation requests and process submissions for allocation. Conduct property inspections prior occupation and eviction by the tenant to determine the condition of the property and report defects / negligence. Follow up on occupant's allocations or evictions. Verify Sessional Officials per Department and ensure confirmation of eligible status. Conduct regular property occupation verifications and update Parliamentary Villages occupancy lists. Ensure record of occupancy is updated regularly and inform Finance Section of any movements to ensure billing is up to date. Facilitate access control and screening of visitors within prestige facilities. Log and attend to all logged calls by tenants regarding day-to-day maintenance and minor repairs and keep client and relevant colleagues updated on progress until completion of work. Follow-up and liaise with the Facilities Management Contractor on work to be executed. Ensure proactive identification of matters requiring attention within the facility and report for work to be executed. Provide movable and immovable assets administration. Assist with appointments and access for asset verification and the barcoding of new assets. Co-ordinate the movement of furniture. Ensure all administration related matters are kept up to date and accurate filing of documents, etc. General administrative duties. Regular communication with clients on all matters relating to the portfolio. Ensure stop orders are processed through the route for timeous processing. Process requests for approval of the bookings of the hall and other facilities. Liaise with Client Relations Manager in respect of transport requests from clients.

zu.title: Offisa Wezokuphathwa: Prestige
zu.summary: Kudingeka offisa wezokuphathwa ophethe okwabelwe abantu bakhulu abasemtsetfweni (MPs) kwiNdvana yeSifundza sase Cape Town, okudinga idiploma yokuphatwa kwabezpalamende kanye namava ahambisana nawo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokuncane se-Minimamu yeminyaka yezifundo ze-Tertiary (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma ePublic Management noma izifundo ezihambisana naleyo. Unyaka walwazi oluhambisana ekuphathweni koluntu noma ekuphathweni kwezimpahla. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Public Finance Management Act; Izilawulo ze-Treasury; Izinqubo / ithuba lesikhathi lebhajethi kahulumeni; Ukuphatwa kwephrojekthi; Iziphatho ezimalini nokuhamba kwezinhlelo; Iminqumo nokuhamba koku-thenga; Izinkqubo zoku-thengisa. Amakhono: Ubudlelwane obuhle nabathengi; Amakhono okuxhumana anempumelelo; Amakhono aphakeme okubhala imibiko; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukucubungula nokuhlela; Amakhono eDiplomasi; Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu; Amakhono okubamba izinkulumo. Izakhiwo zobuntu: Ukusebenza kanzima; Ukuqondisa ngokwakho; Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkundla; Ikhono lokuxhumana ngazo zonke izinga; Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuze ube nesikhathi sokwamukela uluhlu lokusebenza ngokwezidingo zofisi.
zu.duties: Kwenze ukubekwa kwezindlu ezimalini zabameli baseParliament (MPs) kanye neSesional Officials. Bathole futhi bahlole izindlu ezingangenwa bese qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa okuhle. Bamukele bese befaka izicelo zezindlu baze benze izincomi ukuze kubekwe abantu. Bafake izinsuku kuleyo kubekwa abahlali baze bakhulu bathole imali eshintshiwe eParliament; kufakwa izinsuku kusho imibhalo yesigqi yokubekwa kwendlu; kubhaliwe imibhalo yokuthi singakwazi ukuba singanakekela izimpahla zezindlu kodwa ukutholwa okudaliwe kubhaliwe ngqa. Balandele ukuthi kubekwe abantu kulesinsimu noma bakhishwe. Bahlola izinsuku zeSesional Officials seTikithi baze bahlole ukuthi bakhona yini noma yini ebelibekwe imingcele. Bahlola ngokuvamile ukuthi kubekwe abantu ema-Villages eParliament kanti bayaphinde bahlole izinsuku kubekwa abantu baseParliament. Bahlola ngokuvamile ukuba bakhona yini ema-Villages eParliament; bayaphinde bahlole izinkatha zezindlu ezingangenwa kwiVillage leParliament; bayaphinde bafake imininingwane yokuthi singenele singaphuma esimeni esihle ukubhaliswa kwabantu kanti kubhalwa futhi imibhalo yabo bese bezixwaya ngemali ehlukene. Basize ekuphathweni kokuqashwa kwendlu nokuqashwa kwemali ekugcineni. Bamukele babaqashwe baze bahlazo isigqi sokuhamba kwemali yezindlu bese behlazo imibhalo yeFayela leMali yaleMinyaka. Bahlinze nokuqashwa kwesigqi sokuhamba nokubekwa kwesibhali ema-Villages. Bamukele izinsuku ezinkulu ezibhalwe kwiFayela leMali yaleMinyaka ngaphezulu kweNkqubo yokubekwa kwabantu bakhulu baze bahlele abantu ukuba bahlole ukuthi bakhona yini. Bahlele ukuthi izimpahla zibe ngaphansi kwegunya. Bahlele inqubo yezimpahla ezisha zonke izinsuku. Bahle izinkathi ezinkulu ezikwazi ukugcina ukubhalwa kwabantu.

xh.title: IOfisa Ozelwe Iinkqubo Zolawulo: Prestige
xh.summary: Kufuneka kughunyazwe ofisa wolawulo wokusingatha ukwabiwa kwezindlu ezingokusemthethweni kwe-AmaMP eCape Town Regional Office, kufunelo ipiploma yolawulo loluntu nokhade lolunyelolwazi oluhambelana nalo.
xh.requirements: Iziqulatho ezingaphantsi kwamashumi amathathu eminyaka ezifundweni eziphakamileyo (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwi-Public Management okanye isiqu esinxulumene noku. Iiminyaka yolunye lolwazi ehambelana nolawulo loluntu okanye indlela yokulawula izimpahla. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi: I-Public Finance Management Act; Iirhregile zeTreasury; Iinkqubo/zixesha zebhajethi karhulumente; Ukulawula iiprojekthi; Iinkqubo nezixhobo zolawulo lweemali; Iindlela nemigaqo yokuthenga; Iinkqubo zethende. Amakhono: Ubudlelwane obungoomthunywa bobugcisa obungcalo; Amakhono othetho/nxibelelwano asebenzayo; Amakhono aphakamileyo okubhala iiripoti; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuqamba oluqhelanayo nokuhlela; Amakhono obudiplomatha; Amakhono obudlelwane nabantu; Amakhono okubonisa. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ukusebenza ngamandla; Ukuqhelanisa nokuzimisela; Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo; Ikhono lokuthetha kwazo zonke iinqanaba; Ukucinga ngokwahlukanisa. Kulungele ukutshintsha ijisha lokusebenza ngokomthetho wee funo zesebe.
xh.duties: Qhube umbutho wokwabiwa kwezindlu ezingokusemthethweni kubuLuntu bePalamente (MPs) nakubaBeambe beNqanaba leSeshoni. Qaphela kuqinisekise izindlu ezingasezantsi kwaye uqiniseke ukulungiselela okwaneleyo. Wamkele uze ugcine izicelo zokuhlala uze ucace iingeniselo zokuwaba. Qamba ooviko bezimpahla phantsi komhlaluthe ekubeni ingabakhi bendlu nokubakhiwa kwayo ukuze umishe isimo sempahla uze uxelo ngesi sakuzoyeka ngokungalunganga / ukungalungi. Landelela iindawo zabahlali okanye izikhupho. Qinisekisa abalambe beSeshoni ngokweSebe uze uqinisekise isimo esamkelekileyo. Yenza rhoqo ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlala kwempahla uze uhlaziye iintatho zokuhlala kwiParliamentary Villages. Qinisekisa ukuba urekhodi lokuhlala lihlaziwa rhoqo uze uxelele icandelo leMali ngesantya santo kwaye uqinisekise ukuba i-rhedi izakuhamba ngenyanga. Qhube ulawulo lokungena nokuqinisekisa abanjengiwe kwiindlu ezingezo ezigqibeleleyo ze-Prestige. Faka uze uphendule onke amacebo abakhi bendlu malunga nokulungiswa kwemihla ngemihla nokoqeqesho okuncinci uze ugcine abathunywa beethiyori namalungu ahlobeneyo abe sekulungiselelweni de kuphunywe kumsebenzi. Landela uze uncengcelele ngeContractor woLawulo lweZindlu ngomsebenzi okufuneka yenziwe. Qinisekisa ukumiswa ngaphambi koxa kubakho iziganeko ezifuna kuqatshelwa ngaphakathi kwendlu uze uxelele ukuba kwenziwe umsebenzi. Ziba iinkonzo zolawulo lempahla ehambahambayo nengahambahambayo. Ncedisa nokuqinisekiswa kwempahla ukubekwa kothumba kwempahla entsha. Lungiselela ukunyuka kwezinto. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iindaba ezinxulumene nolawulo zigcinwa zihlaziwe ngokuchanekileyo nokulungiselelwa koxando ngokuchanekileyo, njl. Imisebenzi yolawulo jikelele. Unxibelelwano rhoqo namathunywa kuzo zonke iindaba ezingomxholo. Qinisekisa ukuba i-stops orders zicutshungulwa ngendlela eqinisekisa ukuba kuya kubakho isixa esifanelekileyo esheshise. Hamba kumceli-mangalisane webhuki nakuwanye amagumbi okuba neminyhadala. Ncengcelela noMphathi weNxibelelwano namathunywa kumacango okuhamba.

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Eiendomonteiendheid
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte benodig by die Gqeberha Streekkantoor om eiendomonteiendheid te bestuur, terreininspeksies uit te voer en onteiendheidsverslae op te stel vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
af.requirements: Minstens 'n driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Real Estate Management, Property Law of verwante veld. Toepaslike jare se werkservaring binne 'n eiendombestuursomgewing. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Kennis van departementele beleide, prosedures en prosesse rakende die onteiendheid van State Immovable Assets sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Deeglike kennis en begrip van State Land Disposals Act, Government Immovable Asset Management Act, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Management, Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment. Supply Chain Management en treasury Regulations. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sprekend en skriftelik) en die vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer. Goeie analitiese, beplannings-, organisatoriese en finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Hoë vlakke van rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om binne 'n diverse span te werk, buiteure te werk en die gewilligheid om uitgebreid te reis is noodsaaklik.
af.duties: Doen navorsing om inligting te bekom vir die onteiendheid van eiendom en die samestelling van verslae. Voer terreininspeksies uit, berei inligting voor om by die Provincial State Land disposals and Vesting Committee (PSLDVC) aangebied te word ter ondersteuning van die onteiendheid van eiendom. Implementeer die onteiendheidsproses ten opsigte van eiendomskenking, servituut, opheffing van beperkende voorwaarde, langtermynhuur. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning by die regstelling van die eiendomeienaarskapsprobleem deur Land Reform. Skakel met Regional Land claims Commission om vir eise teen eiendom wat onteien moet word, te kontroleer. Berei voorleggings voor om instemming van Minister of Rural Development and Land Reform te verkry. Berei voorleggings voor om goedkeuring van Minister of National Department of Public Works & Infrastructure (NDPWI) te verkry. Administreer finansiële prosesse by die onteiendheid van vaste bates. Hou akkurate eiendomonteiendheiddokumentasie. Skakel met grondeienaars en ander belanghebbendes.

zu.title: Ongunlola Isikhundla: Ukukhishwa Kwempahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka ongunlola isikhundla Esikhungweni Sasedolobheni iGqeberha ukuphatha ukukhishwa kwempahla, ukuqhuba ukuzivakasha kwindawo, nokuhlanganisa izibalo zokukhisha kuMnyango WezaMisebenzi Kaqhoboshangqangi noZokwakheka.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingaphezu kuka- (NQF Level 06) / Isidiploma Ezweni Ezikwaitetyholo ekuthuthukisweni kwempahla, umthetho Wempahla noma inkundla kuhlobene neminye iminyaka yamakwezobunjiniyela ecadulelweyo ekusingathweni komsebenzi wokusebenza kwelasekhaya isabelo. kufuneka anodlisebebe nokugqitha ngomthetho weDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure neminye imithetho ekuphela kwawe wokwazi amathuba amancinci akhokhelwayo ekuthengwa kwempahla Isolapheka ekuphela kwezihlawu, ezinye izigaba zokwaziswa okuphathwa ngokusesikweni ikakhulukazi ekuphela kwezihlalo ezikwaziyo ukuthetha nokuqamba izindaba ezahlukileyo ekuphela kwesigaba sokuqala ekuphela kwamanye amaqela angaphakathi kunabanye ngokungagqibi neKhomishini Yezolimi nokulawula izimali zombuso. ikakhulukazi ezingeni elingentla kwakho ukusabela kwabantu ngokuqinisekileyo ekukwazini ukulungiselela, ukuhlela, kwaye uphawule kakhulu ekusebenzeni koluntu oluqhuba iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuziphilisa nemithetho yezimali, kunye neNgunuqamba Iikhalidi ezahlukeneyo.
zu.duties: Qhuba ucwaningo ukuze uthole ulwazi mayelana nokukhishwa kwempahla nokuqoqwa kwezibalo.enza ukwahlulela kwendawo, lukethe ulwazi oluzosethulwa e-Komidi Lokukhishwa Nokubekwa Kwemihlaba Yezwe Yesifundazwe (PSLDVC) ukuze kusekelwe ukukhishwa kwempahla. Qalisa inqubo yokukhisha ngokukaletela kwempahla, Sevithude, ukususwa kwezinqobo eziyimithetho, ngenkabhluleko eqhuba isikhathi eside. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo ekulungiseni inkinga yokuba ngumnikazi wempahla ngeNguqulo Yomhlaba. Xhumana neKhomishini Yezimangalo Zomhlaba Yesifundazwe ukuze uhlole izimangalo ezibalwa empahleni ezozokhishwa. Lukethe isibuyekiso ukuze uthole imvume kuNgcosele weZolimo Nentuthuko Yomhlaba. Lukethe isibuyekiso ukuze uthole ukugunyazwa kuNgcosele Wezomnyango Kazwelonke WezaMisebenzi Kaqhoboshangqangi & Izokwakheka (NDPWI). Lawula izinqubo zezimali ekukhishweni kwempahla eshintshisiwe. Gcina imibhalo eqinisekile Yokukhishwa Kwempahla. Xhumana nabanikazi bomhlaba nabaninye abahlanganyeli.

xh.title: Lawuli Wolawulo: Ukugqibela Ukusetyenziswa Kolunye Uhlobo Lwepropati
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguLawuli wolawulo eGqeberha Regional Office ukulawula ukusetyenziswa kolunye uhlobo lwepropati, ukuqhuba iindwendwe ezindulula iindawo nokuqokelela iirapotha zokugqibela ukulungelelanisa ukusetyenziswa kolunye uhlobo lwepropati nakwisebe le-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezizingqinelanayo zeminyaka emithathu ezingabakho zethu ngokulinganiseleko (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwabasebenzi bamanani nabalawuli bamazwe, nanasesweni sempahla okanye kummandla oqhagamshelana nalo. Okwangoku, nabaphathwa ngenyanga iimfuno zabo, kukudlula kubomi babo abanamava ngokulawula impahla okanye amandla abo. Kufuneka abe nelayisenisi evumelekileyo yokushayela. Ukukholwa okukhulu ngokulungelelanisa imigaqo-mthetho nesinxibo ekusingathweni kwalo kufuna nokuba ngamandla aphezulu okuyiqondo ekusebenzisweni kolawulo loluntu. Ukukhethwa ukuba ngcono kumntu wonke ngokwamanye amacebo okulungelelanisa iinkalo, imithetho-mthetho nakwisimo esezingqongqo zepropati, ezinye iindlela zokulawula amazwe amakhulu ngamandla aphakamileyo okusekela iinkqubo-mthetho, imithetho-mthetho ye-Act yokulungiselela iindlela ezahlukeneyo nolawulo olubandakanya iindidi ezahlukeneyo zabantu abanokusebenzisa amandla abo. Abasebenzi besebenza izikhathi ezide ukulungelelanisa ulwazi olufunwa ngokuthile ukuba kuxhamle kakhulu, abantu abanokusebenzisa amandla abo, banokusebenzisa ulwazi ukwazi ukuba ngcono kwaye bakhokele abantu ngokubakho kwemithetho ye-Act. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuba ngcono kwicala labo lokuthetha (ngemilomo nokubhaliweyo) nokuba nakho ukuthetha kunye nabantu abanobungakanananana bakho. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuba ngcono ekufumaneni iindlela, ukucinga, ukulungelelanisa nokulawula imali.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando ukufumana ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kolunye uhlobo lwepropati nokuqokelela iirapotha. Yenza ukhangelo kolwazi kwendawo, lulungelelise ulwazi oluya kuveliswa kwi-Provincial State Land Disposals and Vesting Committee (PSLDVC) ukuxhasa ukusetyenziswa kolunye uhlobo lwepropati. Phumeza inqubo yokusetyenziswa kolunye uhlobo lwepropati malunga nombuelo wepropati, iServitude, ukususwa kwezimemo ezithintelayo, nayiresi yexesha elide. Yiza nenkxaso yolawulo ekulungiseni ingxaki yobunini bepropati ngokusebenzisa iLand Reform. Thintana neRegional Land Claims Commission ukujonga ukuba kukho izikhalazo malunga nepropati ezosetyenziselwa ezinye iinjongo. Lungela isinikelo ncese lenkxaso kuMongameli weRural Development and Land Reform. Lungela isinikelo ncese lifumane ugqibo kuMongameli weNational Department of Public Works & Infrastructure (NDPWI). Lawula iinkqubo zemali ekusetyenzisweni kolunye uhlobo lwepropati ezihlala ngokusisigxina. Gcina amaxwebhu acacileyo apropati yokusetyenziswa kolunye uhlobo. Thintana nabaphathi belwandle labanini zeentshwa nakwezinye iindidi zabathathi nxaxheba.

Ulwazi nokuqonda iNqubomgomo yeZizwe eZihlangeneyo ngamalungelo ezingane (UNCRC, 1995). Ulwazi nokuqonda iNdlela yokuSebenzela iZingane kwesiZwe. Ulwazi nokuqonda iSikhungo saseAfrica ngamalungelo nokuHlinzeka ezingane (2000). Ulwazi nokuqonda iphepha eliMhlophe leNtuthukiswa koXhumo. Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho weBulungiswa ezinganeni. Ulwazi nokuqonda iphepha eliMhlophe ngabaNasuHlalo (WPRPD). Ulwazi nokuqonda i-POPIA ne-PAIA. Okudingekayo: Ukuphatha kokuhlelela imisebenzi nemiklamo. Ukuphatha kolwazi. Ukuphatha abantu nokubakhushulela amandla. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuphatha inguqulo. Ukuhlaziya kanye nokwakha izinqubomgomo. Ukuqondisela kubathengi kanye nokugxila kubathengi. Ukubhukuda nokuSiza. Okubukwayo nokuhlolwa. OkuNgo: Ubudlelwane obuhle obuPhakathi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngocindezelo. Okuhlakaniphile nokudala. Ukukwazi ukusebenza eqenjini nokwedwa. Ukuzivumelanisa. zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukwakheka, ukubuyekeza, nokusebenzisa inqubomgomo yesiZwe yokugcina isenzo seZingane. Ukukhuthaza ukulobela ngamalungelo abantwana nokoNgena abantwana. Ukuphatha ukwakheka kwezakhiwo zobuhulumeni kanye nokuhlelela esigabeni samalungelo abantwana. Ukuphatha ukuhlelela okubikwa emthethweni wesizwe, oMkhandlu kanye nakwezizwe. Ukuhlelela ubudlelwano, ukusebenza ndawonye, kanye noBuhlobo nabahlanganyeli basendaweni nakwezizwe ngamalungelo abantwana. Ukuphatha imali, abantu, kanye nezinkinga zoMnyango ngokomthetho nezinqubo ezibekecilile.

xh.summary: Umkhwa we-Siteko, oluLawulo, lokuncedisa loLuntu, nokuHlanganisa, lokuLawula inkqubo yamalungelo abantwana nesizwe nokuncedisa kwisebe loPhuhliso loLuntu.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7, njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA, kwiSocial Work, kwaye u注册 kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP).
