Ulwazi nokuva uMthetho weNkonzo yoLuntu nemiQathango. Ulwazi nokuva uMthetho woPhuhliso loLuntu nemiQathango. Ulwazi nokuva ngeenkonzana ezinxulumene noPhuhliso loBomi, iNkqubo ngamapolisa namathetho. Ulwazi nokuva uMthetho waBantwana no 38 ka 2005. Ulwazi nokuva ngomnqamlezo we-UN ngamalungelo abantwana (UNCRC, 1995). Ulwazi nokuva ngeNdlela yeSizwe yokwenza iNzuzo maBantwana. Ulwazi nokuva ngumthetho waseAfrika ngamalungelo nabomi abantwana (2000). Ulwazi nokuva ngeNkqubo emhlophe yoPhuhliso loLuntu. Ulwazi nokuva uMthetho weNqubo yoBulungisa abaBantwana. Ulwazi nokuva ngeNkqubo emhlophe ngeNgcali ezingenakuPhila (WPRPD). Ulwazi nokuva nge-POPIA ne-PAIA. Iimfuno zokwazi: Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphojekthi. Ulawulo lolwazi nengcombolo. Ulawulo nabantu nokunika amandla. Ukusombulula iingxaki nolawulo lokutshintsha. Ukuhlola nophuhliso lwepolisa. Imboniselo kuluntu nokuqwalasela koluntu. Izinto ezintsha ezenziwayo ekuhambiseni inkonzo. Ulawulo lweziimali. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulawulo lwamajoni abantu. Uqeqesho nokuhlanganisa. Iprezentheshini nokuqeqesha. Ukuqwalasela nokuqinisekisa. Iimpawu: Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenza ngoxinezelelo. Okutsha nokuqamba. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenza ngenqanaba elinye nangokwodwa. Ukuziqhelanisa. Ingqondo ezingcali. Ukucinga ngokodwa. Ukuqwalasela koRhengo. Inyaniso nokuThembeka. Isibindi.
xh.duties: Phatha uphuhliso, ukuhlola kwakhona, nokusebenzisa iSizima seSizwe sokuKhawulezisa iNzuzo kubantwana. Khuthaza ukuzimisela ngamalungelo abantwana nokuthatha inxaxheba kwabantwana. Phatha ukusekwa kwezakho ezisebenzayo zolawulo nokuhlanganisa kwingqungquthela yamalungelo abantwana. Phatha ukuhlanganisa kokubika ngeendaba zesizwe, iindimi, namazwe ngamazwe. Hlanganisa iziganeko, ukusebenzisana, namaqhinelweyo nabantu bakwazisa abangaphakathi namazwe ngamazwe ngokwamalungelo abantwana. Phatha, yalela imali, abantu, nokuvela kolona neSebe ngokumiselwa kwemigaqo nemiyalelo efunekayo.

Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho Wabantwana. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PAJA, i-POPIA ne-PAIA. Okudingekayo ikhono: Ukuphatha izinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ukuphatha ulwazi nolwazi. Ukuphatha abantu nokunika amandla. Ukuqaphela izindleko. Ukuqotho, ukuthembeka nokuqina. Ukuzimisela.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, ukubuyekezwa, nokulandelwa kwezinqubomgomo, izakhiwo zemithetho nokuqoqwa kwezinhlela zokuphatha izibusiso zomphakatha ezantwana abashongozwayo. Phatha futhi umatshule abahlanganyeli ngalezinqubomgomo, umthetho, izinhlela namaphrojekthi mayelana nezibusiso zomphakatha ezantwana abashongozwayo. Hlela ukuxhumana, ukusebenzisana, nobudlelwano nabahlanganyeli abahlukene. Phatha, futhi ubike ngemali, izinsiza zabantu, nokusebenza okuhle kweQoqelo elingaphansi ngokuvumelana nemithetho nemiyalo elibuswayo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Risk Management

jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Risk Management position at the Department of Social Development in Pretoria, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and 3-5 years of junior management experience.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 7, as recognized recognised by SAQA, in Risk Management, including Risk Practitioner Certificate with the Institute for Risk Management South Africa (IRMSA), Plus 3-5 years’ experience at junior management level. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Risikobestuur

af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7, soos erken deur SAQA, in Risikobestuur, insluitend Risikobeoefenaar Sertifikaat met die Institute for Risk Management South Africa (IRMSA), plus 3-5 jaar se ervaring op junior bestuursvlak. Begrotingsbeplanning en monitering. Diensleweringinnovassie. Projekkoördinering. Finansiële bestuur. Inligting- en kennisbestuur. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Probleemoplossing en veranderingbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Belanghebbende bestuur. Voorlegging en fasilitering. Risikobestuur. Konflikbestuur. Openbare betrekkingvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid insluitend Gevorderde Excel. Monitering. Verslagskrywing. Attribuut: Goede interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Innovering en kreatiwiteit. Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Aanpasbaarheid. Diplomasie. Onafhanklike denke. Emosionele intelligensie. Kostebewustheid. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Selfstandigheid.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening, implementering en monitering van risikobestuurbeleid, -strategie en -planne. Vestig die Risk Management Committee (RMC) en Sub-Committee (Risk Champions). Bestuur en koördineer die ontwikkeling en monitering van die implementering van die ondernemingsbreë besigheidskontinuïteitsplan. Voer Risikobepalingswerkswinkels uit en ontwikkel 'n risikobepalingsverslag. Koördineer die kwartaallikse risiko-voortgangsverslae van die takke. Bestuur die risikobestuurstelsel (Barnowl). Bestuur en verslag oor die menslike hulpbronne en prestasie van die subdirektoraat in ooreenstemming met die vasgestelde regulasies en voorskrifte.

zu.title: Unjiniyela Wolwazi Ngohlelo Lokusebenza
zu.summary: Isikhundla: Unjiniyela Wolwazi Ngohlelo Lokusebenza, Department of Water and Sanitation, Pretoria, ezingeni lesi-9. Kudingeka iminyaka eyi-3 yokuthola iziqu zokuqashwa emnyameni ophethe imisebenzi yokubakha.

Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda umthetho nemiyalo Yomphakathi. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda iSocial Development Sector. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda Iziphetho ZokuPhathwa Izingozi Zomphakathi. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda umthetho Wokuqoqwa Kwemali Kahulumeni Nemiqulu Yamali. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda isu se-COSO. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda Umbiko we-King V. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda i-ISO 31000. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda isigaba se-Business continuity 22301. Ulwazi nokusetshenziswa kwe-BarnOwl Risk System. Okudingekayo: Ukuhlola kanye nokuqamba inqubomgomo. Ukuphila Kwebhizinisi. Ukucabangwa kwebajeti kanye nokuhlola. Ukuba yisinhlelo yokupha inoveli. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo. Ukuphathwa kwemali. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda imininngwano. Ukuthetha (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuphathwa kushintsho. Ukuphatha Abantu Kanye Nokuqinisekisa. Ukuqondiswa kumthengi kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuphathwa Kwabantu Abathintekayo. Ukwethula kanye nokukhuthaza. Ukuphathwa kwezingozi. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Amakhono okwenza ubudlelwano bomphakathi. Amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuqamba. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha okuhlanganisa i-Advanced Excel. Ukuhlola. Ukubhala imibiko. Iziphithiphithi: Ubuhlobo obuhle. Ukuthola ukweseka. Iqiniso nokuqamba. Isikhathi sokuhlola nokubambelela.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekezwa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokulawula inqubomgomo yokuphathwa kwezingozi, isu kanye nezinhlelwa. Misi iKomidi Yokuphathwa Kwezingozi (RMC) kanye ne-Komidi Ephansi (Izimpindamandla Zezingozi). Phatha futhi uhlophise ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokulawula ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lobuqotho bezamabhizinisi lonke. Yenza Iziphumo Zokusebenza Ezindaweni Zokuhlola Izingozi futhi uthuthukise umbiko wokuqokelela ulwazi ngezingozi. Hlophisela amaberiko wesigaba ngasinye. Phatha uhlelo lokuphathwa kwezingozi (Barnowl). Phatha futhi umbike ngeminyakathi yabantu kanye nokusebenza kwezikhungo ezingezansi ngokulandela imithetho nemiyalo esethiwe.

Ulwazi nokuqonda i Public Finance Management Act & Treasury Regulations. Ulwazi nokuqonda i COSO framework. Ulwazi nokuqonda i King V Report. Ulwazi nokuqonda i ISO 31000. Ukuqhuba ibhizinisi ngokungapheli. Uqulo lwesixhaso nokulawula inkqubo yokuhamba kwemali. Iingcalo ezitsha zokulethwa kweenkonzo. Ulawulo lweenkqubo ezahluweneyo. Ulawulo lweenkcukacha zemali. Ulawulo lomnika-wethu. Ulawulo lomniko-ngxowa nokuqhuba imihlangano. Ulawulo loqobo lweengxaki. Ulawulo oluhambelanayo lweenkampu. Iinkqubo zokuzimisela koluntu. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ukuqonda nokuqhuba ingxumo yokuhamba nabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kweenkcincthana. Iingcalo ezitsha nokulawula ibango. Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kwela ngqamle kwaye nangokwahlukeneyo. Amandla okuzimisela ngokutsha. Ulawulo lokulawula iingxaki ngokusesikweni. Ukuqonda ngokuhamba kwengqondo. Ulwazi lokuzithiba. Ukuziphatha ngokuchanekileyo. Ukusetyenziswa kwezinto ezindala.
xh.duties: Lawula uqamba, ukuhlola, ukusebenzisa nokuqwalasela inkqubo yomthetho weqondo lemiba, iindlela neenkqubo ezahluweneyo. Misela i Risk Management Committee (RMC) kunye ne Komiti ngoqobo (Risk Champions). Lawula kwaye uhlanganise uqamba nokuqwalasela ukusebenza kwenkqubo egqitha ibhizinisi lonke. Qhuba iindlela zokuqwalasela iingxaki kwaye uqambe ingxelo yokuhlola iingxaki. Hlanganisa iingxelo zokuqhubela phambili kwakonnyaka zeengxaki evela kumacandelo. Lawula inkqubo yemiba (Barnowl). Lawula kwaye uchaze ingxelo ngabasebenzi nangemisebenzi yomsebenzi osezantsi ngokwemigaqo efunekayo.

zu.title: Omlandi Ohlonishwayo: Ukulinganiswa Kwezicala Zomthetho Nokwehlulelwa
zu.summary: Omlandi Ohlonishwayo weLunga elibusayo: Ukulinganiswa Kwezicala Zomthetho Nokwehlulelwa eNhlanganweni yezeNhlalakahle ePretoria, edinga iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 7 eMthethweni nokuba namava eminyaka engu-3-5 ezingeni lobuMphathi obuncane.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 7, njengoba kusabekwa uSAQA, eMthethweni FUTSANA namava eminyakeni engu-3-5 ezingeni lobuMphathi obuncane. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngendandatho yezeNhlalakahle. Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho weZinsizakalo eZidlangaleni kanye Nemithetho yalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemikhuba, imigomo, kanye nokuqhutshwa kwezinhlelo ngaphakathi kwesiza lwempendulo zomphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iMthethosisekelo yeRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho wosizo Lwezenhlalakahle kanye Nemithetho yalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho weSikhungo sokuQinisekisa iNtlalo yomphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PAIA, i-POPIA kanye ne-PAJA. Amakhono adingekayo: Ukuxhumana (Ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuhlaziya nokuthuthukisa amapholisi. Ukuletha kokuqamba ihlelo. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Ukuhlanganisa amaphrojekthi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukukhuthaza nokuhamba ihlelo ukuyoveza. Ukuhlanganisezihloniphi nabathengi. Ukuqapha. Ukubhala umbiko. Izici: Ubuhlobo obuhle kwabanye. Ukuba nokwazi ukwenza izinto ngendlela entsha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ikhono lokusebenza isiqhaza kanye nokuzenzela. Ukuzivumelanisa nezimo. Ukuqonda izinkalo. Ukuzicabangela. Ukuqaphela izindleko. Ukuqotho, ukuthembeka nokuba nobuqotho.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa, ukuhlaziya kanye nokulalela ukuqaliswa kwamapholisi, izinkomba, izindinganiso kanye namazinga okulinganiswa kwezicala zomthetho nokwehlulelwa komthetho, futhi kulalelwe ukuzithobela ngamaphoyisa oMthetho yi-SASSA, Izilungazi- bukeli be-ITSAA Tribunal kanye nabasebenzi. Ukuhlanganise ukuqokwa nokwakhiwa kwamandla kwabalunga beNkantolo yokuHlahlela iziZingidi ngokusesabalelo eNkantolo yokuzimeleyo yokuBabaza iNtlalo yomphakathi. Ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha amasevisi okwehlulelwa okuphathelene nezibhelu zokuncedakala komphakathi. Ukuphatha kokuqasha nokwenza izicelo ezihlobene nokulinganiswa kwezicala zomthetho. Ukuphathwa kwesabelo kanye nokuqashwa kwabantu abavela kunanyana yisiphi isikhungo ukuze kuqiniswe ukuvunyelana kwezinhlelo nemithetho yasese. Ukuphathwa kokuveza nokubika ngekhulu lemali, abantu kanye nokuqhutshwa kwemisebenzi yesikhundla kwendawo engaphansi kokuqondiswa ngemithetho le yiqiniso.

xh.title: Uyonike abantu abanolawulo oluvela: uQwalaselo lweZigaba zamacala eMthetho neGunyaziso
xh.summary: Ummeli oLandelayo weNkokeli yokuQwalasela amacala eMthetho neGunyaziso eSebeni loNtslaloye woLuntu ePretoria, ufuna isidanga seMthetho seNqanaba le-7 le-NQF esinesipho sabo baphathi abasebangeni elincinci beenyanga ezi-3-5.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kumqondo we-NQF level 7, njengokuvunywa yi-SAQA, kuMthetho PLUS unyaka lwe-3-5 bemfundo ekwindlaloye yabaphathi abasebangeni elincinci. Isazile konwaba nokuqonda ngoMgaqo-mthetho woNtslaloye woLuntu. Isazile konwaba nokuqonda ngoMthetho woNkonzo kaLuntu kunye neMigaqo yawo. Isazile konwaba nokuqonda nge-PFMA. Isazile konwaba nokuqonda iinkqubo, iinkqubo-mthetho kunye neenkqubo ngaphakathi kunkxaso yoluntu. Isazile konwaba nokuqonda uGqo-mthetho woRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika. Isazile konwaba nokuqonda ngoMthetho weNkxaso yoLuntu kunye neMigaqo yawo. Isazile konwaba nokuqonda ngoMthetho woSebe loKhuseleko loLuntu. Isazile konwaba nokuqonda nge-PAIA, POPIA ne-PAJA. Iakhono afunekayo: Unonophelo woluntu (olwenziweyo nolubhalwayo). Unyuso-lwekhowudi nentlalo yoluntu. Uxolelwanisiimfumba kunye nolawulo. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ulinganiso lweenkqubo. Isixazululi nxaxheba. Isazile sekhompyutha. Ukulawula nokuvezwa. Unxulumano noogqamlu-ntyatyambo noluntu. Ulawulo lokuqwalasela. Ukuhla kuqonda kwabokuqwalasela iinkqubo ezisetyenziswa yicandelo. Ubudlelwane obuhle ngenkxalabo. Ukuvela kwizinto ezitsha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza eqeleni kwaye wodwa. Ukuzivumelanisa namava. Isazile sekhondo. Ukucinga ngokuzimela. Ukuqwalasela iindleko. Uyinene, ukuthembeka nokuqina kwentsingiselo. Ukuzimisela.
xh.duties: Hlala, kuphinda uphonononge kwaye ulawule ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo, iinkqubo zokulatha, iimiqathango namazinga okulinganayo wonyuso lwezigaba zamacala ezomthetho negunyaziso ezomthetho, uze ulawule ulawulo nge-SASSA, Balawuli be-ITSAA nabasebenzi. Linganisa ulungiselelwe nokwakhiswa amandla koBalawuli Bamthetho beTribunal Elizimeleyo leNtetho nge-Nyuso lweNkxaso yoLuntu. Linganisa ulawule iinkonzo zegunyaziso ezinyuso lwenkxaso yoluntu. Lawula ulinganise uNyuso lwezigaba Zamacala Ezomthetho. Lawula kwaye ubike ngemali ebolekwayo, abantu abasebenzayo kunye nokuvela kolawulo lommandla ongezantsi ngokwemigaqo nemiyalelo elicwangcisweyo.

Knowledge and understanding of RSA Constitution. Knowledge and understanding of PHSDSBC Constitution and rules. Knowledge and understanding of POPIA, PAJA and PAIA. Competencies needed: Negotiation skills. Conflict management skills. Computer literacy. People management skills. People management skills. Planning and organising skills. Communication (written and verbal) skills. Problem-solving skills. Client orientation and customer focus skills. Reporting writing skills. Policy analysis and implementation skills. Facilitation and presentation skills. Attributes: Good interpersonal relations. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to work in a team and independently. Friendly and trustworthy. Diplomacy. Self-starter. Confidentiality. Adaptability. Accuracy. Reliable.
zu.duties: Coordinated and maintained costed responsibilities and procedures and facilitated their implementation. Rendered administrative support to the collective bargaining. Represented the department in the national chamber. Monitored implementation of collective agreements. Conducted and supported capacity-building initiatives on Labour Relations and collective agreements. Facilitated contact and consultative sessions with various stakeholders.

Isizinda somthetho nalolunye uholo lokuphatha. Amakhono: Ukuthuthukiswa kohlangothi nokuhlaziya, ucwaningo, ukusetshenziswa kwephrojekthi ukubuyekeza nokubika, ubuhlobo phakathi kwamaziko kahulumeni, ukuvumelanisa, ukuphatha izinguquko, ukuxhumana, ukuqondiswa kwezikhasimkhakha, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuxoxisana. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo (Abantu abasukuba ngumphumela wesimo sabo sokungakwazi ukushayisa bazocutshungwa ngokufanayo).

Ukuvumelanisa yonke imikhuba ehlobene nezikhalazo zokuvakasha kanye ne-Legal Services lapho kufanele khona futhi alawule imiphumela. Ukuthola izindlela zokungenelela zikahulumeni, amagugu nezindinganiso, izilawuli, amakhowudi wokuziphatha, okuhamba phambili emhlabeni jikelele kanye nemithetho ukuyibuka noma ukuyisebenzisa. Ukuvumelanisa futhi ulawule imiphumela yezikhalazo. Ukugunyaza izinhlelo noma izinhlelo ezizinzileyo zokuxazulula izikhalazo zokuvakasha. Ukuphathwa Kwephrojekthi Nabantu.

Ikhono: Ukuqhutywa kohlalutyo nomahlulelo, Uphando, Ukuqwalasela ukuphunywa kwamaprojekthi nokubika, iindibaniselwana phakathi kurhulumente, uqhathaniso, ulawulo lwezoshintsho, unxibelelwano, ukujolisa kumthengi, ulawulo labantu, ukuhengerera. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni (Abantu abanokuphahluleko ababathintela ukushayisa okuza kusakuba behleli ke kusacwangciswa).
xh.duties: Ukuyakha nokusebenzisa inkqubo yokulawula izinto ezingezizo zohambo ekufuneka ibengomfundi wezinto ezingezizo zohambo, umntu ogqithisileyo oza kuba namagunya alandelayo: Ulawulo lokuhengerera izinto ezingeziso zohambo. Ukuyila nokugcina indlela yokwamkela nokuqamba zonke izinto ezingeziso zohambo kunye nokuqhutywa kwazo. Ukuyila nokugcina indlela yokusebenza ngokubambisana namagunya abalulekileyo kunye namakhowudu okwenza. Ukuqhutywa nokuyila iirepoti zenyanga ezintathu ngeento ezingeziso zohambo eziphawula iintshukumo ezibonisa ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo. Uqhathanisa zonke iindaba zenkqubo ngokuthile ngezinto ezingeziso zohambo ngokuhamba kolwimi oluncedisa apho kufanelekileyo, kwaye ujonge ukuba kuye kwaphunywa njani. Ukuqamba iindlela urhulumente angathintatha ngazo, amagunya, inkqubo, iinkqubo ezilawulayo, iikhowudu zokwenza, inkqubo ehamba phambili kwelizwe lonke kunye neendaba eziphawulwa ukuba zithathwe njengokulungileyo nokuzityhale. Ukukwazi nokuqhathanisa okukhoyo ngokuhala ngezinto ezingeziso zohambo. Ukuvunywa kweendidi ngendlela ezazimisela ukusombulula izinto ezingeziso zohambo. Ulawulo lweProjekthi nabantu.

Die bydrae tot die opstel van 'n raamwerk vir belanghebbende-konsultasie met betrekking tot Sosiale Toerisme-ontwikkelingsintervensies; Die administrasie van die implementering van intervensies om toegang tot toerisme-ervarings en inligting vir mense uit aangewese groepe te verbeter, d.w.s. senior burgers, behoeftiges, vroue en die jeug; Die verspreiding van toerisme-inligting aan die publiek, insluitend die tersaaklike beleide en regulatoriese raamwerke; Die bywerk van die toerisme-inligtingsdatabasis om die inligting wat aan die publiek verskaf word, te valideer; Die opvolg van versoeke om inligting om 'n bevredigende respons te verseker; Die lewer van algemene sekretariaats- en logistieke ondersteuningsdienste; Die reël en verskaffing van sekretariaatsondersteuning aan bestuur en ander vergaderings in die tak; Die neem van notas tydens spesifieke seniorbestuurs- en verwante vergaderings; Die samestel en indien van notule en agenda's; Die verslagdoening oor die vordering van implementering en oor projekte.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokweluleka Ezokuvakasha Endawonye
zu.summary: Ukubumba ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zezokuvakasha zendawo ngokubumba izinhlelo zokusebenza bese ukuhambisana nezinhlelo zesigaba lezokuvakasha nezinhloso zezwe ePretoria.
zu.requirements: A recognised NQF 6 qualification Tourism Management or Social Studies. Three (3) years of relevant experience in a related environment. Knowledge of domestic tourism environment. Understanding of Social Tourism as a tourism concept; Tourism and related industry policies e.g. Domestic Tourism Growth Strategy, Social Tourism as tourism concept and guidelines; Public sector governance instruments. Supply Chain/procurement policies. Inter- Governmental Relations. Strategic partners in Social Tourism. Project/event management. Strong networking and stakeholder management. Professional presentation skills. Report writing. Database management. Desktop research. Communication skills. A valid driver’s licence (Persons with disabilities that prevent them from driving will still be considered).
zu.duties: Umqashi ohamba phambili uzobe nogweme lokuphatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ukuze axhasa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo, ezihambisana nezinhloso zesifunda; Ukubumba ukuhambisana kwezinhlelo ze-Domestic Tourism kanye nezinhlelo zesigaba lezokuvakasha; Ukusiza ekuboneni izindlela zokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zesigaba lezokuvakasha; Ukulungisa imibiko yeqhubekelaphambili kokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuvakasha; Ukusiza ekwelweni ukulinganisela umphumela nokubika; Ukwenza futhi uhlele amawokishopo okulinganisela umphumela; Ukufaka isandla ekusetshenzisweni kwe-Domestic Tourism Growth Strategy ukuze alandelwe futhi anikezelwe ngemiphumela ohlobene nayo; Ukweluleka ukubika okuqhubekayo ngeqhubekelaphambili kohlelo lokuKhuliswa kwe-Social Tourism; Ukwenza izingxoxo nabasharekithi be-Social Tourism; Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekusetshenzisweni kwe Departments Stakeholder Relations management Strategy yomphakathi kanye neyengxenye yangasese; Ukwelula ukuthuthukiswa kwesistimu ephelele futhi ethembekile yokuphatha izinto zokuxhumana nabasharekithi kwi-Department; Ukwenza izingxoxo nabasharekithi; Ukwelula ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwedathabheyisi yabasharekithi kwi-Department; Ukunika inkxaso yabaphathi ekusungulweni koshadipu oluhlelekile lokuxhasa futhi kukhuthaze iziqaliso ze-Social Tourism; Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuqoqeni kwezinye izigaba eziyiminyango ukuba zibumbene ekuxhaseni i-Social Tourism; Ukubumba majini wemicimbi yabasharekithi bangaphandle kuhlanganiswa namapha abasharekithi, izinkomfa, amamejini nemicimbi abalulekile; Ukufaka isandla ekubhalweni kwesakhiwo sokuqondana nabasharekithi mayelana nokungenelela ekuthuthukisweni kwe-Social Tourism; Ukuphatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezingenelela ukuphucula ukufinyelela kwezokuvakasha kubantu abavela kumagumbi achaziwe; Ukusakaza ulwazi ngezokuvakasha emphakathini okuhlanganisa nemicimbi yezinkinga; Ukubuyikhaya kwedathabheyisi yolwazi lwezokuvakasha; Ukulandela izicelo zolwazi; Ukunikeza insiza ekubhaleni nasekuqphenyeni imihango; Ukulungiselela futhi kunike insiza ekubhaleni phakathi kwabaphathi kwezinye imihango; Ukubhala imininingwane; Ukubhala futhi unike iminethi namanhlahla; Ukubika mayelana neqhubekelaphambili kokusetshenziswa nemiklamo.

xh.title: Sesikhululewe ukutshintshwa kwezinto ezahlukeneyo
xh.summary: Kulindele ukuba omlandi azakwazi ukukhangela imisebenzi yokugcina kwaye ahlohlwe ngokulandelelana ngokusemthethweni. Lo mzekelo uthi kuzakwenziwa iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwiziNxulumanisi ezikwindawo apho kudluliswa khona iingcamango namaxwebhu.
xh.requirements: Ifundo ngesiNgesi ezinganganga kwesiNgesi esakudlulwa kwesithathu. Ulwazi kwaye unqonde iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza kwamaphakathi abantu. Imisebenzi efanelekileyo equlathe amaphepha, amaxwebhu, ukwenza ibali negama elikhulu. Ifundo evela kwiziko elithile kwixesha elithile. Ukuba uyakwazi nje nje nje ukuba umntu ufana nantoni na.

Esi sixhobo sithi sinxibelelane nokuvumelana kwezicwangciso zeZiko lezRhohlwankondlo ngaphakathi nasemaphandleni. Kwaye siza ekuvulenzi nokuqhuba iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezenziwa kumaphepha eManyano. Siza ekuthathweni kwesa senzo ekuvavanyweni kwaye sityhile imiphumo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: PFM Donor Mobilisation
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role at National Treasury in Pretoria focused on PFM donor mobilisation, requiring a National Diploma and four years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6) in Public Administration or Management or Financial Management or Accounting or Economics or Internal Audit or Risk Management. Bachelor’s degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in any of the above disciplines is an added advantage. A minimum of 4 years’ experience, of which 2 years should be at Assistant Director level or equivalent, obtained in public finance management. Knowledge and experience in managing projects related to capacity building & training on public finance management, internal audit or risk management. Experience in the management of donor funded programmes will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Policy Development: Contribute towards the development and maintenance of a government wide Capacity Building Strategy for PFM, internal audit and risk management. Assist and support the development and maintenance of competency frameworks, occupational profiles and learning frameworks for PFM, internal audit and risk management. Support the consultative processes in developing strategies and frameworks among relevant stakeholders. Implementation: Contribute towards the coordination and harmonization of various PFM, internal audit and risk management related capacity building programmes. Prepare periodic narrative progress reports and financial reports in relation to capacity building programmes. Contribute towards assessing existing PFM, internal audit and risk management related capacity in the whole of Government. Participate in the analysis of PFM, internal audit and risk management related capacity assessment results and contribute towards the development of appropriate capacity building solutions. Support the development and maintenance of PFM, internal audit and risk management related qualifications and curricula. Monitor implementation of the strategies and frameworks and recommend corrective action and improvements to the national capacity building strategy and models for PFM, internal audit and risk management. Develop and maintain appropriate knowledge management systems. Stakeholder Management: Effective facilitation of Stakeholder Engagement Forums to advance CDS implementation, through NT Capacity Building Steering Committees, Donor Coordination Forums and Consultation Sessions with relevant stakeholders. Engage with other NT Divisions on capacity building initiatives to ensure streamlining and synergies between programmes. Support and participate in ongoing consultation with development partners and Government Institutions to address training needs and organisational constraints. Support and participate in meetings between DPSA, National School of Government, SETA’s, Higher Education Institutions, private sector training providers and relevant bodies in respect of PFM, internal audit and risk management training. Management of Donor Funded Programmes: Support the management of capacity building programmes funded by international and local development partners in line with financial agreements. Facilitate the procurement and appointment of service providers for PFM capacity development projects in line with prescribed Supply Chain Management processes and procedures. Ensure effective financial administration of programmes. Monitor and evaluate programme effectiveness. Conduct field visits to coordinate and monitor field level processes of the project action plan in consultation with stakeholders. Contribute towards resource mobilization aimed at PFM, internal audit and risk management related Capacity Building.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: PFM-skenkermobilisering
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos by National Treasury in Pretoria met fokus op PFM-skenkermobilisering, waarvoor 'n Nasionale Diploma en vier jaar se relevante ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 6) in Publieke Administrasie of Bestuur of Finansiële Bestuur of Rekeningkunde of Ekonomie of Interne Oudit of Risikobestuur. 'n Baccalaureusgraad (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 7) in enige van bogenoemde dissiplines is 'n bykomende voordeel. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se ervaring, waarvan 2 jaar op Assistentdirekteur-vlak of gelykwaardig moet wees, verkry in openbare finansiële bestuur. Kennis en ervaring in die bestuur van projekte wat verband hou met kapasiteitsbou en -opleiding oor openbare finansiële bestuur, interne oudit of risikobestuur. Ervaring in die bestuur van skenkergefondeerde programme sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Beleidsontwikkeling: Dra by tot die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van 'n regeringsbreë Kapasiteitsbou-strategie vir PFM, interne oudit en risikobestuur. Bystand en ondersteuning verleen aan die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van bevoegdheidsraamwerke, beroepsprofiele en leerraamwerke vir PFM, interne oudit en risikobestuur. Ondersteun die konsultatiewe prosesse in die ontwikkeling van strategieë en raamwerke onder relevante belanghebbendes. Implementering: Dra by tot die koördinering en harmonisering van verskeie PFM-, interne oudit- en risikobestuur-verwante kapasiteitsbouprogramme. Berei periodieke narratiewe vorderingsverslae en finansiële verslae op in verband met kapasiteitsbouprogramme. Dra by tot die assessering van bestaande PFM-, interne oudit- en risikobestuur-verwante kapasiteit in die hele Regering. Neem deel aan die ontleding van PFM-, interne oudit- en risikobestuur-verwante kapasiteitsbeoordelingsresultate en dra by tot die ontwikkeling van toepaslike kapasiteitsbou-oplossings. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van PFM-, interne oudit- en risikobestuur-verwante kwalifikasies en kurrikula. Monitor die implementering van die strategieë en raamwerke en beveel korrektiewe maatreëls en verbeterings aan tot die nasionale kapasiteitsbou-strategie en -modelle vir PFM, interne oudit en risikobestuur. Ontwikkel en onderhou toepaslike kennisbestuurstelsels. Belanghebbendebestuur: Effektiewe facilitering van Belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsforums ter bevordering van CDS-implementering, deur middel van NT-kapasiteitsbou-stuurkomitees, Skenkerkoördinasie-forums en konsultasiesessies met relevante belanghebbendes. Skakel met ander NT-afdelings oor kapasiteitsbou-inisiatiewe om stroomlyning en sinergieë tussen programme te verseker. Ondersteun en neem deel aan deurlopende konsultasie met ontwikkelingsvennote en Regeringsinstellings om opleidingsbehoeftes en organisatoriese beperkings aan te spreek. Ondersteun en neem deel aan vergaderings tussen DPSA, National School of Government, SETA's, Hoër Onderwysinstellings, privaatsektor-opleidingsverskaffers en relevante liggame ten opsigte van PFM-, interne oudit- en risikobestuur-opleiding. Bestuur van skenkergefondeerde programme: Ondersteun die bestuur van kapasiteitsbouprogramme wat deur internasionale en plaaslike ontwikkelingsvennote gefinansier word in ooreenstemming met finansiële ooreenkomste. Fasiliteer die verkryging en aanstelling van diensverskaffers vir PFM-kapasiteitsontwikkelingsprojekte in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe Toeleweringsbestuursprosesse en -prosedures. Verseker effektiewe finansiële administrasie van programme. Monitor en evalueer programeffektiwiteit. Voer veldbesoeke uit om veldvlakprosesse van die projek-aksieplan in oorleg met belanghebbendes te koördineer en te monitor. Dra by tot hulpbronmobilisering gemik op PFM-, interne oudit- en risikobestuur-verwante kapasiteitsbou.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mqondisi: Ukuhlinzeka ngesabelo se-PFM
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mqondisi e-National Treasury e-Pretoria esigxile ekuhlinzekeni ngesabelo se-PFM, esifuna i-National Diploma neminye emine yemisebenzi ehambisana nalokhu.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka i-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma (elingana ne-NQF level 6) kwi-Public Administration noma Management noma Financial Management noma Accounting noma Economics noma Internal Audit noma Risk Management. I-Bachelor's degree (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kunoma yisiphi esinye sezifundiswa ezingenhla kuyinto engesabhongo. Kudingeka okungenani iminyaka emi-4 yemisebenzi, lapho emi-2 kumele ibe ngazinga lokaSekela Mqondisi noma okulingana nalokho, etholakele ekuphatweni kwezimali zikahulumeni. Ulwazi nemisebenzi yokuphatha amaphrojekthi ahlobene nokwakha amandla nokufundisa ngokuphathwa kwezimali zikahulumeni, internal audit noma risk management. Umsebenzi wokuphatha amaphrojekthi axhaswa ngemali yabanikazi bezimali kuzoba yinto engesabhongo.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo: Ukusekela ekuthuthukisweni nasekugcineni isu lokwakha amandla kuwo wonke uhulumeli le-PFM, internal audit kanye ne-risk management. Ukusiza futhi sekusekele ekuthuthukisweni nasekugcineni izakhiwo zokusebenza, iphrofayela yomsebenzi kanye nezakhiwo zokufunda ze-PFM, internal audit kanye ne-risk management. Ukusekelela inqubo yokubonisana ekuthuthukisweni amasu nezakhiwo phakathi kwabahlotshanisi abafanele. Ukuphunyulwa: Ukusekela ekuhambiseni nasekuhlanganiseni amaphrojekthi ahlukene okwakha amandla ahlobene ne-PFM, internal audit kanye ne-risk management. Ukulungisa imibiko yokuqhubekayo phakathi kwesikhathi nemibiko yezimali ehlobene namaphrojekthi okwakha amandla. Ukusekela ekuhloleni amandla okutholakala angapheli e-PFM, internal audit kanye ne-risk management kuwo wonke uhulumeli. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuhlaziyeni imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwamandla ahlobene ne-PFM, internal audit kanye ne-risk management futhi sekusekele ekuthuthukisweni izixazululi ezifanele zokwakha amandla. Ukusekelela ekuthuthukisweni nasekugcineni izifundo nezifundo zokufunda ezihlobene ne-PFM, internal audit kanye ne-risk management. Ukugcina iliso ukuphunyulwa kwamasu nezakhiwo futhi ukuphakamisa izinyathelo zokulungisa nokuze kuthuthuke isu lelizwe lokwakha amandla namamodeli we-PFM, internal audit kanye ne-risk management. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuqaphela izinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi ezifanele. Ukuphathwa kwabahlotshanisi: Ukwenza kahle izikhungo zokubonisana nabahlotshanisi ukuze kuqhaswe ukuphunyulwa kwe-CDS, ngokusebenzisa i-NT Capacity Building Steering Committees, Donor Coordination Forums kanye ne-Consultation Sessions nabahlotshanisi abafanele. Ukuhlangana namanye amabhizinisi e-NT ngenhutho yokwakha amandla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nokusebenzisana phakathi kwamaphrojekthi. Ukusekelela futhi ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuqhubekeni kokubonisana nabashibheli bomphakathi nezikhungo zahulumeni ukulawula izidingo zokufundisa nezingqinamba ezinhlelweni. Ukusekelela futhi ukuthatha inxaxheba emihlanganweni phakathi kwe-DPSA, National School of Government, SETA's, Higher Education Institutions, abanikezeli bokufundisa bangesitsha namakhulu afanele mayelana nokufundisa i-PFM, internal audit kanye ne-risk management. Ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi axhaswa ngemali yabanikazi bezimali: Ukusekelela ekuphatweni amaphrojekthi okwakha amandla axhaswa ngabashibhili bomphakathi kanye nabadabuka bendawo ngokusho izivumelwano zezimali. Ukwenza kuqonde inqubo yokuthenga nokubeka abanikazi bezenzo ze-PFM ngenhutho yokwakha amandla ngokusho izinqubo nabaluleki ebezwayo be-Supply Chain Management. Ukuvikela ukuphathwa kwezimali kumaphrojekthi. Ukugcina isikhala nokuhlolwa kusebenza kahle isikhathi eside. Ukuhlela ezikhathini ezinkulu ngokuya ezindaweni ukuze uhambise futhi uqaphe ukusebenza nendawo yomqondo wenqubomgomo kanye nokubonisana nabahlotshanisi. Ukusekela ekufowuneni izinsiza ezihlose ukwakha amandla ahlobene ne-PFM, internal audit kanye ne-risk management.

xh.title: iPhini leNkomfa: Ukuqokelelwa kweziNdidi zoMnikelo zeeMali kwi-PFM
xh.summary: Indima yasekunene kwiNkomfa kwiNational Treasury ePretoria ekugxile ekufeni iindlela zokuzuzwa ngamasiko尼koNcedo kwi-PFM, ifuna i-National Diploma neminye iminyaka eli-4 yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibe khona i-Grade 12 ngakumbi kunye ne-National Diploma (elinganayo ne-NQF level 6) kwi-Public Administration okanye i-Management okanye i-Financial Management okanye i-Accounting okanye i-Economics okanye i-Internal Audit okanye i-Risk Management. I-Bachelor's degree (elinganayo ne-NQF level 7) kulo naluphi na kwalam candelo lulungele ukuze kwikho kumbonelelo. Kufuneka kube khona iminyaka eli-4 yamava, apho kwakuhlala iminyaka eli-2 ngaselwelo loMncedi weNkomfa okanye ngokulinganayo, afunyenwe kumphathi wolawulo wemali kahulumeni. Ulwazi namava ekuphatheni iiprojekthi ezinxulumene nokuqhutywa kolwazi nokulungelelaniswa & uqeqesho kumphathi wolawulo wemali kahulumeni, i-internal audit okanye i-risk management. Amava ekuphatheni iinkqubo ezixhaswa ziindidi zokunikela ngencedo zoncedo ziya kuba ngosizo olongezelelekileyo.
xh.duties: Uphuhliso lweMigaqo: Nika isandla ekuphuhliseni nasekugcineni iNqubomgomo ebanzi kaHulumeni yokuQeqesha iNgcapheko kwi-PFM, i-internal audit nolawulo woMngcipheko. Nceda nixe nkuse ukuqhutywa kolwazi ekuphuhlisweni nasekugcineni iinkqubo zamakhono abantu, iiprofayile zemisebenzi kunye neenkqubo zokufunda ngezihloko ze-PFM, i-internal audit nolawulo woMngcipheko. Xhase iinkqubo zedibana-nokudibana ekuphuhlisweni kweenqubomgomo naze nakwiinkqubo phakathi kweendidi ezifanelekileyo zabanini nzala. UkuQwalaselwa kokuZalathiswa: Nika isandla ekulungelelaniseni nasekelweni kwakho iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokwakhiwa ngamandla ngezihloko ze-PFM, i-internal audit nolawulo woMngcipheko. Lungiselela iingxelo zengqondo ezisetyenziswa rhoqo ngamaxesha ngezigqibo ezimalini ngokubeka kuqwalaselo iinkqubo zokwakhiwa ngamandla. Nika isandla ekutyhilweni okubandakanya iinkqubo ezikhoyo zokwakhiwa ngamandla ngezihloko kakhulu ze-PFM, i-internal audit nolawulo woMngcipheko kuHulumene wonke. Thatha inxaxheba kwiziphumo zokuqwalasela ukwakhiwa kwamandla ngokubeka kuqwalaselo i-PFM, i-internal audit nolawulo woMngcipheko ekuphuhliseni nasekuzuzisweni izisombululo ezifanelekileyo zokwakhiwa ngamandla. Xhase ukuphuhliswa nokugcinwa kwezona mfuno ezifanelekileyo nazo nakweekharityhuleyim ezinxulumene ne-PFM, i-internal audit nolawulo woMngcipheko. Qwalasela inkqubo yokuzalathiswa kwezigqibo neenkqubo naze nacebisa iinyathulo ezilungisayo nentluthelo kumaxesha amaNqamnqam kwiNqubomgomo nakuNcediso IiNkqubo zokuNceda kwi-PFM, i-internal audit nolawulo woMngcipheko. Phuhlisela kwaye ugcine iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuLawula ulwazi noluntu. UkuLawulwa kweendidi zoBukhosi beeNzala: Qhuba umbane osekela ngqo inkqubo yeendidi zoBukhosi beNzala ekwinkqubo ezingayo iphumelelo leNqubo ezimanyeneyo yokuQeqesha iNgcapheko, ngenkqubo yeKomiti yeNkqubo yeNtengiso kwiiKomiti zeNkomfa ekulawule iNqubo yokwakhiwa ngamandla kunye namaza obubano neendidi ezahlukileyo zokubonakalisana nabahlanu abafanelekileyo bazinkalo. Thethathuthi ngeendidi ezahlukileyo kwiiDivisions zeNkomfa malunga nokuba nika isandla nokuba namandla kweprogram yokuqeqesha ukuze kugqitywe ukuba iqhubekeke kakuhle ngokuzalanisa izinto phakathi kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Xhasa kwakhona uthabathe inxaxheba kwinkqubo ethi iba khona ixesha ngesixa ngamaxesha ngokusela ncedo kumahlakani phantsi komHlathi-ntlobo oluLawula ngoHulumene nokuba kwingxaki yokuqeqesha ezifunwayo namathuba abe mkhulu. Xhaza kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwindibano phakathi kweDPSA, National School of Government, SETA's, Higher Education Institutions, kubaphathi bokuqeqesha kumashishini nabangcola, nakumazwe ngamanye amaphandle ekufundweni ngokweengcali, nangabaphathi bokuqeqesha kwamashishini, zithathwa njengamagunya afanelekileyo ngokufundwa kwakunye nolwazi lwe-PFM, i-internal audit nolawulo woMngcipheko. UkuLawulwa kweendidi zoBukhosi beNzala eziqhayisayo: Nikela nceda ekulawulweni kweenkqubo ezixhaswa ziinkampani ezinomdla wokubakhula kwelizwe nangamanye amazwe ngokomthetho wezimali ogqitywe kumaxesha wolawulo Iinkqubo. Qhuba iNkqubo yokuthengisa nokumiselwa kwabakhi bezicelo beenkampani ezingenelelo ngakumbi kumaphulo okuNcedo lwakuQeqeswa abantu kunye nolwazi ngokomthetho weemvumelwano nokuLawulwa kweSazisi kweenkqubo zokulungelelanisa nokuthengisa ukuze kuqhutywe amathuba. Qinisekisa ukuphatha kweemali ezisebenza kakuhle kwinkqubo. Qwalasela kwaye ulinganise amandla okusebenza okwenza inkqubo. Qhuba iindwendwe ngamakomiti noMoya wokubumba nendalo yokuba kuye nangabani abahlobo bengqiqo nokuqhutywa kolwazi kwamandla ombutho ophakathi kwinkqubo yamaphulo ngokubonisana namabandla. Nceda ekubeni kubekho amandla okuqokelelwa okuzisa iNcedo kuqhutywe kolwazi nakwinkqubo efanayo neNqubo yolwazi.

jobs.title: Chartered Accountants Academy
jobs.summary: Trainee chartered accountant position at the CAA 2027 academy requiring a CTA or equivalent SAICA-recognised qualification for the Initial Assessment of Competence in January 2027.
jobs.requirements: Certificate in the Theory of Accounting (CTA) or equivalent qualification that meets SAICA requirements to write Initial Assessment of Competence (IAC) in January 2027
jobs.duties: Key learning areas to be clarified by various units where the successful trainees will be placed.
jobs.enquiries: All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the CAA Team on caa@treasury.gov.za
jobs.applications: To apply for the 2026 CAA programme, login to the following link: National Treasury | e-Recruitment and attach all the required documents (CV, Grade 12 certificate, Tertiary certificates (if available), South African ID, application form and the full official academic record). Please note that e-mailed, post, hand delivered, faxed and late applications will not be accepted
jobs.notes: Training Programme: Candidates are invited to apply for the programme and will be exposed to the public sector with a view to meeting the skills shortage in the sector. Trainees will have an opportunity to be on the cutting edge of financial management transformation and be part of policy development initiatives while developing technical competencies and PVAAs. Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e- Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric/tertiary certificate, ID, CV, full official academic record, etc. These documents need not be certified at the point of application however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to assessments. The assessments will be a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, and the integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on candidates where applicable. Additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. By submitting your application, it also means you consent to the National Treasury processing your information for Human Resources Management purposes. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to sign a learning Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment. The status of your application will be visible on the e-Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Note: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. The National Treasury is compliant with the requirements of POPIA. OTHER POST

jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 at 16:00 NOTES : All fields in the Z83 application form on https://recruitment.dwypd.gov.za/ must be completed in full, in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. It is therefore prudent that fields be completed by applicants and signed, noting the importance of the declaration. South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. Candidate must respond “Yes “or “No “to the question whether you are conducting business with the state. If “Yes”, details thereof only shortlisted candidates will submit Declaration form for conducting business with the state when shortlisted to the application. It is acceptable for applicant to indicate “not applicable” or leave a blank to the question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?” Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents but must submit the completed and signed Z83 and detailed Curricula Vitae. The communication from HR of the Department regarding the requirement for certified document will be limited to shortlisted candidates. Therefore, only shortlisted candidate for a post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. Applications received after the closing date will NOT be considered or accepted. Correspondence is limited to short-listed candidates only; should you not hear from us within six weeks of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Non-RSA citizens/permanent resident permit holders must submit a copy only when shortlisted. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Should you not hear from the Department within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to fill and/or make an appointment to any of the advertised posts. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Further, personnel suitability checks, including security vetting, competency assessment will be conducted, as such transfer/promotion/appointment will made subject to positive outcomes of personnel suitability checks. Successful candidates shall be required to enter into performance agreement within three (3) months of assuming their duties in the Department, and within one (1) month of the date of their appointment conclude the prescribed contract of employment. Designated employees shall be required to disclose their financial interest within 30 days after assumption of duty. Appointments will only be made on the first notch of the advertised salary level. Note that in terms of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2021, the Department will ensure the protection of applicants ‘personal information and only collect, use and retain applicants’ personal information for the purposes of recruitment and selection processes. The Department shall safeguard such personal information against access by unauthorised persons, unlawful disclosure, or breaches. The Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In the filling of these posts, It is the intention of the Department to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of this position and the candidature of persons whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity will receive preference as the objectives of section 195 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act 55 of 1998) will be taken into consideration OTHER POSTS
jobs.summary: Researcher position in the Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities in Pretoria requiring a Social Sciences diploma or degree and three years research experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate and National Diploma/Degree in Social Sciences, Development Sciences, Public Administration/Management or a relevant NQF 6 qualification. A minimum of 3 years practical experience in the research field. Knowledge: Legislation, governance framework and prescripts applicable to research and policy; Policy research and analysis; Policy research and analysis; PMFA and Treasury regulations; Batho Pele principles and application thereof; Research methodologies, data collection, synthesis and analyses; Knowledge management and Data Literacy. Skills, Primary: Diversity awareness, Analytical and report writing skills, verbal and written communication skills; Applied strategic thinking; Customer focus and responsiveness; Planning and organising; Continuous improvement; People management and development; Team leadership. Secondary: Basic Budgeting and Financial Management; Problem solving and decision-making; Project management; Computer Literacy (MS Office Suite); Networking and building bonds; Impact and influence; Diversity management. Personal Attributes: Ethical behaviour; Honestly and Integrity; Emotional Intelligence; Passion and Achievement driven; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to maintain confidentiality of information; Respect for copyrights/ aversion to plagiarism.
jobs.duties: Contribute to the implementation of the research agenda related to women youth and persons with disabilities’ socio-economic empowerment and gender equality; Collect and analyse research data; Analyse qualitative and quantitative data using appropriate tools and techniques; Participate in the compilation of research executive summaries, reports and presentation; Conduct literature reviews; Prepare and update research data; Provide relevant research papers and/or reports; Provide research assistance and support to the Directorate. Provide inputs and support in the review and analysis of policies/bills/legislation/research/reports: Conduct analysis of identified policies/bills/legislation/research reports, provide inputs and where necessary, identify areas of possible review; Participate in forums or meetings for policy dialogues and discussions; Ensure research complies with ethical standards and relevant regulations; Collaborate with team members, stakeholders, and external partners. Render Information Knowledge Management support: Provide assistance with data capturing activities; Maintain the Research, Legislation and Policy Register records for the department; Assist with the identification and maintenance of relevant stakeholders and audience for dissemination of research findings; Support the implementation and operationalization of the Departmental Knowledge Management Strategy, as well as relevant DPSA knowledge management directives, policies, and circulars, to promote effective knowledge-sharing, retention, and management practices across the department; Facilitate and coordinate the participation of subject matter experts in contributing, reviewing, and maintaining knowledge products within the departmental knowledge hub, ensuring that information is accurate, relevant, and aligned with organizational knowledge-management standards. Render Administrative and Secretarial support to the Directorate: Assist with setting up of interviews; Provide assistance with copywriting and editing of documents; Maintain administrative records; Assist with drafting of submissions; Prepare/write/type/documents, presentations, memorandums, letters and reports on behalf of the Directorate; Arrange meetings, take minutes and compile reports; Maintain internal and external stakeholder relationships.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Ntando Buthelezi at 066 077 7002
jobs.applications: Applicants are urged to submit the applications using this URL https://recruitment.dwypd.gov.za/ General enquiries may be brought to the attention of Mr Zuko Bebula Tel No: (012) 359 0417
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to African Male/ Female, Coloured, Female/Male, White female/Male, Youth as well as persons with disabilities as these groups are underrepresented in this post.

af.title: Navorser
af.summary: Navorserspos in die Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities in Pretoria wat 'n Sosiale Wetenskappe-diploma of -graad en drie jaar navorsingsondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: Matrifsertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma/Degraad in Sosiale Wetenskappe, Ontwikkelingswetenskappe, Openbare Administrasie/Bestuur of 'n tersaaklike NQF 6-kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar praktiese ondervinding in die navorsingsveld. Kennis: Wetgewing, bestuursraamwerk en voorskifte van toepassing op navorsing en beleid; Beleidsnavorsing en -ontleding; Beleidsnavorsing en -ontleding; PMFA en Tesourie-regulasies; Batho Pele-beginsels en die toepassing daarvan; Navorsingsmetodes, dataversameling, sintese en ontledings; Kennisbestuur en Dataliteracie. Vaardighede, Primêr: Diversiteitsbewustheid, analitiese en verslagskrywingsvaardighede, mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Toegepaste strategiese denke; Klantfokus en reaksievermoë; Beplanning en organisering; Deurlopende verbetering; Mensebestuur en -ontwikkeling; Spanleierskap. Sekondêr: Basiese begroting en finansiële bestuur; Probleemoplossing en besluitneming; Projektebestuur; Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office Suite); Nettwerk bou en verhoudings bou; Impak en invloed; Diversiteitsbestuur. Persoonlike eienskappe: Etiese gedrag; Eerlikheid en Integriteit; Emosionele intelligensie; Passie en prestasiegedrewe; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Vermoë om vertroulikheid van inligting te handhaaf; Respek vir outeursregte/afkeur van plagiaat.
af.duties: Dra by tot die implementering van die navorsingsagenda wat verband hou met die sosio-ekonomiese bemagtiging en geslagsgelykheid van vroue, jeug en persone met gestremdhede; Versamel en ontleed navorsingsdata; Ontleed kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe data met behulp van toepaslike instrumente en tegnieke; Neem deel aan die samestelling van navorsings-uitvoerende opsommings, verslae en aanbiedings; Voer literatuurstudies uit; Berei voor en werk navorsingsdata by; Verskaf tersaaklike navorsingsartikels en/of verslae; Verskaf navorsings bystand en ondersteuning aan die Direktoraat. Verskaf insette en ondersteuning by die hersiening en ontleding van beleide/wetsontwerpe/wetgewing/navorsing/verslae: Voer ontleding van geïdentifiseerde beleide/wetsontwerpe/wetgewing/navorsingsverslae uit, verskaf insette en identifiseer waar nodig areas vir moontlike hersiening; Neem deel aan forums of vergaderings vir beleidsdialoë en besprekinge; Verseker dat navorsing aan etiese standaarde en tersaaklike regulasies voldoen; Werk saam met spanlede, belanghebbendes en eksterne vennote. Lewer Inligtingkennisbestuursondersteuning: Verskaf bystand met dataregistrasie-aktiwiteite; Onderhou die navorsings-, wetgewings- en beleidsregister vir die departement; Ondersteun die implementering en operasionalisering van die Departementele Kennisbestuurstrategie, asook tersaaklike DPSA-kennisbestuursaandruiwe, beleide en sirkulaires, om doeltreffende kennisdeling, -behoud en -bestuurspraktyke regdeur die departement te bevorder; Fasiliteer en koördineer die deelname van vakdeskundiges by die bydrae, hersiening en onderhoud van kennisprodukte binne die departementele kennishub, en verseker dat inligting akkuraat, tersaaklik en in ooreenstemming met organisatoriese kennisbestuurstandaarde is. Lewer administratiewe en sekretariële ondersteuning aan die Direktoraat: Ondersteun met die reël van onderhoude; Verskaf bystand met kopyskryf en redigering van dokumente; Onderhou administratiewe rekords; Ondersteun met die opstel van voorleggings; Berei voor/skryf/tik dokumente, aanbiedings, memorandums, briewe en verslae namens die Direktoraat; Reël vergaderings, neem notule en stel verslae op; Onderhou interne en eksterne belanghebbende verhoudings.

zu.title: Umceluli
zu.summary: Isikhundla somceluli kumnyango we Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities e Pretoria esifuna idiploma noma idigriyezwe Social Sciences kanye namafinyila eminyaka emithathu yohlelo lokucwaninga.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Matric kanye ne-National Diploma/Degree kwi-Social Sciences, Development Sciences, Public Administration/Management noma iziqu ezihambisana ne NQF 6. Okungenani unyaka we 3 weminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza olubonwayo emkhakheni locwaningo. Ulwazi: Izinto zomthetho, ohlelo lolawulo kanye nemiyalo ephathelene nocwaningo nenqubomgomo; Ucwaningo kanye nenhlokwanalysis yenqubomgomo; Ucwaningo kanye nenhlokwanalysis yenqubomgomo; I-PMFA kanye nemithetho ye Treasury; Imigomo yenkundla yabantu (Batho Pele) kanye nokuyisebenzisa; Izindlela zocwaningo, ukuqoqa ulwazi, ukuvunyaza izinto kanye nohlakahlisimbo; Ukuphathwa kolwazi kanye nokuba nelwazi ngolwazi. Amaqhawu, Okuyinhloko: Ukuqaphela ukwehlukana kwabantu, amaqhawu ohlelo lokuhlaziya nokubhala imibiko, amaqhawu okuxoxa ngomlomo kanye nokubhala; Ukucabanga ngokuya ngohlelo; Ukuqotho kubathengi kanye nokuvela okusheshayo; Ukucubungula kanye nokuhlela; Ukuphucula ngokuqhubeka; Ukuphathwa kabantu kanye nentuthuko; Ukuba nguholi lwethim. Okwesibili: Uhlelo lokwezimali okuyisisekelo kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali; Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo; Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office Suite); Ukwakha ukuxhumana nabantu kanye nokwakha izibopho; Impumelelo kanye nokukhalipha; Ukuphatha ukwehlukana kwabantu. Izimpawu zobuntu: Ukuziphatha ngokuyiqiniso; Ukuqotho nokuzethemba; Ukuqonda izinkimbinkimbi zezwe; Inkamelo yokufuna ukuphumelela; Ukukwazi ukusebenza noma kunqunywe; Ukukwazi ukugcina ubumfihlana bolwazi; Hlakaniphile ngokuziphendulela kumyalezo; Ukuthobeka ngokokuthungathwa kwamalungelo ababhali (copyrights)/ nokuzithiba ekukopiseni izinto ezithunyelwe ezakhiwo kwezinye izincwadi.
zu.duties: Nika isandla ekusebenziseni ihlelo locwaningo ngokuba ngumphakathi kwezomnotho nezomphakathi namalungelo abesifazane bentsha nezisebeneli abanesikhindi kwezenza izinto ezintsha; Qoqa futhi uhlasisiye idatha yocwaningo; Hlasisiya idatha yegalelo nelengamuko kanye namathuluzi akwezobungcali kanye nobuchule bokuqoqa; Yiba negalelo ekwakheni izifushaniso ezinkulu, imibiko, kanye nezethulo; Qoqa izinto ezincane ngolwazi ngamaphepha, izikhalo, izi-Review; Buza ukuba idatha yocwaningo ibe nguqoqolwane; Yibela ngohlelo olukhethiweyo; Thela izinsizakalo ezincane kule-Directorate. Banika izindikimba kanye nezinsizakalo ekuqoqweni, buzeni kuhlola izinto ukuze kuhlakaniswe futhi kwenzeke imigomo: Yenza uhlaziyolwazi ngemigolo noma amaphuzu abhalo/amthetho/imibhalo, imigomo kanye noma imithetho; Ngenela izindikimba kumhlangano olukhethiweyo; Zibophezele ekutheni ucwaningo luhambisana nemigomo yesikhathi sethu kanye nomthetho okhethiwe; Sebenzisana neqembu labantu, abaphathi bezikho, kanye neziphathimandla. Nikeza izinsizakalo ezibalulekile ngokuphathwa kwesihlalisomphakathi ngolwazi: Yiba nesandla ekubhaliwe idatha ekubhaleni izinto eziphathelene nemicimbi; Hlela imibhalo ngocwaningo, kanye kanye nemibhalo yokugcina izinto eziyingqayizivele; Beka izinto eziyingxenye eqoqweni lokuqhubela kumphakathi kanye nezinkinga ezikhethekile noma izinto ezinhle ekutholweni ngemicimbi noma ukuyicaphula ukuze ivelwe kumphakathi ngokwezinsiza ezikhethekile; Sekela ukusebenza isu eliphezulu lokulawulwa kolwazi emnyangweni, kanye nokuqondiswa olukhethiweyo ngokulawula izindlela ezincane ezisukela emnyangweni kumnyango, ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwebhizinisi elifanayo nelikhulu emnyangweni; Hlinzeka kanye nokuhlela amaqhaza abanini elwazi abakhulu kulesikhungo sokungenelela, ukuhlola nokugcina imigqeqesho, kanye nezinhlelo ekukhulumeni ngolwazi ngokwezindinganiso ezimayelana nezinye izinsiza. Zinikeza izinsizakalo ezingqikithi kwezokulawula ne-AbaHlengiweyo abenzele: Nikeza ngosizo ekulungiseleleni amakhono okubuzwa amaqhaza; Sebenzisa amandla akho okubhala futhi uhlele izinto ezibhalwayo ukuba zingathunyelwa; Yenza izinto ezingahlaziywa ngokomhlalakhona; Siza ekubhaliwe izinto ezincane ezithunyelwa kwezomphakathi; Lungiselela/bhala/thepha/imiqulu, izinkulumo, imibhalo, izincwadi nemibiko ngenkathi ulekelela le-Directorate ehlangene; Hlela izinhlangano, qamba amaminithi futhi wakhe imibiko; Gcina izinhlobo zobudlelwano ngaphakathi nangaphandle komnyango nezikhulu ezahlukene.

xh.duties: Nika ngomnikelo ekuphumezeni injongo yocwango ehlobene namakhosikazi amasha, intsha nabantu abakhubazekileyo ngokwakha ngokwezoqoqosho nokulingana kobulili; Qokelela uze ulungelelwanise idatha yokucwanga; Hlaziya idatha ekubeni ithintle kunye nenzalo ngokusebenzisa izixhobo kwaye nezindlela ezifanelekileyo; Thatha inxaxheba kumalungiselelo eengxelo ezifutshane ezibalulekileyo, iingxelo kwaye nokucondvisisa kubathengi; Yenza uvavanyo lophando; Lungiselela uzeuhlaziye idatha yokucwanga; Nikezela amaphepha okucwanga nalusilwa iingxelo; Nikezela ncedo kwaye ixhaso kwigumbi elalawula iintlanga; Nikezela izimvo kwaye ixhaso ekuvavanyeni nasekuhlaziyeni amapholisa / amabheji / urhelo wemithetho / ucwango / iingxelo: Yenza uhlaziyo lwamapholisa abaliweyo / amabheji / urhelo wemithetho / iingxelo zocwango, nikezela izimvo kwaye xa kufuneka, chonga iindawo ezinokuba zisimahla zokuqwalasela kabusha; Thatha inxaxheba kwizibhongo okanye iindibano zeengxoxo ngamapholisa neziqikithi; Qinisekisa ukuba ucwango ulandela imilinganiselo yamapesi kwakunye nemithetho efanelekileyo; Sebenzisana namalungu eqela, abathintekayo, kunye nabaqeshi bangaphandle; Nikezela inkxaso yolwazi nolawulo: Nikeza ncedo kwiendlela zokuqokelela idatha; Gcina okhangelo kolwazi ngocwango, urhelo wemithetho namapholisa, bengaceli kwasebe; Siza ekuchongeni nasekugcineni abathintekayo kubathengi abafanelekileyo bengaphezulu kokusasazwa okubalulekileyo kolwazi ngocwango; Xhasa ukusebenzisa nokusebenzisa inkqubela yolwazi ngokusebenza kwasebe, kuqatshelwa nezikhokelo ezifanelekileyo zolwazi ngenkqubo yabasebenzi ababoneleli ngocwango, kwaye namapholisa, akuqhube kakuhle ukusasazwa, ukugcina, ulawulo kolwazi; Yenza kwaye ulawule ukubakho ngokusebenzisa iingcali kwigumbi lokuzimisela ukunikela, ukuvavanya, kwaye ukugcine ulwazi; Nikeza izinto ezifana nolwazi kwindlela elungelelaniswe ngokweziseko-ngoxhumaniso olusemthethweni lwecandelo loqoqosho ngokusasaza ulwazi olubalulekileyo, oluqhelanisiweyo, noluzo yolwazi olubalulekileyo.

jobs.department: Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities

jobs.summary: Senior Youth Development Officer role in Pretoria requiring a relevant diploma or degree and three years of youth development experience at salary level 8.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate and National Diploma/Degree (NQF6/7) in Youth Development, or Social Sciences, or a relevant NQF 6/7 qualification. A valid driver’s licence is required; however, this requirement is not applicable to persons with disabilities. Applicants must have a minimum of three (3) years’ practical experience in youth development programme/field. Knowledge: Legislation, governance framework and prescripts applicable to the Youth Sector; Risk management; NYP2030, NYDA Act, PFMA and Treasury regulations; Batho Pele principles and application thereof; Research methodologies and analyses; Knowledge management and Data Literacy. Skills: Primary; Diversity awareness; Effective report writing, verbal and written communication skills; Applied strategic thinking; Customer focus and responsiveness; Planning and organising; Continuous improvement; People management and development; Team Leadership. Secondary: Basic Budgeting and Financial Management; Problem solving and decision-making; Project management; Computer Literacy (MS Office Suite); Networking and building bonds; Impact Influence; Diversity management. Personal Attributes: Ethical behaviour; Honesty and Integrity; Emotional Intelligence; Passion and Achievement driven; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to maintain confidentiality of information; Respect for copyrights/aversion to plagiarism.
jobs.duties: Organise, mobilise and engage youth stakeholders: Drafting proposals, concept documents and submissions on youth stakeholder engagements; Compile reports on national and international engagements conducted; Compile reports and outcomes of stakeholder meetings; Oversee convening of stakeholder meetings and ensure that invitations, agenda, and minutes are compiled, signed and approved; Monitor meeting decision and compile status reports; Organise the National Youth Machinery meetings and compile a report; Participate in and support the Provincial and Local Youth Forums; Consolidate National Youth Month Programmes of Activities of stakeholders; Participate in the Youth Month National Task Team. Manage youth development stakeholder database: Update stakeholder database after every stakeholder engagement; Share the database with the stakeholders where necessary. Support youth engagement policies and strategies: Make input into the drafting of National Youth Machinery Framework and consolidate inputs; Make input into the drafting of youth work professionalisation policy; Participate in the consultation process of youth work professionalisation policy consolidate inputs; Distribute the youth work professional policy to stakeholders; Ensure finalisation of the constitution for the association for professionalisation of youth workers; Ensure registration of the youth workers’ Association. Support political principals on national and international engagements: Coordinate the National Youth Engagements; Coordinate International Stakeholder Engagement (BRICKS, Commonwealth, SADCA, UN, EU and IBSA); Attend meetings on national and international engagements and provide reports to the unit; Provide inputs notes for political principals; Develop submissions and briefing notes for the political principals for national and international engagements. Provide support and manage youth projects to advance youth development: Manage the professionalization of youth work project; Support the young women’s projects; Support on the ethical leadership and student representative council project; Facilitate social ills interventions to address the vulnerability of young people; Facilitate capacity building interventions for youth focal points.
jobs.enquiries: Mr OJ Fourie at 079 507 0127
jobs.applications: Applicants are urged to submit the applications using this URL https://recruitment.dwypd.gov.za/ General enquiries may be brought to the attention of Mr Zuko Bebula Tel No: (012) 359 0417
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to African females, Coloured, (Males/Female,) Indians, (Male/Female), White (Male/Female), Youth as well as Persons with Disabilities, as these groups are underrepresented in this post.

af.title: Senior Jeugontwikkelingsbeampte
af.summary: Senior Jeugontwikkelingsbeampte-pos in Pretoria vereis 'n relevante diploma of graad en drie jaar se jeugontwikkelingservaring op salarisvlak 8.
af.requirements: Matric-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma/Degree (NQF6/7) in Jeugontwikkeling, of Sosiale Wetenskappe, of 'n relevante NQF 6/7-kwalifikasie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis; hierdie vereiste is egter nie op persone met gestremdhede van toepassing nie. Aansoekers moet 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar se praktiese ervaring in jeugontwikkelingsprogram/veld hê. Kennis: Wetgewing, bestuursraamwerk en voorskrifte wat op die Jeugsektor van toepassing is; Risikobestuur; NYP2030, NYDA-wet, PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies; Batho Pele-beginsels en toepassing daarvan; Navorsingsmetodes en -ontledings; Kennisbestuur en datageletterdheid. Vaardighede: Primêr; Diversiteitsbewustheid; Effektiewe verslagskrywing, mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Toegepaste strategiese denke; Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë; Beplanning en organiseringswerk; Deurlopende verbetering; Mensebestuur en -ontwikkeling; Spanleierskap. Sekondêr: Basiese begroting en finansiële bestuur; Probleemoplossing en besluitneming; Projekbestuur; Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office Suite); Netwerking en die bou van bande; Impakbeïnvloeding; Diversiteitsbestuur. Persoonlike eienskappe: Etiese gedrag; Eerlikheid en integriteit; Emosionele intelligensie; Passie en prestasiegedrewe; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Vermoë om vertroulikheid van inligting te handhaaf; Respek vir outeursregte/afkeer van plagiaat.
af.duties: Organiseer, mobiliseer en betrek jeugbelanghebendes: Opstel van voorstelle, konsepdokumente en voorleggings oor jeugbelanghebbende-betrokkenheid; Stel verslae op oor nasionale en internasionale betrokkenheid wat uitgevoer is; Stel verslae en uitkomste van belanghebbende-vergaderings op; Hou toesig oor die byeengeroep van belanghebbende-vergaderings en verseker dat uitnodigings, agenda en notules opgestel, onderteken en goedgekeur word; Monitor besluite van vergaderings en stel statusverslae op; Organiseer die Nasionale Jeugmasjinerie-vergaderings en stel 'n verslag op; Neem deel aan en ondersteun die Provinciale en Plaaslike Jeugforums; Konsolideer Nasionale Jeugmaand-programme van aktiwiteite van belanghebbendes; Neem deel aan die Jeugmaand Nasionale Taakspan. Bestuur die jeugontwikkelingsbelanghebbende-databasis: Dateer die belanghebbende-databasis op na elke belanghebbende-betrokkenheid; Deel die databasis met die belanghebbendes waar nodig. Ondersteun jeugbetrokkenheidsbeleid en -strategieë: Lewer insette by die opstel van die Nasionale Jeugmasjinerie-raamwerk en konsolideer insette; Lewer insette by die opstel van die professionaliseringsbeleid vir jeugwerk; Neem deel aan die raadplegingsproses van die professionaliseringsbeleid vir jeugwerk en konsolideer insette; Versprei die professionaliseringsbeleid vir jeugwerk aan belanghebbendes; Verseker finalisering van die grondwet vir die vereniging vir die professionalisering van jeugwerkers; Verseker registrasie van die jeugwerkersvereniging. Ondersteun politieke hoofde by nasionale en internasionale betrokkenheid: Koördineer die Nasionale Jeugbetrokkenheid; Koördineer internasionale belanghebbende-betrokkenheid (BRICKS, Commonwealth, SADCA, UN, EU en IBSA); Woon vergaderings oor nasionale en internasionale betrokkenheid by en verskaf verslae aan die eenheid; Verskaf insetnotas vir politieke hoofde; Stel voorleggings en afskrifnotas vir die politieke hoofde vir nasionale en internasionale betrokkenheid op. Verskaf ondersteuning en bestuur jeugprojekte om jeugontwikkeling te bevorder: Bestuur die professionaliseringsprojek van jeugwerk; Ondersteun die jong vroueprojekte; Ondersteun die projekte vir etiese leierskap en studenteraad; Fasiliteer ingryping teen sosiale euwels om die kwesbaarheid van jong mense aan te spreek; Fasiliteer kapasiteitsbou-ingrypings vir jeugfokuspunte.

zu.title: Umhloli Omkhulu Wokuthuthukiswa Kwabasha
zu.summary: Isikhundla somhloli omkhulu wokuthuthukiswa kwabasha ePretoria esidinga diploma noma degree ehambisana nalomkhakaba kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava wokuthuthukiswa kwabasha emholo izinga 8.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seMatric kanye neNational Diploma/Degree (NQF6/7) kwiYouth Development, noma iSocial Sciences, noma iziqu ezingeni leNQF 6/7 ezihambisana nalomkhakaba. Kudingeka ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile; nokho, lolu dingo alusebenzi kubantu abakhubazekile. Abafakelwayo kumele babe nobuncwane beminyaka engu- (3) yokusebenza ngokuzilolonga kohlelo lweyouth development noma emkhakheni. Ulwazi: Umthetho, ohlelo lolawulo nemithetho ebalulekile ekumkhakheni weYouth Sector; ukuphathwa kwezingozi; NYP2030, NYDA Act, PFMA nemithetho yeTreasury; imigomo yeBatho Pele nokusetshenziswa kwayo; izindlela zocwaningo nanokuhlaziya; ukuphathwa kolwazi kanye nolwazi ngemininingwane. Amakhono: Okuyisisekelo; ukuqaphela ukubumbana koluhlobo; ukubhala okusebenzayo imibhalo yokubika, amakhono okuxhumana okubhaliwe nokuKHULUMA; ukucabanga ngokobuchule obusetshenziswayo; ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula; ukuhlela nokuqamba; ukuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo; ukuphatha abantu nokuthuthukisa; ukuba ngumholi wetimu. Okwesibili: Ukweqela kwemali ebalulekile nokuphathwa kwezimali; ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo; ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi; ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Office Suite); ukwakha uxhumaniso nokubaka ubuhlobo; ukuthonya ngempumela; ukuphathwa koluhlobo olubumbene. Izici zobumuntu: Ukuziphatha ngokuzethembeka; ukuqonda nokubamba iqiniso; ukuqonda izinkundla zezemizwa; inkathalo nokushiselela ukufeza izimpumelelo; ikhono lokusebenza ngocindezelo; ikhono lokugcina ubumfihlo benmininingwane; inhlonipho kwamalungelo okuhumusha ngenkathi yokwenza imisebenzi noma ukugwema ukubeka izinto ezingezona ezakho.
zu.duties: Hlela, hlanganisa futhi uxhumane nalabo abanomdlandla ekuthuthukisweni kwabasha: ukubhala izinkulumo-mboniso, amadokhumenti wezigaba nokungenwa kwezinto ngokushesha mayelana nokuxhumana nalabo abanomdlandla ekuthuthukisweni kwabasha; Qoqa imibiko yokuqashelwa kwezwe nakwamanye amazwe okwenziwe; Qoqa imibiko nemiphumela yemihlangano yabachibiyeli; Qaphula ukuhlanganiswa kwemihlangano yabachibiyeli futhi qinisekisa ukuthi imemela, ihlela, futhi imizuzu-mhlangano iqoqiwe, sayinwa futhi ivunyelwe; Hlola izinqumo zemihlangano bese uqoqa imibiko yesimo; Hlela imihlangano yeNational Youth Machinery uphinde uqoche umbiko; Thatha inxaxheba bese usize kwiProvincial and Local Youth Forums; Qoqa izinhlelo zenyanga yabasha ezingeni lesizwe zabachibiyeli ebeluzweni; Thatha inxaxheba eqenjini leNational Task Team lenyanga yabasha. Phatha idathabhesi yabachibiyeli bokuthuthukiswa kwabasha: Buyela emuva idathabhesi yabachibiyeli emva kokuqashelwa ngakunye; Yabelana ngedathabhesi nalabo abanomdlandla lapho kudingeka khona. Sekela imigomo nezindlela zokuqashelwa kwabasha: Nikeza okungenwayo ekubhaleni iNational Youth Machinery Framework bese uqoqa okungenwayo; Nikeza okungenwayo ekubhaleni imigomo yokumiseswa komsebenzi wokuthuthukisa abasha njengomsebenzi wochwepheshe; Thatha inxaxheba enkambisweni yokuqonda imigomo yokumiseswa komsebenzi wokuthuthukisa abasha njengomsebenzi wochwepheshe bese uqoqa okungenwayo; Sabisela imigomo yokumiseswa umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa abasha njengomsebenzi wochwepheshe kubachibiyeli; Qinisekisa ukugqamiswa komthethosisekelo weqembu lokumisesa abasebenzi bokuthuthukisa abasha njengabochwepheshe; Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa kweqembu labasebenzi bokuthuthukisa abasha. Sekela abaholi abangamalunga kazwelonke kumazwe aphesheya kwezilwandle nakwamanxulumo namazwe aphesheya: Phatha ukuxhumana okubhekene nentsha yezizwe; Phatha ukuxhumana nabachibiyeli bamazwe aphesheya (BRICKS, Commonwealth, SADCA, UN, EU and IBSA); Zivakashele imihlangano ekuxhumaneni kwavelonke nangamazwe aphesheya uphinde unikeze imibiko eqenjini; Nikeza imibhalo yokuqondisa abaholi abangamalunga kazwelonke; Bhala izinkulumo zokungenwa kwezinto ngokushesha bese ubhala imibhalo yokuqondisa abaholi abangamalunga kazwelonke kumazwe aphesheya nangamazwe aphesheya kuphinde. Nikeza usizo futhi uphathe amaphrojekthi abasha ukuze uqhubisele phambili ukuthuthukiswa kwentsha: Phatha amaphrojekthi okwenza umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa abasha njengomsebenzi wochwepheshe; Sekela amaphrojekthi amantombazane abafana abasha; Sekela amaphrojekthi obuholi obuzimele kanye noMkhandlu abamele abafundi; Hola izindlela zokususa izinkinga zomphakathi ukuze kuxazululwe ubusizi bezentsha; Hola izindlela zokukhulisa amandla kubantu abagxile ekuthuthukisweni kwentsha.

xh.title: Umsebenzi oMkhulu woPhuhliso lwaBatsha baseBantwini
xh.summary: Isithuba somSebenzi oMkhulu woPhuhliso lwaBatsha baseBantwini ePretoria esifuna idiploma okanye izidanga ezifanelekileyo kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava ophuhliso lwabantu bakutsha kwinqanaba lemvuzo 8.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi yeMatric kunye neDiploma yeSizwe/Isidanga (NQF6/7) kwoPhuhliso lwaBatsha baseBantwini, okanye kwiZenzo zeZentlalo, okanye isigaba esifanelekileyo seNQF 6/7. Ifayitsha yelayisensi yokushayela iyafuneka; nangona kunjalo, le mfuno ayisebenzi kubantu abakhubekileyo. Abafaki-zicelo kufuneka babe nobuncinci beminyaka emithathu (3) yamava okusebenza kwinkqubo/yasemzimbeni yophuhliso lwabantu bakutsha. Ulwazi: Izimiso zomthetho, isakhiwo sobulungisa namagunya asebenza kwiSecta yabaSha; uLawulo lweengozi; iNYP2030, uMthetho weNYDA, iPFMA namagunya oNtsimbi; iimvisiswano zeBatho Pele nokusebenziswa kwazo; iindlela zophando nokuhlalutya; uLawulo lolwazi kwaye nolwazi ngamanani. Amandla: EyoNgaphambili; ukuQaphela indida; ukwenzwa kweeberipoti ezingundoqo, amandla okuthetha ngesandla nasemlonyeni; ukuCeboza ngokwezobuchule; ukuqwalasela iinxaxheba kwaye ziphendule ngokukhawuleza; ukuCwangcisa nokuhlela; ukuphucula ngokuzinzisa; uLawulo nokuphuhlisa abantu; uBunkokeli bedaniso. Eyesibini: uLawulo lweMali nokuLawula iimali eziNgaphakathi; ukuxazula iingxaki kwaye kwenziwe izigqibo; uLawulo lweenkqubo; uKwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha (MS Office Suite); ukuQhagamshelana nokwakhiwa kweempunzi; ukubakho kolwazi; uLawulo lwendida. Iimpawu zobuTu: Ukuziphatha ngokwenene; ukuQinisekisa inyaniso noQotho; ukuQonda izihlwempu; inQanaba lokuRhumba kwaye nokuPhumelela; ukuRhula ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo; ukuGcina imfihlo yolwazi; ukuHlonela amalungelo okugcwalisa okanye ukuzikhusela ekuTsalelweni kolwazi kolunye.
xh.duties: Ukuhamba, ukuqoka nokuqhagamshela iindidi zabantu abatsha: ukubhala iziphakamiso, amaxwebhu engcamango nokuNgenisa iingxoxo ngokuqhagamshelana nabatsha; ukuQamba iiberipoti ngokuqhagamshelana kwelizwe naphesheya; ukuQamba iiberipoti neziphumo zeengxoxo zabantu; ukuLawula idibano labantu, kuqinisekiswa ukuba iimemo, izicwangciso, namaminathi ahamba phambili, kusayinwe kwaze kwamkelwe; uQaphela izigqibo zedibano kuze kuqutywe iibeepali zokuqina; ukuHlela iidibano zeNkqubo yabaSha kuzwelonke kuze kuqutywe iibeepali; ukuThatha inxaxheba kwaye uxhase iNkqubo yamaphondo neYeNzo zasekhaya; ukuDityanisa inkqubo yeenkqubo zomthi wabaSha kwelizwe naphesheya; ukuThatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yomSuku wabaSha kwakhonye kwisebe leNkqubo; uLawulo lweNgxoxo yaseMazwe ngamanye; ukuHamba kumazwe ngamazwe nokuLawula iingxoxo (iBRICKS, iCommonwealth, iSADCA, iUN, iEU neIBSA); ukuHamba iidibano kwelizwe nakumazwe ngamazwe kuze kubekho iibeepali kwisebe; ukunikezela ngeengcinga ezikwizixhobo ezipolitiki; ukuQamba izinto ezibhalwayo neepenatha epolitiki ngeengxoxo kwelizwe naphesheya. ukwenza inkxaso kwaye ulawule iiprojekthi zabatsha ukuze kuqhutywe phambili ophuhliso lwabo; uLawula inkqubo yokukhuthaza oopropofeshonali kubasebenzi; ukuxhasa iiprojekthi zentswakazi; ukuxhasa inkqubo yolwaluleko ngokuziphatha abafundi; ukuYalela iinkqubo ezisombulula izinto ezibuhlungu kubatsha; ukuYalela iinkqubo zokuphucula amandla abafundi kwinkqubo yolwazi lwabantu.

jobs.summary: IT Technician in Pretoria providing network connectivity support, requiring a National Diploma in IT and two years' experience, at salary level 7.
