ITIL Foundations Certificate, certified ITIL, MCSE, A+, N+ will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s licence is required; however, this requirement is not applicable to persons with disabilities. A minimum of 2 years’ experience in an information technology environment. Knowledge: Working knowledge of the policy and regulatory environment of information technology and security; Android and iPads mobile devices; LAN/WAN support; In-depth knowledge of performing hardware and software support for Windows. Skills: Interpersonal relations skills; Good communication Skills; Problem solving and analytical Skills; Advanced Computer Literacy; IT Technical support skills. Personal Attributes: Ethical behaviour; Honestly and Integrity; Conscientious and proactiveness; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to work independently; Ability to maintain confidentiality of information.
jobs.duties: Provide network connectivity to all computer users: Ensure accessible of WAN dependent functions; Ensure accessible of LAN dependent functions; Report on WAN functionality and connectivity changes and performance status; Report on LAN functionality and connectivity changes and performance status. Maintain Sever Room Infrastructure: Report faults of the server room within an hour to the supervisor; Ensure cleanness of the server room; Manage access to the server rooms; Update and Maintain server room access register. Maintain security and privacy of networks and computer systems: Install and upgrade anti-virus software to ensure security at the user level; Ensure the installation of the correct Operating Systems Version and Patches; Monitor Anti-Virus & Patches updates and escalate where updates are not received; Monitor & ensure connectivity of the GUP Server and escalate where it is not online. Install, configure and troubleshoot computer systems: Perform troubleshooting to diagnose and resolve computer problems; Repair or replace damaged hardware; Install and configure hardware and software components to ensure usability; Upgrade the entire system to enable compatible software on all computers; Performing tests and evaluations on new software and hardware. Provide IT service desk support services: Respond incoming calls, emails and walk in; Log calls for the queries/incidents received; Provide the client with the IT Reference number for tracking issues; Provide support to users and be the first point of contact for error reporting; Transfer or escalate unresolved incidents to the relevant units/service provider; Make certain that all queries are attended to timeously in alignment with a faster turnaround time for service delivery; Monitor the progress of the record life cycle; keep users informed of the progress of their queries. Manage, implement and maintain IT security controls to protect the department's data integrity and ensure continuity of service: Perform and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly backups of departmental systems, servers, databases, and Microsoft 365 services; Verify backup completion reports and promptly resolve backup failures; Conduct quarterly backup restore tests to validate data recoverability and integrity; Perform quarterly Disaster Recovery (DR) tests and document results; Maintain offsite and cloud-based backup repositories to ensure business continuity; Monitor Veeam Backup and Replication operations and ensure successful backup execution.

af.duties: Verskaf netwerkverbinding aan alle rekenaargebruikers: Verseker toeganklikheid van WAN-afhanklike funksies; Verseker toeganklikheid van LAN-afhanklike funksies; Rapporteer oor WAN-funksionaliteit en verbindingsveranderinge en prestasiestatus; Rapporteer oor LAN-funksionaliteit en verbindingsveranderinge en prestasiestatus. Onderhou bedienerkamer-infrastruktuur: Rapporteer foute in die bedienerkamer binne 'n uur aan die toesighouer; Verseker netheid van die bedienerkamer; Bestuur toegang tot die bedienerkamers; Dateer op en onderhou die bedienerkamer-toegangsregister. Onderhou sekuriteit en privaatheid van netwerke en rekenaarsisteme: Installeer en gradeer antivirusprogrammatuur op om sekuriteit op gebruikersvlak te verseker; Verseker die installasie van die korrete bedryfstelselweergawe en -flenters; Monitor antivirus- en flenteropdaterings en eskaleer waar opdaterings nie ontvang is nie; Monitor en verseker verbinding van die GUP-bediener en eskaleer waar dit nie aanlyn is nie. Installeer, konfigureer en los rekenaarsisteme se probleme op: Voer probleemoplossing uit om rekenaarprobleme te diagnoseer en op te los; Herstel of vervang beskadigde hardeware; Installeer en konfigureer hardeware- en sagteskakelkomponente om gebruikbaarheid te verseker; Gradeer die hele stelsel om versoenbare sagteware op alle rekenaars moontlik te maak; Voer toetse en evaluasies op nuwe sagteware en hardeware uit. Verskaf IT-diensdeskondersteuningsdienste: Reageer op inkomende oproepe, e-posse en persoonlike besoeke; Log oproepe vir die navrae/voorvalle ontvang; Verskaf die kliënt met die IT-verwysingsnommer vir die opsporing van kwessies; Verskaf ondersteuning aan gebruikers en wees die eerste kontakpunt vir fouteleding; Dra oor of eskaleer onopgeloste voorvalle na die betrokke eenhede/diensverskaffer; Maak seker dat alle navrae betyds hanteer word in ooreenstemming met 'n vinniger omkeertyd vir dienslewering; Monitor die vordering van die rekordlewensiklus; hou gebruikers ingelig oor die vordering van hul navrae. Bestuur, implementeer en onderhou IT-sekuriteitskontroles om die departement se data-integriteit te beskerm en kontinuïteit van diens te verseker: Voer en monitor daaglikse, weeklikse en maandelikse rugsteune van departementele sisteme, bedieners, databasisse en Microsoft 365-dienste uit; Verifieer rugsteunvoltooiingsverslae en los rugsteunmislukkings onmiddellik op; Voer kwartaallikse rugsteunhersteltoetse uit om dataherstelbaarheid en -integriteit te bevestig; Voer kwartaallikse Rampherstel- (DR-) toetse uit en dokumenteer die resultate; Onderhou buiteperseps- en wolkgebaseerde rugsteunbewaarplekke om besigheidskontinuïteit te verseker; Monitor Veeam-rugsteun en -replikasie-bewerkings en verseker suksesvolle rugsteunuitvoering.

zu.title: Uchwepheshe Bohlakani bekhompyutha
zu.summary: Uchwepheshe bekhompyutha ePretoria ohlinzela ngesekela lokuxhumana kwenethiwekhi, ofuna i-Diploma yezwe kubuchwepheshe bekhompyutha kanye nokuhlolwa okude kube iminyaka emibili, ezingeni leholo le-7.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikuletsho kanye nesitifiketi se-Diploma se-Diploma (NQF6) ku-Inkululeko Yobuhlakani bekhompyutha noma izifundo ezibalulekile ze-NQF 6. Isitifiketi se-ITIL, esigunyaziwe i-ITIL, MCSE, A+, N+ sibe lusizo olwengeziwe. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile iyadingeka; nokho, le sidingo asikabandakanyi abantu abasukuma ngaphezulu kwabantu abasukuma ngaphansi kwesimo sabo. Ukuze uthole isikhundla esingu-2 sonyaka ngaphezulu kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka emi-2 kakhulu emkhakheni we-Inkululeko Yobuhlakani bekhompyutha noma emkhakheni othize ongakhathalela izinto ezitholakala kwi-IT, kudingeka abe nolwazi olunzulu lokuqashwa kanzima ukuze akwazi ukuthi ahlanganele kahle nabantu abakhethe ikhompyutha; abe namakhono amahle okukhuluma nabantu; abe namakhono amahle okusombulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlola ulwazi; abe nobuchule obuvelele bokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; abe namakhono obuchwepheshe bekhompyutha; abe nokuziphatha ngokuzigcina; abe nokukhuthele nokuzethemba; abe nobuqotho; abe namakhono okwenza izinto ngokushesha; abe namakhono okusebenza ngokuzimela; abe namakhono okugcina ubumfihlo bemininingo.
zu.duties: Nika abasebenzisi bekhompyutha konke ukuxhumeka kwenethiwekhi: Qinisekisa ukufinyeleleka kwezimiso ezincike kwi-WAN; Qinisekisa ukufinyeleleka kwezimiso ezincike kwi-LAN; Bika ngesimo sokusebenza kwe-WAN, oshintsho kokuxhumana nesimo sokusebenza; Bika ngesimo sokusebenza kwe-LAN, oshintsho kokuxhumana nesimo sokusebenza. Gcina insimbi yegumbi leseva: Bika amaphutha egumbi leseva ngakathi kwelola lethola kuqaphayili; Qinisekisa ukuthi igumbi leseva lihlanzekile; Phatha ukungena kwabantu emagumbini leseva; Buya nicinise futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lokungena egumbini leseva. Gcina ukuphepha kanye nobumfihlo benethiwekhi kanye namasistimu ekhompyutha: Faka futhi uthuthuse isoftware yokuqothula amagciwane ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphepha ezingeni lomsebenzisi; Qinisekisa ukufakwa kobuhlakani besistimu obulungile kanye nezindawo ezilungisiwe; Qapha uthuthuko zisoftware yokuqothula amagciwane nezindawo ezilungisiwe bese uyaphakamisa lapho zingenakho; Qapha futhi uqinisekise ukuxhumana kwe-GUP Server bese uyaphakamisa lapho kungalikhaya inthanethi. Faka, hlela bese usombulula izinkinga zamasistimu ekhompyutha: Yenza ukusombulula izinkinga ukuze uqaphe futhi usombulule izinkinga zekhompyutha; Lungisa noma ushintshe insimbi eonakaliswe; Faka futhi uhlele izingxenye zensimbi nesoftware ukuze kuqiniseke ukusetshenziswa; Thuthusa lonke isistimu ukuze avumele isoftware ehamisana nayo kuyo yonke impahla yekhompyutha; Yenza izivivinyo kanye nokuhlola isoftware entsha nekhompyutha. Nikeza izingxoxo zokwesekwa kwemitombo yobuchwepheshe be-IT: Phendula amakholi abanikelo, ama-imeyili kanye nalabo abangena ngaphakathi; Bhala amakholi emibuzo izehloko ezuza; Nikela umthengi nenkomba yombhalo we-IT yokuqophelela izinto eziyizingkinga; Nikeza abasebenzisi ngokwesekwa ube yisikhungla sokuqala sokubika amaphutha; Qedela noma uxhase izehloko ezingazuzisile ezinhlanganweni ezihambisana nazo; Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibuzo iphendulwa ngesikhathi esifanele ngokuvumelana nesikhathi esisheshayo sokuphendula ekukhonzeni; Qapha inqubo yokuqhubekeka kwerekhodi; gumede abasebenzisi bazi ngekuqhubekeka kwemibuzo yabo. Phatha, faka esebenzayo futhi ulondoloze izilawuli zokuphepha kwe-IT ukuze kuvikelwe ukuzinza kwemininingo yomnyango kanye nokuqinisekiswa ukuguqulwa kokukhonza: Yenza futhi uqaphe ukugcinwa kwemininingo yonke ilanga, masonto, nanyanga yamakhophi wamasistimu omnyango, amaseva, amadatabase, kanye namasevisi e-Microsoft 365; Qinisekisa izibiko ezoqeda ukwenza amakhophi bese usombulula ngokushesha ukusilela kokwenza amakhophi; Yenza izivivinyo zokubuyisela amakhophi nyanga zonke ukuze uqinisekise ukuphindeleka nokuzinza kwemininingo; Yenza izivivinyo zokuqeda izimpisi (DR) nyanga zonke bese ubhala imiphumela; Gcina izindawo zokulondoloza amakhophi ngaphandle kwesikhungo kanye nasefasiteni ukuze kuqinisekise ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi; Qapha imisebenzi ye-Veeam Backup kanye ne-Replication bese uqinisekisa ukuphumelela kokwenza amakhophi.

Amakhono: Amakhono obudlelwane bakho; Amakhono alungileyo oNxibelelwano; Amakhono oxazululo lweengxaki nolwahlulo; Ulwazi oluphambili lweKhompyutha; Amakhono enkxaso yobuchwephethhe bokwazi bolwazi. Iimpawu zobuntu: Indlela yokuziphatha ngokungathembeki; Inyanisela nokuqinisekisa; Ukuzinikela nokuzimisela; Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo; Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa; Ikhono lokugcina ubumfihlo bolwazi.
xh.duties: Nika unxibelelwano lwenethiwekhi kuwo onke abasebenzisi bekhompyutha: Qinisekisa ukufikeleleka kweenkqabo ezinganyanzeliswa yi-WAN; Qinisekisa ukufikeleleka kweenkqabo ezinganyanzeliswa yi-LAN; Igxine ngokusetyenziswa kwe-WAN nangoshintsho kunxibelelwano nangemo yokusebenza; Igxine ngokusetyenziswa kwe-LAN nangoshintsho kunxibelelwano nangemo yokusebenza. Gcina iNcwadi yoBume beSeva: Ixela iimpazamo zendawo yeseva phakathi kweyure kumlawuli; Qinisekisa ukcoceka kwendawo yeseva; Lawula ukufikelela kwiindawo zeseva; Hlaziya kwaye Ugcine irejista yokufikelela kwindawo yeseva. Gcina ukhuseleko nobumfihlo bafenethiwekhi kunye nendalo yekhompyutha: Fakela kwaye uhlaziye isoftware yachwephethshe yezivirusi ukuze uqinisekise ukhuseleko kwinqanaba lomsebenzisi; Qinisekisa ukufakelwa kweNguqulo yeNkqubo yeSebenziso echanekileyo kunye namaPatches; Qaphela ukuHlaziya kwe-Anti-Virus nePatches kwaye uphakamise kwindawo ezingamkelwa ukuhlaziya; Qaphela ukuqinisekisa unxibelelwano lweGUP Server kwaye uphakamise xa kungekho kwi-intanethi. Fakela, umisela kwaye uxazule iinkqubo zekhompyutha: Yenza ukuxazulula ukuxilonga nokusombulula iingxaki zekhompyutha; Lungisa okanye utshintshe ihardhawe eonakeleyo; Fakela kwaye umisele amacandelo ehardhawe nesoftware ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenziseka; Hlaziya inkqubo yonke ukuze ukwazi ukwenza isoftware ehambelana nakuyo yonke iikhompyutha; Yenza uvavanyo kwaye ukuqamba isoftware ngehardhawe entsha. Nika inkxazo yesevisi yedesk yesebenzo se-IT: Phendla iingxelo ezibizayo, iiimeyile kwaye ungene ngeminyango; Bhala iingxelo zemibuzo/ezizezinto ezifunyenwe; Nikeza umthengi ngenani lesalathiso se-IT sokulandela iingxaki; Nika inkxazo kubasebenzisi kwaye ube ndawo yokuqala yokudibana ngayo ukuxela iimpazamo; Dlulisa okanye uphakamise izizezinto ezingaxazululanga kumayunithi/ababoneleli beepulani ahambelanayo; Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imibuzo iphathwa ngexesha elizeleleni ngokuvumelana nexesha elizingileyo lokubuyela emva lesevisi; Qaphela inkqubela yomjikelezo wobomi begama; gama abasebenzisi bazi ngentshabalalo yemibuzo yabo. Lawula, yenze kwaye ugcine ulawulo lokhuseleko lwe-IT ukukhusela ubunyani bedatha yesebe kwaye uqinisekise ukuqhubeka kwisebe: Yenza kwaye uqaphele iibhakheki zemihla ngemihla, ngeveki, ngenyanga zeendalo zesebe, iiseva, iisiseko sedatha, kwaye iinkonzo zeMicrosoft 365; Qinisekisa iingxelo zokugqibezela kwebhakheki kwaye usombulele ngokukhawuleza usileleko kwebhakheki; Qamba uvavanyo lwethreki lokubuyisa ibhakheki ukugqithisa ukuvunywa kokubuyiswa idatha nobunyani bayo; Yenza uvavanyo lwethreki lokubuyiswa kwamaxhaxha (DR) kwaye ulandele iziphumo; Gcina indawo yokugcina iibhakheki kude nasedyunivesithi yohambo ukugqithisa ukuqhubeka koshishino; Qaphela iinkqubo zokuHlaziya nokunzilela i-Veeam Backup kwaye uqinisekise ukuphumelela kwesigqibo sokwenza ibhakheki.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Logistics
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Logistics at the Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Bloemfontein, requiring a degree in Supply Chain Management and three years supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Degree (NQF Level 7) in qualification in Supply Chain Management/ Logistics Management. 3 years related logistics management experience at supervisory level. Knowledge of PFMA, SCM Regulatory Framework and all prescripts governing procurement in the Public Service. Computer literacy and a valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and review the processing of requisitions for goods and services; receive a requisition, process requisition, coordinate the placement of orders for goods and services, place an order for the service in the case of a service required, order and acquire goods if not a store item or the item is not in stock. Coordinate the safekeeping and distribution of goods; receive and check goods, capture goods on relevant procurement system, return damaged incorrect and substandard goods, issue goods as required, preparation and collation of payment documents. Coordinate the control of stock; continuously monitor inventory, stock taking according to stock taking plan, comparison of stock counted with official records, identify outdated, unserviceable, redundant and obsolete stock. Coordinate the disposal of stock inventory; prepare the identified stock for disposal, develop proposals for the disposal method, presentation to the disposal committee for approval. Supervise employees to ensure an effective logistics and disposal management service and undertake all administrative functions required with regard to financial and HR administration. This would, inter alia, entail the following: general supervision of employees, allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by supervisees, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work, manage performance, conduct and discipline of supervisees, ensure that all supervisees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively, develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective function. Management of assets. Control and safe guarding of all supply chain documentation.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. B. Bosch at (082) 385 3005
jobs.applications: Applications can be hand delivered or sent via email to recruitment1@destea.gov.za and quote the reference number for the above- mentioned position on the subject line (email) when applying.
jobs.notes: Indians/Coloureds and People with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate for SMS to be submitted prior appointment. Note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview, the selection committee will recommend candidates for a generic management competency assessment, as per the Department of public Service and Administration (DPSA) directives. The assessment will evaluate candidates’ managerial competencies using standardised tools. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Shortlisted candidates are informed that they will have to make their own travel arrangement and they will be reimbursed by the department. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DEDT is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applicants must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. Successful candidates will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) months in terms of the prescribed rules. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Logistiek
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Logistiek by die Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Bloemfontein, wat 'n graad in Supply Chain Management vereis en drie jaar se toesigervaring.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike graad (NQF Level 7) in 'n kwalifikasie in Supply Chain Management/ Logistics Management. 3 jaar verwante logistieke bestuurservaring op toesigvlak. Kennis van PFMA, SCM Regulatory Framework en alle voorskrifte wat verkryging in die Public Service regeer. Rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Koördineer en hersien die verwerking van vereistes vir goedere en dienste; ontvang 'n vereiste, verwerk vereiste, koördineer die plasing van bestellings vir goedere en dienste, plaas 'n bestelling vir die diens in die geval van 'n vereiste diens, bestel en bekom goedere as dit nie 'n winkelartikel is of die artikel nie op voorraad is nie. Koördineer die veilige bewaring en verspreiding van goedere; ontvang en kontroleer goedere, registreer goedere op die tersaaklike verkrygingstelsel, stuur beskadigde, onkorrekte en onderstandaard goedere terug, reik goedere uit soos vereis, voorbereiding en samestelling van betaaldokumente. Koördineer die beheer van voorraad; monitor voorraad deurlopend, voorraadopname volgens die voorraadopnameplan, vergelyking van getelde voorraad met amptelike rekords, identifiseer verouderde, onbruikbare, oortollige en verouderde voorraad. Koördineer die wegdoening van voorraad-inventaris; berei die geïdentifiseerde voorraad voor vir wegdoening, ontwikkel voorstelle vir die wegdoeningsmetode, voorlegging aan die wegdoeningskomitee vir goedkeuring. Hou toesig oor werknemers om 'n doeltreffende logistieke en wegdoeningsbestuursdiens te verseker en onderneem alle administratiewe funksies wat vereis word met betrekking tot finansiële en HR-administrasie. Dit sal onder meer die volgende behels: algemene toesig oor werknemers, wys pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur toesighouers gelewer word, gee advies en lei toesighouers met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk, bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van toesighouers, verseker dat alle toesighouers opgelei en ontwikkel word om in staat te wees om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lewer, ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werksisteme en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker. Bestuur van bates. Beheer en veilige bewaring van alle voorsieningskettingdokumentasie.

zu.title: Usomlilo: I-Logistics
zu.summary: Usomlilo: I-Logistics eDepartment of Economic Development and Tourism eBloemfontein, ofuna iziqu kwi-Supply Chain Management noma iminyaka emithathu yokuhola abantu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile (NQF Level 7) kumkhakha we-Supply Chain Management/ Logistics Management; Uzoba neminyaka emithathu yokuhola abantu kumkhakha we-logistics; Uyazi nge-PFMA, i-SCM Regulatory Framework kanye nemithetho yonke ekubuyisweni kwemikhiqizo yomphakathi; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Hlela kanye nokubuka isimo sokwenza izicelo zempahla kanye nezenkonzo; kwemukela isicelo, sihlele, uhlele ukubeka ama-odha empahla kanye nezenkonzo; ufake i-odha yenkonzo uma kudingeka, ufake kanye uthole impahla, uma isingeniso asikho noma impahla ayikho; uhlele ukugcinwa kanye nokuhambiswa kwempahla; kwemukela kanye nokuhlola impahla, ufake impahla esimeni sokuthenga kwaye ebalulekile, ubuyise impahla enobungozi, engalungile, kwaye ingamkelwanga, unike impahla njengoko kufuneka, ulungise kwaye uqoke amaphepha okuhlawulela; uhlele ukulawula isitoko;uhlola isitoko ngokwesikhathi, ubala isitoko ngokweplani yokubala isitoko uze uqhathanise isitoko esibaliweyo nerekhodi esemthethweni, waze wazi isitoko esidala, esingasebenzi, esingadingekiyo neso singasetyenziswayo; uhlele ukususa isitoko esibalulekileyo; ulungise isitoko esiqondiweyo ukuba sisuswe, wakhe izindawo zokususa isitoko, waze wenze isibonelo sakho ngaphambi komkomishane wokususa ukuba uvume; Qonda kwaye uhlele abasebenzi ukuba ukuqinisekisa inkonzo ye-logistics ebalulekileyo, iphumelele; Yonke imisebenzi engaphakathi iya kuba ngokwezimali ngokuhambisana nemigaqo yaseburhulumente; Lo mgaqo ngamnye kwaye uthatha inxaxheba ekugqibeleni kwemisebenzi yakho.

xh.title: Umlawuli oncedayo: I-Logistics
xh.summary: Umlawuli oncedayo: I-Logistics kwi-Department of Economic Development and Tourism eBloemfontein, ifuna isidanga kwi-Supply Chain Management nangeminyaka emithathu yamava abaphathi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekile (NQF Level 7) kwi-qualification kwi-Supply Chain Management/ Logistics Management. 3 years eminyakeni yamava alo ecothayo ekulawulweni kwe-logistics kwinqanaba labaphathi. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, i-SCM Regulatory Framework nakuzo zonke izalathiso ezilawula ukuthengwa kwempahla kwi-Public Service. Ukubuchanabuchana ngekhompyutha nelayisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Lawula uze ulungiselele ukuqhubwa kwezicelo zempahla nesevisi; wamkela isicelo, ulungelelanise isicelo, ulawule ukubekwa kwe-odolo yempahla nesevisi, uze ubeka i-odolo yesevisi kwimeko esidingwa isevise, uze u-odole uze wafumana impahla ukuba ayiyonto egcinwa kwindawo yokugcina okanye into engakhoyo kwindawo egcinwa kuyo. Lawula ukugcinwa ngokhuselekileyo nokusasazwa kwempahla; wamkele uze uqinisekise impahla, ugenise impahla kwinkqubo yokuqhuba ukuthengwa kwempahla, ubuyise impahla echanekileyo ethintekiweyo nengazange kugqitywe ngayo, unikeze impahla njengoko kudingeka, ulungiselele uze uqokelele amaxwebhu okuhlawulela. Lawula ulawulo lwesitokhwe; qaphela ngokuqhubekayo isitokhwe, ukubala isitokhwe ngokwicebo lokubala isitokhwe, uqhathanise isitokhwe esibaliweyo namarekhodi asemthethweni, uchaze isitokhwe esiphelelwe lixesha, esingasebenziyo, esingafunekiyo nangaphezu kweenkqubo. Lawula ukutyhala isitokhwe; ulungiselele isitokhwe esichaziweyo sokutyhala, uze uphuhlise iingcamango ngeendlela zokutyhala, uze uphendule kwikomiti yokutyhala ukuyamkela. Lawula abasebenzi ukuze uqinisekise inkonzo yokuqhuba i-logistics nokutyhala ngokusebenza kakuhle, uze uzenze zonke izigaba zolawulo oludingekayo malunga nokulawula ezo malimali nabaqeshi. Oku kuya, phakathi kwezinye, kuquka oku landelayo: ulawulo olubanzi labasebenzi, ukwaba imisebenzi nokwenza ulawulo lomgangatho kwimisebenzi ezenziweyo ngabaphathiweyo, uncedise uze ubakhokhele abaphathiweyo malunga nayo yonke imicimbi yomsebenzi, ulawule ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nokuqhweswa kwabaphathiweyo, uqinisekise ukuba bonke abaphathiweyo baqeqeshiwe bakhuliswe ukuze bakwazi ukunika umsebenzi womgangatho ofunekayo ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle, aze uphuhlise, asebenze aze aqapsele iinkqubo zomsebenzi nolawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle. Ulawulo lwempahla. Ulawulo nokhuselo lwawo onke amaxwebhu we-supply chain.

jobs.title: Resort Managers: Maria Moroka Resort
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.centre: Ref No: DEDT 03/09/26 (Maria Moroka Resort) Ref No: DEDT 04/09/26 (Willem Pretorious Resort) Ref No: DEDT 05/09/26 (Tussen Die Riviere Resort) Ref No: DEDT 06/09/26 (Gariepdam Resort)
jobs.summary: Resort managers needed for four Free State resorts to oversee financial management, revenue collection and daily resort operations.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) in Tourism/ Hospitality/Resort Management. A maximum of 3-4 year experience in Tourism/Hospitality/Resort Management environment. Computer literacy and valid driver’s license. Good understanding and knowledge of the prescripts governing the tourism and resort management. The successful candidate to demonstrate the following competencies/skills; customer oriented, project Management, financial and coordination, report writing skills, planning and organizing skills, time management, team player and have good interpersonal skills, attention to detail.
jobs.duties: To ensure proper financial management including maximizing of revenue collection at the resort; appoint an official who will assist the manager with collection and deposit of money whenever he or she is unable to do so, ensure that the revenue collected is kept safe and deposited to the bank daily or whenever it exceeds R2000, together with the admin clerk, reconcile the money received daily and ensure that receipt books balance, ensure that the keys for the money safe are kept safe. Responsible for effective management and maintenance (including infrastructural development and refurbishment) of facilities to ensure safe environment for the visitors at the resorts; conduct inspection in the following resort facilities: Storerooms: are used for storage of extra linen, catering suppliers, gardening equipment (grass mowing machines/tractors) etc, Chalets: to ensure that the furniture and other usable items in different chalets are in good conditions, recorded number of each item is correct and the asset lists for each chalets are timeously updated. Camping Sites: ensure proper maintenance, grass cutting, sites and swimming pools cleaning etc. In case of any emergencies (i.e. gyser failure), she/he liaise with the service provider in that particular area for assistance following the Departmental SCM processes. Implement the commercialization strategy of the Resort; liaise with local municipalities and marking association in respective areas to put their resort/facilities in the market space, partake in the annual joints like Tourism Indaba (Durban) and the Gate-Away Show (Johannesburg) for exhibitions and make their facilities known. Partake in grading committee meetings for the proper grading of their respective facilities, conduct research and make recommendations on tariffs for the department. Ensure proper hospitality management and pleasant leisure of guests; attend to resort service bookings on arrival which have not been pre-booked, ensure that chalets are properly prepaid (checking of inventories, cleaning etc.) for the arrival of guests, welcoming guests, including arrival formalities and queries, handing of keys and ensuring that payments were made, attending to client’s queries and complaints during their stay and referring such to relevant officials, attending to client’s complaints and queries and ensure that they are resolved timeously, develop clients satisfaction surveys to ensure that proper feedback is received and improvements are made thereof. Supervision of human, financial and asset resource of the Resort; draw and discuss monthly schedule with staff to ensure the each shift is well informed of what is expected of them, pool cars; ensure serviceability of the cars, proper management of petrol cards and logbooks as well as signing-off trip authorities, plan, monitor and assess staff performance as well as management of leave, ensure personnel development (identify and coordinate required training) of the down line staff, apply discipline measure accordingly. Perform and manage administrative and related functions.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. P. Motsoetla at (082) 432 9060
jobs.applications: Applications can be hand delivered or sent via email to recruitment2@destea.gov.za and quote the reference number for the abovementioned position on the subject line (email) when applying.
jobs.notes: Indians/Coloured and People with disabilities are encouraged to apply Directions to applicants: Applications must be hand delivered or e-mail on a new Z.83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on internet at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies and must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre-entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate for SMS to be submitted prior appointment. Note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview, the selection committee will recommend candidates for a generic management competency assessment, as per the Department of public Service and Administration (DPSA) directives. The assessment will evaluate candidates’ managerial competencies using standardised tools. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Shortlisted candidates are informed that they will have to make their own travel arrangement and they will be reimbursed by the department. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DEDT is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applicants must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. Successful candidates will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) months in terms of the prescribed rules. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Oordbestuurders: Maria Moroka Resort
af.summary: Oordbestuurders word vir vier Free State oorde benodig om finansiële bestuur, inkomsteinvordering en daaglikse oordbedrywighede te oorsien.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF Vlak 7) in Toerisme/ Gasvryheid/Oordbestuur. 'n Maksimum van 3-4 jaar ervaring in 'n Toerisme/Gasvryheid/Oordbestuur omgewing. Rekenaargeletterdheid en geldige bestuurderslisensie. Goeie begrip en kennis van die voorskrifte wat toerisme- en oordbestuur regeer. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet die volgende bevoegdhede/vaardighede toon; kusgoriënterd, projekbestuur, finansiële en koördinering, verslagdoeningsvaardighede, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, tydbestuur, spanspeler en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, aandag aan detail.
af.duties: Om behoorlike finansiële bestuur te verseker, insluitend die maksimering van inkomsteinvordering by die oord; stel 'n beampte aan wat die bestuurder sal help met die invordering en deponeer van geld wanneer hy of sy nie in staat is om dit te doen nie, verseker dat die ingevorderde inkomste veilig gehou en daagliks of wanneer dit R2000 oorskry by die bank gedeponeer word, tesame met die administratiewe klerk, die daagliks ontvangde geld vereffen en verseker dat kwitansieboeke in balans is, verseker dat die sleutels vir die geldkluis veilig gehou word. Verantwoordelik vir doeltreffende bestuur en instandhouding (insluitend infrastrukturele ontwikkeling en opknapping) van fasiliteite om 'n veilige omgewing vir besoekers by die oorde te verseker; voer inspeksie uit in die volgende oordfasiliteite: Stoorkamers: word gebruik vir berging van ekstra linne, spysenieringverskaffers, tuinmaaktoerusting (grasmaaimasjiene/trekkers) ens, Chalets: om te verseker dat die meubels en ander bruikbare items in verskillende chalets in goeie toestand is, die aangetekende aantal van elke item korrek is en die bateslyste vir elke chalet betyds opgedateer word. Kampeerterreine: verseker behoorlike instandhouding, grassny, skoonmaak van terreine en swembaddens ens. In die geval van enige noodgevalle (d.w.s. geisermislukking), tree hy/sy in verbinding met die diensverskaffer in daardie spesifieke gebied vir bystand volgens die Departementele SCM prosesse. Implementeer die kommersialiseringstrategie van die Oord; tree in verbinding met plaaslike munisipaliteite en bemarkingsverenigings in onderskeie gebiede om hul oord/fasiliteite in die markruimte te plaas, neem deel aan die jaarlikse gesamentlike byeenkomste soos Tourism Indaba (Durban) en die Gate-Away Show (Johannesburg) vir uitstallings en maak hul fasiliteite bekend. Neem deel aan graderingskomiteevergaderings vir die behoorlike gradering van hul onderskeie fasiliteite, voer navorsing uit en doen aanbevelings oor tariewe vir die departement. Verseker behoorlike gasvryheidsbestuur en aangename ontspanning van gaste; besoek oorddiensbesprekings by aankoms wat nie vooraf bespreek is nie, verseker dat chalets behoorlik vooraf voorberei is (kontrolering van voorraad, skoonmaak ens.) vir die aankoms van gaste, verwelkoming van gaste, insluitend aankomsformaliteite en navrae, oorhandiging van sleutels en verseker dat betalings gedoen is, hanteer kliënte se navrae en klagtes gedurende hul verblyf en verwys dit na die betrokke beamptes, hanteer kliënte se klagtes en navrae en verseker dat dit betyds opgelos word, ontwikkel kliëntetevredenheidsopnames om te verseker dat behoorlike terugvoer ontvang word en verbeterings daarvolgens aangebring word. Toesig oor menslike, finansiële en batehulpbronne van die Oord; trek 'n maandelikse skedule op en bespreek dit met personeel om te verseker dat elke skof behoorlik ingelig is oor wat van hulle verwag word, pooldiensmotors; verseker diensbaarheid van die motors, behoorlike bestuur van petrolkaarte en logboeke asook die ondertekening van reisgesagsvorms, beplan, monitor en assesseer personeelprestasie asook bestuur van verlof, verseker personeelontwikkeling (identifiseer en koördineer vereiste opleiding) van ondergeskikte personeel, pas dissiplinêre maatreëls dienooreenkomstig toe. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit en bestuur dit.

zu.title: Abaphathi Bezokwamukela Izivakashi: Maria Moroka Resort
zu.summary: Abaphathi bezokwamukela izivakashi badingwa kumazwe amane e-Free State ukuze baqaphele izimali, ukuqoqa imali engenayo kanye nemisebenzi yansuku zonke ezikhungweni zokwamukela izivakashi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor’s Degree ezifanelekanayo (NQF Level 7) kwezokuvakasha / Izokwamukela izivakashi / Ukuphathwa kwezikhungo zokwamukela izivakashi. Ubumfihlo bokusebenza obungu-3-4 iminyaka esikhathini sezokuvakasha / zokwamukela izivakashi / zokuphathwa kwezikhungo zokwamukela izivakashi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nedrayiva elivumelekile. Ukuqonda okuhle kanye nolwazi ngemithetho ephatha izokuvakasha nokuphathwa kwezikhungo zokwamukela izivakashi. Umuntu ozoqoba kufanele abonakalise izindlela ezingezansi; ukugxila kubathengi, ukuphatha imiklamo, izimali nokuqondisa, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okucubungula nokuhlela, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukusebenza njengomuntu ohlanganyele kwiqembu kanye nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu, ukuqikelela izinkunzi.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimali okufanele kuhlanganise nokukhulisa ukuqoqwa kwezimali ezinkundleni zokwamukela izivakashi; ukubeka ofishala ozoasiza umphathi ngeqoqo kanye nenkokhelo yemali lapho esengenakho ukwenza kanjalo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali eqoqiwe igciniwe kakhulu kwayiyanikelwa ebhange nsuku zonke noma noma inini uma ingaphezu kuka-R2000, kanye nomlobi wemibhalo, ukuqondanisa imali etholwe nsuku zonke bese kuqinisekiswa ukuthi izincwadi zesitifiketi zilingana, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okhiye besikhwama semabo bagcinwe kakhulu. Ukuba nogogo ekuphathweni okusebenzayo nasekulondolozweni (okuhlanganisa intuthuko yezakhiwo kanye nokuvuselelwa) kwezikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe isimo esiphephile sabakhamuzi ezikhungweni zokwamukela izivakashi; ukuqhuba ukuhlola izikhungo eziyilezi: Izindlu zokugcina: zisetshenziselwa ukugcina amafayini azengeziwe, abakhi bezokudla, izinkokhelo zezinsimu (izinjini zokusika udwa/amasithereki) njll, Amachalethi: ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ifanitsha kanye nezinye izinto ezisethenziswayo kwamachalethi ahlukene zisezimeni ezinhle, inani lemininingwana yento ngamunye lilungile futhi uhlu lwempahla yalowo nachalethi libuyekezwa ngesikhathi. Izindawo zokucasha: ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa okufanele, ukusika udwa, ukucofa izindawo kanye nezikhulumi ukuhlamba njll. Esimeni samaphutha noma yisiphi (okthi ukwehliswa kwamajyisi), yena uyathintana nenkompani enikela insiza koluhlobo lwendawo okulandela izinqubo ze-Departmental SCM. Ukuphatha umkakhaso wokuthengiswa kwezikhungo zokwamukela izivakashi; ukuthintana namakhansela endawo kanye nenhlangano yokumaketha kulezo ndawo ukubeka izikhungo/zinsiza zabo kwisikhala sokuthengisa, ukuthatha inxaxheba emihlanganweni yaminyakhe yomndeni njenge-Tourism Indaba (Durban) kanye ne-Gate-Away Show (Johannesburg) ukubukiswa bese kwenziwa kwazi izinsiza zawo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emihlanganweni yamakomidi wesigaba ukuze kwenziwe isigaba esifanele izinsiza zawo, ukuqopha ulwazi futhi anike izincomo ngezinga lezimali ku-Department. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele kwezokwamukela izivakashi kanye nobumyama obuhle bezivakashi; ukujobela izinsiza zezikhungo zokwamukela izivakashi ezingabhalanga ngaphambilini, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amachalethi ahlelwe (ukuhlola izinto, ukucofa njll.) ngokuza kwabezivakashi, ukwamukela izivakashi, okuhlanganisa izinkomba zokuza izinkulumo, ukunikeza okhiye bese kuqinisekiswa ukuthi imali ihlawulelwe, ukuphendula izinkinga futhi kuzisolo zabathengi ngesikhathi besele khona bese kuzidlulisela kubasebenzi abahlelekile, ukuqhuba izisolo zabathengi futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisombululwa ngesikhathi, ukwakha imibuzo yokuqonda izinkamelo zabathengi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imibuzo efanele itholakala kwezokuthuthuka kwenziwe. Ukuqapha abantu, izimali kanye nempahla yeResort; ukubhala futhi sixoxe ngesipathi sonyanga nabasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bani nalowo mugqa wokusebenza uyayazi into ebelethwe kuye, izimoto eziyisihlathi; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ziyasebenza, ukuphathwa okuhle kweekhadi zempahla namabhuku wokungenisa kanye nokusayina izigunyaziso zokuhambele, ukucubungula, ukulondolozwa nokuhlolwa kokusebenza kwabasebenzi kanye nokuphatha ukuhlala ikhaya, ukuvakatshela inkululeko yabasebenzi (ukubona bese kuqondiswa uqeqesho oludingayo) koqotho lwabasebenzi, ukusebenzisa izinyathelo zenhlalakahle ngokufanele. Ukuqoba futhi aphathe imisebenzi yamaphuzu nokuqukethwe kuyo.

xh.title: Abaphathi Berheothi: iMaria Moroka Resort
xh.summary: Kufuneka abaphathi berheothi kwi Free State ebhere iiresothi ezine ukulawula ulawulo lwezimali, ukuyigelwa kwentlawulo namashishini ansuku zonke erheothi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo seBachelors (iNqanaba lesi-7 le-NQF) kwiTurism / Ulonwabo / Ulawulo Leresothi. Okungenani ithyoba leminyaka engama-3-4 yamava kwindawo yeTurism / Ulonwabo / Ulawulo Leresothi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nephepha-mvume lokushayela. Ukuqonda okulungileyo nolwazi ngemithetho elawula uturism nolawulo lwerheothi. Umphumeleli kufuneka abonise amandla akhe okuza kubonwa ngezantsi; ukuba nomoya wokuthengisa, ulawulo lomsebenzi, izimali nokuqamba, amandla okubhala ingxelo, amandla eceba nokuqamba, ulawulo lwexesha, ukudlala njengelungu leqela lokubakho namandla aqhelanayo nabantu, kusetyenziswa ingqalelo kwimizuzwana.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekiswa kokulawula ngokusemthethweni izimali kubandakanya ukunyusa ukuyigelwa kwentlawulo kwiresothi; ukhetha ofishi oza kunceda umphathi ekugqithiseni nasekubekeni imali kwibhanki nanini na xa esingakwazi ukwenza njalo, aqinisekise ukuba imali ethunyelwe igcinwe kakuhle kwaye ibekwe kwibhanki nsuku zonke okanye nanini na xa eyadlula i-R2000, kunye noklerka bolawulo, alinganise imali efunyenwe yonke imihla aqinisekise ukuba amagama ebhuku emali ahambelana, aqinisekise ukuba osixhobo sokuvula isikhwama semava sigcinwe kakuhle. Uxanduva lokulawula ngokusebenza nokolondolozo (kuquka ukuthuthwa nokuqhutywa kolawulo lwezakhiwo) kwemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ekhuselekileyo kubakhenkethi kuleresothi; wenze uphononongo kwezi ndawo ziresothi zilandelayo: Iindawo zokugcina izinto: ezisetyenziselwa ukugcina iindwana ezongezelelweyo, abathengisi bakutya, izixhobo zokulima indalo (iimashini zokutyaba utye / amatrekitha) njl, Iindlu ezincinci: ukuqinisekisa ukuba ifanitsha nayo yonke eminye imizekelo esetyenziswayo kule ndlu incinci isemagunjini, inani elibhalwe lento nganye lilungile, yaye uludwe lwempahla kwezo ndlu incinci zihlaziywa ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Iindawo zokuhlala ezibhentshini: qinisekisa ukulondolozwa okulungileyo, ukusika utye, ukucofa iindawo neenkxwelo njl. Kwimeko yayo nayiphi na imiba yomgxakatalo (okt. ukusilela kwamanzi ashushu), makaxedele nomntu onikezela ngolwazi kwelo candelo lifuna ncedo elandela iinkqubo ze-SCM zesebe. Masebenzise umgama wokwenza urhwebo weresothi; axedele ngomasipala bendawo kunye nababambe iqela lokuhamba kwimimandla abayo ukubeka iresothi / imisebenzi yabo kwikhalityhala yemarike, athathe inxaxheba kwindibano zonyaka ezifana noTurism Indaba (i-Durban) neseshoni ye-Gate-Away (eJohannesburg) ngokubonisa kwaye adlale indima yokwenza imisebenzi yabo yawaziwa. Athabathe inxaxheba kwindibano zeekomiti ezilinganisela ukulungelekanisa kwemisebenzi yabo, wenze uphando aze anike iingcebiso ngamaphawu kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukulawula kolonwabo noko kulungileyo kubakhenkethi; anikele kwindawo yokubhalisa isevisi yiresothi ekufikeni abakhenkethi abangekabhalisiwe, aqinisekise ukuba iindlu ezincinci zihlaziywe kakuhle (ukujonga izinto ezisemagunjini, ukucoca njl.) ngokwamakhenkethi afikayo, amkele abakhenkethi, kuquka izinto zokuqalisa ekufikeni imibuzo, ukunika amaqhosha aqinisekise ukuba kwenziwe imirhorho, anikele kumibuzo neengxaki zabakhenkethi ngexesha abahlala khona aze adlulise elo candelo kubasebenzi abahambelanayo, anikele kwiingxaki nangemibuzo yabakhenkethi aqinisekise ukuba igqitywa ngexesha elifanelekileyo, aqhube isiphithiphithi sabakhenkethi sokwaneliseka ukuze aqinisekise ukuba ifezwa ingxelo echanekileyo yaye kwenziwa iziphuculo kuyo. Ulawulo lomntu, zemali nempahla yonke yerheothi; axobe axoxe ngenkqubo yenyanga nabasebenzi ukuze aqinisekise ukuba umzimba ngamnye uyazi ukuba ntoni nilindelwe kuye, iimoto zoluntu; aqinisekise ukuba zikwimeko yokusebenza, ulawulo olulungileyo lamakhadi epetroli namabhuku okugcina ukuze kubekho isatifikethi esibhalwe phantsi sokuhamba, acebele, alawule ahlakule inkqulo yabasebenzi, aqinisekise ukuphuhliswa kwabantu basebenzayo (ukumila kwaye alawule uqeqesho olufunekayo) kubasebenzi abangaphantsi, esebeke izigaba zolawulo ngokufanelekileyo. Aze aphathe ulawulo nokuqhutywa kolawulo nemisebenzi ehambelanayo.

jobs.title: Internal Auditor: Compliance Audit
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.summary: Internal auditor needed in Bloemfontein to conduct compliance audits and examine the regularity of public fund collection and expenditure.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) in Auditing. Computer literacy and a valid driver’s license. DUTIES To conduct audit assignments; undertake auditing according to the audit methodology and IIA standards, collect, analyse interpret and document information to determine the following: whether the collection/expenditure of funds is regular and correctly accounted for, whether state money and goods have been applied advantageously and efficiently and whether there are irregularities, deviations and shortcomings by applying, amongst others audit procedures and techniques, interpreting laws and other instructions; determine procedures and their objectives, examining and comparing book entries, accounts, statements, vouchers and other records, visit offices where cash, stock and other items of value are received, kept, issued or paid to compare physical stock on hand with returns shown in the records. To assist in preparing draft reports to be reviewed by management; write reports on audit findings, point out irregularities, deviations and shortcomings, write audit queries, submissions and letters. To evaluate internal control measures; assist with the investigation and evaluation of internal checking and control measures. Including those contained in existing and envisaged accounting systems and procedures by collect, analyse and evaluate information on the system, measure or action in the light of the experience and knowledge.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. M. Mokone at (082) 788 5804

af.title: Interne Ouditouditeur: Nakomingsoudit
af.summary: Interne ouditouditeur word in Bloemfontein benodig om nakomingsouditte uit te voer en die geregtigheid van die invordering en besteding van openbare fondse on te ondersoek.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF Vlak 7) in Ouditkunde. Rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. PLIGTE Om ouditopdragte uit te voer; oudit te doen volgens die ouditmetodologie en IIA-standaarde, inligting in te samel, te analiseer, te interpreteer en te dokumenteer om die volgende te bepaal: of die invordering/besteding van fondse geregtig en korrek verreken is, of staatsgeld en -goedere voordelig en doeltreffend aangewend is en of daar onreëlmatighede, afwykings en tekortkominge is deur, onder andere, ouditprosedures en -tegnieke toe te pas, wette en ander instruksies te interpreteer; prosedures en hul doelwitte te bepaal, boekinskrywings, rekenings, state, bewysstukke en ander rekords te ondersoek en te vergelyk, kantore te besoek waar kontant, voorraad en ander waardevolle items ontvang, gebêre, uitgereik of betaal word om fisiese voorraad op hand met opgawes in die rekords te vergelyk. Om te help met die opstel van konsepsverslae wat deur bestuur hersien gaan word; verslae oor ouditbevindings te skryf, onreëlmatighede, afwykings en tekortkominge aan te dui, ouditnavrae, voorleggings en briewe te skryf. Om interne beheermaatreëls te evalueer; te help met die ondersoek en evaluering van interne kontrole- en beheermaatreëls. Inbegrip dié wat in bestaande en beoogde rekenkundige stelsels en prosedures vervat is deur inligting oor die stelsel, maatreël of aksie in te samel, te analiseer en te evalueer in die lig van ervaring en kennis.

zu.summary: Kudingeka umqapheli wangaphakathi eBloemfontein ukwenza ukuqaphela ngokulandela imithetho kanye nokuhlola ukuvamile kokuvunwa nokusebenziswa kwemali yomphakathi.
zu.requirements: Izaqulunqwe ngendlela efanele i-Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) ku-Auditing. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuba nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. IMISEBENzi Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuqaphela; ukwenza ukuqaphela ngokulandela indlela yokuqaphela kanye nemigomo ye-IIA, qoqa, hlaziya, chaza futhi uqophe ulwazi ukuze unqume okulandelayo: ukuthi ukuvunwa/ukusebenziswa kwemali kuqhubeka ngokuvamile futhi kuhlotshaniswe kahle, ukuthi imali nezimpahla zombuso zisetshenziswe ngendlela ezuzisayo nangokusebenza kahle, kanye nokuthi kunawo yini amaphutha, ukwehluka kanye nobuncwane ngokusebenzisa, phakathi kwamanye amasu okuqaphela namathuluzi, ukuhumusha umthetho nemiyalo eminye; ukunquma izinqumo nezinjongo zawo, ukuhlola futhi uqhathanise okufakwe kumabhuku, ama-akhawunti, izitatimende, ama-voucher namarekhodi amanye, ukuvakashela amafosi lapho amahashini, izitoku namanye into enexabiso etholakala khona, zibekwe khona, zikhishwe khona noma zikhokhelwa khona ukuze kuqhathaniswe izitoku eziyimfanekisobuvo nalezokuvezwe kumarekhodi. Ukusiza ekulungiseni amarekhodi abhalwayo okuhlonywa abaphathi; bhala amarekhodi ngokuqaphela okutholakele, khomba amaphutha, ukwehluka nobuncwane, bhala imibuzo yokuqaphela, okuhambiswayo namagama. Ukuhlolisisa izinyathelo zolawulo lwangaphakathi; ukusiza ekuphenyweni nasekuhlolweni kokuhlola nokulawula kwangaphakathi. Okuhlanganisa okuqukethwe ezinhlelweni zoku-akhawunta ezikhona nasezibhekiselwe kuzo ngokuqoqa, ukuhlaziya futhi ukuhlola ukutholwa kwemayelana nenhlekelele, isilinganiso noma isenzo esikhanyisela isipiliyoni nolwazi.

xh.summary: Kufuneka umhloli wangaphakathi eBloemfontein ukuze ahlole ukuzithobela imithetho kwaye aqhathanise ukusetyenziswa kwemali yelizwe yokuziqokelela nokuqokelelwa.
xh.requirements: Idegree esifanelekileyo ezinga le-Bachelor (NQF Level 7) kwizinga le-Auditing. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nephepha lokushuka elisebenzayo. IMISEBENzi Ukwenza umsebenzi wokuhlola; ukwenza ukuhlola ngokwendlela yokuhlola nangokweemviwo ze-IIA, qokelela, hlalunga, interpreted kuthi ubhale ulwazi ukuze umise oku kulandelayo: nokuba ukuqokelelwa/ukusebenziswa kwemali kuyaqhetywa ngokuchanekileyo nokuba kusetyenziswa njani imali nezimpahla zelizwe ngokuluncedo nangokusebenza kakuhle, nokuba kukho into ezingalunganga, iimfihlo nokungabikho kokwakho ngokusebenzisa, nokunye iindlela nokuthenga zokuhlola, nokuhumusha imithetho nezinye iimiyalelo; ukumisa iindlela nemiqathango yazo, ukuqhathanisa nokubukisa iintsengedo zalebhu, i-akhawunti, iintetho, ii-voucher namanye amarekhodi, ukutshaya amanqaku kwi-ofisi apho imali, impahla namanye amaxhoba anexabiso eliqokelelwa, igcinwa, inikwa ngenxa yokukhokhelwa ukuze iqhathaniswe nemali ephila ngokumzimba nemali eboniswa kwirekhodi. Ukuncedisa ekulungiseni iiriphotha ezikabhalwa ihlole ngumbutho weentsapho; ukubhala iiriphotha ngokuvela kokuqondiswa, ukubonisa okungalunganga, okungamiselwanga nokungabi kokwakho, ukubhala iimbuzo, iingeniselo neencwadi zokuhlola. Ukupima izigqibo zokulawula ngaphakathi; ukuncedisa ngokuphandwa nokulinganiswa kokuvavanya ngaphakathi nezigqibo zokulawula. Kuquka ezo kwingendlela yamakhowudi athi iyakho kwaye ayicetyiswayo nangemiqathayo ngokuthi uqokelele, uhlalunge kwaye ulinganise ulwazi ngohlobo lwamacandla, isigqibo okanye isenzo ngokwemfundo nolwazi olufumaniseko.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist (OBSTETRICS & Gynaecology) Grade 1 – 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 341 855 – R1 422 810 per annum Grade 2: R1 531 032 – R1 623 609 per annum Grade 3: R1 773 222 – R2 212 680 per annum all -inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that be structured in terms of the applicable rules, Medical Aid (Optional) Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology sought for Bongani Regional Hospital in Welkom, requiring HPCSA registration and an MBChB degree.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/ Grade 12. Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynecology. Appropriate tertiary qualification in the Health Science (MBChB). Initial and current registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynecology. Grade 1: No experience required. Grade 2: A minimum of (5) years relevant experience after registration with Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynecology. Grade 3: A minimum of (10) years relevant experience after registration with the Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynecology. Current annual registration with HPCSA (2026/2027). Knowledge And Skills: Attributes and Abilities Sound clinical concept within the specific domain. Ability to work in multidisciplinary team. Teaching and supervisory skills. Assessment, diagnose and management of patients within the field of expertise. Good verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of all Public Service Legislation, Policies and Procedures. Conflict management skills. Innovation, drive and stress tolerance. Concern of excellence. ACLS, ATLS, APLS. Medical expertise, Clinical competence, Medical regulations and research and Research and analysis. Communication, empathy and compassion, problem-solving, leadership and teamwork, adaptability and attention to detail.
jobs.duties: Patient care and Clinical duties: Management all medical conditions to ensure that a competent service is provided to all patients. Briefing, informing and counselling patients and where appropriate relatives regarding prevention, treatment operative, complications and rehabilitation. Endeavour to becomes killed in resuscitative measures and intensive care treatment to assure survival of critically ill-patients. Prescribe medications, order and interpret diagnostic tests, and assist in medical procedures and surgeries. Team leadership: Supervise junior staff in order to provide adequate medical care and to train them to be able to do key medical interventions Documentation: Reduce medical litigation by exercising good clinical ethos, complete medico-legal documentation, and maintain adequate medical records. Compliance and quality: Perform clinical governance and ensure compliance with all legal and statutory requirements with FSDoH OHSC, HPCSA, CMSA, UFS. Administrative and operational: Consult patients on an outpatient basis to have optimal chronic disease management and good long-term follow-up. Render outreach and support services to other levels of care in our drainage areas (Free State Province). Candidate will have to perform commuted duties (Compulsory & non-negotiable) in line with the relevant policy. Perform all reasonable duties as directed by Head of Department/ Head of Clinical Unit/ Medical Specialist. Conducting clinical audits. Monitoring and evaluating of relevant clinical effectiveness indicators.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis (OBSTETRIE & Ginekologie) Graad 1 – 3
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Obstetrie en Ginekologie gesoek vir Bongani Regional Hospital in Welkom, vereis HPCSA-registrasie en 'n MBChB-graad.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12. Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Obstetrie en Ginekologie toelaat. Toepaslike tersiêre kwalifikasie in die Gesondheidswetenskappe (MBChB). Aanvanklike en huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Obstetrie en Ginekologie. Grade 1: Geen ervaring vereis. Grade 2: 'n Minimum van (5) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Obstetrie en Ginekologie. Grade 3: 'n Minimum van (10) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Obstetrie en Ginekologie. Huidige jaarlikse registrasie by HPCSA (2026/2027). Kennis en vaardighede: Attribute en vermoëns. Degelike kliniese begrip binne die spesifieke domein. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Onderrig en toesighoudingsvaardighede. Assessering, diagnoses en bestuur van pasiënte binne die veld van kundigheid. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kennis van alle Openbare Diens-wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Konflikbestuursvaardighede. Innovasie, dryfkrag en stresverdraagsaamheid. Strewe na uitnemendheid. ACLS, ATLS, APLS. Mediese kundigheid, kliniese bevoegdheid, mediese regulasies en navorsing, en navorsing en analise. Kommunikasie, empatie en deernis, probleemoplossing, leierskap en spanwerk, aanpasbaarheid en aandag tot detail.
af.duties: Pasiëntsorg en kliniese pligte: Bestuur van alle mediese toestande om te verseker dat 'n bevoegde diens aan alle pasiënte gelewer word. Voorligting, inligting en berading van pasiënte en, waar van toepassing, familielede ten opsigte van voorkoming, behandeling, operasies, komplikasies en rehabilitasie. Streef daarna om vaardig te raak in herlewingsmaatreëls en intensiewe sorgbehandeling om die oorlewing van kritieke siek pasiënte te verseker. Medikasie voorskryf, diagnostiese toetse bestel en interpreteer, en help met mediese prosedures en chirurgie. Spanleierskap: Toesig hou oor junior personeel om voldoende mediese sorg te verskaf en hulle op te lei om sleutelmediese ingrepe te kan uitvoer. Dokumentasie: Verminder mediese litigasie deur goeie kliniese etiek toe te pas, volledige medies-juridiese dokumentasie te voer en voldoende mediese rekords te handhaaf. Nakoming en kwaliteit: Voer kliniese bestuur uit en verseker nakoming van alle regs- en statutêre vereistes van FSDoH OHSC, HPCSA, CMSA, UFS. Administratief en operasioneel: Raadpleeg pasiënte op 'n buitepasiëntbasis vir optimale chroniese siektebestuur en goeie langtermyn-opvolg. Lewe uitreik- en ondersteuningsdienste aan ander sorgvlakke in ons dreineringsgebiede (Free State Province). Kandidaat sal wisselende pligte moet uitvoer (verpligtend en nie-onderhandelbaar) in ooreenstemming met die tersaaklike beleid. Voer alle redelike pligte uit soos deur die Hoof van die Departement/Hoof van die Kliniese Eenheid/Mediese Spesialis aangewys. Voer klinise oudits uit. Monitering en evaluering van tersaaklike kliniese doeltreffendheidsaanwysers.

zu.title: Izikhulu Ezikhethekile Zezokwelapha (OBSTETRICS & Gynaecology) Izinga 1 – 3
zu.summary: Kufunwa Izikhulu Ezikhethekile Zezokwelapha ku-Obstetrics and Gynaecology esibhedlela i-Bongani Regional Hospital e-Welkom, kudingeka ubhaliso lwe-HPCSA nedigri ye-MBChB.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Ephakeme/ Izinga 12. Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesikhulu esikhethekile sezokwelapha ku-Obstetrics and Gynecology. Isifundo esifanele samabanga aphezulu ezulwini lwezemfundo ezeSayense Yezempilo (MBChB). Ukubhalisa kokuqala nokwamanje kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesikhulu esikhethekile sezokwelapha ku-Obstetrics and Gynecology. Izinga 1: Akukho mzuzu odingekayo. Izinga 2: Uminimamu weminyaka engu-(5) yomzuzu ofanele ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesikhulu esikhethekile sezokwelapha ku-Obstetrics and Gynecology. Izinga 3: Uminimamu weminyaka engu-(10) yomzuzu ofanele ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesikhulu esikhethekile sezokwelapha ku-Obstetrics and Gynecology. Ukubhalisa konyaka okwamanile ne-HPCSA (2026/2027). Ulwazi Namakhono: Izimilo Namasomo Amsulwa ngaphakathi kwesizinda esithize. Isikhathi sokusebenza eqhweni elinobunjalo obuningi. Amakhono okufundisa nokubeka abantu abangaphansi kwakho. Isilinganiso, ukwelapha ngengcala nokuphatha abaguli ngaphakathi kwesabelo sakho sezokusebenza. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala nokusebenza nabantu. Ulwazi ngazo zonke izinqubo, amaphoyisa namaqiniso osebenza kahle emphakathini. Amakhono okuphatha izingxabano. Ubuchophobomvu, isifiso nokubekezela. Ukukhathalela ukwenza okuhle kakhulu. ACLS, ATLS, APLS. Ulwazi olukhulu lwabezokwelapha, ukuziphatha okuhle ngengcala, imithetho yezokwelapha nokupeywa nokuphila, nokuhlaziya nokuphila nokuhlaziya. Ukukhuluma, ukuzwa isihawu kakhulu nothando, ukusombulula izinkinga, ukubusa nokusebenza eqhweni, ukuzivumelana nobunyenti ekubhekena izinkalo.
zu.duties: Ukukhathalela abaguli nokusebenza ngengcala: Ukuphatha zonke izimo zezokwelapha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kunikezwa insiza enobuchophobomvu kubo bonke abaguli. Ukufaka ulwazi, ukuyitshela nokunika iseluleko abaguli nalapho kufanele khona abamelwe bayo mayelana nokuvikela, ukwelapha, ukwelashwa ngokuthunjwa kwezinyanga, izinkinga nokubuyisela isimo. Ukuzama ukufundisa ngemikhakha yokubuyisa isimo nokukhathalela abaguli abushiselwe isibhedlela abakhathazekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphila kwabo. Ukuyala imithi, ukuyala nokuhlaziya izivivinyo zokwelapha, kanye nukusiza kumasevisi ezokwelapha nasemishweni. Ukubeka iqhwa elisha: Ukubeka abasebenzi abasha phansi kwakho ukuze kunikezwe ukukhathalela okuhle kakhulu kwezokwelapha ukuze bafundiswe ukuba bakwazi ukwenza izindaba ezibalulekile zezokwelapha. Ukwakheka kwemibhalo: Ukunciphisa izinkantolo zezokwelapha ngokusebenzisa isiko elihle lwezokwelapha, ukuqedela imibhalo yezomthetho, nokugcina imibhalo yezokwelapha ehle kakhulu. Ukuvumelana nesesitha: Ukwenza imisebenzi yokubusa kwezokwelapha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana nezidingo zonke zomthetho namaphoyisa kwi-FSDoH OHSC, HPCSA, CMSA, UFS. Izindaba zokuphatha nokusebenza: Ukubonisana nabaguli besikhundla sabaguli abaphandle ukuze bathole ukuphathwa okuhle kakhulu kwesifunda esihlabiwe nokulandela isikhathi eside kakhulu. Ukunika insiza kwezinyanga nabanye abantu emazingeni okunye ukukhathalela emabandla ethu (Free State Province). Umuntu oqashiwe kuzodingeka akwenze imisebenzi yokuhlola ukugqama (Okuphoqelekile futhi okungaleliwa) ngokuvumelana naphoyisa elifanele. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi elifanele njengoba ecelwa ngu-Hoca Wezinsiza/i-Hoca Weqhova Lozokwelapha/Isikhulu Esikhethekile Sezokwelapha. Ukwenza ukulandwa kwemisebenzi yokwelapha. Ukuqapha nokulinganisa izinkomba zokusebenza kahle ezihlobene nezokwelapha.

xh.title: Igunya lokwelapha (OBSTETRICS & Gynaecology) Inqanaba 1 – 3
xh.summary: Kufunwa igunya lokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology kwi-Bongani Regional Hospital eWelkom, kufunelwa ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA nokuba nendima ye-MBChB.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate/ Grade 12. Ifanelekile igunya lemfundo elivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogunywa lokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics and Gynecology. Ifanelekile igunya lemfundo ephakamileyo kwizayensi yeempilo (MBChB). Ukubhalisa ngokuqala nangokwangoku kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogunywa lokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics and Gynecology. Inqanaba 1: Akukho mfundo yamava efunwayo. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-(5) yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogunywa lokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics and Gynecology. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-(10) yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogunywa lokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics and Gynecology. Ukubhalisa ngonyaka ophelileyo kwi-HPCSA (2026/2027). Ulwazi namakhono: Iimpawu namaQondo Amakhono aseMbindini omyinge ofanelekileyo ngaphakathi kwelinye igama lommandla. Ikhono lokusebenza kwiqela elinabaphathi ababali. Amakhono okufundisa nokulawula. Iqondo lokuhlola, ukuxilonga nokulawula abaguli ngaphakathi kommandla wamava. Amakhono amahle okuthetha nokubhala kunye namakhono okuhamba ngabantu. Ulwazi ngomthetho wonke wesebe likarhulumente, iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi. Amakhono okulawula ingxabano. Intshukelo, amandla nokumelana nengxolo. Inkathazo ngokuphumelela. I-ACLS, ATLS, APLS. Iakhono ezobugqirha, ukuzipatha ngokwelapha, imigaqo yokwelapha nophando kunye noPhando nokuqonda. Unxibelelwano, inzwelo nenceba, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukulawula nokusebenza njengeqela, ukuzilolonga nokuqonda iinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Ukhathalo lwabaguli namasebe okwelapha: Ukulawula zonke iimeko zokwelapha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kufikelelwa kwinkonzo elungileyo kuwo onke abaguli. Ukwazisa, ukuchenulisela nokuhlomla abaguli kwaye apho kufanelekileyo abazali ngokuthintela, ukwelapha ukhetho, iingxaki zangaphakathi nokuvingcuswa. Ukuzama ukufumana amakhono kwimizila yokuvusa omlayo nokwelapha abaguli abagula kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphila kwabo. Ukunika amayeza, ukuyalela nokutolika iindawo zokuxilonga, kunye nokunceda kwiinkqubo zokwelapha nokwenza izigqibo. Ukulawula iqela: Ukulawula abasebenzi abancinane ukuze kubonelelwe ngokhathalo olufanelekileyo lokwelapha nokuba kubafundelwe ukwenza ukungenelela okubalulekileyo kokwelapha. Uxwebhu: Ukunciphisa izigqi zomthetho zokwelapha ngokuziphatha ngokwelapha okulungileyo, ukuqedela uxwebhu lomthetho lokwelapha, nokugcina iirekodi zokwelapha ezipheleleyo. Ukuhambelana nomgangatho: Ukuqonda izigqibo zokwelapha kuqinisekiswe ukuhambelana nomthetho wonke nokuqinisekiswa ngemigaqo yesebe lempilo i-FSDoH OHSC, HPCSA, CMSA, UFS. Ulawulo nakusebenza: Ukuhlola abaguli kwindawo yokuhlolwa kwabaguli abangengabhedanga ukuze kubekho ukulawula okulungileyo kwesifo eside nokuqhwesela okuhle ngesikhathi eside. Ukubonelela ngenkonzo yokusasazwa kunye nokuxhasa kwezinye iinqanaba zokhathalo kummandla wethu wokukhupha (Free State Province). Umama kuya kufuneka azenze imisebenzi yokuhamba (Iyinyanzelo futhi ayihambelani nanjalo) ngokwemigaqo equkethwe kumthetho. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ecengeniyo njengoko kuyalelwe sisebe sokuqala/ Inqanaba lesebe lokwelapha/ Igunya lokwelapha. Ukwenza izihloko zokuhlolwa kokwelapha. Ukuyila nokulinganisa inkqubela yemigangatho yokusebenza efanelekileyo yamagosa.

af.title: Assistentbestuurder: Pharmaceutiese Dienste
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder vir Pharmaceutiese Dienste by die Free State Department of Health, wat 'n Pharmacy-graad en SAPC-registrasie met vyf jaar se ervaring na gemeenskapsdiens vereis.
af.requirements: Matric plus toepaslike Bachelor of Pharmacy Degree (NQF 7) soos erken deur SAQA wat registrasie met die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as 'n Apoteker moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie met die South Africa Pharmacy Council (SAPC) (2026/2027). Aanwysing as 'n aktiewe en praktiserende apoteker op die SAPC-register. Minimum 5 jaar as 'n apoteker na gemeenskapsdiens met ten minste drie jaar se toesigervaring (by voorkeur binne die openbare gesondheidssektor). Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing, beleide, en National Department of Health (NDoH) strategieë. Ervaring in farmakowagheid, antimikrobiiese waaksaamheid, en geneesmiddelvoorsieningsbestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bestuurs- en toesigvaardighede. Kennis van wetgewing met betrekking tot die verskaffing van Pharmaceutiese Dienste. Ervaring in farmakowagheid, antimikrobiiese waaksaamheid, geneesmiddelvoorsieningsbestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Projek- en kommunikasievaardighede. Interpersoonlike en onderhandelingsvaardighede.

Antimikrobiiese waaksaamheid in ooreenstemming met NDoH strategieë. Beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering in ooreenstemming met nasionale en provinsiale raamwerke. zu.title: Umabelana Ohlangothi: Isevisi Yamakhemikhali Ephonyiwe
zu.summary: Umabelana Ohlangothi wesevisi yamakhemikhali ephonyiwe e Free State Department of Health, ofuna inani lobudokotela bakhochemistry kanye nokubhaliswa ku-SAPC kanye neminyaka emihlanu yamava emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi.
zu.requirements: I-matric plus Appropriate Bachelor of Pharmacy Degree (NQF 7) njengoba ivunyiwe yi-SAQA evumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengogqityi wezamakhemikhali. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ku-South Africa Pharmacy Council (SAPC) (2026/2027). Ukumiselwa njengogqityi wamakhemikhali osebenzayo futhi oqashwayo ohlelweni lwesikhathi se-SAPC. Okungenani eminyaka eyi-5 njengogqityi wamakhemikhali emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi kanye neminyaka engu-3 yamava okuphatha (okuhlangenwe njalo kwisekthi yezempilo yomphakathi). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezindlela ze-National Department of Health (NDoH). Amava ekugadinweni kwezamakhemikhali, ekulawulen imishanguzo yokulwa naganekwane, kanye nokuqashwa kwezamakhemikhali kuzobayindlela enkulu. Amakhono okuphatha kanye nokuqasha. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nokunikezwa kwezinsiza zamakhemikhali. Amava ekugadinweni kwamakhemikhali, ekulawuleni imishanguzo yokulwa naganekwane, nasekuqashweni kwezamakhemikhali kuzobayindlela enkulu. Amakhono okuhlela amaphrojekthi nokuxhumana. Amakhano bokuxhumana nabantu nokuxoxisana.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi yokugadla izamakhemikhali kulo lonke izifundazwe ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha kwesiguli. Ukuphatha izinhlelo zokuqasha izinto ezingcaleni (AMS). Ukuphatha izinto ezingcaleni ngokuvumelana nezindlela ze-NDoH. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kweqembu elifudumele lezinto namashosho, kanye nokweseka izinhlelo ezikhulisiwe zokugqoka izithombe (EPI) kulo lonke amazinga okunakekelwa. Ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela nokutholakala kwezinsiza zamakhemikhala ngemithombo yamaphoyinti ngenhlangano yamaphoyinti emikhakha ngamikhakha. Ukuphatha nokuphatha izinqubomgomo ngokuvumelana namasheke wavelo namaphoyinti. Ukuqamba imibiko, ukweseka ukuhlolwa nokulandelwa kwezindlela, ukubamba iqhaza emithonjeni ehlobene, kanye nokunikela ngesikhathi esisisekelo kwezempilo. IMIBUZO: Me Moatlhodi at 083 654 2852

xh.title: Isikhundla somphathiswa: Iinkonzo zezeMitho
xh.summary: Umphathiswa weNkonzo zezeMitho kwisebe lezeMpilo leFree State, lifuna isidanga kwezezithethe zeMitho nokubhalisa kwi-SAPC ngen Erfahrung yeminyaka emihlanu emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi.
xh.requirements: I-Matric kunye ne-Degree efanelekileyo yeBachelor of Pharmacy (NQF 7) njengoko ivunyiwe yi-SAQA ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengomuthi. Ugqibo lokubhalisa kwangoku kwi-South Africa Pharmacy Council (SAPC) (2026/2027). Ukwabiwa njengomuthi osebenzayo nokuzilolonga kwi-SAPC register. Iminyaka engaphantsi kwe-5 njengomuthi emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi ngencazelo yokulawula iminyaka edluliweyo (ngokukhethwa kwisebe lempilo lomphakathi). Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba evumelekileyo. Ulwazi lweKhompyutha. Ulwazi nobufundi: Ulwazi ngemithetho, iinkqubo, namacebo asebe lezeMpilo leSizwe (NDoH). Iminyaka yomsebenzi kwi-pharmacovigilance, antimicrobial stewardship, nokulawula ukubonelelwa kwamitho iya kuba lusizo. Amaxabiso okulawula nokulawula. Ulwazi ngemithetho ethetha ngokubonelelwa kweenkonzo zePharmaceutical. Iminyaka yomsebenzi kwi-pharmacovigilance, antimicrobial stewardship, ukulawula ukubonelelwa kwamitho iya kuba lusizo. Amaxabiso oqeqesho nolwaziso. Amaxabiso obudlelwane nabantu nokuxoxisana.
xh.duties: Ukonyusa imisebenzi ye-pharmacovigilance kulo lonke iphondo ukuze kuphuculwe ukhuseleko lwesiguli. Ukuqeqesha iinjenzo zoMbuso woKulawula iMicrobe (AMS). UKulawula iMicrobe ngokulandela amacebo e-NDoH. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawula okusebenzayo kweetempareyisho zamitho negesi zonke amanqanaba ezenzo. Ukuphucula ukufikelela nokupeyileya kweenkonzo zezezamitho kumaphondo ngokuphumeza iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqeqesha nokulawula iindleko zokunika iinkonzo kumaziko ayo. Ukuqeqesha nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ngokulandela iinkqubo zamazwe ngamazwe nasemaphondweni. Ukubhalisa iingxelo, ukuxhasa ukuhlola nokuhlola ukuthobela imithetho, ukuthatha inxaxheba kumagumbi afanelekileyo, nokunika inkxaso yobugcisa kumaziko ezeMPilo. IIMBUZO : Nkosazana Moatlhodi kwi-083 654 2852.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 - 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 - R1 121 241 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 - R1 297 089 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 - R1 713 534 per annum all -inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that be structured in terms of the applicable rules, Medical Aid (Optional) Employee must meet the prescribed requirements
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 sought at Pelonomi Tertiary Hospital to manage urology conditions, with HPCSA registration and graded experience requirements.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Current annual registration with HPCSA (2026/2027). Grade 1: None after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as Medical Officer after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as Medical Officer after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of medical expertise, clinical competence, medical regulations and research analysis. Communication, empathy, compassion, problem solving, leadership, teamwork, adaptability and attention to detail.
jobs.duties: Management of medical conditions in urology to ensure that a competent service is provided to all patients. Briefing, informing and counselling patients and where appropriate relatives regarding prevention, treatment operative, complications and rehabilitation. Endeavour to become skilled in resuscitative measures and intensive care treatment to assure survival of critically ill- patients. Prescribe medications, order and interpret diagnostic tests, and assist in medical procedures and surgeries. Supervise junior staff in order to provide adequate medical care and to train them to be able to do key medical interventions. Reduce medical litigation by exercising good clinical ethos, complete medico-legal documentation, and maintain accurate medical records. Perform clinical governance and ensure compliance with all legal and statutory requirements with FSDoH, OHSC, HPCSA, CMSA and UFS. Consult patients on an outpatient basis to have optimal chronic disease management and good long term follow-up. Render outreach and support services to other levels of care in drainage areas (Free State Province). Candidate will have to perform commuted duties (compulsory & non-negotiable) in line with the relevant policy. Conducting clinical audits. Monitoring and evaluating of relevant clinical effectiveness indicators. Perform all reasonable duties as directed by the Head of Department / Head of Clinical Unit / Medical Specialist.
