af.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 - 3
af.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 tot 3 gesoek by Pelonomi Tertiary Hospital om urologie-toestande te bestuur, met HPCSA-registrasie en gegradeerde ervaringsvereistes.
af.requirements: Matriek plus toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Huidige jaarlikse registrasie met HPCSA (2026/2027). Grade 1: Geen na registrasie met HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Medical Officer na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Medical Officer na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van mediese kundigheid, kliniese bevoegdheid, mediese regulasies en navorsingsanalise. Kommunikasie, empatie, deernis, probleemoplossing, leierskap, spanwerk, aanpasbaarheid en aandag tot besonderhede.
af.duties: Bestuur van mediese toestande in urologie om te verseker dat bevoegde diens aan alle pasiënte voorsien word. Voorligting, inligting en berading van pasiënte en, waar toepaslik, familielede rakende voorkoming, behandeling, operasies, komplikasies en rehabilitasie. Strewe om vaardig te raak in reanimasiemaatreëls en intensiewesorgbehandeling om die oorlewing van kritieke siek pasiënte te verseker. Voorskryf van medikasie, bestel en interpretasie van diagnostiese toetse, en bystand by mediese prosedures en chirurgie. Toesig hou oor junior personeel om voldoende mediese sorg te verskaf en om hulle op te lei om sleutelmediese ingrypings te kan doen. Verminder mediese litigasie deur goeie klinieke etos uit te oefen, volledige medies-juridiese dokumentasie te voltooi, en akkurate mediese rekords te handhaaf. Voer kliniese bestuur uit en verseker nakoming van alle regstatlike vereistes met FSDoH, OHSC, HPCSA, CMSA en UFS. Raadpleeg pasiënte op 'n poliklinieke basis vir optimale chroniese siektebestuur en goeie langtermyn-opvolg. Lewer uitreik- en ondersteuningsdienste aan ander sorgvlakke in dreineringsgebiede (Free State Province). Kandidaat sal skofpligte (verpligtend en nie-onderhandelbaar) moet uitvoer in ooreenstemming met die tersaaklike beleid. Voer kliniese oudits uit. Monitering en evaluering van tersaaklike kliniese doeltreffendheidsaanwysers. Voer alle redelike pligte uit soos deur die Hoof van Departement / Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid / Mediese Spesialis voorgeskryf.

zu.title: I-Medical Officer izinga 1 - 3
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-Medical Officer izinga 1 kuya ku-3 e-Pelonomi Tertiary Hospital ukuphatha izimo ze-urology, nokuba nokubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA nezidingo zolwazi ngokwezinga.
zu.requirements: I-Matric nehlelo elifanele okuvumela ukubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njenge-Medical Practitioner. Ukubhaliswa kwamaje ngonyaka ne-HPCSA (2026/2027). Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njenge-Medical Practitioner. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 yolwazi olufanele njenge-Medical Officer emva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njenge-Medical Practitioner. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-10 yolwazi olufanele njenge-Medical Officer emva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njenge-Medical Practitioner. Ulwazi Nobuso: Ulwazi ngobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha, ukuzikwazisa ngokwelapha, imithethonqubo yokwelapha nokuhlaziya uphando. Ukuxhumana, ukuzwela, inhliziyo ethanda, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ubuqhawe, ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukuzivumelanisa nokunaka imininingwane.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezimo zokwelapha ku-urology ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kunikho konke izinkonzo ezikwazile kubo bonke abagulayo. Ukwazisa, ukwazisa nokweluleka abagulayo lapho kufanelekile nabanabangane ngesithombe sokuvikela, ukwelapha, ukwenza izindlela, izinkinga nokubuyisela isimo. Ukuzamazama ukuba nobuchwepheshe ekwenzeni izindlela zokuphilisa futhi ukwelapha abagule kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphila kwabagule be-sintu. Ukubhala imithi, uku-oda futhi ukuhlaziya izivivinyo zokuxwaya, futhi usize kulezo zindlela zokwelapha nezokuhlinza. Ukulawula abasebenzi abasesigabeni esiphansi ukuze kunikwe ukunakekelwa okwanele kokwelapha futhi bafundiswe ukwenza izinto ezibalulekile zokwelapha. Ukunciphisa izinkohliso zokwelapha ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezinhle zokwelapha, ukuqedela imibhalo yezomthetho yokwelapha, futhi zigcinwe imibhalo yokwelapha enechemile. Ukwenzela ukulawula izinto zokwelapha futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana namaphuphu womthetho we-FSDoH, OHSC, HPCSA, CMSA ne-UFS. Ukubonisana nabagulayo ngendlela yokuphila ezingadini ukuze kutholwe ukuphathwa okuhle kwesifo esihuba isikhathi eside futhi kuhlotshaniswe isikhathi eside. Ukunika izinkonzo zokweseka futhi usize ezinye izinga zokunakekelwa emawunwini (Free State Province). Umuntu okhethiwe uzodinga ukwenza imisebenzi yokuhamba nokwenza eminye umsebenzi (okuyisinyathelo esiyisiphethu) ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo ebanzi. Ukwenzwa kokuhlola izinto zokwelapha. Ukuqapha futhi kuhlaziya izinkomba zokusebenza kwemisebenzi yezokwelapha. Ukuwenza yonke imisebenzi enobulungisa njengoba iwotholwa yiNhloko yoMnyango / Inhloko ye-Clinical Unit / i-Medical Specialist.

xh.title: Isithuba soGqoki weZempilo Isidanga 1 - 3
xh.summary: Kufunwa uGqoki weZempilo onqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 ePelonomi Tertiary Hospital ukulawula izigulo ze-urology, ajongene nokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kunye nemfuno yamava anqanaba elitsha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sematric kananjalo nelifayithelifikheysi elifanelekileyo elivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqoki weZempilo. Ukubhalisa kwamnye onke amnye kunye ne-HPCSA (2026/2027). Isidanga 1: Akukho nalinye emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqoki weZempilo. Isidanga 2: Iminyaka eli-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengoGqoki weZempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqoki weZempilo. Isidanga 3: Iminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengoGqoki weZempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqoki weZempilo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngamava obugqi, isakhono somzimba wokusebenza ngokwempilo, imithetho yezempilo kunye nokuhlalutya kuphando. Ukunxibelelwana, inzwakuphile, isabelo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukulwaya iqela, ukuzivumela kwaye kuqwalaselwe iinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Ukulawula izigulo ezinxulumene ne-urology ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba banikwa inkonzo ezingaguniyo bonke abaguli. Ukwazisa, ukulumisa nokwelisa abaguli nakwezinye iindawo ezifanelekileko abasengozini malunga nokuthintela, ukwelapha, ukusebenza, iziphazeko zangemva kokusebenza kwayes ekubuyisweni kwesigulo. Ukuzama ukufumana amakhono wokuphilisa abaguli abakwingozi enkulu kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba baphila abaguli abasemmandla wokungalunga. Ukubhala amayeza, ukuyalela nokutolika iimvavanyo zokuxilonga, kananjalo ukuncedisa kumathuba okusebenza nokwenza iindwanayo. Ukugcina amakhosi abasebenzi abangatshatanga ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo yezempilo efanelekileyo kananjalo ukubaqeqesha ukuba bakwazi ukwenza izigqibo eziphambili zezempilo. Ukunciphisa izigqibo zezigqibo ezingafunekiyo ngokusebenzisa izimiso ezilungileyo zokusebenza ngokwempilo, ukugqiba amaphepha womthetho wezempilo, kwaye ugcine irekhodi yezempilo echanekileyo. Ukwenza ulawulo lwezempilo nokuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemithetho yonke nemithetho yasesini nesebe lezempilo le-Free State, OHSC, HPCSA, CMSA ne-UFS. Ukubonisana nabaguli ngaphandle kwesibhedlele ukuze kuthathwe ingqondo ezigqibo ezinxulumene nezifo ezingapheliyo kwaye kubekho ulandelo olulungileyo lwexesha elide. Ukunika inkonzo yokukhusela inkxaso kunye neenkonzo kumazinga amaninzi okunakekelwa kummandla wokuhamba kwamanzi (Free State Province). Umqeshwa kuya kufuneka azenze imisebenzi eshiyiweyo (ngamnye kwaye akakwazi ukungalumkiswa) ngokomthetho ohambelanayo. Ukuqeqesha iindaba zokubeka iindawo ezikwinkonzo yesiGqoki sendalo. Ukugcina iindaba ezifanelekileyo zokubeka kwindawo ekhoyo ukuze kubekho iziphumo ezilungileyo zokusebenza kwesoGqoki. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ekulungileyo njengoko iyalelwa ngumlawuli weSebe / Umlawuli weNyuni yokuSebenza / uNjingalwazi weZempilo.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Pnb4 Specialty- (CRITICAL Care Nursing
jobs.salary_text: R785 568 per annum, plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager for critical care nursing at Boitumelo Regional Hospital in Kroonstad, requiring a nursing qualification and SANC registration as a Professional Nurse.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate, Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR - A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with SANC in Critical Care: Trauma and Emergency. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse (2026/2027). A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years of the period referred to the above must be appropriate / recognisable experience in the Critical Care: Trauma and Emergency after obtaining 1-year post-basic qualification in the Critical Care: Trauma and Emergency specialty. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience at management level. Knowledge And Skills: Computer literacy. Knowledge of Public Service Legislation, policies and procedures. Thorough knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele principles, etc. Knowledge of HR policies such as: Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure and Grievance Procedure. Knowledge of OSD for nurses. Knowledge of DOH policies.
jobs.duties: Coordination of optimal, holistic specialised nursing care provided within set standard and a professional / legal framework. Plan for the provision, orientation, induction and mentoring of all nursing staff and orientation of other staff. Plan and coordinate training and promote learning opportunities for all nursing categories i.e. on the job training. Complete patient related data. Contribute to evidence - based research. Provision of effective support to nursing service. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self- development and act in the capacity of Nursing Manager as delegated. Partake in overall specialised unit functions, i.e. team building. Planning of the allocation / change list, day and night duty rosters and inputs for leave. Do readjustments as required on the shift to provide adequate nursing cover. Provide accurate record keeping and statistical information on training and staffing as requested including agency staff. Evaluation of staff on work performance according to staff management system. Execute disciplinary code and grievance procedure executed up to a certain level then referred to the Nurse Manager. Daily emergency cart control. Check ward dispensary. Exercise the control functions to meet medical / legal obligations, i.e. weekly schedule drugs control and control of medication used. Assess the suitability of equipment and consumables for specialised areas. Give budgets inputs regarding consumables and equipment budget for financial year. Order and monitor appropriate levels of consumables i.e. according to norms. Develop and ensure implementation of SOPs for the institution.

af.requirements: Senior Certificate, Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleging) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. OF - 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgelyn in Nursing (R174) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Postbasiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by SANC in Critical Care: Trauma and Emergency. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026/2027). 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in General Nursing. Ten minste 3 jaar van die bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike / erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Kennis En Vaardighede: Rekenaargeletterdheid. Kennis van Public Service-wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Kennis van DOH-beleide.
af.duties: Koordineer van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg verskaf binne vasgestelde standaard en 'n professionele / regsraamwerk. Beplan die voorsiening, oriëntasie, inlywing en mentorskap van alle verpleegpersoneel en oriëntasie van ander personeel. Beplan en koördineer opleiding en bevorder leergeleenthede vir alle verpleegkategorieë d.w.s. opleiding op die werk. Voltooi pasiëntverwante data. Dra by tot getuienisgebaseerde navorsing. Voorsiening van doeltreffende ondersteuning aan verpleegdiens. Onderhou professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling en tree in die hoedanigheid van Verpleegbestuurder soos gedelegeer. Neem deel aan algehele gespesialiseerde eenheidsfunksies, d.w.s. spanbou. Beplanning van die toekenning / veranderingslys, dag- en nagdiensroosters en insetsels vir verlof. Doen aanpassings soos vereis op die skof om voldoende verpleegdekking te bied. Verskaf akkurate rekordhouding en statistiese inligting oor opleiding en personeel soos versoek insluitend agentskappersoniel. Evaluering van personeel se werkprestasie volgens personeelbestuurstelsel. Voer disiplinêre kode en grieweprosedure uit tot op 'n sekere vlak en verwys dan na die Verpleegbestuurder. Daaglikse noodkar-kontrolle. Kontroleer afdeling-dispensarium. Oefen die kontrole-funksies uit om aan mediese / regsmatige verpligtinge te voldoen, d.w.s. weeklikse skedule-medisyne-kontrole en kontrole van gebruikte medikasie. Beoordeel die geskiktheid van toerusting en verbruikstowwe vir gespesialiseerde areas. Verskaf begrotingsinsetsels rakende verbruikstowwe en toerustingbegroting vir finansiele jaar. Bestel en monitor toepaslike vlakke van verbruikstowwe d.w.s. volgens norme. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van SOP's vir die instelling.

zu.title: Umphathi Osekela i-Pnb4 Esikhungweni Esikhethekile- (Ukunakekelwa Kwesimo Esibucayi Kwezempilo
zu.summary: Umphathi osekela ukunakekelwa kwesimo esibucayi kwezempilo e-Boitumelo Regional Hospital e-Kroonstad, ofuna iziqu zokunakekela kanye nokubhaliswa kwe-SANC njengoguli weNesi Ochwebemkhondo.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate, iziqu ze-Basic R425 (okungeyona i-diploma/degree yokunakekela) noma iziqu ezingekho ngaphansi ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguli weNesi Ochwebemkhondo. NGA - I-Degree ye-Bachelor yeminyaka engu-4 Yokunakekela (R174) evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguli weNesi Ochwebemkhondo. Isiqu sokunakekelwa esingemva kwesiqu esiyisisekelo sithatha unyaka owodwa ubuncane, esagunyaziwe yi-SANC kwi-Critical Care: Trauma and Emergency. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje kwi-South African Nursing Council njengeNesi Yochwebemkhondo (2026/2027). Ukwaziswa okungenwa ubuncane kweminyaka engu-10 ehambisana/eqashelwa emsebenzini wokunakekela ngemva kokubhaliswa njengeNesi Yochwebemkhondo kwi-SANC e-General Nursing. Buncane beminyaka engu-6 kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube ukwaziswa okuhambisana/ okuqashelwa kwi-Critical Care: Trauma and Emergency ngemuva kokuthola isiqu sokunakekelwa esingemva kwesiyisisekelo sonyaka owodwa kwi-Critical Care: Trauma and Emergency specialty. Buncane beminyaka engu-3 kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube ukwaziswa okuhambisana/okuqashelwa ezingeni lomphathi. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ULwazi lomthetho, izinqubomgomo namasu amaphathi kahulumeni. ULwazi olujulile ngenqubo nezinyathelo zokunakekela, izixhumanisi zokunakekela, namanye amasimiso omthetho ahambisana nalokhu njengoba kunjalo: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, izimiso ze-Batho-Pele, njll. ULwazi lwezinqubomgomo ze-HR njengoba kunjalo: Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, i-Code nesinqubo sesiyalezo namasu okubeka izinkinga. ULwazi lwe-OSD yabanakekeli. ULwazi lwezinqubomgomo ze-DOH.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa okungalangazelelwa, okuphelele nokukhethekile okunikezwa ngaphakathi kwesigaba esihlelesiwe nangaphakathi komsoco/omthetho. Ukucubungula ukunikezwa, ukumkhondo, ukwethula kanye nokuhola wonke amalunga okunakekela kanye nokumkhondo kolunye ucembu. Ukucubungula kokuqondisa ukulolonga nokuthuthukisa amathuba okufunda kulo lonke amaqembu okunakekela okungayona i-on the job training. Ukuphetha imininingwane ehambisana neguli. Ukufaka isandla ocwaningweni olusekelwe kubufakazi. Ukunikeza inkxaso ephumelelayo kumnyango wokunakekela. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi/izimiso zokuziphatha nokuziphilela nokusebenza ngamandla okuqondiswa njengoMphathi Wabanakekeli. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumisebenzi yamayunithi ekhethekile wonke, okungukuthi ukwakha iqembu. Ukucubungula ukwabiwa / ushintsho lwesikhathi, izikhathi zokusebenza emini nasebusuku kanye nezimiso zokuphumula. Ukwenza ialinganiselo njengoko kudingeka esikhathini ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okwanele. Ukunikeza ukugcina amarekhodi ngokucacile kanye nolwazi lwezibalo ngokuqeqesha nangabasebenzi njengoba kuceliwe kuhlanganise abasebenzi besekhonsini. Ukulinganisa abasebenzi ngokusebenza kwabo ngokwesistimu yokuqasha abasebenzi. Ukuphatha icala lesiyalezo namasu okubeka izinkinga kuye kwenziwe kwesigaba esithile bese kudluliselwa kuMphathi Wabanakekeli. Ukulawula iwhadi lezinsuku zonke zezimo esibucayi. Ukuhlola isitoreji samaphilithi egumbi. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokulawula ukuze uhambisane nezibopho zokwelapha/ zomthetho, okungukuthi ukulawula yonke imingcelela yokuhlinzeka kanye nokulawula imishanguzo esetshenziswe. Ukubuka ukufaneleka kwemisho nezinto ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-consumables kwizindawo ezikhethekile. Ukunikela ngemibono yebhajethi ngokuthi ama-consumables kanye nebhajethi yemisho yonyaka wezimali. Uku-oda kanye nokubuka amazinga ahambisana nama-consumables ngokomthetho. Ukuthuthukisa futhi kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kwe-SOPs wesikhungo.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedisayo Pnb4 Obuso obuGqithisayo- (Ukonzo lwesiGuli esibuthathaka
xh.summary: Umphathi oNcedisayo wokonzo lwesiGuli esibuthathaka eBoitumelo Regional Hospital eKroonstad, efunisa izifundo zokunyanga negunya lokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi oGqithisayo.
xh.requirements: Senior Certificate, izifundo ze-Basic R425 (okt. isatifikethi/ideshi kwinkonzo yokunyanga) okt izifundo ezingajelanelana ezivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oGqithisayo. OKT - iDeshi yeminyaka eyi-4 kwinkonzo yokunyanga (R174) evumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oGqithisayo. Isifundo sokunyanga esingaphezu kwesiseko ngeshishini lokuhamba iminyaka engu-1 ubuncinane, esamkelwe yi-SANC kwisoGqithisayo: iNkundla yokulimala nezeMfazwe. Ugqibelelo lokubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengomongikazi oGqithisayo (2026/2027). Ulwazi olungu-10 ubuncinane olufanelekileyo/lwamkelwayo kwinkonzo yokunyanga emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oGqithisayo kwi-SANC kwinkonzo yokunyanga iNqanaba eliPhanisayo. Inyanga ezingu-6 ubuncinane kwelixesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka zibe lulwazi olufanelekileyo/lwamkelwayo kwisoGqithisayo: iNkundla yokulimala nezeMfazwe emva kokufumana isifundo sokunyanga esingaphezu kwesiseko kwisoGqithisayo: iNkundla yokulimala nezeMfazwe. Inyanga ezingu-3 ubuncinane kwelixesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka zibe lulwazi olufanelekileyo/lwamkelwayo kwinqanaba lolawulo. ULwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngeMithetho, iMigaqo namanyathelo aloMmandla kaWpolisi. ULwazi oluZolileyo ngeenkqubo namanyathelo okunyanga, iMithetho yamagosa kunye nezinye iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo ezinjengal: iMithetho yamagosa okuNyanga, iMithetho yeMpi lo yempilo, iMithetho yoKhuseleko loNyuso kwilwandle, iMithetho yaAmalungelo oMntu, imigaqo yeBatho-Pele, njl. Ulwazi ngoMigaqo babasebenzi njengal: iMithetho yoPhuhliso lwamakhono, iMithetho yolawulo kaWpolisi, iMithetho yeziQendu zokuSebenza, iMithetho esiKolweni namanyathelo ayo nanyathelo lokuphakamisa iingxaki. Ulwazi nge-OSD yamagosa okuNyanga. Ulwazi ngoMigaqo ye-DOH.
xh.duties: Ulungelelwaniso lokuXabisa iinkonzo ezilungileyo, ezibonakalisayo ezikumgangatho ocwelwayo nangommandla wentlalontle. UkuQwalasela ukuBonelela, ukuQeqesha abantu abasha, ukwazisa kuQeqesho nokukhokela onke amagosa okuNyanga nokwazisa abanye basebenzi. UQwalaselo noLungelelwaniso loQeqesho lonke amagosa eNkonzo yokunyanga. UQwalaselo noLungelelwaniso loQeqesho lonke amagosa eNkonzo yokunyanga kunye nokukhuthaza amathuba okuFunda qho bonke oomaKumkani bokuNyanga, oko kukuthi uQeqesho esebenzini. UkuGqibezela iNgcombolo ngagcali abagulayo. UkuNconga kumXholo ophekwe ngonobumba. UkuBonelela ngokusebenza okuLungileyo oNcedweni lokuNyanga. UkuGcina uKukhula kweshishini nemiThetho yolunxibelelwano nokuZithuthelisa phambili. UkuThatha inxaxheba kuNkqubo ngokubanzi, ukwakhiwa kweqela. UQwalaselo loLungelelwaniso oluShiywa abantu abashiya noma uludwe lokuTshintsha, imini nonyaka oNke kunye nokuFakela iNgcombolo ngeNkonzo. UkuQwalasela iNgcombolo njengoko kufunekayo ekubeni kuQeqeshwe ngokwaneleyo amagosa okuNyanga. UkuBonelela ngokugcina iNgcombolo ngeNkcazelo ngokubakhele kweMpilo ngenkqubo yeMithetho yokuNyanga. UkuQwalasela iNgcombolo ngokugcinwa kwemiThetho nemiQathango yesiQendu esiXoxiweyo, oko kukuthi uLawulo lweekhadi lweNkqubo ngeSonto ngeSonto. UkuThathwa ngokusesikweni seNgcombolo nokuQwalaselwa ngokugcinwa kweMithetho. UkuQwalasela kokuQwalaselwa kweMpilo kunye neSihlwele sazo eZithile.

Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of legislation related to environmental health, project management and stakeholder engagement. Knowledge of the International Health Regulations. Ability to work well under pressure, irregular hours, independently and in a team. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Management and supervision of EHP's in the District. Effective development of staff, Plan and implement Environmental Health Strategies, Oversee and coordinate. Environmental health services rendered by EHP's based at different units/ facilities within the district. Liaise with other stakeholders on Environmental Health related issues, support and ideal clinics. Management and coordination of training programs in the district. Monitoring of health care facilities in accordance to national norms and standards. Develop, implement, and review environmental health policies and SOPs. Align Primary Health Care environmental health practices with national health regulations. Contribute to PHC strategic plans and quality improvement programs. Lead environmental health response during emergencies and outbreaks. Participate in disaster and emergency preparedness planning. Advise District leadership during environmental health crises. Ensure ongoing training programs for PHC staff and community awareness campaigns according to health calendar. Review food-related incident investigations and reports. Promote environmental health awareness at senior management level. Advise on chemical safety, hazardous substances, and spill management. Prepare high-level reports for District management. Provide expert advice on environmental health risks and controls. Monitor trends, incidents, and performance indicators. Advocate for resources, staffing, and infrastructure improvements. Investigate complaints related to food safety related to food safety concerns, outbreaks, and any violations to food safety regulations in collaboration with Municipal Health services. Emergency response planning in the development of emergency response plans for food related incidences such as food born illness outbreaks contamination and recalls. Liaise with provincial EHS, ensure the implementation of the department's strategies. Assist with other activities delegated by the supervisor / manager. Provide support to District Environmental Health Manager or Assistant Director Environmental Health on other related activities. Execute other tasks/duties delegated by the Assistant Director Environmental Health Manager / Supervisor. Participate in Malaria control activities. Ensure capturing of relevant data on DHIS and other systems.

af.title: Hoof Omgewingsgesondheidspraktisyn GRD 1
af.summary: Bestuur en hou toesig oor omgewingsgesondheidspraktisyne dwarsoor Lejweleputswa-distrik, implementeer gesondheidsstrategieë en koördineer dienste op fasiliteitsvlak.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat) graad in Omgewingsgesondheid, Registrasie by die Gesondheidsprofessieraad van Suidelike Afrika as 'n onafhanklike praktisyn. Minimum van 6 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA na gemeenskapsdiens. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring in omgewingsgesondheid. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van wetgewing verwant aan omgewingsgesondheid, projekbestuur en belanghebbendesbetrokkenheid. Kennis van die Internasionale Gesondheidsregulasies. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), beplanning en organisering, toesighoudend, navorsing/ontleding en probleemoplossing asook rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). Vermoë om goed onder druk, onreëlmatige ure, onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur en toesig van Omgewingsgesondheidspraktisyne in die distrik. Effektiewe personeelontwikkeling. Beplan en implementeer omgewingsgesondheidsstrategieë. Hou toesig en koördineer. Omgewingsgesondheidsdienste gelewer deur Omgewingsgesondheidspraktisyne gebaseer by verskillende eenhede/fasiliteite binne die distrik. Skakel met ander belanghebbendes oor omgewingsgesondheidsverwante kwessies, ondersteun en ideale klinieke. Bestuur en koördinering van opleidingsprogramme in die distrik. Monitering van gesondheidsorgfasiliteite in ooreenstemming met nasionale norme en standaarde. Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien omgewingsgesondheidsbeleid en standaardbedryfsprosedures. Bely Primêre Gesondheidsorg-omgewingsgesondheidspraktyke met nasionale gesondheidsregulasies. Dra by tot Primêre Gesondheidsorg-strategiese planne en gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Lei omgewingsgesondheidsreaksie tydens noodgevalle en uitbrekings. Neem deel aan ramp- en noodgereedheidsbeplanning. Adviseer distrikleierskap tydens omgewingsgesondheidskrisisse. Verseker deurlopende opleidingsprogramme vir Primêre Gesondheidsorg-personeel en gemeenskapsbewustheidsveldtogte volgens gesondheidskalender. Hersien voedselverwante voorvalondersoeke en verslae. Bevorder omgewingsgesondheidsbewustheid op seniorbestuursvlak. Adviseer oor chemiese veiligheid, gevaarlike stowwe en morsbestuur. Voorberei hoëvlakverslae vir distrikbestuur. Verskaf kundige advies oor omgewingsgesondheidsrisiko's en -beheer. Monitor tendense, voorvalle en prestasie-aanwysers. Pleitbemiddel vir hulpbronne, personeel en infrastruktuurverbeterings. Ondersoek klagtes wat verband hou met voedselveiligheid wat verband hou met voedselveiligheidskwessies, uitbrekings en enige skendings van voedselveiligheidsregulasies in samewerking met Munisipale Gesondheidsdienste. Noodreaksiebeplanning in die ontwikkeling van noodreaksieplanne vir voedselverwante voorvalle soos voedselgedraagde siekte-uitbrekings, kontaminasie en herroepe. Skakel met provinsiale Omgewingsgesondheidsdienste, verseker die implementering van die departement se strategieë. Bystand met ander aktiwiteite gedelegeer deur die toesighouer/bestuurder. Verskaf ondersteuning aan Distrik Omgewingsgesondheidsbestuurder of Assistentdirekteur Omgewingsgesondheid oor ander verwante aktiwiteite. Voer ander take/pligte uit gedelegeer deur die Assistentdirekteur Omgewingsgesondheidsbestuurder/Toesighouer. Neem deel aan Malaria-beheeraktiwiteite. Verseker vaslegging van tersaaklike data op DHIS en ander stelsels.

zu.title: Umphathi oyinhloko Wenzululo Empilo Yendawo GRD 1
zu.summary: Phatha futhi ulawule abenzululo bempilo yendawo kulo lonke i-Lejweleputswa District, ukuphumeza izinhlela zempilo nokuhlanganisa izinsiza ezingeni lesikhungo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) noma iziqu ku-Environmental Health, ukubhalise ku-Health Professional Council of Southern African njengomuntu osebenzela bodwa. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-6 yeminye yohlu lwemisebenzi ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA ngemva kokuqasha abasebenzi bomphakathi. Okungenani eminyakeni emithathu (3) yohlu lwemisebenzi kunsululo empilo yendawo. Ulwazi Nobuhlakani: Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nensululo empilo yendawo, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nokuqhathanisa abahlanganyeli. Ulwazi nge-International Health Regulations. Isakhono sokuxhumana (sokukhuluma nokubhala), ukucubungula futhi uhlele, ukulawula, uphando/uhlaziyo, kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nesakhono sokuqamba ngamakhompyutha (MS Office package). Isikhono sokusebenza kahle ngaphansi kokucindezelwa, emahoreni angajwayelekile, ngabodwa nangeqembu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa nokulawulwa kwe-EHP kuyo yonke i-District. Ukuthuthukiswa okusebenzayo kwabasebenzi, hlela futhi uphumeze Izinhlela Zensululo Empilo Yendawo, Qapha futhi uhlanganise. Izinsiza zensululo empilo yendawo ezihlinzekwa yi-EHP ezisezindawini ezahlukene / izikhungo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Xhumana nabanye abahlanganyeli ezindabeni ezihlobene nensululo empilo yendawo, ukusekela nangamakliniki aqothulayo. Ukuphathwa nokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlela zokuqeqesha esifundeni. Ukuqapha izikhungo zezinsiza zempilo ngokuvumelana nemitsetfo yezwe nemizingwa. Buka, phumeza, futhi ubuyekeze imithetho yensululo empilo yendawo kanye nama-SOP. Lunganisa izindlela zensululo empilo yendawo ze-PHC ngemithetho yempilo yezwe. Yisose izinhlela ezibalulekile ze-PHC kanye nezinhlela zokuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi. Bumba impendulo yensululo empilo yendawo ngesikhathi sezimo eziphuthumayo nezikhululekile. Thatha inhlombe ekuhlelweni kwesimo esiphuthumayo nokulungelelwa iziphazamiso. Lulela inhloli yesifunda ngesikhathi sezikhululeko zensululo empilo yendawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ezinye izinhlela zokuqeqesha zisaphila kubasebenzi be-PHC kanye nemikhankaso yokwazisa abantu ngokuhambisana nakhalenda yempilo. Buyekeza iziphathimandla eziphathe ukudla nokubika. Khuthaza ukwaziswa ngenzulo empilo yendawo ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha. Lulela ngokuphepha kwamakhemikhali, izinto eziyingozi, nokuphathwa kokuchithwa. Lungiselela okubalulekile ukubika kukaphathi we-District. Nikeza ngeluleko elihamba phambili ngezingozi zenzululo empilo yendawo kanye nezilawuli. Qapha izindlela, izehlo, kanye nezinkomba zokusebenza. Sabela ngawomlando, abasebenzi, nokuthuthukiswa kwesakhiwo. Phenya izikhalo ezigqugquzelwa ukuphepha kokudla ngokuphathe izinkathazo zokuphepha kokudla, izikhululeko, kanye nanoma yiluphi ukuphulwa kwemithetho yokuphepha kokudla ngokusebenzisana nemiqulu yezinsiza Yempilo yeMphakathi. Ukulungelelwa ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlela zokuphendula ezimeni ezibucayi ezihlobene nokudla njengesifo sokudla ukutheleleka kudlulele ezimeni eziphuthumayo kanye nokubuyisela. Xhumana ne-provincial EHS, qinisekisa ukuphumeza izinhlelo umnyango. Siza ngeminye imisebenzi enikelwe umphathi / umphathi. Nikeza ngokusekela umphathi wenzululo impilo yendawo we-District noma umsizi we-Director wenzululo impilo yendawo eminye imisebenzi egehile. Zifeze eminye imisebenzi noma izinkomishi ezinikelwe msizi we-Director umphathi wenzululo impilo yendawo / umphathi. Thatha inhlombe emisebenzini yokulawula i-Malaria. Qinisekisa ukufakwa kwemininingwane ebalulekile ku-DHIS kanye nezinye izimiso.

xh.title: Practitioner yeNdalo yezeMpilo eNqununu iGRD 1
xh.summary: Ukulawula nokubeka ngasentla abasebenzi bendalo yetempelokhaya kulo lonke i Lejweleputswa District, nokusebenzisa iindlela zeempilo zoluhlalo nobudlelwane kumgangatho weziko.
xh.requirements: I degree ye Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) kwindalo yezempilo, ukubhalisa kwi Health Professional Council of Southern African njengomntu oqhuba imisebenzi yakhe ngokuzimeleyo. Okungenani iiminyaka engama-6 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi. Okungenani iminyaka elithoba (3) yamava kwindalo yezempilo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo enxulumene nendalo yezempilo, ulawulo lweeprojekthi kunye nentlobo-nntlobo nabantu bakunye. Ulwazi nge International Health Regulations. Ukuziqhelanisa ngokubalulekileyo (ngokuthetha nokubhala), ukuqamba izicwangciso nokuhlela, ukulawula, ukuphanda/hlaziya, kunye nokuqamba iindlela zokuxazulula iingxaki njengokunokuba nakhona ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (iphakheji ye MS Office). Ukuba nako ukusebenza kakuhle ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ngeyure ezingaqhelananga ngokuzimeleyo nakwindima eqela. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties:
Ukulawula nokubeka ngasentla abasebenzi bendalo yetempelokhaya ababhaliswe kwiSebe lezeempilo ekuwohlokeni kweShishini iLejweleputswa District. Ukuba nesakhono ekuphuhliseni izisebenzi. Cwangcisa ukuze kusebenze iindlela zeempilo zoluhlalo nemizekelo yezempilo. Qaphela ukuze kusebenze ngokuhambelana nendalo yezempilo eziswa ngumntu ovela kummandla ongaphaya kwesikhululo samapolisa okanye kwezinye iindawo ezikwisiphithiphathi sokuxhoma esithili. Yenza ibango ngezinye iindawo kwabamelwe ngemiba ethe ngqo kwindalo yezempilo. Yenza uxhaso lwezempilo nemiba echonge ngxweme ekujoliswa kuyo kubakho ukuba nemfuno kwezi zilumkisiwe ngenxa yemiba yendalo.

Ngenxa yokuphila ngobulumko, lingagqitywa kumgangatho ophezulu wokuphatha imali yentlalo nemigaqo esetyenziswayo kwilali. Kodwa ngokusebenzisa igalelo elincinci lama-44.5% ngokugqibeleleyo kwimali yokugqibela ibonele malunga nokuqinisekiswa ngenxa yamathuba emisebenzi ngenkqubo.

Ukusukela emva kweyure ezingama-6, amaqhinga ophando ngamava ngokuphuhlisa ngokusebenzisa izindlu ezahlukene ngokubanzi. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuvavanyeni amava ngosuku olukhulu oluvela kubashiyekileyo njengoko kuchazwe ngumntu ovela kubagqibela ngokusebenzisa inkqubo yokuvavanya abasebenzi ababhaliswe.

Kwiinkqubo zokubonelela ngemiba ethe ngqo kwindalo yezempilo ezikumgangatho ophezulu, ngokuvumelana nemigaqo yesi-6 yamagqabantshintshi. Iinkqubo zokubonelela ngamava kwimizamo yokubonelela kubakho iindawo ezikumgangatho ophezulu kwilali.

Iindlela ezahlukene zokubonelela ngamava ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlulweyo. Kungenjalo, iindlela zokubonelela ngamava kwimizamo yokubonelela kwindalo yezempilo ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezikumgangatho ophezulu. Ukuqinisekisa iindlela zokubonelela ngamava kumgangatho ophezulu kwilali.

jobs.centre: Lejweleputswa District – Theunissen and Winburg Station
jobs.salary_text: Grade 3: R413 199 – R472 449 per annum Grade 4: R499 311 – R570 5710 per annum Grade 5: R584 604 – R631 551 per annum Grade 6: R649 260 – R728 853 per annum plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Station Manager position in Theunissen and Winburg for the Free State Department of Health, requiring ILS or ECT qualification with HPCSA registration.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 or equivalent qualification plus Grade 3: Successful completion of an appropriate Intermediate Life Support (ILS) course that allows registration with the HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) as an Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA), Grade 4: Successful completion of an Emergency Care Technician (ECT) course that allows registration with the HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) as Emergency Care Technician (ECT) Grade 5: Successful completion 184 of an Critical Care Assistant (CCA) Course or National Diploma course that allows registration with the HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) as Paramedic. Grade 6: Successful completion of a Bachelor of Technology Degree that allows registration with the HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) as an Emergency Care Practitioner. A Valid Code 10 Drivers Licence with Professional Drivers Permit (P/G) Experience: Grade 3: A minimum experience of three (3) years after registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa as an Ambulance Emergency Assistant coupled with compulsory exposure to managerial or supervisory line functions. Grade 4: A minimum experience of three (3) years after registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa as an Emergency Care Technician coupled with compulsory exposure to managerial or supervisory line functions. Grade 5: A minimum experience of three (3) years after registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa as a Paramedic coupled with compulsory exposure to managerial or supervisory line functions. Grade 6: A minimum experience of three (3) years after registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa as an Emergency Care Practitioner coupled with compulsory exposure to managerial or supervisory line functions. A valid code C1 driver’s license with an unendorsed PDP. Diploma in Management or above will be an added advantage. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of Supply Chain Policy and Financial Management. Be able to work under pressure and excessive hours. Be prepared to travel and attend to emergencies after hours. 126 Knowledge of Labour Relations. Computer literacy. Good interpersonal Skills, written, verbal and presentation Skills. Accuracy and attention to detail.
jobs.duties: General office administration. Human Resource Management- Ensure completion of Staff Performance Agreements, Monitoring Staff Performance, Management of Shift Rosters, Management of Personnel Leave, Management of Staff Discipline and Conflict, Act as a role player in ensuring Personnel Training and Education, Overall Supervision of Personnel. Financial Management – Management of Personnel Allowances (i.e Standby, Overtime etc), Management of Employer Assets (i.e Vehicles and Equipment including the allocations hereof) Communication – Compile and completion of Monthly Reports and Statistical Data only a daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly basis. Liaison Function – Assisting Members of the public with enquiries and liaise with stakeholders on matters pertaining to Emergency Medical Services. Be responsible of all EMS activities in the Station. Provide advice on procedures and policy matters to staff and ensure compliance with all policies operating in the service. Ensure that fleet management is properly implemented to provide for the maintenance and repairs of vehicles in accordance with Transport Policy. Ensure the control and have an inventory of all resources at the Station. Be responsible for EMS occupational health and safety at the Station. Respond to all major incidents to assist and co-ordinate such incidents within the operational area. Including rescue responses and outstanding calls when necessary and attend debrief meetings. Investigate service complaints received from internal and external resources and report on these complaints to the Sub-District Manager. Effective Emergency Medical Service Management – Management of an EMS Division, Incident Management, Management of Search and Rescue Structures, Medical Rescue Management.

'n Geldige code C1 bestuurderslisensie met 'n onderskryfde PDP. Diploma in Bestuur of hoër sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van Toevoerkettingbeleid en Finansiële Bestuur. Wees in staat om onder druk en buitengewone ure te werk. Wees bereid om te reis en na noodgevalle buite ure toe te gaan. 126 Kennis van Arbeidsverhoudinge. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, skriftelik, mondelings en voorleggingsvaardighede. Akkuraatheid en aandag aan besonderhede.
af.duties: Algemene kantooradministrasie. Menslikehulpbronbestuur – Verseker voltooiing van Personeelprestasieooreenkomste, monitering van Personeelprestasies, Bestuur van Skofroosters, Bestuur van Personeelsverlof, Bestuur van Personeelsdissipline en Konflik, Tree op as 'n rolspeler om Personeelopleiding en -opvoeding te verseker, Algehele Toesig oor Personeel. Finansiële Bestuur – Bestuur van Personeeltoelaes (d.w.s. Standby, Oortyd ens.), Bestuur van Werkgewer bates (d.w.s. Voertuie en Toerusting insluitend die toedeling daarvan) Kommunikasie – Samestel en voltooi van Maandelikse Verslae en Statistiese Data slegs op 'n daaglikse, weeklikse, maandelikse en kwartaallikse grondslag. Skakelfunksie – Bystand aan Lede van die publiek met navrae en skakel met belanghebbendes oor aangeleenthede rakende Noodmediese Dienste. Wees verantwoordelik vir alle EMS-aktiwiteite by die Stasie. Verskaf advies oor prosedures en beleidsaangeleenthede aan personeel en verseker nakoming van alle beleide wat in die diens werksaam is. Verseker dat vlootbestuur behoorlik geïmplementeer word om voorsiening te maak vir die onderhoud en herstel van voertuie in ooreenstemming met Vervoerbeleid. Verseker die beheer en hou 'n inventaris van alle hulpbronne by die Stasie. Wees verantwoordelik vir EMS-beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid by die Stasie. Reageer op alle groot voorvalle om sodanige voorvalle binne die operasionele gebied by te staan en te koördineer. Insluitend reddingsresponse en uitstaande oproepe wanneer nodig en bywoon van kortingsvergaderings. Ondersoek diensklagtes ontvang van interne en eksterne hulpbronne en rapporteer oor hierdie klagtes aan die Sub-Distrikbestuurder. Effektiewe Noodmediese Diensbestuur – Bestuur van 'n EMS-Afdeling, Voorvalbestuur, Bestuur van Soek- en Reddingsstrukture, Mediese Reddingsbestuur.

zu.title: Station Manager Grade 3 – 6
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaStation Manager kwiTheunissen neWinburg kuMnyango wezezeMpilo weFree State, sidinga iziqu ze-ILS noma i-ECT ukuze kubhaliswe kuHPCSA.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi somatikuletsheni / Ibanga 12 noma izitifikedi ezingalingana nalesi. Grade 3: ukwedlula ngempumelelo isifundo esifanele sokulondolozwa ukuphila (ILS) okuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomuntu onceda kwizimo ezibuthuthuma (AEA). Grade 4: ukwedlula ngempumelelo isifundo se-Emergency Care Technician (ECT) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomuntu onceda kwizimo ezibuthuthuma (ECT). Grade 5: ukwedlula ngempumelelo isifundo se-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) noma iziqu ze-National Diploma ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomuntu ophilayo. Grade 6: ukwedlula ngempumelelo iziqu ze-Bachelor of Technology Degree ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomuntu ophilayo. Ifayili ekhethwe 10 yomshayeli ngesimvumelwano sabashayeli abangamadosi (P/G). Isipiliyoni: Grade 3: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomuntu onceda kwizimo ezibuthuthuma, kuhlanganwe nokuqashelwa okuyimfuneko kumsebenzi wokuphathwa noma wokulawula. Grade 4: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomuntu onceda kwizimo ezibuthuthuma, kuhlanganwe nokuqashelwa okuyimfuneko kumsebenzi wokuphathwa noma wokulawula. Grade 5: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomuntu ophilayo, kuhlanganwe nokuqashelwa okuyimfuneko kumsebenzi wokuphathwa noma wokulawula. Grade 6: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomuntu ophilayo, kuhlanganwe nokuqashelwa okuyimfuneko kumsebenzi wokuphathwa noma wokulawula. Isitifikedi sesimvumelwano sabashayeli ngokuthi code C1 esitholakala ngempahla ekhona. Iziqu ezingaphezulu kwe-Diploma in Management zizobe ngcono kakhulu. Ulwazi nezikhali: Ulwazi lwe-Supply Chain Policy kanye ne-Financial Management. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngokucindezelwa kanye neyora eziningi. Ukuba ulungele ukuhamba uhlangene nobuso nokwenza izinkonzo ngemva kwamahora. Ulwazi lwe-Labour Relations. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izakhono ezinhle zokuqondana kwabantu, ukubhala, ukukhuluma nezinkulumo zokuqondana neze. Ukuzinza futhi uqaphele okuncane.
zu.duties: Ukuphathe kwayejensi yenhloko. Ukuphathwa kwamababe abantu - Qinisekisa ukuqedwa kwamavesi emisebenzi yabasebenzi, ukubuka imisebenzi yabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwemusho wokushintshana kwabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwelethi yabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kokuziphatha kwabasebenzi nokuqhathaniswa kwezinkulumo, ukuba ngumdlali ohlukumezayo ekubeni ukutholakala kwemfundo yabasebenzi kususelwa eceleni, ukulawula abasebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwemali - ukuphathwa kwemibhalo yemali yabasebenzi (njengasese, ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi, njll), ukuphathwa kwempahla yakomnuzi (izimoto nezimbonakaliso kuhlangenwe nokuqashelwa kwaleyo mpahla). Ukuxhumana - ukubhala nokuphumelela kwamababalo beyanga ngokulinganisa kolwazi oluwusuku, nsuku zonke, nsini, nangamakhulu amathathu. Inhloso yokuxhumana - ukusiza amalungu emphakathhi ngemibuzo besebaxhumana namanye abantu kochwepheshe bezezimali ezithinta imisebenzi yezinsizakalo zokuxhumana kwesikhashana. Ukuba nomsebenzi wokuphathwa kwayo yonke imisebenzi yesevisi yezokwelapha eceshashelweni. Ukunika izeluleko ngezinqamulelo kanye nenhloso-mayelana nabasebenzi bese ukhuthaza ukuze bathobele wonke amaqhinga okuqhubekayo kule sevisi. Ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kusize ukuphathwa kwezimoto kusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ukuze kutholakale ukuphathwa nokulungiswa kwezimoto ngokulandela isimiso sezokuhamba. Ukwenza isiqiniseko sokulawula ibe nobhalo lwazo zonke izinsizakalo ezisesikhashanweni. Ukuba nomsebenzi wokwazisa kwezokuqapha kwezempilo yakho nokuqapha ukuphila kwabasebenzi eceshashelweni. Ukuphendula konke okungenzeka kakhulu ukuze usize futhi uhlanganise lezo zehlakalo endaweni yokusebenza. Kuhlanganwe nokuphendula ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo kanye nokubiza okugcwele uma kudingeka bese uya emihlanganweni yokuxoxa ngemibiko yomsebenzi. Ukubuyeza izikhalazo ezitholwa kubantu bangaphakathi nabangaphandle futhi uzibike ngazo kumholi wesifunda. Ukuphathwa ngempumelelo kwezokwelapha kwemisebenzi yezokuxhumana - ukuphathwa kwecandelo lezokuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwezehlakalo, ukuphathwa kwezakhi zokuphenya noma ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi bezezimali.

xh.title: UMphathi weNdawo iGreej 3 – 6
xh.summary: Isithuba soMphathi weNdawo eTheunissen nakwiWinburg kumSebenzi wezeMpilo oMntla weNtlambo, esifuna isifikelelo se-ILS okanye se-ECT nokuBhaliswa kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sePimithari / Igrejyeshini 12 okanye isifikelelo esilinganayo ngenyawo Igrejyeshini 3: Ukugqibela ngaphandle kolawulo lokuQeqesha iKholeji yoBomi ePhakathi (ILS) evumela ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomNcedi weZeMveliso eSontweni (AEA), Igrejyeshini 4: Ukugqibela ngaphandle kolawulo lokuQeqesha iTeknikhala yoBomi (ECT) evumela ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengeTeknikhala yoBomi (ECT) Igrejyeshini 5: Ukugqibela ngaphandle kolawulo lokuQeqesha iKholeji yoBomi eVuthi (CCA) okanye iDiploma eSizwe esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomNcedi weGqirha. Igrejyeshini 6: Ukugqibela ngaphandle kolawulo lokuQeqesha iNqununu yeBachelors eVumela ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA (Health Professional Council of South Africa) njengomNcedi weGqirha eNgesiNgesi eZoBomi. Ilayisenisi yoBumpompo beKhodi 10 evunyiweyo ngeMVuthiweyo yoBumpompo beKhodi (P/G) IsipiliSis: Igrejyeshini 3: IsipiliSis esingaphantsi kwamva amawaka athathu (3) emva kokubhaliswa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa njengomNcedi weZeMveliso eSontweni (AEA) afakelwe kwingxwelo enyanzelisayo yomsebenzi oQondisayo okanye oLawulayo. Igrejyeshini 4: IsipiliSis esingaphantsi kwamva amawaka athathu (3) emva kokubhaliswa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa njengeTeknikhala yoBomi eZoBomi eNgesiNgesi afakelwe kwingxwelo enyanzelisayo yomsebenzi oQondisayo okanye oLawulayo. Igrejyeshini 5: IsipiliSis esingaphantsi kwamva amawaka athathu (3) emva kokubhaliswa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa njengomNcedi weGqirha afakelwe kwingxwelo enyanzelisayo yomsebenzi oQondisayo okanye oLawulayo. Igrejyeshini 6: IsipiliSis esingaphantsi kwamva amawaka athathu (3) emva kokubhaliswa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa njengomNcedi weGqirha eNgesiNgesi eZoBomi afakelwe kwingxwelo enyanzelisayo yomsebenzi oQondisayo okanye oLawulayo. Ilayisenisi yoBumpompo beKhodi C1 evunyiweyo enePDP engenasiphose. I-Diploma eNqwenela noma ngaphezulu iya kuba yinzuzo. Ulwazi nokuQonda: Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yoQondiso nokuLawulwa kweMali. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngexesha elinzima nangamawa amaninzi. Ukuba lugqelo lokuhamba nokusabela kwiingozi emva kweyure. 126 Ulwazi lweMigaqo yokuLawulwa kweMisebenzi. Ukuqonda ngeKhompyutha. Ikhono elihle loNxibelelwano nabantu, ekubhaleni, ekuThetheni nasekuBoniseni. Ukwenza kakuhle nokuqwalasela iNkcukacha.
xh.duties: Ukuphathwa kwangaphakathi kwe-ofisi jikelele. Ukuqonda izithuba zabasebenzi - Qinisekisa ukuqedwa kwezivumelwano zokuSebenza kwabasebenzi, Ukuqokelela iziphumo zabasebenzi, Ukuqonda iNkqubo yokuQwalaselwa iSheds, Ukuqonda iNqumamiso labasebenzi, Ukuqonda isiYingqiyo nokuQhidamana kwabasebenzi, Ukuba ngomnye wabadlali beNdima ekwenza ukuqeqeshwa kwaye kufundwe ngabasebenzi, Ukuqondisa abasebenzi ngokubanzi. Ukulawula iMali - Ukulawula iMali yokunikezelwa abasebenzi (njengokuLindayo, ukusebenza iNgeyure eNgaphezulu njl), Ukulawula iziXhobo zoMnikazi (iziXhobo nokuHamba njengemoto). Ukunxibelelwana - Ukudidiyela nokwenza amavebe weNyanga nayo yonke iNkcukacha eZibalulekileyo yonke imihla, ngeVeki, ngeNyanga nakwiNyanga ezintathu. Imisebenzi yoNxibelelwano - Ukuncedisa amalunga oLuntu ngemibuzo nokunxibelelana nabo kwaye nxibelelane namalungu kumthetho othi ngesiNgesi uMA. Ukwazi ukuNika iziGqibo iNgqwalasela namathoro nakumthetho jikelele kwaseBungeni kuMthetho oSekelayo oVela kuBumbi lwesiBini. Kufuneka uQinisekise ukuba uBalo lokuQondisa kwenziwa ngendlela eNcomekileyo xa kuHlola, kuQondisa nokuQonda ngokweMithetho eNkosini. Ukwenza uBume nokuHlola nokuQonda ngokubanzi kwezoBucwazi. UkuHlola iNgxaki nokuHlolwa kweNdalo yonke imimiselo eSibini. Phendula zonke iNgcubu ezisisigxina ukuze uNcede ukuze ziHlolwe, ziNcanjwe kwaye zibe ngaphezulu ngaphakathi kweNdawo eQhuba imisebenzi yaBantu. KuqRamatha iMisebenzi kaBantu kwaye kuGqiba iMisebenzi yokuSika iNgxwela.

jobs.title: Dental Therapist GR 1-3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 - R472 359 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 - R550 389 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 - R683 808 per annum plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Dental Therapist position at National District Hospital in the Free State, providing oral health treatments and education across three grade levels.
jobs.requirements: Formal tertiary qualification (Dental Therapist) that allows for the required registration with HPCSA in the relevant profession. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in the relevant profession in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed Community Services, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed Community Services, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: Minimum of 20 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed Community Services, as required in South Africa. Knowledge And Skills: Good interpersonal skills. Ability to perform under pressure and after hours. Good organizing and communication skills (written and verbal). Computer literacy. Dental Therapist experience.
jobs.duties: Providing emergency treatments for oral pain, managing dental sepsis, and treating post-extraction complications. Executing direct restorations (fillings) and placing fissure sealants. Performing scaling, root planning, and polishing to prevent and treat gum disease. Conducting oral health education and promotion programs in schools, community facilities, and public institutions. Maintaining clinical areas, sterilizing instruments, applying universal precautions to prevent cross-infection, and adhering to Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) regulations. Managing patient clinical records, bookings, correspondence, and inventory/stock control for dental materials and equipment. Providing relief services across various sub-district clinics, mobile dental vans, and correctional facilities as scheduled by provincial health departments.
jobs.enquiries: Dr M Malek at (060) 879 7871
jobs.applications: applications to be send to: https://ihealth.fshealth.gov.za/e-Recruitment
jobs.notes: all applicants must login/register to apply for positions. Accompanying relevant documentation required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, Driver’s license, ID, etc., such documents need not be certified at point of application, however, certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on, or before the day of the interview following an invitation from the Department to attend an interview, and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) should be in line with the requirements of the advertisement. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) is required for being considered for this SMS post prior to appointment. Enrolment for the course should be made on the NSG’s website at https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms- pre-entry-programme. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. Communication will be limited to short-listed candidates only. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial assets check, qualification verification and reference checks). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations and/or record. af.title: Tandheelkundige Terapeut GR 1-3
af.summary: Tandheelkundige Terapeut-pos by National District Hospital in die Free State wat mondgereedheidsbehandelings en -opvoeding oor drie graadsvlakke bied.
af.requirements: Formele tersiêre kwalifikasie (Tandheelkundige Terapeut) wat toelaat dat die vereiste registrasie by die HPCSA in die tersaaklike professie gedoen word. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in die tersaaklike professie vir Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens verrig het, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis word nie. Vlak 2: Minimum van 10 jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in die tersaaklike professie vir Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens verrig het, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis word. Vlak 3: Minimum van 20 jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in die tersaaklike professie vir Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens verrig het, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis word. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk en na ure te funksioneer. Goeie organisatoriese en kommunikasievaardighede (geskryf en mondeling). Rekenaargeletterdheid. Ervaring as Tandheelkundige Terapeut.
af.duties: Verskaffing van noodbehandelings vir mondpyn, bestuur van tandsepsis, en behandeling van post-ekstrasie-komplikasies. Uitvoer van direkte restorasies (vullings) en aanbring van fissuurseëlmiddels. Uitvoer van skubwerking, wortelbeplanning, en poleerwerk om tandvleisiekte te voorkom en te behandel. Gebruik van mondgereedheidsopvoeding en -bevorderingsprogramme in skole, gemeenskapsfasiliteite, en openbare instellings. Onderhoud van kliniese areas, sterilisering van instrumente, toepassing van universele voorsorgmaatreëls om kruisinfeksie te voorkom, en voldoen aan Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsregulasies. Bestuur van pasiëntkliniese rekords, bespreings, korrespondensie, en voorraadbeheer vir tandheelkundige materiaal en toerusting. Verskaffing van aflosdienste by verskeie sub-distriksklinieke, mobiele tandheelkundige waens, en korrektiewe fasiliteite soos deur provinsiale gesondheidsdepartemente geskeduleer.

zu.title: UTherapist Wezinyo Izinga 1-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaDokotela wezinyo esibhedlela iNational District Hospital eFree State, okunikeza ukwelashwa ngempilo yamathemu kanye nokuqinisekiswa okubhaliwe emazingeni amathathu.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esisetshenziswa esikhungweni samakhono (Dental Therapist) esikuvumela ukuba ubhalise njengoba kudingeka kuHPCSA kulikheli elithize. Isipilingo: izinga le-1: akukho okudingekile ngemva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA kulikheli elithize kubasebenzi abafundele eNingizimu Afrika (RSA) abenze inkonzo yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga le-2: ubuncane beminyaka eyi-10 yamava ahambisana nalesi sikhundla ngemva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA kulikheli elithize kubasebenzi abafundele eNingizimu Afrika (RSA) abenze inkonzo yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga le-3: ubuncane beminyaka eyi-20 yamava ahambisana nalesi sikhundla ngemva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA kulikheli elithize kubasebenzi abafundele eNingizimu Afrika (RSA) abenze inkonzo yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi Namakhono: Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nomuntu. Ikono elokuba ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi njalo nangemva kwamahora. Amakhono amahle okuhlela kanye nokuxhumana (okubhaliwe njalo okukhulunywa). Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okuqinisekiswa kokuba udokotela wezinyo.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izikliniki zesikhashana zezenhlalo njalo, uphathe izifo ezibangelwa amazinyo, ulaphe izinkinga ezivela ngemva kokukhipha izinyo. Ukwakha okugcwaliswayo (okugcwalisayo) njalo ubeka izivalo zommbila. Ukwenza ukusula, ukulungisa impande, kanye nokuhlanzisisa ukuze uvimbe ulaphe izifo ezingalimaza izinyo. Ukwakha imikhakha yokufundisa ngempilo yezinyo kanye nezikole, emisebenzi yomphakathi, njalo kwezikhungo zomphakathi. Ukugcina izikhala zesikliniki, ukuhlanza izibhozo, ukusebenzisa okuzivikelayo ngokuvamile ukuze kuvimbulwe ukutheleleka, njalo ulandelane nemithetho yezenhlalo neyeveza ngaphansi komthetho wokuvikelwa kwezenhlalo njengomsebenzi (OHS). Ukuphatha amafayela wesikliniki, ukubhuka, ukuxhumana, kanye nokulawula isitoko sezinto zezinyo kwezixhobo. Ukunikeza izikliniki zokukhuluma kumasiza amaningi, ukuphatwa kwemoto yezinyo kanye nemithetho yokuqinisekiswa ukuthi isikhathi esihle esiya esikliniki nasemakhaya okulawula izinkambu zomthetho njengesikhathi esihle sokubhala kwemithetho yezempilo yomphakathi.

xh.title: Dental Therapist GR 1-3
xh.summary: isithuba soTherapist wezinyo kw isithuba soMmandla National District Hospital kwi Free State, ukunika unyango nolwazi ngempilo yam azinyo kum aq anq an aba b anq.
xh.duties: ukunika unyango oluphuthumayo olubangelwa bubuhlungu bekanzi, ukulawula izifo ezibangelwa amazinyo, nokunyanga iingxaki ezibangelwa ukukhutshwa kwamazinyo. Ukwenza ukulungisa amazinyo ngqo (ukuzaliswa) nokubeka izinto ezivala imikhoba yamazinyo. Ukwenza ukucofa amazinyo, ukuqwalasela izimpande, nokucoca amazinyo ukuze kuthintelwe kunye nokunyanga izifo ezithathelana phakathi kwamazinyo namathambo. Ukuphatha iinkqubo zolwazi nokuqhutywa koluntu ngempilo yam azinyo kwii sikolo, kwindawo zoluntu, nakwiindawo zikawonke wonke. Ukugcina iindawo zokwelapha, ukutshaya izixhobo ngokwenza amajingqi ukubulala iintsholongcolile, nokusebenzisa iingqondo eziqhelekileyo ukuze kuthintelwe ukudibana nezifo, nokuzithobela iMigaqo yeMisebenzi yoWonke Wonke nokuKhuselwa kweMisebenzi (OHS). Ukulawula iirekhodi zabaguli, ukugcina amaqabane, ukubhala iindaba, nolawulo lwesitokhwe kwezinto ezisetyenziswa kwam azinyo nokuqeqesha. Ukunika iinkonzo ezinxibelelwayo kumaziko amabini ngokweendawo ezahlukeneyo, kwii fonik in z ezisuka ngaphandle, nakwindawo zolungisa iintsholongcolile ngokwe Ndikwe esheduli yi ndikwe yempilo ye Ndikwe.

af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Vlak 3: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Intermediate Life Support (ILS) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA) moontlik maak. Vlak 4: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Emergency Care Technician (ECT) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Emergency Care Technician (ECT) moontlik maak. Vlak 5: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Critical Care Assistant-kursus (CCA) of Nasionale Diploma wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Paramedic moontlik maak. Vlak 6: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die B-Tech-graad wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP) moontlik maak. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Geldige kode C1-bestuurslisensie. Huidige professionele bestuurderspermit (P/G). Huidige registrasie by HPCSA as 'n AEA, ECT, Paramedic of ECP. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Toevoerkettingbeleid en Finansiële Bestuur. In staat wees om onder druk en oormatige ure te werk. Bereid wees om te reis en na noodgevalle buite kantoorure aan te spreek. 126 Kennis van Arbeidsverhoudinge. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, skriftelike, mondelinge en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Akkuraatheid en aandag aan besonderhede.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n deurlopende toesighoudende funksie ten opsigte van alle bedryfsake in terme van HPCSA-beleide deur nakoming te verseker en daarvolgens te opereer. Implementering van Operasionele planne op skifvlak. Bestuur alle hulpbronne wat aan die skif toegewys is op 'n doeltreffende wyse deur beheer, monitering van gebruik en rapportering van afwykings en tekortkominge te verseker. Fassiliteer deurlopende administratiewe en Menslike Hulpbronbestuurs-toesighoudende funksies. Verantwoordelik vir Prestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel-assessering. Reageer op massaslagoffer- en rampstonele en verskaf advies en leierskap in sulke situasies. Bestuur klagtes vanuit interne en eksterne bronne. Stel verslae op en voer ondersoeke uit wanneer daarvoor vereis word. Verseker nakoming van standaardbedryfsprosedures en protokolle. Effektiewe pre-hospitaal Noodgeneeskundige Sorg en reaksie op voorvalle wanneer vereis. Verseker effektiewe toesig en onderhoud van Noodvoertuie en toerusting in ooreenstemming met die Finansiële en Vlootriglyne. Verseker effektiewe verslagskrywing met betrekking tot ongeluks- en voorvalverslae, verlies- en diefstalbeheervoorvalle en veiligheidsvoorvalle. Verseker effektiewe kommunikasie met betrekking tot pasiënte, kollegas, ander dienste en lede van die Publiek. -Toesig hou oor en bestuur roosterskofte en personeel in ooreenstemming met Personeelsbestuursbeleide en -praktyke. Verskaf effektiewe administratiewe ondersteuning aan die toesighouer wanneer vereis.

zu.title: Umphathi Weshifthi We-EMS Isigaba 3 - 6
zu.summary: Izikhundla Zabaphathi Beshifthi Be-EMS e-Bothaville ezidinga izifundo ezibhalisiwe kwi-HPCSA zezokunakekela ezimpohweni ukuba bagadle imisebenzi yeshifthi kulo lonke i-Lejweleputswa District.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane semfundo: Isigaba 3: Ukuphumelela kwi-Intermediate Life Support (ILS) okuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Isigaba 4: Ukuphumelela kwi-Emergency Care Technician (ECT) okuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Emergency Care Technician (ECT). Isigaba 5: Ukuphumelela kulesifundo se-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) noma i-National Diploma evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Paramedic. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela namasikhathi amanengi. Ukuba welulekile ukuhamba bese uphephendula ezimpohweni emva kwamahora. 126 Ulwazi Lwezomphakathi. Ukubhala ngokwekhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, okubhala, okukhuluma nokwethula. Ukuchaneka kanye nokuqaphekela imininingwane.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngomsebenzi oqhubelekayo wokulawula ngaphakathi kwazo zonke izindaba zomsebenzi ngokwezinqumo ze-HPCSA ngokuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwazo kanye nokusebenza ngazo. Ukuphetha izinhlela zomsebenzi ezingeni leshifthi. Phatha konke okuhlukanisiwe kweshifthi ngendlela ephumelelayo ngokuqinisekisa ukulawula, ukulalela ukusetshenziswa nokubika ukweqa kanye nezingaqeki. Yenza imisebenzi ephethelelayo eqhubelekayo kanye nemisebenzi yolawulo yolwazi lwabantu. Ubanjwewe ngokuhlola i-Performance Management and Development System. Phendula kwizindawo zezimpelasu nokupelelwa futhi unikeze izeluleko nobuholo kulezo zimo. Phatha izikhalazo ezezithombeni zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Hlanganisa imibiko yenza ucwaningo lapho kudingeka khona. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezinqubo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile kanye nemithetho. Ukunakekelwa okuphumelelayo kwezokwelashwa ezimpohweni ngaphambi kokuya esibhedlela kanye nokuphendula kulezo zimo lapho kudingeka khona. Qinisekisa ukulawula okuphumelelayo kanye nokugcina izithuthi eziphakamisa izimpilo nezimoto ngokuhambisana nemiyalo yezezimali nembali. Qinisekisa ukubhala imibiko okuphumelelayo ngemibiko yezehlukahluko kanye nesenzo, ukulawula ukulahlekelwe kanye nokweba kanye namaphuzu okuphephela. Qinisekisa ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo mayelana neziguli, ongane baka, ezinye izinkonzo, kanye namalungu omphakathi. -Lawula bese uphatha amashifthi ohleliwe nabantu ngokwezinqubo kanye nemikhondo yokuphatha abantu. Hlinzeka ngokusekelwa okuphumelelayo ngokokuphatha komlawuli lapho kudingeka khona.

Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amabalwe nhlobo, abhaliweyo, athethwayo nobungezelo. Ukuchaneka nokuqwalasela iinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Yenza umsebenzi wolawulo oqhubelekayo maqondana nawo onke amacandelo omsebenzi ngokwemigaqo ye-HPCSA kuwo onke amacala ngokuqinisekisa ukuthobela kwaye kusebenze ngokwako. Ukuqwalasela iiplani zomsebenzi kwinqanaba selifu. Lawula onke amacebo anikiweyo kwelifu ngendlela esebenzayo ngokuqinisekisa ulawulo, ukulandela ukusetyenziswa nokubika iindela ezingachanekanga nemitahlelo. Qhubeza umsebenzi olawulo loqulu nxaxheba nokuLawula abasebenzi. Ukwenzela ukulinganiselwa kokuLawula nokuQwalasela inkqubo yomsebenzi. Phendula kumhlaba wezohlwayo nengcuphesi kuze unikezelwe ngolwazi bubukhosi kwimeko enjalo. Lawula iingxabano ezingaphakathi nangaphandle. Hlenga iingxelo uthathe ingxaxheba kuphononongo xa kufunwa. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana neenkqubo zomsebenzi nemigaqo eqhagamshelanayo. Unyango lwe-Emergency Medical Care olusebenzayo nokuPhendula kwiimeko xa kufunwa. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nokugcina iimoto ze-Emergency nezixhobo ngokwemigaqo yezeMalih nokuLawula iimoto. Qinisekisa ukubhala iingxelo ezisebenzayo malunga neengxelo zeonxaxheba nengcuphesi, ulawulo lolahleko nangaphukuthela, neengxelo zokhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukunxibelelwana okusebenzayo malunga nabagulayo, abasebenzi, ezinye iinkonzo, nabaluntu. -Lawula oluqhubelekayo ulawulo loqulu nxaxheba kubasebenzi ngokwemigaqo yokuLawula abantu. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo olusebenzayo kumlawuli xa kufunwa.

jobs.title: Staff Nurse
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R229 440 - R256 671.per annum Grade 2: R272 778 - R306 294.per annum Grade 3: R319 071 - R391 515 per annum
jobs.summary: Staff Nurse position at Universitas Academic Hospital in the Free State, providing holistic nursing care under supervision of a Professional Nurse.
jobs.requirements: A qualification that allows registration with SANC as Staff Nurse. Current registration / APP license with the South African Nursing Council as an Enrolled Nurse. Grade 1: None after registration with the SANC as Enrolled Nurse. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Staff Nurse. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Staff Nurse. Knowledge And Skills: Excellent current clinical competencies and skills. Good organisational, collaborative and interpersonal skills. Computer literacy (Word & Excel). Honesty, integrity and high work ethics.
jobs.duties: Provide optimal, holistic nursing care with adherence to the set norms, standards and applicable professional/ legal framework under direct supervision of a Professional Nurse. Effective utilization of all resources within sphere of influence to maintain costs within the allocated budget. (Human, consumables, assets) in accordance with the Supply Chain Management prescripts. Effective implementation of risk management strategy of the FSDoH to increase efficiency, reduce service delivery-related complaints and potential for litigation. Use relevant electronic data systems including manual source documents to record, capture, reconcile data and or manage the flow of information and communication within the area of specialty. Maintain professional growth/ ethical standards and self-development in line with the Nursing Education Framework.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. MJ Radbe Tel No: (051) 405 3333

af.title: Verpleegkundige (Personeel)

af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as Verpleegkundige (Personeel) moontlik maak. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as Verpleegkundige (Personeel). Eerlikheid, integriteit en hoë werksetiek.

Effektiewe benutting van alle bronne binne invloedsfeer om koste binne die toegekende begroting te handhaaf. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi/ izimiso zokuziphatha nokuzithuthukisa ngokuvumelana neNhlelo Yokufundela Ubuhlengikazi.

Inqanaba 2: Okona kc nge-10 leminyaka yamava afanelekileyo/azifundekayo kwinongadi emva kokuqwalaselwa kwi-SANC njengonesibhakabhaka sezempilo. Inqanaba 3: Okona kc nge-20 leminyaka yamava afanelekileyo/azifundekayo kwinongadi emva kokuqwalaselwa kwi-SANC njengonesibhakabhaka sezempilo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Amakhona othotho oluhle ngezobuchwephesha obungoku kunye namakhona. Amakhona alungelelanisa, amakhona okusebenza kunye nabanye kunye namakhona okuxhumanisa nabantu. Ukuphatha ngokusebenza kakuhle inkqubo yolawulo lengozi ye-FSDoH ukwandisa ukusebenza kakuhle, ukunciphisa iingozi ezinxulumene nokuhanjiswa kwenkonzo nethemba lokubakho zezigxezo. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zedatha ezikwishishini ezifanelekileyo kuquka namaxwebhu abhalwe ngesandla ukugcina, ukubamba, ukuqwalasela idatha okanye ukulawula ukujikeleza kolwazi nonxibelelwano ngaphakathi kwendawo obungcwatile kuyo. Gcina ukukhula kwamakhono obuchwephesha/ amagingqa amagama kwaye uzilole ngokulandela i-Nursing Education Framework.

af.title: Maatskaplike Werk toesiggeweer Graad 1
af.summary: Onderrig maatskaplike werkdienste vir kwesbare individue en gemeenskappe by Mangaung Metro, wat 'n graad in Maatskaplike Werk, SACSSP-registrasie en sewe jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 12 plus 'n toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad in Maatskaplike Werk soos erken deur SAQA. Huidige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as 'n Maatskaplike Werker. 'n Minimum van sewe (07) jaar ervaring in maatskaplike werk na registrasie by die SACSSP. Geldige motorbestuurslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Bestuurs- en evalueringsvaardighede. Kennis van toesigmodel binne die sektor. Kennis van relevante programme in Maatskaplike Werk. Diepgaande kennis van die maatskaplike werkdiensleweringsmodel. Personeelbestuur en bemagtiging.
af.duties: Verseker dat maatskaplike werkdienste gelewer word met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van die relevante programme. Verseker diensnakoming aan norms en standaarde. Verseker maatskaplike werker se nakoming van die South African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP]. Onderrig, mentor, leer en adviseer maatskaplike werkers en maatskaplike hulpwerkers insluitend maatskaplike werkstudente. Koördineer en bestuur alle programme insluitend transformasie van maatskaplike welsynsdienste. Bestuur die sub-eenheid. Lewer psigososiale ondersteuning aan kliënte. Monitering en evaluering van nie-winsgewende organisasies. Verskaf administratiewe, opvoedkundige en ondersteunende funksies. Lewer berading aan kliënte. Monitering en evaluering van nie-winsgewende organisasies.

zu.title: Umphathi Wabasebenzi Bezenhlalakahle Izinga 1
zu.summary: Qapha izinsiza zomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle zabantu nabangcolile kanye namaphakathi e-Mangaung Metro, kudingeka iziqu zezenhlalakahle, ukubhaliswa kwe-SACSSP kanye namakhulu eminyaka yohambo.
zu.requirements: Izinga 12 kanye nendebeshadi efanele kumsebenzi wezenhlalakahle ehambisana ne-SAQA. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengengcwabakazi yomphakathi. Isipilingo somsebenzi wezenhlalakahle eminyakeni eyisikhombisa (07) ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-SACSSP. Ilayisensi yokushayela ethi ngempela. Ulwazi Namakhono: Amakhono Ekhompyutha. Amakhono Okusebenza Nabantu. Amakhono Okuxoxa. Amakhono Okubhala Imbiko. Amakhono Okuphatha Nokuhlola. Ulwazi ngohlelo lwokuqapha phakathi koleso. Ulwazi ngohlelo oluhambisana nomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle. Ulwazi olujulile ngohlelo lwezenhlalakahle ekwenzela abantu. Ukuphatha nokunyusula abantu.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle zinikwa ngokwaleso ngokunakekela, ukusekela, ukuvikela nokuthuthukisa abantu abangcolile, amaqembu, imindeni namaphakathi ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo ezifanele. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana kwensiza ngokwezilinganiso namazinga. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana kongcwabakazi ngokwe-South African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP]. Qapha, owlule, cochisa kanye nomelula abasebenzi bezenhlalakahle nabasebenzi abakhokhelwa ukusiza kubandakanya abafundi bomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle. Hlela futhi uphathe zonke izinhlelo kubandakanya ukuguqulwa kwensiza yokuncedisa ngokomphakathi. Phatha isigaba. Nikela ukwesekela ngokwengqondo nangokomzimba kubathengi. Ukuqapha nokuhlola izinhlangano ezingeniso umphumela. Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokuphatha, yokufundisa kanye nokwesekela. Nikela ngokweluleka abathengi. Ukuqapha nokuhlola izinhlangano ezingeniso umphumela.

xh.title: UmLawuli Wokulawula Isebe LoMsebenzi Womntu WeNqanaba 1
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zemisebenzi yabantu kumntu ngamnye nasekuhlaleni abangasindwa kwi-Mangaung Metro, kufuneka kubekho isidanga kwimisebenzi yabantu, ukubhalisa kwi-SACSSP namava eminyaka yedlule.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 kunye ne-Bachelor’s Degree elifanelekileyo kwimisebenzi yabantu njengokuvunywa yi-SAQA. Ukubhalisa ngoku kunye ne-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengoMsebenzi Wabantu. Amava amancinci eneminyaka esi (07) kumsebenzi wabantu emva kokubhalisa kwi-SACSSP. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba ihayara efanelekileyo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Amakhono Okhompyutha. Amakhono Ekuhlangenwe nakho. Amakhono EkuThetha. Amakhono Ebhali Iingxelo. Amakhono Ekulawula NokuZinikela. Ulwazi ngemodeli yolawulo ngaphakathi kwesebe. Ulwazi lweenkqubo ezifanelekileyo kwimisebenzi yabantu. Ulwazi olujulileyo ngemodeli yokunika iinkonzo zemisebenzi yabantu. Ulawulo bantu nokuqinisekisa amandla.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zemisebenzi yabantu zinikwa malunga nokunakekela, inkxaso, ukhuseleko nophuhliso komntu ngamnye osindwayo, amaqela, usapho nakuhlaleni ngeenkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkonzo ngemilinganiselo nemigangatho. Qinisekisa ukuthobela komsebenzi wabantu kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP]. Lawula, sekela, kwaza uthethe ngamabala nomcebise abasebenzi bantlalo bantlalo kuquka abafundi bemisebenzi yabantu. Lungisanisa ukuze ulawule yonke iinkqobo kuquka iinguqu zemisebenzi yohloliro loxholho. Lawula into ezingaphantsi. Nika inkxaso yomntwengamntu kumaxwebhu. Qhatha nokulinganisa iinkungu zangaphandle ezingeniso. Yonikezela ngokulawuleka ngokuxhomekeke kwemigaqo yeenkqubo. Nika ingcebiso kubaxhasi. Qhatha nokulinganisa iinkungu zangaphandle ezingeniso.

jobs.summary: Supervise community development interventions across multiple Free State offices, requiring a degree in Community Development and seven years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an appropriate three–year tertiary degree (NQF Level 7) as recognized by SAQA in Community Development/ Bachelor of Social Science (Human and Societal Dynamics) or equivalent qualification. A minimum of 7 years recognizable experience in Community Development after obtaining the required qualification. Community Development knowledge, skills, attitudes and values to engage in the social development of communities. Knowledge and understanding of human behaviour and social systems and legislation to assist with interventions at points where people interact with their environments in order to promote self-empowerment. The ability and competence to co- ordinate community development structures and ability to manage projects. The ability to influence individuals and group to participate in their own self- empowerment ventures. Understanding of social dynamics. Presentation, Problem solving skills, Computer skills, Written and verbal communication skills, Research and report writing skills, financial management and Supervisory skills. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: To supervise the identification, facilitation and implementation of integrated community development interventions in partnership with the community and other relevant stakeholders and to assist employees engaged in this function by resolving problems. Supervise and support community development practitioners to ensure that there is communication and co-ordination with all relevant role players, internal and external (e.g., in departments/provinces, NGO, local community structures and faith-based organizations) and stakeholders to facilitate intersectoral collaboration, integrated planning and establishment of partnerships to ensure sustainability of development activities within the community. Supervise and guide community development practitioners to enhance their performance on community development and to perform administrative support on community development and related activities. Keep up to date with new developments in the community development field to enhance service delivery. Supervise and advise community development practitioners to ensure an efficient and effective service. Supervise, mentor, coach and advise community development practitioners to ensure an efficient and effective service. Manage the sub-unit. Monitoring and evaluation of non-profit organisations. Provide administrative, educational and supportive functions.
