af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelings toesighouer Graad 1
af.summary: Toesig hou oor gemeenskapsontwikkelingsingrypings oor verskeie Free State kantore, wat 'n graad in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling en sewe jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 12 plus 'n toepaslike drie-jaar tersiêre graad (NQF Level 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Community Development/ Bachelor of Social Science (Human and Societal Dynamics) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar herkenbare ervaring in Community Development na verkryging van die vereiste kwalifikasie. Community Development kennis, vaardighede, ingesteldhede en waardes om betrokke te raak by die sosiale ontwikkeling van gemeenskappe. Kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en wetgewing om te help met ingrypings by punte waar mense met hul omgewings interakteer om selfbemagtiging te bevorder. Die vermoë en bevoegdheid om gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstrukture te koördineer en die vermoë om projekte te bestuur. Die vermoë om individue en groepe te beïnvloed om aan hul eie selfbemagtigingsondernemings deel te neem. Begrip van sosiale dinamika. Aanbiedings-, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, rekenaarvaardighede, skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, navorsings- en verslagskryfvaardighede, finansiële bestuurs- en toesighoudende vaardighede. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Om toesig te hou oor die identifisering, facilitering en implementering van geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsingrypings in vennootskap met die gemeenskap en ander relevante belanghebbendes en om werknemers wat in hierdie funksie betrokke is te help deur probleme op te los. Hou toesig oor en ondersteun gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyne om te verseker dat daar kommunikasie en koördinasie met alle relevante rolspelers, intern en ekstern (bv. in departemente/provinsies, NGO, plaaslike gemeenskapsstrukture en geloofsgesinde organisasies) en belanghebbendes is om intersektorale samewerking, geïntegreerde beplanning en die vestiging van vennootskappe te faciliteer om volhoubaarheid van ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite binne die gemeenskap te verseker. Hou toesig oor en lei gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyne om hul prestasie oor gemeenskapsontwikkeling te verbeter en om administratiewe ondersteuning te verrig oor gemeenskapsontwikkeling en verwante aktiwiteite. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelingsveld om dienslewering te verbeter. Hou toesig oor en gee advies aan gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyne om 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe diens te verseker. Hou toesig oor, mentor, afrig en gee advies aan gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyne om 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe diens te verseker. Bestuur die sub-eenheid. Monitering en evaluering van niewinsgewende organisasies. Verskaf administratiewe, opvoedkundige en ondersteunende funksies.

zu.title: Umphathi wezokuThuthukiswa kweNdawo izinga 1
zu.summary: Qapha ukungenelela kwezokuthuthukiswa kwendawo kumahhovisi amaningi e-Free State, okudinga idigri ezokusenza izifundo eziyiyo ezingaphezulu kwezintathu emkhakheni weCommunity Development kanye namaviki ayisikhombisa wokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana naleso sikhundla.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nedigri yamanyuvesi ahambisana namazinga ayisikhombisa (NQF Level 7) evunyiwe nguhlelo lwe-SAQA emkhakheni weCommunity Development/ Bachelor of Social Science (Human and Societal Dynamics) noma izifundo ezilingana nalezi. Ukuhlangenwa nakho okuncishiswe ngaphezulu konyaka oyisikhombisa emkhakheni weCommunity Development ngemuva kokuthola izifundo ezidingekayo. Ulwazi, amakhono, imikhuba kanye nabanikazi bezimpokothelwe besibili mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwezomphakathi komphakathi. Ulwazi, amakhono nezimpokothelwe mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwendawo kanye nomxhasi wemiphakathi nabakule ndawo ukuba bathuthukise imikhuba yegunya labo. Isipho kanye namakhono wokubeka ezimeni zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi namakhono aphethe amaphrojekthi. Isipho esipho abanikazi bomphakathi, izinhlangano nezimpande mayelana nezigaba zomphakathi namaphoyinti okuzibandakanya emzamweni wokuthuthukiswa kobuguna bomphakathi. Isipho sokukhuluma, ukubonakaliswa, ukuxazulula, izinhlelo zokulawula, nokusebenzela kahle izinhlelo zokusebenza.
zu.duties: Ukubheka isimo esingabonakali mayelana nokuhlolelwa nezinhlela zokuqinisekiswa kwezokuthuthukiswa kwindawo ngokubamba ihamu kwi-Community Development kanye namanye amathemu ukugcwalisa imigomo yokubambisana nokungenelela. Ukubuyisela emuva umthombo wokubeka ekhokhelweni ukubambe kulolu hlelo abasebenza kulolu hlelo ukubhekwa ngezinkinga. Ukubuyisela emuva nokubambe

xh.summary: Ukuqhuba iingenezo zophuhliso loluntu kuziko ezininzi kwi-Free State, kwaye kufuneka idangatya kwi-Community Development, kwaye neminyaka elishumi yamava alawo.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 ekunye nedangatya elinye leminyaka emithathu laseyunivesithi (i-NQF Level 7) evunyiwe yi-SAQA kwi-Community Development/ u-Bachelor of Social Science (Human and Societal Dynamics) okanye n equivalent qualification. Inani elingaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-7 yamava aqaqamba kwi-Community Development emva kokuze idangatya elifunekayo. Ulwazi lwephuhliso loluntu, amakhono, izimilo neenjongo zokuzibandakanya kumphuhliso weentlangano loluntu. Ulwazi nokuyiqonda indlela eziphatha ngayo abantu namagephepha oluntu namagunya axhasa iingenezo kwizikhulu apho abantu badingana nokusingqongile kwabo ukuze kulawulwe ukuzikhulisa. Ikghonisa ukuqukanisa iisakhiwo zophuhliso loluntu ikwathanda nakwakhona ukulawula amaphulo. Ikhono lokugxininisa iziqendu neeqela ukuba sibandezele ekuzinconweni kwawo. Ukuqonda iindikima zoluntu. Amakhono okubetha iingxaki, amakhono ekhompyutha, amakhono okubhala noku-thetha, amakhonoophando nabhalo-colu, ukuLawula imali, nakunxibelelwano lwephulo. I-license efanelekileyo yoqhayiya.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba ukuchonga, ukwenza lula nokuphumeza iingenezo ezidityanisiweyo zophuhliso loluntu ngokubakene noluntu nakunabanye abathintekayo abafanelekileyo kwaye uncede abasebenzi ababandakanyekile kule msebenzi ngokuxazulula iingxaki. Ukuqhuba nokuqinisekisa abaphuhlisi boluntu bokwenza ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho unxibelelwano nokuqukanisa onke amachaphaza afanelekileyo, angaphakathi nangaphandle (umz., kumasebe/iiphondo, i-NGO, iisakhiwo zoluntu lwendawo neentlangano ezisekelwe kukholo) nakubathintekayo ukuze kwenzeke udibaniswano phakathi kweentlobo, ucwangco oludityanisiweyo nokuqatshelwa kophuhliso lwamashe athile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusinika kohambo lophuhliso kuluntu. Ukuqhuba nokukhokela abaphuhlisi boluntu ukuphucula iziphumelela zabo kuphuhliso loluntu kwaye benze inkxaso yolawulo kuphuhliso loluntu nemisebenzi enxulumene nayo. Ukuhlala uwazi iintshukumo ezintsha kummandla wophuhliso loluntu ukuze kuphuculwe ukunikezela inkonzo. Ukuqhuba kunokuqinisekisa abaphuhlisi boluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo esemgangathweni nesebenzayo. Ukuqhuba, ukuba ngumcebisi, umcochi kunokuqinisekisa abaphuhlisi boluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo esemgangathweni nesebenzayo. UkuLawula isiqendu esingaphansi. Ukuqonda nokuqwalasela iintlangano ezingeniso ngeenzuzo. Ukunika inkxaso yolawulo, yemfundo nokuqinisekisa.

af.title: Maatskaplike Werker Vlak 1
af.summary: Maatskaplike Werker Vlak 1-posisies wat sorg, ondersteuning en beskerming aan kwesbare individue en gemeenskappe regdeur verskeie Free State distrikkantore bied.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike Bachelorsgraad in Maatskaplike Werk (NQF Vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken. Huidige registrasie by die SACSSP. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Lewer 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van die tersaaklike programme. Bring enige ander aangeleenthede wat tot sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei of daaruit voortvloei, in ag. Ondersteun maatskaplike hulpwerkers en vrywilligers. Hou tred met nuwe ontwikkelinge in die maatskaplikewerk- en welsynsvelde. Voer al die administratiewe funksies uit wat die werk vereis. Daar sal van die Maatskaplike Werkers Vlak 4 verwag word om die Maatskaplike Werkers Vlak 1 te mentor en af te rig sodat hulle 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe maatskaplikewerkdiens kan lewer.

zu.title: Umsebenzi wezenhlangothi 1
zu.summary: Izikhundla zeZinga 1 zabasebenzi bezenhlangothi eznikeza ngesandla, ukusekela nokuvikela abantu abangasindwa nemiphakathi emakhaya amaningi eFree State.
zu.requirements: Izinga 12 kanye nediploma noma iziqu ezifanelekile zabasebenzi bezenhlangothi kumkhakha wezenhlalo kanye nesitifiketi seSoftware efanelekile esivunyelwe yi-(SACSSP).
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi yomsebenzi wezenhlalo ngokuphathelene nokunakekelwa, ukusekela, ukuvikelwa nentuthuko yabantu abangasindwa, amaqembu, imindeni namaphakathi ngohlelo oluhambisana nalokho. Ukunakela eminye imikhakha engadala noma engabangelwa ukungazinzile kwemiphakathi nganoma yisiphi isimo. Ukusekela abasebenzi abancedisi bezenhlalo nabathandi. Ukuhlala usupdate ngokuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha emisha emsebenzini wezenhlalo nasekuqinisekisweni komphakathi. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yokuphatha edingekile kuleso sikhundla. Kuzomele kulindeleke kubasebenzi bezenhlangothi Bezinga 1 ukuthi balolonge futhi balungise abasebenzi bezenhlangothi Bezinga 1 ukwenzela ukuthi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yomsebenzi wezenhlalo esebenzayo nesebenzayo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wentlalo Onqwanaba 1
xh.summary: Izithuba zomsebenzi wentlalo onqwanaba 1 ezinika inkathazo, inkxaso nokhuselo abantu abasemngciphekweni nakuwo onke amab a ahlazooneleko kumaziko amaninzi ebumbekwe kumaphondo e Free State.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 kunye nezidanga zobugcisa ezingqamile kwi Bachelor's Degree efanelekileyo kwi Social Work (NQF Level 7) njengoko evunyelwe yi-SAQA. Ubumatshini obusezantsi kwi-SACSSP. I-License yomqhubi egunyaziwe.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yomsebenzi wentlalo ngakumbi nxamlelo ngezindwendwe ngokunika inkathazo, inkxaso, ukhuselo nophuhliso kubantu abasemngciphekweni, kumagumbi, kumaphakathi nakuwo onke amabala abantu bahlala khona. Khangela nomyalele onke amanye amaphetha angabakho, okanye aphuma kwingxaki engazinzile nganoma imuphi na uhlobo. Nika inkxaso abasebenzi abakuncedo kwentlalo nabanjini. Phuhlisa ulwazi ngemigaqo entsha kumsebenzi wentlalo nakwizikhululo zokuncedisa intlalutle. Zenze nazo zonke izigqibo ngokumiselwa kwesithuba. Kuyakuthembeleka abasebenzi bentlalo abangesiNqanaba 4 ukuba basolze banika ingcamango abasebenzi bentlalo abangesiNqanaba 1 ukubakwazi ukunikela inkonzo yomsebenzi wentlalo olusebenzayo kwaye lula.

jobs.summary: Monitor and evaluate NPO funding compliance across five Free State district offices, requiring a National Diploma and 1-2 years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an appropriate National Diploma in Financial Management/Economics/Accounting/ Public Management (NQF Level 6) as recognised by SAQA. A Minimum of 1-2 years relevant working experience in NPO and budget. Driver’s licence. monitoring and evaluation skills. Knowledge And Values: The following knowledge and skills are required: Knowledge, skills attitudes and values to engage in the social development. Monitoring and evaluation skills. Financial management budgeting. Good communication skill. Presentation skill. Problem solving skill. Computer skill. Written and verbal communication. Report writing skill. Day to day administration.
jobs.duties: Monitor compliance and management funds provided to CBO and NGOs in line with financial guidelines. Coordinate and monitoring the NPO funding cycle. Provide support and guidance to CBOs to ensure effective financial and accountability. Identify irregularities and refer them to the relevant section, implement corrective measures: Screening/monitoring all the financial files, collect financial reports from the NPOs, check all the required documents and compile intervention report. Supervising of staff.

af.title: Monitering en Evaluasiebeampte: NPO
af.summary: Moniteer en evalueer NPO-befondsingsnakoming oor vyf Free State distrikkantore, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma en 1-2 jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike Nasionale Diploma in Finansiële Bestuur/Ekonomie/Rekeningkunde/ Openbare Bestuur (NQF Level 6) soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 1-2 jaar se relevante werkervaring in NPO en begroting. Bestuurderslisensie. moniterings- en evaluasievaardighede. Kennis En Waardes: Die volgende kennis en vaardighede word vereis: Kennis, vaardighede, houdings en waardes om by die maatskaplike ontwikkeling betrokke te raak. Moniterings- en evaluasievaardighede. Finansiële bestuur en begroting. Goeie kommunikasievaardigheid. Voorleggingsvaardigheid. Probleemoplossingsvaardigheid. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie. Verslagskryfvaardigheid. Daaglikse administrasie.
af.duties: Moniteer nakoming en bestuur van befondsing verskaf aan CBO en NGOs in ooreenstemming met finansiële riglyne. Koördineer en moniteer die NPO-befondsingsiklus. Verskaf ondersteuning en leiding aan CBOs om effektiewe finansiële bestuur en verantwoordelikheid te verseker. Identifiseer onreëlmatighede en verwys dit na die toepaslike afdeling, implementeer korrigerende maatreëls: Deurkyning/monitering van alle finansiële lêers, versamel finansiële verslae van die NPOs, kontroleer alle vereiste dokumente en stel intervensieverslag op. Toesig oor personeel.

zu.title: Inkulu Yesebenziso Nokuqaphela: NPO
zu.summary: Qaphela futhi uhloliswe ukuziphendulela kwemali yokuxhasa i-NPO kuzinkantolo zesifunda ezinhlanu zase Free State, okudinga i-National Diploma neminyaka engu-1-2 yolesiphiwo esihambisana naleso sikhundla.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma efanelekile kwi-Financial Management/Economics/Accounting/ Public Management (NQF Level 6) njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-1-2 yolesiphiwo lokusebenza oluhambisana ne-NPO neshedi yemali. I-Driver's licence. Amakhono okuqaphela nokuqapha. Ulwazi Namagugu: Kudingeka ulwazi namakhono alandelayo: Ulwazi, amakhono, izinkalo namagugu okuzibandakanya kumnqopho wokuthuthukiswa kwentlukwano yomphakathi. Amakhono okuqaphela nokuqapha. Ukuphathwa kwezimali neshedi yemali. Ikhono elihle lokuxoxa. Ikhono lokubamba amaphrezenteshi. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lekhumuyutha. Ukubhala nokuqamba amagama. Ikhono lokubhala imibiko. Izindlela zolawulo zansuku zonke.
zu.duties: Qaphela ukuziphendulela ukubhaliswa futhi uphathe imali enikezwa i-CBO namabhange e-NGO ngokwezindlela eziphathwa ngemali. Hlela futhi uqaphe inkathi yokuxhaswa kwe-NPO. Nikeza usizo nomlandu kuma-CBO ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphathwa kwezimali nokuziphendulela. Thola okungalungile futhi uzidlulisele kwesigaba esihambisana nako, futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa: Ukuhlola/ukuqaphela yonke imifanekiso yezimali, qoqa imibiko yezimali kuma-NPO, hlola yonke imibhalo edingekayo bese uyihlanganisa imibiko yokungenelela. Ukuphatha abasebenzi.

xh.title: Indlu yoPhando nokuhlola ngokwemigaqo nezoqokelelwano: I-NPO
xh.summary: Qaphela kwaye uhlole ukuthobela imigaqo yokuxhaswa kwe-NPO kumagumbi amahlanu ee-ofisi zesithili kwingingqi ye-Free State, kufuneka i-National Diploma inyakeni i-1-2 ukutatakazeceba ukubonakaliswa kwemfundo echanekileyo.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12 kunye ne-National Diploma efanelekileyo kwi-Financial Management/Economics/Accounting/ Public Management (NQF Level 6) njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Isiqingatha seemyaka ze-1-2 semisebenzi ehambelana nayo kwi-NPO nembali yemali. I-Driver's licence. Amakhono wokuqaphela nokuhlola. Ulwazi Nanexabiso: Olu lwazi nalawa magama alandelayo afunekawa: Ulwazi, amakhono, iinkalo ukulungelelanisa namaxabiso ukuthatha inxaxheba kuthuthuzelo lomphakathi. Amakhono wokuqaphela nokuhlola. ulawulo lwemali inxutywa kukucinga imali. Ikhono lokuzwakalisa ngokuchanekileyo. Ikhono lonikezelo. Ikhono losombululo lwezinkinga. Ikhono lekhompyutha. Isibhali nolwamkelo ngomntu. Ikhono lokubhala ingxelo. Impatho ngosuku nosuku yantlalo.
xh.duties: Qapha ukuthobela kwaye ulawule imali enikezelwe kwi-CBO ne-NGOs ngokwemigaqo yemali. Lungelelanisa kwaye ulawule umjikelo wemali ye-NPO. Nikela inkxaso nomceli-mngeni kwiimbono ze-CBO ukuze kuqiniseke ukusebenza kakuhle kweemali nempendulo. Phawula iingxaki ezingaqhelekanga kwaye uzithumele kwicala elifanelekileyo, uze usebenzise iziphatho ezilungisa: ukuhlolwa/ukuqaphela yonke imifanekiso yemali,okuqokelela iingxelo zemali kwi-NPOs, ukuhlola yonke amaxwebhu afunekayo nokudibanisa ingxelo yesebenzisana. Lawulwa abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Community Development Practitioner Grade 1
jobs.centre: Thabo Mofutsanyana District Ladybrand Office Ref No: DSDFS 68/26 (X1 Post) Lejweleputswa District Welkom Office– Ref No: DSDFS 69/26 (X1 Post) Fezile Dabi District: Kroonstad Office Ref No: DSDFS 70/26 (X1 Post) Xhariep District Koffiefontein Ref No: DSDFS 71/26 (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Community Development Practitioners needed at four Free State district offices to facilitate integrated community development interventions with stakeholders.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an appropriate three–year tertiary degree (NQF Level 7) as recognized by SAQA in Community Development / Bachelor of Social Science (Human and Societal Dynamics). or equivalent qualification. Exposure to community development environment will serve as an advantage. Must have exposure of legislation to assist with interventions at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote self-empowerment. af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyn Vlak 1
af.summary: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyne word by vier Free State distrikkantore benodig om geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies met belanghebbendes te fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike drie-jaar tersiêre graad (NQF Vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling / Baccalaureus in Sosiale Wetenskappe (Menslike en Samelewingsdinamika). of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Blootstelling aan 'n gemeenskapsontwikkelingsomgewing sal as 'n voordeel dien. Moet blootstelling hê aan wetgewing om te help met intervensies by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings in wisselwerking tree ten einde selfbemagtiging te bevorder. Moet in staat wees om navorsing rakende gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk te doen. Moet in staat wees om diverse gemeenskapsontwikkelingsprogramme/intervensies te fasiliteer, identifiseer, beplan en implementeer.
af.duties: Identifiseer en fasiliteer die implementering van geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in samewerking met die gemeenskap en ander tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Skakel en koördineer met alle tersaaklike rolspelers, interne en eksterne belanghebbendes bv. in departemente/provinsies, NGO's, plaaslike gemeenskapsstrukture en geloofsgesinde organisasies om samewerking te fasiliteer en vennootskappe te vestig om die volhoubaarheid van ontwikkelingsaksies binne die gemeenskap te verseker. Ondersteun gemeenskappe en verrig administratiewe ondersteuning rakende gemeenskapsontwikkeling en verwante aktiwiteite. Hou tredy met nuwe ontwikkelinge in die gemeenskapsontwikkelingsveld om dienslewering te verbeter.

zu.title: Umphathi Wentshisekelo Yomphakathi Onganqangi 1
zu.summary: Badingwa abaphathi bentshisekelo yomphakathi emahhovisi amane edolobha lasiFree State ukuba baqhube izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa intshisekelo yomphakathi ngokuhlanganisiwe nabashibameli.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nedigri yezemfundo ephakeme ehambisana namakhulu amathathu (NQF Level 7) evunyiwe yi-SAQA kwi-Community Development / I-Bachelor of Social Science (Human and Societal Dynamics). noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Ukuvezwa emkhakheni wentshisekelo yomphakathi kuzoba ngumsa. Kumele kube nokubonwa komthetho wokulekelela ezinyathelweni lapho abantu bethintana nemvelo yabo ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukuzikhuselela. Kumele ukwazi ukwenza ucwaningo mayelana nomsebenzi wentshisekelo yomphakathi. Kumele ukwazi ukuqhweba, ukuthola, ukucubungula futhi ukuqalisa izinhlelo/izinyathelo ezahlukene zentshisekelo yomphakathi.
zu.duties: Thola futhi uqhwebise ukuqaliswa kwezinyathelo zokuthuthukisa intshisekelo yomphakathi ngokuhlanganisiwe ngokubambisana nomphakathi nabalaye abashibameli abahlobene. Xhumana futhi uhlanganise nabo bonke abadlali abahlobene, abashibameli bangaphakathi nangaphandle okw.ɑ.kumnyango/izifundazwe, ama-NGO, izakhiwo zomphakathi zasendawo kanye nezinhlangano ezisekelwe inkolo ukuze kuqhwebiswe ukusebenza kwabantu kanye nokusungula ubudlelwano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphila kube sikhona kwezenzo zokuthuthukisa endaweni yomphakathi. Sekela imiphakathi futhi wenze inselelo yokuqashelwa mayelana nentshisekelo yomphakathi kanye nezinye izenzo ezihlobene. Gcina ukuthi unolwazi olusha mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwentshisekelo yomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo.

xh.title: Umpracthuni Wophuhliso Lwentsapho Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Kufuneka abapracthuni bophuhliso lwentsapho kweziko leminyango yamawonga amane aseFree State ukukhuthaza ukungena phakathi kophuhliso oludityanisiweyo lwentsapho kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 kunye nedigri esemkhakheni weyunivesithi esifanelekileyo seminyaka emithathu (i-NQF Level 7) evunyiwe ngummeli we-SAQA kwiphuhliso Lwentsapho / i-Bachelor of Social Science (Human and Societal Dynamics). okanye isidanga esilinganayo. Ukuvuleleko kwindawo yophuhliso lwentsapho kuya kuba lusizo. Kufuneka kube nokuvuleleko komthetho ukuncedela ekungeniseni izigqibo kwindawo apho abantu baphathana nobume babo khon’ukuze kuphunyezwe ukuzinikela. Kufuneka kube nako ukwenza uphando malunga nomsebenzi wophuhliso lwentsapho. Kufuneka kube nako ukukhuthaza, kuqonde, zacileze kwaye kuphunyezwe iinkqubo/zigqibo ezahlukeneyo zophuhliso lwentsapho.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda kukhuthaze kuphunyezwe ukungenisa izigqibo zophuhliso oludityanisiweyo lwentsapho ngokusebenzisana nentsapho kunye namanye abathathi-nxaxheba abafanelekileyo. Axabe adibanise kunye nawo onke amalunga abandakanyekayo, abathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokomzekelo.kumasebe/iiphondo, i-NGO, iindawo zentsapho zendawo kunye namanqanaba okholo ukukhuthaza ukusebenzisana kwaye simiwe iindibaniselwano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlala kokuphila kwezenzo zophuhliso ngaphakathi kwentsapho. Axabe aze ancede ngokwakha amacebo ngolawulo kwaye enze inkxaso yolawulo mayela nophuhliso lwentsapho kunye nemisebenzi engenele kuyo. Axabe ahlale ezibuza ngophuhliso olutsha kwikhondo lophuhliso lwentsapho ukuphucula ukunikwa inkonzo.

Ukuqinisekiswa okushajekileyo ebhalisweni eNkundleni Ephatha Abahlinzeki Bezokuphepha (PSIRA). jobs.title: Accounting
jobs.summary: Graduate internship programme in Accounting at the Free State Provincial Treasury in Bloemfontein offering structured workplace learning and professional development.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma or Degree in Accounting, Financial Accounting, or an equivalent recognised qualification, applicants must have successfully completed their qualifications and where a qualification certificate has not yet been issued, applicants must submit an official academic transcript and a letter from the relevant institution confirming the successful completion of their studies. Applicants who have previously participated in any internship programme will not be considered. Should it be discovered, either during the recruitment process or after appointment, that an applicant has previously participated in an internship programme and failed to disclose this information, the internship contract will be terminated with immediate effect. Preference: Preference will be given to eligible youth applicants who are residents of the Free State Province, provided that they meet all the prescribed minimum requirements for the Graduate Internship Programme.
jobs.duties: Development: Successful candidates will undergo a structured programme of on-the-job training, workplace learning and professional development within the Free State Provincial Treasury. The programme will Provide practical workplace experience aligned with the intern's qualification and assigned area of work; expose interns to relevant departmental processes, systems and procedures; Provide opportunities to apply academic knowledge in a practical work environment and enhance the participants' employability and preparedness for entry into the formal labour market.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Xolile Ngesi: Ngesi@treasury.fs.gov.za strictly for enquiries regarding the Graduate Internship Programme

af.title: Rekeningkunde
af.summary: Afgestudeerde-internskapprogram in Rekeningkunde by die Free State Provincial Treasury in Bloemfontein wat gestruktureerde werksplek-leer en professionele ontwikkeling bied.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Rekeningkunde, Finansiële Rekeningkunde, of 'n gelykwaardige erkende kwalifikasie, aansoekers moet hul kwalifikasies suksesvol voltooi het en waar 'n kwalifikasiesertifikaat nog nie uitgereik is nie, moet aansoekers 'n amptelike akademiese afskrif en 'n brief van die tersaaklike instelling voorlê wat die suksesvolle voltooiing van hul studie bevestig. Aansoekers wat voorheen aan enige internskapprogram deelgeneem het, sal nie in aanmerking kom nie. Indien daar gedurende die werwingsproses of na aanstelling ontdek word dat 'n aansoeker voorheen aan 'n internskapprogram deelgeneem het en versuim het om hierdie inligting bekend te maak, sal die internskapknoop onmiddellik beëindig word. Voorkeur: Voorkeur sal gegee word aan in aanmerking komende jeugaansoekers wat inwoners van die Free State-provinsie is, mits hulle aan al die voorgeskrewende minimum vereistes vir die Graduate Internship Programme voldoen.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling: Suksesvolle kandidate sal 'n gestruktureerde program van werkplek-opleiding, werksplek-leer en professionele ontwikkeling by die Free State Provincial Treasury ondergaan. Die program sal praktiese werksplekervaring bied wat ooreenstem met die intern se kwalifikasie en toegekende werkarea; interns blootstel aan tersaaklike departementele prosesse, stelsels en prosedures; geleenthede bied om akademiese kennis in 'n praktiese werksomgewing toe te pas en die deelnemers se werksaamheid en gereedheid vir toetrede tot die formele arbeidsmark verhoog.

zu.title: Izabalazo
zu.summary: Inhlelo yokufunda kwabasha ngezabalazo kumnyango we Free State Provincial Treasury e Bloemfontein evula ukufunda emsebenzini olulotshiwe nentuthuko yobungcalise.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe noma i-Degree kwezabalazo, ukubhalwa kwezimali, noma isitifiketi esitholakala ngokulingana, abafaka isikhundla kumele bephumelele iziqu zabo futhi lapho isitifiketi seziqu besingakatholakali, abafaka isikhundla kumele bathumele ithansikripti yemfundo ephathwa isikhungo kanye nenkumbulo esuswo esithi ikinikeza isikhungo esihlobene iqinisekisa ukuthi baphumelele izifundo zabo. Abafaka isikhundla ababamba iqhaza kuyo yiphi inhlelo yokwenzela abafundi yangaphambilini ngeke bacatshangelwe. Uma kutholakala, noma ngemva kwemfundo noma ngemva kokuqokwa, ukuthi umuntu othathe isikhundla ubamba iqhaza kule minyaka yeqhaza alaze futhi walufihla lolu lwazi, isivumelwano sale minyaka yeqhaza sizonqanywa ngaso leso sikhathi. Okuncanyelwayo: Abafaka isikhundla abasha abahambisana nemigomo bazothola ukuncanyelwa okuhamba phambili uma behlala kule Free State Province, uma kuphoqiwe ukuthi bahambisana nezidingo ezingaphansi kwawo wonke ahlelo loMfundo wokuqeqeshwa kwabasha.
zu.duties: Intuthuko: Abafaki isikhundla abaphumelelayo bazodlula ohlelweni olulotshiwe lwemfundvo yomsebenzi, ukufunda emsebenzini nentuthuko yobungcalise kumnyango we Free State Provincial Treasury. Lohlelo luzohlinzeka ngemvelo yomsebenzi esebenzayo ehambisana nemfundo yesifundi nendawo emiselwe yomsebenzi; luzovezela abafundi kumagqagoshe omyango, izimiso neminyakazo ehlobene nalokho; futhi luzohlinzeka ngamathuba okusebenzisa ulwazi lwezemfundo emvelweni yomsebenzi esebenzayo futhi luthuthukise ukutholakala komsebenzi kolwazi kwabathatha nxaxheba nokulungiselela kwabo ukungena emakethe yomsebenzi esemthethweni.

xh.title: Ezimali
xh.summary: Inkqubo yokuvakalelwa kwabagqibileyo kwi-Accounting kwi Free State Provincial Treasury eBloemfontein enika ukufunda okulungiselelweyo kwendawo yokusebenza nophuhliso olungcaliselelweyo.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma okanye i-Degree kwi-Accounting, i-Financial Accounting, okanye isidanga esithabathwa njengesilinganayo esamkelweyo, abafakeli kufuneka baphumelele iimfuno zabo zokugqiba izidanga kwaye apho ifayidithi yesidanga ingekabhiywa, abafakeli kufuneka ngenise irekhodi yemfundo esemthethweni nentombi evela kwisikhungo esichasiweyo esiqinisekisa ukuphumelela okuphumeleleyo kwizifundo zabo. Abafakeli ababethathe inxaxheba kunkqubo yomnyulethi yangaphambili abayi kubalwa. Xa kubonakala, nokuba senziwa njalo ngexesha lenkqubo yokubakha okanye emva kokumiselenwa, ukuba umfakeli uthathe ngaphambili inxaxheba kunkqubo yomnyulethi yaye asazange achaze olu lwazi, inkqubo yomnyulethi iya kurhoxiswa ngesiquphelo ngokukhawuleza. Ukukhethwa: Ukukhethwa kuya kunikwa abafakeli abamnganga abasebasha abahlala kwi-Free State Province, ngendlela yokuba bahlukanisa zonke iimfuno ezifunwayo ezincinci zenkqubo yomnyulethi yabagqibileyo.
xh.duties: Phuhliso: Omanyulethi abaphumeleleyo baya kuthatha inkqubo equlunqiweyo yokuzimaselela ngokomsebenzi, ukufunda kwindawo yokusebenza nophuhliso lwemvelo ngaphakathi kwi Free State Provincial Treasury. Inkqubo iya Kuqulunqa imfundo yokusebenza ngokwenza eqondene nesidanga somanyulethi nendawo ayabelweyo yokusebenza; tyhila omanyulethi kwiinkqubo, iinkqubo zendlela zokusebenza nemigaqo yesabe ehlobene; Yanika ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi lwezifundo kwimeko yokusebenza ngokwenza yaye kuphucule amandla okufumana umsebenzi kwabathathi nxaxheba nolungelelwaniso lokungena kwimasiko yolwazi olusemthethweni.

zu.summary: Isikhundla somfundi-wokuzinzisa se-Graduate internship sokuhlolwa ngaphakathi esikhungweni se-Free State Provincial Treasury e-Bloemfontein, esinikeza ukuqeqeshwa okuhleliwe kwendawo yokusebenza kubanikazi bezidiploma noma iziqu.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe noma I-Degree yokuhlola ngaphakathi noma isiqu esihlobene esamukelwe, abafaka izicelo kumele basiqedile ngesiphumelelo iziqu zabo futhi lapho isitifiketi sesiqu ngesikathi sikhangelelokuthi sikhishwe, abafaka izicelo kumele bahunyuse ithranskripthi yokwesikole ebusemthethweni nenkulumo evela esikhungweni ohlobene egunyaza ukuthi bafe isiphumelelo izifundo zabo. Abafaka izicelo ababambe iqhaza ohlelweni nanoma yiluphi uhlelo lokuzinzisa ngaphambilini abazokwamukelwa. Kube kutholakala, ngesikhathi kwenziwa inqubo yokubamba abasebenzi noma emva kokubekwa esikhundleni, ukuthi umfaki-sicelo ubebambe iqhaza ohlelweni lokuzinzisa ngaphambilini futhi ehluleke ukwembula lolu lwazi, isivumelwano sokuzinzisa sizokwenziwa siphеле amandla ngokushesha. Okunconywayo: Kuzonikezwa ukuncunya abafaka izicelo abasha abafanelekileyo abahlala esifundeni i-Free State Province, uma kuphela ukuthi bahambisana nazo zonke izidingo ezincane ezibekiwe zohlelo lokuzinzisa abafundi (Graduate Internship Programme).
zu.duties: Inkuliso: Abaphumeleleyo bazodlula ohlelweni oluhleliwe lokuqeqeshwa esikhundleni sokusebenza, ukufunda endaweni yokusebenza nentuthuko yobungcweti ngaphakathi kwe-Free State Provincial Treasury. Uhlelo luzoNikeza isipiliyoni esisebenzayo sendawo yokusebenza esihambisana nesiqu somfundi-wokuzinzisa nendawo ebekiwe yokusebenza; lwenze abafundi bazibandakanye nanqubo zomnyango, izinhlelo nezinqubo ezihlobene; lunikeze ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi lwesikole endaweni yokusebenza esisebenzayo futhi luthuthukise ukuthi kungathathiwa abasebenzi futhi kulungelwe ukungena emthethweni wemisebenzi yokusebenza.

xh.requirements: I-National Diploma okanye i-Degree kwi-Internal Auditing okanye ngesiqualification esithatha njengesilinganayo esiqaphelekwayo, abafakeli kufuneka beqedele ngempumeleyo i-qualifications zabo kwaye apho iqesha le-qualification lisingathanga kunikwa ngoko, abafakeli kufuneka banike isatshethi esisemthethweni sezifundo kunye netshathi kwiziko elichanekileyo eliqinisekisa ukugqitywa ngempumelelo kwezifundo zabo. Ukuba kubhaqwa, nokuba ngelixa lenqubo yokubakha okanye emva kokwenzwa umisenzelo, ukuba umfaki uthathe inxaxheba ngaphambili kwenkqubo yokuzilolongela waza wayifihla lo mngeno, isivumelwano sokuzilolongela siza kuvalwa ngoko nangoko. af.title: Finansies
af.summary: Graduëte-interns met 'n Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Rekenkunde of Finansies word gesoek vir 'n gestruktureerde internskapprogram by die Free State Provincial Treasury in Bloemfontein.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Rekenkunde, Finansiële Bestuur, Finansies, of 'n gelykwaardige erkende kwalifikasie, aansoekers moet hul kwalifikasies suksesvol voltooi het en waar 'n kwalifikasiesertifikaat nog nie uitgereik is nie, moet aansoekers 'n amptelike akademiese afskrif en 'n brief van die tersaaklike instelling voorlê wat die suksesvolle voltooiing van hul studies bevestig. Aansoekers wat voorheen aan enige internskapprogram deelgeneem het, sal nie oorweeg word nie. Indien dit ontdek word, hetsy gedurende die werwerwingsproses of na aanstelling, dat 'n aansoeker voorheen aan 'n internskapprogram deelgeneem het en versuim het om hierdie inligting te openbaar, sal die internskapkonsert onmiddellik met onmiddellike effek beëindig word. Voorkeur: Voorkeur sal gegee word aan geskikte jeugaansoekers wat inwoners van die Free State Province is, mits hulle aan al die voorgeskrewe minimum vereistes vir die Graduëte-internskapprogram voldoen.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling: Suksesvolle kandidate sal 'n gestruktureerde program van werksaam-opleiding, werkplek-leer en professionele ontwikkeling by die Free State Provincial Treasury ondergaan. Die program sal praktiese werkplekervaring bied wat ooreenstem met die intern se kwalifikasie en toegewysde werkarea; blootstelling bied aan relevante departementale prosesse, stelsels en prosedures; geleenthede bied om akademiese kennis in 'n praktiese werksomgewing toe te pas en die deelnemers se werksvaardigheid en gereedheid vir toetrede tot die formele arbeidsmark verbeter.

zu.title: Izimali
zu.summary: Kufunwa abafundi abagqamile abanemadiyula yezwe noma idigri ekubhaleni ngezezimali noma kwezimali ohlelweni lwesikhathi esithile lokusebenza ngaphansi kwe-Free State Provincial Treasury e-Bloemfontein.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma noma i-Degree ekubhaleni ngezezimali, eziphathelene nokulawula izimali, kwezimali, noma isiqinisekiso esifunyanwayo esilinganayo; abafaka izicelo kufuneka baphothule iziqinisekiso zabo ngaphandle komva futhi lapho isiqinisekiso sokuphothulela singakatholakali, abafaka izicelo kufuneka bahambise irekhodi lezemfundo lasemthethweni kanye nencwadi evela esikhungweni esihlobene eqinisekisa ukuphothula ngemphiwa izifundo zabo. Abafaka izicelo abasebenze ngaphambilini nakuhlelo lokusebenza lunye ngeke bacatshangelwe. Kutholakale ukuthi ngesikhathi sokwenza isicelo noma emva kokumiswa, ukuthi umfaki isicelo usebenze ngaphambilini ohlelweni lokusebenza futhi wenze umva ukuyiveza le mininingwane, isivumelwano sokusebenza sizoqediswa ngaso leso sikhathi. Okukhethiwe: Okukhethiwe kuzoba kubafaka izicelo abasha abafanelekileyo abahlala esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natali, Free State Province, ngokusobala ukuba bahambisana namagunya onke okuncane agunyaziwe ohlelweni lokusebenza labafundi abagqamile.
zu.duties: Inkuliso: Abafanelekileyo bazodlula ohlelweni lokuqondiswa ngokusebenza ngokwemisebenzi, ukufunda emsebenzini kanye nokuziphuhlisa ngobungcali ngaphakathi kwe-Free State Provincial Treasury. Uhlelo luzohlinzeka ngemfundo yokuqondiswa ngokusebenza emsebenzini ehambisana nesiqinisekiso somsebenzi kanye nendawo yokusebenza ababelwe; ukubakhombisa izinhlelo, izinhlelo kanye nezindlela ezihlobene nomnyango; ukunika ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi olufundile emsebenzini wokuqondiswa kanye nokuthuthukisa amandla okusebenza abafaki isicelo kanye nokulungele ukungena emsebenzini osemthethweni.

xh.title: i-Finance
xh.summary: Oqeqeshwa njengabangeneleli abanayo i-National Diploma okanye i-Degree kwi-Accounting okanye i-Finance bafunwa kwi-Free State Provincial Treasury kwindawo yokusebenza eBloemfontein ngokwenkqubo esakhiweyo.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma okanye i-Degree kwi-Accounting, i-Financial Management, i-Finance, okanye isidanga esifanayo esiqinisweyo, abakhangelayo kufuneka beqedele ngempumelelo iisidanga zabo kwaye apho isatifikethi sesidanga sikanjalo singakabikho, abakhangelayo kufuneka bahinge igqabantshatsho yasemtyalweni evela kule ntsebenzo kwaye bongeze ileta evela kwindawo echumanekayo eqinisekisa ukuba ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kokufunda kwabo. Abakhangelayo abadlale kwinkqubo yomqeqesho nangayiphi na inkqubo yangaphambili abayi kuthathwa ngqondelelo. Ukuba kuqulunqwe, nokuba ngelixa lenkqubo yokubakha nangemva kokuqeshwa, ukuba umkhangelo othe wadlala kwinkqubo yomqeqesho wangaphambili kwaye walahla ukuzivakalaysa le nxibelelwano, isivumelwano somqeqesho siya kurhoxiswa ngokwaqonda yonke into. Okukhethwayo: Ukhetho luya kunikwa abantu abasebasheni abaneligunya abahlala kwi-Free State Province, inqaba kokuba bahlangabezana nazo zonke iimfuno ezibekekileyo ezincinci zeNkqubo yoQeqesho lweziqu.
xh.duties: Phuhliso: Abasebenzi abaphumeleleyo baya kuthatha inkqubo esakhiweyo yokuqeqesha emsebenzini, ukufunda kwindawo yokusebenza nokuphucuka ngobuchwephesha ngaphakathi kwe-Free State Provincial Treasury. Inkqubo iya Kubonelela ngesipiliwo sokusebenza esibuzisekoyo esihambelana nesidanga kunye nendawo yokusebenzi enikiweyo kumntu oqeqeshwayo; kundlula abaqeqeshi kwiinkqubo zeesebe, iinkqubo nezicwangciso ezifanelekileyo; Kubonelela ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi olufundelwe esikolweni kwindawo yokusebenza esibuzisekoyo kwaye kuphucule ukuzinza komntu oqeqeshwayo kwangaphambili kulawulo lwabasebenzi nolungelelwaniso lokungena kwimarike yabasebenzi esejweni.

jobs.title: Economics and Econometrics
jobs.summary: Fifteen graduate internship opportunities in Economics and Econometrics are available at the Free State Provincial Treasury in Bloemfontein.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma or Degree in Economics, Econometrics, or an equivalent recognised qualification, applicants must have successfully completed their qualifications and where a qualification certificate has not yet been issued, applicants must submit an official academic transcript and a letter from the relevant institution confirming the successful completion of their studies. Applicants who have previously participated in any internship programme will not be considered. Should it be discovered, either during the recruitment process or after appointment, that an applicant has previously participated in an internship programme and failed to disclose this information, the internship contract will be terminated with Immediate Effect. Preference: Preference will be given to eligible youth applicants who are residents of the Free State Province, provided that they meet all the prescribed minimum requirements for the Graduate Internship Programme.
jobs.duties: Development: Successful candidates will undergo a structured programme of on-the-job training, workplace learning and professional development within the Free State Provincial Treasury. The programme will Provide practical workplace experience aligned with the intern's qualification and assigned area of work; expose interns to relevant departmental processes, systems and procedures; Provide opportunities to apply academic knowledge in a practical work environment and enhance the participants' employability and preparedness for entry into the formal labour market.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Xolile Ngesi: Ngesi@treasury.fs.gov.za strictly for enquiries regarding the Graduate Internship Programme

af.title: Ekonomie en Ekonometrie
af.summary: Vyftien gegradueerde internskapsgeleenthede in Ekonomie en Ekonometrie is beskikbaar by die Free State Provincial Treasury in Bloemfontein.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Ekonomie, Ekonometrie, of 'n gelykwaardige erkende kwalifikasie, aansoekers moet hul kwalifikasies suksesvol voltooi het en waar 'n kwalifikasiesertifikaat nog nie uitgereik is nie, moet aansoekers 'n amptelike akademiese afskrif en 'n brief van die betrokke instansie voorlê wat die suksesvolle voltooiing van hul studies bevestig. Aansoekers wat voorheen aan enige internskapsprogramme deelgeneem het, sal nie oorweeg word nie. Indien daar gedurende die werwingsproses of na aanstelling ontdek word dat 'n aansoeker voorheen aan 'n internskapsprogramme deelgeneem het en versaak het om hierdie inligting bekend te maak, sal die internskapskontrak onmiddellik beëindig word. Voorkeur: Voorkeur sal gegee word aan geskikte jeugaansoekers wat inwoners van die Free State Provinsie is, mits hulle aan al die voorgeskrewe minimum vereistes vir die Graduate Internship Programme voldoen.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling: Suksesvolle kandidate sal 'n gestruktureerde program van werksafrigting, werkplekleer en professionele ontwikkeling by die Free State Provincial Treasury ondergaan. Die program sal praktiese werkplekervaring in ooreenstemming met die intern se kwalifikasie en toegewese werkgebied verskaf; intern blootstel aan tersaaklike departementele prosesse, stelsels en prosedures; Geleenthede bied om akademiese kennis in 'n praktiese werksomgewing toe te pas en die deelnemers se werksaanskaflikheid en gereedheid vir toetrede tot die formele arbeidsmark verhoog.

zu.title: I-Economics ne-Econometrics
zu.summary: Kukhona amathuba ayishumi nanhlanu ohlelweni lokwemukelwa kwabafundi be-Economics ne-Econometrics e-Free State Provincial Treasury e-Bloemfontein.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma noma i-Degree kwi-Economics, i-Econometrics, noma isiqu esihlobene esiyaziwayo, abafaka izicelo kumele besebe qedile iziqu zabo futhi lapho isitifiketi sesiqu besingakatholakali, abafaka izicelo kumele bahambise irekhodi lezemfundo ebusemthethweni kanye nencwadi esuka esikhungweni esihlobene eqinisekisa ukuphumelela kwezifundo zabo. Abafaka izicelo abasuke sebebuye bathathe inxaxheba kunoma yiluphi uhlelo lokwemukelwa abafundi abangeniso isicelo. Kutholakale ukuthi, noma ngasenkatheni lenqubo yokubumba abasebenzi noma emva kokuqashwa, ukuthi umuntu ofake isicelo usuke esethathe inxaxheba ohlelweni lokwemukelwa kwabafundi futhi wehlule ukwazisa le mininingwane, inkontileka yokwemukelwa izokwenziwa iphele ngokushesha. Okuthandwayo: Okuthandwayo kunikela abantu abasha abahambisana nemibandela abahlala esifundazweni sase-Free State, uma kuphela bahambisana nonke izidingo ezimisiwe ezincane zohlema lokwemukelwa kwabafundi abeziqu.
zu.duties: Inkululeko: Abaphumelelayo bazodlula ohlelweni oluhleliwe lokuzilolonga emsebenzini, ukufunda endaweni yokusebenza nentuthuko yobungcweti ngaphakathi kwe-Free State Provincial Treasury. Lolu hlelo luzonikeza isipiliyoni sokusebenza endaweni yokusebenza esihambisana nesiqu somqashi kanye nendawo ababelwe ukuyisebenza; lubonise abaqashi izinqubo, izinhlelo kanye namaphrosedha e-umnyango ahlobene; lunikeze amathuba okusebenzisa ulwazi lwemfundo endaweni yokusebenza yonke kanye nokuqinisa ukuzisebenzela abathathi inxaxheba nokulungelelana kwabo ukungena emthakweni wemisebenzi ohleliwe.

Ukukhethwa: Ukhetho luya kunikwa kubafundi abaseleyo basebenzayo abahlala kwi-Free State Province, ndikube bezanelana nazo zonke iimfuno ezize zeNkqubo yeGraduate Internship Programme.

Inkqubo iya kubonelela ngamava okusebenza esebenzayo ahambelanana nesatifiketi somfundi othathe inkqubo kwaye nendawo ababelwe kuyo yokusebenza; iza kuvezisa abafundi abangenayo kumasebe asebeleyo, iinkqubo neendlela zokusebenza; ibonelele ngamathuba okusebenzisa ulwazi lweziqu kwindawo esebenzayo yokusebenza kwaye yonyuse isakhono sabathathi nxaxheba sokusebenza nokulungelelwa ukungena kwithanga elisebenzayo lemihla ngemihla.

zu.title: Data Science

zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe noma i-Degree ye-Data Science, i-Information Technology, i-Computer Science, izibalo, noma iziqu ezivunyelwe ezingazingcwele ngokulingana. Abafaka izicelo kumele bethole iziqu zabo ngempumelelo, futhi lapho isitifiketi seziqu singakatholakali, labafaka izicelo kumele bethule ithranskriphi yezifundo esemthethweni kanye nesencwadi esivela esikhungweni esifanele esigunqaza ngempumelelo yokuthola iziqu zabo. Abantu ababekade baya kohlelweni lwesikhundla sabaqeqeshi abeke waso ngaphambilini abazocatshangelwa. Kutholakale noma ngasikhathi sokuqasha noma emva kokuthunjwa into abantu abafake izicelo abekekade eyingxenye yohlelo lwabathweswe iziqu, akekho obengikthole noma ngasikhathi sokuqasha noma emva kokuthunjwa, kutholakale ukuthi ofakayisicelo useke waba yingxenye yohlelo lokuqeqesha futhi akuzange ukhombise lolwazi, kontrakti yokusebenza izovaleka ngokushesha. Okuncikwe kakhulu kakhulu kuzothunyelwa kubantu abasebasha abafanelekayo abahlala e-Free State Province, uma kuphela bemele yonke imfuno encane ecebisiwe yohlelo lokusebenza lwabathweswe iziqu.
zu.duties: Isuthuthukiso: Abaphumelelayo bazoba ohlelweni olucatshangwayo lokuqeqesha emsebenzini, okufunda emsebenzini kanye nentuthuko yobungcalu ngaphakathi kwe-Free State Provincial Treasury. Lohlelolu luzonikeza isipiliyoni esiphewasenzi esihambisana nokuqeqeshwa komqeqeshi nendawo yokusebenza enikeziwe; luzosiveza abaqeqeshi kumasevisi omnyango ahambisanayo, izinhlelo kanye nezinqubo; luzonikeza ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi lemfundo emandaweni okusebenza ngokwesipiliyono futhi luthuthukise ukuthi abathatha isihambi bakwazi ukutholakala emsebenzini nokulungele ukungena emakethe yomsebenzi eyisikhathi esiseduzane.

xh.title: iSayensi yeData
xh.summary: Inkqubo yomsebenzi wamava wabafundi kwiSayensi yeData eFree State Provincial Treasury eBloemfontein, inikezela izithuba ezili-15 ngesiphalangemihla sanyanga kubathunywa abanemfuneko.
xh.requirements: iNational Diploma okanye iDegree kwiSayensi yeData, iInformation Technology, iComputer Science, izibalo, okanye isiqinisekiso esitholiswayo esifanayo, abathunywa kufuneka bagqibe ngempumeleko iziqinisekiso zabo kwaye apho isatifikethi sesiqinisekiso singakathatyathwa, abathunywa kufuneka bazithumele irekhodi yemfundo evela kwindalo nesipho esivela kwindlu yemfundo ngokwemigaqo eqinisekisa ukugqiba kwempumeleko kweenkcukacha zemfundo yabo. Abathunywa abadlale inkxwelo kunyaka wamava ngaphambili abayi kubakho njengengxenye yokucatshulwa. Xa kubakho okuqoshiweyo, nokuba ngelo xesha lenkqubo yokuqesha okanye emva kokuba kumiselwe, ukuba umthunywa uphinde wadlala inkxwelo kunkqubo yokuqesha wangatsho, isivumelwano sokuthunyelwa kwamava siya kusikwa ngoko nangoko. Ukukhethwa: Ukukhethwa kuya kubakho kubathunywa abasheshayo abahlala eFree State Province, kuxhomekeke kwinqanaba lokuba bahlengamile ngayo yonke imifuno emisiweyo yeenkqubo zokuqesha kwabafundi.
xh.duties: Intshukumo: Abathunywa abaphumeleleyo baya kudlula kunkqubo ekulungele ngokwemisebenzi yokuzilolonga, ukufunda endaweni yokusebenza nentshukumo yezempilo kwisebe leFree State Provincial Treasury. Inkqubo iya kubonezela amava abasebenza ngokwemisebenzi ahambelana nesiqinisekiso somthunywa nendawo aphiliselweyo yokusebenza; iboneze abathunywa kumpilo wesebe iinkqubo, iinkqubo nezinto ezichanekileyo; iboneze amathuba okusebenzisa ulwazi abalufundileyo kwindawo yemisebenzi nasekonyuseni ulungelelwanisa nokulungelelana kokubakho ngaphakathi kwabathunywa ukungena emthethweni osemthethweni womsebenzi.

jobs.title: Construction Project Management
jobs.summary: Graduate internship programme in construction project management at the Free State Provincial Treasury in Bloemfontein, offering structured workplace training for diploma or degree holders.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma or Degree in Construction Management, Building Science, Construction Project Management, or an equivalent recognised qualification, applicants must have successfully completed their qualifications and where a qualification certificate has not yet been issued, applicants must submit an official academic transcript and a letter from the relevant institution confirming the successful completion of their studies. Applicants who have previously participated in any internship programme will not be considered. Should it be discovered, either during the recruitment process or after appointment, that an applicant has previously participated in an internship programme and failed to disclose this information, the internship contract will be terminated with immediate effect. Preference: Preference will be given to eligible youth applicants who are residents of the Free State Province, provided that they meet all the prescribed minimum requirements for the Graduate Internship Programme.
jobs.duties: Development: Successful candidates will undergo a structured programme of on-the-job training, workplace learning and professional development within the Free State Provincial Treasury. The programme will Provide practical workplace experience aligned with the intern's qualification and assigned area of work; expose interns to relevant departmental processes, systems and procedures; Provide opportunities to apply academic knowledge in a practical work environment and enhance the participants' employability and preparedness for entry into the formal labour market.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Xolile Ngesi: Ngesi@treasury.fs.gov.za strictly for enquiries regarding the Graduate Internship Programme

af.title: Konstruksie-projekbestuur

zu.title: Ukuphathwa Kwezakhiwo Ezisemqoka
zu.summary: Uhlelo lwezisebenzi abasha abegraduathile ekuphathweni kwezakhiwo ezisemqoka e Free State Provincial Treasury e Bloemfontein, ehlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okulungiselelwe emsebenzini kwabanikela ngediploma noma iziqu.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwevezwe noma Iziqu Ekuphathweni Kwezakhiwo, Isayensi Yokwakha, Ukuphathwa Kwezakhiwo Ezisemqoka, noma izifundo ezingabalinganelyo ezivunyelwe, abafaki isicelo kumele bede bethathe iziqu zabo ngemvume futhi lapho isnikelo seziqu sengakatholakali, abafaka isicelo kumele bathumela irekhodi lesikole esemthethweni kanye nencwadi esuka esikhungweni esihambisanayo egunyaza ukuthi badede bethathe izifundo zabo ngemvume. Abafaka isicelo abasuke sebeyingxenye yalolu hlelo noma yimuphi omunye uhlelo lolusebenzi abazange bacatshangelwe. Kumahele ukuthi ngesikhathi sokuthumba abasebenzi noma emva kokubekwa esikhundleni, ukuthi umfaki isicelo usuke esebengxenye yohlelo lolusebenzi futhi wazifihla le mininingwane, isivumelwano sohlelo lolusebenzi sizophelwa ngokushesha. Okunconywayo: Kuzonconywa abafaka isicelo abasha abafanelekayo abahlala e Free State Province, uma bede bahambisana nazo zonke izidingo ezibalulekile ezimiswe kuhlelo Lolusebenzi Lwabagraduathile.
zu.duties: Inkuthazo: Abantu abakhethiwe bazodlula endleleni eqeqesha umsebenzi ongokoqobo, okufunda emsebenzini kanye nentuthuko yobungcweti ngaphakathi kwe Free State Provincial Treasury. Loluhlelo luzohlinzeka ngamava emsebenzini ongokoqobo ohambisana neziqu zomsebenzi ongokoqobo kanye nendawo ebekelwe umsebenzi; luzosiveza abasebenzi abafundi kuwo izinqubo, izinhlelo kanye namasistimu womnyango; luzonikeza ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi lwesikole emkhakheni wokusebenza ongokoqobo futhi lwandise ikhono labantu lokusebenza nokulungele ukungenisa emthakweni wokusebenza osemthethweni.

Ukuba kuvela okutsiwa, nangexesha lenkqubo yokubakho okanye emva kokumiselwa, ukuba umfaki-sicelo ubethathe inxaxheba kwenkqubo yamava arhoqo ngaphambili waze wazifihla le nlwazi, inkqubo yamava arhoqo iza kuqwalaselwa ngokukhawuleza. xh.duties: Inkqubo yophuhliso: Abagqithiswa abaphumeleleyo baza kuthatha inxaxheba kwenkqubo equlunqweleyo yokuziqeqesha ngelisebenzo, ukufunda kwindawo yokusebenza nentluko yobuchuli ngaphakathi kwi-Free State Provincial Treasury. Inkqubo iza kubonelela ngamava olusebenzo okwenzeka kwindawo yokusebenza ahambelana nosifundo somntu onamava arhoqo nendawo ayabelweyo yokusebenza; iveze abantu abanamava arhoqo kwiinkqubo, iinkqubo nezinkqubo zesebe; bonelele ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi lwemfundo eMzansi kwindawo yokusebenza yokwenza imisebenzi yelisebenzo yaye yaphucule amandla okusebenza kwabathathi-nxaxheba nolungelelwano lwabo bangena kwisoqulu esiqinileko somsebenzi.

Kuyakuthi ukuba kutyhilwe, nokuba ngexesha lenkqubo yokwamkela abasebenzi okanyasemva kokuba begqibile ukuba umfaki nguye owayekwime lo kulawulo iingozi, izerhasi yokungenwa kwabafakikuyakuxhatshazelwa ngoko nangoko.
