Okuncintisanyayo: Okuncintisanyayo kunikezwa abafaka izicelo abasha abafanelekile abahlala e-Free State Province, uma kuphela bethuta yonke imithefuba yezidingo ezisho ngokulawula i-Graduate Internship Programme.
zu.duties: Intuthuko: Ophumelele bazotholwa uhlelo olulawuliwe lokulolongwa ngaphakathi komsebenzi ngaphansi ko Free State Provincial Treasury. Uhlelo luzothola ukutholakala okubonwayo kanye nezifundo ezingachaza mayelana nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza ngokuhambisana nezidingo zabafaka izicelo nezifundo ezingaqavuki, ukuboniswa ngemisebenzi egxile ngalokho okufanele kwezidingo kanye neqiniso lokuqinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabafaka izicelo ngemisebenzi yokubhalisa ohlelweni lokuqeqeshwa kobungcweti, nokwandisa ukutholwa kwemisebenzi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kanye nokukwazi ukuba nokuhlakanipha kokungenelela emsebenzini kanye nokuba nethemba lokuzinza emsebenzini ohlelekile wokuziphilisa.

xh.title: B.com LAW
xh.summary: Inkqubo yabafundi abangakawafumani amava emsebenzini kwi-Free State Provincial Treasury kwabakwaziyo isidanga kwiLaw okanye iBCom Law, inika ulwazi olulungisiweyo lokuzilolonga emsebenzini nentluthuko yomsebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kwiLaw (LLB) okanye iBCom Law, okanye isidanga esamkelweyo esilinganayo, abafaka isicelo kufuneka bahlole ngempumelelo iimfundo zabo kwaye apho istifikathi sesidanga sisingakabuyeziwa, abafaka isicelo kufuneka banikeze irekhodi yezemfundo ekuqinisekisiweyo nencwadi evela kwisikhongozeli esichwebenyo eqinisekisa ukuphumelela kwemfundo yabo. Abafaka isicelo ababamba iqhaza kule nkqubo yangaphambili yokuzilolonga abayi kubalwa. Ukuba kutyhileka, nokuba ngexesha lenkqubo yokubakha abasebenzi okanye emva kokuqeshwa, ukuba umfaki-sicelo ubekade ethathe inxaxheba kwenkqubo yokuzilolonga yaye wayengazange abike le lwazi, isivumelwano sokuziloliza siya kuqhweselwa ngoko nangoko. Ukukhethwa: Kuza kunikwa kwakhona ukukhethwa kubafundi abasebasha abafanelekileyo abahlala kwi-Free State Province, maxa wane ebe bahlangabezana nazo zonke iimfuno ezimisiweyo ezingangayo zeNkqubo yoKuziloliza kwabafundi abangakawafumani amava emsebenzini.
xh.duties: Intluthuko: Abafundi abaphumeleleyo baza kuthatha inkqubo elungisiweyo yolwazi olusebenzayo ngomsebenzi, ukufunda emsebenzini nentluthuko yomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwi-Free State Provincial Treasury. Inkqubo iza Kubonelela ngamava oqobo emsebenzini ahambelana nesidanga somzilolisi nendawo yawo umsebenzi eyabelweyo; kuvule abazilolisi kwiinkqubo, iinkqubo nendlela zokusebenza ezahlukeneyo zesebe; Ibonelele ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi olufundelweyo emngciphekweni oqobo womsebenzi yaye ikhulise amathuba okuba basebenze kwaye ilungiselele ukungena kwabo emthwambeni oqinileko wabasebenzi abathengiswayo.

jobs.title: Director: Office of the Head of Department
jobs.summary: Director sought to provide strategic coordination, executive support and governance oversight to the Head of Department in Johannesburg.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 Qualification in Public Administration /Business Administration / Commerce or BA degree. Master’s degree/M. Com or postgraduate qualification in Public Administration, Business Administration, Commerce, Governance, Risk Management, or a related field will be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at middle/senior managerial level. Knowledge of generic competencies required: Knowledge of the GPG and South African political environment. Knowledge of departmental policies. Knowledge of DPSA regulations and Ministerial Handbook. Compliance with PFMA. Knowledge of technical competencies required: Professional Integrity. People management. Excellent verbal, written and presentation communication. Ability to handle secret and classified documents. Conflict Management (Conflict and Problem solving). Knowledge of managerial competencies required: Strategic Agility. Drive for Results. Strategic Planning & Analysis expertise. Diversity management. Skills required: Communications skill. Computer literacy. Interpersonal skills. Presentation skills. Report writing. Leadership. Strategic. Planning. Organisation. Attributes required: Be able to work under pressure. Inspire to be Quality Oriented. Should be decisive. Additional competencies and skills include strategic risk management, governance assurance, compliance oversight, executive decision-support, enterprise risk management, digital transformation programme support, audit query coordination, stakeholder engagement, policy alignment, project governance, executive reporting, and the preparation and quality assurance of EXCO, SMT and HOD submissions. Nyukela Pre-entry certificate must be submitted prior to appointment.
jobs.duties: Provide Strategic Coordination and Executive Support: Lead alignment of departmental programmes to HOD priorities. Coordinate strategic inputs across all branches. Provide high-level advisory support to HOD. Provide Governance and Decision Support: Oversee implementation of executive decisions. Ensure quality assurance of submissions to HOD. Monitor implementation of resolutions from executive structures. Maintain effective and efficient stakeholder relations and office management: Build communication approach in dealing with stakeholder requests, enquiries, and liaison matters. Set up and maintain systems in the office that will ensure efficiency in the office for stakeholder management. Disseminate documents in preparation for upcoming meetings to relevant stakeholders addressing the agenda to be discussed. Arrange accessibility for key stakeholders to the office. Coordinate and manage the Heads of branches’ engagement and interactions within the office to ensure alignment with organisational priorities. Ensure that internal and External Stakeholders are informed about Senior Management meetings with HOD. Provide quality assurance and advice: Provide strategic advice to the HOD and Senior Management on governance, compliance, and policy alignment. Facilitate information session on policies, procedures, and best practices within the office. Provide advice to Departmental Senior Management and HOD. Manage Resources within the HOD’s Office: Manage staff performance and developmental needs. Manage and monitor the office budget in terms of the office regarding possible over and under spending. Engage staff in the office to determine the budget needs. Participate in performance assessment review committee. Develop operational plan for the unit. Provide Governance, Secretariat, and Institutional Oversight: Provide strategic oversight of governance structures supporting HOD and the MEC. Ensure effective functioning of decision-making processes. Oversee integrity, quality, and compliance of submissions. Ensure proper recording, tracking and implementation of executive decisions. Serve as custodian of governance processes ensuring transparency, accountability, and ethical leadership. Provide assurance to the HOD on governance effectiveness. Additional duties include supporting the HOD Office through strategic risk and governance advisory services; coordinating and tracking executive submissions, resolutions and action items; assisting with audit, compliance and assurance responses; supporting the alignment of departmental priorities with the APP and operational plans; facilitating cross-branch collaboration on strategic projects, PPP initiatives and ICT commercialisation matters; preparing briefing notes, executive summaries, decision-support documents for the HOD, SMT, EXCO and oversight structures; monitoring governance risks, implementation gaps and control weaknesses; and supporting stakeholder engagement with internal branches, provincial departments, public entities and external partners.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Oscar Baloyi at 066 486 5508
jobs.applications: Manual applications should be delivered to: Gauteng Department of e- Government, Imbumba House, 75 Fox Street, Marshalltown, or Applicants can apply online at: jobs.gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the recent Z83 form (obtainable from any Public Service department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents). Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed personal information, duties, experience, and references) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form is required for both online and manual applications. The Z83 form must be completed in full, and page 2 duly signed. An accurate position and reference number must be indicated on the Z83 form. All fields of Section A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83 it is acceptable for applicants to indicate refer to CV or see attached. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re- appointment under Part “F” must be answered and declaration signed. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit holders in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Failure to submit the requested information will result in the application not being considered and deemed a regret. Shortlisted candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by the Gauteng Department of e-Government. The appointment is subject to positive outcomes on employment suitability checks, which include but are not limited to security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification, and criminal record. Successful candidates must obtain a positive security clearance. Applications received after the closing date as well as those who do not comply with the requirements will not be taken into consideration. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Please note that all applicants for Senior Management positions are required to complete the SMS Pre-Entry Programme administered by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. No appointment will take place without the successful completion of the pre-entry certificate and submission of proof thereof. The Course is available at NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/smspre-entry-programme/.              For more information regarding the course please visit the NSG website: www.thensg.gov.za. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. (This applies only when there is an SMS post).” If you have not received a response from this institution within three months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the below advertised post(s). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Kantoor van die Hoof van die Departement
af.summary: Direkteur gesoek om strategiese koördinering, uitvoerende ondersteuning en bestuurstoesig aan die Hoof van die Departement in Johannesburg te verskaf.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Openbare Administrasie/Besigheidsadministrasie/Kommersie of 'n BA-graad. 'n Meestersgraad/M. Com of nagraadse kwalifikasie in Openbare Administrasie, Besigheidsadministrasie, Kommersie, Bestuur, Risikobestuur, of 'n verwante veld sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Kennis van algemene bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van die GPG en Suid-Afrikaanse politieke omgewing. Kennis van departementele beleide. Kennis van DPSA-regulasies en die Ministeriële Handbook. Nakoming van PFMA. Kennis van tegniese bevoegdhede vereis: Professionele integriteit. Mensebestuur. Uitstekende mondelingse, skriftelike en aanbiedingskommunikasie. Vermoë om geheime en geklassifiseerde dokumente te hanteer. Konflikbestuur (konflik en probleemoplossing). Kennis van bestuursbevoegdhede vereis: Strategiese beweeglikheid. Drang na resultate. Strategiese beplanning en ontledingskennis. Diversiteitsbestuur. Vaardighede vereis: Kommunikasievaardigheid. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Verslagskrywing. Leierskap. Strategies. Beplanning. Organisasie. Eienskappe vereis: Moet onder druk kan werk. Streef daarna om gehaltegerig te wees. Moet besluitvaardig wees. Bykomende bevoegdhede en vaardighede sluit in strategiese risikobestuur, bestuursversekering, nakomingstoesig, uitvoerende besluitnemingondersteuning, ondernemingsrisikobestuur, digitale transformasie-programondersteuning, ouditvraagkoördinering, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, beleidsbelyning, projekbestuur, uitvoerende verslagdoening, en die voorbereiding en gehalteversekering van EXCO-, SMT- en HOD-voorleggings. Nyukela-toegangsertifikaat moet voor aanstelling voorgelê word.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese koördinering en uitvoerende ondersteuning: Lei die belyning van departementele programme met HOD-prioriteite. Koördineer strategiese insetsess oor alle takke. Verskaf hoëvlak-adviserende ondersteuning aan HOD. Verskaf bestuurs- en besluitnemingondersteuning: Hou toesig oor die implementering van uitvoerende besluite. Verseker gehalteversekering van voorleggings aan HOD. Monitor die implementering van besluite van uitvoerende strukture. Onderhou doeltreffende en effektiewe belanghebbende betrekkinge en kantoorbestuur: Bou 'n kommunikasiebenadering op vir die hantering van belanghebbende versoeke, navrae en skakelangeleenthede. Stel stelsels in die kantoor op en onderhou dit wat doeltreffendheid in die kantoor vir belanghebbendebestuur sal verseker. Versprei dokumente ter voorbereiding van komende vergaderings aan tersaaklike belanghebbendes om die agenda wat bespreek gaan word, aan te spreek. Reël toeganklikheid vir sleutelbelanghebbendes tot die kantoor. Koördineer en bestuur die betrokkenheid en interaksies van die hoofde van takke binne die kantoor om belyning met organisatoriese prioriteite te verseker. Verseker dat interne en eksterne belanghebbendes ingelig word oor Senior Bestuur-vergaderings met HOD. Verskaf gehalteversekering en advies: Verskaf strategiese advies aan die HOD en Senior Bestuur oor bestuur, nakoming en beleidsbelyning. Fassiliteer inligtingsessies oor beleide, prosedures en beste praktyke binne die kantoor. Verskaf advies aan Departementele Senior Bestuur en HOD. Bestuur hulpbronne binne die HOD se kantoor: Bestuur personeelprestasie en ontwikkelingsbehoeftes. Bestuur en monitor die kantoorbegroting met betrekking tot die kantoor aangaande moontlike oor- en onderbesteding. Betrek personeel in die kantoor om begrotingsbehoeftes te bepaal. Neem deel aan prestasie-assesseringskomitee. Ontwikkel 'n operasionele plan vir die eenheid. Verskaf bestuurs-, sekretariaats- en instellingsiwering: Verskaf strategiese toesig oor bestuursstrukture wat HOD en die MEC ondersteun. Verseker effektiewe funksionering van besluitnemingprosesse. Hou toesig oor die integriteit, gehalte en nakoming van voorleggings. Verseker behoorlike optekening, opvolging en implementering van uitvoerende besluite. Dien as bewaarder van bestuursprosesse en verseker deursigtigheid, aanspreeklikheid en etiese leierskap. Verskaf versekering aan die Hod oor bestuursdoeltreffendheid. Bykomende pligte sluit in die ondersteuning van die HOD-kantoor deur strategiese risiko- en bestuursadviserende dienste; die koördinering en opvolging van uitvoerende voorleggings, besluite en aksiepunte; bystand met oudit-, nakomings- en versekeringsresponse; die ondersteuning van die belyning van departementele prioriteite met die APP en operasionele planne; die fassilitering van kruistak-samewerking aan strategiese projekte, PPP-inisiatiewe en ICT-kommersialisasie-aangeleenthede; die voorbereiding van voorligtingnotas, uitvoerende opsommings, besluitnemingondersteuningsdokumente vir die HOD, SMT, EXCO en toesigstrukture; die monitering van bestuursrisiko's, implementeringsgaping en beheerswakheid; en die ondersteuning van belanghebbende-betrokkenheid met interne takke, provinsiale departemente, openbare entiteite en eksterne vennote.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ihhovisi likaNhlokwenayikaphethini weMnyango
zu.summary: Kufunwa umphathi ozohlinzeka ngokuqhathanisa okuhlelekile, ukwesekwa okuphakeme kwezenhlalo kanye nokuqapha okubusa inhlokohukela emnyangweni eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kuPublic Administration /Business Administration / Commerce noma iziqu ze-BA degree. Iziqu ze-Master's degree/M. Com noma iziqu ze-postgraduate kuPublic Administration, Business Administration, Commerce, Governance, Risk Management, noma enye imikhakha ehlobene kuzoba yithamsanqa. 5 iminyaka yolesiphephelo ezingeni eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokuphatha. Ulwazi mayelana nezikhono ezijwayelekile ezidingekayo: Ulwazi lwe-GPG kanye nesimo sezepolitiki saseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi lwezinqubomgomo zomnyango. Ulwazi lomthetho ka-DPSA kanye ne-Ministerial Handbook. Ukuhambisana ne-PFMA. Ulwazi lwezikhono zobuchwepheshe ezidingekayo: Ukuzethemba ngobungcweti. Uphatho labantu. Ukuxhumana okuhle ngokomlomo, okubhaliwe kanye nesethulo. Ikono lokuphathwa kwemibhalo ephethe kanye neyefihlo. Uphatho wezingxabano (Ukuqazulwa kwezinkinga nezingxabano). Ulwazi lwezikhono zokuphatha ezidingekayo: Ukushesha okuhlelekile. Ukugijima iziphumo. Ukuhlela okuhlelekile kanye nococisiso olunobuchwepheshe. Uphatho wokwabelwana. Izikhono ezidingekayo: Isikhono sokuxhumana. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izikhono zokuxhumana nomuntu ngamunye. Izikhono zokwenza izethulo. Ukwabhala imibiko. Ukuba ngumholi. Okuhlelekile. Ukuhlela. Inhlangano. Izinto ezidingekayo: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcindezi. Ukukhuthaza ukuba ukhathalele izinga. Kufanele ukhethe ngokuqinisekile. Ezinye izikhono nezinto ezidingekayo zihlanganisa ukuphatha ingozi ekuhleliwe, ukuqinisekiswa kokubusa, ukuqapha ukuhambisana, ukwesekwa izinqumo zokuphatha, ukuphatha ingozi yentshisekelo, ukwesekwa ohlelweni lokuguqulwa kwedijithali, ukuqhathanisa imibuzo yokuhlola, ukuzibandakanya nabathintekayo, ukuqondanisa izinqubomgomo, ukubusa amaphrojekthi, ukubika ngokuphakathi, kanye nokuhlunga kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezinga le-EXCO, SMT kanye nezethulo ze-HOD. Isitifikedi se-Nyukela Pre-entry kufanele sithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Nikeza nge-Strategic Coordination kanye ne-Executive Support: Hola ukuqondanisa kohlelo lomnyango kwabambiswe kuhlelo olubalulekile le-HOD. Qhathanisa okokungenayo okuhlelekile kuzigaba zonke. Nikeza ngokwesekwa okuphakeme kwezeluleko ku-HOD. Nikeza nge-Governance kanye ne-Decision Support: Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumo ezifakwe esikhundleni. Qinisekisa izinga le-EXCO, SMT kanye nezethulo ze-HOD. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumo ezitholakala kumakhasimende abalawuli. Gcina ubudlelwano obubalulekile nabathintekayo kanye nokuqapha ihhovisi: Akha indlela yokuxhumana ekuphatheni izicelo zabathintekayo, imibuzo, kanye nezindaba zokuxhumana. Hlela futhi ugcine izimiso ehhovisi ezozokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kahle ehhovisi ngephathi labathintekayo. Sabelisa imibhalo ukuqalisela izinkomfa ezizayo kubathintekayo abafanele ukugxila kwendaba ezizoxoxwa. Hlela ukufinyelela kubathintekayo ababalulekile ehhovisi. Qhathanisa futhi uphathe ukuzibandakanya kanye nokuxhumana kwamakhosi ezigaba ngaphakathi ehhovisi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqondanisa kwezinhloso zenhlangano. Qinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bangaphakathi kanye nabangaphandle battolakala ngemihlangano ye-Senior Management ne-HOD. Nikeza ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga kanye neluleko: Nikeza ngeluleko lokuhlela i-HOD kanye ne-Senior Management nge-Governance, ukuziphendula, kanye nokuqondanisa izinqubomgomo. Fakazela inhlanganisela yolwazi ngezinqubomgomo, izinqubo, kanye nezindlela ezinhle ehhovisi. Nikeza ngeluleko ku-Departmental Senior Management kanye ne-HOD. Phatha izinsiza ngaphakathi kwehhovisi le-HOD: Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kanye nezidingo zokuthuthukisa. Phatha futhi uqaphe izimali zehhovisi ngesimo sehovisi ngezimo ezingase zidlule noma zingafiki ezidingwayo. Xhumanisa abasebenzi ehhovisi ukuthola izidingo zezimali. Thatha inxaxheba ekushathisweni kwesimo sokusebenza sekomiti. Thuthukisa uhlelo lokusebenza yuniti. Nikeza nge-Governance, i-Secretariat, kanye ne-Institutional Oversight: Nikeza ngokuqhathanisa okuhleliwe kwezinqubo zokubusa ezesekela i-HOD kanye ne-MEC. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kahle kwezinqubo zokwenza izinqumo. Qapha ukuzethemba, izinga, kanye nokuhambisana kwezethulo. Qinisekisa ukurekhodwa, ukulandelwa, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinqumo zokuphatha. Phatha njengenelisi yezinqubo zokubusa ukuqinisekisa ukukhanyela, ukuziphendula, kanye nokebuholo obuzothile. Nikeza ngokuqinisekiswa ku-HOD ngokuqinisekiswa kokubusa. Imisebenzi yongezeza ihlanganisa ukweseka ihhovisi le-HOD ngesevisi yeluleko engozini yokubusa; ukuqhathanisa kanye nokulandela izethulo zokuphatha, izinqumo kanye nezinto ezenziwayo; ukusiza ngezimpendulo zokuhlolwa, ukuhambisana kanye nokuqinisekiswa; ukweseka ukuqondanisa kwezinhloso zomnyango ne-APP kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza; ukwedlulisela ukuxhumana phakathi kwamagatsha ohlelo lwamaphrojekthi ayingqayizivele, iziqaliso ze-PPP, kanye nezindaba zokuhweba nge-ICT; ukulungisa amanothi okweluleka, okufunwa okufunyenwe ehhovisi le-HOD, i-SMT, i-EXCO kanye namakhasimende abaqaphayo; kanye nokweseka ukubuka ingozi yokubusa, izikhala ekusetshenzweni kanye nobuthakathaka ekulawuleni.

xh.title: Umongameli: Iofisi yehloko lesebe
xh.summary: Kufuneki gqithwa umongameli onikele ngolungevano oluzinzileyo, inkxaso yabaphathi kunye nolawulo olupheleleyo kuhloko lesebe eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: Isigqeba sedigri esinqanaba se-NQF 7 kuLawulo Loluntu /Lawulo Loshishino /Urhwebo okanye idigri ye-BA. Idigri ye-Master's/M.Com okanye isigqeba sedigri sasese ngenqanaba eliphezulu kuLawulo Loluntu, Lawulo Loshishino, Urhwebo, Ulawulo, ulawulo lwengozi, okanye indalo engemva, iba luncedo elongeziweyo. 5 yeminyaka yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi elizele/elifanele ukulawula. Ulwazi ngamandla angabamelwane afunekayo ngokubanzi: Ulwazi nge-GPG nendawo yezopolitiko yoMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi ngeendaba zolawulo zesebe. Ulwazi ngemithetho ka-DPSA nesebe esingabo baphathi. Ukuvumelana ne-PFMA. Ulwazi ngamandla angabamelwane of lwezobuchwepheshe afunekayo: Ukuqinisekisa ngobugcisa. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ikomunikesho eluncedo ngokwethethwayo, okubhaliweyo nezethulo. Isakhono sokuphatha amaxwebhu aqhimisileyo nabayela kwi. Ulawulo loqhodo (iNkxazo kunye nokuSombulula iingxaki). Ulwazi ngamandla angabamelwane abalawuli afunekayo: Ukukwazi ukubambelela. Inqwelo yemifanekiso ngemifanekiso. Isikolo sokulungelelanisa kwaye ulungelelanise izigqibo. ulawulo lonke kwindalo ehlukileyo. Amakhono afunekayo: Isiphiwo sokunxibelelwana. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Isiphiwo sokusebenza nabantu. Isiphiwo sezethulo. Ukubhala iiripoti. Ubunkokeli. Iindlela ezisemva. Uluvo. Uqeqesho lobuqhetse. Iimpawu ezifunekayo: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngxam. Inselelo yokuba nomdla woMgangatho. Kufuneka ube nesigqibo sokuzimisela. Amanye amandla abamelwane nakhono aquka ukulawulwa kwengozi enkohlakele, ukuqinisekiswa kolawulo, ukubuyela emva kolawulo, ukuxhaswa kwesigqibo sothisha ulawulo, ukulawulwa koluntu ngokukhanya koluntu, ukuxhaswa lwenkqubo yoshintsho lokulinganiselwa, ulungezano lweenkcazelo zokukhangela, ukuzibandakanya kwabathathi-nxaxheba, ukuqwalasela kwindalo ehlukileyo, ukulawulwa komyalelo, ukubika kolawulo, kunye nokuqinisekiswa koluntu ngokobungakanani bezithuba be-EXCO, i-SMT nezithuba zika-HOD. Isatifikethda sokuqala se-Nyukela sifuneka singeniswe phambi kokuziswa esikhundleni.
xh.duties: Nika ulungevano oluzinzileyo nenkxaso yabaphathi: Qhuba ukubambelela kweendaba zesebe kwimigqibo ka-HOD. Lawula ngokubumbana kweendaba ezo nakuzo iphi na indawo. Nika inkxaso ebaluleke kakhulu ngelungelo ku-HOD. Nika ulawulo nenkxaso yesigqibo: Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwezigqibo zabaphathi. Qinisekisa ukuba yiyona nantlonono ngeendaba ezingeniswa ku-HOD. Lilinde ukusetyenziswa kwezigqibo ezivela kumagqabi solawulo. Gcina ubudlelwane obusetyenziswayo nobusebenzayo nabathathi-nxaxheba nolawulo leofisi: Yakha iindlela zonxibelelwano ekuphatheni iimfazo zabathathi-nxaxheba, iimibuzo, nendaba zokunxibelelwana. Misise kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo zofisi eziya kuqinisekisa ukusebenza kakuhle kwofisi ekuphatheni abathathi-nxaxheba. Saza amaxwebhu kulungelelaniswe iintlanganiso eziza kwenzeka kwabathathi-nxaxheba abafanelekileyo ukujongana nendibano emayithethwe. Hlela ukufikelelela kubathathi-nxaxheba ababaluleke kakhulu kofisi. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuzibandakanya nokudibana kwehloko zamagqabi ngaphakathi kwofisi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubambelela ngokobume bommandla. Qinisekisa ukuba abathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nabo bangaphandle baxelelwa ngeentlanganiso zoLawulo Oluphezulu no-HOD. Nika ukuthembeka koluntu nengcebano: Nika ingcebano ngokuzinzileyo ku-HOD nakuLawulweni Oluphezulu ngokulawulwa, ukubuyela emva, kunye nokuqwalasela kwindalo ehlukileyo. Yenza iintlanganiso ngezaziso ngeendaba ezahlukileyo, izikhokelo, namagama amaninzi ekwazisiweyo eofisi. Nika ingcebano kuLawulo Oluphezulu lwesebe naku-HOD. Lawula izixhobo zofisi ka-HOD: Lawula imisebenzi yabasebenzi nemfuno yokuphuhlisa. Lawula kwaye ulinde inkqubo yemali yofisi malunga neyona ngokwexabiso elingaphezulu nelingasezantsi. Bandakanya abasebenzi ofisi ukumisela iimfuno zemali. Thatha inxaxheba kumabandla okuqwalasela imisebenzi. Phezisa indlela yokusebenza iqoqo leminikelo. Nika ulawulo, isikhululo esingumnini, ulondolazo ngokweziko: Nika ulondolazo oluzinzileyo ngokuqwalaselwa kokulawulwa ixesha elithile lokuzinza iindawo ezixhasa u-HOD ne-MEC. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenza kweendlela zokuqamba iigqibo. Qwalasela ukuzinza, ubuntu, nokuvumelana ngeendaba ezingeniswa. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa, ukulandelwa nokusetyenziswa kwezigqibo zabaphathi. Ziba ngowokulawula iindlela ezithintela ulungevano, ukuqinisekisa ngokucacileyo, ukubeki kwaye nokuzithobileyo ngokwemigaqo. Nika isiqinisekiso ku-HOD ngokusebenza kolawulo. Imisebenzi engethu iquka ukuxhasa iofisi ka-HOD ngenkxazo yengozi enkohlakeleyo nolawulo; ukulungelelanisa nokulandela iindaba ezikhutshwa ngaphandle, izigqibo namagama amakhulu emisebenzi; ukunceda ngeempendulo zokukhangela, ukubuyela emva nokuthembeka; ukuxhasa ukubambelela kolungevano lwesebe kwaye zibe namagqibo e-APP nendlula yokusebenza; ukwenza ukubambelela nasekuqwalaselweni koluntu kumathuba amaninzi; ukulungelelanisa inkxaso-mali ye-PPP nemicimbi yokuhweba nge-ICT; ukulunga iintlanzi, iingaba zemihla leyo yokubhala, iindaba zoxhaso lwesigqibo zika-HOD, i-SMT, i-EXCO nendalo yokugqibela; ukulinda ulawulo lweengozi ezungahoyiyo, iindawo ezingangenwa ndawo kunye neengozi ezibi zokulawula; nasekuxhaseni ukuzibandakanya nabathathi-nxaxheba ngeenkqubo ezisebenzayo kwamagatya angaphakathi, amasebe oburhulumente, amaziko oluntu nabaphathiswa bangaphandle.

jobs.title: Director: Risk Management
jobs.summary: Director of Risk Management in Johannesburg requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and five years' senior management experience to oversee risk strategies and compliance.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 Qualification in Risk Management / Auditing / Commerce / Accounting or Finance. 5 years’ relevant experience at middle/senior management level. Registered Government Auditor (RGA) Qualification, CIA/ CCSA/ CFE/ CA(SA) will be an added advantage. Knowledge of generic competencies required: General GPG business. Government regulations, policies, and procedures. General government sector and organisational structure. Knowledge of technical competencies required: Knowledge of key risk management concepts, framework, and good practices. Knowledge of the PFMA Act and King 2. Knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) principles. Knowledge of managerial competencies required: Business Acumen. Customer Management. Innovative Continuous Improvement. Decision Making. Problem Solving. Skills required: Communications skill. Computer literacy. Interpersonal skills. Analytical, Report writing, Leadership, Strategic, Planning, and Organisation. Attributes required: Be able to work under pressure. Enable Diversity awareness. Inspire innovation within the organisation. Encourage teamwork. Should be cost conscious. Inspire to be Quality Oriented. Nyukela Pre-entry certificate must be submitted prior to appointment.
jobs.duties: Oversee the development and management of the implementation of risk management strategies: Manage the development of risk management control and systems. Manage the analysis of data to detect non-compliance with departmental policies and regulations. Report to management, audit results and recommend changes in operational and financial activities. Manage the monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of risk assessment responses strategies. Continually monitor and evaluate existing framework, risk plan, contingency plans strategies and procedure manuals and identify risk. Monitor the implementation of action of plan to ensure risk mitigation efforts are proceeding as required. Consolidate and compile report on compliance with risk regulatory requirements. Provide strategic risk reports to HOD, Executive Management and Audit Committee. Influence executive decision-making on risk exposure. Manage and facilitate the capacity building on departmental staff on risk management: Provide strategic advisory services to Executive Management on risk and compliance matters. Manage the identification of the of training needs for risk management. Oversee the development of the departmental risk competence, evaluation mechanisms, methodologies and awareness programmes across the department. Provide advice on ad hoc risk matters. Monitor and evaluate the adequacy internal control framework in addressing risk mitigation within the department. Manage the adequacy implementation of actions plans in areas highlighted in audit report within the departmental business units. Facilitate the appointment of risk management committee members. Manage the development of Organisational risk, policies, procedures, strategies, risk plans and framework: Ensure integration of risk management into strategic planning, budgeting and performance management processes. Develop and review risk management framework, risk plan, strategy and procedure manuals. Oversee the implementation and maintenance of risk management framework, strategies, procedure manuals and business continuity plan strategies. Oversee the identification and analysis of potential deficiencies and risks within the department. Monitor, evaluate and report on the effectiveness and efficiency of the risk management framework and best practices. Continually improve/review risk management framework, strategy, procedure manuals and business continuity plan. Ensure the implementation of the recommendations of enhancement improvement plan/action plans. Ensure compliance with provincial risk management framework. Coordinate the development and monitoring of implementation of Business Continuity plan: Ensure the business impact analysis reports for the individual business units are revised. Revise the business continuity plans as and when the need arises. Develop a business continuity strategy. Establish a business continuity steering committee. Work closely with Occupational Health and Safety unit to ensure that an emergency plan is in developed and implemented. Manage the management of data protection and POPIA compliance risks. Manage the oversight of ICT systems and digital service continuity risks. Manage enterprise-wide digital transformation risks across GPG. Table risk and audit reports to all Executive management and Oversight committees. Provide executive-level assurance on audit findings. Advise on governance and performance implications. Oversee implementation of internal and external audit recommendations: Engage with internal and external auditors. Participate in audit steering committees both internal and external in consultation with stakeholders. Monitor implementation of the action plans to address audit findings for both internal and external. Provide assurance to internal and external auditors on the implementation of action plans. Provide Extended Senior Management Team (ESMT), Executive Management Team (EMT), Risk Management Committee (RMC) and Audit Committee (AC) with feedback on target dates not met and implications for department. Manage the provision of Strategic Governance and Advisory: Advise HOD and Executive Management on enterprise risk exposure. Engage with oversight bodies (AGSA, OTP, GAS, Treasury and Provincial Audit Committee). Provide input into strategic decision-making. Manage resources (human, financial): Build and lead a high-performing team by providing guidance, mentorship, and professional development opportunities. Set clear goals and performance expectations for the team, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives. Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages teamwork and continuous learning. Manage all resources, including budget, in terms of the PFMA. Manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the directorate. Manage leave in the business unit.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Portia Makotwane at 066 297 1488
jobs.applications: Manual applications should be delivered to: Gauteng Department of e- Government, Imbumba House, 75 Fox Street, Marshalltown, or Applicants can apply online at: jobs.gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the recent Z83 form (obtainable from any Public Service department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents). Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed personal information, duties, experience, and references) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form is required for both online and manual applications. The Z83 form must be completed in full, and page 2 duly signed. An accurate position and reference number must be indicated on the Z83 form. All fields of Section A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83 it is acceptable for applicants to indicate refer to CV or see attached. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re- appointment under Part “F” must be answered and declaration signed. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit holders in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Failure to submit the requested information will result in the application not being considered and deemed a regret. Shortlisted candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by the Gauteng Department of e-Government. The appointment is subject to positive outcomes on employment suitability checks, which include but are not limited to security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification, and criminal record. Successful candidates must obtain a positive security clearance. Applications received after the closing date as well as those who do not comply with the requirements will not be taken into consideration. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Please note that all applicants for Senior Management positions are required to complete the SMS Pre-Entry Programme administered by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. No appointment will take place without the successful completion of the pre-entry certificate and submission of proof thereof. The Course is available at NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/smspre-entry-programme/.              For more information regarding the course please visit the NSG website: www.thensg.gov.za. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. (This applies only when there is an SMS post).” If you have not received a response from this institution within three months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the below advertised post(s). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Risikobestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Risikobestuur in Johannesburg wat 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se seniorbestuurservaring vereis om risikostrategieë en nakoming te oorsien.
af.requirements: NQF level 7-kwalifikasie in Risikobestuur / Ouditering / Handel / Rekeningkunde of Finansies. 5 jaar se relevante ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Geregistreerde Regeringsouditeur (RGA)-kwalifikasie, CIA/CCSA/CFE/CA(SA) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van generiese bevoegdhede vereis: Algemene GPG-besigheid. Regeringsregulasies, beleide en prosedures. Algemene regeringssektor en organisasiestruktuur. Kennis van tegniese bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van sleutelsrisikobestuurskonsepte, raamwerk en goeie praktyke. Kennis van die PFMA Act en King 2. Kennis van Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)-beginsels. Kennis van bestuursonderderieke bevoegdhede vereis: Besigheidsinsig. Kliëntbestuur. Innoverende deurlopende verbetering. Besluitneming. Probleemoplossing. Vaardighede vereis: Kommunikasievaardigheid. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Analitiese, verslagskryf-, leierskaps-, strategiese, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede._Attribuvere vereis: In staat wees om onder druk te werk. Bevorder diversiteitsbewustheid. Inspireer innovasie binne die organisasie. Moedig spanwerk aan. Moet kostubewus wees. Inspireer om kwaliteitgerig te wees. Nyukela-toelatingsertifikaat moet voor aanstelling ingedien word.
af.duties: Oorsien die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die implementering van risikobestuurstrategieë: Bestuur die ontwikkeling van risikobestuurkontroles en -stelsels. Bestuur die analise van data om nie-nakoming van departementele beleide en regulasies op te spoor. Rapporteer aan bestuur ouditresultate en beveel veranderinge in bedryfs- en finansiële aktiwiteite aan. Bestuur die monitering en evaluering van die implementering van risiko-assesseringsreaksiestrategieë. Monitor en evalueer voortdurend bestaande raamwerk, risikoplan, noodplan-strategieë en prosedurehandleidings en identifiseer risiko's. Monitor die implementering van aksieplanne om te verseker dat risikobeperkingspogings soos vereis verloop. Konsolideer en stel verslag op oor nakoming van risiko-reguleringsvereistes. Voorsien strategiese risiko-verslae aan HOD, Uitvoerende Bestuur en Ouditeerkomitee. Beïnvloed uitvoerende besluitneming oor risikoblootstelling. Bestuur en fasiliteer kapasiteitsbou vir departementele personeel oor risikobestuur: Verskaf strategiese adviesdienste aan Uitvoerende Bestuur oor risiko- en nakomingsake. Bestuur die identifisering van opleidingsbehoeftes vir risikobestuur. Oorsien die ontwikkeling van departementele risikobekwaamheid, evalueringsmeganismes, metodologieë en bewusmakingsprogramme dwarsoor die departement. Verskaf advies oor ad hoc-risiko-aangeleenthede. Monitor en evalueer die toereikendheid van die interne beheerraamwerk in die aanpak van risikobeperking binne die departement. Bestuur die toereikende implementering van aksieplanne in areas wat in ouditverslae uitgelig is binne die departementele besigheidseenhede. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van risikobestuurkomiteelede. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van organisatoriese risiko's, beleide, prosedures, strategieë, risikoplanne en raamwerk: Verseker integrasie van risikobestuur in strategiese beplanning, begroting en prestasiebestuursprosesse. Ontwikkel en hersien risikobestuurraamwerk, risikoplan, strategie en prosedurehandleidings. Oorsien die implementering en instandhouding van risikobestuurraamwerk, strategieë, prosedurehandleidings en besigheidskontinuïteitsplan-strategieë. Oorsien die identifisering en analise van potensiële tekortkominge en risiko's binne die departement. Monitor, evalueer en rapporteer oor die doeltreffendheid en effektiwiteit van die risikobestuurraamwerk en beste praktyke. Verbeter/hersien voortdurend risikobestuurraamwerk, strategie, prosedurehandleidings en besigheidskontinuïteitsplan. Verseker die implementering van die aanbevelings van die verbeteringsplan/aksieplanne. Verseker nakoming van provinsiale risikobestuurraamwerk. Koördineer die ontwikkeling en monitering van implementering van besigheidskontinuïteitsplan: Verseker dat die besigheidsimpakanaliseverslae vir die individuele besigheidseenhede hersien word. Hersien die besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne soos wanneer die behoefte ontstaan. Ontwikkel 'n besigheidskontinuïteitsstrategie. Stel 'n besigheidskontinuïteitsstuurskomitee in. Werk nou saam met die Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-eenheid om te verseker dat 'n noodplan ontwikkel en geïmplementeer word. Bestuur die bestuur van databeskerming en POPIA-nakomingsrisiko's. Bestuur die toesig oor IK-stelsels en digitale dienskontinuïteitsrisiko's. Bestuur ondernemingsbreë digitale transformasierisiko's dwarsoor GPG. Dien risiko- en ouditverslae voor aan alle Uitvoerende bestuur en Toesigkomitees. Verskaf versekering op uitvoerende vlak oor ouditbevindings. Gee advies oor bestuurs- en prestasie-implikasies. Oorsien implementering van interne en eksterne ouditaanbevelings: Skakel met interne en eksterne ouditeurs. Neem deel aan ouditstuurskomitees beide intern en ekstern in oorleg met belanghebbendes. Monitor implementering van die aksieplanne om ouditbevindings vir beide intern en ekstern aan te spreek. Verskaf versekering aan interne en eksterne ouditeurs oor die implementering van aksieplanne. Verskaf uitgebreide Senior Bestuurspan (ESMT), Uitvoerende Bestuurspan (EMT), Risikobestuurkomitee (RMC) en Ouditeerkomitee (AC) met terugvoer oor teikendatums nie bereik nie en implikasies vir die departement. Bestuur die verskaffing van Strategiese Bestuur en Advies: Adviseer HOD en Uitvoerende Bestuur oor ondernemingsrisikoblootstelling. Skakel met toesigliggame (AGSA, OTP, GAS, Tesourie en Provinsiale Ouditeerkomitee). Verskaf insette in strategiese besluitneming. Bestuur hulpbronne (menslik, finansiël): Bou en lei 'n hoëpresterende span deur leiding, mentorskap en professionele ontwikkelingsgeleenthede te bied. Stel duidelike doelwitte en prestasieverwagtinge vir die span, om belyning met organisatoriese doelwitte te verseker. Bevorder 'n samewerkende en inklusiewe werksomgewing wat spanwerk en deurlopende leer aanmoedig. Bestuur alle hulpbronne, insluitend begroting, ingevolge die PFMA. Bestuur en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die direktoraat. Bestuur verlof in die besigheidsdeenheid.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukulawula Ingozi
zu.summary: Umphathi Wokulawula Ingozi e Johannesburg ofuna iziqu ezinga le NQF 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yeziphiwo ezingumqondisi ophakeme ukuba aphephe izindlela zokubhekana nengozi nokuhambisana nemigomo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le NQF 7 ekuqweneni ngeNgozi / Ukuhlola / uThengelo / uBululu wezezimali noma izezimali. 5 iminyaka yeziphiwo ezifanele ezingeni lokuphatha eliphakathi/elphezulu. Isiqu se Registered Government Auditor (RGA), i-CIA/CCSA/CFE/CA(SA) kuzoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi oludingeka kwamakhono jikelele: Umsebenzi jikelele we GPG. Imithetho, izinqubomgomo, kanye neziqondiso kahulumeni. Umhlaba jikelele kahulumeni nesakhiwo esihlukene seminyango. Ulwazi oludingeka kwamakhono obuchwepheshe: Ulwazi ngemibono eyisisekelo yokulawula ingozi, ohlelo, kanye nezindlela ezinhle zokwenza umsebenzi. Ulwazi ngomthetho we PFMA Act kanye ne King 2. Ulwazi ngezimiso zokulawula iNgozi yephakheji (ERM). Ulwazi oludingeka kwamakhono okuphatha: Ubuhlakani bokuhweba. Ukuphatha abathengi. Ukuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo okusanda kabusha. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono adingekayo: Isikhathi sokuxhumana. Ukubhala ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ukuhlaziya, ukubhala imibiko, ukuba ngumholi, okobuchwepheshe bokulawula, ukucubungula, nokuhlela. Izimpawu ezidingekayo: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphansi kwesikhindi. Ukukhuthaza ukuqonda kokuhlukahluka. Ukukhuthaza izinto ezintsha emphakathini. Ukukhuthaza ukusebenza njengomanyano. Ukuba noduni ngezindleko. Ukukhuthaza ukugxila ekulinganiseni. Isitifikedi sokungena sokwangaphambili se Nyukela kufanele sinikezwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kokuqediswa kwezindlela zokubheka nengozi: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kolawulo ngeNgozi nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Phatha ukuhlaziywa kwemininingwane ukuthola ukungahambisani nezinqubomgomo nemithetho yomnyango. Mbikezela kubaphathi, iziphumo zokuqediswa futhi uphakamise ushintsho emisebenzini kanye nezimali. Phatha ukubuka kanye nokuhlolwa kokuqediswa kwezindlela zokubhekana nokubikezelwa ingozi. Qaphela njalo futhi uhlolishe uhlelo lokusebenza olukhona, isu elihleliwe ngeNgozi, izu elihleliwe, izu kanye nezincwadi zokuqondisa bese uthola ingozi. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kwenhlangano yesu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imizamo yokunciphisa ingozi ihamba njengoba kudingeka. Hlanganisa futhi wakhe imibiko ngokuhambisana nezidingo zemithetho yokubheka nengozi. Nikeza imibiko yokubheka nengozi ebuchwepheshe kuHOD, Ukuphatha Okuphezulu kanye neKomidi Yokuhlolwa. Mcondothise izinqumo zobaphathi abaphezulu ngokuvezwa kwengozi. Phatha futhi ukulungeleliswa kobungako ekugcineni amandla emisebenzi emaphakathi noma ngaphandle yomnyango ekubhekeni nengozi emaphakathi: Nikeza izeluleko ezibhekise ebuchwepheshe abaphathini abaphezulu ezindabeni zengozi nokuqondiswa nemithetho. Phatha ukuqashelwa kwezidingo zokuqeqeshwa ngokubheka nengozi. Qhaphela ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono okubheka nengozi komnyango, izindlela zokuqonda, izinhlelo zokwenza imisebenzi nemihlangano yokuvula amehlo emaphakathi wonke umnyango. Nikeza izeluleko ezithinta izindlela zokubheka nengozi ngokwesikhathi. Qhaphela futhi uhloliswe ukwanela kolawulo lwangaphakathi ohlelweni lokunciphisa ingozi ngaphakathi komnyango. Phatha ukwanela kokuqediswa kwenhlangano yesu kumakhonsi akhombiswe emibikweni yokuqediswa ngaphakathi kwezinyanga zomsebenzi zomnyango. Letela ukubekwa kwamalungu ekomidi lokubheka nengozi. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kolawulo lwangozi emphakathini, izinqubomgomo, izinqubo, izinhlela, izu langozi kanye nezinsimbi zokusebenza: Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kokubheka nengozi ekuhlelweni okubhekise ebuchwepheshe, emaphakathi nasekuqondisweni kokuqhuba imisebenzi. Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze izinsimbi zokubheka nengozi, isu nangeNgozi, uhlelo nezincwadi zokuqondisa. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa nokugcinwa kwezinsimbi zokubheka nengozi, izinhlela, izincwadi zokuqondisa futhi uhlele isu lezinhlela zokuqhubeka komsebenzi ngaso sonke isikhathi. Qaphela ukutholwa kanye nokuhlaziya ukungalunga okungaba khona futhi ukubeke ingozi ngaphakathi komnyango. Qaphela, uhlolisе futhi ubikezele ukusebenza kanye nokusebenza kahle kwezinsimbi zokubheka nengozi kanye nezindlela ezinhle zokwenza umsebenzi. Ngaso sonke isikhathi thuthukisa/uyekeze izinsimbi zokubheka nengozi, isu, izincwadi zokuqondisa kanye nesu lokuqhubeka komsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa koshintsho oluphakanyisiwe kolungelelwano nenhlangano yesu/izinhlela zomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezinsimbi zokubheka nengozi esifundazweni. Hlela ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kokuqalwa kwenhlangano yesu yokuphila komsebenzi: Qinisekisa ukuthi imibiko yesibalo sokuhlola umthelela wemisebenzi yabasebenzi ngabanye ibuyekeziwe. Buyekeza izinhlela zokuqhubeka komsebenzi lapho kunesidingo khona. Thuthukisa isu lokuqhubeka komsebenzi. Misa ikomidi elibusayo lokuqhubeka komsebenzi. Sebenza ndawonye nenyanga yeZezempiro Zokuvikela Impilo Nokuphepha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isu lesimo esiphuthumayo lenziwe futhi sisetshenziswa. Phatha ukuphathwa kokuvinjelwa kwemininingwane nokuhambisana nemibhalo ye POPIA nengozi. Phatha ukuqaphela kolawulo lwezinhlelo ze ICT futhi ukubeke ingozi yesevisi ezezimali nasezobuchwepheshe. Phatha ingozi yokushintshwa kwezobuchwepheshe kuso sonke isikhathi kuso sonke isikhungo i GPG. Faka imibiko yengozi nokuqediswa kubo bonke abaphathi abaphezulu nabeKomidi Boqaphelo. Nikeza isiqiniseko kumqondisi ophakathi nangezinyanga zokuqediswa ezingaphandle. Phakamisa ngokuphatha futhi ngokuthinta ukusebenza. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa koshintsho oluphakanyisiwe nokuqeda olubhekwe olungangaphakathi nolungaphandle: Chitha izinkulumo nabo oqeda izinkulu nabancane. Ngena ikomidi elibusayo eliqeda izinkulu futhi elingaphandle kubanye abahloli. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa koshintsho oluphakanyisiwe nokuqeda ukuthola izinkinga ezibhalwe ngokungangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikeza isiqiniseko abo oqeda abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokusethenziswa koshintsho oluphakanyisiwe. Nikeza abaphathi abaphezulu abangekho emkhakheni weNdwendwe (ESMT), Eqondisweni Labaphathi (EMT), eNkomidini yokulawula iNgozi (RMC) kanye neNkomidini yokuhlolwa (AC) imbalo ngosuku okungagcwaliswa kanye nezinkinga ezizobe khona emnyangweni. Phatha ukuletha kwesiPhathi sokuphathwa kwemibuso: Phakamisa kuHOD labaQondisa ukutholwa kwengozi esiphakathi. Chitha izinkulumo nabalawuli (AGSA, OTP, GAS, i Treasury kanye neKomidi yokuhlolwa yaseSifundazweni). Faka isandla ezinqumeni zokwenza izinqumo zokuqhuba imisebenzi. Phatha imithombo (abantu, izimali): Sakha futhi uhola iqembu elisebenza kahle ngokuletha ukulawula, ukukhuleisa, futhi waphulela izinga lokuthuthuka emsebenzini. Hlela ukuqondiswa okucacile kanye nenkokhiso yokusebenza eqenjini, ukuqinisekisa ukuhlangana nezinhloso zomnyango. Khuleisa isimo esihlanganyenayo futhi esivumela ukusebenza ndawonye nokufunda ngokuqhubekayo. Phatha konke okusemthethweni okufakwe kuhlelo lokusebenza, kuhlanganise nesabelomali, ngokusho komthetho we PFMA. Phatha futhi ukukhuthaza ukugcinwa kwayo inhlalo emphakathini. Phatha ilungiselelo le holide eqenjini.

xh.title: Umlawuli: WeNgozi
xh.summary: UmLawuli weNgozi eJohannesburg ofuna iziqinisekiso ze-NQF level 7 nangaphezulu kweminyaka elihlanu yamava ehamba phambathi ekulawulen iindlela zolawulo nokuhambelana.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso seNQF level 7 kwiNgeno-Ngqo / Ukuvavanya / Ushishino / I-akhawunti okanye iMali. Iminyaka yamava emi 5 kwinqanaba eliphezulu. Isiqinisekiso sokuba Ngumvavanyi kaRhulumente (RGA), i-CIA/ CCSA/ CFE/ CA(SA) iya kuba ngaphezulu ngakumbi. Ukuqonda okudingekayo: Intengiso ngokubanzi ye-GPG. Izinto ezibalulwe, iindlela, izikqubo, iinkqubo ngokubanzi zorhulumente nakwimigaqo yoluntu. Ukuqonda okubalulekileyo ngokwemigaqo yoluntu: Ukuqonda amagama abalulekileyo kolawulo, iindlela, neenkqubo. Ukuqonda ingqiqo yomthetho we-PFMA Act ne-King 2. Ukuqonda iNgqiqo yolawulo lwe-Nkampani (ERM). Ukuqonda okubalulekileyo kolawulo: Ukuqonda uluntu. Ulwaluko lwamathuba. Ukuphucula ngokungaphezi kwaye ngokuphila kakuhle. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono adingekayo: Isakhono sokuncoma. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlangana nabantu. Ukwenza izigqibo ngokulunga, ukubhala iingxelo, ukulungelelwa iqela, iindlela zokwenza izicwangciso, kwakunye noLuntu. Izinto ezibalulekileyo: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ukuvumelana ngokuzenzelela. Ukukhuthaza ukungenisa izinto ezintsha kwindalo yoluntu. Ukukhuthaza ukusebenza ngokwenza iqela. Ukuba nokuqonda ngokuhlawulela. Ukukhuthaza ukuqonda ngokwemigaqo ye-Nyukela Pre-entry certificate.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso nolawulo lokusebenzisa iindlela zolawulo loyingozi: Lawula uphuhliso kolawulo ngezithuba kolawulo loyingozi. Lawula uhlalutyo lwedata ukuze kubonwe ukungahambelani namagqabantshintshi esebe. Ivelisa ingxelo kubaphathi ngemiphumela yokuhlola kwaye icebisise iinguquko kumisebenzi yomzobo nemali. Lawula ukuqonda nokuhlolwa kokusetyenzeziswa kwezindlela zokuqonda iingxaki ezingathintelwa. Qhubekekela ukuqonda nokuhlolwa kwesakhelo esikhona, icebo loyingozi, amacebo okuqhubeka phambili kwaye ukhangele iingobo zokuqhuba kwaye uqaphele iingozi. Qonda isetyenziswa secebo senzo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba amalungelo okuthintela iingozi ahamba njengoko kufuneka. Hlanganisa kwaye uqulunqe ingxelo ngokuhambelana neemfuno zolawulo loyingozi. Nikeza iingxelo ezingamagqabantshintshi ngeengozi kuHOD, kuLawulo Liphezulu nakwiKomiti Yokuhola. Tsala umxhantazo kwiindinganiso zokwenza izigqibo ngeengozi ezinokubakho. Lawula kwaye ululele ngokwakhiwa kwamandla abasebenzi basebe malunga nolawulo loyingozi: Nikeza iinkonzo zeluleko ezinqamlezileyo kuLawulo Liphezulu ngezinto ezimalunga neengozi nokuhambelana. Lawula ukuqonde iimfuno zolungelelwaniso kulawulo loyingozi. Lawula uphuhliso lwamandla esebe okuqonda iingozi, iindlela zokuqonda, iindlela nezinkqubo zokuzazi kwesebe lonke. Nikeza izimvo ezithile ngezinto ezize ngokwamazwi ngeengozi. Qonda kwaye uhlolwe ukwanelela kwesakhelo solawulo ngaphakathi ekuthinteleni iingozi kwesebe. Lawula ukusebenzisa okwanelela amacebo esenzo kumacandelo abaluliweyo kwingxelo yokuholo kwiiyuniti zamashishini esebe. Khuthaza ukugqabela iilungu lekomiti yasebe yalawulo. Lawula uphuhliso lolawulo ngeengozi, kwamagqabantshintshi, iinkqubo, iindlela, amacebo eengozi kwaye isakhelo: Qinisekisa ukudibanisa kolawulo loyingozi kwicebo elinengqiqo, kwesindikadla kwaye nakumisebenzi yemveliso. Phuhulisa kwaye uhlole isakhelo solawulo, icebo, indlela namanwedi okuqhuba. Qhubekekela ekusebenziseni nakugcineni isakhelo, iindlela, iingobo zokuqhuba kwaye namacebo ohamba phambili. Qonda nokuhlola iingenelo neengozi ezinokubakho kwesebe. Qhubekekela ekusetyenziswa kolawulo kwangaphakathi nakwangaphandle kwemiphumela. Lawula ukubonelela ngokulawula olunengqiqo nokuLuleka: Luleka uHOD nokuLawula ngento ezinokubakho kwesebe. Hlangana nabalawuli (AGSA, OTP, GAS, Treasury nakomgaPhakathi woluntu). Yonakalise kumacandelo amakhulu. Lawula (abantu, imali):akha kwaye uhola iqela elisebenzayo ngokubonelela ngokuqondisisa, kwaye kubanakho. Misela iinjongo kwaye ukhangele isiqalo seqela, ukuze uqinisekisa ulungelelwaniso namaqondo e-shishini. Qhuba indalo ekwabelwana ngayo nokubakho kwendalo. Lawula zonke izibonelelo, kubandakanywa imali, nangokwesakhiwo. Phuhulisa kukhubeka kolulawulo ngokuzenzakalela. Lawula ukubonelela kweliso eqela.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Risk Management
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, all-inclusive remuneration package

Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attention: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo; Tel: 072 788 2364 - Recruitment OTHER POSTS
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Risk Management position at the Department of Environment in Johannesburg, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and five years of experience including three at supervisory level.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Risk Management or related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years of experience of which 3 years must be at supervisory level (ASD). A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Public Service Act and Regulations and relevant legislation. Knowledge of anti-corruption initiatives and Professional Ethics Infrastructure. Knowledge of ethics auditing and ethics legal frameworks. Skills: Computer literacy, problem solving and analysis, planning and organizing, report writing, communication.
jobs.duties: Manage, implement, review and improve the risk management framework. Undertake studies and analysis to identify risks to establish8 the internal and external organization context. Manage, facilitate and advise on the risk management assessment process. Manage, monitor and review the identified risk response activities. Compile risk profile (ensure that the risk register is maintained). Compile reports as required. Facilitate the institutionalization risk management. Ensure that risk management philosophy and culture is embedded in the organization. Manage and undertake capacity development (inform, guide and advise employees on risk management matters). Manage the Sub Directorate: Risk Management. Maintenance of discipline. Deputy Director Risk Management. Management of performance and Development. Undertake Human Resource and other related administrative functions. Establish implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Develop and manage the operational plan of the sub- directorate and report on progress as required. Develop implement and maintain processes to ensure proper control of work. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Serve on transversal task teams as required. Procurement and asset management for the sub directorate. Planning and allocating work Quality control of work delivered by employees. Functional technical advice and guidance.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo; Tel: 072 788 2364
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za or send an email @ GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Risk Management
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Risk Management-pos by die Department of Environment in Johannesburg, wat 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar ervaring, waaronder drie op toesigvlak, vereis.
af.requirements: Matric plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) in Risk Management of 'n verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar ervaring waarvan 3 jaar op toesigvlak (ASD) moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Public Service Act and Regulations en tersaaklike wetgewing. Kennis van korrupsiebestrydingsinisiatiewe en Professional Ethics Infrastructure. Kennis van etiekouditering en etiekregsraamwerke. Vaardighede: Rekenaargeletterdheid, probleemoplossing en ontleding, beplanning en organisering, verslagskrywing, kommunikasie.
af.duties: Bestuur, implementeer, hersien en verbeter die risikobestuursraamwerk. Onderneem studies en ontleding om risiko's te identifiseer om die interne en externe organisasiekonteks te vestig. Bestuur, fasiliteer en adviseer oor die risikobestuur-assesseringsproses. Bestuur, monitor en hersien die geïdentifiseerde risikoreaksie-aktiwiteite. Stel risikoprofiel op (verseker dat die risk register onderhou word). Stel verslae op soos vereis. Fasiliteer die institusionalisering van risikobestuur. Verseker dat risikobestuurfilosofie en -kultuur in die organisasie ingebed is. Bestuur en onderneem kapasiteitsontwikkeling (lig werknemers in, gee leiding en advies oor risikobestuursaangeleenthede). Bestuur die Subdirektoraat: Risk Management. Onderhoud van dissipline. Adjunkdirekteur: Risk Management. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling. Onderneem menslike hulpbronne en ander verwante administratiewe funksies. Stel effektiewe en doeltreffende kommunikasiereëls vas, implementeer en onderhou dit. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die subdirektoraat en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis. Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werk te verseker. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Dien soos vereis op dwarslopende taakspanne. Procurement en batebestuur vir die subdirektoraat. Beplanning en toewysing van werk. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Funksionele tegniese advies en leiding.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSomphathi: Ukuphathwa kwezingozi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSomphathiji we-Risk Management eDini le-Environment eJohannesburg, esifuna izidanga ezisesigabeni se-NQF level 7 namava eminyakeni eyisihlano okuhlanganisa iminyaka emithathu kwazinga lokuphatha.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye nesidanga se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) ku-Risk Management noma ohlwini oluhlobene njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukwesisokinga okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 lapho kufanele kune-3 eminyakeni okufanele kube ngzinga lokuphatha (ASD). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono: Umthetho Wesebelezela Kahle kanye Nemithetho elandelayo. Ukuqonda ngamaphrojekthi ahusa ukushaya indoda Nobuhle be-Wuze. Ukuqonda ngemithetho yokuhlola ububi nemithetho ehlobene nakho. Amakhono: Ukusebenzisana kwegciwane, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuhlela futhi uhlele, ukubhala imibiko, ukuthetha.
zu.duties: Phatha, misebenzisa, buza kabusha futhiuthuthukisa inkqubomgomo yokuqapha izingozi. Yenza izifundo nokuhlaziya ukuze kutholakale izingozi ekuqalisweni kwesimo sangaphakathi nangaphandle sentisha yenhlangano. Phatha, siza futhi unikezezelwe ngohlelo lokuhlola ukuqapha izingozi. Phatha, qapha futhi ubuyekeze imisebenzi yempendulo yezingozi ezitholakele. Hlanganisela incazelo yezingozi (qinisekisa ukuthi ugogiwe isibalo sezingozi). Hlanganisela imibiko njengoko kudingeka. Siza ukumiswa kwenkqubomgomo yokuqapha izingozi. Qinisekisa ukuthi iyasizakwemikqondo yokuqapha izingozi naleso simsindo sikhona ezinhlanganweni. Phatha futhi uqonde ekuthuthukiseni amandla (azise, qondisa futhi unikeze abasebenzisi ngemithetho yokuqapha izingozi). Phatha iNqencu enkulu: Ukuphathwa kwezingozi. Ukugcinwa kobuhlungiswa. Omunye umphathi wezingozi. Uphathwa nokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Yenza imisebenzi yemithombo yabantu nezinye izinto zolawulo ezihlobene nalezi. Misela, misebenzisa futhi ugcine izinhlelo zokuqondana ezingasiza futhi ezisebenza kahle. Ukuthuthukisa nokuphatha iplani yokusebenza yenqencu kuncane nokubika ngokuqhubekayo njengoko kudingeka. Thuthukisa, misebenzisa futhi ugcine izinqubo ukuze kuqiniseke ukulawula kahle umsebenzi. Hlanganisela futhi unikeze zonke imibiko yentisha ebalulekile. Nika inkonzo ohlelweni oluhlangeneyo lwezinkinga njengokokudingeka. Ukuhlolwa kwezinsiza nempatho yenqencu enkulu. Ukuhlela nokwabelana umsebenzi. Ukulawula khwalithi yomsebenzi ohlinzekwa yibasebenzisi. Uzelulelo lobuchwepheshe nemiqondo yakho.

xh.title: Isekela Mongqamla: Uqeqesho lweengozi
xh.summary: Isithuba sesekela mongqamla: Uqeqesho lweengozi kwiSebe lezeMveliso eJohannesburg, sifuna ifestile yesiNqanaba se-NQF 7 neminyaka emihlanu yamava kuquka emithathu kwinqanaba lokulawula.
xh.requirements: I-Matric ngakumbi nelifikhalishoni lesiqu esingaphantsi kwe-NQF level 7 kwiRisk Management okanye kwicala elinxulumeneyo njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ubuyekezo bemi nyaka emi-5 yamava apho kufuneka kube ngeminyaka emi-3 ukuba ukwinqanaba lokulawula (ASD). Ilayisenisi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo. Isebe nalamagunya athile: iPublic Service Act kunye neRegulations kunye nemicimbi yomthetho. Ulwazi ngezenzo ezichaseneyo nokuqhwagamela ukuqhawukwa komthetho nolwazi lwe-Professional Ethics Infrastructure. Ulwazi ngokuqinisekisa isixhobo sokuhlola amagunya kunye neenkqubo zomthetho ezimalunga namagunya. Amaplenen: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuxazula iingxaki nokuqonda, ukuyila nokuqamba, ukubhala iingxelo, ukunxibelelana.
xh.duties: Ukulawula, ukusebenzisa, ukuphonononga nokuphucula inkqubo yoyilo lweengozi. Ukwenza izifundo nokuqonda ngokuchanekileyo iingozi ukuze kusiwe isimo sangaphakathi nangaphandle kwindalo yenkampani. Ukulawula, ukukhuthaza kunye nokucebisa ngokuqwalaselwa kwengxaki yemisebenzi. Ukulawula, ukulandelela nokuphonononga iimongamana ezifunyenwe zibe ngxaki. Ukuqamba isibhalo seengozi (kuqinisekiswa ukuba kugcinwa irekhodi yamalungelo). Ukuqamba iingxelo nje nje. Ukukhuthaza ukunyuselwa kwindalo inkqubo yoyilo lweengozi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izimbo zoyilo lweengozi zithathwa njengesiko kumaphakathi wonke. Ukulawula nokukhuthaza inkqubo yamava amasha (ukuzisa ulwazi, ukukhokela nokucebisa abasebenzi ngemiba enxulumene noyilo). Ukulawula urhulumente. Ukulawula inqanaba elingaphantsi: Ulawulo lweengozi. Ukugcina isithunzi. Isekela Mongqamla Ulawulo lweengozi. Ukulawula inkqubo yamava nokuphuhliswa. Ukuqhuba iinkqubo ezingagungqiyo ezinxulumene nabalawuli basebenza. Ukumisela ukusetyenziswa nokugcina iindlela ezisebenzayo ezichanekileyo zokunxibelelana. Ukuyila nokulawula iplani yemisebenzi yesigaba se- directorate nokubika ngokuqhuba nje nje. Ukuyila ukusetyenziswa nokugcina iinkqubo ukuze kuqiniseke ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo umsebenzi. Ukuqamba kwaye ungenise zonke iingxelo efunekayo. Ukuba lilungu leethim zomsebenzi onjengoko kufuneka. Ukulawula nokugcina izinto ezithengwayo kwisigaba se- directorate. Ukuyila nokwaba umsebenzi. Ukulawula umgangatho womsebenzi ovela kubasebenzi. Izalathiso zomsebenzi ezikumgangatho ophezulu.

jobs.title: State Accountant
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 NOTES : Quoting the relevant reference number applications must be submitted on the New Z.83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Applications with the Old Z.83 form will not be considered. A New Z.83 form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed by the applicant. A recent, comprehensive CV, specifying all qualifications and experience, with respective dates must accompany the application form. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. After the pre- entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre- entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attention: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo; Tel: 072 788 2364 - Recruitment OTHER POSTS
