xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 kunye ne-National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ i-Degree (NQF level 7) kwi-Finance/Cost and Management Accounting / i-B Comm Accounting okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo njengoko sivunyiwe yi-SAQA. 1-2 iminyaka efanelekileyo/efanelekileyo yamava olawulweni lwemali nakwindawo yokuhlola. Ilayisense yomqhubi elisebenzayo. Ikhono: ulwazi malunga namagqabantshintshi kunye neenqubo ze-GPG nesebe, i-Public Service Regulatory Framework, iinkqubo zokulinganisa, i-Division of Revenue Act, i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, i-BAS, i-SAP nakwezinye iinkqubo zolawulo lwolwazi. Inqubo yehlelo lemali yabrakaraka kunye nonikezelo lweenkonzo kumthengi. Amakhono: Unxibelelwano ngolwimi lokuthetha, unxibelelwano ngokubhalisa, amakhono onxibelelwano nabantu, amakhono obuchwepheshe.
xh.duties: Ukunceda ekuboneleleni ngenkonzo zeakhawunti yolawulo. Ukuqokelela ulwazi oluxhasa izimali ngenjongo zocwangciso, ukulungisa nokuthatha isithuba kolwazi ngehlelo lemali, ukuzalisa amaxwebhu okulinganisa ajikelezayo/ajeyelekileyo, ukuqokelela amaxwebho olwazi oluxhasa izimali afunekayo kwinqubo yocwangciso lwentengiso nentlalo yonyaka, ukuqokelela ulwazi olumayelana nezimali olufunekayo kwigqondo nophuhliso lwezoshishino neephrojekthi. Ukulungisa ulwazi olufunekayo xa kuqedwa inqubo yehlelo lemali le-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) nokuzalisa iitempleyiti, ezinikiwe yindlela yamafa, ukulungisa ulwazi olufunekayo xa kubhalwa ama-Estimates of Provincial Expenditure ngokulandela iinkqubo zoBulungu beeTrezhala. Ukudibanisa izinto ezingeniyo nokulinganisa ukusakuba kwemali yenyanga kunye nokulungiswa kukusakuba kwemali kwii-Estimates of Expenditure/Adjusted Estimates of Expenditure, ukurekoda ukulungiswa kwamaxwebhu kwenkqubo yeakhawunti, ukuthatha isithuba kwiinkqubo zeakhawunti eze sivumelwe ukuba ziphindwe, ukulungela iinkcazolo zemirhalantshoni yenyanga nethrimu ngexesha elifanelekileyo nenyanisekileyo, ukuhlola iintengiselwano zenyanga kwiprogram evela kwi-BAS, ukuhlaziya iinkcazolo zentswalo ngokuzibophelela, ukulungela iinkcazolo zemirhalantshoni kubathathi nxaxheba nyanga zonke, ukuqokelela nokuthatha isithuba kolwazi lweakhawunti yolawulo kwii-templates zokulinganisa kwinyanga, ukulungela umbiko wokulinganiswa unyaka wonke oqhelekileyo wesebe, osuka kwiitempleyiti ezifunyenwe kumacandelo ahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Personnel Practitioner
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 NOTES : Quoting the relevant reference number applications must be submitted on the New Z.83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Applications with the Old Z.83 form will not be considered. A New Z.83 form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed by the applicant. A recent, comprehensive CV, specifying all qualifications and experience, with respective dates must accompany the application form. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. After the pre- entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre- entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attention: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo; Tel: 072 788 2364 - Recruitment OTHER POSTS
jobs.summary: Personnel Practitioner sought at the Department of Environment in Johannesburg to manage recruitment, drafting adverts, shortlisting, and appointment processes.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or Degree (NQF Level 7) in Human Resource Management/Industrial Psychology/Public Administration or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. 1-2 years of experience in Human Resource Management. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Knowledge of Resources Systems (PERSAL/SAP), Public Service Regulations, Public Services Act, Employment Equity Act, White Paper on Transformation and Batho Pele, Basic Condition of Employment Act (BCEA), Labour Relation Act, Public Financial Management Act, Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Skills: Communication (Verbal and written), computer literacy (Excel, Word, PowerPoint etc.), Innovation/Creative, Presentation, Responsiveness, Report writing, Time Management, Organizing and Planning, Financial management, Policy analysis, Problem solving.
jobs.duties: Prepare draft adverts, advertise vacant and funded posts as and when vacated. Draft memos for recruitment process, offer letters and regret letters. Administer the Shortlisting and interview processes. Prepare mandates for appointments, promotions, transfers and terminations. Conduct suitability checks. Compile mandates for the process of employee benefits. Coordinate payment of long service. Facilitate the process of resettlement. Coordinate logistical arrangements for long service awards. Coordinate HR awareness campaigns. Assist lower level employees with capturing of leave on SAP, Verification of Leave interfaced on PERSAL, Auditing of Leave. Appoint new officials on SAP and termination of exit employees. Prepare PILIR applications for submitting to the Health Risk Manager. Coordinate the completion of termination documents, Compile mandates and submit to e-gov for implementation. Facilitate exit interviews. Facilitate the completion of exit and benefit forms. Submit pension documents to Government Employee Pension Fund. Maintain records and statistics on HR, provide monthly report. Provide the information required for compilation of annual reports, quarterly reports, HR plan.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za or send an email @ GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za

af.title: Personeelpraktisyn
af.summary: Personeelpraktisyn gesoek by die Department of Environment in Johannesburg om werwering, die opstel van advertensies, kortlyste en aanstellingsprosesse te bestuur.
af.requirements: Matriek plus Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) of Graad (NQF Level 7) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Bedryfsielkunde/Openbare Administrasie of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 1-2 jaar se ondervinding in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van Resources Systems (PERSAL/SAP), Public Service Regulations, Public Services Act, Employment Equity Act, White Paper on Transformation and Batho Pele, Basic Condition of Employment Act (BCEA), Labour Relation Act, Public Financial Management Act, Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), rekenaarvaardigheid (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, ens.), innovasie/kreatiwiteit, aanbieding, reaksievermoë, verslagskrywing, tydbestuur, organisering en beplanning, finansiële bestuur, beleidsontleding, probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Berei konsepadvertensies voor, adverteer vakante en gefinansierde poste soos wanneer dit vakant raak. Stel memo's op vir die werweringsproses, aanbiedingsbriewe en spytbriewe. Administreer die kortlys- en onderhoudprosesse. Berei mandaterings vir aanstellings, bevorderings, oorplasings en beëindigings voor. Doen geskiktheidskontroles. Stel mandate op vir die proses van werknemervoordele. Koördineer betaling van langdienste. Fasiliteer die proses van hervestiging. Koördineer logistieke reëlings vir langdiens-toekennings. Koördineer HR-bewustheidsveldtogte. Help laer-vlak werknemers met die vaslegging van verlof op SAP, verifikasie van verlof wat op PERSAL geïnterface is, ouditering van verlof. Stel nuwe amptenare op SAP aan en beëindig uitgaande werknemers. Berei PILIR-aansoeke voor vir indiening by die Health Risk Manager. Koördineer die voltooiing van beëindigingsdokumente, stel mandate op en dien by e-gov in vir implementering. Fasiliteer uitgaanonderhoude. Fasiliteer die voltooiing van uitgaan- en voordeelvorms. Dien pensioendokumente by Government Employee Pension Fund in. Onderhou rekords en statistieke oor HR, verskaf maandelikse verslag. Verskaf die inligting wat vir die opstel van jaarverslae, kwartaalverslae, HR-plan benodig word.

zu.title: Umkhakha wezabasebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuzilolonga abantu sifunwa e-Department of Environment e-Johannesburg ukuphatha ukubuyisa abantu abasha, ukuhlela izikhangiso, ukwenza uhlu lomfutho, kanye nokuqhuba inqubo yokwamukela abantu abasha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zamabanga aphezulu kanye ne-Diploma Yesive (i-NQF Level 6) noma i-Degree (i-NQF Level 7) kumabanga aphezulu okuphathwa kwabasebenzi/Isikhando sabantu ngokomphakathi/Imithetho yesive noma iziqu ezamukelekayo njengoba kubonwa ngu-SAQA. 1-2 iminyaka yokusebenza ngokuphathwa kwabasebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuzazi: Ulwazi ngohlelo lwemithombo (i-PERSAL/i-SAP), Imithetho yomphakathi, uMthetho wemiphakathana yomphakathi, uMthetho wokulingana kweziqu, i-Paper emhlophe yokuqhuba kwezinhlelo nabantu, nezinye izinhlelo ezenzelwa ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano babantu namalungu abantu ngokomphakathi, Isimiso somthetho sokutholakala kokusebenza (i-BCEA), uMthetho wokuxhumana kwezinhlangano, uMthetho wokuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi, uMthetho wokuthuthukiswa kokwaziswa kolwazi (i-PAIA). Amakhono: Ukuxhumana (Ngomlomo nangombhalo), ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-Excel, i-Word, i-PowerPoint njll.), Ubuciko nobuntsha, Okubekiwe, Isabelo esinomsito, Iminikelo yezinkomba, Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi, Ukulungiselela nokuhlela, Ukulawula imali, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, kanye noMthetho wokuhlolwa kwamasu.
zu.duties: Hlunga izikhangiso zokuqala, kuyise kuzikhangiso izikhundla ezingenalowo ozithathayo namasheya abhalisiwe. Hlunga amamu-ndidi afakwayo ohlelweni lokubuyisa imisebenzi, ngemibhalo yabahola nabantu abashiyi isikhundla bengathandi imiphumela. Phatha inqubo yokwenza uhlu lomfutho kanye neyabantu abaxoxwa nabo. Lungiseza izinkomba zokumiswa kwabasebenzi, ukukhushulwa, ukudluliselwa kanye nokuphela kwenhlalo. Yenza ukuhlola ukufaneleka. Hlunga amamu-ndidi wenzuzo zabasebenzi. Hlola inkokhelo yabasebenzi isikhundla eside. Yenza isibopho esinamandla sokwenza ihlelo elisha, kusho ukuthi ukushintsha indawo yokuhlala. Lungiseza izinkomba zokuhlela isikhundla eside. Lungiseza isikhangiso sabasebenzi esingaphansi kwalesi simo ukuthi bafake ukushiywa kwesikhundla esingokomphakathi, ukuqinisekisa ukufakwa kwemibhalo yesikhundla abashintshe kuyo abathunyelwe ohlelweni olubizwa nge-PERSAL, nokuhlolwa kokufakwa kwemibhalo. Faka abantu abasha ohlelweni i-SAP bese uphela kwabashiywa isikhundla. Bhalise imibhalo yokufaka igama ohlelweni olusha kwabahola abakwazi ukuthi abalufanele ukuba kulesi simo. Yenza isibopho sokuphela kwemibhalo, Hlunga izinkomba bese uyithumela ohlelweni i-e-gov ukuthi yamukele. Yenza ukuxoxwa nabantu abashiywa isikhundla. Phatha ukugcwaliswa kwemibhalo yokushiywa kwesikhundla kanye namafomu enzuzo. Thumela amaphepha abakwazi ukuthenga ohlelweni lukaHulumeni okuthengisa iziqu zokuphila. Gcina amaphepha okuqopha izinto ezibalwayo ngabasebenzi, unikeze izinsuku eziyisikhathi esithile umbhalo. Nikeza imibhalo yokwenza umbhalo weminyaka yonke, umbhalo wezinyanga ezithile, inqubo yabasebenzi.

xh.title: Personnel Practitioner
xh.summary: Kufuneka yiPersonnel Practitioner kwisebe le-Environment eJohannesburg ukulawula ukurhuqwa kwabantu abafanelekileyo, ukubhala iindaba ezikhuthaza abantu, ukubeka abantu kuluhlu, kunye neenkqubo zokuqoka abantu.
xh.requirements: Kufunke ukuba neMatric eyongezelelwa yiNational Diploma (NQF Level 6) okanye iDegree (NQF Level 7) kwiHuman Resource Management/Industrial Psychology/Public Administration okanye nelifikhasheyo elitshoyo iSAQA. Kufunke umba weminyaka engama-1-2 engoko ubuye waba nolwazi kuHuman Resource Management. Kufunke ilayisensi yokuqhuba eyearha. Iimpawu zokwazi: ukuyazi iinkqubo zesixhobo (PERSAL/SAP), iPublic Service Regulations, iPublic Services Act, iEmployment Equity Act, iWhite Paper on Transformation and Batho Pele, iBasic Condition of Employment Act (BCEA), iLabour Relation Act, iPublic Financial Management Act, iPromotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Amapondo: ukuzwisisa nokuvakalisa okubhaliweyo, amandla okusebenzisa iikhompyutha (Excel, Word, PowerPoint njl.), ukusungula izinto ezintsha, ukubonisa, ukuphendula, ukubhala iingxelo, ukulawula ixesha, ukulungiselela, ukulawula iimali, ukwahlula iinkqubo, ukusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Lungisa iikhophi ezizatshulayo, tatshula izithuba ezingasekho nezixhobo ezimalini ngethuba liseyeko. Bhala iimemo zomthetho wokuqokelela abasebenzi, iileta zesaziso segazi nesifundo sokwenza iileta zamaxhala. Lawula iinkqubo zokwenza uluhlu lwabantu abalungileyo nangabafanelo ukubuzwa iimibuzo bhaxa. Lungela iimandates yokwamkelwa emsebenzini, ukuphakamiswa, ukudluliselwa, nokupheliswa kwabasebenzi. Qhathanisa ukulingana komzimba woluntu. Qokelela iimandates zenkqubo yenzuzo zabasebenzi. Lawula inkxaso-mali yokukhonza ixesha elide. Phatha inkqubo yokubuyela kwakhona kweendlali. Lawula iindlela zokulawula iinkqubo zokuqeqesha iindidi ezahlukeneyo zabasebenzi abakhonzile ixesha elide. Lawula iinkqubo zokwazisa abantu ngokuqonda ngokutsha. Nceda abasebenzi abakwinqanaba elingezantsi ekubhaliweni kweleave kwi-SAP. Qinisekisa iileave ezibhalwe kwi-PERSAL, ukuphonononga iileave. Qokelela abasebenzi abatsha kwi-SAP, ukuphelisa ukungabakho kweempilo zabasebenzi. Lungisa izicelo zePILIR eziza kuthunyelwa kwi-Health Risk Manager. Lawula ukugqitywa kwamaxwebhu okuphelisa umsebenzi, qokelela iimandates kwaye uzithumele kwi-e-gov ukuba zenziwe. Phatha iinkqubo zokuphokolwa ngabasebenzi abasuka kumsebenzi. Phatha ukugqitywa kweefomu zokuphokola nenzuzo abayifumanayo. Thumela amaxwebhu epension kwi-Government Employee Pension Fund. Phatha iirekhodi neestatistics nge-HR, zenze iingxelo nyanga zonke. Zeze ulwazi olufunekayo ekwakhiweni kweekhophi zeminyaka yonke, iingxelo zesikwatha, kunye neplani ye-HR.

jobs.title: Head of Clinical Unit: Psychiatrist
jobs.centre: Sedibeng District Health Services – Mental Health
jobs.city: Sedibeng District Health Services – Mental Health
jobs.summary: Lead the Sedibeng District Mental Health Team as Head of Clinical Unit, monitoring and evaluating mental health needs and developing operational plans to improve service coverage and care outcomes.
jobs.requirements: Master of Medicine (MMed) Degree in Psychiatry or Qualification as a psychiatrist with the Colleges of Medicine (FC Psych); Current registration with the HPCSA. Minimum of 3 years of experience as a psychiatrist post registration as a psychiatrist. It would be an advantage to have clinical experience in community mental health services, the ability to perform research (qualitative and quantitative); and managerial experience. Knowledge of relevant legislation, policies and guidelines, leadership qualities, the ability to work independently and in a team, computer literacy (MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint), and a driver’s license are necessary attributes.
jobs.duties: Work with the Sedibeng District Mental Health Team to monitor and evaluate the mental health needs of and services for the district population. Based on the findings, develop an operational plan towards improvement in mental health coverage, process of mental health care and outcomes of care. Work with the district management to implement the operational plan. Ensure that mental health services include treatment, prevention, promotion and protection of mental health care users and other vulnerable groups through relevant intervention programs and strategies. Promote collaboration between primary health care services, community psychiatry, and therapeutic services, and the non-health sector including governmental and non-governmental organisations, towards person-centered mental health care. Ensure that quality mental health services are provided according to ethical principles, professional standards, and national guidelines, including referral procedures and coordination with all stakeholders. Oversee training of primary care practitioners and community psychiatric staff as well as educational and mental health literacy outreach to the non-health sector and public, including suicide and substance use disorder prevention strategies. As a joint appointee with the Department of Psychiatry at the University of the Witwatersrand, participate in teaching, examining, registrar assessments and research according to the academic program. Maintain academic standards in the district-based in- service training and use research findings to inform situation analyses and improve services.
jobs.enquiries: Dr. M. Thoka at 071 904 4124
jobs.applications: Addrress: Ms M.L. November – Deputy Director SDHS: Email: Mamorwesi.November@gauteng.gov.za Sedibeng District Health Services, Cnr. Pasteur Blvd & Friekie Meyer, Vanderbijlpark.

All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It is our intention to promote representation (race, gender and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of posts and candidates whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representation will receive preference. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity through the filling of all numeric targets as contained in the Employment Equity Plan. af.title: Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid: Psigiater
af.summary: Neem die leiding oor die Sedibeng Distrik Geestesealthspan as Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid deur geestesgesondheidsbehoeftes te monitor en te evalueer en operasionele planne te ontwikkel om diensdekking en sorguitkomste te verbeter.
af.requirements: Magister in Geneeskunde (MMed)-graad in Psigiatrie of Kwalifikasie as 'n psigiater by die Kolleges van Geneeskunde (FC Psych); Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA. Minimum van 3 jaar ervaring as 'n psigiater na registrasie as 'n psigiater. Dit sal 'n voordeel wees om kliniese ervaring in gemeenskapsgeestesgesondheidsdienste te hê, die vermoë om navorsing te doen (kwalitatief en kwantitatief); en bestuurservaring. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing, beleide en riglyne, leierskapskwantiteite, die vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk, rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint), en 'n bestuurslisensie is noodsaaklike eienskappe.
af.duties: Werk saam met die Sedibeng Distrik Geestesgesondheidspan om die geestesgesondheidsbehoeftes en -dienste van die distrikbevolking te monitor en te evalueer. Gebaseer op die bevindinge, ontwikkel 'n operasionele plan ter verbetering van geestesgesondheidsdekking, die proses van geestesgesondheidsorg en sorguitkomste. Werk saam met die distrikbestuur om die operasionele plan te implementeer. Verseker dat geestesgesondheidsdienste behandeling, voorkoming, bevordering en beskerming van geestesgesondheidsorggebruikers en ander kwesbare groepe insluit deur middel van toepaslike intervensieprogramme en -strategieë. Bevorder samewerking tussen primêre gesondheidsorgdienste, gemeenskapspsigiatrie en terapeutiese dienste, en die nie-gesondheidssektor, insluitend regerings- en nie-regeringsorganisasies, ter bevordering van persoon-gerigte geestesgesondheidsorg. Verseker dat gehalte-geestesgesondheidsdienste volgens etiese beginsels, professionele standaarde en nasionale riglyne verskaf word, insluitend verwysingsprosedures en koördinering met alle belanghebbendes. Hou toesig oor opleiding van primêre sorgpraktisyns en gemeenskapspsigiatriese personeel asook opvoedkundige en geestesgesondheidsgeletterdheidsuitreik na die nie-gesondheidssektor en publiek, insluitend selfmoord- en middelmiddelgebruiksteuringvoorkomingsstrategieë. As 'n gesamentlike benoemde met die Departement van Psigiatrie aan die Universiteit van die Witwatersrand, neem deel aan onderwys, eksaminering, registrasie- assessering en navorsing volgens die akademiese program. Handhaaf akademiese standaarde in die distrikgebaseerde in-diens opleiding en gebruik navorsingsbevindinge om situasie-ontledings in te lig en dienste te verbeter.

zu.title: Isikhundla sokubusa ihhovisi le-Kliniki: Isidlidli
zu.summary: Hola iqembu lezinsizakalo zezezezelelwano komphakathi waseSedibeng District njengoba ungumphathi we-Kliniki, uqaphise futhi uhlole izidingo zokuxiluma komphakathi kanye nokuqonda izinsizakalo, bese ukha izinhlelo zokusebenza ukuthuthukisa isibalo sabantu abanakekelwa kanye nokuqonda imiphumela yokunakekelwa.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziphakeme ze-mfundo we-Master of Medicine (MMed) ku-Psychiatry noma ukutholakala kweziqu njengengudunyazi ngamakolishi oyezolo (FC Psych); Ukubhalisa kwaso njengamanje ne-HPCSA. Kudingeka kube khona iminyaka eyi-3 yokuqonda iziqu noma iminyaka yomsebenzi njengengudunyazi ngemva kokubhalisa njengengudunyazi. Kuzothanda noma kubakhona ukutholakala komphakathi ofana nezinkathi, futhi ukuthi ukwazi ukubhala ucwaningo (oluhlotshanisiwe noma olungehlotshanisi); kanye nokuthi ube nokuqonda noma ulawulo. Kudingeka ukwazi imithetho ephathelene, izinqubomgomo kanye nemigiqibelo, kanye nokwazi ukusebenzela ikhaya elilodwa noma eliyiqembu, kanye nokuthi ulwazi lwekhompiyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint), kanye namalayisensi okushayela kube khona izici ezidingekile.
zu.duties: Sebenza nomphakathi wezezezelelwano nokuqondisa komphakathi kwedolobha eliseduzane noma kude, ngokucela izindlu nokuqondisa ukuthuthukisa imikhuba kanye nokuqonda ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ukwenza izinhlalo zendawo ekusingathweni kwezinsizakalo eziseduzane. Ngokusekelwe emininingwaneni, hlela isu lokusebenza ngokuthuthukisa ukuqashwa komphakathi wezezezelelwano, inqubo yokunakekelwa kokuzwela komphakathi kanye nemiphumela yokunakekelwa. Sebenza noma bhangqa naphathi bendawo ukuphumeza isu lokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zezezelelwano zifaka ukwelashwa, ukuthintela, ukukhuthaza nokuvikela abasebenzisi bezinsizakalo zezezezelelwano kanye namanye amaqembu asengozini ngezinhlelo zokungenelela namasu ahlobene. Khuthaza ukusebenza ndawonye phakathi kwezinsizakalo eziyisisekelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, umphakathi wezezezelelwano, nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa, kanye nesekthi engewona yezempilo ehlanganisa izinhlanga zikahulumenu kanye nalezo ezingewona zahulumenu, ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwezezezelelwano okugxile kumuntu. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlinzekwa izinsizakalo zezinga eliphakeme zezezezelelwano ngokuhambisana nemigomo yobuvela, amazinga abantu, kanye namagugu ezwe lonke, okuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuqondisa kanye nohlelo lokusebenza kanye namaqembu bonke abahlanganyeli. Qaphisisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezinsizakalo eziyisisekelo kanye nabaphathi bezimo yomphakathi, kanye nokufundisa nokwazisa ngobuchwepheshe bezezezelelwano kubantu abangezona wezempilo nokuqondisa imiphakathi, okuhlanganisa namasu okuthintela ukuzibulala nokuhlukunyezwa ngesimo sokusebenzisa izidakamizwa. Njengesikhundla esihlanganyelwe nomnyango wokuqonda izinhlalo eNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, hlukumeza ufunde, uhlolwe, uhlole iziguli kanye nothweswe iziqu ngohlelo lwemfundo. Hlala ngamazinga amkhulu okufunda emaphakathi noma osekilini endaweni yokukhuluma kanye nokubhala izipho ezahlobene nokuqeqesha abasebenzi kwabezinyunyana.

xh.title: Umntu weSikhululo seSebe lezeMiphakathi: Ugqirha wezomqondo
xh.summary: Qamba iqela lezeMpilo zeNgqondo kwiSedibeng District njengesikhululo seSebe lezeMiphakathi, lilinde kwaye lihloliswe iimfuno zempilo zengqondo lenze iindaba eziphumelelayo ukuphucula iinkonzo kwaye kubekho iindululo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seMaster of Medicine (MMed) kwiPsychiatry okanye igqibelo lokuba ngugqirha wezomqondo neziKolishi zeNyanga (FC Psych); Uqaleliso lwangoku kuHPCSA. Uqinisekiso lonyaka ongaphantsi kwe-3 lomrhumo njengogqirha wezomqondo emva kokubhaliswa njengogqirha wezomqondo. Kuya kuba luncedo ukuba namava okugqirha kwinkonzo yempilo yengqondo kwilali, ukwazi ukwenza uphononongo (olungabalo nolungamagama); namava obu lawulo. Ulwazi ngemithetho, iingqigamba neengcombolo ezifanelekileyo, iimpawu zobukhosi, ukwazi ukusebenza Wedwa nakwibhunga, ulwazi lwekhompyutha (iMS Word, iExcel nePowerPoint), nefayidhi yomqhubi kukho iimpawu ezinganyanzelekanga.
xh.duties: Sebenza namaQela ezeMpilo zeNgqondo esiKolo iSedibeng District ukulinda kwaye uhloliswe iimfuno zeempilo zengqondo zeze nkalo loluntu. Ngokusekwe kwezifundo ezifunyenweyo, yenze indululo yokuqhuba ukuphucula inkonzo yempilo yengqondo, inkqubo yempilo yengqondo neziphumo zempilo. Sebenza nobukhosi besikolo ukuphumeza indululo yokuqhuba. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zempilo zengqondo ziquka unyango, ithintelo, ukhuthazo nokhuselo abasebenzisi beempilo zengqondo nakwezinye iinqulu ezingakhuselekanga ngenkqubo neengcinga ezingeneleayo. Khuthaza ukusebenzisana phakathi kwekonzo yempilo yomntu wonke, ugqirha wezomqondo welali, nekonzo yokunyanga, nangabangabi ngamagcisa empilo, kuquka oorhulumente nabadali bentsimbi, ukuba kubekho impilo yengqondo egxile kumntu. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo ezilungileyo zempilo yengqondo zinikezelwa ngokweendulo ezifanelekileyo, ipeyinti yomsebenzi, neengqigaba zesizwe, kuquka iinkqubo zokuqamba kwaye ukwazi ukuhlanganisa nabantu bonke abathintekayo. Lilise iisebe lezamagqirha abangakhoyo kwilali abagqirha bezomqondo kwilali ngokwemfundo nolwazi olutsha ngenkqubo yoluntu nakwabangabi ngamagcisa, kuquka iinkqubo ezithintela ukuzibulala nokusebenzisa izinto ezikrazula. Njengomntu ofakwe kunye neSebe lePsychiatry kwiYunivesithi yaseWitwatersrand, thatha inxaxheba kufundo, kwiimviwo, kulwabiwo lomphathi uphando ngokwenkqubo yemfundo. Gcina ipeyinti yemfundo esikolo nakwinkonzo yamagqirha kwaye usebenzise izifundo zophononongo ukwazisa ipeyinti yemfundo ukuphucula iinkonzo.

Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, PPPFA and BBBEE Act. Knowledge of the national and provincial mandates. In-depth knowledge of the supply chain management framework and other legislative prescripts that governs supply chain management. Experience in Ms Office (Ms Excel, Ms Word and Ms PowerPoint) and BAS, SAP and SRM. Knowledge of contract management including management of SLAs. Understanding of National Small Business Act, Service delivery innovation Programme and project management. Knowledge of SCM Framework and Risk Management. Service Delivery and innovation, Business performance management, Stakeholder relationship Management and Financial analytical skills. Knowledge of grievance and disciplinary procedures. Must have report writing, research, numerical and analytical, presentation, decision making and management skills. Excellent ability to facilitate workshops, give training and present policies. Ability to interact at strategic level and implement turn-around strategies. Must be service delivery orientated.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Supply Chain Management (Risk) at the Department of Roads and Transport in Johannesburg, requiring a National Diploma or Degree and 3-5 years' SCM experience.
jobs.duties: Develop, implement and maintain risk and performance management policies, standard operating procedures and ethical framework. Oversee the development, implementation and monitoring of risk management strategies. Ensure compliance with statutory regulations such as PFMA/Treasury regulations, B-BBEE Act) and performance assessment of the SCM value chain. Review supply chain management policies yearly and align new legislation and National/Provincial treasury regulations. Act as a focal point for internal and external audit requirements. Manage and undertake risk management assessments. Manage and undertake prevention of fraud and abuse of the SCM system interventions. Manage and undertake performance assessment of the SCM function. Manage the safeguarding of SCM information. Monitor and evaluate compliance with BBBEE, SMME, and reporting. Ensure that the performance meets the requirements as specified and design a monitoring system to be used for all contracts which were developed to regulate relationships during the life of the project. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Procurement and Asset management for the Sub directorate. Determine and analyse training and development needs for SCM staff. Address poor performance of any team member through the formal performance management process. Undertake Human Resource and other related administrative functions, establish, implement, maintain the efficient and effective communication arrangements and develop and manage the operational plan of the sub-directorate and report on progress as required. Develop, implement and maintain processes to ensure proper control of work, compile and submit all required administrative reports. and serve on transversal task teams as required.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Voorsieningskettingbestuur (RISK &
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Voorsieningskettingbestuur (Risiko) by die Departement van Roads and Transport in Johannesburg, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma of Graad en 3-5 jaar se SCM-ervaring vereis.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou risiko- en prestasiebestuursbeleid, standaardbedryfsprosedures en 'n etiese raamwerk. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van risikobestuurstrategieë. Verseker nakoming van statutêre regulasies soos PFMA/Teskasregulasies, B-BBEE-wet) en prestasieassessering van die SCM-waardeketting. Hersien voorsieningskettingbestuursbeleid jaarliks en belyn dit met nuwe wetgewing en Nasionale/Proviniale teskasregulasies. Tree op as spilpunt vir interne en eksterne ouditvereistes. Verseker dat die prestasie aan die gespesifiseerde vereistes voldoen en ontwerp 'n moniteringstelsel wat gebruik kan word vir alle kontrakte wat ontwikkel is om verhoudings gedurende die lewe van die projek te reguleer. Verskaf leierskap aan die komponent, bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes en ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die subdirektoraat en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis. zu.title: Isiphathihlalo: Ukuphathwa Kwesinqamulelo Sezimpahla (RISK &
zu.summary: Isiphathihlalo: Ukuphathwa Kwesinqamulelo Sezimpahla (Ingozi) e-Department of Roads and Transport e-Johannesburg, kudingeka i-National Diploma noma i-Degree kanye neminyaka eyi-3-5 yokuhlola ekuphathweni kwesinqamulelo sezimpahla.
zu.duties: Bumba, phumeza kwaye ugcine izinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nezokwenza, izinqubo eziyisisekelo zokusebenza nesisombululo sezenzo. Qaphisisa ukwakhiwa, ukuphathwa kanye nokubheka izindlela zokuphatha izingozi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho yesikhulu njenge-PFMA/Izimiso ze-Treasury, i-B-BBEE Act) kanye nenhlolokuhle yenani lesinqamulelo sezimpahla. Phinda ubheke izinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kwesinqamulelo sezimpahla nsuku zonke unyaka futhi zahambisane nomthetho omusha kanye nezimiso ze-National/Provincial treasury. Yiba yisiphinda sendlela ezidingweni zokuhlola ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Phatha futhi wenze ukuhlolwa kokuphathwa kwezingozi. Phatha futhi wenza ukuthintwa kokwenza amacala nokuzezelwa kwesistimu yokuphathwa kwesinqamulelo sezimpahla. Phatha futhi wenza inhlolokuhle yokwenza komsebenzi wokuphathwa kwesinqamulelo sezimpahla. Phatha ukugcinwa kolwazi lokuphathwa kwesinqamulelo sezimpahla. Bheka futhi hlola ukuthi kuhambisana ne-BBBEE, i-SMME, nokubika. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukwenza kuhambisana nezidingo ezichaziwe futhi umbele isistimu yokubheka ezosetshenziswa kuwo wonke amakontatho abhekwe ukulawula izimo phakathi kwempilo yeprojekthi. Lungiselela futhi uhlu i-BBBEE yezinkokhela nyanga zonke futhi unikeze izeluleko ngemiphumela yamaphrojekthi ezifundazwe. Nikeza ithuba lezincongo komzanyana, phatha ukwenza nentuthuko yabangaphansi futhi bumba futhi uphathe ihlelo lokusebenza komqondana ongaphansi kwesikhundla bese uthi ngokuthi kwenze kanjani njengoba kudingeka. Hlanganisa futhi uhlu wonke amabiko okuphatha abhekiwe. Ukuthenga nokuphathwa kwempahla komqondana ongaphansi kwesikhundla. Hlola futhi cicilisa izidingo zokuqeqesha nentuthuko abasebenzi bokuphathwa kwesinqamulelo sezimpahla. Ziba ukwenza kabi komunye nomunye ilungu leqembu ngokuqhubeka ngomumo wokuphatha ukwenza. Yenza Umsebenzi Wabantu kanye nalawo eminye imisebenzi yokuphatha, simise, phumeza futhi ugcine izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezingathathi kalula futhi bumba futhi uphathe ihlelo lokusebenza lomqondana ongaphansi kwesikhundla futhi ngenxa yokuthi kwenze kanjani njengoba kudingeka. Bumba, phumeza futhi ugcine izinqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawulwa okulungile kwemisebenzi, hlanganisa futhi uhlu wonke amabiko okuphatha abhekiwe. futhi ukhonze kumaqembu azenza emisebenzini njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Isezantsi se Director: Supply Chain Management (RISK &
xh.summary: Isezantsi se Director: Supply Chain Management (Risk) kwisebe i Department of Roads and Transport e Johannesburg, ifuna i National Diploma okanye Degree kunye neminyaka eliya kuthi kuba yi 3-5 yamava e SCM.
xh.requirements: Imfuno ye National Diploma okanye Degree kunye neminyaka eliya kuthi kuba yi 3-5 yamava e SCM.
xh.duties: Phatha, phumeza kwangaphambili kwaye ulondoloze iinqobo ezithintela ingozi nezemisebenzi, iinkqubo ezisebenzayo eziqhelekileyo kunye nolwalamkelo lwezomculo. Qondisa uphuhliso, ukuphunywa kwangaphambili nokulandelela iindlela ezithintela ingozi. Qinisekisa ukuvunywa kwezinyanzeleko zomthetho njenge PFMA/iinyanzeleko ze Treasury, B-BBEE Act) kunye nokuhlola imisebenzi ye nkqubo ye SCM. Phinda uhlole iinqobo ezithintela ingozi zemisebenzi ye SCM ngamnyaka kwaye ulungelelanise umthetho omtsha kunye nemiqathango ye Treasury yesizwe/ngephondo. Yiba nexesha elibekiweyo kwiimfuno zokuvelisa iinxelo zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Lawula kwaye wenze ukuvavanywa kolawulo lwengozi. Lawula kwaye wenze iindlela ezithintela ukurhweba ngokungalunganga nokusetyenziswa kakubi kwenkqubo ye SCM. Lawula kwaye wenze ukuhlola imisebenzi yomsebenzi we SCM. Lawula ukugcina ulwazi lwe SCM. Lalatha kwaye uvavanye ukuvunywa kwe BBBEE, SMME, kunye nokubika. Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi ihlangabezana neemfuno ezichaziweyo kwaye ulungise inkqubo yokulandelela eseza kusetyenziswa kuyo yonke iinkontrakazi ezazivelwe ukuze kulawulwe ubudlelwane ngexesha leprojekthi. Lungiselela iinxelo zentsengo ze BBBEE ngenyanga kwaye ucebise ngemiphumezo yemigangatho yephondo. Banika inkokhelo icandelo, lawula imisebenzi nophuhliso labo basezantsi kwaye uphuhle kwaye ulawule iplani yomsebenzi wesuba-irectorate kwaye ubike inkqondo njengoko kufuneka. Hlanganisa kwaye ugenise zonke iinxelo zolawulo ezifunekayo. Ukuthengwa kweempahla kunye noLawulo lwempahla we Sub directorate. Qinisekisa kwaye uhlola iimfuno zokuzilolonga nophuhliso kwabasebenzi be SCM. Jonga ngokuchanekileyo imisebenzi engalunganga yalipho na ilungu leqela ngenkqubo esemthethweni yolawulo lwemisebenzi. Yenza imisebenzi ye Human Resource nezinye iinkqubo zolawulu, mise, phumeza kwangaphambili, gcina ulwandelelwano olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo lokunxibelelwana kwaye uphuhle kwaye ulawule iplani yomsebenzi yesuba-irectorate kwaye ubike ngengqondo njengoko kufuneka. Phuhlisa, phumeza kwangaphambili kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo oluchanekileyo lomsebenzi, hlanganisa kwaye ugenise zonke iinxelo zolawulu ezifunekayo. kwaye ukhonze kwiqembu lemisebenzi ehamba phambili njengoko kufuneka.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Provincial Communication
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 - R2 124 237 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package).
jobs.summary: Deputy Director-general for Provincial Communication at the Office of the Premier in Johannesburg, requiring senior management experience and an NQF level 8 qualification.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 8 qualification in Communications, Public Relations, Media Studies, Public Administration or Journalism related field. An NQF Level 9 qualification (Master's degree) in the related field will be an added advantage. 8 years of experience at a senior managerial level with a strong background in Strategic communication management, Media relations, public participation and stakeholder engagement, Marketing and Branding, Reputation management, Government communication system, Communication, Public Relations and Media. Key Competencies Ability to provide strategic direction and leadership for provincial communication programmes. Capacity to align communication strategies with government priorities and service delivery objectives. Decision-making and problem-solving at executive level. Communication and Media Management. Development and implementation of integrated communication strategies. Media liaison and relationship management. Crisis communication and reputation management. Management of internal and external communication platforms. Stakeholder and Public Participation Management. Building and maintaining relationships with government departments, media, communities, civil society, and other stakeholders. Managing public engagement and citizen participation programmes. Facilitating intergovernmental communication and collaboration. Policy Development and Governance. Knowledge of government communication policies, legislation, and regulatory frameworks. Ability to develop, implement, and monitor communication policies and strategies. Ensuring compliance with Public Service and Government Communication and Information System (GCIS) requirements. Financial and Resource Management.
jobs.duties: A successful candidate will be required to perform the following duties: Provide strategic direction for Provincial Communication Services in alignment with provincial priorities. Lead the development and implementation of the Provincial Communication Policy Strategy. Monitor governance, accountability, and compliance with all relevant legislation and regulatory frameworks. Manage the coordination of communication across provincial departments and entities to ensure coherence and consistency. Align communication plans with Executive Council (EXCO), Cabinet Lekgotla and provincial programme priorities. Serve as provincial spokesperson when delegated. Lead the development and implementation of provincial communication frameworks aligned to government priorities. Manage communication activities across provincial departments to ensure uniformity, coherence and strategic alignment. Provide strategic direction in the development and implementation of an integrated provincial branding and marketing strategy aligned to government priorities. Oversee the performance, governance and integration of the Chief Directorates within the branch. Monitor effective communication planning, reporting and strategic advisory support to the Premier, DG and Executive. Provide strategic direction on provincial public relations activities and ensure consistent public messaging. Oversee media liaison services, including media enquiries, media statements, press briefing, crisis communication and social media. Provide strategic direction for the implementation and institutionalisation of the Ntirhisano Programme across all spheres of government. Oversee the coordination and integration of service delivery war rooms and outreach platforms to improve responsiveness to community needs. Manage the establishment and maintenance of effective feedback and communication mechanisms between government and communities. Manage the branch budget in compliance with PFMA and ensure efficient resource utilisation. Oversee governance, risk management and internal controls within the branch.

jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON
