af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-generaal vir Provinsiale Kommunikasie by die Kantoor van die Premier in Johannesburg, wat bestuurservaring op senior vlak en 'n NQF vlak 8-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n NQF vlak 8-kwalifikasie in Kommunikasie, Openbare Betrekkinge, Mediestudies, Openbare Administrasie of Joernalistiek-verwante terrein. 'n NQF vlak 9-kwalifikasie (Meestersgraad) in die verwante terrein sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 8 jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak met 'n sterk agtergrond in Strategiese kommunikasiebestuur, Mediaverhoudinge, openbare deelname en belanghebbendesbetrekking, Bemarking en Handelsmerkbestuur, Reputasiebestuur, Regeringskommunikasiestelsel, Kommunikasie, Openbare Betrekkinge en Media. Sleutelbevoegdhede Vermoë om strategiese rigting en leierskap vir provinsiale kommunikasieprogramme te bied. Vermoë om kommunikasie-strategieë met regeringsprioriteite en dienslewering doelwitte te belyn. Besluitneming en probleemoplossing op uitvoerende vlak. Kommunikasie en Mediabestuur. Ontwikkeling en implementering van geïntegreerde kommunikasie-strategieë. Mediakontak en verhoudingsbestuur. Krisiskommunikasie en reputasiebestuur. Bestuur van interne en eksterne kommunikasieplatforms. Belanghebbendes- en Openbare Deelnamebestuur. Bou en onderhou verhoudinge met regeringsdepartemente, media, gemeenskappe, burgerlike samelewing en ander belanghebbendes. Bestuur van openbare betrokkenheids- en burgerlike deelnameprogramme. Fasilitering van interregeringskommunikasie en samewerking. Beleidsontwikkeling en Goeweranse. Kennis van regeringskommunikasiebeleide, wetgewing en regulerende raamwerke. Vermoë om kommunikasiebeleide en -strategieë te ontwikkel, te implementeer en te monitor. Verseker van nakoming van Openbare Diens- en Regeringskommunikasie- en Inligtingstelsel (GCIS) vereistes. Finansiële en Hulpbronbestuur.
af.duties: 'n Suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om die volgende pligte uit te voer: Bied strategiese rigting vir Provinsiale Kommunikasiedienste in ooreenstemming met provinsiale prioriteite. Lei die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Provinsiale Kommunikasiebeleidstrategie. Monitor goeweranse, aanspreeklikheid en nakoming van alle relevante wetgewing en regulerende raamwerke. Bestuur die koördinering van kommunikasie oor provinsiale departemente en entiteite om samehang en konsekwentheid te verseker. Belyn kommunikasieplanne met Uitvoerende Raad (EXCO), Kabinet Lekgotla en provinsiale programprioriteite. Dien as provinsiale woordvoerder wanneer gedelegeer. Lei die ontwikkeling en implementering van provinsiale kommunikasieraamwerke in lyn met regeringsprioriteite. Bestuur kommunikasie-aktiwiteite oor provinsiale departemente om eenvormigheid, samehang en strategiese belyning te verseker. Bied strategiese rigting in die ontwikkeling en implementering van 'n geïntegreerde provinsiale handelsmerk- en bemarkingstrategie in lyn met regeringsprioriteite. Hou toesig oor die prestasie, goeweranse en integrasie van die Hoofdirektorate binne die tak. Monitor effektiewe kommunikasiebeplanning, verslagdoening en strategiese adviesondersteuning aan die Premier, DG en Uitvoerende Gesag. Bied strategiese rigting oor provinsiale openbare betrekkinge-aktiwiteite en verseker konsekwente openbare boodskappe. Hou toesig oor mediakontakdienste, insluitend medianavrae, mediaverklarings, persverklarings, krisiskommunikasie en sosiale media. Bied strategiese rigting vir die implementering en institusionalisering van die Ntirhisano-program oor alle sfere van regering. Hou toesig oor die koördinering en integrasie van dienslewering-oorlogs sale en uitreikplatforms om reaksie op gemeenskapsbehoeftes te verbeter. Bestuur die vestiging en instandhouding van effektiewe terugvoer- en kommunikasiemeganismes tussen regering en gemeenskappe. Bestuur die takbegroting in ooreenstemming met PFMA en verseker doeltroue hulpbrongebruik. Hou toesig oor goeweranse, risikobestuur en interne kontroles binne die tak.

zu.title: Isekela elikhulu elingu-Director-general: Ukuxhumana kwezifundazwe
zu.summary: Isekela elikhulu elingu-Director-general wokuXhumana kwezifundazwe eHhovisi leSikhulu saseJohannesburg, esidinga uholo lomphakathi emkhakheni wezokuphatha kanti futhi nethuba lokuba nethuba lokuba nguqeqesho ezingeni le-NQF level 8 ekuhlobene nokuxhumana emphakathini.
zu.requirements: Izidingo
zu.duties: Umkhethwa ophumelelayo uzoba nezidingo zokwenza imisebenzi elandelayo: Nikela umqondo ongqungqulu wokusebenza koluntu emikhakheni yasezifundazweni ngokuhambisana nezinhloso zezifundazwe. Hola ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yokuxhumana ezifundazweni. Qapha izimiso zokuphathwa, ukubhekelelana, nokuhambisana yonke imithetho ezikhulumiyo nezinhlelo zokulawula. Phatha ukuhlelwa kokuxhumana kuzo zonke izifundazwe eminyangweni nasemnyameni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nokungabuye kungafani. Hambisa izinhlela zokuxhumana ngokuvumelana ne-Executive Council (EXCO), i-Cabinet Lekgotla nezinhloso eziyinhloko zezifundazwe. Mela izifundazwe njengomulumeli uma unikwa amandla. Hola ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezifundazweni ngokuhambisana nezinhloso kahulumeni. Phatha imisebenzi yokuxhumana kuzo zonke izifundazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufana, ukuhambisana nokuhambisana ngokomqondo ongqungqulu. Nikela umqondo ongqungqulu ekuthuthukisweni nasekusetshenzisweni kwenqubomgomo ehlanganisiwe yokuzinza nokuqashwa ezifundazweni ehambisana nezinhloso kahulumeni. Bheka ukusebenza, izimiso zokuphathwa nokuhlanganiswa kweminyango ephakeme kwesikhungo. Qapha ukuhlelwa okusebenzayo kwezokuxhumana, ukubika nokwesekwa ngokomqondo ongqungqulu kuPremier, i-DG kanye ne-Executive. Nikela umqondo ongqungqulu emisebenzini yobudlelwano phakathi komphakathi ezifundazweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe imiyalezo ephilayo ethi yehlukahlukene kumonakalo emphakathini nangaphandle kwayo. Bheka izinkonzo zokuxhumana nezinkundla zokuxhumana zilandelana nemibuzo yezinkundla zokuxhumana ngokuzwakalisa imibhalo yezinkundla, ukubika kwezindaba eziphansi koxhumana ezinkundla zokubika ngesimo esibi emphakathini, kanye netheknoloji yezinkundla. Nikela umqondo ongqungqulu wokusetshenziswa nokwakhiwa kohlelo lweNtirhisano kuzo zonke izinkalo zohulumeni. Bheka ukuhlelwa nokuhlanganiswa kwezindlu zokulwa izinkinga ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zokuhamba zokwenza izinto eziyisikhathi esikhulu emiphakathini nangaphandle kwayo. Phatha ukwakhiwa nokugcinwa kwezindlela ezisebenzayo zokuthola umbiko kanye nendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kahulumeni kanye namaphakathi. Phatha imali yesabelo sesikhungo ngokuhambisana nePFMA futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo ngempumelelo. Bheka izimiso zokuphathwa, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nokulawula ngaphakathi kwesikhungo.

xh.title: Isekelwa nguNoMlawuli oMkhulu: oQamba amagama oLuntu
xh.summary: Isekela eliNqanaba leNdalo kumagunya eliNxulumene neNkundla kaSihlalo eThe kwisiGcawu sokuQeqesho iNqanaba leNqanaba elifuna amava amakhulu okulawula kwaye nelifuna izatifikati zomtsetho weNQF level 8.
xh.requirements: Isatifikati samatshadi eNQF level 8 kwindawo eThe kwilizwe elithetha ngokubeka iNdlela ekungalawulwa ngayo iinkonzo zamabandla amakhulu kwindawo yokuziphatha kwaye angagqiba kumagunya athile abe liNhloko yeNdawo ekuyo kwilizwe. Isatifikati seNQF Level 9 (iNqondo yeMfundo ephezulu) kwindawo ethile kuya kubakho iNzuzo ekhoyo. Iminyaka emi-8 yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lokulawula ngokusesikweni sokwazi ngokuyilwa iNdlela ekuthethwa ngayo, Ukuziphatha kwamaphanyisa kumagunya abantu, ukubandakanywa koluntu nokuzonxibelelana nabalawuli bamagunya, Uluntu nokubonwa kwakho, ukulawula iNkangeleko, iNkqubo yokwazisa ngokurhoxa koluntu, iNkqubo yokwazisa nokuqamba amagama akuzwakalise uluntu, Uluntu nakuziphatha kwamanqaku. IInkqubo ezibalulekileyo E mandla okunikela iNdlela ekuyiyo nolawulo kwiinkqubo zonke eziphathekayo.
xh.duties: Umsebenzi opumelelayo uya kufuneka enze e misebenzi elandelayo: Kubeka iNdlela yokuziphatha kwiinkonzo zoNyululo lweNkundla yoQeqesho ngokwamagunya emimandla. Ukulatha ukubakwa nokuqatywa kweNdlela yoluCandelo lokuQamba amagama woluntu kwesi Sebe. Ukuphangqelela ukuphathwa kwenkonzo, iNxaxheba nokuthobela kuwo onke amagunya omtsetho neengqangqhelana zomthetho. Ukulawula ukuqweba kweNdlela yokuziphatha kumasebe awo onke amagunya isigaba kwaye axelelana ngokwakha imigqa emide.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Provincial Forensic Audits
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 - R1 831 350 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Chief Director sought to manage forensic investigations and fraud prevention across Gauteng provincial departments, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF Level 7 qualification in the disciplines of Law (BA Law; B juris, BCom Law; BProc LLB) or Accounting, Finance, Forensic Auditing. An NQF Level 8 qualification in the related field will be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level and Seven (7) or more years of experience in the Forensic investigations or law enforcement specialising in commercial crimes. Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) qualification will be an added advantage. Good problem-solving, decision-making skills, computer literacy, communication skills, report writing kills, good inter-personal relations skills, planning, organising, analytical skills and project planning skills. Key Competencies: Proven ability to operationalise and ensure compliance with legislation and policy development. Demonstrable experience in forensic investigations and reporting. Knowledge and understanding of government priorities. Insight into Government’s Outcomes Based Approach, including performance monitoring and evaluation. Strategic leadership, change management and project management. Ability to communicate eloquently, compliance with the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and financial regulatory frameworks underpinning good governance in South Africa. Excellent co-ordination, communication, networking, negotiation, corporate governance and multi-tasking skills. Ability to work under pressure and willingness to work long and irregular hours. Strategically engage with Auditors and provide appropriate and timely responses to audit queries.
jobs.duties: Provide effective management and oversight into the implementation of fraud prevention in the GPG departments. Manage and oversee the implementation of all the forensic investigations and Provincial forensic investigation procurement in the GPG departments and entities. Review, manage, and provide oversight on the implementation of the Provincial Forensic Investigation Methodology and Standard Operating Procedures. Manage, review and maintain the Anti-Corruption strategy for all GPG departments. Provide leadership on the administration of NACH (National Anti-Corruption Hotlines) for all GPG departments. Develop written protocols and guidelines on forensic investigation methodology and ensure adherence of such guidelines and investigation reporting timelines. Review investigation reports and related documentation and provide assurance that the investigations conducted meet the required standards. Ensure that lessons learned from investigations are incorporated into the GPG policies and procedures and are shared widely within GPG. Support Public Service Commission (PSC) in developing and maintaining mechanism for reporting potential fraud and corruption, including hotline, and the necessary procedures to evaluate and investigate incoming reports of alleged fraud and corruption. Manage and provide comprehensive ICT analytical abilities in GPG database. Ensure development of work plans and the establishment of priorities for the Provincial Forensic Audit function. Supervise and monitor the work of investigative teams and of contracted specialists to ensure that outputs meet the required quality standards and are delivered according to schedule. Provide reports periodically in terms of the operational requirements in the department and including to oversight bodies such as Audit Committee. Build relationships with law enforcement bodies and ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations as appropriate and as required. Build relationship within GPG with all stakeholders and ensure that there is periodic stakeholder engagement and provisioning of support as it relates to forensic investigations undertaken. Conduct regular training to develop investigation capacity within Forensic Investigation unit. Manage the human and financial resource of the Chief Directorate. ENQUIRES : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted only online at www.gautengonline.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity documents and other supporting documents on or before the interview date, as directed by Human Resources. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attend a DPSA-prescribed SMS Competency Assessment if recommended by the Selection Committee following the interview process. Appointment to an SMS post is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Pre-Entry Programme (Certificate for Entry into the SMS) offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The successful candidate must provide proof of registration and successful completion of the programme prior to appointment. The cost of the programme is for the applicant's own account. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Provinciale Forensiese Oudits
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur gesoek om forensiese ondersoeke en bedrogvoorkoming oor Gauteng provinsiale departemente te bestuur, met 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en senior bestuurservaring as vereistes.
af.requirements: 'n NQF Vlak 7-kwalifikasie in die dissiplines van Regte (BA Regte; B juris, BCom Regte; BProc LLB) of Rekenkunde, Finansies, Forensiese Ouditering. 'n NQF Vlak 8-kwalifikasie in die verwante veld sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 5 jaar ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak en Sewe (7) of meer jaar ervaring in Forensiese ondersoeke of regstoepassing met spesialisasie in kommersiële misdade. 'n Gesertifiseerde Bedrogondersoeker (CFE)-kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goeie probleemoplossing, besluitnemingsvaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid, kommunikasievaardighede, verslagdoeningsvaardighede, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede, beplanning, organisering, analitiese vaardighede en projekbeplanningsvaardighede. Sleutelkompetensies: Bewese vermoë om wetgewing en beleidsontwikkeling te operasionaliseer en nakoming te verseker. Aantoonbare ervaring in forensiese ondersoeke en verslagdoening. Kennis en begrip van regeringsprioriteite. Insig in die Regering se Uitkomsgebaseerde Benadering, insluitend prestasie monitering en evaluering. Strategiese leierskap, veranderingsbestuur en projekbestuur. Vermoë om welsprekend te kommunikeer, nakoming van die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet (PFMA) en finansiële regulatoriese raamwerke wat goeie bestuur in South Africa onderlê. Uitstekende koördinasie-, kommunikasie-, netwerk-, onderhandelings-, korporatiewe bestuurs- en multitaakvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en bereidwilligheid om lang en onreëlmatige ure te werk. Strategies met Ouditeurs engageer en gepaste en tydige antwoorde op ouditnavrae verskaf.
af.duties: Verskaf doeltreffende bestuur en toesig oor die implementering van bedrogvoorkoming in die GPG-departeente. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die implementering van al die forensiese ondersoeke en Provinsiale forensiese ondersoekaankope in die GPG-departeente en entiteite. Hersien, bestuur en verskaf toesig oor die implementering van die Provinciale Forensiese Ondersoekmetodologie en Standaard Bedryfsprosedures. Bestuur, hersien en onderhou die Korruptebestrydingsstrategie vir alle GPG-departeente. Verskaf leierskap oor die administrasie van NACH (National Anti-Corruption Hotlines) vir alle GPG-departeente. Ontwikkel geskrewe protokolle en riglyne oor forensiese ondersoekmetodologie en verseker nakoming van sulke riglyne en ondersoekverslagdoeningstydlyne. Hersien ondersoekverslae en verwante dokumentasie en verskaf versekering dat die ondersoeke wat uitgevoer is aan die vereiste standaarde voldoen. Verseker dat lesse uit ondersoeke in die GPG-beleide en prosedures geïnkorporeer word en wyd binne GPG gedeel word. Ondersteun Public Service Commission (PSC) in die ontwikkeling en onderhoud van meganismes vir die rapportering van potensiële bedrog en korrupsie, insluitend 'n kellyn, en die nodige prosedures om inkomende verslae van beweerde bedrog en korrupsie te evalueer en te ondersoek. Bestuur en verskaf omvattende ICT-analitiese vermoëns in GPG-databasis. Verseker die ontwikkeling van werksplanne en die vestiging van prioriteite vir die Provinciale Forensiese Oudit-funksie. Suprerveer en monitor die werk van ondersoekspanne en gekontrakteerde spesialiste om te verseker dat uitsette aan die vereiste gehaltestandaarde voldoen en volgens skedule gelewer word. Verskaf periodiek verslae in terme van die operasionele vereistes in die departement en insluitend aan toesigliggame soos die Ouditkomitee. Bou verhoudings met regstoepassingsliggame en verseker behoorlike rapportering van oortredings of potensiële oortredies soos toepaslik en soos vereis. Bou verhoudings binne GPG met alle belanghebbendes en verseker dat daar periodieke belanghebbede-engagement is en verskaffing van ondersteuning soos dit verband hou met forensiese ondersoeke wat onderneem word. Voer gereelde opleiding uit om ondersoekkapasiteit binne die Forensiese Ondersoekeenheid te ontwikkel. Bestuur die menslike en finansiële hulpbronne van die Hoofdirektoraat. NAVRAE : Me Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

zu.title: Umqondisi Omkhulu: Ukuhlola Ukwebiwe Kwezifundazwe
zu.summary: Kufunwa uMqondisi Omkhulu ozoqondisa ukuphenya izindlela zokweba kanye nokuthintela ukweba kuyo yonke iminyango yesifundazwe se Gauteng, ofuna iziqu ezinga le-NQF 7 namava ohloleni abaphequluli abakhulu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF Level 7 kumkhakha wezomthetho (BA Law; B juris, BCom Law; BProc LLB) noma kwezokuAccounting, izimali, nokuHlola Ukwebiwe. Iziqu ezinga le-NQF Level 8 kwelinye ikheli elihlobene kuzobe kuyinzuzo. 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level and Seven (7) or more years of experience in the Forensic investigations or law enforcement specialising in commercial crimes. Iziqu zikaCertified Fraud Examiner (CFE) kuzobe kuyinzuzo ekhubekayo. Ubuchule obuhle bokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuthatha izinqumo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okubhala imibiko, ubuhle bokuziphathisa nabantu, ukweluleka, ukuhlela, amakhono okuhlola ukuqonda, namakhono okuhlela imiklamo yomsebenzi. Amakhono asemqoka: Amandla abonakalayo okusebenzisa futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela umthetho kanye nentuthuko yemigomo. Ulwazi olubonakalayo lokuphenya ukweba kanye nokubika. Ulwazi nokuqonda okuhlelekile kwemigidingo kahulumeni. Ukuqonda indlela yeHulumeni ebase emiphumeleni, okuhlanganisa nokugqapha kanye nokuhlola inkathi yemiklamo. Ukuba ngumholi ohlakaniphile, ukuphatha izinguquko kanye nokuphatha imiklamo yomsebenzi. Amandla okukhuluma kahle ngokwedlulele, ukuthobela uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA) nezinqubo ezilawula izimali ezenza ukuthi kuhleleke kahle kulawula ezweni iNingizimu Afrika. Amakhono amahle okuhlanganisa, okuxhumanakanya, okuxoxisana ngezimali, okulawula inkampani, kanye nokwenza imisebenzi eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Amandla okusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi kanye nesithakazelo sokusebenza amahora amade nangemahora angajwayelekile. Ukuba nokuqonda okuhlakaniphileko nabahloli kanye nokuphendula ngokuhambisana nesikhathi emibuzweni yokuhloleka.
zu.duties: Nikeza ulawulo olusebenzayo kanye nokuqapha ukusetshenziswa kolwazi lokuthintela ukweba kumnyango we GPG. Lawula futhi uqaphele ukusetshenziswa kwakho konke ukuphenya ukweba kanye nokuthenga ukuphenya ukweba kwesifundazwe kumnyango nasezinhlanganweni ze GPG. Phinda uhlole, ulawule, futhi uqaphe ukusetshenziswa kweNdlela Yokuphenya Ukweba Yesifundazwe kanye NabezokuSebenzela Ngokomthetho. Lawula, phinda uhlole futhi zigcine izindlela zokuthintela ukukhokha eminyangweni yonke ye GPG. Hola ngokuphathwa kweNACH (National Anti-Corruption Hotlines) emnyangweni yonke ye GPG. Bhalisa imilando nemihlahlandlela ngendlela yokuphenya ukweba futhi uqinisekise ukuthobela le migomo kanye nesikhathi sokubika ngokuphenya. Phinda uhlole imibiko yokuphenya kanye namafayela ahlobene nayo futhi unikeze isiqiniseko sokuthi ukuphenya okwenziwe kuhambisana nemigidingo edingekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi izifundo ezitholiwe ekuphenyeni zifakwa kumnyango we GPG emigomeni nasemikhakheni futhi zabelwe abantu bonke ku GPG. Sekela iPublic Service Commission (PSC) ekwakheni nasekugcineni isindlela sokuvela ngemininingwane ngokukhokha kanye nokukhohlakala, okuhlanganisa nomugqa wocingo, futhi nemiginingwane edingekayo ukuze kuhlolywe futhi kuphenywe imibiko engenayo ngokukhokha okungakaze futhi nokukhohlakala. Lawula futhi uhlinzeke ngamandla okuhlola ama-ICT ahleliwe kwidathabhezi ye GPG. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlela zomsebenzi kanye nokubekwa kwemigidingo yesikhundla sokuHlola Ukwebiwe kwezifundazwe. Qaphela futhi ulawule umsebenzi wamagqosha okuphenya nabaqeqeshi abathengiswayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uphelela kumazinga edingekayo futhi uhanjiswa ngokomugidingo. Akho imibiko ngokuvamile ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi kumnyango kanye nakuwo amalunga okuhlola njengoAudit Committee. Yakha ubudlelwano namalunga okuphenwa komthetho futhi uqinisekise ukubika okuhle ngokwephula umthetho noma okungase kuphulwe lapho kufanele futhi lapho kudingeka. Yakha ubudlelwano ngaphakathi kwe GPG namalunga onke futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kunokuxhumana okuvamile nalabo abakhiqizi kwaye ukubasiza ngokuphenya ukweba okwenziwayo. Yenza ukugqiliza njalo ukukhulisa amandla okuphenya ngaphakathi kweqembu lokuphenya. Lawula izinsizakusebenza zabantu kwezimali zesikhundla sikaMqondisi Omkhulu. IMIBUZO : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

xh.title: Um lawuli Ohamba: Uphononongo lweZophondo eziNgabomvu
xh.summary: Kufunekwa um lawuli ohamba ukuze alawule iindwendwe zophando nokuthintela inkohlakalo kumasebe onke apho eGauteng, kufuneka anemfundo ye NQF 7 naloo nqanaba eliphezulu lobugcisa bolawulo.
xh.requirements: Kufunekwa ifom yemfundo ye NQF Level 7 kwizifundo ezinjengomthetho (BA Law; B juris, BCom Law; BProc LLB) okanye iAccounting, iFinance, okanye uphononongo lwezohlwayo ezingabomvu. Ifom yemfundo ye NQF Level 8 kwelinye icandya elithinteyo iya kuba yinzuzo. Kufunekne minyaka emi-5 yamava angowona ngaphakathi kwekhondo elinzima ngokwabantu abaphatha iindwendwe zenkunkuma nokukhohlakala. Isiqu sokuba sisityhiliwe sokukhohlisa (CFE) iya kuba luncedo elibi. Kufunekne ubuncwadi bekhompyutha, iimpawu zokwahlulela, iimpawu zokuzithandela, ukulungiselela nokuqamba kwezicwangciso, kunye nokuqonda ngokugcina iinkcukacha ezinkulu. Izakhono eziyiyo: Ukuze azise kwakhona usetyenziso lwezomthetho nemigaqo ekuwohlokwako, angagqithiswa kokulawula iindwendwe.
xh.duties: Kufuneka athethe ngokwenza ngokuyisiseko imisebenzi eqingqelayo kulwabiwo lululo kwaye ngokomthetho kubekho iinkxibelelwano ezahlukeneyo ezinqamlezileyo ukulandelela ukuphumeza imisimbamthetho kwiNdlu yowiso-mthetho. Kwaye ngexesha elifanayo kubekho isicwangciso ngokumayelana neenkxalabo ezikhethekileyo ezingavela ngokulandela imigaqo ekwiNdlu yowiso-mthetho, kwaye ngaphandle koko kungabikho njani ukuba isicwangciso simememene ngokususa ingcangcazelo nangokuqhawukela imingeni eqingqelayo ethathwa kwindlu yowiso-mthetho ngexesha elifanelekileyo elijoliswe kulo lonke uRhulumente waseGauteng.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Administrative and Secretariat Support
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 – R1 831 350 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Lead administrative and secretariat support services for the Gauteng Executive Council, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Public Administration, Public Management, Public Policy, Corporate Governance, or related field. A postgraduate qualification (NQF Level 8) in the related field will be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level. Extensive experience in Secretariat and governance support services, Executive support to the Gauteng Executive Council, Heads of Departments and executive decision- making structures, administrative management and coordination of governance processes. Key Competencies: The successful candidate must demonstrate strategic leadership, governance and secretariat management, stakeholder and intergovernmental relations, policy development, programme coordination, and financial and people management capabilities. Extensive knowledge of the RSA Constitution of 1996, Public Service Act and Regulations, PFMA, PAIA, POPIA, PAJA, National Archives and Records Service Act, and other relevant governance frameworks. A sound understanding of the Gauteng Provincial Government environment, departmental mandates, business processes, strategic priorities, and governance structures is essential. Strong analytical, communication, report- writing, negotiation, decision-making, monitoring and evaluation, and compliance management skills are required.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and oversight of Executive Council governance, administrative and secretariat support services to ensure the effective functioning of the Executive Council, Heads of Department forums and related governance structures. Coordinate and manage the Executive Council Programme, including the planning and administration of Executive Council meetings, Sub- Committees, the Premier's Coordinating Forum, Head of Department Forum, Makgotla and other intergovernmental structures. Oversee the content design preparation, quality assurance, management and distribution of agendas, cabinet submissions, resolutions, minutes and related governance documentation, ensure compliance with legislative, policy and information security requirements. Manage the implementation and continuous improvement of the e-Cabinet system, EXCO records management processes and decision-tracking mechanisms to support accountability and monitoring of Executive Council resolutions. Provide integrated administrative, logistical, protocol and executive support services for high-level governance forums and meetings. Facilitate collaboration and stakeholder engagement across provincial, local and national government spheres to strengthen policy coordination and service delivery. Oversee the monitoring and reporting of the implementation of Executive Council decisions and programmes. Effectively manage financial, human, assets, information and operational resources of the Chief Directorate to promote excellent service delivery. ENQUIRES : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted only online at www.gautengonline.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity documents and other supporting documents on or before the interview date, as directed by Human Resources. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attend a DPSA-prescribed SMS Competency Assessment if recommended by the Selection Committee following the interview process. Appointment to an SMS post is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Pre-Entry Programme (Certificate for Entry into the SMS) offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The successful candidate must provide proof of registration and successful completion of the programme prior to appointment. The cost of the programme is for the applicant's own account. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Administratiewe en Sekretariatsondersteuning
af.summary: Lei administratiewe en sekretariatsondersteuningsdienste vir die Gauteng Uitvoerende Raad, met 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Openbare Administrasie, Openbare Bestuur, Openbare Beleid, Korporatiewe Bestuur, of verwante veld. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 8) in die verwante veld sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. Uitgebreide ervaring in sekretariats- en bestuursondersteuningsdienste, uitvoerende ondersteuning aan die Gauteng Uitvoerende Raad, Hoofde van Departemente en uitvoerende besluitnemingsstrukture, administratiewe bestuur en koördinering van bestuursprosesse. Sleutelbevoegdhede: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet strategiese leierskap, bestuurs- en sekretariatsbestuur, belanghebbende- en intergoermentele verhoudings, beleidsontwikkeling, programkoördinering, en finansiële en personeelsbestuursvermoëns toon. Uitgebreide kennis van die RSA Grondwet van 1996, Openbare Dienswet en Regulasies, PFMA, PAIA, POPIA, PAJA, Nasionale Argief- en Rekorddienswet, en ander relevante bestuursraamwerke. 'n Deeglike begrip van die Gauteng Provinciale Regering-omgewing, departementele mandate, besigheidsprosesse, strategiese prioriteite en bestuursstrukture is noodsaaklik. Sterke analitiese, kommunikasie, verslagskryf-, onderhandelings-, besluitnemings-, moniterings- en evaluerings- en nakomingsbestuursvaardighede word vereis.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en toesig oor Uitvoerende Raad-besture, administratiewe en sekretariatsondersteuningsdienste om die effektiewe funksionering van die Uitvoerende Raad, Hoofde van Departement-forums en verwante bestuursstrukture te verseker. Koördineer en bestuur die Uitvoerende Raad-program, insluitend die beplanning en administrasie van Uitvoerende Raad-vergaderings, subkomitees, die Premier se Koördineringsforum, Hoof van Departement-forum, Makgotla en ander intergoermentele strukture. Hou toesig oor die inhoudontwerp-voorbereiding, gehaltversekering, bestuur en verspreiding van agendapunte, kabinetsvoorleggings, besluite, notules en verwante bestuursdokumentasie, verseker nakoming van wetgewende, beleids- en inligtingsekuriteitsvereistes. Bestuur die implementering en deurlopende verbetering van die e-Kabinet-stelsel, EXCO-rekordbestuursprosesse en besluitopvolgingsmeganismes om verantwoordelikheid en monitering van Uitvoerende Raad-besluite te ondersteun. Verskaf geïntegreerde administratiewe, logistieke, protokol- en uitvoerende ondersteuningsdienste vir hoëvlak-bestuursforums en vergaderings. Fasiliteer samewerking en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid oor provinsiale, plaaslike en nasionale regeringssfeer om beleidskoördinering en dienslewering te versterk. Hou toesig oor die monitering en verslagdoening van die implementering van Uitvoerende Raad-besluite en programme. Bestuur finansiële, menslike, bates-, inligtings- en operasionele hulpbronne van die Hoofdirektoraat effektief om uitstekende dienslewering te bevorder. NAVRAE : Me Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu: Ukwesekwa Kokuphathwa kwezindaba kanye Nezinsiza Zokubhala
zu.summary: Hola imisebenzi yokwesekwa kokuphathwa kwezindaba kanye nezinsiza zokubhala kuGauteng Executive Council, okudinga izifundo ze-NQF 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yeminyaka yokuqashwa esimweni esiphezulu sokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zazinga le-NQF 7 ezimeni ze-Public Administration, Public Management, Public Policy, Corporate Governance, noma esikhundleni ohlobene naso. Ithi iziqu zesiqu esiphezulu (NQF Level 8) esikhundleni ohlobene naso zibe yinenzuzo eyenezela. Uneminyaka engu-5 yeminyaka yokuqashwa esimweni esiphezulu sokuphatha. Okuhle kwezinsiza zokubhala kanye nokwesekwa kokuphathwa kwezindaba, ukwesekwa abaphathi kuGauteng Executive Council, izikhulu zeminyango kanye nezakhiwo ezenza izinqumo zabaphathi, ukuphathwa kwezindaba zokuphatha kanye nokuhlelwa kwezakhiwo zokuqondisa izinqumo. Amandla abalulekile: Kufanele ofakwe emsebenzini abonise ukuba uyinhloko ehlela amandla, ukuphathwa kwezindaba nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zokubhala, ubudlelwano nabaphathiswa kanye nabahulumeni abavela kuminyango eyahlukene, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqumo, ukuhlelwa kohlelo, kanye namandla okuphatha imali kanye nabantu. Kuqakuliswe kakhulu ulwazi lwe-RSA Constitution of 1996, Public Service Act and Regulations, PFMA, PAIA, POPIA, PAJA, National Archives and Records Service Act, kanye nezinye izakhiwo ezihlobene nezinqumo zokuphatha. Kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle isimo kahulumeni wesifundazwe iGauteng, imithetho yeminyango, izinqubo zebhizinisi, izinhloso ezibalulekile eziyingqayizivele, nezakhiwo zokuphatha. Kudingeka ube namandla okuhlaziya, okukhuluma, okubhala imibiko, okuxoxa, okwenza izinqumo, okuhlola kanye nokuhlolisisa, nokuphatha ukuziphendulela.
zu.duties: Nikeza amandla okuhlela nokuhlola ukuqondiswa kwemisebenzi ye-Executive Council, ukuphathwa kwezindaba kanye nezinsiza zokubhala ukuze kuqiniseke ukusebenza kahle kwe-Executive Council, izikhungo zabaHoli wezemiNyangO namanye amasakhiwo ohlelokusebenza ahlobene nokuqondiswa. Hlela futhi uphathe uhlelo lwe-Executive Council, okuhlanganisa ukucubungula kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkulumo ze-Executive Council, ama-Sub-Committees, i-Premier's Coordinating Forum, i-Head of Department Forum, ama-Makgotla kanye namanye amasakhiwo ahlobene namahulumeni ahlukene. Qapha ukuklanywa kokuqulunqwa kokuqukethwe, ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, ukuphathwa kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi, izincomo zekhabhinethi, izinqumo, amaminithi kanye namadokhumenti ahlobene nokuqondiswa, qinisekisa ukuziphendulela kumthetho, emaqembu nezidingo zokuphepha kolwazi. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kwesistimu ye-e-Cabinet, izinqubo zokuphatha amarekhodi e-EXCO kanye nezindlela zokuqapha izinqumo ukuze kusekelwe ukuziphendulela kanye nokuqapha izinqumo ze-Executive Council. Nikeza izinsiza eziyinhloko zokuphatha izindaba, ezezokuhamba, ezenkambiso kanye nokwesekwa abaphathi ngesikhathi sezinkulumo namasakhiwo amangamgunyathi eholo. Siza ekubambisweni kanye nokuxhumana nabaphathiswa emazingeni wesifundazwe, wedolobha nankuzondo ukuze kuqiniswe ukuhlelwa kolwazi kanye nokulethwa kwezinsiza. Qapha ukuqapha kanye nokubika ngokuqaliswa kwezinqumo kanye nezinhlelo ze-Executive Council. Phatha ngempumelelo imali, abantu, izimpahla, ulwazi kanye nezinsiza ezisetshenziswayo zeChief Directorate ukuze kukhuthazwe ukulethwa kwezinsiza ezinhle kakhulu. IZIBUZO : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

xh.title: Um lawuli Omkhulu: Inkxaso yeBhaliso kunye neSeketeriyate
xh.summary: Ukuhola iinkonzo zeenkxaso zebhaliso kunye neseketeriyate zeGauteng Executive Council, kufuneka kubekho isiqu se-NQF 7 kunye neminye emi-5 yamava ohlolwa phantsi kwabaphathi abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: Isiqu esinengowesibini (NQF level 7) kwiNqanaba 7 kwiluntuPhethulwazi, iNtengiso yaluntu, iNkqubo yeLuntu, iNkqubo yekampani, okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Isiqu sokugqibela (NQF Level 8) kwinkqubo enxulumene nako kuya kuba nenzuzo eyongezelelekileyo. 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level. Amaxa amaninzi kwiinkonzo zolawulo lweseketeriyate nokuxhaswa kukarhulumente, ukuxhaswa kwabaphathi kwiGauteng Executive Council, iiNtloko zeeSebe kunye neendawo zonxibelelwano zokwenza izigqibo zabaphathi, ulawulo lwebhaliso ukuze kuhambelane neenkqubo zolawulo. Iikhompetensi eziyimpilo: Umntu ofunyenweyo kufuneka abonise ukuba ngumlawuli ophilisa iimbono, ulawulo lukaRhulumente kunye neseke teriyate, ukuvelwana noorhulumente kwindawo ezahlukene, uluntu kunye norhulumente, uphuhlisoweenkqubo, ukuqwalaselwa kweenkqubo, kunye nemali elawulwayo nemisebenzi yabantu. Ulwazi oluqinisekileyo lweRSA Constitution of 1996, Public Service Act and Regulations, PFMA, PAIA, POPIA, PAJA, National Archives and Records Service Act, nezinye iindlela zolawulo ezinxulumene nayo. Kuqakathekile ukuqonda kakuhle imeko yakuRhulumente wePhondo iGauteng, imigomiso yesebe, iinkqubo zeshishini, izinto ezibalulekileyo ngakumbi, kunye neendawo zolawulo. Kufunekile ukuba nakhili ezomeleleyo zokwazisa iingxaki ezininzi, ukunxibelelana nabantu, ukubhala iingxelo, ukuqhaqha, ukwenza izigqibo, ulawulo lokuhlolwa nokuhlonipha iindlela ezinyulweyo.
xh.duties: Nikeza inkokheli eqhagamshelana namameko agqithisweyo kwiNkqubo yolawulo kwiGauteng Executive Council, ulawulo lwebhaliso nokuxhaswa kwabaphathi kwindawo yokubhalisa ukugcinwa kwenkqubo kaGauteng Executive Council, iiNtloko zeeSebe kunye nendawo ethile yokulawula. Linganisela ulawulo lwenkqubo kaGauteng Executive Council, kuqala ukuqamba nokulawula iindibano zikaGauteng Executive Council, iiKomiti ezingaphantsi, Premier's Coordinating Forum, Head of Department Forum, Makgotla nezinye iindawo zoluntu ezilawulwayo. Qwalasela ukulungiselelwa, ulawulo lwemigaqo, ukunyanzeliswa kolawulo nolunikezelwa iinkqubo zamagqabhiso, izaziso ezithunyelwa kuGqhumayele, iinkqubo eziskeniweyo, amaminithi nezinye iinkqubo ezinxulumene nolawulo, kuqinisekiswa uhlobo lolawulo maluqwalaselwe ngokomthetho, iinkqubo nolondolozo lolwazi. Lawula ukusebenza nokuphuculwa ngokuhlala kwesixokelelwano se-e-Cabinet, iinkqubo zokuqulunqa iingxelo zikaEXCO nokuqwalasela iinkqubo ezilandela izigqibo ukuxhasa ukubekwa iindibaniselwa nokulandelela iinkqubo zikaGauteng Executive Council. Nikeza iinkonzo ezibhaliweyo, zokuhamba nenyani, ezomthetho nentloni ekuxhasweni kwabaphathi kwizindonga ezibalulekileyo zolawulo naseendibweni. Qhagamshela uluntu lonke, urhulumente, norhulumente ongemva kwamaportifikheysi ukugcina iinkqubo zizonke ngokomthetho nokwenziwa kwemigwebo. Qwalasela ukulawulwa kokubhaliswa kweenkqubo nokuqulunqa iingxelo ezifana noRhulumente weGauteng Executive Council. Lawula iindleko, abantu, izixhobo, ulwazi kunye namacebo okusebenzela aNkulumba lawulo ukuze kuqhubekiswe phambili iinkonzo ezisebenzayo. ENQUIRES : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

jobs.title: Chief Director: Transformation Programmes
jobs.summary: Chief Director needed in Johannesburg to lead transformation programmes covering gender equality, youth development, disability inclusion and diversity management.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Public Administration, Public Management, Social Sciences, Human Resource Management, Development Studies and any related fields. An NQF level 8 qualification in the related fields would be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level in organisational transformation programmes, employment equity, diversity management, organisational culture change, gender and disability mainstreaming, and broader transformation matters. Key Competencies: Demonstrable strategic capability and leadership, with proven experience in programme and project management, organisational transformation, organisational development, and change management. Strong policy development, analysis and implementation skills, as well as the ability to build and maintain effective stakeholder relationships and manage intergovernmental relations. Sound research, monitoring and evaluation capabilities, coupled with financial management and governance expertise. Exceptional people management and empowerment skills, strong problem- solving and analytical abilities, and excellent communication, report-writing and presentation skills are essential for success in this role.

Drive the mainstreaming of transformation priorities across Gauteng Provincial Government’s provincial plans, policies, programmes, budgets and service delivery initiatives. Lead research, policy development, advocacy and public awareness programmes, including awareness campaigns and commemorative days and month celebrations, to promote social inclusion, human rights and equitable access to opportunities. Foster and strengthen intergovernmental relations, stakeholder collaboration and strategic partnerships to advance provincial transformation objectives. Oversee the institutionalisation of systems, frameworks and governance mechanisms that support transformation and inclusion, and ensure the effective implementation, monitoring and evaluation of provincial priorities, including the Provincial Gender-Based Violence Action Plan and other initiatives supporting vulnerable and designated groups. Manage the human, financial and operational resources of the Chief Directorate to ensure effective governance, compliance, performance management and the achievement of strategic objectives. af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Transformasieprogramme
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur word in Johannesburg benodig om transformasieprogramme te lei wat geslagsgelykheid, jeugontwikkeling, die insluiting van persone met gestremdhede en diversiteitsbestuur dek.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Openbare Administrasie, Openbare Bestuur, Sosiale Wetenskappe, Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Ontwikkelingsstudies en enige verwante velde. 'n NQF-vlak 8-kwalifikasie in die verwante velde sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak in organisatoriese transformasieprogramme, indiensnemingsgelykheid, diversiteitsbestuur, organisatoriese kultuurverandering, die hoofstroommaking van geslags- en gestremdheidsake, en breër transformasie-aangeleenthede. Sleutelbevoegdhede: Aantoonbare strategiese vermoë en leierskap, met bewese ervaring in program- en projekbestuur, organisatoriese transformasie, organisatoriese ontwikkeling en veranderingbestuur. Sterke beleidsontwikkeling, analise- en implementeringsvaardighede, asook die vermoë om effektiewe belanghebbende verhoudings op te bou en te handhaaf en intergovernmentele betrekkinge te bestuur. Deeglike navorsings-, moniterings- en evalueringvermoëns, tesame met finansiële bestuurs- en goeder Troue kundigheid. Uitsonderlike mensebestuurs- en bemagtigingsvaardighede, sterk probleemoplossings- en analitiese vermoëns, en uitstekende kommunikasie-, verslagskryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede is noodsaaklik vir sukses in hierdie pos.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en toesig vir die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van transformasieprogramme wat gemik is op die bevordering van geslagsgelykheid, vrouwenbemagtiging, jeugontwikkeling, die insluiting en bestuur van persone met gestremdhede, die regte van ouer persone, die LGBTQIA+ gemeenskap en militêre veterane. Dryf die hoofstroommaking van transformasieprioriteite oor Gauteng Provincial Government se provinsiale planne, beleide, programme, begrotings en dienslewering inisiatiewe. Lei navorsing, beleidsontwikkeling, voorligting en openbare bewusmakingsprogramme, insluitend bewusmakingsveldtogte en herdenkingsdae en maandvierings, om sosiale insluiting, menseregte en billike toegang tot geleenthede te bevorder. Bevorder en versterk intergovernmentele betrekkinge, belanghebbende samewerking en strategiese vennootskappe om provinsiale transformasiedoelwitte te bevorder. Hou toesig oor die institusionalisering van stelsels, raamwerke en goederneermeganismes wat transformasie en insluiting ondersteun, en verseker die effektiewe implementering, monitering en evaluering van provinsiale prioriteite, insluitend die Provincial Gender-Based Violence Action Plan en ander inisiatiewe wat kwesbare en aangewese groepe ondersteun. Bestuur die menslike, finansiële en operasionele hulpbronne van die Hoofdirektoraat om effektiewe beheer, nakoming, prestasiebestuur en die bereiking van strategiese doelwitte te verseker. NAVRAE : Me Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

zu.title: Umongameli Oyinhloko: Izinhlelo Zokushintshintisa
zu.summary: Kudingeka umongameli oyinhloko eJohannesburg ukuba ahole izinhlelo zokushintshintisa ezibhekise kulingana kobulili, intuthuko yabantu abasha, ukubandakanya abantu abakhubazekile kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zobuNQF izinga 7 ekuPhathweni kwezimpilo zabantu, ekuPhathweni kwezentengiselwano, ezifundweni zomphakathi, ekuPhathweni kwabasebenzi, izifundo zentuthuko nakwezinye izinkambu ezihlobene. Iziqu zobuNQF izinga 8 kulezi zinkambu ezihlobene zibe ngaphezulu. 5 unyaka wamava emazinga aphakeme okuphatha kuzinhlelo zokushintshintisa kumkhakha wezinhlangano, ukulingana kwabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo, ushintsho lwenhlalo yomkhakha wezinhlangano, ukuzivumelanisa kobulili nokuvala abakhubazekile, kanye nezinye izindaba ezingasese zokushintshintisa. Ikhono eliyisisekelo: Ukuba khona kwamakhono ayingqikithi okuhola, ngamava obonakalayo ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo namaprojekthi, ekushintshisweni kwezinhlangano, entuthukweni yezinhlangano, nakoshintsho ekuphathweni. Amakhono amakhulu ekuthuthukiseni, ukuhlaziya nokuphatha inqubomgomo, kanye namandla okwakha kanye nokugcina ubudlelwane obuhle nabahlanganyeli kanye nokuphatha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhulumnyango. Amakhono okucwaninga, okulawula nokuhlaziya ahle, ngamava obhekene nezenzo zomzimba nentengo kanye nolawulo. Amandla aphezulu okuphatha abantu nokubanika amandla, amandla okulawula inkinga nokuhlaziya, namakhono aphezulu okuxhumana, ukubhala ngemibiko nokuhamba nezethula ayimfuneko ukuze uphumelele kulesi sikhundla.
zu.duties: Nika isibusiso sohlu oluyingqikithi nokugadza ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuhlaziywa kwezinhlelo zokushintshintisa ezinganikezela isikhokelo ekuthuthukisweni kulingana kobulili, ukunika amandla abesimame, intuthuko yabantu abasha, ukubandakanya nokuphathwa kwabakhubazekile, amalungelo abadala, abantu bendawo yama-LGBTQIA+ kanye namajoni. Hola intuthuko yezinhlelo zokushintshintisa kuzo zonke izinhlelo, inqubomgomo, amahlelo, amabhajethi namasu okuletha izinsiza kuhulumbe waseGauteng. Hola ucwaningo, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, ukukhuthaza nokwazisa umphakathi, okuhlanganisa ukwaziswa kamasu nokugubha izinsuku kanye nenyanga ezithile, ukukhuthaza ukubandakanywa komphakathi, amalungelo abantu kanye nokungena ngokulingana kwamathuba. Khuthaza futhi uqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhulumnyango, ukusebenzisana nabahlanganyeli kanye nobudlelwane obuyisibusiso ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhloso zikahulumbe waseGauteng. Qaphela ukwakheka kwezinsiza, uhlaka lwezinhlelo kanye namasu okulawula okusekela ukushintshintisa kanye nokubandakanya abantu, futhi uqinise ukusetshenziswa, ukulawula nokuhlaziya kwezinhloso zikahulumbe, okuhlanganisa uhlelo lokusebenza ngokwenqubo yesikhala sabesimama nokuhlaselwa kwamalungelo abesimama namanye amahlelo okusekela abantu abasengozini nalabo abakhethwe. Phatha izinsiza zabantu, izimali kanye nezinsiza zokusebenza kulesi hhovisi ukugqize ukulawula okuhle, ukuhambisana nomthetho, ukuphatha ukusebenza kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezinhloso ezibalulekile. IMIBUZO : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

xh.title: Um lawuli oMkhulu: Iinkqubo zoGuqulo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa uMlawuli oMkhulu e Johannesburg ukuba ale iinkqubo zoguqulo ezibandakanya ulinganisela ngokwesini, ukuphuhliswa kwabasha, ukuqatshelwa kwabo bakhubazekileyo nolawulo lwezabantu ezahlukeneyo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-NQF level 7 kwi-Nqaku lokuLawula kuZwizwe, ukuLawulwa kweZentlalo, iNzululwazi yoLuntu, ukuLawulwa kweZemisebenzi yabantu, ukuFunda ngokuPhuhliswa nalo nasiphi na isimemo esinxulumeneyo. Isidanga se-NQF level 8 kumanqaku anxulumene nako kuya kuba lusizo. Iminyaka yamava eyi-5 kwinqanaba eliphezulu lokuLawula kwiinkqubo zoguqulo leshishini, ulinganisela kwimisebenzi, ulawulo lwezabantu ezahlukeneyo, ukutshintshwa kwamasiko leshishini, ukuqatshelwa kolwabiwo-mali ngeentesini, nokuqatshelwa kokukhubazeka, nayo yonke imiba engoguqulo. Amandla aPhambili: Amandla obungcali obu bonakaliseko bokukwazi ukulawula nokuqaqambisa, namava abonwayo ekulawuleni nasekwenzeni iinkqubo, ekuguquleni ishishini, ekuphuhlisweni koshishino, nakulawulweni lotshintsho. Amandla amakhulu ekwenzeni, ukuhlalutya nokuzeke iinkqubo zentsika, kunye nolonwabo lokwakha nalokugcina ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nabathathi-nxaxheba nolawulo lobudlelwane phakathi karhulumente. Amandla aphezulu ekuphonononga, ekulawuleni nokuqwalasela, axhaswe ngamandla ekulawulweni kwemali nolawulo olulungelelanisiweyo. Amandla aphezulu ekulawuleni abantu nakubakhupha amandla, amandla amakhulu ekusombululeni iingxaki nokuqamba izisombululo, namandla aphezulu ekunxibelelwani, ekubhalweni kwemibiko nakubungcali bokuzibonakalisa ayimfuno kuphumelelo kwesi sithuba.
xh.duties: Nika inkokheli eqondileyo nolawulo ekwenzeni, ekuzeke nasekuqwalaselweni kweinkqubo zoguqulo ezijolise ekuphuhlisweni kolinganisela ngokwesini, ukukhuthaza amandla kwabafazi, ukuphuhliswa kwabasha, ukuqatshelwa nokulawulwa kokukhubazeka, amalungelo abantu abadala, uluntu lwe-LGBTQIA+ namajoni. Qhubela phambili ukuqatshelwa kwezinto ezibalulekileyo zoguqulo kuwo onke amacebo, iinkqubo neenkqubo, amabhajeti nokuqaliswa kokuqokelelwa koluntu kurhulumente we-Gauteng Provincial Government. Yiba ngowokuqala ekuphononongeni, ekuzeni iinkqubo, ekukhuthazeni nakumacebo oqondo-mthetho koluntu, kuquka iinkqubo zokuvakalisa nemihibi yokugqamisa ukubhiyozelwa iintsuku ngeyam ngenyanga, ukukhuthaza ukuqatshelwa koluntu, amalungelo abantu nolufikelelo olulinganiselayo kwamathuba. Khuthaza uze qinise ubudlelwano phakathi karhulumente, ukusebenzisana nabathathi-nxaxheba namanqanqamathu eziqondiso ukuqhubela phambili iinjongo zoguqulo kwiphondo. Lawula ukufakwa kweenkqubo, iinkqubo nendlela zolawulo ezixhasa ukuguqulwa nokuqatshelwa, aze waqinisekisa ukuzekeka okusebenzayo, ukulawula nokuqwalasela kwezinto ezibalulekileyo kwiphondo, kuquka iNkqubo yoNyuso lwe-Provincial Gender-Based Violence Action Plan namanye amacebo axhasa amaqela abathathu-nxaxheba abasengozini nabalawuliweyo. Lawula iziseko zomntu, zemali nolawulo kwiNqanaba loMlawuli oMkhulu ukuze waqinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo, ukuhambelana neenkqubo, ukulawula inkqubo yemveliso nokuzekeka kweenjongo ezibalulekileyo. IMIBUZO : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

jobs.title: Director: Leader of Government Business and Governance
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Director role in the Office of the Premier providing strategic support to the Leader of Government Business and coordinating governance across the Gauteng Provincial Legislature.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Social Sciences. An Honours Degree in Social Sciences or LLB Degree would be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Extensive experience in Governance and administration. Strategic planning and performance management. Government coordination and stakeholder relations. Policy development and implementation. Monitoring and evaluation. Executive support and parliamentary/legislative liaison processes. Key Competencies: Strategic leadership and management; governance and compliance management; strategic planning, monitoring and performance management; policy analysis and development; stakeholder and intergovernmental relations management; project and programme management; financial and resource management; excellent communication and report-writing skills; problem-solving and decision-making; and people management and empowerment.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic and technical support to the Leader of Government Business (LGB) in coordinating government business in the Gauteng Provincial Legislature and Gauteng Provincial Government (GPG). Provide support to National Council of Provinces (NCOP). Advise the Executive Council and LGB on legislative, governance, policy, and parliamentary matters. Coordinate, monitor, and manage the implications of Legislature questions, resolutions, petitions to the GPG, ensuring effective feedback and accountability mechanisms. Conduct policy analysis and research on Executive Council memoranda and provide strategic advice on matters tabled before Executive Council. Synthesize and track Executive Council decisions and resolutions, for the Governance and Planning sub-committee on Executive Council -related matters through policy guidance, environmental scanning, and coordination of strategic interventions. Manage the development, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of the Governance and Planning sub-committee Programme. Facilitate collaboration among departments and ensure alignment with provincial priorities, government policies, and Executive Council decisions. Track action plans and monitor the implementation of Executive Council programmes and decisions across departments. Lead and manage the Directorate, including human resources, financial resources, performance management, and achievement of operational targets. ENQUIRES : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted only online at www.gautengonline.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity documents and other supporting documents on or before the interview date, as directed by Human Resources. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attend a DPSA-prescribed SMS Competency Assessment if recommended by the Selection Committee following the interview process. Appointment to an SMS post is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Pre-Entry Programme (Certificate for Entry into the SMS) offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The successful candidate must provide proof of registration and successful completion of the programme prior to appointment. The cost of the programme is for the applicant's own account. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Leier van Regeringsake en Bestuur
af.summary: Direkteurspos in die Kantoor van die Premier wat strategiese ondersteuning aan die Leier van Regeringsake bied en bestuur oor die Gauteng Provinsiale Wetgewer koördineer.
af.requirements: NQF level 7-kwalifikasie in Sosiale Wetenskappe. 'n Honneursgraad in Sosiale Wetenskappe of 'n LLB-graad sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Uitgebreide ervaring in Bestuur en administrasie. Strategiese beplanning en prestasiebestuur. Regeringskoördinasie en belanghebbende verhoudings. Beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering. Monitering en evaluering. Uitvoerende ondersteuning en parlementêre/wetgewende skakelprosesse. Sleutelbevoegdhede: Strategiese leierskap en bestuur; bestuur en nakoming van goeie bestuur; strategiese beplanning, monitering en prestasiebestuur; beleidsanalise en -ontwikkeling; bestuur van belanghebbende en interregeringsverhoudings; projeks- en programbestuur; finansiële en hulpbronbestuur; uitstekende kommunikasie en verslagdoeningsvaardighede; probleemoplossing en besluitneming; en mensebestuur en bemagtiging.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese en tegniese ondersteuning aan die Leier van Regeringsake (LGB) in die koördinering van regeringsake in die Gauteng Provinsiale Wetgewer en Gauteng Provinsiale Regering (GPG). Verskaf ondersteuning aan die Nasionale Raad van Provinsies (NCOP). Adviseer die Uitvoerende Raad en LGB oor wetgewende, bestuurs-, beleids- en parlementêre aangeleenthede. Koördineer, monitor en bestuur die implikasies van Wetgewervrae, besluite, petisies aan die GPG, en verseker doeltreffende terugvoer- en aanspreeklikheidsmeganismes. Voer beleidsanalise en navorsing oor Uitvoerende Raad-memoranda uit en verskaf strategiese advies oor aangeleenthede wat voor die Uitvoerende Raad gedien word. Sinkroniseer en hou treding met Uitvoerende Raad-besluite en -besluite, vir die Bestuurs- en Beplanningsubkomitee oor Uitvoerende Raad-verwante aangeleenthede deur beleidsleiding, omgewingskandering en koördinering van strategiese ingrypings. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering en verslagdoening van die Bestuurs- en Beplanningsubkomiteeprogram. Fasiliteer samewerking tussen departemente en verseker belyning met provinsiale prioriteite, regeringsbeleid en Uitvoerende Raad-besluite. Hou treding met aksieplanne en monitor die implementering van Uitvoerende Raad-programme en -besluite oor departemente heen. Lei en bestuur die Direktoraat, insluitend menslike hulpbronne, finansiële hulpbronne, prestasiebestuur en die bereiking van operasionele teikens. NAVRAE : Me. Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

zu.title: Umongameli: Umholi Wezohwebo Lkahulumeni Nozokuqondiswa
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongameli kwi-Office of the Premier esinika inkxaso ebalulekile kumholi wezohwebo lukahulumeni futhi sihlanganise ukuqondiswa kuso sonke isishayamthetho sifundazwe saseGauteng.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF 7 kumSayensi Wezomphakathi. I-Degree ye-Honours kumSayensi Wezomphakathi noma i-Degree ye-LLB kuzobe kuyinenzuzo. Unyaka wokuqhuba okungu-5 ezingeni eliphakathi noma eliphezulu lokuqondisa. Ulwazi oluningi ekwenzeni ukuqondiswa nokuphathwa. Ukuhlela okusemgangathweni ophakeme kanye nokuphatha ukusebenza. Ukuhlanganiswa kukahulumeni kanye nezimo zobudlelwano namabalengwe. Ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo. Ukuqapha kanye nokuhlola. Inkxaso ebalulekile kanye nezinqubo zokuxhumanisa neziguni somthetho. Ikhono Elibalulekile: Ukukhokhela kanye nokuphatha; ukuqondiswa kanye nokuphatha ukuvumelana; ukuhlela okusemgangathweni ophakeme, ukuqapha nokuphatha ukusebenza; ukuhlaziya nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo; ukuphatha ubudlelwano namabalengwe kanye nokuhle abahulumeni; ukuphatha imiyalo kanye namaprohgramu; ukuphatha imali nezinsiza; ikhono elihle lokuxhumana nokuqamba imibiko; ukuxazula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo; nokuphatha abantu nokuqinisekisa amandla abo.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso ebalulekile nobuchwephetshe kumholi Wezohwebo Lukahulumeni (LGB) ekuhlanganisweni kwezohwebo lukahulumeni esishayamthetho sifundazwe saseGauteng nakuhulumeni besifundazwe saseGauteng (GPG). Nikeza inkxaso kwi-National Council of Provinces (NCOP). Luleka i-Executive Council ne-LGB ngemikhondo engumthetho, ukuqondiswa, izinhlelo, namaphuzu esiguni somthetho. Hlanganisa, qapha, uphathe iziphumo zemibuzo yesishayamthetho, izinqumo, izicelo kwi-GPG, ukuqinisekisa ukuphendula ngempumelelo kanye nendlela zokuqala inxeba. Yenza ukuhlaziya kwemithombo wezinhlelo ucibe ngqo kwamamorandum we-Executive Council unikezezelane ngoluleko ngezinto ezibekwe phambi kwe-Executive Council. Hlanganisa ulandele izinqumo kanye nezinqumomphumela ze-Executive Council, mayelana nesikomidi esincane se-Governance and Planning ngemikhondo ephathelene ne-Executive Council ngokuholela izinhlelo, ukuhlola imvelo, nohlanganisa ukungenelela okubalulekile. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, ukuqapha, nokubika ihlelo lesikomidi esincane se-Governance and Planning. Khuthaza ukusebenzisana phakathi kweminyango uqinisekise ukuhambelana nezindaba eziphakeme zesifundazwe, izinhlelo zikahulumeni, nezincomo ze-Executive Council. Landela amahlela wokuqondisa uqaphe ukusetshenziswa amahlelo nezinqumo ze-Executive Council ko wonke amanyango. Hola uphathe iqonga lakho lobu mongameli, kubandakanya izinsiza zabantu, izimali, ukuphatha ukusebenza, nokufeza imigomo yokusebenza.

xh.title: Director: Leader of Government Business and Governance
xh.summary: Indima kaDirector kwiOffice of the Premier inika inkxaso ephakamileyo kuLeader of Government Business kwaye ilungiselela igcisa-bukhosi lonke kwiGauteng Provincial Legislature.
xh.requirements: Isigaba seNQF level 7 kwiSocial Sciences. Isidanga seHonours kwiSocial Sciences okanye i-Degree yeLLB kuya kuba yingozi ngenyongo. Iimvelaphi zonyaka ezi-5 ngomgangatho ophakathi/uphatha phakathi. Ulwazi olunzulu kwiGovernance nolawulo. Ulungiselelwe ngokuchane ukulinganiswa nokulawulwa kwemveliso. Ulungiselelwe ngokuhlanganisa urhulumente nokuhlobana nabanomdla. Ulungiselelwe ngokudumba kwaye uphumeze iindlela ezichazwe yiNkundla yoWiso-mthetho. Ulungelelaniso lweenkqubo. Inkxaso evela kwabaphathi nabasebenzi bePalamente nethutyana elibambe linguwo. Ulungiselelwe ngokuba nandipha: Ulawulo olubambe ngasemva iNqanaba; ulawulo lwentsiselo nemithetho; ukucwangcisa okubambe ngasemva, ukulawula imisebenzi nokuqonda ukulingana; ukudumba ingxelo nokuqonda ukulunga kwemisebenzi; ukulawula imisebenzi nezigqibo; ulawulo lwemali nezibonelelo; izibonelelo ezichanekileyo zokunxibelelwana nokubhala iingxelo; ukuxazula iingxaki nokuqhelisa iigqibo; nokuqhelisa abantu.
xh.duties: Nikeza inkxaso ephakamileyo nengobuchwepheshe kuMphathi weShishini kaRhulumente (LGB) ekulungeniseni ishishini karhulumente kwiGauteng Provincial Legislature naseGauteng Provincial Government (GPG). Nikeza inkxaso kuNational Council of Provinces (NCOP).nika izalathiso kuQumba looGunyaziswa kwaye ulungiselele iinkqubo zokusebenza. Qhoboshela izicwangciso zentshukumo kwaye ulawule ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo nemiqulu yoQumba leeSebe kuzo onke amasebe. Qonda yaye ulawule iSebe, kuquka amakhosithi abantu, amakhosithi ezimali, ulawulo lomsebenzi ogqithiswayo, nokuwufikezela iinjongo ezisebenzayo. IMIBUZO : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

jobs.title: Director: International Relations
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Director of International Relations at the Office of the Premier in Johannesburg, requiring an NQF Level 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF Level 7 qualification in International Relations, Political Science, Public Administration/ Management, Development Studies, Law, Economics or related field. A post graduate Degree in the related fields would be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Extensive experience in international relations and para-diplomacy, Intergovernmental and stakeholder relations, Strategic planning and policy development. Programme and project management. Managing international partnerships, protocols, and cooperation agreements. Engagement with government departments, diplomatic missions, and international organisations. Key Competencies: The incumbent should demonstrate strategic leadership and directorate management capabilities, including the ability to conceptualise, develop and implement international relations strategies, manage programmes and projects, lead and empower provincial departments in the international relations field, and ensure effective financial and resource management. Strong stakeholder management, diplomacy communication, and negotiation skills to build and maintain partnerships with government institutions, diplomatic missions, and international organizations. Ability to undertake policy development and analysis, provide strategic advice, conduct research, manage change, and make sound decisions based on evidence and analysis. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and knowledge management skills are essential to support effective coordination, reporting, and the achievement of organisational and government priorities.
jobs.duties: Conceptualise, Develop, implement and monitor the Gauteng Provincial Government (GPG) 5-Year International Relations Framework and Strategy. Coordinate and oversee the implementation of the annual International Relations Programme and monitor progress against strategic objectives. Conduct research, policy analysis and provide strategic advice on regional, continental and global issues to support provincial priorities and the Medium- Term Development Plan. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of international relations initiatives, partnerships and bilateral engagements, ensuring implementation of agreed commitments and reporting on outcomes. Coordinate and facilitate international relations engagements, agreements and cooperation programmes in collaboration with the Department of International Relations and Cooperation (DIRCO) and GPG departments. Promote and integrate diplomatic principles, including commercial, public, cultural and bilateral diplomacy, across government engagements and programmes. Lead intergovernmental and stakeholder coordination on international relations matters and provide strategic support to decision-making structures. Manage the financial, human and operational resources of the Directorate, including budgeting, performance management, governance and compliance responsibilities. ENQUIRES : Ms Sylvia Mtshali Tel No: (011) 355 6280

Ulwazi oluhle ngomthetho waseburhulumente, iMigaqo yaseburhulumente, i-PFMA, iMigaqo yeTreasury, uMthetho wokuthintela nokulwa nobungalawuli, iMigaqo yokukhusela iinkcukacha, amaplandu okulawula iingozi. Ulwazi oluhle lokunxiba iingxoxo, ukubhala iingxelo, okokunika iingxelo, ukwenza iinqobo nokuqonda amacebo amakhulu. Ukuqonda ukulawuleka koluntu eGauteng Office of the Premier.
xh.duties: Phatha kwaza uncedise ekuboneleleni ngolawulo lwangaphakathi nolawulo lolwabiwo-mali oluchanekileyo, kuquka kuqinisekiswa ukuba isebe lifumana iziphumo zovavabo olucacileyo. Phatha kwaza uncedise ekuphuhlisweni kwezinqamlelo-politiki, iindlela zeentambo, neenkqubo ezimalunga nokuzithintela ngokuchasene nokungathembeki, ingozi, ulawulo lokuqhubekeka koshishino, nolawulo lokuzeleko. Phatha kwaza uncedise ekwaziseni ngokungathembekanga ngoko kunye nezinhlobo-miselwa ezichaseneyo, ukukhuthaza imbeko nokuzinza eshishinweni. Ngexela ngeengozi, ukungathembeki, imbeka, ulawulo lothungelwano lweenkqubo ezimalunga nembali, nakwindlela yokuzinza kwisebe lokuvavaba, eBhunga EliPhezulu, kuNoxandla Iimali, kulawulo lweengozi nakwiBhunga Loqinisekiso lweThungelwano, unike ncedo ku-RMC. Qwalasela unikelelo lweenkqubo ezenziwayo ze-AGSA kunye nesiBhalo soVavabo sika-GAS kwisebe. Qwalasela ukuzinza kwemigaqo nokuqhubekeka komthetho, iindlela, iinkqubo. Phatha kwaza uncedise ekwaziseni ngokungathembekanga ngemigaqo yethungelwano iinkqubo ezimalunga nembali, kuquka nokuqaphela iingozi ekuthethwa ngazo nakwindlela yokuziphendula kuzo. Bonelela ngeNdlela yoBunkokeli kwaza namacebo okuyisebenzisa ngokwemithetho yoluntu kunye namacebo aluntu anjengoko kuchazwe kumaplandu ezwe. Phatha ukwaziswa ngezinto ezithintelwa zimali kubasebenzi abakhethiweyo ukwenza imisebenzi ngaphandle kokubhaliswa kwabo. Cacisa iingozi ezikhoyo ngokubakho kwethamsanqa kakhulu ukuze kuzalisekwe imisebenzi. Qwalasela nokuqhagamshelana kolawulo olusemthethweni ngokwamaplandu kunye noqinisekiso lweziqinisekiso zeThungelwano. Qwalasela ukuzinza kolawulo, iinkqubo, neenkqubo ngaphakathi kwisebe. jobs.title: Director: Knowledge and Data Analytics
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Director of Knowledge and Data Analytics in the Office of the Premier, Johannesburg, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Knowledge Management, Data Science or Information Technology. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in Performance Monitoring, Evaluation and Data Systems environment. A Strong strategic capability and leadership skills. Excellent knowledge of Monitoring and Evaluation systems, Strategic planning and reporting, Performance information management, Data analysis and interpretation, Research and impact assessment, development and management of databases, policy analysis Government planning frameworks and compliance Reporting. Sound understanding of knowledge management principles, including the creation, capture, storage, sharing, and utilisation of organisational knowledge, lessons learnt, and best practices to promote institutional learning, innovation, and continuous improvement.
