Fasiliteer en implementeer tegniese teenmaatreëls vir die Office of the Premier se Uitvoerende Lede en geïdentifiseerde personeel. Bestee omvattende sekuriteitsadministratiewe ondersteuning. Ontwikkel en implementeer sekuriteitsadministrasiestelsels. Bestee beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid in ooreenstemming met nasionale beleid. Bestee en koördineer die interne keuringsproses. Bestee noodplanne, besigheidsrampherstel- en herwinningsplanne in reaksie op noodsituasies. Evalueer, adviseer, monitor en fasiliteer die implementering van tegniese sekuriteitsmaatreëls en teenmaatreëls. Voer ondersoeke, navorsing, ontwikkeling, bestuur, monitering en evaluering van sekuriteitsoplossings uit. Koördineer behoeftebepalings en die verkryging van tegniese sekuriteitsbates. Bestee risiko- en dreigementbestuurstelsel vir Office of the Premier. Bestee en monitor die nakoming van en voldoening aan fisiese sekuriteitsbeleid, -maatreëls en -standaarde. Lewer fisiese sekuriteitsdienste in ooreenstemming met die Minimum Physical Security Standards (MPSS), MISS, en ander regsvoorskrifte. Voer risikoprofilering uit vir geïdentifiseerde personeel en die Uitvoerendes en verskaf strategiese ingrypings. Verseker veiligheid by interne gebeurtenisse in ooreenstemming met die SASREA Act. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor beleid, prosedures en voldoening aan die Firearms Control Act en prosedures vir OOP. Bestee die ontwikkeling van insetsels tot die direktoraat se begroting, behoefteproses en verkryging van dienste en verseker nakoming van die tersaaklike wetgewing. Bestee die menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die Direktoraat om die effektiewe en doeltreffende lewering van dienste te verseker. NAVRAE: Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

zu.title: Umongameli: Izenzululwazi Zolawulo Lokuvikela & Umsebenzi
zu.summary: Umongameli Wezenzululwazi Zolawulo Lokuvikela eOffice of the Premier eJohannesburg, ofuna iziqu zomlinganiso weNQF level 7 namawunga eminyaka emihlanu wokuhlola phezulu ekuvikeni ukuphepha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zomlinganiso weNQF level 7 kuzolawulo lokuvikela / ukulawula ingozi nokuvikeleka noma inkambu ehlobene. 5 years wamava ezingeni eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokubusa enkambini yokuvikela okubonwayo, ukulawula, ukwesekwa ngobuchwepheshe, amamu wokuvikeleka kolwazi (MISS), ukuxhumana nezinhlobo zokuphenya ngokuvikeleka. Amakhono amahle okulawula imiklomo, izimali nabantu. Amakhono okucubungula futhi ukuhlela, ukulawula izinguquko. Amakhono amahle okuhlanganisa, ukuxhumana, ukwakha izinhlobo, ukuxoxisana, okuboniswayo nokuqeda imisebenzi eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izidingo eziyinhloko: Ukubusa ngokusesibhakabhakeni ekuvikeleni, ekwentuleko, nasekuhleni isimo esikwonjini, ikgovela elinamandla, ukusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, namandla okulanda ukuthobela. Ukuxhumana kahle nabahlanganyeli; amakhono okulawula imiklomo nanguquko, amakhono amakhulu okuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana, kanye nokubhala imibiko; kanye nokuqonda okubanzi komthetho ohlobene nomphakathi wombuso, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, amamu wokuvikeleka kolwazi (MISS), imiyalo yokuvikeleka, kanye nezakhiwo ezihlobene nokuthobela. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela nesifiso sokuqasha isikhathi eside.
zu.duties: Nikeza iseluleko ngesibhakabhakeni solwazi sokuvikela i-Office of the Premier (OOP). Qinisekisa ukuthobela izindlela zokuvikela ulwazi kokuvikeleka kwabantu, amadokhumenti nokuqhweba. Hlanganisa futhi usebenzise ukwazisa ngokuvikeleka, ukulinganisa nokuhlola. Khwezisa futhi usebenzise izindlela zokuthola izinsongo zobuchwepheshe kumalungu abaphathi be-Office of the Premier nabantu abakhethiwe. Lawula ukwesekwa okubanzi kohlelo lokuvikela. Bumba futhi usebenzise izindlela zolawulo lokuvikela. Lawula i-Occupational Health and Safety ngokuvumelana nezinqubomgomo zezwe. Lawula futhi uhlele inqubo yokuqinisekisa ngaphakathi. Lawula izindlela zokubhekana nezimo ezingalindelekile, ukuphahlazeka koshintsho kanye nokubuyela emuva ukuphendula ezenzakalweni. Linganisa, lanele, lwazi futhi khwezisa ukusebenziswa kwezindlela zokuvikela ngobuchwepheshe kanye nokuziphendulela. Yenza ukuphenya, ukucwaninga, ukuthuthuka, ukulawula, ukulanda nokulinganisa izixazululo zokuvikela ze-IDT. Hlanganisa ukulinganisa izidingo kanye nokuthenga impahla yokuvikela ngobuchwepheshe. Lawula uhlelo lokulawula ingozi nesisongo se-Office of the Premier. Lawula futhi lwazi ukuzinza nokuthobela inqubomgomo yokuvikela okubonwayo, izindlela namamu. Nikeza izinsiza zokuvikela okubonwayo ngokuvumelana namamu wokuvikela okubonwayo (MPSS), i-MISS, kanye nemiyalo yomthetho. Yenza inqubo yokubhaliswa kwesisongo kubantu abakhethiwe kanye nabaphathi bize ukuze unikeze izinhlanganisela zesesibhakabhakeni. Qinisekisa ukuvikeleka emicimbeni yangaphakathi ngokuvumelana ne-SASREA Act. Bumba, usebenzise futhi lwazi izinqubomgomo, izindlela nokuthobela i-Firearms Control Act kanye nezindlela ze-OOP. Lawula ukuthuthukiswa kwezimalo zomnyango, ihlelo lofuna nokuthenga izinsiza bese uqinisekisa ukuzinza emthethweni ohlobene. Lawula abantu, izimali kanye nezinsiza ezinye zomnyango ukugcina ukusebenza kahle ukulethwa kwezinsiza. IMIBUZO : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

xh.title: Umongameli: Iinkonzo zoLawulo loKhuseleko & Umsebenzi
xh.summary: Umongameli weeNkonzo zoLawulo loKhuseleko kwiOfisi yeSihlalo eJohannesburg, efuna isifundo seenqanaba le-NQF level 7 nenyanga ezintlanu zesiphaluka sobuchule bokulawulo okuphezulu ekhuselekweni.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seenqanaba le-NQF level 7 kuLawulo loKhuseleko / uLawulo loMngcipheko nokuKhuseleka okanye kwelinye indawo ehambelana nalo. Iminyaka emi-5 yamava enqanaba lokulawula eliphakathi/elphezulu kwinkundla yeKhuseleko lomzimba, uLawulo, uNxibelelwano lobuchule, amaNqanaba aMancinci oKhuseleko lolwazi (MISS), uNxibelelwano nokuPhanda ngokuKhuseleka. Amaphepha abalulekileyo oLawulo lweProjekthi, leeMali nokuLawulwa kweZabantu. Amaphepha eCandelo lokucinga nokuhlela, uLawulo loTshintsho. Amaphepha amaninzi okulungelelanisa, ukunxibelelana, ukuzonda usasazo, ukuxoxa, ukubonisa nokuqhubeeka imisebenzi emininzi ngaxa nye. Amandla aBalulekileyo: Ukuba nogqithiselo obonakalayo ekukhuliseni iinjongo ekhuselekweni, kumngcipheko, nakulawulo lendawo yomsebenzi, ukuba namandla ahambelana nokulawula ngokweemigaqo, ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zolwazi, nokulandelela ukuthobela iinkqubo. Ukuzibandakanya ngokuchanekileyo nabathathi-nxaxheba; amava ohlelo lweprojekthi notshintsho, amandla okuhlalutya, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukunxibelelana, nokubhala iingxelo; nolwazi olubanzi ngomthetho ohambelana noluntu kamazwe nakomgaqo-siseko, uMthetho weMpilo yoMsebenzi nokuKhuseleka, amaNqanaba aMancinci oKhuseleko lolwazi (MISS), iingqikhela zokhuseleko, nezinye iindlela ezihambelana nokuThobeka. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo nolungelo lokusebenza iiyure ezinde.
xh.duties: Nika inkundla yamacebo oLawulo lolwazi loKhuseleko kwiOfisi yeSihlalo (OOP). Qinisekisa ukuthobeka kweendibaniselwano zokhuseleko lolwazi kwimaxhathu, amaphepha kunye nokhuseleko lokunxibelelana. Lungelanisa kwaye usebenzise ulwazi ngokhuseleko, ukulinganiswa nokuphonononga. Yenza kwaye usebenzise izibonelelo ezichaseneyo nokulandelela ubuchule ekuSihlalweni sabaLAWuli beSihlalo nabo basebenza abachongiweyo. Lawula inkxaso yolawulo olubanzi lokhuseleko. Yila kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zolawulo lokhuseleko. Lawula uMthetho weMpilo noKhuseleko komSebenzi ngokuhambelana namagqabantshishi welizwe. Lawula kwaye ulungelelanise inkqubo yokuqinisekisa ngaphakathi. Lawula iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa iimeko, iCandelo leMacala woShishino nokuBuyela emva kweMozushi ukuyiphendula iimeko ezibuthathaka. Hlola, yala, lulandelele kwaye uncede ekusebenziseni iindibaniselwano zobuchule bokhuseleko nomezoso abuchaseneyo. Yenza uphando, uphononongo, uphuhliso, ulawulo, ulandelelwano nokuHlola iindlela zokhuseleko ze-IDT. Lungelanisa ukulinganisa iimfuno kwaye ithenge izixhobo zobuchule bokhuseleko. Lawula iinkqubo zomngcipheko nomezoso eziSihlalweni sabaLAWuli beSihlalo. Lawula kwaye ulandelele ukuthobela nokuHambelana nokuSebenzisa iinkqubo zolwazi lokhuseleko olomzimba. Zisa iinkonzo zokhuseleko olomzimba ngokuhambelana namaNqanaba aMancinci oKhuseleko loMzimba (MPSS), i-MISS, nezinye iingqikhela ezithileyo. Yenza ukulinganisa kubasebenzi abachongiweyo nakuBaphathi kwaye unikeze iindlela ezamkelayo ngamacebo. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko kwiiNkomfa ezingaphakathi ngokuhambelana noMthetho we-SASREA. Yila, sebenzisa kwaye ulandelele amagqabantshishi, iinkqubo nokuThobeka koMthetho woLawulo lwezikhali ezibulalayo kwaye ngeenkqubo ze-OOP. Lawula uphuhliso lwezipho ezingenwa kwibhajethi ye-directorate, icebo lofuno nokuthengwa kweenkonzo kwaye uqinisekise ukuthobeka ngokomthetho ohambelana nalo. Lawula abantu, imali nezinye izixhobo ze-Directorate ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba nakho kwaye ngokuchanekileyo ukwazi ukunikezela iinkonzo. IMBUZO : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

jobs.title: Director: Corporate Communication Services
jobs.summary: Director of Corporate Communication Services in Johannesburg, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and 5 years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF Level 7 qualification in Communication, Public Relations, Marketing, Media Studies, Digital Communication, Visual Communication, Fine Arts or a related field. An NQF Level 8 qualification in the related fields will be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level, with proven managerial capability. Proven experience in leading integrated communication, digital, visual and multimedia communication services, including video, photography, graphic design and website/content management; managing multidisciplinary teams; and delivering high-impact campaigns in a complex environment. Key Competencies: The successful candidate must demonstrate strategic leadership; advanced communication, writing, editing, content development and technical capabilities; strong project, financial, performance and people management skills; and sound knowledge of integrated communication, media, marketing, digital communication and audience engagement practices. Knowledge of website governance, content management systems and SEO principles is essential. The candidate must also demonstrate excellent stakeholder management, negotiation and partnership-building skills; strong analytical, research, problem-solving and decision-making abilities; and the ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders and segmented target audiences. Innovation, creativity, professionalism, integrity, service excellence and a results-driven approach are essential.
jobs.duties: Lead the development and implementation of integrated communication strategies, campaigns and programmes that support provincial priorities and service delivery objectives. Direct media buying, advertising and audience engagement initiatives to maximise communication reach, visibility and impact across multiple platforms. Oversee the governance, performance and continuous improvement of the Gauteng Provincial Government website, including content management, user experience, SEO, accessibility and development of sub-sites. Manage the production and distribution of high- quality print and digital publications, ensuring compliance with editorial, language, publishing and corporate identity standards. Provide strategic leadership for professional photography, videography and multimedia services that support the Executive Council, marketing, communication and public awareness initiatives. Drive internal communication strategies and programmes that strengthen employee engagement, organisational culture and awareness of government priorities. Develop and implement communication policies, governance frameworks, systems and standard operating procedures to improve efficiency, effectiveness, quality and consistency. Foster strategic partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, including executive leadership, communicators, media partners, agencies and service providers. Manage the Directorate's financial, human and operational resources in accordance with the PFMA, Public Service Regulations and other applicable frameworks. ENQUIRES : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted only online at www.gautengonline.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity documents and other supporting documents on or before the interview date, as directed by Human Resources. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attend a DPSA-prescribed SMS Competency Assessment if recommended by the Selection Committee following the interview process. Appointment to an SMS post is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Pre-Entry Programme (Certificate for Entry into the SMS) offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The successful candidate must provide proof of registration and successful completion of the programme prior to appointment. The cost of the programme is for the applicant's own account. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Korporatiewe Kommunikasiedienste
af.summary: Direkteur van Korporatiewe Kommunikasiedienste in Johannesburg, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en 5 jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n NQF Vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Kommunikasie, Openbare Betrekkinge, Bemarking, Mediastudie, Digitale Kommunikasie, Visuele Kommunikasie, Skone Kunste of 'n verwante veld. 'n NQF Vlak 8-kwalifikasie in die verwante velde sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak, met bewese bestuursvermoë. Bewese ervaring in die leiding van geïntegreerde kommunikasie-, digitale, visuele en multimedia-kommunikasiedienste, insluitend video, fotografie, grafiese ontwerp en webwerf-/inhoudbestuur; die bestuur van multidissiplinêre spanne; en die lewer van hoë-impakveldtogte in 'n komplekse omgewing. Sleutelkompetensies: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet strategiese leierskap toon; Gevorderde kommunikasie-, skryf-, redigeer-, inhoudontwikkelings- en tegniese vermoëns; Sterk projek-, finansiële-, prestasie- en mensebestuursvaardighede; En deeglike kennis van geïntegreerde kommunikasie, media, bemarking, digitale kommunikasie en gehalte-betrokkenheidspraktyke. Kennis van webwerf-bestuur, inhoudbestuurstelsels en SEO-beginsels is noodsaaklik. Die kandidaat moet ook uitstekende bestuur van belanghebbendes, onderhandeling en vennootskapsbou-vaardighede toon; Sterke analitiese, navorsings-, probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvermoëns; En die vermoë om effektief met uiteenlopende belanghebbendes en gesegmenteerde teikengroep te kommunikeer. Innovasie, kreatiwiteit, professionaliteit, integriteit, diensuitnemendheid en 'n resultaatgedrewe benadering is noodsaaklik.
af.duties: Leid die ontwikkeling en implementering van geïntegreerde kommunikasie-strategieë, veldtogte en programme wat provinsiale prioriteite en dienslewering-doelwitte ondersteun. Direkte media-aankope, advertensies en gehalte-betrokkenheidsinisiatiewe om kommunikasie-bereik, sigbaarheid en impak oor veelvuldige platforms te maksimeer. Hou toesig oor die bestuur, werksverrigting en deurlopende verbetering van die Gauteng Provinsiale Regering-webwerf, insluitend inhoudbestuur, gebruikerservaring, SEO, toeganklikheid en ontwikkeling van subwerwe. Bestuur die produksie en verspreiding van hoë-kwaliteit druk- en digitale publikasies, en verseker nakoming van redaksionele, taal-, publikasie- en korporatiewe identiteitstandaarde. Verskaf strategiese leierskap vir professionele fotografie, videografie en multimedia-dienste wat die Uitvoerende Raad, bemarking, kommunikasie en openbare bewustheidsinisiatiewe ondersteun. Dryf interne kommunikasie-strategieë en -programme aan wat werknemer-betrokkenheid, organisatoriese kultuur en bewustheid van regeringsprioriteite versterk. Ontwikkel en implementeer kommunikasie-beleide, bestuursraamwerke, stelsels en standaardbedryfsprosedures om doeltreffendheid, effektiewiteit, kwaliteit en konsekwentheid te verbeter. Bevorder strategiese vennootskappe met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes, insluitend uitvoerende leierskap, kommunikeerders, mediapartners, agentskappe en diensverskaffers. Bestuur die Direktoraat se finansiële, menslike en operasionele bronne in ooreenstemming met die PFMA, Openbare Diensregulasies en ander toepaslike raamwerke. NAVRAE : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

zu.title: Umphathi: Amasevisi Okuxhumana Namakhampani
zu.summary: Umphathi wamasevisi okuxhumana namakhampani e-Johannesburg, ofuna izifundo ze-NQF 7 kanye neminyaka engu-5 yesoqeqesho esibangeni esiphezulu sobaphathi.
zu.requirements: Isifundo se-NQF Level 7 kumazwe okuxhumana, ubudlelwano bomphakathi, makethi, izifundo zamahlaya, ukuxhumana kwasikhompiyutha, okubonwayo, bukhali obuhle noma inkambu ephathelene nalokho. Isifundo se-NQF Level 6 kumagatsha ephathelene nalokho kuzoba yinzuzo. 5 yeminyaka yesoqeqesho esibangeni esiphakathi/esiphezulu sobaphathi, obufakazelwa ikhono lokuphatha. Isoqeqesho esifakazelwa ekubhekaneni namasevisi okuxhumana okuhlangene, okwasikhompiyutha, okubonwayo nangamandla amaningi, okuhlanganisa amavidiyo, ukuthatha izithombe, ukwakheka kwezithombe nokuphathwa kwenhlanganisela yawebhusayithi/okuphathwayo; ukuphatha amaqembu anamagatsha amaningi; nokuletha imigomo enomthelela omkhulu endaweni enobuningi. Amandla Abalulekile: Ophumelelayo kufanele abonise ukuba ngumholi ohleliwe; ukuxhumana okuphezulu, ukubhala, ukulungisa, ukuthuthukisa okuphathwayo namandla obuchwepheshe; amandla amakhulu okuphatha imiklamo, imali, ukusebenza nabantu; nenlolivo eliphezulu ngamasu okuxhumana aholiwe, amahlaya, ukumaketha, ukuxhumana kwasikhompiyutha nemikhuba yokubandakanya abathungi. Ulwazi ngokulawula iwebhusayithi, izinhlela zokuphatha okuphathwayo nemigomo ye-SEO kubalulekile. Ophumelelayo kufuthi abonise amandla aphezulu okuphatha abathintana nabo, ukuxoxisana nokwakha ubuhlobo; amandla okuhlaziya, ukuphenya, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo; kanye nenhlelo yokuxhumana nabathintana nabo abahlukene nemitonulo eyahlukene. Ukuba nokwanda kwamava, ubuciko, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukwethembeka, ukuphumelela kwisevisi nendlela ezinhlayiseni kubalulekile.
zu.duties: Hola ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwamasu okuxhumana aholiwe, imigimo namaprogremu asekela izinhloso ezifundekayo namokuhlinzeka ngesevisi. Qondisa imiklamo yokuthenga izindaba, ukukhangisa nokubandakanya abathungi ukuze kusike isibopho, ukubonakala kanye nomphumela kuzinhlelo eziningi. Buka ukulawula, ukusebenza nokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo iwebhusayithi yoHulumeni wesifundazwe i-Gauteng, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha okuphathwayo, okuhlanganyelwa ngumsebenzisi, i-SEO, ukufinyelela kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezinkompo. Phatha ukukhiqizwa nokusatshalaliswa koshicilelo oluphrintiwe nangamandla amaningi olukhululekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nomugomo wokulunga, ulimi, ukushicilela namazinga okubonakala kwakhampani. Nikeza umqondo ohleliwe wokuba ngumholi ngamasevisi okuthatha izithombe, ukurekhoda amavidiyo nangamandla amaningi asekela umkhandlu ophethe, ukumaketha, ukuxhumana nemitonulo yokwazisa umphakathi. Beka amasu namaprogremu okuxhumana ngaphakathi okuqinisa ukubandakanya abasebenzi, inkambu yokuhlelwa komphakathi nokwazi okuhlobene nezinhloso zohulumeni. Thuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinkambiso zokuxhumana, izakhiwo zokulawula, izinhlelo namakhasimende ahambe kahle ukwenza ukuthi kube lula kakhulu futhi kuhambisane. Sakela ubuhlobo namabandla ohleliwe nabangaphandle, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha abaholi, abathintana nabantu, abalinganisana namahlaya, izikhungo ezinikeza isevisi. Phatha izinsiza zedikhe leminyaka yamafinansi, abantu nokusebenza ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kabi okuhle kwezimali kahulumeni kwe-PFMA, imithetho yasezikhundleni zikahulumeni esebenza kanti nalawo aqinisekiswa ukusetshenziswa. IMIBUZO : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

xh.title: Umthethi weNkqubo yokuqala: Iinkonzo zokuqhutywa koluntu.
xh.summary: Umthethi weZiko eNtabazwe Lokubakho ngakunye noluntu olungawoyo eNqanaba lokubakho lokugqithisela kweNkqubo yokuqwalasela iinkqubo eziyimfuno, eJohannesburg, efunwa iNqanaba lesi-7 leNkqubo ekuqwalaselwa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo kweli lizwe.
xh.requirements: Isifungo seNqanaba le-NQF 7 kwiNkcazelo ePhilayo, Ubudlelwane bommango, Iyasetyenziswa, IZifundo zeMiva, Ulonwabo lweDigital, Ulonwabo lweZibonelelo, IZibonelelo ezilula, IIzithuba zobugcisa noma indawo enxulumene noko. Isifungo seNqanaba le-NQF 8 kwizithuba eziphathelene nendawo ngendawo ziya kuba yinzuzo. Iminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/phezulu lolawulo, nokuqinisekiswa ngamandla okulawula. Amapula amava ekubeni ihamba phambili ekudityanisiweni kweenkcazelo, iinkcazelo zamajinja ezilula, ezibonakalayo nakwezamajinja amaninzi, kuquka amavidiyo, iintshombe, ukumiswa kolwelo olubonakalayo nokulawula ngaphezulu kwekhaya ekusingathweni kweeprogram ezilawula iqela lamagunya, kodwa kukho amava amaninzi ekunika amandla okusebenza kolunye ulwimi oluyinkqubo. Ngamandla abalulekileyo: Iqela eliphumeleleyo kufuneka libonise ukuba ngaba the ihamba phambili ngokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwimi obalulekileyo lweNkqubo; ubuchule ekuboniseni iindlela eziqinisekisiweyo zokuthetha nokubhala, ukuhlela, ukwenza okuqukiweyo, nokusebenza kweliso namava okusebenza ngokobuchwepheshe; amandla amakhulu ekulawulwa kolunye ulwimi lomsebenzi, ngokomtya, ekuphumeleleni ngokwentengiso, kunye nobomi bokusingathwa kwabantu; ulwazi oluhle ngokudityaniswa kweekcazelo eziyinkqubo, ulonwabo lomphiliso, ukwenza umthengi, ulonwabo lweNkcazelo yoluntu nakuphathwa koluntu. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwimi ngokomthetho, ukulawulwa kweqela lamatyu, iinkqubo, kunye nemigaqo ye-SEO kubalulekile. Umntu oqwalaselwa kufuneka abonise ubugcisa obuhle ekusingathweni kolunye ulwimi ngokwezinye izizukulwana ezikwindawo yokwenza, ukudibana koluntu nakumanyano lwemiqhubano ngokubakho kunye; amandla amaninzi okwahlukanisa, ukuphonononga, ukusombulula iingxaki nakwezona nndlela ezithetha ngokwahlulelana ngokomsebenzi; kunye namandla okudlulisa iinkcazelo kakuhle nakwizizukulwana eziphila ziwumbonakalisa kwindawo ethile yoluntu olubalulekileyo. Ukutsha kwamava, uluvo, ithe ngokwexesha, intlonipho, ukusebenza ngokwemigaqo yoluntu, konke kubalulekile.
xh.duties: Dala umkhobo kunye nokusebenzisa iindlela ezidityanisiweyo zolonwabo lweenkcazelo, iinkampu kunye neenkqubo ezixhasa iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo zephondo kunye nemiqophyo yokunikela inkonzo. Qondisa iinkqubo zokuthenga izindaba, ukwenza umzikelo wokuziphatha kunye nemiqophyo yokuzibandakanya nabathengi ukwandisa ukufikelela kwolonwabo lweenkcazelo, ukubonakala kunye nomphumela kumaziko amaninzi. Lawula urhulumente, ukusebenza kunye nokuqhubela phambili ngokuqhubekayo kwewebhusayithi kaRhulumente wePhondo la Gauteng, kuquka ukulawula okuqukiweyo, amava komsebenzisi, i-SEO, ukufikelela nokuphuhliswa kweendawo ezincinci. Lawula ukwenziwa kunye nokusasazwa kweepapasho zeprinta ezingcono nangobuchwepheshe ezikwijelo, kuqinisekiswa ukuzithoba kumagunya abahleli, ulwimi, ukupapasha kunye namagunya obume bomntu. Bonezela ubuzamazwe ngokuyilmesa ngokwezicala ukuthatha iintshombe zobuchwepheshe, amavidiyo kunye neenkonzo zamajinja eembali ezixhasa iBhunga eNguMthunywa, imakethe, ulonwabo lweenkcazelo kunye nemiqophyo yokuziva komntu wonke. Qhuba iindlela ezidityanisiweyo zolonwabo lwangaphakathi lweenkcazelo naze ngethutyana lamakhonkco ukunika amandla okuzibandakanya kwabasebenzi, inkcubeko yorhulumente kunye nokuqonda ngokubaluleka kweenkqubo zikarhulumente. Dala umzelelo wokuziphatha kunye nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zolonwabo lweenkcazelo, urhulumente, iindlela ezahlukeneyo, iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza namagunya okusebenza ngokwemigaqo ehlala iyenzeka ukuphucula ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo, ukusebenza ngempumelelo, isimbo kunye nokuqina. Yila ubuhlobo obuzinzileyo ngokwezicala ngaphakathi nangaphandle nabahlobo, kuquka abathe ihamba phambili, abanika iinkcazelo, amakhuphisano amajinja wemiva, oorhulumente kunye neenkonzo ezibonelela. Lawula izixhobo zematyala, zokwabantu kunye nentengiso kwiziko eliqondisa ngokwemigaqo ye-PFMA, imigaqo yeNkonzo kaRhulumente nakwezinye iindlela ezisebenzayo. IIMBUZO : Nkosazana Khanyisile Mafiri Inombolo yefowuni: (011) 355 6060.

jobs.title: Director: Branding and Marketing
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Director sought to lead branding and marketing strategy for the Gauteng Provincial Government, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Marketing / Branding / Graphic Design / Fine Arts / Communication / Public Relations. An NQF Level 8 qualification in the above discipline will be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in branding and marketing/research- based brand strategy. Excellent verbal and written communication skills; interpersonal skills; ability to communicate effectively with the appropriate target audience; analytical and problem-solving skills; and strong leadership and people management skills. Key Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership; project and financial management, branding and corporate identity management, creative concept development; brand development, marketing strategy development and implementation, media and public relations management, stakeholder engagement and partnership management, digital marketing and communication, research, monitoring and evaluation, strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, negotiation and influencing skills. Demonstrable sound knowledge of branding, marketing and reputation management. Ability to lead teams, manage multiple projects, work under pressure, drive innovation, and build effective relationships with diverse stakeholders is essential. Demonstrable sound knowledge of strategic brand management, place branding, reputation management, brand governance, market positioning, audience insights and integrated marketing strategies.
jobs.duties: Manage the development, implementation and monitoring of branding and marketing strategies that position the Gauteng Provincial Government (GPG) and Brand Gauteng. Provide strategic branding and marketing advisory services to provincial departments, entities and stakeholders to ensure a coherent, integrated approach to branding and positioning across government. Lead and manage the development and implementation of creative strategies for key campaigns for Gauteng Provincial Government programmes and Brand Gauteng. Provide strategic oversight of copywriting and messaging to promote programmes, services and priorities that enhance public awareness and access to services. Develop and implement campaigns to profile services, the programme of action, and the work of the Gauteng Provincial Government and Brand Gauteng. Provide leadership on developing brands and corporate identity. Manage and protect provincial brand assets, including logos, taglines, visual identity systems, and brand architecture for GPG and Brand Gauteng. Drive compliance with the Gauteng Provincial Government corporate identity manual and applicable branding frameworks by monitoring, evaluating, and supporting departments and entities. Manage the co-ordination of marketing Gauteng as a preferred destination for investment, tourism, sport, major events, and the creative industries. Facilitate stakeholder engagement, partnerships, and collaborative initiatives to promote Gauteng and enhance the province's reputation and visibility locally, nationally, and internationally. Monitor and evaluate branding and marketing programs, conduct research, analyse data, and provide insights and recommendations to the executive. Develop, implement and review policies, frameworks, standards, and systems to promote the Gauteng Provincial Government and Brand Gauteng. Manage the human, financial and other resources of the Directorate to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of services. ENQUIRES : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted only online at www.gautengonline.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity documents and other supporting documents on or before the interview date, as directed by Human Resources. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attend a DPSA-prescribed SMS Competency Assessment if recommended by the Selection Committee following the interview process. Appointment to an SMS post is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Pre-Entry Programme (Certificate for Entry into the SMS) offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The successful candidate must provide proof of registration and successful completion of the programme prior to appointment. The cost of the programme is for the applicant's own account. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Handelsmerkbemaking en Bemarking
af.summary: Direkteur gesoek om handelsmerkbemakings- en bemarkingstrategie vir die Gauteng Provinsiale Regering te lei, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Bemarking / Handelsmerkbemaking / Grafiese Ontwerp / Skone Kunste / Kommunikasie / Openbare Betrekkinge. 'n NQF Vlak 8-kwalifikasie in bogenoemde dissipline sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in handelsmerkbemaking en bemarking/navorsingsgebaseerde handelsmerkstrategie. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; interpersoonlike vaardighede; vermoë om doeltreffend met die toepaslike teikengehoor te kommunikeer; analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede; en sterk leierskap- en mensebestuursvaardighede. Sleutelbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; projeks- en finansiële bestuur, handelsmerk- en korporatiewe identiteitsbestuur, ontwikkeling van kreatiewe konsepte; handelsmerkontwikkeling, ontwikkeling en implementering van bemarkingstrategie, media- en openbare betrekkingebestuur, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en vennootskapsbestuur, digitale bemarking en kommunikasie, navorsing, monitering en evaluering, sterk analitiese, probleemoplossings-, kommunikasie-, aanbiedings-, onderhandelings- en beïnvloedingsvaardighede. Aantoonbare deeglike kennis van handelsmerkbemaking, bemarking en reputasiebestuur. Vermoë om spanne te lei, veelvuldige projekte te bestuur, onder druk te werk, innovasie te dryf en effektiewe verhoudings met diverse belanghebbendes te bou, is noodsaaklik. Aantoonbare deeglike kennis van strategiese handelsmerkbestuur, plek-handelsmerkbemaking, reputasiebestuur, handelsmerkbestuur, markposisionering, gehoorinsigte en geïntegreerde bemarkingstrategieë.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van handelsmerkbemakings- en bemarkingstrategieë wat die Gauteng Provinsiale Regering (GPR) en Handeimserfg Gauteng posisioneer. Verskaf strategiese handelsmerkbemakings- en bemarkingsadviesdienste aan provinsiale departemente, entiteite en belanghebbendes om 'n samehangende, geïntegreerde benadering tot handelsmerkbemaking en posisionering oor die regering heen te verseker. Lei en bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van kreatiewe strategieë vir sleutelveldtogte vir Gauteng Provinsiale Regering-programme en Handelsmerk Gauteng. Verskaf strategiese toesig oor kopskryf en boodskapgewing om programme, dienste en prioriteite te bevorder wat openbare bewustheid en toegang tot dienste verbeter. Ontwikkel en implementeer veldtogte om dienste, die aksieprogram en die werk van die Gauteng Provinsiale Regering en Handelsmerk Gauteng te profileer. Verskaf leierskap oor die ontwikkeling van handelsmerke en korporatiewe identiteit. Bestuur en beskerm provinsiale handelsmerkbates, insluitend logo's, slagspreuke, visuele identiteitstelsels en handelsmerkargitektuur vir GPR en Handelsmerk Gauteng. Dryf nakoming van die Gauteng Provinsiale Regering se korporatiewe identiteitshandleiding en toepaslike handelsmerkbemakingsraamwerke deur departemente en entiteite te moniteer, te evalueer en te ondersteun. Bestuur die koördinering van die bemarking van Gauteng as 'n voorkeurbestemmeling vir investering, toerisme, sport, groot gebeurtenisse en die kreatiewe nywerhede. Fasiliteer belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, vennootskappe en samewerkende inisiatiewe om Gauteng te bevorder en die provinsie se reputasie en sigbaarheid lokaal, nasionaal en internasionaal te verbeter. Moniteer en evalueer handelsmerkbemakings- en bemarkingsprogramme, voer navorsing uit, ontleed data en verskaf insigte en aanbevelings aan die uitvoerende gesag. Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien beleide, raamwerke, standaarde en stelsels om die Gauteng Provinsiale Regering en Handelsmerk Gauteng te bevorder. Bestuur die menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die Direktoraat om die doeltreffende en doeltrouende levering van dienste te verseker. NAVRAE : Me. Khanyisile Mafari Tel No: (011) 355 6060

zu.title: Umqondisi: Ukumaketha Nokwakha Isithombe
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMqondisi okhokule ijubane nomkhandlu wokuqonda ukumaketha kuHulumeni wesifundazwe i-Gauteng, okudinga iziqu ze-NQF 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yemfundo yokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezikwizinga le-NQF 7 kulezi zifundo i-Marketing / Branding / Graphic Design / Fine Arts / Communication / Public Relations. Iziqu ezikwizinga le-NQF 8 kwelinye lezifundo ezingenhla kuzokuba yinzuzo. 5 iminyaka yemfundo ezingeni eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokuphatha kwimikhankaso yokumaketha noma ukwakha imikhandlu yeseluleko. amakhono okukhuluma kahle nokubhala; amakhono obuntu; ikhono lokuxhumana kahle nomphakathi ohlosiwe; amakhono okuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga; kanye namakhono anamandla okukhokela nokuphatha abantu. Amakhono abalulekile: Ikhono lokubuka phambili nokukhokela; ukuphatha imikhandlu yomsebenzi nezimali, ukuphatha ukumaketha nokwakha isithombe senkampani, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkomba ezididiyelwe; ukuthuthukiswa kwamaphayona, ukuthuthukiswa nokuphunyiswa kwezinhlela zokumaketha, ukuphatha abaningi bokuxhumana kanye nolwazi, ukuxhumanisa nabantu abaningi ekuphumeleleni ukuhlangana, ukumaketha ngokugqamisa ulwazi oluningi, ukwenza ucwaningo, ukulawula ukusebenza okubi nokuhlolwa kokuthile, ukukhuthaza amakhono okuhlaziya izinto ezingaka qaqekile, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwaziswa, okubalulekile, ukukhulumisana nabanye ukuthola imisebenzi, amakhono okubeka igumbi, noma noma ukhuthaza izinhlelo ezizokwenza abafundi benze okuthile. Ulwazi olwembulwa ngesiqu okufanele lwaziwe ngokumaketha, ukwakha umkhandlu wokukhiqiza izinto eziyisimo, ukugcina ukumaketha futhi lawule iinkampani ezinkulu. Ikhono lokukhokela amaqembu, ukuphatha imikhandlu eminingi, ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi, ukukhuthaza ukubunjwa kwezinto ezintsha, kanye nokwakha izinhlobonhlobo ezinhle zokusebenza nabantu abaningi kuyisidingo. Ulwazi olwembulwa ngesiqu okufanele lube khona ngokuphathwa kwamaphayona okuqondile, ukumaketha izindawo, ukuphatha amaphayona eNkampani, ukumaketha, ukuphathwa kwamaphayona, ukugcina amaphuzu, izwi lomphakathi olungamukelekanga, ukusetshenziswa kokumaketha ezindaweni ezahlukene.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukisa, ukuphumeza kanye nokulawula izindlela zokumaketha nokwakha umkhankaso wamaphayona ezinhlelo zenkulumo kaHulumeni wesifundazwe i-Gauteng kanye noMkhandlu wase-Gauteng. Nikeza izinsiza eziyiseluleko ezinjengomqhweqobezinhlelo zokumaketha nokwakha eminyangweni, izinhlanganweni namaphayona ukuze kuqiniseke indlela ehlanganisiwe, edidiyelwe yokumaketha nokubeka amaphayona kunanoma yikuphi kuhulumeni. Hola uphatha ukuthuthukiswa nokuphunyiswa kwezindlela ezididiyelwe zokumaketha izinhlelo ababalule kakhulu zikaHulumeni wesiFunda waseGauteng kanye noMkhandlu waseGauteng. Nikeza isiboniso esiyisihlengo sasolwazi mayelana nezinhlelo, izinsizakalo kanye nezigaba ezibalulekile ukugqamisa ulwazi olwandulela emasimini nokutholakala kwezinsizakalo. Yakha uphumeze imikhankaso yakho yemiphumela, kanye nobunkosi benzo yonke imikhankaso yokumaketha nokuphakamisa izinhlelo nezinkomba zikaHulumeni wesifunda waseGauteng noma ukumaketha i-Gauteng njengesikhungwa esinhle sokutshalwa imali, ukuvakasha, ezemidlalo, amacembu abalulekile nezimboni zokusebenza ngobuciko. Yakha uphumeze imigomo, izinhlelo zokusiza, izinkomba, izindikimaba kanye nezinkomba, ukuze kuphumeze umbhalo kahulumu njengengxenye yokumaketha nokulinganisa imisebenzi yakho ngokuqondile. Hola ukuthuthukiswa kokumaketha, ukuqondisa nokubeka izindilinga kwezomnotho, umthombo, imithombo kanye nezinsiza zikahulumu. Lawula ukusebenza kahle nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo yemali, kanye nokulawula, ukulungisa nokuthuthukisa imikhandlu yezinto ezisizakala kwezimali kanye noMnyango webamba neziNdaba zangaphandle. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo yezimali ekwakhiweni kwemikhotho kanye neMinyango yezinselele ezinempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Lawula imisebenzi, amaphuzu amakhulu wokusiza nokwamukela izigqibo okungazange kuzalwa ngokusheshe. Lawula ukuhleleka nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo yonke ye-Directorate ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi iyenziwa ngempumelelo. Imibuzo: Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

xh.title: Umongameli: Ukuziphawula nokuthengisa
xh.summary: Kufuneka ngumongameli wokukhokela imigaqo yokuziphawula nokuthengisa kwurhulumente wephondo lakwaGauteng, kwaye kufuneka abe neSATifikethi NQF 7 kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava njengomlawuli oyinhloko.
xh.requirements: I SATifikethi NQF level 7 kwizithethi ezithengiswayo / ukuziphawula / ukudizaynwa imifanekiso / umzobo / Unxibelelwano / Unxibelelwano noluntu. Isatifikethi NQF Level 8 kule ndlela igqithiswe kuya kuba luncedo ekwenzeni ingcali. Unyaka wamashumi amahlanu (5)5 wamava phantsi komgcathi / phezulu kumqondo wolawulo ekuqambeni iifestile ezinqamlezileyo nasekuthenjisweni / ngokophando kwamava kwi Brand. Ulwimi olubaliweyo lwezimvo kunye nemisebenzi yentsini; zidibana nemisebenzi yabantu; ukuba nakho ukunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo nabantu abangathanda ukunxibelelana nabo; isakhono sokuqonda noba ingcali nokuqonda nokusombulula iingxaki; nokuze ngamandla kokuqonda njengengcali ngokukhokela abantu. Iikhompethensi ezibalulekileyo: Ulawulo olunesakhono ngakumbi ngamandla okukhokela; ukulawula iveza kunye neemali ezingekho kwindawo ephila kuyo, ukuziphawula nokuqonda ukongamele iintengiso; imbovo yokuyila iindaba ezintsha; ukulawula iveza, ukuqamba amathuba kwezithengiso, nokuqonda ukulawula iveza namathuba okunxibelelana nabantu ngokwendalo kwendalo, ukuthengisa nokuqamba amathuba onxibelelwano oluqhubekayo, ukuthengisa ngokudijithali nalwazi olusuka kwi mpandla ngokubeka iindaba ngokufundisisa, ukuvavanya nokulinganisa, ngokuqonda iingxaki, ukuyahlalutya nokuzisombulula, ukunxibelelana kubakhankenyi njengengcali kwindawo ethengiswayo, nokuzipholisa. Ulwazi olubonakalisa ngokwazi ngeBrand, nokuthengisa njengengcali ngokukhokela kwindawo igama elithi kwindawo kwindawo elihle. Ikhono lokukhokela amaqela abantu, ukulawula imisebenzi emininzi, ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokukhawuleza nokukhuthaza imveliso entsha, kwindawo ekuqalisana kuyo abakwazi ukuqalisana nabantu abantu abasuka kwindawo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi olubonakalisa ngokubanzi ngemigaqo ephethwe ngumntu ngokubanzi, njengendawo ngokuziphawula igama elihle ngokubaluleka, ukusetyenziswa igama elihle ngokuthengisa, ukusetyenziswa kolwazi Ibandla eliya phambili ngokubanzi ngamaphupha, njengengcali ngokuvakalisa iingxaki, ukukwazi ukuqwalasela iingxaki ngokubanzi zoluntu olusuka kwindawo.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso, ukuqwalasela nokusebenza kweenkcukacha zemigaqo yokuziphawula nokuthengisa ezibeka i-Gauteng Provincial Government (GPG) ne-Brand Gauteng. Nikezela ngemisebenzi yengcebiso ngamabala ezilumko ngokuziphawula nokuthengisa kumasebe ephondo, iintiti kunye nabalatheli ukuze kuqinisekiswe indlela edityanisiweyo, ehlangeneyo yokuziphawula nokubeka kwindawo ethile kuwo wonke urhulumente. Qhuba ulawule uphuhliso kwaye usebenzise iindlela ezingqamile zemigaqo yamajelo abalulekileyo amajelo abalulekileyo ohlelo lwe-Gauteng Provincial Government kunye ne-Brand Gauteng. Nikezela nokuqwalasela ngokuziphatha kwengcebiso kolwazi lokubhala nomyalezo ukuze kukhuthazwe iinkqubo, iinkonzo neenjongo ezonyusa ulwazi lwentengiso nendlela yokufikelela kwiinkonzo. Phuhlisa usebenzise amajelo okuthengisa ukuze kuqulunqwe iinkonzo, inkqubo yenyameko, nomsebenzi we-Gauteng Provincial Government kunye ne-Brand Gauteng. Nikezela isikhokelo ngokuphuhlisa iimpawu nongqinelwano lomntu ngamnye kwishishini. Lawula uvikele izixhobo zamaphawu ephondo, kuquka iilogosi, iingxelo ezimfutshane, iinkqubo zempawu ezingabonakalayo, nosakhiwo lwamaphawu kwi-GPG nase-Brand Gauteng. Khuthaza ukuthobela incwadi yongqinelwano ngabantu lwe-Gauteng Provincial Government kunye namakhandlela okuziphawula afanelekileyo ngokuqwalasela, ukulinganisa, nokuqinisekisa amasebe nentiti. Lawula ukuqhyamkelana kokuthengisa i-Gauteng njengendawo ekhethwa ukutyalwa imali, ukhenketho, imidlalo, iinkqubo ezinkulu, kwaye noshishino ongqamileyo. Yenza abathathi-nxaxheba bakwenze ukuba bajole, ubudlelwane bokusebenzisana, nakunye imizamo yokusebenzisana ukuba kukhuthazwe i-Gauteng nokuqhutywa igama elihle nokuqhamka kwindawo, nzantsi nakwamanye amazwe. Qwalasela linganisa iinkqubo zokuziphawula ngezithengiso, yenza uphando, hlalutya i data, nikezela nolwazi nokuqalise kubaphathi. Phuhlisa, usebenzise uphinda uqwalasele iimigaqo, amakhandlela, amanqanaba, nankqubo ezikhuthazayo ukuze kuqutywe i-Gauteng Provincial Government nakuqutywe i-Brand Gauteng. Lawula abantu, imali nezinye izixhobo ze-Gauteng Provincial Government ukwenza inkonzo ehamba phambili nesemgangathweni. IMIBUZO: Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

jobs.title: Director: Transversal Employee Health and Wellness
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Lead the Transversal Employee Health and Wellness Programme strategy for the Gauteng Provincial Government, aligning provincial programmes with national DPSA policies.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Social Work, Psychology, Industrial Psychology, Occupational Health and Safety or Behavioural Sciences or Medical/Health related field. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in Employee Health and Wellness, Occupational Health and Safety, or a related environment. Key Competencies: Strategic leadership in Employee Health and Wellness, extensive knowledge of EHWP Strategic Frameworks and standards relating to Occupational Health and Productivity Management, Psychosocial Support and HIV,TB and STI health promotion strategies; policy development and governance; monitoring, evaluation and reporting; stakeholder and intergovernmental relations; research and analytical skills; programme and project management; financial and people management; knowledge management; service delivery innovation; problem-solving; and strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to drive a coordinated, transversal Employee Health and Wellness Programme across the Gauteng Provincial Government.
jobs.duties: Manage and lead Employee Health and Wellness Programme Strategy in the Gauteng Provincial Government (GPG). Align provincial programmes with national policies issued by the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA). Provide strategic direction on employee wellness occupational health and psychosocial support. Drive innovation and best practices in the workplace across provincial GPG departments. Integrate EHW priorities into broader provincial transformation and human capital strategies. Manage EHWP Service providers and contracts. Oversee the performance of the contracted service providers against the SLA’s. Review service delivery and address gaps. Manage Wellness programmes by overseeing the initiatives such as Employee Assistance Programmes (HIV, TB, and STI Management, Health promotion, Mental Health Support, Substance Abuse Management, Financial Wellness and Occupational Health and Safety. Provide guidance on ethical and confidential management of employee wellness matters. Identify and mitigate risks impacting employee wellbeing and productivity. Monitor the implementation of wellness interventions. Facilitate collaboration with health and wellness institutions. Build and foster internal and external stakeholder partnerships with medical aid providers, academic institutions and wellness organisations. Represent the Programme at national and provincial forums. Manage the human, financial and other resources of the Directorate to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of services. ENQUIRES : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

af.title: Direkteur: Transversal Employee Health and Wellness
af.summary: Lei die Transversal Employee Health and Wellness Program strategie vir die Gauteng Provinciale Regering deur provinsiale programme met nasionale DPSA-beleid in te lyn.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk, Sielkunde, Bedryfsielkunde, Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid of Gedragswetenskappe of 'n Mediese/Gesondheidsverwante veld. 5 jaar ervare op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in Werknemergezondheid en Welstand, Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, of 'n verwante omgewing. Sleutelbevoegdhede: Strategiese leierskap in Werknemergezondheid en Welstand, uitgebreide kennis van WG&W Strategiese Raamwerke en standaarde rakende Beroepsgesondheid en Produktiwiteitsbestuur, Psigososiale Steun en MIV-, TB- en VIGS-gesondheidsbevorderingsstrategieë; beleidontwikkeling en goewerance; monitering, evaluering en verslagdoening; belanghebbende en interregeringsverhoudinge; navorsing en analitiese vaardighede; program- en projekbestuur; finansiële en menslike bestuur; kennisbestuur; diensleweringinnovassie; probleemoplossing; en sterk mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om 'n gekoördineerde, deursnydende Werknemergezondheids- en Welstandprogram oor die Gauteng Provinciale Regering te dryf.
af.duties: Bestuur en lei die Werknemergezondheids- en Welstandprogram-strategie in die Gauteng Proviniale Regering (GPR). Lijn provinsiale programme in met nasionale beleid wat deur die Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) uitgevaardig word. Verskaf strategiese rigting oor werknemerwelstand, beroepsgesondheid en psigososiale steun. Dryf innovasie en beste praktyke in die werkplek oor provinsiale GPR-departemente heen aan. Integreer WG&W-prioriteite in breër provinsiale transformasie- en menslike kapitaalstrategieë. Bestuur WG&W-diensverskaffers en kontrakte. Hou toesig oor die prestasie van die kontrakdiensverskaffers teen die SLA's. Hersien dienslewering en adresseer leemtes. Bestuur welstandsprogramme deur toesig te hou oor inisiatiewe soos Werknemersondersteuningsprogramme (MIV, TB en VIGS-bestuur, gesondheidsbevordering, geestesgesondheidsondersteuning, middelmisbruikbestuur, finansiële welstand en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid). Verskaf leiding oor die etiese en vertrouelike bestuur van werknemerwelstandsaangeleenthede. Identifiseer en matig risiko's wat werknemerwelstand en produktiwiteit beïnvloed. Monitor die implementering van welstandsintervensies. Fasiliteer samewerking met gesondheids- en welstandsinstansies. Bou en bevorder interne en eksterne belanghebbende vennootskappe met mediese hulpverskaffers, akademiese instansies en welstandsorganisasies. Verteenwoordig die Program by nasionale en provinsiale forums. Bestuur die menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die Direktoraat om die effektiewe en doeltreffende lewer van dienste te verseker. NAVRAE : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

zu.title: Umongameli: Izinhlelo Zempilo Nephilisi Yabasebenzi
zu.summary: Hola inqubomgomo yenqubo Yezempilo Nephilisi Yabasebenzi kuGauteng Provincial Government, bese uhlanganisa izinhlelo zesifunda nezinqubomgomo zezwe zeDPSA.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF 7 kwiSocial Work, iPsychology, iIndustrial Psychology, iOccupational Health and Safety noma iBehavioural Sciences noma izifundo ezihlobene nezokwelashwa / ezempilo. Uzovuna unyaka we-5 wokutholakala ngokuhola kwabaphathi abangaphakathi noma abaphezulu kuEmployee Health and Wellness, iOccupational Health and Safety, noma endaweni ehlobene nalokho. Amakhono abalulekile: ukuhola ngokuhle mayelana nezinhlela ezinhle kakhulu ze-EHWP kanye nemigomo ehlobene neqaphela kokuhlinzekwa kwezokwakha izinto ezinhle, ukuqinisekiswa kokuphumelela, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo; ukwakheka kohlelo lokusebenza nokuhlelwa kwemisebenzi; ukuqapha, ukuhlola futhi kubike imisebenzi; ukubambisana nabantu ngokwemithetho yohulumeni; ukuphumelela ngokuhlola bese uhlola ngokuphumelela okuhle kakhulu; ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi kanye nemikhuba; ukuphathwa kwemali nokuqapha abantu; ukuphathwa kolwazi; ukuqinisekiswa kokuphumelela ngosizo ngokuzenzakalela; ukuxazulula izinkinga; nokuphumelela okuhle ngokukhuluma nokuwasha. Ukugqugquzela kwaye ubambe iqhaza ekuvakatsheleni kohlelo lokusebenza ngokuhamba kwesikhathi mayelana namaphila nabasebenzi ohlelweni lukahulumeni oluseGauteng Provincial Government.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhole inqubo yenhlekelele yenkululeko Yezempilo Nephilisi komsebenzi ohwebelayo kwabahulumeni baseningizimu yeGauteng (GPG). Hlanganisela izinhlelo zesifunda nezinqubomgomo zezwe ezikhishwa umnyango Wezikhambi Zentengiso kahulumeni (DPSA). Nikeza isiqondiso sezinhlelo mayelana nempilo yabasebenzi, yezempilo zomsebenzi kanye nokesikhashana komzwelo. Qhuba inhlelo yokusebenza kabusha kanye nezindlela ezihamba phambili endaweni yomsebenzi kumiminye yezingxenye zabo bonke abahulumeni baseGauteng (GPG). Hlanganisa izinhloso ezibalulekile ezinhleweni ezihamba phambili ezindaweni zokushintsha kanye nenhlelo yamandla abantu esifundeni. Lawula abanikezeli ngezenhlaka zenkululeko yezempilo nephilisi komsebenzi kanye namaqiniso. Qapha ukuphumelela kwabanikezeli bemisebenzi behlaka kusuka kuyo yonke imisebenzi (SLA's). Phinda ubuke imisebenzi kanye nezikhewu ezikhona zihlolwe bese zizonqulwa. Lawula imiyalo yezinhlebo ngokuhlola izinhlelo ezifana nalezo esinikeza abantu abangavumi ukulalela (ukuphathwa kwe-HIV, i-TB, kanye ne-STI, ukukhuthazwa kwezempilo, ukwesekwa komphakathi ngokwengqondo, ukuphathwa kokubhema izidakamizwa, ukuzinza ezimalini kanye nokuvikeleka kwezempilo kanye nobulungiswa bokugqama ezindaweni zokusebenza). Nikeza iseluleko mayelana nokuphathwa kobulungiswa okufanele kwezinto ezingasese zezempilo yabasebenzi. Thola bese unciphisa izinkinga ezibaletha empilweni kanye nokuphumelela ngokuphila kwabasebenzi. Hlola ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezinhle eziholelekile ngokuphumelela komsebenzi. Hlanganisa imigqa esizayo ukukhulumisana nabo, ngendlela yokufuna imisebenzi, kanye nenhlelo yokusebenza kwezinyanga zempilo yomphakathi. Phakamisa bese usakaza abahlanganyelana nabahlanganyelana abaphakathi namaphandle ngokusebenzisa imitholampilo yezempilo, izikhungo zemfundo kanye nezinkampani ezibhukuda ezinhle. Mengeza isihlalo ngokwemisebenzi yezwe kanye neyasingasingeni. Hola imitholampilo yezempilo kanye nezinye izinsizakusebenza zeDirectorate ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isetshenziswa ngokupumelelayo, ngokuphumelela okuhle kakhulu. IMIBUZO: Nkosazana Khanyisile Mafiri, ucingo: (011) 355 6060

xh.title: Umongameli: Iinkqubo zezezempilo nze kubasebenzi eziquka iindawo zonke
xh.summary: Qhuba inqubo lemisitho yamaphulo ezindaweni ezahlukeneyo ezezezempilo nze kubasebenzi kulawulo lwesiPhondo seGauteng, ngokuvumelanisa iinkqubo zamaphondo ezinobumbano namagunya avela kwi-DPSA kazwelonke.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso seNQF level 7 kwiSocial Work, Psychology, Industrial Psychology, Occupational Health and Safety, Behavioural Sciences okanye kummandla onxulumene nezonyango/impilo. 5 iminyaka yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lolawulo kwiinkqubo zezezempilo nze kubasebenzi, Occupational Health and Safety, okanye kwindawo enxulumene naleyondawo. Amandla aphambili: Ukulathelelana ngokobuchule ekulawulweni iinkqubo zezezempilo nze kubasebenzi, ulwazi olusasileyo malunga ne-EHWP Strategic Frameworks namazinga anxulumene noLawulo lweMpiIelo yokuSebenza nokuGcina impilo yeNgqondo, inkxaso ye- Psychosocial Support kunye n'amaphulo okuthuthuzisa impilo aye kwi-HIV,TB ne-STI; ukuhlelwa kolawulo nokulawula iindaba; ukuqaphela, ukulinganisa kwaye kwenziwe isibhengezo; ubudlelwane nabathintekayo nangamanye amasebe karhulumente; uphononongo nakhono lokuhlola ungcangca; ulawulo lwenkqubo namaphulo eentsapho; ulawulo lweemali nabantu; ulawulo lolwazi; amaphulo ezenzo eentsapho ezintsha; isisombululi sezinkinga; nakhono olunamandla okubhala nokuqhathanisa. Amandla okuqhuba inkqubo ebumbene, equka iindawo zonke yezempilo nze kubasebenzi kulo lonke ulawulo lwesiPhondo seGauteng.
xh.duties: Lawula uze ulathe iSasulu leNkqubo yeZezempilo nze kubasebenzi kulawulo lwesiPhondo seGauteng (GPG). Linganisa iinkqubo zamaphulu namagunya kazwelonke apapashwe yiDepartment of Public Service and Administration (DPSA). Zele isalathiso esibetha ijija ngokubumbano ekusesekweni kweempilo zabasebenzi, uzempilo ngokomsebenzi ngenkxaso yengqondo. Qhuba izinto ezintsha nendlela ezilungileyo kwindawo yokusebenza kumasebe wonke e-GPG. Hlanganisa iimfuno eziphambili ze-EHW kwisalathiso esibanzi soguqulo lomntu kwiphondo lonke nasemiseni yamaphulo abantu. Lawula ababoneleli bezenzo ze-EHWP nemitshato. Qaphela ukusebenza kwababoneleli bemisebenzi abanemitshato ngokwe-SLA's. Phawula ulawulo lwemisebenzi uze ulungise izikhewu. Lawula iinkqubo ezisesekweni ngokuphawula amaphulo afana noLawulo lomsebenzi wabasebenzi (HIV, TB, kunye noLawulo lwe-STI, ukuthuthuzisa impilo, inkxaso yeMental Health, uLawulo lokuSetyenziswa kwezibanga, izezimali ezisesekwenyo ngezempilo kunye noLawulo loMogo wokuSebenza. Nikeza isalathiso ngolawulo oluyikrwaqonda nolulinganiswayo lwezempilo zabasebenzi ezikwidango. Qaphela uze ulungise iingozi ezithintela impilo yomsebenzi naye inkqubo yakhe. Qaphela ukwenziwa kwezenzo ezisiza impilo yomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ubudlelwane nemiYili yezempilo nze kubasebenzi. Yila uze waphuhlisa ubudlelwano ngaphakathi nangaphandle namaboneleli afana namabhungano okuNyango, iziko zobufundisi kunye namabhungano asebenzela ukusesekwa kwezempilo zabasebenzi. Mela iNkqubo kumabhungano ezizwe naphakade. Lawula abantu, iimali nolunye ulwazi kwiSebe ukwenzela kutholakale ukwethulwa kwemisebenzi elungileyo nesenziweni. IMIBUZO : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

jobs.title: Director: Strategic HR Planning and Reporting
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Director role in the Office of the Premier overseeing strategic HR planning, policy development, compliance monitoring and reporting across Gauteng provincial government.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Human Resource Management, Human Resource Development, Industrial Psychology, Public Administration. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in Human Resource Management environment. Extensive Knowledge and understanding of the Public Service Act., Public Service Regulations, relevant DPSA Prescripts and all the related legislation. Key Competencies: Proven strategic leadership and management capability, people management and empowerment, programme and project management, financial management, and change management. Demonstrable expertise in strategic human resource planning, workforce analytics, HR reporting, succession planning, monitoring and evaluation, and knowledge management. Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, communication, governance, and policy development skills are essential to coordinate transversal HR planning initiatives across the Gauteng Provincial Government, provide evidence-based advice to executive management, ensure compliance with public service prescripts, and drive workforce optimisation and organisational performance improvement.
jobs.duties: Manage the development, review and communication of provincial and transversal Human Resource (HR) policies, strategies, frameworks and guidelines to ensure alignment with national and provincial prescripts. Oversee the monitoring and evaluation of compliance with HR policies, frameworks, strategies and procedures across Gauteng Provincial Government (GPG) departments, and provide strategic advice and interventions where gaps are identified. Manage the provision of strategic Human Resource Planning and Reporting services by assessing departmental HR Plans in line with DPSA requirements, providing feedback to departments, monitoring implementation, consolidating reports and coordinating submissions to the DPSA. Oversee the management of Human Resource Management Information Systems (HRMIS) and the analysis of workforce information, including vacancy rates, turnover rates, headcounts, employment equity, demographic trends and other HR indicators, to support evidence-based decision-making. Develop and coordinate HR interventions based on workforce analytics and provide strategic guidance and recommendations to Executives and departments on HR planning, workforce trends and human capital management matters. Provide strategic advice and support to departments on Human Resource Administration, Human Resource Development and Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) for employees at SMS and Levels 1–12. Monitor compliance with HR legislative and regulatory prescripts and provide consolidated quarterly and annual reports on HR management practices across the GPG. Manage the human, financial and other resources of the Directorate to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of services. ENQUIRES : sMs Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

af.title: Direkteur: Strategiese HR-beplanning en Verslagdoening

af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling, Bedryfsielkunde, Publieke Administrasie. 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing. Uitgebreide kennis en begrip van die Openbare Dienswet., Openbare Diensregulasies, tersaaklike DPSA-Voorwaardes en alle verwante wetgewing. Sleutelbevoegdhede: Bewese strategiese leierskap- en bestuursvermoë, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, programme- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, en veranderingbestuur. Toonbare kundigheid in strategiese menslike hulpbronbeplanning, werkmagontleding, HR-verslagdoening, opvolgbeplanning, monitering en evaluering, en kennisbestuur. Sterke analitiese, probleemoplossings-, belanghebbende-bestuurs-, kommunikasie-, goederbestuurs-, en beleidsontwikkelingsvaardighede is noodsaaklik om transversale HR-beplanningsinisiatiewe regdeur die Gauteng Provinsiale Regering te koördineer, getuienisgebaseerde advies aan uitvoerende bestuur te verskaf, nakoming van openbare diensvoorwaardes te verseker, en werkragsoptimalisering en organisatoriese prestasieverbetering te drywe.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening en kommunikasie van provinsiale en transversale Menslike Hulpbron (HR)-beleide, strategieë, raamwerke en riglyne om ooreenstemming met nasionale en provinsiale voorwaardes te verseker. Hou toesig oor die monitering en evaluering van nakoming van HR-beleide, raamwerke, strategieë en prosedures regdeur Gauteng Provinsiale Regering (GPG)-departemente, en verskaf strategiese advies en intervensies waar gapings geïdentifiseer word. Bestuur die verskaffing van strategiese Menslike Hulpbronbeplannings- en Verslagdoeningsdienste deur departementele HR-planne in ooreenstemming met DPSA-vereistes te assesseer, terugvoer aan departemente te verskaf, implementering te monitor, verslae te konsolideer en voorleggings aan die DPSA te koördineer. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronbestuursinligtingstelsels (HRMIS) en die ontleding van werkmaginligting, insluitend vakansiekoerse, omsetkoerse, hooftellings, indiensneem-gelykheid, demografiese tendense en ander HR-aanwysers, om getuienisgebaseerde besluitneming te ondersteun. Ontwikkel en koördineer HR-intervensies gebaseer op werkragontleding en verskaf strategiese leiding en aanbevelings aan uitvoerendes en departemente oor HR-beplanning, werkragtendense en menslike kapitaalbestuursake. Verskaf strategiese advies en ondersteuning aan departemente oor Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie, Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling en Prestasiebestuur- en Ontwikkelingstelsels (PMDS) vir werknemers op SMS en Vlakke 1–12. Monitor nakoming van HR-wetgewende en regulatoriese voorwaardes en verskaf gekonsolideerde kwartaal- en jaarverslae oor HR-bestuurspraktyke regdeur die GPG.
