zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumholi e-Office of the Premier sokubukeza ukuhlela kobuhlakani babaBantu, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, ukulandelwa kokuhambisana kwezinqubo nokubika kuyo yonke i-Gauteng provincial government.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezikulelinga le-NQF level 7 kwi-Human Resource Management, Human Resource Development, Industrial Psychology, Public Administration. Unyaka we-5 wamazwana ezingeni eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokuphatha kwendawo ye-Human Resource Management. Ulwazi olusanda nokuqonda kakuhle i-Public Service Act., i-Public Service Regulations, imiyalo ehambisana ye-DPSA kanye nayo yonke eminye imithetho ehlobene nayo. Amakhono abalulekile: Ubungcweti obungabukwa bokuba ngumholi obusobuhlakini kanye nokulawula, ukulawula abantu kanye nokubakhulisa amandla, ukulawula izinhlelo namaphrojekthi, ukulawula imali, kanye nokulawula izinguquko. Ubuchwepheshe obubonakalayo ekuhleni kobuhlakani babaBantu, ukuhlaziya amandla abasebenzi, ukubika kwe-HR, ukuhlela ukulandelana kwabaholi, ukubuka kanye nokuqokomisa, kanye nokulawula ulwazi. Amandla okuhlaziya izinkinga, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwabathintekayo, ukuthuthukisana kolimi, ukulawula, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo ababalulekile ukuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlela i-HR ezingangeziwe kuyo yonke i-Gauteng Provincial Government, ukunikeza izeluleko ezisezindabeni ezinobufakho kokuphathwa kweziphathi, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemiyalo yesevisi yomphakathi, kanye nokukhuthaza ukulunga kwamandla abasebenzi nokuphucula ukusebenza kwenhlangano.
zu.duties: Lawula ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekezwa kanye nokuxhumana kwezinqubomgomo ze-HR zesifundazwe kanye nezongezezelweyo, izindlela, izakhiwo kanye nencazelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nemiyalo yezwe nesifundazwe. Bukeza ukulandela nokuhlolwa kokuhambisana kwezinqubomgomo ze-HR, izakhiwo, izindlela kanye nezinqubo kuyo yonke eminyango ye-Gauteng Provincial Government (GPG), bese kunikeza izeluleko zokubuqhakamshela kanye nokungenelela lapho kubonakalisa izikhala. Lawula ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuhelela i-Human Resource Planning and Reporting ngokuqagula amapulani e-HR emnyango ngokuhambisana nezidingo ze-DPSA, ukunikeza impendulo eminyangweni, ukubuka ukusetshenziswa, ukuhlanganisa imibiko kanye nokuhlanganisa okunikelwa i-DPSA. Bukeza ukuphathwa kwe-Human Resource Management Information Systems (HRMIS) kanye nokuqhathaniswa kolwazi ngamandla abasebenzi, okuhlanganisa izinga lezikhala, izinga lokushintsha, inani labantu, ukulingana kwezinkalo, ukwehla kwabantu okuhlotshaniswe nesikhathi namanye okuhlalwe kwelungelo le-HR ukweseka ukwenza izinqumo ezisezindabeni ezinobufakho. Thuthukisa futhi uhlanganise ukungenelela kwe-HR ngokususelwa ekuhlaziyweni kwamandla abasebenzi bese unikeza izeluleko kanye nezincomo eziphathini nasemnyangweni mayelana nokuhelela i-HR, ukuthambeka kwamandla abasebenzi kanye nezindaba zokulawula izindlalifa zabantu. Nikeza izeluleko zokubuqhakamshela kanye nokweseka emnyangweni nge-Human Resource Administration, Human Resource Development kanye Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) kubasebenzi abasezingeni le-SMS kanye nama-Level 1–12. Buka ukuzinza ngokuhambisana nemithetho nemitsetfo ye-HR bese unikeza imibiko ehlanganisiwe yenyanga nenyanga ngekhathi kanyekanye nenyaga zonke ngokuqhubwa kwamapolangokusebenza e-HR kuyo yonke i-GPG. Lawula abantu, imali kanye nezinye izinsiza ze-Directorate ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa okusebenzayo nokuqhubekayo kwezinsiza. IMIBUZO : sMs Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

xh.title: Umlawuli: Uqheliselo lweQhinga le-HR nokuxela
xh.summary: Indima kaMlawuli kwi-Office of the Premier elawula uqheliselo lweqhinga le-HR, ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo, ukugqiba ukuthintelela nokuxela kulo onke urhulumente wephondo lwa Gauteng.
xh.requirements: Isifungo samabakala esinqanaba se-NQF 7 kwiHuman Resource Management, Human Resource Development, Industrial Psychology, Public Administration. Iminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/phezulu lolawulo kwimeko yeHuman Resource Management. ULwazi olubanzi nokuqonda i-Public Service Act., i-Public Service Regulations, izibhalo ezifaneleyo ze-DPSA kunye nayo yonke imithetho edityaneyo. Amandla aPhambili: Amandla abonakalayo abukhulu beqhinga lokulawula nokulawula abantu, ukulawula nokunikela amandla abantu, ukulawula iinkqubo namaprojekthi, ukulawula imali, nokulawula utshintsho. Ubuchwepheshe obubonakalayo kwisiqhinga soqheliselo lwe-HR, uhlalutyo lwamandla omsebenzi, ukuxela kwe-HR, uqheliselo lokulandela, ukuqapha nokuqikelela, kunye nokulawula ulwazi. Amandla amakhulu oohlalutyo, eziyaxabiso ezingxaki, ukulawula abathintelwa, nokuqhathanisa, kolawulo, nokuqhathanisa iinkqubo, kwe-Iiakhoni nentsika, nokuphuhlisa iinkqubo kukho kubaluleke kakhulu ukwenzela ukubamba iingcinga ezidibana phakathi koqheliselo lwe-HR kulo onke urhulumente wephondo lwa Gauteng, ukunikela iingcebiso ezisekelwe kwimfundo kulawulo oluphezulu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthintelela ngeenkqubo zorhulumente, nokuqhuba ukusebenza kwamandla omsebenzi nokuqhubekeka kokwenza koluntu.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphuhliswa, ukucinga nokunyaniseka kweenkqubo ze-HR zamaphondo nangaphezulu, iinqwelo-moya, iinkqubo ezingundoqo kuneenaelo kulo onke amasebe orhulumente wephondo lwa Gauteng, kwaye unike iingcebiso nentsika ngokwenza apho kubonakalise iindawo ezingekoyo. Lawula ukubonelela ngeenkqubo ezisesikweni zoqheliselo lwe-HR nokuxela ngokuqikelela iindlela ze-HR zamasebe ngokwemfuno ye-DPSA, ukunika amaseba impendulo, ukuqapha ukusebenza, ukudibanisa iingxelo nokubamba ngokunyanga iziphumezo kwi-DPSA. Qonda ekubeni kusetyenziswa iinkqubo ze-Human Resource Management Information Systems (HRMIS) nokuqamba kwamaxa ethu oluqheliselo lwamandla omsebenzi, kuqala kwindlela ezizeyo, ukutsha kwamandla omsebenzi, ukubala abantu, ukulingana komsebenzi, iindlela ezahlukeneyo zeziqalo ezihlala kuqala, kwaye ezinye iinkqacha eziqhelisela ukusebenza koluntu ukuyixhasa nokuqinisekisa izigqibo. Phuhlisa ukuqonda ngokuthintela ngokubakho koluntu ngeenkqubo ze-HR ezisekelwe kwiziphumo zulwazi woqheliselo lwamandla omsebenzi, ukulawula iimpongamlilo ezincithekileyo eziguqukayo kunye nezinye iziphakamiso ngokubonelela izikhululi ezingagqibekanga ngelwazi, iziphakamiso neziqibo ngabasebenzi bazo, kwiindlela eziguqukayo zabasebenzi kumacandelo amabini aqhambayo phantsi kolawulo oluqhubekayo phantsi kwekhompyutha yokubala. Thintela ukuthintela ngokumthetho kubasebenzi bakawonke-wonke, kwaye wadibanisa kwaye uphonononge ngokwemfuno yamasebe abakwamaphondo, apho khona athintela iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ezinguqukayo namakhaladi abuyela ngokomthetho oqhelisela iindawo ezahlukeneyo eziqhelisela iindawo ezahlukeneyo ezintathu ezisebenzayo. Lawula ngokupheleleyo iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezisekelwe kwinkqubo ye-Public Service Act, kwiinkalo ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo ngokweenkalo ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo. Lawula iindlu, imali, nezinye iziseko ezingundoqo kwinkqubo ekuqhelisela ukwenza ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba izigqibo zenziwa ngokuchanekileyo. ENQUIRES : sMs Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

jobs.title: Director: GPG Public Liaison Hotline
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Director role leading the Gauteng Public Liaison Hotline strategy, governance frameworks, and citizen engagement programmes within the Office of the Premier.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Public Administration, Management, Social Sciences, Customer Relations Management, Communications, or related field. A postgraduate qualification in the related fields will be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in customer service, complaints management, call centre operations, stakeholder engagement, public participation, case management systems, data analytics, intergovernmental relations or service delivery management. Key Competencies: Demonstrable strategic leadership and management capabilities, with sound knowledge of customer relationship management, public liaison services, complaints and query management, service delivery improvement, stakeholder engagement, and public service governance. Strong intergovernmental relations skills, with the ability to coordinate and collaborate across government spheres and stakeholders to enhance service delivery and citizen satisfaction. Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, project management, people management, financial management, and report-writing skills are essential, together with a commitment to Batho Pele principles, accountability, innovation, and service excellence.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership in the development and implementation of the Provincial Customer Interface and Public Liaison Hotline Strategy, including the establishment of governance frameworks, policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), service standards and citizen engagement programmes in line with Batho Pele principles, POPIA, Public Service Act. and related prescripts. Manage the day-to-day operations of the Hotline and customer contact channels, ensuring the effective logging, referral, tracking and resolution of citizen enquiries and complaints. Drive service excellence through quality assurance, customer experience improvement initiatives, and the promotion of a citizen-centred service culture across the Gauteng Province. Manage stakeholder, intergovernmental and interdepartmental relations to facilitate coordinated responses to service delivery issues. Negotiate and manage service standards, Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs), and represent the Office of the Premier in relevant intergovernmental and service delivery forums. Monitor compliance with service standards and turnaround times, analyse citizen feedback and service delivery trends, and provide strategic reports and recommendations to executive management. Provide evidence-based reports and strategic advice to Executive Management, EXCO, MECs and other governance structures, while ensuring data integrity, reporting accuracy, audit readiness and compliance with applicable information management and governance requirements. Oversee the management of external service providers supporting the Hotline, ensure data integrity and reporting compliance. Identify and mitigate operational and service delivery risks, strengthen internal controls, drive innovation and continuous improvement to enhance government responsiveness and citizen satisfaction. Manage the human, financial and other resources of the Directorate to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of services. ENQUIRES : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted only online at www.gautengonline.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity documents and other supporting documents on or before the interview date, as directed by Human Resources. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attend a DPSA-prescribed SMS Competency Assessment if recommended by the Selection Committee following the interview process. Appointment to an SMS post is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Pre-Entry Programme (Certificate for Entry into the SMS) offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The successful candidate must provide proof of registration and successful completion of the programme prior to appointment. The cost of the programme is for the applicant's own account. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: GPG Publieke Skakelbelyn
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat die Gauteng Publieke Skakelbelyn-strategie, bestuursraamwerke en burgerbetrokkenheidsprogramme binne die Office of the Premier lei.
af.requirements: 'n NQF vlak 7 kwalifikasie in Openbare Bestuur, Bestuurswetenskappe, Sosiale Wetenskappe, Kliëntverhoudingsbestuur, Kommunikasie, of 'n verwante veld. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in die verwante velde sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel/senior bestuursvlak in kliëntdiens, klagtebestuur, oproepsentrum-bedrywighede, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, publieke deelname, saakbestuurstelsels, data-analise, interregeringsbetrekkinge of diensleweringbestuur. Sleutelsbevoegdhede: Aantoonbare strategiese leierskap- en bestuursvermoëns, met deeglike kennis van kliëntverhoudingsbestuur, publieke skakeldienste, klagte- en navraagbestuur, diensleweringverbetering, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, en openbare diensbestuur. Sterk interregeringsbetrekking-vaardighede, met die vermoë om te koördineer en saam te werk regeringsfere en belanghebbendes om dienslewering en burgersatisfaksie te verbeter. Sterk analitiese, kommunikasie-, onderhandelings-, probleemoplossings-, projekbestuurs-, mensebestuurs-, finansiële bestuurs- en verslagskryfvaardighede is essensieel, tesame met 'n toewyding aan Batho Pele-beginsels, aanspreeklikheid, innovasie en diensuitmuntendheid.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Provinsiale Kliëntkoppelings- en Publieke Skakelbelyn-strategie, insluitend die daarstelling van bestuursraamwerke, beleide, Standaardbedryfsprosedures (SBP's), diensstandaarde en burgerbetrokkenheidsprogramme in ooreenstemming met Batho Pele-beginsels, POPIA, die Openbare Dienswet en verwante voorskrifte. Bestuur die daaglikse bedrywighede van die Skakelbelyn en kliëntkanale, en verseker die doeltreffende registrering, verwysing, opvolging en oplossing van burgernavrae en klagtes. Druk diensuitmuntendheid aan deur gehaltversekering, inisiatiewe ter verbetering van die kliëntervaring, en die bevordering van 'n burgergesentreerde dienskultuur reg Gauteng. Bestuur belanghebbende, interregerings- en interdepartementele betrekkinge om gekoördineerde reaksies op dienslewering kwessies te fasiliteer. Onderhandel en bestuur diensstandaarde, Diensvlakooreenkomste (SLA's) en Memorandums van Ooreenkoms (MOU's), en verteenwoordig die Office of the Premier in tersaaklike interregerings- en diensleweringsforums. Monitor nakoming van diensstandaarde en omkeringstye, analiseer burgerterugvoer en diensleweringstendense, en verskaf strategiese verslae en voorstelle aan uitvoerende bestuur. Verskaf bewysgebaseerde verslae en strategiese advies aan Uitvoerende Bestuur, EXCO, MEC's en ander bestuursstrukture, terwyl data-integriteit, verslagdoennauwkeurigheid, ouditgereedheid en nakoming van toepaslike inligtingsbestuurs- en bestuursvereistes verseker word. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van eksterne diensverskaffers wat die Skakelbelyn ondersteun, en verseker data-integriteit en verslagdoennakoming. Identifiseer en matig operasionele en dienslewering risiko's, versterk interne kontroles, dryf innovasie en deurlopende verbetering aan om regeringsresponsiwiteit en burgersatisfaksie te verbeter. Bestuur die menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die Direktoraat om die doeltreffende en effektiewe lewering van dienste te verseker. NAVRAE: Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

zu.title: Umholi: I-GPG Public Liaison Hotline
zu.summary: Isikhundla somholi sokukhokhela inqubomgomo ye-Gauteng Public Liaison Hotline, izakhiwo zolawulo, kanye namaphrogramu okubandakanya abantu bendawo ngaphakathi kwe-Office of the Premier.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesigaba se-NQF level 7 e-Public Administration, Management, Social Sciences, Customer Relations Management, Communications, noma enye indlela ehlobene. I-quification yesiqu esiphezulu kuleyo ndlela ezingaba yinzuzo ehambahamba. Uzothola 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in customer service, complaints management, call centre operations, stakeholder engagement, public participation, case management systems, data analytics, intergovernmental relations or service delivery management. Izindlela eziyinhloko zokukwazi: Ukukhombisa amandla okuba ngumholi olawulayo nokuqondiswa kokuqonda, njengoba kukhona ulwazi oluhle lokuphatha ubuhlobo namakhasimende, izinsiza zokuxhumana nomphakathi, ukuphatha izikhalazo nezibuzo, ukuthuthuka kokulethwa kwezinsiza, ukubandakanya iziphanzi, kanye nolawulo lomphakathi. Amasobhoji ohlelo lwangaphakathi nezinyawo zokuxhumana phakathi kahulumeni, ngamandla okuhlanganisa futhi kusebenze ngokuhlangenwe ndawonye emikhakheni yonke kahulumeni neziphanzi ukuze kuphuculwe ukulethwa kwezinsiza nokwaneliseka kwabantu. Amasobhoji aqinile okuhlaziya imininingwane, okuxhumana, okuxoxa ngokuvumelana, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuphatha abantu, ukuphatha imali, nokubhala imibiko ayadingeka kakhulu, kanye nokuqinisela imigomo ye-Batho Pele, ukubhekana phansi, okusha, kanye nokuphumelela ekuletheni izinsiza.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso esinguqansi ekuthuthukisweni nokusebenziseni inqubomgomo ye-Provincial Customer Interface kanye ne-Public Liaison Hotline Strategy, okuhlanganisa nokumiswa kwezakhiwo zolawulo, imigomo, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), izindlela zokuletha izinsiza, namaphrogramu okubandakanya abantu bendawo ngokuvumelana nemigomo ye-Batho Pele, POPIA, Public Service Act, kanye nezinye iziqondiso. Phatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke ye-Hotline kanye nezindlela zokuqhagamshelana namakhasimende, uqinisekise ukushaywa kumaphayonisi, ukuthunyelwa kwemibuzo, ukulandelwa, kanye nokuxazululwa kwezikhalazo nezibuzo zabantu. Qhuba ukuphumelela ekuletheni izinsiza ngokubheka kakhulu ubuhle, okukhuthazwa ukuba ngomkhiqizo oyinhle, ngamaphrojekthi okuthuthukiswa kokuhlola, kanye nokukhuthaza inhlalo yokulethwa izinsiza eziqondene nabantu kuwo wonke ama-Gauteng Province. Phatha ubuhlobo, okungaphakathi komphakathi kanye nama-department ukwenza ukubonisana ngemibuzo yokulethwa izinsiza. Xoxisana futhi ulawule izindlela zokuletha izinsiza, Service Level Agreements (SLAs) kanye nama-Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs), futhi umele i-Office of the Premier kumaforyamu okulethwa izinsiza ngaphakathi kahulumeni. Lilise ukuvumelana nezindlela zokuletha izinsiza kanye nesikhathi sokuqedwa, hlaziya imibiko yabantu kanye nokuqhubeleka kokulethwa izinsiza, futhi unike imibiko ebusobho ekukhokhelweni. Hlinzeka ngezibonakaliso nemibiko ebusobho nokweluleka u-Executive Management, i-EXCO, ama-MEC kanye nezinye izakhiwo zolawulo, ulondoloze ukuzinza kwemibhalo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imibiko ilungile, ulungele ukuphenya kanye nokuvumelana nezidingo ezenziwe zokuphatha imininingwane kanye nokulawula. Qaphelwa ukuphathiwe kwabahlinzeki abangaphandle abasekela i-Hotline, uqinisekise ukuzinza kwemibhalo kanye nokuvumelana kokubika. Bonwe futhi ususe amaphuzu amabi nokuqhubelela kwabi ekuletheni izinsiza, ukugqamisa ukuphathwa okwangaphakathi, ukukhuthaza okusha nokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo ukuze kuphuculwe ukuzwa kahulumeni nokwaneliseka kwabantu. Phatha abantu, imali, kanye nezinye izinsiza ze-Directorate ukuze kulethwe izinsiza ngeqiniso ngokusebenza kahle ngokuphelele. IMIBUZO : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

xh.title: Umongameli: iGPG Public Liaison Hotline
xh.summary: Isikhundla somongameli esikhokela i-Gauteng Public Liaison Hotline kwinqanaba le-strategy, iinkqubo zolawulo, kunye namajelo abathathi-nxaxheba abangammi ngaphakathi kwi-Office of the Premier.
xh.requirements: Isifundo se-NQF level 7 kwi-Public Administration, Management, Social Sciences, Customer Relations Management, Communications, okanye ndlela ephathelene nayo. Isifundo samangapha kwesidanga kwizinto ezinxulumene nendlela iyakuba ngenzuzo. Iminyaka engama-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokulawula kwindlela yonke yamakhasimende, ulawulo lweziphesheli, iziphelo zomsebenzi we-call centre, unxibelelwano namajelo abathathi-nxaxheba, ungamatho koluntu, iinkqubo zolawulo lezimeko, ukuhlaziywa kwedata, uqhagamshelo phakathi kamarhulumente okanye ulawulo lonikezelo lweenkonzo. Amakhono abalulekileyo: Ukubonisa amandla okukhokela ngokwesiqhelo kwaye ulawule ngokwemaxabiso, ngokuqonda okusemandleni kwendlela yokulawula unxibelelwano namakhasimende, iinkonzo zoluntu, ulawulo lweziphesheli nemibuzo, ukuphucula ulawulo lonikezelo lweenkonzo, unxibelelwano namajelo abathathi-nxaxheba, nolawulo loluntu. Amakhono amaninzi oqhagamshelo phakathi kamarhulumente, anamandla okulungelelanisa nokusebenzisana phakathi kweendawo zikarhulumente namajelo abathathi-nxaxheba ukuphucula ulawulo lonikezelo lweenkonzo nolwaneliseko labantu. Amandla okucinga, okunxibelelana, okuxoxisana ngexabiso, okusombulula iingxaki, okulawula amaxwebhu, okulawula abantu, okulawula izimali, nokubhala iingxelo ngamandla, zibalulekile, kwaye kufuneka uzithobe kwimigaqo ye-Batho Pele, kuqondekile, angathanda ukwenza izinto ngendlela entsha, kwaye akhusele ulawulo olugqwesileyo.
xh.duties: Dlala indima ephambili kwizikhokelo ekwakhiweni nokuzezelwa kwenkqubo yoluntu yokunxibelelana namakhasimende kunye neGauteng Public Liaison Hotline, kuquka nokuqhelanisa iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo ezilawulayo, iinkqubo ezichanekileyo zomsebenzi (SOPs), iinkqubo zoluntu nasekusingathweni koluntu ngokwemigaqo ye-Batho Pele, i-POPIA, i-Public Service Act. nezinye iinkqubo ezilawulayo. Lawula iinkqubo zosuku nosuku ze-Hotline nendlela abantu banxibelelana ngayo namakhasimende, kuqinisekiswa ukubhalwa okusebenzayo, ukuthunyelwa, ukulandwa nokusombululwa kwemibuzo yammi nabantu iphethwe yona. Phucula inkonzo ngokwamaxabiso, ngokusombulula iingxaki zamakhasimende, nokukhuthaza inkqubo eqonde kummi kulo onke i-Gauteng Province. Lawula unxibelelwano namajelo abathathi-nxaxheba, phakathi kamarhulumente nasephasini kuqhubekela ekubeni kusombululwe iingxaki ekunikezelweni kweenkonzo. Xoxa ngamaxesha wamakhasimende kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zoluntu, iinkqubo ezichanekileyo ze-Service Level Agreements (SLAs) kunye nemigaqo yokuqonda (MOUs), uze umele i-Office of the Premier kulawulo olubalulekileyo lwamakhasimende kwamanye amasebe. Qaphela ukuthobela iinkqubo zoluntu, ukukhawulela ekuphendulweni, uhlalutye imibuzo yamakhasimende nendlela ezikhusela uluntu kwinkonzo abayifunayo, uze unike iingxelo ngokuchanekileyo nezindululo kulawulo. Zeza iingxelo ngokwamaxabiso ngezindululo kulawulo, i-EXCO, aba-CEC namanye amajelo abalawulo, kuqinisekiswa ukuba idatha ichanekile, iingxelo zichanekile, zilungele ukuqwalaselwa kwaye zithobela iinkqubo ezilawula ukugcinwa kolwazi. Lawula ngaphandle abanikezeli benkonzo abasiza i-Hotline, qinisekisa ukuba idatha ichanekile kwaye iingxelo zithobela iinkqubo. Phawula kwaye ususe iingozi kwinkqubo kunye nonikezelo lweenkonzo, qinisa ukulawula ngaphakathi, khuthaza izinto ezintsha nokuphucula inkqubo ngokuqhubekayo ukuze uphucule ukuphendula kwarhulumente nolwaneliseko labantu. Lawula abantu, imali namanye amajelo kulawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunikela ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kweenkonzo. IMIBUZO: Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060

jobs.title: Director: Ethics and Anti-corruption
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Director of Ethics and Anti-corruption for the Office of the Premier in Johannesburg, managing anti-corruption policies and frameworks across the Gauteng City Region.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Public Administration and Business Management. Certified Ethics Officer and Fraud Examiners qualifications will be an added advantage. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in anti-corruption and ethics and anticorruption environment. Understanding of the international instruments and SADC agreements. Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership; programme and project management; ethics, integrity and anti-corruption management; governance, risk and compliance management; policy development, analysis and implementation; investigation oversight and fraud prevention; stakeholder engagement, financial and resource management; people management and empowerment; change management; problem-solving and decision-making. Sound knowledge of the public sector legislative and regulatory framework, including the Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, PFMA, PRECCA, Protected Disclosures Act, National Anti-Corruption Strategy and Public Service Integrity Management Framework. Strong analytical, communication, report-writing, presentation, negotiation and interpersonal skills, as well as an understanding of the Gauteng Provincial Government business environment.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of ethics and anti-corruption policies, strategies and frameworks within the Gauteng City Region (GCR). Interact with GCR Institutions regarding the implementation of the ethics and anti-corruption policies, strategies and frameworks. Develop guidelines and manuals to support the development of departmental Ethics policies. Create awareness of the GCR fraud and corruption strategies to stakeholders. Manage the monitoring and evaluation of processes aimed at reducing fraud and corruption cases within GCR. Manage the reports from the Gauteng Ethics Hotline, internal forensic investigations and external forensic investigations by the other government institutions (Special Investigation Unit, Public Protector, Public Service Commission, Auditor General and National Prosecuting Ethics Advisory Council and the Executive Council) on progress made in fighting fraud and anti-corruption and promoting integrity. Manage, implement and evaluate comprehensive ethics and anti-corruption capacity-building programmes. Project management of ethics and anti-corruption forums. Conduct research on best practices to fight corruption and promote integrity. Manage the Directorate’s human, financial and other resources to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of services. ENQUIRES : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060 OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted only online at www.gautengonline.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity documents and other supporting documents on or before the interview date, as directed by Human Resources. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attend a DPSA-prescribed SMS Competency Assessment if recommended by the Selection Committee following the interview process. Appointment to an SMS post is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Pre-Entry Programme (Certificate for Entry into the SMS) offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The successful candidate must provide proof of registration and successful completion of the programme prior to appointment. The cost of the programme is for the applicant's own account. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Etiek en Korrupsiebestryding
af.summary: Direkteur van Etiek en Korrupsiebestryding vir die Office of the Premier in Johannesburg, wat korrupsiebestrydingsbeleid en -raamwerke regoor die Gauteng City Region bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Public Administration en Business Management. Gesertifiseerde Ethics Officer- en Fraud Examiners-kwalifikasies sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n korrupsiebestrydings- en etiek- en korrupsiebestrydingsomgewing. Begrip van die internasionale instrumente en SADC-ooreenkomste. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; program- en projektbestuur; etiek-, integriteits- en korrupsiebestuursbestuur; bestuur, risiko- en nakomingsbestuur; beleidsontwikkeling, -analise en -implementering; ondersoektoesig en bedrogvoorkoming; belanghebbendesbetrokkenheid, finansiële en hulpbronbestuur; mensebestuur en bemagtiging; veranderingsbestuur; probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Deeglike kennis van die wetgewende en regulatoriese raamwerk van die openbare sektor, insluitend die Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, PFMA, PRECCA, Protected Disclosures Act, National Anti-Corruption Strategy en Public Service Integrity Management Framework. Sterk analitiese, kommunikasie-, verslagskryf-, voorleggings-, onderhandelings- en interpersoonlike vaardighede, asook 'n begrip van die besigheidsomgewing van die Gauteng Provincial Government.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van etiek- en korrupsiebestrydingsbeleid, -strategieë en -raamwerke binne die Gauteng City Region (GCR). Skakel met GCR-instellings rakende die implementering van die etiek- en korrupsiebestrydingsbeleid, -strategieë en -raamwerke. Ontwikkel riglyne en handleidings om die ontwikkeling van departementele etiekbeleid te ondersteun. Skep bewustheid by belanghebbendes oor die GCR-bedrog- en korrupsiebestrydingsstrategieë. Bestuur die monitering en evaluering van prosesse wat gemik is op die verminderding van bedrog- en korrupsiesake binne die GCR. Bestuur die verslae van die Gauteng Ethics Hotline, interne forensiese ondersoeke en eksterne forensiese ondersoeke deur ander regeringsinstellings (Special Investigation Unit, Public Protector, Public Service Commission, Auditor General en National Prosecuting Ethics Advisory Council en die Executive Council) oor die vordering gemaak in die stryd teen bedrog en korrupsie en die bevordering van integriteit. Bestuur, implementeer en evalueer omvattende kapasiteitsbouprogramme vir etiek en korrupsiebestryding. Projektbestuur van etiek- en korrupsiebestrydingsforums. Voer navorsing uit oor beste praktyke om korrupsie te bestry en integriteit te bevorder. Bestuur die Direktoraat se menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne om die effektiewe en doeltreffende lewer van dienste te verseker. NAVRAE : Me. Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060 ANDER POSTE

zu.title: Umdidiyeli: Amasiko alungile kanye Nokulwa Nokwephula umthetho
zu.summary: Umdidiyeli Wamasiko alungile kanye Nokulwa Nokwephula umthetho weOfisi yamKhulu ngaphansi kweGauteng eGauteng, ephatha izinqubomgomo nezakhiwo zokulwa nokwephula umthetho kulo lonke iGauteng City Region.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesizinga seNQF 7 ezigxile kuPublic Administration kanye noBusiness Management. Iziqu zobuhlengikazi bamasiko alungile (Certified Ethics Officer) kanye nobuhluleli benkohlakalo (Fraud Examiners) zizoba yinzuzo. Ukuhlangabezana neminyaka engu-5 wamava enzingeni eliphakathi/eliphezulu lobuqhebeqhebe bokulwa nokwephula umthetho kanye namasiko alungile nendawo yokulwa nokwephula umthetho. Ukuqonda izinsiza zamazwe ngamazwe kanye nezivumelwano zeSADC. Amandla: Amandla okubhekana phambili nobuholi; i- programme kanye nokuphathwa kwe-project; ukuphathwa kwamasiko alungile, ukuziphatha okuhle nokulwa nokwephula umthetho; ukuphathwa kobulungiswa, ingozi kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho; ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlaziwa kanye nokuphunyuliswa kwezinqubomgomo; ukugadwa kophando nokuvinjelwa kwenkohlakalo; ukuxhumana nabahlinzeki, ukuphathwa kwezimali nezinsizakusebenza; ukuphathwa kwabantu nakusizingiswa; ukuphathwa koshintsho; ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo. Ukuqonda okuhle ngohlaka lomthetho nezinqubomgomo zesigaba sikahulumeni, okuhlanganisa i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-PFMA, i-PRECCA, i-Protected Disclosures Act, i-National Anti-Corruption Strategy kanye ne-Public Service Integrity Management Framework. Amandla aphezulu okuhlaziya, okuxhumana, okubhala imibiko, okuyimibhalo yesethulo, okuxoxisana nobuchule bokuzwana nabantu, kanye nokuzwisisa imvelo yoshintsho yamabhizinisi kahulumeni wesifundazwe seGauteng.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukuphunyulwa kwezinqubomgomo zamasiko alungile nokuqeda ukwephula umthetho, amasu nolwangu kulo lonke i-Gauteng City Region (GCR). Ukuxhumana nabezikhungo ze-GCR mayelana nokuphunyulwa kwezinqubomgomo, amasu nolwangu wamasiko alungile nokuqeda ukwephula umthetho. Ukwakha imiqhaza kanye nezincwadi zokusebenzela ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo zamnyango zamnyango zamanyuzibale. Ukwenza abantu bazi ngesiphithiphithi sayo isinyawo nokuqeda ukwephula umthetho sabadluli abayibheki ngaso i-GCR. Ukuphatha ukugadwa kanye nokuqoka izinhlaka zokuqinisekisa isidingo sokwehlisa izicala zokubandlulula nokuqeda ukwephula umthetho ngaphakathi kwe-GCR. Ukuphatha imibiko evela ku-Gauteng Ethics Hotline, iziphatho ezingaphakathi zokuhlolwa imibhede (internal forensic investigations) izinsizakusebenza zikahulumeni (Special Investigation Unit, Public Protector, Public Service Commission, Auditor General and National Prosecuting Ethics Advisory Council and the Executive Council) ngohla lwemizamo owenziwayo wokulwa nobubhca (audit) bokuswela ukuziphendulela nokuthuthukisa ukuziphatha okuhle. Ukuphatha, ukuphunyula kanye nekhwalithi yokuqeqesha nokugcina izindawo ngokubanzi zokulwa nobuqili nokuthambisa imizamo yokulwa nokwephula umthetho. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi yamaphandle we-Ethics and anti-corruption forums. Ukwenza ucwaningo ngokuqakulisana imingcele ukulwa inkohlakalo nokudlulisa ubuhlakani. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza zokuphathwa kukaMdidiyeli abangahle abasebenza, izinsizakusebenza zomndeni nezinye izinsizakusebenza ukuba kugqanyiswe ukufikelwa isabelo isinkwa, nokulawulwa imiyalo nokuphendula okusemthethweni futhi iphatha imibuzo nangendlela engachema etholakalayo. IMIBUZO: Nkosazana Khanyisile Mafiri Umnandi weMininingwane: (011) 355 6060 AMAPUSI OKUHLOLA

xh.title: UmQondisi: I-Ethics and Anti-corruption
xh.summary: UmQondisi we-Ethics and Anti-corruption weOfisi yePremier eJohannesburg, elawulayo iinkqubo namakhowodi okulwa nokukhohlakala kwizonke iindawo zeGauteng City Region.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF 7 kwiNqanaba loLawulo kaRhulumente nokuLawula iShishino. Iziqinisekiso zobuQotho bese ngumQondisi boPhononongo lweNgqumbo ziya kuba luncedo. Unyaka lwe-5 Wohlulelelo kwinqanaba eliphakathi/lamaphakathi aphakathi ekulweni nokukhohlakala nasezikhundleni zobuqotho nokuchasene nokukhohlakala. Ukuqonda izixhobo zamazwe ngamazwe namasivumelwano eSADC. Amandla okusebenza: Ikhowudo yokubakho iindlela nokuqhuba; ulawulo lweNkqubo nokuLawula amaProjekthi; ulawulo lobuQotho, ukuThembeka nokuchasene nokukhohlakala; ulawulo loBuzisa, uLawulo loMngcipheko nokuthobela; uPuhulu lwaNkqubo, ukuHlola nokuZisebenzisa; ukuQwalasela uPhononongo nokuthintela iNgcwabo; ukuNxibelelana nabaphathi abahlukeneyo, ulawulo lweMali nokuLawula iziXhobo; uLawulo lwaBantu nokubaNcedo; ulawulo lokuTshintsha; ukuSombulula iNkinga nokuThatha iZigqibo. Ukuqonda okulula kwesiseko somthetho nolawulo lwesector kaRhulumente, kuquka uMthetho woKukhonza kaRhulumente, iNgqungquthela zoKukhonza kaRhulumente, iPFMA, iPRECCA, uMthetho woKuvikela iNxibelelwano, uMgaqo-nkqubo woKulwa nokukhohlakala kweNazionale neseKhowudi yoLawulo loBuQotho boKukhonza kaRhulumente. Amandla aphelile okuhlola, ukunxibelelana, ukubhala iNgxelo, ukubonisa, ukuNhengo nakhono lokuNxibelelana nabantu, kunye nokuqonda inkonzo kaRhulumente koBumi bePhondo likaGauteng.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusebenzisa iinkqubo, iindlela namakhowudi aphathelene nobuqotho nokuchasene nokukhohlakala kwimoto emmandla weGauteng City Region (GCR). Hlangana nemiqathango yeGCR malunga nokusebenzisa iinkqubo, iindlela namakhowodi aphathelene nobuqotho nokuchasene nokukhohlakala. Phepha iindlela zomculo namabhuku axhasa ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo zobuqotho zesebe. Yakha ulwazi malunga neendlela zokulwa nokukrokoza nokukhohlakala kwiGCR kubaphathi abahlukeneyo. Lawula ukuqonda nokuhlolwa kweenkqubo ezijoliswe ekunciphiseni amacala okukrokoza nokukhohlakala ngaphakathi kweGCR. Lawula iingxelo ezisuka kwiGauteng Ethics Hotline, uphononongo lwangaphakathi lokuhlola amaphongo nophononongo lwangaphandle lokuhlola amaphongo ngamanye amaqumrhu karhulumente (Special Investigation Unit, Public Protector, Public Service Commission, Auditor General kwaye National Prosecuting Ethics Advisory Council naye Executive Council) malunga nokuqhubeka ekulweni nokukrokoza nokuchasene nokukhohlakala nasekhuthazeni ubuqotho. Lawula, thuma kuqwalaselwe iinkqubo ezibanzi zokwakha amandla zobuqotho nokuchasene nokukhohlakala. Lawula amaprojekthi amakomiti obuqotho nokuchasene nokukhohlakala. Yenza uphononongo malunga nezona ndlela zokulwa nokukhohlakala nokukhuthaza ubuqotho. Lawula abantu, imali nezinye izixhobo zeDirekte ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunikezela iinkonzo ngokusebenza kakuhle nangempumelelo. IMIBUZO : Ms Khanyisile Mafiri Tel No: (011) 355 6060 EZINYE IZITHUBA

Represent the Office of the Premier in legal, intergovernmental and stakeholder forums and promote legal compliance, good governance and sound decision- making across GPG Departments. af.title: Staatsregskundige Adviseur GR 1 (LP-7)
af.summary: Staatsregskundige adviseur wat professionele regsadvies en litigasiebestuur vir die Gauteng Kantoor van die Premier verskaf.
af.requirements: Baccalaureus Regte (LLB)-graad of gelykwaardige NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie in die regte. Toelating as 'n Prokureur of Advokaat. Ten minste 5 jaar gepaste postkwalifikasie litigasie-/advieservaring. Bevoegdhede: Gevorderde regsnavorsing, analitiese en interpretasievaardighede; vermoë om goeie regstaie te ontwikkel en praktiese regsoplossings te bied; sterk opstelvaardighede vir regsmenings, pleitstukke, verslae en ander regsdokumente; kundigheid in geskilbeslegting, insluitend arbitrasie, bemiddeling en konkordasie; goeie oordeel en besluitnemingsvaardighede; vermoë om regsrisiko's te assesseer en gepaste intervensies voor te stel; onderhoud-, ondersoek- en feitevastellingsvaardighede; uitstekende probleemoplossing- en analitiese vermoëns; sterk mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; onderhandelings-, belanghebbende-betrokkenheids- en konflikbestuursvaardighede; vermoë om regsbeginsels op komplekse aangeleenthede toe te pas en regsverdedigbare uitkomste te lewer; en 'n hoë vlak van professionele integriteit, objektiwiteit en nakoming van etiese standaarde.
af.duties: Verskaf professionele regsadvies en -menings oor grondwetlike, administratiewe, arbeids-, kommersiële en publiekregtelike aangeleenthede. Verskaf regsmenings aan Gauteng Provinciale Departemente oor die interpretasie, toepassing en moontlike konflik van wette. Bestuur en koördineer litigasie wat die Kantoor van die Premier behels, insluitend skakeling met die Kantoor van die Staatsprokureur en ander relevante belanghebbendes. Bystand verleen met die implementering, koördinering en monitering van die Provinciale Litigasiebestuursraamwerk om die belange van die Provinsie te beskerm. Voer regsnavorsing uit en adviseer bestuur oor wetgewende ontwikkelings, regspraak en gepaardgaande regsrisiko's. Opstel, hersien en keur ooreenkomste, kontrakte en ander regsinstrumente goedkeurend. Bystand verleen met die opstel, sertifisering, interpretasie en finale redigering van wetgewing en ondergeskikte wetgewing, insluitend die voorbereiding en verwerking van Wetsontwerpe. Verteenwoordig die Kantoor van die Premier in regtelike, interregerings- en belanghebbende forums en bevorder regsnakoming, goeie bestuur en goeie besluitneming oor GPG Departemente heen. Bydra tot die Direktoraat se prestasie.

zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor of Laws (LLB) noma iziqu ezingenguqulo yohlelo lwe-NQF level 7 emthethweni. Ukubhaliswa njengommeli noma njengosokhemela. Okungenani eminyaka engu-5 yohlelo olufanele ngemva kweziqu kokuhola izeluleko noma izinkohliso. Izindlela: Amandla aphezulu ocwaningo lomthetho, ukuhlaziya nokuhumusha; ikhono lokwakha izizathu zomthetho ezifanele kanye nokunikeza izixazululo zomthetho ezisebenzayo; amandla okubhala okuqinile ngemibono yomthetho, izikhalazo, imibiko kanye namanye amadokhumenti omthetho; buchule ekuxazululweni izinkinga, kuhlanganise nokuphatwa kwezinkinga, ukumelana kanye nokubumbana; isinqumo esihle kanye namandla okwenza izinqumo; ikhono lokulinganisa ubungozi bomthetho kanye nokunikeza izincomo ezifanele; amandla okubuza imibuzo, uphenyo kanye nokuqhamula iziqondiso; ikhono elihle lokuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda izinto; amandla okukhuluma nokubhala kahle; amandla okuxhumana, ukubamba izingxoxo nabahola isikhungo kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkinga; ikhono lokusebenzisa izimiso zomthetho ezindabeni ezinzima kanye nokuletha iziphetho ezikhuselwa ngokomthetho; kanye neninga eliphezulu lokuzethemba, ukungakhethi bani kanye nokulandela izimiso zokuziphatha.
zu.duties: Nikeza izeluleko nemibono yomthetho eqotho ngemikhuba yomthethosisekelo, omphatho, somsebenzi, wezohwebo kanye nomthetho womphakathi. Nikeza imibono yomthetho Kuzinyanga Zesifundazwe i-Gauteng ngokuhumusha, ukusebenzisa kanye namathuba okungqubuzana komthetho. Phatha futhi uhlanganise izinkohliso ezibandakanya Iofisi yeNduna Yomphakathi, kuhlanganise ukuxhumana neNkantolo Yommeli Womphakathi kanye nabanye abahola isikhungo abahlobene. Siza ekusebenziseni, ukuhlanganiseni nokubukeleni Isu Lokuphathwa Kwezinkohliso Yesifundazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinhlayo zesifundazwe. Yenza ucwaningo lomthetho futhi unikeze imphathimbandla izeluleko ngentuthuko yomthetho, izinqumo zenkantolo kanye nobungozi bomthetho obuhlobene. Bhala, hlola futhi uqaphele izivumelwano, amakhasitomu kanye nezinye izinsizakusebenza zomthetho. Siza ekubhalweni, ukuqinisekiseni, ukuhumusha nokulungisa ngokuphelela umthetho kanye nomthetho ongaphansi kwawo, kuhlanganise nokulungiselela nokuphatha Amabhili. Mela Iofisi yeNduna Yomphakathi emikhakheni yomthetho, kahulumende oyingqayizivele kanye nabahola isikhungo futhi uxhase ukuzethemba komthetho, umphathi ohle kahle kanye nokuqumba okuhle kuzinyanga i-GPG. Yisana ekusebenzeni kweQoqo Lemisebenzi.

xh.title: State LAW Advisor GR 1 (LP-7)
xh.summary: State Law Advisor onika izeluleko zobuchwepheshe zomthetho kwaye ulawula izigqi zemithetho kwi Gauteng Office of the Premier.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelor of Laws (LLB) okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayokwisinqanaba se-NQF level 7 kumthetho. Ukumkelwa njengommeli okanye njengesikhokeli. Ubuncinane iya5 iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso kwizigqi zemithetho/nokusetyenziswa kolwazi. Iakhono: Amanqanaba aphezulu okuphonononga umthetho, nokuhlola nokutolika; ikhono lokwakha iingxabano zamthetho ezinzileyo nokunika iisombuluwo zamthetho ezisebenzayo; amakhono amandla okubhala iimbono zamthetho, iingxoxo ezithungwayo, iingxelo naxinyeamaxatyi womthetho; amava ekuxazulweni kwezixabaniso, kuquka nokuxazulwa ngabaphathi, ukubuliselana nokuvumelana; isigqibo esinzima nakhono okwenza izigqibo; ikhono lokulinganisa iingozinkomthetho nokuphakamisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokungenelela; amakhono okubuzana, okuphonononga nokupeytha iinkcukacha; amakhono aphezulu okuxazulwa kweenkinga nokuqhathanisa; amakhono amandla okunxibelela ngesandi nakubhalwe; amakhono okuxoxisana, ukuthintana nabanomdla nokulawula iingxabano; ikhono lokusebenzisa iingcalabazomthetho kumaphula anzima nokunikela iziphumo ezikhuselwa ngumthetho; namanqanaba aphezulu obunyeenyaniso bomsebenzi, ukungabandakanyiyo nokuzinikela kwemigaqo yokuziphatha.
xh.duties: Nika izeluleko zobuchwepheshe zomthetho nemi bona kumaphula omthethosiseko, oolawulo, abasebenzi, oorhwebo norholulo. Nikela iimbono zamthetho kwi Gauteng Provincial Departments ngokutolikwa, ukusetyenziswa nokungabini kwemithetho. Lawula ulungelelanise izigqi ezibandakanya i Office of the Premier, kuquka nokunxibelelana ne Office of the State Attorney nabanye abanomdya abafanelekileyo. Nceda ekusebenziseni, ekulungelelaniseni nasekuqwalaseleni i Provincial Litigation Management Framework ukhusela izinto zomthethonyulo. Yenza uphando lwomthetho uze ululele i bust ngenkqubela komthetho, iigarba zomthetho nayo nakubungozi ezidityanisiweyo zomthetho. Bhala, hlola ulungelelanise iindlela zomthetho, i garba zomthetho nakunyeamaxatyi omthetho. Nceda ekubhalweni, ekuvavanyweni, ekutolikweni nakusikwa kokugqibela komthetho nomthetho ophantsi, kuquka ulungelelaniswa nokugqitywa kweBills. Mela i Office of the Premier kumapula womthetho, phakathi kolurhulumente kunye nabanomdla uze ukhuthaze ukuzaliseka komthetho, ulawulo olululo nesigqibo esinzima kuwo onke amasebe iGPG Departments. Yaka isixa ekubeni kwesiphundu.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant to the Chief Director: Resource
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and administrative support to the Chief Director: Resource at the Office of the Premier in Johannesburg, requiring a Grade 12 plus Secretarial Diploma and three to five years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) or equivalent, coupled with a Secretarial Diploma or equivalent qualification in Office Administration, and a minimum of three to five (3–5) years’ experience in providing administrative and secretarial support to a senior manager. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Sound computer literacy, professional telephone etiquette, strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, as well as planning, organising, analytical thinking, problem-solving and document analysis capabilities.
jobs.duties: Provide professional secretarial, administrative and office support services to the senior manager; manage diaries, appointments, correspondence and telephone enquiries; coordinate the routing, tracking and follow-up of documents to relevant stakeholders. Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, compile supporting documentation and record minutes; draft reports, submissions and other documents as required; collate, consolidate and coordinate reports of the Chief Directorate to support management reporting. Maintain filing and records management systems; coordinate travel and logistical arrangements; facilitate the effective flow of information and communication between the office of the senior manager, the Chief Directorate and stakeholders. Provide budget administration support by coordinating budget-related documentation, monitoring expenditure, maintaining expenditure records, assisting with procurement processes and budget reporting. Alert management to potential over- or under-expenditure. Manage office resources and administrative registers for leave; and ensure compliance with relevant legislation, policies, and procedures.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Phelisa Khuzwayo Tel No: (011) 355 6730
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted only online at www.gautengonline.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity documents and other supporting documents on or before the interview date, as directed by Human Resources. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Attend a DPSA-prescribed SMS Competency Assessment if recommended by the Selection Committee following the interview process. Appointment to an SMS post is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Pre-Entry Programme (Certificate for Entry into the SMS) offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The successful candidate must provide proof of registration and successful completion of the programme prior to appointment. The cost of the programme is for the applicant's own account. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent van die Hoofdirekteur: Hulpbron
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Hoofdirekteur: Hulpbron by die Office of the Premier in Johannesburg, wat 'n Graad 12 plus 'n Sekretariële Diploma en drie tot vyf jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (NQF Level 4) of gelykwaardig, gekoppel aan 'n Sekretariële Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Kantooradministrasie, en 'n minimum van drie tot vyf (3–5) jaar se ervaring in die verskaffing van administratiewe en sekretariële ondersteuning aan 'n senior bestuurder. Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Klank rekenaarvaardigheid, professionele telefoonetiket, sterk interpersoonlike en verhoudingsbestuursvaardighede, asook beplanning, organisering, analitiese denke, probleemoplossing en dokumentontleding vermoëns.
af.duties: Verskaf professionele sekretariële, administratiewe en kantoorondersteuningsdienste aan die senior bestuurder; bestuur dagboeke, afsprake, korrespondensie en telefoonnaavrae; koördineer die roetering, opsporing en opvolging van dokumente na relevante belanghebbendes. Koördineer vergaderings, berei agenda's voor, stel ondersteunende dokumentasie op en neem notule; opstel van verslae, voorleggings en ander dokumente soos vereis; versamel, konsolideer en koördineer verslae van die Hoofdirektoraat om bestuursverslagdoening te ondersteun. Onderhou lêer- en rekordbestuurstelsels; koördineer reis- en logistieke reëlings; fasiliteer die effektiewe vloei van inligting en kommunikasie tussen die kantoor van die senior bestuurder, die Hoofdirektoraat en belanghebbendes. Verskaf begrotingsadministrasieondersteuning deur begrotingverwante dokumentasie te koördineer, uitgawes te monitor, uitgawerekords te hou, met verkrygingsprosesse te help en begrotingsverslagdoening. Stel bestuurder in kennis van potensiële oor- of onderverbruik van fondse. Bestuur kantoorhulpbronne en administratiewe registers vir verlof; en verseker nakoming van tersaaklike wetgewing, beleide en prosedures.

zu.title: Isikhundla sobumabhalane kumPhathi ophethe weSebe: Izinsiza
zu.summary: Hlinzeka ngesekeli kanye nokusekelwa kolawulo kumPhathi ophethe wesebe: Umnyango: Wezinsiza eBhovini kaNdunankulu eJohannesburg, kudingeka ifayela eligunyaziwe i-Garde 12 ephilayo i-Diploma yobungumabhalane bese kube sekuthathwa isiponjiminyaka sezinye - 3–5 yeminyaka yokuhlola emsebenzini.
zu.requirements: I-Garde 12 (NQF Level 4) noma okulingana nayo, edwetshiwe nge-Diploma yobungumabhalane noma izifundo ezilingana nayo kumLawulo weNyofisi, kanye nokuba okungenani isiponjiminyaka sezinye kuya kuhlanu (3–5) weminyaka yokuhlola kokuzekezelwa kolawulo nobungumabhalane kumphathi ophakeme. Ulwimi oluhle lokubhala nolukhuluma. Ukuqonda kakuhle ikhompuyutha, izindlela ezihloniphekile zokuphendula futhi ucocishe ngocingo, amakhono aqinile okuxhumana nabantu nokuphathwa kwezindlela zokusebenza kanye nokuhlela ukusebenza, ukucabanga ngokuhlola izinkinga, ukuxazulula izinkinga, nokuhlola amadokhumenti.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi yobungumabhalane, yolawulo nenyofisi ebalulekile kumphathi ophakeme; lawula izikhathi, ithuba lokuhlangana, inxibelelano nemicelo yocingo ehlobene nenyofisi; hlela ukuthunyelwa, ukulandelwa nokuphinda kuqatshwe kwamadokhumenti kubathintekayo. Hlela izinkomfa, lungiselela izinhlelo zezinkomfa, qamba amadokhumenti okusekela ukuhlangenwe nakho bese ubhala imizuzu; bhala imibiko, izethulo namanye amadokhumenti njengoba kudingeka; qoqa, hlanganisa futhi uhlele imibiko yeNdaba ephethe ukuze kusekelwe ukubika kokuphathwa. Gcina izinhlelo zokulondolozwa kwamafayela namarekhodi; hlela ukuhamba kwezohambo nezinhlelo zokulandelwa kokungeniswa kwemininingwane edlulele; chiniseza ukugeleza kolwazi nolunxibelelwano phakathi kwenyofisi komphathi ophakeme, iNdaba ephethe kanye nabathintekayo. Hlinzeka ngokusekelwa ekuphathweni kwesabelomali ngokuqoqwa kwamadokhumenti ahlobene nesabelomali, ukugcina ukubuka ukuchithwa kwemali, ukugcina amarekhodi okuchithwa kwemali, ukusiza kulezi zinqubo zokuthenga nokubika ngosabelomali. Yisise kumaphathi ukugqugquzelwa noma ukungachithwa kahle kwemali. Lawula izinsiza zenyofisi namarekhodi wolawulo wokuphumula; bese uqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho ohlobene, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo ezihlukene.

xh.title: Umncedi Womuntu kuNoMlawuli Oyintloko: Izeliso
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yobonikeli bezabahlali nolawulo kuNoMlawuli Oyintloko: Izeliso ejikaleni leNkulumbuso eJohannesburg, kufuneka kube ne-Grade 12 kunye neDiploma Yobonikeli bezabahlali nabangamashumi amathathu ukuya kwamihlanu yamava.
xh.requirements: i-Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) okanye efanayo, edibaniswe neSecretarial Diploma okanye nengqineliso efanayo kwiOffice Administration, nendalo ebuzwa kubungakanani bamashumi amathathu ukuya kwamahlanu (3–5) eminyaka yamava ekunikeni inkxaso yolawulo ngezabahlali kumlawuli omkhulu. Amakhono amabalulu ebhalwe nasekuthetheni. Ulwazi oluhle kwiikhompyutha, izimilo ezithembekileyo kumnxeba, amakhono amandla okuxhumana nabantu nokulawla ubudlelwane, nakwakhona amakhono okucwangcisa, okuqamba, okucinga ngokuhlalutya, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya amaxwebhu.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zobonikeli bezabahlali, zolawulo zofice ezingcali kumlawuli omkhulu; lawula iidayari, iindlela zexesha, ombaxo kunye nemibuzo yomnxeba; qhoboshela ekuthumeni, ekulandeleliseni nasekulandeleleni amaxwebhu kwabathintekayo. Qhoboshela iindibano, lungiselela iajenda, qokelela ixwebhu elixhasayo ligqithe kwabathintekayo ukuze lenze ingxelo; bhala iingxelo, iziphozo namanye amaxwebhu njengoko kufuneka; qokelela, hudula kwaye ulawule iingxelo zeChief Directorate ukuyixhasa inkxaso yolawulo. Gcina iinkqubo zokugcina nokuqulunqa iirekhodi; qhoboshela izicwangciso zohambo nezokusungula iindawo zokwenza izinto; yenza kube lula ukuhamba kolwazi noluxhumano phakathi kwe-ofice yomlawuli omkhulu, iChief Directorate kunye nabathintekayo.nika inkxaso yolawulo lwebhajeti ngokubamba amaxwebhu ahlobene nolawulo, ukulandelela ukuchithwa kwemali, ukugcina iirekhodi zokuqhuba imali, ukuncedisa iinkqubo zokuthenga nokwenza iingxelo zebhajeti. Yazisa lolawulo ngesenti esekel' ukutyhilwa okanye ngaphantsi kokutyhilwa kwemali. Lawula izabelo zofice namanani olawulo awodwa wokushiya; qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho ofaneleyo, iinkqubo, iindlela ekuzalisekiseni imisebenzi.

zu.title: Umsekabala Kashidi Wezimali OyiNkosana
zu.summary: Nikela ngokwesekwa okuyimfihlo kwaye nolawulo kuShidi Wezimali OyiNkosana eNdiweni Yesikhungu Samakhosi eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: I-Qrade 12 (NQF Level 4) okwesilinganiso, ehambisana neDiploma Yemfihlo okwesilinganiso esimfuneko kuLawulo LweNdiwo, kanti futhi kudingeka ubudlule obungangathathi hlangothi eminyakeni engu-three to five (3–5) ekunikezeni okwesekwa kolawulo kwaye nemfihlo kumlawuli ophakeme. Amakhono aphelele okuxoxa nokubhala. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha okusemthethweni, amakhono obudlelwane obusesibhaxini obungokoqobo, amakhono abantu nemiphatho yobudlelwano namanye, kanye nokuhlela, ukulungisa, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga namakhono okuhlaziya amadokhumenti.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokwesekwa okuyimfihlo, kolawulo kwaye kwendawo yokusebenza okungokoqobo kumlawuli ophakeme; qondisa okushiwo ngosuku, izikhathi zokubonana, okubhaliwe kwaye nemibuzo yocingo; hlanganisa ukuthumela, ukulandelwa nokuphinda kuqanjwe amadokhumenti kubantu abahlobene. Hlanganisa izinkulumo, lungelelisa izinhlelo zezinkulumo, qoqa amadokhumenti okwesekwa kwaye ubhale okuthiwe ngokwenziwe; bhala okubikiwe, izinto ezithunyelwe namanye amadokhumenti njengoba kudingeka; qoqa, hlanganisa kwaye ulungelelise okubikiwe koMnyango Ophakeme ukuze useke okubikiwe kolawulo. Gcina amafayela kwaye izindlela zokulawula okubhaliwe; hlanganisa ukuhamba kwaye izilungiselelo ezihlobene; wenze ukuba ulwazi nokuxhumana kuhamba kakhulu phakathi kwendawo yokusebenza yomlawuli ophakeme, uMnyango Ophakeme kwaye nabantu abahlobene. Nikela ngokwesekwa ekulawulweni kwesabelo ngokuhlanganisa amadokhumenti ahlobene nesabelo, ukuqapha okusebenzisiwe, ukugcina okubhaliwe ngokusebenzisiwe, ukusiza ngenqubo yokuthenga kwaye nokubikwa kwesabelo. Yezisa ulawulo ngesabelo esingaphezulu noma esingaphansi kwesidingo. Lawula izinsiza zendawo yokusebenza kwaye amabhalansi olawulo angemuva; kwaye uqinisekise ukuvumelana nomthetho ohlobene, nemigomo, kwaye nezindlela.

xh.title: Nomzwayo kwiSikhulu esiNzima leeMali
xh.summary: Ku nikela ngenkxaso yommeli wezoqoqosyo nolawulo kuSikhulu esiNzima leeMali eNdiweni kaNdunankulu eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: IQhalaba le-12 (iNqanaba le-4 le-NQF) okanye elingelo, elidityaniswa neDiploma yezoMmeli okanye ngesi fondoko ekuLawulweni koLundo, kwaye ufanele ube nenqanaba elifanayo leminyaka ezintathu ukuya kwezihlanu (3–5) zemfundo yokunikela ngenkxaso yolawulo nolommye kumlawuli ongumlingane othile. Iimpawu ezilungileyo zokubhala nokuThetha. Ulwazi olululo lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha, amakhosi amanengi anezigqibo ezilungileyo kwindlela yothetha kumamfoni, amakhosi amanengi okusebenza nabantu nokuLawula ubudlelwane, kwanokuyila, ukuqamba, iinkqubo zokucinga, iinkqubo zokuSombulula iingxaki nokuhlaziya amaxwebhu.
xh.duties: Yenza inkxaso yangommeli, yolawulo nolundo oLungileyo kumlawuli ongumlingane othile; ulawule iinkqubo zamaxesha, amangqesha, umbhalo wemibhalo nemibuzo yeFoni; uhlanganise ukuhamba, ukulandelwa nokulandelelwa kwamaxwebhu kumabanjwa abalulekileyo. Qamba iindibano, ulungise iinkqubo zendibano, uqokelele imixholo eqhuba nayo uze ubhale iNqubo yendibano; ubhale iingxelo, iingxelo zokuNgenisa nazipina na iMibhalo njengoko kufuneka; uqokelele, udibanise uze uhlanganise iingxelo zoBukhulu beMmandla ukunikela inkxabo kwiNkqubo yeNgxelo yoLawulo. Gcina inkqubo yamafayili nokuLawula iirekhodi; uhlanganise ukuhamba nolungelelwaniso lwamaxwebhu; unceda ukugqithiswa kolwazi nokuThethelana phakathi kweNdlu yomlawuli oLungile, uBukhulu beMmandla nabanjwa. Nikela ngenkxabo yoLawulo lweMali ngokuhlanganisa imibhalo eNgqamana neMali, ukuQaphela imali eChitshiywayo, ukuGcina iirekhodo zemali eChitshiywayo, ukuncedisa iinkqubo zokuThenga nokwenza iNgxelo yeMali. Yalisa ulawulo ngemali enokugqitha okanye ongagqithiyo kwaye ibe ngaphantsi kweMali. Lawula izibonelelo zolundo nerekhodi yolawulo lwamavesi; uqinisekise ukwamkelwa kwemigaqo, iMigaqo nemiQathango.

jobs.title: Legal Administration Officer GR 3: MR-3
jobs.centre: Johannesburg REQUIREMENTS       Grade 12 plus a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) degree or equivalent (as recognised by SAQA). At least 2 years’ appropriate post qualification legal experience. Key Competencies: Good legal research, analytical and legal advisory skills, with proven ability to interpret legislation, draft legal documents and provide sound legal opinions. The candidate should possess strong communication, negotiation, stakeholder management and problem-solving and report writing skills, as well as the ability to manage litigation, contracts and complex legal matters within a government environment. Demonstrable professionalism, integrity and the ability to work independently under pressure are essential.
jobs.summary: Legal Administration Officer providing legal advisory services, research and litigation management at the Office of the Premier in Johannesburg.
jobs.duties: Provide comprehensive legal advisory services to the Office of the Premier and Provincial Departments by conducting legal research, analysing legislation and case law, and formulating legal opinions and recommendations. Consult with clients to determine objectives, provide advice on legal rights and available courses of action, and ensure that all consultations and advice are accurately documented. Draft and review legal opinions, contracts, service level agreements, submissions, correspondence and other legal documents to support organisational objectives and ensure legal compliance. Manage, coordinate and monitor litigation matters, including liaising with relevant stakeholders and legal representatives. Coordinate and oversee compliance with the Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA) and the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), while maintaining accurate records and ensuring effective case management. ENQUIRES : Ms Phelisa Khuzwayo Tel No: (011) 355 6730
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted only online at www.gautengonline.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must submit a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form; a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV); and the relevant reference number quoted on the application. Applications submitted by email, fax, post or hand delivery will not be accepted. Failure to submit all the required documents will result in the application not being considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity documents and other supporting documents on or before the interview date, as directed by Human Resources. Applicants with foreign qualifications must submit a SAQA evaluation certificate if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Appointment to an SMS post is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Pre-Entry Programme (Certificate for Entry into the SMS) offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The successful candidate must provide proof of registration and successful completion of the programme prior to appointment. The cost of the programme is for the applicant's own account. For further information visit: www.thensg.gov.za/training. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Performance Agreement within three (3) months of assuming duty, disclose their financial interests in accordance with applicable regulations. Undergo personnel suitability checks, including criminal record, citizenship, credit, qualification and employment verification. The Gauteng Office of the Premier is committed to the principles of Employment Equity and fair representation. In line with the Department's Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups. Particular consideration will be given to African females, Coloured males, Indian males, Indian females, White males, White females, and persons with disabilities, in order to promote equitable representation within the Department. By applying, applicants consent to the processing of their personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. The Gauteng Office of the Premier reserves the right not to fill, withdraw or cancel the advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. The Gauteng Office of the Premier thanks all applicants for their interest. No late applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

jobs.title: Manager Pharmaceutical Services
jobs.summary: Manage pharmaceutical services across the Umgungundlovu Health District, coordinating primary healthcare pharmacy operations and strategic planning.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or equivalent. Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy or equivalent qualification. Minimum of 9 years’ appropriate experience after registration as a Pharmacist with the SAPC, of which three (3) years must be managerial experience in pharmaceutical environment. Current Registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competence Required: Knowledge, Skills, Competencies Required: Strategic capability and Leadership. Knowledge Management. Problem Solving and Analysis. People Management and Empowerment. Communication. Programme and Project Management. Financial Management. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Co-ordinate, supervise, monitoring and evaluation of the District Pharmaceutical Services emphasizing on Primary Health Care approach. Drafting and/or translation of strategic operational plan and facilitation of implementation of such a plan. Ensuring that requirements of the various applicable Acts, policies, Procedures and the principles of Batho Pele are adhered to in the pharmaceutical services. Ensure compliance with the SAPC prescripts and maintaining the Grading of all pharmacies in the district. Identification of the training needs coordination and implementation of the training programmes for personnel involved in provision of pharmaceutical services. Improve and maintain medicine availability above 90%. Ensure that PFMA prescripts are adhered to in the pharmaceutical services within the Umgungundlovu district. Provide ongoing coaching and support to all facilities to ensure that all pharmacy personnel remain motivated to work under pressure. Ensure compliance with Ideal hospital and clinic in the district. Development and facilitation of quality improvement projects for hospitals and clinics in the district to improve the quality of pharmaceutical service rendered. Development and maintenance of district medicine supply system to ensure adequate and reliable supply of medicines to all facilities to reduce the rate of stock outs in the district. Ensure continuous and functional Pharmaceutical Therapeutics committee (PTC) and antimicrobial stewardship committee (AMS) in both the district and facility level. Monitoring budget and expenditure for all facilities. Establish and maintenance of the relationships with communities, other districts, NGO and the private sector. Represent pharmaceutical services in various committees in the district. Preparation of reports in all aspects of the pharmaceutical service.

af.title: Bestuurder Farmaseutiese Dienste
af.summary: Bestuur farmaseutiese dienste oor die Umgungundlovu Health District, koördineer apteekbedrywighede vir primêre gesondheidsorg en strategiese beplanning.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matrik of gelykwaardig. Baccalaureusgraad in apteek of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as 'n Apoteker by die SAPC, waarvan drie (3) jaar bestuurservaring in 'n farmaseutiese omgewing moet wees. Huidige Registrasie met die SAPC as 'n Apoteker. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis, Vaardighede, Bevoegdhede Vereis: Strategiese vermoë en Leierskap. Kennisbestuur. Probleemoplossing en Analise. Personeelbestuur en Bemagtiging. Kommunikasie. Program- en Projekbestuur. Finansiële Bestuur. Rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Koördineer, toesig hou en monitering en evaluering van die Distrik se Farmaseutiese Dienste met klem op die Primêre Gesondheidsorg-benadering. Opstel en/of vertaling van strategiese operasionele plan en fasilitering van die implementering van so 'n plan. Verseker dat vereistes van die verschillende toepaslike Wette, beleide, prosedures en die beginsels van Batho Pele nagekom word in die farmaseutiese dienste. Verseker nakoming van die SAPC-voorskrifte en handhaaf die gradering van alle apteke in die distrik. Identifisering van die opleidingsbehoeftes koördinering en implementering van die opleidingsprogramme vir personeel betrokke by die verskaffing van farmaseutiese dienste. Verbeter en handhaaf medikasiebeskikbaarheid bo 90%. Verseker dat PFMA-voorskrifte nagekom word in die farmaseutiese dienste binne die Umgungundlovu-distrik. Verskaf deurlopende afrigting en ondersteuning aan alle fasiliteite om te verseker dat alle apteekpersoneel gemotiveerd bly om onder druk te werk. Verseker nakoming van Ideale hospital en kliniek in die distrik. Ontwikkeling en fasilitering van gehalteverbeteringsprojekte vir hospitale en klinieke in die distrik om die gehalte van farmaseutiese diens wat gelewer word te verbeter. Ontwikkeling en instandhouding van distrik-medikasievoorsieningstelsel om voldoende en betroubare voorsiening van medikasie aan alle fasiliteite te verseker om die koers van vooraadtekorte in die distrik te verminder. Verseker deurlopende en funksionele Pharmaceutical Therapeutics committee (PTC) en antimicrobial stewardship committee (AMS) op beide distrik- en fasilititeitsvlak. Monitering van begroting en besteding vir alle fasiliteite. Vestig en onderhou verhoudings met gemeenskappe, andere distrikte, NGO's en die privaatsektor. Verteenwoordig farmaseutiese dienste in verschillende komitees in die distrik. Voorbereiding van verslae oor alle aspekte van die farmaseutiese diens.
