xh.title: Umphathi Wezenkonzo Zamayeza
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zamayeza kulo wonke uMmgungundlovu Health District, ulungelelanise imisebenzi yobuchwephesha bezezamayeza kwinkonzo yezempilo yokuqala kwaye ulungiselele iindaba ngokwesiqhelo.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric okwaletyunywa. Inqanaba lesidanga kumayeza okungumlinganiso. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-9 yamava afanelekile emva kokubhalisa njengochwepheshe wamayeza ngaphakathi koSAPC, apho iminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe ngumava wokulawula kwelinye lwezamayeza. Ubhaliso lwangoku kwi-SAPC njengochwepheshe wamayeza. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namaQela afunekayo: Ulwazi, Amakhono, amaQela afunekayo: Ikhono lokulawula nokuQonda indlela yokuba buchule noLawulo. ulawulo lolwazi. ukuzoncedisa nokuqonda iingxaki. ulawulo bentu nokunika amandla. unxibelelwano. ulawulo lweenkqubo neziprojekthi. ulawulo lwezimali. ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Ulungelanisa, ulawula, ulawule kwaye uhlole iinkonzo zamayeza zesithili ezigqithisa indlela yoluqeqesho lwempilo yokuqala. Ukubhala nokwenza idrafthi yendlela yokusebenza ekugqitywe ngayo okanye ukuququndula ukuyigqithisa kwindlela ezaqulunqwa ngayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iimfuno zemithetho eyahlukeneyo, iinkqubo, iindlela zokwenza izinto nemigaqo yekhaladi yeBatho Pele kwiinkonzo zamayeza. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzinikela ngokwemigaqo yeSAPC nokugcina inqanaba lezobuchwepheshe bamayeza kwizithili zonke. Ukuchonga iimfuno zeqeqesho, ulungelelanise kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zeqeqesho labasebenzi ababambe iqhaza ekunikeni iinkonzo zamayeza. Ukuphucula kwaye ugcine ukufumaneka kwamayeza ngaphezulu kwe-90%. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba imigaqo yePFMA ilandelwa kwiinkonzo zamayeza ngaphakathi kwesithili i-Umgungundlovu. Unikezela ngokuqeqesha ngokuhlala kunjalo nokedlulelo kwezindawo zonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba bonke abasebenzi bamayeza bagcine bemotivathiwe ukusebenza ngexesha lomngcipheko. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzinikela ngemigaqo yamaphethelo aphethe indlela nasezikhungweni zempilo kwisithili. Ukuphucula kwaye ulungelelanise iiprojekthi zokuphucula izinga lezindawo zempilo ezinkulu namacandelo amancinci kwisithili ukuze kuphuculwe izinga lenkonzo yamayeza inikwayo. Ukuqhutywa kunokugcinwa kwenkqubo yokunikwa amayeza kwisithili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunikwa ngokwaneleyo nangokuzinzile kwamayeza kuzo zonke iindawo ukuze kuncitshiswe isantya sendlela yokuphela kwamayeza kwisithili. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ihlala kusebenza ngokuhlala kunjalo iqela lezamayeza nakwizingqungqula ezibhana ngendlela (PTC) nasekuqeqeshweni kwezikhuni ezingamaza ngokuchasene (AMS) kwisithili nakwindawo ngakunye. Ukulawula umgangatho weemali neemidiya kuzo zonke iindawo zokusingatha imicimbi. Ukuyakha kwaye kugcinwe ubudlelwane noluntu, nezinye iindawo, i-NGO nakumacandelo angasese. Ukumela iinkonzo zamayeza kumagatya amaninzi anamahlakahlaka kwisithili. Ukuqhutywa kokulungiselelwa kwemibiko kwicala ngalinye leenkonzo zokunika amayeza.

jobs.title: Manager Nursing
jobs.summary: Manage district clinical specialist team nursing services for women, pregnant mothers and new-borns in Umgungundlovu Health District, KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualifications (i.e. diploma or degree or in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. PLUS, post-basic Nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 (one) year accredited with the SANC in a relevant specialty. Plus, Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC). Plus, minimum of 10 (ten) years appropriate/recognisable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 (six) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the one-year post basic qualification in the relevant specialty. At least 4 (four) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience at management level. Please Note: Appropriate/recognisable experience in the context of these requirements also includes experience gained after registration in the particular discipline in a foreign country, and which registration is recognised by the SANC for registration in the particular discipline. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competence Required: Knowledge, Skills, Competencies Required: Knowledge in own discipline – Maternal, Women’s and neonatal care: Including best quality antenatal care, peripartum care, postnatal care, neonatal care and women’s health. Relevant legislation, regulations and policies. Programme planning, implementation and evaluation. Information management. Quality assurance and improvement programmes. Skills in own discipline – Maternal, Women’s and neonatal care: Including best quality antenatal care, peripartum care, postnatal care, neonatal care and women’s health. Leadership. Good communication. Problem solving. Computer literacy. Be able to work positively as part of DCST and other district teams. Stress tolerance. Self-confidence. Objective. Empathic.
jobs.duties: Represent own discipline as a member of a District Clinical Specialist Team responsible for the delivery of quality health care for women, pregnant mothers and new-borns at all levels within a health district. Work closely with other members of the DCST. Promote equitable access to an appropriate level of care for all women, pregnant mothers and new-borns throughout the district. Maintain personal competency in own clinical discipline. Support PHC fixed and mobile clinics, community health centres and hospitals with all aspects of service delivery related to own discipline. Support and meet with Subdistrict Midwife Mentors. Promote clinical effectiveness in all facilities through supporting outreach programmes and development, dissemination or implementation of clinical protocols and standard treatment guidelines aligned with national norms and standards. Facilitate and participate in the development, training and mentorship of health professionals in all facilities within the district. Facilitate and participate in the training, development and mentorship of nursing and allied health professionals and community workers under their supervision. Work with the District Management Team to establish and maintain systems including surveillance, health information, communication and referral guidelines and processes to support the delivery of services. Prepare for and co-chair the Quarterly District Perinatal and Child Health Meetings. Provide support to ensure appropriate infrastructure, equipment, resources and sundries for the provision of quality clinical care. Assist, support and participate in risk management activities for patients, (e.g. critical event analysis, morbidity and mortality meetings, especially Facility and District Perinatal and Child Health meetings), practitioners, (e.g. infection control) and the organisation, (e.g. performance reviews). Assist, support and participate in clinical audits and quality improvement cycles in health facilities and, where appropriate, in community settings such as schools and Ward- based Primary Health Care teams. Implement effective monitoring and evaluation processes, effective use of data and appropriate reporting on outputs and health outcomes. Assist, support and participate in relevant research. Foster effective teamwork and collaboration within the DCST and with other professionals in the district involved in the delivery of maternal and neonatal care, especially the District Maternal and Child Health Manager/s. Enable engagement with the local community and relevant non-governmental organisations (E.g. Unjani Clinics), promoting adherence to district clinical and public health guidelines as appropriate. Facilitate and ensure effective communication with all management structures within the district, the regional and tertiary hospitals as relevant as well as the provincial Department of Health. Present regular reports on activities, health services and programmes. Assist with strategic and operational planning of services in the district. Co- ordinate and supervise discipline related services within the district. Assist with the recruitment and management of relevant human resources.

jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the new prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed, initialed and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV (with detailed experience). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Applicants with foreign qualifications are requested to have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). Applicants: Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. If you apply for more than 1 post, submit separate applications for each post that you apply for quoting the relevant reference number. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative employer, whose aim is to promote representivity at all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post.

af.title: Bestuurder Verpleegkunde
af.summary: Bestuur distrik kliniese spesialispan-verpleegdienste vir vroue, swanger moeders en pasgeborenes in Umgungundlovu Health District, KwaZulu-Natal.
af.requirements: Basiese R425 kwalifikasies (d.w.s. diploma of graad of in Nursing) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. PLUS, post-basiese Nursing kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 (one) jaar geakkrediteer met die SANC in 'n relevante spesialiteit. Plus, huidige registrasie met die South African Nursing Council (SANC). Plus, 'n minimum van 10 (ten) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Nursing na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 6 (six) jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na die verkryging van die een-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in die relevante spesialiteit. Ten minste 4 (four) jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Neem asseblief kennis: Toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die konteks van hierdie vereistes sluit ook ervaring in wat verkry is na registrasie in die betrokke dissipline in 'n buiteland, en watter registrasie deur die SANC erken word vir registrasie in die betrokke dissipline. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis, Vaardighede, Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis in eie dissipline – Moederlike, Vroue- en neonatale sorg: Insluitend beste gehalte antenatale sorg, peripartum sorg, postnatale sorg, neonatale sorg en vroue se gesondheid. Relevante wetgewing, regulasies en beleide. Programbeplanning, implementering en evaluering. Inligtingsbestuur. Gehalteversekering en verbeteringsprogramme. Vaardighede in eie dissipline – Moederlike, Vroue- en neonatale sorg: Insluitend beste gehalte antenatale sorg, peripartum sorg, postnatale sorg, neonatale sorg en vroue se gesondheid. Leierskap. Goeie kommunikasie. Probleemoplossing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. In staat wees om positief as deel van die DCST en ander distrikspanne te werk. Stresverdraagsaamheid. Selfvertroue. Objektief. Empaties.
af.duties: Verteenwoordig eie dissipline as 'n lid van 'n Distrik Kliniese Spesialispan wat verantwoordelik is vir die lewering van gehalte gesondheidsorg vir vroue, swanger moeders en pasgeborenes op alle vlakke binne 'n gesondheidsdistrik. Werk nou saam met ander lede van die DCST. Bevordere billike toegang tot 'n toepaslike vlak van sorg vir alle vroue, swanger moeders en pasgeborenes deur die hele distrik. Onderhou persoonlike bevoegdheid in eie kliniese dissipline. Ondersteun PHC vaste en mobiele klinieke, gemeenskapsgesondheidsentrums en hospitale met alle aspekte van dienslewering wat verband hou met eie dissipline. Ondersteun en vergader met Subdistrik Vrolike Mentors. Bevorder kliniese doeltreffendheid in alle fasiliteite deur die ondersteuning van uitreikprogramme en die ontwikkeling, verspreiding of implementering van kliniese protokolle en standaard behandelingsriglyne wat in lyn is met nasionale norme en standaarde. Fasiliteer en neem deel aan die ontwikkeling, opleiding en mentorskap van gesondheidsprofessionals in alle fasiliteite binne die distrik. Fasiliteer en neem deel aan die opleiding, ontwikkeling en mentorskap van verpleeg- en allied gesondheidsprofessionals en gemeenskapswerkers onder hul toesig. Werk met die Distrik Bestuurspan om stelsels tot stand te bring en te onderhou, insluitend toesig, gesondheidsinligting, kommunikasie en verwysingsriglyne en prosesse om die lewering van dienste te ondersteun. Berei voor vir en sit die kwartaallikse Distrik Perinatale en Kinder Gesondheidsvergaderings voor. Verskaf ondersteuning om toepaslike infrastruktuur, toerusting, hulpbronne en verbruiksgoedere vir die voorsiening van gehalte kliniese sorg te verseker. Bystaan, ondersteun en neem deel aan risikobestuur aktiwiteite vir pasiënte, (bv. kritieke gebeurtenis ontleding, morbiditeit en mortaliteit vergaderings, veral Fasiliteit en Distrik Perinatale en Kinder Gesondheidsvergaderings), praktisyns, (bv. infeksie beheer) en die organisasie, (bv. prestasie hersienings). Bystaan, ondersteun en neem deel aan kliniese oudits en gehalte verbetering siklusse in gesondheidsfasiliteite en, waar toepaslik, in gemeenskapsinstellings soos skole en Ward-gebaseerde Primêre Gesondheidsorg spanne. Implementeer effektiewe monitering en evaluering prosesse, effektiewe gebruik van data en toepaslike verslagdoening oor uitsette en gesondheidsuitkomste. Bystaan, ondersteun en neem deel aan relevante navorsing. Bevorder effektiewe spanwerk en samewerking binne die DCST en met ander professionals in die distrik betrokke by die lewering van moederlike en neonatale sorg, veral die Distrik Moederlike en Kinder Gesondheidsbestuurder/s. Moontlik maak betrokkenheid met die plaaslike gemeenskap en relevante nie-regeringsorganisasies (Bv. Unjani Clinics), wat die nakoming van distrik kliniese en openbare gesondheidsriglyne waar toepaslik bevorder. Fasiliteer en verseker effektiewe kommunikasie met alle bestuursstrukture binne die distrik, die streek en tersiêre hospitale waar relevant asook die provinsiale Department of Health. Lewer gereelde verslae oor aktiwiteite, gesondheidsdienste en programme. Bystaan met strategiese en operasionele beplanning van dienste in die distrik. Koördineer en toesien dissipline verwante dienste binne die distrik. Bystaan met die werwing en bestuur van relevante menslike hulpbronne.

zu.title: Uphathi wokunakekelwa kwabesifazane
zu.summary: Phatha izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kweqembu labacwaningi abakhulumayo ngemithetho yezokwelapha ezifundeni zabesifazane, abesifazane abakhulelwe kumatumbu nezinsana e-Umgungundlovu Health District, KwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: Izifundo eziyisisekelo ze-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma noma idigri noma ekunakekelwa kwabesifazane) noma isifundo esingefani nesithako esivumela ukubhaliswa kolunye olusebenza ngokomthetho wase Ningizimu Afrika (SANC) njengesihle sekunakekelwa kwabesifazane. FUTHI, izifundo ezilandela isisekelo ekunakekelwa kwabesifazane ebalo elifana noma elingaphezu kwonyaka owodwa osemthethweni ka-SANC enkundlebeni ethile. FUTHI, ukubhaliswa kwaso maduze kolunye olusebenza ngokomthetho wase Ningizimu Afrika (SANC). FUTHI, okungenani iminyaka engu-10 (yishumi) yohlelo lwemisebenzi efanele/eqashelwe ekunakekelwa kwabesifazane ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengesihle ekunakekelwa kwabesifazane ku-SANC ngenhlangano yokunakekela iNdalo. Okungenani iminyaka engu-6 (yisithupha) yohlelo olushiwo ngenhla kufanele kube imisebenzi efanele/eqashelwe enkundlebeni ethile ngemuva kokuthola isifundo esingaphezu kwesisekelo sonyaka enkundlebeni ethile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 (yine) yohlelo olushiwo ngenhla kufakele kube imisebenzi efanele/eqashelwe ezingeni lomphathi. Ngokomthetho: Uhlelo olufanele/eqashelwe kulezi zidingo futhi kwenteleka ukubhaliswa kwalo emkhakheni ohamba phambili kwelinye izwe elingenamthetho futhi kulapho ubhaliswa obuyisisekelu olusetshenziswa ngu-SANC. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukulolonga nokulinganisa okudingekayo: Ulwazi oludinga ukusebenzisa: Ulwazi ngemikhakha yakho – izinkinga zabesifazane, abesifazane kanye nokunakekela izinsana: okuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kahle kwabesifazane abakhulelwe kumatumbu, ukunakekelwa kwabesifazane ngaphambi, ngasesikhathini nangemva kokubeletha, ukunakekelwa kwezinsana kanye nempilo yabesifazane. Imithetho, imiyalo kanye namaphoyisa. Ukulungiselela uhlelo, ukusebenzisa futhi ukuhlola ukusebenza. Ukuphatha ulwazi. Ukugqamisa futhi ukuthuthukisa izinga lezinhlelo. Amakhono kumkhakha wakho – ukunakekela abesifazane, abesifazane kanye nezinsana: okuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kahle kwabesifazane abakhulelwe kumatumbu, ukunakekelwa kwabesifazane ngaphambi, ngasesikhathini nangemva kokubeletha, ukunakekelwa kwezinsana kanye nempilo yabesifazane. Ubuholi. Ukuxhumana kahle. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kahle njengengxenye ye-DCST namanye amaqembu asesifundeni. Ukubekezela engcindezini. Ukuzethemba. Ukujabulela. Ukuzwela.
zu.duties: Mela isikhungo sakho njengelungu leQembu Labacwaningi Abakhulumayo Ngemithetho Yezokwelapha Esifundeni elibhekele ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo zezokunakekelwa kwempilo ezinhle kubesifazane, kumanina abakhulelwe kumatumbu nakwezinsana emazingeni wonke ngaphakathi kwesifunda sezokunakekelwa kwempilo. Sebenza ngokuseduze nabanye amalungu e-DCST. Xhasa ukufinyelela okulinganiselayo kwazinga elifanele lokunakekelwa kubo bonke abesifazane, manina abakhulelwe kumatumbu nezinsana kulo lonke isifunda. Gcina ukuzipha ukuziphatha ngokwezindlela zezokwelapha ngasesiqueni. Xhasa amakliniki e-PHC amayingiziwe nathwetwe, izikhungu zezokunakekelwa kwempilo komphakathi kanye nezibhedlela nazo zonke izici zokuletha izinsiza ezithinta isikhungo sakho. Xhasa futhi hlangana nabeluleki bomamane abaphakathi kwesifunda. Xhasa ukusebenza kahle kwamayeza ezokwelapha kuzo zonke izikhungo ngokuxhasa izinhlelo zokuthutha ulwazi kanye nokuthuthukisa, ukusakaza noma ukusebenzisa imithetho yezokwelapha kanye nohlelo lokwelapha olulinganiswe namazinga namahlelo kazwelonke. Yenza futhi uthathe inhlangothi ekuthuthukiseni, ukulolonga kanye nokweluleka izisebenzi ezikhandla zezokunakekelwa kwempilo kuzo zonke izikhungo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Yenza futhi uthathe inhlangothi ekulolongweni, ekuthuthukiseni nasekwelulekeni kwabahlengikazi kanye nabasebenzi bezokunakekelwa kwempilo abahlobene kanye nabaqashi bomphakathi abangabo ngaphansi kolawulo lwawo. Sebenza neQembu LaBaphathi Yesifunda ukusungula futhi ugcine izimiso okuhlanganisa ukubheka izinto ezidlule, ukwaziswa ngezempilo, ukuxhumana kanye nohlelo lokukhomba futhi uthuthelwe ukuxhasa ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Lungiselela futhi ube umongameli ohambisanayo wemiyalo Yesifunda yesikhathi Esesiginiswe Ngonyaka mayelana Nempilo Ye-Sesaba LeSisu Kwezinsana Nakwezinsana. Nikeza uxhaso ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kunesakhiwo, izinsiza kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo nasezithi zokunakekelwa okulingiselayo. Siza, xhasa futhi uthathe inhlangothi kumasebenzi okuphatha ingozi abesifazane, (isb. ukuhlaziya izinto ezingezinhle, imihlangano yegciwane nokufa, ikakhulukazi imihlangano yesikhungu nesifunda mayelana nempilo yesigaxa leSesaba leSisu kwezinsana), abasebenzi, (isb. ukulawula ukutheleleka) kanye nenhlangano, (isb. ukubukeza ukusebenza). Siza, xhasa futhi uthathe inhlangothi ekubukeni izikhwama ezinkulu ezokwelapha kanye namaqoqo ukuthuthukisa izinga kumakheli ezokunakekelwa kwempilo futhi, lapho kufanele khona, esimweni somphakathi njengalezikole kanye namagumbi e-Ward ahlele i-Primary Health Care teams. Sebenzisa ukubheka futhi uhlele imithetho yokulinganisa, ukusetshenziswa okuhle kolwazi kanye nokubika okufanele mayelana nezinto ezikhiqiziwe nemiphumela yezempilo. Siza, xhasa futhi uthathe inhlangothi ocwaningweni. Mkhiqiza isiseko esihle sokusebenza ngokuphisana kanye namanye osebenza ngaphakathi kwe-DCST, ngokuhlangana namanye abantu bomthwalo ezimweni mayelana nempilo yabesifazane nezinsana, ikakhulu ongqangi-mlingi wokugcina abesifazane nabantwana. Qinisekisa ulwazi oluchaziwe ngokusungula abantu basesigodini, abantu abangakwazi ukuqasha okuhlobene, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi kuqwalasele imithetho yezokwelapha yezifunda. Hlangana futhi ongqangi-mlingi wokugcina imithetho yezimpilo yomphakathi njengoba kufanele, bese ethuthukisa izinsiza kahle kakhulu ongqangi-mlingi kanye nabezinhlelo. Sinikeza izinhlangothi ezinkulu eziyizehlimleni, ibandakanya imithetho ngemithetho, imiyalo yezokwaziswa namaphoyisa e Department of Health.

xh.title: Umphathi weZokunyanga
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zonokhathalelo lweqela labachwephesha bekhlinikhibesithili ngokunyanga kumabaphakathi, oomama abakhulelweyo nabanewborn kummandla wezempilo we-Umgungundlovu, KwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezisisiseko ze-R425 (okt. idiploma okanye idigri okanye kwiNursing) okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiGqitha sokunyanga. KWAYE, isifundo sokunyanga esingasemva kwesigaba esisisiseko esithatha ubuncinci bonyaka ow-1 (nye) oqinisekisiwe kwi-SANC kwicala elihambelana nalo. Kwaye, ukubhalisa okwangoku kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC). Kwaye, ubuncinci beminyaka eyi-10 (khulu) yamava afanelekileyo/afunekayo kwiNursing emva kokubhalisa njengesiGqitha sokunyanga kwi-SANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Ubuncinci beminyaka eyi-6 (nthathu) yexesha elibalwe ngasentla kufuneka abe ngamava afanelekileyo/afunekayo kwicala elithile emva kokufumana isifundo sonyaka ow-1 esingasemva kwesigaba esisisiseko kwicala elihambelana nalo. Ubuncinci beminyaka eyi-4 (ne) yexesha elibalwe ngasentla kufuneka abe ngamava afanelekileyo/afunekayo kwinqanaba lolawulo. Nceda Qaphela: Amava afanelekileyo/afunekayo ngaphakathi kwale mfuno abandakanya nakanjani amava afunyanwe emva kokubhalisa kwicala elithileelweni lasezweni langaphandle, naloo mbhalo uvunyiwe yi-SANC ukubhalisa kwicala elithile. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho leNamava afunekayo: Ulwazi, Amakhono, iNamava efunekayo: Ulwazi kwicala lakho – Ukunyanga koMama, koBaphakathi kwabasetyhini nabanewborn: Kuquka ukunyanga koluhlu oluhle kaphakathi ngaphambi kokubeletha, ukunyanga ngexesha lokubeletha, ukunyanga emva kokubeletha, ukunyanga banewborn nempilo yabasetyhini. Umthetho, iimigaqo neenkqubo ezihambelana nendawo. Uqeqesho, ukusebenzisa nokuqonda iinkqubo. Ukulawula ulwazi. Iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa nokuphucula ukhwalithi. Amakhono kwicala lakho – Ukunyanga koMama, koBaphakathi kwabasetyhini nabanewborn: Kuquka ukunyanga koluhlu oluhle kaphakathi ngaphambi kokubeletha, ukunyanga ngexesha lokubeletha, ukunyanga emva kokubeletha, ukunyanga banewborn nempilo yabasetyhini. Ukulawula. Unxibelelwano oluhle. Ukuxazula iingxaki. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokwemigaqo njengexesha leqela le-DCST namanye amaqela esithili. Ukumelana nokuxinzelela. Iqinisekiso lokuzithemba. Kubalulekile ukuba nobugxina. Nenceba.
xh.duties: Mela icala lakho njengelungu leQela labaChwephesha beKhlinikha beSithili elibuzwa ngokusetyenziswa kweenkonzo zezempilo ezikhoyo kumabaphakathi, oomama abakhulelweyo nabanewborn kuzo zonke iinqanaba ngaphakathi kwesithili seezonmpilo. Sebenza ngokusondeleyo nabalwelinye balungu be-DCST. Khuthaza unxibelelwano ngokulingana kwiinqanaba ezifanelekileyo zokhathalelo kuzo onke oomama, oomama abakhulelweyo nabanewborn kuwo wonke ummandla. GCina amava kwicala lakho lokunyanga. Xhasa iiklinikhi ze-PHC ezithile nezihambahambayo, iindawo zokhathalelo loluntu nangaphakathi kweesibhedlele ngayo yonke imiba yokuqokelela iinkonzo ehambelana nocala lakho. Xhasa kwaye udibane naBaphathi beSithili abakwindawo yokuzalwa. Khuthaza ukusebenza ngokuchanileyo kwezokunyanga kuzo zonke iindawo ngokuxhasa iinkqubo zokufikelela kwaye ngokuphuhliswa, kwabiliswa okanye ukusebenza kwezithungelo zokunyanga neenqobo ezamkelayo namagunya aseburhulumente. Yenza kwaye ungene ekuphuhliseni, uqeqeshweni nakukukhokelweni kabachwephesha beempilo kuzo zonke iindawo ngaphakathi kwesithili. Yenza kwaye ungene kuqeqesho, ukuphuhliswa nakukukhokelwa kokunyanga kwabanye abachwephesha beempilo nabasebenzi bentlalo ngaphantsi kohloliwe lwabo. Sebenza namaQela oLawulo eSithili ukuyila kwaye ugcine iinkqubo eziquka ulondolozo, ulwazi lweempilo, unxibelelwano neenqobo zokuqhubela phambili nokuqokelela iinkonzo. Lungiselela kwaye uhola ngokulingana iNkomfa yeesikhathi ezintathu yokuLunga nokhathalelo loBantwana kuSithili. Zenza inkxaso ukuqinisekisa izakhiwo, izixhobo, amathuba namathunga afanelekileyo ekubonekeni kokunyanga okukhoyo. Nceda, nkxasa kwaye ungene kwiinkqubo zolawulo ingozi kubaphakathi, (umz. uqeqesho lweziganeko ezingozi, iindibano zokuRhoxa nokufa, ngakumbi iindibano zoBhalo noBantwana beNdawo noSithili), kumasebenzi, (umz. ulawulo kotyalatyalo) nenhlangano, (umz. ukuqwalaselwa kokusebenza). Nceda, nkxasa kwaye ungene kwiziqinisekiso zokunyanga nakuqheliswo lokuphucula ukhwalithi kwindawo zeempilo kwaye, apho kufanelekileyo khona, kuzimo zoluntu njengezikolo namaQela eNqanaba leWard weNkonzo yezeMpilo yoBuntu. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zokuqwalasela nokuqonda ezisebenzayo, ukusebenzisa idatha ngokuchanileyo nokubika ngokuchanileyo ngemveliso nangemiphumela yeempilo. Nceda, nkxasa kwaye ungene kuphononongo oluhambelana nendawo. Khuthaza ukusebenza ngokudibana ngokuchanileyo ngaphakathi kwe-DCST nakubaChwephesha abanye kummandla obandakanyeka ekubonekeni kukhathalelo loMama noBantwana, ngakumbi abaphathi beMaternal noBantwana beSithili. Vumela unxibelelwano loluntulwini nenhlangano ezize ngokusesikweni ezingadibani namaphandle (umz. Unjani Clinics), ukhuthaza ukulandela iinkqubo zokunyanga nempilo yoluntu kusithili njengoko kufanelekile. Yenza kwaye uqinisekise ukulawulwa ngokuchanileyo kweenkonzo kwaye nexesha kuyo yonke iinkqubo zolawulo ngaphakathi kwesithili, kweesibhedlele sephondo nakwezezigungo njengoko kufuneka nangaphantsi kwisebe lezeMpilo loMmandla. Bukela iingxelo ezizezithubeni ngezakhoyo, iinkonzo zeempilo neeNkqubo. Nceda ngeenkqubo ezibalaseleyo nangezokusetyenziswa zokuqulunqa iinkonzo kwisithili. Lawula kwaye ulole iinkonzo ezingcali kwisithili. Nceda ekubizwayo nasekulawulweni koluntu olubanzi kwabantu abafanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Manager Nursing
jobs.summary: Manager Nursing position at Umgungundlovu Health District Office in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration as a Professional Nurse with a post-basic qualification.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualifications (i.e. diploma or degree or in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. PLUS, post-basic Nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 (one) year accredited with the SANC in a relevant specialty. Plus, Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC). Plus, minimum of 10 (ten) years appropriate/recognisable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 (six) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the one-year post basic qualification in the relevant specialty. At least 4 (four) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience at management level. Please Note: Appropriate/recognisable experience in the context of these requirements also includes experience gained after registration in the particular discipline in a foreign country, and which registration is recognised by the SANC for registration in the particular discipline. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competence Required: Knowledge, Skills, Competencies Required: Knowledge in own discipline – Best quality Child Health, Paediatrics and Adolescent Health. Relevant legislation, regulations and policies. Programme planning, implementation and evaluation. Information management. Quality assurance and improvement programmes. Skills in own discipline, best quality Child Health, Paediatrics and Adolescent Health. Leadership. Good communication. Problem solving. Computer literacy. Be able to work positively as part of DCST and other district teams. Stress tolerance. Self-confidence. Objective. Empathic.
jobs.duties: Represent own discipline as a member of a District Clinical Specialist Team responsible for the delivery of quality health care for children and adolescents at all levels within a health district. Work closely with other members of the DCST. Promote equitable access to an appropriate level of care for all children, their caregivers and adolescents throughout the district. Maintain personal competency in own clinical discipline. Support PHC fixed and mobile clinics, community health centres and hospitals with all aspects of service delivery related to own discipline. Support Subdistrict Midwife Mentors with regards to child health. Promote clinical effectiveness in all facilities through supporting outreach programmes and development, dissemination or implementation of clinical protocols and standard treatment guidelines aligned with national norms and standards. Facilitate and participate in the development, training and mentorship of health professionals in all facilities within the district. Facilitate and participate in the training, development and mentorship of nursing and allied health professionals and community workers under their supervision. Be fully involved in Follow-up and Supervision of nurse clinicians trained in IMCI. Work with the District Management Team to establish and maintain systems including surveillance, health information, communication and referral guidelines and processes to support the delivery of services. Prepare for and co-chair the Quarterly District Perinatal and Child Health Meetings. Provide support to ensure appropriate infrastructure, equipment, resources and sundries for the provision of quality clinical care. Assist, support and participate in risk management activities for patients, (e.g. critical event analysis, morbidity and mortality meetings – especially Facility and District Perinatal and Child Health meetings), practitioners, (e.g. infection control) and the organisation, (e.g. performance reviews). Assist, support and participate in clinical audits and quality improvement cycles in health facilities and, where appropriate, in community settings such as schools and Ward-based Primary Health Care teams. E.g. EPoC (Essential Package of Care) for Neonates, Paediatrics and Child Health. Implement effective monitoring and evaluation processes, effective use of data and appropriate reporting on outputs and health outcomes. Assist, support and participate in relevant research. Foster effective teamwork and collaboration within the district specialist team and with other professionals in the district involved in the delivery of Child Health - especially the District Maternal and Child Health Manager/s. Enable engagement with the local community and relevant non-Governmental organisations, promoting adherence to district clinical and public health guidelines as appropriate. Facilitate and ensure effective communication with all management structures within the district, the regional and tertiary hospitals as relevant as well as the provincial Department of Health. Present regular reports on activities, health services and programmes. Assist with strategic and operational planning of services in the district. Co-ordinate and supervise discipline related services within the district. Assist with the recruitment and management of relevant human resources.

af.title: Bestuurder Verpleging
af.summary: Bestuurder Verpleging-pos by Umgungundlovu Gesondheidsdistrikskantoor in KwaZulu-Natal, wat SANC-registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met 'n na-basiese kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasies (d.w.s. diploma of graad in Verpleging) of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. PLUS, 'n na-basiese verplegingskwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 (een) jaar wat deur die SANC in 'n relevante spesialiteitsrigting geakkrediteer is. Plus, huidige registrasie met die South African Nursing Council (SANC). Plus, 'n minimum van 10 (tien) jaar toepaslike/erkenningwaardige ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 6 (ses) jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenningwaardige ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteitsrigting wees na die behaling van die eenjaar-na-basiese kwalifikasie in die relevante spesialiteitsrigting. Ten minste 4 (vier) jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenningwaardige ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Neem asseblief kennis: Toepaslike/erkenningwaardige ervaring in die konteks van hierdie vereistes sluit ook ervaring in wat na registrasie in die spesifieke dissipline in 'n buiteland opgedoen is, en waarvan die registrasie deur die SANC vir registrasie in die spesifieke dissipline erken word. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis, Vaardighede, Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis in eie dissipline – Beste gehalte Kindergesondheid, Kindergeneeskunde en Adolessentgesondheid. Relevante wetgewing, regulasies en beleide. Programbeplanning, implementering en evaluering. Inligtingsbestuur. Kwaliteitsversekering en -verbeteringsprogramme. Vaardighede in eie dissipline, beste gehalte Kindergesondheid, Kindergeneeskunde en Adolessentgesondheid. Leierskap. Goeie kommunikasie. Probleemoplossing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. In staat wees om positief as deel van DCST en ander distrikspanne te werk. Stresverdraagsaamheid. Selfvertroue. Objektief. Empaties.
af.duties: Verteenwoordig eie dissipline as 'n lid van 'n Distrik Kliniese Spesialis Span wat verantwoordelik is vir die lewer van gehalte gesondheidsorg vir kinders en adolessente op alle vlakke binne 'n gesondheidsdistrik. Werk nou saam met ander lede van die DCST. Bevordes billike toegang tot 'n toepaslike vlak van sorg vir alle kinders, hul sorgverskaffers en adolessente dwarsdeur die distrik. Handhaaf persoonlike bevoegdheid in eie kliniese dissipline. Ondersteun PHC vaste en mobiele klinieke, gemeenskapsgesondheidsentrums en hospitale met alle aspekte van dienslewering wat verband hou met eie dissipline. Ondersteun Subdistrik Vroegvrou-mentors met betrekking tot kindergesondheid. Bevorder kliniese doeltreffendheid in alle fasiliteite deur die ondersteuning van uitreikprogramme en die ontwikkeling, verspreiding of implementering van kliniese protokolle en standaardbehandelingsriglyne wat met nasionale norms en standaarde ooreenstem. Fasiliteer en neem deel aan die ontwikkeling, opleiding en mentorskap van gesondheidsprofessionals in alle fasiliteite binne die distrik. Fasiliteer en neem deel aan die opleiding, ontwikkeling en mentorskap van verpleegkundige en allied health professionals en gemeenskapswerkers onder hul toesig. Wees ten volle betrokke by die opvolg en toesig van verpleegkundige klinici wat in IMCI opgelei is. Werk saam met die Distriksbestuurspan om stelsels in te stel en te handhaaf, insluitend toezig, gesondheidsinligting, kommunikasie en verwysingsriglyne en -prosesse om die lewer van dienste te ondersteun. Berei voor vir en sitting voer as mede-voorsitter van die Kwartaallikse Distrik Perinatale en Kindergesondheidsvergaderings. Verskaf ondersteuning om toepaslike infrastruktuur, toerusting, hulpbronne en verbruiksgoedere vir die voorsiening van gehalte kliniese sorg te verseker. Bystaan, ondersteun en neem deel aan risikobestuuraktiwiteite vir pasiënte, (bv. kritieke gebeurtenis-analise, morbiditeits- en mortaliteitsvergaderings – veral Fasiliteits- en Distrik Perinatale en Kindergesondheidsvergaderings), praktisyne, (bv. infeksiebeheer) en die organisasie, (bv. prestasie-evaluerings). Bystaan, ondersteun en neem deel aan kliniese oudits en gehaltesverbeteringsiklusse in gesondheidsfasiliteite en, waar toepaslik, in gemeenskapsinstellings soos skole en Ward-based Primary Health Care spanne. Bv. EPoC (Essential Package of Care) vir Neonate, Kindergeneeskunde en Kindergesondheid. Implementeer effektiewe moniterings- en evalueringsprosesse, effektiewe gebruik van data en toepaslike verslagdoening oor lewerings en gesondheidsuitkomste. Bystaan, ondersteun en neem deel aan relevante navorsing. Bevorder effektiewe spanwerk en samewerking binne die distrikspesialisspan en met ander professionele persone in die distrik wat betrokke is by die lewer van Kindergesondheid – veral die Distrik Moeder- en Kindergesondheidsbestuurder/s. Moontlik maak betrokkenheid met die plaaslike gemeenskap en relevante nie-regeringsorganisasies, en bevordes aanhouding aan distrik kliniese en openbare gesondheidsriglyne soos toepaslik. Fasiliteer en verseker effektiewe kommunikasie met alle bestuurstrukture binne die distrik, die streek- en tersiêre hospitale soos relevant, asook die provinsiale Departement van Gesondheid. Lewer gereelde verslae oor aktiwiteite, gesondheidsdienste en programme. Bystaan met strategiese en operasionele beplanning van dienste in die distrik. Koördineer en hou toesig oor dissipline-verwante dienste binne die distrik. Bystaan met die werwing en bestuur van toepaslike menslike hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umphathi WeBuhlengikazi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMphathi WeBuhlengikazi eKantolo Jezempilo Lasesifundazweni saseKwaZulu-Natal, sidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGidi Wezinsiza WeBuhlengikazi ongesiqu esingemuva kwesiqu esisisekelo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezisezingeni R425 (okt. idiploma noma idigri noma ezoBuhlengikazi) noma isiqu esingathatha esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSANC njengesiGidi SoBuhlengikazi. FUTHELA, iziqu zobuhlengikazi ezibhalwe ngemuva kweziqu ezisezinga esibanzi okungenani isikhathi se-1 (onye) unyaka ezivunyelwe yi-SANC ekulweni nendaba ethile. Futhi, ukubhaliswa okukhulu ndawon kulona ngalesi sikhathi kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC). Futhi, okungenani iminyaka engu-10 (khulu) yeminyaka yokuqinisekiswa kwesipiliyoni esifanele/okubonakalayo kubuhlengikazi ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengesiGidi SoBuhlengikazi ku-SANC ekuQoqweni KoBuhlengikazi Jwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-6 (sithupha) yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yisipiliyoni esifanele/okubonakalayo ekulweni nendaba ethile ngemuva kokuthola iziqu zobuhlengikazi ezibhalwe ngemuva kweziqu zonyaka owodwa kulendoba ethile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 (kune) yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yisipiliyoni esifanele/okubonakalayo ezingeni lokuqashwa. Sicela Uqaphele: Isipiliyoni esifanele/okubonakalayo endleleni yalezo zidingo futhi ihlanganisa isipiliyoni esitholakele ngemuva kokubhaliswa kwendoobo ethile elizweni langaphandle, okuyilo bhaliswa elibonwa yi-SANC ukubhalisa kwendoobo ethile. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi, Amakhono, Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi ekulweni nendaba ngokwemfundo yakho – Ikhwalithi engcono kakhulu yezempilo yezingane, izifo zezingane kanye nezempilo yabasebasheni. Imithetho, imithethonqubo kanye namapholisi ahlobene nokwenza. Ukucubungula izinhlelo, ukuphatha kanye nokuqinisekisa. Ukuphatha kolwazi. Izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi nokuthuthukisa. Amakhono ekulweni nendaba ngokwemfundo yakho, ikhwalithi engcono kakhulu yezempilo yezingane, izifo zezingane kanye nezempilo yabasebasheni. Ubukhosi. Ukuxhumana okuhle. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kahle njengengxenye ye-DCST kanye namanye amaqembu asesifundeni. Ukubekezela ingcindezi. Ukuzethemba. Ukuba nobuzwe obuhle. Ukuzwela.
zu.duties: Mela inqobo yakho njengelungu le-Qembu Leziqu Ikhono Lemitholampilo Esifundeni elibhekene nokulethwa kwemitholampilo yezinga eliphezulu yezingane nabasebasheni emazingeni wonke ngaphakathi kwesifunda sezempilo. Sebenza kusonde lapho kanye namanye amalungu e-DCST. Khuthaza ukufinyelela okulinganisayo kwazinga ahlelekile okwelasho kuzo zonke izingane, abanakekeli bazo nabasebasheni kulo lonke isifunda. Gcina ikhono lakho ngokwemfundo yakho yezokwelapha. Sekela amaklinikhi e-PHC ahlala khona ahambayo, izikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi nezigodla ngazo zonke izindikimba zokulethwa kwezinsiza ezihlobene nenqobo yakho. Sekela abaphathi bombelethisi bazinga ngaphansi kwesifunda ngendaba yezempilo yezingane. Khuthaza ukusebenza kahle kwemitholampilo kuzo zonke izikhungo ngokusekela izinhlelo zokuthumela kolwazi kanye nentuthuko, ukusabalalisa noma ukuphatha imithetho yokwelapha kanye nezinhlela zokwelashwa ezihambisana nemiqatho namazinga wesifunda namazwe. Hlinzeka ngokubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukisweni, ukuqeqeshweni nasekuholeleni iziqu zezempilo kuzo zonke izikhungo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Hlinzeka futhi ubambe iqhaza kuqeqesho, ekuthuthukiseni nasekuhola abaphathi bocukuse kanye neziqu zezempilo ezihlobene nalabo abasebenza nomphakathi abangaphansi kokulawula kwabo. Zibandakanye ngokugcwele ekulandeleni nasekuqashweni kwabakhokhelwa bezinhluli bokuqeqeshwa kwi-IMCI. Sebenza ne-Qembu Lokuqasha Isifunda ukusungula kanye negcina izinhlela ezihlanganisa ukugcina iliso, ulwazi lwesempilo, ukuxhumana nemihlahla yokukhombela kanye nenqubo yokusekela ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Lungiselela futhi ube ngusihlala ohlanganyele iNhlangano Yezigodi Yokuqala Ukuzalwa Nezempilo Yezingane Ezibunjwa njalo ngenkathi yonyaka unyaka. Nikeza isekelo ukuqinisekisa isakhiwo esifanele, izinsiza, amadivayisi nezinto ezidingekayo ukuletha imitholampilo yezinga eliphezulu. Siza, sekele futhi uthathe inxaxheba emisebenzini yokuphathwa kwezingozi kubafundi, (isb. ukuhlaziya izehlo eziphuthumayo, iinhlangano zokuhamba nokufa – ikakhulukazi izikhungo kanye Nesifunda iNhlangano Yokuqala Ukuzalwa Nezempilo Yezingane), abasebenzi, (isb. ukulawulwa kokuthelelana) nenhlangano, (isb. ukuhlola ukusebenza). Siza, sekele futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuhloleni imitholampilo nasemigqeni yekhwalithi ekuthuthukiseni izikhungo zezempilo futhi, lapho kufanele khona, kumimangalo yomphakathi njengezikole namaqembu e-PHC aseMigwaqweni. Isb. i-EPoC (Iphakethe elibalulekile lezinsiza zokwelashwa) lezinhlobo zamafu, amafu ezantwana kanye nezempilo yezingane. Phatha imigqa efesimpule yokuqapha nokuqinisekisa, ukusebenzisa idatha ngempumelelo nokubika okufanele ngemithombo kanye nemiphumela yezempilo. Siza, sekele futhi uthathe inxaxheba ocwaningweni olumayelana nendaba. Khuthaza ukusebenzisana okunamandla phakathi kweqembu labagcini besifunda nakwabanye ongogqetha basesifunda ababandakanyeka ekuletheni izinsiza zezempilo yezingane – ikakhulukazi abaphathi beMama bakaSifunda kanye neNhloli Yezempilo Yezingane. Nika amandla ukubamba iqhaza nomphakathi wendawo kanye nenhlangano zangaphandle ezihlobene, khuthaza ukulandela imithetho yokuqashwa yezokwelapha kanye namazwe esifunda njengoba kufanele. Hlinzeka kwaye uqinisekise ukuthi ukuxhumana kuyasebenza kuyo yonke izakhiwo eziphatha ngaphakathi kwesifunda, izibhedlela zesifunda nakwezikhungo njengoba kufanele, kanye nomnyango wezempiwo weSifunda seKwaZulu-Natal. Yetha imibiko ejwayelekile ngezikhathi mayelana nemisebenzi, imitholampilo nezinhlelo. Siza ekucubunguleni nasekucingweni ngemisebenzi kwesifunda. Hlanganisa futhi ulawule izinsiza ezihlobene nendaba ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Siza ekubeni abantu abafakiwe kwaye baphathwe ngendlela efanele.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager Nursing
jobs.summary: Deputy Manager Nursing position at Umgungundlovu Health District Office requiring a Professional Nurse qualification and nine years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualifications (i.e. diploma or degree or in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC). Minimum of 9 (nine) years appropriate/recognisable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 4 (four) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience at management level. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competence Required: Knowledge, Skills, Competencies Required: Knowledge and understanding of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal/health-related Acts, regulations, guidelines and other related policies such as the Nursing Act. Code of Ethics. Professional Practice of the South African Nursing Council. Nursing Standards of Practice, Scope of Practice, Skills Development Act. Public Service 95 PUBLIC Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act. Patients’ Rights, Batho Pele Principles, Public Finance Management act. Mentorship and supervisory skills. Leadership, Management, Planning, Organizing, Problem Solving Skills and coordinating skills. Clinical competencies and policy formulation skills. Knowledge of nursing care delivery approaches. Good verbal and written communication skills. Conflict management/sound employee management skills. Knowledge and understanding of Human Resources and Financial practices.
jobs.duties: Provide leadership and a strategic direction in the delivery of integrated District Health Services based on relevant policy imperatives. Qinisekisa futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlela eziceliwe ekunikezweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo esifundeni. Phatha ngempumelelo futhi uthuthukise yonke imithombo ngaphansi kokuqonda kwakho ukuze kuqiniseke ukusebenza kahle, ubumnini nenkokhelo enkulu ekunikeleni izinsizakalo. Akha futhi ugcinise ubuhlobo obuqinile nemikhandlu yomphakathi, amakomidi okulawula, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kohulumhlo kanye nalabo abanye abahlanganyeli bezinhlobonhlobo zezempilo. Thatha inhlalo yokubambe iqhaza kwi-DDM, i-Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) kanye nalezo ezinye izinhlanganisela eziphakathi kwezinhleko. Lawula, wofundisa futhi uthuthukise amaqembu ezempilo zomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekise ukusebenza ngamandla, ukuthuthuka okokuqhubekayo nokuhambisana nemigomo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngokugcwele kwezinhlelo ezibalulekile ukuze kuncishiswe ukugula nokufa okubangelwa izifo ezelwayo kanye nalezo ezingazelwa. Yisa isinqumo senqubo yokwenza iqiniseke ukuthi wonke umphakathi wesifunda se-uMgungundlovu uthola ukwelulekwa kwezempilo. Shesha ukusetshenziswa kwe-PHC Re-engineering kuso sonke isifunda.

zu.title: Umphathi Osekela Ikhaya Lezinsiza Eziphilayo - Jikelele
zu.summary: Umphathi Osekela Ikhaya Lezinsiza Eziphilayo (Jikelele) ePort Shepstone Hospital, ofuna idiploma yokwelapha izinsiza eziphilayo, ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC kanye namashumi eminyaka yomlando.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 / Matric noma okulinganayo. Idiploma / I-degree eNyuvesi yokwelapha izinsiza eziphilayo jikelele. Idiploma / I-degree eNyuvesi yokwelapha izinsiza eziphilayo zabesifazane abakhulelwe. Idiploma / I-degree eNyuvesi yezinhlengo zengqondo, Idiploma / I-degree eNyuvesi yokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezempilo. Isitifiketi sekhompyutha. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje kwi-SANC njengesiguli sokwelapha izinsiza eziphilayo jikelele, unkulunkulu wabakhulelwe / ongumsebenzi wezinsiza eziphilayo zabesifazane, isiguli sezinhlengo zengqondo nokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezempilo. Umlingo ongeqwe weminyaka engu-10 womlando okuhle / obonakalayo ekwelapheni izinsiza eziphilayo emhlabeni wesibhedlela ngemva kokubhaliswa njengesiguli sokwelapha izinsiza eziphilayo jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-3 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe umlando okuhle / obonakalayo njengonozini Wezinsiza Eziphilayo. Isiteshi se-SANC 2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi olujulile ngemithetho yezinsiza eziphilayo, iziko lezinsiza eziphilayo kanye nenkqubo yemisebenzi. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemithethongu ehlobene kuhlanganise umthetho wezinsiza eziphilayo, umthetho wezempilo kazwelonke, umthetho wezempilo nokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha emsebenzini, umthetho wokuqhathaniswa kwezinsizakusebenza, imithethongu yesevisi yomphakathi, izimiso zikaBatho Pele, isibhali sezilingelo zabagulayo, kanye nemithethongu ehlobene nomnyango Wezempilo. Ulwazi olunamandla ngemigangatho yezinsiza eziphilayo zokuphenya ngasese, amaphrothokholo kanye nezinkomba zokwelapha. Amakhono obuholi, okuqondisa, ukuhlela, ukuhlela ngokwemithetho nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikono lokuphatha abantu, imali kanye nezinsiza ngempumelelo. Amakhono ohlakaniphile lokuthintana nabantu, kokuxhumana, kokuphatha izinkinga kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza zabantu, ukuphathwa kwemitsetsho yabasebenzi kanye namasistimu okuphatha ukusebenza. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha ohlelweni lwe-Microsoft Office. Ikono lokusebenza ngempumelelo emhlabeni wethimba elihlangene ndawonye.
zu.duties: Nika abantu abaningi isikhundla sobuholi futhi uqiniseke ukuthi kuhlinzekwa ngamayunithi ezinsiza eziphilayo ezinhle ngokuphelele emigangathweni esethiwe nasemibhalweni yemithetho / ngethemuyunivesi. Hlela, hlela ngokwemithetho, hlanganisa, qaphula imisebenzi yezinsiza eziphilayo kanye nokuphatha izinkinga kuleyo ndawo ukuze uqiniseke ukunakekelwa okuhle kwabagulayo. Qaphula futhi ukhuthaze izindlela zokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka, ukuphepha kwabagulayo kanye nokuqashwa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kokuhle. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa nokusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwabantu, imali nezinsiza. Qaphula imali ngokugqamisa ukuqinisekiswa kwezindleko kanye nokugcina yonke imibhalo emithethweni yemali mayelana nokuthenga kanye nemithetho mayelana nokukhiqiza imali. Qondisa futhi usekele basebenzi bezinsiza eziphilayo, qinisekisa ukulandela amaphrothokholo, imithetho kanye nomgangatho wokunakekelwa. Qaphula ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza eziphilayo zomthetho kanye nemigangatho yokuhlonza ubuhle. Qinisekisa ukuthi iyunithi ihambisana nemigangatho ye-OHSC ne-IHRM. Hlolwa abasebenzi ngokusebenza kwabo futhi usebenzise ipulani yosizo yomqashi. Sebenzisana namathambo ahlangene ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kuhlinzekwa ngezenzo eziphumayo, ezibiza kakhulu nangokulingana. Hlanganisa futhi wenze kube lula ukuqondiswa, ukuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi kwesikhundla kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ngokokuqhubekayo. Qamba futhi uhlinze ngemibiko, izibalo kanye nalolunye ulwazi oludingekayo. Yiba ngamandla emisebenzi yokuphenya futhi ukhuthaze ukwelapha izinsiza eziphilayo ngokusekelwe enkingisweni. Gcina ukukhula komthetho, imigangatho yeziko nokuzithuthukisa. Yiba ngumphathi futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwesistimu ye-CPD njengoko kuhlelwe isikhungo se-SANC se-CPD.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedisayo weZemali yokuNakekela- iJikelele
xh.summary: Umphathi oNcedisayo woNakekelo (iJikelele) ePort Shepstone Hospital, ofuna idiploma yonakekelo, ukubhalisa kwi-SANC nakhawunye iminyaka eyi-10 yamava.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 / iMatric oku eqathaniswa nayo. Idiploma / iDegree kwisiNzululwazi soNakekelo lweJikelele. Idiploma / iDegree kwisiNzululwazi soNakekelo lweMidwifery. Idiploma / iDegree kwiPsychiatry, Idiploma / iDegree ekulawulweni kwesebe lezeMpi lo kuNakekelo. Isatifikethi kwiklasi yekhompyutha. Ukubhalisa kwangoku ne-SANC njengesiGqithi soNakekelo iJikelele, iMidwife / iAccoucher, iPsychiatry nasekuLawulweni kweSebe lezeMpi lo kuNakekelo. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-10 yamava afanelekileyo / aqatyanelwayo okliniki kwindawo yesibhedlele emva kokubhalisa njengesiGqithi soNakekelo iJikelele. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-3 yexesha elithintelwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo / aqatyanelwayo njengoMphathi weMisebenzi yoNakekelo. Isityhala seSANC sika-2026. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho nokuSebenzela okuFunekayo: Ulwazi olujulileyo ngomthetho weNtengiso yonakekelo, izigqibo ezinzima zokuziphatha komsebenzi wokugqitha nokwenza. Ulwazi ngomthetho othintela kunye namagunya aquka iNtengiso yoNakekelo, uMthetho wezeMpi lo weSizwe, uMthetho woKuPhepha kwoMsebenzi nokuQinisekiswa, uMthetho weMpilo yoBomi, iMigaqo yeNkonzo yaKawonke, iMigaqo kaBatho Pele, iNqaku lamaLungelo aboGulayo, kunye namagunya esebe lezeMpi lo kunye neziko elithintela. Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngamazinga, iinkqubo kwaye nokuqonda iNtengiso yoNakekelo loGqithiweyo wezenzo ngokubethelwa kwaye ngokweNtetho ekuqwalaselwa ngayo. Amandla okuba ngumongameli, okuQeqesha aboMsebenzi, iNkqubo, uMgangatho weMisebenzi nokuSombulula iNgxaki. Amandla okulawula abantu, imali nezinto ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Amandla aphambili ekunxibelelaneni, ekunxibelelaneni nabantu, ekusombululeni iingxaki kwaye ekubhaliweni kweekhophi. Ulwazi ngokuLawulwa kwabaNtu baseNkonzo, iNgxaki zoBomi nokuQwalaselwa kweenkqubo zoMsebenzi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokuchanekileyo kwiinkqubo zeMicrosoft Office. Amandla okusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwindawo eqokelelwe abantu abanjalo bokugqitha.
xh.duties: Nika isoqhakavu kwaye uqinisekise ukubonelelwa kwezinto ezifunekayo, ezizonke kwaye zilungele iindawo zonakekelo ngokwamazinga afunekayo nokuLawulwa ngokomthetho / ngokweNtetho. Yila inkqubo, yihlole, yibeke ngendlela kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yonakekelo kwaye ulawule iNkonzo kwiNgcinezelo yonke kwelinye iqondo ukunika iNkonzo yonakekelo lomntu ogulayo. Qwalasela kwaye ukhuthaze iinkqubo zoKuthintela nokuQwalaselwa iNkonzo ekuNakekelweni, uKhupelelo kwabaNtu baseNkonzo kunye nokuPuhla kweNkonzo. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo nokuSebenzisa abantu, imali nezinto. Qwalasela imali ngokugqithisa kwiNkonzo ekugcineni iNkcitho kwaye ugine zonke iinkcukacha ngeenkcitho zemali ezimalunga nokuThenga kwaye ngeenkcitho ezifunwa ngokwenza iNkcitho. Qeqesha kwaye uxhase abaGqithiswa boNakekelo, uqinisekise ukulandela iinkqubo, amagunya nokuQwalasela iNkonzo ekuNakekelweni. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweenkqubo zokuLawulwa kweNtengiso kwaye nokuQwalasela iNkcitho nokuBonelela iNkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuba iNtengiso ihambelana neNkcitho kaBantu baseNkonzo nasekuQwalaselweni kweNkcitho kaBantu baseNkonzo ekuNakekelweni. Qwalasela aboMsebenzi ekusebenzeni nokuQwalasela iNkcitho yaboMsebenzi. Sebenzisana nabantu abaqokelelweyo ukuze uqinisekise iNkonzo ekuNakekelweni ngokuchanekileyo, ngokugqithisa iNkcitho kwaye ngesabelo esilinganisela wonke umntu. Hlela kwaye uxhase iNkqubo yoKungenisa aboMsebenzi abasha, uQeqesho lwangaphakathi nokuQeqeshwa kwaye nokuphuhliswa kolwazi lwabaMsebenzi. Yila kwaye ugcwalise iinkcukacha, izibalo nolunye ulwazi olufunekayo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yokuFunda kwaye ukhuthaze iNtengiso ekuNakekelweni ngokusebenzisa iNkqubo eqinisekisiweyo. P-hlula ulwazi lwakho, amagunya agqithiswayo nokuPuhla kolwazi. Qonda kwaye uQwalasele ukusebenza kweNkqubo kaBantu baseNkonzo njengoko kucacisiwe yiNkqubo kaBantu baseNkonzo.

Verskaf leierskap en verseker die voorsiening van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde O&G-verpleegeenhede binne vasgestelde standaarde en professionele / regtelike raamwerk. Beplan, organiseer, koördineer, monitor verpleegaktiwiteite en rampbestuur in die domein om gehalte pasiëntesorg te verseker. Monitor en bevorder Infeksievoorkoming en Beheerpraktyke, pasiëntveiligheid en gehaltsverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Verseker effektiewe bestuur en benutting van menslike, finansiële en materiële hulpbronne. Monitor finansiële hulpbronne met klem op kostebeheer en byhou van alle rekords binne finansiële beleide rakende verkryging en die beleid rakende inkomstegegenereering. Supriveiseer en ondersteun verpleegpersoneel, verseker nakoming van protokolle, beleide en sorgstandaarde. Verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan OHSC- en IHRM-standaarde. Monitor implementering van kliniese bestuursprogramme en gehaltversekeringsstandaarde. Evalueer personeel se werkprestasie, en implementeer werknemer bystandsplan. Werk saam met multidissiplinêre spanne om doeltreffende, koste-effektiewe en billike dienslewering te verseker. Koördineer en fasiliteer oriëntering, in-diensopleiding, mentorskap en deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling van personeel. Stel verslae, statistieke en ander vereiste inligting op en dien dit in. Neem deel aan navorsingsaktiwiteite en bevorder bewysgebaseerde verpleegpraktyk. Onderhou professionele groei, etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Beywer en monitor die implementering van CPD-program ooreenkomstig die SANC CPD-raamwerk.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi- Okukhethekile
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wemisebenzi esibhedlela i-Port Shepstone Hospital endaweni yokunakekela abantu abakhulelwe nezalo ukuba ahole ukunakekelwa kwezokubelethisa, aphathe izimo eziphuthumayo, abuke futhi aqinisekise ukunakekelwa kwezokuhlenga.
zu.requirements: I-GRADE 12 / Matric noma okulinganayo. I-Diploma / I-Degree kusayensi yokuhlenga jikelele. I-Diploma / I-Degree kusayensi yokubelethisa. I-1 year post basic qualification kusayensi yokubelethisa ezuzele kakhulu. I-Diploma / I-Degree ekuqondweni kwezinsizakusebenza zempilo. Isitifikedi ekilasini lekhompyutha. Ukuqajelwa njengamanje ne-SANC njengomhlinzi jikelele, umhlinzi wokubelethisa / umsizi wokubelethisa, ezuzele kakhulu kusayensi yokuhlenga. Ubuncwane beminyaka eyi-7 yokuhlenga okufanele / okwaziwayo esibhedlela ngemuva kokuqajelwa njengomhlinzi jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 kuleyo kufanele ibe ukuhlenga endaweni yezokubelethisa ngemva kokuthola i-1 year post basic qualification kusayensi yokubelethisa ezuzele. Isitifikedi se-SANC 2026. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqesha nokuqeqesha okudingekayo: Ulwazi lwenqubo kanye nemithetho yokuhlenga, imithetho yokuhlenga, kanye nalawo eminye imithetho ebalulekile njengoba: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient's Rights Charter, izimiso ze-Batho Pele, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, i-Disiplinary Code and Procedure, i-Grievance Procedure njll. Amakhono obuholo, ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lwezimali namabhajethi mayelana nezinsizakusebenza eziphathwe. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu okufaka phakathi ukwenza ubudlelwano nomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye namakhono okweluleka. Ukuhlela futhi uhumushe imibhalo yemibiko. Amakhono ekhompyutha ohlelweni oluwusuku. Amakhono obuholo, ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Diagnostic and ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo zokubelethisa ekungenweni kadokotela (okuthi) i-Eclampsia, i-APH njll. Ukubona abatholwa abasesimingweni esiphezulu senhlangothi phambi nangemva kokubeletha, ukubaphatha noma ukubathumela ngokomthethosisekelo wesibhedlela. Ukuthuthukisa umbono, umgomo namagephu enqinweni yokubelethisa. Ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa nokuphinda ubuke izinqubomgomo zokubelethisa / i-SOP. Ukwenza izinkomfa noma imihlangano yokubuka ukufa kwezinsana ezingakazalwa. Ukukwazi imithetho nemibandela ye-SANC mayelana nokubelethisa. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zemfundo yangaphakathi nentuthuko yekhwalithi enqanweni yokubelethisa. Ukuba ngumelweli wabatholwa kusetshenziswa izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Ukuba yingxenye yeqembu elihlangene emikhakheni eminingi. Ukubamba iqhaza nokuba ngumholi kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokubelethisa, okuthi i-PPIP, i-PMTCT, i-BBI, i-MBFI, ne-RHC – impilo yenza le. Ukubona izidingo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Ukwenza ukuphathwa ngokubamba iqhaza ngokusiza emisebenzini yokusiza umqondisi. Ukugcina nokubuka isitoko nezinsizakusebenza. Ukuhamba imihlangano ebanjwe esikhungweni / phandle. Nikeza ubuholo futhi uqinisekise ukunikezwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezihle kakhulu, eziphelele eziqeqeshwe kakhulu kumayunithi e-O&G ngaphakathi kwezinga ezihlwelwe nemithetho / yomthethosisekelo ohlelwe. Hlela, hlela komgwaqo, landela imisebenzi yokuhlenga kanye nokuphathwa kwezisuleleko endaweni ukuze uqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle komuntu ogulayo. Buka futhi ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka, ukuphepha komuntu ogulayo nentuthuko yezinhlelo zekhwalithi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokusebenzisa izinsizakholwandle, ezemali, nezobuqwangu. Buka izinsizakusebenza zemali ngokugqamisa ukugcina izindleko nokugcina yonke imibhalo ngaphakathi kwezinqubomgomo zemali mayelana nokuthenga kanye nenqubomgomo mayelana nokukhiqiza imali. Qeqesha futhi usekele abasebenzi bokuhlenga, qinisekisa ukulandela imithetho, izinqubomgomo nezinga lokunakekelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi inqobo ihambisana nezinga le-OHSC ne-IHRM. Buka ukusebenziswa kwezinhlelo zokulawula okusemthethweni kwezokwelapha kanye nezinga lokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Hlola abasebenzi ngemisebenzi yawo, futhi usebenzise ihlelo lokusiza abaqashi. Sebenzisana namaqembu ahlukene emikhakheni eminingi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwenza okusebenzayo, okugcina izindleko futhi okulinganayo. Hlela futhi wenze kube lula ukuqondisa, ukuqeqesha ngaphakathi, ukwelisa nokuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo komsebenzi wabasebenzi. Hlela futhi uhambise imibhalo, izibalo nalolunye ulwazi oludingekayo. Bamba iqhaza emsebenzini wocwaningo futhi ukuthuthukise ukwenza kwamakhilihathi okuhlola. Hlala ukhula, uhlele izimiso zokuziphatha nokuzithuthukisa. Zulu nokubuka ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo ye-CPD njengoko kuhlelwe ngokwe-SANC CPD Framework.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi- Iqela elizinikeleyo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umphathi wemisebenzi esibhedlele i-Port Shepstone Hospital kwibhedi yokuqaliswa kokuletha neyokuzala ukuze aphathe ukunyanga ukubeletha, alawize iimeko ezibuthathaka, aze alawule nanikezelo lenkonzo yokuhlala kwabagulayo.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or Equivalent. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing Science. Diploma / Degree in Midwifery Nursing Science. 1 year post basic qualification in Advanced Midwifery Nursing Science. Diploma / Degree in Health Service Management. Certificate in Computer Course. Current registration with SANC as General Nurse, Midwife / Accoucher, Advanced Nursing Science. A minimum of 7 years appropriate / recognizable clinical experience in a hospital environment after registration as General Nurse. At least 5 years of the above should be clinical experience in Obstetrics unit after obtaining the 1 year post basic qualification in Advanced Midwifery Nursing Science. SANC receipt 2026. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient’s Rights Charter, Batho Pele principles, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure etc. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem solving abilities. Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the resources under management. Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Planning and organizing, report writing skills. Computer skills in basic programme. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem-solving abilities.
xh.duties: Diagnose and manage obstetric emergencies in the absence of a doctor (i.e.) Eclampsia APH etc. Identify high risk clients during ante-partum and post- partum periods, manage them or refer them accordingly to hospital policy. Develop vision and mission and objectives for obstetric unit. Develop, implement and review obstetric policies / SOP. Conduct Perinatal Mortality reviews or meetings. Know SANC rules and regulations pertaining to obstetrics. Develop and implement in-service education and quality improvement programs for the obstetrics department. Act as an advocate for clients utilizing Batho Pele principles. Form part of the multi-disciplinary team. Participate and lead in all obstetrics programs, i.e. PPIP, PMTCT, BBI, MBFI, and RHC – reproductive health. Identify training needs for the staff. Practice participative management by assisting with relief duties of the supervisor. Maintain and monitor stock and supplies. Attend meetings held in the institution / outside. Provide leadership and ensure the provision of optimal, holistic specialized O&G nursing units within set standards and professional / legal framework. Plan, organise, coordinate, monitor nursing activities and disaster management in the domain to ensure quality patient care. Monitor and promote Infection Prevention and Control Practices, patient safety and quality improvement initiatives. Ensure effective management and utilization of human, financial, and material resources. Monitor financial resources with emphases on cost containment and keeping of all records within financial policies regarding procurement and the policy regarding revenue generation. Supervise and support nursing personnel, ensure adherence to protocols, policies and standard of care. Ensure that the unit complies with OHSC and IHRM Standards. Monitor implementation of clinical governance programmes and quality assurance standards. Evaluate staff on work performance, and implement employer assistance plan. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure efficient, cost-effective and equitable service delivery. Coordinate and facilitate orientation, in-service training mentoring and continuous professional development of staff. Compile and submit reports, statistics and other information required. Participate in research activities and promote evidence based nursing practice. Maintain professional growth, ethical standards and self-development. Champion and monitor the implementation of CPD program as per SANC CPD Framework.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing PHC Grade1
jobs.salary_text: R720 8198 – R821 454 per annum, basic salary, 8% inhospitable allowance of basic salary, 13th cheque, Medical Aid (optional), Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Manage primary healthcare nursing operations and service delivery at a district hospital clinic, overseeing facility plans and quality improvement programmes.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Senior Certificate, Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing and Midwifery) plus (1) year post-basic nursing qualification in Clinic Nursing Science Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC). Current registration with SANC (2026) as General Nurse, Midwife/Accoucheur and Primary Health Care. A minimum of nine (09) years appropriate /recognisable nursing experience after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing of which at least five (5) years must be appropriate/recognizable PHC experience after obtaining a one (1) year post basic qualification in PHC. In depth knowledge of nursing legislation, related legal and ethical nursing practices, public service policies and other Health related prescripts. Knowledge of quality norms and standards as directed by Negotiated Service Delivery Agreement, OHSC and ICRM prescripts, patient Right Charter and Batho Pele Principle. Leadership, organizing, decision - making, problem solving skills. Computer literacy to enhance service delivery. Time and conflict management skills. Report writing skills. Communication skills to enhance teamwork. Human Resource and Financial Management.
jobs.duties: Provision of comprehensive package of services at Primary health Care level. Develop, implement and monitor facility plans and submit progress reports. Implement quality improvement Programs that work towards achieving Universal Health Coverage as stipulated in the National Health Act. Effective utilization and monitoring of resources in line with cost containment plan. Effectively implement PHC Re-engineering strategy. Implement Employment Performance management and Development System. Manage and utilize date to improve service delivery and health outcomes. Implement and monitor Department projects, including special project in line with health calendar. Conduct clinical audits of priority programs with the aim to improve health care services.
