af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde PHC Graad1
af.summary: Bestuur primêre gesondheidsorg-verpleegbedrywighede en dienslewering by 'n distriks hospitaalkliniek, met toesig oor fasiliteitsplanne en gehalteverbeteringsprogramme.
af.requirements: Graad 12/ Senior Sertifikaat, Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vroedkunde) plus (1) jaar postbasiese verpleegkwalifikasie in Kliniek Verpleegkunde Wetenskap Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en Sorg (PHC). Huidige registrasie by SANC (2026) as Algemene Verpleegkundige, Vroedvrou/Verloskundige en Primêre Gesondheidsorg. 'n Minimum van nege (09) jaar toepaslike /herkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde waarvan ten minste vyf (5) jaar toepaslike/herkenbare PHC-ervaring moet wees na die verkryging van 'n een (1) jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in PHC. Diep kennis van verpleegwetgewing, verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyke, openbare diensbeleid en ander Gesondheidsverwante voorskrifte. Kennis van gehaltenorme en standaarde soos gerig deur Onderhandelde Diensleweringsooreenkoms, OHSC en ICRM-voorskrifte, pasiënteregtehandves en Batho Pele-beginsel. Leierskap, organiseer-, besluitneming- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid om dienslewering te verbeter. Tyd- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede om spanwerk te verbeter. Menslike Hulpbron- en Finansiële Bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaffing van 'n omvattende pakket van dienste op primêre gesondheidsorgvlak. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor fasiliteitsplanne en doen vorderingsverslag oor. Implementeer gehalteverbeteringsprogramme wat daarop gemik is om Universele Gesondheidsdekking te bereik soos uiteengesit in die Nasionale Gesondheidswet. Effektiewe benutting en monitering van hulpbronne in ooreenstemming met kostebeheerplan. Implementeer PHC-heringenieurstroategie effektief. Implementeer Werksprestasie-bestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel. Bestuur en benut data om dienslewering en gesondheidsuitkomste te verbeter. Implementeer en monitor departementele projekte, insluitend spesiale projekte in ooreenstemming met die gesondheidskalender. Voer kliniese oudits van prioriteitsprogramme uit met die doel om gesondheidsorgdienste te verbeter.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokwelapha Eyangaphakathi Kobuhlengi Bokuqala Ohlangothi Lwezempilo Elingaphakathi izinga 1
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yokwelapha eyangaphakathi kobuhlengi bokuqala nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo enkliniki yesibhedlela sesifunda, bengibuza amaphulo esikhungo namaphrogramu okuthuthukisa izinga.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/ Isitifikedi Samakhulu Ongu-12, Iziqu ezisisiseko ze-R425 (okungukuthi iDiploma / I-Digri kubuhlengi jikelele nakokubeletha) okuhlangene nesiqu sokuhlengi semuva kokuqala esithatha unyaka (1) kwesayensi yokuhlengi enkliniki, ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa (PHC). Ukuqashelwa kwamanje ne-SANC (2026) njengesihlengi esijwayelekile, ongumbelethisi/nosiseduzi nokwelapha ezempilo ezingaphakathi. Ukuze ube nokungenani eminyaka yisishiyagalolunye (09) yeminyaka yamava okuhle okwayo/okuqashwayo kokuhlengi emuva kokubhalisa njengesihlengi esiphumelelekile ne-SANC kokuhlengi jikelele, okuyinto okungenani eminyaka eyisihlanu (5) kumele ibe yamava ahle okuqashwayo kokwelapha ezempilo ezingaphakathi emuva kokuthola isiqu sokuhlengi seminyaka eyodwa (1) esemuva kokuqala (post-basic) kokwelapha ezempilo ezingaphakathi. Ukuqonda ngobunjalo kokumelana nokuhlengi, okuhlobene nomthetho nokuziphatha kokuhlengi, izinqubomgomo zomphakathi kanye nezinye izimiso ezihlobene nezempilo. Ulwazi lwezilinganiso nezimiso zekhwalithi njengokuqondiswa isivumelwano somsebenzi wokuletha izinsizakalo esixhunyiwe, OHSC ne-ICRM, isitifikedi samalungelo esiguli kanye nemigomo ye-Batho Pele. Amakhono okuba ngumholi, ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo, nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi nokulawula impiyayezingxabano. Amakhono okubhala okubika. Amakhono okuxhumana ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukuphatha abasebenzi nezimali.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza isethi eqembu kwaye eyodwa yezinsizakalo ezingeni lokwelapha ezempilo ezingaphakathi. Lenga, ukuphumeza bese ulawula amaphulo esikhungo uthume okubika inqubo. Phatha ngokusebenzisa amaphrogramu okuthuthukisa izinga ahlose ukufinyelela ukubandakanywa okujwayelekile kokunakekelwa kwezempilo njengokuqunyiwe eMthethweni Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nokulawulwa kwemithombo ngokuhambisana nesu lokugcina izindleko. Ukuphatha ngokusebenzayo i-PHC Re-engineering. Phatha i-Employment Performance management and Development System. Phatha bese usebenzisa ukwaziswa ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo nemiphumela yezempilo. Phatha bese ulawula amaphulo omnyango, okuhlanganisa napho ahlobene nekhalenda yezempilo. Yenza ukuhlolwa kokuhlengi kwamaphrogramu abalulekile nenhloso yokuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa ezempilo.

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi yeGqeberha iPHC Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Ukulawula iinkqubo zesiGqeberha kunye nokunikelwa kweenkonzo kwindawo ezisemzimbeni zokwenza iziGqeberha, nokuqhawukela iindawo ezisemzimbeni zokulawula nokuqhuba imicimbi engangcamsha.
xh.requirements: IQondo le-12/ Isatifikethi seQondo eliPhezulu, isemfuno esisiseko seR425 (okt. Diploma / Degree kwesiXhosa ngokusetyenziswa iindawo ezahlukeneyo zeNkundla yeGqebera) kwaye ihlaziwe ngokuhambisana neMthetho weNkundla yeGqeberha neNkundla yeBabbiza, nokuba ngesiqinisekiso semisebenzi yehlelo eqinisekisa iinkqubo ezifunwa kumagatya eNkundla yeGqeberha kwesiXhosa. Isatifikethi sokubhalisa kwi-SANC (2026) njengesiXhosa ngokusetyenziswa kweNkundla yeGqeberha, yeBabbiza/Accoucheur kunye neZempilo lokuQala. Ubuncinane i-9 (09) yeminyaka yokungahamba emva kwenkundla yeNkundla yeGqeberha ukuya kwi-5 (5) yeminyaka echanekileyo/eqinisekisiweyo ekungeniseni iziko leGqeberha, ekungeniseni iSaziso seNkundla yeGqeberha eqinisekisa iinkqubo ezifunwa kwiziko ngokusetyenziswa kweNkundla yeGqeberha. Ulwazi olujulileyo ngomthetho weGqeberha, imigaqo ethetha ngokusebenzisa ngokutsha kunye neenkqubo ezifunwa kummandla weNkundla, kunye neenkqubo ezisebenza kumnyama wezeNkundla yeLiso. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela ezokwenza ngokutsha ibe ngcono eqinisekiswa yiKhalenda yeBabbiza, OHSC kunye nokuqhawukelwa kweNyuso yeBabbiza. Indlela ekulawulwa ngayo, yokuhlela nokuqaqamba, ekunxuseni amathambo. Ukusebenza ngeKhompyutha ukwenza ngcono ukwamkelwa kokusebenza. Amaphulo wokuzama ukuze atshintshe ukungqubana. Amaphulo okubhala iingxelo. Amaphulo okunxibelelwana ukuyisebenzisa ukuyila ngokutsha iphakathi. Ukulawula nokuqhelanisa iimfuno zeZemihla ngemihla.
xh.duties: Ukunikeza iphakheji equlekileyo yenkonzo kwinqanaba leZempilo lokuQala. Ukuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa nokuqonda iiplani zesikhululo nokuhamba kuhamba emva kweenguquko eziziselwa ngesinxibo. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuphucula ubungangcamshi nokusetyenziswa okujoliswe kufikelelo lweZempilo kuwo wonke umhlaba njengoko kuchazwe kuMthetho weZempilo weSizwe. Ukusetyenziswa kakuhle nokuqonda kwamathemba ngokwemigaqo yokulinganisa iindleko. Ukusebenzisa ngempumelelo isamamkeli sokutsha kwakhona iPHC. Ukusebenzisa iNkqubo yoLawulo noPhuhliso loKusebenza kweBasebenzi. Ukulawula nokusetyenzisa i-data ukuze kuphuculwe ukunikelwa kwenkonzo nokuqhawukelwa kwemikhubo yempilo. Ukusebenzisa nokuqonda iiprojekthi zeNkundla, kuquka iiprojekthi ezikhethekileyo ngokuhambisana neKhalenda yeZempilo. Ukwenza ukuphonononga kwezempilo kwemiba yokuxakeka kwaye kugqithiswe ngalo nto ukunikelwa kweenkonzo zempilo.

jobs.title: Operational Manager- Specialty
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 per annum. Other Benefits: 12% Rural Allowance, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Operational manager needed at Port Shepstone Hospital to lead critical care, renal dialysis and trauma nursing units, requiring nursing qualifications and SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or equivalent, Diploma / Degree in General Nursing Science Diploma/degree in Midwifery Nursing Science. 1 year post basic qualification in Critical care / Emergency &Trauma Nursing Science. Diploma / degree in Health Service Management. Certificate in Computer Course. Current registration with SANC as General Nurse, Midwife / Accoucher; Critical care / Emergency &Trauma Nursing Science and Health Service Management. A minimum of 7 years appropriate / recognizable clinical experience in a hospital environment after registration as a General Nurse. At least 5 years of the above should be experience in Intensive Care Unit & CCU / Trauma & Emergency department after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification in Critical Care Nursing/ Emergency &Trauma Nursing Science. SANC receipt 2026. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: In-depth knowledge of nursing legislation, nursing ethics and professional practice. Knowledge of relevant legislation and policies including the Nursing Act, National Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Regulations, Batho Pele Principles, Patients' Rights Charter and relevant Department of Health policies. Sound knowledge of Nephrology Nursing standards, protocols and clinical guidelines. Leadership, supervisory, planning, organisational and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage human, financial and material resources effectively. Good communication, interpersonal, conflict management and report-writing skills. Knowledge of Human Resource Management, Labour Relations and Performance Management Systems. Computer literacy in Microsoft Office applications. Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team environment.
jobs.duties: Provide leadership and ensure the provision of optimal, holistic specialized Intensive Care, Renal Dialysis and Trauma & Emergency nursing units within set standards and professional / legal framework. Plan, organise, coordinate, monitor nursing activities and disaster management in the Critical Care domain to ensure quality patient care. Monitor and promote Infection Prevention and Control Practices, patient safety and quality improvement initiatives. Ensure effective management and utilization of human, financial, and material resources. Monitor financial resources with emphases on cost containment and keeping of all records within financial policies regarding procurement and the policy regarding revenue generation. Supervise and support nursing personnel, ensure adherence to protocols, policies and standard of care. Monitor implementation of clinical governance programmes and quality assurance standards. Evaluate staff on work performance, and implement employer assistance plan. Ensure that the unit complies with OHSC and IHRM Standards. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure efficient, cost- effective and equitable service delivery. Coordinate and facilitate orientation, in-service training mentoring and continuous professional development of staff. Compile and submit reports, statistics and other information required. Participate in research activities and promote evidence based nursing practice. Maintain professional growth, ethical standards and self-development. Champion and monitor the implementation of CPD program as per SANC CPD Framework.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder- Spesialiteit
af.summary: Operasionele bestuurder benodig by Port Shepstone Hospital om kritiese sorg-, nierdialise- en trauma-verpleegeenhede te lei, met verpligting vir verpleegkwalifikasies en SANC-registrasie.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matriek of gelykwaardig, Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde Diploma/graad in Vroedvroukunde Verpleegkunde. 1 jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kritiese Sorg / Noodgevalle en Traumaverpleegkunde. Diploma / graad in Gesondheidsdiensbestuur. Sertifikaat in Rekenaarkursus. Huidige registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige, Vroedvrou / Accoucher; Kritiese Sorg / Noodgevalle en Traumaverpleegkunde en Gesondheidsdiensbestuur. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike / erkenbare kliniese ervaring in 'n hospitaalomgewing na registrasie as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige. Ten minste 5 jaar van bogenoemde moet ervaring wees in 'n Intensiewe Sorgeenheid en CCU / Trauma en Noodgevalle-afdeling na verkryging van die 1-jarige post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kritiese Sorg-verpleging / Noodgevalle en Traumaverpleegkunde. SANC-kwitansie 2026. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Diepgaande kennis van verpleegwetgewing, verpleegetiek en professionele praktyk. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleide insluitend die Nursing Act, National Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Regulations, Batho Pele-beginsels, Patients' Rights Charter en tersaaklike Department of Health-beleide. Deeglike kennis van Nefrologie-verpleegstandaarde, protokolle en kliniese riglyne. Leierskaps-, toesighoudende, beplannings-, organisatoriese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om menslike, finansiële en materiaalhulpbronne effektief te bestuur. Goeie kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike-, konflikbestuurs- en verslagskrywingsvaardighede. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Arbeidsverhoudinge en Prestasiebestuurstelsels. Rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft Office-toepassings. Vermoë om effektief binne 'n multidissiplinêre spanomgewing te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf leierskap en verseker die voorsiening van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde Intensiewe Sorg-, Nierdialise- en Trauma- en Noodgevalle-verpleegeenhede binne vasgestelde standaarde en die professionele / regsraamwerk. Beplan, organiseer, koördineer en monitor verpleegaktiwiteite en ramponbestuur in die Kritiese Sorg-domein om gehalte pasiëntversorging te verseker. Monitor en bevorder Infeksievoorkoming en Beheerpraktyke, pasiëntveiligheid en gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Verseker effektiewe bestuur en benutting van menslike, finansiële en materiaalhulpbronne. Monitor finansiële hulpbronne met die klem op kostebeheer en die byhou van alle rekords binne finansibeleide rakende verkryging en die beleid rakende inkomstegenerering. Hou toesig oor en ondersteun verpleegpersoneel, verseker nakoming van protokolle, beleide en sorgstandaarde. Monitor die implementering van kliniese bestuursprogramme en gehaltversekeringsstandaarde. Evalueer personeel se werkprestasie en implementeer die werknemerbystandsplan. Verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan OHSC- en IHRM-standaarde. Werk saam met multidissiplinêre spanne om doeltreffende, koste-effektiewe en billike dienslewering te verseker. Koördineer en fasiliteer oriëntering, in-diensopleiding, mentorskap en deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling van personeel. Stel verslae, statistieke en ander vereiste inligting op en dien dit in. Neem deel aan navorsingsaktiwiteite en bevend evidence-gebaseerde verpleegpraktyk. Handhaaf professionele groei, etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Kampioen en monitor die implementering van die CPD-program volgens die SANC CPD-raamwerk.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi- Isikhundla Esikhethekile
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wemisebenzi esibhedlela i-Port Shepstone Hospital ukuba aholo amayunithi ezokunakekelwa ezibangelwa ubungozi, i-renal dialysis kanye nezokunakekelwa kwezilimele, edinga izifundo zokuhlinza kanye nokubhalisa ku-SANC.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 / Matric noma okufanayo, i-Diploma / Degree kwi-General Nursing Science Diploma/degree kwi-Midwifery Nursing Science. Isifundo sangemva kwesisekelo seminyaka eyi-1 kwi-Critical care / Emergency &Trauma Nursing Science. I-Diploma / degree kwi-Health Service Management. Isitifikedi kwi-Computer Course. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-SANC njengoba yi-General Nurse, i-Midwife / Accoucher; i-Critical care / Emergency &Trauma Nursing Science kanye ne-Health Service Management. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-7 yohlelo / oluhlonzekeka lomzekelo wokuhlinza emzileni wesibhedlela ngemva kokubhalisa njengoba yi-General Nurse. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 kokungenelayo kufanele kube uluhlelo kwi-Intensive Care Unit & CCU / Trauma & Emergency department ngemva kokuthola isifundo sangemva kwesisekelo seminyaka eyi-1 kwi-Critical Care Nursing/ Emergency &Trauma Nursing Science. Isiphathimthetho se-SANC 2026. Ulwazi, Amandla, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Adingekayo: Ulwazi olujulile ngomthetho wezokuhlinza, izimiso zokuziphatha kwezokuhlinza kanye nokwenza umsebenzi ngobungcweti. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohlobene kanye nenqubomgomo kufaka phakathi i-Nursing Act, i-National Health Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Public Service Regulations, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele, Isitifiketi samalungelo abagula kanye nemiqathango yomnyango we-Health. Ulwazi oluhle ngezizinga, amaphrothokholo kanye nemihlahlandlela yokuqeqesha ye-Nephrology Nursing. Amandla okuba ngumholi, okuqondisa, okuhlela, okuhlela inhlangano kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokuphatha ngokusebenzayo abantu, imali kanye nezinsiza ezinhlobonhlobo. Amandla ahle sokuxhumana, kokuhlobana nabantu, kokuphatha ingxingo kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ulwazi lokuphatha izinsiza zabantu, I-Labour Relations kanye namasistimu okuphatha ukusebenza. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kumapulegeshi e-Microsoft Office. Ikhono lokusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwendawo yeqembu elihlukene.
zu.duties: Nikeza ubuholi futhi qinisekisa ukunikezwa kokunakekelwa okuyingqayizivele, okubandakanya konke kwe-Intensive Care, i-Renal Dialysis kanye namayunithi ezokunakekelwa kwezilimele nezibangelwa ubungozi ngaphakathi kwezizinga ezibekiwe nesakhiwo sezobungcweti / somthetho. Hlela, hlela inhlangano, hlanganisa, hlola imisebenzi yokuhlinza kanye nokuphatha iziphothiwe ekuhambeni kwe-Critical Care ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa kwemithombo ehle. Hlola futhi unake amaphrothokholo okuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka, ukuphepha komuntu ofuna unakekelwa kanye nokuqhuba okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kanye nokusetshenziswa kwabantu, kwezimali, kanye nezinsiza. Hlola izinsiza zezimali ngokugqamisa ukugcina izindleko kanye nokugcina zonke iziqoshwa ngaphakathi kwenqubomgomo yezimali mayelana nokuthenga kanye nenqubomgomo mayelana nokukhiqiza imali. Qondisa futhi useke basebenzi bezokuhlinza, qinisekisa ukulandela amaphrothokholo, inqubomgomo kanye nezinga lokunakekelwa. Hlola ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha ezobungcweti kanye nezinga eziqinisekisa ukuthuthuka. Hlola abasebenzi ngokusebenza kwabo, futhi usebenzise ihhovisi elisiza umqashi. Qinisekisa ukuthi iyunithi ihambisana nezilinganiso ze-OHSC kanye ne-IHRM. Sebenzisana namaphuzu wezinkalo ezihlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo okusebenzayo, okugcina izindleko futhi okulinganayo. Hlanganisa futhi wenze lula ukugxila, ukuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi, ukukhulekela ukubekelwa ohlelweni kanye nokuqhubeka kobungcweti bemisebenzi yabantu. Hlela futhi uhambise imibiko, izibalo kanyeolunye ulwazi oludingekayo. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphrothokholo kwenqubo yokuphenya futhi unake nokusetshenziswa kwezokuhlinza ngokususelwa kobufakazi. Qhuba ukukhula kobungcweti, izimiso zokuziphatha kanye nokuzithuthukisa. Sibhoshiza futhi uhlale ukubheka ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo ye-CPD njengoba kuhlela umthethosisekelo we-SANC CPD Framework.

xh.title: Umphathi wokuSebenza- iSebe eliPhela ngokwezifo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umphathi wokuSebenza e Port Shepstone Hospital ukuba uhlele amagumbi okuhambisa izigulo ezinkqubela phambili, okuhlanza igazi nokuqubula iindaba zokuqala ukwenzisa ukugonywa kwamagumbi, oko kufuna izifundo zokugonywa nokubhalisa kwi SANC.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 / Matric okanye efana nayo, iDiploma / iDegree kwiGeneral Nursing Science Diploma/degree kwiMidwifery Nursing Science. Unyaka we-1 wemfuno emva kokuqeqeshwa kwesiseko kwiCritical care / Emergency &Trauma Nursing Science. iDiploma / degree kwiHealth Service Management. Isatifikethi kwiComputer Course. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwi SANC njengengeNese jikelele, iMidwife / Accoucher; iCritical care / Emergency &Trauma Nursing Science neHealth Service Management. Iminyaka engu-7 ubuncinane yamava ahambelana noko / aqaphelekayo ovela kwindawo yesibhedlele emva kokuBhalisa njengenese jikelele. Iminyaka engu-5 ubuncinane kuleyo ingentla kufuneka ibe yamava kwiIntensive Care Unit & CCU / Trauma & Emergency department emva kokufumana imfuno yonyaka we-1 ngemva kokuqeqeshwa kwesiseko kwiCritical Care Nursing/ Emergency &Trauma Nursing Science. Isityhulu se SANC se-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namaNgcablelo aFunekayo: ULwazi oluJongene nokuSebenza kolwabo ngokutsha kwezayo ngesi Xhosa.
xh.duties: Nika isikhokelo uze uQiniseke ukuZenziwa kwezibonelelo ezilungele, eziyimvama kwamagumbi eNsetshana oluQwalaselwe ngokuchanekileyo, oluHlanza iGazi noluQubula iziGulo iTrauma & Emergency ngaphakathi kweziLungiselelo ezisethiweyo nesiKhokelo / isakhiwo somthetho. Cwangcisa, uhlele, uhambelanise, ulawule imisebenzi yokugonywa nolawulo lweengcinezelo kwindawo yeCritical Care ukuze uQiniseke isoNiso soNakekelo lweSigulo. Qwalasela ukuze uKhuthaze ukuSingqongile nokuThintela ukuNtshula, uKhuseleko lweSigulo nokuPhucula isoNiso. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluSebenzayo nokusetyenziswa kwezibonelelo zabantu, zemali, ngeZixhobo. Qwalasela izibonelelo zemali ngokugxininisa ukuYalela iindleko kugcino lweerikhoti zonke ngaphakathi kwezolimo zemali mayela nokuThenga nengqiqo malunga nokuNzuzwa. Lawula uXhasa abasebenzi bokuGonywa, qinisekisa ukuzinikela kumalungiselelo, iingqiqo nesoNiso soNakekelo. Qwalasela ukuSetyenziswa kwiNkqubo yokuLawula ngokweMida yamagumbi noNakekelo lweNqanaba. Qwalasela abasebenzi ngokusebenza ngeNkqubo yoMsebenzi, uze usebenzise iNkqubo yoNxibelelaniso lomntu ongumsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba igumbi lixhoma nge OHSC ne IHRM Standards. Hlanganyela namanqanaba amaninzi oMsebenzi ukuQinisekisa ukuHlinzekwa kokuSebenza okuSebenzayo, okuGcina iindleko kwaye sithatheka. Hambelanisa uze uKhokele ukuQeqeshwa ngakumbi ukuMfunda ekuSebenzini abasebenzi nokuQhubelela phambili iNkqubo yokuSebenza. Hlela uze uNgenise iVezi ngesiBalo nolunye ulwazi olufunekayo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yokutya kwengcamango kwaye ukhuthaze uMsebenzi wokuGonywa oZelweyo. Londoloza ukhulele ngokweMfundo uNako kweMfundo ethile, iNkqubo ngokwezomBhalo nosiko. Qhuba uze uQwalasele ukuSetyenziswa kwenkqubo ye CPD ngokweNkqubo ye SANC CPD.

jobs.title: Clinical Programme Coordinator (MNCWH)
jobs.salary_text: R571 161 - R644 613 per annum. Plus 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional) and Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Clinical Programme Coordinator for Maternal, Neonatal, Child and Women's Health at Uthukela District Office, requiring a nursing degree, SANC registration and seven years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric / Grade 12. An appropriate B Degree / National Diploma or equivalent qualification in Nursing PLUS. Minimum of 7 year appropriate / recognizable nursing experience after registration as a professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Registration as Midwife / Accoucheur with SANC. Valid Driver’s License – C1. Diploma in advanced Midwifery and neonatal nursing will be an added advantage. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of experience / service certificate endorsed by HR Department. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Presentation / Facilitation skills. Knowledge of HIV and AIDS Comprehensive plan Knowledge of District Health Systems. Knowledge of relevant regulation and policies. An understanding of challenges facing the public Health Sector. Ability to translate and transform objectives into practical plans. Ability to prioritize work related matters and to comply with time frames. Financial Management skills. Project Management skills. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem-solving abilities within the DHS framework. Knowledge of MCWH programs. Supervisory and analytical thinking skills. Provide effective management and professional leadership.
jobs.duties: Develop MNCWH plan in line with District & project strategic plans. Co-ordinate and promote MNCWH and Phila Mntwana Programme. Promote messages which support the programme in all events. Co-ordinate and facilitate MNCWH and Phila Mntwana in-service Training. Ensure integration of maternal and child in health programmes. Monitor indicators which measure the health practices, provide support and guidance to health facilities and report finding to District management Team. Report writing. Manage all resources allocated to MNCWH and Phila Mntwana Project. Ensure Programme integration into Sukuma Sakhe Objectives. Implement and coordinate Maternal and Child Health Care Services in Hospital. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality Maternal Child health Care. Facilitate and conduct perinatal mortality meetings. Maintain a plan to improve the quality of maternal and Child Health Care Services. Maintain a constructive working relationship with a multi-disciplinary team. Ensure effective utilization of all resource in the department. Manage and supervise the implementation of AI obstetric programmes PMTCT etc. Ensure effective implement of the ANC / PNC policy. Review current policies and develop and implement new policies and protocols in line with realizing the millennium goals. Display a concern to patients, promoting advocacy and facilitating proper treatment and care ensuring that the unit adhere to principles of Batho Pele, Patients’ Rights Chatter and National Core Standards. Displays Knowledge of NCS and quality in DHS. Conduct or assist in ESMOE drills in the Facility.
jobs.enquiries: Ms T.J. Mpembe Tel No: (036) 6312202 Ext.102

OR Email to UthukelaDistrictHealth.HRJobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za and apply online siyathesha waya waya eservice. FOR ATTENTION : Assistant Director: HRM

af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder (MNCWH)
af.summary: Kliniese Programkoördineerder vir Moeder-, Neonatale-, Kind- en Vrouegesondheid by Uthukela Distrikkantoor, wat 'n verpleeggraad, SANC-registrasie en sewe jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matric / Grade 12. 'n Toepaslike B-graad / Nasionale Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde PLUS. Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike / erkende verpleegervaring na registrasie as 'n professionele verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Registrasie as Vroedvrou / Accoucheur by SANC. Geldige bestuurslisensie – C1. 'n Diploma in gevorderde vroedvrouskunde en neonatale verpleegkunde sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Slegs gekorte lysde kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van ervaring / dienssertifikaat wat deur HR-departement onderteken is, voor te lê. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Sterk interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Voorlegging / Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Kennis van MIV en VIGS-omvattende plan. Kennis van distrikgesondheidstelsels. Kennis van toepaslike regulasies en beleide. 'n Begrip van uitdagings wat die openbare gesondheidssektor in die gesig staar. Vermoë om doelwitte te vertaal en om te sit in praktiese planne. Vermoë om werkverwante sake te prioriteer en tydraamwerke na te kom. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die DHS-raamwerk. Kennis van MCWH-programme. Toesighoudende en analitiese denkvaardighede. Verskaf effektiewe bestuur en professionele leierskap.
af.duties: Ontwikkel MNCWH-plan in ooreenstem met distrik- en projekstrategiese planne. Koördineer en bevorder MNCWH en Phila Mntwana-program. Bevordere boodskappe wat die program by alle geleenthede ondersteun. Koördineer en fasiliteer MNCWH en Phila Mntwana in-diensopleiding. Verseker integrasie van moeder- en kindgesondheidsprogramme. Monitor aanwysers wat gesondheidspraktyke meet, bied ondersteuning en leiding aan gesondheidsfasiliteite en rapporteer bevindings aan die distrikbestuurspan. Verslagskrywing. Bestuur alle hulpbronne wat aan MNCWH en Phila Mntwana-projek toegeken is. Verseker program-integrasie in Sukuma Sakhe-doelwitte. Implementeer en koördineer moeder- en kindgesondheidsorgdienste in hospitale. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalte moeder- en kindgesondheidsorg. Fasiliteer en voer perinatale sterftevergaderings. Handhaaf 'n plan om die gehalte van moeder- en kindgesondheidsorgdienste te verbeter. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met 'n multidissiplinêre span. Verseker effektiewe benutting van alle hulpbronne in die departement. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die implementering van VK- verloskundige programme, PMTCT ens. Verseker effektiewe implementering van die ANC / PNC-beleid. Hersien huidige beleide en ontwikkel en implementeer nuwe beleide en protokolle in ooreenstemming met die verwesenliking van die millenniumdoelwitte. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder voorligting en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg om te verseker dat die eenheid die beginsels van Batho Pele, die Handves vir Regte van Pasiente en Nasionale Kernstandaarde handhaaf. Toon kennis van NCS en gehalte in DHS. Voer ESMOE-oefeninge in die fasiliteit uit of help daarby.

zu.title: Umhlanganisi Wohlelo Lwezokwelapha (MNCWH)
zu.summary: Umhlanganisi Wohlelo Lwezokwelapha wezempilo yabesimama, bentsha ekudlulenile, izingane nabesifazane e-Uthukela District Office, ofuna iziqu zokuhlinzwa, ukubhaliswa ku-SANC kanye namafamu eminyaka yisikhombisa.
zu.requirements: I-Matric / Isibili se-12. I-B Degree / National Diploma esemthethweni noma iziqu ezilinganayo ekuhlinzweni PLUS. Okungenani ungamunya weminyaka engu-7 wokuhlinza okuhambisana / okubonakalayo ngemuva kokubhalisa njengongidi ohlinzayo ne-SANC ekuhlinzeni jikelele. Ukubhaliswa njengonozeli / i-Accoucheur ne-SANC. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile – C1. Idiploma ekuphatheleni kokubeletha okuthuthukisiwe kanye nokuqashwa kwezinsiza ezisanda kuzalwa kuzoba yinzuzo ekungeziwe. Kuphela abaphakanyiswa ohlwini abozofunwa ukuthi bazinikeze ubufakazi besikhathi basebenze / isitifiketi sokusebenza esigunyazwe uMnyango we-HR. Ulwazi, Amandla, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Afunekayo: Amandla amakhulu okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuchaza kahle. Amandla okuzethula / okuququza. Ulwazi nge-HIV kanye ne-AIDS Comprehensive plan. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo ze-District Health Systems. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye namapholisi ahambisana. Ukuqonda izinselelo ezibhekene nomkhakaba Wezempilo Yomphakathi. Amandla okuhumusha futhi okuguqula imigomo ibe yinhlelo ezokwenziwa zisobala. Amandla okubeka ohlwini izindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi kanye nokuhambisana namasikhathi abekiwe. Amandla okuphatha imali. Amandla okuphatha amaphrojekthi. Amandla okuhola, okuhlela, okuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kohlaka lwe-DHS. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo ze-MCWH. Amandla okuhlola abanye kanye nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Nikeza ngokuphathwa okusebenzayo kanye nokuhola ngobungcweti.
zu.duties: Baka iplan ye-MNCWH ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zomkhakaba we-District & project strategic plans. Hlanganisa futhiukukhuthaza i-MNCWH kanye nePhila Mntwana Programme. Khuthaza imiyaleza egcizelela uhlelo kuzo zonke izikhathi. Hlanganisa futhi uthumele i-MNCWH kanye nePhila Mntwana in-service Training. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kwabesimama nezingane ezinhlelweni zezempilo. Hlola izinkomba ezilinganisa izendlela zokwelapha, nikeza inkusele ekulawulen, kanye nokuhlakanipha ezindaweni zezokwelapha kwaye uxe izinto othole kuyo ohlelweni lwe-District management Team. Ukubhala imibiko. Phatha yonke imithombo ekwabelwa kuyo i-MNCWH nePhila Mntwana Project. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kohlelo kumagaba eSukuma Sakhe Objectives. Yila futhi uhlanganise izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha kwezesimama kanye nezingane esibhedlela. Yila imigomo, izindlela, izigaba kanye nezinkomba zomgangatho wezokunakekelwa ezinkulu kwezesimama nezingane. Ququza futhi ubambe izinkumbulo zokufa kwabasakhulile. Zigcine iplan yokuphucula umgangatho wamaphrojekthi ezokunakekelwa kwezempilo yabesimama nezingane. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhlakulele obuqhakambisayo nomkhakaba wabantu abanamakhono ahlukahlukene. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwonke imithombo kumnyango. Phatha futhi ulawule ukumiswa kwezinhlelo ze-AI obstetric programs PMTCT etc. Qinisekisa ukumiswa ngempumelelo komgomo we-ANC / PNC. Buyekeza imigomo yamanje futhi ubeke futhi umise imigomo namaphrotokholi amasha ngokuthobela imigomo yeminyaka yonke yokwenza izinto. Khombisa ukunaka iziguli, ukukhuthaza ukumelana kanye nokukhuthaza ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okulungile ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi inkambu ihambisana nemigomo yeBatho Pele, Patients' Rights Chatter kanye ne-National Core Standards. Khombisa ulwazi lwe-NCS kanye namakhono ku-DHS. Yenza noma usize kumajazi i-ESMOE kulesikhungo.

xh.title: Umquathi Weenkqubo Zezempilo (MNCWH)
xh.summary: Umquathi Weenkqubo Zezempilo zoNdleno, Nezasekhaya eNtsha, Nezabantwana nezoKwabasaziwe kwiOfisi yeSebe leSithili sase-Uthukela, efuna inqununuqelo lokunsesa, uBhaliso kwi-SANC neminyaka yamashumi asixhenxe yamava.
xh.requirements: IsiMatikuletshi / IsiGredi 12. Isidanga se-B / Isidiploma seQonga okanye isifundo esilinganayo kuKunsesa PLUS. Ukwaziswa ngeyure ezisisi 7 zemisebenzi ehambelana nokuqatshelwa kwekunsesa emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha weKunsesa e-SANC kuKunsesa Jikelele. UBhaliso njengoNinikeli wezozala / i-Accoucheur e-SANC. Ilayisenisi eSebenzayo yoKushayela – C1. Isidiploma esiPheleleyo sokuba yiNinikeli wezozala eZisezantsi nezoKunsesa kuzakuba lusizo. Kuphela oMgqethwa abakhethiweyo kuya kufuneka bahenge umboniso wamava / isatifikethi senkonzo esigunyaziswe liSebe le-HR. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namApawundi afunekayo: Amanethiwekh omnetho namakhono oThethazana. Amanethiwekh okubonisa / uNcedo. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo eNgcangathela ye-HIV ne-AIDS. Ulwazi ngeeNkqubo zeZezele Zamaphondo. Ulwazi ngezoLawulo namagunyaziso ahambelana nayo. Ukuqonda iingcinezelo ebonelelayo eNKomponi yaQofo yeLonke. Amanethiwekh okugqibelela okuqulunqwa ngqo ibe ziNkqubo ezisebenzayo. Amanethiwekh okubeka izinto zomsebenzi ngokubaluleka nokuhambelana namaxesha. Amanethiwekh oLawulo lweMali. Amanethiwekh oLawulo lweeProjekthi. Amanethiwekh oBukhosi, oLuntu, oGqibo-ntetha, nokuSombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwenkqubo ye-DHS. Ulwazi ngenkqubo ze-MCWH. Amanethiwekh oQeqesho loLawulo kwaye nokuCikiza. Ukubonelela ngolawulo olusebenzayo nobukhosi bengcali.
xh.duties: Yakha inkqubo ye-MNCWH ngokuhambelana neNkqubo eNkulu yoMzila weSithili neprojekthi. Qamba kwaza noncedise i-MNCWH nenkqubo i-Phila Mntwana. Qamba amagama axhasa inkqubo yonke imicimbi. Qamba kwaza uqeqeshe ngaphakathi inkonzo i-MNCWH nese-Phila Mntwana. Qinisekisa ukudibanisa ukunakekelwa komzali naba-ntwana kwinkqubo zezezele. Yengisa amagama alothatya iziseko, bonelela ngenkxaso nolwazi kwizikhululo zezezele kwaye uvakele iziphumo kuThimba loLawulo yoMzila. UkuBhala iingxelo. Lawula yonke imithombo ebalulekileyo kwinkqubo ye-MNCWH neprojekthi i-Phila Mntwana. Qinisekisa uDityaniso lwenkqubo ngakumbi ngokomgangatho weSukuma Sakhe. Zalisa kwaye ulawule iinkonzo zoNakekelo lweZezele lwaBazali nabaNtwana eZibhedlele. Zalisa imigangatho, iinkqubo, iindlela namagama alothatya umgangatho weNkonzo yoNakekelo lwezezele lwaBazali naba-ntwana. Qamba uthethelele kwaza uncedise ngeengxelo zokuShona kwabasaziwe ngenkqubo ekhaya. Gcina inkqubo yokuphucula umgangatho weNkonzo yoNakekelo lwezezele lwaBazali naba-ntwana. Gcina uludwe olusebenzayo ngeThimba elinobuninzi bezigaba. Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kwawo onke amathuba kwisebe. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuZalisa iinkqubo zokunsesa i-AI uzalo i-PMTCT njl. Qinisekisa ukuZalisa ngokusebenzayo iNkqubo ye-ANC / i-PNC. Jonga iNkqubo ezikhoyo kwaye uzalise kwaye usebenzise iNkqubo namaprotokhali amatsha ngokuhambelana nokufezekiswa kwemigangatho yamawaka. Yonwabisa iingxaki zabaGuleyo, ukukhusela ngokubeka amagama awo, kwaye uphucule unakekelo lwesibhedlele oluyilo lokuchithwa kwesikhathi kuqinisekisa ukuba iKhompyutha ihambelana nemigaqo ye-Batho Pele, iMikhuba yaBantu iSazela neGunyaziso ezikwMgangatho weNyanga. Yonwabisa iNkqubo eYixa nokuMgangatho kwiNkqubo yoLawulo iDHS. Yenza okanye uncedise ekuzameni i-ESMOE kwiSikhululo.

jobs.title: Chief Artisan
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R499 470 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional) & Housing Allowance (Employees to meet the Prescribe requirements)
jobs.summary: Chief Artisan needed at Umgungundlovu Health District Office to manage technical services and support across hospitals and workshops, requiring a trade test certificate and ten years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or equivalent Appropriate Trade Test Certificate in terms of section 13(2)(h) of the Manpower Act of 1981 as amended. National Diploma electrical/mechanical or civil engineering. Ten (10) years post qualification experience required as an Artisan/Artisan Foreman. Valid Driver’s License. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competence Required: Knowledge of Project management. Technical design and analysis knowledge. Computer-aided technical applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing and Develop Technical specification. Technical consulting. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Change management. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Good communication skills, written and verbal. Computer skills. Planning and organizing.
jobs.duties: Manage technical services and support in conjunction with Technicians/Artisans and associates in Hospitals, CHCs, field, workshops and technical office activities. Ensure the promotion of safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Provide input into existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Ensure quality assurance in line with specifications. Provide input into the budgeting process. Compile and submit reports as required. Provide and consolidate inputs to the technical operational plan. Manage artisans and related personnel and assets. Control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related activities and services. Manage the development, motivation and utilization of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of technical services according to organizational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives. Continuous individual development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on technical/engineering- related matters. Preparation of documentation and other material required by the accountants. Maintaining relevant document filing systems including specifications, projects and financial records.
jobs.enquiries: Mr NC Madlala Tel No: (033) 897 1000
jobs.applications: To be hand delivered to 171 Hoosen Haffejee Street, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs Emailed To: N/A Couriered To: Human Resource Management Services, uMgungundlovu Health District Office,171 Hoosen Haffejee Street, Pietermaritzburg, 3200. FOR ATTENTION : Human Resource: Practices
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the new prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed, initialed and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV (with detailed experience). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Applicants with foreign qualifications are requested to have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). Applicants: Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. If you apply for more than 1 post, submit separate applications for each post that you apply for quoting the relevant reference number. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative employer, whose aim is to promote representivity at all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post.

af.title: Hoof Ambagsman
af.summary: Hoof Ambagsman benodig by Umgungundlovu Health District Office om tegniese dienste en ondersteuning oor hospitale en werkswinkels te bestuur, wat 'n ambagstoets-sertifikaat en tien jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matriek of gelykwaardig. Toepaslike Ambagstoets-sertifikaat volgens artikel 13(2)(h) van die Manpower Act van 1981 soos gewysig. Nasionale Diploma in elektriese/meganiese of siviele ingenieurswese. Tien (10) jaar se ervaring na kwalifikasie vereis as 'n Ambagsman/Ambagsman Voorman. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van projekbestuur. Tegniese ontwerp- en ontledingskennis. Rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings. Kennis van regsgeneemheidsnakoming. Tegniese verslagskrywing en opstel van tegniese spesifikasies. Tegniese konsultasie. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Veranderingsbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, skriftelik en mondeling. Rekenaarvaardighede. Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste en ondersteuning in samewerking met Tegnici/Ambagsmanne en geassosieerdes in hospitale, CHCs, in die veld, werkswinkels en tegniese kantooraktiwiteite. Verseker die bevordering van veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes. Verskaf insette tot bestaande tegniese handboeke, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie in te sluit. Verseker kwaliteitsversekering in ooreenstemming met spesifikasies. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese operasionele plan. Bestuur ambagsmanne en verwante personeel en bates. Beheer en monitor besteding volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van dissipline-verwante aktiwiteite en dienste. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van tegniese dienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasie-standaarde te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik. Deurlopende individuele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor tegniese/ingenieurswese-verwante aangeleenthede. Voorbereiding van dokumentasie en ander materiaal wat deur die rekenmeesters vereis word. Onderhou van relevante dokumentlêerstelsels insluitend spesifikasies, projekte en finansiële rekords.

zu.title: Inkosana yezandla
zu.summary: I-Artisan eNkulu kufuneka ibekho kofisi wezempi loNyaka we-Umgungundlovu Health District uphatha iinkonzo ezingcali kwaye uxhase iibhedi kunye namawokishu, ifuna isatifikethi senkonzo yezandla kwaye kuneiminyaka elishumi yamava.
zu.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric okwa kufana nalo. Ifom yenkonzo yokubakho kwe-Trades Act yomnyaka wama-1981 njengoko kulungisiwe. I-National Diploma ye-electrical/mechanical okwa yecivil engineering. Imihla yamashumi (10) yamava emva kokuba negunya njengonjiniyela/Onyathi we-Artisan. Ilaysensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi, amandla, uqeqesho kwaye Kufuneka kubekho ikhono: Ulwazi ngokulawula inkqubo. Ulwazi ngokuyila nokuhlalutywa okungcali. Izicelo ezibonelelwa khompyutha ezisezantsi kwamathemba. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Ukubhala iingxelo ezingcali kwaye wenze izicatshulwa ezingcali. Iingxelo ezingcali. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutywa. Ukwenza isigqibo. Ukulawula utshintsho. Ukulawula imali. Ukuqonda ukulawula, nokuphendula. , nokubhala kakuhle. Abasebenzi basebenzisa iplani yokuhlela.
zu.duties: Phezulu obempilo e-Umgungundlovu Health District Office ngokuphathwa kweenkonzo ezingcali kwaye inkxaso kwiibhedi kunye namawokishophu. Kufuneka kube norefunda y, kwakhona iziko elidlulileyo kunye nexesha lokwenza iiyure ezilishumi.

xh.title: INkulu yezenzobuKhosimtha
xh.summary: Kufunekwe INkulu yezenzobuKhosimtha kwiSikhululo seSebe leeZempilo saseMlazi ukulawula iinkonzo ezobuchwephesha kunye nentlaluthe kumanxwemeni kunye nakwiindawo zokuqamba izinto, kufunekwe isatifikethi sesivivinyo sobugcisa kunye nolwazi lweminyaka elishumi.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12 / i-Matric okanye efanayo Nesatifikethi esifanelekileyo sesivivinyo sobugcisa ngokwesigaba 13(2)(h) seMthetho weBasebenzi ka-1981 njengoko ulungisiwe. IDiploma yaseSizwe yobunjiniyela kagesi/yamashishini okanye yakhowucwina. Iminyaka elishumi (10) yolwazi emva kokugqiba izifundo njengoko kufunekwa njengomKhosimtha/ondlawuli boMkhosimtha. Ilayiseni yokushayela ethi nje. Ulwazi, amakhono, uQeqesho kunye naBucapableyo abuFunekayo: Ulwazi ngokuLawula iiprojekthi. Ulwazi lokuyila ngobuchwephesha nakuqwalasela. Iinkqubo eziselwe khompyutha zokusetyenziswa ngobuchwephesha. Ulwazi ngeLondolozo yomthetho. UKubhala iingxelo zobuchwephesha nokuPhuhlisa iinkcazelo zobuchwephesha. Iingcebiso zobuchwephesha. UkuSombulula iingxaki nokuQwalasela. UkuThabatha iigqibo. UkuLawula utshintsho. UkuLawula izimali. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuPhendula. Amakhono amabalawulide obuNcedise, okubhaliweyo nokuThetha. Amakhono ekhompyutha. UkuCwangcisa nokuHlela.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zobuchwephesha nentlaluthe ngokuhambisana noBuchwephesha/abaKhosimtha nabahlobo kumanxwemeni, kwiZiko lezeMempo, kumbindi-wezwe, kwindawo zokuqamba izinto nakwiinkqubo zosiba lobuchwephesha. Qinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kokhuseleko ngokwemigaqo nangokweemfuno zomthetho. Nikezela isigqibo kwizikhokelo zobuchwephesha eziphilayo, iizalo eziqhelekileyo nakuqhuba izikhokelo ukungenisa itheknoloji entsha. Qinisekisa uQinisekiso lwekhwalithi ngokwemigaqo. Nikezela isigqibo kwinkqubo yokwakha ibhajethi. Hlanganisela unikezela iingxelo njengoko kufunekwa. Nikezela uze uhlanganise izigqibo kwicwangciso lokusebenza ngobuchwephesha. Lawula abaKhosimsha nengqalasihlo kwabanye abantu kunye nezinto. Lawula uze ulawule ukutshatyalaliswa ngokwebhajethi ukuqinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwehamba-tyali-mali. Lawula ixabiso leshishini elingeniswa yimisebenzi yephando elinxulumeneyo ngenkonzo. Lawula ukuPhuhlisa, ukugxininisa ukusetyenziswa kolwazi ngabantu kwiphando ukuqinisekisa ulwazi olusebenzayo oluqinisekileyo lolwazi loqhagamshelo lwezakhono nokuQhagamshela kolunye uqhagamshelo nokuQinisekisa ukuphuhliswa koluntu ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuphuhliswe ngokufanelekileyo iNgcali yamakhono abalawula abangaphantsini bobuchwephesha ukulawula amanqaku abo abakhulu bokusebenza ngokucwangcisa nokulawula ngokuchanekileyo iSakhiwo sewebhusayithi nakumasiza ukuba ulawule ngokugqibeleleyo ukuze kuqatse iMfuno Yeqonga nelawulo.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner
jobs.centre: Madadeni Provincial Hospital: Mndozo Clinic Ref No: MAD 19/2026 Madadeni Clinic 5 Ref No: 20/2026
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum plus 8% Inhospitable Allowance, 13th cheque, medical Aid (Optional) and housing allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner positions at Madadeni Provincial Hospital requiring SANC registration with clinical assessment qualification and four years nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 Degree/ Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a professional nurse. A post basic qualification with a duration of at least 1 year in Clinical assessment, treatment and care. A minimum of 4 years appropriate/ recognizable nursing experience after registration as a professional nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Knowledge of all applicable legislation and guidelines, including scientific nursing and nursing principles. Good interpersonal relationship skills and good listening skills. Good communication and problem-solving skills. Co-ordination and planning skills. Team building and supervisory skills. Ability to formulate patient care related policies. Sound knowledge of the health programmes run at the PHC level. Sound knowledge of the Co-Standards, Ideal Clinic and data management.
jobs.duties: Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, including report writing and statistics. Assist the unit manager/ Operational Manager with overall management and necessary support for effective functioning in the clinic. Work as part of a multidisciplinary team to ensure effective Nursing Care in the clinic. Implement and advocate for preventive and promotive health initiatives for clients and the community served by the clinic. Ensure proper utilization of human, material and financial resources and maintain updated records of resources in the clinic. Ensure effective implementation of National Co- Standards Ideal Clinic Realisation and Maintenance Framework. Ensure clinical intervention to clients including administration of prescribed medication and ongoing observation of patients in the clinic. Implement health programmes within the PHC package in accordance with set guidelines, monitor performance and outcomes against the set targets and act on deviations. Ensure that programme specific data collected is timeous and accurate. Motivate staff regarding development in order to increase level of expertise and assist patients to develop a sense of care. Refer patients promptly according to the set guidelines, protocols, policies. Ensure proper utilization and safe keeping of basic medical, surgical and pharmaceutical stock. Participates in clinical audits, data validation and RIPDA for the facility. Ensure facility meet the set out targets as per operational plan. ENQURIES : Ms. R.M. Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137
jobs.applications: All applications can be submitted through hand delivery /courier to: The HR Recruitment Office no:3, Madadeni Hospital, f0001, section 6, Madadeni, 2951. Applications can also be emailed to: sibongiseni.kheswa@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : The Recruitment Officer
jobs.notes: This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Note: The contents of this Circular Minute must be brought to the notice of all eligible officers and employees on your establishment of all Institutions. Institutions must notify all candidates who qualify for post in this circular minute even if they are absent from their normal places of work to apply. Direction to Candidates: the following documents must be submitted: Application for Employment form (Z83) which is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website - www.kznhealth.gov.za. The application form (Z83) must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae, Certified copies of ID, Highest educational qualification and other relevant documents will be requested for submission only from shortlisted candidates. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will be disqualify applicants. Person with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post.
