af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn-posisies by Madadeni Provincial Hospital wat SANC-registrasie met 'n kliniese assesseringskwalifikasie en vier jaar verpleegervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-graad/diploma in Algemene Verpleging en Vrouesiekte of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as professionele verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse basiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in Kliniese assessering, behandeling en sorg. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as professionele verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van alle toepaslike wetgewing en riglyne, insluitend wetenskaplike verpleging en verpleegbeginsels. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede en goeie luistervaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Koördinasie- en beplanningsvaardighede. Spanbou- en toesigvaardighede. Vermoë om pasiëntsorgverwante beleide te formuleer. Deeglike kennis van die gesondheidsprogramme op PHC-vlak uitgevoer. Deeglike kennis van die Ko-Standaarde, Ideal Clinic en databestuur.
af.duties: Toon doeltreffende kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing en statistiek. Bied die eenheidsbestuurder/operasionele bestuurder bystand met algehele bestuur en nodige ondersteuning vir doeltreffende funksionering in die kliniek. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om doeltreffende verpleegsorg in die kliniek te verseker. Implementeer en bevorder preventiewe en gesondheidsbevorderende inisiatiewe vir kliënte en die gemeenskap wat deur die kliniek bedien word. Verseker behoorlike benutting van menslike, materiaal- en finansiële hulpbronne en hou opgedateerde rekords van hulpbronne in die kliniek by. Verseker doeltreffende implementering van National Co-Standards Ideal Clinic Realisation and Maintenance Framework. Verseker kliniese ingryping by kliënte insluitend toediening van voorgeskrewe medikasie en deurlopende waarneming van pasiënte in die kliniek. Implementeer gesondheidsprogramme binne die PHC-pakket ooreenkomstig vasgestelde riglyne, monitor prestasie en uitkomste teen die gestelde teikens en tree op afwykings. Verseker dat programspesifieke data wat versamel word, tydig en akkuraat is. Motiveer personeel ten opsigte van ontwikkeling om vlak van kundigheid te verhoog en help pasiënte om 'n sin van sorg te ontwikkel. Verwys pasiënte voldoende volgens die vasgestelde riglyne, protokolle en beleide. Verseker behoorlike benutting en veilige bewaring van basiese mediese, chirurgiese en farmaseutiese voorraad. Neem deel aan kliniese oudits, datavalidering en RIPDA vir die fasiliteit. Verseker fasiliteit bereik die gestelde teikens volgens operasionele plan. NAVRAE: Me. R.M. Sithole Telefoonnommer: (034) 328 8137

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezokwelapha Womasesi
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomsebenzi wezokwelapha womasesi e-Madadeni Provincial Hospital ezidinga ukubhaliswa kwe-SANC ngesitifikati sokuhlola kwezokwelapha kanye neminyaka emine yamasimu wokuba ngumasesi.
zu.requirements: I-Degree/ Diploma yama-R425 ebonayo ekuqashweni komasesi kanye nokuvela kwezinhlezi noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwe-SANC njengomasesi oyingcwangcwa. Isifundo esingaphezulu esithatha okungenani unyaka owodwa sokuhlola kwezokwelapha, ukwelapha kanye nokunakekelwa. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 yamasimu wokuqashwa/okuqashwe kahle ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengomasesi oyingcwangcwa kwe-SANC ekuqashweni komasesi. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi ngawo wonke umthetho nezinkomba ezifanele, okuhlanganisa izindlela zesayensi zokuqashwa komasesi kanye nemigomo yokuqashwa komasesi. Amakhono amahle abudlelwano nabantu namakhono amahle okuzwa. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuhlela nokuqhathanisa. Amakhono okwakha iqembu nokuqondisa. Amandla okubhalwa kwenqubo yokunakekelwa kweguli. Ulwazi oluzwilwe ngohlelo lwezempilo olusetshenziswa emazingeni e-PHC. Ulwazi oluzwilwe ngamazinga e-Co-Standards, i-Ideal Clinic kanye nokuphathwa kwemininingwane.
zu.duties: Kombisa ukuxoxa okusebenzayo nabaguli, abaqondisi kanye nabanye ochwepheshe bezokwelapha, okuhlanganisa ukubhala imibiko kanye nezibalo. Siza umphathi wesigaba/ umphathi wokuqashwa ngokuphathwa kwendalo konke kanye nesesekelo esidingekayo ukusebenza ngempumelelo esikhungini sokwelapha. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlukene hlobo ukuthi kutholakale ukunakekelwa kwabasesi okusebenzayo esikhungweni sokwelapha. Qalisa futhi usekele izinkomba zokuqaphela futhi zikhuthaze izempilo zabathengi nendawo ekhonwa yisikhungo sokwelapha. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwabantu, izinto nezimali kanye nokugcina ukubhalwa kwezinto esikhungweni sokwelapha. Qinisekisa ukuqaliswa okusebenzayo kwe-National Co-Standards Ideal Clinic Realisation and Maintenance Framework. Qinisekisa ukungenelela ngokwelapha kwabathengi okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezidakhi ezibhalwe kanye nokubuka ngokuhlala phansi kwabaguli esikhungweni sokwelapha. Qalisa ohlelo lwezempilo ngaphakathi kwesethula ye-PHC ngokuhambisana nezinkomba ezibekiwe, qapha ukusebenza nemiphumela ngokumelana nemitshingo ebekiwe bese uthatha isinyathelo ekuthuthukisweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane etholwe ohlelweni ihlakaniphile futhi icacile. Khuthaza abasebenzi ngokuthuthukiswa ukuze kwandiswe izinga lolwazi futhi usize abaguli ukuba bakhe umuzwa wokunakekelwa. Thumela abaguli ngokushesha ngokuhambisana nezinkumba, imithetho, izinqulumo ezibekiwe. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kanye nokugcina okuphephile kwenani lezokwelapha, izilonzo kanye namakhemikhali. Ahlanganyele ekuhlolweni kwemisebenzi, ekuqinisekisweni kwemininingwane nase-RIPDA yesikhungo. Qinisekisa ukuthi isikhungo sifinyelela imigomo ebekiwe njengenhlelo yokuqashwa. IMIBUZO: Nkosazana R.M. Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

xh.title: Umongikazi weZobugqirha obungeniso isalathiso
xh.summary: Izithuba zomongikazi weZobugqirha obungeniso isalathiso eMadadeni Provincial Hospital ezifuna ukubhaliswa kwiSANC ngesidanga sokuhlola ngobugqirha kunye neminye yonke eminye imisebenzi yokuqonda e-4.
xh.requirements: Isidanga/iDiploma esisisiseko iR425 eZonwabizwa jikelele nasekuhlinzwa abafazi okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo. Isidanga sasemva kwesesisiseko esithatha ubuncinane i-1 yonyaka ekulingweni ngobugqirha, ekunyangekeni nasekunakekelweni. Ubuncinane beminyaka yonke emi-4 yamava okungqongqo olingana nakuqondwa emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo kwiSANC eZonwabizwa jikelele. Ulwazi, Amap方位a, uQeqesho Namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi ngomthetho wonke osekelayo namacebiso, kuquka nezobugqirha zesayensi nemithelela yokugqirha. Amandla amahle okwakha ubudlelwane bomntu nomntu nokuva kakuhle. Amandla amahle okuzithetha nokuqamba iingxaki. Amandla okulungelelanisa noqwalaselo. Amandla okwakha iqela nokuqeqesha abanye. Amandla okwenza iinkqubo ezimalana nenkonzo kumagula. Ulwazi oluzinzileyo ngeenkqubo zeempilo eziqhutywa kwinqanaba lePHC. Ulwazi oluzinzileyo ngeeCo-Standards, i-Ideal Clinic nolawulo lwedata.
xh.duties: Bonisa unxibelelwano olusebenzayo nomagula, abaqeqeshi-bafundi nabanye baziigqirha, kuquka nokubhala iingxelo neziyivilithi. Nceda umphathi wenqanaba/Umphathi woSebenzo ngolawulo jikelele noncedo olufunekayo ukwenzisa ukusebenza kakuhle kwikliniki. Sebenza njengenxalenye yeqela elinabasebenzi abanamandla amaninzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo yokugqirha ephumeleleyo kwikliniki. Zisebenzise kwaye uxele ngokuzithandela ngeenkqubo zokuthintela nokuqhutywa phambili ezimalana namagula nommiba oncedwa yikliniki. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kakuhle kwabantu, izinto nemali, kwaye ugcine urekhodi oluhlaziywe lwezibonelelo kwikliniki. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kakuhle kweNational Co-Standards Ideal Clinic Realisation and Maintenance Framework. Qinisekisa ukungena ngobugqirha kumagula kuquka nokunikela iyeza elibhalwe nokuqaphela ngokuya kwexesha umagula kwikliniki. Zisebenzise iinkqubo zeempilo ngaphakathi kophakheji yePHC ngokwemigaqo ebeluliweyo, lungelelanisa ukusebenza nemiphumela ngokwemigangatho ebeluliweyo uze uthathe inyathelo kwiingqabasela. Qinisekisa ukuba idata ebuqhelwa ngokwenkqubo ithunyelwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo yaye ichanekile. Khuthaza abasebenzi ngokuphuhliswa ukuze kwande inqanaba lolwazi kwaye uncede abagula ukuba baphuhle isidima sonakekelo. Thumela abagula ngexesha ngokwemigaqo, amaphrothokholu, iinkqubo ebeluliweyo. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kakuhle nokugcinwa ngokhuseleko kwezinto ezingundoqo zonyango, zokuhlinza nezamayeza. Thatha inxaxheba kwiziyilongo zobugqirha, ukuqinisekiswa kwedata naseRIPDA kwisiseko. Qinisekisa ukuba isiseko sifikelela kumgangatho ophawuliweyo njengoko kukuchazwe kwicebiso lokuqwalaselo. IMIBUZO : Ms. R.M. Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum Other Benefits: 12% Rural Allowance, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner sought for Marburg Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal to provide comprehensive primary healthcare services with rural allowance benefits.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing, Midwifery +1 year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing & Midwifery + 1 year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognizable experience in the speciality after obtaining the one (1) year post basic qualification in the relevant specialty Grade 12 / Matric or Equivalent. Degree / Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery / Accoucher; PLUS 1 year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care. Registration with SANC as General Nurse and Midwife / Accoucher. Current SANC receipt for 2026. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of SANC rules and regulations. Scope of practice. Labour Relations. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to function well within a team.
jobs.duties: Provide quality comprehensive Primary Health care by promoting preventative, curative and rehabilitative services for the clients and community. Perform clinical nursing practice in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards for primary health care. Utilize human, material and physical resources effectively and efficiently. Administrative service such as providing accurate statistics for evaluation and future planning, identifying needs for financial planning and indirect control of expenditure as an integral part of planning and organization. Motivate staff regarding development in order to increase level of expertise and assist patients and families to develop a sense of self care. Provide safe and therapeutic environment as laid down by the Nursing Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act and all other applicable prescripts. Develop and ensure implementation of nursing care plans. Participate in clinical records audits. Work effectively, co-operatively and amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including willingness to respond to patients’ needs and expectations according to Batho Pele Principles. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by standards at primary health care facilities.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. R.K Mpisi Tel No: (039) 862 5343
jobs.applications: Applicants Are Encourage To Utilise Courier Services/ S’thesha Waya Waya or e-mail to PSRH.Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za (Copies Should Be Submitted By Shortlisted Candidates Only) Applications could be posted / hand delivered to: The Human Resource Manager, Port Shepstone Hospital, Private Bag X5706, Port Shepstone, 4240 FOR ATTENTION : Mr. Z.M Zulu
jobs.notes: Detailed application for employment (Z83) and Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies – must not be submitted when applying for employment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Due to financial constraints, S&T claims will not be paid to candidates who attended interviews. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications.

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn gesoek vir Marburg Kliniek in KwaZulu-Natal om omvattende primêre gesondheidsorgdienste te verskaf met voordele van 'n landelike toelaag.
af.requirements: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging, Vrouekunde +1 jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde, Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en Sorg. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging & Vrouekunde + 1 jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde, Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en Sorg. Ten minste 10 jaar van die bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike / erkende ervaring in die spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die een (1) jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit Graad 12 / Matrik of Ekwivalent. Graad / Diploma in Algemene Verpleging en Vrouekunde / Accoucher; PLUS 1 jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde, Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en Sorg. Registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige en Vrouekundige / Accoucher. Huidige SANC-kwitansie vir 2026. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van SANC-reëls en regulasies. Werksomvang. Arbeidsverhoudinge. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om goed binne 'n span te funksioneer.
af.duties: Verskaf gehalte omvattende Primêre Gesondheidsorg deur voorkomende, genesende en rehabilitasiedienste vir kliënte en die gemeenskap te bevorder. Voer kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit in ooreenstemming met die werksomvang en verpleegstandaarde vir primêre gesondheidsorg. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne effektief en doeltreffend. Administratiewe diens soos die verskaffing van akkurate statistieke vir evaluering en toekomstige beplanning, die identifisering van behoeftes vir finansiële beplanning en indirekte beheer van uitgawes as 'n integrale deel van beplanning en organisering. Motiveer personeel ten opsigte van ontwikkeling om vlak van kundigheid te verhoog en help pasiënte en gesinne om 'n sin van selfsorg te ontwikkel. Verskaf 'n veilige en terapeutiese omgewing soos uiteengesit deur die Verpleegwet, die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid en alle ander toepaslike voorskrifte. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van verpleegsorgplanne. Neem deel aan oudits van kliniese rekords. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vriendelik met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. Toon bekommernis vir pasiënte, bevorder en pleit behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes en verwagtings te reageer ooreenkomstig Batho Pele-beginsels. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur standaarde by fasiliteite vir primêre gesondheidsorg.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Wokuqaphela Iziguli Ngokwelapha
zu.summary: Kufunwa ongumdidiyeli wokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha ozoqashwa esikhungweni sase-Marburg Clinic KwaZulu-Natal ukuleta insiza zokwamukela izinsizakusebenza zokwelashwa kokugcina ezifakelwe esigodeni emakhaya ngesibonezelo sokusiza abantu bahlale ikhaya lesibhedlela.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 1: Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele / okumelwe kwezokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhalisa njengesibhedlela sisebenzi esiqu phansi kwe-SANC kwezokunakekelwa jikelele kanye nezokubelethisa + unyaka owodwa wemfundo ebalulekile yokuba ngumunyathi wezokuqaphela kwezokusubha kwezokwelapha eziphathelene nezokunakekelwa i-Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care. I-Grade 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-14 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele / okumelwe kwezokunakekelwa kwabesibhedlela ngemuva kokubhalisa njengesibhedlela esisebenza esimthetho ngokunakekelwa kwezokunakekelwa ngokuvumelana ne-SANC kwi-Generic Nursing Science & Midwifery + 1 year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kufanele kube ukuhlangenwe nakho okufanele / okumelwe kumkhakha ohlukile kwezokusubha ngemuva kokuzuza unyaka (1) wemfundo ebalulekile wokuba ngumunyathi kwesikhundla esibalulekile. I-Grade 12 / Matric noma okulinganayo. I-Degree / Diploma eku-General Nursing and Midwifery / Accoucher; PLUS 1 year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care. Ukubhalisa ne-SANC njengoba kukhona ohlelweni lwe-Generic Nursing Science, Midwifery & Accoucher. Isitifiketi sokugcina se-SANC se-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nama-Kholomophu afunekayo: Ulwazi ngemithetho nezilawulo ze-SANC. Umkhawulo wokwenza umsebenzi. Izindaba Eziphathelene Nesikhathi Esibambe Abasebenzi. Amakhono okuxhumana futhi ahlobene nabantu. Amakhono okusebenza ngesiqhwaga sabantu ngaphakathi kohlelo.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okuphelele kwezempilo okuyisisekelo ngokugqugquzela izinsiza zokuvikela, zokwelapha nokuphinda uvumele abathintekayo kanye nomphakathi. Yenza ukunakekelwa kwabesibhedlela ngokuvumelana nomkhawulo wokwenza umsebenzi nezizinga zokunakekelwa kwabesibhedlela ezinsizeni zempilo eziyisisekelo. Sebenzisa abantu, izinsiza ezibambekayo nezimpahla ngokusebenza kahle nangokuphumelelayo. Isevisi yolawulo efana nokuhlinzeka ngezibalo ezifanele ukuhlola nokuhlela okuzayo, ukuhlukanisa izidingo zokuqamba izindleko kanye nokulawula okungalangaquthwa izindleko njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuhlela kanye nenhlanganisela. Khuthaza abasebenzi mayelana nentuthuko ukuze khuphuke izinga lobuchwepheshe futhi usize abagula kanye nemindeni ukuthi bazibandakanye ekuzinakekeleni. Hlinzeka ngendawo ephephile neyonakekelo njengoba kushiwo uMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwabesibhedlela, uMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezomsebenzi kanye namanye emiyalo ephathekayo. Hlela futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokunakekelwa. Zibandakanye okuhloleni irekhodi zabesibhedlela. Sebenza ngokusebenza kahle, ngokubambisana futhi ngokuzwana nabantu abehlukeni ngokobuchopho, amasiko, isibala noma inkolo. Khombisa inkathiyo ngabagula, ukukhuthaza nokugqugquzela unakekelwa nokwelashwa okufanele okuhlanganisa ukuzimisela ukuphendula izidingo nezinhlayiya zomgula ngokuvumelana nezinhloso ze-Batho Pele. Khuthaza izinga elikhulu lokunakekelwa kwabesibhedlela njengokuqondiswa izizinga ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa ezimpilo eziyisisekelo.

xh.title: Ungcali bokunyanga esiBhedlela
xh.summary: Kufunwa uNgcali bokunyanga esiBhedlela we-Marburg Clinic eKwaZulu-Natal ukunika iinkonzo ezibanzi zezempilo ekuqalweni kunye neemvuzo zasemaphandleni.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Amava angu-4 ubuncinane afanelekileyo / aqaqambisayo kulunyango emva kokuibhalisa njengongcali weempilo ogqithisweyo kwi-SANC kwiNzalo jikelele, ukuBelekisa +1 unyaka wemfundo yasemva kweqela elingenelo ekulawulweni kweSayensi yokunyanga, ukuHlolwa kwempilo, ukuNyanga nokunikela ngenkathalo. Inqanaba 2: Amava angu-14 ubuncinane afanelekileyo / aqaqambisayo kulunyango emva kokuibhalisa njengongcali weempilo ogqithisweyo kwi-SANC kwiNzalo jikelele nokuBelekisa + 1 unyaka wemfundo yasemva kweqela elingenelo ekulawulweni kweSayensi yokunyanga, ukuHlolwa kwempilo, ukuNyanga nokunikela ngenkathalo. Okungenani amava angu-10 kweli thuba elithunyiwe ngasentla kufuneka abe ngamava afanelekileyo / aqaqambisayo kwelo candelo emva kokufumana ngowunyaka (1) wemfundo yasemva kweqela elingenelo kwelo candelo elifanelekileyo. Inqanaba 12 / iMatric okanye esilinganayo. IDigiri / iDiploma kwiNzalo jikelele nokuBelekisa / i-Accoucher; KWAPHEZULA unyaka ow-1 wemfundo yasemva kweqela elingenelo ekulawulweni kweSayensi yokunyanga, ukuHlolwa kwempilo, ukuNyanga nokunikela ngenkathalo. UkuBhalisa kwi-SANC njengongcali weNzalo jikelele noMbelekisi / i-Accoucher. Isipho soku-2026 esijewele i-SANC. Ulwazi, amakhono, uQeqesho nokuSebenza okufunekayo: Ulwazi ngemigaqo kunye nemithetho ye-SANC. Ummandla wokusebenza. Izingqinamba zobudlelwane bomsebenzi. Amakhono amabalawuni okuThetha nokuba nendlela yokuhamba nabantu. Isakhono sokuSebenza kakuhle ngaphakathi kwethimba.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo echanekileyo ezibanzi yokuQala kwempilo ngokukhuthaza iinkonzo ezithintela, ezonyanga kwaye zibuyisela isigulo kumaxhoba nabakwikomkhulu. Zenza ulonwango lokunyanga ngokulandela ummandla wokusebenza namazinga okunyanga ezenkelwa inkonzo yokuqala yempilo. Sebenzisa abantu, izixhobo namathafa ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokukhuselekileyo. Iinkonzo ezilawulayo ezinjengokunikela ngezibalo echanekileyo zokuHlola nokuceba kwixesha elizayo, ukuChonga iimfuno zecebo lemali nolawulo olungatshatangayo lwemali eyichitho njengenxalenye yokuCeba nokuHlela. Khuthaza abasebenzi ngokuphathelene nokuveliswa ukwandisa inqanaba lolwazi kwaye uncede abagulayo naboomaya bakho ukuba baveze umdla wokukhonza ngokwabo. Nika indawo ekhuselekileyo kwaye inyanga njengoko kumisiwe yiMithetho yokunyanga, iMithetho yeMpilo yoKhuseleko neNgqiyo yamanye amathetho alawulayo. Phuhlisa uqinisekise ukusebenza kweendlela zeendlela zokunyanga. Thatha inxaxheba ekuhloleni irekhodi zokunyanga. Sebenza ngokusebenza kakuhle, ngokubakho ndlebe kwaye ngobuhlobo nabantu abahlukene ngokwengqondo, ngenkcubeko, ngobuhlanga okangeenkolo. Bonisa inkathalo ngabagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela ukunyanga ngenkathalo eqinisekileyo kuquka isazela sokuphendula iimfuno nokulangazelwa abagulayo njengoko kumisiwe ngemigaqo yeBatho Pele. Khuthaza ikhwalithi yenkonzo yokunyanga njengoko kumiswe ngamazinga kweziko lempilo eliqalayo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse- General Stream
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 per annum Other Benefits: 12% Rural Allowance, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Professional nurse sought for Assisi Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal to provide primary healthcare services, with salaries ranging across three grade levels.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: No Experience Required Grade 2: Experience: A minimum of 10 years appropriate / recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing and Midwifery. Experience: A minimum of 20 years appropriate / recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing and Midwifery. Grade 12 / Matric or Equivalent. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing. Diploma / Degree in Midwifery Nursing Science. Current registration with SANC as General Nurse and Midwife / Accoucher. Current SANC receipt for 2026. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Knowledge of Public Service Policies, Acts and Regulations. Knowledge of SANC rules and regulations. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal frameworks. Good communication skills- verbal and written, leadership, interpersonal, problem solving, conflict management, decision-making, coordinating and negotiating skills. Knowledge and experience in implementation of Batho Pele Principles and Patient’s Rights Charter. Code of Conduct and Labour Relations.
jobs.duties: Provide quality comprehensive Primary Health care by promoting preventative, curative and rehabilitative services for the clients and community. Perform clinical nursing practice in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards for primary health care. Utilize human, material and physical resources effectively and efficiently. Administrative service such as providing accurate statistics for evaluation and future planning, identifying needs for financial planning and indirect control of expenditure as an integral part of planning and organization. Motivate staff regarding development in order to increase level of expertise and assist patients and families to develop a sense of self care. Provide safe and therapeutic environment as laid down by the Nursing Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act and all other applicable prescripts. Develop and ensure implementation of nursing care plans. Participate in clinical records audits. Work effectively, co-operatively and amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including willingness to respond to patients’ needs and expectations according to Batho Pele Principles. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by standards at primary health care facilities.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. N.C Sibisi Tel No: (039) 682 6976
jobs.applications: Applicants are encourage to utilise courier Services/ S’thesha Waya Waya or e-mail to PSRH.Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za (copies should be submitted by shortlisted candidates only) Applications could be posted / hand delivered to: The Human Resource Manager, Port Shepstone Hospital, Private Bag X5706, Port Shepstone, 4240. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. Z.M Zulu
jobs.notes: Detailed application for employment (Z83) and Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies – must not be submitted when applying for employment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Due to financial constraints, S&T claims will not be paid to candidates who attended interviews. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige- Algemene Stroom
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige gesoek vir Assisi-kliniek in KwaZulu-Natal om primêre gesondheidsorgdienste te verskaf, met salarisse wat oor drie graadvlakke strek.
af.requirements: Vlak 1: Ervaring: Geen ervaring vereis nie. Vlak 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar gepaste / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging en Vrouensiektes. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar gepaste / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging en Vrouensiektes. Grade 12 / Matric of gelykwaardig. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleging. Diploma / Graad in Vrouensiekte-verpleegkunde. Huidige registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige en Vrouensiekte-verpleegkundige / Accoucher. Huidige SANC-kwitansie vir 2026. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van Openbare Diensbeleide, Wette en Regulasies. Kennis van SANC-reëls en regulasies. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander relevante regsraamwerke. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede- mondeling en skriftelik, leierskap, interpersoonlike, probleemoplossing, konflikbestuur, besluitneming, koördinering en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Kennis en ervaring in implementering van Batho Pele-beginsels en die Handves vir Pasiënteregte. Gedragskode en Arbeidsverhoudinge.
af.duties: Verskaf gehalte omvattende primêre gesondheidsorg deur preventiewe, genesende en rehabilitasiedienste vir kliënte en die gemeenskap te bevorder. Voer kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde vir primêre gesondheidsorg. Benut menslike, materiaal- en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Administratiewe diens soos die verskaffing van akkurate statistieke vir evaluering en toekomstige beplanning, die identifisering van behoeftes vir finansiële beplanning en indirekte beheer van besteding as 'n integrale deel van beplanning en organisering. Motiveer personeel ten opsigte van ontwikkeling om die vlak van kundigheid te verhoog en help pasiënte en gesinne om 'n sin van selfsorg te ontwikkel. Verskaf 'n veilige en terapeutiese omgewing soos uiteengesit deur die Nursing Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act en alle ander toepaslike voorskrifte. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van verpleegsorgplanne. Neem deel aan kliniese rekoudoudits. Werk doeltreffend, samewerkend en vriendelik saam met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en pleit behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend die bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes en verwagtings te reageer ooreenkomstig Batho Pele-beginsels. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur standaarde by primêre gesondheidsorgfasiliteite.

zu.title: Unesi Ohunywe - Umphathe Jikelele
zu.summary: Kufunwa unesi ohunywe we-Assisi Clinic e-KwaZulu-Natal ukuze ahlinze ngezinkonzo zezempilo yomphakathi eziyisisekelo, ngeholo elihamba kumazinga amathathu.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Isipiliyoni: Asikho isipiliyoni esidingekayo. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni: Uqobo luncane lwe-10 iminyaka yohlobo olufanele / oluvunyelwe isipiliyoni kunokunesa ngemva kokuqoshwa njengoNesi Ohunywe ne-SANC kunokunesa okujwayelekile nokubelethisi. Isipiliyoni: Uqobo luncane lwe-20 iminyaka yohlobo olufanele / oluvunyelwe isipiliyoni kunokunesa ngemva kokuqoshwa njengoNesi Ohunywe ne-SANC kunokunesa okujwayelekile nokubelethisi. I-Grade 12 / i-Matric noma okulinganayo. I-Diploma / i-Degree kunoNesa okujwayelekile. I-Diploma / i-Degree kwiNzululwazi yokunisa yokubelethisi. Ukuqoshwa kwamanje ne-SANC njengoNesi oJwayelekile noBelethisi / oAccoucher. Isibambi sikamabhilidi se-SANC sika-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namakhono aJwayelekile: Ulwazi ngeZinqubomgomo zeNkonzo kaZwelonke, oMthetho nezimiso. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezimiso ze-SANC. Ulwazi ngeminqubo nezindlela zokunelisa, izimiso zokunesa nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihlobene. Amakhono okuxhumela ahle - avela mlomo nawabhalwe, ukukhulekela, abantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezinkedingo, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuhlela nokuxoxa. Ulwazi nolwazi ekusebenziseni imigingo yeBatho Pele kanye noMqondo wezekaLungelo komGulayi. Ikhodi yokuziphatha nezindaba zeMisebenzi.
zu.duties: Hlinzela ngokunelisa okuphelele okunemvingo eYisisekelo impilo yomphakathi ngokukhuthaza izinkonzo ezivikela, eziphilisa nezilungisa abayisimo kanye nomphakathi. Yenza umkhakha wokunesa ogulisayo ngokuvumelana nomkhawulokukwazi namazinga okunesa wezempilo yomphakathi eziyisisekelo. Sebenzisa izinsiza ezintantayo, izinsimbi nezokubakha ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle. Izenkonzo zokuphatha njengokunikeza izibalo ezifanele zokuqeqesha nokuqamba esikhathini esizayo, ukubona izidingo zokuhlela imali nokulawula ngokungeqondisi izinkwama njengexuba ekubalulekile ekuhleleni nasekuhleleleni. Khuthaza izisebenzi ngenkathi yokuthuthuka ukuze kukhuliswe izinga lobuchwepheshe futhi usize abayisimo kanye nemindeni ukuthi bakhule isiko lokuzinakele. Nikeza isikhungo esiphephile nesisapulazi njengoba kumiswe umthetho weNesing, uMthetho weMpilo nokHuseko kuMsebenzi nanjalo yonke eminye imithetho elawulayo. Cumba futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokunelisa. Thatha inxaxheba ekuhlolweni kwezinkomba zogulisayo. Sebenza ngempumelelo, ngokubambisene futhi ngokuzwana ngabantu abehlukene ngokujwayelekile, ngamasiko, ngobuhlanga noma ngokholo. Khombisa ukukhathazeka ngabayisimo, ukukhuthaza nokusekela ukwelashwa nokunelisa okufanele okubandakanya ukuthanda ukuphendula izidingo nokulangazelela kwabayisimo ngokuvumelana nemigingo yeBatho Pele. Khuthaza izinga lokunelisa njengokuqondiswa emazingeni ezikhungweni eziyisisekelo ezempilo yomphakathi.

xh.title: Umongikazi oPhatheleyo- Isiqhagamshelo esiPhakathi
xh.summary: Kufunwa umongikazi ophatheleyo we-Assisi Clinic eKwaZulu-Natal ukuze aboneze iinkonzo zeempilo eziphelmayo, ngemivuzo ehamba ngamathuba amathathu enqanaba.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Isipilo: Akukho sipilo sifunekayo Inqanaba 2: Isipilo: Iminyaka eli-10 ubuncinane esimafutshaneleneyo / esiqaphelekayo ekunyukezeni emva kokuqatshelwa njengoMongikazi oPhatheleyo kwiSANC ekunyukezeni iNursing General kunye neMidwifery. Isipilo: Iminyaka eli-20 ubuncinane esimafutshaneleneyo / esiqaphelekayo ekunyukezeni emva kokuqatshelwa njengoMongikazi oPhatheleyo kwiSANC ekunyukezeni iNursing General kunye neMidwifery. Grade 12 / Matric okanye okulinganayo nayiphi na. Idiploma / Idegree ekunyukezeni iNursing General. Idiploma / Idegree kwiNursing Science yeMidwifery. Ukuqatshelwa okwangoku kwiSANC njengoMongikazi General noMidwife / uAccoucher. Isiphethu sangoku seSANC sango-2026. Ulwazi, Amandla okuSebenza, uQeqesho namAbaqhubi aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngeNkqubo zoBuntu, iMithetho kunye neMigaqo yoLwazi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo kunye nemithetho yeSANC. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo neenkqubo zokukhathaleka kwabaguli, imithetho yamakhosazana namanye amathangqhra axhambele kuyo. Amandla amhle ekuzitheyezisweni- ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo, uphuhliso, obantu phakathi kwabo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ulawulo lwezingxwobu, ukwenza izigqibo, ulungelelaniso nokupe phakathi kwabo. Ulwazi nisipilo ekuphumezeni iMigaqo yeBatho Pele kunye noMgaqo-sishwankathelo weeLungelo zeGuli. Umgaqo wokuziphatha kunye neNtlangano yoBasebenzi.
xh.duties: Boneza inkonzo yeempilo eziphela ezingundotho ngokuqhutywa, ukuthintela, ukwelapha nokubuyisela kwakhona iinkonzo kubaxhasi nasebumnqwaneni. Yenza inkqubo yokukhathaleka kokwemithombo yemali ngokuvumelana nolubandzululo lokusebenza nangamazinga okukhathaleka kokwemithombo yemali. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto eziphathekayo namathuba amabutshu ngokusebenzisekayo nangokuchanekileyo. Inkonzo yolawulo enjengokuboneza izibalo ezingundotho ngenjongo yokuqaphela nokuqwalasela iindaba zexesha elizayo, ukuqaphela iimfuno zolwazi lwezimali nokulawula ngokungathanga ngqo ukuchithwa kwemali njengesinye isiqendu esibalulekileyo sokuqwalasela nolungelelano. Khuthaza abasebenzi malunga nophuhliso ukuze wandise inqanaba lolwazi oluqinileyo nancede abaguli noosapho ukuba baphuhlise iingcinga zokuzikhathalela. Boneza indalo ekhuselekileyo nangenaphakathi njengoko kuqhelwe liMithetho yokukhathaleka, uMthetho woLawulo lweMpilo yoBusebenzi nakuzo naziphi na ezinye iimithetho. Phuhlisa uqinisekise ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zokukhathaleka. Thatha inxaxheba kwiqaphelo lemibhalo yesigqibo. Yenza ngokusebenza kakuhle, ngokubambisana ngokwamathambo athungelweyo nabantu abanolwazi olwahlukileyo, abamasiko, abobuhlanga okanye abenekolo. Bonisa inkathalo ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza nokuzimela ukwelapha nokukhathalela okulungileyo kuquka ukulungelelana ukuphendula iimfuno nolindilelo labaguli ngokuvumelana neMigaqo yeBatho Pele. Khuthaza ngandotho ukukhathaleka kokwemithombo yemali njengoko kuqondwa ngamazinga kumathuba weempilo eziphela.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional) & Housing Allowance (Employees to meet the Prescribe requirements)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management overseeing HR provisioning and practices at the KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health, paying R487 197 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or equivalent or equivalent. Degree/ National Diploma in Human Resource Management/Public Management/Administration. 3 - 5 years’ experience in Human Resource Management environment, of which 3 years must be at supervisory level. Proof of Current and Previous working experience endorsed by HR department will be required for shortlisted candidates. Valid Driver’s License. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competence Required: Knowledge, Skills, Competencies Required: Knowledge of Public Service Regulations, as amended, Public Service Act, as amended, Project management and Strategic planning, Employee Performance and Management System, Expert knowledge and understanding of operational issues affecting the administration of Human Resource Management practices within a health service delivery environment. Expert knowledge of the legislative and policy imperatives informing the area of operation, Confronting and resolving conflicts, Comprehensive understanding and knowledge of current HR practices, Expert knowledge legislative and policy framework informing the area of operation, High level of communication skills, both written and verbal, Computer literacy in the MS Office software applications. Advanced PERSAL skills. Basic auditing. Decision making, Networking, Planning and organizing policy formulation and analysis, Problem solving, Report writing skills, Team player. Ability to prioritize issues and other work-related matters and to comply with time frames set.
jobs.duties: Oversee Human Resource Management Provisioning, Practices and administration services and ensure that high-quality human resource management services are provided. Develop and monitor Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s) for implementation of Human Resource policies. Provide advice and guidance to management regarding the interpretation and implementation of legislation, prescripts, policies and resolutions. Monitor and control budget allocated to Human Resource component and clearing of suspense accounts. Manage and coordinate activities aimed at addressing staff well-being and labour relations. Maintain good/sound labour peace and ensure establishment of fully functional employee health and wellness programmes. Ensure provision of Occupational Health and Safety services to the District Office Components. Ensure functional HR committees such as co- ordination of Institutional Management Labour Committee Meetings (IMLC) and Occupational Health and Safety and other relevant committees. Ensure timely submission of HR related reports and information. Manage the utilization of resources allocated to the Section inclusive of the development of staff.
jobs.enquiries: Mr N Zondi Tel No: (039) 897 1000
jobs.applications: To be hand delivered to 171 Hoosen Haffejee Street, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs Emailed To: N/A Couriered To: Human Resource Management Services, uMgungundlovu Health District Office,171 Hoosen Haffejee Street, Pietermaritzburg, 3200. FOR ATTENTION : Human Resource: Practices
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the new prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed, initialed and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV (with detailed experience). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Applicants with foreign qualifications are requested to have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). Applicants: Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. If you apply for more than 1 post, submit separate applications for each post that you apply for quoting the relevant reference number. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative employer, whose aim is to promote representivity at all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur wat toesig hou oor Menslike Hulpbronne-voorsiening en -praktyke by die KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health, teen R487 197 per jaar.
af.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric of gelykwaardig of gelykwaardig. Graad/Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Openbare Bestuur/Administrasie. 3 - 5 jaar se ondervinding in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing, waarvan 3 jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Bewys van huidige en vorige werkervaring wat deur die Menslike Hulpbronne-departement onderskryf is, sal vir gekorte lys kandidate vereis word. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van Openbare Diensregulasies, soos gewysig, Openbare Dienswet, soos gewysig, Projektbestuur en Strategiese beplanning, Werknemerprestasie- en Bestuurstelsel, Kundige kennis en begrip van operasionele kwessies wat die administrasie van Menslike Hulpbronbestuurspraktyke binne 'n gesondheidsdiensleweringomgewing beïnvloed. Kundige kennis van die wetgewende en beleidsgebiede wat die werkarea inlig, Konflikte hanteer en oplos, Omvattende begrip en kennis van huidige Menslike Hulpbronne-praktyke, Kundige kennis van die wetgewende en beleidsraamwerk wat die werkarea inlig, Hoë vlak van kommunikasievaardighede, beide skriftelik en mondelings, Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office-sagtewaretoepassings. Gevorderde PERSAL-vaardighede. Basiese ouditering. Besluitneming, Netwerkwerk, Beplanning en organisering van beleidsformulering en -ontleding, Probleemoplossing, Verslagskryfvaardighede, Spanspeler. Vermoë om kwessies en ander werkverwante aangeleenthede te prioriteer en om vasgestelde tydperke na te kom.
af.duties: Hou toesig op Menslike Hulpbronne-voorsiening, praktyke en administratiewe dienste, en verseker dat hoëgehalte menslike hulpbronbestuursdienste gelewer word. Ontwikkel en monitor Standaardbedryfsprosedures (SOP's) vir die implementering van Menslike Hulpbronne-beleide. Verskaf advies en leiding aan bestuur rakende die interpretering en implementering van wetgewing, voorskifte, beleide en besluite. Monitor en beheer die begroting wat aan die Menslike Hulpbronne-komponent toegeken is, asook die skrap van wagrekeninge. Bestuur en koördineer aktiwiteite wat gemik is op die aanpak van personeelswelstand en arbeidsverhoudinge. Handhaaf goeie en gesonde arbeidsvrede en verseker die instelling van ten volle funksionele werknemergesondheids- en welsynsprogramme. Verseker die verskaffing van Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsdienste aan die Distrikkantoor-komponente. Verseker funksionele Menslike Hulpbronne-komitees, soos die koördinering van Institutionele Bestuurs- en Arbeidskomiteevergaderings (IMLC) en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, asook ander tersaaklike komitees. Verseer die tydige indiening van Menslike Hulpbronne-verwante verslae en inligting. Bestuur die benutting van hulpbronne wat aan die Afdeling toegeken is, insluitend die ontwikkeling van personeel.

zu.title: Umhola ongumqondisi ofanayo: uCwazabatali olungezwelela ngokubonelela ngezinqubo ze-HR
zu.summary: Umhola ongumqondisi ofanayo: uCwazabatali olungezwelela ngokubonelela ngezinqubo ze-HR zokubonelela kanye nezinqubo eNkundleni yezezempilo yakwaZulu-Natali, ehola i-R487 197 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Ithemu le-Grade 12 / Matric noma okulingana nayo noma okulingana nayo. Isiqu/IDiploma yezwe kwi-Human Resource Management/Public Management/Administration. Ukuba namava eminyaka engu-3 - 5 kumhlabo we-Human Resource Management, lapho kufuneka kube ngonyaka we-3 emzinganweni wokuhlola. 1 Isibonakaliso sokuba namava okusebenza okwamanje nakwedlule esiqinisekiswe yidipathimenti ye-HR kuzodingeka kubafakiwe ohlwini abancane. jobs.summary: Deputy Director-General for Curriculum Management at the Limpopo Department of Education, requiring post-graduate qualifications and eight years of senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: Post-graduate (NQF Level 8) in Education as recognized by SAQA. Minimum of eight (8) years’ experience at a senior management level. Provide regular reports to the HOD, the Executive Authority and oversight bodies on the overall performance of the system informed by provincial assessment outcomes, national and international benchmark assessment studies and the general trends in the education arena. Initiate and implement systems that are aimed at integrating information technology in curriculum delivery in schools. Oversee the management of resources (Financial, Human and Physical).

SMS Pre-Entry (Nyukela) Certificate before appointment. Valid South African driver’s license (with exception of person with disability) and be willing to travel extensively. Lead the development, implementation, monitoring and reporting of strategic and operational plans for district management, institutional governance and related support services. Oversee institutional governance, quality promotion and standards across schools and districts. Provide executive oversight of learner social support programmes, including school sport, culture, psychological support, guidance services and special projects. Provide strategic direction for Education Management Information Systems, including data management, LURITS administration and support to planning, budgeting and reporting. Oversee the management of Learning and Teaching Support Material and library services. Promote compliance, good governance, performance management and continuous improvement across all functional areas of the Branch.

af.title: Adjunk-Direkteur-generaal, Distrikbestuur en
af.summary: Adjunk-Direkteur-generaal vir Distrikbestuur en Institusionele Goewerneerskap by die Limpopo Department of Education, wat 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie en agt jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nagraadse (NQF Vlak 8) kwalifikasie in Onderwys hê soos erken deur SAQA. Minimum van agt (8) jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. SMS-Voor-toetrede (Nyukela) Sertifikaat voor aanstelling. Geldige Suid-Afrikaanse bestuurslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met 'n gestremdheid) en bereid wees om uitgebreid te reis. Kennis: Die ideale kandidaat moet 'n effektiewe kommunikeerder wees met die vermoë om beleide en programme te ontwikkel om gehalte-dienslewering binne onderwysdistrikte te verseker, institusionele bestuurs- en goewerneerskapsbeleidsrigting te verskaf, en die voorsiening van gehaltestandaarde vir onderrig en leer te ondersteun, monitor en evalueer. Uitgebreide professionele en praktiese ervaring in die veld van onderwys/kurrikulum is noodsaaklik. Kommunikasievaardighede. Die kandidaat moet selfversekerd, betroubaar, akkuraat, aanpasbaar en diplomatieke wees. Kern- en Prosesbevoegdhede. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Program- en projekbestuur; Finansiële bestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Rekenaargeletterdheid Kennisbestuur. Dienslewering. Innovasie; Probleemoplossing en analise. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Kommunikasie. Openbare dienskennis. Onderhandeling, beleidsformulering en analitiese denke. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die voorsiening van uitvoerende leierskap en strategiese rigting in Distrikbestuur en Institusionele Goewerneerskap. Sleutelverantwoordelikhede sluit in: Voorsien strategiese leierskap en goewerneerskap-toesig vir die Tak in ooreenstemming met departementele prioriteite en statutêre mandate. Lei die ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering en verslagdoening van strategiese en operasionele planne vir distrikbestuur, institusionele goewerneerskap en verwante ondersteuningsdienste. Hou toesig oor institusionele goewerneerskap, gehaltebevordering en standaarde oor skole en distrikte. Voorsien uitvoerende toesig oor leerder sosiale ondersteuningsprogramme, insluitend skoolsport, kultuur, sielkundige ondersteuning, voorligtingsdienste en spesiale projekte. Verseker effektiewe koördinasie tussen Hoofkantoor en distrikkantore om dienslewering en verantwoordbaarheid te versterk. Monitor en ondersteun distrikprestasie, beplanning, hulpbron-toewysing en doeltreffende benutting van hulpbronne. Voorsien strategiese rigting vir Onderwysbestuursinligtingstelsels, insluitend databestuur, LURITS-administrasie en ondersteuning aan beplanning, begroting en verslagdoening. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van Leer- en Onderwysondersteuningsmateriaal en biblioteekdienste. Bevorder nakoming, goeie goewerneerskap, prestasiebestuur en deurlopende verbetering oor alle funksionele areas van die Tak.

zu.title: Umsebenzi ongusekeli weNhloko-Dikela, Ukuphathwa kweSifunda kanye
zu.summary: UMsebenzi ongusekeli weNhloko-Dikela wezokuPhathwa kweSifunda kanye noBuphathi Bezinhlangano eMnyangweni weZemfundo waKwaLimpopo, ofuna isijobelelo esingaphezu kweziqu kanye namava eminyaka yisishiyagalombulu enkathini yokuphathwa kwabaphezulu.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ne-Post-graduate (NQF Level 8) kuZemfundo njengoba kunikwa isibukeli yi-SAQA. Amava amancane ebanga leminyaka yisishiyagalombulu (8) enkathini yokuphathwa kwabaphezulu. Isitifiketi se-SMS Pre-Entry (Nyukela) ngaphambi kokwamukelwa esikhundleni. Ilayisensi yaseNingizimu Afrika evumelekile (ngaphandle komuntu ophila nokukhubazekile) kanye nokuthi abe nalolungelelwenu lokuhamba kakhulu. Ulwazi: Umuntu ofanele kule sikhundla kufanele abe yisithunjana esisebenzayo enekhono lokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo namaphrojekthi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwemisebenzi emnandi ngaphakathi kwezifunda zemfundo, anike indlela yezinqubomgomo yokuphathwa kwezinhlangano nobukhosi bezinhlangano, axhasa, alawule futhi ahlole ukulethwa kwemigomo emihle yokufundisa nokufunda. Amava amakhulu emsebenzini nasemzobeni ohlukilewe enkathini yemfundo/ikharikhulamu ayadingeka. Amakhono okuthintana. Umuntu ofanele kufanele abe nokuzethemba, ethembekile, eqinisekile, ekwazi ukuzivikela futhi obezwele bonke abantu. Amakhono Omzimba kanye nokuPhathwa kwenqubo. Ikhono Lokubhekisisa Phambili kanye noBuholi. Ukuphathwa Kwabantu kanye NokuKhulisa Amandla. Ukuphathwa Kwephrojekthi nokuhlela amaphrojekthi; Ukuphathwa kweMali. Ukuphathwa Okushintshayo. Ulwazi Lwekhompyutha nokuphathwa kolwazi. Ukulethwa kwemisebenzi. Izinto ezintsha; Ukuxazulula Izinkinga kanye Nokuqondisa. Ukuqondisa kubathengi kanye Nokuqwalasela Izidingo Zabo. Ukuthintana. Ulwazi ngesevisi yakithi. Ukuxoxisana, ukumiswa kwezinqubomgomo kanye nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegesi.
zu.duties: Umuntu ophumelele uzobe necalishe ukunikeza ubukhosi obungenhloko nokuqondisa phambili ezokuPhathweni kweSifunda kanye noBuphathi Bezinhlangano. Izibopho eziyisihluthulelo zifaka phakathi ukunikeza ubukholi nokuqondisa phambili nokuqaphela ukuphathwa kweSifunda ngokuhambisana nezinhloso zomnyango nezinyanzelo eziphathwa umthetho. Buka ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, ukulawula kanye nokubika amaphulani ekuqondisweni nasekusebenzeni okuhle mayelana nokuphathwa kwesifunda, ukuphathwa kwezinhlangano kanye namasevisi axhasa ahlobene. Qapha ukuphathwa kwezinhlangano, ukukhuthaza izinga elihle nemitombo emisi kulo lonke amasikole kanye nezifunda. Nikeza ukuphathwa okuphezulu kuleminye imisebenzi yokuxhasa abafundi emphakathini, okufaka phakathi isikole esezemidlalo, amasiko, ukuxhaswa ngokobuchopho, amasevisi okuqondisa kanye namaphrojekthi akhethekile. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisana okuhle phakathi kweHhovisi Elikhulu namahhovisi ezifunda ukuze kuqiniswe ukulethwa kwemisebenzi kanye nobandlululo. Lawula futhi uxhase ukusebenza kwesifunda, ukuhlela, ukwabiwa kwezibalo kanye nokusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwabezindiza. Nikeza ukuqondiswa mayelana ne-Education Management Information Systems, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwemininingwane, ukuphathwa i-LURITS kanye nokuxhaswa kokuqondiswa, ukwabiwa kwemali nokubika. Qapha ukuphathwa kwe-Learning and Teaching Support Material namasevisi etholozane. Khuthaza ukuvumelana, ukuphathwa okuhle, ukuphathwa kokusebenza kanye nentuthuko ephaqa kuzo zonke izingxenye zokusebenza zeSifunda.

xh.title: Isebe elinguzamagxada–jikelele, ukulawula iNkqubo
xh.summary: Isebe elinguzamagxada eNqanaba lokulawula iNkqubo nokulawula iziko kwiLekela leZemfundo kwisebe lemfundo eLimpopo, lifuna iziqu zephedi yemfundo ephezulu kwaye nethiyori yokusebenza kwiminyaka yethoba eqongeni lokulawula abantu abakhulu.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neNqanaba le-8 yeNQF kwilunga lemfundo njengoko kusolulwa yiSAQA. Kufuneka abe nomsebenzi ongemva kwamashumi asi-8 onyaka uphezimva aze asetyenziswe esigqebeni. Kufuneba afake isatifikethi se-Nyukela phambi kokuziswa kumsebenzi. Ifayitsha yokuqhuba eMzantsi Afrika esemthethweni ngokupheleleyo (ngaphandle komntu onokusilela ngeyakhe imfihlo) ayifuniwa kwaye athande ukuhamba nkqo njengoko kulindelekile. Ulwazi: Ukho isicelo esinomdla kufuneka abe ngumthetho okhulayo, olula athande naye ukwazi ukunika izicwangciso nemigaqo nemicimbi yokwazi nokuqwalasela ukulungiselelwa kolwazi oluqeqeshiweyo kwindawo yoluntu, anike iqhankqalazo ngokulawulwa kwendawo yoluntu ngokomthetho, axhase, aze athe ngasexesha kwingqokelela yamagama abucala anikwe ngokomthetho wendawo yoluntu. Ulwazi olukhulu ngokwemfundo/iNkqubo yemfundo yimfuno. Ulwazi ngendlela yokubeka isicelo. Kufuneka abe nesithembu, asisizi ngokuchanekileyo, aze akwazi ukuzenza njengoko kulindelekileyo kumthetho wocandelo. Iinkalo ezifana nemisebenzi yokulawula iNkqubo. Ulwazi ngokuqonda ngokulawula, Ulwazi ngokuqonda ngokulawula kwindawo yokusebenza, kwindawo yokwenza izicwangciso kweli candelo; ukusebenzisa imali. Iinkcukacha zokwenza iinkqubo ezintsha. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha, ulwazi ngokulawula inkqubo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi. Ukwenza izinto ngendlela entsha. Indlela yokusombulula iingxaki nokwahlola. Ulwazi ngokubeka iingcinga ngokusondeleyo kubantu. Ulwazi ngokulawula abantu abahlala kwindawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngokuqonda ngokulawula iNkqubo yakawonke-wonke. Ulwazi ngokusebenza ngokomthetho weNkqubo, nokuziphatha. Ukuba nazo zonke izakhono zokwazi nokuyazi. Ukuba nokwazi ngokusondeleyo nokusebenza ngokomthetho weNkqubo yakawonke-wonke, nokuba nesakhono sokwenza izicwangciso, nokuba nesakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Umsebenzi ophumeleleyo uza kuba nenxaxheba ekunikezeni iqhankqalazo lokulawula nokuqondisa ngokwemigaqo kwiLawulo loMmandla nokuLawulwa kwesiGqeba. Iimsebenzi ezibalulekileyo ziquka ukunika iqhankqalazo ngokwemigaqo nolawulo loqwalaselo loCandelo ngokwemigaqo yesebe nemigudu esemthethweni. Ukuzisa intsebenziswano ekwakhiweni, ukusebenziseni,okuqwalaselayo nokubika iinguqulelo zolwakhiwo ezisezantsi nezisezantsi kwindawo yokulawula, ukulawulwa kwesigqeba, kwaye nakuze kuxhaso ngokwemigaqo ebalulekileyo. Ukulawula ukulawulwa kwesigqeba, ukuthuthuziswa kwelona nemiqathango phakathi kwezikolo nendawo. Ukunika iqhankqalazo ngokwemigaqo ekuxhasweni kweenkqubela zeentlalo zabafundi, kuquka imidlalo yezikolo, isiko, ukuxhaswa ngokwefuthe, iinkonzo zokuqondisa, kwaye nakumisebenzi ekhethekileyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukwenziswa komanyano phakathi kweNkundla eNkulu neendawo zokuvala, ukuze kuqiniswe ukuyalelana kolwazi nezigqibo. Ukulawula nokuqwalasela ngokusondeleyo ukusebenza kwendawo yokusebenza ekwindawo yokulawula yokwenza izicwangciso, ukwazi kwindawo nokuze kusetyenziswe okuluncedo. Ukunika iingcinga ngokuqondisa iNkqubo yolwazi lokulawula izikolo, kuquka ulawulo lolwazi, ulawulo lweLURITS nokuxhasa izicwangciso, imigqomo ngebali nokusetyenziswa ngokwemigaqo. Ukulawula ulawulo lwenkqubo ekufundwa ngayo nasekufundiseni kuxhaso ngeenkonzo ezifana nethala leencwadi. Ukukhuthaza ukuhambelana, ukulawulwa okulungileyo, ukulawula inkqubo yokusebenza nokuphucula ngoko nangoko kuzo zonke iindawo zocandelo.

jobs.title: Director: Physical Resource Planning & Property
jobs.closing_date_text: 25 September 2026 (Applications received after the closing date and faxed copies will not be considered).
jobs.summary: Director of Physical Resource Planning and Property at the Limpopo Department of Education, managing infrastructure strategies and property planning.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification as recognized by SAQA. Minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Pre - entry (Nyukela) Certificate upon appointment. Valid driver’s license except for people living with disabilities. Core & Process Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership; People Management and Empowerment; Programme and Project Management; Financial Management; Change Management; Knowledge Management; Service Delivery Innovation; Problem Solving and Analysis; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; Communication; Public Service Knowledge; Negotiation; Policy Formulation; Analytical Thinking; Planning and Organizing; Monitoring and Evaluation; Stakeholder Management; Risk Management and Functional Computer Literacy. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations and applicable public sector governance prescripts. Knowledge of the Government Immovable Asset Management Act, Infrastructure Delivery Management System, National Building Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, South African Schools Act, environmental legislation and relevant provincial land administration prescripts. Knowledge of education infrastructure planning, norms and standards for school infrastructure, spatial planning, enrolment trends, demographic analysis, infrastructure backlog assessment and prioritization methodologies. Knowledge of immovable asset management, land administration, acquisition and disposal processes, vesting, leases, accommodation management, municipal services and property records management. Knowledge of strategic planning, annual performance planning, User Asset Management Plans, infrastructure programme planning, monitoring and reporting systems, including NEIMS, EFMS and related information systems. Knowledge of project and programme management, stakeholder coordination, risk management, compliance monitoring, audit requirements and public sector reporting standards. Strategic leadership, planning and decision-making skills. Analytical, research, problem-solving and interpretation skills. Programme, project and contract management skills. Financial management, budgeting, resource allocation and expenditure monitoring skills. Policy development, implementation, monitoring and evaluation skills. Stakeholder management, negotiation, consultation and conflict management skills. Report writing, presentation, communication and briefing skills. Information management, data analysis and records management skills. Computer literacy, including the use of Microsoft Office applications and infrastructure/property management information systems. People management, performance management, coaching and change management skills.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and overall management of the Directorate: Physical Resource Planning and Property Management in support of the Department’s infrastructure delivery mandate. Manage and coordinate the development, review and implementation of infrastructure strategies, policies, systems, plans, procedures, norms and standards relating to physical resource planning and property management. Manage inputs into the Provincial Infrastructure Plan, Departmental Service Plan, Strategic Plan, Annual Performance Plan, User Asset Management Plan and related infrastructure planning instruments. Oversee the analysis of school infrastructure needs, including enrolment trends, population projections, facility utilization, spatial planning, backlog identification and prioritization of infrastructure interventions. Manage the preparation, updating and quality assurance of project lists, accommodation schedules, project briefs, business cases and related planning documentation for infrastructure delivery. Oversee the management of immovable assets, including land administration, land acquisition, disposal processes, vesting, verification, immovable asset register information and related property records. Oversee and monitor the administration of office and school accommodation, leases, Section 14 agreements, municipal accounts, utilities and other property-related arrangements. Ensure alignment of infrastructure planning and property management with applicable legislation, including the Government Immovable Asset Management Act, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, South African Schools Act, National Building Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, environmental legislation and relevant provincial land administration prescripts. Manage and monitor post-project and post-occupancy evaluations, condition assessments and utilization reviews to inform future infrastructure planning and investment decisions. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, including Infrastructure Delivery, districts, schools, implementing agents, municipalities, Provincial Treasury, Department of Public Works, National Treasury, DBE and other relevant structures. Oversee the maintenance of accurate infrastructure and property information on relevant systems, including NEIMS, EFMS, Immovable Asset Register and other departmental information systems.

af.requirements: 'n NQF vlak 7 kwalifikasie soos erken deur SAQA. Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Voor-toetree (Nyukela) Sertifikaat by aanstelling. Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone wat met gestremdhede leef. Kern & Prosesbevoegdhede: Strategiese Vermoë en Leierskap; Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging; Program- en Projektbestuur; Finansiële Bestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Kennisbestuur; Diensleweringinnoviasie; Probleemoplossing en Ontleding; Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus; Kommunikasie; Openbare Dienskennis; Onderhandeling; Beleidsformulering; Analitiese Denke; Beplanning en Organisering; Monitering en Evaluering; Belanghebbendebestuur; Risikobestuur en Funksionele Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations en toepaslike openbare sektor se bestuursvoorskrifte. Kennis van die Government Immovable Asset Management Act, Infrastructure Delivery Management System, National Building Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, South African Schools Act, omgewingswetgewing en relevante provinsiale landadministrasie-voorskrifte. Kennis van onderwysinfrastruktuurbeplanning, norme en standaarde vir skoolinfrastruktuur, ruimtelike beplanning, registrasietendense, demografiese ontleding, infrastruktuuragterstand-assessering en prioritiseringmetodologieë. Kennis van onroerende batebestuur, landadministrasie, verkrygings- en afdoeningsprosesse, vesteding, huurkontrakte, akkommodasiebestuur, munisipale dienste en eiendomsrekordbestuur. Kennis van strategiese beplanning, jaarlikse prestasiebeplanning, User Asset Management Plans, infrastruktuurprogrambeplanning, monitering en verslagdoeningstelsels, insluitend NEIMS, EFMS en verwante inligtingstelsels. Kennis van program- en projektbestuur, belanghebbendekoördinering, risikobestuur, nakomingsmonitering, ouditvereistes en openbare sektor se verslagdoeningsstandaarde. Strategiese leierskap, beplannings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Analitiese, navorsings-, probleemoplossings- en interpretasievaardighede. Program-, projek- en kontraktbestuursvaardighede. Finansiële bestuurs-, begrotings-, hulpbrontoekennings- en uitgawemoniteringsvaardighede. Beleidsontwikkelings-, implementerings-, moniterings- en evalueringsvaardighede. Mensebestuurs-, prestasiebestuurs-, afrigtings- en veranderingsbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en algehele bestuur van die Direktoraat: Fisiese Bronbeplanning en Eiendomsbestuur ter ondersteuning van die departement se infrastruktuurleweringmandaat. Bestuur en koördineer die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van infrastruktuurstrategieë, beleide, stelsels, planne, prosedures, norme en standaarde met betrekking tot fisiese bronbeplanning en eiendomsbestuur. Bestuur bydraes tot die Provincial Infrastructure Plan, Departmental Service Plan, Strategic Plan, Annual Performance Plan, User Asset Management Plan en verwante infrastruktuurbeplanningsinstrumente. Hou toesig oor die ontleding van skoolinfrastruktuurbehoeftes, insluitend registrasietendense, bevolkingsprojeksies, fasiliteitsbenutting, ruimtelike beplanning, agterstandidentifisering en prioritisering van infrastruktureingrypings. Bestuur die voorbereiding, bywerking en gehaltsekerheid van projeklyste, akkommodasieskedules, projekbriefings, besigheidsgevalle en verwante beplanningsdokumentasie vir infrastruktuurlewering. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van onroerende bates, insluitend landadministrasie, landverkryging, afdoeningsprosesse, vesteding, verifikasie, onroerende bate-registerinligting en verwante eiendomsrekords. Hou toesig oor en monitor die administrasie van kantoor- en skoolakkommodasie, huurkontrakte, Section 14-ooreenkomste, munisipale rekenings, nutsvoorsiening en ander eiendomverwante reëlings. Verseker belyning van infrastruktuurbeplanning en eiendomsbestuur met toepaslike wetgewing, insluitend die Government Immovable Asset Management Act, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, South African Schools Act, National Building Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, omgewingswetgewing en relevante provinsiale landadministrasie-voorskrifte. Bestuur en monitor na-projek- en na-besettingsevaluerings, toestandassessering en benuttingsoorsigte om toekomstige infrastruktuurbeplanning en beleggingsbesluite in te lig. Koördineer met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes, insluitend Infrastructure Delivery, distrikte, skole, implementeringsagente, munisipaliteite, Provincial Treasury, Department of Public Works, National Treasury, DBE en ander relevante strukture. Hou toesig oor die handhawing van akkurate infrastruktuur- en eiendomsinligting op relevante stelsels, insluitend NEIMS, EFMS, Immovable Asset Register en ander departementele inligtingstelsels.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Physical Resource Planning & Property
zu.summary: Umqondisi we-Physical Resource Planning and Property e-Limpopo Department of Education, ophatha izindlela zokuqamba amasu zesakhiwo kanye nokuqamba amasu empahla.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 7 njengoba zibonwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yothlolakalo oluhlobene ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi noma ophezulu. Isitifiketi sokungena ngaphambili (i-Nyukela) ngemuva kokuthunyelwa. Ilayisense yokuqasha esivumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abaphila abasindile. Amandla okuyinhloko kanye ne-Process Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership; People Management and Empowerment; Programme and Project Management; Financial Management; Change Management; Knowledge Management; Service Delivery Innovation; Problem Solving and Analysis; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; Communication; Public Service Knowledge; Negotiation; Policy Formulation; Analytical Thinking; Planning and Organizing; Monitoring and Evaluation; Stakeholder Management; Risk Management and Functional Computer Literacy. Ulwazi kanye namakhono: Ulwazi lwe-Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations kanye nemithetho ephethwe ngaphansi komthetho kahulumeni ophathwa emkhakheni womphakathi. Ulwazi lwe-Government Immovable Asset Management Act, i-Infrastructure Delivery Management System, i-National Building Regulations, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-South African Schools Act, umthetho wendawo kanye nemithetho ehlobene yokuphathwa kwabelo bendawo esifundazweni. Ulwazi lokuqamba amasu kwesakhiwo zemfundo, izilinganiso kanye nemigqa-migqa yesakhiwo sezikole, ukuhlelwa kwezikhala, izitayela zokubhalisa, ukuhlaziwa kwabantu, ukuhlola izinsalela zesakhiwo kanye nezindlela zokuqamba amasu. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwempahla engahambahambi, ukuphathwa kwabelo, izinqubo zokuthola kanye nokudida, ukufakwa igama, izinkontileka, ukuphathwa kwezindawo zokuhlala, izinsiza zomasipala, kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi lwempahla. Ulwazi lokuqamba amasu okuhlelekile, ukuhlelwa kokusebenza ngonyaka, i-User Asset Management Plans, ukuhlelwa kwehlelo lokwakha, ukulandela nokubika amasistimu, okuhlanganisa i-NEIMS, i-EFMS, namanye amasistimu olwazi ahlobene. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwamaprojekthi kanye nezinhlelo, ukuhlanganisa abalingani, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, ukulandela ukuvumelanisa, izidingo zokuqinisekisa, kanye namazinga okubika ohulumeni. Amandla obuholi bokuhlela okuyisinqumo, ukuhlela nokuthatha izinqumo. Amandla okuhlaziya, uphando, ukuxazulula izinkinga, nokuchaza. Amandla okuphathwa kwezinhlelo, amaprojekthi, kanye nezinkontileka. Amandla okuphathwa kwezimali, ukwenza izabelo, ukubalwa kwemali kanye nokuqaphela okukhishwayo. Amandla okuthuthukisa, ukuphoqelela, ukulandela nokubuyekeza izinqubomgomo. Amandla okuphathwa kwabalingani, ukuhlola, ukubonisana, nokuphathwa kwezinsingisi. Amandla okubika, ukubonisa, ukuxhumana, nokweluleka. Amandla okuphathwa kwolwazi, ukuhlaziya idatha, nokuphathwa kwezinkambiso. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-Microsoft Office applications, namasistimu olwazi wokuqasha isakhiwo noma impahla. Amandla okuphathwa kwabantu, ukulawula amandla, ukweluleka, kanye nokuqondisa izinguquko.
zu.duties: Nikeza ubuholi obuhlelekile kanye nezokuqondisa ukuphathwa okubanzi kwe-Directorate: Physical Resource Planning and Property Management ukuze kusekelwe imandla yomnyango yokuhanjiswa kwesakhiwo. Phatha futhi uhlobole ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekezwa kanye nokuphoqelelwa kwezindlela zokuqamba amasu, izinqubomgomo, izimiso, izinhlela, izinqubo, izilinganiso kanye nemiqondo ehlobene nokuhlelwa kwabezimali okubalulekile kanye nokuphathwa kwempahla. Phatha okungenayo kwi-Provincial Infrastructure Plan, Departmental Service Plan, Strategic Plan, Annual Performance Plan, User Asset Management Plan kanye nezinye izinsiza zokuhlela izakhiwo. Qaphisisa ukuhlaziwa kwezidingo zesakhiwo sezikole, okuhlanganisa izitayela zokubhalisa, ukubikezelwa kwabantu, ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi, ukuhlelwa kwezikhala, ukutholwa kwezinsalela kanye nokubaluleka kokungenelela kwesakhiwo. Phatha ukulungiselelwa, ukubuyelela emuva kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi yohlu lwamaprojekthi, izikheduli zokuhlala, izincazelo zamaprojekthi, izicala zebhizinisi kanye nemibhalo ehlobene yokuhlela ukuze kuhanjiswe isakhiwo. Qaphisisa ukuphathwa kwempahla engahambahambi, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwabelo, ukuthola izwe, izinqubo zokuqeda, ukufakwa igama, ukuqinisekisa, ulwazi lwesibhalwe sempahla engahambahambi kanye nemibhalo yempahla ehlobene. Qaphisisa futhi ulandele ukuphathwa kwezindawo zokusebenza noma izikole, izinkontileka, izivumelwano sika-Section 14, ama-akhawunti omasipala, izinsiza kanye nezinye izinhlela ezihehene nempahla. Qinisekisa ukuqondana kokuqamba amasu kwesakhiwo kanye nokuphathwa kwempahla nomthetho ophumelelako, okuhlanganisa i-Government Immovable Asset Management Act, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, South African Schools Act, National Building Regulations, Occupational Health and Safety Act, umthetho wendawo kanye nemithetho ehlobene yokuphathwa kwabelo bendawo esifundazweni. Phatha futhi ulandele ukuhlola kwemuva-kwamaprojekthi nangemuva-kokuhlala, ukuhlola izimo, kanye nokuphinda ubuke ukusetshenziswa ukuze kwaziswe ukuphathwa kwesakhiwo esikhathini esizayo kanye nezinqumo zotshalo-mali. Hlobola nabalingani bangaphakathi kanye nangaphandle, okuhlanganisa i-Infrastructure Delivery, izifundazwe, izikole, abezikebeli, omasipala, i-Provincial Treasury, i-Department of Public Works, i-National Treasury, i-DBE kanye nezinye izakhiwo ezihlobene. Qaphisisa ukugcinwa kolwazi oluchwayo lwesakhiwo nempahla kumasistimu ahlobene, okuhlanganisa i-NEIMS, i-EFMS, i-Immovable Asset Register kanye nabanye amasistimu olwazi omnyango.

Qwalasela iimfuno zezi siseko zemfundo, ukuqulathe ukubakho kwezifundo ezingangeni ezikolo, ukujongwa ngaphambili kwabantu, ukusetyenziswa kweziseko, iplani yendawo, ukumisela okungekayo okubangelwa kukungabi nazo iisiseko nokuqwalasela ukunika ntlonho ukungabi nayo iplani. Lawula ukulungiselela, ukuhlaziya nokucwangcisa uluhlu lweephulo, uluhlu lweendawo zokuhlala neendawo zokusebenza, iinkcukacha zeephulo, iinqobo zobomi nezinye iinkqubo zokucwangcisa ezingayalelwa iisiseko. Lawula ukulawula iziseko ezingahambi, kubandakanya ulawulo komhlaba, ukuthenga umhlaba, iinkqubo zokuqothula, ukugqithiswa ngeCandelo lokuqinisekiswa ngaphandle kolwazi, ulawulo lokuqinisekiswa, ulwazi ngoluhlu olubhalwe kwisiseko esingahambiyo, nolawulo olunxulumene nerekhodi yepropati. Qwalasela ulawulo lwendawo yokusebenza kwaye nasesikolo, ukuthengiswa, iingxoxo zaseCandelo 14, i-akhawunti zasezini, nezinye izinto ezikwidityaniso nepropati. Qinisekisa ukuba uCwangciso lokwakhiwa kolawulo lwepropati luhambelana noMthetho, kuqulathe uMthetho woLawulo lwesiSiseko esingahambiyo, uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali kaRhulumende, iMigaqo yeNgxowa-mali yeNgxowa, uMthetho weSikolo saseMzantsi Afrika, iMigaqo yoKwakhiwa kweZindlu eZizwe, uMthetho woKhuseleko koNyuso nokuLunga, iMigaqo yendalo namagunya oluLawulo lweMvela kolawulo. Lawula nokuqwalasela ukuqwalasela konke konke ngemva kweephulo kwaye nangemva kokusingathwa kwindawo, nokuqwalasela ngemo yeziseko nokuphononongwa kwesetyenziswa sezi siseko, ukuze kube khona ulwazi oluya kusebenza njengesiseko saxa kusenziwa ucwangciso nokuqwalasela iisiseko kwixesha elizayo. Nceda undixhumanise nabathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle, abaquke iNkonzo yokunika iSiseko ngeendawo, iindawo, iikholeji, ooyili kwindawo abakuyo abalawulwa yile ndawo, oorhulumende basezini, iNgxowamali yasePhondo, iSebe loLwazo lokuLawulo lweMidlalo, iNgxowamali yeNazionale, iDBE nanye na amanye amagunya ahambelanayo nokuqinisekiswa kwamacebo. Qwalasela ulawulo lwolwazi lweesiseko kwaye nolwazi lwePropati kwinzuzo yamagunya aqinisekileyo, okuqulathe i-NEIMS, i-EFMS, uluhlu lokulawula iziseko ezingahambi nolwazi lwamanye amanye amagunya esebenza ngokusemthethweni wesebe.

Hlelanisa imizamo yokuklama ukuze ihlanganiswe kubo bonke amagatsha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlanganiswa okuphelele nobuchwepheshe besikhathi esiphila kubo. Qedela izinsiza ezintsha zobunjiniyela kanye nendlela ezintsha zokuphatha imisebenzi. Gcina ukusebenza kahle kobunjiniyela. Phatha ukuphunjwa komsebenzi wokulungisa ngokuhlinzeka ngezakhiwo - 111 - 2010#0601#OSD Engineers And Related (Annexure A) (Updated 20 July 2011).doc. izimiso kanye nezinsiza. Landa izindlela ezisebenzayo zokulungisa ngokwezinhloso zenhlangano ukuze uzulisize noma ulungise izinsiza zobunjiniyela ukuze kuqinisekiswa ukufeza izinhloso zenhlangano (c) Ukuphatha (i) Abela, ulawule, ulande izibhalo bese uthela ngazo zonke izinsiza. Lungeza amafafoli ezenkingayo bese uphatha izinkinga ezinkulu ngokwemithetho yokuphatha izinkinga kanye nezidingo zenhlangano. Nikeza izinsiza zobunjiniyela ezingumhleli wocwaningo mayelana nokusebenza ezindabeni ezihlobene nobunjiniyela ukunciphisa izinkinga zobunjiniyela ezingaba khona. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi isb. ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi yesikhathi esifushane kanye nokuthunyelwa phakathi nokudlula emisebenzini ukweseka izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu ngamunye, izidingo zokusebenza kanye nenzuzo yokutshalwa imali. Qhubeka ulande ulwazi ngokushintshiselwano nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kokusebenza nabantu ukugunyaza ukuphathwa kolwazi ngokwezinhloso zomnyango. Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokuphathwa kwezimali ukufeza izinhloso ze-MTEF ngaphakathi kwesimo/izinsiza zobunjiniyela. Phatha ipothifoliyo yamaphrojekthi wesikhumulo wokusebenza kuleso sikhundla ukugunyaza ukweseka ngokwezidingo nezinhloso zenhlangano. Phatha inani lezimali lento ehambahambayo kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi ahlobene namagatsha ahlehlukene. Hlela ukulungiselelwa kwemibono yokukha kanye nobuchwepheshe bekatsha bokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwayo kanye nokulandelwa kwemigomo yenhlangano. Abela, ulawule futhi uhloliswe ukushiza imali ngokwehlaka lwezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kwe-holo ngokugqamile. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukuzuma ukubakhuthaza kanye nokusetshenziswa kabezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwazi okuhlakaniphile ukuze kuqhubekele phambili impumelelo yamasevisi obunjiniyela ngokwezidingo nezinhloso zenhlangano. Phatha izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza kwabangaphansi kakhona ngokumisela bese ulalela imigomo yokusebenza, uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa iziyalazi ukuze kuzuwe izinhloso zomnyango.
