jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. af.title: Direkteur: Infrastruktuurlewering: Ander Provinsiale
af.summary: Direkteur van Infrastruktuurlewering by die Limpopo Departement van Public Works, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie in die bou-omgewing en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matrik-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 in die bou-omgewing soos erken deur SAQA. Vyf (05) jaar se ervaring op 'n middelbestuurs- (MMS) / seniorbestuursvlak. Registrasie by die tersaaklike professionele raad (d.w.s. SACPCMP, SACAP, ECSA of SACQSP) as professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurder, Argitek, of Hoeveelheidsopmeter sal 'n voordeel wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Degente en diep kennis van tersaaklike skrifte, toepassing van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer soos: Public Finance Management Act. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, veranderingbestuur, Treasury Notes, Arbeid, Promotion of Access to Information Act Openbare Diensregulasies Government Immovable Assets Management Act (GIAMA). Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuur Ingenieurswese, regsondersteunende en operasionele nakoming Ingenieursoperasionele kommunikasie Proseskennis en -vaardighede Onderhoudskennis en -vaardighede Mobiele toerusting en analise-kennis Navorsing en ontwikkeling Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings en MS-sagteware insluitend power point. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur Tegniese konsultasie.
af.duties: Bestuur die tegniese portefeulje vir Provinciale Departemente se infrastruktuur. Bestuur die verskaffing van professionele insette aan die Provinciale Departemente met betrekking tot die voorbereiding van die User Asset Management Plan. Bestuur die hersiening van infrastruktuurprojeklyste in terme van haalbaarheid in oorleg met Provinciale Departemente en doen aanbevelings. Bestuur die assessering van die geskiktheid van terreintoekenning in terme van die verskaffing van geïntegreerde multi-doel regeringsdienste in die provinsie. Bestuur die bepaling van lewenssikluskoste vir roerende bates van die Provinciale Departemente. Bestuur die beplanning, ontwerp en begroting vir tegniese toestandassessering vir Provinciale Departemente se fasiliteite in oorleg met Provinciale Departemente. Bestuur die verkryging van konstruksieprojekte: Verskaf die professionele insette aan die Provinciale Departemente met betrekking tot die verpakking van projekte en finalisering van die verkrygingsstrategie. Ondersteun die Provinciale Departemente om aan alle vereistes soos vermeld in die Division of Revenue Act (DoRA) te voldoen. Bestuur die verkryging van projekte en raamwerkkontrakte vir die Provinciale Departemente. Bestuur die voorbereiding van projekte uitvoeringsplanne tot by die punt van verkryging. Bestuur die implementering van die konstruksieverkryging vir alle projekte namens die ander Provinciale Departemente. Monitor die doeltreffende bestuur van finansiële hulpbronne vir projekte. Bestuur die lewering van infrastruktuurprogramme en -projekte: Verskaf die professionele insette aan die Provinciale Departemente met betrekking tot die voorbereiding van die Infrastructure Programme Management Plan [IPMP]. Verskaf die professionele insette aan die Provinciale Departemente met betrekking tot die verpakking van projekte en finalisering van die verkrygingsstrategie. Ontwikkel IPIP en verskaf die professionele insette en toepaslike stelsels aan die Provinciale Departemente om suksesvolle infrastruktuurbiedings vir die toekenning van prestasiegebaseerde toelaes in te dien. Ondersteun die Provinciale Departemente om aan alle vereistes soos vermeld in die Division of Revenue Act (DoRA) te voldoen. Verskaf die professionele insette aan die Provinciale Departemente met betrekking tot die bepaling van tegniese norme en standaarde. [Hoofsaaklik kostenorme]. Bestuur die validering van bouplanne in terme van Nasionale en Plaaslike Regering Bouregulasies. Bestuur die finalisering van die Infrastructure Programme Implementation Plan (IPIP) vir die Provinciale Departemente. Bestuur die voorbereiding en implementering van Diensleweringsooreenkomste. Bestuur die verkryging van projekte en raamwerkkontrakte vir die Provinciale Departemente. Bestuur die voorbereiding van projekte uitvoeringsplanne tot by die punt van verkryging. Bestuur die implementering van die konstruksieverkryging vir alle projekte namens die ander Provinciale Departemente. Monitor die doeltreffende bestuur van finansiële hulpbronne vir projekte. Verskaf onderhoud aan provinsiale departemente se infrastruktuur: Verseker opdatering van die dokumentbestuurstelsel en die projekbestuurstelsel. Verseker nakoming van tydraamwerke, begrotings en gehaltversekeringsstandaarde vir alle kontrakte: Rapporteer vordering met betrekking tot implementering van infrastruktuurprojekte aan tersaaklike regeringsstrukture. Verskaf die insette vir die voorbereiding van finansiële en nie-finansiële verslae wat by die Provinciale Departement van Gesondheid se Onderhoudsstrategie ingedien moet word. Bestuur en monitor die implementering van die gebruikersbatesbestuursplan. Bestuur onderhoudsoperasies. Bestuur die infrastruktuurinsette vir langertermyn geïntegreerde infrastruktuurbeplanning en -ontwikkeling: Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling en opdatering van die langertermyn geïntegreerde provinsiale infrastruktuurplan soos verwys na as die Limpopo Master Infrastructure Plan. Interakteer met munisipaliteite en die publieke entiteite om lewering van dienste binne die vereiste tydlyne van die Limpopo Master Infrastructure Plan en die Munisipale Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsplanne te bevorder. Werk saam met ander Hoofdirektorate in LDPWRI om die moontlike verpakking van infrastruktuurleweringprojekte oor sektore heen vir naatlose verkryging te oorweeg. Neem deel aan die hersiening en opdatering van die Limpopo Infrastructure Delivery Management System op grond van institutionele veranderinge en areas wat vir verbetering geïdentifiseer is. Bestuur en benut hulpbronne (menslik, finansieel en fisies) ooreenkomstig tersaaklike riglyne en wetgewing. Gee rigting aan span om die Direktoraat se strategiese doelwitte te verwesenlik. Ontwikkel aksieplanne om strategiese inisiatiewe uit te voer. Verseker behoorlike implementering van die begroting deur monitoring, projeksie en verslagdoening van besteding. Monitor en rapporteer oor die benutting van toerusting. Koördineer memorandums van ooreenkoms, diensvlakooreenkomste en bestedingshersiening. Verseker dat die afdeling toereikend beman is. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en beoordeling van werknemers. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Bestuur dissipline.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuhanjiswa Kwezinsiza: Ezinye Izigaba Ezifanele
zu.summary: Umphathi wokuhanjiswa kwezinsiza e-Limpopo Department of Public Works, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF 7 kumkhakha wokwakuhla kanye namava eminyaka emihlanu ebuso bomphathi ophakeme.
zu.requirements: Ithifikethi le-Grade 12/Matric kanye nelifikhwelifikheyshini ezingeni le-NQF level 7 kumkhakha wokwakuhla njengoba kunconywa yi-SAQA. Amava eminyaka emihlanu (05) ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi (MMS) / ezingeni lomphathi ophakeme. Ukwemukelwa ebhungweni lezifundo ezihambisana nalo mkhakha (okungukuthi i-SACPCMP, SACAP, ECSA noma i-SACQSP) njengomphathi wezinhlela zokuqasha izakhiwo, umakhi noma umlinganisi kuzoba yithuba elihle. Ilayisense yokuqasha evumelekile, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abanesikhindi. Ulwazi Nezakhono: Ulwazi olujulile noluhle mayelana nemithetho ehlobene nale nkalo, kanye nokusebenzisa izindlela ezilawula Inkonzo Kahulumeni njengesi: uMthetho woMphatho weMali ezokusabekayo. Ikhono lokubusa kanye noBuhlakani bokuhola. uMphatho wezinhlela namaphrojekthi, uMphatho weMali, uMphatho wokushintsha, ama-Notes eTreasury, iLabour, uMthetho wokuKhuthaza uFinyelelelwolwazi, iziMiso zenkonzo Kahulumethu kanye noMthetho woMphatho weziMpahla ezingahambahamba kahulumeni (GIAMA). Ikhono lobuchwepheshe: uMphatho wezinhlela namaphrojekthi, uBuchwepheshe, ukuvumelana ngokomthetho kanye nokusebenza, ukuxhumana kochwepheshe, ulwazi noma ikhono lokuqonda izinqubo, ulwazi noma ikhono lokugcina, ulwazi noma ikhono lwamathuluzi ahambahambayo kanye nokuqondisisa, ucwaningo nentuthuko, ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha nobuchwepheshe kuhlanganise i-MS software ehlanganisa i-power point. · Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu, wokweluleka ngobuchwepheshe.
zu.duties: Phatha iportfolio yobuchwepheshe mayelana noMphatho Wezinsiza Wezigaba Ezifanele ezingowezifundazwe. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinto eziphakeme eziyingene ezifundazweni phakathi kokulungiselelwa kweplani yoMphatho weziMpahla zabasebenzisi. Phatha ukubuyekezwa kohlu lwamaphrojekthi ezinsiza ngokwethekuqonda ukuzivumelana nezigaba ezifanele ezingowezifundazwe futhi nikezela izindulo. Phatha ukubuyezwa kokuzivumelana kokuqashwa kwendawo ngokunikezwa kwezinsiza kahulumeni ezintathu ezibhekene nayo yonke imigqo ezesifundazweni. Phatha ukumiswa kwezindleko zomkhakha wokuphila kwezimpahla ezingahambahambi zeSigaba Ezifanele ezingowezifundazwe. Phatha ukucubungula, ukwakha kanye nokuqasha isimo sobuchwepheshe ezinsizeni zeSigaba Ezifanele ezingowezifundazwe kanye neSigaba Ezifanele ezingowezifundazwe. Phatha ukuqashwa kwamaphrojekthi okwakha: Nikeza izinto eziphakeme eziyingene ezifundazweni ngokuhlanganiswa kwamaphrojekthi kanye nokuqedwa kwenkambiso yokuqasha. Siza ezigabeni ezingowezifundazwe ukuba zilandele yonke imithetho equkethwe kuMthetho wokuHlukaniswa kweMali yombuso (DoRA). Phatha ukuqashwa kwamaphrojekthi kanye namasheke wokusebenza kwezinsiza ezigabeni ezingowezifundazwe. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kwezinhlela zokuqasha amaphrojekthi kuze kufike kuzuqanjwa ukuqashwa. Phatha ukuqashwa kwezinsiza ezibhaliweyo ngamaphrojekthi wonke abakwa-Sigaba Ezifanele ezingowezifundazwe. Qapha ukuphethwa okuphumelelayo kwezinsiza zemali ngamaphrojekthi. Phatha ukuhanjiswa kwezinhlela kanye namaphrojekthi ezinsizini: Nikeza izinto eziphakeme eziyingene ezifundazweni ngokulungiselelwa kwenkambiso yoMphatho weSisekelo seHlelo [IPMP]. Nikeza izinto eziphakeme eziyingene ezifundazweni ngokuhlanganiswa kwamaphrojekthi kanye nokuqedwa kwenkambiso yokuqasha. Yenza i-IPIP futhi nikeza izinto eziphakeme eziyingene kanye nezinhlela ezifanele ezigabeni ezingowezifundazwe ukuba zithume izicelo eziphumelelayo zezinsiza zokuqasha imibhalo yokubonelelwa ezenza ngokwemiklomelo. Siza ezigabeni ezingowezifundazwe ukuba zilandele yonke imithetho equkethwe kuMthetho wokuHlukaniswa kweMali yombuso (DoRA). Nikeza izinto eziphakeme eziyingene ezifundazweni ngokumiswa kwezinga nobuchwepheshe bokulingana. [Ikakhulukazi izindleko zokulingana]. Phatha ukuqinisekiswa kwezinhlela zokwakha ngokomthetho kahulumeni oyingqayiweyo nowaseduzahlweni. Phatha ukuqedwa kwenkambiso yoQaliswa lweHlelo loMphatho Wezinsiza (IPIP) ezigabeni ezingowezifundazwe. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezivumelwano zoKulethwa kwenkonzo. Phatha ukuqashwa kwamaphrojekthi kanye namasheke wokusebenza kwezinsiza ezigabeni ezingowezifundazwe. Phatha ukulungiselelwa kwezinhlela zokuqasha amaphrojekthi kuze kufike kuzuqanjwa ukuqashwa. Phatha ukuqashwa kwezinsiza ezibhaliweyo ngamaphrojekthi wonke abakwa-Sigaba Ezifanele ezingowezifundazwe. Qapha ukuphethwa okuphumelelayo kwezinsiza zemali ngamaphrojekthi. Bonezela ukugcinwa kwezinsiza zigabeni ezingowezifundazwe: Qinisekisa ukubuyekezwa kwenkambiso yokuqoqwa kwemibhalo kanye nenkambiso yokuqoqwa kwamaphrojekthi. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwesikhathi, imali kanye nezinkambiso zokuqinisekisa izinga lokho konke okuqashiwe: Bika inqubomgomo ngokuqaliswa kwamaphrojekthi ezinsizini izakhiwo ezinhle zikahulumene. Nikeza izinto ezingxenyeni yokulungiselelwa kwezibiko zemali ezingeyona zemali okufanele zithunyelwe eSigabeni Esifanele Sempilo ezingowezifundazwe ngomgomo wokugcina. Phatha kanye noqapha ukusetshenziswa kohlaka lweplani yoMphatho weziMpahla zabasebenzisi. Phatha imisebenzi yokugcina. Phatha izinto eziphakeme eziyingene eziyinsiza ezihlelweni ezinde zokuqondisisa kanye nentuthuko: Hlanganyela ekwakheni nasekubuyekezeni iplani yesifunda eside ezinsizeni njengoba kubizwa ngokuthi iplani uLimpopo Master Infrastructure Plan. Phathana namasipalathi namaphoyintu abantu ukukhuthaza ukuhanjiswa kwezinsiza ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esidingekile se-Limpopo Master Infrastructure Plan kanye neMunicipal Integrated Development plans. Hlanganyela nabanye oMphathi abaphakathi kwi-LDPWRI ukubhekisisa amaphrojekthi wokuthunyelwa kwezinsiza ezingaba khona ezingqayiweyo ngokuhamba kwezinhlela. Hlanganyela ekubuyekezweni nasekubuyekuzeni i-Limpopo Infrastructure Delivery Management System ngokushintshwa kwemikhakha kanye nezindawo ezitholakala ukusizwa. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinsiza (abantu, imali nezimpahla) ngokuhambisana nemiyalo kanye nomthetho ohlelekile. Nikeza isiqondiso qhaza ekufinyelelwa okuhlose ukubusa. Yizela izinhlela zokuqhuba izinhlelo zokuhlongakwabo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okulungile kweholo ngokuqapha, ukubona kusengaphambili nokubika ukuchithwa. Qapha futhi ubike ngokuqashwa kwezinsiza. Hlanganisa imemorandamu yokuqonda, izivumelwano zenkonzo kanye nokuqapha ukuchithwa. Qinisekisa ukuba inqwanqi inabantu abanele. Hlola futhi uqaphe ukusebenza nokubukisisa abasebenzi. Qinisekisa amandla nentuthuko yabasebenzi. Phatha inzila.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ukunikela Kolwakhiwo: Ezinye Iiphondo
xh.summary: Umlawuli Wokunikela Kolwakhiwo kwisebe leLimpopo Department of Public Works, lifuna izidanga ze-NQF 7 kolwakhiwo-lwangoku namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yamava ohlangahleni oluphakamileyo olulawulayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12/Matric nesidanga kumgangatho we-NQF 7 kwimozamo yolwakhiwo njengoko sivunywa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emihlanu (05) yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi lolawulo (MMS) / eliphezulu lolawulo. Ukuqatshelwa kwiBhunga elichwethezayo lomsebenzi (okt. i-SACPCMP, i-SACAP, i-ECSA okanye i-SACQSP) njengomphathi weNgqiqo woMsebenzi woKwakhiwo, uMmisiwo weSakhiwo, okanye uMlingani woQhweshe kuya kuba lusango oluhle. Ilayisensi esemthethweni yokuqhuba, ngaphandle kooboqerhwaba abanoluleko. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olunjalo nolunjalo kolwabiwo lwemimiselo oluhambelana nomthetho ophatha iNkonzo zoLuntu enjengale: i-Public Finance Management Act. Ikhono loQhamba nokuLawula nokuBaNkokeli. Ulawulo lweNkqubo neProyekthi, uLawulo loMali, uLawulo lweShintsho, i-Treasury Notes, iNyuse, uKuthuthwa kweNkcazelo yamacebo eNkonzo yoLuntu iMigaqo yoLuntu i-Government Immovable Assets Management Act (GIAMA). Ikhono leNgcaca: Ulawulo lwenkqubo neproyekthi yoKwakhiwo, ulandelelwano olungokomthetho nolusebenzayo loKwakhiwo, ungeniso-colisa olusebenzayo lweKwakhiwo, ulwazi nolukwazi lweNkqubo, amakhono nolwazi loKugcinwa kolwakhiwo, amakhono nolwazi oKusesixhobeni esihambahambayo nolungxamvayo. Uphando nophuhliso Izicelo zokwakhiwa ngekhompyutha nesoftwe ye-MS kuquka i-power point.·Ukudala inkqubo yenkqubo yokusebenza ngamandla aphantse ngamakhono okubonisana ngobuchwepheshe.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ibe yeobuchwepheshe yeelwakhiwo zamaSebe ePhondo. Ulawula ukunikwa kwezimvo zobuchwepheshe kumaSebe ePhondo ngokwokuqulunqa iQhalo loLawulo loBunjini. Ulawula uphando loluhlu lweeproyekthi zolwakhiwo ngokwamandla okwenziwa sicebo kunye namaSebe ePhondo wenze izindululo. Ulawula ukuqokelelwa kolungelo lwendawo ngokwokuqokelelwa kweenkonzo zahulumeni ezahlukeneyo ephondweni. Ulawula ukuqokomwa kwexabiso lobomi belwakhiwo ezakhiwo namaSebe ePhondo. Ulawula ukuqulunqa, ukuyila nokuqhuba imali yokuqwalasela imo yobuchwepheshe zeziseko zamaSebe ePhondo ngokubonisana namaSebe ePhondo. Ulawula ukuthengwa kweeproyekthi zolwakhiwo: Nikeza izimvo zobuchwepheshe kumaSebe ePhondo ngokwokuqokelelwa kweeproyekthi nokuqwalaselwa kwe-strategy yokuqokelela. Siza amaSebe ePhondo ukuba aqondele konke okufunekayo okutyhilwe kwi-Division of Revenue Act (DoRA). Ulawula ukuthengwa kweeproyekthi namagama eproyekthi asisiseko samaSebe ePhondo. Ulawula ukuqulunqwa kweecalaba zokuqhuba iiprojekthi kuze kufikele kwindawo yokuqokelela. Ulawula ukuqalwa kolwakhiwo kwiinkqubo zokuqokelela iiprojekthi ngenkxaso yamanye amaSebe ePhondo. Qwalasela ukulawula ngokusebenzayo amabhankisi emali yeeproyekthi. Ulawula ukunikwa kolwakhiwo lweenkqubo neeproyekthi: Nikeza izimvo zobuchwepheshe kumaSebe ePhondo ngokuqulunqa iCalaba loLawulo lolwakhiwo [IPMP]. Nikeza izimvo zobuchwepheshe kumaSebe ePhondo ngokwokuqokelelwa kweeproyekthi nokuqwalaselwa kwe-strategy yokuqokelela. Phuhlisa i-IPIP kwaye unike izimvo zobuchwepheshe neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo kumaSebe ePhondo ukuba ngenise izicelo zolwakhiwo eziphumeleleyo zokuqokelelwa kwamagranthi aqwalaselwa ngokwemigangatho. Siza amaSebe ePhondo ukuba aqondele konke okufunekayo okutyhilwe kwi-Division of Revenue Act (DoRA). Nikeza izimvo zobuchwepheshe kumaSebe ePhondo ngokuqokomwa kwemigangatho yobuchwepheshe. [Ngokuyilolonga iindleko]. Ulawula uqinisekiso lweplani zokwakhiwa ngokwemigaqo yoLuntu yoLwakhiwo eNdingbolwethu nasekuLwandle. Ulawula ukuqwalaselwa kweCalaba loLawulo lolwakhiwo (IPIP) lwamaSebe ePhondo. Ulawula ukuqulunqa nokuphatha iSivumelwano soLawulo lweNkonzo. Ulawula ukuthengwa kweeproyekthi namagama eproyekthi asisiseko samaSebe ePhondo. Ulawula ukuqulunqwa kweecalaba zokuqhuba iiprojekthi kuze kufikele kwindawo yokuqokelela. Ulawula ukuqalwa kolwakhiwo kwiinkqubo zokuqokelela iiprojekthi ngenkxaso yamaSebe ePhondo. Qwalasela ukulawula ngokusebenzayo amabhankisi emali yeeproyekthi. Nikeza izinkonzo zolondolozo kolwakhiwo lwamasebe ephondo: Qinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwenkqubo yokuqulunqa amaxwebu nenkqubo yokuqulunqa iiprojekthi. Qinisekisa ukuqonda kolwethu, amabhankisi nemiqathango yokuyila ngokwemigangatho yonke iinkqubo: Chaza inkqondo ngokuphatha iiprojekthi zolwakhiwo kubunye beeNkqubo zohulumeni. Nikeza izimvo zokuqulunqa iingxelo zomali nongeze mali ezifuna ukuba zinikwe kuSebe lwePhondo leMpilo yokuLondoloza i-strategy. Ulawula ukuqwalasela nokuphatha i-strategy yolondolozo lwesebe. Ulawula imisebenzi yolondolozo. Ulawula izimvo zolwakhiwo ngokwakuqulunqa nokuqhuba iinqcaba ezinde zolwakhiwo: Thabatha inxaxheba ekuphuhliseni nokuqwalasela iQhalo elide elihlangene lolwakhiwo lophondo elithiwa yiLimpopo Master Infrastructure Plan. Yiba nabantu bomasipala nabeNkqubo zoLuntu ukukhuthaza ukunikwa kweenkonzo ngaphakathi kolwethu olufunekayo lweLimpopo Master Infrastructure Plan neeMigaqo yeNkqubo yokuPhuhlisa iMasipala. Sebenzisana namanye amaQumragu eNkokeli kwiLDPWRI ukuze uqwalasele iindlela ezinokuba zikhona zokuqokelelwa kweeproyekthi zolwakhiwo kumagumbi ngokulula kolwakhiwo. Thabatha inxaxheba ekuphuhliseni nokuqwalasela iNkqubo yoLawulo lokuNikezwa koLwakhiwo laseLimpopo ngokutshintshele kwentshilo nakuqonda iindawo ezifana nokuphuculwa. Ulawula usebenzise iibhankisi (abantu, imali & ezabakho) ngokomthetho ophatha nemithetho. Nikeza iNkqondo eqondisa iqela ekufezweni iinjongo ezicwangciswe nguMlawuli. Phuhlisa iiplani zomzobo ukuqhuba iinjongo ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okulungileyo kwexabiso ngokuqwalasela, ukubhala nokuvelisa imali echitshiyiwe. Qwalasela chaza ngokusetyenziswa kolusebenzo. Hlanganisa iNkcazolo eQondene, izivumelwano zomgangatho wesebe nokuqwalaselwa kwemali echitiwe. Qinisekisa ukuba iqumrha libeke ngokwaneleyo abasebenzi. Qwalasela hlola ukusebenza nokuqwalaselwa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa amandla nophuhliso lwabasebenzi. Ulawula isohlwayo.

jobs.title: Chief Construction Project Manager: Grade a
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R1 317 108 per annum Grade B: R1 593 765 per annum (to be structured according to individual needs). The Department will determine the salary package based on years of experience post professional registration), OSD
jobs.summary: Chief Construction Project Manager position in the Limpopo Department of Public Works, requiring a Built Environment qualification and SACPCMP registration with six years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Matric certificate and a qualification at NQF level 7 as recognized by SAQA in Built Environment with a minimum of 6 years’ experience as a registered Professional Construction Project Manager with the SACPCMP, Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Technical Competencies: Programme and project management. Project Management skills, principles and methodologies. Project and professional judgement. Computer-aided engineering and project applications. Project design and analysis knowledge. Project operational communication. Process knowledge and skills. Maintenance skills and knowledge. Mobile equipment operating skills. Legal and operational compliance. Research and development. Creating high performance culture. Technical consulting. Generic Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership, problem solving and analysis, decision making, team leadership, creativity, financial management, customer focus and responsiveness, communication, computer skills, people management, planning and organizing, conflict management, negotiation skills, change management.
jobs.duties: Project design and analysis effectiveness: Perform final review and approvals or audits on project designs according to design principles or theory. Co – ordinate design efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology. Maintain project operational effectiveness: Manage the execution of project management strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set project standards, specifications and service levels according to organizational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor project management efficiencies according to organizational goals to direct or redirect project services for the attainment of organizational objectives. Financial Management: Ensure availability and management of funds to meet the MTEF objectives within the project environment/ services. Manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organizational needs and objectives. Manage the commercial added value of the discipline-related programmes and projects. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organizational principles. Allocate, monitor, control, expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cashflow management. Governance Allocate, monitor and control resources. Compiles risk logs (database) and manages significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organisational requirements. Provide technical consulting services for the operation of project related matters to minimise possible project risks. Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives e.g. short – term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. People management Direct the development motivation and utilization of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of project services according to organisational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.

af.title: Hoofkonstruksieprojekbestuurder: Graad a
af.summary: Hoofkonstruksieprojekbestuurder-pos in die Limpopo Department of Public Works, wat 'n bouomgewingskwalifikasie en SACPCMP-registrasie met ses jaar se ondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 12/Matrik-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken in die Bouomgewing met 'n minimum van 6 jaar se ondervinding as 'n geregistreerde Professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurder by die SACPCMP. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuur. Projekbestuursvaardighede, beginsels en metodes. Projek- en professionele oordeel. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurs- en projekte toepassings. Kennis van projekontwerp en -ontleding. Projekte operasionele kommunikasie. Proseskennis en -vaardighede. Onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis. Vaardighede in die bedryf van mobiele toerusting. Regs- en operasionele nakoming. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese advisering. Algemene bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, probleemoplossing en ontleding, besluitneming, spanleierskap, kreatiwiteit, finansiële bestuur, klienstefokus en -reaksie, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardighede, mensebestuur, beplanning en organisering, konflikbestuur, onderhandelingvaardighede, veranderingbestuur.
af.duties: Doeltreffendheid van projekontwerp en -ontleding: Voer finale hersiening en goedkeurings of oudits uit op projekontwerpe volgens ontwerpbeginsels of -teorie. Koördineer ontwerppogings en integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker. Onderhou projekoperasionele doeltreffendheid: Bestuur die uitvoering van projekbestuurstrategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Stel projeksstandaarde, -spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimale operasionele beskikbaarheid te verseker. Monitor projekbestuursdoeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om projekdienste te rig of te herlei vir die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte. Finansiële bestuur: Verseker beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om die MTEF-doelwitte binne die projekomgewing/-dienste te bereik. Bestuur die operasionele kapitaalprojekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbrontoewysing volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissipline-gebaseerde programme en projekte. Fasiliteer die samestelling van innoveringsvoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Allokeer, monitor en beheer besteding volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloeibestuur te verseker. Begaan Allokeer, monitor en beheer hulpbronne. Stel risikologs (databasis) op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurpraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes. Verskaf tegniese adviesdienste vir die operasie van projekverwante sake om moontlike projekrisiko's te minimaliseer. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe bv. korttermyn-opdragte en ontheffings binne en oor operasies heen, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor deurlopend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Mensebestuur Stuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van projekdienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasieareas deur die stel en monitor van prestasiestandaarde en die neem van aksies om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Iphini leNhloko Yokuakhiwa Iphrojekthi Yenhloko: izinga a
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMenenja Wephrojekthi Yokuakhiwa oyiNhloko e-Limpopo Department of Public Works, esidinga ithiziwe le-Built Environment futhi ukubhalise kwi-SACPCMP ngeminye engu-6 yeminyaka yohlelo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12/Matric kanye nethiziwe ezingeni le-NQF 7 njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA kwe-Built Environment eneminye engu-6 yeminyaka yohlelo njengomenenja wephrojekthi yokuakhiwo oreyisithiwe ne-SACPCMP, ilayisenisi yomshayeli esemthethweni, ngaphandle kwabafaka izindlovana abanesono. Izikhono zobuchwepheshe: Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi kanye nokuqondisa inqubo. Amakhono, izimiso nezindlela zokuphatha amaphrojekthi. Isahluleko sephrojekthi nesobuchwepheshe. Abasebenzise uchweba oluncedwa isistimu ekwakhiweni kwezimiso kanye nakukusebenziseni amaphrojekthi. Ulwazi ngokuhlela nokuhlaziya amaphrojekthi. Unxibelelwano lokuqhuba iphrojekthi. Ulwazi namandla okwenza izinhlelo. Amakhono nolwazi lokuqhuba nokugcina. Amakhono okusebenzisa uchweba oluhambayo. Ukulandela imithetho nokusebenza ngokwayo. Ukuqondisisa nokuthuthukisa. Ukudala isiko elenza kahle kakhulu. Ukubonisana ngobuchwepheshe. Amakhono ajwayelekile: Ukubonakala okuhlela futhi abe yinhloko, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nekuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukubamba ihloko eqenjini, ukudala izinto ezingavamile, ukuphatha izimali, ukugcinele futhi unake kakhulu abathengi kanye nokuphendula okusheshayo, ukunxibelelana, amakhono okusebenzisa uchweba, ukuphatha abantu, ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto, ukulawula izinkinga, amakhono okuxoxisana, ukuphatha ushintsho.
zu.duties: Ukusebenza kahle kokuhlela nokuhlaziya iphrojekthi: Yenza ukubuyekeza okugqamile futhi uvume noma uhlola ukuhlelwa kwezinhlelo ngokwezinzo zokuhlela noma inqubo. Hlanganisa imizamo yokuhlela futhi uguquise iyahluke kwezinye izigaba ukuze kuqiniseke ukuhlanganiswa okuhlayo netheknoloji yanamuhla. Gcina ukusebenza kahle kwezokusebenza kwephrojekthi: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokuphatha iphrojekthi ngokunikezwa kwezakhiwo ezifanele, izistimu ngezinsiza. Hlela izindinganiso zeziprojekthi, izinkomba kanye namazinga enkonzo ngokwezinjongo zenhlanganiso ukuze kuqiniseke ukutholakala okuhle kwezokusebenza. Qapha ukusebenza kahle kokuphatha amaphrojekthi ngokwezinjongo zenhlanganiso ukuze uqondise noma ushintshe izinkonzo zephrojekthi ukuze kufinyelelwe izinjongo zenhlanganiso. Ukuphathwa kwezimali: Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokuphathwa kwezimali ukuze kuhambisane nezinja zenhlanganiso ngokwezinjongo ze-MTEF ezindaweni/kwezinkonzo zephrojekthi. Phatha ifolio yephrojekthi yamakhapithali okusebenzayo kuleso sikhundla ukuze kuqiniseke ukugcinwa kwezinsiza ngokwezidingo nezinja zenhlanganiso. Phatha inani elengezwe lezinhlela kanye namaphrojekthi ahlobene naleso sikhundla. Yisa phambili ukuhlela kwepropozha ezintsha ukuze kuqiniseke ukusebenza nokulandela izimiso zenhlanganiso. Abela, qapha, lawula, ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwebajeti ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphathwa kahle kwenani lemali esebenzayo. Ulawulo: Abela, qapha futhi ulawule izinsiza. Hlela amafayi wengozi (idathabheysi) futhi uphathe ubungozi obuvelako ngokwenqubo ephilile yokuphatha ubungozi futhi ngemithetho yenhlanganiso. Nikeza ngezinkonzo zokuveza ubuchwepheshe ngokusebenza kwezindaba ezihlobene nephrojekthi ukuze kuncishiswe ubungozi bemikhakha engase yenzeke kuleso sikhundla. Lawula futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi ezifana nokubekwa okunesikhathi esifushane futhi ukuthunyelwe kwezinye izigaba ngaphakathi nakwezinye imikhakha, ekusekeleni izinhlela zokuthuthukisa abantu, izidingo zokusebenza kanye nenzuzo eshajwe. Qapha njalo ukushintshaniswa nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kwezinye izigaba nezihlezi ukuze kuqiniseke ukulawulwa okuhle kolwazi ngokwezinjongo womnyango. Ukuphathwa kwabantu: Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa ukugqugquzela nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo yabantu kuleso sikhundla ukuze kuqiniseke inani lolwazi elikhono ngokuza kwezinsiza zemikhakha eqhubekayo ukuze kubuyele impumelelo yezinkonzo zephrojekthi ngokwezidingo nezinhloso zenhlanganiso. Phatha indawo ebalulekile yokubamba ihole yezisebenzi ngokuhlela kwaye qapha amazinga okusebenza bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa iziphambeko ukuze kufeze izinjongo zomnyango.

xh.title: UMlawuli Omkhulu weNkqubo yoLwakhiwo: Grede a
xh.summary: Isithuba somLawuli Omkhulu weNkqubo yoLwakhiwo kwiSebe leZoLuntu lomSebenzi iLimpopo, elifuna izifundo zeNzululwazi zoLwakhiwo nokubhalisa kwi-SACPCMP eneminyaka emithandathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrede 12/Matric nesenzo sokufunda kwesinqanaba se-NQF 7 esamkelwa yi-SAQA kwiNzululwazi yoLwakhiwo eneminyaka engu-6 yamava njengomLawuli weNkqubo yoLwakhiwo obugcweleyo obhalisiweyo kwi-SACPCMP, ilayisenisi yokuqhayiya esebenzayo, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abasandulelwe kukuhluleka. Iakhoni ezisezantsi zobugcisa: Ulawulo lwenkqubo namaphulo. Amanyathelo, iimigaqo neendlela zokuLawula iPhulo. Isiphindi-mbuya sobugcisa nephulo. Iinkqubo zokwakhiwa ngekhompyutha nakwizicelo zephulo. Ulwazi ngokuqamba nokuhlalutya iphulo. Unxibelelwano osebenzayo lwegama lophulo. Ulwazi namakhono enkcubeko. Amanyathelo nolwazi lokulondoloza. Amanyathelo okusebenzisa izixhobo eziyahambayo. Ukuthobela imithetho nemithefana yokusebenza. Uphononongo nentl开发了. Ukudala inkqubo yemveliso ephezulu. Iingcebiso zobugcisa. Amanyathelo ajikeleleyo: Ikhono lokulawula iindaba ezingalindanga nokuqhuba, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukuthabatha iigqibo, ukulawula iqela, ukuyila, ukulawula imali, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula, unxibelelwano, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukulawula abantu, uqeqesho lolungiselelo, ukulawula ingxabano, amakhono okuxoxisana, ukulawula utshintsho.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba nokuhlalutya ukusebenza kwephulo: Qamba ukuphonononga okugqibeleleyo nokuzamkela okanye ukuqamba eziczweni zephulo ngokwemigaqo yokuqamba okanye inyani. Xobana imizamo yokuqamba kwaye udibanise ngaphakathi kwemimandla ukuze kuqinisekiswe udibaniso olungenantphukwano netekhnoloji yangoku. gcina ukusebenza kwekqubo yephulo: Lawula ukwenziwa kwenkqubo yokulawula iphulo ngokuqikelela iindidi ezifanelekileyo, iinkqubo neemithombo. Misela iinkqubo zeephulo, iinkcazelo nemigangatho yesebenzo ngokwemigqongo yoshicilelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufumaneka okugqibeleleyo kokusebenza. Qaphela iindlela ezisebenzayo zokulawula iphulo ngokwemigqongo yeshicilelo ukuze uqhobe okanye uqhobe ngokutsha iinkonzo zephulo ukuze kufunyanwe imigqongo yeshicilelo. Ukulawula imali: Qinisekisa ukufumaneka nokulawula imali ukuze kuhlangelwe imigqongo ye-MTEF ngaphakathi kwindalo/inkonzo yephulo. Lawule iphoftifoliyo yephulo leenxutyana zekhaphethi yokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubonelelwa okusebenzayo ngokwemfuno nemigqongo yeshicilelo. Lawula ixabiso elongezelelweyo lenkonzo yeenkqubo namaphulo ahlobene nendalo. Yenza isixhobo sokwakha iingcamango zotsha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza nokuthobela iimigaqo yeshicilelo. Suka, qaphela, ulawule ukuchithwa ngokwesetinge ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo lwe-cashflow olusebenzayo. Urhulumente: Suka, qaphela ulawule iimithombo. Xela iingxaki (kwindawo yokugcina iinkcukacha) ulawule iingozi ezibalulekileyo ngokweenkqubo ezilungileyo zokulawula iingozi kwaye njengoko kufunwa ngushicilelo. Bonelela iinkonzo zengcebiso zobugcisa ngokusebenza kwezintlu ezihlobene nephulo ukuze unciphise iingozi ezinokubakho zephulo. Lawula uphumeze iinkqubo zokusabelana ulwazi ngokomzekelo: kwimizekelo emfutshane nokuthumelwa abantu kwaye emaphakathi nakumandla okusebenza, ngokuxhasa iplani zokuphuhlisa umntu, iimfuno zokusebenza nenzuzo yotyalo-mali. Qhuba qaphela ukutshintshelana nokukhusela inkcazolo phakathi kokusebenza nabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula ulwazi ngokwemigqongo yeshicilelo. ukulawula abantu: Qhobisa uphuhliso, ukukhuthazwa nokusebenziswa kweemithombo zabantu kwindawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olugqithiselayo ukuze kuphumelele ngokuphela iinkonzo zephulo ngokwemfuno neemfuno zeshicilelo. Lawula iindawo ezibalulekileyo zokusebenza ezisezantsi ngokumisela ukuqaphela imigangatho yokusebenza uthathe iinyameko zokulungisa iingxaki ukuze kufikelelwe kumgqongo weshicilelo.

Manage the commercial added value of the discipline-related programmes and projects. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organizational principles. Allocate, monitor, control expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Governance: Allocate, monitor and control resources. Compile risk logs (database) and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organizational requirements. Provide technical specialist services for the operation of quantity survey related matters to minimize possible risks. Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. People management: Manage the development, motivation and utilisation of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of quantity survey services according to organizational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.

af.title: Hoofkwantiteitsopmeter (GRADE a -B)
af.summary: Hoofkwantiteitsopmeter by die Limpopo Department of Public Works, wat SACQSP-registrasie en ses jaar se na-kwalifikasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matriek-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 soos erken deur SAQA in Quantity Survey. Ses jaar se Quantity Survey-na-kwalifikasie-ervaring word vereis. Verpligte registrasie by SACQSP as 'n Professionele Kwantiteitsopmeter. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Personeelbestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Veranderingsbestuur. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuur. Quantity Survey-wetlike en operationele nakoming. Quantity Survey-operationele kommunikasie. Proseskennis en -vaardighede. Onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis. Mobiele toerusting-bedryfsvaardighede. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaarondersteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsulting. Professionele oordeel.
af.duties: Doeltreffendheid van Quantity Survey-ontleding: Voer finale hersiening en goedkeurings of oudite op kwantiteitsopmetingsprosedures uit. Koördineer kwantiteitsopmetingspogings en -integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker. Handhaaf operationele doeltreffendheid van kwantiteitsopmeting. Bestuur die uitvoering van kwantiteitsopmetingsstrategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Stel kwantiteitsopmetingsstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimale operationele beskikbaarheid te verseker. Monitor kwantiteitsopmetingseffektiwiteit volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om kwantiteitsopmetingsdienste te rig of te herlei vir die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte. Finansiële Bestuur: Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om die MTEF-doelwitte binne die kwantiteitsopmetingsomgewing/-dienste te bereik. Bestuur die operationele kapitale projekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbronvoorsiening volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële toegevoegde waarde van die dissipline-verwante programme en projekte. Fasiliteer die samestelling van innovasievoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Ruis, monitor en beheer bestedingsvolgens begroting om effektiewe kontantvlootbestuur te verseker. Bestuur: Ruis, monitor en beheer hulpbronne. Stel risikologboeke (databasis) op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens gesonde risikobestuurpraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes. Verskaf tegniese spesialisdienste vir die werking van kwantiteitsopmetingsverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike risiko's te minimeer. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operationele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor deurlopend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Personeelbestuur: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van kwantiteitsopmetingsdienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Umlobi Obalwe Ngobukhulu Wezokulinganisa (GRADE a -B)
zu.summary: Umlobi Obalwe Ngobukhulu Wezokulinganisa e-Limpopo Department of Public Works, ofuna ukubhaliswa ku-SACQSP namafomu eminyaka eyisithupha okusebenza emva kokuthola isiqu.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Matric nesiqu esingazinga le-NQF Level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA kwezokulinganisa ezakhiwayo. Kudingeka unamafomu eminyaka eyisithupha okusebenza emva kokuthola isiqu kwezokulinganisa ezakhiwayo. Ukubhaliswa ngokuphoqeleleko ku-SACQSP njengomlobi obalwe ngobungcweti wezokulinganisa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, ngaphandle kwezicelo zabantu abakhubazekile. Amakhono: Ukubheka phambili ngokubonisana nokuqonda ukuba kuhamba kanjani uhlelo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukubekephambili iqembu. Ubuciko. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuqala kwesidingo somthengi nokuphendula. Ukuthintana. Amakhono wekhompyutha. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ukuphatha izingxabano. Amakhono okuxoxisana ngokwezimali. Ukuphatha izehlulo. Amandla okusebenza ngobuchwepheshe: Ukuphatha izinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ukuhambisana ngokomthetho noma ngokomthetho wokusebenza kwezokulinganisa. Ukuxhumana kwabasebenzi ngesikhathi sokulinganisa. Ulwazi namakhono wezinqubo. Amakhono nolwazi wokugcina. Amakhono okusebenzisa izinsimbi zohamba naye. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kobuchwepheshe. Ukwakha isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Ukuphakamisa ngobuchwepheshe. Ukwahlulela ngobungcweti.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola ukusebenza kwangempela kwezokulinganisa: Yenza ukubuyekeza okugcwele futhi uvume noma ahlole izinqubo zokulinganisa. Hlanganisa imizamo yokulinganisa kwayo yonke imikhakha ukuze kuqhubeke kahle nezinyanga ezisemthethweni. Gcina ukusebenza kahle kwezokulinganisa. Phatha ukuphunyulwa kwendlela yokulinganisa ngokunika izakhiwo, amasistimu namatholokhindi afanele. Hlela amagama, izinkomba namanani okwenza imisebenzi ngokuhlangana nezinhloso zenhlangano ukuze kuqhubeke kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi. Qapha ukusebenza kahle kwezokulinganisa ngokuhlangana nezinhloso zenhlangano ukuze uhambise noma uhambise kabusha izinsiza zokulinganisa ngokuze kufikelelwe izinhloso zenhlangano. Ukuphatha imali: Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokuphathwa kwemali ukuze kuhambisana nezinhloso ze-MTEF kwindawo/insiza yokulinganisa. Phatha iholo lamaphrojekthi akhona kuwo wonke amaqembu wokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenzisa okuhle ngokwezidingo nezinhloso zenhlangano. Phatha inani lezimali eziveza inzuzo kwamaphrojekthi ahlobene nalawo msebenzi. Siza ekuqoqweni kwezinhlela zokuthoma ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuziphendula ngokomthetho nokuhambisana nezindinganiso zenhlangano. Hlanganisalalela, lawula ukusebenzisa imali ngokwehlelo ukuzinikela ukuba ngokwezimali okuhle. Ukuphatha: Qaphela, lawula nokuphatha izinsiza. Qamba amafayela ezingozi (isiqungathi sezinsiza) uphathe izingozi ezinkulu ngokuhambisana nendlela ethembekile yokuphatha izingozi nangokwezidingo zenhlangano. Nikela ngolwazi olubhekise kubuchwepheshe ukuze kusebenze kahle izinto ezihlobene nokulinganisa zokunciphisa izingozi ezingaba khona. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi ukuze kwakhaselwe izinhlelo zokuqaliswa komuntu, izidingo zokusebenza nenzuzo yokutshalwa imali. Qaphela ngokungapheli ukuphathwa nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kokusebenza nabantu ukuze kuqhubeke kahle ukuphathwa kolwazi ngokuhambisana nezinhloso zomnyango. Ukuphatha abantu: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukwesekwa nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo yabantu phakathi kweqembu ukuzinikela ukuba khona ulwazi oluthembekile ukuze kuqhubeke nokuqashwa komsebenzi wezokulinganisa ngokwezidingo nezinhloso zenhlangano. Lawula izindawo eziphambili zabasebenzi ngezinhlelo zokwenza imisebenzi ngokubeka futhi ulalela izinkomba zokwenza umsebenzi futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa iziphakamiso ukuze kutholakale izinhloso zenhlangano.

xh.title: Chief Quantity Surveyor (GRADE a -B)
xh.summary: Kwindawo yeLimpopo Department of Public Works, kukho isithuba sikawonke wommiselo wesixa ( Chief Quantity Surveyor), sifuna ukubhalwa kwi SACQSP neminyaka elithandathu yangomva kokufumana isifo.
xh.requirements:
Isetifikethi se Grade 12 / Matric kwaye nesignali kwinqanaba le NQF Level 7 njengokuqatshwa yi SAQA kwi Quantity Survey.Kufunekayo iminyaka esi(6) yamava alandelwa isetiḿkatheḋe yoku Quantity Survey.Kufunke ukubhaliswa kwi SACQSP njengengcali yoku Quantity Survey.Ilayisensi yokushayela, ngaphandle kweabo abaswela amandla aphawulekayo.Amandla:Ulawulo lwamandla nobunkokeli.Ukusombulula iingxaki kwaye nokuqhute uhlalutyo.Ukwenza iigqibo.Ulawulo lwethimba.Udaliyo.Ukulawula imali.Kunika uxhaso nakwimiba abathengi.Unxibelelwano.Amandla ekhompyutha.Ulawulo lwabantu.Ukucwangcisa nokuhlela.Ukulawula ingxabano.Amandla okuxhomekeka.Ukutshintsha ulawulo.Iinkqubo zobugcisa ezifanelekileyo:Ulawulo lwenkqubo neprojekthi.Ukuvumelana nemithetho noku Quantity Survey.Tshumayelo olusebenzayo lwaku Quantity Survey.Ukuvumelana kwemigaqo yamahlelo kwaye ufumane izazisi.Malinziwe empilweni ukuvuselela ulwazi kwindawo yokushukuma kuthatha amava nemilinganiselo yamathuba.
Ukuhlala kukho imilinganiselo yamathuba.
Uvavanyo nophuhliso.Izicelo zokusebenzisa ekhompyutha.Ukudala inkqubo yokusebenza ngokugqibeleleyo.Inkxwelo ngesazisi-magqabhuko.Esondinga-nobukhulu-buntununtunu.
xh.duties: Ukuze kusebenze ukuhlolwa kwe Quantity Survey:enza iintsingiselo ezingangqinelaniyo nokuvunywa okanye ukuhlolwa kwemigaqo ye Quantity Survey.Hlenza nomanyaniswe imizamo ye Quantity Survey kumagatya ahlukeneyo ukwenzela ukuhlanganiswa okungenazo iingxaki neteknoloji yangoku.Gcina ukusebenza okusebenzayo kwe Quantity Survey.Phatha ukuSETYENZiswa kolwazi lwe Quantity Survey ngokubonelela iintlobo ezifanelekileyo, iinkqubo nemithombo.Seka imilinganiselo yoku Quantity Survey ukubakho kweemfuno kwaye imilinganiselo yokukhankanywa ibe ngokwemigqango yenkundla, ukuze kubekho imilinganiselo ngokusebenzayo.Iqondo loku Quantity Survey elingenisa imiba ngokwenza ukuqwalasela okusemgangathweni ngokwemilinganiselo yokusebenza ngokwemigqango yenkundla ukusuka  okanye ukulawula iinkonzo ukuze kufikelelwe kwemigqango yenkundla.I York Yenza imali yokulawula:Qinisekisa ukubakho kolawulo lwemali yokwenza imigqango yeMTEF kwindawo yoku Quantity Survey/inkonzo.Phatha ibhashte yeprojekthi yokusebenza ukuze kufikelelwe kwemigqango yokusebenza ngokwemfuno nemigqango yenkundla.Phatha ixabiso elongeziweyo le Calculer amaxabiso eeprogramu neprojekthi ezinxulumene nefuthe.Amukela iNkqubo yokulungiselela iingcamango ezintsha ukuze zibe nefuthe nesiNgcangcazelo esimanyanisweyo.Kabelwa, qwemasela, ulawule intsengu ngokweNkqubo yokusebenza ukwenzela ulawulo lwebhajeti.Gcina kwaye ulawule imali yokusetyenziswa ngokwemigaqo yokusebenza ukuze lusebenze ngokufanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Security Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (to be structured according to individual needs)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Security Management at the Department of Public Works in Polokwane, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification and five years' security management experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Matric and a qualification at NQF level 6 in Security Management as recognised by SAQA. State Security Agency (SSA), Security Grade A/B (PSIRA). 5 years’ experience in Security Management environment of which three (3) years MUST be at Junior Management / Assistant Director level. Valid firearm competencies. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Physical security risk control measures. Security principles and practices. MPSS. MISS. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. People management. Conflict management.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of operational risk and security awareness programmes: Develop operational risk and security awareness programmes. Implement security awareness plans. Monitor the provision of workshops on security awareness. Evaluate the security status within the department. Liaise with other departments on security issues. Propose control measures to minimise or eliminate the security risks. Monitor and evaluate the implementation of Security Policies and Procedures as well as the Security Measures e.g. MISS, MPSS, etc: Develop security procedures. Develop policy for security measures. Develop a contingency plan. Develop, manage and monitor the implementation of security plans and programmes. Advice and attend to security breaches. Propose control measures to minimise or eliminate the security risks. Manage the provision security administrative services. Provide tender bulletin for security advertisement. Maintain the contract(s) for outsourced security. Monitor performance of private security services as per service level agreement. Monitor in – house security guards. Provide specifications for purchasing of security equipment’s (Guard Monitoring systems, EACS etc.). Investigate security related cases. Manage physical security appraisals and information security audits by:- Verify company documents at PSIRA, Vetting of service providers at SSA. Manage key control. Provide resource (Human, Financial and Equipment): Manage the component’s budget against its strategic objectives. Coordinate budget monitoring, projecting & reporting expenditure. Ensure that spending is maximized in line with strategic objective. Monitor and report on the utilisation of equipment’s. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage discipline. Provide job description to subordinates. Manage division leave matters.

Monitor en evalueer die implementering van Sekuriteitsbeleid en -prosedures asook die Sekuriteitsmaatreëls bv. MISS, MPSS, ens.: Ontwikkel sekuriteitsprosedures. Ontwikkel beleid vir sekuriteitsmaatreëls. Ontwikkel 'n noodplan. Ontwikkel, bestuur en monitor die implementering van sekuriteitsplanne en -programme. Adviseer en reageer op sekuriteitskending. Stel beheermaatreëls voor om sekuriteitsrisiko's te minimeer of uit te skakel. Bestuur die voorsiening van sekuriteitsadministratiewe dienste. Verskaf tenderkennisgewings vir sekuriteitsadvertensies. Onderhou die kontrak(te) vir uitbesteedde sekuriteit. Monitor die prestasie van privaat sekuriteitsdienste volgens die diensvlakooreenkoms. Monitor huiseie sekuriteitswagte. Verskaf spesifikasies vir die aankoop van sekuriteitsuitrusting (Wagmoniteringstelsels, EACS ens.). Ondersoek sekuriteitsverwante sake. Bestuur fisiese sekuriteitswaardasies en inligtingsekuriteitsoudits deur:- Verifieer maatskappydokumente by PSIRA, Keuring van diensverskaffers by SSA. Bestuur sleutelbeheer. Verskaf hulpbronne (Menslik, Finansieel en Uitrusting): Bestuur die komponent se begroting teen sy strategiese doelwitte. Koördineer begrotingmonitering, projeksie en verslagdoening van uitgawes. Verseker dat besteding in ooreenstemming met strategiese doelwitte gemaksimeer word. Monitor en rapporteer oor die benutting van uitrusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en waardering van werknemers. Verseker kapasiteitsbou en ontwikkeling van personeel. Verbeter en onderhou werknemersmotivering en bou 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur dissipline. Verskaf werksbeskrywings aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur afdelingsverlof-aangeleenthede.

xh.title: I-Deputy Director: Security Management
xh.summary: I-Deputy Director: Security Management kwisebe le-Department of Public Works e-Polokwane, ifuna igunya eliya kwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 kunye namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yamava ekulawulweni kokhuseleko.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12/Matric nengena elisingatha inqanaba le-NQF level 6 kwi-Security Management njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. I-State Security Agency (SSA), i-Security Grade A/B (PSIRA). I-5 years’ experience kwindawo ye-Security Management apho kuthi i-three (3) years KUMELA ibe kunqanaba le-Junior Management / Assistant Director. Ukuziphatha okugqithisiweyo ngokuqinisekiswa kwesikhuni esityibilikayo. I-Valid driver’s license, ngaphandle kwezicelo ezinokuphela-okubuthathaka. Ulwazi noBuchule: Ulwazi ngokuqatshelwa kweenkqubo zenkonzo yoluntu, iindlela zolawulo namaphandle. Ulwazi nokuqondeko kwelungelelaniswa, kophuhliso nokuqonde lweenkqubo. Iindlela zolawulo ezifanelekileyo zomzimba ukuthintela iingozi. Iinkqubo nendlela ezilandelwa ngayo ukhuseleko. I-MPSS. I-MISS. I-Problem solving and analysis. I-Decision making. I-Team leadership. I-Creativity. I-Financial management. I-Customer focus and responsiveness. I-Communication. I-Computer skills. I-People management. I-Conflict management.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikela iinkqubo zobungozi bokusebenza nemazisekelo ngokhuseleko: Zenza iinkqubo zobungozi bokusebenza nemazisekelo ngokhuseleko. Zalisa iindwendwe ezimala ngokhuseleko. Qwalasela ukunikela kwamabanga okhuseleko. Hlola isimo sokhuseleko ngaphakathi kwesebe. Thethana nezinye iindawo zolawulo malunga nemiba yokhuseleko. Posa iindwendwe zolawulo ukunciphisa okanye ukugqiba iingozi zokhuseleko. Qwalasela kwaye uhlole ukuvezwa kweenkqubo zeNgqiqo nokwenzwayo nendlela ezilandelwa ngayo ukhuseleko, njengoko kukwaMISS, MPSS, njalo: Zenza inkqubo yokhuseleko. Zenza inkqubo yokuhlela iindwendwe zokhuseleko. Hlela inkqubo ethile yokumamela. Zenza, lawula kwaye ulandele ukuvezwa kweenkqubo zokhuseleko. Nikeza ingcebiso kwaye ukhathalele imiba yokuhluleka ukhuseleko. Posa iindwendwe zolawulo ukunciphisa okanye ukugqiba iingozi zokhuseleko. Lawula ukunikela iinkonzo zolawulo lokhuseleko. Nikela isaziso sendlela yokuthengwa iinkonzo ngaphandle. Zigcine iinkqubo ezithengwe ngaphandle ngokhuseleko. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweenkonzo zokhuseleko ngokwesivumelwano senqanaba lenkonzo. Qwalasela abagadi bakwitha. Nikeza iingcebiso zokuthengwa kwezixhobo zokhuseleko (iinkqubo zokuqwalasela abagadi, EACS, njl.). Phando imiba ehlobene nokhuseleko. Lawula iindwendwe zokuhlolwa komzimba nokuhlolwa kolwazi ngendlelailandelayo: Qinisekisa amaxwebhu enkampani kwi-PSIRA, ukuhlola abanikezeli benkonzo kwi-SSA. Lawula ulawulo lokuqalisa. Nikela izixhobo (Abantu, lemali, nezixhobo zokusebenza): Lawula imali yesandulelo ngokumgama wemiganga yolawulo. Hlanganise ukulandela umthetho, ukulinganisa nokuchaza imali echithekiwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba imali ichitheka ngendlela egqibeleleyo ngokuhambelana nemganga wolawulo. Landela kwaye uchaze ngokusetyenziswa kwamathuba. Hlola kwaye ulandele ukusebenza kwaye uhlole abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukukhululeka kunye nophuhliso wabasebenzi. Phucula kwaye ugcine inkqubo yokukhuthaza abasebenzi kwaye ulimbe inkqubo yokulawula ukusebenza. Lawula isithundu. Nikeza inkcazelo yomsebenzi kubalawuli. Lawula imiba yokuphumla ngokwecandelo.

zu.title: Onobhala Ohlangene: Izokulinganisa Ukuvikeleka
zu.summary: Onobhala Ohlangene: Izokulinganisa Ukuvikeleka e-Department of Public Works e-Polokwane, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF level 6 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yamava ekulawulen i-security management.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/Matric kanye nelifikhwelifikhesheni e-NQF level 6 ku-Security Management njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. State Security Agency (SSA), Security Grade A/B (PSIRA). 5 years’ experience in Security Management environment of which three (3) years MUST be at Junior Management / Assistant Director level. Valid firearm competencies. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Physical security risk control measures. Security principles and practices. MPSS. MISS. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. People management. Conflict management.
zu.duties: Manage the provision of operational risk and security awareness programmes: Develop operational risk and security awareness programmes. Implement security awareness plans. Monitor the provision of workshops on security awareness. Evaluate the security status within the department. Liaise with other departments on security issues. Propose control measures to minimise or eliminate the security risks. Monitor and evaluate the implementation of Security Policies and Procedures as well as the Security Measures e.g. MISS, MPSS, etc: Develop security procedures. Develop policy for security measures. Develop a contingency plan. Develop, manage and monitor the implementation of security plans and programmes. Advice and attend to security breaches. Propose control measures to minimise or eliminate the security risks. Manage the provision security administrative services. Provide tender bulletin for security advertisement. Maintain the contract(s) for outsourced security. Monitor performance of private security services as per service level agreement. Monitor in – house security guards. Provide specifications for purchasing of security equipment’s (Guard Monitoring systems, EACS etc.). Investigate security related cases. Manage physical security appraisals and information security audits by:- Verify company documents at PSIRA, Vetting of service providers at SSA. Manage key control. Provide resource (Human, Financial and Equipment): Manage the component’s budget against its strategic objectives. Coordinate budget monitoring, projecting & reporting expenditure. Ensure that spending is maximized in line with strategic objective. Monitor and report on the utilisation of equipment’s. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage discipline. Provide job description to subordinates. Manage division leave matters.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Corporate Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (to be structured according to individual needs)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Corporate Services in Limpopo requires a Grade 12 plus NQF 6 qualification and five years' HRM experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric and a qualification at NQF level 06 as recognized by SAQA. Five (5) years’ relevant experience of which three (03) years must be at junior management/ ASD level in HRM. PERSAL Certificate / results. A Valid driver’s license with the exception of applicants with disabilities. skills and knowledge: Strategic Capability and Leadership; People Management and Empowerment; Financial Management; Change Management; Knowledge Management; Service Delivery Innovation; Problem solving and analysis; Decision making; Team leadership; Client Orientation and Customer focus; Communication. Knowledge of relevant public service acts, regulations and frameworks. knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Communication skills, Ms Office package / Computer skills. PFM & Treasury regulations.
jobs.duties: Manage human resources services: Develop Human Resource Management policy in line with acts, regulations and directives. Develop and manage resource Management policy, strategies and processes. Manage and populate the District Human Resource plan. Manage the district recruitment, selection and appointment processes. Manage and provide inputs to the recruitment plan. Manage and facilitate transfer and translation of personnel. Manage and facilitate District head count. Manage and approve PERSAL transactions. Manage and coordinate resignations (deaths, retirements and resignations). Manage awarding of long service. Manage and coordinate benefits, state guarantees and housing allowances. Manage employee wellness: Develop wellness policy in line with acts, regulations and directives. Develop and manage employee wellness guidelines, strategies and processes. Develop employee assistance programmes and plans in the district. Manage and conduct district wellness day. Facilitate HIV/AIDS awareness and campaigns. Manage and monitor occupational health and safety. Manage auxiliary services in the district: Manage District’s Government owned and subsidized motor transport: Developing and monitoring implementation of fleet management policies, strategies, processes and procedures. Manage district fleet. Facilitate district needs analysis in terms of fleet management. Monitor and implement disposal of fleet as per policy documents. Liaise and report on redundant fleet with Head Office. Provide budget projections for fleet. Monitor licensing, servicing and repairing of district fleet. Manage Telecommunication systems of the District by: Developing and monitoring implementation of telecommunication policies, strategies, processes and procedures. Manage district telecommunications. Manage provisioning and distribution of labour serving devices and disposal of waste papers by: Developing and monitoring implementation of labour-saving policies, strategies, processes and procedures. Manage labour saving devices. Provide budget for labour serving devices. Monitor service level agreements. Manage provisioning and distribution of office and domestic services by: Managing and providing budget for office and domestic furniture. Manage and identify redundant furniture. Manage and procure furniture, protective clothing, cleaning materials and toiletries. Manage records: Develop and monitor implementation of records management policies, strategies, processes and procedures. Manage and advocate the implementation of records file plan. Manage security of records, Manage and identify vital records and retention periods. Manage and utilise resources (human, financial & physical) in accordance with relevant directives and legislation: Plan and organise resources for future requirements (human, finance, equipment’s etc.). Prepare the budget in line with strategic plans, operational plans and department’s objectives. Implement the budget by monitoring, projecting & reporting expenditure. Maximize spending in line with strategic objectives. Monitor performance and task completions. Set targets. Monitor and report on the utilisation of equipment’s. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Provide staff capacity and development. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Management of discipline. Provide job descriptions to subordinates. Manage division leave matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Hanyane NP, Mr. Moabelo MJ, Ms. Motsai S Tel No: (015) 284 7586/7627,7262.
