Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. The application on eRecruitment system should be accompanied by recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates) as well as copies of all qualifications, Identity Document and valid driver’s license only. Failure to attach copies and required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualification.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Korporatiewe Dienste
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Korporatiewe Dienste in Limpopo benodig 'n Graad 12 plus 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se MPO-ervaring.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matriek en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 06 soos erken deur SAQA. Vyf (5) jaar se relevante ervaring waarvan drie (03) jaar op juniorbestuurs-/ASD-vlak in MPO moet wees. PERSAL-sertifikaat/uitslae. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Vaardighede en kennis: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; Mensebestuur en bemagtiging; Finansiële bestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Kennisbestuur; Diensleweringinnoviasie; Probleemoplossing en -analise; Besluitneming; Spanleierskap; Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntefokus; Kommunikasie. Kennis van relevante openbarediens-wette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsontleding, -ontwikkeling en -interpretasie. Kommunikasievaardighede, MS Office-pakket/rekenaarvaardighede. PFM- en Tesourie-regulasies.
af.duties: Bestuur menslikehulpbrondienste: Ontwikkel Menslikehulpbronbestuursbeleid in ooreenstemming met wette, regulasies en direktiewe. Ontwikkel en bestuur hulpbronbestuursbeleid, -strategieë en -prosesse. Bestuur en vul die Distrik Menslikehulpbronplan in. Bestuur die distrikwerving, -keuring en -aanstellingsprosesse. Bestuur en verskaf insette tot die werwingsplan. Bestuur en fasiliteer oorplasing en translasie van personeel. Bestuur en fasiliteer distrikhoftelling. Bestuur en keur PERSAL-transaksies goed. Bestuur en koördineer bedankings (sterftes, aftrede en bedankings). Bestuur toekenning van langdiens. Bestuur en koördineer voordele, staatwaarborgs en behuisings-toelaes. Bestuur werknemerswelsyn: Ontwikkel welsynsbeleid in ooreenstemming met wette, regulasies en direktiewe. Ontwikkel en bestuur werknemerswelsynsriglyne, -strategieë en -prosesse. Ontwikkel werknemerbystandprogramme en -planne in die distrik. Bestuur en voer distrikwelsynsdag uit. Fasiliteer MIV/VIGS-bewustheid en -veldtogte. Bestuur en monitor beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Bestuur hulpdiensste in die distrik: Bestuur die distrik se staatsbesitde en gesubsidieerde motorvervoer: Ontwikkel en monitor implementering van vlootbestuursbeleide, -strategieë, -prosesse en -prosedures. Bestuur distrikvloot. Fasiliteer distrikbehoeftesontleding ten opsigte van vlootbestuur. Monitor en implementeer beskikking van vloot ooreenkomstig beleidsdokumente. Skakel en rapporteer oor oortollige vloot met Hoofkantoor. Verskaf begrotingsprojeksies vir vloot. Monitor lisensiëring, diens en herstel van distrikvloot. Bestuur Telekommunikasiestelsels van die Distrik deur: Ontwikkeling en monitering van implementering van telekommunikasiebeleide, -strategieë, -prosesse en -prosedures. Bestuur distriktelekommunikasie. Bestuur voorsiening en verspreiding van arbeidsbesparende toestelle en beskikking van afvalpapier deur: Ontwikkeling en monitering van implementering van arbeidsbesparende beleide, -strategieë, -prosesse en -prosedures. Bestuur arbeidsbesparende toestelle. Verskaf begroting vir arbeidsbesparende toestelle. Monitor diensvlakooreenkomste. Bestuur voorsiening en verspreiding van kantoor- en huishoudelike dienste deur: Bestuur en verskaf begroting vir kantoor- en huishoudelike meubels. Bestuur en identifiseer oortollige meubels. Bestuur en verkry meubels, beskermende klere, skoonmaakmateriaal en toiletartikels. Bestuur rekords: Ontwikkel en monitor implementering van rekordbestuursbeleide, -strategieë, -prosesse en -prosedures. Bestuur en bevorder implementering van rekordlêerplan. Bestuur sekuriteit van rekords, bestuur en identifiseer noodsaaklike rekords en retensieperiodes. Bestuur en benut hulpbronne (menslik, finansieel en fisies) in ooreenstemming met relevante direktiewe en wetgewing: Plan en organiseer hulpbronne vir toekomstige vereistes (menslik, finansies, toerusting, ens.). Bereid die begroting voor in ooreenstemming met strategiese planne, operasionele planne en die departement se doelwitte. Implementeer die begroting deur uitgawes te monitor, te projekteer en te rapporteer. Maksimeer besteding in ooreenstemming met strategiese doelwitte. Monitor prestasie en taakvoltooiings. Stel teikens. Monitor en rapporteer oor benutting van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en beoordeling van werknemers. Verskaf personeelkapasiteit en -ontwikkeling. Verbeter en behou werknemermotivasie en kweek 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur van dissipline. Verskaf werksbeskrywing aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur afdelingsverlofaangeleenthede.

zu.title: Onozimele: Izenzo Zomnyango
zu.summary: Isekhundla sikaOnozimele: Izenzo Zomnyango eLimpopo sidinga i-Grade 12 kanye nesifundo se-NQF 6 kanye namava eminyaka emihlanu kwi-HRM.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/ i-Matric kanye nesifundo esingeni le-NQF 06 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Amava ahambisana nayo iminyaka emihlanu (5) lapho kuleyo kumele kube yiminyaka emithathu (03) ebekiwe ebunqumeni obungezansi/ izinga le-ASD ku-HRM. Isitifiketi/ iziphumelelo ze-PERSAL. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile ngaphandle kokhetho abafaka izicelo abanamasuva. Amandla nolwazi: Amandla okubamba iqhaza njengesu kanye noMbuso; Abantu bobuNqunqunwana bokuBusa kanye NokuNika Amandla; ukuLawula kweziNtu; ukuLawula kwezinguGu; ukuLawula ulwazi; uQumba kolwazi olunikelwa inqubo; ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya; ukwenza izinqumo; ukuBusa iqembu; ukuQondiswa kwoMthengi kanye nokuGxila kuwo; ukuThumela/ukuAmukela imiyalezo. Ulwazi ngemithesho, imithetho yezindawo kahulumeni kanye nezakhiwo ezihambisana nalokho. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlaziya, ukuthuthukisa nokuhumusha inqubo. Amandla okuxhumana, iphakheji ye-MS Office/ amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izimiso ze-PFM kanye nezezimali zesikhwama.
zu.duties: Phatha izinkonzo zokuseto kwabantu: Thuthukisa inqubo yoMnyango weNqunqunwana bokuBusa ngokuvumelana nemithetho, imithetho yezindawo neziyalezo. Thuthukisa futhi ulawule inqubo, izu kanye nenqubo yoMnyango weZinto. Lawula futhi ugcwalise iNqubo yeNqunqunwana bokuBusa Yesifunda. Lawula ukubumba, ukukhetha kanye nokubeka emsebenzini kwesifunda. Lawula futhi unikeze okokufaka kuNqubo yokubumba abasebenzi. Lawula futhi unciphise ukudluliselwa nokuhumushwa kwabasebenzi. Lawula futhi unciphise ukubala abantu besifunda. Lawula futhi vumela izinkalo ze-PERSAL. Lawula futhi uhlele ukuyeka umsebenzi (okufa, okuhamba emsebenzini nokuyeka umsebenzi). Lawula ukubhaliswa kwabasebenzi bakhule isikhathi eside. Lawula futhi uhlele izinzuzo, iziqinisekiso zegunya lesifundazwe kanye nezibonelelo zokuhlala. Lawula impilo yabasebenzi: Thuthukisa inqubo yokulondoloza impilo ngokuvumelana nemithetho, imithetho yezindawo neziyalezo. Thuthukisa futhi ulawule izindlela zokulondoloza impilo yabasebenzi, izu kanye nenqubo. Thuthukisa amaphulo kanye neNqubo yabusizo abasebenzi esifundeni. Lawula futhi ube namaphoyisa okugcinwa kwempilo yesifunda. Yisa isikhathi somqondo mayelana ne-HIV/AIDS kanye namaqembu okuqashwa kwayo. Lawula futhi ulungele ukugcinwa kwezempilo kanye nokuphephela esikhundleni somsebenzi. Lawula izinkonzo ezuncane ezisesifundeni: Lawula uHambo lwemoto oluphethwe uHulumene kanye nalolo oluxhaswa ngemali yesifunda: Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukulandelela ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo, izu, inqubo kanye nemithetho yokuLawula ibhasikidi. Lawula ibhasikidi lesifunda. Siza ekwenzeni uhlolojio oluzuzisayo oluhlobene nokuLawula ibhasikidi. Landelela futhi ufake ezinsweni ukulahlwa kwebhasikili njengokuqinisekiswa emaphepheni oMthetho. Xhumana futhi wenze umbiko ngebhasikidi elingadingeki nenhlokodolobha. Hlinzeka ngeminikelo yeSikhwama sebhajeti yebhasikidi. Landelela ukubhalisa, ukulungisa nokulungisa ibhasikidi lesifunda. Lawula izinto ezithumela iZwi ngesifunda ngokuthi: Kuthuthukiswa futhi kulandelwa ukusebenziswa kwezinqubo zokuxhumana, izu, inqubo kanye nemithetho. Lawula izinto zokuxhumana zesifunda. Lawula ukubhaliswa kokutholakala kwamafoni futhi ahanjiswa emakadekhuni ngokuthi: Bathuthukise futhi balandele ukusebenziswa kwezinqubo, izu, inqubo kanye nemithetho yokusebenzisa inqubo yamafoni. Lawula amafoni eGumbi lokusebenzela. Hlinzeka ngebhajethi yamafoni. Landelela izivumelwano ezingahleliwe zendlela yokwenza konke. Lawula ukubhaliswa nokunikezwa kwezinto zokukhuluma futhi zisetshenziswe: Bathuthukise futhi balandele ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo, izu, inqubo kanye nemithetho yokukhuluma. Lawula amafoni. Hlinzeka ngebhajethi yamafoni. Landelela izivumelwano zokukonza abantu ngokuthi: Bathuthukise futhi balandele ukusebenzisa inqubo, izu, izindlela nezinqumo zemithetho yokulondoloza izinto. Lawula amafoni. Lawula ukubhaliswa nokuhamba kwesikhathi sokugcwalisa amafoni. Lawula nokugcwalisa amafoni ngokuthi: Balawule futhi banikeze ibhajethi yokulawula izinto ezingaphakathi kanye nezinto ezingangaphandle. Lawula futhi uchaze izinto ezingadingeki ezingangaphandle. Lawula futhi uthole izinto zangaphakathi, izingubo zokuvikela, izinto zokuhlanzela futhi bakhulu amabhulukwe. Lawula izinto ezibhalwe phansi: Thuthukisa futhi ulandele ukusebenziswa kwezinqubo zokulawula izinto ezibhalwe phansi, izu, inqubo kanye nemithetho yokwenza konke. Lawula futhi wenze abantu bazi ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokubala izinto. Lawula ukuphepha kwemibhalo, Lawula futhi uchaze ukubaluleka kwemibhalo kanye nesikhathi sokuyigcina. Lawula futhi usebenzise izinto (abantu, izimali kanye nezinto ezithintekayo) ngokuvumelana neziyalezo ezihambisana nalokhu kanye nemithetho: Cwangcisa futhi uhlele izinto ezidingekayo ekusetheni (abantu, izimali, amathuluzi, njll.). Lukela ibhajethi ngokuvumelana neNqubo, iNqubo yokusebenza kanye namagqabozo oMnyango. Sebenzisa ibhajethi ngokulandelela, ukwabula kanye nokwenza umbiko wokuchithwa kwemali. Khulisa ukuchitha ngokuhambisana namagqabozo. Landelela ukufeza izifundo kanye nokuqedwa kwenqubo. Hlela amagqabozo. Landelela futhi wenze umbiko wokusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi. Hlaziya futhi ulandele ukufeza kanye nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Hlinzeka ngamandla abasebenzi kanye nokuqaliswa kwemfundo. Khulisa futhi ulondoloze ukukhuthazwa kwabasebenzi futhi ukhiqize isiko elihamba phambili. Lawula ukuziphatha okuhle. Yenza izincazelo zemisebenzi kubandana.

xh.title: Isekela uMlawuli: Iinkonzo zeNhlangano
xh.summary: Isekela uMlawuli: Iinkonzo zeNhlangano kwiLimpopo efunwa ipile yesi-12 kunye nemviwo yeNQF 6 kunye neminye emihlanu yamava eHRM.
xh.requirements: Ipile yesi-12 / Isatifikethat samatikilasi nenguqulelo emgangathweni weNQF 06 njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA. Iiminyaka elihlanu (5) esemsebenzini ofaneleyo apho kwelishumi (03) iminyaka kufuneka ibe ngamabanga abaphathi abancinci / ASD kwiHRM. Isatifikethi / iziphumo zePERSAL. Ilayisenisi yokushayela elisebenzayo ngaphandle kwabafake isicelo abanokukhubazeka. Amakhono nolwazi: Ulwazi lokuqonda iNqanaba namaKhono oBukhosi; Ulwazi loLawulo abantu nokuBanika amandla; ULawulo lweMali; ULawulo loTshintsho; Ulwazi lokuLawula; iziNkqubo zokuHlaba iNkonzo; ukuSombulula iNkinga nokuHlola; ukuThatha isiSwa; ukuKhokela iqela; iNdlela yokujonga abaKhulumi nogqamelo labaKhethwa; iNxibelelwano. Ulwazi ngemithetho, imiso ngezenkqubo ezithintela inkonzo kahulumende. Ulwazi lokuqonda uhlalutyo, uphuhliso nokutolika imigaqo. Amakhono onxibelelwano, isixhobo se-MS Office / amakhono ekhompyutha. Iimiso zePFM nezikaNdlu yoMlindeli.
xh.duties: Phatha iinkonzo zabantu: Phuhlisa inqaku loLawulo loBantu ngokwemithetho, iimiso nokulumisa-mthetho. Phuhlisa waluphathe inqaku loLawulo lwamathala, iindlela zemigaqo neenqubo. Phatha wazise ngecebo loBantu lommandla. Phatha iinkqubo zokuba nokubakwa, ukukhethwa nokumiselwa kommandla. Phatha waze unike izimvo kwicebo lokubakwa. Phatha wakhuthaze ukuhanjiswa nokuguqulwa kwebasebenzi. Phatha wakhuthaze ukubala kwabantu bommandla. Phatha wamkele iintengiso ze-PERSAL. Phatha wongamise iindefile zomsebenzi (iimfazeko, iikhwaza nokunqumama). Phatha ukwamkelwa komyalezo wokwenza inkonzi eside. Phatha wongamise izibonelelo, iziqinisekiso zahulumende nemali engenyukelo yamakhaya. Phatha impilo yabasebenzi: Phuhlisa inqaku lempilo ngokwemithetho, iimiso nokulumisa-mthetho. Phuhlisa waluphathe imiqathango, iindlela zemigaqo neenqubo zempilo yabasebenzi. Phuhlisa iinkqubo neeplani zosizo lwabasebenzi kommandla. Phatha wenza umhla wempilo wommandla. Khuthaza ukuziva nge-HIV/AIDS nongqeqesho. Phatha wamkele impilo yokusebenza nokhuseleko. Phatha iinkonzo ezinceda ommandla: Phatha uthutho lwamakoloi ahulumende abelwe naxa axhaswa ahamba ngawo: Phuhlisa wamkele ukusebenza kweziqinisekiso, iindlela zemigaqo, iinkqubo neenqubo zokulawula iqela lemakoloi. Phatha iqela lemakoloi wommandla. Khuthaza uhlalutyo lweemfuno zommandla malunga nokulawula iqela lemakoloi. Hlola waphumeze ukushiywa kweqela lemakoloi ngokwezixwebhu zemigaqo. Thathelana nisike iingxelo malunga neqela elingenanto naseNtloko enkulu. Nikezela ngeengxelo zemali eqikelelwe iqela lemakoloi. Hlola uvunyulwe, ukonza kulungiswe iqela lemakoloi bommandla. Phatha iinkqubo zokunxibelelwana zeSithili nge: Phuhlisa wamkele ukusebenza kwezinqaku, iindlela zemigaqo, iinkqubo neenqubo zokunxibelelwana. Phatha ukunxibelelwana kommandla. Phatha ukubonelelwa nokusasazwa kwezona zixhobo ezikunceda ukuba ligqabi kwaye ukutshatyalaliswa kwamaphepha: Phuhlisa wamkele ukusebenza kweziqinisekiso, iindlela zemigaqo, iinkqubo neenqubo zokugqabathwa. Phatha iindawo ezikunceda ekugqabeni. Nikezela ngeemali ezibonelela ekusebenzeni. Hlola iingqezo. Phatha ukubonelelwa nokusasazwa kwezenkonzo zoqango nasekhaya ngokoku: Phatha wabanikezela ngesabelo semali. Phatha wakumbe izinto ezingasemva esisela. Phatha wazifunela izinto ezikhuselayo, izinxibo eziyahlambayo, izinto zokucoca nemveliso. Phatha amagama: Phuhlisa walawule wamkele ukusebenza kweziqinisekiso, iindlela zemigaqo, iinkqubo neenqubo. Phatha kakhuthaze ukusebenza kwecebo lesixa. Phatha ukhuseleko, wazi kwaye uphathe amagama. Sebenzisa izibonelelo ngokomthetho.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Demand and Acquisition Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (to be structured according to individual needs)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director managing demand and acquisition procurement planning for the Limpopo Department of Public Works at Head Office in Polokwane.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric and a qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA in Procurement/ SCM/Financial Management. Five years’ relevant experience within Supply Chain of which three (3) years must be at junior Management level (ASD). Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Treasury Regulations, Supply Chain, Management procedures. Procurement Procedures. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Strategic capability and leadership. Problem solving and analysis Decision making Team leadership Creativity Financial management Customer focus and responsiveness Communication Computer skills People management Planning and organising Conflict management.
jobs.duties: Manage and develop the goods and services procurement plan: Develop Demand Management policy strategies and processes in line with the Supply Chain Management acts, regulations and directives, Manage and facilitate the approval of infrastructure procurement plan, Manage and communicate the procurement plan, Manage and monitor that is goods and services rendered according to the procurement plan, Manage and compile budget projection as per the departmental needs analysis. Manage and conduct market assessment: Develop and manage market analysis policy, strategies and processes, Develop a purchasing strategy for the department, Develop and conduct market assessment through: Benchmarking; Industry/ market analysis; Market characteristics; Sourcing strategy. Manage supplier database: Facilitate registration of supplier database, Manage and liaise with CIDB about professionals/ contractor’s information, Manage the process of verifying supplier and professionals. Manage the functional operation of the goods and services acquisition management: Manage, design and develop acquisition management policies processes and procedures, Compile operational/supply chain acquisition management plan and obtain approval, Manage the execution of the acquisition management plan, Monitor and review the acquisition management activities, Establish Bid Evaluation, Bid Adjudication and Bid Specification Committees and render a secretariat service to the relevant committees. Oversee the biding process: Compilation of bid documents and advertisements, Publishing of bid documents, Receipt (closing and opening) of bid documents, Processing of bid documents. Manage and utilise resources (human, financial, & physical): Report on the utilisation of equipment’s, Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of subordinates, Provide capacity development of subordinates, Enhance and maintain subordinates motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management, Provide job description to subordinates, Manage division leave matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Hanyane NP, Mr. Moabelo MJ, Ms. Motsai S Tel No: (015) 284 7586/7627,7262.
jobs.applications: Applicants should apply through the following website https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za. The application on the eRecruitment system should be accompanied by the new Z83 and recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates). Failure to attach required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualified Applications may also be hand delivered/posted to: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure: Private Bag X9490, Polokwane, 0700 or hand delivered at Works Tower Building, No. 43 Church Street, Polokwane, 0699. For Capricorn District: Private Bag X9378, Polokwane, 0700 Or hand deliver at 15 Landros Mare street, next to Correctional Services. For Mopani District: Private Bag X576, Giyani, 0826 or hand deliver at 570 Parliamentary Building, Giyani. For Sekhukhune District: Private Bag X02 Chuenespoort, 0745 or hand deliver at Lebowakgomo Zone A, next to traffic department. For Vhembe District: Private Bag X2248, Sibasa, 0970 or hand deliver at Cnr. Traffic and Raluswielo Street, Sibasa. For Waterberg District: Private Bag X1028, Modimolle, 0510 or hand deliver at Cnr. Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. The application on eRecruitment system should be accompanied by recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates) as well as copies of all qualifications, Identity Document and valid driver’s license only. Failure to attach copies and required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualification.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Vraag- en Verkrygingsbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur wat verkrygingsbeplanning vir vraag en verkryging vir die Limpopo Department of Public Works by die Hoofkantoor in Polokwane bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matriek en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos erken deur SAQA in Procurement/SCM/Financial Management. Vyf jaar se relevante ervaring binne Supply Chain waarvan drie (3) jaar op junior bestuursvlak (ASD) moet wees. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante Public Service Acts, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsanalise, ontwikkeling en interpretasie. Treasury Regulations, Supply Chain, bestuursprosedures. Procurement Procedures. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en ontwikkel die verkrygingsplan vir goedere en dienste: Ontwikkel Beleidsstrategieë en prosesse vir bestuursvrae in ooreenstemming met die Supply Chain Management-wette, regulasies en richtlijne; Bestuur en fasiliteer die goedkeuring van die infrastruktuurverkrygingsplan; Bestuur en kommunikeer die verkrygingsplan; Bestuur en monitor dat goedere en dienste gelewer word volgens die verkrygingsplan; Bestuur en stel begrotingsprojeksies op volgens die departementele behoeftebepaling. Bestuur en voer markevaluasies uit: Ontwikkel en bestuur beleid, strategieë en prosesse vir markanalise; Ontwikkel 'n inkoopstrategie vir die departement; Ontwikkel en voer markevaluasies uit deur: Meting; Bedryfs-/markanalise; Markeienskappe; Verskaffingstrategie. Bestuur die verskafferdatumbasis: Fasiliteer registrasie van die verskafferdatumbasis; Bestuur en skakel met CIDB oor inligting oor professionele persone/kontrakteurs; Bestuur die proses om verskaffers en professionele persone te verifieer. Bestuur die funksionele werking van verkrygingsbestuur van goedere en dienste: Bestuur, ontwerp en ontwikkel verkrygingsbestuursbeleid, prosesse en prosedures; Stel 'n operatiewe/voorsieningsketenverkrygingsbestuursplan op en verkry goedkeuring; Bestuur die uitvoering van die verkrygingsbestuursplan; Monitor en hersien die verkrygingsbestuursaktiwiteite; Stel Biedevaluerings-, Biedbeoordelings- en Biedspesifikasiekomitees op en lewer 'n sekretariaatsdienst aan die betrokke komitees. Hou toesig oor die biedproses: Samestelling van bieddokumente en advertensies; Publiseer van bieddokumente; Ontvang (sluiting en opening) van bieddokumente; Verwerking van bieddokumente. Bestuur en benut hulpbronne (menslike, finansiële en fisiese): Rapporteer oor die benutting van toerusting; Evalueer en monitor prestasie en beoordeling van ondergeskiktes; Verskaf kapasiteitsontwikkeling aan ondergeskiktes; Verbeter en handhaaf ondergeskiktes se motivasie en kweek 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur; Verskaf werksbeskrywings aan ondergeskiktes; Bestuur verlofangeleenthede van die afdeling.

zu.title: Onozanele: Ukuphathwa kokuhlinzeka nokuthenga izinto ezibalulekile
zu.summary: Onozanele ophatha ukuqonda izidingo futhi athenge ngendlela yokuqondisisa noma yokuqhakambisa izinto eziyisidingo zaseLimpopo Department of Public Works eNdiya ePolokwane.
zu.requirements: Iklasi 12/ Isitifiketi se-Matric kanye nefomelishi ezingeni le-NQF 7 njengoba kujatshulwa yi-SAQA kwi-Procurement/ SCM/Financial Management. Unyaka weminyaka emihlanu wokuhlanganyela ngokusebenza ngaphakathi kokuHlinzeka okungenamkhondo lapho kule minyaka emithathu (3) kufanele kube yizinga eliphansi lokubusa (ASD). Ilayisense yesibophi esivumelekile, ngaphandle kokuba abafaki isicelo abanesimo sabo. Ulwazi futhi namakhono: Ulwazi lwe-Acts, imithetho namasimu okusebenza kahle kumnyango kahulumeni. Ulwazi futhi ukuqonda ukuqondisisa, ukuthuthukisa nokuphinda uhlaziyе inqubomgomo. Imithetho yoMnotho, intambo yokuhlinzeka, amaphrosesi okuphatha. Amaphrosesi okuthenga. I-PFMA. I-DORA. I-PPPFA. Ikhalo lokubala kanye nokuqondisa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga futhi uhlaziye Ukwenza izinqumo Ubukhosi bokuhamba iqembu Ukudala Amakhono okuphatha imali Ukuqonda umthengi kanye nokuqonda ukuthuthukisa Amakhono okuxhumana Amakhono okusebenza ngakhompyutha Ukuphatha abantu Ukucubungula futhi uhlele Ukuphatha konflikthi.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uthuthukise izinhlela zokuthola izimpahla kanye nezinsiza: Thuthukisa inqubomgomo yokuqonda izidingo, izindlela kanye namaphrosesi ngokuvumelana namaphoyisa, imithetho kanye nemiyalo yokuphathwa kwentambo yokuhlinzeka, Phatha futhi ulawule ukuvunyelwa kwenhlela yokuthenga izakhiwo, Phatha futhi wethule inqubomgomo yokuthenga, Phatha futhi uhlole ukuthi izimpahla nezinsiza zihlinzekwa ngokwenqubomgomo yokuthenga, Phatha futhi uqoqe izibalo sabugqemu besabelo njengokwesidingo somnyango. Phatha futhi wenze ukuhlolwa kwesikhalazo: Thuthukisa futhi uphathe inqubomgomo yokuhlola isikhalazo, izindlela namaphrosesi, Thuthukisa inqubomgomo yokuthenga yomnyango, Thuthukisa futhi wenze ukuhlolwa kwesikhalazo ngokusebenzisa: Ukulinganisa; Ukuhlola imboni/ isikhalazo; Izici zesikhalazo; Inqubomgomo yokuvela kwezinsiza. Phatha idatha yolwazi kubanikezeli: Khuthaza ukubhaliswa kolwazi kubanikezeli, Phatha futhi uxhumane ne-CIDB mayelana nolwazi ngabakwigqiza/ obovuqo, Phatha inqubo yokubeka kuqinisekiso abanikezeli nabakwigqiza. Phatha ukusebenza okuyisisekelo kokuphathwa kokuthola izimpahla nezinsiza: Phatha, yakha futhi uthuthukise izinqubomgomo, amaphrosesi kanye namaphrosesi okuphathwa kokuthola izimpahla, Qamba iplani yokuphathwa yokuthola izimpahla/ yokuphathwa kwentambo yokuhlinzeka uthole ukuvunyelwa, Phatha ukuphumelelwa kwenqubomgomo yokuthola izimpahla, Hlola futhi uphinde ubuke ukusebenza kokuthola izimpahla, Sula amakomidi okuqondisa, amakomidi okuhlola amathenda namakomidi okubala amathenda unhlolise futhi unikeze inkonzo yobunluleki emakomidini ahambisana nawo. Qapha inqubo yokubuyisa imathenda: Ukuqoqwa kwemibhalo yamathenda kanye nokukhangisa, Ukushicilelwa kwemibhalo yamathenda, Ukutholwa (ukuvala nokuvala) kwemibhalo yamathenda, Ukucubungula imibhalo yamathenda. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinsiza (abantu, izimali, nezimpahla ezithwahwayo): Umbiko wokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza, Hlola futhi ulawule ukusebenza kahle kanye nokulinganisa ukusebenza kwabaphansi kwabo, Nikeza uthuthukiswa lamandla kubaphansi kwabo, Phakamisa futhi ulondoloze ukuzethemba kwabaphansi kwabo futhi uqoke isiko lokuphathwa kokusebenza kahle, Nikeza incazelo yomsebenzi kubaphansi kwabo, Phatha izindaba zeholide yenhlanga.

xh.title: Mongameli Ohluthi: uLawulo lwe-Mfundo noLondolozo
xh.summary: Mongameli ongene theko kwaye elawula ukubhaliselwa nokuthengwa ngokulawulo kwisoqhamo kwi Limpopo Department of Public Works e Head Office e Polokwane.
xh.requirements: Iveyili yasekhaya/ Isidanga se10 kunye nesebe elithathwa njengengowamagqabi eNQF level 7 njengokoqatshwa yiSAQA ekulinganisweni kwesoqhamo/ SCM/ soLawulo lweMali. Iminyaka emi-5 yamava afanelekileyo ngaphakathi kwesoqhamo apho iminyaka mithathu (3) kufuneka ibengowamanqanaba alawulo abangaphantsi (ASD). Ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekileyo, ngaphandle kwabafaki behlazo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngeMithetho yoQhamo, imigaqo namaxesha. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlalutyo, ukuphuhlisa nokutolika imigaqo. Ipeketi yolawulo, iinkqubo zoLawulo lwesoqhamo. Iinkqubo zokuqamba. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Isakhono esibonakalayo sokulawula kwaye ubengumpheki-mthetho. Ukuqonda nokusombulula iingxaki ukwenza izigqibo, ukulawula iqela, unobumba, ulawulo lweMali, ukugqaliswa komthengisi nokuvela iindlela zokuqhubana, isazuba-magama, ikhompyutha, ulawulo lwabantu, ukulungelelanisa nokuqamba, ulawulo lwezingxungumbela.
xh.duties: Qhuba kwaye uphuhlise icebo lokulinganisa nokuthenga iimpahla neenkonzo: Phuhlisa iindlela ezichaza inkqubo yoku lawula isicelo, iindlela namaxeshaokuzaliseka kwemfuno ngokwemithetho, imigaqo nemiyalelo yo Lawulo lwesoqhamo, Qhuba kwaye ulawule ukuvunywa kwecebo lokulinganisa nokuthengwa kwesiseko senkqubo, Qhuba kwaye uxela ngecebo lokulinganisa nokuthenga, Qhuba kwaye ulawule ukuba impahla neenkonzo zihlawuliswa ngokwecebo lokulinganisa nokuthenga, Qhuba kwaye udibanise ipeketha yokuchazwa kwemali ngokweendingo zohlalutyo lwisebe. Qhuba kwaye uqonde ukulinganiswa kwerhavethi: Phuhlisa kwaye ulawule inkqubo yoluntu lwahlalutyo lwerhavethi, iindlela namaxesha, Phuhlisa iindlela zokuthenga zesebe, Phuhlisa kwaye uqonde isilinganisi sehlabathi ngokwe: Ukuqhathanisa; Uhlalutyo lwemizi-mveliso/ rhavethi; Iimpawu zerhavethi; Iindlela zokufumana iindlela zokubonelela. Qhuba isiseko seenkcukacha zabathengisi: Lawula ukubhalisa kwabathengisi, Qhuba kwaye uqhagamshelane ne-CIDB malunga nolwazi lwabaphrofeshinali/ abakhi, Qhuba inkqubo yokuqinisekisa abathengisi nabaphrofeshinali. Qhuba imisebenzi yemisebenzi yokulawula ukufunyanwa kweempahla neenkonzo: Qhuba, yila kwaye uphuhlise iinkqubo, iindlela nemigaqo yolawulo lokufunyanwa kweempahla, Hlela icebo lokusebenza/ lokufumana isoqhamo kwaye lifumane isigunyaziso, Qhuba ukuphunyezwa kwecebo lokufumana isoqhamo, Qhuba kwaye uhlola imisebenzi yokulawula ukufunyanwa kweempahla, Misela iiKomiti zoLinganiso lokuNxibelelanisa ngokweNkqubo, iiKomti zoQeqesho lokuNxibelelanisa ngokweNkqubo neeKomiti zoQeqesho lweSicatshulwa kwaye unike inkonzo yobakhuseli kumakomti ahambelanayo. Lawula inkqubo yokubhalisa: Ukuhluza amaxwebhu okubhalisa nokuqwashisa, Ukushicilelwa kwamaxwebhu okubhalisa, Ukufumana (ukuvala nokupeyta) amaxwebhu okubhalisa, Ukusebenza ngamaxwebhu okubhalisa. Qhuba kwaye usebenzise iimfuno (abantu, imali, nezinto ezibonakalayo): Xela ngenkonzo yezixhobo, Linganisa kwaye ulawule ukusebenza kwaye iqikelelo kubantu abangaphansi kwakho, Nikela ngethuba lokuphuhlisa amandla abantu abangaphansi kwakho, Phucula kwaye ulondoloze inkuthazo yabantu abangaphansi kwakho kwaye utyise inkqubo yokulinganisa ukusebenza, Nikela abantu abangaphansi kwakho ngemisebenzi yabo, Qhuba izindaba zokuqhwesha koluhlu lwesebe.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Office Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (to be structured according to individual needs)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Office Services at the Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure in Polokwane, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification and five years' office services experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric and a qualification at NQF level 06 level in Public Administration/ Management/ Office Management and Technology as recognized by SAQA. 5 years’ experience office services administration environment with a minimum of three (3) years at Junior management level. A Valid driver’s license with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Strategic capability and leadership. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of office goods and services: Develop policies, strategy and processes relating to the provision of goods. Facilitate budgeting for departmental office goods and services. Develop norms and standards for provision of goods. Conduct needs assessment in respect of required number, type of office and domestic furniture. Provide specifications for goods to be procured. Oversee the receiving of goods from the service provider. Manage the distribution of goods according to the set norm. Determine and facilitate maintenance and repair of broken office and domestic furniture. Recommend and facilitate disposal of redundant or irreparable furniture. Conduct periodic inspection with regard to all furniture taken on stock. Manage the procurement of Uniform and Protective Clothing. Manage and provide accommodation and related needs (flights, shuttles, etc.). Manage telecommunication services: Develop and implement telecommunication policies, strategy, processes and procedures. Facilitate budgeting of telecommunications services aligned to the needs of the department. Manage the switchboard. Manage and facilitate installations of landlines and extensions needed in accordance to the number of offices and personnel available. Liaise with service providers with regard to service maintenance and activation of speed dials and Pin Codes. Provide norms for provision of cell phones. Evaluate application for cell phones and make recommendations. Manage the procurement of cell phones. Monitor compliance to allocated airtime as per norms and standards. Manage the provision of monthly statements of account. Provide the monetary value on the usage of telecommunication. Manage the provision of labour saving devices: Develop and implement labour saving procurement policies, strategy, processes and procedures. Facilitate budgeting for the procurement of departmental labour saving devices. Manage the service level agreement with the service providers on labour saving devices. Monitor the compliance of the agreement by the service provider. Manage the maintenance of the devices as per the agreement. Provide and monitor the monetary value on the usage of labour saving devices as per the service agreement. Manage the payment for labour saving devices. Manage and utilise resources (human, financial, & physical) in accordance with relevant directives and legislation. Plan and organise resources for future requirements (human, finance, equipment’s etc.) Prepare the budget in line with strategic plans, operational plan and department objectives. Implement the budget by monitoring, projecting & reporting expenditure. Maximize spending in line with strategic objective. Monitor performance and task completions. Set targets. Monitor and report on the utilisation of equipment’s. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Provide staff capacity and development. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage discipline. Provide job description to subordinates. Manage division leave matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Hanyane NP, Mr. Moabelo MJ, Ms. Motsai S Tel No: (015) 284 7586/7627,7262.
jobs.applications: Applicants should apply through the following website https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za. The application on the eRecruitment system should be accompanied by the new Z83 and recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates). Failure to attach required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualified Applications may also be hand delivered/posted to: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure: Private Bag X9490, Polokwane, 0700 or hand delivered at Works Tower Building, No. 43 Church Street, Polokwane, 0699. For Capricorn District: Private Bag X9378, Polokwane, 0700 Or hand deliver at 15 Landros Mare street, next to Correctional Services. For Mopani District: Private Bag X576, Giyani, 0826 or hand deliver at 570 Parliamentary Building, Giyani. For Sekhukhune District: Private Bag X02 Chuenespoort, 0745 or hand deliver at Lebowakgomo Zone A, next to traffic department. For Vhembe District: Private Bag X2248, Sibasa, 0970 or hand deliver at Cnr. Traffic and Raluswielo Street, Sibasa. For Waterberg District: Private Bag X1028, Modimolle, 0510 or hand deliver at Cnr. Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. The application on eRecruitment system should be accompanied by recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates) as well as copies of all qualifications, Identity Document and valid driver’s license only. Failure to attach copies and required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualification.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Kantoordienste
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Kantoordienste by die Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure in Polokwane, wat 'n NQF level 6-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se kantoordienste-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12/ Matriek en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF level 06 vlak in Openbare Administrasie/ Bestuurswetenskappe/ Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie soos erken deur SAQA. 5 jaar ervaring in 'n kantoordienstadministrasie-omgewing met 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar op juniorbestuursvlak. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van relevante Openbare Diens-wette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsontleding, -ontwikkeling en -interpretasie. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en responsiwiteit. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur die voorsiening van kantoorbenodigdhede en -dienste: Ontwik beleide, strategie en prosesse met betrekking tot die voorsiening van benodigdhede. Fasiliteer begroting vir departementele kantoorbenodigdhede en -dienste. Ontwik norme en standaarde vir die voorsiening van benodigdhede. Voer behoeftebepaling uit met betrekking tot die benodigde aantal en tipe kantoor- en huismeubels. Verskaf spesifikasies vir benodigdhede wat verkry moet word. Hou toesig oor die ontvangs van benodigdhede van die diensverskaffer. Bestuur die verspreiding van benodigdhede volgens die vasgestelde norm. Bepaal en fasiliteer instandhouding en herstel van gebroke kantoor- en huismeubels. Beveel aan en fasiliteer die wegdoening van oortollige of onherstelbare meubels. Voer periodieke inspeksies uit ten opsigte van alle meubels in voorraad geneem. Bestuur die verkryging van uniforms en beskermende kleding. Bestuur en verskaf akkommodasie en verwante behoeftes (vlugte, pendeldienste, ens.). Bestuur telekommunikasiedienste: Ontwik en implementeer telekommunikasiebeleide, -strategie, -prosesse en -prosedures. Fasiliteer begroting van telekommunikasiedienste in ooreenstemming met die behoeftes van die departement. Bestuur die skakelbord. Bestuur en fasiliteer die installering van landlyne en uitbreidings wat benodig word in ooreenstemming met die aantal kantore en beskikbare personeel. Skakel met diensverskaffers met betrekking tot diensinstandhouding en die aktivering van spoelskakels en PIN-kodes. Verskaf norme vir die voorsiening van seltelefone. Evalueer aansoeke om seltelefone en doen aanbevelings. Bestuur die verkryging van seltelefone. Monitor nakoming van toegekende lugtyd volgens norme en standaarde. Bestuur die voorsiening van maandelikse rekeninge. Verskaf die monetêre waarde van die gebruik van telekommunikasie. Bestuur die voorsiening van arbeidsbesparende toestelle: Ontwik en implementeer arbeidsbesparende verkrygingsbeleide, -strategie, -prosesse en -prosedures. Fasiliteer begroting vir die verkryging van departementele arbeidsbesparende toestelle. Bestuur die diensvlakooreenkoms met die diensverskaffers oor arbeidsbesparende toestelle. Monitor die diensverskaffer se nakoming van die ooreenkoms. Bestuur die instandhouding van die toestelle soos per ooreenkoms. Verskaf en monitor die monetêre waarde van die gebruik van arbeidsbesparende toestelle soos per diensooreenkoms. Bestuur betaling vir arbeidsbesparende toestelle. Bestuur en benut hulpbronne (menslik, finansieel en fisies) in ooreenstemming met relevante riglyne en wetgewing. Beplan en organiseer hulpbronne vir toekomstige vereistes (menslik, finansieel, toerusting, ens.). Berei die begroting voor in ooreenstemming met strategiese planne, operasionele plan en departementele doelwitte. Implementeer die begroting deur besteding te monitor, te projekteer en te rapporteer. Maksimeer besteding in ooreenstemming met strategiese doelwitte. Monitor prestasie en taakvoltooiing. Stel teikens. Monitor en rapporteer oor die benutting van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en waardering van werknemers. Verskaf personeelkapasiteit en -ontwikkeling. Verbeter en behou werknemermotivering en kweek 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur dissipline. Verskaf posbeskrywings aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur afdelingsverlof sake.

zu.title: IPhini Likadireka: Izinsizakalo Zofisi
zu.summary: IPhini Likadireka: Izinsizakalo Zofisi eDepartment of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure ePolokwane, kudinga iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 6 kanye namakhulu eminyaka eyisihlanu okuhlolene nezinsizakalo zofisi.
zu.requirements: Ibhodi yokuqala yesikhathi lesi-12/ i-Matric kanye nethathu okuqashwe ezingeni le-NQF level 06 ekuPhathweni Komphakathi/ EkuPhathweni/ EkuPhathweni Kwezofisi kanye Nnobuchwepheshe njengoba kuqashwe yi-SAQA. 5 years’ experience office services administration environment with a minimum of three (3) years at Junior management level. Ilayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni ngaphandle kwalabo abafaka izicelo abanesikhalo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho, izimiso namaphodeli ahlobene Nkonzo Yomphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlaziywa kwengaqubomgomo, ukuthuthukiswa nokutolikwa. Ikhono lokuhamba phambili kanye nokuholwa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqhathanisa. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuholwa iqembu. Ukudala. Ukuphatha imali. Ukugxila kumthengi nokupekula. Ukuxhumana. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuhlela nokuqoqwa. Ukuphatha izinkinga.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kwezimpahla nezinsizakalo zofisi: Bumbe izinqubomgomo, isu kanye nokuqhubeka mayelana nokunikezwa kwezimpahla. Siza ekubhaliseni imali yesabelo mayelana nezimpahla nezinsizakalo zofisi zomnyango. Bumisa amanani namazinga okunikezwa kwezimpahla. Yenza ukuhlola izidingo ngokuphathelene nenani elidingekayo, uhlobo befulethi yofisi nasedomestikhi. Hlinza ngemibhalo mayelana nezimpahla ezizothengwa. Qaphela ukutholwa kwezimpahla kusuka kumnikezeli wensizakalo. Phatha ukwabiwa kwezimpahla ngokwesizinga esihlusile. Qinisekisa futhi usize ekulondolozweni nokulungisweni kwefulethi yofisi nasedomestikhi ephukile. Tusa futhi usize ekulahlweni kwefulethi edinge kakhulu noma engakalungiseki. Yenza ukuhlola njalo ngamunyamunya ngokuphathelene yonke imifulethi ethathwe esitokweni. Phatha ukuthenga izingubo zokusebenza kanye nezimpahla zokuvikela. Phatha futhi uhlinze ngezidingo zokuhambisana nezokuhlala (amabhange, amashuthi, njll.). Phatha izinsizakalo zokuxhumana: Bumise futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo, isu, inqubo nemigomo yoxhumano. Siza ekubhaliseni imali yesabelo yezinsizakalo zoxhumano ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomnyango. Phatha i-switchboard. Phatha futhi usize ekufakeni izinkomba zamafoni ahlonzwayo kanye nezandiso ezidingekayo ngokohamba nomnyondo wezofisi kabanzi abasebenzi abakhona. Xhumana nabonikezeli bezinsizakalo mayelana nokulondolozwa kwenkonzo kanye nokusebenzisa amafoni abo msinya namakhodi ze-Pin. Hlinza ngamabili okunikezwa kwamafoni eselula. Hlola isicelo samafoni eselula bese ukwenza izincomo. Phatha ukuthengwa kwamafoni eselula. Qaphela ukuzinza ngokwezimali ezabelwe isikhathi sokuxhumana njengoba kuqashwe ngamabinana namazinga. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezitatimende zenyanga zonke zama-akhawunti. Hlinza ngokubaluleka kwemali ekusetshenzisweni kokuxhumana. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinto ezilondoloza isikhathi: Bumise futhi usebenfise izinqubomgomo, isu, inqubo nemigomo yokuthenga izinto eziphila isikhathi. Siza ekubhaliseni imali yesabelo mayelana nezinto ezilondoloza isikhathi zomnyango. Phatha isivumelwano senkonzo nabakliki baleyo nxulumene nezinto eziphila isikhathi. Qaphela ukuzinza kwesivumelwano ngumnikeli wenkonzo. Phatha ukugcinwa kwezinto ngokwesivumelwano. Hlinza futhi uphawule ukubaluleka kwemali ekusetshenzisweni kwalezo zinto ngokwesivumelwano. Phatha ukukhokhelwa kwezinto eziphila isikhathi. Phatha futhi usebenfise izinsiza (abantu, imali, nezinto ezingabonakali) ngokuhambisana nemiyalo nemithetho ehlobene. Hlela futhi uhlele izinsiza ezidingekayo ngokwesikhathi esizayo (abantu, imali, izibuciko, njll.). Lungelela ibhajethi ngokuhambisana namasu, ohlelweni lokusebenza namagqabo omnyango. Sebenzisa ibhajethi ngokuqapha, ukubuka kanye nokubika ukusebenzisa. Khulisa ukusebenzisa ngokuhambisana nesenzo esihamba phambili. Qaphela ukusebenza kokuqeda imisebenzi. Hlela imigomo. Qaphela bese ubika ngokuSetshenziswa kwemishini. Hlola futhi qaphela ukusebenza kanye nokubalwa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Hlinza ngamandla abasebenzi nentuthuko. Phakamisa futhi ulondoloze ukwesekwa kwabasebenzi bese ukhulisa isiko lokuphatha ukusebenza. Phatha isiyaleni. Hlinza ngemibhalo yomsebenzi kubaphansi. Phatha izindaba zokushiya kwesigaba. Phatha izinsizakalo zokuxhumana: Bumise futhu usebenfise izinqubomgomo, inqubo nemigobo yoxhumano. Siza ekubhaliseni imali yesabelo yezinsizakalo zoxhumano ngokuambisana nezidingo zomnyango. Phatha i-switchboard. Phatha futhi usize ekufakeni izinkomba zamafoni ahlonzwayo kanye nezandiso ezidingekayo ngokuohamba nomthondo wezofisi nabasebenzi abakhona. Xhumana nabonikezeli bezinsizakalo ngokuphathelene nokulondolozwa kwenkonzo nokufaka ukushayela ngokushesha kanye namakhodi ze-Pin. Hlinza ngamabinani okunikezwa kwamafoni eselula. Hlola isicelo samafoni eselula bese ukwenza izincomo. Phatha ukuthengwa kwamafoni eselula. Qaphela ukuzinza ngokwezimali esezinze njengoba kuqashwe ngamabinana namazinga. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezitatimende zama-akhawunti zinyanga zonke. Hlinza ngobukhulu bemali ekusetshenzisweni kokuxhumana. Phatha ukunikezwa kwemishini engasindi: Bumise futhi usebenfise izinqubomgomo, inqubo nemigomo yokuthenga imishini engasindi. Siza ekubhaliseni imali yesabelo yokuthenga imishini engasindi yomnyango. Phatha isivumelwano esibekiwe nabonikezeli ngokuphathelene imishini engasindi. Qaphela ukuzinza kwesivumelwano ngumnikeli wenkonzo. Phatha ukugcinwa kwemishini ngokohamba nesivumelwano. Hlinza futhi qaphela ubukhulu bemali ekusetshenzisweni kwemishini engasindi ngokuhamba nesivumelwano. Phatha imali yokukhokha imishini engasindi. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinsiza (abantu, imali, kanye nezinto eziyingqayi) ngokuhambisana nemiyalo nemithetho ehlobene. Cubungula futhi uhlele izinsiza ezizodingeka ngokwesikhathi esizayo (abantu, imali, imishini, njll.). Hlela ibhajethi ngokuhambisana namabango ashukumisayo, ohlelweni lokusebenza namagqabho omnyango. Sebenfisa ibhajethi ngokuqapha, ukubuka nokubika okushayiswa imali. Yandisa ukusebenzisa imali ngokuhambisana nesenzo esihamba phambili. Qaphela ukusebenza nokuphothulwa kwebhajethi. Hlela imigomo. Qaphela bese ubika ngokusetshenziswa kwemishini. Hlola bese qaphela ukusebenza nokuhlakaniphwa kwabasebenzi. Hlinza ngamandla abasebenzi nentuthuko. Phakamisa futhi ulondoloze ukwesekwa kwabasebenzi bese ukhulisa isiko lokuphatha ukusebenza. Phatha isiyaleni. Hlinza ngomtshingo womsebenzi kubaphansi. Phatha izindaba zokushiya kwesigaba.

xh.title: ITITSHALA ELILO: IINKONZO ZEOFISI Kwisebe leNtengiso yoLuntu, iindlela naluchungechunge kwiPolokwane, ifuna izidanga zenqanaba le NQF level 6 namashumi amahanu eminyaka yamava kwinkonzo yofisi.
xh.summary: ITHONI EYINDODAKA: IINKONZO ZEOFISI Kwisebe leNtengiso yoLuntu, iindlela naluchungechunge kwiPolokwane, ifuna izidanga zenqanaba le NQF level 6 namashumi amahanu eminyaka yamava kwinkonzo yofisi.
xh.requirements: Iklasi 12 / Matric neditifikhe ikwinqanaba i NQF level 06 kwilawulo kahulumeni / ulawulo / ukulawula ihlelo kwaye la makhono eqatyiweyo e SAQA. Minyaka elthatha ukuphila i office services administration environment neNyaka amathathu (3) kwinqanaba i Junior management. Ifayini drive to the licence naisimeko onobu kwi basebenzi abakuba lisentshokhwehle. Nazali nawakhono: nazali ngomthetho kahulumeni, laws and regulations. Nazali nalusityalo kwinkqubo yokubala, iinkqubo nobuyilo. Isisu sikwaziukwenza izinto. Ukuqonde nabakho obukhokelwa kwindlu. Nceda luntu nokubonelela ngolwazi. Kuhlawule ukwenza izinto. Ukukhokela ngamandla. Isandla esithubeni. Imali yokulawula. Imali abantu abayifuna. Into yokulawula. Kompyutha iindlela. Imali yabantu. Indawo yokwenza uluntu.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikela kwempahla nezixhobo zihlelo: Phuhliza iinkqubo, isuqube kunye namanyathelo ahlobene nokunikela kwempahla. Qhubele phambili ngokuqwalasela kabuhlungu yemali yempahla nezixhobo zesebe. Phuhliza imigaqo namazinga okunikela impahla. Yenza isiqendu sezidingo ngenani, uhlobo lweofisi nempahla yasekhaya efunekayo. Nikeza iinkcazelo ngezixhobo eziza kuthengwa. Qhatha ukwamkela kwempahla kumboneleli wenkonzo. Lawula ukuhanjiswa kwempahla ngokwelunxulumene namazinga abekiweyo. Qamba uze uqhubele phambili ukonakaliswa nokulungiswa kweofisi nempahla yasekhaya ephukileyo. Ngcela uze uqhubele phambili ukuphunga kwempahla engasafunekiyo noma engakwazi ukulungiswa. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngokuthe ngqo ngayo yonke impahla ethathiwe kwisitokhwe. Lawula ukuthengwa kwezingqimba zemfanelo namagqabi okuzikhusela. Lawula uze unikeze indawo yokuhlala nezidingo ezinxulumene nayo (iinqwelizulu, iindlela zokuhamba, njl njl). Lawula iinkonzo zoxhumaniso: Phuhliza uze usebenzise iinkqubo zoxhumaniso, isuqube, amanyathelo namalungelo. Qhubele phambili ngokuqwalasela kabuhlungu yamaxesha einkonzo zoxhumaniso ezilungelelaniswe nezidingo zesebe. Lawula ibhodi yokuqhuba. Lawula uze uqhubele phambili ukufakwa kwemigca yefowuni kunye nendawo yokwandisa edingekayo ngokwexabiso leofisi nabasebenzi abakhoyo. Thetha nolawulelele ngezenkonzo ngokuhlengwa nokuvuleka kweefowuni ezikhawulezayo namakhodi ze Pin. Nikeza imigaqo yokunikela iifowuni zasenyango. Qwalasela isicelo sefowuni yasenyango uze unikeze izindululo. Lawula ukuthengwa kweefowuni zasenyango. Qhatha ukuthobela kwamaxesha okuthetha anikiweyo ngokwemigaqo namazinga. Lawula ukunikela kwangenyanga izatatementi ze-akhawunti. Nikeza ixabiso lemali ekusetynzisweni koxhumaniso. Lawula ukunikela kwezixhobo eziligisa nzima: Phuhliza uze usebenzise iinkqubo zokuthenga izixhobo eziligisa nzima, isuqube, amanyathelo namalungelo. Qhubele phambili ngokuqwalasela kabuhlungu yokuwuqwalasela kwamahlawuliselo ee labour saving devices. Lawula isivumelwano ngokumgangatho wenkonzo nolawulelele ngezixhobo eziligisa nzima. Qhatha ukuthobela kwesivumelwano ngumboneleli wenkonzo. Lawula ukulungiswa kwesixhobo ngokwesivumelwano. Nikeza uze uqhathe ixabiso lemali ekusetynzisweni kwezixhobo eziligisa nzima ngokwesivumelwano senkonzo. Lawula ukuhlawula kwezixhobo eziligisa nzima. Lawula uze usebenzise izixhobo (abantu, imali, nezixhobo) ngokwemiyalelo ncamathelayo namthetho. Cwangcisa uze uhlele izixhobo ezizodingeka njalo (abantu, imali, izixhobo, njl). Lungiselela amahela ahambelana ne nkqubo yam, iplani yamalungiselelo nemiqondo yesebe. Setyenzisa amahela ngokuqhatha, ukubhuka nokubika. Phuhlisa ukuqhitha kwamahela ahambelana nombonjo opheleleyo. Qhatha umphumo nogqibo kwezokuphumeza iintshukumo. Misela iinqaba. Qhatha uze ubike ngokusetyenziswa kwee equipment. Qhatha uze uqwalasele umphumo nokugqibo kwabasebenzi. Faka isakhono nolonwabo kubasebenzi. Phucula uze ugcine ukhuthazo kubasebenzi uze ukhulise inkqubo yokulawula ukuphumeza. Lawula inyathelo. Faka izalathiso zomsebenzi kubasebenzi. Lawula iindawo zeholide zabahleli bokuhlola.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Finance
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (to be structured according to individual needs)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Finance role in Sekhukhune District managing budget planning, financial reporting and compliance for the Department of Public Works.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric and a qualification at NQF level 07 as recognised by SAQA in Financial Accounting/Financial Management/Supply Chain Management/ Logistics and Asset Management as recognised by SAQA. Five years’ relevant experience in Finance of which three (3) years must be at junior Management level (ASD). Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Strategic Capability and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management, Knowledge Management, Problem solving and analysis, Customer focus, Communication. Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks, Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation, Treasury Regulations, Knowledge and understanding of the following: Supply Chain Management procedures, Procurement Procedures, PFMA, DORA, PPPFA.
jobs.duties: Manage Budget: Facilitate the financial planning and budgeting for the district. Provide the district financial reporting, monitor cash flow and submit cash flow reports and plans as required. Monitor compliance with financial prescripts. Provide advice and guidance to role players on the use of forecasting methods and tools, Facilitate the roll-overs and virement process, Provide the district financial reporting. Provide acquisition services: Compile procurement plan and facilitate the approval. Manage the execution of the procurement plan. Monitor and review the acquisition management activities. Setting up the Bid Evaluation, Bid Adjudication and Bid Specification Committees and render a secretariat service to the relevant committees. Oversee the biding process: by Compilation of bid documents and advertisements. Publishing of bid documents, Receipt (closing and opening) of bid documents. Processing of bid documents. Manage the compilation of the list of prospective providers. Compile terms of reference to invite service providers for an expression of interest. Receive, evaluate and adjudicate expressions of interest. Compile a database of approved suppliers. Manage the sourcing of bids from the database according to the threshold values determined by the National Treasury. Provide logistics and assets management services: Design and develop inventory and assets management policies processes and procedures. Manage inventory and movable asset management services. Manage district stores. Manage district stock –taking services. Inform guide and advice departmental employees on logistics and disposal management matters to promote correct implementation and sound logistics and disposal management practices. Manage Revenue collection: Monitor the implementation of policy and legislative framework to ensure that cognizance is taken of new developments, maintain policies and processes. Monitor revenue collected and expenditure incurred and submit reports and plans as required. Undertake revenue services by ensuring that cashier, banking, debt management, monitoring and reporting services are rendered. Provide advice and guidance to role players on revenue and expenditure procedures. Manage salaries, accounts and expenditure: Authorize all salaries transactions of the district. Monitor the distribution of payroll and payslip and facilitate submission to Head Office, undertake expenditure management and accounting work as required to provide financial administration and accounting services (legers/journals, accounting and reporting (interim and annual financial statements). Manage resource (Human, Financial and Equipment): Manage the component’s budget against its strategic objectives. Coordinate budget monitoring, projecting & reporting expenditure. Ensure that spending is maximized in line with strategic objective. Monitor and report on the utilisation of equipment’s. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage discipline. Provide job description to subordinates. Manage division leave matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Makalela RC, Mankge LJ and Mr Mathabatha MJ Tel No: (015) 636 8300/8330.

Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. The application on eRecruitment system should be accompanied by recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates) as well as copies of all qualifications, Identity Document and valid driver’s license only.
