jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Finansies
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Finansies-pos in Sekhukhune-distrik wat begrotingsbeplanning, finansiële verslagdoening en nakoming vir die Departement van Openbare Werke bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matriek en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 07 soos deur SAQA erken in Finansiële Rekeninge/Finansiële Bestuur/Toeskettingbestuur/Logistiek en Batebestuur soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf jaar se relevante ervaring in Finansies waarvan drie (3) jaar op junior bestuursvlak (ASD) moet wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, personebestuur en bemagtiging, finansiële bestuur, kennisbestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, kliëntfokus, kommunikasie. Kennis van relevante Openbare Diens-wette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsanalise, -ontwikkeling en -interpretasie, Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis en begrip van die volgende: Toeskettingbestuurprosedures, Aanbestedingsprosedures, PFMA, DORA, PPPFA.
af.duties: Bestuur Begroting: Fasiliteer die finansiële beplanning en begroting vir die distrik. Verskaf die distrik se finansiële verslagdoening, monitor kontantvloei en dien kontantvloei-verslae en -planne soos vereis in. Monitor nakoming van finansiële voorskrifte. Verskaf advies en leiding aan rolspelers oor die gebruik van voorspellingsmetodes en -instrumente. Fasiliteer die oorplatings- en oorboekingsproses. Verskaf die distrik se finansiële verslagdoening. Verskaf verworingsdienste: Stel aanbestedingsplan op en fasiliteer die goedkeuring daarvan. Bestuur die uitvoering van die aanbestedingsplan. Monitor en hersien die verworingsbestuursaktiwiteite. Stel die Bievevaluering-, Biedwaardering- en Biedspesifikasiekomitees op en lewer 'n sekretariaatsdiens aan die betrokke komitees. Hou toesig oor die biedproses: deur samestelling van bieddokumente en advertensies. Publiseer bieddokumente, Ontvang (sluiting en opening) van bieddokumente. Verwerking van bieddokumente. Bestuur die samestelling van die lys van voornemende verskaffers. Stel terme van verwysing op om diensverskaffers vir 'n belangstellingsuitdrukking uit te nooi. Ontvang, evalueer en waarder belangstellingsuitdrukkings. Stel 'n databasis van goedgekeurde verskaffers saam. Bestuur die verkryging van biedinge uit die databasis volgens die drempelwaardes wat deur die Nasionale Tesourie bepaal is. Verskaf logistieke en batebestuursdienste: Ontwerp en ontwikkel voorraad- en batebestuursbeleid, prosesse en prosedures. Bestuur voorraad- en roerbare batebestuursdienste. Bestuur distriksmagasyne. Bestuur distriksvoorraadtellingdienste. Stel departementele werknemers in oor logistieke en uitkappingsbestuursaangeleenthede om korrekte implementering en gesonde logistieke en uitkappingsbestuurspraktyke te bevorder. Bestuur inkomstesameling: Monitor die implementering van beleids- en wetgewende raamwerk om te verseker dat kennis geneem word van nuwe ontwikkelinge, handhaaf beleide en prosesse. Monitor ingesamelde inkomste en gemaakte uitgawes en dien verslae en planne soos vereis in. Onderneem inkomstedienste deur te verseker dat kassier-, bank-, skuldbestuurs-, monitorings- en verslagdoeningsdienste gelewer word. Verskaf advies en leiding aan rolspelers oor inkomste- en uitgaweprosedures. Bestuur salarisse, rekeninge en uitgawes: Magtig alle salaristransaksies van die distrik. Monitor die verspreiding van loonstaat en loonstrokie en fasiliteer voorlegging aan Hoofkantoor, onderneem uitgawebestuur en rekenkundige werk soos vereis om finansiële administrasie- en rekenkundige dienste te verskaf (ledgerjoernale, rekeningkunde en verslagdoening (tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële state). Bestuur hulpbronne (Menslike, Finansiële en Toerusting): Bestuur die komponent se begroting teen sy strategiese doelwitte. Koördineer begrotingsmonitoring, -projektering en uitgaweverslagdoening. Verseker dat besteding in ooreenstemming met strategiese doelwitte gemaksimeer word. Monitor en rapporteer oor die benutting van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en waardering van werknemers. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Versterk en handhaaf werknemermotivering en kweek 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur dissipline. Verskaf werkbeskrywing aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur afdeling se verlofaangeleenthede.

zu.title: Deputy Director: Finance
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Deputy Director: Finance kwi-Sekhukhune District ukuphatha ukuhlela ibhajethi, ukubikeka kwemali kanye nokuziphendulela koMnyango we-Public Works.
zu.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric kanye nesifundo esinganqadi se-NQF level 07 njengoba sometwa yi-SAQA ku-Financial Accounting/Financial Management/Supply Chain Management/ Logistics and Asset Management njengoba sometwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emihlanu yemfundo efanele kwezezimali okuyiminyaka emithathu (3) kufanele ibe sezingeni lokuphatha abancane (ASD). Ilayisensi yomshayeli egunyaziwe, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abayisehlulekile. Ulwazi Namakhono: Amandla okubuka ngasese nokuqhosa, ukuphatha kanye nokunika amandla abantu, ukuphatha izimali, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqapha, ukugxila kumthengi, ukuxhumana. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezabhuliki ephathelene, imithetho kanye namaphethini, ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuxazululwa, ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuhumusha inqubomgomo, imithetho ye-Treasury, ulwazi kanye nokuqonda okulandelayo: izinqubo zokuphatha izinto ezingathengiswa, izinqubo zokuthenga, PFMA, DORA, PPPFA.
zu.duties: Phatha ibhajethi: Qondisa ukuhlelwa kwezimali kanye nokubeka ngokwesikhathi isifundo sebhajethi wesifunda. Hlinzeka ngemibiko yesifunda yezimali, hlola ukugeleza kwemali bese udlulisela imibiko nemihlela yokugeleza kwemali njengoba kudingeka. Hlola ukuziphendulela ngokwezimali. Nikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa abadlela imikhakha mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezindlela nezinsiza zokuqagela, qondisa inqubo yokuguqulwa kanye nokudluliselwa kwemali, hlinzeka ngemibiko yesifunda yezimali. Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokuqedela isidingo: Hlola uhlelo lokuthenga bese uqondisa ukugunyazwa kwalo. Phatha ukuphumeza uhlelo lokuthenga. Hlola bese ubuyekeza imisebenzi yokuphatha isidingo. Misa amakomidi Okuhlola Izitende, Amakomidi Okwezula Izitende namakomidi Okukhomba Izitende, bese uhlinzeka ngesevisi yababhali kumakomidi ahlobene. Qaphula inqubo yezitende: ngokuhlela amadokhumenti ezitende kanye nokumemeza. Ukushicilela amadokhumenti ezitende, ukwamukela (ukuvala nokuqamba) amadokhumenti ezitende. Ukucubungula amadokhumenti ezitende. Phatha ukuhlela uhlu lwabanikezeli abahlosiwe. Hlela imigomo yekhaselo ukumema abanikezela ngemisebenzi ukubakhombisa intshisekelo. Yamukela, hlolela bese ugezula izinkomba zentshisekelo. Hlela isisekelo senani sabanikezeli abagunyaziwe. Phatha ukuthola izitende esisisekelo senani ngokwezinani esimiswe yi-National Treasury. Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokuphatha izimpahla nezibhalo: Hlela bese uthuthukisa izinqubomgomo, izinqubo nemikhakha yokuphatha izibalo nezimpahla. Phatha imisebenzi yokuphatha izibalo nezimpahla ezihambisayo. Phatha izitolo zesifunda. Phatha imisebenzi yokubala izinto yesifunda. Tshela, qondisa bese unikeza izeluleko abasebenzi bomnyango mayelana nezindaba zokuphathwa kwemisebenzi yokuhambisa izinto nokulahla ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okulungile nokuphathwa okuhle kokuhambisa izinto nokulahla. Phatha ukuyonga imali: Hlola ukuphumeza izinqubomgomo nenhlelo yomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuqashelwa uthuthukiso olusha, gcina izinqubomgomo nezinqubo. Hlola imali etholwe kanye nalokho okuchithiwe bese udlulisela imibiko nemihlela njengoba kudingeka. Yenza imisebenzi yokuyonga imali ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa imisebenzi yomgcinimafa, yokufaka emabhange, yokuphatha amadebithi, yokuqaphela bese kubikwa. Nikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa abadlela imikhakha mayelana ngezinqubo zokuqoqa imali nokuchitha. Phatha amaholo, ama-akhawunti noku-chitha: Gunyaza wonke amathuluzi wezimali amaholo wesifunda. Hlola ukusatshaliswa kohlulo lwemali kanye nemakhaslhedi bese uqondisa ukudluliselwa eNdiweni enkulu, yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha noku-accounta ukuchithwa njengoba kudingeka ukunikeza izinsiza zokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokusebenza koku-accounta (amakhadi/ amajenjwala, ukusebenza kwezimali kanye nokubika (imibiko yephakathi kanye nenyanga yemibiko yezimali). Phatha izinsiza (Abantu, Izimali kanye Nsesetshenziswa): Phatha ibhajethi yecandule mayelana nezinhloso zayo ezihlose kakhulu. Hlelanganisa ukuqaphela ibhajethi, ukubuka ngaphambili koku-chithwa nokubika. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuchithwa kwemali kukhuliswa ngokwezinhloso ezihlose kakhulu. Hlola bese ubika ngokusetyenziswa kwesetshenziswa. Hlolela bese uqaphela ukusebenza nokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ikhono nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Khuthaza bese ugcina ukukhuthazwa kwabasebenzi bese uvuna isiko lokuphatha ukusebenza. Phatha isiyephu. Nikeza incazelo yomsebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Phatha izindaba zoku-yeza zecandule.

xh.title: Ityala lendlela yeMali
xh.summary: Isikhundla seketyala ndikithi: Iminikelo ngokunxibelelanisa kwangokwezasemali kwaye kwesiSebe seMinyango yamaphatho
xh.requirements: Iklasi 12 / Umatric nendifikazi kumanqanaba eNQF level 07 njengokuqaphela i-SAQA kwi-Financial Accounting/Financial Management/Supply Chain Management/ Logistics and Asset Management njengokuqaphela i-SAQA. Iminyaka emihlanu yamava afanelekileyo kwimali apho kufuneka kube miminyaka mithathu (3) ibengowaseManyano woLawulo osekunqanabeni eliphezulu (ASD). Ilayisensi yokushuka esemthethweni, ngaphandle kwabalindekileyo abasmandla. ULwazi Kunye Nemisebenzi: Amandla okuyila nokuBeka iNgcamango, uLawulo kuBantu nokuNika amandla, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo loLwazi, ukuSombulula iNgxaki nokuHlola, ukuqwalasela kumXhasi, nokuThetha. ULwazi ngomThetho woLuntu, iMigaqo namaQhinga ahambelana nayo, ulwazi nokuqonda ukwahlula isicwangciso sengingqi, uphuhliso nenguqulo, iMigaqo yeQhinga lemali, ULwazi nokuqonda oku landelayo: iMigaqo yoLawulo lokuHambisa izinto, iMigaqo yoThengo, i-PFMA, i-DORA, i-PPPFA.
xh.duties: Phatha umgangatho wemali: Qhubezasela iplani yemali nokuqwalasela umgangatho wemali kwisithili. Nikela ngemibiko yemali yesithili, qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwemali kwaye ungenise iimbowo zokusetyenziswa kwemali nezicwangciso njengoko kufunekayo. Qwalasela ukuziphathisa ngemigaqo yemali. Nikela ngengcinga noluncedo kubathathi nxaxheba malunga nendlela nezixhobo zokuqikelela, Qhubezasela inkqubo yokugqithisa kunye nokudlulisela imali, Nikela ngemibiko yemali yesithili. Nikela ngeenkonzo zokufumana izinto: Hlenga isicwangciso sokuthenga ukuze qhubezasela ukuvunywa. Phatha ukuphumeza isicwangciso sokuthenga. Qwalasela kwaye uzihlolisise imisebenzi yophatho lokufumana izinto. Misela amaKomiti eQwalaselo loMiso, amaKomiti eSigqibo ngokuDawunywa koMiso namaKomiti eMigaqo yoMiso kwaye unike inkonzo yobungazihlali kumakomiti ahambelana nayo. Qhobosa inkqubo yokudawula: ngokuHlenga amaxwebhu okudawula nakusetyenziswa iindaba ezithunyelwa kumaphephandaba. Ukupapasha amaxwebhu okudawula, Ukufumana (ukuvala nokuwukulisa) amaxwebhu okudawula. Ukucubungula amaxwebhu okudawula. Phatha ukuhlelwa koludwe lwabanikezeli abanokuthi babanikezele. Hlenga iitembikamigaqo ukuze mema abaniki ngokubakho kwentshukumo yentshukumo yokwazisa. Fumana, hlola kwaye uzinike isigqibo ngezinto abanikezelwe ngazo. Hlenga isiseko seenkcukacha zabathengisi abavunyiweyo. Phatha ukufumana imiso kwisiseko seenkcukacha ngokomlinganiselo oqondiswe liCandelo leQhinga leNazionale. Nikela ngeenkonzo zophatho lwezinto ezidityanisiweyo nezimpahla: Yila kwaye uphuhlise iingqwalasela nemigaqo yeenkcukacha zophatho lempahla nethunzi lemali ekuhalaleni. Phatha iinkonzo zophatho lempahla ehambayo. Phatha iindawo ezigcinwa kwisithili. Phatha iinkonzo zokuqwalasela amaphahla kwisithili. Yazisa, khokela kwaye unike iselapho kumsebenzi besebe kwimiba zophatho lwezinto nokuqhomforha ukukhuthaza ukuphumeza ngokuchanekileyo nendlela echanekileyo yophatho lwezinto nokuqhomforha. Phatha ukuqokelelwa kwezimali ezingenayo: Qwalasela ukuphumeza imigaqo noshicilelo lomthetho ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba kuqwalaselwa izinto ezintsha, zibe khona imigaqo nendlela. Qwalasela imali ezingenayo efunyenweyo nenyangeko yokuhomboza imali, ulifaka iimbowo namaxhwebu ngoko kufunekayo. Thatha iinkonzo zamali ezingenayo ngokuqinisekisa ukuba zenziwa iinkonzo zomamkeli bemali, zokuyibhankile, zokuphatha imali efunyenweyo ebambe, nokwenza imibiko. Nikela ngengcinga noluncedo abathathi nxaxheba malunga nendlela yokuqokelela nemali efunyenweyo kwaye ukhondoze imali. Phatha imivuzo, i-akhawunti kunye nemali ekhoyo: Vumela zonke iintengiso zemivuzo zesithili. Qwalasela ukuhambisa i-payroll namapay-slip kwaye uqhubezise ulwazi oluye kwiNtloko yeNkundla, thata inyango lokuqhobola imali kunye nomsebenzi we-akhawunti njengoko kufunekayo ukunikela ngeenkonzo zolawulo lwemali kunye ne-akhawunti (iilegers / iijamali, i-akhawunti nokuvela ngemibiko (imibiko yemali ethutyelayo kunye nenyaka). Phatha izibonelelo (abantu, imali nempahla): Phatha umgangatho weqela ngokumalingana nokuqondwa kwebalangoku ezibalulekileyo. Hlanganisa ukuqwalasela umgangatho, i Projekthi & ukuvela kwemibiko ngemali. Qinisekisa ukuba imali ihanjiswa ngokugcweleyo ngokomgama oqondiswe ukuba ngowona. Qwalasela kwaye uvele ngomxabi weenkonzo zokusebenziswa kwegajethi. Hlola kwaye uqwalasele ukuphumeza nokulinganisa imisebenzi yabasebenzi. Qinisekisa amandla nophuhliso wabasebenzi. Phucula kwaye ulondoloze inkuthazo yabasebenzi kwaye utye ucwe ucwambise kwindlela yophatho lokuphumeza kwangokuphumeza. Phatha ulawulo. Nikela inqaku elinguchazo ngomsebenzi kumsebenzi ngezantsi. Phatha imiba zokuthatha iholide kwicandelo.

jobs.reference_number: S.4/3/10/163 Component: Environmental and Disaster Management
jobs.title: Deputy Director: Environmental and Disaster Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (to be structured according to individual needs)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Environmental and Disaster Management at the Limpopo Department of Public Works, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification and five years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Matric and a qualification at NQF level 6 in Environmental Management/Natural Science as recognised by SAQA. Five (5) years’ of experience in Environmental Management or Natural Science of which three (3) years must be at Assistant Director /junior management level. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Programme and project management. Scientific methodologies and models. Research and development. Computer-aided scientific applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Creating high performance culture. Professional judgment. Data analysis Policy development and analysis Strategic capability and leadership. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict Management.
jobs.duties: Ensure the development and implementation of policies, systems and procedures: Review and recommend/approve scientific projects. Facilitate the setting of scientific standards, specifications and service levels according to organizational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor scientific efficiencies according to organizational goals. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organizational principles. Provide strategic leadership and direction. Align project to organizational strategies. Provide support and advice to the industry and stakeholders. Develop and maintain relationships/ collaborations. Review scientific documents. Implement, monitor and enforce compliance to Safety, Health and Environmental Management (SHE) legislation in Road Maintenance and Infrastructure Activities: Facilitate Environmental Impact Assessment and Environmental Management Plans for road maintenance activities (National Environmental Management Act). Implementation and enforcement of the Minerals Petroleum Resources Development Act (MPRDA). Identification and acquisition of good sources of construction material for re-gravelling activities (obtain mining permits and closure certificates for borrow pits and management thereof). Ensure effective waste management in road maintenance activities (NEMA: Waste Act). Ensure that occupational health and safety plans, policies, procedures and programmes are developed, implemented and improved in project sites (Occupational Health and Safety Act and Construction Regulation 2014). Conducting occupational health hazard identification, risk assessments, audits and inspections to ensure roads maintenance contractor safety requirements are satisfied. Ensure Road Safety through conducting Road Safety Appraisals. Comply with National Government directives to update the current Acts. Monitor the updating of departmental policies on environmental and Occupational Health and Safety (contracts sites). Review of project reports and assessments; provide comments on EIA and EMP’s submitted. Liaise with relevant stakeholders on the implementation of the legislation. Manage and coordinate appointment of professional services (PSPs) (Environmental Management and Occupational Health and Safety) for road maintenance and building activities: Draft Terms of Reference for appointment Professional Service Providers (PSPs). Facilitate the advertisements of PSPs in the tender bulletin. Draft Service Level Agreement (SLA) for appointed PSPs. Facilitate the appointment of PSPs. Ensure effective project contract and performance management (Monitor accomplishment of deliverables and milestones). Governance: Allocate, control, monitor and report on all resources. Compile risk logs and manages significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organizational requirements. Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. Facilitate and liaise with structures/stakeholders on scientific matters. Facilitate the development of Integrated Development Planning with the Districts: Manage services provided by PSPs in order to enhance service delivery and to ensure compliance. Consolidate overall plans of their gravelling and re- graveling projects in advance. Provide scientific and technical support in implementation and mainstreaming of legislation and policies on Environmental Management and Occupational Health and Safety. Research and development: Manage scientific research to improve expertise. Publish and present research findings (results). Lead, co-ordinate and conduct basic and applied research or knowledge application. Financial Management: Allocate, monitor, control expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Manage the commercial value add of the discipline- related programmes and projects; and Asset management. People management: Manage the development, motivation and utilization of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of scientific services according to organizational needs and requirements. Manage staff key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Hanyane NP, Mr. Moabelo MJ, Ms. Motsai S Tel No: (015) 284 7586/7627/7262.

jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Omgewings- en Rampbestuur
af.summary: Onderdirekteur vir Omgewings- en Rampbestuur by die Limpopo Department of Public Works, wat 'n NQF level 6-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matriek en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF level 6 in Omgewingsbestuur/Natuurwetenskap soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in Omgewingsbestuur of Natuurwetenskap waarvan drie (3) jaar op Assistent-direkteur/juniorbestuursvlak moet wees. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van applikante met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Program- en projekbestuur. Wetenskaplike metodologieë en modelle. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde wetenskaplike toepassings. Kennis van regsvereistes. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Professionele oordeel. Data-analise Beleidsontwikkeling en -analise. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievernuf. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Mensbestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleide, stelsels en prosedures: Hersien en beveel aan/keur wetenskaplike projekte goed. Fasiliteer die vasstelling van wetenskaplike standaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimum operationele beskikbaarheid te verseker. Monitor wetenskaplike doeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte. Fasiliteer die samestelling van innovasievoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Verskaf strategiese leierskap en rigting. Lijn projekte aan by organisatoriese strategieë. Verskaf ondersteuning en advies aan die bedryf en belanghebbendes. Ontwikkel en onderhou verhoudings/samewerkings. Hersien wetenskaplike dokumente. Implementeer, monitor en handhaaf nakoming van Veiligheids-, Gesondheids- en Omgewingsbestuurs- (VGOM) wetgewing in Padonderhoud en Infrastruktuuraktiwiteite: Fasiliteer Omgewingsimpakbepalings en Omgewingsbestuursplanne vir padonderhoudsaktiwiteite (National Environmental Management Act). Implementering en handhawing van die Minerals Petroleum Resources Development Act (MPRDA). Identifisering en verkryging van goeie bronne van konstruksiemateriaal vir hergrondingaktiwiteite (verkry mynbouvergunnings en sluitingsertifikate vir leenputte en bestuur daarvan). Verseker effektiewe afvalbestuur in padonderhoudsaktiwiteite (NEMA: Waste Act). Verseker dat beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsplanne, beleide, prosedures en programme ontwikkel, geïmplementeer en verbeter word op projekterreine (Occupational Health and Safety Act en Construction Regulation 2014). Voer beroepsgesondheidsgevaaridentifikasie, risiko-assessments, oudits en inspeksies uit om te verseker dat padonderhoudskontrakteurs se veiligheidsvereistes nagekom word. Verseker padveiligheid deur die uitvoer van Padveiligheidsassessments. Voldoen aan Nasionale Regeringsdirektiewe om huidige Wette op date te bring. Monitor die opdatering van departementele beleide oor omgewing en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid (kontrakterreine). Hersiening van projekverslae en assessments; verskaf kommentaar op ingediente EIA en EMP's. Skakel met relevante belanghebbendes oor die implementering van die wetgewing. Bestuur en koördineer die aanstelling van professionele dienste (PSP's) (Omgewingsbestuur en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid) vir padonderhouds- en gebouaktiwiteite: Opstel van Terms of Reference vir die aanstelling van Professional Service Providers (PSP's). Fasiliteer die advertensies van PSP's in die tender bulletin. Opstel van Service Level Agreement (SLA) vir aangestelde PSP's. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van PSP's. Verseker effektiewe projekkontrak en prestasiebestuur (Monitor bereiking van lewerings en mylpaal). Bestuur: Wijs toe, beheer, monitor en rapporteer oor alle hulpbronne. Stel risikologboeke op en bestuur noemenswaardige risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurspraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdeling-inisiatiewe bv. korttermyn-opdragte en uitleenings binne en oor operasies, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operationele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor voortdurend die uitruiling en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Fasiliteer en skakel met strukture/belanghebbendes oor wetenskaplike aangeleenthede. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsbeplanning met die Distrikte: Bestuur dienste wat deur PSP's verskaf word om dienslewering te verbeter en nakoming te verseker. Konsolideer algehele planne vir hul grondering- en hergronderingsprojekte vooraf. Verskaf wetenskaplike en tegniese ondersteuning in implementering en hoofstroom van wetgewing en beleide oor Omgewingsbestuur en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Bestuur wetenskaplike navorsing om kundigheid te verbeter. Publiseer en bied navorsingsbevindings (resultate) aan. Lei, koördineer en voer basiese en toegepaste navorsing of kennistoepassing uit. Finansiële bestuur: Wijs uitgawes toe, monitor en beheer dit volgens begroting om effektiewe kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële waardetoevoeging van dissiplineverwante programme en projekte; en Batebestuur. Mensbestuur: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van wetenskaplike dienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur personeel se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde vas te stel en te monitor en optrede te neem om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Somkhulu Wezinsizakalo Ezibalulekile Nezokuphatha Iziphithiphithi: Ukuphathwa Kwemvelo Nezokuphatha Iziphithiphithi
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Somkhulu Wezokuphathwa Kwemvelo Nezokuphatha Iziphithiphithi e-Limpopo Department of Public Works, sidinga ngesikhifikazini se-NQF level 6 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlaka oluhlobene naleso sikhundla.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/Matric kanye nesikhifikazini esingu-NQF level 6 kwe-Environmental Management/Natural Science njengoba kunqatshwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava e-Environmental Management noma i-Natural Science, lapho kuyadingeka khona iminyaka emithathu (3) ibe kumabandla we-Assistant Director/abaphathi abancane. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile, ngaphandle kwezicelo zabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukuphatha amaprojekthi namuhlelo. Izindlela zokwenza ucwaningo ngobungcalu kanye namamodeli. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zesikhompiya eziseduzo nobungcalu. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Isahluleko sobungcalu. Ukuhlaziya imininingwane. Ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlaziywa kwemigomo Namandla okubeka ihlelo kanye nobuholi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ubuholi beqembu. Ukubumbeka. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuqala ukugcwaliseka kwemfuno kanye nokuphendula ngokushesha. Unxibelelwano. Amakhono wekhompiya. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuphatha izinkulumo eziphikisayo.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemigomo, izinhlelo kanye namasiko: Buka futhi waphakamise/vume amaprojekthi obuchwepheshe. Siza ekubekweni kwemilinganiselo yobuchwepheshe, izici namazinga enkonzo ngokusho imigomo yenhlanganiso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala okulingene kokusebenza. Qaphela ukusebenza kahle kobuchwepheshe ngokusho amagqasu enhlanganiso. Siza ekubumbeni izinkimbinkimbi zeziphakamiso zentuthuko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusemthethweni kanye nokulandelwa kwezigaba zenhlanganiso. Nikeza ubuholi obubhalwe phansi kanye nokuqondisa. Linganisa amaprojekthi nemigokwa yenhlanganiso. Nikeza usizo kanye nzeluleko emhlabeni wemikhiqizo nabaluhlangothi. Thuthukisa futhi ugcine ubudlelwano/kubumba. Buka imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Setha, qaphela futhi phoqa ukuvumelana nomthetho we-Safety, Health and Environmental Management (SHE) ekwakhiweni kwezindlela nezinye izenzo ezenza inhlalo: Siza ukuqondwa kokunamathiselwa kwemvelo kanye namahlela okuphatha imvelo ekwenziweni kwezindlela (National Environmental Management Act). Ukusebenzisa kanye nokuphoqa u-Minerals Petroleum Resources Development Act (MPRDA). Ukubona nokuthola imithombo emihle yezinto zokwakha mayelana nokuqalisa kabusha umsebenzi wokugcwalisa itshe (thola izimvume zokuqasha kanye namatifikhethi okuvala ukwembula amapitsi kanye nokuphathwa kwawo). Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimpahla ezingasebenza kahle ekwenziweni kwemisebenzi yendlela (NEMA: Waste Act). Qinisekisa ukuthi amahlela, imigomo, amasiko namuhlelo wezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini aqhutshwa, asetshenziswa futhi athuthuke kumasayithi amaprojekthi (Occupational Health and Safety Act and Construction Regulation 2014). Yenza ukubona izingozi ezisbulala isempilweni yabasebenzi, ukuhlola imingcele yezingozi, ukubuka kanye nokuphenya ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zokuphepha zabathengisi bokulondolozo zezindlela zihambiswe. Qinisekisa Ukuphepha Kwezindlela ngokwenza ukuhlola Ukuphepha Kwezindlela. Hambisana nemiyalo kahulumeni wavelonkosi ukuze uvuselele emthethweni osekhona. Qaphela ukuvuselelwa kwemigomo yomnyango mayelana nemvelo kanye ne-Occupational Health and Safety (emasayithi ohlelo). Ukuhlola imibhalo yaprojekthi kanye nokuhlola ubuchwepheshe; nikeza izimpendulo ngama-EIA nama-EPO athunyelwe. Thintana nalabo abahlotshaniswe nabo ekusebenziseni umthetho. Phatha futhi uhlelise ukumiswa kwezinkonzo zobungcalu (ama-PSP) e-Environmental Management kanye ne-Occupational Health and Safety) ekulondolozweni kwendlela nakumsebenzi wokwakha: Bhala Ithermso Yokuqondisa ukumiswa kwezinkonzo zabahlinzeki be-Professional Services (PSPs). Siza ekumemeni kwama-PSPs esithombe sithengiso. Bhala isivumelwano sayithi (SLA) sabo abamisiwe abama-PSPs. Siza ekubekeni abo benkonzo abama-PSPs. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kweprojekthi kwekhontrakthi nokuqondisa imigomo (qaphela ukufeza izinhloso kanye namagagasi). Ukuphatha: Nikeza, lawula, qaphela futhi ungabiko ngawo onke amagunya. Hlela amafayela ezingozi futhi uphathe izingozi ezinkulu ngokusho okuhle kokuphatha izingozi ngemigogo yenhlanganiso. Phatha futhi usebenzise ukwabelana ngolwazi izinhloso ezinjengokuthi ukunikezwa ikakhulume ngaphakathi nakunaphandle kwezinhlelo, ukweseka amahlela okuthuthuka komuntu ngamunye, izidingo zokusebenza nenzuzo yokutsha imali. Qhubeka uqaphela ukushintshiselana nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kwezinhlelo nabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kolwazi okuhlakaniphile ngokusho imigomo yomnyango. Siza futhi uthintane nezakhiwo/baluhlangothi emabuzweni obuchwepheshe. Siza ekuthuthukisweni kohlelo lokubumba Hlela isikhathi esihle ekusebenziseni izifundo ezingahleliwe kanye nokuqashwa kwesikhathi eside ngaphakathi nakunaphandle kwezinhlelo, ukweseka amaphulani wokuthukiswa komuntu ngamunye, izidingo zokusebenza nenzuzo yotshalo-mali. Qhubeka ulawule ukushintshiselana nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kwezinhlelo nabantu ngamunye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kolwazi okuhle ngokusho imigomo yomnyango. Siza ekuthuthukisweni kwe-Integrated Development Planning namasifundazwe: Phatha izinkonzo ezinikwe abo abayaphakamisa ukuze phezulu kakhulu ekulethweni kwesevisi nakweqinisekisa ukulandela imithetho. Hlanganisa wonke amaphulani okuqalwa kabusha bokubeka itshe nakumaprojekthi wokuqalisa kabusha isikhathi eside ngaphambili. Nikeza ngosizo lwesayensi nobuchwepheshe ekusetshenzisweni kanye nokufaka umthetho nemigomo e-Environmental Management kanye ne-Occupational Health and Safety. Ucwaningo nentuthuko: Phatha ucwaningo lwesayensi ukuze kwandise ulwazi olunjaniyane. Shicilela futhi thola iziphakamiso zocwaningo (imizimba). Holisa, hlelisa futhi wenze ucwaningo oluyisisekelo noma olusetshenziswa ulwazi. Ukuphathwa kwemali: Nikeza, qaphela, lawula ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwesabelomali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugcina imali kahle. Phatha inzuzo yokuhweba yamaprojekthi kanye namasiko adingekile bese Uphatha impahla. Ukuphathwa kwabantu: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukubakhuthaza nokuphatha ukusetshenziswa kwabantu ngesihlukanisi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi oluqotho lokuphatha ngesikhathi esizayo sezinkonzo zesayensi ngokuthanda kwezidingo zenhlanganiso. Phatha izindawo ezibalulekile zokuphumeza abasebenzi ngokusetha kanye nokuphenya izinga lokusebenza futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa amaphutha ukuze kufeze imigomo yomnyango.

xh.title: Isebeli: ulawulo lwendalo nobungozi
xh.summary: Isebeli kwi-Environmental and Disaster Management e-Limpopo Department of Public Works, lifuna isidanga se-NQF level 6 kwaye neminyaka elishumi elihlanu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12/iMatric kunye nesesidanga se-NQF level 6 kwi-Environmental Management/i-Natural Science njengoko kugunyaziswe yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emi-5 yokuguqulwa kwi-Environmental Management okanye i-Natural Science apho kufuneka kunyuke iminyaka emi-3 kwindima kaAssistant Director/abaphathi abasesantlula. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni, ngaphandle koxakeke bakhethwa ngokomthetho. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulawulo lweenkqubo ngeeprojekthi. Iindlela zenzululwazi namaphuphu. Uphononongo nophuhliso. Izicelo zenkululeko yenzululwazi ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Ukuqulunqa iingxelo ngokobuchule. Ukuyila inkqubo yensebenzo ephezulu. Ukuqwalasela ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuqwalasela idatha Ukuphuhlisa nokwahlula iNkqubo. Ukusebenza ngamandla kwaye unxibelele. Ukuza kwenza izigqibo. Ukukhusela abantu. Ukuqamba. Ulawulo lwemali. Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokuPhendula. Unxibelelwano. Amakhono eKhompyutha. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ukuqwalasela nokuLungelelanisa. Ulawulo loqhinga.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa nokusebenziswa kweenkqubo, iinkqubo nemigaqo: Phonononga uze uqeqeshe/vumile iiprojekthi zenzululwazi. Lungiselela ukumiswa kwezinga lokwenza ulwazi, iinkcazelo namazinga enkonzo ngokomgomo wenhlangano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufumaneka okugqwesileko ekusebenzeni. Qhathanisa ukusebenza ngokwenza ulwazi ngokweenjongo zenhlangano. Lungiselela ukuqulunqwa kweeproposal zobuchwepheshe entontto ukugqithisa ukuzisebenzisa ngokomgama wenhlangano. Nikezela intshayelelo ephononongwayo nokuqonda. Yenzelana iprojekthi namacebo ashukumisayo enhlangano. Nikezela inkxaso nengcebiso kumashishini nabanomdla. Phuhlisa igcino kwaye ulondoloze iindibano/inkxaso. Phonononga iimaxwebhu ezisuka kwilwazi ngokwenza. Yenza, ulawule uze uwenzele ukuthobela iMithetho yeZokhuseleko, Impilo nolawulo Lwendalo (SHE) kumisebenzi yokulondolozo iindlela nemiSebenzi yeZakhiwo: Lungiselela ukuqulunqwa kokunikezelwa isicelo sokukhangela imiba yendalo nokulungiselela amacebo okulawula imiba yendalo yomsebenzi wokulondoloza iindlela (National Environmental Management Act). Ukuqutywa nokuphinyiswa kweMinerals Petroleum Resources Development Act (MPRDA). Ukuqaphela nokufumana iindawo ezilungileyo zokwakha izinto zokwakhela umsebenzi wokuzalela ngokutsha (ukufumana iimvume zokumbatha ngeendawo zokutyhila nolawulo lwazo). Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo iindlebe zokutshaya kumisebenzi yokulondolozo iindlela (NEMA: Waste Act). Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iindaba ezithengisiweyo, iinkqubo, iingqiqo nemisebenzi yokuqonda impilo nokhuseleko olwenziwa, kusetyenziswa kunye nokuqaqumbiswa kwindawo yeprojekthi (Occupational Health and Safety Act and Construction Regulation 2014). Ukwenza uqeqeshe lokumila kwimpilo, ukuqwalasela iingozi, ukuqinisekisa iindawo ezithile ukugqiba izidingo zokhuseleko abakhweli abalawulayo.iindlela zokulondolozwa. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko lwendlela ngokwenza isicelo sokukhangela ukhuseleko lwendlela. Thobela iinkqubo zeNational Government zokuhlaziya iMithetho ethi ixhentswe. Qhathanisa ukuhlaziya iinkqubo zedepartment malunga nendalo nokuQonda Impilo nokuKhuseleka (iindawo zesebe). Phonononga iingxelo zeprojekthi nezingqwalasela; nikezela izimvo malunga ne-EIA ne-EMP ezithunyelweyo. Ncedisana nabanomdyo abafanelekileyo malunga nokusebenza kweMithetho. Lawula ukuqwalasela ukwenzela kubakho abanika inkonzo ngeemveliso (PSPs) (iNkonzo yokulondoloza iindawo nokuvakalelwa kwezoMpilo nokuKhuseleka) kumsebenzi wokulondoloza iindlela nokwakha: Bhala iMagatya eNkonzo yokuqwalasela abanika iinkonzo ngeemveliso (PSPs). Lungiselela ukuzisa iindaba zemihla yeprojekthi kwigazethi eqwalaselwe ngomceli-mngeni. Bhala isivumelwano seNkonzo (SLA) sabanika inkonzo ngeemveliso abavunyelweyo. Lungiselela ukwabelwa abanika iinkonzo ngeemveliso. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo inkonzo neprojekthi yokusebenza (Qhathanisa ukufezwa kwezinto ezelweyo nokuqhuba phambili). Urhwebo: Sabelu, ulathule, uqinisekise uze uchaze zonke iindawo ezikho. Qulunqe iingxelo zengozi uze ulawule iingozi ezikhulu ngokumiseko wenkqubo yokulawula iingozi kwaye ngokweenkqubo zenhlangano. Lawula uze usebenzise iinkqubo zokwazisa ngolwazi ngokomzekelo, iinkalo zexesha elincinci kunye nokubekwa kolunye ukhondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweekqubo, ukuxhasa iinkqubo zokuphuhliswa komntu, iimfuno zokusebenza kunye nenzuzo yemali. Qhathanisa ngokuqhubekayo ukutshintshiselana kolwazi nokukhuselwa kolwazi phakathi kweekqubo nabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo ulwazi ngokweenjongo zedepartment. Lungiselela uze uncedisane neenkqubo/abanomdla kumacala olwazi lwenzululwazi. Lungiselela ukuphuhliswa kokuQulunqa iNkqubo Yokuphuhliswa ngokuhlangenwe nayo naye emaphandleni: Lawula iinkonzo ezinikiweyo ziPSPs ukuze kube ngcono ukunikwa kwenkonzo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela. Qulunqa zonke iinkqubo zeeprojekthi zabo ezithileyo zokuzala ngokutsha kangaphambi kwexesha. Nikezela inkxaso yolwazi ngokwenza kwaye ngamacebo ekusebenziseni nasentsimbi yokwenza inkqubo yentsimbi kwemigaqo kunye neenkqubo malunga noLawulo Lwendalo noQondiso lweMpilo nokuKhuseleko. Ulwazi ngokwenza: Lawula uphando lwenzululwazi ukuze kube ngcono ulwazi. Shicilela uze ubhale iingxelo zesiphumo sophando (iimpendulo). Qhuba, ulungelelanise uze uqwalasele uphando olusisiseko nolusetyenzisiweyo okanye ulwazi olusetyenzisiweyo. Ulawulo LweMali: Yaba, ulawule, ulathule imali ngokwesibonelelo-sinxaxa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo oluchanekileyo lwe-cash flow. Lawula isinxaxa esidla ngokudluliselwa kwentsimbi ngeenkqubo kunye neeprojekthi; kunye nolawulo lwemali. Ulawulo lwabantu: Lawula ukuphuhliswa, ukwenza ukuba bafunele kwaye ukwazi ukuqwalasela abantu ngokobuchule bentsimbi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi obuqinisekileyo ngokuphumelela ngokwesiqu iinkonzo ezisuka kwizicelo zenkqubo ngokweemfuno zenhlangano. Lawula izindaba ezibalulekileyo zabasebenzi ngesiga sokuzisa kunye nokuqinisekisa iinkqubo zokusebenza kwaye uthathe izigqibo zokulungisa iindlela ezingachanekanga ukuze kufezwe iinjongo zedepartment.

jobs.title: Civil/ Structural Engineer (GRADE A-C)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R914 517 per annum Grade B: R1 030 296 per annum Grade C: R1 172 184 per annum (to be structured according to Individual needs), (The department will determine the salary package based on years of experience post professional registration), OSD
jobs.summary: Civil/Structural Engineer position at the Department of Public Works in Polokwane requiring an NQF 7 Civil Engineering qualification, ECSA registration and three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric certificate and a qualification at NQF level 07 as recognised by SAQA in Civil Engineering. 03 years’ experience required in Civil Engineering. Compulsory valid registration with ECSA as Professional Engineer. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Technical Competencies: Programme and project management. Engineering design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Creating high performance culture. Professional judgment. Networking. Generic Competencies: Decision making, team leadership, analytical skills, creativity, self-management, financial management, customer focus and responsiveness, communication, computer literacy, planning and organizing, conflict management, problem solving and analysis and people management.
jobs.duties: Design new systems to solve practical civil engineering challenges and improve efficiency and enhance safety: Plan, design, operate and maintain civil engineering projects. Develop cost effective solutions according to standards. Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Develop tender specifications (civil). Ensure through evaluation that planning and design by others is done according to sound engineering principles and according to norms and standards and practice. Approve civil engineering works according to prescribed norms and standards. Human capital development: Ensure training and development of technicians, technologists and candidate engineers to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound engineering principles and code of practice. Supervise the civil engineering work and processes. Administer performance management and development. Office administration and budget planning: Manage resources and prepare and consolidate inputs for the facilitation of resource utilization. Ensure adherence to regulations and procedures for procurement and personnel administration. Monitor and control expenditure. Report on expenditure and service delivery. Research and development: Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research/literature studies on civil engineering technology to improve expertise. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on civil engineering-related matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Hanyane NP, Mr. Moabelo MJ, Ms. Motsai S Tel No: (015) 284 7586/7627/7262.
jobs.applications: Applicants should apply through the following website https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za. The application on the eRecruitment system should be accompanied by the new Z83 and recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates). Failure to attach required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualified Applications may also be hand delivered/posted to: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure: Private Bag X9490, Polokwane, 0700 or hand delivered at Works Tower Building, No. 43 Church Street, Polokwane, 0699. For Capricorn District: Private Bag X9378, Polokwane, 0700 Or hand deliver at 15 Landros Mare street, next to Correctional Services. For Mopani District: Private Bag X576, Giyani, 0826 or hand deliver at 570 Parliamentary Building, Giyani. For Sekhukhune District: Private Bag X02 Chuenespoort, 0745 or hand deliver at Lebowakgomo Zone A, next to traffic department. For Vhembe District: Private Bag X2248, Sibasa, 0970 or hand deliver at Cnr. Traffic and Raluswielo Street, Sibasa. For Waterberg District: Private Bag X1028, Modimolle, 0510 or hand deliver at Cnr. Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. The application on eRecruitment system should be accompanied by recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates) as well as copies of all qualifications, Identity Document and valid driver’s license only. Failure to attach copies and required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualification.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Siviele-/ Strukturele Ingenieur (GRAAD A-C)
af.summary: Siviele-/Strukturele Ingenieur pos by die Department of Public Works in Polokwane wat 'n NQF 7 Siviele Ingenieurswese-kwalifikasie, ECSA-registrasie en drie jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matrik-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 07 soos deur SAQA erken in Siviele Ingenieurswese. 03 jaar se ervaring word vereis in Siviele Ingenieurswese. Verpligte geldige registrasie by ECSA as Professionele Ingenieur. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van ingenieursontwerp en -analise. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Kennis van regsnakoming. Skryf van tegniese verslae. Skep van 'n hoë-prestasiekultuur. Professionele oordeel. Netwerkwerk. Generiese Bevoegdhede: Besluitneming, spanleierskap, analitiese vaardighede, kreatiwiteit, selfbestuur, finansiële bestuur, kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardigheid, beplanning en organisering, konflikbestuur, probleemoplossing en -analise en mensebestuur.
af.duties: Ontwerp nuwe stelsels om praktiese siviele ingenieursuitdagings op te los en doeltreffendheid te verbeter en veiligheid te verhoog: Beplan, ontwerp, bedryf en onderhou siviele ingenieursprojekte. Ontwerp kostedoeltreffende oplossings volgens standaarde. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Ontwerp tender spesifikasies (siviel). Verseker deur evaluering dat beplanning en ontwerp deur ander gedoen word volgens gesonde ingenieursbeginsels en volgens norme en standaarde en praktyk. Keur siviele ingenieurswerke goed volgens voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde. Menslike kapitaalontwikkeling: Verseker opleiding en ontwikkeling van tegnici, teknoloë en kandidaat-ingenieurs om vaardighede/kennisoordrag en nakoming van gesonde ingenieursbeginsels en gedragskode te bevorder. Hou toesig oor die siviele ingenieurswerk en prosesse. Administreer prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling. Kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning: Bestuur hulpbronne en berei en konsolideer insette voor vir die fasilitering van hulpbronbenutting. Verseker nakoming van regulasies en prosedures vir verkryging en personeeladministrasie. Monitor en beheer uitgawes. Rapporteer oor uitgawes en dienslewering. Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor siviele ingenieurstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor siviele ingenieurswese-verwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Injiniyela yoMgwaqo / Yezakhiwo (GRADE A-C)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobuNjiniyela /Bwemi koNyakatho sebenza ngokusebenzisa isikhundla esikhululekile se-Department of Public Works ePolokwane, esidinga isimemozwi se-NQF 7 kwesimo sabo sesi-7 samabomvu athatwe nhlobo kanye nokuqashwa kwe-ECSA futhi eminyakeni emithathu yokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-GRADE 12 / Matric futhi nge-NQF level 07 njengokuqashwa i-SAQA kubunjiniyela bomgwaqo. 03 years’ experience idingekayo kubunjiniyela bomgwaqo. Ukubhaliswa okuyisisekelo nekuqashwe yi-ECSA njengoPhrofeshonali Wenjiniyela. Layisensi yokushayela esesimweni, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abanesikhungo. Amakhono Okusebenza: Ukuqondisa izinhlelo futhi imigwaqo. Ulwazi lokuqamba futhi ukuhlaziya izinhlela. Cwaningo futhi ukuthuthukiswa. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ubujiniyela ngosizo lwesikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko elenza ngokuphumelela kakhulu. Isahlulelo sobungcali. Ukuxhumana. Amakhano Jikelele: Ukwenza izinqumbo, ukuba nogogo kokuqondisa iqembu, amakhono wokuhlaziya, ukudala, ukuziphatha, ukuphathwa kwemali, ukugxila kumthengi futhi ukuphendula, ukuxhumana, ukufunda ngosizo lwesikhompyutha, ukuhlela futhi ukuhlanganisa, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukuhlaziya futhi ukuphathwa kwabantu.
zu.duties: Hlela izinhlelo ezintsha ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibonakalayo zobunjiniyela bomgwaqo futhiuthuthukise ukusebenza kahle nokuphatha ubuphepha: Cubungula, hlela, sebenzisa futhi lgcine izinhlela zobunjiniyela bomgwaqo. Bathuthukisa izixazululo ezibe nezindleko eziphansi ngokwezindinganiso. Hlola imanuali ezisezincwadi ezedumile, izithombe ezingezinhla ezidumile futhiqhuba izinkambiso futhi zifake ubuchwephesha obusha. Buthuthukisa izinkomba zokuqashisa (emzweni). Qinisekisa ngokuhlola ukuthi ukuhlela futhi ukudizayinha abakwe abanye kwenziwa ngokwezimiswanjiniyela ezinhle futhi ngokohlelo lohlelo futhi imiswanjiniyela. Gqamisa izinhlelo zobujiniyela bomgwaqo ngokohlelo lohlelo futhi imiswanjiniyela ebiqanjiswe. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemithombo yabantu: Qinisekisa ukudlulisela amakhono/ulwazi futhi ukuthobela izimiswanjiniyela ezinhle futhi ikhodi yokusebenza ngokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa abacwaningi, izinjiniyela zezobuchwepheshe futhi abagqaji bokuba abanjiniyela. Bahlolisise futhiqondise imisebenzi nezinqubo zobujiniyela bomgwaqo. Phatha ukwenza futhi ukuthuthukiswa kokusebenza kahle. Inqulo lolunye lwe-ofisi futhi ukuhlela isabelo somali: Phatha imithombo yezinto futhi lungiselela futhi uhlanganise iziqalelelo zokuqasha ngokusebenzisa imithombo yezinto. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho nangezinqobo ukuthengwa futhi kuphathwa kwezempilo. Londa futhi lawulule ukusetshenziswa kwemali. Nikezwa ingxoxo ngemali yokusebenza futhi ukuletha izinsizakalo. ucwaningo futhi ukuthuthukiswa: Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono akuqhubekayo ukugcina isikhathi nobuchwephesha obusha futhi izinqubo. Cwaningo / Ucwaningo lwemibhalo ngobujiniyela bomgwaqo ukuthuthukisa amakhono. Xhumana nezindikimbe / amakhonsidi ahlobene ngemicabango yobujiniyela bomgwaqo.

xh.title: Injinieri yeNzululwazi/Yeemitheo (INQANABA A-C)
xh.summary: Isithuba senjinieri yeNzululwazi/Yemitheo kwisebe lezoMsebenzi kaRhovaweti ePolokwaneelifuna izifundo zeNjiniri yeNzululwazi zemviwo yeNQF 7, ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA nemimiselo yeminyaka emithathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGraji ye-12 / iMatric nendima ngenqanaba le-NQF 07 njengokuvunywa yi-SAQA kwiNjiniri yeNzululwazi. Kufuneka kube khona imimiselo yeminyaka eyi-03 yamava kwiNjiniri yeNzululwazi. Ukubhalisa ngokuyimfuneko okusebenzayo kwi-ECSA njengoNjiniri oGqithisileyo. ilayisenesi yokushayela esebenzayo, ngaphandle kwezicelo ezikwisimo zokukhubazeka. Amakhono obuchwepheshe: Ulawulo lwenkqubo neprojekthi. Ulwazi olupheleleyo lwenkqubo yemisebenzi yoxilongo lolwazi. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yekhompyutha ekwinkqubo yoncedo lwenkqubo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Ukuhombisa iirepoti zobuchwepheshebo. Ukudala inkqubo yentshukumo ephezulu. Ukuzigqatsa ngokunyani. Ukwakhiwa kweenethiwekhi. Amakhono ajikeleziwe: Ukwenza izigqibo, inkokeli yeqela, amakhono okuhlalutya, ukuyila, ukuzilawula, ulawulo lwezemali, ukujolisa nakwindlela yokuphendula abathengi, unxibelelwano, ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwenkqubo yekhompyutha, ulungiselelo nokuqamba, ulawulo lweengxabano, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya ulawulo lwabantu.
xh.duties: Yila iinkqubo ezintsha ukusombulula iingxaki zenjiniri yeNzululwazi nokuphucula isiseko sokusebenza ngokwanelisayo kwaye uluze ukhuseleko: Cwangcisa, yila, qhweba ulondoloze iiprojekthi zenjiniri yeNzululwazi. Yakha iindlela ezizezimali ngokweemfuno. Hlola izikhokelo zobuchwephesha ezikhoyo, iimilo ezikumgangatho opheleleyo noluvo ukwakha ingqwalasela ngobuchwepheshe obutsha. Cwangcisa iinkcukacha zokuqesheka (eyenjingini yentsimbi). Qinisekisa ngokuhlalutya okuzinzileyo ukuba ucwangciso nedyayini ezilandelwa ngabanye kwenziwa ngokwemigaqo yenkqubo yegqwetha njengoko lisitibhile njalo nangokweemfuno zekhulo yokuphila. Vuma urkubakho ubugcisa benjiniri ngokumiselwa kwemigaqo esebenzayo. Imbuyiso yenkqubo abantu: Qinisekisa ukhokelelo kuphuhliso labaqeqeshi kwizifundo ubugcisa kwakunye nokoqhelwa beemfundi ukuphuhlisa ulwazi ngokunikezela kobuqeqeshwa bolwazi kwaye ulandele umkhondo wenjiniri ekhoyo yengcalabala eqinisekileyo. Qhweba abantu abanobugcisa benjiniri kwaboro bokulawula abantu ngokubeka iinkqubo zemisebenzi. Lawula iinkqubo ngesiseko sokulawula imisebenzi. lawula olunye ulawulo olwenziwa ngabanye ngokumiselwa kwemigaqo esebenzayo. Ulawulo lwe-ofisi nendlela yokucwangcisa imali lawula inkqubo yamandla kwaye ulungiselele nokuqamba umba wonke kwindlela yokusetyenziswa kwemali. Yongamela amandla emisebenzi nolawulo. qaphela kukho imali echithiweyo ekubakho inkqubo ngokunika ingxelo. Into ethile egqibele iingxelo ngokuphendula ingxelo ngokukhawuleza. inkqubo: ukuphuhlisa ulwazi ngokuqhubela phambili njalo nokugcina indlela ezizezona nokuqhubela phambili nobuchwepheshe. uphando iifom ezincedisa impilo yabantu ngomsebenzi wezopolitiko

jobs.duties: Design new systems to solve practical civil engineering challenges and improve efficiency and enhance safety: Plan, design, operate and maintain civil engineering projects. Develop cost effective solutions according to standards. Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Develop tender specifications (civil). Ensure through evaluation that planning and design by others is done according to sound engineering principles and according to norms and standards and practice. Approve civil engineering works according to prescribed norms and standards. Human capital development: Ensure training and development of technicians, technologists and candidate engineers to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound engineering principles and code of practice. Supervise the civil engineering work and processes. Administer performance management and development. Office administration and budget planning: Manage resources and prepare and consolidate inputs for the facilitation of resource utilization. Ensure adherence to regulations and procedures for procurement and personnel administration. Monitor and control expenditure. Report on expenditure and service delivery. Research and development: Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research/literature studies on civil engineering technology to improve expertise. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on civil engineering-related matters.

af.title: Siviele Ingenieur (GRAAD A-C)
af.summary: Siviele Ingenieur benodig by Limpopo Department of Public Works Hoofkantoor in Polokwane; vereis ECSA-registrasie en 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie in Siviele Ingenieurswese.
af.requirements: Grade 12 / Matrik-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 07 soos deur SAQA erken in siviele ingenieurswese. 03 jaar se ervaring in siviele ingenieurswese vereis. Verpligte geldige registrasie by ECSA as Professionele Ingenieur. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuur. Ingenieursontwerp- en analise-kennis. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurswese-toepassings. Kennis van regstoepassing. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Professionele oordeel. Netwerking. Generiese Bevoegdhede: Besluitneming, spanleierskap, analitiese vaardighede, kreatiwiteit, selfbestuur, finansiële bestuur, klienstens en reaksiesnelheid, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardigheid, beplanning en organisering, konflikbestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, en personeelbestuur.
af.duties: Ontwerp nuwe stelsels om praktiese siviele ingenieurswese-uitdagings op te los en doeltreffendheid en veiligheid te verbeter: Beplan, ontwerp, bedryf en onderhou siviele ingenieursprojekte. Ontwerp kostedoeltreffende oplossings volgens standaarde. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Ontwerp tender spesifikasies (siviel). Verseker deur evaluering dat beplanning en ontwerp deur ander gedoen word volgens gesonde ingenieursbeginsels en volgens norme en standaarde en praktyk. Keur siviele ingenieurswerk goed volgens voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde. Menslike kapitaal ontwikkeling: Verseker opleiding en ontwikkeling van tegnici, technoloë en kandidaat-ingenieurs om vaardigheids/kennisoordrag en nakoming van gesonde ingenieursbeginsels en gedragskode te bevorder. Ouloen die siviele ingenieurswerk en prosesse. Administreer prestasiebestuur en ontwikkeling. Kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning: Bestuur hulpbronne en berei en konsolideer insette vir die fasilitering van hulpbronbenutting voor. Verseker nakoming van regulasies en prosedures vir verkryging en personeeladministrasie. Monitor en beheer besteding. Rapporteer oor besteding en dienslewering. Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsings/literatuurstudies oor siviele ingenieurstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor siviele ingenieurswese-verwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Injineli Yesakhiwo (IZINGA A-C)
zu.summary: Kudingeka iNjineli Yesakhiwo eLimpopo Department of Public Works Head Office ePolokwane; kudingeka ukubhaliswa kwe-ECSA nefundo le-NQF 7 eNzulwini bakaCwaka kweCivil Engineering.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Matric nefundo ezingeni le-NQF level 07 njengoba kuhlonzwa i-SAQA kwiCivil Engineering. 03 years’ experience eNjinini Yesakhiwo. Kuyisibopho ukubhaliswa okusebenzayo ne-ECSA njengenkaneli Yobuchwepheshe. Isilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo, ngaphandle kwabafaki izikhalazo abayizikhulumi. Amandla Obuchwepheshe: Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi namaprogremu. ulwazi lweNjineli yokuhlela nokuhlaziya. ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ngekhompyutha ebusiza obuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Isahluleko senkaneli. Ukuxhumana. Amandi Ajwayelekile: Ukwenza izinqumo, abantu abaphezulu bokuqonda, amandla okuhlaziya, ukuzindleka, ukuzibusi, abantu abaphezulu bokuqhuba, ukuzinaka kwegci kwesi, ukulalela, ukulalela, isikhompyutha, ukulunga komuntu, ukuhlonza nokuhlela, ukuphatha ingcindezi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nesibopho senkaneli.
zu.duties: Hlela izindlela ezintsha ukuxazulula izinkinga zokwakha izinto ezisebenza ngokomthetho wokwakha ukuze kuthuthuke ukusebenza futhi kube nokuphepha. Cwangcisa, hlela, sebenzisa futhi gcina amaphrojekthi okwakha. Phakamisa izixazululo ezehlulela ngokwezimali ngokomqondo. Hlola imibhalo yobuchwepheshe, ukulanda okuvamile nokuqonda ukuze kufakwe ingqalasizinda eYINTSHA. Phakamisa imininganingwane yokuthenga izimpahla (zokwakha). Qinisekisa ngehlolo ukuthi ukucwangcisa nokuhlela kwabanye kwenziwa ngokomgomo ohlelwile ngengcali yokwakha ngokomgomo nemigomo. Uma qinisekiswa, bese vuna izinto ezinhle ukuthi zihambe kahle ngokwezinhlelo zabo nemigomo.

xh.title: Injini Yezenzululwazi EzoLuntu (GRADE A-C)
xh.summary: Kufuneka injini yezenzululwazi ezoLuntu kwiNqanaba leSikhululo ePolokwane kwiLimpopo Department of Public Works; kufuneka kubekho uBhaliso kwi-ECSA kwaye kufuneka kubekho isifanekiso seNQF 7 kwiZemiziNzululwazi EzoLuntu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric nesifanekiso kwinqanaba le-NQF level 07 njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA kwiCivil Engineering. Kufuneka kubekho iminyaka yam-03 yamava kwiCivil Engineering. Kuyakumandelwa ubhaliso osebenzayo kwi-ECSA njengakwimProfeshonale yoMIngcaphepheli. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi esebenzayo, ngaphandle kwabo bafuna abanokuphela kokwakwa. IimFuzo zoBuchwepheshe: Ulawulo lwenkqubo noluwo lomsebenzi. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yoyilo kwi-engineering nokwahlulo-hlulo. Uphando nentlUTHUTYI. izicelo zokubeka komqhubi ekuqwalaselweni ngokukhetha. Ulwazi lokuThobela umthetho nokuBhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Udalwe amakhono okwenza ngokugqithisileyo. Isigqibo somProfeshonale. Ukusebenza kwakunye. ama-Competencies ahlanganayo: Thatha isigqibo, inkokheli eqeqeshiweyo, amakhono ekuqwalasela, imibuzo ephathwayo, ukuzilawula ngokwakho, ulawulo lweziMali, kugqithiswa kubakho kuMthengi kwaye aphendule, kuQqaliswa nokuQulunqwa, ukusetyenziswa kwesixhobo esingenazenziso, ukwakheIwa kweNkqubo, ukulawuIwa kabiIwa, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuwahlenula, ukulawuIwa kwemiSebenzi naBantu.
xh.duties: Yila iinkqubo ezintsha ukusombulula iingxaki ezenzululwazi ezoLuntu ezisebenzayo, uze ulungelelanise ukusebenza kakuhle kwaye uphucule ukhuseleko. Cwangcisa, yila, qhuba kwaye ulondoloze imisebenzi yezenzululwazi ezoLuntu. Puhlaza izisombululo ezihlawuliswayo ngokwemigqatho. Qwalasela iimanual ezingagqibekanga ngobuchwepheshe, izisolzo ezizezakowo nemiQatho kuboniswe ubuchwepheshe obutsha. Puhlaza ipecifikhe yoluwo lomsebenzi (ezozululwazi ezoLuntu). Qinisekisa ngokuqwalaselwa ukuba uCwangciso kunoYilo abakwenzayo abanye kwenziwa ngokwemiQatho eyeyyo yonkulunkulu inzelwesi nangokwemigaqo namava. Vumela imisebenzi yezenzululwazi ezoLuntu ngokwemigaqo nangokwemigaqo eshiweyo. Inkinga yolwazi lomntu: Qinisekisa uqeqesho nolunIwulo lwechnology, kwabazali bechnology kunye nabaFuna abakwaziyo abakubakho abakwaziyo ukuze baqhube impilo/ulwazi kwaye baThobele imigaqo eyeyyo yenzululwazi nenguMthetho wokuZiphatha. Qaphela iMisebenzi yezInzululwasi naBantu ezenzelwe nokuQhatshwa kweNkqubo. Lawula kwaye lulawule imiQOQO engoNyani naBakho abakwaziyo iinkQOBO ekuQhatshweni kwenkQOBO. Qinisekisa ukuthathwa kwemigaqo nemiQatho ngokuthengiswa nangeniso lomntu. Qaphela kwaye uLawule imali eQhutshwa. ZiiNgxelo ngokuQhutshwa ngokwemali nangokunikela ngenkonzo. Uphando nolwaIulo: Qhubeka nokuphucuIwa ngokuBhaliswa komProfeshonale ukuze ugwame ngobuchwepheshe obutsha nemiQatho. IIfundo zoPhando/ngeNgcweti zobuchwepheshe kwezenzululwasi ezoLuntu ukuze uphucule ulwazi. Qhagamshelana nabasebenzisi abahloIweyo /namabandla ngeemiba ezidibana nezenzululwasi ezoLuntu.

jobs.title: Construction Project Manager
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R914 517 per annum Grade B: R1 030 296 per annum Grade C: R1 172 184 per annum (to be structured according to Individual needs), (The department will determine the salary package based on years of experience post professional registration), OSD
jobs.summary: Manage and coordinate construction projects in the Limpopo Department of Public Works, reporting to the Chief Construction Project Manager.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric certificate and a qualification at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA in Built Environment, 04 years’ experience in Built Environment (04 years and 06 months experience), or Grade 12 / Matric certificate and a qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA in Built Environment (04 years’ experience in Built Environment), or Grade 12 / Matric certificate and a qualification at NQF level 8 as recognised by SAQA in Built Environment, 03 years’ experience in Built Environment. Compulsory registration with the SACPCMP as a Professional Construction Project Manager. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Core And Process Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership; People Management and Empowerment; Programme and Project Management; Financial Management; Change Management; Knowledge Management; Service Delivery Innovation; Problem solving and analysis; Client Orientation and Customer focus; Communication. Skills: Programme and project management. Project management skills, principles and methodologies. Project and professional judgement. Computer-aided engineering and project applications. Project design and analysis knowledge. Project operational communication. Process knowledge and skills. Maintenance skills and knowledge. Mobile equipment operating skills. Legal and operational compliance. Research and development. Creating high performance culture Technical consulting. Strategic capability and leadership. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. People management. Planning and organizing. Conflict management. Negotiation skills. Change management.
jobs.duties: Manage and coordinate all aspects of projects under the supervision of the Chief Construction Project Manager: Guide the project planning, implementation, monitoring, reporting and evaluation in line with project management methodology, Create and execute project work plans and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements, Identify resources needed and assign individual responsibilities, Manage day-to-day operational aspects of a project and scope, Effectively apply methodology and enforce project standards to minimize risk on projects. Project accounting and financial management: Report project progress to Chief Construction Project Manager, Manage project budget and resources. Office administration: Provide inputs to other professionals with tender administration. Liaise and interact with service providers, client departments, and management, Maintain the record management system and the architectural library, Utilise allocated resources effectively. Research and development: Keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research/literature on new developments on project management methodologies, Liaise with relevant bodies/ councils on project management.

af.title: Konstruksie-projekbestuurder
af.summary: Bestuur en koördineer konstruksieprojekte in die Limpopo Department of Public Works, met verslagdoening aan die Hoofkonstruksie-projekbestuurder.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matriek-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 6 soos deur SAQA erken in Built Environment, 04 jaar se ervaring in Built Environment (04 jaar en 06 maande ervaring), of Graad 12 / Matriek-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken in Built Environment (04 jaar se ervaring in Built Environment), of Graad 12 / Matriek-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 8 soos deur SAQA erken in Built Environment, 03 jaar se ervaring in Built Environment. Verpligte registrasie by die SACPCMP as 'n Professionele Konstruksie-projekbestuurder. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kern- en prosesbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; Personebestuur en bemagtiging; Program- en projekbestuur; Finansiële bestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Kennisbestuur; Dienslewering-innovasie; Probleemoplossing en analise; Kliëntoriëntasie en klantfokus; Kommunikasie. Vaardighede: Program- en projekbestuur. Projekbestuursvaardighede, -beginsels en -metodologieë. Projektegne en professionele oordeel. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurs- en projektoepassings. Projekontwerp- en analisekennis. Projekoperasionele kommunikasie. Proseskennis en -vaardighede. Onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis. Vaardighede vir die bestuur van mobiele toerusting. Regs- en operasionele nakoming. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Klantfokus en -reagerendheid. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Personebestuur. Beplanning en organising. Konflikbestuur. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Veranderingsbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer alle aspekte van projekte onder toesig van die Hoofkonstruksie-projekbestuurder: Lei die beplanning, implementering, monitering, verslagdoening en evaluering van die projek in ooreenstemming met projekbestuursmetodologie. Skep en voer projekwerksplanne uit en hersien dit soos nodig om aan veranderende behoeftes en vereistes te voldoen. Identifiseer benodigde hulpbronne en wys individuele verantwoordelikhede toe. Bestuur daaglikse operasionele aspekte van 'n projek en omvang. Pas metodologie doeltreffend toe en handhaaf projekstandaarde om risiko's by projekte te minimaliseer. Projekrekeningkunde en finansiële bestuur: Rapporteer projekvordering aan die Hoofkonstruksie-projekbestuurder. Bestuur projekbegroting en hulpbronne. Kantooradministrasie: Verskaf insette aan ander professionele persone oor tenderadministrasie. Skakel en interaksioneer met diensverskaffers, kliëntdepartemente en bestuur. Onderhou die rekordbestuurstelsel en die argitektuurbiblioteek. Benut toegekende hulpbronne doeltreffend. Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Hou tredes met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuur oor nuwe ontwikkelinge in projekbestuursmetodologieë. Skakel met relevante liggame/raade oor projekbestuur.
