zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seGrade 12 / Matric noma isiqu esinganqangi leya noma isidingo sokuthola iziqu ezifundiswe emkhakheni weBuilt Environment eNQF level 6 njengokuqashwa yiSAQA, nokuba nomlando wezinyanga ezingama-04 weziqapho emkhakheni we-Built Environment (okuyisikhathi esingaba yizi-04 nezi-06 nyanga zesikhathi), noma isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Matric esifundiswe kwiNQF level 6 njengesitifikedi se-SAQA, kanye nokuba nesipiliyoni esinganani angu-04 emkhakheni we-Built Environment (04 years' experience in Built Environment), noma isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Matric kanye nesiqu esibonwa yi-SAQA eNQF level 6 kwiBuilt Environment, isipiliyoni esingunyaka o-1-3. Ubume bokubhalisa ebungeni elithile kwiiSACPCMP njengesikhulu esiyingozi sePhrojekthi yoKwakhiwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, ngaphandle kwabo bafaka izicelo abanokukhathazeka. Iminikelo yamandla nemikhuba esemqoka: Ikhono elibonwayo ngokuhlobene nokuphatha ibala; Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokukhulisa amandla; Ukuphathwa kwehlelo kanye nePhrojekthi; Ukuphathwa kweMali; Ukuphathwa kokushintsha; Ukuphathwa kolwazi; Ukuthumela izinsizakalo bese kubakhuthaza ukuthi bakwazi ukuqonda futhi bakhombise ukuthi bawasebenzisa kanjani amathuluzi wale mikhakha; Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya iminikelo yamandla emishwana emikhulu yabantu; Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokubeka kanye nokuqina isikhathi esidlule kulezi zindlela; Ukuxhumana. Amandla okwenza izinto: Ukuphathwa kohlelo nangaphandle kwale minikelo yamathuluzi. Ikhono lokugcina imfundo nangaphandle kwayo. Isipiliyoni ekuphathwa kwezinto ezikhulu ekuphathwa. Ikhono lokuthola izindlela ezisha zokuphatha imisebenzi nangaphandle kwale minikelo. Amandla okwenza izinto ezinhle ngokugqamisa imisebenzi. Amandla okuthola izinsizakalo ezihlukene. Ukuxhumana nabantu abaningi ababekwa kwiwebhusayithi. Ukuthuthukiswa kokulawula izinkinga ezinkulu. Amandla okuphathwa kwezezimali ekuthuthukisweni kolwazi olusha. Amandla okuba nokwazi ukulawula izindlela zokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ezincane.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlobo zonke izici zemaprojekthi ngaphansi kokulawula kwaMeneja wePhrojekthi yoKwakhiwa oyiNhloko: Qondisa ukuhlelwa kweprojekthi, ukusetshenziswa, ukulawulwa, ukubika nokuhlola ngokuvumelana nezindlela zokuphathwa kwaprojekthi. Dala futhi usebenzise izinhlela zokusebenza zeprojekthi bese uzilungisa njengokuwohlokayo ukuze zaholele ezidingweni nasezidingweni ezishintshayo. Hlola izinsiza ezidingekayo bese umkhombe izibopho zabantu bese bese bese bese bese. Phatha izici zansuku zonke zokuphatha iprojekthi nesisindo sayo. Sebenzisa ngokusebenza kakhulu izindlela futhi ugcine amazinga aphakeme kwaphrojekthi ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi kumaprojekthi. Ukuhola kwamaphrojekthi nokuphathwa kwezimali: Bikisa inqubo yeprojekthi kuMeneja wePhrojekthi yoKwakhiwa oyiNhloko. Phatha ibhajethi yeprojekthi nezinsiza. Ukuphathwa kwe-ofisi: Nikeza izindlela kubanye ochwepheshe mayelana nokuphathwa kwethenda. Xhumana nabanikezeli benkonzo, oonina bangaphakathi, kanye nezinhlangano ezahlukene. Hlola nokugcina amaphrojekthi namathuluzi asemthethweni wezokwakhiwa. Hlola amaphrojekthi amasha nezinhlela ezisha nokuthuthukisa amaphrojekthi kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokusebenza kahle kwawo. Xhumana nabahlinzeki bezinsiza, oonina bangaphakathi, kanye nobulungu. Xhumana nabahlinzeki bezinsiza, oonina bangaphakathi, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo.

xh.title: Umphathi Weprojekthi YokuMakwa
xh.summary: Ukuphatha nokulungelelanisa iiprojekthi zokwakha kwiLimpopo Department of Public Works, kuvela kubhaliso kwiChief Construction Project Manager.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric nelifikhesheyshi kwinqanaba leNQF 6 njengokuqatywa yi-SAQA kwi-Built Environment, unyaka bahlumi-04 bemihla ngokusebenzela kwi-Built Environment (04 years and 06 months experience), okanye isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric nelifikhesheyshi kwinqanaba leNQF 7 njengokuqatywa yi-SAQA kwi-Built Environment (04 years’ experience in Built Environment), okanye isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric nelifikhesheyshi kwinqanaba leNQF 8 njengokuqatywa yi-SAQA kwi-Built Environment, unyaka bathathu-03 bemihla ngokusebenzela kwi-Built Environment. Ubhaliso obuyiyo ku-SACPCWP njengomphathi weprojekthi yokuMakwa ngowmsebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni, ngaphandle kwabo bakhubekileyo kumzimba. Amaphepha ezoNginelwa nezeNgqalaselana eziBalulekileyo: Ikhandabizo eQiniselweyo neQonda kuBukhosi; uLawulo lwabaNtu nokuBa mdla; uLawulo lweNkqubo neyoQhubo; uLawulo lweMali; uLawulo loShintsho; uLawulo oluZinikela ngokwazi; iNkcubeko yokuNika inkonzo; iSisombululo seenkinga nokuHlola isifenxo; uQhelaniso neeNkxwabo eZinomdla; uThethathethwano. Izakhono: uLawulo lweenkqubo neeprojekthi. Izakhono, iimigaqo neendlela zokusebenza zolawulo lweprojekthi. Isigqibo seprojekthi nesesigqibeli. Iinkqubo zokusebenzela ezingenelelwa ngamakhompyutha nakwiprojekthi. Ulwazi lokuyila nokuHlola iiprojekthi. Unxibelelwano ngokusebenza kweprojekthi. Ulwazi nezakhono zenkqubo. Izakhono nolwazi lokwazisa. Izakhono zokusebenzisa izixhobo eziNtsokayamanyathelo. Ukuzinikela ngokomthetho nangokwendlela yokusebenza. Uphando nokuKhula. Ukwakha inkqubo yokusebenza ephezulu nokuQondisa ngekwelo. Ikhandabizo eqiniselweyo neqonda kubukhosi. iSisombululo seenkinga nokuHlola isifenxo. ukuThatha isigqibo. uBukhosi beQela. uQhayiya. uLawulo lweMali. uQhelaniso nokuPhendula kwiNkxwabo. uThethathethwano. Izakhono zekhompyutha. uLawulo lwabaNtu. uCwangciso nokuHlela. uLawulo lweNxwelo. Izakhono zokuXhanda. uLawulo loShintsho.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha nokulungelelanisa onke amacala eeprojekthi ngaphantsi kolawulo lweChief Construction Project Manager: Qondisa uCwangciso, ukuZisebenzisa, ukuQwalasela, iingxelo nokuHlola iiprojekthi ngokwemigaqo yolawulo lweprojekthi, Yila iqhelaniso elihle nelisebenzayo leprojekthi ulenze ngokufanelekileyo ukuze uhlangabezane neemfuno ezishukumayo, Qaphela izixhobo ezingcangcazelwayo wazidibanisa neemfuno zabantu, Lawula amacala onke emihla ngemihla okusebenzayo kwiprojekthi nakwindawo ephathwayo, Sebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo imigaqo yendlela yokusebenza uze uyivumele imilinganiselo yeprojekthi ukuze kutswele iingozi eziprojekthini. uLawulo lweMali neeprojekthi: Yenceatha ngomva weprojekthi kwiChief Construction Project Manager, Lawula isabelo nezigcinwa seprojekthi. uLawulo leOfisi: Nikezela izimvo abo baphi abanamagama abaphethe ukuqhutywa konyiso. Thethathethwana nonxibelelwano nabemiKhusi-nkonzo, amasebe aneNkxwabo, nangolawulo, Zonke inkqubo yokugcina iingxelo nendawo egcina imicu yomzobo, Sebenzisa izixhobo ezabelwe ngokuchanekileyo. uPhando nokuKhula: Zihlaziile ngobutsha bokwazi kunye nemigaqo. uPhando imigaqo emisha yokuphatha iiprojekthi, Thethathethwana nabemi kweziqu/ amabumba anogqitho kumalunga ngokwamagunya.

jobs.title: Quantity Surveyor (GRADE A-C)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R791 604 per annum Grade B: R900 957 per annum Grade C: R1 015 071 per annum (to be structured according to Individual needs). The Department will determine the salary package based on years of experience post professional registration)
jobs.summary: Quantity Surveyor needed at the Department of Public Works in Polokwane to manage construction costs and coordinate professional teams on building projects.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric certificate and a qualification at NQF Level 07 in Quantity Survey as recognized by SAQA. Three years’ experience in Quantity Survey is required. Compulsory registration with SACQSP as a Professional Quantity Survey. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Technical Competencies: Programme and Project Management. Quantity Survey, principles and methodologies. Research and development. Computer- aided engineering applications. Knowledge of legal compliances. Technical report writing. Technical consulting. Creating high performance culture. Professional judgement. Networking. Generic Competencies: Decision making, team leadership, analytical skills, creativity, self-management, financial management, customer focus and responsiveness, communication, computer literacy, planning and organizing, conflict management, problem solving and analysis and people management. Change Management and Innovation.
jobs.duties: Perform quantity survey activities on buildings, structures or facilities. Co – ordinate professional team on all aspects regarding quantity survey. Ensure adherence to quantity determination standards. Provide quantity survey advice and technical support in the evaluation of costs. Ensure the adoption of technical and quality strategies. Develop quantity survey related policies, methods and practices. Provide solution on non – compliance on quantity determination. Review the cost determination of projects and estimates accomplished by building designers and/or sub- professional personnel. Ensure adherence to the requirements of professional registration. Human capital development: Mentor, train and develop candidate quantity survey and related technical and administrative personnel to promote skills/ knowledge transfer and adherence to sound architectural principles and code of practice. Supervise quantity survey work and processes. Administer performance management and development. Office administration and budget planning: Manage resources, prepare and consolidate inputs for the facilitation of resource utilisation. Ensure adherence to regulations and procedures for procurement SCM and personnel human resource administration. Monitor and control expenditure. Report on expenditure and service delivery. Research and development: Continuous professional development and according to council guidelines. Research/literature on quantity survey to improve expertise. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on quantity survey related matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Hanyane NP, Mr. Moabelo MJ, Ms. Motsai S Tel No: (015) 284 7586/7627/7262.
jobs.applications: Applicants should apply through the following website https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za. The application on the eRecruitment system should be accompanied by the new Z83 and recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates). Failure to attach required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualified Applications may also be hand delivered/posted to: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure: Private Bag X9490, Polokwane, 0700 or hand delivered at Works Tower Building, No. 43 Church Street, Polokwane, 0699. For Capricorn District: Private Bag X9378, Polokwane, 0700 Or hand deliver at 15 Landros Mare street, next to Correctional Services. For Mopani District: Private Bag X576, Giyani, 0826 or hand deliver at 570 Parliamentary Building, Giyani. For Sekhukhune District: Private Bag X02 Chuenespoort, 0745 or hand deliver at Lebowakgomo Zone A, next to traffic department. For Vhembe District: Private Bag X2248, Sibasa, 0970 or hand deliver at Cnr. Traffic and Raluswielo Street, Sibasa. For Waterberg District: Private Bag X1028, Modimolle, 0510 or hand deliver at Cnr. Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. The application on eRecruitment system should be accompanied by recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates) as well as copies of all qualifications, Identity Document and valid driver’s license only. Failure to attach copies and required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualification.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoeveelheidsmeter (GRADE A-C)
af.summary: Hoeveelheidsmeter benodig by die Department of Public Works in Polokwane om konstruksiekoste te bestuur en professionele spanne op bouprojekte te koördineer.
af.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF Level 07 in Quantity Survey soos deur SAQA erken. Drie jaar se ervaring in Quantity Survey word vereis. Verpligte registrasie by SACQSP as 'n Professionele Quantity Survey. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Program- en projektbestuur. Quantity Survey, beginsels en metodes. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaarondersteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Kennis van regsonderhouning. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Tegniese konsultasie. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Professionele oordeel. Netwerk bou. Generiese Bevoegdhede: Besluitneming, spanleierskap, analitiese vaardighede, kreatiwiteit, selfbestuur, finansiële bestuur, klienfokus en reaksievermoë, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardigheid, beplanning en organisering, konflikbestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, en mensebestuur. Veranderingsbestuur en Innovasie.
af.duties: Voer hoeveelheidsmeetaktiwiteite op geboue, strukture of fasiliteite uit. Koördineer professionele span oor alle aspekte rakende hoeveelheidsmeting. Verse voldoening aan hoeveelheidsbepalingsstandaarde. Verskaf hoeveelheidsmeetadvies en tegniese ondersteuning by die evaluering van koste. Verse die aanvaarding van tegniese en gehaltestrategieë. Ontwikkel hoeveelheidsmeetverwante beleide, metodes en praktyke. Verskaf oplossing vir nie-nakoming van hoeveelheidsbepaling. Hersien die kostebepaling van projekte en skattings wat deur gebouontwerpers en/of sub-professionele personeel gedoen is. Verse voldoening aan die vereistes van professionele registrasie. Menslike kapitaalontwikkeling: Mentor, lei en ontwikkel kandidaat-hoeveelheidsmeet en verwante tegniese en administratiewe personeel om vaardigheids-/kennisoordrag en nakoming van goeie argitektoniese beginsels en gedragskode te bevorder. Outelei hoeveelheidsmeetwerk en prosesse. Administreer prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling. Kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning: Bestuur hulpbronne, berei insette voor en konsolideer insette vir die fasilitering van hulpbronbenutting. Verse voldoening aan regulasies en prosedures vir verkryging SCM en personeel-menslike hulpbronadministrasie. Monitor en beheer uitgawes. Rapporteer oor uitgawes en dienslewering. Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling en volgens rigsyne van die raad. Navorsing/literatuur oor hoeveelheidsmeting om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor hoeveelheidsmeetverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Quantity Surveyor (GRADE A-C)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu ongumyali wezindleko eDepartment of Public Works ePolokwane ukuphatha izindleko zokwakha kanye nohlanganisa amaqembu abangcweti emaphrojekthi okwakha.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seGrade 12 / Matric kanye nefomula iNQF Level 07 kwi-Quantity Survey njengoba kugunyazwa yi-SAQA. Kubalulekile ukuba unamaphakathi amathathu eNkathi yokubakho ekubukeni izilinganiso. Ukubhalisa kwi-SACQSP njengengcweti yokubheka izilinganiso kuyisadingo. Isitifikedi sokushayela esivunyelwe, okwanye babantu abanesikhindi sethu. Isiko sobuchwepheshe: I-Picture yomqondo ongumonamusi. Amasiko kanye nokuqonda imithetho. Ucwaningo kanye nokuthuthukiswa. Ukusetshenziswa kwekhompyutha ekwenzeni amasu. Ulwazi nokuqonda imithetho ehleziwe. Ukubhala imibiko yezobuchwepheshe. Inceshe emcwaningweni w ezobuchwepheshe. Ukudalwa kwezinkalo eziphakeme. Isipho sokuzicabangela. Ukwaziswa kwezinto eziningi. Izindlela eziyinhloko: Ukwenza izinqumo, ukuyala iqembu, izindlela zokuhlaziya, ukudala okusha, ukuzibusa ngokwenu, ukuqasha izimali, ukubheka ngogwayi kanye nokusabela kubantu, ukuxhumana, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuhlela, ukuphathwa kwezixuku, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nohlaziyo nokuphathwa kwabantu. Ukushintsha kwezinto kanye nokubumba okusha.
zu.duties: Zenza imisebenzi yokubheka izilinganiso kwakhiwa, izakhiwo noma izikhungo. Hlanganisa iqembu labacwaningi ngakho konke okuphatelene nokubheka izilinganiso. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa amazinga okuncqoba izilinganiso. Nikeza izeluleko mayelana nokubheka izilinganiso kanye nenkethalo yezobuchwepheshe ekuhloleni izindleko. Qinisekisa ukuthi ziyasetshenziswa izindlela zezobuchwepheshe kanye nobuchwepheshe. Buthula izinqubomgomo, izindlela kanye namaphrothokholi ahlobene nokubheka izilinganiso. Nikeza izisombululo kungahlonishwa ekuncqobeni izilinganiso. Phinda ubuke izinkomba zendlalo yamaphrojekthi kanye nezigqibo ezenziwe yizakhiwo kwakhiwa nabasebenza abangaphansi kwesikhundla sabacwaningi abaziwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa izidingo zokubhalisa ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yabantu: Qeqesha, fundisa futhi uthuthukise abantu abakhethele ukubheka izilinganiso kanye nasebasebenzini abahlobene nobuchwepheshe ukukhuthaza ukufudukele kwamakhono/ulwazi nokuhlonipha izimiso eziyisisekelo zokwakha kanye namakhodi ezokuziphatha. Qapha ukubheka izilinganiso kanye namaqeqesho. Yenza inqubo yokuqashelwa imigwaqo futhi ithuthuke. Isikhungo sobuqu kanye nokucohwa kwesabelo: Lawula izinsiza, hlela futhi uhlanganise okufakwayo ukuze kuqedwe lula ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa izimiso kanye nokuqashelwa emthethweni wokuthenga i-SCM kanye nokuqashisa izinsiza zempilo yabantu. Qapha futhi ulawule izindleko. Inika umbiko ezindlekweni kanye ekulethweni kwesevisi. Ucwaningo kanye nokuthuthuka: Ukuthuthuka ngokobuchwepheshe okuhamba phambili ngokwamagunya oLawuzo. Cwaninga / ufunda izinhlaka ezahlukeneyo kwi-Quantity Survey ukuze uthuthukise usizo. Xhumana nabakuzayo noma amalungu noma amakhomidi ahlobene nemikhakha yokubheka izilinganiso.

xh.title: Oqwalasela iNdleko ze-Projekthi (I-GRADE A-C)
xh.summary: Zimbekiwe isixhobo somvuzo-oxhobo esifana nokuba yi-Quantity Survey ngokwesebe leDepartment of Public Works kwakhiwo esizima ezakhiwa kulo inkqubo yendalo esisusa ukulawula iindleko ezimalunga noqwalaselo kwiprojekthi zokwakhiwa.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga asi-12 / i-Matric nangaphezulu ngokwamabanga afanelekileyo afana neNQF Level 07 kwi-Quantity Survey njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Zimbekiwe rhoqo amaxesha amathathu kwi-Quantity Survey. Ngokumgangatho ophezulu phezulu ukwaziswa kwemisebenzi yobunjiniyela. Amanqanaba amathathu kwi-Quantity Survey akhutshelwa ngokusemthethweni eMzantsi Afrika. Iprole inemfuno yokuba ngummeli webhanki eqinisekiswe ngokumthethweni ezakhelwe ngokutsha.
xh.duties: Zenza imisebenzi yokuqonda ubungakanani kwakhiwo, izakhiwo okanye iziseko. Qhoboshela iqela labangcali kuzo zonke iindawo ezimalunga noqondo lobungakanani. Qinisekisa ukuzithobela kwemigaqo yokuqonda ubungakanani. Nikeza ingcebiso ngokuqonda ubungakanani ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekulinganiseleni iindleko. Qinisekisa ukuthathwa kweenkqubo zobuchwepheshe nomgangatho. Phuhlisa iinkqubo, iindlela namaziko ahlobene noqondo lobungakanani. Nikeza isisombulu ekungazithobelweni kwemigaqo yokuqonda ubungakanani. Phinda uhlolo uqondo lweindleko zemiproje nokuqikeqela okwenziwe ngabakhangi bezakhiwo nabo/basebenza ngaphantsi kwabangcali. Qinisekisa ukuzithobela iimfuno zokubhalisa njengomcalu. Ukuphuhlisa abantu: Khokela, lungisa aze aphuhlise abakhandi kokuqonda ubungakanani nabasebenzi abahlobene nobuchwepheshe nolawulo ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kolwazi/ amakhono nokuzithobela iinkqubo ezilungileyo zokwakhiwa nemiqathango yokwenza. Qaphela imisebenzi neenkqubo zokuqonda ubungakanani. Lawula ulawulo lokusebenza kolunye noMvuzo. Lolawulo lofiso nokuqokelela iingcombiso: Lawula izixhobo, lungisa uze uqokelele iingcombiso ukuze kulawulwe ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo. Qinisekisa ukuzithobela iingqungumbutho nemiqathango yokuthenga iSCM nolawulo lwabantu abasebenlayo. Qwalasela ulawula iindleko. Xela ngeindleko nokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo. Uphononongo nentembuxelo: Ukuphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo njengomcalu ngokwemigaqo yesikhululeli. Uphononongo/ imibhalo ngokuqonda ubungakanani ukuphucula ubuchwepheshe. Thetha nemiqathango/ amakhomiti ahlobene noqondo lobungakanani.

jobs.title: Architect (GRADE A-C)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R791 604.per annum Grade B: R900 957.per annum Grade C: R1015 071 per annum (to be structured according to Individual needs). The Department will determine the salary package based on years of experience post professional registration)
jobs.summary: Architect sought by Limpopo Department of Public Works to perform architectural activities on state buildings, co-ordinate professional teams and provide technical support at Head Office in Polokwane.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric and a qualification at NQF level 07 in Architecture as recognized by South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Three (03) years post qualification experience in Architectural is required. Compulsory registration with South African Council for the Architectural Profession (SACAP) as a professional Architect. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Technical Competencies: Programme and project management. Technical report writing. Architectural design and analysis knowledge. Computer-aided engineering applications. Research and development. Knowledge of legal compliance. Creating high performance culture. Networking. Professional judgement. Generic Competencies: Decision making Team leadership Analytical skills Creativity Self - management Financial management Customer focus and responsiveness Communication Computer Literacy Planning and organising Conflict Management Problem solving and analysis People management Change Management Innovation.
jobs.duties: Perform architectural activities on state owned or leased buildings, structures or facilities: Co-ordinate professional team on all aspects regarding architecture. Ensure adherence and compliance with legal, safety, and health requirements. Provide architectural advice and technical support in the evaluation of solutions. Ensure the adoption of technical and quality strategies. Develop architectural related policies, methods and practices. Provide solution on non-compliance and failure of designs. Review plans, drawings, specifications and estimates accomplished by building designs and/or sub- designs and/or sub-professional personnel. Ensure adherence to the requirements of professional registration. Human capital development: Mentor, train and develop candidate architects and related technical and administrative personnel to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound architectural principles and code of practice. Supervise architectural work and processes. Administer performance management and development. Office administration and budget planning: Manage resources, prepare and consolidate input for the facilitation of resource utilization. Ensure adherence to regulations and procedures for procurement SCM and human resource administration. Monitor and control expenditure. Report on expenditure and service delivery. Research and development: Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research/literature studies on architecture to improve expertise. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on architectural related matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Hanyane NP, Mr. Moabelo MJ, Ms. Motsai S Tel No: (015) 284 7586/7627/7262.

jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. af.title: Argitek (GRAAD A-C)
af.summary: Argitek gesoek deur Limpopo Department of Public Works om argitektoniese aktiwiteite op staatsgeboue uit te voer, professionele spanne te koördineer en tegniese ondersteuning by Hoofkantoor in Polokwane te verskaf.
af.requirements: Graad 12/ Matriek en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 07 in Argitektuur soos erken deur die South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Drie (03) jaar postkwalifikasie-ervaring in Argitektuur word vereis. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Council for the Architectural Profession (SACAP) as 'n professionele Argitek. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuur. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Kennis van argitektoniese ontwerp en ontleding. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Kennis van regslyne nakoming. Skep van 'n hoë prestasiekultuur. Netwerk bou. Professionele oordeel. Algemene Bevoegdhede: Besluitneming Spanleierskap Analitiese vaardighede Kreatiwiteit Selfbestuur Finansiële bestuur Klantefokus en reaksievermoë Kommunikasie Rekenaarvaardigheid Beplanning en organisering Konflikbestuur Probleemoplossing en ontleding Menslikehulpbronbestuur Veranderingsbestuur Innovasie.
af.duties: Voer argitektoniese aktiwiteite uit op staatsbesitte of gehuurde geboue, strukture of fasiliteite: Koördineer professionele span oor alle aspekte rakende argitektuur. Verseker nakoming van en voldoenning aan regs-, veiligheids- en gesondheidsvereistes. Verskaf argitektoniese advies en tegniese ondersteuning by die evaluering van oplossings. Verseker die toepassing van tegniese en gehaltestrategieë. Ontwikkel argitektuurverwante beleide, metodes en praktyke. Verskaf oplossing vir nie-nakoming en faling van ontwerpe. Hersien planne, tekeninge, spesifikasies en skattings wat deur gebouontwerpe en/of subontwerpe en/of subprofessionele personeel gedoen is. Verseker nakoming van die vereistes van professionele registrasie. Menslikekapitaalontwikkeling: Mentor, oplei en ontwikkel kandidaatargitekte en verwante tegniese en administratiewe personeel om vaardigheids/kennisoordrag en nakoming van deeglike argitektoniese beginsels en praktykkode te bevorder. Hou toesig oor argitektoniese werk en prosesse. Administreer prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling. Kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning: Bestuur hulpbronne, berei voor en konsolideer insette vir die fasilitering van hulpbronbenutting. Verseker nakoming van regulasies en prosedures vir verkryging SCM en menslikehulpbronadministrasie. Monitor en beheer uitgawes. Rapporteer oor uitgawes en dienslewering. Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor argitektuur om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor argitektuurverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Umakhiwezinhlelo (IZIBALO A-C)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umakhiwezinhlelo esikhungweni Limpopo Department of Public Works ukuba enze imisebenzi yokwakha ezakhiweni zahulumeni, ahlanganise iqembu labasebenzi bachwebeki, anike inkuseleko ngokwamandla e Head Office e Polokwane.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/ Matric kanye nesifundo esingeni NQF level 07 kokwakha njengokuqashelwa yi South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Kudingeka ubeminyaka emithathu (03) weminyaka yokusebenza emumva kokuthola isifundo kokwakha. Ukubhaliswa okuyingxenye e South African Council for the Architectural Profession (SACAP) njengomakhiwezinhlelo oyingcweti. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, ngaphandle kwabo abaphila nokhubazekile. Amandla okusebenza ngobuchwepheshe: Ulawulo lwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokwakha kanye nokuhlaziya. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ngokwegumbi elikhombisa imiphumela ngokwekhompyutha. Ukuqhenya nentuthuko. Ulwazi ngokuzelelwa ngomthetho. Ukudala isiko eliveza impumelelo ephezulu. Ukuxhumanisa. Isahlulelo sezingcweti. Amandla ajwayelekile: Ukwenza izinqumo. Ubuchwepheshe bokuhola iqembu. Amandla okuhlaziya. Ukudalwa kwamagugu. Iziphathimandla - ukuzilawula. Ukulawula izimali. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokusabela. Ukuthumela imiyalezo. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlanganisa. Ukuphathwa kwezinxunguphano. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Ukuphathwa koshintsho. Ukubungaza okusha.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokwakha ezakhiweni, izakhiwo noma izindawo zikahulumeni noma eziqashiwe: Hlanganisa iqembu labachwebeki kuzo zonke izindikimaba ezithinta ukwakha. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kanye nokuzalisekiswa kwezidingo zomthetho, okokulondolozwa, kanye nezempilo. Nikeza izeluleko zokwakha kanye nenkuseleko ngokwamandla ekuhlaziyeni izixazululo. Qinisekisa ukuthathwa kwezindlela zokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe kanye nenhla. Hluza izindlela, imidwebo, izindinganiso kanye nokubalwa kwentengo ezedlule ekuqondweni kwemikhiqizo kanye/noma izingxenye ezisezansi kanye/noma basebenzi abangezingcweti. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezidingo zokubhaliswa kwezingcweti. Intuthuko yamandla abantu: Qoqa, qeqesha futhi athuthukise abakhiwezinhlelo abafuna ukuba yizingcweti kanye nabeluleki abasebenza ngokobuchwepheshe kanye nabaphathi ukuthuthukisa ukudluliselwa kwamandla/ulwazi kanye nokuzelelwa kwezimiso ezihle zokwakha nokuqonda isiko lokusebenza. Qaphela imisebenzi kanye nenqubomgomo yokwakha. Phatha ulawulo lwemisebenzi kanye nentuthuko. Ukuphathwa kwehhovisi kanye nokuhlela isabelo: Lawula izinsiza, lungiselela futhi uhlanganise okufakwayo ukuze kusize ekusetshenzisweni kwezinsiza. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezimiso kanye nenqubomgomo yokuqasha i-SCM kanye nokuqashwa kwabasebenzi. Buka kanye nokulawula ukusebenziswa kwemali. Yenza umbiko ngokusebenziswa kwemali kanye nokuqashiswa kwemisebenzi. Ukuqhenya nentuthuko: Ukuba khona entuthukweni ezingcweti ukugcina isifundo ngezimiso ezintsha nangendlela ezintsha zokwenza imisebenzi. Ukuqhenya/ukufunda emibhalweni ngokwakhe ukuthuthukisa amandla. Xhumana nemibhali/amakhansela ahlobene ngokwakha.

xh.title: Umakwethu wezakhiwo (GRADE A-C)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umakwethu wezakhiwo kwisebe leZempilo zeLuntu kwisebe leRhuqo laseLimpopo ukuba azenze imisebenzi eyahlukahlukene yezakhiwo kwiNdlu zeLuntu, acwangcise iqela labasebenzi abangcali abanobuchwepheshe, anike inkxaso yobuchwepheshe eNdwaweni enkulu ePolokwane.
xh.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric kunye nethungelwano kumgangatho NQF level 07 kwindawo yezakhiwo njengoko kavunywa yiSouth African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Kufuneka kubekho eminye iminyaka emithathu (03) yamava emva kokufumana ithungelwano kwindawo yezakhiwo. Kufuneka kubekho ukuwangqinelana ngokumthethweni ngesiNdikithwa saseMzantsi Afrika saboMmandla weSakhiwo (SACAP) njengomakwethu wezakhiwo onobuchwepheshe. Ifayidweka yokuqhuba efezekileyo, ngaphandle kwabo bakhubazekileyo. Amandla obuchwepheshe obuqhelanayo: Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphrojekthi. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngokuyila nokuhlalutya izakhiwo. Iinkqubo zokusebenzisa iikhompyutha kumsebenzi wokwakha. Uphando nophuhliso. Ulwazi ngokuthobela imithetho. Ukudala inkqubo yomsebenzi osezulu. Unxibelelwano. Isigqibo sobuchwepheshe. Amandla angagqibekanga: Ukwenza isigqibo. Intsimi yolawulo lweqela. Amandla okuhlalutya. Ukudala. Ukuqamba. Ukuqonda. Ulawulo lweemali. Ukuqwalasela kakhulu abathengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha. Uplani nokucwangcisa. Ulawulo lweengxaki. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela. Ulawulo labantu. Ulawulo lokushintsha. Ukuba nobuchwephesha obutsha.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yezakhiwo kwiNdlu zeLuntu noma iindlu eziqashiweyo, iindlu, izakhiwo nendawo zokusebenzela: Cwangcisa iqela labasebenzi abangcali kuzo zonke iindawo ezimalunga nezakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela nokuhambelana nemfuno yomthetho, yokhuseleko, nempilo. Nikeza igazetha yezakhiwo nenkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekubhenyeni iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukubambelela kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo zezobugcisa nobuchwepheshe. Phuhlisa iindpulisim, iindlela nemisebenzi ephathelene nezakhiwo. Nika iindlela zokusombulula iingxaki zokungabambelela nobungamaxhathu. Phinda ubone iiplani, izixhobo zokusika, iimfuno nokuqwalasela izixa ezifunekayo kwizakhiwo ezikwiinkqubo zokwakha. Qinisekisa ukubambelela kumagazetha obuchwepheshe bokwangqinelana nemithetho. Ulwazi oluphathelele kwindawo yomntu efunekayo: Yala, khulisa nophuhlisa abaMakwethu abangagqibekanga nabantu abangenamava kwindawo yezakhiwo ukwazi ukudlulisa ulwazi nokuthobela iindlela ezisezleni nengcinga-mthetho. Lilise imisebenzi nendlela yomsebenzi wokwakha. Lawula inkqubo yokwenza nokuphuhlisa umsebenzi. Lawula imisebenzi yofiso noplani wemali: Lawula izixhobo, lungisa nikuba ndege izinto ezifunekayo zokusetyenziswa kwemisebenzi ehlukene ezokwenza lula umsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukusukuma kwemithetho nemigaqo ekuthengeni iinkqubo kunye nolawulo lwemisebenzi yamadoda. Lilise ulawulo lokuhlawulela imali. Nikela iingxelo ngeemali ezize kwaye ezisebenzayo ekwenzwa kumsebenzi. Ulwazi olutsha nophuhliso: Kufuneka kuqhubeke umba wokulolongwa ngobuchwepheshe ukwazi ukuba nalwazi olutsha kakhulu nendlela entsha yokusebenza. Yenza uphando nolwazi oluphathelele kwizakhiwo ukuphucula ulwazi lo msebenzi. Thethathathani ngeziko elibalulekileyo nongamnkqhagamshelwano malunga nemiba ephathelene nendawo yokwakha.

jobs.summary: Chief Artisan position in Malamulele requiring a Carpentry Trade Test Certificate and ten years post-qualification experience, offering R499 470 per annum with OSD.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate Trade Test Certificate in Carpentry. Ten years post qualification experience as an Artisan/ Artisan Foreman. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Technical Competencies: Project Management, Technical Design and analysis, Computer aided technical applications, Legal compliance, technical report writing, technical Consulting, Production, process knowledge and skills. Generic Competencies: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Teamwork. Creativity. Change Management. Financial Management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. Planning and organising.
jobs.duties: Manage Technical Services: Manage technical services and support in conjunction with Technicians/Artisans and associates in field, workshop and technical office activities. Ensure the promotion of safety in line with statutory regulatory requirements. Provide inputs into existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Ensure Quality assurance in line with specifications. Manage administrative and related functions: Provide inputs in the budgeting process. Compile and submit reports as required. Provide and consolidate inputs to the technical operational plan. Update database. Manage artisans and related personnel and assets. Financial Management: Control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Manage the commercial value add of the discipline related activities and services. People management: Manage the development, motivation and utilization of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of technical services according to organizational needs and requirement. Manage subordinate: Key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives. Maintain and advance expertise: Continuous individual development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research/literature studies on technical/ engineering technology to improve expertise. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on technical/engineering-related matters.

af.title: Hoofambagsman Graad Verwysing NO: S.4/3/2/91
af.summary: Hoofambagsmanpos in Malamulele wat 'n Ambagsmanne-toetssertifikaat in Skrynwerk en tien jaar se kwalifikasie-ervare ondervinding vereis, wat R499 470 per jaar met OSD bied.
af.requirements: Toepaslike toetssertifikaat in Skrynwerk. Tien jaar se kwalifikasie-ervare ondervinding as 'n Ambagsman/Ambagsman-voorman. Geldige bestuurderlisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Projektbestuur, Tegniese ontwerp en ontleding, Rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings, Regsgevolglikheid, tegniese verslagskrywing, tegniese konsultasie, Produksie, proseskennis en -vaardighede. Generiese bevoegdhede: Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanwerk. Kreatiwiteit. Veranderingsbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Klienfokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Bestuur Tegniese Dienste: Bestuur tegniese dienste en ondersteuning in samewerking met Tegnici/Ambagsmanne en medewerkers in veld-, werkswinkel- en tegniese kantooraktiwiteite. Verseker die bevordering van veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre reguleringsvereistes. Verskaf insette tot bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Verseker gehalteversekering in ooreenstemming met spesifikasies. Bestuur administratiewe en verwante funksies: Verskaf insette in die begrotingsproses. Stel verslae op en dien dit soos vereis in. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese operasionele plan. Dateer databasis op. Bestuur ambagsmanne en verwante personeel en bates. Finansiële bestuur: Beheer en monitor bestedingsvolgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissipline-verwante aktiwiteite en dienste. Mensebestuur: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om bekwame kennisbasis te verseker vir die voortgesette sukses van tegniese dienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes. Bestuur ondergeskiktes: Sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik. Onderhou en bevorder kundigheid: Deurlopende individuele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese/ingenieurstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor tegniese/ingenieurs-verwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: IChief Artisan Grade Aref NO: S.4/3/2/91
zu.summary: Isikhundla seChief Artisan eMalamulele esidinga iCarpentry Trade Test Certificate namava eminyaka eyishumi emva kokuthola isikhwalifikheshini, sinikeza iR499 470 ngonyaka ne-OSD.
zu.requirements: I-Trade Test Certificate efanelekile kwiCarpentry. Amava eminyaka eyishumi emva kokuthola isikhwalifikheshini njengoArtisan/ Artisan Foreman. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, ngaphandle kwabafaki abanesikhohlabelele. Ikhompedensi yobuchwepheshe: Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, Ukudiza ubuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya, Izinhlelo zomshini ezisekelwa kukhompyutha, Ukuzinza ngokomthetho, ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe, Izingcingo zobuchwepheshe, Ukukhiqiza, ulwazi kanye namakhono enqubo. Ikhompedensi evamile: Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengqembu. Ukudala. Ukuphatha inguquko. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuqala komthengi kanye nokusabela. Ukuxhumana. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukucubungula kanye nokuhlela.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsiza zobuchwepheshe: Phatha izinsiza kanye nokuwesekela ngokubambisana namaTechnician/Artisan kanye nabahlobene emsebenzini wensimini, kwiworkshop nasezinhlelweni zohhovu lobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuphepha ngokuvumana nezidingo zomthetho ezibalulekile. Nikeza izimfundo kumanuwali obuchwepheshe abakhona, izithombe eziyisindingisi kanye nokuqhuba okuvamile ukuze kufakwe ubuchwepheshe obusha. Qinisekisa ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi ngokuvumana nezinkomba ezidingekile. Phatha imisebenzi yocuphatho kanye neminye emihlobene: Nikeza izimfundo enqubweni yokwenza ibhajethi. Qamba futhi uhambise imibibo njengoba kudingekile. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise izimfuneko ohlelweni lokuqhuba kobuchwepheshe. Buyisela idathabhesi. Phatha abaArtisan kanye nabasebenzi abahlobene kanye nempahla. Ukuphatha imali: Lawula futhi qaphela ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwebhajethi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kwekhashi elihamba kahle. Phatha inani lezentengiso lemisebenzi eholelayo kanye nesevisi. Ukuphatha abantu: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhuthazwa kanye ne ukusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi abantu kule ndima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwaziswa okukhokhelwa kahle kokuphumelela okuqhubekayo kwezinsiza zobuchwepheshe ngokwezidingo kanye nezidingo zenhlangano. Phatha abaphansi: Izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza ngokusetha kanye nokuqaphela amazinga okusebenza bese uthatha izinyathelo zokuqondisa ukwehluka ukuze kufinyelelwe ezinhlosweni zomnyango. Gcina futhiuthuthukise ukukhokhelwa: Ukuthuthukiswa komuntu ngamunye okuqhubekayo ukuze kugcinwe isivakashi sobuchwepheshe obusha kanye neziqhubo. Ucwaningo/izifundo zolwazi kobuchwepheshe/ ubuchwepheshe bokunquma ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhokhelwa. Xhumana namabhodi/khonsidi ahlobene ngemibuzo yobuchwepheshe/bokunquma.

xh.title: Nobumba weNyanga weGadi A: S.4/3/2/91
xh.summary: Isithuba sobunkosi wophando obungengamathemba kwindawo evela kwiphondo, sifuna isatifikethi sobugcisa bokulungiselela indawo yokusebenza kunye neminyaka elishumi yamava emva kokugqiba isidanga, sinika R499 470 ngonyaka kunye ne-OSD.
xh.requirements:
Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sokubhaliswa kobugcisa ekuVekiweni. Iminyaka elishumi yamava emva kokugqiba isidanga njengengcali yobuchwepheshe/ Umdedeli wabachwepheshe. Iilesensei yokushayela, ngaphandle kwezicelo zabantu abanokuphila ukungagqibeli. Iimpawu zobugcisa bokuchwepheshe: Ulawulo loPhando, Ukuzoba okunobugcisa nokukhupha iziphumo, izicelo zobugcisa eziqulunqwe ngekhompyutha, ukuhambelana nomthetho, ukubhala iingxelo ngokobugcisa, iingcali ekujoliswe kuzo yobugcisa, ulenziwa, ulwazi nolwazi lweenkqubo. Iimpawu eziqhingqiweyo: Iindlela ezisombulula izibuxo kwaye zityhile.

Ukwenza isigqibo.

Ukusebenza njengam.

Ukulunga ngeengcamango.

ULawulo lokuguqula.

ULawulo lwemali.

Ukuqwalasela kubathengi nokuqhama impendulo.

Unxibelelwano.

Amakhono ekhompyutha.

Ukucwangcisa kwaye uhlele.
xh.duties:
Lawula Iinkonzo EziNgummandla: Lawula iinkonzo ezingezelelwe kunye nenz oko zikwabanikezela ngokusekwa ngeengcali zobuchwepheshe kunye namaphakathi efilithi, kwinkonzo yokusebenza okanye kwindawo yomsebenzi wothutho eya kuthotho.

Qinisekisa ukuthuthwa kokhuseleko ngokumelana nemfuneko yomthetho kabanjwa ngemigaqo.

Nika izigqibo kwimiveliso yokwakhiwa ngokobugcisa, imiwezo eyisulungeki nokusebenza okungathathwa ngokwezinye iindlela ukuze kufakelwe kusetyenziswa iindlela ezintsha zobugcisa.

Qinisekisa ukomelela komgangatho ngokumelana neenkcazelo ezichaziweyo.

Lawula izinto ezingezelo kunye nokwenza okusesikweni: Nika izigqibo kwinkqubo yokwenza isqwembe.

Qamba kwaye uzinike iingxelo njengoko kufuneka.

Nika kwaye udibanise izigqibo kwisicwangciso sezemisebenzi yothutho.

Hlaziya isiseko seengcombolo.

Lawula abachwepheshe bobugcisa kunye neentsapho zomsebenzi nokwabiwa kwemisebenzi.

UkuLawula kwemali: Lawula kwaye ulawule ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwesqwembe ukuya kuthi kugqinywe kwingcalo yokulawula imali.

Lawula isixhobo sokuthengisa kwemisebenzi eqondene nophando, inkqubo namakhono.

UkuLawula abantu: Lawula ukuphuhliswa, ukukhuthazwa nokusetyenziswa kweemfuno zabantu kwicala ukuze kugqinywe ukulunga kolwazi ukuze kugqinywe kwindalo ephumelelayo yeenkonzo ezizezelo ngokwemfuneko ezifunwa ngumbutho.

Lawula abaphansi ngokwamaphawu: Ndawoni ekubalulekileyo ngokumisela nokukhokelela iindlela ezibekiweyo ngaphezulu komsebenzi wakho, ukuba neenzo zokulungisa ezingangenanga kwiindawo ezibekiwe ukuze kugqinywe iinjongo zesebe.

Sigcine kwaye siphuhlise amakhono obungcali: Ukuphuhliswa ngokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi yomntu nyeni ukugcina inqanaba eliya kwindlela ezintsha ezikwinkqubo nabakwinkonzo yophando.

Uphononongo lweenkcazelo ngokwobugcisa ukugcina ubuchwepheshe.

Qhagamshelana nabathile abachwephesha/abakwikomkhulu ngakumbi iindaba ezizidibanisa nobugcisa bokwakha.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Acquisition Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Manage procurement planning, demand management and acquisition processes for the Department of Public Works in the Mopani district of Limpopo.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric and a qualification at NQF Level 7 as recognised by SAQA in Supply Chain Management Three (3) years’ experience at supervisory level / Supply Chain Officer / Admin Officer in Supply Chain Management environment. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Treasury Regulations. Knowledge and understanding of the following: Supply Chain Management procedures. Procurement Procedures. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Problem solving and analysis Decision making Team leadership Creativity Financial management Customer focus and responsiveness Communication Computer skills People management Planning and organising.
jobs.duties: Manage the district demand for goods and services. Manage the development of the procurement plan. Facilitate the approval of procurement plan. Communicate the procurement plan. Monitor that goods and services is rendered according to the procurement plan. Monitor the compilation of budget projection as per the district needs analysis. Monitor the procurement of goods and services in line with the procurement plan. Advice on the performance of procurement in line with the plan. Manage the acquisition of goods and services: Provide and implement supply chain management policy, strategies and processes. Manage the acquisition of goods and service as per the transversal contract. Provide and consolidate requests for invitation of quotation. Verify and advice on specifications for goods and services. Analyse the received quotation. Issue purchase order. Provide approval of received goods as per the specification. Provide BEC secretariat. Monitor the implementation of guidelines for appointment of bids evaluation committee. Facilitate the appointment of BEC members. Facilitate logistical arrangements for BEC meetings. Provide secretariat function to the BEC. Monitor the implementation of BEC. Provide bids evaluation: Facilitate and monitor evaluation of bids and quotations. Develop and define processes for bids evaluation. Monitor adherence to advertised criteria in the evaluation process. Facilitate and verify captured information for all bids and quotations. Prepare an evaluation report- submission. Facilitate the clearance of the successful bidders. Customise and implement any changes on standard evaluation criteria. Provide Suppliers database: Facilitate registration of supplier database. Monitor and liaise with CIDB about professionals/ contractor’s information. Monitor the process of verifying supplier and professional. Manage resource (Human, Financial and Equipment): Monitor and report on the utilisation of equipment’s. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage discipline. Provide job description to subordinates. Manage division leave matters.
jobs.enquiries: For Sekhukhune: Ms Makalela RC, Mankge LJ and Mr Mathabatha MJ Tel No (015) 636 8300/8330. For Mopani: Mr P Malesa, Ms KS Mabunda, Ms P Bila Tel No: (015) 811 4000/4070/4075

Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. The application on eRecruitment system should be accompanied by recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates) as well as copies of all qualifications, Identity Document and valid driver’s license only. Failure to attach copies and required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualification.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Verwerwingsbestuur
af.summary: Bestuur voorzieningsbeplanning, aanvraagbestuur en verwerwingsprosesse vir die Department of Public Works in die Mopani-distrik van Limpopo.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matriek en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken in Supply Chain Management. Drie (3) jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak / Supply Chain Officer / Admin Officer in 'n Supply Chain Management-omgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van toepaslike Public Service Acts, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsanalise, ontwikkeling en interpretasie. Treasury Regulations. Kennis en begrip van die volgende: Supply Chain Management-prosedures. Verwerwingsprosedures. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Menslike bestuur. Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Bestuur die distriksaanvraag vir goedere en dienste. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van die voorsieningsplan. Fasiliteer die goedkeuring van die voorsieningsplan. Kommunikeer die voorsieningsplan. Monitor dat goedere en dienste gelewer word volgens die voorsieningsplan. Monitor die samestelling van begrotingsprojeksies volgens die distriksbehoeftesontleding. Monitor die verkryging van goedere en dienste in ooreenstemming met die voorsieningsplan. Adviseer oor die prestasie van verkryging in ooreenstemming met die plan. Bestuur die verwerwing van goedere en dienste: Verskaf en implementeer supply chain management-beleid, strategieë en prosesse. Bestuur die verkryging van goedere en dienste volgens die transversale kontrak. Verskaf en konsolideer versoeke vir uitnodiging van kwotasies. Verifieer en adviseer oor spesifikasies vir goedere en dienste. Analiseer die ontvangde kwotasies. Uitreik van bestelorders. Verskaf goedkeuring van ontvangde goedere volgens die spesifikasie. Verskaf BEC-sekretariaat. Monitor die implementering van riglyne vir die aanstelling van 'n bod-evalueringskomitee. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van BEC-lede. Fasiliteer logistiese reëlings vir BEC-vergaderings. Verskaf sekretariaatfunksies aan die BEC. Monitor die implementering van die BEC. Verskaf bod-evaluering: Fasiliteer en monitor die evaluering van bodde en kwotasies. Ontwikkel en definieer prosesse vir bod-evaluering. Monitor voldoening aan geadverteerde kriteria in die evalueringsproses. Fasiliteer en verifieer vasgelêe inligting vir alle bodde en kwotasies. Berei 'n evalueringsverslag-voorlegging voor. Fasiliteer die skikking van suksesvolle bieër. Pas aan en implementeer enige veranderings aan standaard evalueringskriteria. Verskaf verskaffersdatabasis: Fasiliteer registrasie van verskaffersdatabasis. Monitor en skakel met CIDB oor inligting oor professionele persone / kontrakteurs. Monitor die proses om verskaffers en professionele persone te verifieer. Bestuur hulpbronne (menslik, finansieel en toerusting): Monitor en rapporteer oor die benutting van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en beoordeling van werknemers. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Verbeter en behou werknemersmotivering en kweek 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur dissipline. Verskaf posbeskrywings aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur afdeling se verlof-sake.

zu.title: Umncedi weNqola: UkuPhathwa koKutholwa
zu.summary: Phatha ukuhlelelwa kokuthenga, ukuPhathwa kwesidingo nemicimbe yokuthola okuthengiswayo koMnyango wezeMisebenzi eRhovamenti kusifunda saka Mopani eLimpopo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/ i-Matric nemitshingo yemfundo ezingeni le-NQF Level 7 njengoba kunikwa isiqiniseko yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management. Ubudlule iminyaka emithathu (3) osebenza ezingeni lokubhekwa / njengonogada we-Supply Chain / njengenkokheli yezokongwa kwindawo ye-Supply Chain Management. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni, ngaphandle kwabo bakhubazekile abafaka izicelo. Ulwazi Nobuqotho: Ulwazi ngemithetho, izimiso namakhulu ohlelo oluhlobene noMsebenzi woWonke. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlaziya, ukwakha nokuhlaga imigomo. Izimiso zeTreasury. Ulwazi nokuqonda kokulandelayo: Inqubo ye-Supply Chain Management. Inqubo yokuthenga. I-PFMA. I-DORA. I-PPPFA. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukubhekwa phambili kwethimba. Ubuciko. UkuPhathwa kwezimali. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Izindlela zokusebenzela ikhompuyutha. UkuPhathwa kwabantu. Ukuhlela nokuqamba.
zu.duties: Phatha isidingo sesifunda sezimpahla nezinsiza. Phatha ukwakhiwa kohlelo lokuthenga. Yisa esigabeni sokugunyazwa kohlelo lokuthenga. Yazisa uhlelo lokuthenga. Qaphela ukuthi izimpahla nezinsiza zihlolwa ngokuhambisana nohlelo lokuthenga. Qaphela ukuqoqwa kokubikezelwa kwezimali ngokuya nokuhlaziwa izidingo zesifunda. Qaphela ukuthengwa izimpahla nezinsiza ngokuhambisana nohlelo lokuthenga. Nikela iseluleko ngemisebenzi yokuthenga ngokuhambisana nohlelo. Phatha ukutholwa kwezimpahla nezinsiza: Nikeza futhi usebenzise imigomo, amasu nemicimbe ye-Supply Chain Management. Phatha ukutholwa izimpahla nezinsiza ngokuya ngesivumelwano esivundlile. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise izicelo zokumema ukubikezelwa. Qinisekisa futhi uphathe iseluleko mayelana nezinkinganiso zezimpahla nezinsiza. Hlaziya izibikezelo ezitholiwe. Khishwa umyalo wokuthenga. Nikeza isigunyazilo sezimpahla ezitholiwe ngokuya ngezinkinganiso. Nikeza isikhungo sokubhala phansi se-BEC. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kwezinqwayi zokuqasha ikomidi lokuhlola izibidingo. Yisa esigabeni ukuqashwa kwamalungu e-BEC. Lungiselela izinhlela zokulogistika izehla ezinkundleni ze-BEC. Phatha umsebenzi wokubhala phansi kwe-BEC. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kwe-BEC. Nikeza ukuhlolwa kwezibidingo: Yisa esigabeni futhi uqaphele ukuhlolwa kwezibidingo nezibikezelo. Yakha futhi ucacise izinqubo zokuhlola izibidingo. Qaphela ukuzinikela ezinkinganisweni ezibikiwe kuleyo nqubo yokuhlola. Yisa esigabeni futhi qinisekise ulwazi olubhalwe ngayo yonke imibhalo yezibidingo nezibikezelo. Hlela umbiko wokuhlola- okuwethulwayo. Yisa esigabeni ukusula igama labo baphumelele. Lungisa futhi usebenzise nanoma yimaphi inguquko ezinkinganisweni ezivamile zokuhlola. Nikeza isisekelo sezinsiza: Yisa esigabeni ukubhaliswa kwesisekelo sezinsiza. Qaphela futhi uxhumane ne-CIDB mayelana nolwazi ngabanhumesi/ abakhiqizi. Qaphela inqubo yokuqinisekisa izinsiza nabochwepheshe. Phatha izinsiza (abantu, izimali nezixhobho): Qaphela futhi ubike ngokusetshenziswa kwezixhobho. Hlola futhi uqaphele ukusebenza nokubalwa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ikhono nentuthuko yabasebenzi. Phakamisa futhi ulondoloze ukukhuthazwa kwabasebenzi futhi uhlakaze isiko lokuPhathwa kwemisebenzi. Phatha inzondo. Nikeza incazelo yomsebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Phatha izindaba zokulibala kwesigaba.

xh.title: Umphathi ongenelwa: Ulawulo lokuQokelela iinkcukacha
xh.summary: Phatha uyilo lokuqokelela iindleko, ukulawula iindingwe nokusetyenziswa iinkqubo kwesebe lemsebenzi kaWonke linellomo kwisithili sase Mopani ellimo la Limpopo.
xh.requirements: Ireyith 12/ Isiqinisekiso kwaye nelayisensi yemoto esebenzayo, ngaphandle kwabafaka isicelo abanokuphela komzimba. Ulwazi Namageba: Ulwazi ngemithetho, imigaqo nolawulo loLuntu olufanelekileyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlolwa, ukuyila nokutolika inkqubo. Imigaqo yeNdalo yemali. Ulwazi nokuqonda oku kulandelayo: Iinkqubo zoLawulo lweqela loNxibelelwano. Iinkqubo zoQokelelo lwezinto. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuhlola Ukwenza isigqibo Ukulunga eqela Ukuyila ngeendlela ezintsha uLawulo lwemali Ukwagqibelela ngomthengi nokuPhendula Unxibelelwano Amakhono ekhompyutha uLawulo lwabantu Uyila nokuqokelela.
xh.duties: Phatha izicelo zeemveliso neezebenzi kwisithili. Phatha ukuyila kohlulo lokuqokelela iindleko. Qhubekisa phambili ukuvunywa kohlulo lokuqokelela iindleko. Yaziisa olunye uhlu lokuqokelela iindleko. Qwalasela ukuba iimveliso neenzebenzi zihlengwa ngokwehlulo lokuqokelela iindleko. Qwalasela ukuqokelelwa kolwazi olujoliswe kumgangatho weemfuno zesithili. Qwalasela ukuthengwa kweemveliso neezenzo ngokwehlulo lokuqokelela iindleko.nika ingcebiso ngemisebenzi yohlulo ngokwalo hlulo. Phatha ukufunyanwa kweemveliso neenzebenzi: Nikeza futhi usebenzise inkqubo, amacebo neenjongo zolawulo lweqela lenkxaso-mali. Phatha ukufunyanwa kweemveliso neenzebenzi ngokwesivumelwano esididiyelweyo. Qinisekisa futhi udibanise iimfuno zokumema iinxibelelwano. Qinisekisa futhi ucebise ngemilinganiselo yemveliso neenzebenzi. Chaza iinxibelelwano ezifunyenweyo. Nikeza ioda yokuthenga. Nikeza isigqibo semveliso ezifunyenwe ngokwemilinganiselo. Nikeza indima yesikrondolo kwi-BEC. Qwalasela ukusebenza kwemigaqo yokumisa iqela lokuhlolwa kweenkqubo. Qhubekisa phambili ukumiswa kwamalungu e-BEC. Qhubekisa phambili izicwangciso zokuhambelana kweendibano ze-BEC. Zenza umsebenzi wesikrondolo kwi-BEC. Qwalasela ukusebenza kwe-BEC. Nikeza ukuhlolwa kweenkqubo: Qhubekisa phambili futhi qwalasela ukuhlolwa kweenkqubo neenxibelelwano. Yakha futhi uchaze iinkqubo zokuhlola iinkqubo. Qwalasela ukulandelana kwemigaqo ebaluliweyo kwinkqubo yokuhlola. Qhubekisa phambili futhi uqinisekise ulwazi olugcinwe ngeenkqubo zonke neenxibelelwano. Lungiselela ingxelo yokuhlola- yohlwayo. Qhubekisa phambili ukucoca abaphumeleleyo. Misela futhi usebenzise naluphi na ushintsho kwimilinganiselo eqhotyoshwayo yokuhlola. Nikeza isiseko sedatha zabathengisi: Qhubekisa phambili ubhalo lwesiseko sedatha yabathengisi. Qwalasela futhi uxhumane ne-CIDB malunga nolwazi ngabachwi/ abakhiwo. Qwalasela inkqubo yokuqinisekisa umthengisi nongcali. Phatha izibonelelo (abantu, imali nezixhobo): Qwalasela futhi uchaze ngemisebenzi yezixhobo. Hlola futhi qwalasela imisebenzi nokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa amandla nentshukumo yabasebenzi. Phucula futhi zigcine iinkxaso-mali zabasebenzi futhi ulimbe inkqubo yokuqwalasela imisebenzi. Phatha isithintelo. Nikeza inkinganisela yomsebenzi kubalawuli. Phatha iindaba zeholide yesanduleli.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Logistiek en Batebestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Logistiek en Batebestuur in die Limpopo Departement of Public Works, wat toezicht hou oor voorraadbeleid, stasiebestuur en inspeksiedienste.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matriek en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 in Logistiek/Voorraadkettingbestuur soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak / Senior / Admin-offisier in 'n Logistiek/Batebestuuromgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante Openbare Diens-wette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsanalise, -ontwikkeling en -interpretasie. Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis en begrip van die volgende: - Batebestuursprosedures. Procurement Procedures: PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Probleemoplossing en ontleding Besluitneming Spanleierskap Kreatiwiteit Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë Kommunikasie Rekenaarvaardighede Mensebestuur Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Verskaf voorraad: Implementeer voorraadbeleid en -prosedures. Verskaf voorraadlewensduur. Voer voorraadinspeksiedienste uit. Ontleed inspeksieverslag. Verskaf inspeksieverslag en maak projeksies ten opsigte van die herstel van voorraad. Bestuur stasie/winkels: Voer ontleding van stasiebehoeftes uit. Verskaf die departementele behoefte-ontleding in verband met stasiebegroting. Verskaf stasieprojeksies. Monitor die distrik se voorraadbewerings en doen ontledings. Bestuur distrikswinkels. Verskaf waarskuwings oor oor/onderbesteding van stasie/winkels. Bestuur die uitreiking van winkels. Verskaf voorraadopnamedienste: Ontwikkel die distrik se voorraadopname-plan. Ontwikkel voorraadopname-prosesse. Verskaf 'n voorraadopname-span. Bestuur die aanstelling van 'n voorraadopname-span. Bestuur en voer voorraadopname uit. Konsolideer die winkelvlak. Balanseer die grootboek. Verskaf aanbevelings vir die van die hand doing van verouderde winkels. Bestuur en werk die verouderde register by. Bestuur die distrik se roerbare bates: Dra by tot die ontwerp en ontwikkeling van batebestuurstelsels, -beleid, strategiese en jaarlikse fisiese batebestuursbeplanning. Monitor en hersien die vaslegging van alle fisiese roerbare bates in die batebestuursregister. Bestuur die ontvangs van alle roerbare bates. Voer bate-kwantiteits- en gehaltebeheer uit en kontroleer ontvangde goedere. Bestuur die toekenning van voorraad en strepieskode aan bates. Bestuur die vaslegging van bate-inligting in die betrokke registers. Monitor die distrik se roerbare bates: Verskaf leiding en advies aan departementele werknemers oor batebestuursaangeleenthede. Monitor bates vir nakoming van batebeheer-voorskrifte. Monitor bates vir fisiese toestand, benuttingsfunksionaliteit en finansiële prestasie. Monitor die prestasie van bateverifikasiemet betrekking tot voorgeskryfde tydraamwerke. Stel verslae op oor die toestand van bates. Bestuur hulpbronne (Menslike, Finansiële en Toerusting): Monitor en verslag doen oor die benutting van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en beoordeling van werknemers. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Verbeter en handhaaf werknemersmotivering en kweek 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur dissipline. Verskaf werkbeskrywing aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur afdeling se verlofaangeleenthede.

xh.title: Umsekeli weNjingalwazi: uLawulo loMthwalo nokuLawulwa kwempahla
xh.summary: Umsekeli weNjingalwazi wokuLawulwa koMthwalo nokuLawulwa kwempahla kwiLimpopo Department of Public Works, elijonga iinkqubo zemithwalo yemihla, ulawulo lwamaxwebhu okusebenza nesevicini yokuhlola.
xh.requirements: I Grade 12/ Matric nentlalothu kumqondo onqanaba lwe-7 kwi-Logistics/ Supply Chain Management njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kwinqanaba labaphathi / iSenior / iAdmin Officer kwindawo yokuLawulwa koMthwalo/impahla. Ilayisensi yokuqeshisa esemthethweni, ngaphandle kweelayisensi zokuqeshisa ezisemthethweni, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abanokukhubazeka. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Ulwazi ngemithetho yolwazi lwaseburhuleni, iimithetho nemiqathango ehambisana nayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukwahlula-hlula, ukuphuhlisa nokutolika iinkqubo. Iimithetho yeTreasury. Ulwazi nokuqonda oku kulandelayo: - Iinkqubo zokuLawulwa kwempahla. Iinkqubo zokuThengwa kwempahla: i-PFMA. i-DORA. i-PPPFA. Ukuzisombulula iingxaki nokuwahlula-hlula. Ukuthatha iigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Ubuchule bokudala. uLawulo lweziimali. Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokusabela kubo. Unxibelelwano. Amanyathelo ekhompyutha. uLawulo lwabantu. uCoccoliso lolungelelwaniso.
xh.duties: Nikeza imithwalo yemihla: Zisebenzisa iinkqubo nemicimbi yemithwalo yemihla. Nikeza isiphelo sobomi somthwalo wemihla. Yenza iinsvicini zokuhola imithwalo yemihla. Hlola ingxelo yokuhola. Nikeza ingxelo yokuhola yenza ukubakubonile malunga nokuqwalaselwa kwemithwalo yemihla. Lawula amaxwebhu okusebenza/izitoro: Yenza uhlolojlo-lwazi lwemfuno yamaxwebhu okusebenza. Nikeza uhlolojlo-lwazi lweemfuno zesebe ngokwelana nemali echaziweyo yamaxwebhu okusebenza. Nikeza iingcebiso ngamaxwebhu okusebenza. Qapha imisebenzi yomthwalo yemihla yebandla yantlalo yenze uhlolojlo-lwazi. Lawula izitoro zebandla. Nikeza izilumkiso ngaphezulu/ngaphantsi kwexabiso lamaxwebhu okusebenya/izitoro. Lawula ukunikwa kwemithwalo yemihla. Nikeza iinsvicini zokubala imithwalo yemihla: Phuhlisa icebo lokubala imithwalo yemihla yebandla. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zokubala imithwalo yemihla. Nikeza iqela lokubala imithwalo yemihla. Lawula ukumiselwa kweqela lokubala imithwalo yemihla. Lawula yenze ukubala imithwalo yemihla. Gqibezela amanqanaba ezitoro. Linganisa isibali. Nikeza iingcebiso zokusetyenziswa kwezitoro ezingasetyenziswanga. Lawula yenze uvuselelo lwebhali lezinto ezingasetyenziswa. Lawula impahla ehanjwayo yebandla: Ngenisa umngeni ekuyilweni nasekuphuhliseni iinkqubo zokulawula impahla, iinkqubo, iplani yomzila wokulawulwa kwempahla yonyaka. Qapha uvavaze ukubhalwa kuyo yonke impahla ehanjwayo kwibhali lokulawulwa kwempahla. Lawula ukwamkelwa kwemithwalo yemihla yonke. Yenza ulawulo olulinganisiweyo nolwengxelo yokuhola impahla egqithiweyo. Lawula ukwabelwa kwemithwalo yemihla kunye namakhodi abhalwe ngomxhosho kwimpahla. Lawula ukubhalwa kolwazi ngemithwalo yemihla kwiibhali ezihambelanayo. Qapha impahla ehanjwayo yebandla: Nikeza izikhokelo neengcebiso kubasebenzi basebe ngemicimbi yolawulo lwempahla. Qapha impahla ukuze ihambisane nemithetho yolawulo lwempahla. Qapha imo yempahla, indlela esetshenziswa ngayo, ukusebenza kwayo nemigqaqo yeemali. Qapha ukwenziwa kolwazi ngemithwalo ngokwexesha elichaziweyo. Qamba iingxelo ngemo yemithwalo yemihla. Lawula izixhobo (Abantu, iimali nempahla): Qapha wenze ingxelo ngendlela esetshenziswa ngayo izixhobo. Linganisa qapha ukwenza kwayo nokulinganiswa kubasebenzi. Qinisekisa amandla nophuhliso lwabasebenzi. Phucula zigcine ukukhuthaza kwabasebenzi yaze ube noluntu lwenkqubo yokulinganisa ukwenza. Lawula isohlwayo. Nikeza inhlaluthe yomsebenzi kumagosa akwalo. Lawula imicimbi yokurhoxa iholide yesebe.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Hulpdienste
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Hulpdienste in Limpopo se Capricorn-distrik wat tosigting hou oor regeringsvlootbestuur, vervoervoorsiening en voertuigonderhoud op salarisvlak 9.
af.requirements: Vervoerbestuur/Openbarebestuur/Openbareadministrasie soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (03) jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak / Admin-offisier in 'n hulpdienste-omgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Openbaredienswette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsontleding, -ontwikkeling en -interpretasie. Strategiese vermoëns. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Klantefokus en reaksievermoë. Rekenaarvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Hou tosig oor die voorsiening van die distrik se regeringsbesit en gesubsidieerde motorvervoer. Fasiliteer en verskaf verkryging van departementele vloot. Hou toezig op die hernuwingsproses van lisensies. Fasiliteer die onderhoud en herstel van regeringsvoertuie. Bestuur ongelukke. Fasiliteer die van die hand doen van regeringsvoertuie. Fasiliteer die administrasie van gesubsidieerde voertuie. Hou tosig oor die voorsiening van telekommunikasiestelsels van die distrik. Fasiliteer installasies van landlyne en uitbreidings. Skakel met diensverskaffers met betrekking tot diensonderhoud en aktivering van snelbelkodes en PIN-kodes. Evalueer aansoeke vir vereiste selfone vir indiening by hoofkantoor. Ontvang goedkeuring om aan te skaf en fasiliteer die aankoop van die selfone. Hou toezig op nakoming van toegewysde lugty volgens departementele beleid. Ontleed maandelikse state van rekening en hou toezig op betalings van privaat oproepe. Hou tosig oor die voorsiening en verspreiding van arbeidsbesparende toestelle en die weggooi van afvalpapier. Skakel met diensverskaffer met betrekking tot verspreiding en onderhoud en diens van gehuurde en aangeskafte kantoormasjiene – fotostaatmasjiene en faksmasjiene. Fasiliteer bevestiging en verwerking van die fakture. Hou toezig op nakoming van diensvlakooreenkomste en adviseer hoofkantoor om te hernu of nuwe kontrakte te reël. Fasiliteer sortering en vernietiging van afvalpapier. Skakel met diensverskaffers met betrekking tot die insameling van verpakkte afvalpapier. Stel verslag op aan hoofkantoor met betrekking tot eenhede papier ingesamel en bedrag betaal. Hou tosig oor die voorsiening en verspreiding van kantoor- en huishoudelike dienste. Doen behoeftebepaling ten opsigte van vereiste aantal en tipe kantoor- en huishoudelike meubels en versprei volgens die vasgestelde norme. Bepaal en fasiliteer onderhoud en herstel van gebroke kantoor- en huishoudelike meubels. Fasiliteer die van die hand doen van oortollige of onherstelbare meubels. Doen periodieke inspeksie met betrekking tot alle meubels op voorraad geneem. Aankoop van uniforms en beskermende klere. Fasiliteer akkommodasiebehoeftes. Bestuur en benut hulpbronne (menslike, finansiële en fisiese). Rapporteer oor die benutting van toerusting. Evalueer en hou toezig op prestasie en beoordeling van ondergeskiktes. Verskaf kapasiteitsontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes. Verbeter en handhaaf ondergeskiktes se motivering en kweek 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Verskaf werkbeskrywings aan ondergeskiktes.
