Three (03) years of experience at supervisory level / Admin Officer in Auxiliary Services environment. Valid Driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Strategic capabilities. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial Management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Computer skills. People management. Planning and organizing. Conflict management.
zu.duties: Qapha ukunikezwa kwezimoto zikahulumeni ezingowohulumeni noma ezikhokhelwa ngokuncediswa esifundeni. Hola futhi unikeze ukutholwa kwamabhoyidi e-ayini enkampanini. Qapha inqubo yokubuyekeza izimalayisensi. Hola ukugcinwa nokulungiswa kwezimoto zikahulumeni. Phatha izenzo zezimoto. Hola ukulahleka kwezimoto zikahulumeni. Hola ukuphatheka kwezimoto ezinikwa ukwesekwa. Qapha ukunikezwa kwezinhlelo zoxhumano esifundeni. Hola ukufakwa kwezinto zoxhumano ngomugqa nezandiso. Xhumanisa nezinkonzo zokweminye imithwalo osemthwethelelini mayelana nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwayo, ukuvuselelwa kwesikhathi sezimalayisensi kanye nokumiswa kwezinsimbi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Hola ukugcina umkhondo wokususwa kwemikhondo yamahhovisi. Hola ukwenza i-odini yokugcina imikhondo yamahhovisi. Hola imisebenzi yokusingathwa kwemikhiqizo ebuyisa imigqa yezwi esebenzisa inethiwekhi. Hola ukumiswa kwe-imeyili nezinkomba zodaba ezingangeniswa. Hola ukumiswa kwenhlangano. Hola imisebenzi yokudluliswa kolwazi mayelana nezinsizakusebenza zamahhovisi. Cacisa imigqa yokuqondisa ngemikhondo ehlukene nasezinye izindlu. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zoxhumano. Hola ukwenza isabelo sezinsizakusebenza eziyisilinganiso kubasebenzi abaningi. Hola ukutholwa kwezinsizakusebenza zamahhovisi nezihlahla zamandla ngokugcizelela ukusebenza kolimi. Qapha ukusebenza kolimi. Hola imisebenzi esekela inqubo yokubeka imikhosi namanye amaphuzu abhalwe kumanethiwekhi ohlelo. Hola ukuba ngumxhumanisi phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuxhumanisa nenhlangano. Hola imisebenzi esekela ukugcinwa kolimi. Hola imisebenzi yokuvuselela izinsimbi zokusebenza ezihamba zisinkininingo. Hola ukubeka amaphuzu abhalwa ngokusemthethweni kumanethiwekhi. Hola ukuphatheka kwemikhiqizo eku-inthanethi. Hola ukuphathwa kolimi. Hola ukusiza ukutholwa kolimi. Hola ukusiza ekutholeni izinto zokusebenza. Hola ukuba ngusihlalo. Hola ukuba ngumqapheli kakhulu. Hola ukugcina imininingwane mayelana nokuphathwa kolimi. Hola imisebenzi yokugciza izinhlangothi zokusebenza. Hola ukugciza imiphumela yokuqinisekisa imigqa yezinkinga. Hola ukugciza imisebenzi yesikhulu esimaphakathi. Hola ukugciza iminikelo yezinkomba. Hola ukugciza imisebenzi eqinisekisa ukuphathwa kolwazi mayelana nokuqinisekiswa kolimi. Hola ukugciza ukuphatheka kwamanye amaphoyinti. Hola ukugciza ukwenziwa kolimi. Hola ukugciza imininingwane. Hola ukugciza amaphuzu. Hola ukugciza izinhlangothi. Hola ukugciza imisebenzi eyenziwayo. Hola ukugciza ukuphathwa kolimi.

xh.title: Umsekeli Wohlahlelobulumko: Iinkonzo eziNcedo
xh.summary: Umsekeli Wohlahlelobulumko: Iinkonzo eziNcedo kwisiFunda sika Capricorn e Limpopo, ezilawula ukulawulwa kolwabiwo lwezimoto zikarhulimnt, inikezelo lokuhamba nokulondolozwa kwezimoto kwinqanaba lesi-9 lomvuzo.
xh.requirements: I Degree kwindlela ePhathwayo yolwimi / Unika inkqubo ekudleni kolwimi / Inkqubo kaNyathelo kaNyathelo ukwakhiwa kwesebe layo. Indlela ephathwayo yolwimi noma unika inkqubo ekudleni kolwimi noma inkqubo kaNyathelo kaNyathelo njengoko ivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Ithathwa ngokukhawuleza ixesha (03) lamakhulu iindlela ezizakuqwalaselwa nomsebenzi wam / kunye nesebe loManyano oluyenzeka kwindawo apho kusebenza khona. Ilaisensi yokushayela esebenzayo, ngaphandle kwabo banesikhalazo ngokomzimba. I skill yomsebenzi kaNyathelo: lI Acts yolwimi eNtloko yesebe, iinkqubo zakwaNtu nemigaqo. Inkcazelo yokulunga nokuqonda ingqondo yokwenza iinkcazelo nokuvisisa nokwenza ingxelo. Iikhompha ezikwazi ukusetyenziswa. Unikezelwe ngokuqonda kwezibonelelo ezimbi kweendlela ezizakuqwalaselwa. Inkqubo yokwenza izigqibo kwinkqubo ekuqwalaselwa. Iinkqubo ezisebenzayo. Inkxaso yokulawula inkqubo eqhawukile. Inkqubo yokulawula imali. Inkqubo ekuqwalaselwa iimfuneko zabathengi kwaye iphendule ngokukhawuleza. Iinkqubo zokusebenzisa inkqubo ekudleni kolwimi. Inkqubo yokulawula abantu. Inkqubo ekuqwalaselwa nokulawula abantu. Inkqubo yokuqwalaselwa kweendlela ezizakuqwalaselwa.
xh.duties: Zengisele inikezelo lezimoto zikarhulimnt ezingamntfu kwaye zixhaswa ngemali kwicandelo lesi. Zenze kunyukele kwaye unikeze ngenkululeko lokufumana ibhetshi yesebe. Qaphela inqubo yenkqubo zokuqalisa iilayisenisi. Zenza ulondolozo nokulungiswa kwezimoto zikarhulimnt. Phatha iingozi. Zenza ukushenxiswa kwezimoto zikarhulimnt. Zenza ulawulo lwezimoto ezixhaswa ngemali. Zengisele inikezelo kweenkqubo zolonxibelelwano ezingamntfu kwesi candelo. Zenza ukufakelwa kweefowuni zamadial kwaye usasaze. Xhumana neenkampani ezinikezela iinkonzo malunga nokolondolozo lweenkonzo, ukuvuleka kwamakhol oqhubo okukhawuleza neekhowudi ze-Pin. Hlola iimfuneko zenkqubo zefowuni zasenyongweni ezifunekayo ukuze zithunyelwe kwi-ofisi eNtloko. Thola imvume yokuthenga kwaye ulawule ukuthengwa kweefowuni zasenyongweni. Qaphela ukuzithobela ekwabelweni koluxhazo lwerhafu ngokwemigaqo yesebe. Hlola iinkqubo zenyanga zee-akhawunti kwaye ulawule imali eqatywa kwiinkingo ezithile. Zengisele inikezelo nokusasazwa kweekhaphukhaphu ezigcina umsebenzi nokushenxiswa kwamaphepha alahlekileyo. Xhumana neenkampani ezinikezela iinkonzo ngokwokusasazwa, ukulondolozwa, ukusebenza kweekhaphukhaphu zofiso nesebe ezithengiweyo njengemishini zokutsala nokushicilela neefeksi. Zenza ukuvunywa kolawulo nokucutshungulwa kweefaktishi. Qaphela ukuzithobela kumigaqo esemva kwamaxa enkonzo kwaye uyale i-Ofisi eNtloko ukuba ivuse okanye ilungiselele amaxa amatsha. Zenzisa ukuhlelwa kwaye kushatuliswe amaphepha agqithiweyo. Xhumana neenkampani ezinikezela iinkonzo ukuyiwa kwamaphepha abhalelwe phantsi. Hlela ingxelo kwi-Ofisi eNtloko malunga namaphepha athunyelwe kunye nemali ekhokhwayo. Zengisele ukubonelela nokusasazwa kweenkonzo zofiso nezasekhaya. Yenza inkqubo yokupima imfuneko yexabiso nephelo lefayitha yofiso nesekhaya kwaye ulwabelwe ngokwemigaqo efunekayo. Qumba kwaye ulawule ukulondolozwa nokulungiswa kwefayitha eqhawukileyo yofiso nesekhaya. Zenza ukushenxiswa kwefayitha engasafanelekanga okanye engazange ilungiseke. Yenza oluvo olujievileyo ngefayitha yonke egciniweyo efakwe kusuku. Ukuthenga kolunxibo kwaye umhlaza wokhuselo. Zenza ulawulo ngokwemfuneko yendlal apho kuhlalwa khona. Lawula kwaye usebenzise izixhobo (abantu, nzima, kwaye ngokwephysical). Yenza ingxelo ngokusetyenziswa kweekhaphukhaphu. Hlola kwaye ulawule inkqubo yokusebenza kwaye kubekho abagcinwa kwinkqubo ezingasezantsi. Bonelela ngokusetyenzwa kolwazi kweabomntlula inkqubo ezingasezantsi. Yandisa kwaye ulondoloze inkqubo yabangasentsi kwaye upakamise inkqubo kuzo yonke imisebenzi kwaye uqinise ukusetyenziswa ngokweyure. Nikela abangasezantsi ngeenkcazelo zemisebenzi yabo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Financial Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Financial Management post in Limpopo requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and three years supervisory experience in financial management.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric and a qualification at NQF level 7 in Financial Management/ Management Accounting as recognised by SAQA. Three (03) years’ experience at supervisory level/ Senior /State Accountant/ Senior / Admin Officer in financial Management environment. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Treasury Regulations. Knowledge and understanding of the following: Supply Chain Management procedures. Procurement Procedures. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity, Financial management, Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication, Computer skills, People management, Planning and organising.
jobs.duties: Manage payments and accounts: Implement payments and accounts strategy, policy and procedures. Implement and monitor internal controls relating to payments and accounts. Monitor the payments due to the supplier is paid on time within 30 days. Advice on fruitless, wasteful and unauthorized expenditure. Verify the reconciled supplier statements against payments. Authorise payment of vouchers. Attend to audit queries in relation to accounts and expenditure. Manage Salaries: Implement salary strategy, policy and procedures. Authorize all salaries transaction of the district. Provide PERSAL administration in salary enquiries and reports. Monitor submission of taxpayers IRP 3A to SARS. Identify and specify state liabilities on pension fund. Manage and submit signed payroll to Head Office. Manage Revenue: Implement revenue strategy, policy and procedures. Confirm deposit on receipt batches. Provide revenue collection. Confirms deposit in the BAS system. Collecting all money due to state. Revenue collected and deposited in time. Monitor budget: Align the budget according to the needs of line managers. Monitor the spending pattern. Advice on over/under spending of budget. Render budget classification. Manage debt recovery: Analysis district finance in relation to debt management. Identify debts to be recovered. Notify the employee on the intension to recover the debt. Monitor the opening of debt file for relevant employer. Liaise with head office in updating BAS records. Monitor the closing of Debt files. Manage resource (Human, Financial and Equipment): Monitor and report on the utilisation of equipment’s. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage discipline. Provide job descriptions to subordiates. Manage division leave matters.
jobs.enquiries: For Vhembe: Mr MF Mavhungu, Ms M Muthabi & Mr TI Tshipuke Tel No: (015) 963 3790

Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Finansiële Bestuur pos in Limpopo wat 'n NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie en drie jaar se toesigervaring in finansiële bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matriek en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 in Finansiële Bestuur/Bestuursrekenkunde soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (03) jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak/Senior/State Accountant/Senior/Admin Officer in 'n finansiële bestuursomgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van toepaslike Openbare Diens-wette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsontleding, -ontwikkeling en -interpretasie. Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis en begrip van die volgende: Voorsieningskettingbestuursprosedures. Aankoopprosedures. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Probleemoplossing en -ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit, Finansiële bestuur, Kliëntgerigtheid en ingesteldheid, Kommunikasie, Rekenaarvaardighede, Mensebestuur, Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Bestuur betalings en rekeninge: Implementeer betalings- en rekeninge-strategie, -beleid en -prosedures. Implementeer en monitor interne beheer met betrekking tot betalings en rekeninge. Monitor dat betalings verskuldig aan die verskaffer binne 30 dae betyds betaal word. Adviseer oor nuttelose, vermorsende en ongemagtigde uitgawes. Verifieer die vereffende verskafferstate teen betalings. Magtig betaling van tjekies. Hanteer ouditnavrae met betrekking tot rekeninge en uitgawes. Bestuur salarisse: Implementeer salarisstrategie, -beleid en -prosedures. Magtig alle salaristransaksies van die distrik. Verskaf PERSAL-administrasie in salarisnavrae en verslae. Monitor indiening van belastingbetalers se IRP 3A by SARS. Identifiseer en spesifiseer staatsaanspreeklikhede op pensioenfonds. Bestuur en dien getekende loonstaat by Hoofkantoor in. Bestuur inkomste: Implementeer inkomste-strategie, -beleid en -prosedures. Bevestig Deposito op ontvangs lotjies. Verskaf inkomstesameling. Bevestig Deposito in die BAS-stelsel. Versamel alle geld verskuldig aan die staat. Inkomste betyds ingesamel en gedepositeer. Monitor begroting: Belyn die begroting volgens die behoeftes van lynbestuurders. Monitor die bestedingspatroon. Adviseer oor oor-/onderbesteding van begroting. Verskaf begrotingsklassifikasie. Bestuur skuldherwinning: Ontleed distrikfinansies met betrekking tot skuldbestuur. Identifiseer skuld wat herwin moet word. Stel die werknemer in kennis van die voorneme om die skuld te herwin. Monitor die opening van skuldlêers vir die toepaslike werkgewer. Skakel met hoofkantoor oor bywerking van BAS-rekords. Monitor die sluiting van skuldlêers. Bestuur hulpbronne (menslike, finansiële en toerusting): Monitor en rapporteer oor die benutting van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en beoordeling van werknemers. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Versterk en handhaaf werknemermotivasie en bevorder 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur dissipline. Verskaf posbeskrywings aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur afdeling se verlofaangeleenthede.

zu.title: Umsekeli Womqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla Somsekeli Womqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali eLimpopo esidinga iziqu ezinga le-NQF 7 kanye namahora eminyaka emithathu ahola abantu esimweni sokuphathwa kwezimali.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/ Matric kanye neziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 7 kwi-Financial Management/ Management Accounting njengoba kujulwe ngcono yi-SAQA. Three (03) years’ experience at supervisory level/ Senior /State Accountant/ Senior / Admin Officer in financial Management environment. Valid driver’s license, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abanesikhindi. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi lweziqu ezihlobene Nemithetho Yomphakathi, imithetho kanye nezakhiwo. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda kukanhloliyankomfa wezinqumo, ukuthuthukiswa nokutolikwa. Imithetho yeTreasury. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda okulandelayo: Izindlela ezenziwa ngazo izinto ze-Supply Chain Management. Izindlela zoku-Procurement. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphatha iqembu. Ukudala izinto, Ukuphathwa kwezimali, Ukuqaphela abathengi kanye noku#sabela, Unxibelelwano, Amakhono wekhompyutha, Ukuphatha abantu, Ukucubungula kanye noku#hlela.
zu.duties: Phatha izinkokhelo kanye nama-akhawunti: Qalisa inqubomgomo, izinqubo kanye nemithetho yezinkokhelo nama-akhawunti. Qalisa futhi uqaphe izilawuli zangaphakathi ezihlobene ngezinkokhelo nama-akhawunti. Qaphela ukuthi izinkokhelo ezifanele ukwenziwa kumhlinzeki zikhokhelwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30. Nikela ngeluleko ngekhaya elingenamthombo, elishiswa kabi nelingemvume. Qinisekisa izitatimende zomhlinzeki ezilinganisiwe nezigqamile nezinkokhelo. Gunyaza izinkokhelo ze-voucher. Phendula imibuzo yokuhlola ngokuphathelene nama-akhawunti kanye nekhaya elishisiwe. Phatha Amaholo: Qalisa inqubomgomo yamaholo, izinqubo kanye nemithetho. Gunyaza wonke amaholo we-transactions wesifunda. Nikeza ukuphathwa kwe-PERSAL kwimibuzo yamaholo kanye namarekhodi. Qaphela ukungeniswa kwemali yokuhlinzeka abanikazizezinkokhelwa se-Mali kwa-SARS IRP 3A. Hlaziya bese ubala izikweletu zombuso ngemali yokuphumula. Phatha bese ungenisa amaholo awuzuzile abhalwe i-Head Office. Phatha Imali Engenayo: Qalisa inqubomgomo yemali engenayo, izinqubo kanye nemithetho. Qinisekisa izibhalo ezifakwa kumagobolondo okutholwa. Nikeza imali engenayo eziqoqiwe. Qinisekisa izibhalo kusistimu ye-BAS. Qoqa yonke imali efanele umbuso. Imali engenayo ebaqoqiwe futhi kufakwe ibhange ngesikhathi. Qaphela umthamo wemali: Lungelelanisa imali ngokwezidingo zabalawuli bemicimbo. Qaphela indlela imali ekhokhwa ngayo. Nikela ngeluleko ngokukhokha kakhulu/kuncane umthamo wemali. Nikeza ukubalwa kwemali. Phatha ukubuyiswa kwamikweletu: Hlaziya izimali zesifunda ngokuphathelene nokuphathwa kwamikweletu. Hlaziya amakweletu okubuyiswa. Yezisa umsebenzi ngengalelo yokubuyisa ikweletu. Qaphela ukuvulwa kwefayela ledebts kumamephulasi okukhulunywa ngaye. Xhumana ne-Head Office ukubuyekeza amarekhodi e-BAS. Qaphela ukuvalwa kwamafayela amakweletu. Phatha imithombo (abantu, imali kanye nezinsiza): Qaphela bese ukubika ngokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza. Hlaziya bese uqaphela ukusebenza kanye nokulinganiselwa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ikhono kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Khulisa futhi ulondoloze ukukhuthaza kwabasebenzi bese usakaza isiko lokuphathwa kokusebenza. Phatha isiyalenti. Nikeza izinhlushuko zabaphansi bazomsebenzi. Phatha izindaba ezihlobene namaholo esigaba.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedayo: uLawulo lweMali
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguMphathi weNtloko: uLawulo lweMali Limpopo esifuna isiqu sika-NQF level 7 kwaye namava eminyaka emithathu ekulawuleni abantu kwilawulo lemali.
xh.requirements: Ireyithi ye-Gred 12/ Matric nangaphezulu kwesiqinisekiso seNQF level 7 kwinkqubo yolawulo lwe-akhawunti noma iFiscal Management njengoko kubonwa ngumGA. Amava eminyaka emithathu (03) kwinqanaba lolawulo lomsebenzi/ Umphathi/ State Accountant/ Senior / Admin Officer. Ifayitha yebhas yomanyano, kodwa ngaphandle kwabo bakhubekileyo kubuchopho nobunzima bomzimba. Ulwazi Nakhono: Ukuba nolwazi malunga nemigaqo yabantu ngabanye, iindlela nemigaqo-siseko eqinisekisa ulawulo lwemali. Ukuba nolwazi nokuyiqonda iindlela zohlalutyo, ukulungiselelwa nokutolikwa kolwazi. ITreasury Regulations. Ulwazi nokuyiqonda oku kulandelayo: Iinkqubo ezikwisiphakathi se Supply Chain Management. Iinkqubo zokuThengisa. PFMA. DORA. PPPFA. Ukuxelela iNgxaki noHlalutyo. Ukuze unike isigqibo. Ulawulo loQeqesho lobuqhawe. Ukuzalisekisa, ukulawula imali, ukuba nolwazi malunga nabathengi kwaye uphendule, Unxibelelwano, Amakhono ekhompyutha, ulawulo lwabantu, ukuqamba nokuqulunqa.
xh.duties: Yaphula imiselwe ngokuhlawulela nge-akhawunti: Ukuze usebenzise iindlela, umgaqo-nkqubo nemiqathango yokuhlawula ne-akhawunti. Ukuze usebenzise ulawulo lwangaphakathi ngokuhlawula nge-akhawunti. Ukuze uphathe ukuvunywa kwemali enikezelwa kumthengisi ngeentsuku ezingama-30. Ukunika izalathiso malunga nokungalawuleki kwenkwenkceshe ebangenwa sisigwegwede. Ukuze uqinisekise iindlela ezahambelanayo zemali zabathengisi. Ukuze uvume imali yokuhlawula. Ukuba kumphendulo kweepaketha ezibuzwa kwizikolo ezihamba phambili kwimali ebanzi. Yaphula imivuzo: Ukuze usebenzise iindlela, umgaqo-nkqubo nemiqathango yemivuzo. Ukuze uvume imisebenzi yomvuzo we district. Ukunika inkqubo yepersal kwimibuzo nemizekelo yemivuzo. Ukuze uphathe ukuthunyelwa kwezimali zerhafu kwi SARS. Ukuze uchaze ukuba ngabantu abanjani kwisigaba se pension. Ukuze uphathe kwaye uthumele i payroll esayinwe kw Head Office. Yaphula iNzuzo: Ukuze usebenzise umgaqo-nkqubo, iindlela nemiqathango yenzuzo. Ukunika isiqinisekiso malunga ngenzuzo ngeemali ezifunyenweyo. Ukunika iindlela zokuqokelela inzuzo. Ukuqinisekisa iindlela zokuqokelela imali kw inkqubo ye BAS. Ukuqokelela yonke imali elinganayo kurhulumente. Ukuba ukugqithiswa kolwazi lokuba ngumntu othile. Ukuze uphathe i bhajeti: Ukuze ulungelelanise i bhajeti ngokwemfuno yabaphathi. Ukuze uphathe iindlela zokuhlawula. Ukuze unike izalathiso malunga nokusebenzisa i bhajeti ngaphezulu okanye ngezantsi. Ukuze unike izahluko ze bhajeti. Yaphula ukubuyiselwa kwemali: Ukwenza luhlalutyo kwimali yedistrict malunga nokulawula inkwenkceshe ebangenwa sisigwegwede. Ukuba ukuthobela ukubuyiselwa kwe nkwenkceshe ebangenwa sisigwegwede. Ukuxelela umsebenzisi ngomgca-nkqubo wokubuyiswa kwemali. Ukuze uphathe ukuvulwa kweefayili zokugqithiswa kolwazi kumsebenzisi. Ukuba ngumthunywa we head office ekubeni kulungiswe iifayili ze BAS. Ukuze uphathe ukubuyiswa kolwazi lokugqibela kwale ndlela ethile. Yaphula izixhobo (abantu, imali nezixhobo): Ukuba ukugqithiswa kolwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo. Ukuze uhlole kwaye uphathe ukwenza kwaye uvavanye abasebenzi. Ukuze uqinisekise ulwazi lwabasebenzi kwaye uphuhlise. Ukuze ukhulise kwaye ulondoloze inkuthazo kubasebenzi kwaye wakhe inkqubo yokuqatwa kwemisebenzi. Ukuze ulawule isohlwayo. Ukunikela ngolwazi ngemisebenzi kumsebenzisi osezantsi kwakhe. Ukuze uphathe izinto zokuhamba ezihambelanayo nendima.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Strategic Planning Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Strategic Planning Services at the Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure in Polokwane, requiring an NQF Level 6 qualification and 3-5 years supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric certificate and a qualification at NQF Level 6 Developmental studies, Strategic Planning or Public Administration/ Management. 3-5 years relevant experience at supervisory level / Senior / Admin Officer in Strategic Management/ Planning, PGDS or Municipal IDP’, at least 3 years in supervisory position. A valid driver’s license with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge of Strategic Management Framework. Government programs such as the National Development Plan. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Leadership skills. Computer Literacy. Facilitation. Planning and organising. Analytical thinking. Creative Problem Solving. Policy Analysis and formulation.
jobs.duties: Coordinate planning processes: Facilitate and coordinate the compilation of Departmental Strategic Plan, Annual Performance Plan and Operational Plan. Provide guidance to programme managers on the implementation of strategic plan. Schedule follow up sessions with programme managers on the implementation of the strategic plan. Align the departmental business plan with the PGDS and municipal IDP’s: Provide effective IGR Services. Facilitate the integration of departmental plans into municipal IDP’s. Coordinate inter sectorial sessions. Participate in provincial development Planning Forum. Participate in IDP review sessions. Facilitate general management of the department, Provincial Government and liase with national departments, local governments and other stakeholders: Facilitate IDP review sessions. Facilitate IR and Donor Funding Committee. Facilitate in provincial development Planning Forum. Facilitate MOU implementation plan Committee. Provide stakeholder liaison from outside government and at community level. Provide departmental policies: Facilitate the development of the departmental policies. Conduct research and or benchmark with other departments on departmental policies. Facilitate the approval of the departmental policies. Provide policy advocacy sessions.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Hanyane NP, Mr. Moabelo MJ, Ms. Motsai S Tel No: (015) 284 7586/7627/7262.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Strategiese Beplanningsdienste
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Strategiese Beplanningsdienste by die Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure in Polokwane, wat 'n NQF Level 6-kwalifikasie en 3-5 jaar toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matriek-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF Level 6 in Ontwikkelingstudies, Strategiese Beplanning of Publieke Administrasie/Bestuur. 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring op toesigvlak / Senior / Admin Offisier in Strategiese bestuur/Beplanning, PGDS of Munisipale IDP', ten minste 3 jaar in 'n toesigposisie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante Public Service Acts, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis van Strategiese Bestuursraamwerk. Regeringsprogramme soos die National Development Plan. Kennis en begrip van beleidsontleding, -ontwikkeling en -interpretasie. Leierskapsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Fasilitering. Beplanning en organisering. Analitiese denke. Kreatiewe probleemoplossing. Beleidsontleding en -formulering.
af.duties: Koördineer beplanningsprosesse: Fasiliteer en koördineer die samestelling van die departementele Strategiese Plan, Jaarlikse Prestasieplan en Operasionele Plan. Verskaf leiding aan programbestuurders oor die implementering van die strategiese plan. Skeduleer opvolgsessies met programbestuurders oor die implementering van die strategiese plan. Belyn die departementele besigheidsplan met die PGDS en munisipale IDP's: Verskaf doeltreffende IGR-dienste. Fasiliteer die integrasie van departementele planne in munisipale IDP's. Koördineer intersektoriele sessies. Neem deel aan provinsiale ontwikkelingsbeplanningsforum. Neem deel aan IDP-hersieningsessies. Fasiliteer algemene bestuur van die departement, Provinsiale Regering en skakel met nasionale departemente, plaaslike regerings en ander belanghebbendes: Fasiliteer IDP-hersieningsessies. Fasiliteer IR- en Skenkerborsingskomitee. Fasiliteer in provinsiale ontwikkelingsbeplanningsforum. Fasiliteer MOU-implementeringsplankomitee. Verskaf belanghebbende-skakeling van buite die regering en op gemeenskapsvlak. Verskaf departementbeleide: Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van die departementele beleide. Doen navorsing en of toets met ander departemente oor departementele beleide. Fasiliteer die goedkeuring van die departementele beleide. Verskaf beleidsadvokasiesessies.

zu.title: Onakezela kakhulu: Isevisi yokuhlela amasu weNkulumo yokuqala
zu.summary: Umnikelo omkhulu ohlelwe: Oqamba izinhlela ezibalulekile kumnyango we-Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure ePolokwane, ofuna isitifikedi se-NQF Level 6 kanye neminyaka eyi-3-5 yamakhono okuphatha abantu.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Matric kanye nelayithensi ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 kwe-Developmental studies, Strategic Planning noma Public Administration/ Management. Unyaka we-3-5 wemisebenzi ehambisana naleyo ezingeni lokuhlola / Senior / Admin Officer Strategic Management/ Planning, PGDS noma municipal IDP', okungenani unyaka we-3 esikhundleni sokuhlola. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kokuba nguyena ophila nesisu. Ukwati nokusebenzisa: Ulwazi ngemithetho yomphakathi, izinqubo nezinhlelo ezithinta indlela. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuphatha iNkqubo Yokusungula. Izinhlelo zomphakathi ngenhlangano ezinjengohlelo oluhleliwe lokuthuthuka kubandakanya izinhlelo zezwe. Ukuqonda nokuhlaziya imithetho yomphakathi ngokwakha nokutshuma. Amakhono okukhokha. Ukusebenzisana kwekhompyutha. Ukukhuthaza. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukucabanga ngokuthungatha. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokuhlakanipha. Ukwakha nokuhlaziya imithetho yomphakathi.
zu.duties: Hlela izinqubo zokuqulunqa: Hola futhi uhlele ukuqulunqwa kweNkqubo Yokuqamba Ebandakanyayo Yomnyango, Inkqubo Yemisebenzi Yomnyango Yonyaka kanye neNkqubo Yokusebenza. Nikeza isiqondiso kubaphathi benhlelo ngokuqaliswa kwenkqubo yokuhlela. Hlela ızihlanganisi zokuqhubela phambili nabaphathi benhlelo ngokuqaliswa kwenkqubo yokuhlela. Linganisa inkqubo yebhizinisi lomnyango ne-PGDS kanye ne-municipal IDP’s: Nikeza izinkonzo ezisebenzayo ze-IGR. Hola ukuhlanganiswa kwezinkqubo zomnyango kwi-municipal IDP’s. Hlela iziqophelana phakathi kwemikhakha. Thatha inhlalo enkundleni yokuqulunqa kweNkqubo Yophuhliso. Thatha inhlalo kumasiko okubuyekeza i-IDP. Hola okuqanjwayo komanyango, uhulumeni wesifundaze kanye nokuxhumana namnyango kahulumeni kazwelonke, kahulumeni wasekhaya nalabo abanye abahlanganyeli: Hola amasiko okubuyekeza i-IDP. Hola i-IR kanye neKomidi Yokuxhaswa ngemali abanikwayo. Hola enkundleni yokuqulunqa kweNkqubo Yophuhliso. Hola iKomidi leNkqubo yokuqaliswa i-MOU. Nikeza ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli abangaphandle kahulumeni nakwazinga komphakathi. Nikeza izinqubo zomnyango: Hola ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo zomnyango.enza ucwaningo noma ufanise namanye omanyango ngaphezu kwezinqubo zomnyango. Hola ukuvunywa kwezinqubo zomnyango. Nikeza amasiko okukhuthazwa izinqubo zomnyango.

xh.title: Umsekeli woMlawuli: Iinkonzo zoLungelelwaniso oluQhubela phambili
xh.summary: Umsekeli woMlawuli: Iinkonzo zoLungelelwaniso oluQhubela phambili kwisebe leZiNtloko zaSebe, iindlela zoRhangqo neNyaniso yokoQhubela phambili ePolokwane, lifuna ingenothelelo yeNqanaba le-6 kwi-NQF kunye ne-3-5 yeminyaka yamava ekulawuleni.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seBhashe le-12 / iMatric nengenothelelo kwi-NQF Level 6 kwiZifundo zokuQhubela phambili, uLungelelwaniso lokuQhela phambili okanye uLawulo loLuntu. I-3-5 yeminyaka yamava ahambelanayo kwinqanaba lokulawula / umPhathi oMkhulu / noMsebenzisi woLawulo kuLawulo loLungelelwaniso / uLungelelwaniso, i-PGDS okanye iMunicipal IDP, ubuncinane i-3 yeminyaka kwithuba lokulawula. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba esemthethweni ngaphandle koxhaso babantu abakhubekileyo. ULwazi neNgeniso: Ulwazi ngeMithetho yoLuntu, iimithetho elandelayo neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yoLawulo lokuQhela phambili. Iinkqubo zikaRhulumente ezinjengeNqubo yoQhubela phambili yoZwelonke. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlaziywa, ukulungelelwaniso nokutolika iinkqubo. Amaphepha abakhoki ekulawuleni. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukukhuthaza. Ukuqamba nokulungelelanisa. Ukucinga ngokuhlaziya. UkuSombulula iingxaki ngokudala. UkuHlaziya nekuqamba iinkqubo zolawulo.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkqubo zolungelelwaniso: Qhubeza kwaye ulawule ukuqulunqwa kweNqubo ekuqhubekayo yoLungelelwaniso lweSebe, iNqubo yoMsebenzi waQho kwaye uLungelelwaniso lokuSebenza. Nikela isikhokelo kubaphathi beenkqubo malunga nokusebenzisa inqubo yolungelelwaniso. Hlela iindibano zokulandela kubaphathi beenkqubo malunga nokusebenzisa inqubo yolungelelwaniso. Linganisa icebo lokushishina lesebe ne-PGDS nakumagazini wamasipala i-IDP: Nikela iinkonzo eziphumelelayo ze-IGR. Qhubeza ukudityaniswa kweenkqubo zesebe kumagazini wamasipala i-IDP. Lawula iindibano ezihamba phakathi kweendawo ezahlukeneyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNqubo yoLungelelwaniso lokuQhubela phambili ekuwohlokweni. Thatha inxaxheba kwiindibano zokuphonononga i-IDP. Qhubeza ukulawula ngokubanzi isebbe, urhulumente weNgingingqi kwaye unxibelelane namasebe karhulumente kazwelonke, masipala kwaye nabanye abathathi-nxaxheba: Qhubeza iindibano zokuphonononga i-IDP. Qhubeza iKomiti ye-IR nezoNxibelelwano ziMali ezinikwa ngabaxhasi. Qhubeza kwiNqubo yoLungelelwaniso lokuQhubela phambili ekuwohlokweni. Qhubeza iKomiti yeNqubo yoKusebenzisa i-MOU. Nikela unxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba abangaphandle karhulumente nakwinganga loluntu. Nikela iinkqubo zolawulo zesebe: Qhubeza ukulungelelwaniso kweenkqubo zolawulo zesebe. Qhuba uphononongo okanye ngqamanisa namanye amasebe ngeenkqubo zolawulo zesebe. Qhubeza ukuvunywa kweenkqubo zolawulo zesebe. Nikela iindibano zokuxhasa iinkqubo zolawulo.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Fasiliteite Dienste
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Fasiliteite Dienste in Sekhukhune-distrik, bestuur van landskapserwingsdienste, verkryging en begrotings op salarisvlak 9.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matrik-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 in Kantooradministrasie/Openbare Administrasie/Openbare Bestuur/Tuinbou/Onroerendegoedbestuur. 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring op toesighoudende vlak / Senior / Admin Offisier in 'n Fasiliteite- of Onroerendegoedbestuur-omgewing, ten minste 3 jaar in 'n toesighoudende posisie· 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van relevante Openbare Diens Wette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsanalise, ontwikkeling en interpretasie. Kennis in kantoorbestuur en administrasie. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Kliëntefokus en responsiwiteit. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Fasilitering. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur landskapserwingsdienste: Ontwikkel landskapserwingsplanne vir die distrik. Monitor begroting vir landskapserwingsdienste. Bestuur verkryging van beskermende klere vir die distrik. Bestuur en verskaf spesifikasies vir verkryging van landskapserwings toerusting en materiaal. Bestuur herstel en onderhoud van landskapserwings toerusting. Bestuur toewysing van grondwerkers om die distrikantoor en kostesentra te bedien. Monitor nakoming van beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidspraktyke. Monitor EPWP-projekte ten opsigte van landskapserwing. Bestuur skoonmaakdienste: Ontwikkel skoonmaakplanne vir die distrik. Monitor begroting vir skoonmaakdienste. Bestuur verkryging van beskermende klere vir die distrik. Bestuur en verskaf spesifikasies vir verkryging van skoonmaak toerusting en materiaal. Bestuur herstel en onderhoud van skoonmaak toerusting. Bestuur en monitor die verspreiding van skoonmaakmateriaal en chemikalieë. Bestuur toewysing van skoonmakers om die distrikantoor en kostesentra te bedien. Monitor nakoming van beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidspraktyke. Monitor EPWP-projekte ten opsigte van skoonmaakdienste. Verskaf kostesentrumondersteuning: Verskaf skoonmaak en landskapserwing in die kostesentrum. Fasiliteer kostesentrum menslike hulpbron aangeleenthede. Fasiliteer kostesentrum hulpaangeleenthede. Uitreiking van regeringsvoertuie, Berging van sleutels en brandstofkaarte, Fasiliteer vrystelling om na werkure te bestuur, Rapportering van ongeluksverslae. Verskaf afvalbestuursdienste: Ontwikkel afvalbestuursplan. Fasiliteer sortering en vernietiging van afvalpapier. Skakel met diensverskaffer met betrekking tot insameling van verpakte afvalpapier. Ontvang maandelikse inkomsteverslae wat deur afvalbestuur gegenereer word. Verskaf hulpbronne (Menslike, Finansiële en Toerusting): Monitor en rapporteer oor die benutting van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en beoordeling van werknemers. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Verbeter en handhaaf werknemermotivering en bou 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur dissipline. Verskaf werksbeskrywing aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur afdeling se verlofaangeleenthede.

zu.title: Onxusemlingisi: Izinsizakusebenza Zokuhlela Indawo
zu.summary: Onxusemlingisi wezinsizakusebenza zokuhlela indawo edolobheni i-Sekhukhune, ephatha izinsizakusebenza zokuhlela indawo, ukuthenga nebhajethi eholo elingu-9.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Matric kanye nelayisensi ezingeni le-NQF 6 ekuqondweni kohhovu / ukuqondwa kohulumeni / ukuqondwa kwezimpahla / umlimi / ukuphathwa kwezimpahla. 3-5 iminyaka yamava ehambisanayo ezingeni lokubeka / umphathi ongaphezulu / ofisa ohhovu ezinsizakusebenza noma ekuqondweni kwezimpahla, okungenani 3 iminyaka esikhundleni sokubeka. Ilayisense elivumelekile lokushayela ngaphandle kwalabo abafaka izicelo abasikhondivo. Ulwazi nezikhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho, izilawulo namakhasimu ahambisana nesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlaziya, ukuthuthuka nokuchaza iphulisi. Ulwazi ekuqondweni kwayo nasekuphathweni kohhovu. Ikhono lokubuka ngaphambili nokuqonda. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqhathanisa. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukubeka iqembu. Ukukhiqiza. Ukuqonda ukunakekela abathengi nokuphendula. Ukuthumela imiyalezo. Izikhono zekhompyutha. Ukwenza izisekelo. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuhlela nokuqondisa. Ukuphatha ingxabano.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsizakusebenza zokuhlela indawo: Hlola amaphulani wokuhlela indawo esifundeni. Qaphasela ibhajethi yezinsizakusebenza zokuhlela indawo. Phatha ukuthenga izingubo zokuvikela esifundeni. Phatha futhi uhlinze ngesibeki sokuthenga izinsiza zokuhlela indawo nokwakhiwa. Phatha ukulungiswa nokukhonza izinsiza zokuhlela indawo. Phatha ukwabiwa kwabakhi bezindawo ukukhonza ihhovu lesifunda namasikhungo okuhlola izindleko. Qaphasela ukuthobela izindlela zokuphila nokuphepha ezimsebenzini. Qaphasela amaphrojekthi e-EPWP ngokuhlela indawo. Phatha izinsizakusebenza zokusula: Hlola amaphulani wokusula esifundeni. Qaphasela ibhajethi yezinsizakusebenza zokusula. Phatha ukuthenga izingubo zokuvikela esifundeni. Phatha futhi uhlinze ngesibeki sokuthenga izinsiza zokusula nokwakhiwa. Phatha ukulungiswa nokukhonza izinsiza zokusula. Phatha futhi uqaphele ukwabiwa kwensiza yokusula namakhemikhali. Phatha ukwabiwa kwabasuli ukukhonza ihhovu lesifunda namasikhungo okuhlola izindleko. Qaphasela ukuthobela izindlela zokuphila nokuphepha ezimsebenzini. Qaphasela amaphrojekthi e-EPWP ngokwenzakusebenza zokusula. Nikeza ngokwesekwa kwesikhungo sokuhlola izindleko: Nikeza ukusula nokuhlela indawo esikhungweni sokuhlola izindleko. Sebenzela izindaba zabantu ezikhungweni sokuhlola izindleko. Sebenzela izindaba ezingeziwe ezikhungweni sokuhlola izindleko. Ukunikezwa kwesithuthi sikahulumeni, Ukugcina amaki nezikhulu zamafutha, Sebenzela ukugunyazwa ukushayela emuva kwamahora omsebenzi, Ukwethula inkombombo yezehlakalo. Nikeza ngensizakusebenza yokuphatha ukungcola: Hlola iphulani yokuphatha ukungcola. Sebenzela ukuhlukanisa nokudliwa kwephepha elingenampilo. Xhumana nenikezinsiza mayelana nokuthola iphepha elingenampanga elibekiwe. Thola inkombombo yezimali ezingenayo zanyanga zonke ezengezelwe ngokuphatha ukungcola. Nikeza ngensiza (abantu, izimali, nezinsiza): Qaphasela futhi uthule mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwensiza. Hlola futhi uqaphele ukusebenza nokulinganisa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ikhono nentuthuko yabasebenzi. Khulisa futhi ugcine ukukhuthazwa kwabasebenzi futhi uhlaze inkambiso yokuphatha ukusebenza. Phatha inzima. Nikeza incazelo yomsebenzi kubabekiwe. Phatha izindaba zokuphumula kwesigaba.

xh.title: Oncaledi weSebe: Iinkonzo zeziFasilithi
xh.summary: Oncaledi weNkonzo yeziFasilithi kwisinga iSekhukhune, elawula iinkonzo zokuhlela imihlaba, ukuthenga kunye neyajiwali kwinqanaba lomvuzo 9.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seBanga le-12 / iMatric kunye nefa khwalifikheshini kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 kwi-Office Administration/Public Administration/ Public Management/ Horticulturist/ Property Management. Iiminyaka engama-3-5 yamava ahambelanayo kwinqanaba lobalulekile / Omtsha / iNkundla yoLawulo kwimeko yeziFasilithi okanye yoLawulo lwePropathi, ubuncinane iiminyaka engama-3 kwithuba sobalulekile· Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni ngaphandle kwezicelo zabantu abakhubazekileyo Ulwazi neakhono: Ulwazi ngeMithetho, iimigaqo-nkqubo kunye neenkqubo zeNkonzo yoLuntu ezihambelanayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukwahlulwa-phantsi, uphuhliso kunye nokutolikwa kwezinqulumo-mgaqo. Ulwazi kuqwalaselo kwanmakhelo kunye nolawulo. Ikhono lokuqonda iindlela ezahlukeneyo nokulawula. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukulawula iqela. Ubuchule bokudala. Ugxile kumthengi kunye nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Iikhono zekhompyutha. Ukunceda ezinkqubweni. Ulawulo labantu. Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ulawulo lwezingxaki.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zokuhlela imihlaba: Phuhlisa iindlela zokuhlela imihlaba zesinga. Qwalasela ijowudi yeenkonzo zokuhlela imihlaba. Lawula ukuthenga kweempahla zokhuseleko zesinga. Lawula kwaye uze nikela iinkcazelo zokuthenga ezixhobo zokuhlela imihlaba kunye nezinto. Lawula ukulungisa nokusebenza ezixhobo zokuhlela imihlaba. Lawula ukwabiwa kwabagadi bethafa ukuba bakhonze ihovu lesinga kunye neendawo zeendleko. Qwalasela ukuzinikela kumasebe okuqina empilweni nasekhuselekeni somsebenzi. Qwalasela iiprojekthi ze-EPWP malunga nokuhlela imihlaba. Lawula iinkonzo zokucoca: Phuhlisa iindlela zokucoca zesinga. Qwalasela ijowudi yeenkonzo zokucoca. Lawula ukuthenga kweempahla zokhuseleko zesinga. Lawula kwaye uze nikela iinkcazelo zokuthenga ezixhobo zokucoca kunye nezinto. Lawula ukulungisa nokusebenza ezixhobo zokucoca. Lawula kwaye uqwalasele ukusasazwa kwezinto zokucoca kunye namachemicals. Lawula ukwabiwa kwabacoci ukuba bakhonze ihovu lesinga kunye neendawo zeendleko. Qwalasela ukuzinikela kumasebe okuqina empilweni nasekhuselekeni somsebenzi. Qwalasela iiprojekthi ze-EPWP malunga neenkonzo zokucoca. Nikela inkxaso kwindawo yeendleko: Nikela ukucoca nokuhlela imihlaba kwindawo yeendleko. Khokela iindaba zemithombo yabantu yendawo yeendleko. Khokela iindaba ezongezelelweyo zendawo yeendleko. Ukupha iimoto karhulumente, Ukugcina okufihlakeleyo amaqhosha kunye namakhadi ezibaso, Khokela ukuxhoxha ukuqhuba emva kweeveki zokusebenza, Ukubika iingxango zokwenza iingozi. Nikela iinkonzo zolawulo lwezinto ezingafunekiyo: Phuhlisa indlela yolawulo lwezinto ezingafunekiyo. Khokela ukuhlelwa nokusikwa kwamaphepa angafunekiyo. Thintana nemboneleli wenkonzo ngokujongo lokuyikho iipakethe zamaphepa angafunekiyo. Yamkela iingxelo zemali zenyanga eziveliswa ngokulawula izinto ezingafunekiyo. Nikela izibonelelo (Abantu, Imali kunye neZixhobo): Qwalasela kwaye uze ubike ngokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo. Hlola kwaye uqwalasele ukusebenza kunye nokubakwa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa amandla nophuhliso wabasebenzi. Phucula kwaye ulondoloze inkuthazo yabasebenzi kwaye utye iziko lolawulo lokuqhuba phambili. Lawula isithukuthezi. Nikela inkcukacha yomsebenzi kubangenwa. Lawula iindaba zokuqhwesha kohlulo.

jobs.title: ASD: Roads Project Implementation
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Coordinate EPWP roads project implementation at the Limpopo Department of Public Works head office in Polokwane, requiring supervisory experience and a project management qualification.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric certificate and a qualification at NQF Level 06 as recognized by SAQA in Project Management/ Public Management/Community Development Studies. Three (03) years’ relevant experience at supervisory level / Senior / Admin Officer. A Valid driver’s license with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Skills And Knowledge: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of Roads Maintenance Manual. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Strategic capability and leadership.
jobs.duties: Coordinate development of EPWP Business plan: Establish steering committee of Local Municipal Councilor, Community Development Workers and Transformation and ensure that this committee identifies EPWP projects to be implanted. Select projects in term of priority and suitability in line with EPWP. Manage the design and costing of EPWP projects. Ensure the setting up of database of potential participants for EPWP project implementation. Arrange the advertising of projects as well as the appointment of participants. Facilitate compliance to EPWP Guidelines. Register all planned LIC projects in the EPWP Reporting System. Ensure the signing of employment contracts by participants. Ensure Basic Life Skills Training for all labourers. Registration of participants/contractors with CETA. Monitor the performance of EPWP projects. Ensure programming of the works and strict adherence to set dates in line with the EPWP Business plan. Insist on setting of manageable daily task for workers in with Ministerial. Determination for EPWP projects. Ensure strict adherence to the carrying out of activities according to specifications. Ensure performance of tasks is done under proper supervision to ensure quality production and application of correct approved materials. Ensure similarity in scope of work for all districts. Ensure the application of civil construction industry guidelines, viz general conditions of contract 2000, SABS and EPWP Ministerial Determination. Encourage registration of participants/contractor with standards authorities such as CIDB. Ensure the establishment of code of best practice for EPWP. Develop projects specification and contracts for service providers. Ensure project design is per Labour Intensive Construction Methods. Draw up specifications and terms of reference that will govern the operations of the projects. Provide OHSA training for participants. Ensure that consultants appointed have CETA Accreditation and are registered with recognized bodies controlling civil construction industry,e.g. SAICE. Confirm validity of contract documentation drawn up by consultants with departmental legal directorate. Facilitate community participation in the projects with the relevant directorate. Ensure good relations and closer cooperation between the Roads Projects Implementation Directorate, Departmental District Offices, Cost Centers and Local Authorities through Social Facilitation. Convene and conduct EPWP workshops and seminars during project identification on community participation. Compile an analysis of household status of projects participants in line with EPWP targeted demographics i.e. %women, %youth and %disabilities.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Hanyane NP, Mr. Moabelo MJ, Ms. Motsai S Tel No: (015) 284 7586/7627/7262.

For Vhembe District: Private Bag X2248, Sibasa, 0970 or hand deliver at Cnr. Traffic and Raluswielo Street, Sibasa. For Waterberg District: Private Bag X1028, Modimolle, 0510 or hand deliver at Cnr. Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. The application on eRecruitment system should be accompanied by recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates) as well as copies of all qualifications, Identity Document and valid driver’s license only. Failure to attach copies and required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualification.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: ASD: Implementering van Padprojekte
af.summary: Koördineer die implementering van EPWP-padprojekte by die Limpopo Department of Public Works-hoofkantoor in Polokwane, wat toesighoudende ervaring en 'n projekbestuurskwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric-sertifikaat en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 06 soos deur SAQA erken in Projekbestuur / Openbare Bestuur / Gemeenskapsontwikkelingstudies. Drie (03) jaar se relevante ervaring op toesighoudende vlak / Senior / Administratiewe beampte. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Vaardighede en kennis: Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Klantefokus en responserendheid. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Menslike hulpbronbestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Kennis van tersaaklike Openbaredienswette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van die Handleiding vir Padonderhoud. Kennis en begrip van beleidsontleding, ontwikkeling en interpretasie. PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap.
af.duties: Koördineer die ontwikkeling van die EPWP-sakeplan: Stel 'n stuurskomitee van die Plaaslike Munisipale Raadslid, Gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerkers en Transformasie in en verseker dat hierdie komitee EPWP-projekte identifiseer om geïmplementeer te word. Kies projekte volgens prioriteit en geskiktheid in lyn met EPWP. Bestuur die ontwerp en kosteberekening van EPWP-projekte. Verseker die opstelling van 'n databasis van potensiële deelnemers vir EPWP-projekimplementering. Reël die advertering van projekte asook die aanstelling van deelnemers. Fasiliteer nakoming van EPWP-riglyne. Registreer alle beplande LIC-projekte in die EPWP-verslagdoeningstelsel. Verseker die ondertekening van dienskontrakte deur deelnemers. Verseker Basiese Lewensvaardigheidsopleiding vir alle arbeiders. Registrasie van deelnemers/kontrakteurs by CETA. Monitor die prestasie van EPWP-projekte. Verseker programmering van die werk en streng nakoming van vasgestelde datums in lyn met die EPWP-sakeplan. staan aan op die vasstelling van hanteerbare daaglikse take vir werkers in lyn met Ministeriële. Bepaling vir EPWP-projekte. Verseker streng nakoming van die uitvoering van aktiwiteite volgens spesifikasies. Verseker dat die uitvoering van take onder behoorlike toesig gedoen word om gehalteproduksie en toepassing van korrekte goedgekeurde materiaal te verseker. Verseker ooreenstemming in omvang van werk vir alle distrikte. Verseker die toepassing van riglyne van die siviele konstruksiebedryf, nl. algemene kontrakvoorwaardes 2000, SABS en EPWP Ministeriële Bepaling. Moedig registrasie van deelnemers/kontrakteurs by standaardowerhede soos CIDB aan. Verseur die vestiging van 'n kode van beste praktyk vir EPWP. Ontwikkel projekspesifikasies en kontrakte vir diensverskaffers. Verseker dat projekontwerp ooreenkomstig Arbeidsintensiewe Konstruksiemetodes is. Stel spesifikasies en termyne van verwysing op wat die bedrywighede van die projekte sal regeer. Verskaf OHSA-opleiding vir deelnemers. Verseker dat aangestelde konsultante CETA-akreditasie het en by erkende liggame wat die siviele konstruksiebedryf beheer, geregistreer is, bv. SAICE. Bevestig geldigheid van kontrakdokumentasie deur konsultante opgestel met die departementele regsdirektoraat. Fasiliteer gemeenskapsdeelname aan die projekte met die tersaaklike direktoraat. Verseker goeie betrekkinge en nouer samewerking tussen die Direktoraat: Implementering van Padprojekte, Departementele Distrikkantore, Kostesentra en Plaaslike Owerhede deur Maatskaplike Fasilitering. Reël en voer EPWP-worsshops en seminare uit gedurende projekidentifisering oor gemeenskapsdeelname. Stel 'n ontleding op van die huishoudelike status van projekte deelnemers in lyn met EPWP-teikendemografie, d.w.s. %vroue, %jeug en %gestremdes.

zu.title: ASD: Roads Project Implementation
zu.summary: Hlanganisa ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi we-EPWP roads esikhungweni esikhulu se-Limpopo Department of Public Works e-Polokwane, okudinga ukuhlatshelwa ngomsebenzi wokubaphathi kanye nesididiba sokuphatha imiphrojekthi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Matric kanye nesididiba ezingeni leNQF Level 06 njengesemukelekwa yi-SAQA ku-Project Management / Public Management / Community Development Studies. Uhambo lweminyaka emithathu (03) ngomsebenzi ongafanele ezingeni lokubaphathi / Senior / Admin Officer. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwalabo bafaka izicelo abanesikhathi. Amakhono kanye nolwazi: Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphatha iqembu. Ukudala. Ukuphatha imali. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela izinto. Ukuphatha ingxabano. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izilawulo namasemu ahlobene ne-Public Service. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda i-Roads Maintenance Manual. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuhlaziya, ukuthuthukisa kanye nokuhumusha inqubomgomo. I-PFMA kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela kanye nokuphatha.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-EPWP Business plan: Sungula komidi ensele yokuqondisa enamalungu abakhethiwe bewomakhela abakhulu, abasebenzi bemphakathi kanye nezinhlela zokushintsha, futhi qiniseka ukuthi leli komidi libeka izinhlela ze-EPWP ezizoqaliswa. Khetha izinhlela ngokobalulele nokulungele ngokuvumelana ne-EPWP. Phatha ukwakhiwa kanye nenani lemali yamaprojekthi we-EPWP. Qiniseka ukwakhiwa kwegciwo labantu abangaba babathikili ekuphathweni kwamaprojekthi we-EPWP. Hlela ukumemezwa kwamaprojekthi kanye nokubekwa kwabathikili. Phakamisa ukuhambisana nemihlahlandlela ye-EPWP. Bhalisa wonke amaprojekthi ahleziwe aLIC kwisimiso yesi盒子iwe se-EPWP. Qiniseka ukusayinwa kwamavesi omsebenzi ngabathikili. Qiniseka ukuqeqeshwa kwe-Basic Life Skills Training kubasebenzi bonke. Ukubhaliswa kwabathikili/banumeli e-CETA. Bheka ngokocingo imisebenzi yamaprojekthi we-EPWP. Qiniseka ukuhlelwa kwemisebenzi nokulandwa ngokuqinile kwamaphathi ngokuhambisana ne-EPWP Business plan. Phakamisa ukubeka imisebenzi yansuku zonke engaphathwa kalula ngabasebenzi ngokuvumelana noMgqashi owhlule i-EPWP. Qiniseka ukulandelwa ngokuqinile kokwenziwa kwemisebenzi ngokwezindlela ezibekiwe. Qiniseka ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa ngaphansi kolawulo olufanele ukuze kuqiniseke ukukhiqiza okuhle nokusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezihlonziwe ezamukelekile. Qiniseka ukufana kwesigaba somsebenzi kuzo zonke izifunda. Qiniseka ukusetshenziswa kwemihlahlandlela yeshishini lokwakha, okuyinto emi ngemikhawulo evamile yavesi luka-2000, i-SABS kanye noMgqashi owhlule i-EPWP. Khuthaza ukubhaliswa kwabathikili/banumeli kumagunya amakhulu njenge-CIDB. Qiniseka ukumiswa kwekhodi yemisebenzi emihle kwe-EPWP. Hlela izinkomba zemiprojekthi namavesi abanikeli besebenzi. Qiniseka ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwephrojekthi kuhambisana nezindlela ze-Labour Intensive Construction Methods. Bhala izinkomba kanye negama elizobe belawula imisebenzi yamaprojekthi. Nikeza ngokuqeqesha i-OHSA abathikili. Qiniseka ukuthi banumeli ababekiwe bane-CETA Accreditation futhi babhaliswe emabhungweni ahloniphekile ahlula ishishini lokwakha, njenge-SAICE. Qiniseka ukusebenza koxhumana ngezwi wesi agreements sitshiwo abakhonzi ndawonye. Sibekela ukuba ukubumbisana kwamaphrojekthi kanye nabalawuli abahleliweyo ekhaya. Qiniseka ubuhlobo obuhle nogqibelele phakathi kwe-Roads Projects Implementation Directorate, i-Departmental District Offices, i-Cost Centers kanye ne-Local Authorities kusetshenziswa i-Social Facilitation. Baqinisile okuqhutywa kwe-EPWP ukubumba okukhulu kubandakanya ukuzitsho abantu ekuhlotyeni kwephrojekthi. Yenza isibhalo sakho ngokuhlaziya isimo sasekhaya sabathikili bephrojekthi ngokuhambisana ne-EPWP targeted demographics i.e. %women, %youth kanye ne-%disabilities.

xh.title: ASD: Ukuphunyezwa kweenjongo zemigwaqo
xh.summary: Ukuqhelanisa ukuphunyezwa kweenjongo zemigwaqo ze-EPWP kwindlu enkulu yesebe le-Limpopo Department of Public Works ePolokwane, kufuna amava obukhokheli nesatifikethi sokulawula iiprojekthi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric nesatifikethi kumqangatho we-NQF Level 06 njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA kwi-Project Management / Public Management / Community Development Studies. Iimini ezintathu (03) zemava ephathwayo kwinqanaba lobukhokheli / Njingalwazi / Ofisi ye-Admin. Ilayisensi yomqeshi egqithisiweyo ngaphandle kwabo bafaka isicelo ababenokuphela bokungabi namandla. Amandla nokulunga: Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokhela iqela. Ubuchule bokwenza izinto. Ukulawula imali. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Amandla ekhompyutha. Ukulawula abantu. Ukuqhamba kwaye ulungise izinto. Ukulawula iingxabano. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo lwaseburhulumente, iimithetho yokuqaliswa kunye nezakhiwo. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Manual yokon维护a iindlela. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlalutya, ukuqhuba nokutolika inkqubo. I-PFMA kunye neTreasury Regulations. Amandla aqhubekayo nobukhokheli.
xh.duties: Qhelanisa ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zoshishino ze-EPWP: Sula ikomiti yokukhokela elibumba i-Gordiyane loorhulumente bendlu, Basebenzi beNtshukubo yokuqaliswa kwezindlu kuqondise ukuhlala nasekwenzeni iinguqulo kwaye ngenene yobuchule emisebenzi yolawulo lwentsimi. Khetha iiprojekthi ngokwemfuneko nangokulunga nangokulungileyo ngenkqubo ye-EPWP. Lawula ukuqulunqa nokuqamba amaxabiso emisebenzi ye-EPWP. Qinisekisa uluhlu oluzii kwinkqubo yokugcina amagama abathathi nxaxheba kumisebenzi we-EPWP. Qhelanisa ukwenza umtya we-EPWP nendlela yokugcina abathathi nxaxheba. Yenza umsebenzi wokuthobela imigaqo ye-EPWP. Babisa zonke iiprojekthi ze-LIC ekuyimeni nasekunikezweni ngeenkqubo ezimiselweyo ze-EPWP Reporting System. Qinisekisa ukusayinwa kwamagama ethileyo nabasebenzi ngaphandle kobudenge. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi bagqibelele ngemisebenzi engaphantsi yobuchule. Ukubhaliswa kwabathathi nxaxheba / oqeqeshi abaqeqeshwa yi-CETA. Lilimele ukwenza umsebenzi ngokuzinza kweenkqubo ze-EPWP. Qinisekisa ukuqondwa kolawulo nemigaqo eqqho yenkqubo nangokuzinza kolawulo olungangezi kwinkqubo yolawulo. Beka umzila wemisebenzi ngokomthetho kaNgengangamzila weNkqubo yokuQe Mkhothi uwo wenziwe ngokubonwa kwabantu bobunkqubo bobasebenzi be-EPWP. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo nangokwenza imisebenzi ngokomthetho weenkqubo ezichanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi ifakwa ngqo nokuba iqondwe kubukhokheli obungenanto ukwenza ukuba nalolunge loluhlu kwaye amaxabiso okubonwayo aqotywe ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi lungqamaniswe kwiinkqubo ezifanayo kumazwe onke. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwemigaqo yamashishini okwakha izindlu ngokomthetho we-2000, i-SABS nasekulawulweni kuka-Ngengamzila we-EPWP. Khuthaza ukubhaliswa kwabathathi nxaxheba / oqeqeshi koomamkela bamagatya njengabe-CIDB. Qinisekisa ukubakho kweenkqubo ezintle ngokwesiko zamashishini we-EPWP. Yenza imigaqo yemisebenzi nequmfo yogqozi labo bakhoyo. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo iqonde ngokwe-Labour Intensive Construction Methods. Qamba imigaqo nendlela yokukhokela ukwenza ulawulo oluqhuba imisebenzi. Nikeza ngeenkcubeko ze-OHSA kubathathi nxaxheba. Qinisekisa ukuba oqeqeshi abakhethiweyo bane-CETA Accreditation nabo bakubhalisile kumaziko efaneleyo okulawula amashishini okwakha izindlu, ngokomzekelo i-SAICE. Qinisekisa ukuba magatya egazini lweNkqubo okuyiyo ecaleni kolawulo ngokomthetho wamagatya athunyelwe koomamkela. Yenza ukuba abantu banxibelelane ngeenkqubo zomsebenzi nangokwentsebenziso. Qinisekisa ukubakho kobuhlobo obuhle nokuqhelanisa phakathi kweekomityo zoLawulo lweNkqubo yeMigqaqo, Iindlu ZoMgaqo eZilawula uMzantsi, Iindlu ezongamela amaxabiso nangokwentshukumbo yoluntu. Qhuba inkqubo yokubonana neenkqubo ezizii ngeenkqubo ezifundwa kwaye nasekuboneni ngokomsebenzi wokuqaliswa korhulumente ekuqhelanisweni korhulumente. Hlaziya inkqubo yokuhlolwa kubathathi nxaxheba ngokweenkqubo ze-EPWP okuzii ngeendlela ezimiselweyo i.e. %women, %youth and %disabilities.

jobs.title: Chief Works Inspector -electrical
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Chief Works Inspector (Electrical) for the Department of Public Works in Modimolle, Limpopo, requiring an NQF 6 qualification or trade test and three years of electrical experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric and a qualification at NQF level 6 (T/N/S streams) as recognized by SAQA or N3 and a Trade Test Certificate in Electrical, or registration as an Electrical Engineering Technician. Minimum of three (03) years of experience in Electrical environment. A valid driver’s license with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Technical Competencies: Project Management. Technical analysis. Computer Literacy. Technical report writing. Production, process knowledge and skills. Generic Competencies: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team work. Creativity. Change Management. Financial Management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. Planning and organising.
jobs.duties: Identify needs and requirements of new work and repairs through the investigation of customer complaints and new services. Prepare specifications for unplanned maintenance and minor new work. Develop bill of quantities. Develop proposals on the associated costs. Render an inspection service of work done on new projects and existing structures. Inspect new and/or maintenance work undertaken on project sites to ensure that it is being done in compliance with all relevant regulations and legislation and that proper quality control is maintained. Compile and estimate of repairs and costs for minor new work and maintenance work to be undertaken. Develop, implement and maintain an electronic record system for work being done and work that was finalized. Develop progress reports on outstanding and finalized work. Analyse and compile relevant project documentation for new and existing structures. Develop and interpret plans and sketched. Draw – up quotation documents and compile specifications, bills of quantities and bid documents. Adjudicate and provide recommendations on quotations and bids. Liase with relevant stakeholders in respect of technical aspects. Manage the activities of contractors on project sites. Advice and guide contractors in respect of the compliance to legislation and procedures. Verify invoices and certify progress of payments. Check and process variation orders and make recommendations on requests for the extension of deadlines. Brief contractors and consultants on projects and certify claims for fees. Ensure effective contract administration. Facilitate and resolve problems emanating from projects and develop progress reports on projects. Provide extended Public works Programme. Gather and submit information in terms of the extended Public Works Programme. Supervise the performance and conduct of works Inspectors. Identify skills development needs and provide training and development opportunities for Works Inspector. Provide advice and guidance on the interpretation and application of legislation, policies and procedures. Ensure quality control and effective and efficient workflow of work done by works Inspectors and report on all work allocated. Monitor proper utilization of equipment, stores and expenditure. Administer the departmental performance management and development system.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Rammala MY and Ms PE Hlaole Tel No: (014) 718 3000/3040/3052/3027.

jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment.
