Ulwazi nge-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Directives, i-Notes ne-DORA. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zemali i-BAS, LOGIS, PERSAL. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukwahlulahlula, ukuphuhliswa nokucafuna iinkqubomgubo. Amakhono okukhokelela inkqubo. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuwahlulahlula. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokelela iqela. Ubuchule bokwakha. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuwuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Amakhono ekhompyutha. UkuLawula abantu. Ukucajiswa nokuqulunqa.
xh.duties: Bonezela ukuthwala iingeniso: Qinisekisa imali ethathiwe ngokuchasene nencwadi yesitshixo. Bhala isitshixo kwi-BAS. Bonezela incwadi yemali: Linganisa incwadi yemali nesipesheli sokugcwtya. Qwalasela ukuvalwa kweencwadi. Bonezela iingxelo zencwadi yemali ezivezwe ngeveki, ngenyanga, ngetrimester ngonyaka. Bonezela ulondolazo lwenkqubo: Bonezela ulondolazo lwenkqubo yemali. Qinisekisa isakhiwo sekhodi ethathiwe ngokuchasene nesakhiwo sangaphakathi sesebe. Yenza ukuba kusebenze izinto ezisusiweyo okanye ezingasebenziyo. Faka iiparamitha ezintsha zize zilondolozwe eziphelayo. Bonezela inkxaso kumsebenzisi: Ndika nokuqinisekisa imisebenzi yenkxaso kumsebenzisi ngokwodirektorate. Phonononga i-ids ezithintelweyo. Aba imisebenzi. Qwalasela okuphumayo kwenkqubo.

jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: State Accountant needed at Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure in Limpopo to process payments, accounts and vouchers on LOGIS.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric and a qualification at NQF Level 6 in Financial Accounting, Financial Management/ Administration/ Cost Accounting as recognized by SAQA. 2-3 years’ experience in the finance environment. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations, PFMA, DORA, PPPFA. Knowledge of PERSAL & BAS systems. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Creativity. Financial management. Communication. Computer skills.

Capture/ approve payment voucher on LOGIS. Receive EBT stubs. Link stubs and invoices and dispatch copy of stubs to suppliers. File payment vouchers according to system. Reconcile supplier statements against payments. Negotiate with suppliers regarding payments. Compile monthly register for fruitless and wasteful expenditure and submit to Head Office. Compile monthly report for payments made after thirty (30) days. Capture EPWP stipends on BAS. Provide salary: Check authenticity of documents to be capture on PERSAL system. Capture PERSAL transactions such as allowances, deductions, fringe benefits and IRP deductions. Provide PERSAL administration in salary enquiries and reports. Verify and approve receipts in the BAS. Day-end receipts on BAS. Confirm deposits on BAS. Monitor online receipts and deposits for reconciliation. Compile monthly reports. Keep a register for reserve face value forms. Facilitate debt: Open debt file for relevant employer. Complete BAS Debt take on and attached supporting documents for submission to Head Office for implementation of debt on suspense account. Receive advice from Head Office to implement DEBT ON PERSAL in cases where the debtor is a government/department employee. Liaise with Head Office in updating BAS records. Conceive reports from Head Office in clearing of Debts. Close Debt files. Provide resource (Human, Financial and Equipment): Monitor and report on the utilisation of equipment’s. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage discipline. Provide job description to subordinates. Manage division leave matters.

af.title: Staatsrekenmeester
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeester benodig by Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure in Limpopo om betalings, rekeninge en tjekies op LOGIS te verwerk.
af.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric en 'n kwalifikasie op NQF Vlak 6 in Finansiële Rekenkunde, Finansiële Bestuur/ Administrasie/ Kosterekenkunde soos deur SAQA erken. 2-3 jaar ervaring in die finansiële omgewing. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante Openbare Diens-wette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsontleding, -ontwikkeling en -interpretasie. Kennis van Tesourie-regulasies, PFMA, DORA, PPPFA. Kennis van PERSAL & BAS-stelsels. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede.
af.duties: Verwerk betalings en rekeninge: Ontvang bestelling vanaf voorsieningsketting. Kontroleer vir afleweringsnota en faktuur. Stel betaaltjie op vir EBT-oordrag. Vang/keur betaaltjie op LOGIS. Ontvang EBT-stompies. Skakel stompies en fakture en stuur afskrif van stompies aan verskaffers. Lê betaaltjies volgens stelsel. Rekonsilieer verskafferstate teen betalings. Onderhandel met verskaffers rakende betalings. Stel maandelikse register op vir vrugtelose en vermorsende besteding en dien by Hoofkantoor in. Stel maandelikse verslag op vir betalings gedoen na dertig (30) dae. Vang EPWP-toelaes op BAS. Verskaf salaris: Kontroleer egtheid van dokumente om op PERSAL-stelsel vas te lê. Vang PERSAL-transaksies soos toelaes, aftrekkings, byvoordele en IRP-aftrekkings. Verskaf PERSAL-administrasie in salarisnavrae en verslae. Monitor indiening van belastingbetalers se IRP 3A by SARS. Identifiseer en spesifiseer staatsverpligtinge op pensioenfonds. Verskaf inkomste: Invordering van Regeringsgeld. Reik kwitansies handmatig of aanlyn uit onder korrekte toekenning. Registreer kwitansies in kontantboek. Deponeer geld. Balanseer kwitansies, kontantboek en deponeerboek. Kontroleer bankgeld. Kontroleer en keur kwitansies in BAS. Eind-van-dag-kwitansies op BAS. Bevestig deposito's op BAS. Monitor aanlyn kwitansies en deposito's vir rekonsiliasie. Stel maandelikse verslae op. Hou 'n register vir reserwe-nominaalwaarde-vorms. Fasiliteer skuld: Open skuldlêer vir toepaslike werkgewer. Voltooi BAS-skuldoorname en heg ondersteunende dokumente vir voorlegging aan Hoofkantoor vir implementering van skuld op hangrekening. Ontvang advies van Hoofkantoor om SKULD OP PERSAL te implementeer in gevalle waar die skuldenaar 'n regerings-/departementwerknemer is. Skakel met Hoofkantoor in verband met bywerking van BAS-rekords. Ontvang verslae van Hoofkantoor in verreken van skuld. Sluit skuldlêers. Verskaf hulpbron (Menslik, Finansiële en Toerusting): Monitor en rapporteer oor benutting van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie en beoordeling van werknemers. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Bevorder en behou werknemermotivasie en kweek 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur dissipline. Verskaf werksbeskrywing aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur afdelingsverlofaangeleenthede.

zu.title: Isiphathimandi Sombuso
zu.summary: Kudingeka isiphathimandi sombuso ePublic Works, Roads and Infrastructure eLimpopo ukucubungula izinkokhelo, izikhwama kanye namathikithi kwi-LOGIS.
zu.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric kanye nokuqeqeshwa okulingana ne-NQF Level 6 ku-Financial Accounting, Financial Management/ Administration/ Cost Accounting njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. 2-3 years’ experience in the finance environment. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations, PFMA, DORA, PPPFA. Knowledge of PERSAL & BAS systems. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Creativity. Financial management. Communication. Computer skills.
zu.duties: Cubungula izinkokhelo nezikhwama: Thola i-oderivhumbo kusuka kumkhiqizo ophuma kwi-supply chain. Hlola ukuthi kunothi lokulethwa noma i-invoice. Hlanganisa ithikithi lenkokhelo yayo i-EBT transfer. Faka/amukele ithikithi lenkokhelo kwi-LOGIS. Thola ama-stubs e-EBT. Xhuma ama-stubs nama-invoices bese uthumela ikhophi yama-stubs kubanikazi bamahlinza. Faka emafayelini amathikithi okukhokha ngokwesimiso zomtholampilo. Ukuqathanisa amafayili abanikazi bahlinza ezinkokhelweni. Xoxisana nabahlinza ngemayelana nezinkokhelo. Lungelelanisa i-monthly register le-fruitless and wasteful expenditure bese iyithumela eHead Office. Hlanganisa ingxoxo yenyanga ngezinkokhelo ezenziwe emva kwamalanga angamashumi amathathu (30). Faka izimali zokusebenza ze-EPWP kwi-BAS. Hlinzeka ngeholo: Qinisekisa ubungempela chamaphepha okufanele afakwe kwi-system ye-PERSAL. Faka izinkonzo ezengeziwe, izibalo kanye ne-IRP deductions kwi-PERSAL. Hlinzeka ngenkonzolisekelo ye-PERSAL kwimibuzo nangemigca yemininingwane. Qapha ukuthunyelwa kwabahlawulelwa phansi ababhaliswa ku-IRP 3A bayise kwi-SARS. Hlola futhi uchaze izibopho zombuso kwi-pension fund. Hlinzeka ngemali engenayo: Eqoqwa imali kahulumeni. Khipha izitifikedi ngesandla noma online ngaphansi komtholampilo. Qamba okutholwayo encwadini yemali. Faka imali egunyazweni. Linganisa okutholwayo kanye nencwadi yokufaka imali. Qinisekisa imali esesikhungweni. Hlola futhi uvume iziphoqezelwa kwi-BAS. Qedela usuku ngezitholwayo kwi-BAS. Qinisekisa imali egcinwe kwi-BAS. Qapha izitholwayo nezimali ezibhalisiwe online zenqubo. Hlanganisa imibiko yenyanga. Gcina irejista yezinto. Phatha imali ehlalwe ibambe: Vula ifayela lomhlawuleli wasebenza. Qedela isistimu yokuqamba idethi kumhlawuleli bese kunamaphepha abambe iqhaza okuthunyelwa eHead Office ukuba kuqhutshwe inqubo yokwenza isibopho senhlawulo. Thola amazwi avela eHead Office okwenza idethi ekhonza abasebenzi bomhlawuleli. Xhumana neHead Office ekubhaleni imibhalo. Thumela imibiko eHead Office. Qedela idethi. Hlinzeka ngokuhlakulela: Qapha bese ubika ngokusetyenziswa kwemishini. Nika amandla abasebenzi futhi banike isikhuthazo. Phatha inhlalo nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Landa, futhi ugcine isifiso nokusebenza ngemigomo nokuqina kwabasebenzi. Phatha izinkomba. Hlinzeka ngokubhaliswa kwabasebenzi. Lawula ukushiywa kwemisebenzi ngqo.

xh.title: I-accountant karhulumente
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe ngumsebenzi we-Accountant we-Levabo esiPumalanga ukuqala ukuqinisekisa imirhumo ye-Accountant e-Pfuma.
xh.requirements: Ivela kwinqanaba le-12 nesidanga se-6 kwi-National Qualifications Framework kwinkqubo ye-Accounting okanye i-Cost Accounting, njengoko bonakaliswa ngumlalo we-South African Qualifications Authority. Iminyaka ye-2 ukuya kwe-3 yamava kwindalo yemali. Ilungiselelo lokusebenza ngesithuthi, ngaphandle kwabo bakhubazekileyo. Ulwazi kwiincomboxo, iimiso nolwazi ngokusebenza kwe-nto. Ulwazi ngokusebenza kwe-nto ukusuka kumthetho okhoyo we-Public Service. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezingaphezulu kwesikhundla nangaphezulu kwamagunya.
xh.duties: Qhuba ukuhlawula iimalizo nee-akhawunti: Landa iodolo kumntla wokusetyenziswa. Hangqala inkqubo yokuhlawula. Qinisekisa inqaku lokuhlawula kwesixhobo sokuhlawula i-EBT. Faka ngokusetyenziswa kwaye uvume inqaku lokuhlawula ngokusebenzisa inkqubo ye-BAS. Qinisekisa ukuvunywa kweenkcukacha ezithunyelwe kwinkqubo ye-BAS. Lungisa iindlela zokubhalisa kwe-BAS. Qhuba umbhalo we-BAS ngokwamava abasebenzisiyo. Hlola imisebenzi yabasebenzi ngokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo ye-BAS. Qinisekisa ukuvunywa kweenkcukacha kwiziko elikhulu. Lungisa nokutshintsha iinkcukacha zoluntu. Ndweba ingxelo ngokuhlawula. Faka imisebenzi yabasebenzi eqondweni lokuqonda amava abo. Khipa ingxelo yamava abasebenziyo ngenyanga.

jobs.title: Works Inspector
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Works Inspector needed in Mopani district to inspect building and maintenance work on project sites for compliance with regulations.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (T/N/S streams) or equivalent, or N 3 and a trade test in the building environment, or Registration as an Engineering Technician, and Valid driver’s license with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Technical Competencies: Project Management. Technical analysis. Computer Literacy. Technical report writing. Production, process knowledge and skills. Generic Competencies: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Teamwork. Customer focus and responsiveness. Planning and organising. Job Knowledge. Communications. Interpersonal. Flexibility. Teamwork. Computer. Planning and organising. Language. Good verbal and written communication. Accuracy. Flexibility. Co-operative.
jobs.duties: Render a basic inspection service of work done on minor new and existing structures on a project basis. Check if new and/or maintenance work undertaken on project sites are following all relevant regulations and legislation. Conduct inspections on work done, or to be done, to check that proper quality control is maintained. Compile an estimate of repairs and costs for minor new work and maintenance work to be undertaken. Maintain an electronic record system for work being done and work that was finalised. Develop progress reports on outstanding and finalised work. Analyze and compile relevant documentation for work to be done on minor new and existing structures, through inter alia the following: Development and interpretation of plans and sketches. Draw-up quotation documents and compile specifications. Participate in the adjudication process and provide recommendations on quotations. Liaise with relevant stakeholders in respect of technical aspects. Oversee the work of contractors through inter alia the following: Inspect the work done by contractors to determine whether it is following all relevant prescribed standards. Advice and guide contractors in respect of the relevant legislation and regulations. Compile payment documents. Compile and process variation orders and requests for the extension of deadlines. Ensure effective contract administration. Timeous development of reports on problems emanating from projects. Render extended public works Programme. Gather and submit information in terms of the extended public works Programme.

af.title: Werkinssspakteur
af.summary: Werkinssspakteur benodig in Mopani-distrik om bou- en instandhoudingswerk op projeksusterreine te ondersoek vir voldoening aan regulasies.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (T/N/S-strome) of gelykwaardig, of N 3 en 'n vaktoets in die bou-omgewing, of Registrasie as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus, en Geldige bestuurslisensie met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Projektbestuur. Tegniese analise. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Tegniese verslagdoening. Produksie, proseskennis en vaardighede. Algemene Bevoegdhede: Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Samewerking. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Beplanning en organisering. Werkkennis. Kommunikasie. Interpersoonlik. Aanpasbaarheid. Samewerking. Rekenaar. Beplanning en organisering. Taal. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasie. Akkuraatheid. Aanpasbaarheid. Saamwerkend.
af.duties: Lewer 'n basiese inspeksiediens van werk gedoen aan klein nuwe en bestaande strukture op 'n projeksusbasis. Kontroleer of nuwe en/of instandhoudingswerk wat op projeksusterreine onderneem word, alle tersaaklike regulasies en wetgewing volg. Voer inspeksies uit op werk gedoen, of om gedoen te word, om te kontroleer dat behoorlike gehaltebeheer gehandhaaf word. Stel 'n skatting op van herstelwerk en koste vir klein nuwe werk en instandhoudingswerk wat onderneem moet word. Onderhou 'n elektroniese rekordstelsel vir werk wat gedoen word en werk wat afgehandel is. Ontwikkel vorderingsverslae oor uitstaande en afgehandelde werk. Analiseer en stel tersaaklike dokumentasie op vir werk wat gedoen moet word aan klein nuwe en bestaande strukture, deur middel van onder andere die volgende: Ontwikkeling en interpretasie van planne en sketse. Stel kwotasiedokumente op en stel spesifikasies op. Neem deel aan die evaluasieproses en verskaf aanbevelings oor kwotasies. Skakel met tersaaklike belanghebbendes ten opsigte van tegniese aspekte. Hou toesig oor die werk van kontrakteurs deur middel van onder andere die volgende: Inspekteer die werk wat deur kontrakteurs gedoen is om te bepaal of dit alle tersaaklike voorgeskrewe standaarde volg. Adviseer en begelei kontrakteurs ten opsigte van die tersaaklike wetgewing en regulasies. Stel betalingsdokumente op. Stel veranderingsordes en versoeke om verlenging van sperdatums op en verwerk dit. Verseker effektiewe kontrakadministrasie. Tydige ontwikkeling van verslae oor probleme wat uit projekte voortspruit. Lewer uitgebreide openbare werke-programme. Versamel en dien inligting in in terme van die uitgebreide openbare werke-programme.

zu.title: Works Inspector
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMhloli Wesikhundla kwisebe le-Mopani ukuze ahlole umsebenzi wokwakha kanye nowokulondolozwa emasayithi ephrojekthi ngenhloso yokuthi uhambisane nemithetho.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe (T/N/S streams) noma okulinganayo, noma N 3 kanye nesesivivinyo sethreyidi esimhlathini wokwakha, noma ukubhalisa njengoBuchwepheshe Bomunyenti, kanye Nelayisense evumelekile yokuqasha ngaphandle kokuthi kufakiwe abafaki izicelo abanomphumela wokukhubazeka. Amakhono obuchwepheshe: Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Ukuhlola okobuchwepheshe. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukukhiqiza, ulwazi lenqubo kanye namakhono. Amakhono ajwayelekile: Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlola. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukusebenza njengqembu. Ukuqonda iklayenti kanye nokuzwa ngokushesha. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ulwazi lomsebenzi. Ukuthumela imiyalezo. Okwabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengqembu. Ikhompyutha. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ulimi. Ukuxhumana kahle ngokukhulunywa nokubhalwayo. Ukubhekisisa. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenzisana.
zu.duties: Nikeza insiza yokuhlola okuyisisekelo yomsebenzi ozenziwe ezakhiwo ezincane ezintsha futhi ezikhona ngokwesikhundla sephrojekthi. Hlolisisa ukuthi umsebenzi omusha kanye/noma umsebenzi wokulondolozwa ozenziwe emasayithi ephrojekthi ulandela yonke imithetho nemithethonqubo ehlobene. Yenza izinhlobo zokuhlola emsebenzini ozenziwe, noma okuzokwenziwa, ukuze uhlole ukuthi kulawulwa kahle izinga lomsebenzi. Hlanganisa ukulinganiswa kokulungisa kanye nezindleko zomsebenzi omusha omncane kanye nomsebenzi wokulondolozwa okuzokwenziwa. Gcina uhlelo lerekhodi lekhompyutha lomsebenzi ozenziwayo nomsebenzi oqedile. Butha imibiko yokuqhubeka komsebenzi ongaqedile nongaqediwe. Hlola futhi uhlanganise umhlahlandlela ohambisanayo womsebenzi okuzokwenziwa ezakhiwo ezintsha futhi ezikhona, phakathi kokunye okulandelayo: Ukuthuthukiswa nokutolikwa kwezinhlelo kanye namadrayimi. Kubala amaxhesha futhi uhlanganise izinkomba. Thatha inxaxheba kwenqubo yokuqasha futhi unikeze izincomo ngamaxhesha. Xhumana namaphathi ahlobene ngamaphuzu obuchwepheshe. Qaphela umsebenzi wabaninkosi phakathi kokunye okulandelayo: Hlola umsebenzi ozenziwe yibaninkosi ukuze unqume ukuthi ulandela yonke izindinganiso ezibalulekile ezimisiwe. Nikela ngolwazi futhi uhola abaninkosi mayelana nomthetho nemithethonqubo ehlobene. Hlanganisa amadokhumenti ezimali. Hlanganisa futhi ucubungule amadeshi okushintsha kanye nezicelo zokunweba izikhathi zokuqedwa. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo kusukela ngesikhathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemibiko ngokushesha mayelana nezinkinga ezivel kumaphrojekthi. Nikeza insiza evuliwe yohlelo lolusebenzo lomphakathi. Qoqa futhi uhlole ulwazi ngokusho kohlelo oluvuliwe lolusebenzo lomphakathi.

xh.title: uMhloli womsebenzi
xh.summary: Kufuneka idwelwe iMhloli womsebenzi kummandla i-Mopani ukuze ahlole umsebenzi owakhiwa nowolondolozwa kwindawo zamaphrojekthi ukuzinisekisa ukuba ulandela imigaqo.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma yesiKahulumende (iindlela ze-T/N/S) okanye into elinganayo, okanye i-N 3 kwaye unomlinganiselo weshishini kwindawo yokwakha, okanye uBhaliso njengoTshensi kaMzingeni weNjiniya, kwaye unelayisense yokuqhuba esemthethweni ngaphandle kwabo bafaka isicelo abanokuwongozolo. Ikhono emmandla wamandla: ukuPhatha iPhrojekthi. Uhlolojio olusemmandla wamandla. Ukufunda nokubhala ngesikompyutha. Ukubhala iingxelo zemithambo. Ukuvelisa, ulwazi lenkqubo namakhono. Iikhakhi elisetyenziswa ngokubanzi: ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo. Ukwenza iigqibo. Ukusebenza ngokudibana. Ukwagqitha kubathengi kwaye uphendule. Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ulwazi lomsebenzi. Iindlela zoxhumo. Ngokomntu nomntu. Ukuqhelana. Ukusebenza ngokudibana. Isikompyutha. Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ulwimi. Ulwazi oluchanekileyo lokuthetha nokubhala. Ukuchaneka. Ukuqhelana. Ukubambisana.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo esisiseko yokuhlola umsebenzi ozenziweyo kwiindlwana ezintsha ezincinci nakele zikhoyo ngokusekelwe kumthamo. Qinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi omtsha kwaye nokunokuthi ngowolondolozo owenziwa kwindawo zamaphrojekthi ulandela zonke iimigaqo nengcombolo ezifanelekileyo. Yenza ukuhlola kumsebenzi ozenziweyo, okanye ofanele ukuba yenziwe, ukuqinisekisa ukuba kulawulwa ngokuchanekileyo umgangatho wemigangatho. Hlanganisela ulwazi lokulinganisa irekhayamendi nokuqinisekisa iindleko zomsebenzi omtsha ongaphantsi nomsebenzi wolondolozo ofanele ukuba wenziwe. Phatha inkqubo yokugcina iirekhod ngamandlobhane yomsebenzi oqhubekayo nowegqityweyo. Dala iingxelo ezingatshongo ngomphumo malunga nomsebenzi ongaphelanga nogqityweyo. Hlaziya kwaye uhlanganise oxelo lwamaxwebhu afanelekileyo yomsebenzi ofanele ukuba wenziwe kwizakhiwo ezintsha ezincinci nakele zikhoyo, phakathi kokunye ngezinto ezilandelayo: Ukuqumba nokutolika iiplani nezandifa. Hlaziya oxelo lweempahla ezinxulumene namaxabiso kwaye uhlanganise iingcebiso ezithile. Thatha inxaxheba kwindlela yokuphathwa komngeni kwaye unike iingcebiso malunga noxelo lweempahla. Thatha ingxoxo naba ngabanye abanegalelo malunga neendlela ezisemngangathweni. Qhubela phambili umsebenzi kontrathathi phakathi kokunye ngezinto ezilandelayo: Hlola umsebenzi ozenziwe ngabakontrathathi ukuzinqumla ukuba ulandela yonke imigangatho echaziweyo eqhelekileyo. Nikela ngolwazi kwaye uqokele kontrathathi malunga nengcombolo nemiqathango eqhelekileyo. Hlanganisela oxelo lweempahla zentlawulo. Hlanganisa kwaye ulungise amaxwebhu okutshintsha imiofelo neemfuno zokwandisa ixesha lokugqibela. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okusebenzayo kwekhontrakthi. Ukwenza iingxelo ngokuphuhlunga kwexesha malunga neengxaki ezivela kumaphrojekthi.nika inkonzo ebanzi yenkqubo yamashishini esiKahulumende. Khuthaza kwaye ungenise ulwazi ngokwalo lwase mthethweni wenkqubo ebanzi yamashishini esiKahulumende.

jobs.title: Artisan Production Grade A,
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Artisan Production Grade A at Sibasa Mechanical Workshop responsible for servicing and repairing roads-related plant and equipment.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate Trade Test Certificate as Diesel Mechanic. Experience will be an added advantage. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge: Relevant Acts and regulations. Road maintenance Manual. Health and safety measures. Technical Competencies: Technical analysis. Computer aided technical applications, Legal compliance, Technical report writing, Technical consulting, Production, process knowledge and skills. Generic Competencies: Problem solving and analysis, Decision making, Team work, Creativity, Self-Management, Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication, Computer skills, Planning and organising.
jobs.duties: Perform services and repairs to roads related plant and equipment: Repairs: Receive job card. Stabilize machine or vehicle. Run the engine until warm. Turn engine off. Drain oil into container. Re-install the drain plug. Remove filters (oil, fuel & air filter). Examine filter debris. Install new filters. Refill oil and check for leaks and level. Test drive. Service: Check the condition of working area for safety. Determine problem existing. State problem in writing. Visual inspection on machine/ vehicle (for further damage such as leaks boos bolts and cracks). Fix the problem and re-test. Analyse the failure. List all possible causes. Run test and record information. Eliminate and insolate. Provide mechanical expertise: Carry out services as per service category and complete standards. Doing visual and pre-checks inspection on plant before and after service/repairs is carried out as well as the compiling of inspection sheet. Making full report of the findings and completing of job cords after competing any repair or service. Perform per-inspection for additional defects before repairs: Dismantling. Lay-out. Check condition of warn out parts. Repair or replace where necessary and assemble. Clean the object/part and test it. Perform administrative and related functions: Provide inputs on the compilation of technical reports. Keep and maintain job records and other registers. Maintain and adhere to agreed development plan.

af.title: Artisan Production Grade A,
af.summary: Artisan Production Grade A by Sibasa Mechanical Workshop verantwoordelik vir die diens en herstel van padverwante aanleg en toerusting.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Vaktoetssertifikaat as Dieselmeganikus. Ervaring sal 'n voordeel wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis: Relevante Wetten en regulasies. Pad-instandhoudingshandleiding. Gesondheids- en veiligheidsmaatreëls. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Tegniese ontleding. Rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings, Regsonderhouding, Tegniese verslagskryfwerk, Tegniese konsultasie, Produksie, proseskennis en vaardighede. Algemene Bevoegdhede: Probleemoplossing en ontleding, Besluitneming, Spanwerk, Kreatiwiteit, Selfbestuur, Kliëntfokus en aanspreeklikheid, Kommunikasie, Rekenaarvaardighede, Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Voer dienste en herstelwerk aan padverwante aanleg en toerusting uit: Herstelwerk: Ontvang werkkaart. Stabiliseer masjien of voertuig. Laat die enjin loop tot warm. Skakel enjin af. Dreineer olie in 'n houer. Herinstalleer die dreineerprop. Verwyder filters (olie-, brandstof- en lugfilter). Ondersoek filterrommel. Installeer nuwe filters. Vul olie by en kontroleer vir lekkasies en vlak. Toetsrit. Diens: Kontroleer die toestand van die werksarea vir veiligheid. Bepaal die bestaande probleem. Stel die probleem skriftelik. Visuele inspeksie op masjien/voertuig (vir verdere skade soos lekkasies, los boltte en krake). Herstel die probleem en toets weer. Ontleed die fout. Lys alle moontlike oorsake. Voer toets uit en rekord inligting. Elimineer en isoleer. Verskaf meganiese kundigheid: Voer dienste uit volgens dienskategorie en voltooi standaarde. Doen visuele en voorafkontrole-inspeksie op aanleg voor en nadat diens/herstelwerk gedoen is, asook die opstel van die inspeksieblad. Maak 'n volledige verslag van die bevindings en voltooi werkkaarte na die voltooiing van enige herstelwerk of diens. Voer vooraf-inspeksie uit vir bykomende defekte voor herstelwerk: Demontage. Uitleg. Kontroleer toestand van uitgediende onderdele. Herstel of vervang waar nodig en monteer. Maak die objek/deel skoon en toets dit. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit: Verskaf insette oor die opstel van tegniese verslae. Hou en onderhou werkrekords en ander registers. Onderhou en voldoen aan die ooreengekome ontwikkelingsplan.

zu.title: Artisan Production Grade A,
zu.summary: Artisan Production Grade A kwaSibasa Mechanical Workshop uphathwa ngokukhonzwa kwezinsiza nezinsiza ezihlobene nezinkambu zokwenza umsebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esimfaneleko sokuhlolwa kwebhizinisi njengoba injini. Ulwazi luya kuba yinzuzo. Leslesi yomshayeli, okungehlwa ngalabo abafaka isicelo abanesikhindi sesandla. Ulwazi: Izikhalazo nemitikhasa. Ibhalo yokulondoloza. Izindlela zokuvikela impilo nokuphepha. Ikhono lobuchwepheshe: Ukucubungula ubuchwepheshe. Izinhlelo eziyisibonelo zezilawuli, ukulandela umthetho, ukubhalwa kwamabhiko ezilawuli, ukuphakamiswa kwamabiko obuchwepheshe, ukukhiqizwa, ukwazi kanye nokwaziswa izinhlelo. Amakhono awo: Ukuxazulula inkinga nokucubungula, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza ngohlelo, ukwakha, ukuzinakekela, ukunaka iKhasimende kanye nokuphendula, ukuthumela imilayo, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukulungiselela nokuhlela. Yonke imibuzo mayibanjwe ngaphezulu. Izikhalazo ezenza imigomo.
zu.duties: Yenza izinsizo nokulungisa izitshi nezihlahlama zihlobene nezimoto: Ukulungisa: Thola ikhadi lomsebenzi. Zinise imoto noma inqolovane. Qhuba injini kuze kufudumele. Vala injini. Chitha uhowo esitsheni. Beka kabusha isikhafu sokuchitha. Khupha amafuletha (uhowo, uphethiloli nephoyiza). Hlola izinsalela zamafuletha. Faka amafuletha amasha. Gcwalisa uhowo uhole ukuya kwamakhophu nazinga. Qhuba ukuhlola. Ukulekelelwa: Hlola isimo sendawo yokusebenza ngokuphepha. Qinisekisa inkinga ekhona. Chaza inkinga ngokubhalwe. Ukubuka ngaso sonke isikhathi imoto/inqolovane (ukuthola konke ukulimala okunjengokuwohloka, izikwebhu namaqhinga). Lungisa inkinga uphinde uhlôle. Hlola inkinga. Bhala yonke imiba ebandakanyekayo. Qhuba ukuhlola ubhale ukwaziswa. Susa okungalusiwa, zivale emaKhasimende. Faka isandla ngokwesibonelo nangokwenza izidingo. Lelelise imisebenzi yokuthola imiba: Ukuqoqa imisebenzi kanye nokulungisa inqolovane ngaphambi nangemva kokwenza ukulungiswa/uKulekelelwa, kanye nokubhalwa kwekhasi lokuhlola. Ukubhala umbiko ngakho konke okutholiwe, nokugcwalisa amakhadi emisebenzi, kanye nokugcwalisa emaKhasimende ngemva kwalokho kwenziwa konke ukulungiswa noma uKulekelelwa. Yenza ukucubungula ukuthola eminye imiba ephansi ngaphambi kokulungisa. Qoqa. Hlola isimo sezinsalela. Sika noma ukhiqize okusha lapho kudingeka khona, ubuyise. Hlanza noma yisiphi isiqu/isikhindi bese uhlola. Yemisebenzi yamaministri: Nikeza imibono ekwenzeni imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Gcina amarekhodi emisebenzi. Zinike ngamarekhodi kanye nemibhalo. Zinike emigomo yentuthuko.

xh.title: I-Artisan Production Grade A,
xh.summary: I-Artisan Production Grade A e-Sibasa Mechanical Workshop ebuyelele ekukweni inkonzo nokulungisa izixhobo nemishini ezihlobene nezithili.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sokuvavanywa kobuchwepheshe esifanelekile njengakwa-Diesel Mechanic. Amava kuya kuba lusizo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni, ngaphandle kabanini abanokuphila kukhubekile. Ulwazi: Izithili ezifanelekileyo nemigaqo. Inkqubo yokulungisa iindlela. Izigqibo zempilo nokhuseleko. Ikhono lobuchwepheshe: Uhlalutyo lobuchwepheshe. Izicelo zobuchwephesha ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuzalathiswa komthetho, ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe, iingcebiso zobuchwepheshe, ukukhiqiza, ulwazi nakhono lwenkqubo. Iikhono ezijolise kuzo zonke iindawo: Ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo, ukuthatha izigqibo, ukusebenza njengesithyithi, ukwakha, ukuzilawula, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula, unxibelelwano, iikhono zekhompyutha, ukucazulula nokuhlela.
xh.duties: Yenza inkonzo nokulungisa izixhobo nemishini ezihlobene nezithili: Ukulungisa: Yamkela ikhadi lomsebenzi. Misela isixhobo okanye isithuthi. Qhuba injini de yafudumeze. Vala injini. Thela uoli kwisitya. Buyisela isinxibelelothuli. Susa amafilitha (uoli, mafutha & filitha yomoya). Pheqa izinto ezitholwa kumanfilitha. Faka amafilitha amatsha. Gcwalisa uoli uze uhlola ukuba kukho ukuchitha nengqondo. Hamba uvavanye isithuthi. Inkonzo: Jonga imeko yendawo yokusebenza ngokwakhuseleko. Chaza ingxaki ekhoyo. Chaza ingxaki ngokubhalwayo. Ukujongwa okubonakalayo kwisexhobo/isithuthi (ngakumbi iingozi ezinjengokuchitha, iibholts ezibandayo nokuqhwaba). Lungisa ingxaki uvavanye kwakhona. Hlaza isilele. Bhala onke amachazi achanekileyo. Qhuba uvavanyo uze ulugcine ulwazi. Susa uyekele. Zenza iingcebiso zobuchwephesha bechwephesha: Yenza iinkonzo njengoko kuhlaululwe kwiindlela zenkonzo aze agqibezi ngemigaqo. Ukwenza ukujongwa okubonakalayo nokuqwalasela phambi nakwangemva kwenkonzo/ukulungisa izixhobo nokuhlela iphepha loqwalaselo. Ukwenza ingxelo epheleleyo ngako okufunyenweyo negqibelelo lamakhadi omsebenzi emva kokugqiba nalo naliphi na ilungiso okanye inkonzo. Yenza ukuqwalasela kwangaphambili ngeengozi ezongezelelekileyo phambi kokulungisa: Ukuxula. Ukubeka ngendlela. Jonga imeko yamacandelo aqhwathiweyo. Lungisa okanye tshintsha apho kufuneka khona uze udibane ndawonye. Cofa into/icandelo uze uluvavanye. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo nayo onayo: Nikela ngegalelo ekubhalweni kweengxelo zobuchwepheshe. Gcina ulondolozo amarekhodi omsebenzi nayo manye amagcisa. Yiza ulondoloze uze ulandele iplani yonnyulo elizwisiweyo.

zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esifanele se-Trade Test. Ilayisensi yokushayela esesimweni, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abanesisindo. ITechnical Competencies: Ulwazi lwe-technical analysis. Izinhlelo ze-computer-aided technical. Ulwazi lokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibiko ye-technical. Ulwazi nemakhono ekukhiqizeni nasezinqamuleleni. Generic Competencies: Ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengeqembu, amakhono okuhlaziya, ukudala, ukuzilawula, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula, ukuxhumana, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto, nokuxazulula izinkinga nokuzihlaziya.
zu.duties: Design: Kukhiqize imikhiqizo ngokwesici somthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Production: Kukhiqize izinto ngezinto zokwakha nangezinto ezingasetshenziswa ngokwesici somsebenzi nangokwezinga elivunyelwe. Quality assurance of produced objects. Quality assurance of serviced and maintained equipment and or facilities. Perform administrative and related functions: Bukela futhi uhlanganise nemibiko eqoqwe kuleso simo. Hlolisisa imibiko yezobuchwepheshe bese unikeza iziphakamiso ngokokuqoqwa kwawo. Gcina futhi ulungise irekhodi nesinyathelo sokukhiqiza kwesikhathi esizayo. Bukela nokuphatha abantu. Hlala nolwazi olunjani olusezingeni: Qhubeka nokuzithuthukisa ukuze ulandele izinhlelo nobuchwepheshe obusha.

Ulwazi ngezakhono zemveliso, yokuqhuba iinkqubo. xh.duties: Ubuzoba: Yakha iimodeli ngokwesicwangciso somthengi nangaphakathi kwemida yamandla okwenza. Ukwenza: Yenza izinto ngemisebenzi nasezixhobini ngokwesicwangciso somsebenzi nangokwemigaqo eziqhelanayo, Qinisekisa umgangatho wemveliso ezilungisiweyo. Ulungiselelo: Hlola izixhobo kwaye noma iziseko zeempahla ukujonga iimpazamo zobugcisa, Lungisa izixhobo nemiqobo yamagumbi ngokwemigaqo elandelwayo, Hlola izixhobo ezilungisiweyo kwaye okanye iziseko zeempahla ukukwanqamlezela nemiqobo yamagumbi ukunqamlezela imigaqo evunyiweyo, Zisebenzise izixhobo ngokwesicwangciso esivunyelweyo, qinisekisa umgangatho kwiixhobo ezizezwa nasezilungisiweyo ezizezwa nasezilungisiweyo. Zenza imisebenzi yolawulo: Lungelelanisa kwaye uzenze iingxelo ezithunyelwayo, Nikela iimbonakaliso ekwakheni iingxelo zobugcisa, Ziphathele phantsi kwaye zigcine irekhodi yomsebenzi nangamanye amagama alandela umqondiso, Phuhlisa kwaye ulandele isicwangciso sokuqhubela phambili esivunyelweyo, Qondise kwaye ulungise izisebenzi. Ulondolozo lwamandla obugcisa: Phuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo amandla karuntu kuwo namhlanje ukuze ugqame kumatechnoloji namaxesha amasha nangeendlela entsha.

Ikhono elijwayelekile: Ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengaqoqo, izikhokelo zokuhlaziya, ukwakha izinto, ukuzilawula, ukugxila kumthengi nokusabela, ukuxhumana, izikhokelo zekhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Ukudizayina: Kukhiqize amadizayini ngokuvumelana nesicelo somthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwezinkinga zokukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza: Kukhiqize izinto ngezinto zokwakhiwa nempahla ngokuvumelana nesicelo somsebenzi nasemazingeni abonakalayo, kuqinisekiswe ikhwalithi yezinto ezikhiqiziwe. Ukulondoloza: Kuhlole imishini nezinye izinto zezobuchwepheshe noma izindawo ukuze kubonakale iziphazamiso, kulungiswe imishini nezindawo ngokwezindinganiso, kuhlolwe imishini elungisiwe nezindawo ngokwezicelo, kunikezwe insiza imishini nezindawo ngokuhlelekile, kuqinisekiswe ikhwalithi yemishini nezindawo ezinikezwe insiza noma ezilondolozwe. Ukwenza imisebenzi yabaphathi nezinye imisebenzi ehlobene nayo: Kuhlanganiswa futhi kunikezwe imibiko, kunikezwe izinkomba ekubhenyeni imibiko yezobuchwepheshe, kugcinwe futhi kulondolozwe irekhodi lomsebenzi namanye amarejista, kugcinwe futhi kulandelwe uhlelo olumisiwe lokuthuthukisa, kuqedwe futhi kuholwe abasebenzi. Ukugcina ikhono: Ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo komuntu ngamunye ukuze kugqamisane nobuchwepheshe obusha nasezinqumeni.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wokuQeqesha I-A
xh.summary: Uvavanyo lokumiselwa koluhlu I-A kwisebe le-Vukileyo KwaXhosa, idolophu iVukileyo nakwaLimpopo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi esifanelekileyo sikaVavanyo loMsebenzi kwisebe lesixhobo esingeniso. I-TA plezhu yamakhaka ihlala iluncedo. Ulayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni, ngaphandle kwezicelo ezingekho mthethweni zokuvakalelwa.
xh.duties: Uyilo: Kwenza iziyo ngokwezicwangciso ziklayenti nangaphakathi kwemida yamandla okuvelisa. Ukukhiqiza: Kukhiqize izinto ngakwemixa nangokwamakhaka ezixhobo ngokwezicwangciso zomsebenzi nangokweemilinganiselo eziyaziwayo, Qinisekisa ukwakheka koluhlu lwezinto ezenziweyo. Ukugcina: Kujongwe izixhobo kwaye noma iziseko zeempahla ekuwohloko lwamath technical, Kulungiswe izixhobo nendalo yemizekelo yamakhaka, Kuvavwe ukulungiswa kwamakhaka noma iziseko zeempahla ngokwemilinganiselo, Kwenziwa inkonzo yamakhaka noma iziseko zeempahla ngokweluhlu lwexesha, Kuqinisekiswe ukwakheka koluhlu lwezinto ezenziweyo kwaye zigcinwe amakhaka noma iziseko zeempahla. Kwenziwa imisebenzi yolawulo nezengqe: Kuhlelwe kwaye kunikwe iingxelo, Kubhalelwe iingxelo ngokwamakhaka ezixhobo, Kugcinwe kwaye kuhlalwe kusemthethweni irekhodi yomsebenzi nokuqwalasela okunye, Kugcinwe kwaye kungamiselwa ngendlela eqqondiweyo ukuqonda iplani, Kuyalwa kwaye kubekwa ngumntu osesikhundleni ukuba afundise abasebenzi. Ukugcina ulwazi: Ukuphuhlisa ngokwenza kakuhle kumntu ngamnye ukuba bagcine ulwazi ngemiyalo nantlalo yamakhaka.

jobs.title: Road Works Foreman
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.centre: Sekhukhune district: Tsimanyane Roads Maintenance Ref No: S.4/3/10/190 (X1 Post) Groblersdal Roads Maintenance Ref No: S.4/3/10/191 (X1 Post) Mopani district: Ba-Phalaborwa Roads Maintenance Ref No: S.4/3/10/201 (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: The Department of Public Works seeks road works foremen to support road construction and maintenance across Sekhukhune and Mopani districts in Limpopo.

Valid drivers license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Acts and regulations. Road maintenance Manual. Roads operating machinery. Health and safety measures. Roads production procedures and processes. Problem solving and analysis Decision making Team leadership Creativity Financial management Customer focus and responsiveness Communication People management Planning and organising Conflict management.
jobs.duties: Support Road construction or maintenance work through: Construction of culvert and side drains. Erect and maintain steel guardrail and gabions. Construction of road earth and layer works. Clean and maintain roads, sidewalks and resting areas. Surfacing and pothole patching. Road fencing and pipe laying. Setting of road markings/signs. Install road signs and barricade the work area. Supervise activities in respect of road construction or maintenance work through: Application of safety and precautionary measures. Conduct inspection. Exercise control over tools, supplies and other equipment. Allocate tasks and oversee work performance. Maintenance of Equipment. Co-ordinate the blading program.

af.title: Padwerkvoorman
af.summary: Die Department of Public Works soek padwerkvoormanne om padkonstruksie en padonderhoud regdeur die Sekhukhune en Mopani distrikte in Limpopo te ondersteun.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF level 04 soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (03) jaar se padwerkonderhoudervaring. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van tersaaklike Wette en regulasies. Road maintenance Manual. Padopererende masjinerie. Gesondheids- en veiligheidsmaatreëls. Padproduksieprosedures en prosesse. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Ondersteun padkonstruksie- of onderhoudswerk deur: Konstruksie van duikers en sykanaal. Oprig en onderhou staalrighoute en gabions. Konstruksie van padaarde en laagwerke. Skoonmaak en onderhou van paaie, sypaadjies en rusareas. Oppervlaktewerking en potgate regmaak. Padheinings en pyplegging. Plaas van padmerke/tekens. Installeer padtekens en versper die werkarea. Hou toezig op aktiwiteite ten opsigte van padkonstruksie- of onderhoudswerk deur: Toepassing van veiligheids- en voorsorgmaatreëls. Voer inspeksies uit. Oefen beheer oor gereedskap, voorraad en ander toerusting uit. Ken take toe en hou toesig oor werkprestasie. Onderhoud van toerusting. Koördineer die skuiwingsprogram.

zu.title: Umphathi wemisebenzi yezindlela
zu.summary: IDepartment of Public Works ifuna abaphathi bezindlela ukusekela ukwakhiwa nokulondoloza kwezindlela kuso sonke isifunda i-Sekhukhune ne-Mopani e-Limpopo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezinga NQF level 04 njengoba zivunyelwe yi-SAQA. Three (03) years wokugcina izindlela. Isibhanekisi sokushayela, ngaphandle kwabo bakhubazekile. Ulwazi nezikhono: ULwazi ngomthetho. Indlela yokugcina. Izinto ezenza umsebenzi wezindlela. Izinsiza zezokuvikela inhlizio nezomzimba. Izindlela zokuqala nokwenza imigqa yomsebenzi. Ukuxazulula futhi uhlaziye izinkinga. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukuba ngumholi wethimba. Ukudala. Ukuphatha imali. ukweluleka abathengi. Isibhaxu. ukuphatha abantu. ukucubungula futhi uhlele. ukuphatha imibango.
zu.duties: Sekela umsebenzi wokwakhiwa noma ukugcinwa kwezindlela ngokuthi: Ukwakhiwa kwezitshiqamelo namagqogi esibhaxu. Ukumisa nokugcina osulethi besimende begqoloziyi. Ukukhiqiza umhlaba kwezindlela kanye nemisebenzi yezendlamathafa. Ukuqoba nokugcina izindlela, izihamba-hamba nabakumbe. Ukuletha umphepho kanye nokulungisa izigaxa. Ukubeka izingodo kanye nokubeka izimpompi. Ukumisa izimpawu kanye nokubeka izinkomba zezindlela. Beka izimpawu zokuthintela imishini kanti futhi thintela indawo yokusebenza. Qapha imisebenzi le yokwakhiwa noma yokugcinwa kwezindlela ngokuthi: Sebenzisa izinto zokuvikela nokuqapha. Yenza ukuhlola. Lawula izinkqubo, izingxenye nezinye izinto ezenziwa umuntu. Yabelana imisebenzi ubuke imisebenzi ezenziwayo. Ukugcina izinsiza. Hlanganisa uhlelo lokulungisa izindlela.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yendlela
xh.summary: Isebe lezaMisebenzi kaRhulumente lifuna abaphathi bemisebenzi yendlela ukunikela inkxaso ekwakhiweni nasekulondolozweni kweendlela kumazwe a-Sekhukhune naka-Mopani eLimpopo.
xh.requirements: Isitshixo. Isatshethu ukulunga nesiqinisekiso kusetyenziswa ngokutsha kokuba sisetyenziselwe ukuba ngoko kusetyenziswa iinkcukacha ezichaziweyo. Amakhulu amathathu. Isatshethu sikwalungele. Isatshethu sokuba sisetyenziswe. Isatshethu sokuba ngoko sikwalungele na. Isatshethu.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso emisweni wokwakhiwa okanye konjululwa kweendlela ngokuba: Kwakhiwa iindonga zamanzi ezithomalalisa amanzi. Misela kwaye ulondoloze izixhobo zensimbi ezikhusela iindlela. Kwakhiwa iindonga ezisuka emhlabeni kwaye kwakhiwe amanqanaba endlela. Coxumba kwaye ulondoloze iindledlana, iindawo zokuqhuba izithuthi kunye neendawo zokuphumla. Ukubeka umongo kwaye ulungise iimposo. Ukuhlala iindonga zendlela. Ukuhlala iimpawu zendlela. Misela iimpawu zendlela kwaye uvale indawo yokusebenza. Qwalasela imisebenzi ngokumayela nokuwakhiwa okanye ukulondolozwa kweendlela. Ukusebenzisa izithixhobo. Kwenziwe iingqwalasela. Lawula izixhobo, izinto kunye naye nyani na izixhobo. Abantu. Qwalasela. Zonke.

jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed in the Mopani district to manage rental services, capture payments, maintain registers and handle document safekeeping.

Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment. Computer. Planning and organising. Language. Good verbal and written communication.
jobs.duties: Administer rental services: Update and issue monthly rental statements. Update the rental register. Capture and update rental payments system for cash payments. Update register and statistics. Provide safekeeping of rental documents by: File in the respective files. Folio numbers the files. Update the refund register. Update the arrear rental register. Write arrear notifications to tenants. Prepare statement of accounts. Render general clerical support services: Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data. Remove the property from the Asset Register. Handle routing enquiries. Make photocopies and receive or send facsimiles. Distribute documents/packages to various stakeholders as required. Keep and maintain the filling system for the component. Type letters and/or other correspondence when required. Keep and maintain the incoming and outgoing document register of the component. Provide supply chain clerical support services within the component; Liaise with internal and external stakeholders in relation to procurement of goods and services. Order office stationery. af.title: Administrasieklerk
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig in die Mopani-distrik om huurdienste te bestuur, betalings in te vang, registers te onderhou en die veilige bewaring van dokumente te hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF level 04 soos deur SAQA erken. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data in te vang, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistieke te versamel. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Rekenaar. Beplanning en organisering. Taal. Goede mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie.
af.duties: Administreer huurdienste: Werk maandelikse huurstellings by en reik dit uit. Werk die huurregister by. Vang huurbetalings vir kontantbetalings in die stelsel in en werk dit by. Werk register en statistieke by. Verskaf veilige bewaring van huurdokumente deur: Liasseer in die onderskeie lêers. Voeg folionommers aan die lêers toe. Werk die terugbetalingsregister by. Werk die agterstallige huurregister by. Skryf kennisgewings oor agterstallige bedrae aan huurders. Berei rekeninguittrekkels voor. Lewer algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste: Neem op, organiseer, stoor, vang in en onttrek korrespondensie en data. Verwyder die eiendom uit die bate-register. Hanteer roeteringsnavrae. Maak fotostate en ontvang of stuur faksimiles. Versprei dokumente/pakkette aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent. Tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent. Verskaf toeleweringsketting-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent; Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Bestel kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent. Verskaf personeel- en finansiële administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Fasiliteer reis en akkommodasie. Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaan- en reisaansprake van amptenare.

zu.title: Iclerk Lokuphatha
zu.summary: Kudingeka iclerk lokuphatha esifundeni saMopani ukuphatha izinsizakalo zokuhlinzeka ngenhlaziyo, ukubhala izinkokhelo, ukugcina izinkomba nokuphatha ukugcinwa kwemibhalo ngokuphepha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 04 njengoba kunconywa i-SAQA. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo, ngaphandle kokubakwa kwabafuna abayizikhashana. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamaclerk, izinqubo kanye nokuthi ukwazi ukubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda inqubo yomthetho ebusa Inkonzo Yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngamaphuzu okusebenza ngaphakathi kwendawo yokusebenza. Ikhompyutha. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ulimi. Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhala kahle.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsizakalo zokuhlinzeka ngenhlaziyo: Buyekeza futhi ukhulule izitatimende zenyanga zonke zenhlanzela. Buyekeza inkomba yamahlazo. Bhala futhi ubuyekeze inqubo yezinkokhelo zamahlazo ngemali yesikhoto. Buyekeza inkomba nezibalo. Hlinzeka ngokugcinwa kwemibhalo yamahlazo ngokuphepha ngokuthi: Faka kumafayela ahambisanayo. Faka inombolo yamakhasi kumafayela. Buyekeza inkomba yembuyiselo. Buyekeza inkomba yamahlazo amiswe ngemuva. Bhala izaziso zamahlazo amiswe ngemuva kwabahlinzeki. Lungiselela izitatimende zama-akhawunti. Nikeza imisebenzi jikelele yokuqasha: Bhala, hlela, gcina, futhi ukhiye ulwazimagama nemibhalonikeza futhi ulandele inkomba.  Khupha impahla kuNkomba Yempahla. Phatha imibuzo ejwayelekile. Yenza amakhophi futhi wamukele noma uthumele ama-fax. Sula imibhalo/amasenthimishi kubalingane abahlukene njengoba kudingeka. Gcina futhi uphendle inqubo yokufaka izinto kwelunga. Bhala izincwadi futhi/noma eminye imibhalo lapho kudingeka. Gcina futhi uphendle inkomba yemibhalo engenayo naphumayo kwelunga. Nikeza imisebenzi yokwesekwa kwezinto zokusiza ezintweni zokusiza kwelunga; Xhumana nabalaye bangaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nokuthengwa kwempahla nezinsiza. Thema izinto zokubhala ezioffisini. Gcina futhi uphendle inkomba yempahla kwelunga. Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokwesekwa kokuphatha abantu nezimali. Gcina inkomba yokuhlala ikhona kwelunga. Qondise ukuhamba nokuhlala. Hlola ukulungile kokufuna kokudla nokuhambe komsebenzi.

xh.title: I-Klerki Yolawulo
xh.summary: Kufuneka iklerki yolawulo kwisithili se-Mopani ukulawula iinkonzo zokuqeshwa, ukubhalisa imahlawulo, ukugcina iirejista nokusingatha ukhuseleko lwamaxwebhu.
xh.requirements: Ifane le NQF level 04 njengoko evunyiwe yi-SAQA. Ilayisensi yokuqeshela esemthethweni, ngaphandle kwabafaki bempazamo. Ulwazi Nobuchule: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yecalulu, iindlela zokwenza kwaye nakhona ukubhalisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela isibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwejime apho lulawulo lulawula iNkonzo kaZwelonke. Ulwazi ngendlela zokusebenza ngokomxholo wendawo yokusebenza. Khompyutha. Cwangcisa kwaye uhambe. Ulwimi. Unxibelelwano olululo ngomlomo nangolubhaliweyo.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zokuqeshwa: Hlaziisa kwaye upapasheshe izatatementi zenyanga zokuqeshwa. Hlaziisa irejista yokuqeshwa. Bhalisa kwaye uhlaziise inkqubo yemahlawulo yokuqeshwa yemali yasekheshi. Hlaziisa irejista noma isibalo. Qinisezisa ukhuseleko lwamaxwebhu okuqeshwa ngoku: Faka kwifayile ezahweni zayo. Faka amanombara kwifayile. Hlaziisa irejista yemali ebuyiselwayo. Hlaziisa irejista yokuqeshwa okusalele. Bhala izaziso zakuqeshwa okusalele kubaqeshi. Lungisa izatatementi zii-akhawunti. Yaziise iinkonzo zenkxaso yemisebenzi yecalulu jikelele: Qamba, hlela, gcina, bhalisa kwaye uzive ulwazi lwe-correspondence nedatha. Susa ipropati kwi-Asset Register. Phatha iimibuzo ekumaziko. Yenza iikhophi kwaye wamkele okanye uthumele iifax. Sahlula amaxwebhu okanye iipakagesi kubaphathi abahlukeneyo njengoko kufuneka. Gcina kwaye ulonde inkqubo yokugcina iifayili kwesi samanzi. Bhala iileta okanye ezinye i-correspondence xa kufuneka. Gcina kwaye ulonde irejista yamaxwebhu angena naphehla kwesi samanzi. Nikeza iinkonzo zenkxaso yebosenkqubo yokuhlinzekwa ngaphakathi kwesi samanzi; Xhumana nabaphathi bangaphakathi nabangaphandle mayela nolweliso lwezinto nezenkonzo. Funa izixhobo zofice ezibhalwayo. Gcina kwaye ulonde irejista yempahla kwesi samanzi. Nikeza iinkonzo zenkxaso yolawulo lwabantu noluwezimali. Gcina irejista yobhalo lwesi samazu kwesi samanzi. Yenza izibini ezisencweni zokuhamba nokuhlala. Qaphela ukuchaneka kwamagama obungcangcutsha nokuhamba kwe-ofisi.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.centre: Vhembe district: Thohoyandou and Collins Chabane Stores
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed at Thohoyandou and Collins Chabane Stores in Limpopo to provide asset management clerical support at salary level 5.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 04 as recognised by SAQA. Valid driver’s license with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of general administration duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Job knowledge. Communication. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Computer. Language and good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Render asset management clerical support: Bar code new assets. Compile and maintain records (e.g asset records/databases). Check and issue furniture, equipment and accessories to components and individuals. Identify redundant, non-serviceable and obsolete equipment for disposal. Conduct assets verification. Update the inventory list. Order stores: Place orders for goods. Receive and verify goods from suppliers. Capture goods in the system, or item registers. Issue stores: Receive Logis requisition form. Check and verify the form with the requester. Issue goods to end users. Issue goods out of the system. Update and maintain register of suppliers. Render stock-taking services: Count the stock level in the stores. Verify the stock against the issuing reports. Balance the stock level.
jobs.enquiries: Mr MF Mavhungu, Ms M Muthabi & Mr TI Tshipuke Tel No: (015) 963 3790
jobs.applications: Applicants should apply through the following website https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za. The application on the eRecruitment system should be accompanied by the new Z83 and recent comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and duration/dates). Failure to attach required documents will result in the application not being considered/disqualified Applications may also be hand delivered/posted to: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure: Private Bag X9490, Polokwane, 0700 or hand delivered at Works Tower Building, No. 43 Church Street, Polokwane, 0699. Thabo Mbeki & Elias Motsoaledi Street. jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. The department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation or meals) for candidates attending interviews. The Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. af.title: Administratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig by Thohoyandou en Collins Chabane Stores in Limpopo om klerklike ondersteuning vir batesbestuur te verskaf op salarisvlak 5.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 04 soos deur SAQA erken. Geldige bestuurderslisensie met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van algemene administratiewe pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaar te bedien en statistiek te versamel. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Werkkennis. Kommunikasie. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Buigsaamheid. Rekenaar. Taal en goeie verbale en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning vir batesbestuur: Barkode nuwe bates. Stel rekords op en onderhou dit (bv batesrekords/databasisse). Kontroleer en reik meubels, toerusting en bykomstighede aan komponente en individue uit. Identifiseer oortollige, onbruikbare en verouderde toerusting vir beskikking. Voer batesverifikasie uit. Werk die voorraadlys by. Bestel store: Plaas bestelle vir goedere. Ontvang en verifieer goedere van verskaffers. Lê goedere in die stelsel of itemregisters vas. Reik store uit: Ontvang Logis-aanvraagvorm. Kontroleer en verifieer die vorm met die aanvrager. Reik goedere aan eindgebruikers uit. Reik goedere uit die stelsel uit. Werk die register van verskaffers by en onderhou dit. Verskaf voorraadopnamedienste: Tel die voorraadvlak in die stores. Verifieer die voorraad teen die uitreikverslae. Balanseer die voorraadvlak.

zu.title: Iklerka Yokuphathwa Kwezomphakathi
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklerka yokuphathwa kwezomphakathi e-Thohoyandou nase-Collins Chabane Stores e-Limpopo ukuze inikeze ukusekelwa kokuphathwa kwefa emsebenzini wamaklerka ezingeni le-5 leholo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 04 njengoba kujatshulwe yi-SAQA. Ilayisense yokuqasha evumelekile ngaphandle kokuba umfaki oyinalwe yisikhungo sabakhubazekile. Ulwazi Namasakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ejwayelekile yokuphathwa kwezomphakathi, izindlela kanye nokuba nakho ukufaka ulwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda isimiso sezomthetho esibusa Inkonzo Yomphakathi. Ulwazi lwezindlela zomsebenzi mayelana nendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lomsebenzi. Ukuxhumana. Izindaba ezingaphakathi komuntu. Ukuguquguquka. Ikhompyutha. Ulimi namakhono amahle okuxhumana okukhulunywayo nokubhalwayo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokusekelwa kokuphathwa kwefa njengamaklerka: Fakha ikhodi egxini kufa entsha. Hlanganisa zigcine futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi (isb. amarekhodi/amasethi wefa). Hlola futhi uphathe infanitsha, izinto zokusebenza nezinsiza kumagumbi nabantu. Chaza izinto zokusebenza ezingasetshenziswa, ezingasebenzi futhi ezadala ukuthi ziqhishwe. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwefa. Buyekeza uhlu lwe-fa. Oda izitolo: Hlola izinto ezithunyelwe. Yamuka futhi uqinisekise izinto ezivela kubanikezeli. Faka izinto esistimeni noma kumarejista ezinto. Phatha izitolo: Yamuka ifomu lokucela i-Logis. Hlola futhi uqinisekise ifomu nomceli. Phatha izinto kubasebenzisi bazo bokugcina. Khuphula izinto esistimeni. Buyekeza futhi ulondoloze irejista labanikezeli. Nikeza ngesevisi yokubala inani lefesitho: Bala inani lefesitho ezitolo. Qinisekisa inani lefesitho namapheshana okuphathwa. Linganisa inani lefesitho.

xh.title: Clerk wezeolonkezo
xh.summary: Kufuneka iClerk yezeolonkezo kwiThohoyandou naseCollins Chabane Stores eLimpopo ukunika inkxaso yomsebenzi weclerk kulo lonkezo leempahla kwinqanaba 5.
xh.requirements: Ifomali yemfundo kwinqanaba le-NQF 04 njengoko kwamkelwa yi-SAQA. Ilayisenisi yokuqeshela esemthethweni ngaphandle koogqatso abanokuphela komzimba. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yonke yolonkezo, iindlela zokuqeshela nokwazi ukungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda inguqulelo yomthetho elawula iNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yomsebenzi mayelana nendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lomsebenzi. Unxibelelwano. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ikhompyutha. Ulwimi nakhono olulungileyo lokunxibelelana nokuthetha nokuibhala.
xh.duties: Yenza inkxaso yomsebenzi weclerk kulo lonkezo leempahla: Faka ikhowudi yemali kwiimpahla ezintsha. Qamba zigcine irekhodi (umzekelo irekhodi/isedatha yolonkezo leempahla). Khangiza uphathise ifanitsha, izixhobo nezinto ezidityaniswayo kumacandelo nakuqaba. Chonga izixhobo ezingafanelekanga, ezingasebenzisekiyo nezindala zokutshatyalaliswa. Yenza ukuqinisekisa kweempahla. Hlaziya uludwe lweempahla. Faka iiodolo kwindawo yokugcina impahla: Faka iiodolo kweempahla. Yamkela ukuqinisekisa impahla ezivela kubanikezeli. Faka impahla kwinkqubo, okanya kumagciniswawezinto. Phathisa impahla: Yamkela ifomu lokucela i-Logis. Khangiza uqinisekise ifomu nomcelayo. Phathisa impahla kubasebenzisi bokuqhamsha. Khupha impahla kwinkqubo. Hlaziya ugcinile uludwe lwabanikezeli. Yenza iinkonzo zokubala impahla: Bala inqanaba lempahla kwindawo yokugcina. Qinisekisa impahla namaxesha okuphathisa. Linganisa inqanaba lempahla.

jobs.title: Registry Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Registry Clerk needed in Limpopo's Mopani district to handle mail registration, counter services and correspondence at salary level 5.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 4 as recognised by SAQA. No experience. Knowledge And Skills: Basic knowledge of registry duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics. Basic knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Basic knowledge of storage and retrieval procedure in terms of the working environment.
jobs.duties: Provide registry counter services. Attend to clients. Handle telephonic and other enquiries received. Receive and register hand delivered mail/files. Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence. Receive all mail. Sort, register and dispatch mail. Distribute notices on registry issues. Render an effective filing and record management service. Opening and close files according to record classification system. Filing/storage, tracing (electronically/manually) and retrieval of documents and files. Complete index cards for all files. Operate office machines in relation to the registry function. Open and maintain Franking machine register. Frank post, record money and update register on a daily basis. Undertake spot checks on post to ensure no private post is included. Lock post in postbag for messengers to deliver to Post Office. Open & maintain remittance register. Record all valuable articles as prescribed in the remittance register. Hand delivers and signs over remittances to finance. Send wrong remittances back to sender via registered post and record reference number in register. Keep daily record of amount of letters franked. Process documents for archiving and/ disposal. Electronic scanning of files. Sort and package files for archives and distribution. Compile list of documents to be archived and submit to the supervisor. Keep records for archived documents.

af.title: Registerklerk
af.summary: Registerklerk benodig in Limpopo se Mopani-distrik om posregistrasie, toonbankdienste en korrespondensie te hanteer op salarisvlak 5.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 4 soos deur SAQA erken. Geen ervaring nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Basiese kennis van registerpligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel. Basiese kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Basiese kennis van bergings- en terugwinningprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing.
af.duties: Verskaf registertoonbankdienste. Draai kliënte by. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae wat ontvang word. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgelewerde pos/lêers. Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Ontvang alle pos. Sorteer, registreer en stuur pos. Verspreid kennishuigings oor registerverskillende sake. Lewer 'n effektiewe indiening en rekordbestuursdiens. Oopmaak en sluiting van lêers volgens rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Indiening/bergings, naspeur (elektronies/ handmatig) en terugwinning van dokumente en lêers. Voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Bedryf kantooruitrusting in verband met die registerfunksie. Oopmaak en onderhou Frankingmasjienregister. Frank pos, teken geld aan en werk register op 'n daaglikse basis by. Onderneem steekproewe op pos om te verseker dat geen private pos ingesluit is nie. Sluit pos in pos sak vir boodskappers om na Post Office te neem. Oop & onderhou remittance register. Teken alle waardevolle artikels soos voorgeskryf in die remittance-register aan. Hand-aflevering en ondertekening van remittances aan finansies. Stuur verkeerde remittances terug na sender via geregistreerde pos en teken verwysingsnommer in register aan. Hou daaglikse rekord van hoeveelheid briefies gefrank. Proses dokumente vir argiewering en/of beskikking. Elektroniese skandering van lêers. Sorteer en pak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel lys op van dokumente om geargiveer te word en dien by die toesighouer in. Hou rekords vir geargiveerde dokumente.

zu.title: Iclerk Yeregistry
zu.summary: Kudingeka Iclerk yeregistry esifundazweni sakwaLimpopo edijisini lakwaMopani ukuthi iphathwe ngobhaliso lweposi, izinsiza zebhokisi kanye nokuxhumana eholo elingeni 5.
zu.requirements: Ifomula ezingeni le-NQF level 4 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mkhuleko. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemisebenzi yeregistry, izinto ezisetshenziswa kanye nendlela yokubamba idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo nokuqonda uhlelo lwemithetho oluphethe Isevisi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngendlela yokulondoloza nokubuyisa imibhalo mayelana nemvelaphi yokusebenza.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi yedesika elibhokisi. Phatha abakhasimende. Phatha imibuzo efoni nabanjalo etholiwe. Wamukela bese ubhalisa iposi/maphayela lezandla. Phatha ukuxhumana okungenayo nokuphumayo. Wamukela yonke iposi. Hlola, bhalisa bese uthumela iposi. Sazisa ngemibhalo ezindaba zeregistry. Hlinzeka ngesevisi esebenzayo yokuqu kanye nolawulo lwemibhalo. Vula bese uvala amaphayela ngokwesistimu sokuhlukanisa imibhalo. Ukuqu/ukulondoloza, ukulandelana (ngekhompyutha/ngezandla) kanye nokubuyisa amadokhumenti namaphayela. Qedela amakhadi ashintshashintsha wawo wonke amaphayela. Sebenzisa imishini yehhovisi ohlobene nomsebenzi weregistry. Vula buse ugcina irekhodi lefanki mashini. Faka ifanki kwiposi, bhalisa imali bese uvuselela irekhodi nsuku zonke. Yenza ukuhlolwa okungazelelwe kwiposi ukuze qiniseke ukuthi ayikho iposi yangasese ifakiwe. Vala iposi esikhwameni seposi abathunywa baze bayithume ePost Office. Vula bese ulondoloza irekhodi lemali ethunyelwe. Bhalisa wonke amabhagimu abalulekile njengoba kumiswe irekhini lemali ethunyelwe. Yeze ngemali ezoyikhokha ngaphandle bese uyayikhokhela kumnyango wezezimali. Thumela imali engeyona emumva kumthumeli ngeposi ebhalisiwe bese ubhalisa inombolo yenkomba kwirekhodi. Gcina irekhodi nsuku zonke yenhamba yamagama afankiwe. Sebenzisa amadokhumenti ukuba zilondoloze kumabhulokhwe noma zithotyelwe. Ukuskana kwamaphayela ngekhompyutha. Hlola bese ubopha amaphayela amabhulokhwe nokusatshalaliswa. Hlela uhlu lwamadokhumenti okulondoloza bese uyathumela kumlawuli. Gcina imibhalo yamadokhumenti alondoloziwe.

xh.title: UmKhazi weBhuku leziBhalo
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMkhazi weBhuku leziBhalo kwisiFunda saseMopani eselingaphakathi kwaseLimpopo ukubumba ngokuqwalasela ukubhalisa iimeyile, iinkonzo zesikunuku, nolunye ulwimi-lwazi, ngumvuzo onqanaba 5.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso malunga nesiNqanaba seNQF 4 njengokuqatwe yiSAQA. Akukho naluphi na lluvo lokuqeqesheka. Ulwazi Namava: Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemisebenzi yeBhuku leziBhalo namasiko, kuqondene nale ngokuqinisekiswa kokubuyisa nokubuyiswa ngokuqokelela iinkcukacha ekhompyutheni nokuhambisa ngolu hlobo. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngokumisela komthetho ophatha iNkonzo kaRhulumente.
xh.duties: Phethe iinkonzo zomgca wesikunuku seBhuku leziBhalo. Phatha abaxumi. Phatha imibuzo yefowuni. Thatha kwaba bhali nomyalezo othunyelwe ngesandla. Thatha ulwimi-lwazi olungenayo. Gcina iBhuku leziBhalo. Hlaza ngokwezithuba. Hamba ngokukhutsha iBhuku leziBhalo. Thumela iingxelo ezithunyelwe kumsebenzi kaBhuku leziBhalo. Yenza ukugcinwa okusebenzayo kweekhadi ezibhaliweyo. Vula waze uvale amafiye ngeNkqubo. Gcina olu hlobo lwemisebenzi ngokusetyenziswa kwesikhuseli esisezantsi nakwindlu yokugcina iiBhuku. Phatha iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezibhaliweyo ngokuzinikela. Qamba iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokuthumela iBhuku leziBhalo. Thumela kumzekeli wakho ukubhaliweyo. Gcina ulwazi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kolwazi. Gcina iBhuku leziBhalo.

jobs.title: Security Officer Supervisor
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Supervise security officers and service providers in the Waterberg district, ensuring adherence to departmental security policies and monitoring duty allocation.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 04 or 05 as recognized by SAQA. Security certificate (A minimum of 1 year of study) Grade B PSIRA certificate. Three (3) years’ experience in security Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Physical security risk control measures. Security principles and practices. MPSS. MISS. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management.
jobs.duties: Supervise the security functions performed by the security officers/service providers, ensuring adherence to department security policies. Allocate duties to security officers/service providers, monitor outcomes and institute the necessary corrective measures to address deviations from norms and standards. Monitor access control to prevent unauthorised entry in buildings and other premises. Authorisation of the equipment, documents and stores into or out of the building or premises Inspect and report all none functioning of security measures (e.g. XRay machines, Walk-through metal detectors, security lights and etc.). Check incidents / occurrence books/registers. Monitor and provide support in case of emergencies. Administrative and related functions: Determining rosters, shift schedules and overtime. Monitor performance of employees and determine training needs. Control leave and related personnel matters in line with HR procedures and prescripts. Provide security related services: Administer key control system. Identify risks and threats to the security of the department. Provide information regarding incidents to investigating officers. Monitor and respond to alarm system. Report faulty equipment/systems. Ensure systems are functioning optimally through scheduled services. Conduct preliminary incident investigations and submit reports. Administer all control room operations to safeguard the department`s assets: Supervise all control room activities. Report all incidents and any identified non-compliance relating to security prescripts. Review of footages upon request through proper procedure. Update all registers for the incidents observed.
