af.title: Veiligheidsbeampte Toesighouer
af.summary: Hou toesig oor veiligheidsbeamptes en diensverskaffers in die Waterberg-distrik, verse nakoming van departementele veiligheidsbeleid en monitor toewysing van pligte.
af.requirements: ‘n Kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 04 of 05 soos erken deur SAQA. Veiligheidssertifikaat (‘n Minimum van 1 jaar van studie) Graad B PSIRA-sertifikaat. Drie (3) jaar se ervaring in veiligheid. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante Openbare Diens-wette, regulasies en raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van beleidsontleding, -ontwikkeling en -interpretasie. Fisiese veiligheidsrisikobheermaatreëls. Veiligheidsbeginsels en -praktyke. MPSS. MISS. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor die veiligheidsfunksies wat deur die veiligheidsbeamptes/diensverskaffers uitgevoer word, en verse nakoming van departementele veiligheidsbeleid. Wijs pligte toe aan veiligheidsbeamptes/diensverskaffers, monitor uitkomste en instel die nodige korrektiewe maatreëls om afwykings van norme en standaarde aan te spreek. Monitor toegangsbeheer om ongemagtigde toegang tot geboue en ander persele te voorkom. Magtiging van toerusting, dokumente en voorrade in of uit die gebou of perseel. Inspekteer en rapporteer alle nie-funksionering van veiligheidsmaatreëls (bv. XRay-masjiene, loopmetaaldetektors, veiligheidsligte ens.). Kontroleer voorvalle / voorvalboeke / registers. Monitor en bied ondersteuning in geval van noodsituasies. Administratiewe en verwante funksies: Bepaal roosters, skofskedules en oortyd. Monitor prestasie van werknemers en bepaal opleidingsbehoeftes. Beheer verlof en verwante personeelsake in ooreenstemming met HR-prosedures en -voorskrifte. Verskaf veiligheidsverwante dienste: Administreer sleutelbeheerstelsel. Identifiseer risiko's en bedreigings vir die veiligheid van die departement. Verskaf inligting aangaande voorvalle aan ondersoekbeamptes. Monitor en reageer op alarmsysteem. Rapporteer foutiewe toerusting/stelsels. Verseker stelsels funksioneer optimaal deur geskeduleerde dienste. Voer voorlopige voorvalondersoeke uit en dien verslae in. Administreer alle beheerkamerbedrywighede om die departement se bates te beskerm: Hou toesig oor alle beheerkameraktiwiteite. Rapporteer alle voorvalle en enige geidentifiseerde nie-nakoming met betrekking tot veiligheidsvoorskrifte. Hersiening van beeldmateriaal op versoek deur behoorlike prosedure. Dateer alle registers op vir die waargenome voorvalle.

zu.title: Umphathi Wabagadi Bezokuphepha
zu.summary: Qapha abagadi bezokuphepha nezinkampani ezinikeza izinsiza esifundeni sase Waterberg, qinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwa izinqubomgomo zokuphepha zomnyango futhi kulandelwe ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Ifundo eqinisekiswe i-SAQA ezingeni le-NQF 04 noma 05. Isitifiketi sezokuphepha (Okungenani unyaka oyedwa wokufunda) Isitifiketi se-PSIRA Sezinga B. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuhlola emsebenzini wezokuphepha Ilayisensi yokuqasha esebenzayo, ngaphandle kwabafakazi abanasikhwenzane. Ulwazi Nobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi nge-Mithetho Yomphakathi ehlobene, izimiso nezinqubo. Ulwazi nokungqonda ukuhlaziya, ukuthuthukisa nokuchaza izinqubomgomo. Izindlela zokulawula ingozi yezokuphepha zomzimba. Izimiso nezindlela zokuphepha. MPSS. MISS. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Bunkosi eqenjini. Ubuciko. Ukulawula imali. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Abantu. Ukuhlelalolungelelweniso. Ukuphatha izingxabano.
zu.duties: Qapha imisebenzi yokuphepha yenziwe abagadi bezokuphepha/izinkampani ezinikeza izinsiza, qinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwa izinqubomgomo zokuphepha zomnyango. Wabe imisebenzi kubagadi bezokuphepha/izinkampani ezinikeza izinsiza, qapha imiphumela futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa ezifanele ukulungisa ukwehluka kwezindinganiso kanye nezimiso. Qapha ukulawula ukungena ukuvimbela ukungena okungagunyaziwe ezakhiweni nakwezinye izindawo. Ukwemukela amapulangwe, amadokhumenti nezinto zesitolo ezingenayo noma eziphuma esakhiweni noma esindawweni Hlola futhi umbike konke okungalasebenzi kwezinyathelo zokuphepha (isb. Izimoto ze-XRay, abahloli bezinhlamvu zemithobi, izibani zokuphepha njll.). Hlola izinsiza / izincwadi zezenzakalo/ukubhalisa. Qapha futhi nikeza usizo uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo. Imisebenzi yokuqamba kanye namanye ehlobene: Ukubhaqa uhlu, ukuhlela izikhathi zoshintshoshintsho kanye nemisebenzi engaphezu kwesikhathi. Qapha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi futhi ukhiqaze izidingo zokwelulekwa. Lawula ukuphumula kanye namanye amaphuzu abantu ahlobene ngokuvumelana nezinqubo kanye nemiyalo ye-HR. Nikeza izinsiza ezihlobene nokuphepha: Lawula uhlu lokulawula okhiye. Chaza izingozi kanye nezinsongo ekuphepheni komnyango. Nikeza ulwazi ngemayelana nezinsiza kubaphathi bophenyо. Qapha futhi uphendule uhlobo lwe-alamu. Bika izinto/ohlelo abangasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasistimu asebenza ngokugcwele ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezihleliwe. Yenza uphenyo lokuqala ngezenzakalo futhi uhluze imibiko. Lawula konke ukusebenza kwegumbi lokulawla ukuvikela izimpahla zomnyango: Qapha yonke imisebenzi yegumbi lokulawula. Bika yonke imiyalo noma yonke ukungalandelwa okubonwa okuhlobene nezinqubo zokuphepha. Ukubuka kabusha izinkathi ezibukiwe lapho kucelwa khona ngokulandelwa inqubo efanele. Buyekeza zonke izincwadi zokubhalisa ngezenzakalo ezibukiwe.

xh.title: Mphathi wabaQinisekiso bokuKhuseleko
xh.summary: Lawula abaQinisekiso bokuKhuseleko nabahanjiswa kwingingqi yeWaterberg, kuqinisekisa ukuzityalela kweenqobo ezilawula ukhuseleko kwesebe nokuhlola ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi.
xh.requirements: Ifundo kwinqanaba leNQF 04 okanye 05 njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Isatifikethi sokuKhuseleko (Uphindo olungu-1 lweminyaka yofundo) Isatifikethi seGrade B sePSIRA. Iiminyaka elithathu (3) yamava ekhuseleko. Ilayisensi yokuqeshela epheleleyo, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abanokuphela kwamandla emizimba. ULwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngeMithetho yoLwazi lwaZizwe, iimiso nokuqwalaselwa okuhambelana nayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlalutya, ukuphepha nokuhulumula iinkqubo. Iindlela zolawulo lomngcipheko wokhuseleko lokomzimba. Iingcali nezenzo zokhuseleko. MPSS. MISS. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nohlalutyo. Ukwenza iigqibo. Ukuba nguMphathi weQela. Ubuchule bokudala. ULawulo lweMali. Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Amakhono ekhompyutha. ULawulo lwabantu. UkuCwangcisa nokuhlela. ULawulo loququzelelo.
xh.duties: Lawula imisebenzi yokhuseleko ezenzwa ngabaQinisekiso bokuKhuseleko/abahanjiswa, kuqinisekisa ukuzityalela kweenqobo zokhuseleko kwesebe. Yabela imisebenzi kubaQinisekiso bokuKhuseleko/abahanjiswa, hlola iziphumo uze useke izithintelo ezifanelekileyo zokulungisa iindimima ezingahambelaniyo nemigaqo neemilinganiselo. Hlola ulawulo lokungena ukuthintela ukungena okungalunganga kwiZakhiwo nezinye iindawo. Ukugunyazisa ukhuseleko, amaxwebhu nemiqathango ukungena okanye ukuphuma kwizakhiwo okanye iindawo. Phepha uze uxelo zonke ezingasebenziyo iindlela zokhuseleko (umz. iishishini zeXRay, abavumi beMetal detectors, iilathi zokhuseleko njl njl). Khangela iiganeko / iincwadi zokwenzekayo / iirejista. Hlola uze unike inkxaso kwiimeko eziphuthumayo. Imisebenzi yolawulo nemicimbi ephathelene nayo: Ukuqamba irosters, iinkqubo zeshifthi nokusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha. Hlola inkqubo yabasebenzi uze uqonde iimfuno zokuqeqesha. Lawula iinkhomhlo nemicimbi ephathelene nabantu ngokuhambelana neenqobo zeHR neemila. Nikeza iinkonzo ezihambelana nokhuseleko: Lawula inkqubo yolawulo lwezitshixo. Chonga iingozi neendikiba ezikwingozi yokhuseleko lwesebe. Nikeza ulwazi malunga neenganeko kubahlohli. Hlola uze uphendule inkqubo yalaam. Xela ipelezele/inkqubo ezingasebenzayo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zisebenza ngokugqibeleleyo ngenkqubo ezicwangcisiweyo. Qamba uphando lokuqala lwenganeko uze uzinike iiripoti. Lawula zonke iinkqubo zegumbi lolawulo ukhuseleko iimpahla zesebe: Lawula zonke izenzo zegumbi lolawulo. Xela zonke iiganeko nayo nawuphi na ukungahambelaniyo okuboniswe kumila wokhuseleko. Ukuqwalaselwa kweefutshi kusicebo ngendlela efanelekileyo. Hlaziya zonke iirejista ngeeganeko ebuqweleyo.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Administratiewe Klerk wat klerklike ondersteuning ten opsigte van vlootdienste in die Mopani-distrik verskaf, met 'n NQF level 4-kwalifikasie en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF level 04 soos deur SAQA erken. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Basiese kennis van die betrokke Openbare Diens. Kommunikasievaardighede. Beplanning en organisering. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe klerklike ondersteuning van vlootdienste: Ontvang en verskaf GG-toekenning om gedurende en na normale werksure te gebruik. Rekord, organiseer, stoor, vasleg en onttrek korrespondensie en data met betrekking tot vlootbestuur. Werk vlootbestuurregistre en statistieke by. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotostaatkopieë en ontvang of stuur faksimiles. Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent. Tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent. Verskaf administratiewe klerklike ondersteuning ten opsigte van kantoor- en akkommodasiedienste: Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaard kantooritems. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent (distrikkantore). Verskaf personeeladministratiewe klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent: Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Verskaf finansiële administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent: Leg uitgawes in die komponent vas en werk dit by. Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaans- en reisbenuttingseise van amptenare en dien by bestuurder in vir goedkeuring. Hanteer telefoonrekeninge en kleinkontantgeld vir die komponent.

zu.requirements: Iziqu ezisingatha izinga le-NQF level 04 njengoba zamukelekwa yi-SAQA. Ilayisense elivumelekile lokushayela, ngaphandle kwabafaki abanemikhawulo yomzimba. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi oluyisiseko mayelana ne-Public Service. Amakhono okuxhumana. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yomsebenzi wezokubhaliswa kumasevisi enkampani yezimoto: Yamukela futhi unikeze ukwabiwa kwe-GG okuzosetshenziswa ngaphakathi nangemva kwezinsini eziyisikhathi esijwayelekile sokusebenza. Bhala, hlela, gigima, bamba ukwaziswa futhi ulibuse ukwaziswa okuphathelene nokulawula inkampani yezimoto. Buyekeza amarejista nokubalwa kwezibalo ekulawulweni enkampani yezimoto. Phendula imibuzo ejwayelekile. Yenza izikopishini futhi wamukele uthumele i-fax. Yaba amafayela/amasheke kubambiswana abahlukene njengoba kudingekwa. Gcina futhi ulondoloze isistimu yokulondolozwa kwamafayela yeqoqo. Bhala amagama neminye imibhalo lapho kudingeka khona. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lemibhalo engena naphuma yeqoqo. Nikeza inkxaso yomsebenzi wezokubhaliswa kumasevisi ohhovisi nasezindlini: Xhumana nabambiswana bangaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nokuthenga izimpahla namasevisi. Thola izilinganiso zentengo, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izinto ezijwayelekile zohhovisi. Lawula isitokhwe sezinto zokubhala zohhovisi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lempahla yeqoqo (amahhovisi esifunda). Nikeza inkxaso yomsebenzi wezokubhaliswa kokuqashwa kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kweqoqo: Gcina irejista yokuphumula yeqoqo. Gcina futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi abasebenzi eqoqweni. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista yokubakho eqoqweni. Nikeza inkxaso yomsebenzi wezokubhaliswa kwezimali eqoqweni: Bamba futhi ubuyekeze izinkokhelo eqoqweni. Hlola ukulungile kwezifundo zokuhamba nokuhlala kwabasebenzi futhi uzinikeze umphathi ukuze azivume. Phathela ama-akhawunti efoni nemali encane yeqoqo.

xh.title: Inkonyana Yezabelo
xh.summary: Inkonyana yezabelo ezinika inkxaso yabasebenzi beenkobe kumasebenzi ehamba ngamagunya kwisithili saseMopani, ifuna iziqu ezikwi-NQF level 4 nelayisenisi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezikumanqanaba NQF level 04 njengoko zivunywa yi-SAQA. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo, ngaphandle kwabo bafaka isicelo abanokuqhwaleka. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olusisiseko ngabe basebenzi kaRhulumente. Amakhono okunxibelelwana. Ukucwangcisa nokuqulunqa. Ulwazi ngakompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yabasebenzi beenkobe lolawulo lwemisebenzi ehamba ngamagunya: Amkele unikeze ngenqwelomoya kaGG ukuyisebenzisa ngexesha elinqamlezile nangemva kwamaxesha okusebenza aqhelekileyo. Qumba, hlela, gcina, bhalisa kwaye uphinde ukhuphe iinkxwela nedatha ezimalana nolawulo lwamagunya. Hlaziya amarejista nakwingqokelela yedatha yolawulo lwamagunya. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikopi zefoto kwaye amkele uthume iifeksi. Sabelisa amaxwebhu/amasenthakatho kumahlombe ahlukeneyo njengoko kufuneka. Gcina uhlale ulawula inkqubo yamagciniweyo yesebe. Thepha iileta nakwezinye iinkxwela xa kufuneka. Gcina uhlale ulawula irejista yamaxwebhu angenayo nayaphumayo yesebe. Nika inkxaso yabasebenzi beenkobe kulawulo leziko lendawo yokuhlala: Thethathetha namahlombe angaphakathi nangaphandle ezimalana nolungelelaniso lwezinto neenkonzo. Fumana iikoti, gcwalisa iifom zolungelelaniso zokuthenga izinto zesabelo esiqhelekileyo zofise. Lawula isitoko sesabelo sofise. Gcina uhlale ulawula irejista yempahla yesebe (ziyofisi zesithili). Nika inkxaso yamasebenzi abasebenzi beenkobe yolawulo lwabantu ngaphakathi kwesebe: Hlala ulawula irejista yokuhamba kwabasebenzi yesebe. Gcina uhlale ulawula iirekhodi zabasebenzi kwisebe. Gcina uhlale ulawula irejista yokubakho kwabasebenzi yesebe. Nika inkxaso yolawulo lweemali kwisebe: Bhalisa kwaye uhlaziye inkxwabelwano yemali kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwezicelo zokuhamba nokuhamba kweemali zabasebenzi uze uzithumele kumphathi ukuba azamkele. Phatha i-akhawunti zefowuni netyala elincinci lemalisebe.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Fleet Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Administration clerk providing fleet management support at the Department of Public Works Head Office in Polokwane, handling vehicle allocation, log sheets and related data.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 04 as recognized by SAQA. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Basic knowledge of relevant Public Service. Subsidized Vehicle Motor Transport Handbook version 1 of 2017. Government Motor Transport Handbook version 1 of 2019. Public Finance Management Act, Act No. 1 of 1999 as amended. Communication skills (verbal and written). Planning and organising. Data capturing. Collecting statistics. Presentation skills. Functional computer literacy (MS word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook).
jobs.duties: Render administration clerical support on government-owned vehicles: Allocate and issue government vehicles to the users. Receive and verify log sheets & trip Authorization forms upon vehicle return. Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data in relation to fleet management. Capture and update fleet management registers and statistics. Handle routine enquiries. Maintain accurate fleet records (Approved Trip Authorization forms, Exemptions, Log sheets etc). Conduct pre and post vehicle inspections. Reconcile log sheets, fuel receipts, Trip Authorization forms and transaction reports from the suppliers. Book vehicles for maintenance and repairs. Capture & Issue traffic fines to the responsible driver. Ensure that vehicles licence are renewed on time. Safeguard fleet management assets, including fuel cards, vehicle keys, licenses, and fleet-related equipment. Render administration clerical support on Subsidised Vehicle Motor Scheme A & B. Verify the accuracy of Scheme A, B fuel claims in line with the policy. Submit accurate fuel claims for payment. Capture and update fuel claims on systems. Attend to queries related to fuel claims. Keep accurate records of fuel claims processed each month. Conduct monthly vehicle inspection on Scheme A vehicles. Capture and update fleet management registers and statistics. Liaise with the service providers on matters related to fleet. Render administration clerical support on MMS/SMS running allowances. Verify the accuracy of MMS/SMS fuel claims in line with the policy. Submit accurate fuel claims for payment. Capture and update fuel claims on systems. Attend to queries related to MMS/SMS fuel claims. Keep accurate records of fuel claims processed each month. Capture and update fleet management registers and statistics. Render administration support services on financial and physical resources in accordance with the relevant policies and legislative frameworks: Capture and update fleet expenditure for G-Cars, Subsidised vehicle Scheme A & B, and MMS/SMS running allowances. Verify supporting documents for payments and ensure compliance with financial prescripts and departmental policies. Assist with the preparation of audit files and provide supporting documentation during internal and external audits. Identify and report discrepancies, irregularities, or potential risks relating to fleet expenditure and resource management. Ensure compliance with the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, departmental policies, and other relevant legislative frameworks. Compile monthly, quarterly and annual expenditure reports for management.

jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed prescribed Z83 application for employment form (2021 version) obtainable from any public service department or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za. Applications must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application except when applying through the erecruitment system. All fields in Part A, Part C and Part D of the Z83 form should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full. Part E, F & G applicants often indicate “refer to CV or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Successful incumbent will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. The successful candidate will also be required to disclose his or her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Proof of the completion of the SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following        the     link:https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/. The recommended candidate for appointment will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Check for security reasons. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application. The Department reserve the right not to make any appointment(s) to the posts advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application as being unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are advised to seek reasons for the above administration action in terms of Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Act No. 3 of 2000. af.title: Administrasieklerk: Vlootbestuur
af.summary: Administrasieklerk wat vlootbestuurondersteuning by die Department of Public Works se hoofkantoor in Polokwane bied, en voertuigtoewysing, logblaaie en verwante data hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF level 04 soos deur SAQA erken. Geldige bestuurslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Basiese kennis van die tersaaklike Public Service. Subsidized Vehicle Motor Transport Handbook version 1 of 2017. Government Motor Transport Handbook version 1 of 2019. Public Finance Management Act, Act No. 1 of 1999 soos gewysig. Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Beplanning en organisering. Data-invoer. Statistiekversameling. Voorleggingsvaardighede. Funksionele rekenaarvaardigheid (MS word, PowerPoint, Excel en Outlook).
af.duties: Verleen administratiewe klerklike ondersteuning vir staatsvoertuie: Ken staatsvoertuie toe en reik dit uit aan gebruikers. Ontvang en verifieer logblaaie en reisagtigeringsvorms by terugkeer van voertuie. Neem op, organiseer, berg, teken in en haal korrespondensie en data rakende vlootbestuur op. Teken vlootbestuurregisters en statistieke in en werk dit op. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Handhaaf akkurate vlootrekords (Goedgekeurde reisagtigeringsvorms, Vrystellings, Logblaaie ens). Voer voor- en na-inspeksies van voertuie uit. Versoen logblaaie, brandstofkwitansies, reisagtigeringsvorms en transaksieverslae van die verskaffers. Bespreek voertuie in vir onderhoud en herstelwerk. Teken verkeersboetes in en reik dit uit aan die verantwoordelike bestuurder. Verseker dat voertuiglisensies betyds hernu word. Beskerm vlootbestuurasbates, insluitend brandstofkaarte, voertuigsleutels, lisensies en vlootverwante toerusting. Verleen administratiewe klerklike ondersteuning vir Subsidieerde Voertuigenjinskema A & B. Verifieer die akkuraatheid van Skema A en B-brandstofeise in ooreenstemming met die beleid. Dien akkurate brandstofeise vir betaling in. Teken brandstofeise op stelsels in en werk dit op. Hanteer navrae rakende brandstofeise. Hou akkurate rekords van brandstofeise wat elke maand verwerk is. Voer maandelikse voertuiginspeksies op Skema A-voertuie uit. Teken vlootbestuurregisters en statistieke in en werk dit op. Skakel met die diensverskaffers oor sake rakende die vloot. Verleen administratiewe klerklike ondersteuning vir MMS/SMS-lopie-toelaes. Verifieer die akkuraatheid van MMS/SMS-brandstofeise in ooreenstemming met die beleid. Dien akkurate brandstofeise vir betaling in. Teken brandstofeise op stelsels in en werk dit op. Hanteer navrae rakende MMS/SMS-brandstofeise. Hou akkurate rekords van brandstofeise wat elke maand verwerk is. Teken vlootbestuurregisters en statistieke in en werk dit op. Verleen administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste vir finansiële en fisiese bronne in ooreenstemming met die tersaaklike beleide en wetgewende raamwerke: Teken vlootuitgawes vir G-Cars, Subsidieerde voertuigskema A & B, en MMS/SMS-lopie-toelaes in en werk dit op. Verifieer ondersteunende dokumente vir betalings en verseker nakoming van finansiële voorskrifte en departementele beleide. Bied hulp met die voorbereiding van ouditlêers en verskaf ondersteunende dokumentasie tydens interne en eksterne oudite. Identifiseer en rapporteer afwykings, onreëlmatighede of moontlike risiko's rakende vlootuitgawes en hulpbronbestuur. Verseker nakoming van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, departementele beleide en ander tersaaklike wetgewende raamwerke. Stel maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse uitgaweverslae vir bestuur op.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezindaba: Ukuphatwa Kwezimoto
zu.summary: Umphathi wezindaba onikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa kwezimoto eNqangweni yeNkantolo eNkulu koMnyango weZentengahmiso ePolokwane, ephatha ukuhlukaniswa kwezimoto, amaphepha okugibela kanye nedatha ephathelene naleyo.
zu.requirements: Izitshudiso ezinga NQF level 04 njengoba kuqatshwe yiSAQA. Layisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo, ngaphandle kabalalele abanesikhizi. Ulwazi kanye Namakhono: Ulwazi olusisekelo lomSebenzi woHulumende. Incwadi yokuthutha izimoto ezikhokhiswayo ngokwesibonezelo 1 ka-2017. Incwadi yokuThutha izimoto zoHulumende ngokwesibonezelo 1 ka-2019. Umthetho wezeMali yoHulumende, Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999 njengoba ulungisiwe. Amakhono okukhulumisana (okuthiwa nokubhaliwe). Ukuhlela futhi uhlele. Ukuqoqa idatha. Ukuqoqa izibalo. Amakhono okubonisa. Ulwazi lokusebenzela isiKhalazikhathi (MS word, PowerPoint, Excel kanye ne-Outlook).
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yabasebenzi bokuphatha emizweni ehlangabezwe kahulumende: Aba nokwabel izimoto zikahulumene kubasebenzisi. Thola futhi qinisekisa amaphepha okugibela kanye namafomu emvume yokuhamba lapho imoto ibuyela. Bhala, hlela, gcine, faka futhi ubuyisile ongqishana namadata ahlobene nokuphatwa kwezimoto. Faka futhi buyekeza imabuko yokuphatwa kwezimoto kanye nezibalo. Phatha imibuzo yansuku zonke. Gcina amarekhodi afanele wezimoto (amafomu emvume yokuhamba avunyiwe, izikhipho, amaphepha okugibela njll).enza ukubheka izimoto ngaphambi nangemva kokusetshenziswa. Linganisa amaphepha okugibela, izipesheli zamafutha, amafomu emvume yokuhamba kanye namabiko wemikhozo ovela kubanikezeli. Bhala izimoto ukuthi zihlolwe futhi zilungiswe. Faka futhi abele izijezo zokugibela kumshayeli ongcono. Qinisekisa ukuthi amalayisensi wezimoto avusezelwa ngesikhathi. Zivikela izimpahla zokuphathwa kwezimoto, okuhlanganisa amakhadi amafutha, okhiye bezimoto, amalayisensi, nempahla ehlobene nezimoto. Nikeza inkxaso yabasebenzi bokuphatha kolunyuswa loluHlelo lwezimoto Ezigibelayo A kanye noB. Qinisekisa ukulingana kwamangaki amafutha eHlelo A noB ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo. Thumela amangaki amafutha afanele ukuze akhokhelwe. Faka futhi buyekeza amangaki amafutha ohlelweni. Phongca imibuzo ephathelene namangaki amafutha. Gcina amarekhodi afanele amangaki amafutha aqedwe inyanga ngayonyanga.enza ukuhlolwa kwezimoto ngenyanga kwezimoto eziHlelweni A. Faka futhi buyekeza imabuko yokuphatwa kwezimoto kanye nezibalo. Xhumana nebanikezeli besevisi ezindabeni eziphathelene nezimoto. Nikeza inkxaso yabasebenzi bokuphatha kumasotshisi okugijima amaMMS/SMS. Qinisekisa ukulingana kwamangaki amafutha amaMMS/SMS ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo. Thumela amangaki amafutha afanele ukuze akhokhelwe. Faka futhi buyekeza amangaki amafutha ohlelweni. Phongca imibuzo ephathelene namangaki amafutha amaMMS/SMS. Gcina amarekhodi afanele amangaki amafutha aqedwe inyanga ngayonyanga. Faka futhi bukeza imabuko yokuphatwa kwezimoto kanye nezibalo. Nikeza inkxaso yolusebenzi kumgcelo wemali nezinsiza eziyingqayuziveza ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo eziyinhloko nemigomo yomthetho: Faka futhi buyekeza ukuhsubuka kwezimoto amaG, UHlelo oluNgeniswayo A noB, kumasotshisi okugijima amaMMS/SMS. Qinisekisa amaphepha asiza ukukhokha ukuze ahambisana nemiyalo yezimali kanye nezingqubomgomo zikahulumende zomnyango. Siza ekulungiseni amafayela okuphenya futhi unikeze amaphepha asizayo phakathi nokuphenya ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Hlaza futhi wenze umbiko wokuhoqelela, okungalungile, noma ingozzi ephathelene nokuqhekeka kwemali kwezimoto kanye nokuphathwa kwemaluleki. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhambisana uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikahulumende (PFMA), Izinqubo zeTreasure, izinqubomgomo zikahulumende, kanye nezinye izimiso ezifanele zomthetho. Lungeka amabiko okuhsubuka amanyanga, nkathi yethatu nenyanga ngonyaka ukuphathwa.

xh.title: Clerk yolawulo: Lolawulo loMbonakaliso wamalori
xh.summary: Clerk yolawulo enika inkxaso yolawulo loMbonakaliso wamalori kwiNkomkhulu yeSebe lezoMsebenzi oVekiweyo ePolokwane, iphatha ukuqokelelwa kwezithuthi, amaphepha okungatshatwa kunye nedatha ephathwayo.
xh.requirements: Isifanezo kumqondo oNQF level 04 njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni, ngaphandle kweabafaki isicelo abanobunyama. ULwazi nanoNdxwana: Ulwazi olusisiseko ngeNkonzo kaRhulumente ephathwayo. Isihandbukhu sikawonke-wonke sokuHamba ngezeThuthi eNxutywe ngemali inguqulo 1 ka-2017. Isihandbukhu sikaRhulume wokuHamba ngezeThuthi inguqulo 1 ka-2019. uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, uMthetho uNo. 1 ka-1999 njengokuqwalaselwe. Amakhono okunxibelela (ngemilomo nangokubhaliweyo). Ukuca kunye nokuqamba. Ukuqokelelwa kweDatha. Ukuqokelela izibalo. Amakhono okubonisa. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwekhompyutha (MS word, PowerPoint, Excel kwaye no-Outlook).
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwizithuthi ezinqwenwe ngurhulumente. Qokelela kwaye uze unike izithuthi zikarhulumente kumsebenzisi. Yamkela kwaye uqinise ise log sheets & Trip Authorization forms ngokubuyiswa kwezithuthi. Qamba, qamba indlela, gcina, qokelela kwaye uze ubuyisele ukunxibelelana nedatha ngokubanzi ngelawulo lombonakaliso. Qokelela kwaye uvuselela iiqhoboshelelo nokubala kwezibalo zolawulo lombonakaliso. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Gcina irekhodi echazayo ngelawulo lombonakaliso (Approved Trip Authorization forms, Exemptions, Log sheets etc). Yenza ipononelo lokuqala nongoyilo-nye lwezithuthi. Ngqamana i log sheets, izipho zefuel, Trip Authorization forms nemizekelo yemigca evela kumnikezeli. Beka izithuthi izikolokotho zolungiselelo nokuqhwesha. Qokelela & Yika i traffic fines kumqhubi onoxanduva. Qinisekisa ukuba ilayisenisi zezithuthi zivuselelwa ngexesha. Thatha iindaba ngamafa e theethi, kunye nezitshixo zezithuthi, ilayisenisi, kwaye nasezixhobo ezinxulumene nolawulo lombonakaliso. Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwi Subsidised Vehicle Motor Scheme A & B. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwe Scheme A, B fuel claims ngokweNkqubo. Nika i fuel claims echanekileyo ngeNkqubo yokuhlawula. Qokelela kwaye uvuselele i fuel claims kweenkqubo. Phatha imibuzo enxulumene ne fuel claims. Gcina irekhodi echazayo yefuel claims ezingenisweayo inyanga nganye. Yenza ipononelo lezithuthi nyanga nganye ku Scheme A. Qokelela kwaye uvuselela iiqhoboshelelo nokubala kwezibalo zolawulo lombonakaliso. Nxibelelana kubanikezeli ngeNkonzo ngezinto ezinxulumene nomthelela. Nika inkxaso yolawulo kumahlulo e MMS/SMS running allowances. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwe MMS/SMS fuel claims ngokweNkqubo. Nika i fuel claims echanekileyo ngeNkqubo yokuhlawula. Qokelela kwaye uvuselela i fuel claims kweenkqubo. Phatha imibuzo enxulumene ne MMS/SMS fuel claims. Gcina irekhodi echazayo yefuel claims ezingenisweayo inyanga nganye. Qokelela kwaye uvuselela iiqhoboshelelo nokubala kwezibalo zolawulo lombonakaliso. Nika inkxaso yolawulo ngezomali nezibonelelo ngokwezImigaqo-nkqubo namaseKetanga amthetho achaphazelekayo: Qokelela kwaye uvuselele iinkcitha ze theethi ze theethi ze G-Cars, Subsidised vehicle Scheme A & B, kunye ne MMS/SMS running allowances. Qinisekisa amaxwebhu axhasa ngeNkqubo yokuhlawula kwaye uqinisekise ukwamkelwa ngokweNkqubo yemali neNkqubo nakuzo iNkqubo. Nceda ngolungiselelo lwe audit files kwaye unikeze amaxwebhu axhasayo ngexesha le audit zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Qaphula kwaye uchaze ukungahambelani, iziphoso, okanye iingozi ezikhoyo ezinxulumene nokuSebenzisa iNkcitha ngalawulo lomthelela. jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Infrastructure
jobs.centre: Vhembe Ref No: S.4/3/8/53 (X2 Posts) Sekhukhune Ref No: S.4/3/8/81 (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: The Department of Public Works in Limpopo seeks personnel officers to provide recruitment administration support, including processing applications and scheduling shortlisting activities.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 04 as recognized by SAQA. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of general administration duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Computer. Communication skills (good verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Render administration clerical support of recruitment services. Receive application forms from registry and keep record thereof. Provide statistics of received application per post. Compile scheduling of district posts. Arrange boardroom, accommodation and transport claim for shortlisting and interviews in the district. Capture appointment on PERSAL system. Verify qualifications with academic institutions and other authorised bodies. Update PERSAL system in terms of personnel qualifications. Render administration clerical support of conditions of services. Receive notification of service termination due to death/ resignation, retirement (normal and early retirement). Circulate route form to relevant section for liabilities. Effect termination on the PERSAL system upon receipt. Issue the employee benefits (pensions, housing allowances, medical aid scheme recognition of long service awards) forms. Verify correctness of the forms and attachments. Capture benefits. Facilitate state guarantees. Issue the leave forms. Verify correctness of the forms and attachments. Acknowledge the receipt of leave applications. Capture leave on the PERSAL system. Conduct districts leave auditing. Render administration clerical support for post establishment and HR system. Receive transfer application letter. Verify correctness of the application and attachments. Verify the availability of post. Capture PERSAL transaction. Compile monthly statistics on transfers. Conduct district head count. Render administration clerical support for district human resource development services. Create a training/ learning programmes database according to the WSP. Make logistical arrangements for the training programme. Liaise with personnel about the training logistics in time. Issue and receive the course attendance form from personnel. Capture the certificate(s) on PERSAL system. Liaise with head office on schedule of courses to be attended. Verify the compilation of performance management and development system documentation. Make logistical arrangements for performance management and development system moderation. Implement rewards on the PERSAL systems.

af.title: Personeelbeampte
af.summary: Die Department of Public Works in Limpopo soek personeelbeamptes om werwingadministrasie-ondersteuning te bied, insluitend die verwerking van aansoeke en die skedulering van kortlystaktiwiteite.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 04 soos deur SAQA erken. Geldige bestuurderslisensie, met die uitsondering van aansoekers met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van algemene administratiewe pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Buigsaamheid. Rekenaar. Kommunikasievaardighede (goeie mondelinge en skriftelike).
af.duties: Lewer administratiewe klerklike ondersteuning van werwingsdienste. Ontvang aansoekvorms van die register en hou rekord daarvan. Verskaf statistieke van ontvangde aansoeke per pos. Stel skedulering van distriksposte op. Rengel besprekingskamer, akkommodasie en vervoervergoeding vir kortlysting en onderhoude in die distrik. Lui aanstellings op die PERSAL-stelsel vas. Verifieer kwalifikasies met akademiese instellings en ander gemagtigde liggame. Dateer die PERSAL-stelsel op ten opsigte van personeelkwalifikasies. Lewer administratiewe klerklike ondersteuning van diensvoorwaardes. Ontvang kennisgewing van diensbeëindiging weens sterfte/bedanking, aftrede (normale en vroeë aftrede). Sirkuleer routevorm aan relevante afdeling vir laste. Effekteer beëindiging op die PERSAL-stelsel upon ontvangs. Verskaf werknemervoordele (pensioene, behuisingsbydraes, mediese hulpskema erkenning van langdiensprys) vorms. Verifieer korrektheid van die vorms en aanhegsels. Lui voordele vas. Fassiliteer staatwaarborge. Verskaf die verlofvorms. Verifieer korrektheid van die vorms en aanhegsels. Erken die ontvangs van verlofaansoeke. Lui verlof op die PERSAL-stelsel vas. Voer distrikte se verlofoudit uit. Lewer administratiewe klerklike ondersteuning vir postvestiging en HR-stelsel. Ontvang oorplasing-aansoekbrief. Verifieer korrektheid van die aansoek en aanhegsels. Verifieer die beskikbaarheid van die pos. Lui PERSAL-transaksie vas. Stel maandelikse statistieke oor oorplasings op. Voer distrikshoofopname uit. Lewer administratiewe klerklike ondersteuning vir distrikshumannebr ontwikkelingsdienste. Skep 'n databasis van opleidings/ leerprogramme volgens die WSP. Maak logistiese reëlings vir die opleidingsprogram. Skakel betyds met personeel oor die opleidingslogistiek. Verskaf en ontvang die kursusbywoningsvorm van personeel. Lui die sertifikaat(e) op die PERSAL-stelsel vas. Skakel met hoofkantoor oor skedule van kursusse wat bygewoon moet word. Verifieer die samestelling van prestasiebestuur en ontwikkelingstelsel-dokumentasie. Maak logistiese reëlings vir prestasiebestuur en ontwikkelingstelsel-moderering. Implementeer belonings op die PERSAL-stelsels.

zu.title: Inkantshela Yabasebenzi
zu.summary: I-Department of Public Works e-Limpopo ifuna abankantshela basebenzi ukuze banikeze inkxaso yabasebenzi yokuphathwa kokuqashwa, okuhlanganisa ukucubungula izicelo nokuhlela izinhlela zokuqoqa amagama abafanelekile.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF level 04 njengoba kunconywa yi-SAQA. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abanesiKhalazo. Ulwazi Nezikhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ejwayelekile yolawulo, okuhlanganise nokuba nemandla okufaka idatha, nokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ulwazi nokuqonda kohlelo loqobo oluphethe Inkonzo Kahulumeni. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zomsebenzi ngokohlelo lwendawo yokusebenza. Izinhlobonhlobo zokuxhumana. Ukuguquguquka. Ikhompuyutha. Izikhono zokuxhumana (ezinhle zokukhuluma nokubhala).
zu.duties: Nikela inkxaso yolawulo ebuqoshwa yemisebenzi yokuqasha. Thola amafomu esicelo kusilulu bese uligcina irekhodi. Nikela izibalo zezicelo ezitholiwe ngesikhundla. Hlela ishejuli yamaphoshi esifunda. Hlela igumbi lezintanga, indawo yokuhlala kanye nesicelo sezimali zokuhamba okukhokhelwa ukuqoqa amagama nezingingxoxo esifundeni. Faka izigqibo ku-PERSAL system. Qinisekisa iziqu nezikhungo zemfundo namanye amasikhungo avunyelwe. Buyekeza i-PERSAL system ngokweziqu zabasebenzi. Nikela inkxaso yolawulo ebuqoshwa yemigomo yezinsiza zomsebenzi. Thola isaziso sokuphela kwesebenzi ngenxa yokufa/ukuyeka ukusebenza, yokuphumela emalunjalo (evamile nokuqala kusenesikhathi). Sathulelisa ifomu endleleni kumhume ofanelo izibopho. Phumisa umsebenzi kwi-PERSAL system uma sewutholiwe. Khishwa amafomu ezinzuzo zabasebenzi (izibonelelo ezitholwa emalunjalo ngeze kanye nezinhlelo zezimali zokwakha amakhaya okwelapha nezipho zomsebenzi omude). Qinisekisa ukuthi amafomu nezithunywa zalwo azikhiwo. Faka izibonelelo ekusetshenzisweni. Sikisela isiqinisekiso sombuso. Khishwa amafomu okuphumula. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafomu nezithunywa zalwo azikhiwo. Yamukela isitifikedi sokuthola izicelo zokuphumula. Faka ukuphumula kwi-PERSAL system. Yenza ukubuyekwa kwesifunda kokugcina irekhodi lokuphumula. Nikela inkxaso yolawulo ebuqoshwa yokuqashwa kwamaphoshi ne-PERSAL system. Thola incwadi yesicelo sokudluliswa. Qinisekisa ukuthi isicelo nezithunywa sasilungile. Qinisekisa ukuthi isikhundla sikhona. Faka imisebenzi ye-PERSAL. Hlela izibalo zenyanga zokudluliswa kwabasebenzi. Yenza ukubala izinhlangothi kwesifunda. Nikela inkxaso yolawulo ebuqoshwa yamasevisi okuqasha abasebenzi esifundeni. Yenza isisekelo sedatha semikhakha yokuzijwayeza/kuyilunga ngokohlelo lokuqasha. Hlela izinhlelo zemikhakha yokuzijwayeza. Xhumana ngokuqondile nendawo yokuzijwayeza ngase khuluma nendawo. Thola amafomu esigcawu sokuqeshe izinkosi emsebenzini wakho. Faka amafomu esisekelo sokuzijwayeza ohlelweni lokuqasha abantu. Xhumana no-Communications yohlelo lokuqeshe abantu ohlelweni lokuqashwa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe ohlelweni lokuqeshe abantu lwanele. Yenza izinketho zokuzijwayeza ngohlelo lokuqeshe abantu. Yenza izinkomelo ezinikeza imisebenzi ekhokhelwa ngokwezimali ohlelweni lokuqeshe abantu.

xh.title: Ofisa yoQesho
xh.summary: Isebe le-Ntsebenziso kuSebenzo kaRhulumente kuLimpopo lifuna abalawuli bokuqeshwa abasebenzi ukuba banike inkxaso yolawulo ekubeni abantu basebenze, kuquka nokuqwalasela izicelo zokusebenza kunye nohlelo lokucwangcisa izinto ekukhethwa ngayo abantu.
xh.requirements: Ifomali ye-NQF level 04 njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Ilayisenisi yokuqeshwa elisebenzayo, ngaphandle kwabafaka izicelo abanokuphila kakubi. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ejikelezileyo yolawulo, iindlela zokuqeshwa njengoko nakho nako ukwazi ukuyigcina idatha, kwaye usebenzise ikhompyutha. Ulwazi nakuqonda kolwimi ngokomthetho olawula inkonzo karhulumente. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ngeendlela zendalo yokusebenza. Ubudlelwane bomntu nomntu. Ukuguquguquka. Ikhompyutha. Amakhono okunxibelelana (kulungile ngokuthetha nokubhala).
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo njengomsebenzi weofisi kwiinkonzo zokuqeswa abasebenzi. Yamkela iifomu zokusebenza ezisuka kwirejistri zigcinwe kunye nerekhodi yazo. Nikezwa ngeestatistics zezi fomu ezamkeliweyo ngasinye isithuba. Hlela ishedyuli yamaphositha omandilika. Lungelelanise igumbi leboardroom, indawo yokuhlala neklamusi yothutho ukwenzela ukuba kwindilist namava kwindilika. Faka iimpheshala kwinkqubo yePERSAL. Qinisekisa iifomali zemfundo neziko lemfundo nabanaye oogunyaziweyo. Hlaziya inkqubo yePERSAL malunga nefomali zabasebenzi. Nika inkxaso yolawulo njengomsebenzi weofisi kwimeko lekonzo. Yamkela isaziso sokupheliswa kosebenzi ngenxa yokufa / ukushiya umsebenzi, ukuphumla kwashukuma (kweqhelekileyo nokuphumla ngaphambili). Xhela ifomu yendlela kumacandelo afanelekileyo ukujongana nezinyikima. Phumeza ukupheliswa kosebenzi kunkqubo yePERSAL xa ifunyenwe. Nikeza iifomu zabasebenzi nenzuzo (iipenshini, izibonelelo zendlu, isikimu senkxaso yezempilo kwaye nokuqatshelwa kweendya ezide zenkonzo). Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kweefomu neziqhotyoshelwa. Faka izibonelelo. Phatha nokuqinisekiswa ngamarhwebo karhulumente. Faka iifomu zokushiya umsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kweefomu neziqhotyoshelwa. Yamkela ifomu yokushiya umsebenzi. Faka ishedyuli yokushiya umsebenzi kunkqubo yePERSAL. Yenza ukuhlola okujikelezayo ibhodi yeshedyuli. Nika inkxaso yolawulo njengomsebenzi weofisi ngokumisela iifomu abasebenzi nendlela yonikezelo lenkqubo. Yamkela ifomu yokudluliselwa komsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kokusebenza nezinyikima. Qinisekisa ukubakho kweofisi. Faka iimpheshala kunkqubo yePERSAL. Hlela iistatistics nyanga zonke malunga nokuqeswa. Hlala ngenkululeko yexesha. Nika inkxaso yolawulo njengomsebenzi weofisi kwiinkonzo zophuhliso lweemisebenzi ngomntu ngamnye kwindilika. Dala idata yamaphulo ukuziphilisa / amaphulo eemfundo ngokwesikhokelo se-WSP. Lungelelanisa zonke izinto ezibekwe ngokuhambelana kwexesha lamaphulo. Thintathisa nabasebenzi ngokuhambelana nexesha lamaphulo. Yiza namava afanelekileyo namava e-WSP. Faka isatifikeyithi kunkqubo yePERSAL. Landela inkqubo elungelelanisiweyo yokulinganisela kweefomu ezifana ne-WSP. Lungelelanisa iindawo zamaphulo aqediweyo afanelekileyo wazise zilungele ukwenziwa. Nika inkxaso yolawulo njengomsebenzi weofisi kwiinkonzo zophuhliso kwiziko elihamba phambili kuluntu. Dala idathabeysi yamaphulo okufundwa ngokuhambelana ne-WSP. Lungelelanisa izinto ezifuna kwindilika yamaphulo. Thintathisa nabasebenzi ngeenkxaso zamaphulo kwixesha elifanelekileyo. Nikeza kwaza uyamkela ifomu yokubakho kwamaphulo ukusuka kubasebenzi. Faka isatifikethi kunkqubo yePERSAL. Thintathisa nenkomkhulu malunga noshedyuli wamaphulo okuya kuqhelwa. Qinisekisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuziphatha kwabasebenzi ekunikwayo iinkxaso malunga nokuphuhliswa kwemisebenzi yabo. Lungelelanisa okukhethwayo okuhlotywe ngokuchanekileyo. Hlola iimfuno zokusebenza ekwazi ukuthintathisa ngokuchanekileyo malunga nezindlu zamaphulo phantsi kwe-WSP. Lungelelanisa uluntu ngokuhamba kwexesha kwaye lo msebenzi ubalulekileyo ekwenziweni kwakho. Hlola ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yokulinganisa iimfuno zophuhliso nemisebenzi yabantu ngabanye. Hlola ukwakhiwa kweefomu ezahlukeneyo ngokwemisebenzi ekhoyo. Nika inkxaso kwinkqubo yokulinganisa nokuphuhlisa imisebenzi kwindilika. Faka iinkcukacha zemisebenzi yamaphulo abasebenzi ngokuchanekileyo afanelekileyo kubasebenzi ukhoyo. Lungelelanisa imisebenzi yokuhamba okukhethwayo kwindilika ngokuhambelana nexesha. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kwemisebenzi ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Faka iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokuphucula ukusebenza kwentsha yamaphulo abasebenzi kwakuni. Hlola ukuphuculwa kwemisebenzi yamaphulo abasebenzi ngokuhambelana ne-WSP. Hlomela imisebenzi yokuhamba ibhodi kwintsika yokuphucula imisebenzi yamaphulo. Lungiselela izinto ezahlukeneyo zokulungelelanisa nokulawula iinkqubo zokusebenza ngokwamaphulo eemfundo ekhoyo. Faka isatifikethi kwinkqubo ye-PERSAL.

af.title: Skakelbordoperateur
af.summary: Die Limpopo Department of Public Works soek skakelbordoperateurs oor drie distrikte om telefoonoproepe te hanteer, boodskappe aan te neem en telefoonrekords te handhaaf op Vlak 4.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF Level 04 soos deur SAQA erken. Kennis En Vaardighede: Masjienbedryf. Werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Basiese Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Basiese geletterdheid. Organisering.
af.duties: Lewer skakelborddienste: Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande telefoonoproepe. Skakel oproepe deur na relevante toestelle. Verskaf kliënte met toepaslike inligting. Neem boodskappe en dra dit oor aan die relevante personeel. Hou rekord van alle uitgaande oproepe. Druk en reik telefoonrekenings uit. Onderhou telefoondatabasis. Ken pin-kodes toe wanneer gemagtig. Onderhou skakelbordstelsel: Identifiseer en rapporteer telefoonfoute aan die toesighouer. Stel die personeel in kennis as telefone buite werking is. Rekord onderhoud van die skakelbord. Blokkeer en aktiveer telefoontoestelle wanneer gemagtig.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wesikhuluma Sefoni
zu.summary: I-Limpopo Department of Public Works ifuna abalawuli besikhuluma sefoni kuzikhulu ezintathu ukuze baphathe amakholi efoni, bathathe imiyalezo, futhi balondoloze amarekhodi efoni kwelizinga 4.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingazinga 04 le-NQF njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukusebenza kwemishini. Izindlela zokusebenza mayelana nendawo yokusebenza. Ubudlelwano obuyisisekelo phakathi kwabantu. Ukufunda nokubhala okuyisisekelo. Ukuhlela.
zu.duties: Nikela ngamasevisi esikhuluma sefoni: Uphathe amakholi efoni engena naphuma. Dlulisela amakholi kumakhonza ahambisana nawo. Nikela amakhasimadi ngolwazi oluhambisana nawo. Thatha imiyalezo uyidluliselle abasebenzi abahambisana nawo. Gcina irekhodi lawo onke amakholi aphuma. Phrinta futhi ugunyaze ama-akhawunti efoni. Gcina idathabheyisi yefoni. Nikeza amakhodi e-pin uma kunemvume. Gcina isistimu yesikhuluma sefoni: Chaza futhi ucwire iziphazekiso zefoni kumlawuli. Yazise abasebenzi uma amafoni enakekile. Qamba irekhodi lokunakekelwa kwesikhuluma sefoni. Vala futhi uvule amakhonza efoni uma kunemvume.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokusebenza Ngefowuni Yesitishi
xh.summary: Isebe leZaseMimu eLimpopo lifuna abasebenza ngefowuni yesitishi kumazwe amathathu ukubamba amacingo, ukuthatha umyalezo, nokugcina irekhedi lefowuni kwiNqanaba 4.
xh.requirements: Ifomali kwiNqanaba le-NQF 04 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukusebenza kwemishini. Iinkqubo zokusebenza ngokwemvelaphi yendawo yokusebenza. Ubudlelwane obusisiseko phakathi kwabantu. Ukufunda nokubala okusisiseko. Ulungiselelo.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yefowuni yesitishi: Phendula amacingo angenayo aphumayo. Dlulisa amacingo kwi-extension ezifanelekileyo. Nikeza abaxhasi nolwazi olufanelekileyo. Thatha imiyalezo uyidlulisele kumsebenzi ofanelekileyo. Gcina irekhodi yazo zonke iifowuni eziphumayo. Printa uzinike i-akhawunti zefowuni. Phatha idathabheyisi yefowuni. Aba amakhowudi pin xa negunyaziwe. Phatha inkqubo yefowuni yesitishi: Qamba kwaye uchaze iziphazyo zefowuni kumlawuli. Yazise abasebenzi ukuba iifowuni azisebenzi. Qamba ukugcinwa kwefowuni yesitishi. Thintela kwaye uvule i-extension zefowuni xa negunyaziwe.

af.title: Voorman: Skoonmaak en Grondgebied
af.summary: Oulêers skoonmakers en hou toesig oor skoonmaakdienste by die Ba-Phalaborwa-kostesentrum, wat 'n NQF-vlak 4-kwalifikasie en kennis van masjienbedryf vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF level 04 soos deur SAQA erken. Kennis en vaardighede: Masjienbedryf. Werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Basiese interpersoonlike verhoudings. Basiese geletterdheid. Organisasie. Buigsaamheid. Samewerkend. Spanspeler.
af.duties: Oulêers skoonmakers: Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Verskaf leiding en advies aan skoonmakers. Stel die skoonmaakrooster op en werk dit by. Verskaffing en monitering van skoonmaakdienste: Hou toesig oor en monitor skoonmaak van: Kantore. Gange. Algemene kombuis. Ruskamers. Hysbakke. Raadsale. Verskaffing en monitering van grondgebieddienste: Hou toesig oor en monitor skoonmaak van: Omgewing. Persele. Bestuur en verseker die onderhoud en vervanging van skoonmaakmateriaal en toerusting: Onderhou en vervang skoonmaakmasjiene en toerusting. Doen 'n aansoek en reik skoonmaakmateriaal uit.

zu.title: Phathi: Ukuhlanza nezinkambu
zu.summary: Qaphela abahlanzayo bese ubuka izinsiza zokuhlanza esikhungweni sezindleko sase-Ba-Phalaborwa, sidinga iziqu ezingazinga le-NQF 4 nolwazi lokusebenza ngemishini.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingazinga le-NQF 04 njengoba kuvunywe yi-SAQA. Ulwazi nemakhono imisebenzi yoMshini. Izinqubo zokusebenza ngokwendawo yokusebenza. Ubudlelwano obusisiseko phakathi kwabantu. Ukuqala ukubhala. Ukuhlela. Ukuzezelwa. Ukusebenza ndawonye. Ukusebenza njengelungu leqembu.
zu.duties: Qaphela abahlanzayo: Yenza imisebenzi yobulungisi kanye nemisebenzi ehambisana nayo. Nikela ngokuqondisa neseluleko abahlanzayo. Bumba ubuhlalu bokuqasha nabahlanzayo. Nikela ngokuhlinzeka bese uqaphela izinsiza zokuhlanza: Buka bese uqaphela ukuhlanzwa kwezindawo ezilandelayo: Izikhungo. Izihlangi. Ikhishi elijwayelekile. Izindawo zokuphumula. Amalifti. Izinkundla zokuhlangana. Nikela ngokuhlinzeka bese uqaphela izinsiza zendlazi: Buka bese uqaphela ukuhlanzwa kwezindawo ezilandelayo: Izinkambu ezingomakhelwane. Izakhiwo. Phatha futhi qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokushintshwa kwezinto zokuhlanza nezinsiza: Gcina futhi ushinthe izinsiza zokuhlanza kanye nemishini. Yenza izicelo futhi uhlethe izinto zokuhlanza.

xh.title: I-Foreman: Ukucofa kunye nemiMbono
xh.summary: Lawula abacofiga ulwanga lusebenzi kwii-cleaning services, kwaye ulawule iziphatho ezincinci ezikwcost centre Ba-Phalaborwa, kufuneka nomyalelo ofanelekileyo we-NQF level 4 kwaye wonwazi wokusebenzisa iimachine.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esise-NQF level 04 njengoko samkelwe yi-SAQA. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukusebenza kwii-Machine. Iinkqubo zokusebenza ngokubanzi kwendawo yomsebenzi. Iakhono ekusetyenziswa kolwandle. Isakhono sokudlala kwesiXhosa ngokulula. Isakhono sokuhlohlozela. Ukuguquguquka. Kwindawo efezekiswayo. Umdlali wetimu.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ubuncwane bokubakho kwabasebenzi: Gqiba imisebenzi ehleliweyo kwaye ukhululeke kumsebenzi wakho. Banika izikhokelo nababuzi kubacofiga ulwango. Phucula kwaye uvavanyise iinkqubo zokucofa. Xinzelela ulawulo lwezixhobo ezincinci: Khangeloza kwaye ulawule ukucoca: Kwii-ofisi. Endleleni ekuyo. Kwikhishi elikhulu. Kwindawo yokuhlambela. Kwi-elevators. Kwi-boardroom. Xinzelela ulawulo lwezixhobo ze-grounds: Khangeloza kwaye ulawule ukucoca: Endaweni ejikelezileyo. Kwiziseko. Lawula kwaye uqinisekise ukwakhiwa nokutshintshwa kwezixhobo zokucoca: Gcina kwaye utshintshe iimachine zokucoca nezixhobo. Yenza isicelo kwaye unike abantu abacoca imishini yabo.

af.title: Ambagsman AID
af.summary: Ambagsman AID-posisies wat bystand met gebouonderhoud oor Mopani- en Capricorn-distrikte bied, 'n NQF Level 4-kwalifikasie en ambagsvaardighede vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF Level 04 soos deur SAQA erken. Kennis en vaardighede: Vermoë om elektriese en handgereedskap te gebruik, goeie interpersoonlike kommunikasie- en organisatoriese vaardighede, 'n vermoë om onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf bystand in die onderhoud van fasiliteite en toerusting: Voer gereelde gebou-inspeksies uit. Skenk aandag aan klein elektriese, loodgieters-, pleister- en timmermanwerkprobleme. Rapporteer gebreke. Herstel, skoonmaak, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van toerusting en gereedskap volgens standaard: Herstel gebroke meubels en toerusting. Maak toerusting en masjinerie na gebruik skoon. Rapporteer foute.

zu.title: Umsizi Wobuso Bemisebenzi
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomsizi wobuso bemisebenzi ezinikeza usizo lokugcina izakhiwo kulo lonke elaseMopani naseCapricorn, kudingeka izinga le-NQF Level 4 kanye namakhono obuso bemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingazinga le-NQF Level 04 njengoba sivunywe i-SAQA. Ulwazi Namakhono: ikhono lokusebenzisa amathuluzi kagesi nanamathuluzi esandla, amakhono ohlelo nobuxhumano obuhle kanye namakhono okuhlela, ikhono lokusebenza ngabanye.
zu.duties: Nika usizo ekugcineni izinto zokusebenza nempahla: Yenza ukuhlolwa kwakho kwamakade efakwe ezindlini njalo. Yelekelela izinkinga ezincane zamagesi, amayiva, ukuphalaza, kanye nobugcisa bezinkuni. Bika izimpahla ezonakele. Lungisa, hlanza, ukhonze futhi gcina izinto zokusebenza namathuluzi ngokomgomo othile: Lungisa impahla nezinto zokusebenza eziphukile. Hlanza izinto zokusebenza namashini emva kokusebenzisa. Bika amaphutha.

xh.title: Umncedisi weTrade Tradesman AID
xh.summary: Izithuba zomncedisi weTrade Tradesman AID ezinika inkxaso ekunakekelweni kwezakhiwo kuloonke amaswaphi eMopani naseCapricorn, kufuneka abe nemfuno yeqela leNQF Level 4 namakhono emisebenzi yezandla.
xh.requirements: Ifundo eqeqeshiweyo kwinqanaba leNQF Level 04 njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulungelelwano lokusebenzisa izixhobo zombane nezandla, amakhono amahle onxibelelwano nabantu nokuhlelwa kweenkonzo, amandla okusebenza kodwa.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekunakekelweni kweziseko ezingundoqo nezixhobo: Qhuba iingqondo ezizerho ngezakhiwo. Jongana nemiba emincane yombane, yamajikijolo, yegwele, nokuqhotsa inkuni. Bikela iimposiso. Lungisa, hamba ucocze izixhobo kwaye zigcinwe ngokhuseleko ngokomgangatho: Lungisa ifenitsha nezixhobo ezingasebenyo. Coca izixhobo namashini emva kokuzisebenzisa. Bikela iimposiso.

af.title: Bestuurder-operateur
af.summary: Bestuurder-operateurs word in verskeie Limpopo-distrikte gesoek om gespesialiseerde padmasjienerie te bedryf, met 'n vereiste vir 'n Code EC- lisensie en 'n NQF Level 4-kwalifikasie.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF Level 04 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie Code EC en bedryfsertifikaat. Minimum 2 jaar se bestuurs- en bedryfservaring van gespesialiseerde toerusting. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante Wette en regulasies· Bedryf van padmasjienerie· Gesondheids- en veiligheidsmaatreëls· Werksprosedures ten opsigte van die padomgewing. Besluitneming. Kreatiwiteit. Kommunikasie. Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Verrig aktiwiteite ten opsigte van bedryf deur: Bedryf van gespesialiseerde toerusting. Laai en aflaai van goedere/toerusting. Inspeksie en onderhoud van toerusting en rapporteer gebreke. Hou logblaaie van voertuie en masjiene aan. Toepassing van veiligheids- en voorsorgmaatreëls. Skoonmaak en smering van masjiene en toerusting. Gradering van gruispaaie. Hergruisering / skouderonderhoud. Lewer bestuursdienste. Verrig aktiwiteite ten opsigte van bedryf deur onder andere die volgende: Vervoer van werkgroepe en materiaal/toerusting. Ontdek en herstel klein siviele probleme aan die voertuig en neem stappe om dit te laat herstel (kontroleer vlak en toestand van olie, brandstof, bande en water). Inspeksie van die voertuie / toerusting en rapporteer gebreke. Voltooi voertuiglogboek, ritmagtiging vir die voertuig.

zu.title: Umdidiyeli Wezimoto
zu.summary: Abadidiyeli bezimoto bafunwa kuzigaba eziningi zase-Limpopo ukuba basebenze ngemishini ekhethekileyo yezindlela, kudingeka ilayisense ye-Code EC nesithakazelo se-NQF Level 4.
zu.requirements: Isithakazelo ezinganeni le-NQF Level 04 njengoba samukelwa i-SAQA. Ilayisense evumelekileyo yokushayela ye-Code EC nokuqwesabiswa kokusebenza. Okungenani iminyaka 2 yohlelo lokushayela nokusebenza ngemishini ekhethekileyo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho emitsha yolawulo. Ukusebenza ngemishini yezindlela. Izinyathelo zempilo nokuqinisekiswa kokuphephileko. Izinqubo zokusebenza ngokomthetho wemvelo yezindlela. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukudala. Ukuxhumana. Ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi ngokusebenza ngemishini ngezindlela ezilandelayo: Ukusebenza ngemishini ekhethekileyo. Ukufaka nokukhipha impahla/imishini. Ukugcina nokuhlolwa kwemishini nokubika izinkinga. Ukugcina amafomu ezimoto nemishini. Ukusebenzisa izinyathelo zokuphepha nokungabeka engozini. Ukucwecela nokugcoba imishini. Ukugqema izindlela ezibhagelwayo. Ukubuyisela itshe/ukulondoloza izibambo. Ukunika inkonzo yokushayela. Ukwenza imisebenzi ngokusebenza ngemishini phakathi kwokunye okulandelayo: Ukuthutha amaqembu okusebenza nempahla/imishini. Ukuqapha nokulungisa izinkinga ezincane ezingokobucwebe kwimoto bese uthatha izinyathelo zokuzilungisa (kuhlolwe izinga nokuqakatheka kwamafutha, kaphethioli, amathayi namanzi). Ukuhlola izimoto/imishini nokubika izinkinga. Ukuqedela ifomu lemino yezimoto, ukuvumelanisa uhambo lwemoto.

xh.title: Umqhubi Wemishini
xh.summary: Kufunwa abaquhubi bemishini kumaze aphathene nayo eLimpopo ukuba basebenze imishini yendlela ebalulekileyo, kufuneka babe nelayisensi ye-Code EC kunye nefomali ye-NQF Level 4.
xh.requirements: Ifomali kwi-NQF Level 04 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo ye-Code EC kunye neSatifikhate Yokusebenza. Ubuncinane i-2 yiminyaka yamava okuqhuba nokusebenzisa imishini ebalulekileyo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngabaMthetho balawulo abafaneleyo· Ukusebenzisa imishini yendlela· Izixhobo zempilo nakho kusingathwa· Iinkqubo zokusebenza malunga nomhlaba weendlela. Ukwenza izigqibo Ukuyila Unxibelelwano Ukuqamba iindlela nokuzihlanganisa.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi malunga nokusebenza ngokwesigaba esilandelayo: Ukusebenzisa imishini ebalulekileyo. Layisha kwaye ukhuphe izinto/imishini. Ukuhlolwa kunye nolondolozo lwemishini kwaye uxule iimpazamo. Gcina amaphepha okubhalisa iimoto nemishini. Ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zokhuseleko nezithiyacideso. Ukucotha kunye nokugquba imishini nezixhobo. Ukulinganisa iindlela ezityhola. Ukuzihlaziya / ukulondoloza iindawo eziyele. Yazi iinkonzo zokuqhuba. Yenza imisebenzi malunga nokusebenza ngaphakathi kokunye oku landelayo: Ukuthutha amaqela omsebenzi nezinto/imishini. Phawula kulungise iingxaki ezincinci zolwakhiwo kwimoto kwaye uthathe izigqibo ukuba zilungiswe (kuhlolwe inqanaba kunye nemo yoyilo, izixhobo zokutya, iithaya kunye namanzi). Ukuhlolwa kwezithuthi / imishini kwaye kuxulwe iimpazamo. Gcwala incwadi yokubhala iimoto, igunyaziso lokuhamba lemoto.

Ukubeka izinto ngokuthi izinsimbi ezibambe nomhlaba nezinkuni. Ukuqamba uphawu lwezindlela namatshe ezindlela. Ukusebenza njengelungu l eqela.

af.title: Grondwerker
af.summary: Grondwerkers benodig in Mopani en Sekhukhune distrikte om persele, tuine en gronde te onderhou, wat 'n NQF Level 2 kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF Level 2 soos erken deur SAQA. Kennis en vaardighede: skoonmaaktoerusting. Gesondheids- en veiligheidsmaatreëls. Werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Basiese syferkennis. Basiese interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Basiese geletterdheid. Organisering.
af.duties: Onderhou persele en omgewing: skoonmaak van persele en omgewing. Ledig vuil blikke. Onderhou die tuin: Besproei die tuin. Snoei en knip blomme en bome. Sny die gras. Verwyder onkruid en tuinafval. Dien insekdoders toe. Bewerk die grond vir bome en blomme. Onderhou tuinmaaktoerusting en gereedskap: Ondek en rapporteer wanfunksionering van tuinmaaktoerusting en gereedskap. Herstel klein foute aan tuinmaaktoerusting en gereedskap. Hou tuinmaakmateriale en toerusting: Skoonmaak van masjiene en toerusting na gebruik versoek tuinmaakmateriale.

zu.title: Umlondolozi wendlu nezindawo

Izinqubo zokusebenza ngokuhlobene nendawo yokusebenza. Ukubala okuyisisekelo. Ubudlelwano obuwumuntu obuyisisekelo. Ukufunda nokubhala okuyisisekelo. Ukuhlela.

Ukusika ihlathi. Ukukhipha amakhilha nezinto ezingafuneki esivandeni. Ukusebenzisa izibulala-zinambuzane. Ukuvundisa umhlabathi wezihlahla nezimbali. Ukugcina amapulangwe nezithulu zokulima: Ukubona futhi ukubika ukungasebenzi kahle kwamapulangwe nezithulu zokulima. Ukulungisa iziphazamiso ezincane zamapulangwe nezithulu zokulima. xh.duties: Ukugcina iindawo nendawo ejikele: ukucoca iindawo nendawo ejikele. Ukushenxa izitya ezidaka. Ukugcina igadi: Ukunisela igadi. Ukusika nokuhlela iintyatyambo namthi. Ukusika undongwe. af.summary: Skoonmaker gesoek vir Public Works in Giyani, Limpopo, wat Graad 8- of ABET-kwalifikasies en basiese kennis van skoonmaaktoerusting en gesondheidsveiligheid vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 08/ABET/AET-kwalifikasies/'n Kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 02 soos erken deur SAQA. Kennis en vaardighede: Skoonmaaktoerusting. Gesondheids- en veiligheidsmaatreëls. Werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Basiese syferkennis. Basiese interpersoonlike verhoudings. Basiese geletterdheid. Organisasie.
af.duties: Verskaf skoonmaakdienste: Kantorgange, hysers en raadsale. Stof afvee en was van kantoor meubels, vee, skuur en was van vloere, stofsuig en sjampoe van vloere, skoonmaak van mure, vensters en deure, ledig en skoonmaak van vuil blikke, versamel en verwyder van afvalpapier, verfris die kantoorareas. Verskaf skoonmaakdienste: kombuis en rusruimtes deur, was wasbakke, was en hou voorraad van kombuisgerei. Verskaf skoonmaakdienste in rusruimtes, hervul handwasvloeibare seep, vervang toiletpapier, handdoeke en verfrismiddels, ledig en was afvalblikke, hou en onderhou skoonmaakmateriaal en toerusting, rapporteer gebroke skoonmaakmasjiene en toerusting, skoonmaak van masjiene (mikrogolwe, stofsuiers ens.) en toerusting na gebruik, versoek skoonmaakmateriaal.

zu.title: Umsuki
zu.summary: Kufunwa umsuki osebenza kwi-Public Works e-Giyani, Limpopo, ofuna ibanga le-Grade 8 noma izifundo ze-ABET kanye nolwazi oluyisiseko mayelana nezinto zokumsuka nobungozi bezempilo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ze-Grade 08/ABET/AET/Isifundo esingazingeni le-NQF level 02 njengoba kunikwe amandla yi-SAQA. Ulwazi nezakhono: Izinto zokumsuka. Izindlela zokuvikela impilo nokuphepha. Izinqubo zokusebenza ngokuthintana nemvelaphi yokusebenza. Ukubala okuyisiseko. Ubudlelwano obuyisiseko nabantu. Ukufunda nokubhala okuyisiseko. Ukuhlela.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesevisi yokumsuka: Izindlela zamahhovisi, ama-elevator namakamelo abhadane. Ukususa uthuli nokufaka iwashi emefeni yamahhovisi, ukusula, ukuhlamba nangokufaka iwashi phansi, ukusula ngomshini wokumtsa nokugeza izinkomba phansi, ukumsuka izindonga, amafasitela namnyango, ukushabalalisa futhi ukuhlisa izinsiza ezingcolile zokuphumayo, ukuqoqa futhi ususe amaphepha angasebenziyo, ukuvuselela izindawo zamahhovisi. Nikela ngesevisi yokumsuka: igumbi lokupheka kanye namagumbi okuhlambela ngokuhlamba, ukusula amabhasigi, ukugeza futhi ugcinelo izitshali zegumbi lokupheka. Nikela ngesevisi yokumsuka kumagumbi okuhlambela, gcwalisa isiphesheli esithathwa ngesandla sesiphuni, buyela phansi amaphepha wocansi, amathawula ezandla nezinto zokuvuselela, ziqhuqe futhi uhlale izinsiza ezingcolile zokuphumayo, zigcine futhi uzinake izinto zokumsuka namakhaphethwuni, wenze umbiko ngezinto namakhaphethwuni ephukile zokumsuka, ukumsuka amakhaphethwuni (amakhiye-omshini, abasuli ngomoya njll.) nezinto emva kokusetshenziswa, celwa izinto zokumsuka.

xh.title: Umcoci
xh.summary: Kufunwa umcoci kwi-Public Works e-Giyani, Limpopo, ofuna ibanga le-Grade 8 okanye iziqinisekiso ze-ABET nolwazi olusetyenziswa kumacoco namazinga ophilo nephepho.
xh.requirements: Iziqinisekiso ze-Grade 08/ABET/AET/A isiqinisekiso kwinqanaba le-NQF level 02 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Amacoco. Amanyathelo ephepho nophilo. Iinkqubo zomsebenzi ngokubaluleka kwendawo yomsebenzi. I-Numeracy ekuqaleni. Ukuhamba nabantu ngokuqala. Ukufunda nokubhala okusetyenziswa ngokuqala. Ulungiselelo.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yokucoca: Ikorridori zee-ofisi, iilevatha neebhodaroom. Ukucoca nokupolisa ifanitshala yee-ofisi, ukuqhumza, ukurhola nokupolisa phantsi, uku-coceeda nokushampoo amaphantsi, ukucoca iindonga, iifestile nee-cwtango, ukuyahlaza nokucoca iindawo ze-flop, ukuthutha kwaye ususe amaphephu alahlekileyo, ukutsha amacwecwe e-ofisi. Zenze inkonzo yokucoca: iikhishi kunye neendawo zokuhlambela ngokuhlamba, usuke ahlaze ucine ipepo yekhitshi. Zenze inkonzo yokucoca phakathi kweendawo ze-toilet, zigcwalise isepha esetyenziselwa ukuzihlamba isandla, ufake ezinye iipesika zamacwecwe e-toilet, amathawula esandla neze-freshener, uze uhlaze ii-waste bins, zilahlaze ngononophelo ukhulule izixhobo, uchaze amacoco angasebenziyo namashini ekhuselo, ucoce amashini (ama-microwave, ii-vacuum cleaners njl.njl.) namanye amashini emva kokusebenzisa, ucele iimpahla ezicocwayo.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Financial Accounting
jobs.summary: Chief Director: Financial Accounting at the Department of Health Provincial Office in Mbombela, requiring an NQF 7 finance qualification and five years of SMS-level experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF 7) in Finance, Financial Accounting / Management as recognized by SAQA. At least five (5) years’ experience in financial accounting / management at Senior Management Service (SMS) level. Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme Certificate. A valid driver’s licence. Skills: Proven experience in public sector accounting, reporting, risk management, internal controls and/or auditing. Proven experience in managing Supply Chain Management and fraud prevention. Experience in programme management as well as diversity and change management. Clear understanding of priorities of government. High level of communication and consultation skills. Ability to work proactively and under pressure. Track record in the preparation and management of strategic plan, business plans and budgeting ability to implement, monitor and evaluate internal systems controls to ensure sound financial management and other resources management practices. An in-depth knowledge of PFMA, Treasury Regulations and PPPFA. An understanding of good cooperate governance principles (King III) and all other relevant financial regulations and budget laws. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulation. National Treasury regulations. National Treasury/Practice Notes. National Treasury & DPSA Circulars. General Accounting Principles. Division of Revenue Act. SCM Guidelines and Frameworks Public Service Regulation; and other relevant acts, policies and regulations. Planning. Team development. Decision making. Problem solving. Report writing & general (Academic) writing skills. Financial management. Budgeting systems. Analytical skills. Management skills. Written Communication: Prepare reports required in terms of Public Service statutory framework by collecting, formatting & explaining information.
jobs.duties: Develop, implement and maintain appropriate mechanisms/strategic to timeously respond to the changing needs of financial information and the interpretation thereof. Give expect advice on the strategic financial planning of the Department through analysis of budget and expenditure patterns, financial status, financial plans, past and present financial operation and estimates of future revenues and expenditures. Ensure that financial resources and assets of the department are utilized effectively and economically to ensure the objectives of the strategic plans. Ensure adequate internal financial control arrangements and systems for the accountable delegation of financial powers, assets security, monitoring and evaluation of systems and timeous corrective action. Assists the Head of Department by applying cost – benefit analysis principles to certify value for money. Oversee budgetary process within the Department, exercise budgetary control and provide early arrangement at a strategic level. Develop and facilitate the implementation of the Supply Chain Management System, consistent with legislative and other government policies. Facilitate Risk Management in the Department and maintain an internal audit system and external audit processes. Ensure that fraud and prevention systems are implemented. Monitor the implementation of the Departmental Clean Audit Strategy. Oversee the preparation and submission of annual financial statements and liaise with the Auditor – General. Liaise with relevant role – players within National and Provincial Department. Responsible for management of Human Resources in the respective Chief Directorate.
