af.summary: Hoofdirekteur: Finansiële Rekeningkunde by die Department of Health Provincial Office in Mbombela, wat 'n NQF 7-finansieskwalifikasie en vyf jaar se ervaring op SMS-vlak vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF 7) in Finansies, Finansiële Rekeningkunde / Bestuur soos erken deur SAQA. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in finansiële rekeningkunde / bestuur op Senior Management Service (SMS)-vlak. Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme-sertifikaat. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Vaardighede: Bewese ervaring in openbare-sektor-rekeningkunde, verslagdoening, risikobestuur, interne beheer en/of ouditering. Bewese ervaring in die bestuur van Voorsieningskettingbestuur en bedrogvoorkoming. Ervaring in programbestuur asook diversiteits- en veranderingbestuur. Duidelike begrip van die prioriteite van die regering. Hoë vlak van kommunikasie- en konsultasievaardighede. Vermoë om proaktief en onder druk te werk. T Rekord in die voorbereiding en bestuur van strategiese plan, besigheidsplanne en begrotingsvermoë om interne stelselbeheer te implementeer, te monitor en te evalueer om gesonde finansiële bestuur en ander bronnebestuurspraktyke te verseker. 'n Diepgaande kennis van PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en PPPFA. 'n Begrip van goeie korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels (King III) en alle ander tersaaklike finansiële regulasies en begrotingswette. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulation. National Treasury regulations. National Treasury/Practice Notes. National Treasury & DPSA Circulars. Algemene Rekeningkundige Beginsels. Division of Revenue Act. SCM-riglyne en -raamwerke Public Service Regulation; en ander tersaaklike wette, beleide en regulasies. Beplanning. Spanontwikkeling. Besluitneming. Probleemoplossing. Verslagskrywing & algemene (akademiese) skryfvaardighede. Finansiële bestuur. Begrotingstelsels. Analitiese vaardighede. Bestuursvaardighede. Geskrewe kommunikasie: Berei verslae voor wat vereis word ingevolge die Public Service-wetgewende raamwerk deur inligting in te samel, te formateer en te verduidelik.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou toepaslike meganismes/strategieë om betyds te reageer op die veranderende behoeftes van finansiële inligting en die interpretasie daarvan. Gee kundige advies oor die strategiese finansiële beplanning van die Departement deur ontleding van begrotings- en bestedingspatrone, finansiële status, finansiële planne, vorige en huidige finansiële bedrywe en beramings van toekomstige inkomste en bestedings. Verseker dat finansiële bronne en bates van die departement doeltreffend en ekonomies benut word om die doelwitte van die strategiese planne te verseker. Verseker voldoende interne finansiële beheerreëlings en stelsels vir die aanspreeklike afvaardiging van finansiële bevoegdhede, bate-sekuriteit, monitering en evaluering van stelsels en betydse korrektiewe optrede. Bied bystand aan die Hoof van Departement deur koste-batenalise-beginsels toe te pas om waarde vir geld te sertifiseer. Hou toesig oor die begrotingsproses binne die Departement, oefen begrotingsbeheer uit en verskaf vroegtydige reëling op strategiese vlak. Ontwikkel en fasiliteer die implementering van die Voorsieningskettingbestuurstelsel, in ooreenstemming met wetgewende en ander regeringsbeleid. Fasiliteer Risikobestuur in die Departement en onderhou 'n interne ouditstelsel en eksterne ouditprosesse. Verseker dat bedrog- en voorkomingstelsels geïmplementeer word. Monitor die implementering van die Departementele Skoon Oudit-strategie. Hou toesig oor die voorbereiding en indiening van jaarlikse finansiële state en skakel met die Ouditeur-Generaal. Skakel met tersaaklike rolspelers binne Nasionale en Provinciale Departement. Verantwoordelik vir bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne in die onderskeie Hoofdirektoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu: Izimali Eziphathwayo
zu.summary: Umphathi Omkhulu: Izimali Eziphathwayo ehhovisi lephrovinsi leDepartment of Health eMbombela, kudingeka iziqu ze-NQF 7 kwezimali namava eminyaka emihlanu ezingeni le-SMS.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-undergraduate (NQF 7) kwezimali, ezimali eziphathwayo / eziphathiswayo njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Uhlole eminyakeni engu- five (5) ubudala amava ezimalini eziphathwayo / eziphathiswayo ezingeni le-Senior Management Service (SMS). Isitifiketi se-Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Amakhono: Amava abekiwe ezimali zomphakathi, ukubika, ukulawula ingozi, izilawuli zangaphakathi kanye noma nokuhlolwa. Amava abekiwe ekuphatheni i-Supply Chain Management nokuvinjelwa ukwenza amaqhiga. Amava ekuphathweni kwamaphrogramhe kanye nokuphathwa kwehlukahluko koshintsho. Ukuqonda okucacile ngaphambili kahulumeni. Izinga eliphezulu lekhono lokuxhumana nokubonisana. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokubambekayo phantsi koxinzelelo. Umbhalo-kenqa ekulungiseni nokuphatheni ihlelo lezobuciko, amaphulani ebhizinisi kanye nethonyama yokwakheka amaphulo, ukulawula nokuhlola izilawuli zamasistimu angaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kwezimali okulungile nakunye ukuphathwa kwezinsiza. Ukwazi ngokujulile i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations kanye ne-PPPFA. Ukuqonda imigomo yezentengiselwano enhle ehlangene (King III) nakho konke okunye imithetho yezimali ehembe kanye nemithetho yamaphulo. I-Public Service Act. I-Public Service Regulation. I-National Treasury regulations. I-National Treasury/Practice Notes. Ama-National Treasury & DPSA Circulars. I-General Accounting Principles. I-Division of Revenue Act. Izinkomba nezakhiwo ze-SCM Public Service Regulation; kanye naneminye imithetho, amapholisi nomthetho osemthethweni ohlobene. Ukucubungula. Ukuthuthukisa iqembu. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala imibiko & amakhono okubhala jikelele (ezemfundo). Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Amasistimu wokwakheka amaphulo. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okuphatha. Ukuxhumana okubhaliwe: Lokubala imibiko edingekayo ngokusho kwe-Public Service statutory framework ngokuqoqa, ukulungiselela & ukucazulula ulwazi.
zu.duties: Butha, phumeza futhi zigcine izindlela/izobuciko ezifanele ukuphendula ngokushesha ezidingweni ezishintshayo zolwazi lwezimali nenhlokweni yalo. Nikela ngeluleko elithembekile ekuhlelweni kobuciko bezimali komnyango ngokuhlaziya amaphulo kanye nemisoco yokuchitha, isimo sezimali, amaphulani wezimali, imisebenzi yezimali edlule namanje kanye nokulinganiselwa kwemali engenayo nokuqoqwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza nezimpahla zezimali zomnyango zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo nangokwendlulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinjongo zamaphulani obuciko. Qinisekisa izinhlelo zangaphakathi nezilawuli zezimali ezanele ukubekwa kobubele bezimali obuzwikwe, ukuphephiswa kwempahla, ukuhlola futhi kubhekwe amasistimu kanye nokuqhathaniswa okusheshayo. Siza iNhloko yoMnyango ngokusebenzisa imigomo yokuhlaziya inzuzo - inani ukuze kugunyazwe inani lemali. Bheka inqubo yamaphulo ngaphakathi koMnyango, wenza ukulawula kwamaphulo futhi unikeze intshayelelo ngaphambili ezingeni lobuciko. Butha futhi wenze kwenzeke ukuphathwa kwe-Supply Chain Management System, ehambisana nomthetho kanye namapholisi ayo ohulumeni. Wenze ukulawula kwengozi kuMnyango futhi ugcine isistimu yokuhlolwa ngaphakathi kanye namacala okuhlolwa angaphandle. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasistimu okuvimbela iqhiga asetshenzisiwe. Hlola ukuphathwa kwe-Clean Audit Strategy yoMnyango. Bheka ukulungiselela nokuthunyelwa kwemibiko yezimali yonyaka futhi uxhume ne-Auditor - General. Xhuma nabalingisi abahlobene kwi-National and Provincial Department. Uyebekile ngokuphathwa kwe-Human Resources kwoMnyango ophathekayo.

xh.title: Umntu oPhambili oLawulayo: ukuBala kweeMali
xh.summary: Umntu oPhambili oLawulayo: ukuBala kweeMali kwiSebe lezeMpilo eKwindla lePhondo eMbombela, kufuneka abe nesidanga seNQF 7 kwezezimali nolunyaka lweeminyaka emihlanu lolugqatso kumgangatho we-SMS.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF 7 kwezezimali, ekuBalweni / ekuLawulweni kwezezimali njengoko kwamkelwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinaneieminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ekuBalweni / ekuLawulweni kwezezimali kumgangatho woBakonzo abaNgangamshi (SMS). Isatifikethi seNyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Amakhono: Amapasi anengcamango ekuBalweni, exela ngeemeko, kulawulo lweengozi, kolawulo langaphakathi kwaye/okanye ekuqwalaselweni kummandla karhulumente. Amapasi anengcamango ekulawulweni koLawulo lwoQhagamshelwano lweeNkcukacha nokuthintela inkohlakalo. Amava ekulawulweni kweenkqubo nakulawulo lokwahlukano nokutshintsha. Ukuqonda ngokucace gcaio iingqwalasela zorhulumente. Umgangatho ophezulu wokunxibelelwana nokuveliswa kweemvo. Isakhono sokusebenza ngokuzimisela nangaphantsi koxinzelelo. Irekhodi ekulungiseni nasekulawulweni isicwangciso esiNgangamsha, iicwangciso zorhwebo nesakhono sezimali ezingeniso sokuze kusebenze, iqwalasele kwaye ihlole iindlela zolawulo zangaphakathi ukuqinisekisa ulawulo olululo lwezezimali nezinye iindlela zolawulo zesixhobo. Isazisi esijulile se-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations ne-PPPFA. Ukuqonda iimpawu zolawulo olululo oluhle (King III) nazozonke ezinye iimithetho yezimali enomthelela neemthetho zesabelo sezezimali. I-Regulations Public Service Regulation; nezinye iimithetho, iinkqubo neemithetho. Uqwalaselo lomsebenzi weqela. Ukomelela kwexesha elizayo. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukubhala iingxelo nolunye (iNzululwazi) ukubhala amakhono. Ulawulo lwezezimali. Iindlela zeNkqubo ezimali. amakhono oqwalaselo. Iinkqubo zamakhono. Ulwimi lokuBhaliweyo: Lungiselela iingxelo efuneka ngokomthetho Public Service Regulation, ngokutyabatheleka, ukulungiselela nokucacisa iinkcukacha; nezinye iimithetho, iinkqubo neemithetho. Uqwalaselo lomsebenzi weqela. Ukomelela kwexesha elizayo. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukubhala iingxelo & olunye (iNzululwazi) ukubhala amakhono. Ulawulo lwezezimali. Iindlela zeNkqubo zeNgeno-mali. Amakhono oqwalaselo. Amakhono oLawulo. Ilwimi eBhaliweyo: Lungiselela iingxelo ezifuneka ngokomthetho Public Service Regulation; nezinye iimithetho, iinkqubo neemithetho.
xh.duties: Phuhlisisa, sebenzisa kwaye ulondoloze iindlela ezingathathi hlangothi / ezisemgangathweni sokuphendula ngokusesikweni iimfuno ezitshintshayo zeenkcukacha zezimali nenkcazelo yazo. Nikela ingcebiso ngokulindileyo kwisicwangciso esiNgangamsha sezezimali leSebe ngokwahlulahlula iindlela zeNgeno-mali nokuchithwa, iimeko zezimali, iicwangciso zezimali, imisebenzi yangaphambili yethu yamhlanje iindlela eziya kwenziwa zeNgeno-mali nokuchithwa rhoqo. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxhobo ezezimali namaxhobo esebe asetyenziswa ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchithwa kancinci ukuze kuqinisekiswa iinjongo zeecwangciso ezisemgangathweni. Qinisekisa iindlela ezaneleyo zolawulo lwezezimali ngaphakathi noluvo lwenkqubo kwikomkhulu lokugqithisa amagunya ezezimali, ukhuseleko lwamaxhobo, ukulawula nokuhlola iindlela zolawulo nokuyilungisa ngexesha. Nceda uLawuli weSebe ngokusebenzisa iimfuno zoqwalaselo nenzuzo-rhoqo ukuqinisekisa inzuzo-rhoqo. Phuhlisa kwaye ukhuthaze ukusebenza kwenkqubo yoLawulo lwoQhagamshelwano lweeNkcukacha ngokungathathi hlangothi ngomthetho neyamanye amagunya omhlaba. jobs.title: Director: Communicable Diseases Control
jobs.summary: Director: Communicable Diseases Control at the Mpumalanga Provincial Office, requiring a Health Sciences qualification and five years' managerial public health experience.
jobs.requirements: An under-graduate qualification (NQF Level 7) in Health Sciences as recognised by SAQA. At least five (5) years’ experience in Public Health Services at a middle / senior managerial level. Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme Certificate. Proven knowledge and experience in Health Services delivery at Primary Health Care and hospital level within the District Health System, in line with relevant legislation, policies, and regulations within the Public Sector. Experience in managing emerging, re-emerging, malaria, and vector-borne diseases. A Master’s degree in Public Health qualification will be an added advantage. A driver’s license. Strategic and Leadership abilities. Financial Management; Project management, problem-solving and analysis. Change management, decision-making, conflict management, verbal communication and report writing skills. People management, Client-orientated and customer-focused. Computer literacy. A dynamic individual with excellent management skills. A proactive thinker; effective reporting, interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills are essential.
jobs.duties: Ensure optimal provision of communicable disease control and management in the Province. Ensure the development, implementation, and monitoring of strategic and operational plans for the Province. Submit timely weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports regarding programme activities. Develop, maintain and implement the strategies and policies in line with National Health- related legislation and frameworks. Provide strategic leadership and Human Resource Management and Development. Prepare and maintain the programme’s resources and meet the Health and Service needs of the province in accordance with the relevant prescripts. Represent the province of the Department at relevant forums. Facilitate the development and implementation of the system geared towards the improvement of service delivery.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Emmanuel Makokoropo Tel No: (013) 766 3384 / Ms. Gugu Nkosi Tel No: (013) 766 3103 / Mr. Mxolisi Maseko Tel No: (013) 766 3351, Mr. Samson Nyoni Tel No: (013) 766 3087 and IT related queries: Help desk Tel No: (013) 766 3018. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Direkteur: Beheer van Oordraagbare Siektes
af.summary: Direkteur: Beheer van Oordraagbare Siektes by die Mpumalanga Provinsiale Kantoor, wat 'n kwalifikasie in Gesondheidswetenskappe en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring in openbare gesondheid vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 7) in Gesondheidswetenskappe soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in Openbare Gesondheidsdienste op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Nyukela Openbare Diens SMS Toetree-program Sertifikaat. Bewese kennis en ervaring in die lewering van Gesondheidsdienste op primêre gesondheidsorg- en hospitaalvlak binne die Distrik Gesondheidstelsel, in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing, beleide en regulasies binne die Openbare Sektor. Ervaring in die bestuur van ontluikende, herontluikende, malaria- en vektor-gedraagde siektes. 'n Meestersgraad in Openbare Gesondheid-kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Bestuurslisensie. Strategiese en leierskapsvermoëns. Finansiële Bestuur; Projekbestuur, probleemoplossing en analise. Veranderingsbestuur, besluitneming, konflikbestuur, mondelinge kommunikasie en verslagskryfvaardighede. Mensebestuur, kliëntgerig en op die klieënt gefokus. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Dinamiese individu met uitstekende bestuursvaardighede. 'n Proaktiewe denker; effektiewe verslagdoening, interpersoonlike, onderhandelings- en kommunikasievaardighede is noodsaaklik.
af.duties: Verseker die optimale voorsiening van beheer en bestuur van oordraagbare siektes in die Provinsie. Verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van strategiese en operasionele planne vir die Provinsie. Dien tydig weeklikse, maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae rakende programaktiwiteite in. Ontwikkel, onderhou en implementeer die strategieë en beleide in ooreenstemming met nasionale gesondheidsverwante wetgewing en raamwerke. Verskaf strategiese leierskap en Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en -ontwikkeling. Berei en onderhou die program se hulpbronne voor en vul in die gesondheids- en diensbehoeftes van die provinsie ooreenkomstig die toepaslike voorskrifte. Verteenwoordig die provinsie van die Department by toepaslike forums. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en implementering van die stelsel wat gemik is op die verbetering van dienslewering.

zu.title: Umlawuli: Ukulawula Izifo Ezithathelwanayo
zu.summary: Director: Communicable Diseases Control at the Mpumalanga Provincial Office, edinga iziqu zezeSayensi yezEmpilo kanye namava eminyakeni emihlanu yokuphatha kwezeMpilo yomphakathi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kweziqu zesiqu (NQF Level 7) ezifundweni ezeSayensi yezEmpilo njengoba kujatshulwe nguhlelo lweSAQA. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yamava kusekela ukuqashwa kwezinsiza zezeSempilo kolowo oqashwe ngokusebenza ehlezi esigabeni esiphakathi noma esiphezulu sokulawula kwayo. Isitifiketi sehlelo lokungenza ngaphambi kokuqala iNyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme. Ulwazi olujwayelekile kanye namava kulelinyazwe ngokubonelela ngezinsiza zezeSempilo kwiPrimary Health Care kanye nasezingeni lelisibhedlela ngaphakathi kohlelo lweDistrict Health System, ngokuhambisana nomthetho kanye namaphoyisa namalungelo ohlelo lwezenhlalo yomphakathi. Amava ekuphatheni izifo ezithuthuka futhi zibuyela emuva ezithathelwanayo, i-malaria kanye nezifo ezenzakaliswa ngamaxhyembe nezilwane ezingumthwalo. I-Master's degree kweziqu ezeSempilo izokuba ngokungezwa okubalulekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Amandla wokuqasha kanye nozwi oluqondile. Ukulawula imali; ukulawula uhlelo, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlolisisa. Ukulawula izinguquko, ukwenza izinqumo, ukulawula ukungezwani, ukukhuluma ngomlomo kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ukuphatha abantu, ukubuka kakhulu ngabathengi. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Umuntu ongahlelisiwe ngamakhono okulawula. Umuntu ohlakaniphileyo ocinga ngaphambilili; ukubika okunembile, amakhono obuhlobo, wokuxoxisana nokuxoxa noma yikuphi ukuthi kubalulekile.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukubonelela okulinganiselayo kokulawula kanye nokuphatatha izifo ezithathelwanayo eNdingisweni. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, kanye nokulawula izinhlelo zokuqasha kanye nezindlela zokusebenza eNdingisweni. Thumela ngemva kwesikhathi imibiko yamasonto, nyanga zonyaka, ihora ngesonto, kanye nemibiko yonyaka ngemayelana nemisebenzi yenhlekelele. Thuthukisa, igcine futhi ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela kanye nezinqubomgomo ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezeZempilo weSizwe kanye namakhiwizo. Hlinzeka ngebuqhongo bokuqasha kanye noLawulo kanye noTuthuko koBuntu. Lungiselela futhi ulondoloze izinsiza zenhlekelele futhi uhlangabezane nezidingo ezeZempilo kanye nesevisi esendingisweni ngokuhambisana nemiyalo ehlobene. Mele isifundazwe senhlanganiso emaphuzu aholayo. Siza ekuthuthukiseni nasemisebenzini yohlelo olubhekise ekwenzeni ukusebenza kwezinsiza.

xh.title: Umntu oPhethe iSebe: Ulawulo lwezifo eziqhathunyelwayo
xh.summary: Umntu oPhethe iSebe: Ulawulo lwezifo eziqhathunyelwayo kwiLisebe lePhondo laseMpumalanga, lifuna isidanga kwiZamagqirha ezibalulekileyo kubomi bemihla ngemihla kwaye nalamashumi eminyaka emihlanu yamava okulawula ezempilo kwabantu bonke.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwesidanga se-graduate (NQF Level 7) kwiZamagqirha ezibalulekileyo kubomi njengokoqatyiweyo yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane eminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kwiinkonzo zeZempilo kuBantu kwinqanaba eliphakathi / eliphezulu lolawulo. Isatifikethi seNyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme. Ulwazi oluchazwe ngokwenene namava ekunikweni kweenkonzo ezamagqirha kwinqanaba leNkonzo yeZempilo ekuqaleni nasekwizibhedlele ngaphakathi kweNkqubo yeZempilo yeBango, ngokwemigaqo-nkqubo, iinkqubo, neemimiselo ethintekayo ngaphakathi koMmandla kaRhulumente. Amava ekulawuleni izifo ezisavelayo, eziphinda zivele, umkhuhlane wesisu, nezeifo eziqhathunyelwa zizinambuzane. Isidanga se-Master's kwiZempilo kuBantu sibe ngongezo. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Iakhoni ezingakumbi ezibalulekileyo nokulawula abantu. Ulawulo lweMali; ulawulo lweenkcukacha, nokusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda iingxaki. Ulawulo lwezinto ezintsha, ukuthatha iigqibo, ukulawula iingxabano, ukuthetha nokubhala iingxelo. Ulawulo lwabantu, ukuzinikela kumthengi nokujongana nabo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Umntu onamandla ngeakhoni ezisezantsi zolawulo. Umntu oqonda ngaphambili; ukubika ngokusebenzayo, ukusebenzana nabantu, ukuthenga nokuthengiselana, nokuqonda ukuthetha kubalulekile.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngokuchanekileyo kolawulo nokulawulwa kwezifo eziqhathunyelwayo ePhondweni. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenza, nokuhlola iindaba ezibalulekileyo nezoqobo ezilungele iPhondo. Rhuma iingxelo ngeveki, nyanga zinye, kwindawo ethile yexesha, ngeveki yonyaka malunga nemisebenzi yenkqubo. Phuhlisa, zigcine uze uzisebenzise iindlela neenkqubo ngokwemigaqo-nkqabo yoLuntu malunga neeNkonzo zeZempilo nemiqathango. Boneleza ngokulawula iindaba ezingundoqo nokuLawula nokuPhuhlisa abantu. Lungiselela uze ulondoloze iindabo zenkqubo uze udibanise neemfuno zeZempilo ngeeNkonzo zephondo ngokwemiqathango ethintekayo. Mela iphondo leSebe kwindawo ethintekayo yoluntu. Yenza kube lula ukuphuhliswa nokusebenza kwenkqubo ehlose ukuphucula ukunikwa kweenkonzo.

jobs.title: Clinical Technologist Grade 1: Nephrology
jobs.summary: Clinical Technologist Grade 1 in Nephrology sought for Witbank Hospital to deliver renal dialysis care and patient education.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Clinical Technology. Current registration with the HPCSA as Clinical Technologist (2026). Basic life support (BLS). A minimum of two (2) years Dialysis experience will be an added advantage. Grade 1: SA qualified employees: none experience after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession (where applicable) in respect of employees who performed Community Service as required in SA. Foreign qualified employees: one (1) year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession (where applicable) in respect of employees who performed Community Service as required in SA. Knowledge and insight related to dialysis machines and reverse osmosis/water purification system. Knowledge of infection prevention and control (IPC) protocols. Basic computer literacy. Knowledge of relevant legislation and policy related to nephrology. Ability to function independently as well as part of a multidisciplinary team. Effective communication. Good organizational skill and ability to function under pressure. Must be prepared to work shifts, weekends and public holidays.
jobs.duties: Deliver safe, comprehensive and quality patient care, with specific reference to renal disease treatment and education according to the Scope of Practice and Renal Care policies and standard procedures. Demonstrate knowledge of Acute Dialysis and Chronic Dialysis Treatment. Clinical record keeping, procedures and protocols. Operate dialysis machine and water purification system. Identify, prevent and manage risks to ensure patient safety. Facilitate a positive patient experience by creating a conducive environment. Develop/modify an integrated, comprehensive patient based care plan. Conduct patient assessment and interpret of blood results.

af.title: Kliniese Tegnoloog Vlak 1: Nefrologie
af.summary: Kliniese Tegnoloog Vlak 1 in Nefrologie gesoek vir Witbank Hospital om nierdialise sorg en pasiëntvoorligting te lewer.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Kliniese Tegnologie toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Tegnoloog (2026). Basiese lewensondersteuning (BLS). 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar Dialise ervaring sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vlak 1: SA gekwalifiseerde werknemers: geen ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in die relevante beroep (waar van toepassing) met betrekking tot werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens soos in SA vereis verrig het. Buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers: een (1) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in die relevante beroep (waar van toepassing) met betrekking tot werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens soos in SA vereis verrig het. Kennis en insig rakende dialise masjiene en omgekeerde osmose/watersuiwerings stelsel. Kennis van infeksie voorkoming en beheer (IPC) protokolle. Basiese rekenaar geletterdheid. Kennis van relevante wetgewing en beleid rakende nefrologie. Vermoë om onafhanklik sowel as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer. Effektiewe kommunikasie. Goeie organisatoriese vaardigheid en vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer. Moet bereid wees om skofte, naweke en openbare vakansiedae te werk.
af.duties: Lewer veilige, omvattende en gehalte pasiëntesorg, met spesifieke verwysing na niere siektebehandeling en -voorligting ooreenkomstig die Werksomvang en Niersorgbeleid en standaardprosedures. Toon kennis van Akute Dialise en Chroniese Dialise Behandeling. Kliniese rekordhouding, prosedures en protokolle. Bedien dialise masjien en water suiwerings stelsel. Identifiseer, voorkom en bestuur risiko's om pasiëntveiligheid te verseker. Fasiliteer 'n positiewe pasiënt ervaring deur 'n gepaste omgewing te skep. Ontwikkel/wysig 'n geïntegreerde, omvattende pasiënt-gebaseerde sorgplan. Voer pasiënt beoordeling uit en interpreteer bloed resultate.

zu.title: Injini Yezobucwebe Yezokwelapha Ezingeni 1: I-Nephrology
zu.summary: Kufunwa Injini Yezobucwebe Yezokwelapha Ezingeni 1 ku-Nephrology e-Witbank Hospital ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwe-dialysis yezinso nokuqeqesha iziguli.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / I-Grade 12 kanye nesifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoba i-Health Professions Council of South Africa. Ukubhalisa okwamanje ne-HPCSA njenge-Clinical Technologist (2026). I-Basic life support (BLS). Ukuhlola okuncane kweminyaka emibili (2) kwe-Dialysis kuzoba yinzuzo. I-Grade 1: Abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe eNingizimu Afrika: akunaloluvo oludingekayo emva kokubhalisa ne-HPCSA esikhundleni esihlobene (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi abaye benza isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe koMhlaba jikelele: unyaka oyedwa (1) woluvo oluhlobene emva kokubhalisa ne-HPCSA esikhundleni esihlobene (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi abaye benza isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi nokuqonda okuhlobene namashini we-dialysis nesistimu ye-reverse osmosis/ukuhlanzwa kwamanzi. Ulwazi lwemithethonqondo yokuvikela ukutheleleka nokulawula (IPC). Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lwekhompyutha. Ulwazi lomthetho kanye nenqubomgomo ehlomene ne-nephrology. Ikono lokusebenza ngokuzimele kanye nokuba yingxenye yethimba elinguqukile. Unxibelelwano olusebenzayo. Ikono elihle lokuhlelela nokwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkinga. Kumeleubeulungele ukusebenza ngoshifti, nangamasonto futhi nangamaholide omphakathi.
zu.duties: Yinikeze iziguli inakekelo eliphephayo, elibandakanya konke futhi elikhulu, ngekugqama ekwelapheni izifo zezinso nasekuqeqeshzeni ngokwe-Scope of Practice kanye namapholisi we-Renal Care kanye nendlela ejwayelekile. Khombisa ulwazi lwe-Acute Dialysis nokwelaphwa kwe-Chronic Dialysis Treatment. Ukugcina irekhodi ezokwelapha, izinqubo kanye nemithethonqondo. Setha isistimu yokuhlanza amanzi neshini le-dialysis. Bona, vivikela uphathwe ngcono nangcono futhi ulawule nginga ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwesiguli. Yamukele futhi ulawule amanja abantu ngokuhambisa kakhulu ubuhle bokuba isiguli sibe nobuhle bokuhlola indawo efanele. Yakha/shintsha icebo lokunakekelwa okuyingqikithi, elibandakanya konke okusekelwe kusiguli. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwesiguli ize iqondo iziphetho zegazi.

xh.title: Umnelwazi wezonyobo weKliniki inqanaba 1: iNephrology
xh.summary: Kufunwa umnelwazi wezonyobo weKliniki inqanaba 1 kwiNephrology eWitbank Hospital ukuze anikeze ukhathalelo lwezinso kunye nemfundo yomntu ongumahlule.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior / Grade 12 kunye nempahlo efanelekileyo evumela ubhaliso ngoMphathiswa weZenzo zezeMpilo eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengoba kwiTeknoloji yamaKliniki. Ubhaliso lwangoku kwiHPCSA njengomnelwazi wezonyobo weKliniki (2026). Isixhaso esisisiseko sobomi (BLS). Iminyaka emibini (2) yamava kwiDialysis iya kuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Inqanaba 1: Abasebenzi abagqitywe eSA: akukho mva emva kobhaliso kwiHPCSA kwishishini elichanekileyo (apho kusebenza khona) kubasebenzi abenze iNkonzo yeQela njengoko kufunekwa eSA. Abasebenzi abagqitywe kwamanye amazwe: unyaka omnye (1) wamava achanekileyo emva kobhaliso kwiHPCSA kwishishini elichanekileyo (apho kusebenza khona) kubasebenzi abenze iNkonzo yeQela njengoko kufunekwa eSA. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngeendonco zedialysis kunye nendlela ye-osmosis ebuyiselwayo/nkqubo yokucoca amanzi. Ulwazi ngemiqathango yokuthintela kunye nokulawula iintsholongwane (IPC). Isikolo esisisiseko sekhompyutha. Ulwazi ngomthetho kunye namagqabantshintshi afanelekileyo anxulumene nenephrology. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nakwelinqa elisebenza ngokubambisana namanye amagqabantshintshi. Unxibelelwano olusebenzayo. Ikhono elihle lokulungiselela nethamsanqa lokusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo. Makabe alungile ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ishifthi, iiveki zokuphumla kunye namaholide aseburhulumenteni.
xh.duties: Ukunikeza ukhathalelo olukhuselekileyo, olubandakanya yonke into nolwenzayo kumntu ongumahlule, ngokuthe ngqo kwinkqubo yokwelapha izifo zeziwashu kunye nemfundo ngokweMmandla woBuchule kunye namagqabantshintshi eKathalelo leZinso nemiqathango eqhelekileyo. Ukubonisa ulwazi ngeDialysis eNgqamana kunye noKwelapha ngeDialysis eNgcangcazelayo. Ukugcina iirekhodi zeKliniki, iinkqubo kunye nemiqathango. Ukusebenzisa iindonco zedialysis kunye nenkqubo yokucoca amanzi. Ukuqonda, ukuthintela nokulawla iingozi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhuseleko lomntu ongumahlule. Ukwenza umntu ongumahlule abe nokuba namava amabalwa ngokudala indalo ekhululekileyo. Ukuqaqamba/hlengahlengisa inkqubo yokhathalelo olubambisanyo, olubandakanya yonke into olusekelwe kumntu ongumahlule. Ukuqokelela ulwazi ngomntu ongumahlule nokutolika iziphumo zegazi.

Ability to function independently and to prioritize work. Leadership and sound interpersonal skills, problem solving and decision-making skills.

Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards. Participate in the implementation of the National Core Standards and Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, including report writing when required. Work as part of the multi-disciplinary team to ensure quality nursing care. Work effectively, co-operatively amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Able to plan and organize own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient needs, requirements and expectations (Batho- Pele). Effectively manage resources allocated in your unit.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 (PN-A2): met Vroedkunde
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige met vroedkunde benodig by Sister Mashiteng CHC in Mpumalanga om kliniese verpleegsorg te verskaf in ooreenstemming met SANC-standaarde.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12-kwalifikasie of gelykwaardig plus basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Regeringskennisgewing R425 (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026) toelaat. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer 'n kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde. Neem deel aan die implementering van die National Core Standards en Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Demonstreer effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing waar nodig. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om gehalte-verpleegsorg te verseker. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vreedsaam met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid oor pasiënte, bevorder en pleit vir behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiëntbehoeftes, vereistes en verwagtings te reageer (Batho-Pele). Bestee hulpbronne wat aan u eenheid toegewys is doeltreffend.

zu.title: I-Professional Nurse Izinga 1 (PN-A2): one Nobugcotshwa bokunakekela abakhulelwe
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Professional Nurse enokunakekela abesifazane abakhulelwe esikhungweni se-Sister Mashiteng CHC esifundazweni saKwaMpumalanga ukuze inikeze unakekelo lwezokwelapha ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso ze-SANC.
zu.requirements: Ufakazi lwe-Senior Certificate / izinga le-Grade 12 noma okulingana nalo kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo okugunyaziwe yi-SANC ngokuka-Government Notice R425 (okungukuthi i-Diploma / i-Degree kwi-General Nursing) noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengo-Professional Nurse (2026). Ukukwazi ukusebenza kodwa nokubeka izinhloko zomsebenzi ngokwebalulele. Amandla okuba ngumbuyisi kanye namakhono okuxhumana kahle, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuthatha izinqumo.
zu.duties: Yenza umsebenzi wezokwelapha osemthethweni ngokuvumelana nomkhawulezomsebenzi nezindinganiso zokunakekela njengokuqinisekiswa isikhungo sezempilo. Khuthaza izinga eliphezulu elinobumnini lokunakekelwa kwabagula njengokuqondiswa umkhawulezo wemisebenzi kanye nezindinganiso ezisemthethweni. Thatha inhlalo ekusebenziseni Izindinganiso Eziyisisekelo Zwe lonke kanye Nohlelo Lokuqinisekiswa Isibhedlela Esiphelele. Khombisa ukuxhumana okunomsimamo nabagula, abaphathi kwanye nabanye oqeqeshiwe ekwelapheni okuhlanganisa nokubhala imibiko uma kudingeka. Sebenza njengenxenye yeqembu elihlangene njalo elinamagugu ahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa kwabagula. Sebenza ngempumelelo, ngokubambisana ngokuhlonipha labo abanobuhlakani,amasiko, isibala noma inkolo ehlukene. Kwazi ukuhlela futhi uhlele umsebenzi wakho kanye nabalawuleli abakusizayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa kwabagula okulungile. Khombisa ukukhathazeka ngabagula, ukukhuthaza futhi ukwesekela ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele okuhlanganisa nokuba nakwazi nokuthanda kokuwabela izidingo, izinhlobo nemibuzo yabagula (Batho-Pele). Lawula ngempumelelo izinsiza ezinikezwe kuleso sikhungo sethu.

xh.title: UNgesikazi weKhilikha Isidanga 1 (PN-A2): oneZizo lokuzisa abantwana
xh.summary: Kufuneka uNgesikazi weKhilikha ongumnuzi wokuzisa abantwana kwiSisters Mashiteng eMpumalanga ukubonelela ngokunyanga ngokwekhlinikali ngokwemigangatho yeSANC.
xh.requirements: Iqela elikhulu leSithili / Isidanga se-12 okanye esilinganayo ngakumbi nokuqinisekiswa okusesikweni ngokwesiGqibo sikaRhulumde isiLumkiso noR425 (okt. idiploma / idigri ekunyangeni jikelele) okanye isigqibo esilinganayo esinika ukubhaliswa ngokweNtlangano yeSANC njengomnyuzi weKhilikha (2026). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokuzimela nokubeka kuqala umsebenzi. Amakhono okukhokela kwaye nokuqonda kwelinye elinye, amakhono okulawula iingxaki kwaye nokuqumisa iigqibo.
xh.duties: Qhuba umsebenzi wekhlinikali wokunyanga ngokwemigaqo yomsebenzi nemigangatho yokunyanga njengoko kumiswe sisisilo sempilo. Khuthaza umgangatho wokunyanga njengoko kuchazwe ngumda wabaphathi bomsebenzi nemigangatho. Thatha inxaxheba kwentlbelebono kwiSangqa lesiZwe ngokweNgqungqutha eBalulekileyo nesiNgengixo sokuPhumeza iSpezhi eNgcwele. Bonisa ukunyaniseka kwentetho kunye nabadanisiweyo, abaphathi abaphezulu nabananye baphathi begorofa, kuquka nokuvela iingxelo xa kufuneka. Sebenza njengelinye iqela labasebenzi abanemimimangaliselo ehlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe umgangatho wokunyanga. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokwethu kwaye ngokwamablethe nabantu abahlukeneyo ngengqondo, isiko, uhlanga okanye inkolo. Wazi ukuqamba uhlelo loyilo lomsebenzi wakho nalawo abasebenzelayo ukumanya abakhokeleleyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyanga okulungileyo. Khombisa ukukhathalela abadanisiweyo, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela ukunyanga okulungileyo nokulungiselela okuquka nokuqonda nokulungele ukuphendula iimfuno, iimfuno nentembiso zabadanisiweyo (Batho-Pele). Lawula ngokusebenzayo izixhobo ezinikiweyo kwisebe lakho.

jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 qualification or equivalent plus Basic qualification accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice R425 (i.e. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse (2026). Ability to function independently and to prioritize work. Leadership and sound interpersonal skills, problem solving and decision-making skills.
jobs.duties: Perform a clinical nursing practice in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determined by the health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards. Participate in the implementation of the National Core Standards and Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, including report writing when required. Work as part of the multi-disciplinary team to ensure quality nursing care. Work effectively, co-operatively amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Able to plan and organize own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient needs, requirements and expectations (Batho- Pele). Effectively manage resources allocated in your unit.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 (PN-A2): met Vroedkunde
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 met Vroedkunde gesoek by Mmametlhake Hospital in Mpumalanga om kliniese verpleegsorg binne die SANC se omvang van praktyk te verskaf.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12-kwalifikasie of gelykwaardig, plus basiskwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Regeringskennisgewing R425 (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026) toelaat. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap- en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing- en besluitnemingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder kwaliteit van verpleegsorg soos bepaal deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde. Neem deel aan die implementering van die Nasionale Kerstandaarde en Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend die skryf van verslae wanneer vereis. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om kwaliteitsverpleegsorg te verseker. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vreedsaam met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en beyder behoorlike behandeling en sorg, insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om pasiëntebehoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge (Batho-Pele) na te kom. Bestuur hulpbronne wat aan u eenheid toegewys is, effektief.

zu.title: UesiBhedlela Ochwepheshe Beshibhili Elinga 1 (PN-A2): Nobuhlengikazi
zu.summary: Kufunwa uNesi Ochwepheshe Beshibhili Elinga 1 Nobuhlengikazi eMmametlhake Hospital eMpumalanga ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha ngaphakathi kwesigaba somsebenzi we-SANC.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketu Samalinga / Isitifiketu Sezinga 12 noma okulinganayo kanye nesifundo esisisekelo esamukelekwe yi-SANC ngokusho kweGazette Kahulumeni R425 (okungukuthi iDiploma / i-Digri eNokunakekelwa Okujwayelekile) noma isifundo okulinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengenesi Yeshibhili (2026). Isikhono sokusebenza kodwa nokubeka izinto ezibalulekile phambili ekwenzeni umsebenzi. Izikhono sokuhola nokuhlobana kahle nabantu, izikhono zokuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo.
zu.duties: Yenza isenzo sokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha ngokuvumelana nesigaba somsebenzi namazinga okunakekelwa njengokuqunywe isikhungo sezempilo. Khuthaza izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa njengokuqondiswa isigaba somsebenzi somuntu ochwepheshe namazinga. Thatha inxaxheba ekusetshenzweni kwezindinganiso Zomhlaba Jikelele neNqubo Yokuqinisekisa Izigodlo Ezingcono. Khombisa ukuxhumana kahle nabagulayo, abaphathi nabanye ochwepheshe bezokwelapha, okuhlanganise nokubhala imibiko lapho kudingeka khona. Sebenza njengenxenye yeqembu elinochwepheshe abahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okulinga eliphezulu. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokubambisana ngomoya omuhle nabantu abahlukene ngobuchopho, ngenhlalo, ngobuhlobo noma ngokholo. Ukwazi ukuhlela futhi ulungiselele umsebenzi wakho nowabasebenzi abasize ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okulungile. Khombisa ukunakwa abagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokweseka ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okulungile okuhlanganise nokuba uyakwazi futhi ulungele ukuphendula izidingo, izifiso nethemba labagulayo (Batho-Pele). Phatha ngokusebenzayo izinsiza ezabelwe kwindawo yakho yokusebenza.

xh.title: Umongikazi ongumzekelisi weNqanaba 1 (PN-A2): onesiqu sokunika abantu abayinkwenkwezi
xh.summary: Kufunwa umongikazi ongumzekelisi weNqanaba 1 onesiqu sokunika abantu abayinkwenkwezi eMmametlhake Hospital eMpumalanga ukunika unyango lwekliniki lwamangcwaba ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yokusebenza yeSANC.
xh.requirements: Izatifikethi eziphezulu / Isidanga se-12 okanye esinjalo ngokulingana kunye nesiqu esisisiseko esamkelwe yiSANC ngokomyalo kaRhulumente othi R425 (okt. Idiploma / Isidanga kwiiNkwenkwezi eZiqhelekileyo) okwesiqu esinjalo ngokulingana esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomongikazi ongumzekelisi (2026). Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nokuqamba ngokutsha ukulungiselela umsebenzi. Amandla okukhokela namakhono amabalwa ngabantu, ukusombulula iingxaki kunye namakhono okwenza izigqibo.
xh.duties: Yenza inkqubo yokunyanga amangcwaba ngokwemigaqo yokusebenza neemigangatho yamangcwaba njengoko iqheliswe sisikhululo sempilo. Khuthaza ngangokusemandleni inani lonyango lwamangcwaba njengoko kukhokelelwa lingakanani elisebenzayo lemigaqo nokumgangatho. Thatha inxaxheba ekusebenziseni iimigangatho eYeyona yoLwazi eQinisekisiweyo neNkqubo yokuzinika iSidanga seSibhedlele esinako ukufezekiswa. Bonisa ukunxibelelana okusebenzayo nabaguli, abalawuli nakwezinye iingcali zekliniki, kuquka nokubhala iingxelo xa kufuneka. Sebenza njengenxalenye yeqela labantu abanemimandla emininji ukuze kuqinisekiswe inani lonyango lwamangcwaba. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokuthanda ukubambisana ngokuzolileyo nabantu abahlukene ngokwengqondo, basekwinzuvi, nasemvelweni okanye inkolo. Yiba nakho ukucwangcisa nokuqamba ngokutsha umsebenzi wakho nawo abasekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe onyango oluchanekileyo lwamangcwaba. Bonisa inkathazo ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela onyango oluchanekileyo nonyango kuquka nokuba sengqondweni nomthamo wokuphendula iimfuno, iimfuno nolindelelwano abaguli (Batho- Pele). Lawula ngokusebenzayo amacebo awabeliweyo kwicandelo lakho.

jobs.department: Department of Environmental Affairs and Development Planning
jobs.centre: Department of Environmental Affairs and Development Planning, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R636 978 - R728 646 per annum, (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Control Environmental Officer focusing on climate change response strategy for the Western Cape Government, requiring a relevant degree and six years of experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 4-year Degree (or equivalent qualification) in Social, Natural, Physical, Environmental Sciences or relevant Engineering qualification; A minimum of 6 years relevant post-qualification experience; A valid (Code B or higher) driving licence. NB: People with disabilities that restrict driving abilities, but who have reasonable access to transport, may also apply. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: The development and/or the implementation of climate change adaptation related policies, legislation, strategies, action plans, guidelines and environmental norms and standards; Mainstreaming and capacity building climate change programmes across multiple sectors; Development and rollout of financing and funding models. Skills needed: Written and verbal communication; Proven computer literacy; Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: Contribute to the review and update of the Western Cape Climate Change Response Strategy and Implementation Plan and monitor, assess, drive and report on climate change response implementation in the Western Cape; Guide, coordinate and position adaptation response actions through mainstreaming the Western Cape Climate Change Response Strategy and implementation plan across provincial sectors and into local provincial level initiatives, policies, strategies and plans where applicable as well as associated monitoring, evaluation and reporting; Develop, drive and support the implementation of a climate change adaptation pathway for the province that is aligned with the Western Cape Climate Change Response Strategy and that is pro-poor, inclusive and just; Conduct research as required such as climate change adaptation strategies, risk and vulnerability assessments, monitoring and evaluation, climate budget tagging, etc; Undertake presentations, capacity building sessions and workshops on climate change to local government, business, civil society and other stakeholders; Coordinate and participate in international climate change adaptation platforms and compile adaptation focused climate change funding applications, particularly large international funding opportunities; Project, Human Resources and Financial Management.
jobs.enquiries: Ms G Isaacs Tel No: (021) 483 2775

af.title: Beheer-omgewingsbeampte: Klimaatsverandering
af.summary: Beheer-omgewingsbeampte met fokus op die klimaatsverandering-reaksiestrategie vir die Western Cape Government, wat 'n relevante graad en ses jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Gesikte 4-jarige Graad (of ekwivalente kwalifikasie) in Sosiale, Natuurlike, Fisiese, Omgewingswetenskappe of 'n relevante Ingenieurskwalifikasie; 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se relevante post-kwalifikasie-ervaring; 'n Geldige (Kode B of hoër) bestuurslisensie. NB: Mense met gestremdhede wat bestuursvermoëns beperk, maar wat redelike toegang tot vervoer het, mag ook aansoek doen. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Die ontwikkeling en/of die implementering van klimaatsverandering-aanpassing verwante beleide, wetgewing, strategieë, aksieplanne, riglyne en omgewingsnorme en -standaarde; Hoofstrooming en kapasiteitsopbouing van klimaatsverandering-programme oor veelvuldige sektore; Ontwikkeling en uitrol van befondsings- en subsidiemodelle. Vaardighede benodig: Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Bewese rekenaargeletterdheid; Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Dra by tot die hersiening en opdatering van die Western Cape Climate Change Response Strategy and Implementation Plan en monitor, assesseer, dryf en rapporteer oor die implementering van die klimaatsverandering-reaksie in die Western Cape; Lei, koördineer en posisioneer aanpassings-reaksie-aksies deur die hoofstrooming van die Western Cape Climate Change Response Strategy en implementeringsplan oor provinsiale sektore en in plaaslike provinsiale vlak-inisiatiewe, beleide, strategieë en planne waar van toepassing, asook gepaardgaande monitering, evaluerings en verslagdoening; Ontwikkel, dryf en ondersteun die implementering van 'n klimaatsverandering-aanpassingsroete vir die provinsie wat in lyn is met die Western Cape Climate Change Response Strategy en wat pro-arm, inklusief en regverdig is; Voer navorsing uit soos benodig, soos klimaatsverandering-aanpassingstrategieë, risiko- en kwesbaarheidsassesserings, monitering en evaluering, klimaatsbegrotingsmerking, ens; Onderneem aanbiedings, kapasiteitsopbousessies en werkswinkels oor klimaatsverandering aan plaaslike regering, besigheid, burgerlike samelewing en ander belanghebbendes; Koördineer en neem deel aan internasionale klimaatsverandering-aanpassingsplatforms en stel aanpassinggefokusde klimaatsverandering-befondsingsaansoeke op, veral groot internasionale befondsingsgeleenthede; Projek-, Menslike Hulpbron- en Finansiële Bestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezomondo: Ukushintshwa Kwesimo Sezulu
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezomondo egxile kwinqubo yokusebenzela ukushintshwa kwesimo sezulu kahulumeni wase Western Cape, ofuna iziqu ezifanelekile neminyaka eyisithupha yeminyaka yokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile zonyaka we-4 (noma iziqu ezingalinganayo) kwezomphakathi, iziqu zemvelo, iziqu ezibandakanya ubuchwepheshe bemvelo noma iziqu ezifanelekile ze-Engineering; Okuncane iminyaka engu-6 yamava okusebenza okuhambisana neziqu okushiwo ngemuva kokuthola iziqu; Ilayisense yokushayela (Code B noma iphakeme) elisebenzayo. NB: Abantu abasikhohlweni sokuhamba abasivimbeli ukushayela, kodwa abanokufinyelela kalula ezokuthutha, bangafaka futhi isicelo. Amandla: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Ukuthuthukiswa kanye/noma ukuqashelwa kwezinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokuzivikela ekushintshweni kwesimo sezulu, umthetho, izinqubomgomo, amaphulani okusebenza, imihlahlandlela namazinga omphakathi nezindinganiso zemvelo; Ukufaka ezinkundleni futhi kwakhe amandla ohlelo lokushintshwa kwesimo sezulu kuzigaba ezahlukene; Ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusakazwa kwezindlela zokuxhaswa ngemali. Amandla adingekayo: Unxibelelwano olubhalwayo nolwenyathelomlomo; Ukubhaliseka kakhulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha; Ikono lokusebenza eyedwa nangaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Nikela ekubukeni futhi kubuyekezeni i-Western Cape Climate Change Response Strategy ne-Implementation Plan bese uphehlelela, ehola, uphusha ubuchwepheshe futhi abike ngokuqashelwa kwesimo sezulu e-Western Cape; Hola, hlanganisa futhi ubeke izinyathelo zokuzivikela ngokufaka i-Western Cape Climate Change Response Strategy nophulani wokuqashelwa kuzigaba zesifundazwe nasemigangathweni yezinyanga nezindawo yesifundazwe, izinqubomgomo, izinqubomgomo namaphulani lapho kufanele khona kanye nokuqashelwa okuhambisanayo, ukuhlolwa kanye nobunikelo; Thuthukisa, yensa futhi uxhase ukuqashelwa kwenqubo yokuzivikela ekushintshweni kwesimo sezulu yesifundazwe ehambisana ne-Western Cape Climate Change Response Strategy futhi engabasizi abampofu, ehlanganayo futhi ilungile; Yenza ucwaningo njengoba kudingeka njengakuzinqubomgomo zokuzivikela ekushintshweni kwesimo sezulu, ukuhlolwa kwezingozi nokupezula, ukuqashelwa nokuhlolwa, ukuqashwa kwebhajethi yisimo sezulu, njll; Yenza izinkulumo, amaseshi okwakha amandla namagejasimu ngesimo sezulu kahulumeni waseduze, amabhizinisi, impilo yenani labantu kanye nabanye abahlanganyelayo; Hlanganisa futhi uthathe inhlangothi ezinkundleni zamazwe ngamazwe zokuzivikela ekushintshweni kwesimo sezulu bese uhlanganisa izicelo zokuxhaswa ngemali zesimo sezulu eziqagelwe ukuzivikela, ikakhulukazi ithuba elikhulu lexhaso lamazwe ngamazwe; Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi, Abasebenzi kanye Nemali.

xh.summary: ISikhululi SoMmandla WezIkompwutha: Ionotshala YeemFundo ZeNdalo egqithisela kumgaqo-siseko wokuphendula kw i-climate change ukwenzela urhulumente we Western Cape, kufuneka kubekho iziqu ezahambelanayo neminyaka emithandathu yamava.

NB: Abantu abakhubekileyo ekubeni bakwazi ukuqhuba, kodwa banokufikelela kalula kwiith lekiesi, banako nakwo ukwenza isicelo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngaloku kulandelayo: Ukuphuhliswa nokusebenzisa iindlela zokuzinikela kumgaqo-siseko wezopolitiko, izayithi, amacebo, iiplani zokusebenza, iingqiqo kunye nemilinganiselo yezinto zendalo; Ukuzinza kumazinga amaninzi kumacandwo ngokuphuhliswa kwamacebo okuzinza koluguquko lwezimo; Ukuphuhliswa nokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokufutha nemodeli zemali. Ikhono efunekayo: Unxibelelwano ngokubhaliweyo nangokuthethwa; Ulwazi oluchaziweyo lwekhompyutha; Ikhono lokusebenza ngodwa nangaphezu kwesithandathu kwethu.
xh.duties: Nika isandla ekuphendulweni nokuhlaziyweni komgaqo-siseko wokuzinza koluguquko lwe Western Cape kunye nePlani yokusebenza kwaye ulawule, uqhonge, uqhubise uphinde uchaze ngokuphendula koluguquko lwe Western Cape; Qonda, qhoboshisa uphinde umise iindlela zokuzinza ngokufaka umgaqo-siseko wokuzinza koluguquko lwe Western Cape kunye nePlani yokusebenza kwamasebe ephondo nakumathuba okuzenzekela ephondo, iindlela, amacebo neeplana apho kufuneka kwaye njalo ulawule, uhlasele uphinde uchaze; Phuhlisa, qhubisa uphude unike isandla ukusebenzisa iNdlela yokuzinza koluguquko lweephondo ehambelana nomgaqo-siseko wokuzinza koluguquko lwe Western Cape ephezu kokuva kangakanani na, kubandakanya bonke abantu kwaye ilungelelaniswe ngokulunga; Yenza uphando njengoko kufuneka njengamacebo okuzinza koluguquko, ukupima iingozi nokungathathi hlangothi, ukulawula nokuhlolwa, ukuphawula imali yamaphondo, njalo njalo; Yeza iinton导, iinton导 zokwakha amandla iworkshops ezimbalwa koluguquko kuluntu, kumashishini, kuluntu jikelele nakwezinye iindwendwe; Qhoboshisa uphinde ungene kumazwe ngamazwe kwezinto zokuzinza koluguquko uphinde ulungise izicelo zemali ezikwicala lokuzinza koluguquko, ngokukodwa amathuba mahle e-International funding; Ukulawulwa kweProject, i-Human Resources yaye imali.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (RADIOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs). (It will be expected of the successful candidate to participate in a system of remunerated commuted overtime).
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Radiology sought for New Somerset Hospital, Western Cape, to provide clinical services including CT scanning and X-ray reporting.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Specialist in Radiology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Radiology. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Radiology. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Radiology. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Radiology. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Willingness and ability to travel within the Metro. Willingness to participate in the commuted overtime system within the Metro Health Services. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to oversee and report on radiological procedures, primarily CT-scanning services at a Regional Hospital. Appropriate experience in teaching, training and supervision of medical staff Work with a team of hospital clinicians to optimise use of CT- scanning facilities. Knowledge and understanding of relevant legislation, hospital procedures and policies. Good computer literacy skills in the MS Office package.
jobs.duties: Clinical service provision, primarily manage, administer and co-ordinate the implementation of a comprehensive CT scanning service. X-ray reporting, provide statistics and strategic planning and assistance for ultra-sound services. Ensure the maintenance of quality care standards in the radiology services together with Chief Radiographer and Clinical Manager. Guide staff, teaching, training and supervision of staff. To support the Metro West platform as required. Efficient use of resources, manage assets, consumables, and services effectively.
jobs.enquiries: Dr J Hendricks Tel No: (021) 402-6479.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Mediese Spesialis Vlak 1 tot 3 (RADIOLOGIE)
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Radiologie gesoek vir New Somerset Hospital, Western Cape, om kliniese dienste te verskaf insluitend CT-skandering en X-straalverslaggewing.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Spesialis in Radiologie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Radiologie. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Radiologie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Radiologie. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Radiologie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid en vermoë om binne die Metro te reis. Bereidwilligheid om aan die pendel-oortydstelsel binne die Metro Gesondheidsdienste deel te neem. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om radiologiese prosedures toesig te hou en daaroor verslag te doen, hoofsaaklik CT-skanderingsdienste by 'n Streeks hospitaal. Toepaslike ervaring in onderrig, opleiding en toesig van mediese personeel. Werk saam met 'n span hospitaalklinici om gebruik van CT-skanderingsfasiliteite te optimaliseer. Kennis en begrip van toepaslike wetgewing, hospitaalprosedures en beleide. Goeie rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede in die MS Office-pakket.
af.duties: Kliniese dienslewering, hoofsaaklik die bestuur, administrasie en koördinering van die implementering van 'n omvattende CT-skanderingdiens. X-straalverslaggewing, voorsiening van statistieke en strategiese beplanning en bystand vir ultraklankdienste. Verseker die handhawing van gehalte-sorgstandaarde in die radiologiedienste tesame met die Hoofradiograaf en Kliniese Bestuurder. Begelei personeel, onderrig, opleiding en toesig van personeel. Ondersteun die Metro West-platform soos vereis. Doeltreffende gebruik van hulpbronne, bestuur bates, verbruiksgoedere en dienste doeltreffend.

zu.title: Ithuluzi Lezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 (RADIOLOGY)
zu.summary: Kufunwa Ithuluzi Lezokwelapha kwelobu Radiology elibekwe e-New Somerset Hospital, Western Cape, ukunikeza izinsiza zezokwelapha kuhlanganisa nokuskena i-CT nokubika ngama-X-ray.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane semfundo: Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoba Ithuluzi Lezokwelapha ku-Radiology. Ukubhalisa komkhandlu wezobungcweti: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoba Ithuluzi Lezokwelapha ku-Radiology. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okuceliwe emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoba Ithuluzi Lezokwelapha ku-Radiology. Izinga 2: Okuncane iminyaka emi-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoba Ithuluzi Lezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma kwi-foreign Health Professional Council ebonwayo ngokomsebenzisi oqeqeshiwe kwelinye ilizwe) njengoba Ithuluzi Lezokwelapha ku-Radiology. Izinga 3: Okuncane iminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoba Ithuluzi Lezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma kwi-foreign Health Professional Council ebonwayo ngokumsebenzisi oqeqeshiwe kwelinye ilizwe) njengoba Ithuluzi Lezokwelapha ku-Radiology. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esevisayo. Ukuzithoba nendlela yokuhamba ngaphakathi kwe-Metro. Ukuzithoba ukuthatha inxaxheba kwisimiso se-commuted overtime ngaphakathi kwezinsiza Zezempilo ze-Metro. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhali): Ikhono lokubuka nasokubeka ngemisebenzi ye-radiological, ikakhulukazi izinsiza zokuskena i-CT esibhedlela se-Regional Hospital. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekufundiseni, ukuqeqesha kanye nokuhlola abasebenzi bezokwelapha. jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 in Surgery at Mitchells Plain District Hospital, providing clinical management of surgical and trauma emergencies plus supervision of interns.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate experience and skills in surgical care to manage a ward, theatre and outpatients at a large district level hospital. Ability to work in a team and all levels of staff. Must be able to perform amputations and minor surgical procedures safely and without surgical supervision. Candidates must be able to perform basic diagnostic upper endoscopy.
jobs.duties: Clinical management of all acute and non-acute surgical and trauma emergencies at a busy district level hospital. Management of critically ill patients including resuscitation of patients while awaiting transfer to tertiary level care. Supervision and teaching of students and interns. Provide a proficient administrative service regarding all clinical and non-clinical matters and medicolegal work. Provide guidance and leadership towards strategic goals and objectives of the department. Ensure cost efficient service at clinical level with regards to laboratory services, blood, medicines, consumables and equipment.
jobs.enquiries: Dr F Gool Tel No: (021) 377-4382
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).

It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie vereis word om Community Service soos in Suid-Afrika vereis uit te voer nie. Verskaf 'n bekwame administratiewe diens ten opsigte van alle kliniese en nie-kliniese aangeleenthede en medieseregte werk. Verskaf leiding en leierskap in die rigting van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke van die departement. Verseker kostedoeltreffende diens op kliniese vlak met betrekking tot laboratoriumdienste, bloed, medisyne, verbruiksbare items en toerusting.

zu.title: Dokotela Wezezifo Ezingozini izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (UBUGONYA)
zu.summary: uDokotela Wezezifo Ezingozini izinga 1 kuya ku-3 ebugonyeni esibhedlela sasedolobheni i-Mitchells Plain District Hospital, ehlinzeka ngokolawulo lwezokwelapha kokuphela kwezimo eziphuthumayo zokugonywa nokulimala ngokuyiqhayiza kanye nokuqapha abafundi abangathathi iziqu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela wezezifo ezingozini. Ukubhalisa kubungqangi bomsebenzi: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela wezezifo ezingozini. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqanjwa igama lakho njengodokotela wezezifo ezingozini ku-HPCSA maqondana nabanikazi bazo abakule-Rhawudi yaseNingizimu Afrika abanamaphuzu ababhadele; unyaka we-1 wokuthola isipiliyoni ohlelweni oluhle ekulawulweni kobugonya emva kokubhalisa njengodokotela wezezifo ezingozini emkhandlwini wamazwe ngamazwe ongaziwa ngabaphathi bezempilo ohlinzeka ngamandla nokutolakwa emsebenzini ohlezi kakhulu wokusiza abafundi bezezela empumalanga eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu abanikelwa isikhathi esingathintwa emhlabeni jikelele abakhiqizayo. Izinga 2: Kudingeka izinga lokuziqhenya okuqinisekile, unyaka we-1 wokubhalisa kwamanye amaphuzu ohlelweni lwezigigaba zemfundo anamandla kuhlelo lwezokwaziswa kwabantu abangalungile, kanye nokuvela kabanikazi bemizwakala eqinileyo ukuze bakhombise isipiliyoni esihle ngomsebenzi wokugonya abanye i-Ningizimu Afrika ngaphandle kokuba kudingeka abenze inkonzo yokukhululeka ekuthunyelweni. Izinga 3: Amaphuzu asemthethweni waseNingizimu Afrika: Isipiliyoni esincane esifanele iminyaka eyi-5 njengodokotela wezezifo ezingozini emva kobhalisa njengodokotela wezezifo ezingozini ku-HPCSA, okusetshenziswa kabanikazi bazo abakule-Rhawudi yaseNingizimu Afrika abanamaphuzu ababhadele. Amaphuzu angu-6 kuphela ezinhlobonhlobo zezezela eziphuma ngokukhululeka emsebenzini wolawulo lwemfundo, nakumaNingizimu Afrika apho ukubhalisa kwamanye amaphuzu ohlelweni lwezigigaba zemfundo kusadingeka kabanikazi bemizwakala eqinileyo bengenankinga yokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika ekwenzelwa abantu abamnyama. Iziqu ezidingekayo (ulwazi/izikhombi): Isipiliyoni esifanele kanye namandla ekunakekelwa amagula angaphela, ukuphathwa kwesibhedlela, i-theatre kanye nabagula abangangeni esibhedlela kuleso sibhedlela sikhulu sedolobha; amandla okusebenza eqembini nakumazinga onke abasebenzi; kubalulekile ukuba nokwazi ukwenza ukususwa kwezithako zezinwele nemisebenzi yokugonya ezenza inkinga noma kanzima ngaphandle kokubonisana nodokotela ohlinzayo. Kudingeka abasebenzi bakwazi ukwenza ukuvavanywa okuyisisekelo kwabagula ngokuqhubeka nokulinga izifo ezithile.
zu.duties: Ukulawula ngokwelapha zonke izimo eziphuthumayo ezingozinhle kanye nezezenzo ezingezona eziphuthumayo zokulimala ezibangelwa izifo ezinkulu kumaspala omkhulu wezesibhedlela; ukulawula abagula abakhulu ngokukhathazeka, okuhlanganisa nokuvuselela okuphila kwabagula abalindele ukuthunyelwa kumazinga aphakeme okwelashwa. Ukuphatha nokufundisa abafundi kanye nabalawuli bokulawula ukulawulwa kwezincwadi ngokushesha ngokwenza imisebenzi ebanzi. Ukuthi, ngokushesha, ube ngumuntu ongaphakathi kwabaholi ekulawulweni okuqhubekayo nokuhlinzekwa ngemibhalo yezokwelashwa engahambisani nalawo asemthethweni. Ukubanikeza isiqondiso nokuqondisa ngokuya emigomeni nasezinjweni zenhloko yomnyango ekugcobeni izigqibo nasekuletheni imikhakha ekugqamisa imithetho ekusebenzeni komnyango. Ukwenza isiqiniseko sokulawula imisebenzi ngesibalo esibizayo ngokusebenzisa imikhando, izindleko zamagazi, imithi, izinto okusetshenziswa kanye nezokutholakala kumazinga okusebenza ezokwelashwa kumazwe ngamunye.

Isiseko seeminyaka eli-6 esipilingo esifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezempilo kwiKhansile yamaphrofeshinali yamanye amazange ebonwayo malunga nabasebenzi abagqitywe kwamanye amazanga, abangafunelwanga ukwenza Inkonzo yomthonyama njengoko kufunekile eNingizimu Afrika. Isidanga 3: Isiseko seeminyaka eli-10 esipilingo esifanelekileyo njengogqirha wezempilo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengogqirha wezempilo malunga nabasebenzi abagqitywe eNingizimu Afrika. Isiseko seeminyaka eli-11 esipilingo esifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezempilo kwiKhansile yamaphrofeshinali yamanye amazange ebonwayo malunga nabasebenzi abagqitywe kwamanye amazanga, abangafunelwanga ukwenza Inkonzo yomthonyama njengoko kufunekile eNingizimu Afrika. Ikhompthensi (ulwazi/ikakhono): Isipilingo esifanelekileyo namakhono ekunakekelwa kokudumba ukulawula igumbi lwegazi, indlu yokugudlula ioparatho nabaguli abangangeni esibhedlele kwisibhedlele esikhulu esizingatyi lena. Amandla okusebenza kwiqela nakuzo zonke iinqaba zabasebenzi. Kufuneka ukwazi ukuwenza amputation namanyuzo okudumba angoakhokelelowa lula ngaphandle kokugqiba kwabagqibi bokudumba. Abagqibi kufuneka bakhobe ukwenza isifo sokuphonononga i-endoscopy ephezulu esisisiseko.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ngokweklinikhi zonke iimeko ezibuthathaka kwaye ezingabuthathaka zokudumba nezehloko esibhedlele esinobunyulu esizingatyi lena. Ukulawula abaguli ababuhlungu kakhulu kubandakanya ukuvusa kabusha abaguli bekulindele ukudluliselwa kwinkonzo ezingatyi le-tertiary. Ukugcina amakhoswe kunye nokufundisa abafundi nabagcinwa nkathazo. Ukubonelela ngkonzo ekuphathweni ebenelweyo ngokwazo zonke izinto ezinxulumene neklinikhi ezingekho yeklinikhi nemisebenzi evunyiswa ngomthetho wokwelapha. Ukunika inkqubela kunye nobukhosi malunga neenjongo nokujongana nemigqabantshintshi yesebe. Ukuqinisekisa inkonzo eguqukayo ngexabiso kwinqanaba leklinikhi ngeenkonzo zohlelo lokuhlolwa, igazi, imithi, izinto ezisetyenziswa kanye nezixhobo.

Grade B: At least 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration as a Professional Engineer. Grade C: At least 26 years appropriate/recognisable after registration as a Professional Engineer. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver's licence. Willingness to travel within the Western Cape, and occasionally, nationally. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy (MS Office). Appropriate experience in and understanding the design and construction of complex buildings and associated civil and/or structural infrastructure. Proven experience with feasibility studies in terms of life cycle costing of civil and/or structural engineering elements, green building technologies, technical specifications and commissioning principles for both Capital and Maintenance projects. Understand how to interpret existing and develop new Functional and Technical Norms and Standards. Knowledge of risk analysis and risk mitigation strategies. Experience in the preparation of reports, submissions and presentations in English and sound interpersonal and good verbal and written communication skills.

Investigate proposals for innovative service delivery mechanisms and undertake feasibility studies. Compile briefing documentation and specifications. Investigate civil and/or structural engineering installations, undertake design work and implement corrective measures, where necessary. Oversee implementation (design and construction) and commissioning of civil and/or structural engineering installations. Assist in site investigations and preparation of User Asset Management Plans. Research/literature studies to keep up with new technologies and procedures including interaction with professional Councils/Boards.

Amava abonakalayo ngemizamo yokwenziswa yamaholo ebangapi yobuciko be-civil and/or structural engineering, izobuchwepheshebe ezinsimbi eziluhlaza, izinkomba zobuchwepheshe kanye imigomo yokubhalisa kokubili kokuxhasa kwezimali nokulondolozwa ngemigwaqo yokuqale nokugcina. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kolwazi olukhona lwezokuthuthukiswa kwemigomo nobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqamba kwabasha. Ulwazi ngokuhlolwa kokubeka ezindangeri kanye nezinyathelo zokusiza kwezokuphepha. Amava ekulungiseleleni imibhalo, izibambo, kanye nezinkulumo ngolimi lwesiNgisi kanye nokuba nengaphandle kobuntu okuhle, ikhono lokubhala nokuqamba emlonyeni nangokubhala.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa, ukuchaza nokwenza ngokwezidingo izimagama ezisebenzayo nezobuchwepheshe kanye nemigomo. Ukuphenya iziphakamiso mayelana nezindlela ezintsha zokuletha izinsiza futhi kwenziwe izifundo zokubuka ukuzothelekisa. Ukuqoqa umbhalo wokweluleka kanye nezinkomba zobuchwepheshe. Ukuphenya ukufakwa kwemisebenzi yenqubo yobuchwepheshe yasekhaya nokwesakhiwo, ukwenza umsebenzi wokwakha futhi kusetshenziswe izinyathelo zokulungisa, lapho kudingeka khona. Ukubhekisisa ukuphathwa kwayo (ukwakhiwa nokwakhiwa) nokutholakala okusebenzayo kwezifakelo zenzinbobu yasekhaya nakwesakhiwo. Ukusiza ekuphenyeni izindawo kanye nokuqoqa ama-User Asset Management Plan. Ukuphenya izifundo/izincwadi ukuze ughubeke nezobuchwepheshe obusha kanye nendlela, okuhlanganisa nxulumano namakhonsela/Amabhodi abangochwepheshe.

Amava abonwayo ngesifundo sokusombulula iindlela ezintsha zonikezelo lweenkonzo kwaye uqonde iindleko zobomi bezakhiwo ezicivil okanye structural, iiteknoloji ezitsha zokwakha izakhiwo eziluhlaza, iimbalabala ezicwangcisiweyo nemigaqo yokwamkela iiprojekthi zobuxhasi nalwezilungiso.
