Analiseer data en diensneigings om risiko's, gapings en areas vir verbetering te identifiseer, en verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van toepaslike regstellende aksieplanne. Ondersteun uitbreekondersoeke, infeksievoorkoming en beheer-bewaking, beroepsgesondheidsprogramme en nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, beleide, standaarde, norme en diensverbeteringsplanne. Ontwikkel, hersien en implementeer beleide, protokolle, standaard bedryfsprosedures en verslagdoeningstelsels wat veilige, doeltreffende, billike en pasiëntgesentreerde dienslewering bevorder. Verskaf tegniese advies, opleiding en ondersteuning aan departemente en multidissiplinêre spanne, en bevorder 'n kultuur van kwaliteit, verantwoordelikheid, leer, responsiwiteit en deurlopende verbetering dwarsoor die hospitaal. Mag vereis word om pligte buite normale werksure te verrig.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokuqinisekiswa Kokulingana: Central Hospital
zu.summary: Hola inqubomgomo yokuqinisekiswa kokulingana, ubulungiswa bemizimba nokuphathwa kwezingozi eGroote Schuur Hospital, kudinga iziqu ze-Health Sciences nempilo egudluzekayo yokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane semfundo: Four-year National Diploma / Degree noma isiqu esilinganayo kwi-Health Sciences, esibhaliseka ku-South African Statutory Health Professions Council noma i-South African Nursing Council. Impilo: Impilo efanele ekuqinisekisweni kokulingana, ukuphathwa kwezingozi nobulungiswa kwezinsizakalo zempiло. Impilo efanele yokuphatha endaweni yesibhedlela. Impilo ekuphepheni kwabaguli, ukuphathwa kwezikhungo, ukuphathwa kwezehlakalo ezingemihle, ukuhlolwa kwemizimba, impilo yomsebenzi nokuphepha, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo. Impilo ekuphathweni kwabasebenzi. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi evumelekile yomshayeli we-Code EB/B. Amandla (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi olubanzi ngezinhlelo zokuletha izinsizakalo zempiло, ukuqinisekiswa kokulingana, ubulungiswa bemizimba, ukuphepha kwabaguli, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, impilo yomsebenzi nokuphepha. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene, izinqubomgomo, amanani, amaphuzu, amathuluzi okuhambisana nezidingo zokubika ngaphakathi kwesigaba sezempilo somphakathi. Amandla amakhulu okuhola, okuphatha, okuxhumana, okuhlobana nabanye, okuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokuhola amaqembu ahlukene, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo, ukuphatha inguquko nokusebenza ndawonye nabalingani baphakathi nangaphandle. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, kuhlanganise ikhono lokugcina, ukuhlaziya nokutolikela idatha nembiko. Ikhono lokulungisa imibiko ebhalwe ngokuphezulu, okwethulwayo, izinqubomgomo namaphuzu wokuqondisa. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ikakhulukazi kwi-MS Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
zu.duties: Nikeza inqubomgomo ebalulekile nesebenzayo yokuhola ukuqinisekiswa kokulingana, ubulungiswa bemizimba, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, ukuphepha kwabaguli nempilo yomsebenzi nokuphepha ngaphakathi kwe-Groote Schuur Hospital. Bumba, faka, hlola futhi diehlaze izinhlela ezikhusa izinga, ukuphepha, ukusebenza kahle kanye nobuwezulu ekunakekelweni kuzo zonke izinqubo zemizimba, ezolawula nezobuciko. Hola futhi uhlanganise izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga, kuhlanganise nesistimu yezikhungo nobungcweti, ukubika kwezehlakalo ezingemihle, inqubo yokuqinisekisa ukufa nokugula, ukuhlolwa kwemizimba, imibuzo yokuqonda abaguli kanye nemibuzo yesikhathi sokulinda. Hlaziya idatha kanye namathrendi ezinsizakalo ukuthola izingozi, izikhala kanye nezindawo zokuthuthukisa, futhi qinisekisa ukubumba, ukufaka nokuqapha amaphuzu wokuqondisa ahambisana. Sekela iphupho lokuphenya ukubhebetha, ukuqapha ukuvikelwa ukutheleleka nolawulo, amaphulo empilo yomsebenzi kanye nokuhambisana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo, amaphuzu, amanani namaphuzu wokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo. Bumba, hlola futhi faka izinqubomgomo, amaphrotokholi, izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza kanye nezinhlela zokubiza ezikhuthaza ukulethwa kwemizamo okuphephile, okusebenzayo, okulinganayo futhi okugxile kumuntu. Nikeza iseluleko sesimo sobuchwepheshe, ukuqeqesha futhi useke eminyangweni namaqembu ahlukene, futhi khuthaza isiko lelinga, ubuwezulu, ukufunda, ukusabela kanye nokuqhubeka nokuthuthuka kulo lonke isibhedlela. Kungenzeka ucelwe ukwenza imisebenzi ngaphandle kwamasikhathi ajwayelekile omsebenzi.

xh.title: Meneja wokuQinisekisa Ubuchule: Central Hospital
xh.summary: Qonda ekuqinisekiseni ubuchule, ulawulo lokhondo kunye nokulawula ingozi kwi-Groote Schuur Hospital, kufuneka ube nelifa lezeMfundo ezezeMpilo kunye namava ohlelo oluhambelana naloo mfundo.
xh.requirements: Ifundo esemthethweni evunyiweyo: iNqanaba lesine leDiploma yeSizwe / iDegree okanye elifa elilinganayo kwizeMfundo ezezeMpilo, elibhaliseka kuKhongo lweSizwe lewoMsebenzi wezeMpilo oluSemthethweni lwaseMzantsi Afrika okanye uKhongo lweBongikazi lwaseMzantsi Afrika. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo ekugxileni nokuqinisekisa ubuchule, ekulawuleni iingozi nakulawulweni lweenkonzo ezizezempilo. Amava ohlelo olufanelekileyo olulawula kwindlu yolwelabo. Amava ekhuselekeni kwabagulayo, ekulawuleni iingxaki, ekulawuleni iiganeko ezingalunganga, ekuhloleni ukhondo lokuhamba, ekhuselekeni nakuhlelo lomsebenzi, nakuPhuculweni kweenkonzo. Amava ekulawuleni abasebenzi. Iimfuno ezisesikhundleni somsebenzi: ilayisenisi evumelekileyo yokushuka yeKhowudi EB/B. Iimpawu zokwazi (ulwazi/amehlo): Ulwazi olubanzi lweenkonzo ezizezempilo, ukuqinisekisa ubuchule, ulawulo lokhondo, ukhuseleko lwabagulayo, ukulawula iingozi, kunye nokhuseleko nakuhlelo lomsebenzi. Ulwazi ngemithetho, iindlela ezisemthethweni, iziphelo, izigqibo, izixhobo zokuvumelana nemfuno yokubika ngaphakathi kundlu yolwelabo yoluntu. Amandla okukhokela, okulawula, okuthetha nabantu, okuziphendulela, okuhlalutya nokusombulula iingxaki. Amandla okukhokela amaqela ahlukeneyo, okumuncuza ukuphucula iinkonzo, okulawula iinguquko nokusebenza ngokubambisana nabantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, kuquka namandla okugcina, ukuhlalutya nokutolika iindlela zedatha emkhankathweni nemiyalelo. Amandla okulungela imiyalezo ebhalwe ngobuchule, iinkcazelo, iindlela ezisemthethweni neenkqubo zokusebenza. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ngakumbi kwi-MS Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
xh.duties: Nika iNqanaba eliphezulu neliqinisekileyo lokukhokela ukuqinisekiswa kobuchule, ulawulo lokhondo, ukulawula iingozi, ukhuseleko kwabagulayo nakukhuseleko nakuhlelo lomsebenzi kwi-Groote Schuur Hospital. Phucula, seta, hlola nilinganise iindlela ezonyusa ubuchule, ukhuseleko, ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo nokuziphendulela ekunakekelweni ngokuske zombini iinkalo zokhondo, zolawulo nakweziko. Qhuba kwaye ulungiselele iinkqubo zokuphucula ubuchule, kuquka nenkqubo yengxaki nemivuzo, ukubika iiganeko ezingalunganga, iinkqubo zokuqwalasela ukhubawu nokufa, ukuphenya ngokwamagigesa, iingxelo zokuziphendulela zabagulayo nezexesha lokulindela. Hlalutya idatha netrendi zentsapo ukuze ukhangelwe iingozi, amathuba akanasiphelo namabala okuphucula ukuze kuqiniseke ukususwa, ukusetyenziswa nokuqwalaselwa kweekhadi ezifanelekileyo zokulungisa. Yinkxaso ekuphenyeni iiganeko ezisasazeka, ekulawuleni ukungalunywa kwaye kulawulwe iingozi, nakuhlelo lokhuseleko nakuhlelo lomsebenzi nakuvumelaneni nemithetho, iindlela, izigqibo, iziphelo neenkqubo zokuphucula iinkonzo. Phucula, hlola kwaye uzisebenzise iindlela, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokusebenza ezingagqibekanga kwaye ulungise iinkqubo ezithetha ngeenkxaso ezikhuselekileyo, ezisebenzayo, ezilinganayo nezigqiba ngomntu ogulayo. Yinkxaso yamava, yemfundo yamava kwamaphandle kweekhondo namaqela ahlukahlukeneyo, kwaye uzamdise ukugcinwa kobuchule, ukuziphendulela, ukufunda, nokuphendula ngokukhawuleza nokuphucula ngokusuke ngokuske ehospitale. Kungenzeka kufunwe ukwenza imisebenzi engaphandle kwamaxesha okusebenza ajikelezayo.

(This dispensation is only applicable for posts of Clinical Programme Coordinator where it is an inherent requirement of the post, incumbent to maintain registration with the SANC). Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence and willingness to travel and work overtime when required. Responsible for the strengthening and coordination of internal and external interface management with stakeholders, including NPOs, to enhance implementation of the COPC principles. af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder Graad 1 (OMVATTENDE
af.summary: Kliniese Programkoördineerder gesoek vir Saldanha PHC om subdistrik-omvattende gesondheidsdienste, insluitend MIV, TB en chroniese siektebestuur, te koördineer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasies: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegstersraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. OF 'n 4-jarige baccalaureusgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegstersraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. (Hierdie beskikking is slegs van toepassing op poste van Kliniese Programkoördineerder waar dit 'n inherente vereiste van die pos is, die ampsdraer om registrasie by die SANC te handhaaf). Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis en oortyd te werk wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om strategies en analities te dink, onafhanklik te werk, asook die vermoë om beleide en riglyne te interpreteer en te implementer. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint).
af.duties: Koördinering en implementering van die subdistrik se geïntegreerde omvattende gesondheidsdienste, d.w.s. MIV/VIGS/SOG/TB-dienste en die daarstelling van dienskoppeling met geïntegreerde bestuur van chroniese toestande, die eerste 1000-dae strategie, adolessent-, vroue- en mansgesondheidsdienste, en die daarstelling van gesondheidsdienskoppeling op alle diensplatforms op subdistrikvlak. Verskaf toesiig, toesig en ondersteuning aan gesondheidsfasiliteite ten opsigte van die implementering van gehalteversekeringsbeleid, riglyne, protokolle, norme en standaarde. Betrokkenheid by die Menslike Ontwikkelingskomponent in vaardigheidsontwikkeling en opleiding om geïntegreerde gesondheidsdienslewering te ondersteun. Verantwoordelik vir die versterking en koördinering van interne en eksterne skakelbestuur met belanghebbendes, insluitend NPO's, om implementering van die COPC-beginsels te verbeter. Monitering en evaluering van geïntegreerde gesondheidsdiensprestasie asook die effektiewe implementering van toepaslike projekte om geïntegreerde primêre gesondheidsdienste en uitkomste in die subdistrik te verbeter.

zu.title: I-Coordinator Yohlelo Lwezokwelapha Izinga 1 (COMPREHENSIVE
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-Coordinator Yohlelo Lwezokwelapha e-Saldanha PHC ukuze kuhlelwe izinsizakalo eziphelele zezempilo eziseningizimu ohambisana nomkhakha ohlanganisa i-HIV, i-TB nokuphathwa kwezifo ezingapheli.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwenqanaba elibekiweyo: I-Basic R425 qualification (okt. idiploma/iziqu kubunyazi) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R683 + R254) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenkosikazi eyezempi. Noma I-4-year bachelor's degree kubunyazi (R174) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R683 + R1497 noma R171 + R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenkosikazi eyezempi. (Le nkqubo isebenza kuphela kwizikhundla ze-Coordinator Yohlelo Lwezokwelapha lapho kuyimfuneko yegunya elithileyo ukuba umntu ophatha igunya agcine ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC). Ukubhaliswa kwikomidi yamagunyazwe: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengenkosikazi eyezempi. I-explore: Ukuba kunesipho esinganqamle kakhulu emsebenzini wezempi kangangeminyaka eyi-7 ngemva kokubhalisa njengenkosikazi eyezempi e-SANC e-General Nursing. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kogunyazwe: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni nokuzimisela ukuhamba nokusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi xa kuyimfuneko. I-Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ukuba nengqondo yokucinga ngokuya ngokuqonda ukuba kuhamba njani, ukuba nokwazi ukuqonda nokuba nengqondo yokuphumeza izaphethwe kwaye ulandelana nemithetho elandelwayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
zu.duties: Ukuhlela nokusebenzisa izinsizakalo eziphelele ezihlanganiswe zezempilo eziseningizimu ohambisana nomkhakha ohlanganisa i-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB kwaye kwakhiwe izithuba zokuqhuba iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuhlela isixokelelwano sokulawula iimfiwo ezahlukahlukeneyo, i-1st 1000 day's strategy, izinsizakalo eziphelele zobudala, abesifazane nabesilisa nokwakha izinto eziphelele zoxhumo kwindawo yonke iimfuno kwelona zinga kwisifunda. Ukubonelela ngolawulo, ulawulo nokuxhasa iindawo zokunyanga ngokwemigaqo yokulawula, izikhokelo, iinkqubo, amagunya neenkqubo ezingagqibekanga. Ukubandakanyeka kwikomponenti Yophuhliso Lobuntu ekuphuhliseni amakhono nokuqeqesha ukuxhasa ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. Ukuba ngumntu onoxanduva lokomeleza nokuhlela ukulawula ngaphakathi nakangaphandle ukungqamanisa nabantu abahlukene, kuquka i-NPO, ukuphucula ukusebenza kolwazi lwe-COPC. Ukuqwalasela nokulinganisa ukusebenza kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezihlanganisiweyo nokuqwalasela ukuphunyezwa koluntu oluqhuba imisebenzi yokuphucula izinsizakalo eziphelele kwezempilo kwindawo ezingaphantsi kolawulo wezibhedlela kwindawo yonke iimfuno kwelona zinga kwisifunda.

xh.title: Ilungu leNqanaba loku-1 leKomiti yoMiso-miso weMinyanya yoNyango (EZIDIDI)
xh.summary: Kufuneki kubekho ilungu leKomiti yoMiso-miso weMinyanya yoNyango kwiSaldanha PHC ukuze alungiselele iinkonzo ezidibanisiweyo ezibonelelwa kummandla ongaphantsi kwesebe, kuquka nokulawula i-HIV, i-TB, nezigulo ezihlala ziphila ixesha elide.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingowona mgangatho ophezulu: Isifundo esisisiseko seR425 (oko kukuthi idiploma/inder卵 kwinz enonyango) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (R683 ngeR254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha weSifo. OKANYE Inderile yeminyaka e-4 kwinz enk (R174) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (R683 ngeR1497 okanye R171 ngeR1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha weSifo. (Lo mgangatho usebenza kuphela kwabezala bakaKomiti yoMiso-miso weMinyanya yoNyango apho kubuyiswe ngakumbi kumfuno yesithuba, umntu okhethiweyo makagcine ukubhalisa kwakhe kwiSANC). Ukubhalisa kwiBhungo elilawula inz: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengogqirha weSizo. Imfundo ngokwemizekelo: Amava amnye angaziiwa ukuba awa ngaphezulu kweminyaka ey-7 enqabakayo/aqattheyo kwinz emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha weSizo kwiSANC kwinkqubo yamagunya onke. Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho womsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) egqithisiweyo nentembko yokuhamba nokusebenza ngeminyaka e ngokwemfuneko. Ukuzinza (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokucinga ngokweembona ezisetiweyo nangokwenyani, ukusebenza eyedwa, nakho ukuba nakho ukuquka umba kwaye uwusebenzise iinkqubo nemicimbi ekhokeleyo. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel nePowerPoint).
xh.duties: Ukulungiselela nokusebenzisa iinkonzo ezidibanisiweyo ezibonelelwa kummandla ongaphantsi kwesebe, oko kukuthi iinkonzo ze-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB kwaye uqhube iindibaniselwano zezinkonzo nokulawulwa kwezigulo ehlala ziphila ixesha elide, ingoma yam suku aba-1000, ulutsha, impilo yabasetyhini nabadoda nokuqhube iindibaniselwano zezinkonzo ezempilweni kuzo zonke iinkqubo zezinkonzo kummandla ongaphantsi kwesebe. Ukunika iNqaku eliphezulu, ulawulo nencoko ngeenkxaso kumaziko empilo malunga nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezisigqibeleleyo zokuqinisekisa umgangatho wemisebenzi, iinkqubo ezilawulayo, iinkqubo ezixhasayo, imigangatho nezimemo. Ukubandakanyeka kwesiquqa esibhekene nokuPhuhliswa kwabantu ekuphuhliseni amakhono nako kuyakholwa ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo ezidibanisiweyo ezempilweni. Ukuba nayiphi na indima ekugxilweni nakulungiselelweni kolawulo olungaphakathi nolungaphandle nabanomdla, kuquka namaNPO, ukuphucula ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zemigaqo yeCOPC. Ukulawula nokuHlola ukusebenza kweenkonzo ezidibanisiweyo eZempilweni, nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza okusebenzayo kweemisebenzi elifanelekileyo ukuphucula iinkonzo eziyimfuneko eZempilweni ezingunaphakathi nemiphumla kummandla ongaphantsi kwesebe.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner (PRIMARY Health Care) (X3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Three clinical nurse practitioners sought for Grabouw Community Health Centre to manage disease burden and deliver primary healthcare services.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year diploma in Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, accredited with the SANC (R48). OR A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Primary Care Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognizable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognizable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in the specific speciality after obtaining the 1 year post basic qualification OR a post-graduate diploma in the relevant speciality. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB/C1) driver’s licence and willingness to travel. Willingness to work on the mobile health clinic bus. Willingness to work overtime. Competencies (knowledge/skills): NIMART training or experience. Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal). Problem solving, report writing, liaison and facilitation skills. Basic computer skills in (i.e., MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Knowledge of relevant legislation and policies of the Department of Health Western Cape.

zu.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner (PRIMARY Health Care) (X3
zu.summary: Kudingwa ogogosikhi abayisithupha bezokwelapha besikhundla se-Grabouw Community Health Centre ukulawula inzuzo yezigula kanye nokuletha izinsiza zezempilo eziyisiseko.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ezisezingeni elincane: Isibawo se-R425 esisisiseko (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu zobuciko kwezokwelapha) noma isibawo esifana naleso (i-R683 kanye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiNdlu Yezokwelapha YaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANC) njengogogosikhi isezinga eliphezulu. Isibawo esingaphezu kwesiseko sezokwelapha esithatha okungenani unyaka owodwa wediploma kwezzenzululwazi zokwelapha: ukuhlola impilo, ukwelashwa kanye nokunakekelwa, esivunyiwe yi-SANC (i-R48). Noma iziqu zobuciko ze-Bachelor zeminyaka eyi-4 (i-R174) noma isibawo esifana naleso (i-R683 kanye ne-R1497 noma i-R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiNdlu Yezokwelapha YaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANC) njengogogosikhi isezinga eliphezulu. Idiploma yesizinda okutholwe ngemuva kwamanye eminyaka eminingi (i-R635) evunyiwe yi-SANC kwezokwelapha okuyisiseko. Ukubhalisa kwiNdlu yezimongo: ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengogogosikhi isezinga eliphezulu. Okuhlolwayo: Izinga 1: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-4 yesipiliyoni sezokwelapha esifanele/sesobala ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengogogosikhi isezinga eliphezulu ezokwelapha eziwombe. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-14 yesipiliyoni sezokwelapha esifanele/sesobala ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengogogosikhi isezinga eliphezulu ezokwelapha eziwoombe. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/sesobala kuleyo ndiza ngemva kokuthola idiploma yenyaka owodwa engaphezu kwesiseko noma idiploma yesizinda esitholwe ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yezigaba ezezayo kuleyo ndiza esihlobene nayo. Isidingo esidalwa umsebenzi: Ileyisensi yokushayela (i-Code B/EB/C1) eseleyo kanye nesifiso sokuhamba. Isifiso sokusebenza kubhasi yezempilo ezihamayo. Isifiso sokusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi. Izikhindi (ulwazi/izikhokhelo): ukuqeqeshwa noma isipiliyoni se-NIMART. Amakhono okuxhumana aphezulu (okubhalwayo nokukhulumayo). Amakhono okusombulula izinkinga, okubhala izinkomba, okudibanisa kanye nokwenza kubambe iqhaza. Amakhono wokusebenzisa khompyutha wokwakheka (okungukuthi, i-MS Word, Excel, kanye ne-Outlook). Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye namapholisi ahlobene neDepartment of Health Western Cape.
zu.duties: Siza ukuphatha inzuzo yezigula ngokusho kwenkululeko yezempilo ebanzi. Isimemo senzuzo: Hlela futhi uzeke imisebenzi yokuqhasha kanye nokuqinisekisa impilo endaweni yokwelapha nasemmundweni; qinisekisa ulawulwazi lolwazi olunembile kanye nokugcina izinkomba.

xh.title: Umgangatho we-Clinical Nurse Practitioner (PRIMARY Health Care) (X3
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho abathathu abangabaluleki be-Clinical Nurse Practitioner kwi-Grabouw Community Health Centre ukulawula inzala yezifo kunye nokunikela iinkonzo eziziseko ezenempilo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona mgangatho: Isikhifizo esisisiseko se-R425 (okt i-diploma/degree kwizibonelelo) okt isikhifizo esilinganayo (i-R683 ngaphezu kwe-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoko ugqithisa i-Professional Nurse. Isikhifizo esingakanani se-1 yokugqibela i-post-basic kwizibonelelo zokuqhuba i-Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, esamkelwe yi-SANC (R48). OKT I-4-year Bachelor Degree kwizibonelelo (i-R174) okt isikhifizo esilinganayo (i-R683 ngaphezu kwe-R1497 okt i-R171 ngaphezu kwe-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoko ugqithisa i-Professional Nurse. I-post graduate diploma (R635) esamkelwe yi-SANC kwizibonelelo ezingundoqo ezenempilo. Ukubhalisa kwi-council ebalulekileyo: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njenge-Professional Nurse. Iimbonakaliso: Grade 1: Iminyaka engu-4 ubukhulu ubuncinci yamava afanelekileyo/owaziwayo wokugqithiswa kwemisebenzi emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njenge-Professional Nurse kwizibonelelo. Grade 2: Iminyaka engu-14 ubukhulu ubuncinci yamava afanelekileyo/owaziwayo wokugqithiswa kwemisebenzi emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njenge-Professional Nurse kwizibonelelo. Kufuneka kube neminyaka engu-10 ubuncinci yexesha elibekiweyo ngasentla njengamava afanelekileyo/owaziwayo kulondoloko ekhethekileyo emva kokufumana isikhifizo se-1 year post-basic OKT i-post-graduate diploma kulondoloko ekhethekileyo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: I-License yomqhubi (Code B/EB/C1) esebenzayo nokuzimisela ukuhamba. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza kwi-mobile health clinic bus. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngaphezu kweenyanga. Ubuncinane (ulwazi/izakhono): Uqeqesho okt amava e-NIMART. Izakhono ezilumkileyo zokunxibelelana (kokubhaliswa nokuthethwayo). Izakhono zokusombulula iingxaki, ukubhala iingxelo, nokubumba iindlela yokusebenza. Izakhono ezingowona mgangatho wekhompyutha (okt i-MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Ulwazi ngomthetho kunye namapolicies apha kwisebe le-Department of Health Western Cape.
xh.duties: Nceda ngokulawula inzala yezifo ngokwahlulelo beka i-Comprehensive Health Programme. Isakhono seplani nokusebenzisa iinkonzo ezenza ukukhuthaza ukuPhepha kwezempilo nokuthintela izifo kwisiphithiphithi nakwindlu. Ulawulo lwolwazi oluchanekileyo kwaye kugcinwe izibhalo. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: Child or Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: General or Child Nursing Science OR 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Demonstrate a good understanding of People Management (Human Resources) and financial policies and practices. Computer literacy (i.e. MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook}. Participate with the multi-disciplinary team to provide holistic health care, Provide good documentation, care, planning and health education. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukwenza ubunhesi ngokwesikhashana kunikezwa iqembu labanesi futhi kukhuthazwe inani lolunakekelo lwabanesi njengokuqondiswa ngobubanzi bokwenza umsebenzi ochwepheshe kanye nemigomo. Amakhono aphelele okuxhumana nabantu, abaholi, ahlelekile, okuthatha izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubonisa ukuqonda okuhle kokuphathwa Kwabantu (Human Resources) nemigomo nezindlela ezimalini. Thatha inxaxheba eqenjini elibanzi lezinkalo ezahlukene ukunikeza inakekelo yezempilo ephelele, Nikeza umgxhululo wezibhalo, inakekelo, ukuletha kanye nolwazi ngempilo. Ukusekela futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kwenkambiso yokwenza umsebenzi ochwepheshe, imisebenzi yemfundo, kanye nocupheno. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwemithombo yabantu nezimali. jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Finance
jobs.summary: Senior Administrative Officer needed at Citrusdal Hospital to manage Supply Chain, inventory, assets and financial reporting for the Department of Health and Wellness.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate 3-year Diploma/Degree. Experience: Appropriate experience in Supply Chain Management, Finance, Revenue and Patient Administration environment. Appropriate knowledge and practical experience in BAS, LOGIS, Clinicom and Account Receivables System. Appropriate practical experience in Budget and expenditure control as well as Assets and Liabilities accounts. Appropriate experience in the procurement of goods, services, warehouse management and asset management administration. Appropriate proven supervisory experience. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence and willingness to travel within the West Coast District. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Must have organisational, managerial, leadership skills, an aptitude for working with financial figures and strong people management skills. Ability to work in a team context and motivate team members. Computer literacy in Microsoft package with experience in LOGIS, BAS, Clinicom and account receivables system. Knowledge of PFMA, Finance instructions, Provincial and National treasury regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act 5 of 2000 (PPPFA) as well as Accounting Officer System. Good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Responsible for overall management of all Supply Chain Management functions. Responsible for Inventory Control, warehouse management and asset management processes. Accurate and timeous preparation of reports and assist with the compilation of the Interim and Annual Financial Statements. Supervise the clearance of Asset and Liabilities accounts, Sundry payments, Budgeting vs expenditure and timeous preparation of relevant reports. Authorization of BAS/Logis payments. Effective and efficient supervision of Financial Management processes such as creditor payments, journals, SCOA and BMI management. Accurate and timeous completion of all Revenue related monthly reporting and Revenue transaction system authorization. Contract management assistance in respect of Supply Chain and Finance responsibilities. Ensure sound Labour practices are executed and implemented.

af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte benodig by Citrusdal Hospital om Voorsieningsketting, voorraad, bates en finansiële verslagdoening vir die Department of Health and Wellness te bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike 3-jarige Diploma/Degree. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n Voorsieningskettingbestuur, Finansiële, Inkomste- en Pasientadministrasie-omgewing. Toepaslike kennis en praktiese ervaring in BAS, LOGIS, Clinicom en Account Receivables System. Toepaslike praktiese ervaring in Begroting en bestedingsbeheer asook Bate- en Aanspreeklikheidsrekeninge. Toepaslike ervaring in die verkryging van goedere, dienste, pakhuisbestuur en batebestuursadministrasie. Toepaslike bewese toesigervaring. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om binne die Weskus-Distrik te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Moet organisatoriese, bestuurs-, leierskapsvaardighede hê, 'n aanleg vir werk met finansiële syfers en sterk mensebestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n spankonteks te werk en spanlede te motiveer. Rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft-pakket met ervaring in LOGIS, BAS, Clinicom en account receivables system. Kennis van PFMA, Finance instructions, Provincial and National treasury regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act 5 of 2000 (PPPFA) asook Accounting Officer System. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die algehele bestuur van alle Voorsieningskettingbestuursfunksies. Verantwoordelik vir Voorraadbeheer, pakhuisbestuur en batebestuursprosesse. Akkurate en tydige voorbereiding van verslae en hulp met die opstel van die Tussentydse en Jaarlikse Finansiële State. Toesig hou oor die skering van Bate- en Aanspreeklikheidsrekeninge, diverse betalings, Begroting teenoor besteding en tydige voorbereiding van toepaslike verslae. Magtiging van BAS/Logis-betalings. Doeltreffende en effektiewe toesig oor Finansiële Bestuursprosesse soos skuldeiserbetalings, joernale, SCOA en BMI-bestuur. Akkurate en tydige voltooiing van alle Inkomste-verwante maandelikse verslagdoening en magtiging van inkomsetransaksiestelsel. zu.title: Umphathi Ohlezi Phakathi Ophakeme: Izimali
zu.summary: Udingwa Umphathi Ohlezi Phakathi Ophakeme esibhedlela iCitrusdal ukuphatha i-Supply Chain, izimpahla ezibekiwe, imfuyo nokubika ngokwezimali kuMnyango Wezempilo Nephiliso.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo eyingqayizwele: I-Diploma/I-Degree ehambisana neminyaka eyi-3. Isipiliyangqondo: Isipiliyangqondo esihambisana nemvela kwe-Supply Chain Management, Izimali, Inzuzo kanye nokuphathwa kwabagulayo. Ulwazi kanye nolwazi lokusebenza oluhambisana nama-BAS, LOGIS, Clinicom kanye ne-Account Receivables System. Isipiliyangqondo sokusebenza esihambisana nokulawula ngemali yokusebenza kanye nezimali ezichithiwe kanye nama-akhawunti we-Assets and Liabilities. Isipiliyangqondo esihambisana nokuthenga izimpahla, izinsiza, ukuphathwa kwe-warehouse kanye nokuphathwa kwe-asset management. Isipiliyangqondo esiqinisekisiwe sokuba ngumlawuli. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) evumelekile kanye nesithakazezelo sokuhamba ngaphakathi kwe-West Coast District. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Kumele kube nokuba nokuhleleka, ukuphatha, amasu okuhola, isipiliyangqondo sokusebenza ngamanani wezimali kanye namasu amakhulu okuphatha abantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kwethim kanye nokukhuthaza amalunga ethim. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kusuka ku-Microsoft package okunolwazi kuma-LOGIS, BAS, Clinicom kanye ne-account receivables system. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, imiyalo yezimali, imithetho ye-Provincial and National treasury, i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act 5 of 2000 (PPPFA) kanye ne-Accounting Officer System. Amasu amahle okuxoxa nokubhala.
zu.duties: Uphethe ngokuphelele ukuphathwa kwayo yonke imisebenzi ye-Supply Chain Management. Uphethe ukulawulwa kwe-Inventory, ukuphathwa kwe-warehouse kanye namasu okuphathwa kwe-asset management. Ulungiselela ngokunembile nangesisikhathi imibiko kanye nokusiza ekwakheni i-Interim and Annual Financial Statements. Uqapise ukusula kwama-akhawunti we-Asset and Liabilities, izinkokhelo ze-Sundry, ukwenza ngemali yokusebenza kanye nezimali ezichithiwe kanye nokuqasha ngesikhathi esifanele imibiko ehambisana naleyo. Ukuvuma izinkokhelo ze-BAS/Logis. Ukuphathwa ngokusebenza kahle nangokushesha amasu okuphathwa kwe-Financial Management njengoba izinkokhelo zezikweletu, ama-journals, i-SCOA kanye nokuphathwa kwe-BMI. Ukuqedelwa ngokunembile nangesisikhathi sonke imibiko yenyanga ngenyanga ehlobene ne-Income kanye nokuvuma inkqubo yokuhweba ngemali yenzuzo. Usizo ekuphathweni inkontileka maqondana nemithwalo ye-Supply Chain and Finance. Kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa nokuphunywa kwezindlela ezilungile zokusebenza.

xh.title: Umphathi Wezindaba Olawulayo: Nzalo
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe khona umphathi wezindaba ophakamileyo kwiCitrusdal Hospital ukulawula uqoqosho lokubonelela, izinto ezikho, iimpahla nokuxela ngemali yesebe lezeempilo nalonzulu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kweyamagama: iDiploma/IDigri elungileyo yeminyaka engama-3. Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo kwindawo yoLawulo loQoqosho lokubonelela, Nzalo, Inzuzo nokuLawulwa kwabaGuliyo. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo nesiphiwo sokusebenza ngokwemisebenzi kwiBAS, LOGIS, Clinicom neNkqubo yamaAkhawunti oMthengi. Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo sokusebenza ngokwemisebenzi kwiBajeti nolawulo lwentlawulo nakuwo onke amaAkhawunti weziPahla neziNxibelelanisi. Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo ekuthengeni izinto, iinkonzo, ulawulo lwevenkile yokugcina iimpahla nolawulo lolawulo lweempahla. Isiphiwo esigelwe ngqo esifanelekileyo sokulawula abantu. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zendawo yokusebenza: ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esezeleyo nokulungele ukuhamba ngaphakathi koMmandla wase West Coast District. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Kufuneka abenezakhono zokuhlela, zokulawula, zokuba nogqithiswa-kwexesha, ikhono lokusebenza namanani ezimali nezakhono ezikhulu zokulawula abantu. Ikhono lokusebenza kwindawo yeqela kwaye nokukhuthaza amalungu eqela. Ukuba nesiphico sekhompyutha kumsebenzi weMicrosoft ngesiphiwo sokusebenza kwiLOGIS, BAS, Clinicom nenkqubo yamaAkhawunti oMthengi. Ulwazi ngePFMA, imiyalelo yezimali, iNgqungquthela yaseRhulumede yengingqi naseRiphabliki, iPreferential Procurement Policy Framework Act 5 of 2000 (PPPFA) nakuLawulo lweNkqubo yomPhathi weziBalwa. Izakhono ezilungileyo zokuthetha nokuBhala.
xh.duties: Uyakuphathwa ngokulawula ngokubanzi onke amasebenzi oLawulo loQoqosho lokubonelela. Uyakuphathwa ngokuLawulwa kweziPahla, ulawulo lwevenkile yokugcina iimpahla neenkqubo zolawulo lweempahla. UkuLungiselela ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo iingxelo nokuNcedisa ekwenzeni iNganiso yemali yangaphakathi neYonyaka. UKulawula ukucocwa kwamaAkhawunti weziPahla neziNxibelelanisi, iNtlawulo yemisebenzi eyahlukahlukeneyo, iBajeti malunga neNtlawulo nokuLungiselela ngexesha elifanelekileyo iingxelo ezifanelekileyo. UkuVuma iNtlawulo zeBAS/Logis. UKulawula ngokusebenzisekileyo nangokuchanekileyo iNkqubo zoLawulo lweNzalo ezinjengentlawulo yabaTyheli, iiJournals, iSCOA nokuLawulwa kweBMI. UKuqedwa ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo koOnke iingxelo zenyanga ezinxulumene neNzuzo nokuVuma iNkqubo yeenkqubo zeNzuzo. UNcedo olusebenzayo ekulawulweni kweSivumelwano malunga noQoqosho lokubonelela neziMfuno zeNzalo. UKuqinisekisa ukuba kuqatywa kwaye kusebenziseke izimiso zoLawulo olungileyo.

jobs.title: Social Worker Grade 1 to 4
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R338 208 per annum Grade 2: R413 004 per annum Grade 3: R496 668 per annum Grade 4: R608 859 per annum
jobs.summary: Social Worker position at Mitchells Plain District Hospital providing clinical social work services including counselling, crisis intervention and child protection across grades 1 to 4.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification as a Social Worker that allows for registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professionals (SACSSP). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Social Worker. Experience: Grade 1: None, Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with SACSSP, Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with SACSSP, Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with SACSSP. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid Code B/EB driver’s licence. Willing to work across all hospital departments; including Emergency Centre Heideveld and Freesia Ward and represent the hospital in stakeholder engagements. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of social work legislation, policies, ethical standards, and case management processes, including psychosocial assessment, crisis intervention, child protection, discharge planning, and services to vulnerable groups. Strong communication, counselling, interviewing, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with patients, families, multidisciplinary teams, and external stakeholders. Report writing, documentation, and administrative skills, including accurate record keeping, statistical reporting, quality assurance, and compliance with organisational requirements. Problem-solving, advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work collaboratively, manage complex cases, and coordinate services across multiple sectors.
jobs.duties: Render comprehensive clinical social work services through psychosocial assessments, counselling, crisis intervention, child protection services, and discharge planning for patients and families. Provide support to vulnerable individuals and groups by addressing psychosocial needs, facilitating access to resources, and promoting patient wellbeing and continuity of care. Participate in multidisciplinary team processes and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate services, advocate for patients, and address barriers to care and discharge. Maintain accurate and compliant records, reports, and statistics in accordance with professional, legal, and organisational requirements. -Contribute to quality assurance, service improvement, supervision, training, and research activities to promote effective and evidence-based social work practice. Ensure professional governance and compliance through adherence to legislation, ethical standards, departmental policies, continuous professional development, and performance management requirements.

Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. af.title: Sosiaalwerker Graad 1 tot 4
af.summary: Sosiaalwerkerpos by Mitchells Plain District Hospital wat kliniese maatskaplike werksdienste lewer, insluitend berading, krisisintervensie en kinderbeskerming oor grade 1 tot 4.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie as 'n Sosiaalwerker wat registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professionals (SACSSP) moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Sosiaalwerker. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen, Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Sosiaalwerker by SACSSP, Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Sosiaalwerker by SACSSP, Graad 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Sosiaalwerker by SACSSP. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Geldige Code B/EB-bestuurslisensie. Bereid om oor alle hospitaaldepartemente te werk; insluitend Emergency Centre Heideveld en Freesia Ward en om die hospitaal in belanghebbende-betrokkenheid te verteenwoordig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van maatskaplike werk-wetgewing, beleide, etiese standaarde en gevalbestuurprosesse, insluitend psigososiale assessering, krisisintervensie, kinderbeskerming, ontslagbeplanning en dienste aan kwesbare groepe. Sterk kommunikasie-, beradings-, ondervragings- en interpersoonlike vaardighede, met die vermoë om doeltreffend met pasiënte, gesinne, multidissiplinêre spanne en eksterne belanghebbendes te kommunikeer. Verslagskrywing, dokumentasie en administratiewe vaardighede, insluitend akkurate rekordhouding, statistiese verslagdoening, gehalteversekering en nakoming van organisatoriese vereistes. Probleemoplossing, voorligting, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en spanwerksvaardighede, met die vermoë om saam te werk, komplekse gevalle te bestuur en dienste oor veelvuldige sektore te koördineer.
af.duties: Lewer omvattende kliniese maatskaplike werksdienste deur psigososiale assesserings, berading, krisisintervensie, kinderbeskermingsdienste en ontslagbeplanning vir pasiënte en gesinne. Verskaf ondersteuning aan kwesbare individue en groepe deur psigososiale behoeftes aan te spreek, toegang tot hulpbronne te fasiliteer en pasiëntwelsyn en kontinuïteit van sorg te bevorder. Neem deel aan multidissiplinêre spanprosesse en werk saam met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes om dienste te koördineer, vir pasiënte op te tree en hindernisse vir sorg en ontslag aan te spreek. Onderhou akkurate en nakomende rekords, verslae en statistieke in ooreenstemming met professionele, wetlike en organisatoriese vereistes. -Dra by tot gehalteversekering, diensverbetering, toezig, opleiding en navorsingsaktiwiteite om doeltreffende en bewysgebaseerde maatskaplike werkpraktyk te bevorder. Verseker professionele bestuur en nakoming deur die nalewing van wetgewing, etiese standaarde, departementele beleide, deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling en prestasiebestuursvereistes.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezenhlalo Izinga 1 kuya ku-4
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi wezenhlalo esibhedlela sakwa-Mitchells Plain District Hospital esinikeza amasevisi omlinzimomthelela omsebenzi wezenhlalo okuhlanganisa ukweluleka, ukungenelela esimeni esibucayi, nokuvikelwa kwezingane kuzo zazo izinga 1 kuya ku-4.
zu.requirements: Izindingo eziphezulu zemfundo: Iziqu ezifanele njengomsebenzi wezenhlalo ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professionals (SACSSP). Ukubhalisa ekuhlanganeni okunesiphoqi: Ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wezenhlalo. Isiphephelo: Izinga 1: Akukho, Izinga 2: Iminyaka engu-10 ngenani elingaphansi kweminyaka engu-10 yamava afanele kumsebenzi wezenhlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezenhlalo ku-SACSSP, Izinga 3: Iminyaka engu-20 ngenani elingaphansi kweminyaka engu-20 yamava afanele kumsebenzi wezenhlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezenhlalo ku-SACSSP, Izinga 4: Iminyaka engu-30 ngenani elingaphansi kweminyaka engu-30 yamava afanele kumsebenzi wezenhlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezenhlalo ku-SACSSP. Isidingo esibeke semthethweni somsebenzi: Ilayisense lokushayela le-Code B/EB elivumelekayo. Volontiya ukusebenza kuyo yonke iminyango yosibhedlela; okuhlanganisa Isikhungo Sokuphela Sempilo Heideveld nendlala Freesia futhi umele isibhedlela kumahlelo abalingani. Amakhono (ulwazi/amandla): Ulwazi ngomthetho womsebenzi wezenhlalo, izinqubomgomo, izindinganiso zokuziphatha, kanye namapuloqembu okuphathwa kwezicala, okuhlanganisa ukuqashelwa kwezomumo kwezengqondo nabezimilo, ukungenelela esimeni esibucayi, ukuvikelwa kwezingane, ukuhlela ukukhishwa kwesiguli, kanye namasevisi abantu abasengozini. Amakhono okuthumela imiyalezo, ukweluleka, okokubuza imibuzo, kanye nobudlelwane nabantu, anamandla okuthintana ngempumelelo nabaguli, imindeni, amaqembu ahlukene abantu, futhi nabalingani bangaphandle. Amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukubhala okubhalisiwe, kanye namakhono okuphatha, okuhlanganisa ukugcina ibayibhalo elinembile, ukubika izibalo, ukutholakala kwezinga, nokuhambisana nezidingo zenhlangano. Amandla okuxazulula izinkinga, ukumela abanye, ukuthintana nomyalelo kumalingani, nokusebenza njengeqembu, angakwazi ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela, ukuphatha izicala ezinzima, kanye nokuqondisa imisebenzi kumagumbi amaningi.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemisebenzi egcwele yomsebenzi wezenhlalo nezempilo ngokuqashelwa kwezomumo kwezengqondo nabezimilo, ukweluleka, ukungenelela esimeni esibucayi, imisebenzi yokuvikela izingane, kanye nokuhlela ukukhishwa kwesiguli kubaguli nemindeni. Nikeza ngokweseka abantu nabaqembu abasengozini ngokuziswa izidingo ezingomumo wezengqondo nabezimilo, ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwizinsiza, futhi ukuthuthukisa impilo yabeziguli nokuqhubeka kokunakekelwa. Thatha inhlalo kumapuloqembu ahlukene futhi usebenze ndawonye nabalingani bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze uhlole imisebenzi, uze usize abaguli, kanye nokulawula izithi ezingangena ekunakekelweni nasekukhishweni kwesiguli. Gcina abayibhalo abanembile, okuhambisana nomthetho, imibiko, kanye nezibalo ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomsebenzi, ezingokomthetho, nasezinhlanganweni. -Nikeza ekuthuthukiseni izinga, ekwenzeni imisebenzi ibe ngcono, ekuqondisweni, ekugadenisweni, ekwelulekeni, kanye nocwaningolwazi ukuze kukhuthazwe umsebenzi osebenzayo futhi onesisekelo salokwazayo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi ngokufanele nokuhambisana nomthetho ngokulandela umthetho, izindinganiso zokuziphatha, izinqubomgomo zomnyango, ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi okuqhubekayo, kanye nezidingo zokuphathwa kwemisebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokwenzela Ntshumayeli Wesixelo Ezingqwalaselwa 1 ukuya ku-4
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli wesixelo esibhalwe kwi-Mitchells Plain District Hospital esinika iinkonzo zokwenzela ntshumayeli wesixelo ngokwesiko lokusebenza, kuquka ukweluleka, ukungena phakathi kwexesha lemingxaki kunye nokhuselo lwabantwana kumanqanaba 1 ukuya ku-4.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwesigaba esisisiseko: Isifundo esifanelekile njengomsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli wesixelo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwisikhungo saseMzantsi Afrika samagosa eentsebenzo ezintsonkotho zokwenzela ntshumayeli (SACSSP). Ukubhaliswa kwikomkhulu leemfundo: Ukubhaliswa kwisikhungo saseMzantsi Afrika samagosa eentsebenzo ezintsonkotho zokwenzela ntshumayeli (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli wesixelo. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nanye, Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-10 yamava afanelekileyo kulmsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli wesixelo kwi-SACSSP, Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-20 yamava afanelekileyo kulmsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli wesixelo kwi-SACSSP, Inqanaba 4: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-30 yamava afanelekileyo kulmsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli wesixelo kwi-SACSSP. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwesithuba somsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushayela ye-Code B/EB esebenzayo. Ukulungele ukusebenza kuzo zonke iisebe zesibedlele; kuquka i-Emergency Centre Heideveld ne-Freesia Ward kwaye umele isibedlele kwiintlanganiso namabalane. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngemithetho yomsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokuziphatha, kunye neenkqubo zolawulo lweetyala, kuquka ukuhlolwa kwengqondo nengqondo, ukungena phakathi kwexesha lemingxaki, ukhuselo lwabantwana, icebo lokukhululeka kwesibedlele, kunye neenkonzo kumagumbi angenamsindvo. Amakhono amaninzi okuqhathanayo, okweluleka, okuxoxa, nokuhlangana nabantu, anamandla okusebenza ngokufanelekileyo nabalawuli, ngeentsapho, ngeqela labasebenzi abangenamsebenzi othile, nabanomdla. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo, amaxwebhu, kunye nokulawula amaxwebhu, kuquka ukugcina iirekhodi echanekileyo, iingxelo ezibonisa izibalo, ukuqinisekisa umgangatho, nokuzalisekisa iimfuno zoshishino. Amakhono ezingxaki ezinzonzo, ukumela abanye, ukuhlangana namabalane, nokusebenza njengesqela, anamandla okusebenza ngokubambisana, ukulawula iingxaki ezingacacanga, nokuqwalasela iinkonzo kwiiqondo ezininzi.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo ezibanzi zokwenzela ntshumayeli wesixelo ngokwesiko lokusebenza ngokuhlola ubomi bomntu ngengqondo nengqondo, ukweluleka, ukungena phakathi kwexesha lemingxaki, iinkonzo zokhuselo lwabantwana, nokuqwalasela ukukhululeka kwesibedlele kubalawuli nangeentsapho. Nika inkxaso kumantluka abantu namarhoroma ngokuthatha iimfuno zabo zengqondo nangengqondo, ukwenza lula ukufikelela kwezi zinto, kunye nokukhuthaza impilo yomlawuli nokuhamba kweso sixa sengqondo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zeqela elihlangene elingenangqondo kwaye usebenzisane nabalawuli bangaphakathi nabangaphandle ukuqwalasela iinkonzo, ukumela abalawuli, nokuphelisa iithinteloi ekunakekelweni nasekukhululekeni kwesibedlele. Gcina iirekhodi, iingxelo, neesitathistikhi ezichanekileyo nangokulandela imithetho ngeenjongo zokusebenza, ngokwemithetho, nangokweemfuno zeshishino. -Nika isixhaso kuqinisekiso lomgangatho, ukuphucula iinkonzo, ukulawula, ukuqeqesha, nokupeyila imisebenzi ukuze ukhuthaze ukwenziwa komsebenzi wokwenzela ntshumayeli ngokufanelekileyo nangokusesikweni. Qinisekisa ulawulo olulungileyo lolwazi ngokwemithetho nangokuziphatha ngokulandela imithetho, iinkqubo zokuziphatha, iinkqubo zesebe, ukuphucula ulwazi ngokungqubana phantsi, nangeenjongo zokulawula ukusebenza.

zu.title: Umncedisi we-Pharmacy (POST Basic) Isigaba 1 kuya ku-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedisi we-Pharmacy (POST Basic) esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur esinikeza inkonzo ye-pharmacy ephila kanye nezokusebenza ngokusebenza kahle ngeholo elisuka ku-R275,340 kuya ku-R343,761 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Iminyanelo yemfundo engaphansi kwayo: Iziqu ezifanelekile ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengoMncedisi we-Pharmacy (Post Basic) Institutional noma uMncedisi we-Pharmacy (Post Basic). Ukubhaliswa kubhungo lobuchwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengoMncedisi we-Pharmacy (Post-Basic) noma uMncedisi we-Pharmacy (Post-Basic) (Institutional). Isiphephelo: Isigaba 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengoMncedisi we-Pharmacy (Post-Basic). Isigaba 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yamashebe okufanelekile njengoMncedisi we-Pharmacy emva kokubhaliswa njengoMncedisi we-Pharmacy (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Isigaba 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-13 yamashebe okufanelekile njengoMncedisi we-Pharmacy emva kokubhaliswa njengoMncedisi we-Pharmacy (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo zomsebenzi: Ukukwazi ukunyakaza ngokuphepha izinto ezisindayo ze-pharmacy ezibekwe ezindaweni ezahlukene kwindlu yamakhemikhali. Kumele uze ukulungise futhi uhole amakhemikhali okwelapha umdlavuza. Ukukwazi futhi ukuzithoba ukusebenza endaweni yethimba ngokushintshana kumisebenzi ngokwemishado yamahora. Kumele uze ukusebenza amahora amaningi nangemva kohora lokuqeda lomsebenzi uma kudingeka. Ulwazi (izinkombandlela/amashebe): Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook) kanye nokubonisa isiphephelo ekusebenziseni uhlelo lokukhokha i-JAC/WellSky. Ulwazi ngokuqondiswa Okuhle kokuqondiswa kwe-Pharmacy kanye nenkonzo ye-pharmacy yamayunithi nezinqubo. Ulwazi ngemigomo yoMphatho Wezokulethwa Kwezidakamizwa, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kweqembu elibandayo. Ulwazi olufanelekile ngemigaba Yezempilo Yezwe kanye Neyesifunda, i-Medicines Act 101of 1965, i-Pharmacy Act 53 of 1974 kanye NomoMphatho WezeMali Zomphakathi. Ukugxila kumagula ngobuhle bokuxhumana nokuxoxa okuhlanganisa ukukwazi ukuxhumana nabanye ochwepheshe bokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukukwazi ukucwangcisa, ukuphatha isikhathi ngempumelelo, ukuthatha inkinga, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuletha izinto ezintsha, ukusebenza ngokunembile ngaphansi kwenkani kanye nogcina izinga eliphezulu lobungcali. Ukukwazi ukuthatha inkinga yemisebenzi enikeziwe okuhlanganisa imibuzo ehlobene namakhemikhali.
zu.duties: Nikela inkonzo ye-pharmacy ephila, ezokusebenza ngokusebenza kahle, enezindleko eziphansi futhi ephelele. Ukukhokha amakhemikhali okuhlanganisa nokugcina ukubhaliswa kanye nokuncedisa ngemibuzo ehlobene namakhemikhali. Ukulawula ngokusebenza kahle isitoko se-pharmacy endlini yamakhemikhali nakuWards, okuhlanganisa nokwamukela, ukugcina, ukulawula, ukwaba, ukuphatha iqembu elibandayo kanye nokulawula amaza obushushu. -Ukuncedisa ngokuqoqa imininingwane kanye nokugcina amarekhodi. Ukuncedisa ngokuqeqesha, ukufundisa kanye nokuqondisa abasebenzi be-Pharmacy. Ukusekela umphathi we-Pharmacy ngezinhlaka zokuthuthukisa inqubo, ukulandelana kwezokubuzwa nokuba ngokomthetho we-GPP. Ukulandelana nayoyonke imigaba yomphatho wabantu kanye nezokwenza, okuhlanganisa nokuphatha ukungabani kanye nokuphathwa kwezikhulumi. Kuqinisekisa ukulandela ukuLawulwa Kokutheleleka kanye Namashebe OkuLondolozwa Kokuzivikela KwezeMpi Akhayithi.

Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-13 yamava afanelekileyo njengomncedi wezezamafa emva kokuqatshelwa njengomncedi wezezamafa (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Amandla okuzihambela ekushukumiseni ngokhuseleko izinto ezinzima zamaza ezigcinwa kumagonga ahlukene kwithlesi. Kufuneka ufune ukulungisa kwaye uhlanganise i-chemotherapy. Amandla nokulungelelana ukusebenza kwimeko yeqela ngenkqubo yokujikeleza imisebenzi ngokwemisebenzi ye-rosters. Kufuneka ulungele ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwexesha nangemva kweyure xa kudingeka. Amandla (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukubhalisa ngekhompyutha (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) kunye nokubonisa amava ekusebenziseni inkqubo yokunika amaza ye-JAC/WellSky. Ulwazi lwe-Good Pharmacy Practice nolwazi lemisebenzi yamaza yesebe lezeempilo ngeendlela. Ulwazi lwe-Medicine Supply Management Principles, kuquka nokulawula i-cold chain. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lwe-National and Provincial Health Policies, Medicines Act 101 of 1965, i-Pharmacy Act 53 of 1974 ne-Public Finance Management Act. Ukuqonda ngomntu ofana nemimiselo yokuhambelana nezakhono zokuthethana kuquka nelandlela yokuthethana namanye oogqirha bezempilo. Amandla okucwangcisa, okulawula ixesha ngokusebenzayo, ukuthathela iqondo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukungqamisa, ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokugcina umgangatho ophezulu wokusebenza ngobungcali. Amandla okuthathela iqondo kwimisebenzi enikiweyo kuquka namashishini amaza.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkonzo yamaza ekhuselekileyo, esebenzayo, efanelekileyo ngeexabiso namabala agqithisayo. Ukunika amaza kuquka nokubhala nokunceda ngemibuzo ehambelana namaza. Ukulawula ngokusebenzayo isitokhwe yamaza kwithlesi nakwi-Wards, kuquka nokufumana, ukugcina, ukulawula, ukusasazwa, ukulawula i-cold chain nokubuka ubushushu. -Ukunceda ngokuqokelela i-data nokugcina irekhodi. Ukunceda nokufundisa, nokufundisa nokulungisa abasebenzi bethlesi. Ukuxhasa umphathi wethlesi ngeendlela zokuphucula iinkqubo, ukuthobela i-audit nokuhambelana neemfuno ze-GPP. Ukuthobela zonke iinkqubo nokusebenza kokulawula abantu, kuquka nokulawula iingxabano namashishino. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela i-Infection Control ne-Occupational Health & Safety Practices.

Inherente vereiste van die werk: In staat wees om tuinmasjinerie (grasmaaiers en bosknippers) te bedien. Geldige kode (B/EB)-bestuurslisensie asook die vermoë om 'n trekker te bedryf en te bestuur. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Tuinmaakvaardighede insluitend landskapontwerp en besproeiingstelsels. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede.

Ondersteuning aan toesighouer.

zu.title: Isimo somhlaba (amagade nezitshalo)

Isidingo sendalo yomsebenzi: Kube nokuqhakambisa izimoto zensimu (amasimu okukhetha kanye namasimu okusika ihlabathi). Ilayisense lesikhashana lekhodi (B/EB) lokushayela kanye nokuqhakambisa nokushayela isithipha. Ukukhamba kwemfanelo (ulwazi/izikhali): Izikhali zokutshala kuhlanganise ukwakhiwa komhlabathi nemithombo yokunisela. Izikhali ezinhle zokuxhumana ngokubhala nokukhuluma.
zu.duties: Oxhambele ekuthuthukisweni nasekugcineni indawo ezitshalwe kwindawo yokusebenza kanye nendawo, kanye nokuqoqa izimoto zokusebenza. Ukulungiselela indawo yokutshala izihlahla namakhamba. Ukugcina izimbali namanye amabhedi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izindawo namagade ziyagcinwa (izinto ezihlobene nezitshalo). Ukweseka umphathi.

xh.title: Umlozi wegadi (INDALO nokuGada)
xh.summary: Isithuba somlozi wegadi kwiTygerberg Hospital eParow Valley esifuna isiphathi esisisiseko, isipholo segadi, ilayisenisi ekusemthethweni B/EB, namandla okusebenzisa iimishini zegadi nakutrakta.
xh.requirements: Iziqinisekiso zemfundo ezingowona mgangatho: Isiphathi esisisiseko sokufunda nokubala. Isipholo: Isipholo esifanelekileyo sokusebenza kwendawo yexhaxha legadi nolonwabo. Imlinganiselo wangaphakathi womsebenzi: Makakwazi ukusebenzisa iimishini zegadi (iinjini zokusika indalo kunye neenjini zokusika iintsiba). Ilayisenisi yokushayela ekusemthethweni (B/EB) njengoko nakho namandla okusebenzisa nokushayela itrakta. Ikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono ogadi aquka ukulungisa ibala kunye neenkqubo zokuchukumisa amanzi. Amakhona amabalise nokuthetha.
xh.duties: Uxanduva lophuhliso nokugcina ixab nexhaxha lesixeko kunye nendawo, nokuqhomfa iimishini. Ukulungiselela amagqabi omhlaba ukutshala iinkuni namahlathi. Ukugcina iintyatyambo kunye nezityalo ezinye. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba iindawo neeminxwale zigcinwa (kumacala ogadi). Inkxaso kumphathi.

zu.title: Umshayeli (Isithuthi Esingaphansi Kwesigaba Esiphansi) (Inkxaso ye-PHC Nokuthunyelwa Komsebenzi)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umshayeli wesigaba esingaphansi kwesigaba esiphansi e-Matzikama Sub-District ukuthi athuthwe abasebenzi, abagulayo, izisetshenziswa nezimpahla, agcine izithuthi anike inkxaso yolawulo eqenjini lezokwelapha amazinyo.

Ulwazi ngemibhalo yokuqashwa, ukuhlola ukulungiswa kwezithuthi ukuze kutholakale iziphazamiso namakhono okushaya ngokuphephile. Kumele abe nezinyongo ezithile.

Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha nasekwenza imisebenzi yokuqwalaselwa, kuquka iintsuku zomgqibelo ngezimo zodidi lwakho. Ukuba nemizimba egqithisileyo ukusingatha izixhobo ezinzima kunye nezinto. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuba nakho ukuzithathela inxaxheba kunye nexanduva nasekusebenzeni lodwa ngaphandle kolawulo. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Die vermoë om fisiese take te doen en swaardiens-skoonmaak- en huishoudelike toerusting te bedryf. Moet bereid en in staat wees om skofte oor naweke en openbare vakansiedae te werk, insluitend dag- en nagdiens soos operasionele vereistes dicteer. Bereidwilligheid om oor verskeie departemente te roteer in ooreenstemming met operasionele vereistes en organisatoriese behoeftes. Handhandiging van 'n hoë standaard van netheid en higiëne in die fasiliteit. Verskaf effektiewe skoonmaakondersteuning aan die Fasiliteitsbestuurder en kollegas.

Kumele ukwazi futhi ukubekezelela ukusebenza izinguqulo ngezinsuku zokuphumula nasemiholweni yomphakathi, kuhlanganise ukusebenza emini nasebusuku njengoba kudingwa izidingo zokusebenza. Ukubekezelela ukushintsha kwezinye izindawo ezahlukene zomnyango ngokuvumelana nezidingo zokusebenza nezidingo zenhlangano. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Ulwazi ngendlela elungile yokuphatha nokulahla izinto ezingadingekile kanye nokuze kwezinqubomgomo nendlela zokuhlanzwa. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana.

Ukusetshenziswa okuyisisekelo nokugcinwa kwemishini yokuhlanzwa. Ukulandela iziqondiso zokuphepha futhi uqinisekise ukulandelwa kwezinqubomgomo zezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini. Ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokuhle nokuhlanzwa esikhungweni. Ukunikeza ukwesekwa okuyisisekelo kokuhlanzwa kwi-Facility Manager nabasebenzi nabo.

Iimfuno ezibangelwa msebenzi: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa kweenxuba, kuquka iintsuku zokuphumla ngeempelaveki namaholide axhamliweyo. Makabe sempilweni entle-eyedwa anamandla wagcinwa ngezinto ezinzima kwaye ame iyonke imini. Xhoma ngokomiselo lwesebe uze ulandele iNkqubo yeSibhedlele. Ukuziphatha (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngokwenza ukutya okuqhelekileyo nokwelapha iindwamkazi kwiyunithi yenkonzo yokutya eshishini. Ulwazi ngamacebo okucoxa, impilo yabasebenzi, i-HACCP namagunya okhuseleko. Ukuba nakho ukupatha ngokukhuselekileyo nangendlela efanelekileyo izixhobo zeshishini. Makabe nakho ukusebenza yedwa naphantsi koxinzelelo. Ukuba nakho ukucazulula iiresiphi, ukusebenzisa isikali, ukwenza iimbalo ezisisiseko nokuceba ukutyalwa kwentveliso.
xh.duties: Bonezela iinkonzo zakutya. Sebenzisa zigcine ngenqanaba eliphezulu ulungelo nengozi. Gcina izixhobo nezitya. Xhasa umsebenzi weZabasebenzi.

Physically fit and be able to hear and speak clearly. Perform hard physical tasks, e.g. pushing heavy linen trolleys to and from the linen bank and wards.
