af.title: WASERIJ-BEDIENDE
af.summary: Waserij-bediende gesoek by Robertson Hospital in die Western Cape om linneerdienste te verskaf en voorraadbeheer te handhaaf, wat basiese geletterdheid en fisieke gesondheid vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese geletterdheid en syfergeletterdheid. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in algemene wasserijfunksies. Inherent vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk, bv. na werksure, naweke en openbare vakansiedae wanneer bedryfsbehoeftes dit vereis. Fisieke gesond en in staat om duidelik te hoor en te praat. Hard fisiese take uitvoer, bv. swaar linneewaens na en van die linnebank en saals stoot. Laai en los swar linnesakke 25kg + tussen fasiliteite en Central Laundry. Bestuurslisensie om linne na sentrale wasserij te vervoer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om skoon, spoel en tel linne van vuile en besoedelde linne. Vermoë om te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). Kennis van voorraad- en infeksiebeheer.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n professionele linneediens aan die instelling. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende voorraadbeheer. Verseker veilige en higiëniese werkarea-standaarde. Verskaf ondersteuning binne die ondersteuningsdiensomgewing. Handhaaf lojale diensetiek. Verskaf ondersteuning aan toesighouer.

zu.title: umsizi wokwelapha impahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsizi wokwelapha impahla esibhedlela i-Robertson Hospital e-Western Cape ukunikeza izinkonzo zempahla futhi agcine ukulawula izintshalo, kudingeka abe nokwazi ukufunda nokubala okuyisisekelo nokuba nomzimba ophilile.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo elinganiselwe: Ukuba basic literacy and numeracy. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanele kumisebenzi jikelele yokwelapha impahla. Izidingo ezingaphakathi womsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza amahora amaningi, njengangemva kwehora lokusebenza, ngezinsuku zokuphumula namaholide omphakathi uma kudingeka izidingo zokusebenza. Ukuba nomzimba ophilile nokuba nokukwazi ukuzwa nokukhuluma kucace. Ukwenza imisebenzi enzima ngokomzimba, njengokushova izithela ezinzima zempahla kanye nasemabhankini empahla nasemawadeni. Ukufaka nokukhipha izikhwama ezinzima zempahla 25kg + phakathi kwezinto zomphakathi kanye ne-Central Laundry. I-drivers licence ukuthutha impahla eya e-central laundry. Ukufaneleka (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukukwazi ukuhlukanisa, hlanza nokubala impahla embi nengcolile. Ukukwazi ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ulwazi ngokulawula izintshalo kanye nokulawula ukutheleleka.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkonzo yempahla eyisiprofeshonale esikhungweni. Qinisekisa ukulawula izintshalo okusebenzayo nokuqinile. Qinisekisa izinga eliphephile nelihlanzekile lendawo yokusebenza. Nikeza inkxaso endaweni yemvelo yenkxaso yomsebenzi. Zinikezela ngokuzithoba kwenkolo yomsebenzi. Nikeza inkxaso kumphathi.

xh.title: Umncedi weLondolozo lempahla egqabhukayo
xh.summary: Kufunwa umncedi wolondolozo lempahla egqabhukayo eRobertson Hospital kwingingqi yaseWestern Cape ukuze kubonelelwe ngenkonzo yempahla egqabhukayo kwaye kugcinwe ulawulo lwesitokhwe, kufuneka abe nalwazi olusesantweni lokufunda nokubala nokuba namandla emzimbeni.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingakananiyo: Ulwazi olusesantweni lokufunda nokubala. Imfundo: Amava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi jikelele wolondolozo lweempahla. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngeyure ezongezelelweyo, umzekelo emva kweeyure zomsebenzi, ngecawe nangamaholide korhulumente xa kufuneka ngenxa yezidingo zomsebenzi. Kuba namandla emzimbeni kwaye ukwazi ukuziva nokuthetha kakuhle. Ukwenza imisebenzi eminzima emzimbeni, umzekelo ukududiza izithuthi ezinzima zeempahla ezisuka kwaye ziyi kwibhanka yeempahla nasezibedlele. Ukufaka nokukhupha izikhwama ezinzima zeempahla 25kg + phakathi kweziseko kunye neLaundry eNgangathyo. Ilayisenesi yokushayela ukuthutha impahla egqabhukayo kwindlu yolondolozo eNgangathyo. Ikhono (ulwazi/amashebe): Ikhlono lokwahlula, ukucoca nokubala impahla egqabhukayo edirty kwaye ifoule. Ikhono lokunxiba (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo). Ulwazi ngolawulo lwesitokhwe nolawulo lotyholo.
xh.duties: Kubonelelwe ngenkonzo yempahla egqabhukayo esemgangathweni kwishishini Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nolusemgangathweni lwesitokhwe Qinisekisa iindawo ezikhuselekileyo nezicocekileyo zokusebenza Bonelela ngenkxaso ngaphakathi kwendawo yeenkonzo zonxibelelwano. Zingathathi hlazo kwizimiso zenkonzo elungelelweni. Bonelela inkxaso kum lawuli.

jobs.title: Chief Quantity Surveyor: Education Infrastructure
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R1 143 468 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Chief Quantity Surveyor needed to manage education infrastructure projects, requiring a relevant degree, SACQSP registration, and six years' experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate B-Degree in Quantity Survey or relevant qualification; A minimum of six years post qualification quantity survey experience required; Compulsory registration with South African Council of Quantity Surveying Professionals (SACQSP) as a professional Quantity Surveyor; A valid code B driving licence. Competencies: Working knowledge of the following: An asset management life-cycle; Strong research, assimilation of data and recommendation outputs; Understanding of the life-cycle costing of an asset; Ability to adapt to new systems, development and implementation thereof at an asset, portfolio and project level management; Experience of contract documentation and administration, act/regulations of Occupation Health & Safety (OHS-Act), National Building Regulations, SANS and all relevant built environment legislation; Programme, project management, research and planning procedures; Financial management; Experience in project management, formulation of policies in a multi-disciplinary professional environment; Leadership, communication, organising and teamwork; Public sector procurement. Skills in the following: Decision making; Team leadership; Analytical skills; Creativity; Self-management; Financial management; Customer focus and responsiveness; Communication; Computer literacy (MS Office); Planning and organising; Conflict management; Problem solving and analysis; People Management; Change Management; Innovation; Willingness to travel on a regular basis; Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines; Ability to work in a team.
jobs.duties: Quantity Surveying analysis effectiveness: Perform final review and approvals or audits on quantity survey procedures; Coordinate quantity surveying efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology; Maintain quantity survey operational effectiveness: Manage the execution of quantity surveying strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources; Set quantity survey standards, specifications and service levels according to organisational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability; Monitor quantity survey efficiencies according to organisational goals to direct or redirect quantity surveying services for the attainment of organisational objectives; Financial Management: Ensure the availability and management of funds to meet the MTEF objectives within the quantity surveying environment/services; Manage the following: The operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organisational needs and objectives; Commercial added value of the discipline-related programmes and projects; Facilitate the compilation of Innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organisational principles; Allocate, monitor and control expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management; Governance: Allocate, monitor and control resources; Compile risk logs (database) and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practise and organisational requirements provide technical specialist services for the operation of quantity surveying related matters to minimise possible risks: Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment; Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. People Management: Manage the development, motivation and utilisation of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of quantity surveying services according to organisational needs and requirements manage subordinate's key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Jodie Thomas Tel No: (021) 483 2004
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoofkwantiteitsmeter: Onderwysinfrastruktuur
af.summary: Hoofkwantiteitsmeter benodig om onderwysinfrastruktuurprojekte te bestuur, met 'n relevante graad, SACQSP-registrasie en ses jaar se ervaring as vereistes.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte B-graad in Kwantiteitsopname of relevante kwalifikasie; 'n Minimum van ses jaar na-kwalifikasie kwantiteitsopname-ervaring word vereis; Verpligte registrasie by South African Council of Quantity Surveying Professionals (SACQSP) as 'n professionele Kwantiteitsmeter; 'n Geldige kode B-bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Werkkennis van die volgende: 'n Lewensiklus van batesbestuur; Sterk navorsing, assimilasie van data en aanbevelingsuitsette; Begrip van die lewensikluskosteberekening van 'n bate; Vermoë om aan nuwe stelsels, ontwikkeling en implementering daarvan by te pas op 'n bate-, portefeulje- en projekvlakbestuur; Ervaring van kontrakdokumentasie en -administrasie, wet/regulasies van Occupation Health & Safety (OHS-Act), National Building Regulations, SANS en alle relevante bou-omgewingswetgewing; Program-, projekbestuur-, navorsings- en beplanningsprosedures; Finansiële bestuur; Ervaring in projekbestuur, formulering van beleide in 'n multidissiplinêre professionele omgewing; Leierskap, kommunikasie, organiseervermoë en spanwerk; Openbare-sektor verkryging. Vaardighede in die volgende: Besluitneming; Spanleierskap; Analitiese vaardighede; Kreatiwiteit; Selfbestuur; Finansiële bestuur; Kliëntefokus en -reaksie; Kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office); Beplanning en organiseringsvermoë; Konflikbestuur; Probleemoplossing en -analise; Personebestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Innovasie; Bereidwilligheid om gereeld te reis; Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums te haal; Vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Doeltreffendheid van kwantiteitsopname-analise: Voer finale hersiening en goedkeurings of oudits op kwantiteitsopname-prosedures uit; Koördineer kwantiteitsopname-pogings en integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker; Handhaaf operasionele doeltreffendheid van kwantiteitsopname: Bestuur die uitvoering van kwantiteitsopname-strategie deur die verskaffing van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne; Stel kwantiteitsopname-standaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimale operasionele beskikbaarheid te verseker; Monitor kwantiteitsopname-doeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om kwantiteitsopname-dienste te rig of her-rig vir die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte; Finansiële bestuur: Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om die MTEF-doelwitte binne die kwantiteitsopname-omgewing/-dienste te haal; Bestuur die volgende: Die operasionele kapitale projekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbronverskaffing volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker; Kommersiële toegevoegde waarde van die dissipline-verwante programme en projekte; Fasiliteer die opstel van innovasievoorstelle om geldigheid en voldoening aan organisatoriese beginsels te verseker; Allokasie, monitering en beheer van besteding volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker; Goewerance: Allokasie, monitering en beheer van hulpbronne; Stel risikolêers (databasis) op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurspraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes; verskaf tegniese spesialisdienste vir die operasie van kwantiteitsopname-verwante aangeleenthede om moontlike risiko's te minimeer: Bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging; Monitor deurlopend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Personebestuur: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bekwame kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van kwantiteitsopname-dienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker; bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasiegebiede deur prestasiestandaarde vas te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: INkosana Eyinhloko Yokuqoqa Izinani: Izakhiwo Zemfundo
zu.summary: Kudingeka iSihlali ephethe amaphrojekthi okwakha izakhiwo zemfundo. Ifuna iziqu ezihlobene nakho, ukubhalisa ku-SACQSP, kanye neminyaka eyisithupha yesipiliyoni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-B-Degree Quantity Survey noma iziqu ezihlobene nazo; Ukuze ube nohlu oluncane lweminyaka eyisithupha ngemva kokuthola iziqu okudingeka kona ohlelweni lokulinganisa izindleko; Ukubhalisa okuyikho ngokungapheli ku-South African Council of Quantity Surveying Professionals (SACQSP) njengesinhloli sokulinganisa izindleko esingochwepheshe; Ilayisense lokushayela le-code B elisebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi lokusebenza okulandelayo: Iminyaka yezimpahla kusukela zidalwa kuze kufeze ukuphela kwayo; Ukuqoqwa kolwazi, ukuhlanganiswa kwenani kanye neziphakamiso; Ukuqonda inani lezindleko zempahla kusukela idalwa kuze kugcine; Ikono lokuzivumelanisa nezindlela ezintsha, intuthuko nokusetshenziswa kwayo kwazo onqenqemeni lwezimpahla, isikhulu nomphumela wamaphrojekthi; Lokho kungenziwa uhlelo lokulinganisa izindleko nokugcinwa kokuqinisekiswa okuhlobene nemicimbe yokuphathwa kanye nomthetho wokuqinisekisa ukuphila nokuphepha komsebenzi (OHS-Act), umthetho wezakhiwo kazwelonke, i-SANS kanye nomthetho ohlobene nemimedeli yesimo sendalo esakhiwayo; Inqubo yokuhlela amaphrojekthi, ukwenza uphando kanye nohlelo; Ukuphathwa kwezimali; Okuhlelekile kwezinto ezenziwayo, umphumela wamaphrojekthi, ukwenza izinqumela ezindabeni zomhlaba wonke jengoqotho; Ukubusa, ukuxhumana, ukuhlela nokuba kulesi sabahlanganyeli; Ukuze thenge izidingo kusebenza umbuso. Amakhono okulandelayo: Ukwenza izinqumela; Ukubusa iqembu; Izindlela zokuqonda; Ukuqamba izinto; Ukuzihlela; Ukuphathwa kwezimali; Ukuzinaka futhi uphendule abathengi; Ixhumo elihle; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Office); Ukuhlela nokuhlela abantu; Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga; Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqoqa inani; Ukuphatha abantu; Ukuphathwa koshintsho; Ukungafani; Ukuzithoba ukuhamba njalo; Ukuba nekono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi nokugcina amathemu; Ukuba nekono ukuba iqembu elisebenzayo ngenqubo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola ukusebenza kwesinhloli sokulinganisa izindleko: Qedisisa futhi gumede izibuyekezo, izivumelwan​z​o izihlolwa zokuqinisekisa kumadlela okulinganisa izindleko; Hlanganisa imizamo yokulinganisa izindleko kanye nokuhlanganisa kuzo zonke izinkalo ukuqinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa okuhamba kahle netheknoloji yamanje; Gcina ukusebenza kahle kwezomsebenzi wokulinganisa izindleko: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokulinganisa izindleko ngokunikeza izakhiwo, izindlela nezinsiza ezifanele; Hlela amazinga okulinganisa izindleko, izinkomba kanye namazinga enkonzo ngokuhloselwe inhlangano ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala okuphumelelayo; Qapha ukusebenza kahle kokulinganisa izindleko ngokuhloselwe inhlangano ukuqondisa noma ukuqondisa kabusha izinsiza zokulinganisa izindleko ukufeza izinhloso zenhlangano; Ukuphathwa kwezimali: Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokuphathwa kwezimali ukuze kufezekwe izinhloso ze-MTEF endaweni/ezinsizini zokulinganisa izindleko; Phatha okulandelayo: Isikhulu somsebenzi wezimali wamaphrojekthi wesimenuzo ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza okuphumelelayo ngokwezidingo nezinhloso zenhlangano; Inani elengeziwe lokuhweba kumuhlela namaphrojekthi ahlobene nesikhala; Sebenzisa ukwenziwa kweziphakamiso ezintsha ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwezinhlelo nokuze kuhambisana nemigomo yenhlangano; Sabala, qapha futhi lawula ukuchithwa ngokwesabelo ukuze kuphathwe kahle imali; Ukubusa: Sabala, qapha futhi lawula izinsiza; Hlela izibali zengozi futhi uphathe izingozi ezinkulu ngokwenqubo yokuphatha izingozi kanye nezidingo zenhlangano, unikeze izinsiza zobuchwepheshe zeziqu ezihlobene nokulinganisa izindleko ukuze kuncishwe izingozi ezikhona: Phathe futhi ufeze izinhlelo zokwabelana ulwazi ngokusekelwe izinhlelo zentuthuko yomuntu ngamunye, izidingo zomsebenzi kanye nenzalo yesitshali; Qapha ngokuqhubekayo ukushintshiselana kolwazi nokukuvikela phakathi kwezimenuzo nabantu ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kolwazi ngokwezinhloso komnyango. Ukuphathwa Kwabantu: Phatha intuthuko, ukukhuthaza nokusetshenziswa kabalulekile bensiza yabantu ngokwesikhala ukuze kuqiniseqise ukwaziswa okuqukethwe kusobala ukutholakala ngokulinganisa izindleko ngokwezidingo nezinhloso zenhlangano, phatha izindawo zokusebenza eziyisihluthulelo zabasebenzi ngokuhlela bese uqapha amazinga okusebenza bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa okungahambisani ukuze kufezeke izinhloso komnyango.

xh.title: NoMpephuli weeQondo zoMsebenzi oyiNqanaba eliPhezulu: IinfRAstrAka yezeMfundo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa uNoMpephuli weeQondo zoMsebenzi oyiNqanaba eliPhezulu ukulawula iiprojekthi zeziqulatho zeemfundo, kwaye kufuneka abe negunya elidibene nalenkalo, abhalwe kwi-SACQSP, aze aneminyaka emithandathu yamava.

af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma/B-Degree (equivalent of hoër kwalifikasie); PSIRA-registrasie minimum Grade B; 'n Minimum van 3 jaar relevante ervaring. Bevoegdhede: Bewese kennis en werkervaring van die volgende: Wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat 'n uitwerking het op die lynfunksies; Inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting wat verband hou met die lynfunksie; Projekbestuur; Operasionele bestuurspraktyke; Beleidsontwikkeling, en operasionele bestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse; Moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie; Openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels; Streeks- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape; Konstitusionele, regtelike en institutionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer; Openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, direktiewe en kollektiewe ooreenkomste; Werking van die Provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente/verwante funksionele areas; Beleide van die regering van die dag; Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en -regulasies; Control of access to public premises and vehicles Act, Act 53 of 1985; Occupational Health and Safety Act, Act 85 of 1993; Begrip van PSIRA; Criminal Procedure Act; Weapons and Ammunition Act; Springstowwe; Elektroniese sekuriteitsstelsel; Security officials Act, Act 92 of 1997. Vaardighede in die volgende: Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Menslike bestuur; Projekbestuur; Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling); Syferkundigheid; Geletterdheid.
af.duties: Koördineer fisiese sekuriteitsbedrywighede binne Western Cape Government-instellings en -fasiliteite; Koördineer die implementering van toegangskontroleprosedures om risiko te beperk; Rapporteer en ondersoek sekuriteitsvoorvalle en -oortredings; Moniteer en bestuur uitbestee sekuriteitsdiensverskaffers; Bestuurlike/Toezigfunksies.

zu.title: Onobhala-Jikelezelwe Obusiwe Wokuvikela: Ukuvikelwa Komzimba
zu.summary: Kudingeka Onobhala-Jikelezelwe Obusiwe Wokuvikela ukuze ahloboze imisebenzi yokuvikela komzimba nokulawula ukungena emakamelweni e-Western Cape Government, kufuneka abhalise kuma-PSIRA Grade B abe nenkulumo yesikhathi seminyaka eyisithupha yamava.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma/B-Degree ehambisana neminyaka engu-3 (iziqu ezilinganayo noma eziphezulu); Ukwabhalwa kuma-PSIRA ukuphela kwe-Grade B; Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 yamava ahambelanayo. Amakhono: Ulwazi olubonakaliswe nolwazi lokusebenza okuhambisana nalokhu: Umthetho, izimiso ezilawulayo, izinqubomgomo nezindlela ezinhle eziphathele kumisebenzi yemigqa; Izinhlelo zolwazi ezisiza ekuphathweni kolwazi nemininingwane ephathelene nomsebenzi wemigqa; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo; Izindlela zokuphathwa kwezindlela zokusebenza; Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, nokuphathwa, ukulawula nokubuyekeza izinhlela; Izimiso zamanje zokubusa nokuphathwa; Izinqubo, izindlela nezinhlelo zomphakathi; Izindaba zezombusazwe, amnozo, nezomphakathi zaseduze nasendaweni ezithinta ukuphathwa kwesifundazwe i-Western Cape; Izimiso zomthethosisekelo, zomthetho nezinhlelo eziphatha umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika; Izimali zomphakathi, izinsizakuxhumana nabantu, izinqubo zokuphathwa kwemibhalo; Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zahulumeni, Izimiso ze-National and Provincial Treasury, ezinye izinqubomgomo zezimali, imiyalo, iziqondiso, nezivumelwano zokuhlanganyela; Ukusebenza kwesifundazwe nemisebenzi yeminyango ekhaliphile/izindawo ezihlobene nalo; Izinqubomgomo kahulumeni wasesikhathini; Umthetho nezimiso ezibusa ubuhlobo bokusebenza; Umthetho Wokulawula Ukungena Kwindawo Zomphakathi Nezimoto, Umthetho Act 53 of 1985; Umthetho Wokuqinisekiswa Kwezempilo Nokuphepha Kusebenza, Act 85 of 1993; Ukuqonda i-PSIRA; Umthetho Wokuqhuba Icala Lombhalo; Umthetho Wezinsimbi Nezikhali; Izibhombu; Isimiso sokuvikela ngezentengo; Umthetho Wabavikeli Bokuphepha, Act 92 of 1997. Amakhono okusebenza kule mikhondolwana: Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kule Microsoft Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Ukuphathwa kabantu; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo; Amakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunwayo); Ukukwazi ukubala; Ukufunda nokubhala.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa izinsiza zokuvikelwa komzimba ngaphakathi kwezikhungo namakamelo i-Western Cape Government; Hlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zokulawula ukungena ukuze unciphise ingozi; Bika uphenye izehlakalo zokuphepha nezehlakalo eziphula izimiso; Buka uphathe abanikezeli besebenzi bokuvikela abangaphandle; Imisebenzi yokuphathwa/okuqondisa.

xh.title: NoQqobho Mkhosi Wohlaziyo Iindawo zokuSebenza
xh.summary: I-CEFO Physical Protection & Security Strategy idinga umntu onelwazi nangamandla okuyilawula nokuyilawula ngokupheleleyo inkqubo yamathandathu kubandakanya namaphulo amaninzi, idinga ukuqinisekiswa kwe-PSIRA Grade B nakwiiveki ezintathu zokusebenza.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma ye-3-year okanye i-B-Degree esemthethweni (okanye isifanekiso / ngaphezulu kwabo); Ukuqinisekiswa kwesiXhosa ngokusemthethweni okanye ukuzinza ngokusemthethweni ngokusemthethweni nokuzinza ngokusemthethweni; EsiNiba seQumrhu LemiCimba Lithetha ukuba abantu ababhala Iindaba bemithetho yaseNingizimu Afrika balifundise. I-National Diploma ye-3-year okanye i-B-Degree esemthethweni (okanye isifanekiso / ngaphezulu kwabo); Ukubhalwa kwe-PSIRA ubuncinane i-Grade B; Unyaka wokuqala wemisebenzi, kubandakanya imisebenzi yokubeka amathambo inqwenywa, ukuya kwisiphelo seenkcuba, ukucwangciswa kwezonyaka, ukubhalwa kwemisebenzi yokubeka amathambo, nokuphatha iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezibhaliweyo; Ulwazi ngemigaqo, urhwebo, imithetho nemigaqo-sikhokelo ehambelana nesebe; Iinkqubo zolwazi ezinceda ekulawulweni kolwazi nolwazi olumayela nesebe; Ukulawula amaphulo; Iinkqubo zolawulo loxhaso; Ukulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezingagqithiswa ngamaza afana nayo naymanye amacandelo njengoko kuchazwe kumthetho-siseko, kumthetho, nakumaxwebhu asuka kumazwe amathathu. Ulwazi ngokusebenza ngokwemigaqo yamathetho yaseNingizimu Afrika, okuqinisekiswa ngamagunya asuka kumazwe amathathu kwesiXhosa.
xh.duties: Coordin imisebenzi yokhuseleko ngaphezu kwemifanekiso phantse esiKholoni nakwiiNcwadana zalo; Coordinate and implement protocols for managing external threats on departmental premises; Report and investigate security incidents; Coordinate physical security operations within Western Cape Government institutions and facilities; Coordinate the implementation of access control procedures to mitigate risk; Report and investigate security incidents and breaches; Monitor and manage outsourced security service providers; Managerial/Supervisory functions.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Policy and Strategy
jobs.centre: Department of the Premier, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Chief Director: Policy and Strategy position at the Department of the Premier, Western Cape, requiring NQF Level 7 qualification and five years' senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: A Qualification at NQF Level 7 as recognised by SAQA; A minimum of 5 years relevant senior management level experience. Competencies: Proven working knowledge and relevant working experience of the following: Legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions; Information systems; Procurement and tendering processes; Policy development, and strategy management, monitoring and review processes; Modern systems of governance and administration; Global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape; The functioning of the Province and the activities of sister departments. Core Competencies: Strategic Capability and leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management and Change Management. Skills: Networking and network formation skills; Conceptual and formulation skills; Leadership skills with specific reference to the ability to display thought leadership in complex applications; Team building and strong interpersonal skills; Planning, organising and people management skills.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic management, advice and guidance in respect of the following functional areas: Facilitate the conducting of high-level policy analysis: Transversal coordination, management and promotion of innovative and evidence-based policy and strategy development, planning, implementation, and review. Facilitate the research and analysis of the provincial policy environment and identify critical areas for provincial government intervention, including futures capability. Analyse national and provincial policies, strategies and laws, and prepare provincial responses. Analyse on-going national policy and strategy developments, and sensitise Cabinet, Sector Committees and departments on its implications for the province. Facilitate the development of transversal provincial policies as may be required (including stakeholder consultation as required). Ensure that WCG legislation, policies and strategies align with the Provincial Strategic Plan and long-term plans. Facilitate the periodic review of the Provincial Strategic Plan in line with prescribed strategic planning and budgetary processes. Initiate and manage transversal futures modelling research. Ensure that WCG legislation, policies and strategies align and comply with human rights principles and with international, constitutional and national human rights obligations, policies and strategies. Support the provincial executive in respect of provincial human social development strategy: Facilitate and coordinate the collation of the Provincial Strategic Plan for the Human Development (HD) Social Sector. Advise in consultation with Provincial Treasury on the macro prioritisation of the provincial budget in line with provincial strategic priorities for the HD Social Sector. Facilitate the initiation of new integrated government programmes and projects in pursuance of provincial strategic priorities for the HD Social Sector as required. Advise on the alignment of HD Social Sector and departmental strategic plans, as well as integrated development plans, with provincial strategic priorities. Continuously assess progress with the implementation of HD Sector provincial programmes, projects and plans, and advise on the management of blockages. Advise the Premier, Cabinet and departments on performance variances, and recommend corrective actions for the HD Sector. Coordinate support for the Premier and DG in their participation in intergovernmental structures and forums for the HD Social Sector. Support the provincial executive in respect of provincial economic strategy: Facilitate and coordinate the collation of the Provincial Strategic Plan for the Economic Sector. Advise in consultation with Provincial Treasury on the macro prioritisation of the provincial budget in line with provincial strategic priorities for the Economic Sector. Facilitate the initiation of new integrated government programmes and projects in pursuance of provincial strategic priorities for the Economic Sector as required. Advise on the alignment of Economic Sector and departmental strategic plans, as well as integrated development plans, with provincial strategic priorities. Continuously assess progress with the implementation of Economic Sector provincial programmes, projects and plans, and advise on the management of blockages. Advise the Premier, Cabinet and departments on performance variances, and recommend corrective actions for the Economic Sector. Coordinate support for the Premier and DG in their participation in intergovernmental structures and forums for the Economic Sector. Manage integrated provincial strategic planning: Advise on the alignment of departmental strategic and annual performance plans as well as integrated development plans with provincial strategic priorities. Facilitate the development and periodic review of the provincial strategic plan in line with prescribed strategic planning and budgetary processes. Advise, in consultation with the Provincial Treasury, on the policy prioritisation of the provincial budget in line with provincial strategic priorities. Change Management, People Management, Financial Management.

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Beleid en Strategie
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur: Beleid en Strategie-pos by die Department of the Premier, Western Cape, wat 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 soos erken deur SAQA; 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring op senior bestuursvlak. Bevoegdhede: Bewese werklike kennis en relevante werkervaring van die volgende: Wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat betrekking het op die lynfunksies; Inligtingstelsels; Aanbesteding en tendervwerwerwingsprosesse; Beleidontwikkeling en strategiebestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse; Moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie; Globale, streeks- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n impak het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape; Die funksionering van die Provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente. Kernebevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Mensebestuur en bemagtiging, Program- en projekbestuur, Finansiële bestuur en Veranderingsbestuur. Vaardighede: Netwerk- en netwerkvormingsvaardighede; Konseptuele en formuleringvaardighede; Leierskapsvaardighede met spesifieke verwysing na die vermoë om denke-leierskap in komplekse toepassings te toon; Spanbou- en sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede; Beplannings-, organisasie- en mensebestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese bestuur, advies en leiding ten opsigte van die volgende funksionele areas: Fasiliteer die uitvoer van hoëvlak-beleidsanalise: Dwarslopende koördinering, bestuur en bevordering van innoverende en bewysgebaseerde beleid- en strategieontwikkeling, beplanning, implementering en hersiening. Fasiliteer die navorsing en analise van die provinsiale beleidsomgewing en identifiseer kritieke areas vir provinsiale regeringsintervensie, insluitend toekomsvermoë. Analiseer nasionale en provinsiale beleide, strategieë en wette, en berei provinsiale response voor. Analiseer voortdurende nasionale beleid- en strategieontwikkelings, en sensitiseer die Kabinet, Sektorkomitees en departemente oor die implikasies daarvan vir die provinsie. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van dwarslopende provinsiale beleide soos benodig (insluitend belanghebbende konsultasie soos benodig). Verseker dat WCG-wetgewing, beleide en strategieë in ooreenstemming is met die Provinsiale Strategiese Plan en langtermynplanne. Fasiliteer die periodieke hersiening van die Provinsiale Strategiese Plan in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe strategiese beplannings- en begrotingsprosesse. Inisieer en bestuur dwarslopende toekomsmodelleringnavorsing. Verseker dat WCG-wetgewing, beleide en strategieë in ooreenstemming en nakoming is met menseregte-beginsels en met internasionale, grondwetlike en nasionale menseregte-verpligtinge, beleide en strategieë. Ondersteun die provinsiale uitvoerende gesag ten opsigte van die provinsiale menslike sosiale ontwikkelingsstrategie: Fasiliteer en koördineer die samestelling van die Provinsiale Strategiese Plan vir die Menslike Ontwikkeling (HD) Sosiale Sektor. Adviseer in oorleg met Provincial Treasury oor die makro-prioritisering van die provinsiale begroting in ooreenstemming met provinsiale strategiese prioriteite vir die HD Sosiale Sektor. Fasiliteer die inisiëring van nuwe geïntegreerde regeringsprogramme en -projekte ter nastrewing van provinsiale strategiese prioriteite vir die HD Sosiale Sektor soos benodig. Adviseer oor die belyning van HD Sosiale Sektor- en departementele strategiese planne, asook geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsplanne, met provinsiale strategiese prioriteite. Assesseer voortdurend vordering met die implementering van HD Sektor provinsiale programme, projekte en planne, en adviseer oor die bestuur van blokkades. Adviseer die Premier, Kabinet en departemente oor prestasieafwykings, en beveel regstellende maatreëls vir die HD Sektor aan. Koördineer ondersteuning vir die Premier en DG in hul deelname aan interregeringsstrukture en -forums vir die HD Sosiale Sektor. Ondersteun die provinsiale uitvoerende gesag ten opsigte van die provinsiale ekonomiese strategie: Fasiliteer en koördineer die samestelling van die Provinsiale Strategiese Plan vir die Ekonomiese Sektor. Adviseer in oorleg met Provincial Treasury oor die makro-prioritisering van die provinsiale begroting in ooreenstemming met provinsiale strategiese prioriteite vir die Ekonomiese Sektor. Fasiliteer die inisiëring van nuwe geïntegreerde regeringsprogramme en -projekte ter nastrewing van provinsiale strategiese prioriteite vir die Ekonomiese Sektor soos benodig. Adviseer oor die belyning van Ekonomiese Sektor- en departementele strategiese planne, asook geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsplanne, met provinsiale strategiese prioriteite. Assesseer voortdurend vordering met die implementering van Ekonomiese Sektor provinsiale programme, projekte en planne, en adviseer oor die bestuur van blokkades. Adviseer die Premier, Kabinet en departemente oor prestasieafwykings, en beveel regstellende maatreëls vir die Ekonomiese Sektor aan. Koördineer ondersteuning vir die Premier en DG in hul deelname aan interregeringsstrukture en -forums vir die Ekonomiese Sektor. Bestuur geïntegreerde provinsiale strategiese beplanning: Adviseer oor die belyning van departementele strategiese en jaarlikse prestasieplanne asook geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsplanne met provinsiale strategiese prioriteite. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en periodieke hersiening van die provinsiale strategiese plan in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe strategiese beplannings- en begrotingsprosesse. Adviseer, in oorleg met die Provincial Treasury, oor die beleidsprioritisering van die provinsiale begroting in ooreenstemming met provinsiale strategiese prioriteite. Veranderingsbestuur, Mensebestuur, Finansiële bestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohamba Phambili: Amacebo kanye noMgomo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi ohamba phambili: Amacebo kanye noMgomo esikhundleni kwi-Department of the Premier, Western Cape, esidinga izifundo ezingazinga le-NQF Level 7 kanye nosuku lweminyaka elingu-5 loluhambo lwabaphathi abaphezulu.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingazinga le-NQF Level 7 njengoba kudunyiswe yi-SAQA; Umkhawulo osukwela unyaka wengu-5 wokuhlangabezana kwesikhathi eside ezingeni lomphathi ophakeme. Amandla: Ulwazi olusebenzayo olubonakaliswe kanye nokuqashelisa okuhlobene kokusebenza okulandelayo: Umthetho, izinhlela zolawulo, izinhlelo zokuqondisa kanye namasiko ahamba phambili anomthelela emisebenzini ohambisana nayo; Izinhlela zolwazi; Izenzo zokuthenga kanye nezenzo zokuqashelisa okuthengiswayo; Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqondisa, kanye nolawulo lwebalwe, ukuqashelisa kanye nokuqedwa kwezenhlama; Izinhlela zokubusa nezolawulo zamanje namuhla; Izindaba zezombusazwe, zezomnotho kanye nezomphakathi emhlabeni jikelele, esifundeni nasedolobheni ezinomthelela kahulumeni wasifundazwe we-Western Cape; Ukusebenza kwesifundazwe kanye nemisebenzi yeminyango ehlangene. Amandla Ayisisekelo: Amandla Nokuba Nhloko kokuqondisa, Ulawulo Bantu kanye Nokugcwalisa Amandla, Ulawulo Lemihlelo Namaphrojekthi, Ulawulo Wezimali kanye Nolawulo Lwoshintsho. Amandla: Amandla okuxhumanisa kanye nokwakheka koxhumano; Amandla okucabanga nokuveza; Amandla okuba nhloko ngokuqondisa ngokwekhono lokubonisa ukuba nhloko kwizicelo ezinzima; Amandla okwakha iqhaza kanye namandla aphakeme okuzidibanisa nabantu; Amandla okuhlela, ukuqoqa kanye nokuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Nikela nokuqondiswa okuyinhloko, icebo nenselelo ngokwalokhu okulandelayo emikhakheni yemisebenzi: Sebenzisa ukwenziwa kokuhlaziya kwezinhlelo zokuqondisa ngokwazinga eliphezulu: Ukuqondisa okuvuka kumakhulu omkhakha, ulawulo nokukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqondisa namacebo okusekelwe kubuqotho nasezintweni ezintsha, ukuhlela, ukuqashelisa nokubuyekeza. Sebenzisa ucwaningo nokuhlaziya kwendawo yezinhlelo zokuqondisa zasifundazwe bese ukhomba izindawo ezibalulekile zokungenelela kahulumeni wasifundazwe, okuhlanganisa n’amandla okubuka phambili. Hlaziya izinhlelo zokuqondisa, amacebo nomthetho kazwelonke nasasifundazwe, bese ulungisa izimpendulo zasifundazwe. Hlaziya intuthuko eziqhubekayo zezinhlelo zokuqondisa namacebo kazwelonke, bese umenyezela iKhabhinethi, Amakomidi Abahlukanisiwe kanye neminyango ngomthelela wawo esifundazweni. Sebenzisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqondiza zasifundazwe ezivuka emakhakheni njengoba kudingeka (okuhlanganisa nokubonisana nabahlanganyeli njengoba kudingeka). Qinisekisa ukuthi umthetho, izinhlelo zokuqondisa namacebo e-WCG ahambisana neNhlelo Yokuhlakanipha Yasifundazwe namacebo okuhamba isikhathi eside. Sebenzisa ukubuyekewa kwesikhathi esithile kweNhlelo Yokuhlakanipha Yasifundazwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlama zokuqondisa ezibekiwe nokuqashelisa kwezimali. Qala bese uphatha ucwaningo lokumodela kwesikhathi esizayo okuvuka emakhulu omkhakha. Qinisekisa ukuthi umthetho, izinhlelo zokuqondisa namacebo e-WCG ahambisana futhi ahambisana nemigomo Yamalungelo Abantu kanye nezibopho zamalungelo abantu emazweni aphesheya, emthethosisekelo nasekazwelonke, izinhlelo zokuqondisa namacebo. Sekela abaphathi basifundazwe ngokwale nhlelo yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi yamalungelo abantu: Sebenzisa futhi uqondise ukuqoqa kweNhlelo Yokuhlakanipha Yasifundazwe yomKhakha Wezentuthuko Yabantu (HD) Wolwazi. Etsa izeluleko ngokubonisana neSikhwama Sezimali Sasifundazwe ngokubaluleka kwezimali zasifundazwe ngokwamaphuzu ahlakaniphile asifundazwe azele umKhakha Wezentuthuko Yabantu Wolwazi. Sebenzisa ukuqala kwemihlelo emisha kahulumene ehlangene kanye namaphrojekthi ekufezeni amaphuzu ahlukaniphile asifundazwe azele umKhakha Wezentuthuko Yabantu Wolwazi njengoba kudingeka. Etsa izeluleko ngokuqondiswa kweNhlelo Yokuhlakanipha YomKhakha Wezentuthuko Yabantu kanye nezinhlelo zokuqondisa zeminyango, kanye namacebo entuthuko ahlangene, ngokwamaphuzu ahlakaniphile asifundazwe. Hlola njalo inqubo yokufeza imihlelo yasifundazwe yomKhakha Wezentuthuko Yabantu, amaphrojekthi namacebo, bese etsa izeluleko ngokuqondisa kwesithiyo. Etsa izeluleko kuNdunankulu, Khabhinethi kanye neminyango ngokwehluka kokusebenza, bese uncoma izinyatholo zokulungisa azele umKhakha Wezentuthuko Yabantu. Qondisa ukusekela iNdunankulu ne-DG ekubameni kwabo ngokwemikhakha yohulumene ohlangene namafulemu azele umKhakha Wezentuthuko Yabantu Wolwazi. Sekela abaphathi basifundazwe ngokwale nhlelo yezomnotho yasifundazwe: Sebenzisa futhi uqondise ukuqoqa kweNhlelo Yokuhlakanipha Yasifundazwe yomKhakha Wezomnotho. Etsa izeluleko ngokubonisana neSikhwama Sezimali Sasifundazwe ngokubaluleka kwezimali zasifundazwe ngokwamaphuzu ahlakaniphile asifundazwe azele umKhakha Wezomnotho. Sebenzisa ukuqala kwemihlelo emisha kahulumene ehlangene kanye namaphrojekthi ekufezeni amaphuzu ahlukaniphile asifundazwe azele umKhakha Wezomnotho njengoba kudingeka. Etsa izeluleko ngokuqondiswa kweNhlelo Yokuhlakanipha YomKhakha Wezomnotho kanye nezinhlelo zokuqondisa zeminyango, kanye namacebo entuthuko ahlangene, ngokwamaphuzu ahlakaniphile asifundazwe. Hlola njalo inqubo yokufeza imihlelo yasifundazwe yomKhakha Wezomnotho, amaphrojekthi namacebo, bese etsa izeluleko ngokuqondisa kwesithiyo. Etsa izeluleko kuNdunankulu, Khabhinethi kanye neminyango ngokwehluka kokusebenza, bese uncoma izinyatholo zokulungisa azele umKhakha Wezomnotho. Qondisa ukusekela iNdunankulu ne-DG ekubameni kwabo ngokwemikhakha yohulumene ohlangene namafulemu azele umKhakha Wezomnotho. Phatha ukuhlelwa kwenhlelo yokuhlakanipha yasifundazwe ehlangene: Etsa izeluleko ngokuqondiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqondisa nemihlelo yomsebenzi yonyaka kanye namacebo entuthuko ahlangene ngokwamaphuzu ahlakaniphile asifundazwe. Sebenzisa ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekeka kwesikhathi esithile kwenhlelo yokuhlakanipha yasifundazwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlama zokuqondisa ezibekiwe nokuqashelisa kwezimali. Etsa izeluleko, ngokubonisana neSikhwama Sezimali Sasifundazwe, ngokuqondisa kwezimali zasifundazwe ngokwamaphuzu ahlakaniphile asifundazwe. Ulawulo Loshintsho, Ulawulo Babantu, Ulawulo Wezimali.

xh.title: Umlawuli Omkhulu: IInqgela noMgaqo-nkqubo
xh.summary: Isithuba somLawuli oMkhulu: IInqgela noMgaqo-nkqubo kwisebe leaPremier, Western Cape, sifuna isifundo seNQF Level 7 kunye neminye emi-5 yamava abaphathi abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo kumaNQF Level 7 esamkelwe yi-SAQA; Ubuncinane beminye emi-5 yamava abalawuli abaphezulu abahambelanayo. Iakhono: Ulwazi olusebenzayo olubonisiweyo namava ohambiweyo ahambelanayo kwezilandelayo: Izicelo somthetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinqgela ezizezona endlela elungileyo ezinomthelela kumisebenzi yomgca; Iinkqubo zolwazi; Iinkqubo zokuthenga nasekubuyisweni kweminikelo; Ukwenza iinqgela, nolawulo lomgama wokuqhuba, ukuqwalasela nokuhlola iinkqubo; Iinkqubo zolawulo nolawulo lwamanyango zanamhlanje; Izinto zepolitiki, izinto ezikwinqanaba lethutyana, lelakwindla nendawo ezithintela urhulumente wephondo le Western Cape; Indlela esebenza ngayo iPhondo nemisebenzi yamanye amasebe. IiKhono eziNgundoqo: Ikhono lokulawula nokuqhuba ngomgama, uLawulo lwabantu noMandiso, uLawulo lweNkqubo namaPhojekthi, uLawulo lweMali noLawulo lokuTshintsha. Iakhono: Iakhono zokudibanisa nabantu nokuqweba iintsingiselo; Iakhono zokuqamba nokuvelisa iingcamango; Iakhono zokuqhuba ngokukodwa ngesalathiso ekubeni kukhona ikhono lokubonisa ukuba ngumphathi weengcinga kwiinkqubo ezinzima; Iakhono zokwakha iqela nezobuntu ezomeleleyo phakathi kwabantu; Iakhono zokuqamba, zolungiselelo nolawulo lwabantu.
xh.duties: Nikezela ngolawulo lomgama, ngengcebiso nokuqondisa ngezicelo ezingamagunya ala alandelayo: Qhubeza ukuqwalaselwa kweNqgela ezingaziwa kakhulu: Ukuqhubekeka phakathi kweendawo, ulawulo lokhuthazo lokwenza iinqgela ezitsha nangolwazi eziseziseni nangomgama wokuqhuba, ukucwangcisa, ukuze kusebenze, nokuqwalaselwa kwazo. Qhubeza uphando nokuqwalaselwa kwendawo yemigaqo yephondo, ukhulule iindawo ezibalulekileyo zingenelelo lurhulumente wephondo, kuquka nakhono okubonisa okuzakwenzayo. Qwalasela imigaqo yesizwe nasephondweni, iimgama nomthetho, uze ulungiselele iimpendulo zephondo. Qwalasela imigaqo yethutyana yonke yezizwe nesezumphumo wezakuqhuba, uze uxhase iKhomishoni, iiKomiti nesebe ngemiphumela yawo kwiphondo. Qhubeza ukwenziwa kweemigaqo yephondo ekuqhubekeka phakathi kweendawo, kufuneka kubekho (kuquka naxesha elithile lokuxoxwa nabantu njengoko kufuneka). Qinisekisa ukuba umthetho we-WCG, iinqgela nomgama oqhuba kuhambelana neNqgela yeQhobo lasePhondo nakhono eziqhuba ixesha elide. Qhubeza ukuhlolwa kwexesha nangesixa seNqgela yeQhobo lasePhondo ngokuhambelana nendlela ecetyiweyo yokucwangcisa ngomgama nokuqhuba imali. Qalisa uze ulawule uphando lokuqamba iindlela zangomso ekuqhubekeka phakathi kweendawo. Qinisekisa ukuba umthetho we-WCG, iinqgela nomgama oqhuba kuhambelana nangomthetho weelungelo zabantu nangeminye imithetho yamazwe ngamazwe, yoMthethosiseko nowesizwe malungana nelungelo labantu, iinqgela nakhona. Xhasa urhulumente uphawu wephondo malunga neNqgela yephondo yokuphuhlisa isigaba sabantu ekuhambelana nemiba yemikhakha ehlobene: Qhubeza uze ulawule ukuqokelelwa kweNqgela yeQhobo lasePhondo yokuPhuhlisa abantu ekuhambelana nesigaba sabantu. Copa ngokubonisana noMlawuli weeMali wePhondo malunga neNxulumaniso namaphakamiso obuncinane beholo yephondo ngokuhambelana namaphakamiso aphambili ephondo kusigaba sabantu. Qhubeza ukuqaliswa kweenkqubo nokuqhuba amaphojekthi ahlukeneyo alawulwayo urhulumente ukufezwa amaphakamiso aphambili ephondo kusigaba sabantu njengoko kufuneka. Nika isalathiso malunga nokuhambelana kweNqgela yomgama wokuqhuba yesebe esigabeni sabantu, nangakumbi amacwangciso abakhululekileyo, namaphakamiso aphambili ephondo. Qhubeka uqwalasela inkqubo kwindlela yokuphumeza amaphojekthi, iinkqubo namacwangciso ayo yonke imikhakha yoluntu ephondweni, uze uthethe ngolawulo lokuvala izikrwele. Nika isalathiso kuPremier, eKhabinedi nasebengi ngokwahluka kwemiphumela, uze uzeke izinyuzelo zokuqwalasela kusigaba sabantu. Lawula inkxaso kaPremier noDG ekubeni kwabo ngabathathi nxaxheba kubumbano olusezantsi nasezikhundleni zoluntu ekuphuhliseni isigaba sabantu. Xhasa urhulumente uphawu wephondo malunga neNqgela yephondo yokuphuhlisa isigaba sokuqhuba imali: Qhubeza uze ulawule ukuqokelelwa kweNqgela yeQhobo lasePhondo kusigaba sobuRhwebo. Nika isalathiso ngokubonisana noMlawuli weeMali wePhondo malunga neNxulumaniso namaphakamiso obuncinane beholo yephondo ngokuhambelana namaphakamiso aphambili ephondo kusigaba sobuRhwebo. Qhubeza ukuqaliswa kweenkqubo nokuqhuba amaphojekthi ahlukeneyo alawulwayo urhulumente ukufezwa amaphakamiso aphambili ephondo kusigaba sobuRhwebo njengoko kufuneka. Nika isalathiso malunga nokuhambelana kweNqgela yomgama wokuqhuba yesebe kusigaba sobuRhwebo, nangakumbi amacwangciso abakhululekileyo, namaphakamiso aphambili ephondo. Qhubeka uqwalasela inkqubo kwindlela yokuphumeza amaphojekthi, iinkqubo namacwangciso ayo yonke imikhakha yezoqoqosho ephondweni, uze uthethe ngolawulo lokuvala izikrwele. Nika isalathiso kuPremier, eKhabinedi nasebengi ngokwahluka kwemiphumela, uze uzeke izinyuzelo zokuqwalasela kusigaba sobuRhwebo. Lawula inkxaso kaPremier noDG ekubeni kwabo ngabathathi nxaxheba kubumbano olusezantsi nasezikhundleni zoluntu ekusigabeni sobuRhwebo. Lawula amacwangciso ahambelana oqhuba ngomgama ephondweni: Nika isalathiso malunga nokuhambelana kwamacwangciso omgama abalawuli kunye namacwangciso eminyaka yonke yokuphumeza, nangakumbi amacwangciso abakhululekileyo namaphakamiso aphambili ephondo. Qhubeza ukwenziwa nokuqwalaselwa ngesixa sexesha leNqgela yephondo ngokuhambelana nendlela ecetyiweyo yokucwangcisa ngomgama nokuqhuba imali. Nika isalathiso, ngokubonisana noMlawuli weeMali wePhondo, malunga neNqgela ngamaphakamiso amakhulu ephondo ngokuhambelana namaphakamiso aphambili ephondo. uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo abaNtu, uLawulo lweMali.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Priority Unit
jobs.centre: Department of the Premier, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 - R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), all-inclusive salary package
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed in the Western Cape to lead talent acquisition consulting, project management and quality control within the Priority Unit.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (National Diploma/B-degree) in Human Resource Management or Industrial Psychology; A minimum of 3 years’ experience at managerial level within a human resource management environment. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: National and Provincial instruments and legislation pertaining to human resources management with specific reference to the Public Service Amendment Act, Public Service Regulations and Labour Relations Act, all Bargaining Council resolutions and Public Service Commission (PSC) guidelines; Ability to maintain the highly confidential nature of people management work; Ability to travel for various meetings and maintain flexible work schedule; Demonstrate resourcefulness and initiative in dealing with daily challenges; ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Communication (written and verbal) skills in at least two of the three official languages of the Western Cape.
jobs.duties: Provide a talent acquisition consulting service and service benefits support in respect of Heads of Departments, senior managers and employees within ministerial offices; project management, quality control of and report on all work within the Priority Unit; Ensure the publication of advertisements in various media; Facilitate the compilation of advertisements and pre-selection questionnaires; Facilitate the recruitment and selection process, inclusive of shortlisting, case studies, competency-based interviews, competency assessments and personnel suitability checks.
jobs.enquiries: Ms T Viljoen @ Thora.Viljoen@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. af.title: Onderdirekteur: Prioriteitseenheid
af.summary: Onderdirekteur benodig in die Western Cape om talentverkrywing-konsultasie, projekbestuur en gehaltebeheer binne die Prioriteitseenheid te lei.
af.requirements: Toepaslike 3-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma/B-graad) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of Bedryfsielkunde; 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op bestuursvlak binne 'n menslike hulpbronbestuursomgewing. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Nasionale en Provinsiale instrumente en wetgewing met betrekking tot menslike hulpbronbestuur met spesifieke verwysing na die Public Service Amendment Act, Public Service Regulations en Labour Relations Act, alle Bargaining Council-resolusies en Public Service Commission (PSC)-riglyne; Vermoe om die hoogs vertroulike aard van mensebestuurswerk te handhaaf; Vermoe om vir verskeie vergaderings te reis en 'n buigsaam werkskedule te handhaaf; Toon vindingrykheid en initiatief in die hantering van daaglikse uitdagings; vermoe om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom. Kommunikasie (skriftelike en mondelinge) vaardighede in ten minste twee van die drie amptelike tale van die Western Cape.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n talentverkryging-konsultasiediens en diensvoordele-ondersteuning ten opsigte van Hoofde van Departemente, senior bestuurders en werknemers binne ministeriële kantore; projekbestuur, gehaltebeheer van en verslag doen oor alle werk binne die Prioriteitseenheid; Verseker die publikasie van advertensies in verskeie media; Fasiliteer die samestelling van advertensies en voorkeusevraelyste; Fasiliteer die werwing- en keuringsproses, inklusief kortlyssamesstelling, gevallestudies, bevoegdheidsgebaseerde onderhoude, bevoegdheidsassessering en personeelgeskiktheidskontroles.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esikhulu Sezwi: Iyunithi Yokuqasha Abantu Abaphambili
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isikhulu Esikhulu Sezwi Western Cape ukuqasha abantu abaphambili ukuba siholele ekuletheni izindaba ezinhle mayelana nabasebenzi, kuphathe imiklombe futhi lilawule ikhwalithi eyinhloko kuleziYunithi Yokuqasha Abantu Abaphambili.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngolwazi ngokuba ngumuntu okwesikhashana oqashwa abantu abanamandla kanti njalo unike ngezinkokhelo ezingabonwa ngabantu abanjengabantu abaphezulu namaphoyisa nezikhulu ezinkulu; lawula imiklombe kanti futhi uhlole ikhwalithi bese uchaza ngemisebenzi yonke esebenzayo ekuqashwenziweni kwabantu abakhulu; qinisekisa ukuthi izikhangiso zibhalwe kumaphephandaba ahlukene; qedela izikhangiso namafomu okukhetha ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukwenza; facilite ukuthi kubakhethwe abantu abangaba ngabasebenzi kanti njalo bahlolelwe ukuthi bafanele yini ngokwamandla abanawo, njalo kwenzakale izivivinyo ezinjengokuba ngumphakathi ngokuqonda noma ngokwenza imisebenzi egqamisa izinto abazikwaziyo kanti njalo kwenzakale nezivivinyo ezifana nokuhlolelwa ukuthi umuntu uyimfihlo yini noma cha.

xh.title: Isebe leNqanaba eliPhezulu: Icandelo loPheliselo lweMisebenzi ePhambili
xh.summary: Kufuneka iSebe eliya kuba nguMlawuli ongoyena nkokeli kwiWestern Cape ukuba alawule ukucecesa ngokufumana abantu abanolwazi, ulawulo lweprojekthi nolawulo lomgangatho ngaphakathi kwecandelo elipheleleyo lemisebenzi ephambili.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo zeminyaka emi-3 zemfundo ephakamileyo (iNational Diploma/isidanga se-B) kwilawulo loLuntu okuyilo nomthetho weNhlangano yoluntu; Amava amabalwa kwiminyaka elithathu elithatha inqanaba lolawulo kwinkqubo yoluntu. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngemigaqo kunye nemithetho yoluntu ngokubhekiselele kumthetho yoluntu ojikeleze iNdlu yoMthetho yaseBurhulumente kunye noMthetho wezeLwazi zoLuntu oqhutshwa yiNkundla yoLuntu, iNdlu yoMthetho yaseBurhulumente nayasePhondo, iMithetho yokuLawula abantu baseRiphabhlikhi, noMthetho woQoqosho loluntu, izigqibo zonke zeBargaining Council kunye neen inkqubo zeNdlu yoMthetho yaseBurhulumente (PSC); Ulwazi lokugcina imfihlelo ngokumalunga nolawulo lwabantu abasebenzayo; Ulwazi lokuzinceda ngokuhamba kwindawo ezahlukeneyo ukuya kwiintlanganiso ezahlukeneyo, nokwenza ishedyule yokusebenza ekutheni ihambelane nemiqathango yayo; Ukubakho buchule ekubeni uyakwazi ukuzimela nasemsebenzini wakho, ukuqonda ukuba uyifunda ntoni na kwicala lakho, nokuba nokuzimisela yokwenza izinto ezingekoyo ngokwakho; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngaphantsi kokunzima nokuba nefuthe lokuphumeza iinkqubo ngexesha elitsha kwithuba lakho. Ukuzithetha nokubhala kalula kwezinye iilwimi ezimbini kwezilwimi ezintathu ezisemthethweni zaseWestern Cape.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkonzo yokucecesa ngokufumana abantu abanolwazi, nokubakhuthaza ngokunika izibonelelo ezingezizo zeemfuno ngokubaluleka kwiNhloko zeeSebe, abalawuli abaphezulu, kunye namasebenzi abakho kwindawo abayiyo; ukulawula iiprojekthi, ukulawula umgangatho wemisebenzi yonke ekw icandelo elipheleleyo lemisebenzi ephambili, nokwenza ingxelo ngemisebenzi yonke ekuyo; ukuqinisekisa ukushicilelwa kweenkcazelo zemisebenzi kolunye uhlobo lwemixhosto; ukukhuthaza ulungelelwaniso lweenkcazelo zemisebenzi nemicelo yokukhetha ngaphambi kokungena emsebenzini; ukukhuthaza inkqubo yokuzama abantu abathanda ukungena emsebenzini nokuqokelela abantu abathanda ukungena, okuquka ukwenza uluhlu lwabafake iinkcazelo zemisebenzi, izifundo ezibalulekileyo, iintlanganiso ngokumisela ulwazi oluthile, ukuvavanya olunye ulwazi lomntu ofuna ukungena, nokuvavanywa kokufaneleka komntu ofuna ukungena emsebenzini.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Secretariat Services
jobs.centre: Department of the Premier, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 - R1098 195 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director providing secretariat and executive decision-making support to governance structures within the Western Cape Department of the Premier.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year Tertiary qualification (National Diploma/B-Degree or higher qualification) on NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA; A minimum of 3 years relevant Management experience. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of the following: decision support systems; the latest advances in public management theory and practice; policy analysis, policy development, and operational management, monitoring and review processes; the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions; information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function; and project management; operational management practices; procurement and tendering processes; modern systems of governance and administration; public service procedures, processes and systems; the regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape; Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector; public finance, human resources and discourse management processes; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements; the functioning of the province and the activities of sister departments/related functional areas; Knowledge and understanding of the policies of the government of the day; Labour Relations legislation and regulations; performance management in general.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of secretariat and logistical support to executive structures; Manage the provision of executive decision-making support; Manage the provision of executive governance and compliance support; Plan and manage the work of and account for the overall performance of the Sub- directorate: which includes planning; organising; monitoring, evaluation and reporting; records and information management; people management; which includes recruitment and selection; training; performance management; mentoring and coaching; discipline; and financial management; which includes budget; assets; procurement; and monitoring and evaluation.
jobs.enquiries: Mr C Ahmed @ Caushiem.Ahmed@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Sekretariatsdienste
af.summary: Onderdirekteur wat sekretariats- en uitvoerende besluitnemingsondersteuning verskaf aan bestuursstrukture binne die Western Cape Department of the Premier.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte 3-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma/B-Grade of hoër kwalifikasie) op NQF vlak 6 soos erken deur SAQA; 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se relevante bestuurservaring. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van die volgende: besluitnemondersteuningstelsels; die jongste vooruitgang in openbare bestuurstorie en -praktyk; beleidsontleding, beleidsontwikkeling, en operasionele bestuur, moniterings- en hersieningsprosesse; die wetgewing, regulerende raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat betrekking het op die lynfunksies; inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting rakende die lynfunksie; en projekbestuur; operasionele bestuurspraktyke; verkryging en aanbiedingsprosesse; moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie; openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels; die streeks- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape; Konstitusionele, regs- en institusionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer; openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, direktiewe en kollektiewe ooreenkomste; die funksionering van die provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente/verwante funksionele areas; Kennis en begrip van die beleide van die regering van die dag; Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en -regulasies; prestasiebestuur in die algemeen.
af.duties: Bestuur die voorsiening van sekretariaats- en logistieke ondersteuning aan uitvoerende strukture; Bestuur die voorsiening van uitvoerende besluitnemingsondersteuning; Bestuur die voorsiening van uitvoerende bestuurs- en nakomingsondersteuning; Beplan en bestuur die werk van en reken vir die algehele prestasie van die Subdirektoraat: wat beplanning insluit; organiserende; monitering, evaluering en verslagdoening; rekords en inligtingsbestuur; personeelbestuur; wat werwing en seleksie insluit; opleiding; prestasiebestuur; mentorskap en afrigting; dissipline; en finansiële bestuur; wat begroting insluit; bates; verkryging; en monitering en evaluering.

zu.title: Isikhundla sePhini likaMqondisi: Izenzelo zeSikhokelo
zu.summary: Phini likaMqondisi ohlinzeka ngesenzo sokwesekela ukwenza izinqumo eziphathelene nezinhlobo zokuphatha ngaphakathi kwe-Western Cape Department of the Premier.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole samabanga aphakeme ezithathwa eminyakeni emithathu (National Diploma/B-Degree noma iziqu eziphakeme) ezingeni le-NQF 6 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA; Okungenani ungamava okuphatha okuhlobene nalokhu okungu-3 iminyaka. Izindlela zokusebenza: Ulwazi nokuqonda okulandelayo: izinhlela zokwesekela ezenzweni zokuqumisa izinqumo; izinhleliso ezintsha ekuhlanganisweni nokwenzweni kokuphatha kwabezomphakathi; ukuhlaziya amapholisi, ukuthuthukisa amapholisi, kanye nokuphatha izindlela zokusebenza, ukulawula kanye nokuqaphela inqubo; umthetho, izinhlelo zokulawula, amapholisi kanye nezindlela ezinhle ezithinta imisebenzi yansuku zonke; izinhlela zolwazi ezisiza ekuphatheni ulwazi lwansuku zonke oluhlobene nemisebenzi yansuku zonke; kanye nokuphatha amaphrojekthi; izindlela zokuphatha izinto ezenziwayo; inqubo yokuThenga nokwenza izitende; izinhlelo zamanje zokubusa nokuqondisa izindaba; izinqubo, izindlela kanye nezinhlelo zabezomphakathi; izindaba zezwe nasedolobheni ezezombusazwe, ezomnotho nasezenhlalakahle ezithinta urhulumende wesifundazwe se-Western Cape; izinhlelo zomthethosisekelo, ezomthetho nabezikhungo ezibusa indikimba yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika; imali kahulumende, abantu kanye nokuqondisa ingxoxo; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, eminye imithetho yezimali, imiyalo, kanye nokuqavunyelana; ukusebenza kwesifundazwe kanye nemisebenzi yeminyango ekhonza obuhlolweni; Ulwazi nokuqonda amapholisi kahulumende waso namuhla; umthetho nobuhle bomithetho mayelana nezimo zomsebenzi; ukuphatha ukusebenza ngokuvamile.
zu.duties: Lawula ukunikeza isenzo sokwesekela nokuhlela izinto ezisiza izakhiwo eziphatha izindaba; Lawula ukunikeza isenzo sokwesekela ezenzweni zokuqumisa izinqumo; Lawula ukunikeza isenzo sokubusa nokuqondisela kwamapholisi; Cwangcisa ulawule umsebenzi futhi ubhale ngemisebenzi yonke yeSub-directorate: okuhlanganisa ukucwangcisa; ukuhlela; ukulawula, ukuhlola kanye nokubika; ukulawula kugcinwa kolwazi; ukuphatha abantu; okuhlanganisa ukuthola abantu ngokukhethe; ukuqeqesha; ukuphatha ukusebenza; ukweseka nokuhlakanipha; isiyaliso; kanye nokuphatha izimali; okuhlanganisa ukubhukuda; izinto; ukuThenga; nokulawula kokuqaphela.

xh.title: Iphini Lomlawuli: Iinkonzo Zelebhotye
xh.summary: Iphini Lomlawuli elibonelela ngenkxaso yelebhotye noku thatha izigqibo ezilawulayo kumazakhiwo olawulo ngaphakathi kwiSebe leWestern Cape lePremier.
xh.requirements: Isifundo sesithathu seNyanga seMfundo ePhezulu (National Diploma/B-Degree okanye isifundo esiphezulu) kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA; Iminyaka yamava elinganiselwa kwi-3 yonke kwelawulo. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda oku kulandelayo: iinkqubo zoxhaso loku-thatha izigqibo; iingqondo nendlela entsha kulawulo lwentlalo yoluntu nolwengingqi; uhlalutyo lwezixhobo ezichaza imigaqo, intlhaltlakazo nolwakhiwo lwezixhobo; ulawulo lomsebenzi wesiqhelo, iinkqubo zokuqwalasela nokuqwalasela kabusha; imithetho, iinkqubo ezilawulayo, imigaqo nendlela elungileyo enomthelela kumsebenzi; iinkqubo zolwazi ezinceda kulawulo lolwazi nolwazi malunga nomsebenzi; nolawulo lwapojekthi; iindlela zolawulo lwangaphakathi; iinkqubo zoku-thenga nokuqashela; iinkqubo zanamhlanje zolawulo lolawulo; iinkqubo, iinkqubo nendlela zentlalo yoluntu; iindaba zendawo nezorhoxo ezingathintayo kulawulo lwephondo leWestern Cape; izicwangciso zoMgaqo-siseko, ezomthetho nezoluntu ezilawula ingingqi yaseMzantsi Afrika yoluntu; imali yoluntu, amandla abantu nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zentetho; uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu, imigaqo yeNational neProvincial Treasury, eminye imigaqo yemali, imigaqo, imiyalelo nemvumelwano eqqunjwe ndawonye; ukusebenza kwephondo nokuqhubeka kweemimandla ahlobene nayo; Ulwazi nokuqonda kwemigaqo karhulumente wakuleso sxesha; uMthetho nemiqathango yeLabour Relations; ukuqwalasela amandla ngokubanzi.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikela ngenkxaso yelebhotye nokuqhuba iinkxaso kwizakhiwo ezilawulayo; Lawula ukunikela ngenkxaso yokuthatha izigqibo ngamagunyazwe; Lawula ukunikela ngenkxaso kolawulo nokutshatya ngemigaqo; Cwangcisa ulawule umsebenzi kwaye wazise ngokuqhutywa komsebenzi ngokubanzi kwiSub-directorate: okuquka ukuqwalasela; ukuhlanganisa; ukuqwalasela kabusha, ukuqwalasela nokushicilela; ulawulo lwamarekhodi nolwazi; ulawulo lwabantu; okuquka ukudwelisa nokhetho; ukulungelelisa; ukuqwalasela amandla; ukukhokela nokukhokelisa; isohlwayo; nolawulo lwemali; okuquka ngeyure yemali; iimpahla; ukuthenga; nokuqwalasela nokushicilela.

jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date.
