jobs.title: Director: Research and Information Management
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Director of Research and Information Management for Western Cape Social Development, overseeing population development services, social research, and knowledge resources.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF 7 or higher qualification as recognised by SAQA; A minimum of 5 years relevant middle/senior management level experience; Successful completion of Certificate for entry into the SMS (Senior Management Service) prior to appointment is requirement. The nominated candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) before the candidate can be appointed into this post. Please see notes below. Competencies: Proven knowledge and understanding of Working experience with the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions. Understanding of information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function. Programme and project management. Procurement and tendering processes. Policy development, and strategy management, monitoring and review processes. Modern systems of governance and administration. Public service procedures, processes and systems. The global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape. Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector. Public finance, human resources and discourse management processes. The Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements. The functioning of the province and the activities of sister departments. The policies of the government of the day. Labour Relations legislation and regulations. Performance management in general. Core Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership. People Management and Empowerment. Programme and Project Management. Financial Management. Change Management. Skills: Numeracy; Literacy; Computer Literacy; Language skills; Project Management; Accounting/ Finance/ Audit; Strategic Planning.
jobs.duties: Line Management: Render population development services to inform provincial-wide and departmental planning in line with South African Population Policy; Plan, manage and coordinate ethical social and evaluation research; Manage and coordinate departmental records and strategic knowledge resources; Manage and coordinate the departmental information systems and information and communication technology (ICT) governance processes; Strategic Management (including Change Management); Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Directorate. Drive the Directorate’s strategic planning process. Drive the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Directorate. Evaluate the performance of the Directorate on a continuing basis against pre-determined key measurable objectives and standards. Report to the Chief Director on a regular basis on the activities of the Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating to operational management support. Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it. Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Directorate, and the Department. Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Director. People Management: Participate in the recruitment of employees in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Directorate’s Business Plan. Motivate, train and guide employees within the Directorate, to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery. Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of employees within the Directorate. Monitor information capacity building within the Directorate. Ensure involvement in the compilation of a workforce plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Directorate. Promote sound labour relations within the Directorate. Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the budgeting process at Directorate level. Ensure the preparation of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Directorate. Assume direct accountability for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Directorate’s budget and expenditure. Assume direct accountability for ensuring that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Directorate. Assume direct accountability for ensuring contracts are managed effectively and efficiently for the Directorate. Ensure that all spending is aligned with the strategic objectives of the Directorate and Department. Report to the Chief Director and relevant oversight role players/committees on all aspects of the Directorate’s finances. Assume overall accountability for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of the Directorate’s assets. Assume direct accountability for ensuring that appropriate risk management procedures are in place and adhered to for the Directorate. Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards.

af.title: Direkteur: Navorsing en Inligtingsbestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Navorsing en Inligtingsbestuur vir Wes-Kaapse Sosiale Ontwikkeling, met toesig oor bevolkingsontwikkelingsdienste, maatskaplike navorsing en kennishulpbronne.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF 7 of hoër kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken; 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante midde-/seniorbestuursvlak-ervaring; Voltooide Sertifikaat vir toetrede tot die SMS (Senior Management Service) voor aanstelling is 'n vereiste. Die benoemde kandidaat sal vereis word om die Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) te voltooi voordat die kandidaat in hierdie pos aangestel kan word. Sien asseblief notas hieronder. Bevoegdhede: Bewese kennis en begrip van werkervaring met die wetgewing, regulerende raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat op die lynfunksies van toepassing is. Begrip van inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie. Program- en projekbestuur. Aanbestedings- en tenderprosesse. Beleidsontwikkeling, en strategiebestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse. Moderne stelsels van goewerance en administrasie. Openbare diens prosedures, prosesse en stelsels. Die globale, streek- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Wes-Kaap. Konstitusionele, regs- en instellingsreëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer. Openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse. Die Public Finance Management Act, Nasionale en Provinciale Tesourie Regulasies, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, richtlyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Die funksionering van die provinsie en die aktiwiteite van sustersdepartemente. Die beleide van die regering van die dag. Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en -regulasies. Prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging. Program- en Projekbestuur. Finansiële Bestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Vaardighede: Geletterdheid met getalle; Geletterdheid; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Taalvaardighede; Projekbestuur; Rekeningkunde/ Finansies/ Oudit; Strategiese Beplanning.
af.duties: Lynbestuur: Lewer bevolkingsontwikkelingsdienste om provinsie-wye en departementele beplanning in ooreenstemming met die Suid-Afrikaanse Bevolkingsbeleid in te lig; Beplan, bestuur en koördineer etiese maatskaplike en evaluasienavorsing; Bestuur en koördineer departementele rekords en strategiese kennishulpbronne; Bestuur en koördineer die departementele inligtingstelsels en inligtings- en kommunikasietegnologie (IKT) goewerance prosesse; Strategiese Bestuur (insluitend Veranderingsbestuur); Definieer en hersien op 'n deurlopende basis die doel, doelwitte, prioriteite en aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat. Dryf die Direktoraat se strategiese beplanningsproses aan. Dryf die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en besigheidsplanne vir die Direktoraat aan. Evalueer die prestasie van die Direktoraat op 'n deurlopende basis teen voorafbepaalde sleutel meetbare doelwitte en standaarde. Rapporteer op 'n gereelde basis aan die Hoofdirekteur oor die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat en oor aangeleenthede van wesenlike belang met betrekking tot operasionele bestuurstoesig. Monitor en verseker nakoming met toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte ten opsigte van voldoende en toepaslike rekordhouding van die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat, en van die hulpbronne (mense, finansies en bates) wat daarvoor aangewend word. Bevorder en bevorder 'n kultuur van innovasie binne die Direktoraat, en die Departement. Voer ywerig al die pligte wat aan die pos van Direkteur opgedra is uit. Mensebestuur: Neem deel aan die werwing van werknemers in die getalle en grade wat toepaslik is om die bereiking van die Direktoraat se Besigheidsplan te verseker. Motiveer, oplei en lei werknemers binne die Direktoraat, om uitmuntendheid in dienslewering te bereik en te handhaaf. Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van werknemers binne die Direktoraat. Monitor inligtingskapasiteitsbou binne die Direktoraat. Versekeer betrokkenheid by die opstel van 'n werksmagplan, 'n diensleweringverbeteringsprogram, en 'n inligtinghulpbronplan vir die Direktoraat. Bevorder gesonde arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Direktoraat. Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Direktoraat. Finansiële Bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Direktoraatvlak. Verseker die voorbereiding van die Jaarlikse en Aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Direktoraat. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe beheer en bestuur van die Direktoraat se begroting en uitgawes. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en aanbestedingsprosedures ten opsigte van aankope vir die Direktoraat nagekom word. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat kontrakte doeltreffend en effektief vir die Direktoraat bestuur word. Verseker dat alle besteding met die strategiese doelwitte van die Direktoraat en Departement ooreenstem. Rapporteer aan die Hoofdirekteur en toepaslike toesigrolspelers/komitees oor alle aspekte van die Direktoraat se finansies. Neem algehele verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van die Direktoraat se bates. Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat toepaslike risikobestuurprosedures in plek is en deur die Direktoraat nagekom word. Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die Direktoraat gehou word in ooreenstemming met enige voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Ucwaningo Nokuphathwa Kolwazi
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wocwaningo Nokuphathwa Kolwazi we-Western Cape Social Development, obhekele izinsiza zentuthuko yabantu, ucwaningo lwemiphakathi, namathuluzi olwazi.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esifanele samazinga angu-NQF 7 noma aphezulu njengoba somunywa yi-SAQA; Ukwaziswa okuncane eminyakeni engu-5 kokusebenza okuhlobene ezingeni eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokubusa; Ukuphothula ngemphumelele i-Certificate for entry into the SMS (Senior Management Service) ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni kuyisidingo. Umuntu onqunyiwe uzodinga ukuphothula i-Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) ngaphambi kokuba abekwe kulesi sikhundla. Ngicela ubuke izinotshe ezingezansi. Ikhono: Ulwazi olubonakalayo nokugonda kwezomsebenzi ngomthetho, izinhlelo zolawulo, izinqubomgomo, namasu ahamba phambili anomthelela emisebenzini yesigaba. Ukuqonda izinhlelo zolwazi ezisiza ekuphathweni kolwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi wesigaba. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Inqubo yokuthenga kanye nokuqashisa. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, ukuphathwa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukulandelelwa, kanye nezinqubo zokuhlola. Izinhlelo zanamuhla zokubusa nokuphatha. Izenqubo, izinhlelo, namasistimu omphakathi. Izindaba ezomhlaba, zesifundazwe nendawo ezezombusazo, ezezomnotho, nasezomphakathi ezithinta urhulumende wesifundazwe i-Western Cape. Izinhlelo zomthethosisekelo, zomthetho, nezinhlelo zamasiko ezibusi umkhakha kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika. Izimali zorhulumende, abantu, kanye nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezinkulumo. I-Public Finance Management Act, i-National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, eminye imithethonqubo yezimali, imiyalo, iziyalezo, nezivumelwano zohlanga. Ukusebenza kwesifundazwe kanye nemisebenzi yeminyango ohlobene nayo. Izinqubomgomo zorhulumende wanamuhla. Umthetho kanye nemithethonqubo yezindaba zolusebenzano. Ukuphathwa kokusebenza ngokuvamile. Ikhono Elingunto: Ikhono lokubuswa nokuholwa. Ukuphathwa Kwabantu Nokubakhuthaza. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Namaphrojekthi. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali. Ukuphathwa Ishintsho. Amakhono: Ukufunda izibalo; Ukubhala nokufunda; Ukusebenzisa Ikhompyutha; Amakhono Olimi; Ukuphathwa Amaphrojekthi; Izimali/ Ukubala/ Ukuhlola; Ukuhlela Izobuchwepheshe.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa Komugqa: Nikeza izinsiza zentuthuko yabantu ukwazisa ukuhlelwa kwesifundazwe nakomnyango ngokuhambisana ne-South African Population Policy; Hlela, phatha futhi uhlobanise ucwaningo lwezomphakathi nokuhlolwa okuzothile; Phatha futhi uhlobanise amarekhodi omnyango namathuluzi olwazi ayingunqumo; Phatha futhi uhlobanise izinhlelo zolwazi zomnyango kanye nezinqubo zokubusa kolwazi nolwazi kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana (ICT); Ukuphathwa Izobuchwepheshe (kuhlanganise Ukuphathwa Ishintsho); Chaza futhi uhlole ngokuhlala njalo injongo, izinhloso, izinto eziyisihluthulelo, namasebenzi eKhaya leMiqondisi. Qhuba inqubo yokuhlela izobuchwepheshe yeKhaya leMiqondisi. Qhuba ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwezinhlela ezisobuchwepheshe nezoshisho zeKhaya leMiqondisi. Hlola ukusebenza kweKhaya leMiqondisi ngokuqhubeka ngokuhambisana nezinhloso ezibalulekile ezilinganisiwe ngaphambilini namazinga. Mbika uMqondisi Omkhulu njalo ngezenzo ngemisebenzi yeKhaya leMiqondisi nangezindaba eziwusizo ezihlobene nesekelo sokuphathwa kwezokusebenza. Londa futhi uqinisekise ukuthobela umthetho ohlobene kanye nemiyalo mayelana nokugcinwa okwanele okufanele kwezinkulumo ngemisebenzi yeKhaya leMiqondisi, nakulamathuluzi (abantu, izimali, namafa) asetshenziswa yona. Khuthaza futhi ukugqugquzela isiko lohlelokusebenza okusha ngaphakathi eKhaya leMiqondisi, nakomnyango. Yenza ngokuzinikela yonke imisebenzi enikelwe esikhundleni somQondisi. Ukuphathwa Abantu: Ngenxa ekubeni abasebenzi kumanani namazinga afanele ukuze uqinisekise ukufeza iNqubo Yeshisho yeKhaya leMiqondisi. Khuthaza, qeqesha futhi ohole abasebenzi ngaphakathi eKhaya leMiqondisi, ukuze kufeze futhi kugcine ukuphakama ekuletheni izinsiza. Phatha ngokusebenzayo ukusebenza, ukuhlola, kanye nokukhumbula abasebenzi ngaphakathi eKhaya leMiqondisi. Londa ukwakhiwa kwamandla olwazi ngaphakathi eKhaya leMiqondisi. Qinisekisa ukubandakanyeka ekwakheni ipleni yomsebenzi, inhlelo yokuthuthukisa ukuletha izinsiza, kanye neplenı yolwazi yeKhaya leMiqondisi. Khuthaza ubuhle bezindaba zolusebenzano ngaphakathi eKhaya leMiqondisi. Phatha ngokusebenzayo futhi ukhuthaze ukugcinwa kwesigaba ngaphakathi eKhaya leMiqondisi. Ukuphathwa Izimali: Phatha ukubandakanyeka ekuhlelweni kwesabelomali ezingeni leKhaya leMiqondisi. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwe-Budgets zonyaka kanye nezokulungisa zeKhaya leMiqondisi. Zamukela ngqo ukuphathwa okusebenzayo, okugwema izindleko, nokulawula kwe-sabelomali kanye nezinkokhelo zeKhaya leMiqondisi. Zamukela ngqo ukuphathwa ukunikeza inqinisekelo yokuthi izinqubo zokuqashisa nezokuthenga ezifanele zilandelwa ngokubhekise ekuthengeni iKhaya leMiqondisi. Zamukela ngqo ukuphathwa ukunikeza inqinisekelo yokuthi izinkontileka ziphatshwa ngokusebenzayo futhi ngempumelelo iKhaya leMiqondisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imali okushukunyisiwayo ihambisana nezinhloso ezisobuchwepheshe zeKhaya leMiqondisi nomnyango. Mbika uMqondisi Omkhulu nabalingisi bekuqapha/bhodi abahlobene nazo zonke izindaba zezimali zeKhaya leMiqondisi. Zamukela ukuphathwa konke okuphathwayo mayelana nokuphathwa, ukugcinwa, nokugcina ngokuphepha amafa eKhaya leMiqondisi. Zamukela ngqo ukuphathwa ukunikeza inqinisekelo yokuthi izinqubo zokuphathwa ingozi ezifanele zikho futhi zilandelwa iKhaya leMiqondisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi azele futhi afanele ezindabeni zezimali zeKhaya leMiqondisi agcinwa ngokuhambisana nanoma yimaphi amagugu namazinga abekiwe.

xh.title: Umphathi: Uphononongo Lolwazi nokuLawula
xh.summary: Umphathi wezoPhononongo Lolwazi nokuLawula kwiSebe lokuPhuhlisa iZentlalo eWestern Cape, elibukelela iinkonzo zokuphuhlisa abantu, uphononongo lwentlalo, namathuba olwazi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo seNQF 7 okanye siphezulu njengokuqatshelwa yiSAQA; Amava amabali angu-5 ubuncinane abalulekileyo kwinqanaba lokulawula eliphakathi/elphezulu; Ukuphumelela iQinisekiso lokungena kwiSMS (Inkonzo yoLawulo ePhakamileyo) phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni yimfuno. Umfuniwe uyakufuneka aqedele iNkqubo yoLawulo ePhakamileyo yangaphambili yoKungena (Nyukela) phambi kokuba abekwe kule sikweni. Nceda jonga iinqwaba ngezantsi. Ikhono: Ulwazi olubonisiweyo nokuqonda kolunye ulwazi ngomsebenzi ngomthetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo kunye nezona nzila ezikhoyo ezithinta imisebenzi yomgca. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zolwazi ezinceda ekulawuleni ulwazi nanolwazi ngokubaluleka kwemisebenzi yomgca. Ukulawula iinkqubo namaphulo. Iinkqubo zokuthenga nokuqashisa. Ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo, nokuLawula iQela lemigaqo, ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela iinkqubo. Iinkqubo zamanje zolawulo loluntu nokulawula. Iinkqubo, iinkqubo namakhuselo abantu. Iindaba zamazwe ngamazwe, ezifunyanwe kunye nedolophu ezithinta urhulumente wephondo leWestern Cape. Uluvo lwentlalo nolwezomthetho olulawula urhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika. Iimali zorhulumente, iinkonzo zabantu nokuLawula iinkqubo zethetha-thetha. uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zorhulumente, iMgqatho yeNgcwele yaseNgcwele nasePhondo, ezinye iinkqubo zeemali, izalathiso, imiyalelo nokuqwalasela ngokuvunyelwana. Ukusebenza kwephondo kunye nemisebenzi yamanye amasebe. Iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo zorhulumente wakulo namhlanje. uMthetho wezeMfundo wezomsebenzi nemiqathango. Ukulawula ukuphumeza iinkqubo ngokubanzi. Ikhono eziNtaba: Ikhono lokulawula iqela labantu nokubakhulisa. Ukulawula iinkqubo namaphulo. Ukulawula izeMali. uLawulo lokuTshintsha. Amakhono: ukubala; ukufunda nokubhala; ukusebenza ngekhompyutha; amakhono olwimi; uLawulo lweziPhulo; ukuTshada/ izeMali/ ukuqwalasela; uCwangciso lweQela.
xh.duties: uLawulo lomGca:unikela iinkonzo zokuphuhlisa abantu ukunikela isalathiso kwicandelo elingaphakathi nasekunxulumene noCwangciso ngokuvumelana neNkqubo yomGa-qo-nkqubo yabantu baseMzantsi Afrika; ucwangcisa, ulawula kwaye ulawule uphononongo lwentlalo nokuqwalasela; ulawule kwaye ulungelelanise iirekhodi zesebe namathuba olwazi obalulekileyo; ulawule kwaye ulungelelanise iinkqubo zolwazi zesebe nolawulo lweenkqubo zolwazi ngekhompyutha (ICT); uLawulo lweQela (kuquka noLawulo lokuTshintsha); cwangcisa kwaye uqwalasele ngokuqhubekeka injongo, iinjongo, iindidi ezibalulekileyo kunye nemisebenzi yeDirekhore. Qhuba inkqubo yocwangciso lweDirekhore. Qhuba ukuphuhlisa nokulawula iinqobo zocwangciso nezoshishino zeDirekhore. Qwalasela inkqubo yokuphumeza iDirekhore ngokuchasene neenjongo ezingeniswayo ezibalulekileyo neemigangatho. Phendula kuMlawuli oPhambili rhoqo ngemisebenzi yeDirekhore nangemiba ebalulekileyo ehlotyeni ngenkxaso yolawulo. Qwalasela kwaye qinisekisa ukuzithoba kumthetho othinteleyo ngezalathiso ngokubaluleka kokugcina iirekhodi ezaneleyo nokuqhelekileyo zemisebenzi yeDirekhore, namathuba (abantu, iimali, nemiqobo) esetyenziswa yona. Khulisa kwaye uncede inkqubo yokuqaliswa kolunye ulwazi ngaphakathi kwiDirekhore, naseSebenzini. Yenza ngokuzimisela yonke imisebenzi enikelwe kusikhundla soMlawuli. uLawulo abaNtu: thabatha inxaxheba ekungeniseni abasebenzi kwizinani kunye neendidi ezifanelekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukufezekiswa kweNkqubo yoShishino yeDirekhore. Khuthaza, qeqesha kwaye khokele abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwiDirekhore, ukufezekisa kwaye igcine ukuphumeza iinkonzo ngokuphumelelayo. Lawula ngokuzimisela ukuphumeza inkqubo yemisebenzi, ukuqwalasela nokubakhathalela abasebenzi ngaphakathi kweDirekhore. Qwalasela ukwakhiwa kwamathuba olwazi ngaphakathi kwiDirekhore. Qinisekisa ukuthabatha inxaxheba ekubhalweni kocwangciso lwabasebenzi, inkqubo yokuphuculwa kwezinkonzo, nocwangciso lwamathuba olwazi weDirekhore. Khuthaza izigqibo ezilungileyo zobudlelwane basebenzi ngaphakathi kweDirekhore. Lawula ngokuzimisela kwaye ukhuthaze ukugcinwa kweenkqubo zolawulo ngaphakathi kweDirekhore. uLawulo lwezeMali: lawula ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwenkqubo yokuqwalasela kwamathuba eDirekhore. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kweMali yomNyaka nakuLungelelaniswa iBhajethi yeDirekhore. Thatha iresponsibility eqonde ngqo yokulawula ngokusebenziseka, ngokuthengisa, ngokuphumeza nokuLawula iBhajethi yokuSebenzisa iDirekhore. Thatha iresponsibility eqonde ngqo yokulawula iinkqubo zokuthenga nokuqashisa eziqhelekileyo kwindlela yokuthenga kwakunye neendlela zokuthengisa zeDirekhore. Thatha iresponsibility eqonde ngqo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba iinkonqubo zorhulumente zilawulwa ngokusebenziseka nangokuphumelela zeDirekhore. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imali echithwayo ihambelana ncnxeba kunye neenjongo ezibalulekileyo zokulawula iDirekhore nesebe. Phendula kuMlawuli oPhambili kwaye kwabo bagcina iinkqubo zeKomiti kuwo onke amacandelo ezeMali zeDirekhore. Thatha iresponsibility iyonke ngokulawula, ukugcina nokugcina iinkonzo zeDirekhore. Thatha iresponsibility eqonde ngqo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba iinkqubo zokulawula iingozi ezifanelekileyo zikho kwaye zithintelwe kwiDirekhore. Qinisekisa ukuba iirekhodi ezizezinye nangokuchanekileyo zezemali zikaDirekhore zigcinwe ngokuvumelana naziphi na iinkqubo ezilawulayo nemigangatho.

jobs.title: Social Work Manager: Regional Office
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 009 512 - R1 154 271 per annum, (as prescribed by OSD) Grade 2: R1 200 894 – R1 414 593 per annum, (as prescribed by OSD)
jobs.summary: Social Work Manager sought by the Western Cape Department of Social Development to lead advanced social welfare and community development services for vulnerable groups.
jobs.requirements: Formal tertiary qualification in Social Work (e.g. Bachelor of Social Work) that allows professional registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP); Compulsory registration with SACSSP as a Social Worker; A minimum of 10 years appropriate/ recognisable experience in social work after registration as Social Worker with the SACSSP. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Analytic, diagnostic, assessment tools, evaluation methods and processes (Social Work); Personnel Management; Supervision Framework for Social Work profession; Social Welfare and Community Development legislation related to children; Social Welfare and Community Development theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics.
jobs.duties: Provide a Social Welfare and Community Development service of the highest, most advanced and specialised nature within a defined area(s) of specialisation with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant programmes in partnership with stakeholders. Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; Facilitate the development and planning of programmes and interventions to render a social welfare and community development service through the efficient, economical and effective utilisation of financial resources; Management of service delivery area(s) (unit(s)) to ensure that an efficient and effective social welfare and community development service is delivered through the efficient and effective utilisation of human resources; Plan and ensure that social welfare and community development research are undertaken; Undertake complex social welfare and community development research. Perform and / or ensure that all the administrative function required in the service delivery area(s) are performed; Keep up to date with new developments in the Social Welfare and Community Development field; Supervise all the administrative functions required in the service delivery area(s) and undertake the higher-level administrative functions.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A van Reenen Tel No: (021) 483 3996
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Maatskaplike Werkbestuurder: Streekkantoor
af.summary: Maatskaplike Werkbestuurder gesoek deur die Western Cape Department of Social Development om gevorderde maatskaplike welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdienste vir kwesbare groepe te lei.
af.requirements: Formele tersiêre kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (bv. Baccalaureus in Maatskaplike Werk) wat professionele registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Diensberoep (SACSSP) toelaat; Verpligte registrasie by SACSSP as 'n Maatskaplike Werker; 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in maatskaplike werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by die SACSSP. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Analitiese, diagnostiese, assesseringsinstrumente, evalueringsmetodes en -prosesse (Maatskaplike Werk); Personeelbestuur; Toesigkader vir die maatskaplike werkberoep; Maatskaplike welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingswetgewing met betrekking tot kinders; Maatskaplike welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsteorie en -intervensies; Inligting- en kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n maatskaplike welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiens van die hoogste, mees gevorderde en gespesialiseerde aard binne 'n gedefinieerde area(s) van spesialisering ten opsigte van die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van die relevante programme in vennootskap met belanghebbendes; Woon enige ander aangeleenthede by wat tot sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei, of daaruit kan voortspruit; Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en beplanning van programme en intervensies om 'n maatskaplike welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiens te lewer deur die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe benutting van finansiële hulpbronne; Bestuur van diensleweringarea(s) (eenheid(e)) om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe maatskaplike welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiens gelewer word deur die doeltreffende en effektiewe benutting van menslike hulpbronne; Beplan en verseker dat maatskaplike welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing onderneem word; Onderneem komplekse maatskaplike welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing. Voer alle administratiewe funksies wat in die diensleweringarea(s) vereis word, uit en/of verseker dat dit uitgevoer word; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die maatskaplike welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsveld; Hou toesig oor al die administratiewe funksies wat in die diensleweringarea(s) vereist word en onderneem die hoër-vlak administratiewe funksies.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezomsebenzi Wokuthakaza Nabantu: Inqila Le Ofisi
zu.summary: I-Western Cape Department of Social Development ifuna umphathi Wobulungisevi BakhoMphakathi ukuze aholise izinsiza eziyisisekelo nezithuthukile zokuthakazela abantu kanye nentuthuko yomphakathi kumaqembu abuthathaka.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziphezulu evela esikoleni esiphakeme ngesiZulu (isb. I-Bachelor's Degree eZothando Njengabasebenzi Bantu) ezeqeni abantu ukungena kohlelo lohlelele i-Western Cape Social Service Professions (SACSSP); Kufuneka ibhalwe kwi-SACSSP njengomsebenzi wokuthakaza nabantu; A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in social work after registration as Social Worker with the SACSSP. Amandla okusebenza: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Analytic, diagnostic, assessment tools, evaluation methods and processes (Social Work); Personnel Management; Supervision Framework for Social Work profession; Social Welfare and Community Development legislation related to children; Social Welfare and Community Development theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesithakazelo sabantu kanye nesevisi yentuthuko yomphakathi yesigaba esiphezulu kakhulu, esithuthukile nesiseceleni ngaphakathi kwendawo ethize ezithile ekuqeqeshwe kuzo ngokuqhasha, ukusekela, ukuvikela nentuthuko yabantu, amaqembu, osaphaya nemiphakathi ebuthathaka ngezinhlela ezihambisana nalabo abanesiqu emphakathini. Zinakele namunye imibuzo ongaholela kuze kube yimaphi na, noma ovela kuyo, inkathazokuhle na yimuphi na uhlobo; Hola intuthuko nokuhlelwa kwezinhlela nokungenelela ukuze kunikezwe isithakazelo sabantu nesevisi yentuthuko yomphakathi ngokusebenzisa ngempumelelo, ngokugcina imali nangokusebenza kahle izinsizakusebenza zezimali; Uphathwa kwendawo yesevisi (iziminyakazo) ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kunikezwa isithakazelo sabantu nesevisi yentuthuko yomphakathi ebalulekile, ngokusebenzisa ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle izinsizakusebenza zabantu; Cwangcisa futhi uqinise ukuthi uphenyo ngosithakazelo sabantu kanye nentuthuko yomphakathi lubhalwe; Zenza uphenyo oludanisayo ngosithakazelo sabantu nentuthuko yomphakathi. Zenza, futhi noma qiniseka ukuthi yonke imisebenzi yesibhalo edingeka kwindawo yesevisi ibhalwe; Gcina usemazweni amatsha osithakazelo sabantu nasentuthukweni yomphakathi; Qapha yonke imisebenzi yesibhalo ebalulekile kwindawo yesevisi, futhi wenze imisebenzi yesibhalo esezingeni eliphezulu ngenkathi.

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi yoBuntu: Iofisi yoMmandla
xh.summary: Kufunwa umphathi wemisebenzi yobuntu ngaphakathi kwiSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu lase Western Cape ukuba ahole iinkonzo ezitheVeterho zenzela uluntu kunye nophuhliso loluntu kumacandla abuthathaka.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seThutyana esesisemthethweni kumisebenzi yobuntu (umz. iBachelor of Social Work) esivumela ukubhalisa ngobungcali kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP); Kubhaliswa ngokuyimfuneko kwiSACSSP njengomsebenzi wobuntu; Ixabiso elingentla leminyaka eli-10 lemveliso ephathekayo ebonakalayo kumsebenzi wobuntu emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wobuntu kwiSACSSP. Iimfuno zokwazi: Ulwazi ngaloku landelayo: Iindlela zokuhlola, zokuqonda isiphumo, izixhobo zokuqonda, iindlela nezinqubo zokuqamba ixabiso (kumsebenzi wobuntu); Ukulawula abasebenzi; Isakhelo sokuhlola umsebenzi wobuntu; Imithetho yoPhuhliso loluntu noLuntu malunga nabantwana; Iminikelo ngokomthetho ngezenzo kuPhuhliso loluntu noLuntu; Ulawulo lwolwazi nolwazi; Iprotothokhol kunye namaziko obungcali.
xh.duties: Kubonezele inkonzo yoPhuhliso loLuntu nokuPhuhliswa koluntu eseyona ndalo iphakamileyo, ithethwe kakhulu kwaye izspecificikiweyo ngaphakathi kwendawo (iindawo) eziqhelanayo ngokwemigaqo yokukhathalela, ukuxhasa, ukukhusela nophuhliso labantu abathathakileyo, amaqela, usapho noluntu ngokwemisebenzi ehambelana nabo ngokubambisana nabathathi nxaxheba. jobs.title: Social Work Supervisor: Facility Policy Planning and
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: R496 668 - R583 833 per annum, (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Social Work Supervisor position in the Western Cape requiring a 4-year social work qualification, SACSSP registration, 7 years' experience, and a valid driving licence.
jobs.requirements: A 4-year tertiary qualification in social work (degree/diploma) that allows registration with SACSSP; registration and proof of current registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). A minimum of 7 years of appropriate experience in social work after registration as a social worker with the SACSSP. Valid Code B (or higher) Driving Licence. NB: People with disabilities that restrict driving abilities, but who have reasonable access to transport, may also apply. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Job- related knowledge; analytic and diagnostic tools, assessment tools, evaluation methods, and processes. Personnel Management, Supervision Framework for Social Workers, and Social Work Legislation Related to Children. Social work theory and interventions; Information and knowledge management, protocol, and professional ethics Job-Related Skills: Organizing and planning; project planning; psychosocial intervention; communication and language (2 official languages of the Western Cape Government); People management practices; interpersonal, report writing, computer literacy, presentation and facilitation, problem solving and analytical, and client orientation and customer focus.
jobs.duties: To ensure that a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection, and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families, and communities through the relevant programs is rendered, attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form. Supervise employees engaged in these functions; This would include the following actions: Conduct assessments that are problematic for supervisees, aimed at identifying conditions in individuals, groups, families, and communities that justify relevant interventions. Ensure that the appropriate recommendations and interventions required to address the conditions are identified. Ensure the development and planning of programs to render the recommended interventions efficiently, effectively, and economically. Ensure that the recommended interventions are implemented by supervisees by providing continuous support, counselling, guidance, and advice to supervisees. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the recommended interventions; Ensure reporting on progress and identify further/amended interventions to address the identified conditions; Study, interpret, apply, and give guidance on legislation and policies in the identified work fields to supervisors and other role players/stakeholders. Perform statutory functions that are problematic for supervisees relating to the relevant function, compile court reports, and attend to court inquiries and the other tasks emanating from these matters. Ensure that records of social work interventions, processes, and outcomes are produced and maintained. Ensure implementation and compliance with all standard operating procedures and sector norms and standards.

zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wezempilo: Ukuhlelwa Kwamapolisi Wokwakhiwa
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMphathi Womsebenzi Wezempilo esifundeni i-Western Cape esidinga isiqu seminyaka emi-4 somsebenzi wezempilo, ukubhalisa ku-SACSSP, iminyaka eyi-7 yohlelolwemisebenzi, nelilayisense elivumelekile lokushayela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-tertiary zeminyaka emi-4 kumsebenzi wezezempilo (isiqu/idiploma) ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-SACSSP; ukubhalisa nokuphakamisa isibambi samanje sokubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). Okungenani iminyaka eyi-7 yohlelolwemisebenzi olufanele kumsebenzi wezezempilo ngemva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezezempilo ku-SACSSP. Ilayisense yokuqhuba elivumelekile le-Code B (noma eliphezulu). NB: Abantu abasabilekhono lokuhamba ngokwabo ngenxa yesimo sempilo, koduma abanendlela yokuhamba ekahle, bangasingatha futhi. Izakhono: Ulwazi ngokulandelayo: Ulwazi ngomsebenzi oluhlobene; izinto zokuhlola nezinto zokuhumusha, izinto zokuqashwa, izindlela zokuqinisekisa izinto, nezinqubo. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi, Umthethosisekelo Wokuphatha Abasebenzi Bezempilo, kanye Nomthetho Wezempilo Ohlobene Nezingane. Incazelo yomsebenzi wezezempilo nezindlela zokungenelela; ukuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi, amapolisi, kanye nesiko elihlelolwelemisebenzi yezempilo. Amakhono Ahlobene Nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela nokupanga; ukupanga amaphrojekthi; ukungenelela ngokomuntu nangokwengqondo; ukuxhumana nezilimi (izinguqulo ezimbili ezisemthethweni zahulumeni wesifundazwe se-Western Cape); izindlela zokuphatha abantu; ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu, ukubhala izibiko, ukusebenzisa isikhompyutha, ukubamba izinkulumo nokukhokhela, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlola, ukukhomba ngokumthengi ukugxila ekusebenzeleni kwesikhathi eside.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunikezwa insizeko yomsebenzi wezemphilo ezeithanjeni mayelana nokunakekelwa, ukusekela, ukuvikela, kanye nentuthuko yabantu, amaqembu, imindeni, kanye namaphandle ngaphakathi kwamahlela ahambisana nalawo, ukuze kuqashelwe nanoma yiphi eminye imikhakha engadala noma ingaphuma ekungalungile komphakathi nganoma yisiphi isimo. Ukuphatha abasebenzi ababambe iqhaza kulemisebenzi; Lokhu kuzofaka phakathi izenzo ezilandelayo: Ukwenza ukuhlola okubhedela abaphathi, okubhekiswe ekuboneni izimo kubantu, amaqembu, imindeni, namaphandle ezibiza izindlela zokungenelela ezifanele. Ukubona ukuthi izincomo nangokungenelela ezidingekayo ukulungisa lezozimo zitholwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunakwa kuhlelwa amahlela okunikeza izindlela zokungenelela ezitholakele ngendlela ephumelelayo, eqinisekisiwe, neyomthelela. Ukubona ukuthi izincomo zokungenelela zenziwe yibo abaphathi ngokusikhasela ngasokudla ngokusikhasela okuqhubekayo, ngokweluleka ngokomzwili, ngokuqondisa, nangokunika izeluleko abaphathini. Ukuqapha nokubuyekeza ukusebenza okuhle kwaleyonke engenwe ngokusikhasela; Ukuqinisekisa ukubika nganqenqema futhi kutholakale izindlela ezintsha/ezibuyekeziwe zokungenelela ezizobe zibhekiswe ekulungiseni izimo ezitholakele; Ukufunda, ukuhumusha, ukusebenzisa, futhi kunikezelwe isiqondiso mayelana nomthetho kanye namapolisi ezikhungweni zokusebenza eziqoshiwe kubaphathi nakuwo onke amanye amadayisi/abaphathi bomkhakha. Ukwenza imisebenzi esemthethweni engabangela inkinga abaphathini ehambisana nomsebenzi ohlukile, ukuze kuhlelwe izibiko zasenkantolo, nokuzoba kukhona enkantolo kwezombuzo kanye neminye imisebenzi ephuma kulemikhakha. Ukubona ukuthi kugcinwa futhi kulungisiswa izibiko zemisebenzi, izinqubo, nezisiphumo zemisebenzi ehlukene. Ukubona ukuthi kusetshenziswa futhi kuqinisekiswa izinqubo zonke ezisetshenziswa ngokomthetho kanye nemigomo nemithetho yemikhakha.

xh.title: Mphathi Womsebenzi Wezentlalo: Ulwazi-lwenqela lweZakhiwo kunye noCwangciso
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi womsebenzi wezentlalo kwi-Western Cape esifuna izidanga zeminyaka eyi-4 kumsebenzi wezentlalo, ukuwazisa ku-SACSSP, amavalemiyaka eyi-7, kunye nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zesikolo samabanga aphakamileyo zeminyaka eyi-4 kumsebenzi wezentlalo (idigri/diploma) ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SACSSP; ukubhalisa nokuvelisa uluve lokubhalisa ngokwangoku kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). Amava amancinci angeminyaka eyi-7 afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wezentlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wentlalo kwi-SACSSP. Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code B (okwa phezulu) esemthethweni. QAPH, Abantu abanokuphathwa kukungabakho kwamandla okushayela, kodwa banendlela ezingathintelanga yokufumana izithuthi, banako ukungenisa izicelo zabo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokuqhelekileyo malunga; nezixhobo zokuhlaziya nokuxilonga, izixhobo zokuqokelela ulwazi, iindlela zokuqwalasela, nokuqhuba izigqibo kumasebe. uLawulo lwabasebenzi, uLuntu olusebenza ngokulawula oomsebenzi bentlalo, kunye neMithethonkambiso yoMsebenzi weZentlalo enxulumene noMtsha. I-theori yomsebenzi wezentlalo noku singer ilwazi; ulawulo lolwazi nolwazi olupheleleyo, i-protocol, namagunya osebenzi ngokwemigaqo. Ikhono elinxulumene nomsebenzi: ukuquumba nokucwangcisa; ucwangciso lomsebenzi; ukujolisa kwizinto ezinzima; ukuthetha nolwimi (iilwimi ezisemthethweni ezibini zolawulo lwe-Western Cape Government); iindlela zolawulo lwabantu; ubudlelwane obuhle namntu, okokubhala iingxelo, ulwazi ngemikhomba yolwazi, ukubonelela nokuququzelela, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, nokuqwalasela umxhasi nogqaliselo lwabathengi.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho inkonzo yomsebenzi wezentlalo malunga nonyamezelo, inkxaso, ukhuselo, nophuhliso kwabantu abakhathazekileyo, amaqela, usapho, noluntu ngenkqubo ezifanelekileyo, kuqwalaselwe naziphi na ezinye izinto ezingabangela, okanye eziqhamuka kuzo, ukungazinzi nangayiphi na indlela entlalweni. Lawula abasebenzi ababambe kule misebenzi; Oku kuza kubandakanya izinto ezilandelayo; Qhuba iingxelo ezizibuza abasebenzi abalawulwa, ngenjongo yokuchonga iimeko kubantu, kumaqela, usapho, noluntu ezikumgangatho wokwenza iintshukumo ezifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kuye kuchongwe izindululo neendlela ezifanelekileyo zokwenza izinto eziya kujongana nale meko. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliso nokucwangcisa iinkqubo zokuqhuba izindululo ngenkqubo ezisebenzayo, ngokuchanekileyo, nangexabiso elingathathi kalanga. Qinisekisa ukuba izindululo ziyaphumezelwa ngabasebenzi abalawulwa ngokubonelela ngonxaxheba olungapheliyo, inceba, inkokheli, kunye namacebiso kubasebenzi abalawulwa. Beka esweni bese uqwalasela ukusebenza kwazo ezindululo; Qinisekisa ukubika ngentshukumo zichonge nokuqwalasela okongezelelekileyo okanye okutshintshelwe ukuya kujongana ne meko; Funda, tyhola, usebenzise, unike imigaqo ngenkqubo malunga neentshukumo kumawela obusebenza kubaphathi kwakhona nakuwo onke amanqanqamla/bathengi. Yenza iinkalo ezehlwayo kubasebenzi abalawulwa ezinxulumene nalo msebenzi, qamba iingxelo zesigqeba-sigqeba, bese uyihoya iingxelo zegqeba ngaloo nto. Qinisekisa ukuba iirekhodi zomsebenzi wezentlalo, iinkqubo, nokuvelisa imveliso zihle zigcinwe zisezweni. Qinisekisa ukubekwa esebenziseni nokuthobela zonke iinkqubo ezingagqibekanga zokusebenza namagunya obungcali obuqhelekileyo.

jobs.title: Social Work Supervisor
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: R496 668 - R583 833 per annum, (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Social Work Supervisor role at the Department of Social Development in the Western Cape, requiring SACSSP registration and seven years of post-qualification experience.
jobs.requirements: A 4-year tertiary qualification in Social Work (Degree/Diploma) that allows registration with SACSSP; Registration and proof of current registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). A minimum of 7 years appropriate experience in social work after registration as Social Worker with the SACSSP. A valid (Code B or higher) driving licence. NB: People with disabilities that restrict driving abilities, but who have reasonable access to transport, may also apply. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Job-related knowledge; analytic and diagnostic tools, assessment tools, evaluation methods and processes. Personnel Management, Supervision Framework for Social Workers, and Social Work legislation related to children. Social work theory and interventions; Information and knowledge management, protocol, and professional ethics Job-Related Skills: Organizing and planning; Project planning; psychosocial intervention; Communication and language (2 official languages of the Western Cape Government); People management practices; Interpersonal, report writing, computer literacy, presentation and facilitation, problem solving and analytical, and client orientation and customer focus.
jobs.duties: To ensure that a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection, and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families, and communities through the relevant programs is rendered: Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form. Supervise employees engaged in these functions; This would include the following actions: Conduct assessments, that are problematic for supervisees, aimed at identifying conditions in individuals, groups, families and communities that justify relevant interventions. Ensure that the appropriate recommendations and interventions required to address the conditions are identified. Ensure the development and planning of programmes to render the recommended interventions efficiently, effectively and economically. Ensure that the recommended interventions are implemented by supervisees by providing continuous support, counselling, guidance and advice to supervisees. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the recommended interventions; Ensure reporting on progress and identify further/amended interventions to address the identified conditions; Study, interpret, apply and give guidance on legislation and policies in the identified work fields to supervisors and other role players/stakeholders. Perform statutory functions that are problematic for supervisees relating to the relevant function, compile court reports and attend to court enquiries and the other tasks emanating from these matters. Ensure that records of social work interventions, processes and outcomes are produced and maintained. Ensure implementation and compliance with all standard operating procedures and sector norms and standards.
jobs.enquiries: Ms S Cummings-Damon @ Shamiela.Cummings- Damon@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Maatskaplikewerktoesighouer
af.summary: Maatskaplikewerktoesighouer-pos by die Department of Social Development in die Western Cape, wat SACSSP-registrasie en sewe jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n 4-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (Graad/Diploma) wat registrasie by SACSSP toelaat; Registrasie en bewys van huidige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike ervaring in maatskaplike werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by die SACSSP. 'n Geldige (Kode B of hoër) bestuurslisensie. NB: Mense met gestremdhede wat bestuursvermoëns beperk, maar wat redelike toegang tot vervoer het, mag ook aansoek doen. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Werkverwante kennis; analitiese en diagnostiese instrumente, assesseringsinstrumente, evalueringsmetodes en -prosesse. Personeelbestuur, Toesighoudingsraamwerk vir Maatskaplike Werkers, en Maatskaplikewerkwetgewing verwant aan kinders. Maatskaplikewerkteorie en -ingrypings; Inligting- en kennissbestuur, protokol, en beroepsetiek Werkverwante vaardighede: Organisering en beplanning; Projekbeplanning; psigososiale ingryping; Kommunikasie en taal (2 amptelike tale van die Western Cape Government); Mensebestuurspraktyke; Interpersoonlik, verslagskryf, rekenaarvaardigheid, aanbieding en fasilitering, probleemoplossing en analitiese, en kliëntoriëntasie en klantefokus.
af.duties: Om te verseker dat 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van die tersaaklike programme gelewer word: Hanteer enige ander aangeleenthede wat tot, of voortspruit uit, sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei. Superviseer werknemers wat by hierdie funksies betrokke is; Dit sou die volgende optrede insluit: Voer assessments, wat problematies vir toesighouers is, uit wat daarop gemik is om toestande in individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe te identifiseer wat tersaaklike ingrypings regverdig. Verseker dat die toepaslike aanbevelings en ingrypings wat nodig is om die toestande aan te spreek, geïdentifiseer word. Verseker die ontwikkeling en beplanning van programme om die aanbevole ingrypies doeltreffend, effektiief en ekonomies te lewer. Verseker dat die aanbevole ingrypings deur toesighouers geïmplementeer word deur deurlopende ondersteuning, berading, leiding en advies aan toesighouers te bied. Monitor en evalueer die effektiwiteit van die aanbevole ingrypings; Verseker verslagdoening oor vordering en identifiseer verdere/gewysigde ingrypings om die geïdentifiseerde toestande aan te spreek; Bestudeer, interpreteer, pas toe en gee leiding oor wetgewing en beleide in die geïdentifiseerde werkvelde aan toesighouers en ander rolspelers/belanghebbendes. Voer statutêre funksies wat problematies vir toesighouers is met betrekking tot die tersaaklike funksie uit, stel hofverslae op en hanteer hofnavrae en die ander take wat uit hierdie aangeleenthede voortspruit. Verseker dat rekords van maatskaplikewerkingreps, prosesse en uitkomste geproduseer en gehandhaaf word. Verseker implementering en nakoming van alle standaardbedryfsprosedures en sektorstandaarde en -norme.

zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wabantu
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi womsebenzi wabantu kumnyango we Social Development e Western Cape, esidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SACSSP kanye neminyaka eyisikhombisa yemfundo ngemuva kokuthola iziqu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphezulu kwesikhombisa zeminyaka yezifundo eziphakeme ku-Social Work (Degree/Diploma) ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SACSSP; Ukubhaliswa kanye nesibonakaliso sokubhalisa okwamanje ne-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). Okungenani ungeminyaka eyi-7 yemfundo ebhekele ohlelweni lomsebenzi wabantu ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wabantu kwi-SACSSP. Ilayisense yokushayela evumelekile (Code B noma okuphezulu). QAPHELA: Abantu abakhubazekile abakwazi ukushayela, kodwa abanendlela etholakalayo yokuhamba, bangafaka futhi izicelo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngakulesi: Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi; amathuluzi okuhlaziya nokuxilanga, amathuluzi okuqinisekisa, izindlela nemicimbe yokuqinisekisa. Izindlela zokuphatha abantu, Ohlelo lokugadza abasebenzi besocial work, kanye nemithetho yomsebenzi wabantu ehlobene nezingane. Inqubo nomthelela wokusebenza kwezomsebenzi wabantu; Ukuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi mayelana nolwazi, iphrothokholi, kanye nemicimbe yezokuziphatha mayelana nomsebenzi Amandla ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela nokuhlela; Ukulungiselela amaphrojekthi; ukungenelela kwe-psychosocial; Ukuxhumana kolimi (olwemiqulu emibili esemthethweni kahulumeni we Western Cape); Izindlela zokuphatha abantu; Ubudlelwano obuhlobene nomuntu, ukubhala imibiko, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukwethula futhi kuqonde, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqhathanisa, kanye nokuqonda iklayenti nokugxila kumthengi.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inkonzo yomsebenzi wabantu mayelana nokunakekelwa, ukusekela, ukuvikela, kanye nentuthuko yabantu, amaqembu, imindeni, kanye namakomakhulu ngokuhamba kwezinhlelo ezihlobene yanikezwa: Ukujobela ezinye izindaba ezingabangela, noma eziveza, ukungalungi kokomphakathi nganoma iyipho indlela. Ukugadza abasebenzi ababambe iqhaza kulemisebenzi; Lokhu kubandakanya izenzo ezilandelayo: Ukwenza ukuxilanga okubhedla abasebenzi abaphansi kwakho, okuhloswe ukuthola izimo kubantu, amaqembu, imindeni kanye namakomakhulu ezisiza izindlela zokungenelela ezihlobene. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindulumiso nezindlela zokungenelela ezidingekayo ukuxazulula lezo zimo zitholwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuhlelwa kwezinhlela ukunikeza izindlela zokungenelela eziphakanyisiwe ngokusebenza ngempumelelo, ngokwenzako, kanye nangokwezimali. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokungenelela eziphakanyisiwe zisetshenziswe abasebenzi abaphansi kwakho ngokunikeza ukwesekwa okuqhubekayo, ukweluleka, ukukhokhela kanye nokuthi inzeluleko abasebenzini abaphansi kwakho. Ukuhlola kanye nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwezindlela zokungenelela eziphakanyisiwe; Ukuqinisekisa ukubika ngokuqhubeka kokuqinisekisa ukuthola izindlela ezingeziwe/ezilungisiwe zokungenelela eze zixazulule lezo zimo; Ukufunda, ukuhumusha, ukusebenzisa kanye nokunikeza inzeluleko ngemithetho kanye nemithethongqangi kumagumbi omsebenzi abekiwe kubaphathi kanye nalabo abathatha iqhaza/kubaxhasi. Ukwenza imisebenzi yesikhungasomthetho ebedla abasebenzi abaphansi kwakho ehlobene nomsebenzi ohlobene, ukulungiselela imibiko yankantolo kanye nokujobela ezinye izindaba zokuphenya ezinkantolo kanye neminye imisebenzi evela kulezindaba. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi okungeniswa komsebenzi wabantu, inqubo, kanye nezempumelelo zenziwe zigcinwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuhambisana nazo zonke izinqubo eziyisisekelo zokusebenza kanye nemitsetzo namazinga waleziqanduqandi.

xh.title: Umphathi Wabasebenzi Bezenhlalakahle
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi Wabasebenzi Bezenhlalakahhe kwisebe leZenkcubeko eNtshona Kolonela, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SACSSP neminyaka yamava emisebenzi yemihla esixhenxe emva kokufumana isidanga.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seminyaka emi-4 samabanga aphakamileyo kwiZenkcubeko (Isidanga/Icwecwe lesidanga) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SACSSP; Ukubhaliswa nobungqina bokubhaliswa ngoku kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). Uncedo lweminyaka eyi-7 yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wezenhlalakahle emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle kwi-SACSSP. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo (i-Code B noma ngaphezulu). QAPHELA: Abantu abanokuphaluka abasetyhenzisa ikhono lokushayela, kodwa abanendlela yokufikelela ezithuthweni, banako nabo ukufaka isicelo. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi elandelayo: Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi; izixhobo zokuhlola kunye nokuxilongo, izixhobo zokulinganisa, iindlela nezinqubo zokuqwalasela. Ukuqondwa kweNdlela yokulawula Abasebenzi, iNquli lokulawula abaSebenzi beZenhlalakahle, kunye nomthetho wezenhlalakahle ohambelana nabantwana. Ithiyori yomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle kunye nokungena phakathi; ulawulo lolwazi nolwazi, iprotocol, kunye nezenzo ezifanelekileyo zomsebenzi Ulwazi Oluhambelana Nomsebenzi: Ukuqamba kunye noqulunqo lweendaba; uqulunqo lweenjongo; ukungena phakathi kwezengqondo nezenkcubeko; Unxibelelwano nolwimi (iilwimi ezisemthethweni ezimbini karhulumente weNtshona Kolone); Iindlela zokulawula abantu; Ubudlelwane obufikelelo phakathi kwabantu, ukubhala iingxelo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, izibonelelo nokuyala, ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela, kunye nokujolisa kumxhasi nokuqwalasela iimfuno zabathengi.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuqulunqwa inkonzo yomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle malunga nokukhathaleka, inkxaso, ikhuselo, nentlculo yabantu, amaqela, osapho, nakumaphakathi abathathwa ngemisebenzi edibene nayo: Ukujoyina kwamanye amacandio anokubangela, okanye okuvela kuyo, inkquzuluko yezentlalo nganoma yimuphi na umthetho. Ukulawula abasebenzi ababandakanyeka kule misebenzi; Oku kuya kubandakanya iintshukumo ezilandelayo: Ukuqwalasela iimeko, ezingela lubonakalise kubalawuli, ezijolise ekuqwalaseleni iimeko kubantu, amaqela, usapho namaphakathi ezibangela ukungena kwezinye iindlela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kubekwa izindululo ezifanelekileyo kunye nokuqwalasela ezifunekayo ukusombulula iimeko ezifunekiweyo. Ukuqinisekisa uphuhliso noqulunqo lweenkqubo ukuze kuqulunqwe iindlela ezindululwayo ngokusebenza kakuhle, ngokuchanekileyo nangokulinganiselekileyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iindlela ezindululwayo ziyasetyenziswa ngabaphathi kubasebenzi ngokunika inkxaso eqhubekayo, ingcebiso, imbuyiselo nencekelo kubaphathi. Ukuqwalasela nokulinganisa ukusebenza kweendlela ezindululwayo; Ukuqinisekisa ingxelo ngakuqhubekayo nokuqwalasela iindlela ezongeziweyo/ezilungisiweyo ukuze kusombululwe iimeko eziqwalaselweyo; Ukufunda, ukutolika, ukusebenzisa nokunika ingcebiso ngomthetho iinkqubo kumaphakathi abhalwe ngawo kubaphathi nabanye abathathi nxaxheba/baphathi. Ukwenza imisebenzi esemthethweni engadinga ukuba sengxaki kubaphathi ngesiseko sedithi, ukuqulunqa iingxelo zasevenkileni nokubakhathalela kwiinkumbuzo zasevenkileni namanye amasebe aphumayo kule mincili. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zibhalwa zigcinwe iirekhodi zenkonzo yomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle, iinkqubo nathi-mvela. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwaye kuhlangatyezwana nazo zonke iinkqubo ezisebenzayo ngemigangatho kwaye ngemigangatho yesebe.

jobs.title: Office Manager: Financial Management
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Office Manager providing secretarial, administrative and budget support to a manager within the Western Cape Department of Social Development.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification National Diploma (B-degree or higher qualification); A minimum of 5 years' relevant experience.
