zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele zangemva kwesikole ezithatha unyaka wama-3; Ukuqanjwa kanye e-SACE njengomfundi oqeqeshiwe; Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yokuhlolambili njengentathelana yemfunda/Um gwixotshi; Isimoto enesivume-nqumo esikhundla seB noma ngaphezulu. OKUBALULEKILE: Abantu abanesisemkhathini abakwazi ukuqondiswa kweminyanisekela yezimoto, ke abatholakala ukutbolaka kofnadvo, bangafataka ngenkathi. ABAHLOLWAYO BESIKHUNDLA: Ukwaziswa okunemayelana: Izinqubo kanye nezinqubo ezimisele; Izinqubo zakahulumeni; Amaghosha okumama nesimama; Uphatlwo lwemayelane; Ukuqondisa imizila; Tehlula futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo. Amakhono okufuneka: Isixazanulo samazinyoni, intolakalo ngokushaywa kwamaholo, ukwakha, ukugqugquzela, ukufundela ngokuthinta abanye kanye nokuphathwa nokubumbana nomphakathi; Ukubhala kanye nokukhuluma ngomlomo; Ukuhlela kanye nokubumbwa; Ukufunda nokuphenya; Ukuxhuman nokulunga amathuba; Ukuzelela nokuphendula kwiinguquko; Ukuzezeke ngokuya ngemigiqelo kanye namanani; Isithathu.
zu.duties: Qalasela Izinhlelo zemfundo Ezikhempheni Ngokuvumelana Nezidingo Zohlelo Lwemfundo Nomthetho Womnyango; Qalasela izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela zasekhayeni ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa okuphephile/ukugcinwa kanye nentuthuko yabahlala (i-MDT, ukubika izenzakalo, okuphathwa ngokuziphatha, izinto ezingagunyaziwe, njll.);enze imisebenzi yengqikithi; Ukuthuthuka Kwebhizinisi Eliqhubekayo: Gcina ukuya phambili nentuthuko ezinkundleni zomsebenzi wokweluleka kwezomphakathi nenzalo yomphakathi.

xh.title: Iofisa zemfundo: Imfundo
xh.summary: Iofisa zemfundo lifunwa yi Western Cape Department of Social Development ukuphumeza iinkqubo zemfundo kwezi zinzelelo, lifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SACE nelifikeshuni yokufundisa.
xh.requirements: Ifikeshuni efanelekileyo yeminyaka emi-3 yangasese kwisikolo; Ukubhaliswa kwi-SACE njengomfundi-ngcali; Okungevo nge-3 yeminyaka yamava njengomfundi-ngcali/ Umfundisi; Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B nangaphezulu) esemthethweni. NB: Abantu abakhubazekileyo abakhawulezisayo amandla okushayela, kodwa abanako kufikelela kalula kwiinkalo zothutho, banako nakube ngenisa izicelo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngalondolwayo: Iinkqubo neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo; Iinkqubo zoluntu lophatho; Iindaba zoluntu-basebenzi; Ulawulo lweziindinganiso; Ulawulo lweenkqubo; Ukutolika nokusebenzisa iinkqubo neenkqubo. Amaxabiso afunekayo: Ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza isicwangciso sendlela yokuhlawulela, ukucwangcisa, ukulawula iingxoxo, ukuchukumisa iintlobo namagama athile, nokukhulumanisa nabantu; Unxibelelwano ngokubhalayo nangokuthethwa; Ukucwangcisa nokuhlela; Ukufunda nokuphandalays; Unxibelelwano nomnini wamava; Ukuzivumela nokuphendula ukutshintsha; Ukuzinika kwiinkqubo nezinto ezizile; Ukuhlalutya.
xh.duties: Phumeza iinkqubo zemfundo kwiZiko ngesi esivumelana neMfuno yeNkqubo yeFundo neMthetho weSebe; Phumeza iinkqubo neenkqubo zesikolo ukuphucula ukhathalo/ukugcina ngokhuseleko nophuhliso lwabahlali (MDT, ukubika iiganeko, ukulawula indlela abaphatha ngayo, izinto ezingagunyaziswanga, njl.); Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo lwebhodi; Ukuphuhlisa kuQqaliselo lwamandla oluPhakamileyo: Gcina kulungelelaniso namava amatsha kwinkalo yomsebenzi wentlalo namava abasemagunyeni.

jobs.title: Chief Registry Clerk: Cape Winelands/ Overberg Logistical
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Supervise registry services, filing, record management and correspondence distribution for the Department of Social Development in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 (Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification); A minimum of 6 years relevant experience. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Registry duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, and operate computer; Legislative framework governing the Public Service; storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment; Skills in the following: Proven computer literacy; Planning and organising; Communication (written and verbal).
jobs.duties: Supervise the following: Supervise and render an effective filing and record management service; the Coordination, Handling, and Distribution of Incoming and Outgoing Correspondence; human resources/staff; the processing and process documents for archiving and/disposal; provide registry counter services.
jobs.enquiries: Ms S Cummings-Damon at Shamiela.Cummings- Damon@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofregisterklerk: Cape Winelands/ Overberg Logisties
af.summary: Hou toesig oor registerdienste, lêerwerk, rekordbestuur en korrespondensieverspreiding vir die Department of Social Development in the Western Cape.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie); 'n Minimum van 6 jaar relevante ervaring. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Registerpligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf; Wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer; berging en ontrekkingsprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing; Vaardighede in die volgende: Bewese rekenaarvaardigheid; Beplanning en organisering; Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings).
af.duties: Hou toesig oor die volgende: Hou toesig oor en lewer 'n doeltreffende lêer- en rekordbestuursdiens; die Koördinering, Hantering en Verspreiding van Inkomende en Uitgaande Korrespondensie; menslike hulpbronne/personeel; die verwerking en proses van dokumente vir argivering en/of beskikking; verskaf registertoonbankdienste.

zu.title: Ikhomishana Elikhulu Le-Rejista: Cape Winelands/ Overberg Logistical
zu.summary: Qapha izinsiza ze-rejista, ukufaka kumafayela, ukuphathwa kwezinkampani kanye nokusatshalaliswa kweekhomishani zomnyango we-Social Development e-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (I-Senior Certificate noma iziqu ezingulinganayo); Okuncane eminyakeni eyi-6 yoluhlu oluhlobene. Izindlela: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Imisebenzi ye-rejista, izindlela kanye nobuhlakani bokungenisa idatha, futhi usebenzise ikhompyutha; Umthetho ohomba abantu basezikhundleni zikahulumeni; izinqubo zokugcina nokuveza idatha ngokwesimo sokusebenza; Amakhono okulandelayo: Ubuhlakani bekhompyutha obuqinisekisiwe; Ukucubungula futhi uhlele; Unxibelelwano (olubhalwe nolwenziwa ngomlomo).
zu.duties: Qapha okulandelayo: Qapha futhi unikeze insiza efanele yokufaka kumafayela nokuqashwa kwezinkampani; ukubambisana, ukuphatha, nokusatshalaliswa kweekhomishani ezingenayo naseziphumayo; abantu/basezikhundleni; ukulungisa futhi uqambe amadokhumenti okugcina noma ukulahla; unikeze insiza yecawundi ye-rejista.

xh.title: ISithluleli Sokuqala Selebhu YokuBhalisa: Cape Winelands/ Overberg Logistical
xh.summary: Qondisa iinkonzo zelebhu yokubhalisa, ukuhlela iifayili, ulawulo lwemiba negabelo lemxholo wesebe leSocial Development eWestern Cape.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 (ISatifikethi SePhakamile okanye isidanga esilinganayo); Isiphelo seminyaka elingama-6 esiphiwo-sebenzi esifanelekileyo. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi ngoku landelayo: Imisebenzi yelebhu yokubhalisa, iinkqubo kunye namandla okungenisa idatha, nokuqhuba ikhompyutha; Umthetho olawula iNkonzo kaRhulumente; iinkqubo zokugcina nokuvelisa imiba ngokwendalo yokusebenza; Amakhono oku landelayo: Isibonakaliso sokuba negunya lokusebenza ngekhompyutha; Ucwangco lweenkqubo; Unxibelelwano (elubhalwe noluthethwayo).
xh.duties: Qondisa oku landelayo: Qondisa kwaye uze unikeze inkonzo efanelekileyo yokuhelela iifayili nolawulo lwemiba; Ulawulo, Ukuphatha, kunye Nogabelo Lwemxholo Olungenayo Noluphumayo; amabele abantu/abasebenzi; ukucutshungula kwaye kucutshungule amaxwebhu okugcina esikhumbuzweni/nokususa; ukunikeza iinkonzo zesika yelebhu yokubhalisa.

jobs.title: Information Management Officer: West Coast Region
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Manage regional information systems and ICT services for the Department of Social Development in the West Coast Region, requiring a relevant degree and one year of experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year B-Degree (equivalent or higher qualification); A minimum of 1-year relevant experience. Competencies: Knowledge and working experience of the following: legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions; information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function; project management; operational management practices; procurement and tendering processes; Knowledge and understanding of policy development, and operational management, monitoring and review processes, modern systems of governance and administration; Knowledge and understanding of public service procedures, processes and systems; the regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape; constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector; public finance, human resources and discourse management processes; the Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements; the functioning of the province and the activities of sister departments/related functional areas; the policies of the government of the day; labour relations legislation and regulations; performance; management and information systems. Skills: Numeracy; Literacy; Driving; Typing; Computer Literacy; Language skills.
jobs.duties: Develop and maintain regional information management systems; Coordinate Information and Communication Technology services; Analyse and present business management information [financial and non-financial data (NFD)]; Identification, implementation and maintenance of knowledge and information management services in the region.

af.title: Inligtingsbestuursbeampte: West Coast Region
af.summary: Bestuur streeksinligtingstelsels en IK-diens vir die Department of Social Development in die West Coast Region, wat 'n toepaslike graad en een jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar B-graad (ekwivalent of hoër kwalifikasie); 'n Minimum van 1-jaar toepaslike ervaring. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en werkervaring van die volgende: wetgewing, regulasie-raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat 'n uitwerking het op die lynfunksies; inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie; projektebestuur; operasionele bestuurspraktyke; verkrygings-en aanbiedingsprosesse; Kennis en begrip van beleidsontwikkeling, en operasionele bestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse, moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie; Kennis en begrip van openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels; die streeks- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape; konstitusionele, regtelike en institusionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer; openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse; die Public Finance Management Act, Nasionale en Provinciale Tesourie-regulasies, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, riglyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste; die funksionering van die provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente/verwante funksionele areas; die beleide van die regering van die dag; arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en -regulasies; prestasie; bestuur en inligtingstelsels. Vaardighede: Geletterdheid met syfers; Skryf- en leesvaardigheid; Bestuur van 'n voertuig; Tikvaardigheid; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Taalvaardighede.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en onderhou streekstelsels vir inligtingsbestuur; Koördineer Inligtings- en Kommunikasietegnologie-diens; Analiseer en bied besigheidsbestuursinligting [finansiële en nie-finansiële data (NFD)]; Identifisering, implementering en instandhouding van kennis- en inligtingsbestuursdienste in die streek.

zu.title: Umphathi Wolwazi: West Coast Region
zu.summary: Phatha izimiso zolwazi zesifundazwe nezinsizakalo ze-ICT ze-Department of Social Development kwi-West Coast Region, kudingeka idigri efanele unyaka oyedwa wesisindo.
zu.requirements: I-B-Degree yeminyaka eyi-3 efanele (izinhlaka ezilinganayo noma eziphezulu); Okungenani unyaka oyedwa wesisindo. Iziqu: Ulwazi nesisindo sokusebenza kwalokhu okulandelayo: umthetho, izinhlelo zolawulo, izinqubomgomo namasu aphezulu ahlobene nemisebenzi yomugqa; izimiso zolwazi ezisiza ekuphatheni ulwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi womugqa; ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; amasu okuphatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke; inqubo yokuthenga nokuqasha; Ulwazi nokuzwa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yansuku zonke, ukulandelela nokubuyekezwa kwezinhlaka, izimiso zanamuhla zokubusa nokuphatha; Ulwazi nokuzwa izinqubo, izinhlelo nezimiso zomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika; izindaba zezepolitiki, ezomnotho n ezomphakathi zasifundazwe nasedolobheni ezithinta hurumente yesifundazwe sase-Western Cape; izinhlelo zomthethosisekelo, zomthetho nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezibusa umkhakha kahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika; izimali zomphakathi, ulwazi lwabantu nokuqondana nokuqondisa izinkulumo; i-Public Finance Management Act, i-National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ezinye izinqubomgomo zezimali, imiyalo, izinkomba nezivumelwano zokuhlanganyela; ukusebenza kwesifundazwe nemisebenzi yeminyango ohlobene nayo/izindawo ezihlobene nomsebenzi; izinqubomgomo kahulumeni waleso sikhathi; umthetho nezinqubo zezibandakanya nomsebenzi; ukwenza ngcono ukusebenza; ukuphathwa nezimiso zolwazi. Amakhono: Ukubala; Ukufunda nokubhala; Ukuqhuba; Ukubhala ngemishini; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Amakhono olimi.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa ulondoloze izimiso zokuphatha ulwazi zesifundazwe; Hlela izinsizakalo ze-Information and Communication Technology; Hlaziya futhi ubuke imininingwane yokuphatha ibhizinisi [imininingwane yezimali nengeyona yezimali (NFD)]; Ukuhlukanisa, ukusebenzisa nokugcina izinsizakalo zokuphatha ulwazi nolwazi esifundazweni.

xh.title: Isikhululi soLawulo lweNkcukacha: West Coast Region
xh.summary: Lawula iinkqubo zolwazi zelali ngenkqubo yamacebo ekhompyutha nakwesebe leNtshutsho nokuPhuhliswa kulawulo le-West Coast Region, kufuneka isidanga esifanelekileyo wze unyaka owodwa wamava.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-B kweminyaka emi-3 esifanelekileyo (okanye izidanga ezizezona okanye eziphezuday); Okungowona mgangatho unyaka oyi-1 wobugcisa obufanelekileyo. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda kwenkqubo yemigaqo; iindlela zokusebenza nezithintelwano zolawulo; imigaqo-nkqubo nemigaqo ehamba phambili ekuthintela kumsebenzi wesebe; iinkqubo zenkcukacha ezingalawula ulwazi nenkcazacha enxulumene nomsebenzi wesebe; ulawulo lweeprojekthi; iindlela zolawulo lomsebenzi; iinkqubo zokuthenga wze zamkele iintengiso; Ulwazi wze uqonde ukuphuhliswa kwemigaqo-nkqubo, ulawulo lomsebenzi, ukuqwalasela wze uhlolwa kwenkqubo, iinkqubo zolawulo zangoku zolawulo noburhulumentha; Ulwazi wze uqonde iinkqubo, iindlela namarhwebo olawulo lwamanyathelo woluntu; iindaba zoluntu, zoqoqosho nentlalo zendawo kwelali nakumapandlela azithintela urhulumente weWestern Cape province; iziqendu zeMgaqo-siseko, zamagazethi wze ezolawulo ezilawula ingququ zoluntu yoMzantsi Afrika; imali yoluntu, amathambo abantu wze iinkqubo zolawulo lenkcazelo; uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, iMigaqo yeQhina leNazhonal neyePhondo, eminye imigaqo yemali, imiyalelo, nemigaqo ekhutshwa ngokuthomalalisana kwentlangano; ukusebenza kwephondo wze imisebenzi yeembeba ezinqamlezileyo; imigaqo-nkqubo karhulumente wethamsanqa; umthetho wamagatya nemigaqo yabasebenzi; ukuphumeza imigaqo-nkqubo yokwenza umsebenzi; ulawulo wze iinkqubo zenkcazelo. Amakhono: Ukubala; ukufunda nokubhala; ukuqhuba; ukuthayipha; ukusebenza ngekhompyutha; amakhono olwimi.
xh.duties: Phuhlisca wze ullondoloza iindidi zolawulo lwenkcukacha zelali; linganisela iinkonzo zeTeknoloji yoluNxibelelwano nenkcazelo; hlalahlwa wze ubonise inkcazelo yolawulo loshishino [i-data yemali engenayo nengayo (NFD)]; ukuziqonda, ukusebenzisa wze ulondoloze iinkonzo zolawulo lwenkcazelo nolwazi kwelali.

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R289 296 - R337 959 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 2: R347 796 - R409 689 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 3: R421 020 - R564 846 per annum, (OSD as prescribed)
jobs.summary: Community Development Practitioner needed in the Western Cape to facilitate integrated community development interventions across three grade levels with varying experience requirements.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (National Diploma/B- Degree or higher); No experience required. Grade 2: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (National Diploma/B-Degree or higher); A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Community Development work after obtaining the required tertiary qualification. Grade 3: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (National Diploma/B-Degree or higher); A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Community Development work after obtaining the required tertiary qualification. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Community development work, skills, attitudes and values of communities; Human behaviour and social systems and legislation to assist with interventions at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote self-empowerment; The ability and competence to co- ordinate community development structures and ability to manage projects; The ability to influence individuals and group to participate in their own self- empowerment ventures; The understanding of social dynamics of communities; Skills needed: Presentation; Proven computer literacy; Written and verbal communication; Facilitation; Research; Knowledge and understanding of basic Financial Management.
jobs.duties: Identify and facilitate the implementation of integrated community development interventions in partnership with the community and other relevant stakeholders; Liaise and co-ordinate with all relevant role players, internal and external and stakeholders (e.g. in departments/provinces, NGOs, local community structures and faith-based organisations) to facilitate collaboration and to establish partnerships to ensure the sustainability of development actions within the community; Support communities and perform administrative support on community development and related activities; Keep up to date with new developments in the community development field to enhance service delivery. Monitor funded organisations' financial compliance to ensure transferred funds are utilised in line with approved activities; Implementation of the approved Community Development Norms and Standards.
jobs.enquiries: Mr L Arnolds Tel No: (021) 483 6657

af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyn: Volhoubaar
af.summary: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyn nodig in die Western Cape om geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies oor drie vlakke te fasiliteer, met uiteenlopende ervaringvereistes.
af.requirements: Vlak 1: 'n Geskikte 3-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma/B-Graden of hoër); Geen ervaring word vereis nie. Vlak 2: 'n Geskikte 3-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma/B-Graden of hoër); 'n Minimum van 10 jaar geskikte ervaring in Gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk na verkryging van die vereiste tersiêre kwalifikasie. Vlak 3: 'n Geskikte 3-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma/B-Graden of hoër); 'n Minimum van 20 jaar geskikte ervaring in Gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk na verkryging van die vereiste tersiêre kwalifikasie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk, vaardighede, gesindhede en waardes van gemeenskappe; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en wetgewing om behulpsaam te wees met intervensies by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings wisselwerk ten einde selfbemagtiging te bevorder; Die vermoë en bevoegdheid om gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstrukture te koördineer en die vermoë om projekte te bestuur; Die vermoë om individue en groepe te beïnvloed om aan hul eie selfbemagtigingsondernemings deel te neem; Die begrip van sosiale dinamika van gemeenskappe; Vereiste vaardighede: Voorlegging; Bewese rekenaarvaardigheid; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Fasilitering; Navorsing; Kennis en begrip van basiese Finansiële Bestuur.
af.duties: Identifiseer en fasiliteer die implementering van geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in samewerking met die gemeenskap en ander tersaaklike belanghebbendes; Skakel en koördineer met alle tersaaklike rolspelers, interne en eksterne rolspelers en belanghebbendes (bv. in departemente/provinsies, NRO's, plaaslike gemeenskapsstrukture en geloofsgesinde organisasies) om samewerking te fasiliteer en vennootskappe te vestig om die volhoubaarheid van ontwikkelingsaksies binne die gemeenskap te verseker; Ondersteun gemeenskappe en verrig administratiewe ondersteuning rondom gemeenskapsontwikkeling en verwante aktiwiteite; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelinge in die gemeenskapsontwikkelingsveld om dienslewering te verbeter. Monitor gefinansierde organisasies se finansiële nakoming om te verseker dat oorgedraagde fondse in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde aktiwiteite gebruik word; Implementering van die goedgekeurde Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnorme en -standaarde.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wokuthuthukiswa Kwemiphakathi: Okuzinzileyo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi eWestern Cape ukuba ahole ekwenzeni imizamo yokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi ehlangene kumazinga amathathu ahlukeneko ngezidingo ezingezinye zokuhlakanipha.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Iziqu ezifanelekileko zonyaka we-3 zemfundo ephakeme (National Diploma/B-Degree noma ngaphezulu); Akukho hlakanipho okudingekako. Izinga 2: Iziqu ezifanelekileko zonyaka we-3 zemfundo ephakeme (National Diploma/B-Degree noma ngaphezulu); Okunciniso eminyakeni eyi-10 yokuhlakanipha okufanelekileko emsebenzini Wokuthuthukiswa Kwemiphakathi ngemva kokuthola iziqu ezingezimfundo ephakeme ezingezidingo. Izinga 3: Iziqu ezifanelekileko zonyaka we-3 zemfundo ephakeme (National Diploma/B-Degree noma ngaphezulu); Okunciniso eminyakeni eyi-20 yokuhlakanipha okufanelekileko emsebenzini Wokuthuthukiswa Kwemiphakathi ngemva kokuthola iziqu ezingezimfundo ephakeme ezingezidingo. Ukugondelela: Ulwazi ngokuqondene nalokhu: Umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi, amakhono, izimilo namagugu womphakathi; Ukuziphatha kwabantu kanye namasistimu wokuhlangana nemithetho ukuba nasize emizamweni emaphuzu lapho abantu bahlangana khona namaphasi wabo ukukhuthaza ukuzikhulisa; Ikono namandla okuhlanganisa amasu okuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi kanye namandla okuphatha imiklamo; Amandla okukhuthaza abantu nabantu abambisene ukuba babambe inxaxheba kumizamo yabo yokuzikhulisa; Ukuqonda isimo sokuhamba kwesikhathi somphakathi; Amakhono okudinga: Okokuzethula; Ukubhala nokukhuluma ngokwekhompyutha; Ukubhala nokuthintana ngokwezwi; Ukulekela; Ukuphanda; Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezimali Eziyisisekelo.
zu.duties: Thola ukuze uhole ekwenzeni imizamo yokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi ehlangene ngokubambisana nomphakathi kanye nabanye abahlanganyelako; Thintana ukuze uhlanganise nawo onke abadlali abafanelekileko, ngaphakathi nakaphandle kanye nabahlanganyelako (oknj. emanyango/iimphondo, i-NGO, izisu zomphakathi wendawo kanye namahlelo asekukholweni) ukukhuthaza ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze umiswe iinhlangano zokubambisana ukukhombisa ukuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi ngaphakathi komphakathi; Sekela imiphakathi ukuze uyenze inkokhelo yokwesekela emsebenzini wokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi nakuminye imisebenzi ehlobene; Gcina ulwazi olutsha ngemikhakha yokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi ukukhuphula ukukhonza. Lilolulele ukuhambisana kwemali kwezinhlangano ezixhaswayo ukukhombisa imali ethunyelweko isetshenziswa njengemisebenzi emukelweko; Ukwenza imithetho nemigomo Yokuthuthukiswa Kwemiphakathi emukelweko.

xh.title: Umpracthoni woPhuhliso lweZithili: Eziqhubekayo
xh.summary: Kufuneka iPracthoni yoPhuhliso lweZithili kwi-Western Cape ukuyalela iingenelelo zoPhuhliso lweZithili ezidityanisiweyo kumazinga amathathu ebanga aneemfuno ezahlukeneyo zomzinga wamava.
xh.requirements: Ibanga 1: Isifundo esifanelekileyo seminyaka emi-3 sesidanga seyunivesithi (National Diploma/B-Degree okanye ngaphezulu); Akukho mava ofunekayo. Ibanga 2: Isifundo esifanelekileyo seminyaka emi-3 sesidanga seyunivesithi (National Diploma/B-Degree okanye ngaphezulu); Ubumfihlo beminyaka eli-10 bomva oqeqeshiweyo kulwazi lomsebenzi woPhuhliso lweZithili emva koku fumana isidanga esifunekayo sesidanga seyunivesithi. Ibanga 3: Isifundo esifanelekileyo seminyaka emi-3 sesidanga seyunivesithi (National Diploma/B-Degree okanye ngaphezulu); Ubumfihlo beminyaka eli-20 bomva oqeqeshiweyo kulwazi lomsebenzi woPhuhliso lweZithili emva koku fumana isidanga esifunekayo sesidanga seyunivesithi. Ikhompetensi: Ulwazi ngoku lathe ngayo: Umsebenzi woPhuhliso lweZithili, amakhono, imiqondo namaxabiso amaqela abantu; Ukuziphatha kwabantu kunye nezithinteli zentlalo nemithetho yokuncedisa ngeengenelelo kumaphakathi apho abantu banxibelela nemibeke yabo ukuze bakhuthaze ukuzenzela amandla; Isakhono nakhono lokuhlanganisa iinkqubo zoPhuhliso lweZithili nako kukwazi ukulawula iiprojekthi; Isakhono sokuba nempembelelo kwabantu nabuntu bangene kwamashishini abo okuzenzela amandla; Ukuqonda ngokujikeleza kweentlalo kumaqela abantu; Amaxhala afunekayo: Okubhiyozelwayo; Isifundo sekhompyutha esiqinisekisiweyo; Unxibelelwano ngokubhalwa nangokuthethwa; Ukuyalela; Uphononongo; Ulwazi nokuqonda kweziNgqalwa zokuLawula imali.
xh.duties: Kubonwe kwaye kuyalelwe ukusetyenziswa kweengenelelo zoPhuhliso lweZithili ezidityanisiweyo ngokusebenzisana nomzi kunye nabo babelana ngamagugu abo; Kuboniswe kwaye kuhanjiswe ngokuhambelana nabo bonke abadlali indima abafanelekileyo, bangaphakathi nangaphandle nabo babelana ngamagugu (umz. kumasebe/iiprovinsi, i-Ngo, iinkqubo zoMzi kunye neentlangano ezingokukholwa) ukuze kuhanjiselwe ngokusebenzisana kwaye kuqalwe ngokusebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusinika kolwazi lwenzo kunyaka wolwazi olumzi; Kunikezelwe amaqela abantu kwaye kwenziwe inkxaso yolawulo kuPhuhliso lweZithili naku msebenzi ohambelanayo naye; Kugcinwe ulwazi olutsha malunga noPhuhliso lweZithili ukuze kwandisekhono lokubonelela ngemibuzo. Kujongwe uvuyo lweentlangano ezixhaswayo kumthetho wemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba imali edluliselwe isetyenziswa ngokwemisebenzi emisiweyo; Kusetyenziswa iNkqubo yamagugu aMisiweyo noPhuhliso lweZithili.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Admin Support
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Administration clerk providing clerical support services including data capture, record management and routine enquiries at the Western Cape Department of Social Development.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification). Competencies: Good understanding of the following: Clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics; Legislative framework governing the Public Service; Working procedures in terms of the working environment. Skills needed: Written and verbal communication; Literacy; Numeracy; Presentation; Decision –making; Computer literacy; Interpersonal; Flexibility; Planning and organising.

Provide personnel administration clerical support services within the component; Maintain a leave register for the component; Keep and maintain personnel records in the component; Keep and maintain the attendance register of the component; Arrange travelling and accommodation. Provide financial administration support services in the component; Capture and update expenditure in component; Check correctness of subsistence and travel claims of officials and submit to manager for approval; Handle telephone accounts and petty cash for the component.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Administratiewe Ondersteuning
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk wat klerklike ondersteuningsdienste verskaf, insluitend datavaslegging, rekordbestuur en roetine-navrae by die Western Cape Department of Social Development.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat of ekwivalente kwalifikasie). Bevoegdhede: Goeie begrip van die volgende: Klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel; Wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer; Werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Vaardighede benodig: Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Geletterdheid; Syfergeletterdheid; Voorlegging; Besluitneming; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Interpersoonlik; Buigsaamheid; Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Verleen algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste: Rekord hou, organiseer, berg, vaslê en onttrek korrespondensie en data (lynfunksie); Werk registers en statistieke by; Hanteer roetine-navrae; Maak fotostatiese kopieë en ontvang of stuur faksimiles; Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis; Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent; Tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis; Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent; Verskaf voorsieningsketting-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent; Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes in verband met die verkryging van goedere en dienste; Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaard kantoorartikels; Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie; Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent (distrikskantore). Verskaf personeeladministrasie-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent; Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent; Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent; Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent; Reël reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent; Leg uitgawes vas en werk dit by in die komponent; Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaans- en reisaansoeke van amptenare en dien dit by bestuurder vir goedkeuring in; Hanteer telefoonrekeninge en klein kontant vir die komponent.

zu.title: Iklerki Okuphathwa ngokwabahlinzeki: Ukusekelwa Ngokuphathwa Kwemisebenzi
zu.summary: Iklerki okuphathwa ngokwabahlinzeki okunikeza izinsiza zokusekella emisebenzini yamakherikhali okuhlanganisa ukugcina ulwazi, ukuphathwa kwezinkumbulo kanye nemibuzo evamile eWestern Cape Department of Social Development.
zu.requirements: Iredeyidi 12 (Isitifikedi sePhezulu noma izifundo ezifanayo). Ikhomphethensi: Ukuqonda okuhle okulandelayo: Imisebenzi yamakherikhali, izinqubo kanye nethuba lokugcina ulwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibalo; Uhlelo lwemithetho oluphatha Inkonzo Yomphakathi; Izinqubo zokusebenza ngokohlelo lwendawo yokusebenza. Izikhali ezingeduva: Ukuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nangokukhulunwayo; Ukubala nokubhala; Ukubala izibalo; Okubekiwe; Ukwenza izinqumo; Ukubala ngokwekhompyutha; Ubudlelwano nabantu; Ukuguquguquka; Ukuhlela nokuhlelela.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza zokusekela emisebenzini yamakherikhali: Qopha, hlela, gcina, thatha futhi ulandelele imibhalo yolwazi emisebenzini ohamba ngqo; Buyekeza imibhalo nezibalo; Phathisela imibuzo evamile; Yenza amakophi wokwenziwa kabusha uthathe noma uthumele amafeksi; Sula imibhalo/amaphakheji kubaphathi abahlukahlukene njengokudingekayo; Gcina futhi ulondoloze uhlelo lokulondolozwa kwamafayela endawo yokusebenza; Bhala amagama nezinye imibhalo uma kudingeka; Gcina futhi ulondoloze umbhalo wemibhalo eingena naphumayo endaweni yokusebenza; Nikeza izinsiza zokusekela ngohlelo lwesikwama endaweni yokusebenza; Xhumana nabaphathi bangaphakathi nangaphandle maqondana nokuthenga impahla kanye nezinsiza; Thola izikotelwa, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izimpahla zohlelo lwezinhlela zesikhungo; Ukulawula isitoko samawadi esikhungweni; Gcina futhi ulondoloze umbhalo wempahla endaweni yokusebenza (izinhlelo zikadistrikhi). Nikeza izinsiza zokusekela ngokuphathwa kubantu endaweni yokusebenza; Londoloza umbhalo weholo endaweni yokusebenza; Gcina futhi ulondoloze izinkumbulo zabantu endaweni yokusebenza; Gcina futhi ulondoloze umbhalo wobungkungco endaweni yokusebenza; Hlela ukuhamba nokuhlala. Nikeza izinsiza zokusekela ngokuphathwa kwezimali endaweni yokusebenza; Qopha futhi buyekeza okushiswa emalini endaweni yokusebenza; Hlola ukulunga kwezikhalazo zokuhamba nabahamba bezimali zabasebenzi bese uzithumela kumanaja ukuze avume; Phathisela ama-akhawunti efoni nezimali ezincane endaweni yokusebenza.

xh.title: Usihlalo Wezolawulo: Uluxhaso Lolawulo
xh.summary: Unobhalo wolawulo obonelela ngeenkonzo zoluxhaso olubandakanya ukubhala idatha kwiikhompyutha, ulawulo lweekhadi ezibhalwe ngamanani nemibuzo eqhelekileyo kwi-Western Cape Department of Social Development.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abe no-Grede 12 (Izatiyifika yomatikile okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo). Ikhompetensi: Kuqondwa kakuhle oku kulandelayo: Imisebenzi yabasebenzi, iinkqubo nakanjalo nako kukwazi ukubhala idatha kwiikhompyutha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhluza iisitisti; Inkqubo yomthetho elawula inkonzo zikarhulumente; Iinkqubo zokusebenza ngokommandla wokusingathwa kwemisebenzi. af.title: Registerklerk: Logistieke Dienste
af.summary: Registerklerk benodig om lêerwerk, korrespondensie en elektroniese rekords vir die Department of Social Development in die Western Cape te bestuur.

Vaardighede in die volgende: Geletterdheidsvaardighede in wiskunde; Geletterdheidsvaardighede; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Beplanning en organisasie; Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Rekordbestuur / ECM-stelsel; Skandering en hantering van elektroniese dokumente; Aandag aan detail by die vaslegging en lêerwerk van rekords; Vermoë om 'n elektroniese rekordbestuurs- / ECM-stelsel te bedien.
af.duties: Verskaf registertoonbankdienste; Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie; Lewer 'n doeltreffende lêer- en rekordbestuursdiens; Bedien kantoor masjiene met betrekking tot die registerfunksie; Verwerk dokumente vir argivering en/of vernietiging.

zu.title: Iklekhi Lebhalansi: Isevisi Yezokuhamba Zempahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklekhi lebhalansi ukuphatha ukufaka emafayelini, ukuxhumana, kanye nerekhodi lekhompyutha eMnyangeni Wezentuthuko Yomphakathi eWestern Cape.

jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R200 691 – R227 145 per annum, (as prescribed by OSD) Grade 2: R236 385 – R269 742 per annum, (as prescribed by OSD) Grade 3: R280 809 – R353 016 per annum, (as prescribed by OSD)
jobs.summary: Social auxiliary worker needed in the Western Cape to support social workers in providing care, protection and development services to vulnerable individuals, families and communities.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Grade 10 plus completion of the learnership to allow registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Social Auxiliary Worker; Registration with the SACSSP as Social Auxiliary Worker. af.summary: Maatskaplike auxiliairwerker word benodig in die Western Cape om maatskaplike werkers te ondersteun in die verskaffing van sorg-, beskermings- en ontwikkelingsdienste aan kwesbare individue, gesinne en gemeenskappe.

Bevoegdhede: Kennis en basiese begrip van die volgende: Menslike gedrag, verhoudingstelsel en maatskaplike kwessies; Suid-Afrikaanse maatskaplike welsynskonteks: die beleid en praktyk van ontwikkelingsgerigte maatskaplike welsynsdienste; Suid-Afrikaanse regstelsel en die wetgewing wat maatskaplike auxiliairwerk regeer en beïnvloed; Basiese kennis van finansiële aangeleenthede verbonde aan maatskaplike auxiliairwerk; Gebruik toepaslike hulpbronne in dienslewering aan kliëntstelsels; Implementeer toepaslike maatskaplike auxiliairwerkmetodes en -tegnieke om die maatskaplike behoeftes van kliëntstelsels aan te spreek; Inligting- en Kennisbestuur (Hou noukeurige rekords en stel akkurate verslae oor maatskaplike behoeftes en maatskaplike auxiliairwerkaktiwiteite op en lê dit toepaslik weg; Protokol en professionele etiek.
af.duties: Verskaf bystand en steun aan maatskaplike werkers met die lewer van 'n maatskaplike werkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die tersaaklike departementele programme. Help maatskaplike werkers om enige ander aangeleenthede by te woon wat tot, of voortspruit uit, maatskaplike onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei; Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling; verrig administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies ter ondersteuning van maatskaplike werkers soos vereis deur die werk.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Womphakathi Oyikhulu: Metro North
zu.summary: Kudingwa umsebenzi ohlukile womphakathi eWestern Cape ukweseka abasebenzi bomphakatha ukuxhasa ukunakekelwa, ukuvikela kanye nentuthuko yabantu ababuthathaka, osaphaya, namaphandle.
zu.requirements: Ireji 1: Ikhredithi yesikhombi sekhaya kunomyalelo kokuqedela isikole kulesi silabo sokuvula ukubhalisa kwiNkundla yeNingizimu Afrika yabasebenzi baseZenzekweni seHlelo (SACSSP) njengenkokheli bomphakathi; Ukubhalisa kwi-SACSSP njengenkokheli bomphakathi. Amakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda okuyisisekelo okulandelayo: Ukuziphatha kabantu, indlela yemishado kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi; Isimo sobuhlakani bomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika: umthetho kanye nokuphoqa kwemisebenzi yokuziphendula ngomphakathi; Isimo somthetho saseNingizimu Afrika nomthetho okuvuna kanye nokuqondakaliswa kwemisebenzi ehlukene zomphakathi; Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemali ehlobene nomsebenzi ohlukile womphakathi; Ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo enhle ekunikela ngenkonzo kumaphathe okuhlakaliswa; Ukusetshenziswa kwendlela ezinhle zomsebenzi ohlukile nomthetho wokuqeda izidingo zomphakathi womphathe; Ukuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi (Gcina imibhalo eqinile futhi uhlole imibhalo eqinile ngezidingo zomphakathi kanye nemisebenzi yomphakathi futhi uyifake endaweni efisha; Imithetho nezinhlelo zomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesize nesekela abasebenzi bomphakathi ngokunikela ngomphakathi wokusebenza ngokuhlobene nokunakekela, ukusekela, ukuvikela, kanye nentuthuko yabantu, amaqembu, osaphaya, namaphandle ahambisana namaphrogramu ohlelo. Siza abasebenzi bomphakathi ukuba bagcine ukwenzela noma yikuphi okunye okungadala, noma okuvela, ekuhlakazeni komphakathi nganoma isiphi isimo; Intuthuko yobungcweti ephila; wenza imisebenzi yokweseka imibhalo ngokweseka abasebenzi bomphakathi njengoko kudingwa umsebenzi.

xh.summary: Kufuneka umsebenzi womncedi wendalo kwi-Western Cape ukuze axhase abasebenzi bendalo ekunikezeleni ngemisebenzi yonakele, yokhuselo nentlalo kwimithwalo yabantu, iintsapho nangokwiiyuniti zamanani.
xh.requirements: Grade 1: Grade 10 plus ukugqiba kwesiseko sezenzo ukuze kubhalise kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi womncedi wezendalo; Ukubhalisa kwi-SACSSP njengomsebenzi womncedi wezendalo. Amandla: Ulwazi nakuqonda okusesiseko okulandelayo: Ukuziphatha kwabantu, indlela yonxibelelwano nengxaki zentlalo; Imeko yentlalo eMzantsi Afrika: umgaqo-nkqubo nensenzo yemisebenzi yentlalo ekutheni kuphuhliseke; Indlela yomthetho waseMzantsi Afrika namagatya elawula kwaye anomphumela kumsebenzi womncedi wezendalo; Ulwazi olusesiseko ngemibandela yemali exhoke kumsebenzi womncedi wezendalo; Ukusebenzisa izibonelelo ezifanelekileyo ekunikezeleni ngemisebenzi kwimimiselo yamaxhoba; Ukusebenzisa iindlela nezicwangciso ezifanelekileyo zomsebenzi womncedi wezendalo ukubhekana nezidingo zentlalo zemimiselo yamaxhoba; Ulwazi lolwazi nolawulo (Gcina irekhodi ngokuchanekileyo kwaye udibenjule iingxelo ezichanekileyo ngemfuno yentlalo nangeenkalo zomsebenzi womncedi wezendalo kwaye uzihlele ngokufanelekileyo; Iprotoxhelo namandla obuchwepheshe obungcali.

jobs.title: Director: Freight and Logistics
jobs.centre: Western Cape Mobility Department, Western Cape Government.
jobs.summary: Director position leading freight and logistics policy, strategy and legislative development for the Western Cape Mobility Department.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Freight, Transport, Logistics, or related field as recognised by SAQA. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership; Project and Programme Management; Change Management; People Management and Empowerment; Financial Management.
jobs.duties: Develop provincial legislation, policies, strategies and plans for freight rail, maritime and ports, road freight, intermodal facilities, and aviation and pipelines in conjunction with the Directorate Transport Policy and Strategy. Develop frameworks, guidelines, norms and standards for multi-modal freight planning and operations. Conduct technical studies, feasibility assessments, research, business cases, and business plans across freight modes. Assess the impact of freight-related legislation, policies, strategies, programmes, and projects. Facilitate and improve freight services in the Western Cape, across multiple transport modes through the implementation of key strategic documents, including the Provincial Freight Strategy, Freight Implementation Programme (FIP), and Provincial Land Transport Framework (PLTF), the Freight Rail Revitalisation Framework (FRRF); Manage freight data and ensure the development of freight information systems, digital alignment and integration across all freight modes through platforms such as the Western Cape Freight Demand Model, Freight Management System and Integrated Transport Hub. Manage information (data and knowledge) by applying tools and technologies to inform decision-making in government operations; produce reports; enhance service delivery; support transparency; support integration/collaboration across departments and spheres of government. Represent the Province in high-level engagements with public and private freight stakeholders, promoting coordination and investment in freight systems across all modes. Ensure engagement and collaboration with industry stakeholders, public and private sector entities to coordinate, develop, and implement freight system improvements across modes. Align freight projects with the province’s spatial, economic, and social development goals. Financial and People Management.

af.title: Direkteur: Vrag en Logistiek
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat vrag- en logistiekbeleid, -strategie en -wetgewingontwikkeling vir die Western Cape Mobility Department lei.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in Vrag, Vervoer, Logistiek, of 'n verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; Projekte- en programbestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Personeelsbestuur en bemagtiging; Finansiële bestuur.
af.duties: Ontwikkel provinsiale wetgewing, beleid, strategieë en planne vir vrugtespoorweg, maritieme en hawens, padvrag, intermodale fasiliteite, en lugvaart en pyplyne in samewerking met die Direktoraat Vervoerbeleid en -strategie. Ontwikkel raamwerke, riglyne, norme en standaarde vir multimodale vragbeplanning en -bedrywe. Voer tegniese studies, haalbaarheids评估erings, navorsing, besigheidsgevalle en besigheidsplanne oor vragmodi uit. Evaluer die impak van vragverwante wetgewing, beleid, strategieë, programme en projekte. Fasiliteer en verbeter vragdienste in die Western Cape, oor veelvuldige vervoermodi heen, deur die implementering van sleutel strategiese dokumente, insluitend die Provincial Freight Strategy, Freight Implementation Programme (FIP), en Provincial Land Transport Framework (PLTF), die Freight Rail Revitalisation Framework (FRRF); Bestuur vragdata en verseker die ontwikkeling van vraginligtingstelsels, digitale belyning en integrasie oor alle vragmodi heen deur platforms soos die Western Cape Freight Demand Model, Freight Management System en Integrated Transport Hub. Bestuur inligting (data en kennis) deur die toepassing van nutsprogramme en tegnologieë om besluitneming in regeringsbedrywe in te lig; vervaardig verslae; verbeter dienslewering; ondersteun deursigtigheid; ondersteun integrasie/samewerking oor departemente en regeringsfere heen. Verteenwoordig die Provinsie in hoëvlak-engagements met openbare en private vragbelanghebbendes, en bevorder koördinasie en investering in vragstelsels oor alle modi heen. Verseker betrokkenheid en samewerking met bedryfsbelanghebbendes, openbare en private sektor-entiteite om vragstelselverbeterings oor modi heen te koördineer, te ontwikkel en te implementeer. Belyn vragprojekte met die provinsie se ruimtelike, ekonomiese en sosiale ontwikkelingsdoelwitte. Finansiële en Personeelsbestuur.

Amandla: Ikhono lesevisi nokuba nguMholi; Ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi namaphroghramu; Ukuphathwa kwentshintsho; Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokunika amandla; Ukuphathwa kwezimali.
zu.duties: Lembula umthetho wesifundazwe, izinqubomgomo, izindlela namaphulani efreyithi yohlelo lwesitimela, lolwandle namasonto, ireyithi yezimoto, izindawo zokuhlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zokuhamba, kanye nendiza namayizi anamafutha kanye ne-Directorate Transport Policy and Strategy. Lembula izakhiwo, imihlahlandlela, amanani namazinga okuhlela futhi uphathe ireyithi ehlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zokuhamba. Yenza izifundo zobuchwepheshe, ukuhlola ukuzenzakalela, ucwaningo, amacala ebhizinisi, namaphulani ebhizinisi kuzo zonke izinhlobo zefreyithi. Hlola umthelela womthetho, izinqubomgomo, izindlela, amaphroghramu, namaphrojekthi ehlanyelwe ireyithi. Siza futhi uthuthukise izinsiza zefreyithi e-Western Cape, kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuhamba ngokusebenzisa amadokhumenti asemqoka evisi, okuhlanganisa i-Provincial Freight Strategy, Freight Implementation Programme (FIP), kanye ne-Provincial Land Transport Framework (PLTF), i-Freight Rail Revitalisation Framework (FRRF); Phatha idatha yefreyithi futhi qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zolwazi lwefreyithi, ukuqondaniswa okwedijithali nokuhlanganiswa kuzo zonke izinhlobo zefreyithi ngokusebenzisa izinkundla ezifana ne-Western Cape Freight Demand Model, Freight Management System kanye ne-Integrated Transport Hub. Phatha ulwazi (idatha nolwazi) ngokusebenzisa amathuluzi nobuchwepheshe ukwazisa ukuthathwa kwezinqumo emsebenzini kahulumeni; lulungelelanise imibiko; uthuthukise ukulethwa kwezinsiza; useke ukubonakala; useke ukuhlanganiswa/ukusebenzisana phakathi kweminyango nasemazingeni ahlukene kahulumeni. Mela isifundazwe ekubambisweni nabalawuli abaphakeme bafreyithi blikahulumene nabangingaphandle, ukukhuthaza ukuqondana nokutshalwa kwezimali kuzinhlelo zefreyithi kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuhamba. Qinisekisa ukubambisana nokusebenzisana nabandabanda bebizinisi, izinhlangano zabahulumene nasezinkantolo zabantu bomphakathi ukuze uhlole, uthuthukise, futhi uphule izinhlelo zefreyithi kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuhamba. Qondanisa amaphrojekthi efreyithi namaphuzu esifundazwe okuthuthukiswa kwendawo, ezomnotho, nezenhlalo. Ukuphathwa kwezimali nokuPhathwa kwabantu.

xh.title: Umongameli: IFreight and Logistics
xh.summary: Isithuba somongameli esikhokela inkqubo yamagunya, iindle kunye nokuthuthukwa kwemithetho ye-freight and logistics kwisebe le-Western Cape Mobility Department.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zasekwinqanaba elingaphantsi (NQF level 7) kwi-Freight, Transport, Logistics, okanye elinye icandelo elicofiweyo njengoko lavunywa yi-SAQA. 5 iminyaka yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi eliphezulu okanye eliphakamileyo lolawulo. Ikhono: Ikhono eliqhelayo nokuba ngumahluleli; Ulawulo lweziprojekthi nezenzo; Ulawulo lentshintsho; Ulawulo labantu nokunika amandla; Ulawulo lwezemali.
xh.duties: Phucula imithetho yephondo, iinkqubo zamagunya, iindle kunye neecandelo ze-freight rail, maritime and ports, road freight, intermodal facilities, kunye ne-aviation and pipelines ngokusebenzisana ne-Directorate Transport Policy and Strategy. Phucula iinkqubo, iindlela ezalathwayo, iindlela ezisemthethweni nezisamthethweni zokucinga nokusebenza kwe-multi-modal freight. Yenza uphononongo oluchazwe ngobuchwepheshe, ukulinganisa ukwenzeka kwezinto, uphando, iimeko zoshishino, neecandelo zoshishino kwizinto ezahlulahlulayo ze-freight. Linganisa umphumo wemithetho, iinkqubo zamagunya, iindle, iinkqubo, neziprojekthi ezinxulumene ne-freight. Khokelisa ukuba ngcono iinkonzo ze-freight kw-Western Cape, kwizithethi eziningi zothutho ngokusebenzisa amaxwebhu abalulekileyo aneendlela, aquka i-Provincial Freight Strategy, Freight Implementation Programme (FIP), kunye ne-Provincial Land Transport Framework (PLTF), i-Freight Rail Revitalisation Framework (FRRF); Lawula iingcombolo ze-freight uze uqinisekise ukuphuculwa kweekompyutha zeengcombolo ze-freight, ulungelelaniso ngokwedijithali nokudibana kwazo kwazonke izithethi ze-freight ngamaplatifom anjengoba yi-Western Cape Freight Demand Model, Freight Management System kunye ne-Integrated Transport Hub. Lawula ulwazi (iingcombolo nolwazi) ngokusebenzisa izixhobo nobugcisa bokwazisa okuthathwayo kwigqitha lakarhulumente ekusebenzeni; vhumba iingxelo; zenze ngcono ukunikwa kweenkonzo; ixhase ukubonakala; ixhase ukudibana/ngokusebenzisana kumaphephandla nabakarhulumente. Mela iPhondo kwimibono ephezulu ngokusebenzisana nabantu abanomdla kwi-freight kummandla wolumke nabasembini, ngokukhuthaza ulungelelaniso nokutyyiswa kumdlalo kwiinkqubo ze-freight kuwo wonke amacandelo. Qinisekisa ukubakho kolwaziso nokusebenzisana nabantu abanomdla kushishino, kumacandelo obulumke nabasembini ukulungelelanisa, ukuphucula, nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ze-freight eziphuculwayo kwamacandelo. Linganisa iiprojekthi ze-freight neengoqo ezimalunga nendawo, ezoqoqosho, nezentlalo zephondo. Ulawulo lweemali nokuLawula Abantu.

xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yokuthenga nokunikezela kwisebe; Qinisekisa ukugcina idatha ngokusebenzayo nangokufanelekileyo kwinkqubo yokuthenga; Nikezela ngenkululeko yabasebenzi nanemisebenzi yoncedo lwezibalo ngaphakathi kwelungu; Ulawula izinto ezisetyenziswa nazo ezisalayo.
